Both girls were genuinely abuzz with joy and delight.
Seeing smiles more radiant than flowers in Planting Season, the clouds in Lide’s heart were swept away.
He stepped forward, reaching out to ruffle Isa’s head, and the little girl nuzzled his hand like a kitten, showing immense docility.
Lifting his gaze, he smiled at Vina’s envious expression and pinched her delicate, perfect cheek, filling Vina’s eyes with satisfaction.
“Isa, today your teacher needs to do something, but for this task, I need the help of my little princess…”
Upon hearing this, Isa’s eyes instantly brightened; being able to help Lide was a pleasant surprise for the girl.
“Teacher, I’m willing~” Although she had yet to hear what it was, Isa immediately agreed, her beautiful eyes squeezing into crescents.
In the girl’s heart, Lide was the most trustworthy person in the world, without equal.
She was even willing to give her life for him.
Lide nodded, his tone becoming somewhat solemn.
“I need Isa’s blood…”
Blood? The word startled both of them.
In Glory, anything associated with blood was linked to evil.
Vampires, Demons, Evil God sacrifices, and so on.
Unexpectedly, neither Vina nor Isa asked questions; both girls just looked at him with trusting eyes.
There was a trust in their gaze that outsiders could hardly imagine; to them, this didn’t seem to be a matter of great consequence.
“Teacher~ here,” Isa timidly offered her snow-white wrist to Lide, her eyes filled with heartfelt joy.
Isa could finally be of help to her teacher.
Looking at their gazes, warmth filled Lide’s heart.
It was hard for others to imagine the feeling that such unconditional trust brought.
His lips curled into a high arc.
“Your teacher won’t let you down.”

chapters.title: Chapter 174: 175: I Have a Golden Race Juvenile...
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 175: I Have a Golden Race Juvenile…
“Viscount Bernard, I need the blood of the Golden Race. Please, you must help me,”
Grot knelt on one knee before Viscount Bernard, this Northern Warrior who dared to charge into tenfold and hundredfold enemies was now utterly humble.
For the future of the North, the warrior who would never bend even when pierced by a heavy sword, lowered his proud head time and time again.
Viscount Bernard gave his Guard Commander a deep look and shook his head.
“Grot, you should know what kind of existence the Golden Race is. If you could have the ability to hunt an Extraordinary Level giant dragon, I might be able to tell you about a Fire Element Giant Dragon.
But now, you cannot even defeat me…
...
I can’t help you.”
Grot opened his mouth as if to say something, but then he sighed in despair.
An Extraordinary Level giant dragon…
It wasn’t that he lacked the courage to face a giant dragon, but he didn’t have the strength to defeat one.
Though fearless of danger, he was no mindless brute.
“I will use all the power of the Dark Contract to search for the Golden Race for you, but right now, our goal should be the Twelve Magic Scrolls.
Grot, Divine Artifacts possess unimaginable power, and I think perhaps they could solve the difficulty you’re facing now,”
Upon hearing this, a complex expression crossed Grot’s face and he sighed in resignation.
“Thank you for your help. The North will forever hold it dear in our hearts.”
He stood up and pounded his fist heavily against his chest.
When he left Viscount Bernard’s residence, Grot’s face still bore an unsolvable weight.
The power of Divine Artifacts was unimaginable, but he didn’t think even the Twelve Magic Scrolls could restore the life that had been drained.
Only the blood of the Golden Race could cure the Northern Valkyrie.
So he must get the blood of the Golden Race within three months.
This challenge was perhaps no simpler than hunting an Extraordinary Existence.
Was there really no hope at all?
Would the Northern Royal Family, which he had traded for with the horn of the glorious Northern Dragon Rhinoceros, just like the North’s glory, leave him far behind?
His black eyes were full of confusion.
This Northern Warrior could no longer see the road to the future.
“Good day, Lord Grot,” just then, a voice with a hint of mirth came from beside him.
Grot turned his head, his eyes showing a bit of surprise at the newcomer.
“Good day, Lord Emi.”
Before, he had little to do with Emi, mainly because he had always looked down on Emi’s profession as a Shadow Priest.
True bravery should be charging directly at a giant dragon, not skulking in shadows like a disgusting rat.
But now, Emi, who had become a level 15 Shadow High Priest, was worthy enough to speak to him.
So at that moment, Grot was a bit baffled by the other’s broad smile.
“Lord Grot, perhaps I have what you’re seeking,”
Grot frowned at the burning gaze in Emi’s eyes.
“Are you sure, Lord Emi? What I need now is the blood of the Golden Race. Can you produce it?”
There was a hint of mockery in his tone. If even Viscount Bernard did not have it, how could a rat, who had been chased by a low-ranking bishop from the Knight Temple around the streets not too long ago, have it?
Unexpectedly, the Shadow High Priest didn’t get angry, instead, he took out a crystal bottle the size of a small pinky from his pocket. Inside swirled a few drops of blood, tinged with a faint golden hue.
Upon seeing this, Grot’s eyes widened in disbelief at the transparent crystal bottle.
The faint golden liquid in the bottle radiated energy brimming with life; he swore it was the most vibrant blood he had ever seen, even more than any Extraordinary Life blood.
It far surpassed even the Holy Water in the Life Goddess’ temple that had been blessed by the goddess herself!
A chilling name came to mind for Grot.
The Golden Race!!
Grot, who had been near despair, was now overwhelmed by immense surprise.
The Golden Race! He had actually, truly found the Golden Race!
This was a High-level Life form, on par with a giant dragon!
“Lord Emi, please forgive my presumption and ignorance. I swear to the War God, it was not my intention…” Grot’s tone, anxious and thrilled, held not a trace of haughtiness as he apologized to Emi.
This Northern Warrior had lost all his former pride.
“Respected Grote, I’ve come to trade with you,”
Emi spoke with a hint of amusement in her tone, apparently undisturbed by Grote’s rudeness.
Hearing this, Grote hurriedly asked,
“Emi, do you really have the blood of the Golden Race? I’m willing to trade with you.”
“Mr. Grote, this is blood I obtained from the Golden Race just this morning,”
Emi extended his hand and passed the crystal bottle to Grote.
Feeling the rich life essence about to burst forth at close quarters, Grote was visibly excited.
“How much must I pay to acquire it?”
He naturally referred to the Golden Race.
Emi shook his head, “I’m sorry, Mr. Grote, but the Golden Race is not for sale.”
Grote’s face suddenly changed, but the rest of Emi’s statement somewhat eased his mind.
“This youngling of the Golden Race was something I acquired unintentionally at the Beastman border. I suppose no one knows better than you how precious the Golden Race is.
Therefore, no matter the price, I am not willing to sell, but some blood is not a big issue,”
Emi said with a broad smile.
“I also hope to win your friendship with this gesture, and as for the price to obtain the blood,
I want a Northern treasure—the Secret Silver Armor.”
Grote’s expression changed slightly upon hearing this. He hadn’t expected Emi, a spellcaster, to choose such a treasure.
The Secret Silver Armor was not as precious as the Northern Dragon Rhinoceros Horn, but it was his most important piece of life-saving innerwear.
The Secret Silver Armor, forged by Dwarf master craftsmen from Mithril, Fine Gold, Underground Cold Iron, Heart of Magma, and other rare materials, was truly a priceless treasure. Grote had fought in the Northern lands for twenty years in his youth, and this armor had saved him at least thirty times.
Losing this treasure, Grote felt his strength would drop by two levels.
“Of course, if you’re unwilling, then forget it. I swear to the Magic Goddess that I…”
Grote showed a hint of reluctance but still nodded firmly.
“No, Emi, I agree.”
The bloodline of the Northern Royal Family must not end here; the future North needs a king.
He had already given up the honor of the North—the Northern Dragon Rhinoceros Horn. He did not mind sacrificing another precious Secret Silver Armor for the sake of the North.
Although it may well be the most treasured possession he was loath to part with.
When Emi received the intricately carved Secret Silver Armor that weighed only ten pounds and shone with a unique bright silver light, his face was filled with a thick smile.
“Mr. Grote, you should arrange for your men to escort the esteemed members of the Northern Royal Family and leave the city with me.”
“Leave the city?”
Grote frowned.
“Of course, you didn’t think I would keep the youngling of the Golden Race within Green City, did you?” Emi wore a peculiar expression.
“I don’t mind if you bring more men, in fact, after completing this trade, I plan to leave Green City to adventure in an Ancient Ruin.
It may be ten or twenty years before I return, and by then, I think I will try to break through to the Extraordinary level,” Emi’s eyes conveyed an almost uncontrollable frenzy.
Grote watched with some disdain. These damned spellcasters were always trying to find shortcuts through ancient ruins to gain lost magic and reach Transcendence.
Emi seemed not to notice Grote’s openly disdainful expression and continued, “If it wasn’t for that ruin being too dangerous, needing an armor capable of withstanding strong attacks, I wouldn’t have revealed the existence of the Golden Race.
Their importance, I guess, needs no further explanation.”
Emi’s tone carried a hint of regret, as if he was at a considerable loss in this deal.
Grote relaxed a bit upon hearing this.
His initial caution almost entirely dissipated.
“No, I trust my old friend of twenty years, Emi. I only need to bring a team of Northern Warriors.”
Emi casually waved his hand, “No, I think you could bring several teams.”
Grote’s caution faded, and he nodded with a smile.
“As you wish.”
In fact, whether Emi agreed or not, he would have brought additional teams anyway; the inquiry was merely a probe.
And Emi’s response eased his mind, showing no ill intent. Otherwise, he would have tried to reduce the number of his assistants.
Emi watched Grote’s friendly gaze and cheered loudly in his heart.
Praise be to the Night Goddess, the wisdom of the Ancestor Crown could make the sun pale in comparison.

chapters.title: Chapter 175: 176: Indifferent to Life and Death, Fight if You Disagree
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 176: Indifferent to Life and Death, Fight if You Disagree
Two days later.
Grot stood in his own estate, looking at dozens of Northern Warriors clad in Dwarf Forged armor, ready to mobilize, his eyes flashing with satisfaction.
Northern Warriors are the innate warriors of the Main Plane of Glory; even civilians who have never seen a Northern Warrior can recognize them with a 90% probability upon first sight.
Because that unique temperament is simply too outstanding.
Resolute, Fearless.
No one could crush a group of Northern Warriors head-on, for even at the cost of all their lives, these warriors with fearless blood coursing through their veins would not retreat a single step.
...
“Form ranks!!”
With a shout, whoosh—
The Northern Warriors before him neatly divided into five squads, each precisely ten men strong.
These robust Northern Warriors were clan members Grot had brought out when he left the Northern Lands twenty-five years ago,
originally numbering 300. But as time passed, more and more fell in battle, and these were his last remaining troops.
Lord Emi, however, had a clearly different focus as he silently assessed the strength of this group of Northern Warriors through their aura.
50 Northern Warriors, 12 of level 10, the rest of the ranks around levels 8 to 9.
Plus a level 16 Grot,
Emi took a deep breath.
A complete force of Northern Warriors, once arrayed in formation, would dare to charge even against an enemy a hundredfold their number.
Fearing nothing.
Although he was very confident in the upcoming plan, Emi’s heart still felt heavy when he looked at Grot’s determined face; no one dared to underestimate the Northern Warriors.
To be sung warriors praised throughout Glory, their reputation was forged in countless battles.
Clip-clop, clip-clop—
A pure white horse-drawn carriage slowly approached from outside the yard, Emi’s eyes narrowing slightly— he sensed an almost imperceptible spark of life on it.
A glint flashed through his eyes, the Northern Land Valkyrie.
“Lord Emi, we can depart now,”
Emi took a deep look at the carriage and nodded.
“As you wish.”
Servants brought horses from the back yard, and a group of Northern Warriors mounted up, forming a protective circle around the carriage.
They set off.
…
50 kilometers from Green City, inside a tall valley.
“Ancestor Crown, do you think Lord Emi can bring that Northern Warrior here?”
Audis stood behind Lide, gazing down at the open valley beneath them, his tone steady.
After learning from Lide last night the true strength of the enemy they were facing, a heavy pressure weighed profoundly in the hearts of all the second-generation Bloodlines.
This was the second time since their emergence that the Bloodline was facing such a formidable enemy.
The last time was a century ago when the Extraordinary Existence of Green City dispatched troops to exterminate the Bloodline.
Everyone knew the consequences of that war; the fear left by the Extraordinary Beings in the Bloodline still lingered to this day.
It was a nightmare that no one wished to recall.
But this time, although the enemy they faced did not hold Extraordinary Existence among them, their strength might not be much less.
Yet unlike the last time,
this time, even though they faced a formidable enemy, all the Bloodlines rose with indescribable confidence at the sight of Lide’s not particularly burly but extraordinarily upright silhouette standing at the cave entrance.
It seemed as long as Lide was here, all the difficulties Bloodline faced wouldn’t be difficult at all.
Because their great Ancestor Crown had managed to amplify the Bloodline’s strength tenfold in just half a year’s time.
Now the Bloodline had the strength to stand against the forces that, just half a year ago, had made them suffocate.
And as long as Ancestor Crown was present, the Bloodline feared nothing.
The work Lide had done in this period not only filled the residents of Dawn City with boundless confidence, but trust among all Bloodlines in him had also reached a full measure.
This was trust that transcended the influence of Ancestor Bloodline loyalty; it was a trust in strength, a trust in the future.
All this had been carved out by Lide’s own hands.
“Do not worry, no one can make the Bloodline bow their heads. As long as I am here, even if faced with the Divine, what of it?”
“Bloodline, Fear nothing.”
The calm yet resolute voice instantly buoyed the morale of the Bloodlines behind.
“Teacher~”
A crisp voice at this moment sounded particularly dissonant among the Bloodline with their bat-like demonic wings.
Lide turned around, upon seeing the somewhat worried face of the girl beside him, he showed a smile and reached out to tousle her flaxen hair.
“Isa, are you afraid?”
The petite Isa glanced at the diabolically beautiful faces of the Bloodline around her, then looked up at Lide, and suddenly her lips curved into a radiant smile.
“Isa isn’t scared, with the teacher here.”
With those words, she stepped forward and gently took Lide’s hand.
Those ruby-like eyes held a reliance and trust that outsiders could hardly imagine.
She didn’t care whether Lide was human or of another race; she only knew he was her teacher.
He was the hero who saved her from Hell and brought her back to the world of the living, the figure she could never forget, who, when the entire world abandoned her, promised to use his own life to protect her.
After Lide revealed his true identity to the girl, Isa’s first thought was not fear or anxiety, but… “My teacher is so powerful, actually the legendary Blood Clan Ancestor…”
Even Lide was stunned by the girl’s way of thinking.
Isa was Lide’s last ace. He could not guarantee that people from the Dark Contract wouldn’t suddenly attack, so these days, no matter where he was, he always took Isa with him.
Even if he lost the Crimson Mage Tower, he couldn’t allow Isa to be in danger.
As for Vina, Lide had already made an excuse for her to secretly leave the city and go to other cities to purchase Magic Materials; she wouldn’t be back for half a month.
The power of the Dark Contract forced him to be cautious in his actions; the only pity was that the time left for him was too short. Even if he prepared as much as possible, due to the constraints of time, it wasn’t perfect.
After tightening his grip on Isa’s hand, Lide turned his gaze toward the valley below, his eyes filled with unwavering determination.
Leading a race to rise was not as simple as imagined.
Every decision, every action, could influence the direction of their destiny, making the pressure he felt exceptionally heavy.
But it was precisely these pressures that filled Lide with vigor every time. He was never a weak person, and the stubbornness in his bones meant he never thought of retreating.
Even when he learned that the Dark Contract possessed several beings above level 15, with its leader nearing the status of the Transcendent, he never once considered abandoning the Crimson Mage Tower.
“Take life and death lightly; if you don’t submit, you fight.”
…
When Grote led his subordinates and Emi through the third valley and into the fourth, the usually silent Grote could no longer contain the restlessness within him.
“Lord Emi, how much longer will it take?”
Grote silently observed his surroundings; it was getting dark around them, the forest full of the soothing sounds of birds and insects, peaceful and harmonious.
However, the anxious Grote couldn’t be bothered with these things; this was the fourth valley he had been through.
The mountain range outside Green City was vast because it was close to the Far Mountain Range, which had many valleys and caves.
It wasn’t strange for Emi to raise younglings of the Golden Race here.
At first, he remained highly vigilant, sending groups of Northern Warriors ahead to scout.
But after three valleys, he was too preoccupied to care that much, only wanting to quickly find the younglings of the Golden Race; the Northern royal family couldn’t afford to lose them.
The Northern Land Valkyrie, weak to the point of possibly losing her life at any moment, couldn’t be delayed any longer, and the sooner she recovered, the more at ease he would be.
Upon hearing this, Emi’s face suddenly revealed a thick smile.
“Lord Grote, we’ve arrived.”
“Arrived??”
“Yes, welcome to the Land of Death…”
What?
Grote’s warrior intuition made him turn pale in an instant.
Danger!! Every pore in his body conveyed a signal of imminent threat.
Just as he was about to take action, thump~
Emi’s form quietly disappeared from the spot, Second Circle Magic: Shadow Jump.
At the same time.
Around the valley, numerous huge figures took off, a massive swarm of giant bats appeared under the dim sky, obscuring the sun.
With vicious barbed grey-black bat wings and gleaming sharp teeth, enormous pointed ears, and piercing shrieks emanating from their throats.
The scene was like the bottomless abyss on the Main Plane, the arrival of Demons.
Whoosh whoosh~
Accompanying the giant bats was an even more terrifying assault.
Amidst the howling winds, a dozen huge boulders were flung like castle-busting stones from a giant siege engine, with terrifying speed towards the Northern Warriors.
“Ambush!!”
“All units, spread out into squads!!”
“Protect His Highness!”
Amidst Grote’s shocked and enraged bellowing, a group of Northern Warriors, led by an Advanced Warrior, immediately dispersed.
At that moment, the huge boulders arrived.
No one could have imagined the kind of strength required to hurl such enormous stones.
The largest one was ten blades long and six or seven blades wide, like a small mountain.
Boom~
The meteor from the sky shattered the earth.
The boulder slammed into the ground, causing the entire grassland to burst.
Unfortunately, a squad of twelve Northern Warriors couldn’t evade in time, and as the boulder rolled, both they and their mounts were crushed to pieces.
Blood spread everywhere.
The boulder continued to roll behind them, toppling three large trees before coming to a stop.
“No!!” Grote’s eyes reddened upon seeing this, and as he looked towards Emi, who had teleported to the distance, his eyes were filled with a murderous intent that could make even a giant dragon recoil.

chapters.title: Chapter 176: 177: Soaring to the Heavens, the Fearless Northern Warrior
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 177: Soaring to the Heavens, the Fearless Northern Warrior
The battle had immediately entered a state of carnage after starting.
Two hundred Bloodline, riding Magic Language Bats, smashed down with searing large fireballs in their hands.
Bang, bang, bang~
The scorching flames erupted on the ground, turning everything within a ten-blade radius into a sea of fire with each explosion of the great fireballs.
Two hundred fireballs fell from the sky, from behind the demon-like Magic Language Bats.
If raindrops were a natural phenomenon, then the fireballs, as dense as rain at that moment, were undoubtedly a world-ending natural disaster, the divine wrath destroying the world.
...
Boom~
The light arising from the exploding fireballs was even more blinding than the afterglow in the sky.
“Protect his highness and retreat first, I’ll draw the enemy’s attention!”
Grote looked at the fiery ocean of red, fell into a rage, and the Northern Warriors’ horses turned to ash after a round of fiery onslaught.
Two teams of Northern Warriors stepped forward, lifting the still unconscious Northern Land Valkyrie from the carriage.
Among the scorching flames all over the ground, these mentally resilient Northern Warriors still maintained sufficient calm.
“Form up, archers suppress!”
A team of archers, ten in number, who had been running around to dodge the searing flames,
but upon hearing the order, immediately ignored the threats around them, drew their longbows to the full, and fired deadly arrows towards the Bloodline in the sky.
Clang~
The long bowstring twanged, and a Magic Language Bat, diving down, was instantly pierced from eye socket to neck by the sharp arrows.
Roar~
After a painful scream, the huge body flapped its wings a few times and plummeted towards the ground.
Thud~
The huge body slammed into the ground, kicking up grass and blood everywhere.
Humans, with their capacity for retaliation, weren’t like the cumbersome One-eyed Giants; the dive-bombing that had accomplished great success against One-eyed Giants didn’t have the same effect against humans.
But a few archers couldn’t cause too much damage to the large numbers of the Magic Language Bat Clan.
The Bloodline had an absolute advantage in numbers.
And the magic released by the Bloodlines kept the Northern Warriors running ragged, no one could ignore those lethal fireballs.
Humans were not One-eyed Giants, lacking strong Magic Resistance, and unless they wore enchanted armor, even an Advanced Warrior wouldn’t survive being hit by a fireball.
The strength of the Bloodline plunged the ground into chaos in an instant.
Even with commanders striving to direct their forces, the sudden attack and the relentless offensive of the Bloodlines still put the Northern Warriors into an extremely passive position at that moment.
Grote’s eyes slowly turned red, and rage filled with brutality flashed through them as he looked at the Bloodline in the sky, recklessly dropping magic.
“Clan Leader, the valley’s passage!”
At that moment, a Northern Warrior with a face full of grief and indignation came before Grote, pointing at the way they had come.
Grote turned his head sharply, to see that the entrance, now engulfed by huge flames, the flames rising several blades high, were enough to melt steel.
His complexion changed again and again.
He could not wait any longer.
Grote closed his eyes slightly, his keen senses as a Level 16 Warrior allowed him to obtain the information he wanted on the battlefield.
Level 15 Warriors would activate a unique Talent.
Danger Perception.
Just as one Magic Language Bat was hit by an arrow and about to hit the ground, Grote’s body burst forth with tremendous power, jumping upwards vigorously.
Thud~
One foot landed on the Magic Language Bat that was about to fall, the Bat screeched even louder as it fell faster.
And Grote’s body rose sharply, using the Bat as a stepping stone.
Just then, another Magic Language Bat, diving down, opened its massive jaws to bite as it saw this scene.
Grote’s eyes showed no fear, his broadsword that was the width of two palms sweeping across.
Pssht~
Under everyone’s gaze, Grote brutally passed through the mouth of the Magic Language Bat.
The original Magic Language Bat had its head blown apart, falling to the ground.
Blood bloomed in the air like Death Flowers, alluring and terrifying.
Using the body of this Magic Language Bat, Grote’s body rose again, and the second Magic Language Bat couldn’t evade in time, the greatsword flashed.
Crack~
The Magic Language Bat was sliced into two parts by a single sword strike, and the Bloodline riding behind it couldn’t get away in time, Grote’s fist exploded its head with a direct punch.
A Level 16 Northern Warrior, violent to the extreme.
The dense Magic Language Bat swarm provided Grote with the perfect stepping stones, but against a group of creatures that hadn’t even reached level 10, this was simply a one-sided massacre.
Within a matter of minutes, the Magic Language Bat swarm, which held air superiority, suffered losses of over thirty.
In the sky, Grote had choreographed a Death Waltz.
Witnessing this scene, Lide took a deep breath.
Humans weren’t One-eyed Giants; it was difficult to employ the same tactics against these agile and intelligent warriors.
This was Lide’s first time suffering such heavy losses.
“Initiate the second plan.”
Upon receiving the command, the previously close-knit Magic Language Bat clan began to scatter in all directions.
And Grote, who had been slaughtering all around in the sky, now found himself in a dilemma without any other Magic Language Bats to use as stepping stones, the Northern Warrior who lacked the ability to fly was immediately in a tight spot.
At that moment, the ground began to tremble with a thunderous rumble.
The Northern Warriors on the ground, dodging the bombardment of large fireballs, turned their heads towards the source of the noise.
And then, these Northern Warriors witnessed a scene they would never forget for the rest of their lives.
Dozens of colossal creatures, towering 6 to 7 blades tall, recklessly ran down from the mountain and entered the valley.
The earth seemed to shatter under their stampede, vibrating with pounding sounds.
These terrifying creatures had gray-white wrinkled skin and wore massive black armor, which protected their enormous bodies; their muscular arms, bulging with veins, wielded iron Wolf Fang Clubs.
Their heads were safeguarded by helmets with single horns, and on top, a massive One-eyed.
The impact of this scene was overwhelming.
“One-eyed Giants!” A Northern Warrior’s eyes flickered with shock.
These creatures, only known in human legends, were now seen for the first time by them, but that gigantic One-eye still allowed everyone to recognize their identity immediately.
The legendary One-eyed Giants.
Also, the heavy soldiers of Dawn City.
Lide’s trump card.
After more than half a year of mining iron ore, with the efforts of the craftsmen with half Dwarf bloodline engaged in Gold Mining, they had successfully crafted armor suitable for these behemoths.
The armor of a single One-eyed Giant weighed 6 tons, and armor half a palm thick could even withstand siege weapons’ attacks.
Unarmed One-eyed Giants were already dominant on land, but once armed, One-eyed Giants were more impactful than any other creature.
Although Northern Warriors generally stood over 1.9 blades tall, when faced with 6 to 7 blades tall One-eyed Giants, it was like children in front of adults.
It was a feeling of helplessness.
This was an advantage brought by race, not something that could be compensated for by mere strength.
Even without exaggeration, in sheer strength, Grote, a 16th-level Northern Warrior, could not compare with a 10th-level One-eyed Giant.
The immense strength of these creatures with a lineage of primeval giants could simply be inferred by the thickness of their black armor they wore.
Even the usually fearless Northern Warriors couldn’t help but hold their breath at this time.
Too shocking.
Giant behemoths 6 blades high, leading them was a One-eyed Giant Lord towering at 7 blades.
The visceral impact of this sight stunned everyone.
They had to tilt their heads back just to gaze at these creatures of legend.
“Northern, Fearless!!”
At that moment, a furious roar came from behind the Northern Warriors.
The morale of the Northern Warriors, which had been declining, instantly boiled over.
Northern Warriors, even when faced with giant dragons, dared to charge.
What were One-eyed Giants then!!
Warriors from the Northern Plateau, who never stepped back!
What followed in the valley was an extremely shocking scene.
Less than 40 Northern Warriors left, charged with the fearless attitude, wielding greatswords toward the armored One-eyed Giants that were like mountains themselves.
They knew death was certain, but they had no fear.
The honor of the warriors at this moment shone brighter than the flames in the valley.
But no matter how much they struggled, they were still helpless under the overwhelming advantage of the One-eyed Giants.
Courage could overcome enemies slightly stronger than oneself, but it could not defeat those many times more powerful.
The Northern Warriors, not taller than the thighs of the One-eyed Giants, had to jump to strike at their vitals.
Long greatswords hacked against the armor of the One-eyed Giants, leaving merely a mark; they couldn’t pierce through the armor half a palm thick, even using all their strength.
In contrast, with a swing of their huge Wolf Fang Clubs, any warrior who failed to dodge in time was smashed by their immense power.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: 178: Northern Bloodline, Extraordinary Traits: Fearless
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 178: Northern Bloodline, Extraordinary Traits: Fearless
When Grott saw the one-sided battle below, his gaze, sharp as a falcon’s, locked firmly onto the One-eyed Giant at the tallest peak. After severing the head of the Magic Language Bat beneath his feet, he leapt from the sky, hundreds of blades high.
Beneath him was Koso, the 15th Level Lord of the One-eyed Giant Race.
Koso sensed something and abruptly looked up, locking eyes with Grott in midair.
Feeling the powerful aura emanating from Grott, Koso showed no fear in his eyes; instead, he was filled with excitement.
This was the first time the One-eyed Giant Race fought for Dawn City, and they needed to secure a victory.
For only glory could earn them respect.
...
During his time in Dawn City, he had fallen in love with this city where one never had to worry about starving or being attacked by terrifying demon beasts.
This had become his home, and now he was fighting for Dawn City!
Cold lights flickered in Grott’s eyes as he held his sword in both hands in the air.
The two-palm-wide silver-white thick sword passed down by his ancestors was sharp enough to cleave through the scales of a giant dragon.
The blink of an eye was enough to cover hundreds of blades’ distance.
With the help of gravitational acceleration, Grott’s body was filled with berserk power.
As Grott drew near, Koso, wielding a giant iron Wolf Fang Club, swung it like playing baseball.
And Grott had no way out.
He directly executed a Jump Cut.
Using the Warrior Skill — Jump Cut and Challenge, his body released a powerful force, the higher the leap, the greater the burst of strength.
Thud~
A massive collision sound erupted.
Space itself seemed to ripple.
Koso’s huge Wolf Fang Club was actually split into two by Grott’s giant sword.
Grott’s descending momentum undiminished, his giant sword cleaved down from Koso’s front, powered by the fall.
The One-eyed Giant had immense strength but lacked agility and could not dodge at that moment.
Screech~
An even sharper frictional sound exploded.
Koso’s full body armor was directly split open by the opponent.
Then starting from the chest down to the abdomen, a huge wound appeared.
Blood splattered.
Driven mad by intense pain, Koso, holding the half Wolf Fang Club, swung with all his strength at Grott.
Grott, who had just landed, didn’t have time to react and was directly hit by the Wolf Fang Club, ten times his weight.
Bang~
Squelch~
Perhaps only now did Grott fully grasp how strong a Lord of the One-eyed Giant Race with the Ancient Giant Bloodline really was.
After being struck, Grott was sent flying hundreds of blades’ length away, crashing through two large trees held together by one person before smashing into the ground, leaving behind a bloody streak.
Mud and grass clippings splattered.
In a brief moment, the strongest fighter of the Bloodline, Koso, exchanged blows equally with Grott, the 16th level Northern Warrior.
This armored One-eyed Giant Lord, after receiving a huge wound from Grott’s strike, collapsed on the ground, momentarily losing combat capacity.
Lide, observing from afar, showed little change in his expression.
Unless the heart or head of a One-eyed Giant was severed, these beings with Ancient Giant Bloodline would not easily die.
As long as it meant disabling the strongest fighter of the Northern, a one-for-one trade wasn’t a loss.
But what followed next surprised him.
Grot struggled to his feet again after being hurled away hundreds of blades by Koso.
“Unscathed?”
The resilience of a high-level warrior had taken Lide by surprise; this was his first time encountering a creature who could stand up after being smashed hundreds of blades away by the massive weight of a Wolf Fang Club.
By now, Grot’s armor was shattered, his face smeared with a mix of mud and blood, and his gray clothes stained red with blood.
The excruciating pain in his chest made him realize that at least three of his ribs were broken, and his right arm was fractured as well.
Yet, after sustaining such severe injuries, there was still no wavering in the Northern Warrior’s dark eyes.
His will was as firm as a mountain.
“Kill!”
Taking up the giant sword planted in the ground with his left hand, Grot charged again toward the one-eyed giant lord, now collapsed and bleeding a hundred meters away.
Northern Warrior, fearless, unafraid!
Death is glory!
At this moment, Lide, who had a commanding view of everything, was deeply shocked.
No wonder Northern Warriors are called the first of the three great warriors of glory.
Their unyielding conviction was terrifying.
Thud, thud, thud~
With each step, Grot’s momentum grew stronger as he sprinted, scattering clods of earth and tufts of grass.
At this time, the cumbersome one-eyed giant lord, Koso, had just managed to start getting up, utterly unable to stop the opposing charge.
“Shadow Touch”
“Shadow Prison”
Just then, two soft commands rang out.
Two massive black wrists emerged from the shadows, grabbing Grot’s ankles, while a prison made of shadows appeared around him.
Dual Casting.
Thud~
The tremendous force of the charge slammed into the two spells.
But the spell prison was unscathed.
Emi appeared thirty blades away.
Clearly, this magic was the handiwork of the Shadow High Priest, and Emi, who excelled in shadow spells, was undoubtedly a master at cursing and ensnaring his foes.
In direct combat, he might not match the explosive power of traditional mages, but in terms of restraining and weakening an enemy, shadow mages were far superior.
The sight of Emi enraged Grot instantly.
It was this filthy rat that had put him in this predicament.
Slowly, his black eyes reddened with blood.
He was determined to kill this damned bastard!
Some hidden power within Grot began to awaken under his resolute will.
The surging power within him vibrated vigorously.
Under Emi’s gaze, even though Grot was seriously injured, his body’s aura grew even more powerful, and his wounds visibly scabbed over at an observable speed.
The broken arm healed in the blink of an eye.
Northern Bloodline, activated.
The reason Northern Warriors could claim the title of the first of the three great warriors of glory wasn’t just their robust physical condition and innate talent.
It was also because their bloodline carried a talent exclusive to warriors.
Northern Bloodline: activates the power left in the bloodline by ancestors, immune to pain, immune to mental magic, strength increased by 30%, stamina and life recovery speed increased by 500%, able to harness the power of the bloodline to heal physical injuries, duration: 20 minutes.
During the activation of the Northern Bloodline, Northern Warriors possess the trait: Fearless.
Fearless: The warrior’s attacks, imbued with extreme intent damage, would cause higher damage, the stronger their willpower was.
This Fearless Trait was a powerful characteristic only Extraordinary Warriors could possess, among which the extreme intent damage was a signature.
It was because of their exceptionally brilliant Bloodline Talent that the Northern Warriors became an existence that no one could ignore.
Among all the warriors of Glory, only Northern Warriors could wield powers exclusive to the Transcendents even at a low level.
Grote swung his giant sword once more.
Zzzzt~
The Shadow Prison that had entrapped him, this invisible force of Magic Power, was directly cleaved apart.
By now, a faint glow had already attached itself upon the giant sword.
Extreme Intent — when a warrior’s willpower reached its peak, they could manipulate Magic Power to imbue their weapon, allowing the warrior to wield terrifying elemental lethality.
This had always been exclusive to Extraordinary Warriors.
After Grote activated the power of his Bloodline, Emi’s face drastically changed.
As a Shadow High Priest, direct combat was never his forte, and clashing head-on with a Northern Warrior who had activated his Bloodline was not something even a brainless Half-Beast would consider.
Emi’s body rapidly disappeared into the shadows, attempting to withdraw from combat.
But it was already too late.
Emi had only become a level 15 for half a year, whereas Grote had already been a level 15 warrior when he left the Northern lands over twenty years ago — the gap between them was significant.
Moreover, Emi wasn’t a Spellcaster skilled in direct combat.
Thump-thump~
The pale glow broke through the shadow cage.
The spot where Emi had vanished was blasted into a huge pit by Grote wielding his giant sword.
After imbuing the sword with Extreme Intent, its lethality had increased more than fivefold.
Boom-boom~
Two Thunder Bursts shot from Emi’s hands
But as they approached Grote, they were directly exploded by the glowing giant sword, causing no damage whatsoever to Grote.
The power of Extreme Intent could disrupt the structure of spells and was the backbone of the Extraordinary Warriors’ resistance against Extraordinary Spellcasters.
At that moment, the last ray of light in the sky also finally vanished.
Night had fallen.
Grote had completely abandoned the injured One-eyed Giant Lord, his gaze firmly locked on Emi, his hatred for the traitor exceeding everyone else’s.
Emi, meanwhile, was on the run, repeatedly thwarted in his attempts to take flight by Grote.
Facing a Northern Warrior who had activated the power of his Bloodline, Emi dared not confront him head-on and could only fight while retreating.
In fact, if he hadn’t been fast, he might have been slain by Grote already.
“All Bloodlines, begin your move.”
It was only then that Lide, who had been observing the scene calmly, finally acted.
In truth, by now, they had forced out all of Grote’s backup strategies.
If they did not act soon, it was very likely that Emi, the newly ranked level 15 Shadow High Priest, would be killed outright by Grote who had activated his Bloodline.
This was a loss he could not afford.
Upon hearing Lide’s command, the second-generation Bloodlines behind him, full of eagerness, immediately set off.
They had watched long enough; they needed a battle to prove themselves.
Before he left, Lide turned to look at Little Yisha, the girl whose resilience surpassed his expectations. It seemed the gruesome scenes below her did not unsettle her much.
“Teacher, are you going down?”
Yisha, sensing Lide’s gaze, slightly lifted her head and asked with some reluctance.
“Yes, as the Ancestor of the Bloodline, I must take responsibility for my kin.
Just as I must take responsibility for you as your teacher.”
Isa’s eyes slightly curved when she heard this, and she nodded vigorously.
“Teacher, Isa will not be afraid, you can go ahead.”
Looking into those ruby-like eyes, Lide nodded in satisfaction, finding the obedient Isa quite endearing.
“Stay here and wait for me.”
With that, he turned around to set off.
The cave was located below the summit, a height of three hundred blades from the valley floor. Although the night had already fallen, the valley was still brightly illuminated by a large fire.
“Ancestor Crown, we have captured the Northern Land Valkyrie you ordered!”
Just as he was about to leave, two Bloodline members approached him with an excited expression, one of them carrying the scar-riddled Northern Land Valkyrie on his back.
After the One-eyed Giant entered the valley, the formation of the Northern Martial Warriors had been disrupted.
And the unprepared Northern Warriors, although they used their agile figures to avoid being entirely killed by the One-eyed Giant, were mostly reduced to a crippled state, with less than twenty of them left on the field.
Especially after the Bloodline had joined the battle from the skies, these Northern Warriors stand no chance against the sheer numbers and absolute power of the enemy.
Grot had been detained by Emi and Koso, and with the Northern Warriors at a severe disadvantage in terms of strength, numbers, and preparation, even the highest willpower couldn’t withstand the onslaught of the Bloodline’s army.
Had these Northern Warriors not activated their Northern Bloodline, they would have probably been completely annihilated by now.
Despite their efforts to fiercely protect her, the Northern Land Valkyrie was still plundered by the Bloodline.
Lide sensed the frail aura emanating from the scar-covered Northern Land Valkyrie in front of him and nodded in satisfaction.
His month’s first embrace was still ongoing, but there was no rush; after the embrace, he would be weakened for a while, and to weaken himself in battle would be foolish.
Moreover, even if the Northern Land Valkyrie became a Bloodline member, she wouldn’t be able to join the battle below.
It had taken several ‘Sunshine Hours’ for Emi at Level 14 to become a Bloodline member, and it was unknown how long it would take for this Level 15 Northern Land Valkyrie, so there was no need to waste his Bloodline’s power right now.
“You two stay here to guard her, and also, protect Isa well,
Lide finished speaking and glanced at the girl who was staring straight at him.
“Isa’s safety is the top priority. If an enemy is encountered, under any circumstances, prioritize Isa’s safety first.”
“Yes, Ancestor Crown.”
Isa held an extremely special place in Lide’s heart, this girl, both in talent and character, was highly cherished by him, and he would never allow her to be harmed in any way.
“Isa, stay here and wait for the teacher, I will be back soon.”
“Yes, Teacher~”
Although there was worry in Isa’s eyes, she didn’t say much.
In the girl’s heart, Lide’s decisions just needed her unconditional support, it was that simple.
After Lide left, Isa, curious, glanced towards the Northern Land Valkyrie lying unconscious on the grass.
The scars on the Northern Land Valkyrie’s body were even more exaggerated than those on an old tree, utterly ferocious.
Isa took a few steps forward and after seeing the scarred face of the Northern Land Valkyrie, she inexplicably felt some heartache.
Such many scars must be painful. Isa remembered it hurt even when she accidentally cut her hand.
Suddenly, the girl’s ruby-like eyes narrowed slightly, as if sensing something, her expression subtly changed.
“Teacher said that you need my blood to be revived,” Isa said, frowning slightly as she looked at the figure on the ground.
“But, do I need to save you? Teacher didn’t ask me to save you.”
“No, Isa must listen to the teacher…”
The two Bloodline members exchanged glances, somewhat puzzled.
Who was Miss Isa talking to? The unconscious Northern Land Valkyrie?
Their faces were a bit odd, wanting to say something but since their duty was only to guard the place, they couldn’t inquire too much.
Besides, nothing had happened yet, so they could only let this girl, highly favored by the Ancestor Crown, act as she wished.
Isa, seemingly talking to herself, then suddenly showed a big smile.
“I just awakened a new ability the day before yesterday, and Teacher doesn’t even know yet, maybe I can save you…”
A new ability of the Golden Race… Unfortunately, Lide wasn’t there to hear this sentence.

chapters.title: Chapter 178: 179: Revival of the Ancient Bloodline - Bronze One-eyed Giant (Three in One)
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 179: Revival of the Ancient Bloodline – Bronze One-eyed Giant (Three in One)
Lide was unaware of Isa’s affairs; at this moment, he watched with a chill in his eyes as Groth, consumed by frenzy, recklessly pursued Emi through the valley.
Emi had only reached level 15 half a year ago, and although his strength had multiplied several times compared to level 14,
it still paled in comparison to Groth, a Northern Warrior who had fought and grown through battles and had reached level 15 more than twenty years ago.
Especially since the opponent had activated the power of his Bloodline, making him almost invincible for the next twenty minutes.
Lide also wanted to wait out Groth’s twenty minutes of dominance, but if he didn’t intervene now, Emi would have no chance of escaping Groth’s hunt.
In fact, within the next three to five minutes, this blasphemer might face the crisis of falling.
...
Emi’s potential was far from being fully tapped; if he were to fall here, then even a victory in this battle would be meaningless.
“Have the One-eyed Giant hold off Groth, send a portion of the Bloodline to clear the Northern Warriors in the valley, and prepare the rest of the Bloodline for casting spells.”
Taking advantage of the night, Lide descended into the valley and directly took control of the battlefield.
“Yes, Your Majesty.”
The command was immediately executed on the battlefield.
The One-eyed Giants, still entangled with the Northern Warriors, simultaneously dropped their opponents and turned to rush towards Groth, who was wildly pursuing Emi in the woods.
The Northern Warriors had no strength to stop the One-eyed Giants and could only watch as the Bloodline took over their battle.
But the agile Bloodline was not like the One-eyed Giants; their numbers crushed the still stubbornly resisting Northern Warriors quickly.
In the face of absolute power, all resistance was futile.
Protected by two One-eyed Giants, Cosso had also regained a certain level of combat ability.
Cosso, with a giant wound from his chest to his abdomen inflicted by Groth, had an unimaginably strong physique due to his Ancient Giant Bloodline.
“Grab him!”
Cosso, enraged, shouted as he raised the severed Wolf Fang Club and charged at Groth first.
To have his weapon cut in half by a mere human and to be seriously injured by the opponent was a tremendous humiliation for Cosso.
He swore to smash this human’s skull with the Wolf Fang Club!
Being from the Bloodline, Emi’s abilities were greatly enhanced in the night, and his profession as a Shadow High Priest greatly increased his power in the shadows.
Yet even so, faced with Groth empowered by the Bloodline to an alarming degree, he continued to be overwhelmed.
Groth, the foremost among the three great warriors of the Glories and a powerful Northern Warrior, was enough to make anyone dread.
Bang bang~
Two Bursting Fireballs carrying searing energy bloomed spectacularly in the night.
The Three Circle Magic, secretly gathered for several seconds before being released, flew towards Groth at an invisible speed as soon as Emi stepped out of the shadow.
Groth’s piercing gaze was more intimidating than a falcon’s.
The silver greatsword in his hands swung, carrying a faint glow through the night.
Utterly fearless.
The blade clashed with the Bursting Fireballs; shockingly, instead of the expected magical explosion,
the sword incredibly sliced right through the Bursting Fireballs, splitting them in half.
The two Three Circle Spells disintegrated directly into Magic Power.
Transcendent, exclusive to the Extradordinary, the warrior’s will now influenced the Magic Power, enabling it to adhere to the weapon and grant it elemental lethality.
The ability to break spell structures was a characteristic of Transcendent, which was why warriors could compete with Mages post-transcendence.
The seemingly ordinary greatsword now appeared even more perfect than an enchanted one.
Groth’s legs powerfully propelled him forward, his muscles compressing like tight springs; he shot towards Emi, who had just stepped out of the shadow, with tripled speed.
Warrior Skill: Charge.
Emi had no chance to react before Groth reached behind him, his sword gleaming like the Creation God splitting chaos, slashing downwards.
In that moment, Emi could even smell the scent of death.
Just as a look of pleasure surfaced on Groth’s face, thud—a large piece of the Wolf Fang Club slammed down hard.
Caught off guard, Groth was struck by the massive weapon, weighing tens of times more than him, and was flung dozens of blades away.
While in the air, despite the intense pain ravaging his body, Groth roared furiously and swung his greatsword, using it like a spear to fiercely hurl it towards Emi.
Emi, still dazed, took the wide greatsword directly to his back.
Splurt~
Emi’s not particularly large body was thrown several blades away, eventually crashing violently against a still-burning large tree, blood streaming from his mouth.
Seven ribs were instantly broken, and his body felt as if it had fallen apart, wracked by intense pain.
Had Emi not become part of the Bloodline, with his original human body, he would have already met Death.
The formidable Northern Warrior.
Boom~
The ground shook as the half of the Wolf Fang Club thrown by Cosso caused considerable damage to Groth, who was slammed onto the ground and dragged over twenty blades before crashing heavily against a large tree, leaving a dramatic scratch on the ground.
Yet still, this Northern Warrior did not fall.
Groth roared furiously, pushing away the gigantic Wolf Fang Club that weighed ten times more than him, and stood up again, his injuries visibly healing back to normal.
From afar, Lide took a deep breath upon seeing this scene.
Too monstrous, this Northern Warrior was too strong.
It could be said that Groth had fallen into a trap from the start, yet facing the combined assault of the Bloodline and the One-eyed Giants alone, he hardly fell into disadvantage.
From the moments when a single person forced the Magic Language Bats to disperse in the sky to the moment when he leapt down to sever Cosso’s massive Wolf Fang Club, heavily injuring Cosso,
And then, after activating the Bloodline, he single-handedly hunted down Emi at the same level 15, pushing his opponent to the brink of death and back.
This treatment was no longer about merely being strong, the title of first among the three great warriors of Glory was truly deserved by this level 16 Northern Warrior.
If today there had been only the Bloodline or just the One-eyed Giant Race, they would have likely found it impossible to handle this level 16 Northern Warrior, perhaps even unable to defeat him.
Lide took a deep breath and immediately made a decision.
“Cosso, limit Grotet’s range of movement; suppress with Fireball Technique,”
He decided to be ruthless now, already having paid no small price. No matter what, he had to win today; otherwise, all his efforts would have been in vain.
Moreover, the most crucial point was that if Grotet managed to escape, then Emi would be exposed, and the Crimson Mage Tower might be forced to abandon their position.
This was a consequence he could not accept.
So no matter the cost, Grotet must stay here today.
Dead or alive!
Lide’s command was the direction for everyone to advance, whether Bloodline or One-eyed Giants; his established prestige was enough to make anyone willingly follow his orders.
He was the King here, the sole King.
The not yet fully healed Cosso, devoid of any hesitation upon receiving the order, his enormous body charged towards Grotet, while at the same time, more than ten other One-eyed Giants also followed their Chieftain.
The earth itself trembled.
In just a mere ten seconds, Grote had returned to perfect condition, the severe injuries he had just suffered were healed by the powerful force within his Bloodline.
Seeing a scene where ten mountainous One-eyed Giants charged towards him did not waver the resolve in his eyes in the slightest.
Without a weapon, Grotet let out a ferocious roar and single-handedly charged towards the more than ten towering One-eyed Giants.
A Northern Warrior, fearless, undaunted!
“Fireball Technique, suppress, attack indiscriminately!”
Lide’s tone also carried an unshakeable determination, this was a battle to death between enemies and friends, where there was only life or death, no room for mercy.
The skin of One-eyed Giants had very high Magic Resistance; in comparison, it was unheard of for Northern Warriors to possess high Magic Resistance.
They were indeed durable, but magic could still damage them significantly.
The remaining 182 Bloodline members started to wildly release Lide’s signature Spell—Small Fireball Skill.
To a level 16 warrior, a single Small Fireball was merely a tickle.
But with nearly two hundred Bloodline members, thousands of small fireballs could burst out every second, this truly was a Fireball Gatling.
The temperature of the air soared tens of degrees in a moment.
Bang, bang, bang~
Fireballs flooded the ground, a true flooding of fireballs.
Except for their cooperative use of Small Fireball Skill in the farms to carve out water reservoirs, this was truly Lide commanding nearly two hundred Bloodline Spellcasters to release the Small Fireball Skill simultaneously.
The scene resembled magma erupting, terrifyingly powerful.
Even the Magic resistant One-eyed Giants suffered huge injuries under this indiscriminate attack.
Instantly, flames several blades high started burning on the ground.
At this moment, the second collision between the One-eyed Giants and Grotet, the level 16 Northern Warrior, began.
Leading the charge wasn’t Cosso but another level 9 One-eyed Giant.
On sensing the momentum of the One-eyed Giant before him, Grotet’s eyes flashed with a sharp coldness, and his body sped up again.
Charge.
The One-eyed Giant colliding head-on with Grotet instinctively swung its massive Wolf Fang Club, but Grotet showed no concern and faced it head-on.
Just as the Wolf Fang Club was about to strike him, Grotet leaped, soaring high.
At this moment, the One-eyed Giant’s attack could not be retracted.
With no greatsword, Grotet’s right arm, acting as a weapon, thrust forward—
The arm penetrated right past the eyeball of the One-eyed Giant.
The enormous One-eyed Giant was instantly killed, not even managing a second attack.
Seeing this, Cosso let out a massive roar, his body speeding up even more.
And just as Grotet landed, the body of the One-eyed Giant thunderously fell in the background.
Bang, bang, bang~
Hearing the massive sound by his side, Grotet fiercely turned his head, and Cosso’s huge body appeared before his eyes.
Without any fear.
Facing it head-on.
A Northern Warrior, fearless, undaunted!
Cosso, seeing his kin being killed lively by someone else, was almost driven mad by anger.
“Trap him!!”
Just at that moment, a voice from the sky instantly brought him back to his senses.
A glance from the corner of his eye revealed that the surroundings were already a sea of fire, and countless fireballs were still densely flying towards him.
Cosso suddenly remembered his powerlessness during his first encounter with the Bloodline in Giant Valley.
With a sky-shaking roar, Cosso rushed forward recklessly, wrapping his strong arms around Grotet directly.
However, after Grotet landed a punch on Cosso’s chest, he was immediately trapped, not expecting this move from the One-eyed Giant, who surprisingly didn’t attack him!
Anger rose in his heart; he wanted to kill this One-eyed Giant!
No creature dared to get this close to a Northern Warrior without paying a steep price, not even a giant dragon.
Just as he prepared to counterattack, countless fireballs flew towards him.
Grogrot had been moving at high speed, which would normally allow him to dodge any number of fireballs,
but now, restrained by Cosso, the element fireballs, more terrifying than a sea of flames, engulfed the land with scorching energy.
“Other One-eyed Giants, spread out.”
Lide’s voice carried an uncontrollable rage.
Each One-eyed Giant was a precious asset, not only in terms of combat but also in their irreplaceable role in production.
At this moment, not only had Grogrot killed nearly fifty Magic Language Bats and over a dozen from the Bloodline, he had also killed one of the irreplaceable One-eyed Giants.
This loss made him grit his teeth in frustration.
As a level 15 One-eyed Giant, Cosso’s skin was immune to Three Circle Magic and lower,
During the battle in the Giant Valley, facing the endless magic bombardment from the Bloodline, he alone had held out for nearly five minutes without falling.
Thus, he drowned Cosso, who was restraining Grogrot, in fireballs without any hesitation.
He didn’t believe that this Northern Warrior could withstand more than Cosso, who was immune to Three Circle Magic and possessed the Ancient Giant Bloodline.
Scorching and bursting.
Grogrot, restricted recklessly by Cosso, was engulfed by fireballs.
Even though Cosso, due to his size, took more damage, the terrifying heatwave still inflicted fatal burns on Grogrot, who had low Magic Resistance.
Grogrot was tightly embraced by Cosso, and those arms, three times thicker than his waist, were as heavy as mountains, leaving Grogrot, despite his significant warrior skills, with no leverage to escape.
One-on-one, he had countless methods to kill this One-eyed Giant, but under these circumstances, he could only compete in a contest of will and raw strength with him.
With his left hand tightly locked, Grogrot could only use his right hand to frantically pound on Cosso’s chest.
Cosso’s thick armor began to crack under Grogrot’s terrifying and relentless attacks.
The massive recoil made Cosso cough up blood continuously.
In the midst of the blazing flames, the scene of their deadly struggle was both cruel and mad.
At this moment, the fireballs not only did not cease, but became even more intense.
The Bloodline, having consumed Magic Blood before the battle began, had no concerns about depleting their magic power in the darkness of night.
Ten seconds, twenty seconds, thirty seconds, a minute later, the rock beneath the heart of the struggle where Cosso detained Grogrot had begun to melt into fiery red magma.
Despite being cooked by the fireballs at the epicenter, both Cosso and Grogrot remained vigorously alive, Cosso’s fury from his kinsmen’s deaths enabling him to disregard the intense pain.
He only wanted to kill this damned human warrior!
Grogrot, as a Northern Warrior, had already forged an unyielding, fearless soul, whose tenacious will never allowed him to shrink back or give up.
Moreover, activating the Northern Bloodline, his body’s strong regenerative abilities gave him enough confidence and resources to cope with all this.
His fists still crazily attacked Cosso’s chest armor, now thickly layered and covered in spiderweb-like cracks.
Two minutes later.
Cosso’s black armor, subjected to thousands of degrees of intense heat, had turned cherry red and even began to slowly melt.
Even Cosso’s pale, wrinkled skin, highly resistant to magic, was still singed by the intense heat.
The unbearable pain from being baked at such temperatures was unimaginable to outsiders.
“Roar~~~”
A furious roar escaped his throat, but Cosso could feel that the wretched human warrior he held was still strong,
Even though he felt his own condition rapidly deteriorating, perhaps having only three to five more minutes before succumbing to the high temperature, he still did not let go.
For Lord Kachar, for Dawn City!
The ferocity within his bloodline was activated by the severe pain, making Cosso fearless.
His huge single eye now tightly closed, relying solely on subconscious movements to tighten his grip on the wretched human.
Flames, still a sky full of flames.
Grogrot could no longer see any color other than fire; each breath burned his lungs and throat, before the damage was quickly healed by the power in his bloodline.
But the damned One-eyed Giant behind him still did not let go, no matter how powerful his attacks were, the giant seemed utterly fearless.
He had stopped moving twenty seconds ago as he felt the armor of the One-eyed Giant behind him had turned red hot.
Death was his only destination.
Grogrot remained fearless, waiting for the moment the One-eyed Giant behind him would die; he believed that ultimately, victory would belong to him.
Three minutes later.
Cosso’s armor had completely melted, and molten iron continuously bubbled out.
At this point, Cosso’s will had nearly become numb because he no longer felt any pain in his body.
Every cell and every patch of skin screamed agony to his brain, the overwhelming pain exceeding what his mind could handle.
Cosso only felt his life force rapidly ebbing,
He was going to die.
This thought surfaced, and his mind flashed through past scenes.
Born in the Thunder Tribe during his childhood, he grew up hunting,
Slowly, as he reached adulthood, he awakened to consciousness,
But, in the struggle to compete for the position of chieftain, unable to defeat his power-awakened brother, he was banished from his tribe.
Hungry and confused,
Cosso still remembered the feeling from that time.
But as he involuntarily came to the surface, everything changed.
Although he had been defeated by the Bloodline, he had unexpectedly joined Dawn City and become one of its members.
Here there was no killing, no need to worry about venomous Demon Beasts emerging from the swamp to kill him, no need to go out every day in search of food, no fear of starving to death.
They were respected and worshipped by the humans here, and he had a life he had never had before, feeling a safety and happiness he had never known.
And now, it was time for him to contribute to Dawn City.
He really liked attending the ideological education classes at the City Hall plaza,
The classes said that Lord Kachar was the great being who had given them everything,
Every resident of Dawn City should fulfill Lord Kachar’s commands with pride.
Every resident should contribute to Dawn City.
A long time ago, he had to fight for the Thunder Tribe,
Now, he had to fight for Dawn City.
Right in the center of the fire that Lide couldn’t detect.
A change that no one had anticipated was happening,
Because of his firm belief, Cosso’s life force gradually stabilized.
In the midst of the thousands of degrees of insane burning, some unfathomable changes slowly began to appear in his bloodline.
The armor on his body melted into molten iron and integrated into his body,
The high-temperature molten iron, which should have corroded everything, gradually fused with his skin and bones under the mysterious power of the bloodline.
It was an even more intense pain, but by now, Cosso was numb; he could not feel the changes happening in his body.
He only knew to use all his strength to restrain the dying human warrior in his arms.
Meanwhile, Groot’s attacks also slowed down, for he saw the armor turning into molten iron, bit by bit corroding the One-eyed Giant below him.
Due to the high-frequency use of Bloodline Power, though he hadn’t yet reached the twenty-minute automatic release limit, he was already at a critical point.
If not for activating the Fearless Trait, possessing the ultimate trait exclusive to extraordinary warriors, and alleviating a significant portion of the magic damage with his tenacious will, he would have died many times over.
Yet even so, Groot’s eyes were gradually dimming.
He felt he was about to die.
Perhaps he would die alongside the One-eyed Giant behind him.
At that moment, he suddenly remembered the Northern Land Valkyrie that he had been ignoring since the fight began.
A bitter smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Being an experienced warrior through countless hardships, he would naturally not make a beginner’s mistake.
If he had started by protecting the Northern Royal Family’s bloodline, he wouldn’t have survived till now.
Only by attracting most of the enemies’ attention to the other side, could his Northern Warriors have a chance to escape with the Northern Land Valkyrie.
“Is this the end then, the glory of the Northern, is it truly to be buried by my hands?”
In Groot’s eyes full of dimness, he had personally sent off the symbol of Northern honor, the Northern Dragon Rhinoceros’s horn,
Then, to obtain the blood of the Golden Race, he traded his most treasured item—his Secret Silver Armor—to that cursed Shadow High Priest, forcing him to prematurely use his Bloodline Power in this battle.
If he hadn’t fallen for the Undead Mage’s trick at the beginning, perhaps he might have been able to preserve a vein of Northern bloodline.
But without the Northern Royal Family’s leadership, what use was preserving the Northern bloodline?
Groot slowly closed his eyes; this unyielding Northern warrior already sensed the approach of his death.
And just then, Groot suddenly widened his eyes, gazing incredulously at the One-eyed Giant that had trapped him and was on the verge of death.
A powerful and infinitely vigorous force was resurging within its body.
Thump-thump~
Thump-thump~
The enormous heartbeat sounded like muffled thunder.
Under Groot’s shocked gaze,
The previously melting molten iron slowly integrated into the One-eyed Giant’s body.
It seemed the bubbling molten iron was like ordinary water.
The melted armor completely became a part of the One-eyed Giant.
And the previously corroded wrinkled skin slowly returned to normal, taking on a gray-white with a subtle bronze metallurgical luster.
One could feel the unshakable strong defensive power at a glance.
Even Groot had a premonition that if this One-eyed Giant were attacked from a leap from the sky now, it probably wouldn’t suffer the same damage as before.
Powerful, mysterious, terrifying.
Extremely weakened, Groot could only look with a complex gaze at this slowly recovering powerful life.
This powerful Northern warrior slowly closed his eyes, waiting for death to come.
He was too exhausted…
And at that moment, outside of the sea of fire, Lide’s eyes suddenly opened to their widest.
“Ding~ One-eyed Giant Lord, Cosso Thunder, triggered Bloodline Evolution, Ancient Giant Bloodline activating, meeting special evolution conditions, successfully evolved into a Bronze One-eyed Giant…”

chapters.title: Chapter 179: 180 The Mantis Stalks the Cicada, Unaware of the Oriole Behind (Extra Update)
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 180 The Mantis Stalks the Cicada, Unaware of the Oriole Behind (Extra Update)
Lide could never have imagined Cosso actually evolving into a Bronze One-eyed Giant.
His eyes were filled with surprise and confusion.
Because the flames from the Fireball explosion obscured his vision, he couldn’t see what was happening inside, so he was quite taken aback when the system notification appeared.
Cosso Thunder
Title: Wisdom (Intelligence increased by 50%)
Age: 289
...
Level: 16
Profession: Giant Heavy Armored Warrior
Bronze Giant Bloodline: Strength increased by 500%, Physical Defense increased by 300%, skin immune to Four Circle Magic and below.
Introduction: A powerful One-eyed Giant who has activated the Bronze Giant Bloodline from the meager Ancient Giant Bloodline, possessing not only great strength but also outstanding intelligence.
Seeing Cosso’s attributes on the attribute panel, a strong sense of excitement uncontrollably rose on Lide’s face.
Before, Cosso’s Bloodline was the Ancient Giant Bloodline, with strength increased by 300% and skin immune to Three Circle Magic.
Now, it had jumped three grades, with a qualitative enhancement in strength, physical defense, and spell resistance.
“Stop casting.”
After Cosso evolved, Lide felt another presence grow weaker, so he decisively stopped the Bloodline from continuing their actions.
An order was given, and no disobedience was allowed.
Nearly two hundred Bloodlines received the command and stopped casting in unison.
The raging inferno that had been burning for several minutes had turned the entire valley into a barren Land of Death.
The original grassland, even the soil, was filled with traces of being scorched by high temperatures.
The central area was oozing scorching lava, desolate and silent, like the life-forbidden zone that had been burned by magic flames in the abyss for years.
With the cease of Fireballs, the flames towering several blades high slowly faded, cooling down from the superhigh temperatures that could melt steel and rock.
And in the center area targeted by all the Bloodline’s concentrated attacks, a tragic scene unfolded.
Cosso now lay on the ground, completely blackened, his armor seemingly melted by the high temperatures long ago, revealing his wrinkled, ashen skin. But uniquely, his skin now had a metallic sheen.
His giant One-eyed was tightly closed, as if he had fallen into a deep coma, but even so, his two massive arms still tightly restrained Grote the level 16 Northern Warrior,
the scene was filled with tragedy, this war had reached a point that could not be described in simple terms.
All the Bloodline witnessing this scene felt an immense respect for Cosso; the big guy had earned their esteem.
This was a victory bought with his life.
Although the One-eyed Giants weren’t as intelligent as adults, they were not mindless beasts. Sensing Cosso’s life force, which didn’t seem very strong, worry flickered in their eyes, but at the same time, their hearts swelled with immense pride and honor.
He was their Chieftain! Their brave Chieftain!
“Use Mage’s Hand to bring the person over.”
Lide could see Cosso’s attributes and status, so he was not concerned.
“Cosso has been reborn in the flames, do not worry about him,”
The surrounding Bloodline and One-eyed Giants immediately eased their concerns upon hearing these words; if Ancestor Crown said it was fine, it certainly was.
Two Bloodline members stepped forward, and with a Magic Hand, they dragged Grote, whose clothes had turned thoroughly charred, out from Cosso’s arms.
Perhaps sensing the presence of his own, or perhaps having fully passed out, Cosso’s hands did not grip as tightly as before, allowing the Magic Hand to easily lift the opponent into the air.
Seeing this, Lide breathed a sigh of relief.
This Northern Warrior had been more troublesome than he anticipated.
They had paid too much for this victory.
With absolute numerical superiority, their chosen battleground, and even an ambush set up.
In the end, they had to resort to a one-for-one, life-for-death struggle just to wear this guy down.
Even after being scorched by temperatures high enough to melt steel for five to six minutes, he had still not died.
The tenacity of this level 16 Northern Warrior astonished him.
He indeed deserved the title of being the foremost among the three greatest warriors of Glory, without a doubt.
The Bloodline quickly brought iron chains and ropes to tie up Grote tightly, even if he were in good condition, it would take some time to free himself.
“Ancestor Crown,” Emi dragged his heavily injured body to Lide’s presence, his eyes filled with bitterness.
He thought that after becoming a Level 15 Shadow High Priest, his strength had skyrocketed. Even if he couldn’t defeat the Northern Warrior, known for their combat prowess in the Glory World, stalling for time should have been possible.
But reality was cruel, the levels between them differed by only one, yet the actual combat strength was at least three tiers apart. If it weren’t for Lide’s decisive order to rescue him, he would have been killed by now.
Lide patted his shoulder, offering a consoling smile, “There’s no need to blame yourself, the might of a Northern Warrior is renowned throughout Glory. Furthermore, how long have you been at Level 15?
Victory now belongs to us.”
No sooner had he spoken than a cold voice from behind made everyone’s face change color.
“Is that so?”
Bang~
Accompanying the voice was a terrifying surge of magic power.
“Scatter!!”
All Lide could do was issue a warning before a massive spell exploded in the midst of the Bloodline.
The fearsome black magic energy was like a world-ending catastrophe.
Four Circle Magic: Dark Impact
The densely packed Bloodline had not anticipated this turn of events at all. Hundreds were struck by the enormous burst of energy, plummeting from the elation of victory to the depths of the abyss in an instant.
Pchhtt~
Blood spattered,
Lide was flung twenty paces, a crimson trail of blood leaking from the corner of his mouth. He violently turned his head, eyes filled with unmistakable fury.
But the sight that followed sent shivers down his spine.
It was them!!
Stanley looked at the nearly annihilated Bloodline before him, his expression full of delight.
“Hahaha, damned Vampires, and that damned Grot! Daring to compete with the Late Bell Church for a sacrifice!!
Now, all of this is mine!!”
Stanley felt indescribably exhilarated. He had received news in the morning that Grot had taken the Northern Land Valkyrie out of the city.
He coveted the Northern Land Valkyrie in Grot’s possession, which the Late Bell Church greatly desired.
She was a super warrior, whose fame spread far and wide in Glory, and also of the royal Northern lineage.
One could only imagine the richness of her soul. What reward might he receive if he were to offer it to the God of Tyranny?
Unwilling to let go of any opportunity, Stanley and Kolong, the First Bishop of the Late Bell Church, prepared to secretly follow Grot out of the city.
At the same time, they also discovered Emi’s presence, which excited them even more.
The two had never crossed paths before, and now to walk together must involve secrets beyond outsiders’ imagination.
So, they followed Grot in secret, two bishops who worshiped the Evil God, both of Level 15, and managed to remain undetected even by Emi and Grot with their keen senses.
Thus, the two bishops of the Late Bell Church emerged, ready to pick fruit when both were beaten and worn.
Kolong, the Level 17 Shadow Bishop of the Late Bell Church, stood next to Stanley, cloaked in black, his piercing gaze fixed on Lide, his voice bone-chilling.
“I did not expect Emi to be your Bloodline, that a Level 13 Vampire could become a Blood Clan Ancestor, how amusing.”
Then turning his attention to the ragged figure of Emi, he continued, “Emi, I helped you transform into a Shadow Priest twenty years ago, with the intention of making you the third bishop of the Late Bell Church, but didn’t expect you to choose to become a Vampire.
And to be initially embraced by a Level 13 Vampire,
What a disgrace.”
Lide was not provoked by the words, his eyes returning to a calm state after the initial rage.
Meanwhile, his brain was spinning frantically.
How to break the situation when facing two Evil God believers, one of Level 15 and one of Level 17?
He glanced back at the fallen warriors behind him, the only two high-level combatants, Emi and Cosso, one severely injured by Grot’s giant sword and the other still unconscious from Bloodline Evolution.
The Bloodline, exhausted from the high-intensity combat, had significantly weakened, and although the ambush had taken out only seven or eight, most of them were gravely injured.
Another fight with two beings above Level 15 was nearly impossible.
The atmosphere fell into silence.
Two Evil God believers above Level 15 had cornered Lide and the entire Bloodline into a fight to the death.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: 181: Appearance of the Northern Royal Bloodline (Two in One)
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 181: Appearance of the Northern Royal Bloodline (Two in One)
“What a delectable sacrifice, Vampire Ancestor, One-eyed Giant, and Northern Warrior…”
Stanley’s expression became even more excited.
“What a pleasant collection. Are you ready to embrace Death?”
He thoroughly enjoyed watching his prey step closer to death.
This thrilling sensation intoxicated him.
Those who became believers of the Evil God were seldom normal; they had already lost themselves in the darkness, pursuing only slaughter and power.
...
Click~
Stanley stepped forward, and a Bloodline trying to rise just had its head brutally crushed under his foot.
The scene was bloody and cruel.
Lide turned his head to take a deep look at the still-unconscious Bronze One-eyed Giant, Cosso, then slowly stood up, his eyes coldly fixed on the two.
“I am Kachar, Ancestor of the Bloodline, a believer of the God of Tyranny. Please state your business.”
Hearing this, Stanley and Kolong were taken aback, exchanging a derisive look between themselves.
Stanley shook his head, full of disdain, “Foolish Vampire, now all of you are my trophies, sacrifices for the great God of Tyranny!”
His eyes filled with indescribable frenzy, he had a premonition that sacrificing this batch of precious offerings would greatly strengthen his power.
Praise the God of Tyranny!
“All will become sacrifices for our God!”
Upon hearing this, Lide’s expression did not change, his penetrating gaze continuing to bore into Stanley.
“So, the Late Bell Church wishes to make an enemy of the Bloodline? Are you ready?”
A sneer peeked out from under Stanley’s cloak.
“Ready? With just a bunch of lowly Vampires?? I…”
Just then, Kolong frowned and shook his head, “Stanley, kill him. This Vampire is stalling for time.”
Stanley, surprised then slightly embarrassed, snapped, “Damn Vampire, I will personally make you taste death.”
Lide shrugged. “Such low intelligence, can’t even discern such an obvious tactic. It’s a wonder how the Late Bell Church has survived so long.
Are all the followers of the Evil God so brainless??”
Stanley’s face turned livid, and he ripped off the black cloak covering his face. The terrifying scar that resembled a centipede across his face sent chills down the spine.
The dimming fires around him faintly illuminated his surroundings, making that face even more horrifying.
“Damn bastard!!”
