After testing several exclusive skills of the Bloodline, Lide had gauged his own close combat strength.
Even with limited fighting experience, taking on opponents one level higher than himself without special bloodlines posed no significant problem.
It was even safe to say it was easy, a casual slaughter.
Another reflection dawned on Lide, Shadow Blade, this skill could explode with ten times the power when coming out of the Dimension Space, which was quite refreshing.
However, it drained too much Bloodline Power, not suitable for extended combat, and… he was a mage. Wielding a sword not even two “blades” long against a beast with eight tentacles each thirty “blades” long was utterly foolhardy.
Magic is eternal, and the way of the warrior was not his style.
A cold glint flashed in Lide’s eyes; with a wave of his hand, the Dimension Space shattered.
Unleashing a Bloody Storm, the Dark Boss who had slain two Level 16 fierce octopuses reappeared within the Crimson Mist.
Feeling Lide’s presence, several fierce octopuses immediately charged towards him.
Lide’s lips curled slightly upon seeing this scene.
It was time to relish the beauty of magic.
Deep sea giants, prepare to pray.
The skirt of the Magic Goddess will envelop this ocean today.
And I, today, am the controller of magics.

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 287 289 Mobile Gun Turret Dada Dada (8200
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 287: Chapter 289: Mobile Gun Turret, Dada Dada (8200 words) Chapter 287: Chapter 289: Mobile Gun Turret, Dada Dada (8200 words) When Lide returned to the Crimson Mist from the Dimension Space, the air immediately became scorching hot.
Powerful magic of indescribable force rapidly coalesced in his hands.
Dangerous and lethal.
The Fierce Octopus sensed the presence they were hunting appear and violently turned its body, its huge tentacles creating a massive undercurrent in the water as it swiftly approached Lide through the hazy mist.
Lide merely floated in midair, his elegant figure now radiating an unbearable aura of terror.
In his hands, two fireballs the size of human heads slowly rotated, bubbling like magma.
Four Circle Magic: Magma Fireball
This was a high-level spell Lide had learned from Spark, and it was his first time using it in real combat.
“Try the delightful taste of grilled octopus… I think you’ll enjoy it.”
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly.
At that moment, five Fierce Octopuses, like demons climbing from the abyss to the Main Plane after a collapse, attacked with overwhelming momentum through the endless crimson mist.
Huff, huff~
Here they came!
Tentacles thirty blades long, covered in spikes like steel needles, whipped through the air, their tearing sound like a demon’s scream.
The two enormous tentacles swung simultaneously, carrying with them the scent of death, constantly reminding Lide of the impending threat he was about to face.
Lide’s eyes were cold as he watched the rapidly approaching tentacles, and his killing intent soared instantly.
Fifty blades, thirty blades…
Now was the time!
The magma-like fireballs in his hands churned and bubbled, smashing towards the Fierce Octopuses at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
At that moment, two tentacles flew towards the fireballs, only to collide with the magma spheres.
Bang~
The terrifying fireballs exploded on the tentacles, instantly shattering the two sturdy appendages.
The intense heat boiled the surface of the sea, and clouds of steam rose.
The heat of the fireballs cooked the severed tentacles, filling the air with the smell of charred octopus.
Roar~
From the mouths of the two Fierce Octopuses came pitiful screams as intense pain crazily entered their minds; yet, this agony only spurred the deep-sea beasts to even greater ferocity as they attacked Lide in a rage once more.
A cold smirk played on Lide’s lips, magic in his hands once again condensing.
His Level 15 Dual Casting allowed him to reach an extreme speed of spellcasting, casting the Four Circle Magic Magma Fireball, costing 300 mana, with a casting time of only 5 seconds.
With Dual Casting, he could release two Magma Fireballs in 5 seconds. The only concern was whether his 2000 mana would be sufficient.
However, after reaching Level 15, Lide naturally had a mana recovery of 20 points per second. If one added the 30 points of mana recovery provided by two pieces of Divine Artifact Fragments, his normal mana recovery rate was now 50 points per second.
Most crucially, once the Bloodline shackles were unlocked and the Bloodline of the Blood Clan Ancestor was activated, he would receive a 1000% bonus on mana recovery rate.
That is to say, Lide’s mana recovery rate had now reached 500 points per second.
As long as his mana expenditure did not exceed this value, he was like a mobile spell turret, an eternal engine with an unlimited supply of shells.
The familiar magic aura from Lide’s hands plunged the two heavily damaged Fierce Octopuses into total frenzy.
Their bodies even grew taller, their presence becoming incredibly ferocious.
Just after Lide had gathered his fireballs, a familiar lethal danger approached from behind.
It was the Fierce Octopus which had successfully ambushed him before, once again diving into the deep sea in an attempt to attack from behind.
Huff, huff~
Tentacles capable of tearing through space, covered in sharp thorns, approached with a terrifying sound of ripping air.
Even a hundred-bladed large ship would be broken into two under such a fearsome assault at that moment.
The hour of crisis neared as the scythe of the Death God seemed to be swinging down.
But at that moment, Lide seemed oblivious to the danger, still madly condensing magic in his hands. However, when the yellow single eye of the Fierce Octopus showed a glint of surprise,
Swoosh~
Lide’s body vanished from the spot, reappearing in the air a hundred blades away.
Instant Teleportation.
A hint of disbelief, almost human-like, flashed in the eyes of the Fierce Octopus.
What shocked it even more was that the two spells in Lide’s hands continued to condense, unaffected by his use of Instant Teleportation.
This was a violation of common spellcasting knowledge.
A spell must be completed before the next one could be used, or one would have to abandon the incomplete one to start condensing another.
It was impossible to pause the first and then commence the second spell.
Dual Casting could achieve this, but a third spell could not be operated in this manner.
Yet Lide had indeed released the third spell while condensing two others—the familiar magic fluctuation convinced the Fierce Octopus that this was not a spell attached to a magic item, but released by this being.
Class Triple Spell was a derivative magic technique researched by Lide.
The whole operation involved momentarily stopping the two active Magic Models, casting a third spell in less than 0.1 seconds, and immediately resuming control of the two paused Magic Models before they collapsed after casting the third spell.
This was Class Triple Casting.
Although it was far from the real Triple Casting, the effect was shockingly sufficient.
Naturally, to do this, one must possess an extremely strong affinity and control over magic, which Lide had.
Bang, bang~
The two Magma Fireballs erupted again.
This time, the two approaching Fierce Octopuses didn’t have time to defend with their tentacles and were struck directly.
The muffled sound of explosions rang out as the Crimson Mist was instantly cleared by the heat.
A large hole was blasted into the eight-bladed body of the Fierce Octopus, leaving it charred black.
Meanwhile, the other four Fierce Octopuses continued to swarm.
The massive tentacles formed a net of death, where not even a fly could escape.
But in that instant, Lide’s body disappeared once again.
Shadow Blade.
Within the range of over two hundred blades, Lide reappeared, unleashing magic from his hands.
Fierce Octopuses tried to encircle him.
Second Circle Magic Shadow Jump, Third Circle Magic Instant Teleportation, Third Circle Magic Void Walking, Four Circle Magic Space Gate, the Bloodline’s exclusive skill Shadow Blade.
Lide possessed as many as five spatial displacement spells.
And with an exaggeratedly extreme rate of magic power recovery, except for Shadow Blade, Lide alternately used his other displacement skills.
This created an extremely shocking scene.
Five terrifyingly huge octopuses in an area couldn’t even touch Lide’s body, every time they were about to attack him, his Threat Perception would immediately alert him to the danger’s approach, and he would step into Dimension Space or teleport away the next second.
However, Lide’s attacks made the Fierce Octopuses feel the horror of magic.
Every time he appeared, he would carry with him two Four Circle Magics, and the explosive high temperatures had already steamed the sea surface over and over again, causing the water to boil because of the high heat.
Lide was like an unceasing magical artillery, his hands full of magic that scorched the bodies of the Level 16 Fierce Octopuses.
Even if these giant beasts hadn’t lived in the high-pressure environment of the deep sea with sturdy bodies and terrifying recovery speeds, they would have long since been burnt to charcoal by Lide.
These creatures were completely unprepared for this kind of combat.
Bang~
Another explosion of a Magma Fireball, the scorching heat swept over, and if not for the substantial amount of blood flowing from the Fierce Octopuses, the surrounding Crimson Mist would have already been scorched to nothing by the high temperatures.
Crash~ The sea surface was smashed apart by the huge octopus’s tentacle, spattering water into the sky.
Lide appeared behind one of the Fierce Octopuses, the Magma Fireball in his hand condensing once more.
But this time was different from the last; at this moment, the Power of Crimson from his body was also being poured into the fireball.
The other gigantic octopuses attacked once again.
In less than ten minutes, these octopuses had developed an intense hatred for Lide, willing to pay any price to tear apart this damned Mage.
Lide watched the gigantic tentacles breaking through the air, his lips curling into a cold arc, the Power of Crimson bursting from his body was channeled into the fireball along with the magic, turning the bubbling hot Magma Fireball into a Crimson hue, like a magical flame.
The final moment.
Two Magma Fireballs infused with the Power of Crimson, concentrated into being.
The very forefront Fierce Octopus, which had just had a tentacle blasted off, had now entwined three tentacles attempting to bind Lide.
If he were to be hit, he would undoubtedly pay a heavy price in the face of the giant beast’s enormous body.
Lide didn’t dodge the attack from the Fierce Octopus; the Magma Fireball in his hand was the most lethal weapon.
Boom~ Rumbling~
A violent explosion sounded, and terrifying crimson flames burst forth.
The three tentacles of the octopus seemed to be slightly less powerful due to the Power of Crimson substituting for the magic power. Though torn and ragged, they weren’t blasted off and remained ferociously combat-effective.
Seeing this, Lide didn’t show the slightest hint of disappointment; instead, the corners of his mouth rose in a chilly arc.
The Magma Fireball exploded, and the Power of Crimson, like a deep-rooted disease, eroded along the unbroken tentacles into the body of the Fierce Octopus.
In the blink of an eye, it had corroded every part of the creature’s body…
The three tentacles, now ruptured and oozing corrosive mucus, were closing in on Lide, and he would undoubtedly be smashed if he didn’t dodge. Despite their ruptured state, the tentacles still carried an immensely terrifying force.
But at this moment, Lide showed no intent to dodge, his gaze coldly observing it all.
Finally, he casually extended his right hand, his thumb and middle finger lightly sliding together, and with a snap~, he flicked his fingers.
Then, the Fierce Octopus with thirty cubits long tentacles, standing eight cubits tall and possessing a yellow One-eyed the size of two stories, suddenly stiffened in the split second before its tentacles could crush Lide.
Before even having the time to blink, the Fierce Octopus’s body explosively burst open, its massive form shredding into pieces like a popped balloon.
The scene was extremely shocking.
So much so that several nearby Fierce Octopuses paused in their movements, and as they looked at Lide’s figure, their eyes were filled with the unmistakable terror they could not hide.
The Fierce Octopus, although a Deep Sea Giant Beast, possessed an intelligence equivalent to that of a 10-year-old human.
Fear of death is unavoidable for any living creature.
And whether it was Lide’s terrifying artillery fire or his recent instant kill of the Fierce Octopus, he had delivered the most direct shock to these malevolent beings.
Blood Boiling, each attack causing enemy blood to boil, with magic resistance checks failing, after ten successful stacks, the blood would burst.
Blood Boiling is the hallmark skill of the Bloodsucking Sword Guard, which Lide also possessed. However, after delving deeper, he discovered that the primary principle behind Blood Boiling was to erode the enemy’s body with the Power of Crimson during the attack, and when the Power of Crimson reached a certain threshold, to directly manipulate it to make the enemy’s blood boil.
Because the Bloodsucking Sword Guard couldn’t mobilize the Power of Crimson as freely as he could, they had to rely on dense attacks to erode the enemy with their power.
He, however, as the Bloodline Ancestor with the strongest talent in the Bloodline, could directly manipulate the Power of Crimson and didn’t have to rely on attack accumulation like the Bloodsucking Sword Guard.
As long as the Power of Crimson met the requirements for Blood Boiling inside the enemy, it could unleash this skill, regardless of the number of attacks made.
The vampiric feature attached to the Power of Crimson worked much the same way.
Power of Crimson (passive, all attacks include the Power of Crimson, causing armor break, chaos element and corrosive damage, with 30% of damage converted into his own life.)
The very essence of the Power of Crimson’s vampirism was to absorb the enemy’s fresh blood to replenish his energy after inflicting damage during the attack. He, however, could directly manipulate the blood, devouring the enemy’s energy outright, so converting 30% of the damage into life was not of great value to him.
Because his efficiency in bloodsucking was twice or even three times more than what the skill description indicated.
Also, because of his deep understanding of these few skills, Lide realized that the skills listed on the system attribute panel were not fixed and rigid, but could be developed and studied for more derivative uses.
Woo woo~
At this moment, the fishmen outside seemed to sense something, the sound of the conch rising once again, becoming even more intense.
The remaining four Fierce Octopuses, initially hesitant and afraid to approach, now gradually had their yellow one-eyes filled with bloodshot, and their aura turned truly fierce.
The fear in their hearts was still present, but their rage and killing intent overpowered their inner panic, charging toward Lide with a fatal determination.
Whoosh whoosh~
Tentacles broke through the air, Lide’s gaze remained cold…
Outside the Crimson Mist.
More than a dozen fishmen, watching that area in the Crimson Mist where terrifying sounds of combat emanated, didn’t show much nervousness; all of them were relaxed, confidently waiting for the victory that was certain to be theirs.
Only the Clan Leader of the Blue Star Tribe, Amiya Blue Star, this exceedingly beautiful mermaid, felt somewhat uneasy, her expression grave.
In theory, seven 16th Level Fierce Octopuses, after the imposition of a No-fly Zone within the sea, should have no issues hunting down a 15th Level vampire in unison; she couldn’t figure out where there could possibly be a chance for defeat.
“The Deep Sea Holy Pearl’s sensed aura must have been accurate. Judging by the opponent’s bloodline aura, his level can’t be higher than 15…”
Amiya murmured to herself.
A living creature might hide and change anything, but the aura of the soul and bloodline can’t be altered or concealed, especially when the other party has no guard up.
Although the existence of the Demigod-level Deep Sea Holy Pearl could not be detected, it had never made a mistake with anyone below transcendent.
That’s why Amiya was so confident at the beginning.
However, this beautiful mermaid seemed to not realize that while level and combat power are related, they aren’t entirely linked.
Five minutes, ten minutes, until after half a Sunshine Hour, the Crimson Mist that had been violently stirring suddenly stopped.
The atmosphere descended into an eerie silence.
At this moment, a dense swarm of deep-sea monsters once again surrounded the Crimson Mist, these dark creatures had drawn the barbs from their backs, waiting for the enemy to emerge.
Amiya’s unease grew even stronger.
She recalled the scene where the Bloody Storm had just raged.
Not only her, but all the fishmen felt that odd sensation; the atmosphere underwent a slight change.
The certainty and indifference from just moments ago now harbored doubts.
“Lord Amiya, should we send someone…”
A male fishman, the strongest and only Level 16 among the four male fishmen at Level 15, stepped forward to ask.
Amiya shook her head, “No, it’s not yet time for you to act, send the monsters to check the situation.”
Despite the fact that the Crimson Storm created by Lide had left her shaken, if they didn’t act now, things might really take an unpredictable turn.
But how could a Level 15 vampire withstand the attack of 7 Level 16 Fierce Octopuses??
Seven Level 16 Fierce Octopuses attacking at once, not to mention a vampire, even a Level 15 giant dragon would have to pay a heavy price after being restrained from flying by a Fifth Circle Spell.
But now, the scene had fallen silent, and this was hard for Amiya to accept.
A triumphant return was the scene that was supposed to happen.
Whoo~whoo~
Another mermaid nearby immediately blew the war conch upon Amiya’s orders.
The mass of deep-sea monsters, numbering just over a hundred thousand, surged towards the Crimson Mist.
But at this moment, a look of astonishment crossed Amiya’s eyes because she saw the mist dispersing.
Yet when the Crimson Mist cleared, she wasn’t elated; instead, her eyes reflected extreme shock.
An unimaginable scene unfolded above the ocean.
The vampire, whom she had considered prey, was standing atop the head of a Fierce Octopus whose skin shimmered with faint golden spots.
And behind this Fierce Octopus, like guards, stood two other Fierce Octopuses with charred skin still looking formidable on either side.
That wasn’t even the most absurd part. What was most absurd was that Amiya saw submission in the giant solitary eyes of these three Fierce Octopuses.
Yes, the 7 Fierce Octopuses, which the Blue Star Tribe had accumulated at great cost over hundreds of years, were now submitting to a vampire!
Amiya snatched the gray conch from the hands of the mermaid beside her and blew it herself.
Whoo~whoo~
The crisp sound of the conch, imbued with magic power, echoed throughout the sea region.
At that moment, the bodies of the three Fierce Octopuses trembled slightly; but moments later, they returned to calmness. The Magic Conch, which had the power to control these deep-sea giants, had lost its effect.
Amiya’s face turned extremely grim, her deep blue hair that floated in the air now seemed even darker.
Several members of the Fishman Clan felt an uncontrollable panic rising in their hearts at this scene.
“Lord Amiya, why, why can’t the Magic Conch command these octopuses anymore??”
“This damned Vampire, he has actually stolen our octopuses!!”
“Kill him!!”
“…”
The crowd was in an uproar, as these beasts were the slaves that had kept the Blue Star Tribe powerful for so many years.
But now, they had been conquered by a Vampire they regarded as prey, one they had planned to use as a sacrifice!!
However, along with their anger, all the Fishmen inevitably began to feel a tinge of irrepressible fear.
This Vampire was too strong.
7 level-16 Fierce Octopuses, now three were enslaved by him, while the remaining four became food for the sea.
How could this be the achievement of a level-15 Vampire?!!
Lide stood on top of the central Fierce Octopus, whose skin had taken on a faint golden hue, with a very pleased expression.
Immortal King (You are the king of the Bloodline with eternal life, your strength increases by 100%, healing speed by 200%, and when night falls, all attributes increase by 20%. All Bloodline members perpetually regard you with respect, and you have a strong oppressive effect on Dark Life. When facing Dark Creatures with a Legend Level lower than 10, they will fall into negative states of fear, panic, weakened will, etc., with their attributes decreasing by 20% and a high probability that those with a lower Level than you will choose to submit to you.)
Glory is a real world, where the Skill explanations on the attribute panel can’t fully describe the potential of the Skills.
After he forcefully killed two Fierce Octopuses, then used Blood Boiling to explode the third Fierce Octopus to death, these somewhat intelligent beings had already been invaded by fear.
When the fourth Fierce Octopus burst in front of the remaining three, the traits of the Immortal King and the Master of Crimson’s Crimson Eye, combined with a Perfect Level Fear Aura.
Boundless fear devoured these Fierce Octopuses.
They submitted, these powerful deep sea giants, with a somewhat weaker will to resist, submitted to Lide, the true overlord of darkness.
Their Bloodline was suppressed by Lide, their strength was suppressed by Lide, their everything was suppressed by Lide.
And crucially, the Fierce Octopuses felt the higher Dark Life Bloodline emanating from Lide.
Compared to the neutral Fishman Clan, these deep sea giants from the Evil Camp preferred the aura that Lide emitted, plus he was such a powerfully terrifying existence.
In fact, if the will of the Fierce Octopuses wasn’t so fragile, the Fishman Clan wouldn’t have chosen them to enslave.
Thus, Lide hadn’t expected that he was about to finish off these giant octopuses, when he suddenly acquired a bunch of underlings.
And these were level-16 giants with a terrifying stature.
What was even more surprising was that when he took these Fierce Octopuses under his command, the system prompted that one of them was on the edge of leveling up, asking if he wished to spend Power of Faith to help it advance.
Then Lide spent three thousand Power of Faith to level up the Fierce Octopus under his feet, perhaps due to the influence of the Power of Faith.
This Fierce Octopus developed golden spots on its skin, undergoing some unpredictable metamorphosis.
Golden Octopus
Race: Deep Sea Giant Beast
Level: 17
Size: Giant Life
Exclusive Talents: Demon’s Kiss (Devour enemies with a large mouth, immune to poison damage) Death Strangulation (Strangle enemies with tentacles, strength increased by 500% during strangulation) Limb Regeneration (Severed limbs can regenerate, recovery speed increased by 1000%) Control Sea Water (Able to manipulate sea water to attack and escape, swimming speed in water increased by 500%) Toxic Mucus (Body fluids and mucus are highly poisonous)
Bloodline: Ancient Golden Octopus Bloodline (Awakening Level 10%) Affected by some powerful force, the hidden power within is activated, completing the transformation will change into the Ancient Octopus Bloodline, currently increased attributes: Strength increased by 300%, body toughness increased by 500%.
Introduction: Demons from the deep sea relish the hunt for powerful beings, awakening the hidden bloodline under the divine instruction of gods.
This is the attribute panel of the Fierce Octopus that Lide had subdued. It must be said that the octopus, which had its ancient bloodline activated by the Power of Faith, was impressive. Although Lide couldn’t see its more specific bodily attributes, the toughness of its body—which was clearly superior to the other two more simple-minded Fierce Octopi—was testament enough to its strength.
Wuu wuu~
At that moment, as the Fishman Clan had yet to give up, the horn sounded once again.
Lide turned his head sharply, his gaze extending into the distance. It was then he finally spotted the mastermind behind all of this.
A mermaid??
His eyes narrowed slightly, but due to the distance of over ten kilometers, and though his vision was exceptionally wide, Lide could not fully make out the adversary’s face.
However, whether it was a mermaid or not, it was now his turn to take the stage.
“You’ve played your cards, and now, it’s time for my ace.”
Lide’s gaze deepened, his presence slowly becoming more terrifying.
Looking around at the countless deep-sea creatures obstructing his path, a slight smirk appeared on Lide’s lips.
With a subtle gesture, the Golden Octopus beneath him immediately swept its thirty-bladed tentacles through the water, charging towards those deep-sea monsters.
Before the signal for retreat had sounded, though filled with fear, the deep-sea creatures dared not flee when faced with the Fierce Octopus.
After awakening its bloodline, the speed of the Golden Octopus had further improved; within only a few breaths, it had already plunged into the throng of deep-sea Fishman.
Lide, watching the Fishman below, extended his right hand, the Power of Crimson spreading over it once again.
Crackle~
As his fingers clenched into a fist, the bodies of thousands of Fishman burst apart.
The classic scenario replayed itself.
A Bloody Storm swept up, and the devillike figure of the killing bat appeared out of nowhere.
Lide no longer concerned himself with these deep-sea creatures—the killing bat would teach them a lesson.
Lide directly urged the Golden Octopus to move at top speed towards the location of the orchestrators behind the scenes.
“Lady Amiya, that vampire is coming!!!”
With no regard for rules, the three Fierce Octopi were simply not creatures that the low-level deep-sea monsters could withstand; the barbs of the deep-sea monsters couldn’t even breach the Fierce Octopi’s defenses.
Amiya watched Lide as he drew ever closer, her expression growing extremely somber, her slender hand subconsciously grasping the golden conch at her waist.
“Prepare for battle,” Amiya turned her head to look at the four top-tier combatants beside her, all above level 15, her expression turning very grave.
“If we retreat, the Blue Star Tribe will start to decline from today onwards. Without the Fierce Octopi that took centuries to cultivate, and losing this pureblooded vampire as a sacrifice, the Blue Star Tribe might very well be wiped out.
If we capture this vampire, when the diadem awakens, the reward it bestows upon us might offset the losses from this incident…”
Amiya’s heart bled. Seven level 16 Fierce Octopi represented the foundation of the Blue Star Tribe. They were just an ordinary tribe in the Sea of Lost, and if they lost these 16 Fierce Octopi this time without capturing that pureblooded vampire,
they would completely lose the protection of the divine diadem. They might even be punished by the divine diadem.
The Blue Star Tribe might be forced to leave the rich waters they had inhabited for over ten thousand years. Without those rich waters, the Blue Star Tribe would inevitably face a serious existential crisis and would, like countless Fishman Clans, slowly fade away.
This was an outcome she couldn’t accept.
Amiya had already invested too much in hunting Lide, making it nearly impossible to back out. At that moment, it was as if she were a gambler who had lost everything, almost willing to bet her last chip.
In fact, no one could have imagined that Lide would drive the Blue Star Tribe to a dead end.
After all, those were seven Level 16 Deep Sea Giant Beasts, who would believe that an entire army would be wiped out while trying to encircle a vampire that was sensed, through Bloodline Power, to be merely Level 15??
Moreover, three of them were even subdued by the adversary.
It was simply unimaginable.
Under normal circumstances, if seven Fierce Octopuses worked together, even if they couldn’t kill their target, they wouldn’t suffer such heavy losses.
Lide’s horror greatly exceeded the imagination of the Fishman Clan of the Blue Star Tribe, and this was the consequence…
Over a distance of more than ten kilometers, in front of the terrifyingly large octopuses, it took mere minutes, as the eight massive tentacles flailed, Lide could clearly feel the scenery around him suddenly moving away.
The Fierce Squid was tremendously large, with its thirty-meter-long tentacles raging like mountains, closing the distance by hundreds of meters each time it struck.
When Lide arrived in front of Amiya, he couldn’t help but show an unmistakable expression of surprise upon seeing her clear countenance.
Amiya’s near-perfect face appeared before Lide’s eyes, her fishtail below the surface of the water was out of sight.
Her upper body was clad in attire made of shells, pearls, and onyx that just covered the peaks of her chest, irresistibly seductive, and her blue hair slightly floated behind her head, giving her a beautiful yet mysterious look.
Even the three mermaids in the middle, who had their hair floating, had the beauty of the Bloodline race that was almost at its peak.
Moreover, the mermaid’s aura was quite unique, making her unforgettable at a glance.
However, now was not the time for friendly exchanges; the moment Lide met with Amiya, the atmosphere froze.
Sparks flew.
Dressed in a black mage robe and standing atop a Golden Octopus like a monument, Lide looked down at Amiya, resembling a scene out of ancient murals where divine beings enslaved giant beasts.
It looked immensely impressive.
At this point, only Amiya was left of the Fishman Clan; the other Level 15 beings had vanished without a trace.
Amiya, equally wary, watched Lide approaching her.
This vampire was the powerful being who enslaved three and hunted down four Fierce Bats!!
Two hundred meters away, the giant octopus halted, and Lide, looking at the distant mermaid, curled his lips into a cold smile,
“Fishman, who gave you the courage to start a war with Dawn City?!”
To think they dared to rob him, and even forced him to personally take down three second-generation Bloodline members.
This is bullshit, I only wanted to trade, and you motherfucker want to double-cross me??
Amiya slightly tilted her head, her long hair of deep-sea hues floating in the air with an air of mystery, “War? No, vampire, we never start wars with outsiders.
I just need you pure-blooded individuals as sacrifices.”
Lide’s face darkened.
Sacrifice? Since when have the Bloodline fallen to the point of becoming sacrifices?
Fishman Clan, isn’t your appetite too great??
Seeing Lide’s shocked expression, Amiya raised her eyebrows.
“Don’t tell me you don’t even know about the Great Sea God’s Awakening Day?”
Sea God’s Awakening Day??
What the hell is that? Lide’s brow furrowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 288 290 Did It Just Turn into a Flirty
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 288: Chapter 290: Did It Just Turn into a Flirty Situation? (10,000-Word Mega Chapter) Chapter 288: Chapter 290: Did It Just Turn into a Flirty Situation? (10,000-Word Mega Chapter) “Bearer of the Sea God’s Crown?”
“The Day of Awakening?”
“What is this all about?” Lide frowned tightly.
Yet the title ‘Sea God’ instantly put him on high alert.
A god is the most frightening and supreme power in Glory, and anything related to such beings is never simple.
Could there really be a deity in this sea domain?
But the main plane of Glory repelled divine beings, so much so that even ancient and everlasting divinities like the Life Goddess could not descend to the main plane. So how could a Sea God suddenly appear?
Seeing Lide’s expression, Amiya narrowed her eyes. Did this vampire truly not know about the Sea God Festival? Her keen intuition told her that the other party probably wasn’t lying.
A bold idea formed in her mind.
“Esteemed Bloodline representative, your power has earned the recognition of the Blue Star Tribe, perhaps we can make a trade…”
Lide quietly sensed his surroundings for a moment. Aside from the four Level 15 beings frolicking in the deep sea, there were no other formidable combat forces.
There was a playful glint in his eyes.
This mermaid was somewhat interesting. Just moments ago, they were fighting tooth and nail, and now she could switch her mindset instantly to start a negotiation.
Even he would find it difficult to stay as composed.
It was only because the second-generation Bloodlines hadn’t truly perished, or else he wouldn’t bother “chatting” with this mermaid. He’d turnout the situation first and talk later.
Negotiation? That too would wait until he had her in a tub back in Dawn City.
However, the brief mention of the ‘Sea God’ had piqued his interest, so he decided to hold off on taking action.
Uncharacteristically during battle, he did something he often scorned and despised—engaging in idle talk with the enemy.
“Never mind the trade for now, what’s this ‘Bearer of the Sea God’s Crown’s Day of Awakening’?”
As soon as Lide voiced the question, the atmosphere on the field entered into a strange state.
Just a moment ago, they were enemies on the verge of a life-and-death fight.
Even now, far in the deep sea, sea monsters were being slaughtered by countless crimson bats, and the Bloody Storm was growing fiercer by the second, with countless lives perishing every second.
Yet under these circumstances, the two leaders of the opposing forces were now conversing in an unexpectedly “harmonious and friendly” manner.
The scene was downright surreal.
