chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 315: Chapter 317: Golden Spider Egg (9800-word Mega Chapter) Chapter 315: Chapter 317: Golden Spider Egg (9800-word Mega Chapter) “Your Majesty, ahead lies the nest of the Cave Spiders, which they’ve established directly atop a vein of Magic Crystal Ore, connecting deep to that half-plane.”
In a dark cavern, Frey, fully restored under the nourishment of Magic Blood, pointed to an underground passage not far away, his expression grave.
“We just need to mask our scent and avoid stepping on those webs; the dull-sensed Cave Spiders will hardly notice our presence.
Once inside the nest, you’ll see the vein of Magic Crystal Ore.
I’d wager that the sight inside will take you by surprise.”
Lide took a deep look at Frey, surmising that something inside had rattled him; otherwise, this typically aloof second-generation Bloodline wouldn’t be so agitated.
This mission, he had only allowed Frey to lead the way, leaving Castro, Withered Bone, and Cap to guard the entrance of the underground passageway.
Here, his presence along with Frey’s was sufficient; he was here to verify information, not to hunt Cave Spiders.
“No need for more talk, lead the way.”
After speaking, the canines in Lide’s mouth slowly elongated, and the handsome bat wings on his back unfurled slightly.
That breathtakingly handsome Bloodline face appeared once more.
Taking a step forward, the space shattered like a mirror, and his figure vanished into thin air.
Watching Lide’s disappearing form, Frey took a deep breath, cast several spells on himself to minimize his presence, and turned to sneak into the lair of the Cave Spider.
Although the Crimson Hunter was powerful, he lacked skills to conceal his form and had to rely on magic and the most primitive methods to infiltrate.
Once Lide entered the Dimension Plane, everything around him seemed veiled by a thin curtain, much like viewing the world from inside a mosquito net in his childhood.
Quiet, desolate, that was the melody of the Dimension Plane.
He watched as Frey adeptly used the terrain to evade the patrolling Cave Spiders, progressing deeper step by step.
The dark underground passage seemed like a maze with no end.
The dark space, the claustrophobic environment, the stench and musty air, all felt oppressively suffocating.
Especially the Ghost-faced Spiders crawling out intermittently from various hidden caves, their distorted and twisted features casting a veil of terror over everything.
Armed with experience from last time, Frey’s infiltration this time was smoother, perfectly evading detection by the Cave Spiders.
Lide, needless to say, with his achievement of Level 18, merely needed to hide within the Dimension Plane, and not even the Extraordinary Ghost Spider Queen of this nest could likely detect him.
Unimpeded wherever he went.
Frey navigated through one shadowy, narrow passage after another, evading wave after wave of Cave Spiders.
It took a full half of a Sunshine Hour before the scene changed anew.
Upon reaching the intersection of several caves, Frey’s eyes lit up with excitement.
Turning his head, he carefully examined for a moment, found a fine scratch on the rock wall, and without hesitation, directly crawled into the hidden passage next to the scratch.
This was a passage only wide enough for one person, too narrow for the Cave Spiders to enter.
After covering a distance of a hundred blades, Frey abruptly halted, turned his head to look back at the empty space, and pointing ahead at the forthcoming passage, his voice carried an irrepressible excitement,
“Your Majesty, below lies the vein of Magic Crystal Ore.
By the Creator God above, I’d wager that you will be immensely surprised.”
Seeing Frey’s slightly nervous and excited expression, Lide’s mouth twitched a little — was all this necessary?
With a wave of his hand, the space in front of him shattered, revealing his handsome, statuesque form within the narrow and dark passage.
Frey respectfully cleared the way, gesturing towards the exit just a few steps away.
Lide, somewhat amused, advanced a few steps, leaned forward slightly, and looked towards the Magic Crystal Ore vein as Frey had mentioned.
But just that one glance stirred a profound shock within him.
What lay before him almost transcended his understanding of a Magic Crystal Ore vein.
They were in a vast underground space, resembling a miniature version of the Underworld or a beehive.
The irregular rock walls of this underground space stretched about two thousand blades long, a thousand blades wide, and five hundred blades high.
The distance from the passage where Lide stood to the opposite rock wall was about two thousand blades, the upper region riddled with densely packed passages, within which menacing and grotesque Cave Spiders crawled back and forth.
Anyone with a fear of tight clusters would feel chills down their spine and curdle at the toes upon seeing this.
The scene resembled the Extreme Evil of Hell, those dense and fierce monsters even more terrifying than demons.
But that wasn’t the focus—the real point of interest was the floor of this underground space.
Brilliant, a sheet of crystal-clear brilliance.
Under the dim illumination of fluorescent plants on the cave ceiling, the ground was covered with Magic Crystal Stones, endless as piles of diamonds and crystals.
Some piles of Magic Crystal Stones even stood a few blades high, their shimmering brilliance made this underground space seem as if the stars themselves were twinkling.
The thick fluctuation of Magic Power made this underworld ten times more abundant in magic than the outside world.
From a bird’s-eye view, the lustrous sea of Magic Crystal Stones could drive anyone insane.
Even though Lide was prepared, the sight of these mountains of Magic Crystal Stones still astounded him.
It resembled the treasure hoard of the giant dragon Smaug in Earth’s classic movie “The Lord of the Rings,” shocking to the core.
The only difference was that instead of gold coins, there were Magic Crystal Stones pulsing with magic fluctuations, which held even greater value.
At this moment, this boundless wealth lay before Lide, seemingly at his disposal.
It had to be said that Frey made a lot of sense.
They had to face off against the Cave Spiders that occupied this place in earnest.
No one could reject such a rich vein of Magic Crystal Stones.
No one!!
If a Secret Silver Vein could prompt two empires to wage war,
Then such a rich vein of Magic Crystal Stones could make two empires deploy all their power and stake everything on the line.
This could influence the fate of nations.
At this moment, Lide had only one feeling.
The future was right in front of him.
Dawn City’s chance for rapid development was in the Spider Nest.
Once Dawn City seized this place, everything would change.
Lide took a deep breath, forcibly calming the excitement in his heart, and regained his composure.
He turned to look at Frey, who was equally ecstatic, and spoke in a deep voice,
“Frey, have you only scouted this area? Are there more veins around here?”
Usually, such a wealthy main vein was likely to have associated veins.
However, even just this vein of Magic Crystal Ore was enough to drive one insane; what surfaced was often just the tip of the iceberg, the exposed veins were far from all there was.
The real bulk was still hidden underground.
Lide could distinctly sense an energy as vigorous as a volcanic eruption hundreds of blades beneath the surface.
He couldn’t estimate the amount of Magic Crystal Stone.
“No wonder it attracted the Cave Spiders’ half-plane space anchor. If this energy were not deep underground, in a labyrinthine channel, it would have attracted countless observers long ago.
Perhaps even the Black Dragon in the depths of the swamp would forcibly occupy this place.”
Lide felt somewhat relieved; had the group of Cave Spiders not suddenly emerged on the surface and killed the miners in Giant Valley, he might have taken a long while to explore the underworld.
Moreover, if Frey hadn’t advanced to level 15 on time, using his powerful ability to evade most of the Cave Spiders’ detection and find their nest,
He might never have known about this underground space hiding earth-shattering secrets.
Perhaps a few years later when exploring the underworld, he might have discovered it, but by then the Magic Crystal Ore might have been heavily mined by the Cave Spiders.
At this moment, Lide suddenly felt as if he was pushed by the Goddess of Luck?
This sensation of about to strike it rich… was exhilarating.
Hearing Lide’s words, Frey nodded affirmatively,
“Your Majesty, this underground space is the main vein, and there are three other rich derivative veins around, although they don’t contain as many Magic Crystal Stones, they still qualify as medium-sized veins.
This is just what I’ve discovered; we still need a professional prospector to find out if there are more.”
Lide slightly nodded, a thoughtful look flashing in his eyes.
The moment he saw the Magic Crystal Vein, there was no question of whether to battle the Cave Spiders; the only consideration was how Dawn City would take over this super-rich vein.
Here, was the future.
The value of this vein was enough for him to go all in.
“Take me to the half-plane’s space portal.”
Suppressing the throb within his heart, Lide swiftly withdrew from his excited emotions and regained his usual calm.
His deep and dark eyes brimmed with light.
He had only two matters to attend to in the Spider’s lair. The first was to determine whether the Magic Crystal Ore Vein was worth his bet,
and the second was to investigate, after confirming the first, his current concern—the Extraordinary Level Ghost-faced Spider Queen.
As the ultimate existence of the Cave Spider race, Lide could not fathom the true strength of the Ghost-faced Spider Queen.
He needed to thoroughly explore and also confirm whether that half-plane truly had limitations on Extraordinary Lives, as Frey had investigated.
Naturally, Frey wouldn’t lie, but he was only Level 15 and wasn’t adept in Space Magic. Therefore, it was normal for there to be gaps in his information; Lide had to personally verify it to be at ease.
This matter affected his decisions, which in turn directly determined the fate of Dawn City.
Although Lide wasn’t adept in Space Magic either, owning the Land of Bone-Burying allowed him to see many nuances that outsiders often missed.
“Yes, Your Highness. Follow me.”
Frey quietly turned and headed in another direction.
Lide once again stepped into the Dimension Space, and the two did not disturb the Cave Spiders mining Magic Crystal Stones in the underground space.
Ten minutes later.
Frey stopped in a dark, narrow underground passage, the Level 15 second-generation Bloodline pointing outwards several hundred blades away.
His expression was complex.
“Your Highness, that is the space gate to the half-plane…”
Lide didn’t exit from the Dimension Plane but continued observing within the Dimension Space.
In the Dimension Space, he could clearly see, not far away in space, a series of pits had appeared.
Those pits resembled black holes, causing the space of the Dimension Plane to collapse directly.
The space gate to the half-plane wasn’t just one; on that rock wall, there were densely packed dozens of space gates of varying shapes and sizes, much like a honeycomb.
“Frey, you must immediately evacuate from the Spider Nest.
Remember, if I don’t return within a day, you immediately need to lead the Bloodline out of the Underworld, letting Captain Kapu continue building defensive works with the Beastman.”
It wouldn’t matter if the Beastman were gone; they could always pull in another group from Dwarf Valley, but the Bloodline was different; it was his foundation, which needed to be preserved as a priority.
After all, the Spider Plane harbored an Extraordinary Existence, and Lide wasn’t sure he could return unscathed.
However, for the sake of these riches in the Magic Crystal Ore Vein, which were enough to drive one mad, he had to take the risk.
And it couldn’t just be called a risk, for even if he died this time, it would merely waste three months.
If, as a result, he could secure an incalculable reserve of Magic Crystal Ore Vein, then the trade would undoubtedly be hugely profitable.
Lide’s goal was clear, and he knew how to execute it.
The risk of this operation was great, but compared to the benefits, it was worth it.
“Yes, Your Highness.”
Frey bowed with his hand on his chest, and then the somewhat aloof second-generation Bloodline immediately turned and left.
He naturally knew about Lide’s rebirth talent, so he didn’t worry too much.
As a Bloodline, death was all too common.
It was just that usually, they were the executioners bestowing death upon others.
Lide watched Frey’s disappearing figure and shook his head with a slight amusement.
At this moment, he felt as though he had returned to the state he was in when he first entered the period of Glory.
Back then, his destiny was unknown, and he had to struggle in preparation to resist the players that were soon to come.
Now, although the setting had changed, the meaning was fundamentally the same.
He also had to strive for the sake of Dawn City.
Looking at the space gate in front of him, which resembled a black hole, Lide’s heart slowly quickened, and a hint of excitement rose in his eyes.
This was still his first time venturing alone into an adventure since arriving in Glory without any subordinates.
Moreover, on the other side of the space gate, there might very well be an Extraordinary being preparing to hunt all outsiders.
Any slight mishap this time would result in the delightful embrace of death, and being visited by the Death God was not a pleasant experience.
In the void of the Dimension Plane, Lide walked towards the Space Gate.
Beside him, Cave Spiders buzzed back and forth, their unique life energy fields preventing Lide from passing through them like a shadow; he could only sneak through the gaps.
The Space Gate leading to the Spider Plane was on a rock wall, looking like irregular cave openings.
Continuously, Cave Spiders crawled in and out, transporting freshly mined Magic Crystal Stones to the Spider Plane.
The closer Lide got, the more he could feel the Plane Power emitting from the spatial fissures. In Dimension Space, he couldn’t pass through the Space Gate—he had to leave the Dimension Plane first.
Moments later, Lide arrived at the least conspicuous Space Gate at the bottom of the rock wall.
He halted his steps.
Peering through the Space Gate to the other side, a thin mist seemed to obscure his vision, making it impossible for Lide to see any signs of what lay beyond.
Lide took a deep breath.
His body instantly left the Dimension Plane, flickered, and he stepped directly into the Space Gate.
Nearby, several Ghost-faced Spiders abruptly paused, their heads turning in unison towards where Lide had vanished—they had just sensed an aura that didn’t belong to them.
But now, there were no traces left outside the Space Gate; the strange aura seemed more like an illusion.
After a moment, detecting no external threats, the Ghost-faced Spiders turned back and resumed their unfinished tasks.
Sigh~
As Lide passed through the Space Gate, his body felt as though it had broken through a thin layer of paper, experiencing a slight restriction, but this sensation disappeared after he crossed.
Once he entered the half-plane controlled by Cave Spiders, he made no pause and tore through space, re-entering the Dimension Plane.
At this moment, Shadow Blade, his potent Skill, became the best tool for his infiltration.
Only after entering the Dimension Plane did Lide have time to observe this half-plane.
His first impression of the Spider Plane was—majestic.
If he hadn’t seen it with his own eyes, Lide would have struggled to imagine such a breathtaking spectacle existed in this world.
Mountains hung upside down.
Nearby, the peaks resembled upside-down hammers, big at the top and tapering down.
Even more bizarre, some mountains floated in mid-air, without any support.
Had the scene not been gloomy, even bearing a somewhat spine-chilling horror, Lide would have questioned if he was in some mythical eastern paradise.
Between the floating mountains, connected by spider webs.
A dense network of spider webs turned into corridors in the sky.
Almost no Cave Spiders walked on the ground; most crawled on the webs.
The sturdy webs were strung with massive spiders, a chilling sight.
The scene was too disgusting and horrifying.
Lide’s view was mostly blocked by the floating mountains and webs.
But after careful observation, he could still make out a few details.
Besides the omnipresent spiders and the floating mountains, he keenly felt the chaos of this world.
It wasn’t just any chaos, but a turmoil of Plane Rules and Plane Power.
Like a mess of tangled ropes, it was impossible to distinguish the beginning from the end.
Compared to the orderly Land of Bone-Burying, the Spider Plane felt like an anarchic mess of no rules and no one to oversee the Plane Power.
Because of this chaos, the Plane Power wasted away unrestrained, causing mountains to float—an extravagant waste of Plane Power.
Lide gave a wry smile and shook his head, inexplicably feeling a bit envious.
This half-plane must have been a vast Plane before, otherwise, the residual Plane Power wouldn’t be so intense; such reckless waste seemed to have no significant impact on the whole Plane.
Compared to that, the Land of Bone-Burying seemed pitifully sorrowful.
“So poor…”
Lide now felt a bit like a family lacking food while a rich man casually fed meat to dogs.
After observing a while longer without further thoughts, he began exploring this Plane ruled by Cave Spiders.
Unidentified fungal mats spread across the ground, with surrounding Cave Spiders continuously transporting Magic Crystal Stones from outside.
And most of the Magic Crystal Stones transported by the Cave Spiders were heading in one direction.
Lide’s mind flickered, and he followed the cave spiders as they moved forward.
Snaking through, after passing dozens of floating peaks, his view suddenly brightened, revealing a stunning scene before him.
A basin, flanked by three tall mountains, was filled with Magic Crystal Stones.
And these Magic Crystal Stones had piled up into hundreds of small hills, covering the entire area within a thousand-blade radius.
The highest pile in the center was fifteen blades tall and composed entirely of human-head-sized Magic Crystal Stones.
These piles of Magic Crystal Stones twinkled with specks of light, like stars in the nighttime sky, dazzling to behold.
Lide recognized them at a glance—they were the highest-level Star Magic Crystal Stones.
Seeing this scene made him gasp in astonishment.
He finally understood why the underground space inhabited by the cave spiders was so vast.
It had been forcibly carved out.
How many Magic Crystal Stones did that vein really contain? Mined by cave spiders so extensively yet still so rich.
Thinking this, Lide wished he could immediately return to Dawn City and dispatch all the troops to seize that Magic Crystal Mine.
“This must be the storage warehouse of the cave spiders, right?”
After calming his emotions, Lide continued to observe this treasure vault, still amazed by the value it contained.
Setting aside everything else, the value of that pile of brilliant Star Magic Crystal Stones was indescribable.
They were a rare treasure that money could hardly buy.
Star Magic Crystal Stones are essential for setting up high-level Magic Arrays.
And Dawn City also needs Star Magic Crystal Stones to create Divine Gifted Holy Armor…
Lide took a deep breath, suppressing the impulse to seize all the Magic Crystal Stones right then.
The Extraordinary Ghost-faced Spider Queen lurking somewhere would not allow it, and even if he could seize them, his System Space couldn’t hold so many Magic Crystal Stones.
Even just one pile wouldn’t fit.
At that moment, Lide sincerely felt a sense of loss. If the Land of Bone-Burying could extend here…
Taking just one-third would keep Dawn City worry-free about Magic Crystal Stones for three years.
Hiss, hiss~
Just as Lide was about to enter this open-air vault, he suddenly felt a chilling sense of crisis.
His form retreated sharply, moving far away from the range of the vault.
Moments after he left, a grotesquely gigantic spider appeared in his field of vision.
That spider stood eight blades tall and was an exaggerated twenty blades long, covered in black fur, its body emitting a slick glow, its bones indescribably hard.
Its head bore a distorted, horrific visage, chilling to behold.
The Ghost-faced Spider Queen, that Extraordinary existence.
Even a Bone Dragon with an eighteen blade wingspan, in front of this Ghost-faced Spider Queen, would seem minuscule.
A complex gravity filled Lide’s eyes.
His entire body seemed to warn him, Danger, extreme danger.
Only by retreating a thousand blades away did that feeling slightly diminish.
He could clearly sense the power emanating from the Ghost-faced Spider Queen.
In Dimension Space, he saw terrifying energy fluctuations arising.
Normally, with Level-15 top combat power, he could approach within ten blades, but facing this Ghost-faced Spider Queen, he felt that even within a hundred blades, he could be directly discovered by it.
He opened the attribute panel, but the information displayed left him somewhat helpless.
Ghost-faced Spider Queen
???
???
Question marks, other than the name, all were question marks.
Even having reached level 18, he still couldn’t access more information.
The greater the difference in strength, the less one could see.
Transcendent creatures were indeed not something he could confront directly now.
However, Lide didn’t retreat; instead, utilizing his Advanced Danger Perception talent, he carefully maintained a relatively safe range to observe the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, whose level was unknown.
After a moment, the terrifyingly large Ghost-faced Spider Queen, reached the area filled with Magic Crystal Stones. The swath of crystals seemed to be her resting nest. Her eight limbs slowly drew together as she gently lay down among them and peacefully fell asleep.
The energy emitted by the Magic Crystal Stones were consumed by her like a tide.
Due to their abundance, the Ghost-faced Spider’s consumption speed wasn’t fast, but even so, to Lide, the amount of energy she absorbed seemed excessively extreme.
A fist-sized Star Magic Crystal Stone contained enough energy to release a Five Circle Magic.
And that heap of Star Magic Crystals, piled high like a mountain, was capable of releasing thirty to fifty Forbidden Curses without any problem.
Watching the Ghost-faced Spider Queen enjoying herself there, Lide felt somewhat like he was looking at a rich tycoon.
After observing for a short while and noticing no further actions from her, Lide, who was thousands of blades away, didn’t linger any longer and quietly retreated.
He couldn’t carry these treasures away, and he wouldn’t have been able to fit much into his System Space either.
Gathering information was his main goal today.
When his great army arrived, everything here would become his spoils of war.
Just a Magic Crystal Stone for sleeping, right?
Eventually, he could use Magic Crystal Stones to build a tower sky-high for this Ghost-faced Spider Queen to see…
But a Sky Tower seemed boring; maybe he should just build a statue of the Goddess of Luck instead, yeah, the one with a short skirt…or perhaps, without one?
Having confirmed the position of the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, Lide acted much bolder.
He wandered throughout this world with incomplete rules.
He also encountered many other spiders he hadn’t seen before.
Such as the Seven-Colored Poison Spider, reaching Level 15, colorful all over, capable of spitting deadly poison from its abdomen,
The giant-bodied Shellback Spider, covered with a hard layer of bone armor,
And the Magic Spider, with a head larger than its abdomen and huge eyes, capable of launching spirit attacks…
A myriad of peculiar kinds, completely refreshing Lide’s understanding of spiders.
Of course, all these special spiders belonged to the Cave Spider category.
Or, it could be said that other higher-level spiders all evolved from Cave Spiders.
However, other types of spiders were rare, only the Ghost-faced Spider was most abundant and had the greatest evolutionary potential.
After roaming around the spider’s nest, Lide gained a more direct understanding of the strength of this opponent.
Powerful was the best descriptor.
This plane, occupied by Cave Spiders for an unknown length of time, had long become a paradise for spiders.
To wrestle a Magic Crystal Ore Vein from these creatures, he’d need to be prepared for a prolonged battle.
Because what he was facing was half a plane of Cave Spiders.
Their numbers were beyond counting.
Lide finally took flight around the Spider Plane for a while.
After spending 10 Sunshine Hours, he barely managed to discern the range of this plane.
Since it was an irregular half-plane, the details were uncountable, but Lide estimated that the plane was approximately 500 kilometers long and 200 kilometers wide, easily over ten times stronger than the Land of Bone-Burying, which was merely the size of a thousand blades’ diameter.
Wherever he went, his eyes met with spiders almost everywhere.
As numerous as the stars in the sky.
The spiders’ main food source was the fungal mats on the ground. It seemed these mats grew by absorbing the free energy in the air.
A very simple food chain; beyond that, there were no other life forms here.
Another thing Lide noticed was that the rules of this half-plane were crumbling, and within a hundred years, the plane would completely break down, just like the former Bone-Burying Plane.
A plane that had entered its age of decline and death.
However, regarding this, Lide could only shake his head as its impending collapse hardly mattered to him anymore.
A hundred years later? Never mind a hundred years, even three years from now, the Magic Crystal Ore Veins would have been entirely consumed by the countless, continuously excavating Cave Spiders.
By then, what more would concern him?
The only good news was that he hadn’t sensed a second extraordinary existence in the Spider Plane for the time being.
It seemed that birthing one extraordinary being was the limit with the residual power of this plane.
But what concerned Lide the most was—in addition to that extraordinary being, there was a large number of spiders above level 15 in the Spider Plane.
If Frey’s detected information was correct and the extraordinary truly couldn’t leave this half-plane, then the top combat power above level 15 would be his biggest stumbling block.
No one knew how much power a plane that had existed for tens of thousands of years had accumulated.
Moreover, with such a large base number of Cave Spiders, even if there was one level 15 born out of 100,000 Cave Spiders, with that huge number, they could exert immense pressure on Dawn City.
The level 15 combat power he now possessed barely reached double digits, which was far too few compared to the other side.
Thinking of this, Lide couldn’t help but take a deep breath.
“Indeed, it’s not as simple as I imagined.
To occupy this extremely rich resource point, it seems I might have to use all my strength to stand a chance of winning.”
His deep eyes gradually became solemn.
“But given the richness of this Magic Crystal Vein, no price is too high to pay.
This is the chance for the rise of Dawn City.
No one can stop the strides of Dawn City progressing, no one at all.”
His gaze was filled with unshakable determination; once he set his mind on something, he would carry it out in the most resolute way.
No one could shake his will.
After confirming that he couldn’t detect any more useful information in a short period of time, Lide returned quickly to the vicinity of the Space Gate using the markings he had initially left behind.
Once he got to the Space Gate to reconfirm his bearings, he turned and entered the Spider Plane once again.
Before leaving, he had one more crucial thing to do—confirm whether the Extraordinary Ghost Spider Queen truly could not leave this plane.
Frey had already roughly sketched out the route to the Spider Egg Chamber before Lide entered.
Lide quickly identified his goal and started to act.
An hour later, although there were a few deviations in the route, Lide had arrived at the egg chamber as Frey had described.
It was a floating mountain suspended in the sky,
much larger than Lide had anticipated.
In fact, after exploring this plane for more than ten hours, this was the largest mountain he had encountered.
Standing just a bit closer, it was impossible to see its entirety; hanging in the air, it was particularly breathtaking.
And this mountain was linked to surrounding mountains by dense, white spider webs.
The scene looked like some apocalypse mythology painted by followers of an Evil God.
Countless giant spiders crawled on the white webs spread across the sky, their fierce appearances enough to startle even the mightiest warriors, and the floating mountain seemed like prey caught by spider webs, wrapped round and round.
Lide stared deeply at this mythical scene for a long time without a word.
A moment later, a Ghost-faced Spider passing by with a Magic Crystal Stone snapped him back to reality.
Shaking his head, he didn’t think too much and slowly followed the Ghost-faced Spider.
Perhaps because Frey had inadvertently intruded here before, the Cave Spiders were quite vigilant now.
From time to time, he saw spiders above level 15, and some important passages were guarded by magic spiders with heads larger than their stomachs, emitting strong spiritual power to check their surroundings and prevent the entrance of foreign enemies.
Lide didn’t pay much attention to this, as Shadow Blade had a very powerful feature—Shadow Blade: After transforming into a Bloodline, one could enter the Dimension Space, immune to detection by anything below Divine Level…
Thus, as long as he didn’t intentionally approach them, the likelihood of being discovered was virtually zero.
Smoothly passing through the passage wrapped in spider webs, Lide entered the interior of the mountain.
Upon entering, his eyes sharply narrowed, confronted with a scene that could make anyone with claustrophobia’s skin crawl.
Before him was a space about ten blades high and a hundred blades in length and width.
Around this space, spider eggs were densely packed, each attached to the rock walls by spider silk.
Those translucent spider eggs, glowing with a ghostly green light, were scattered haphazardly like cobblestones, and that was just one space.
Looking upward, one could see this hollowed-out peak, honeycombed by cave spiders into thousands upon thousands of spaces.
And every space was filled with spider eggs.
Despite being mentally prepared, Lide still couldn’t help but take a deep breath at such a sight.
This race that had survived for countless millennia was indeed much more powerful than Dawn City.
Even just the spider eggs here were enough to astonish anyone.
Even if all the spiders outside met their demise, the enemy could still replenish their military forces in a short time.
No wonder these cave spiders could venture to the surface to explore, their foundation was solid to a certain degree.
A bit more pressure rose within Lide’s heart.
The enemy of Dawn City this time was unprecedentedly powerful.
But the greater the pressure, the higher his spirits soared, firing up the indomitable perseverance within his Bloodline.
Cowardice was never in his character.
The cave spiders were indeed powerful, but… Dawn City was no longer that weak entity.
With bayonets drawn, only through battle would victory or defeat be known.
After slightly regaining his composure, Lide continued exploring the hollowed-out mountain.
The eggs of the Ghost-faced Spider Queen were his target today.
Finding the eggs laid by the Ghost-faced Spider Queen was not difficult, one only needed to head towards the most heavily guarded core area.
After several misdirections in the hatching chambers, Lide spent two Sunshine Hours and finally reached the core area.
He confirmed his target at first glance, seeing as it was a cave guarded by twelve Level 15 Magic Spiders.
It was no surprise for a race that occupied half a plane, even the gatekeepers were twelve Level 15s. Thinking about his own Blood Pool which now lacked even a single Level 15, Lide couldn’t help but grind his teeth.
The mental power of the fifteen Magic Spiders linked into a net, and to enter the hatching room, one must pass through their mental network.
Lide raised an eyebrow slightly, with a more serious look in his eyes as he completely concealed his aura, pushing the immunity to detection attribute of Shadow Blade to the extreme.
Inside the Dimension Space, Lide silently slipped past the twelve Magic Spiders.
As Lide passed by, the group of Magic Spiders suddenly lifted their heads in unison, looking around as if they sensed a different presence.
Their mental power spread fiercely, checking every speck of dust in the space.
Yet they detected nothing.
It wasn’t until after Lide’s figure had entered the spider hatching room that these Magic Spiders felt the strange presence dissipate. After observing carefully again and confirming no external enemy was present, they slowly laid down comfortably on the spider web attached to the rock wall.
At this moment, Lide had successfully stepped into the Spider Queen’s hatching room.
Upon seeing the contents inside, he immediately showed a hint of pleasant surprise.
Magic Crystal Stones, covering the ground, each shimmering with a star-like brilliance.
The space, more than twenty blades in length and width, was entirely filled with Star Magic Crystals.
But that wasn’t the key point; the focus was the central area, where twelve pale gold spider eggs were laid.
Spider Queen’s Egg
Status: Incubating
Explanation: An Extraordinary Level Ghost-faced Spider Queen, having consumed most of its strength to produce these eggs, from their birth, they have been bathed in a rich Magic Power, undergoing some marvelous transformations.
Though not having many attributes listed, the simple explanation gave Lide the feeling of having stumbled upon a treasure.
Twelve of them…
Lide gazed at the pale gold spider eggs, and took a deep breath.
But just as he was about to collect these twelve gold spider eggs, each half a blade in diameter, into his System Space, he suddenly caught a glimpse of a dark, inconspicuous orb beside the eggs.
Lide approached it curiously, it was a half-buried thing in the Magic Crystal Stones, with just half a pointy grey orb visible.
It looked like some metallic rock but also resembled some kind of biological egg.
“Is this also an egg produced by the Spider Queen?”
Lide squinted slightly, instinctively opening the attribute panel.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 316: Chapter 318: Dual Transcendents, Return to Earth, Is This What a Young Married Woman Is Like (10,000-Word Mega Chapter) Chapter 316: Chapter 318: Dual Transcendents, Return to Earth, Is This What a Young Married Woman Is Like (10,000-Word Mega Chapter) Lide approached with a touch of curiosity, it was an object half buried in the Magic Crystal Stone, with only a gray, pointed hemisphere peeking out.
It resembled some kind of metal stone, but it also seemed like some creature’s egg.
“Is this a Spider Queen’s egg as well?”
Lide slightly narrowed his eyes and subconsciously opened the attribute panel.
Unknown Bronze Egg
Status: Deep sleep
Explanation: Appears to be the egg of some powerful life form that has absorbed a portion of the Plane Power while hibernating, but due to the passage of time, it has lost most of its vitality and requires strong Life Force to reactivate it.
Unknown Bronze Egg?
The name is truly top-notch, only someone with no culture would be so perfunctory.
Lide shook his head, just as he was about to reach out for it, but he suddenly felt a sense of danger, his back hair stood on end in an instant.
He immediately retracted his hand, and after a moment, the strong sense of crisis dissipated.
Lide’s figure paused for a long while, and after ensuring no more danger was sensed, he somewhat relaxed.
This Bronze Egg was definitely not simple.
After that incident, when he looked again at the Bronze Egg that couldn’t be fully identified by the system, the glint in his eyes grew even hotter.
When he had just tried to take the Spider Queen’s eggs, he didn’t feel that deadly threat, but now with this inconspicuous Bronze Egg, he could.
This meant the value of the Bronze Egg was much higher than that of the eggs laid by the Extraordinary Spider Queen.
He seemed to have found something incredible.
A flicker of excitement passed through his eyes.
However, Lide did not rush to take the Bronze Egg but turned to the row of pale golden Spider Eggs after deep thought and took a deep breath.
His gaze gradually grew intense.
Crack~
The space in front of him shattered, and Lide’s figure, at a speed invisible to the naked eye, directly placed the first Spider Egg into the System Space.
At that exact second, the twelve 15-level Magic Spiders guarding outside the egg-laying chamber sensed an unusual presence, waking immediately.
The Shadow Blade’s feature of being immune to Divine Level and below Investigation Skill only took effect in the Dimension Plane, and after leaving the Dimension Plane, the psychic web woven by the Magic Spiders was immediately triggered by him.
The Magic Spiders guarding the egg-laying chamber plunged into a rage, rising swiftly to crawl towards the chamber.
In the blink of an eye, Lide had collected seven Spider Queen’s eggs, when the first Magic Spider had just entered the egg-laying chamber.
Upon seeing Lide, the intruder’s figure, the Magic Spider fell immediately into a furious rage, letting out a shrill scream.
The scream caused the spider silk on the rock walls to vibrate, this warning signal began to spread out along the spider silk.
The speed of the vibration was like that of light, and within a few seconds, the trembling of the web spread throughout the entire hollowed-out mountain.
All the spiders went into a frenzy, rushing towards the egg-laying chamber as if a tide were coming in.
But it was too late, by the time the Magic Spider screamed and prepared to cast a spell to attack Lide, he had already placed the last of the Spider Queen’s eggs into the System Space.
Time was running out.
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly, he could already sense a severe crisis looming.
It seemed like the next second he would be torn apart by some powerful being.
Without time to think, he immediately bent down, picked up the watermelon-sized Bronze Egg from the Magic Crystal Stone, and placed it into the System Space.
Just a second before he left, he waved his hand and two Mage’s Hands transformed into the shape of spoons appeared in the air, scooping two large spoonfuls of the incredibly precious Star Magic Crystal Stone into the System Space.
After this action, every pore on Lide’s body was frantically warning him.
It was as if he had angered a Divine being.
Lide was about to act, looking at the sea of Magic Spiders that had poured into the egg-laying chamber, when his mind thundered, as if hit by a hammer.
Spirit Shock.
The spirit shock formed by the twelve 15-level Magic Spiders was enough to cause brains of life forms of the same level to burst open and die.
Even with Lide’s terrifying strength, he too was dealt a heavy blow, his figure suddenly froze.
At this moment, his Spiritual Sea was under direct attack, the shock from the Magic Spiders was like a giant hammer pounding on his head, causing blood to leak from his nose.
The intense pain turned Lide’s eyes blood-red in an instant.
Bloodline shackles, unlock.
The aura of his body exploded tenfold in an instant, firmly stabilizing the violently shaking spiritual sea.
Lide took a deep breath, didn’t entangle himself with these magic spiders, and swish— his body directly appeared outside the spawning room.
Instant teleportation.
The next second after appearing outside, space shattered, and his hands tore through the dimension plane, disappearing from the senses of all spiders.
Shadow Blade.
The magic spiders entering the spawning room, seeing the empty scene on top of the magic crystal stone, instantly had their eyes turn blood-red, then let out a wail far more extreme and piercing than before.
Their treasured egg had been stolen!!!
Kill that damned intruder!!!
The vibrations of the spider webs began to spread out madly at this moment.
However, after entering the dimension plane, Lide felt that the fatal threat hadn’t disappeared, but instead was becoming more intense.
It was as if someone was resting a long knife against his neck, ready to chop down at any moment.
The terrifying sense of crisis didn’t allow him any time to think further, as he flew away from the mountain at top speed, feeling the threat getting closer.
The Death God had already approached, scythe in hand.
Just as he flew out of the mountain, his eyes suddenly narrowed.
Through the veil-like thin space wall, he saw the web that connected the mountains in the spider plane was now filled with spiders.
If previously there was a slight sparsity with a dozen blades spanning between each spider, now they were lined up densely, like skewered sugar-coated hawthorns.
The exaggerated number had completely covered the sky.
The already dim light was now fully extinguished, and the land was enshrouded in darkness.
After pausing for half a second, Lide immediately fled toward the Space Gate at his maximum speed.
Danger, extreme danger!
Every pore on his body was on end at this moment.
The chilling intent to kill was drawing nearer and nearer.
Fortunately, the Space Gate was less than ten kilometers away from the spawning ground.
When he transformed into his true Bloodline form, his flight speed surpassed 200 kilometers per hour, and with the help of the high-level Floating Skill, he had now reached 300 kilometers per hour.
The distance of ten kilometers, he had arrived in just a few minutes.
But just as he was a mere thousand blades away from the Space Gate.
Crack~ The space in front of Lide suddenly shattered.
Then, a massive spider, 8 blades tall and 20 blades long, covered in black fur, with a ghastly, twisted face, forcefully appeared in front of him.
The distorted face, like that of a hanged corpse, would send a shiver down even a warrior’s spine with a strong willpower.
“Hiss~”
A sound akin to a blade scraping across glass nearly pierced the eardrums.
The eyes of the Ghost-faced Spider Queen were filled with a chilling murderous intent.
The scent of the Spider Eggs on Lide drove the Extraordinary creature into a complete rage.
Those were its children!!
Roar~
The Ghost-faced Spider Queen fiercely opened its mouth, resembling a meat grinder, and roared at Lide. A wave of impact, nearly warping the space itself, swept a thousand blades around.
Lide couldn’t avoid it in time; instantly two Dragon Scale Shields formed around him, but these shields didn’t last more than a second.
Crack~
They burst apart immediately.
The impact wave swept over, and Lide was hit with tremendous damage. His robust body, possessing passive strengths like super strength and a super strong physique, felt as if it was slashed by countless knives.
Splurt, blood sprayed across the sky.
Even on his arms, stark white bones could be seen.
The Extraordinary Ghost-faced Spider Queen was unparalleled in its terror.
With a single action, it had inflicted upon Lide the greatest damage he’d ever endured.
Stimulated by the intense pain, Lide’s eyes became even more blood-red.
He didn’t give up resistance, a sinister curve hanging at the corner of his mouth.
The killing intent was chilling.
His body disappeared from its original spot in an instant, and he quickly closed the distance to the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, barely a hundred blades away, his hands igniting with an intense glow.
Gurgling sounds—
The fireball, like magma, rolled in his hand.
Seeing Lide daring to rush toward her enraged the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, as if a lowly, insignificant bug was challenging her, bringing a humiliating annoyance that drove her to complete madness.
From her mouth burst forth shockwaves, multiples times more intense than before.
Boom—
Within a diameter of two thousand blades, it was an indiscriminate attack.
More than three thousand Cave Spiders burst dead, the fungal carpet on the ground was torn into pieces, and then the ground itself exploded, flinging countless fragments of stone into the sky.
The scene was like an apocalyptic disaster.
Extraordinary power, destroying heaven and earth.
Bloodline Shackles (….. Activate the Bloodline of the Bloodline Ancestor, which increases strength, body recovery speed, and magic recovery speed by 1500% after activation. This effect doubles at night, and internal blood can be consumed to maintain this state for a long time.)
Lide’s body was visibly being destroyed at an alarming rate, but the terrifying recovery speed of the Ancestor Bloodline exaggeratedly restored the damage to normal.
Between these two extremes, Lide’s bloodline power was draining away like a floodgate had been opened.
In just a few short seconds, more than 30% of his power was consumed.
The pressure he faced when confronting the extraordinary far exceeded his estimations.
But, what was there to fear?
Fearless, without dread!
His eyes sharp as a falcon’s, piercing to behold.
The magma fireball in his hand, finally shaped after relentless impact, was now transformed into a crimson hue after being infused by the abundant Power of Crimson.
Deadly and bewitchingly beautiful.
But just as he was about to smash it forward.
Pssht—
From behind, a limb like that of a praying mantis pierced through Lide’s body, floating in mid-air.
The sharp limb was like a knight’s lance, the tip glinting with a cold light as drops of blood slid down before being shattered by the shockwave.
Lide’s body stiffened abruptly, but without a moment’s hesitation, he gnashed his teeth onto his tongue, and the bubbling magma fireball in his hand was hurled straight at the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, less than thirty blades away.
Whoosh whoosh—
The magma fireball traveled the thirty-blade distance in less than a second.
The Ghost-faced Spider Queen paid no mind to the twin fireballs, their magic fluctuations greatly diminished having been infused with the Power of Crimson, appearing to be at most Three Circle Magic, and they seemed to be so off-target, flying away at a wide distance.
However, just a half second later, pssht— the two magma fireballs took an eerie curve in mid-air and directly hit her eyes before she could react.
Pssht—
The Power of Crimson-enhanced, searing flames erupted, her right eye of two blades in diameter being consumed by fire in an instant.
But, shockingly, just moments later, the Ghost-faced Spider Queen seemed barely harmed by the twin magma fireballs striking her eyes.
There were merely slight scorched marks around her eye socket.
The magical resistance of an extraordinary body was unbelievably strong.
At this moment, Lide, impaled by the spider’s limb, seemed to have anticipated this, a cold arc forming on his lips, the severe injury that would have killed an ordinary person seemingly having no effect on him.
His right hand stretched out, the Power of Crimson wildly diffusing, burning like Hellish Demon Flames.
He clenched his fist.
Crackle—
The Power of Crimson dispersed.
In that instant, the Ghost-faced Spider Queen’s right eye, which had seemed undamaged from the hit, suddenly burst out in a crimson light.
Then, pssht—
It exploded.
Green slime splattered across the sky as the extraordinary Ghost-faced Spider Queen was blinded in one eye.
The terrifying pain drove the Ghost-faced Spider Queen into madness. Its eight massive limbs flailed wildly like razors, instantly bursting everything around it.
It was a spectacle more chilling than demons crawling out from the abyss.
Death was spreading.
A hint of regret flashed in Lide’s eyes. He hadn’t intended to take just an eye, but the entire head of the creature.
Alas, the extraordinary body was too horrific.
At that moment, the power inside his body had drained to its limit, leaving no possibility to continue the battle.
With his last bit of strength, he returned the two Divine Artifact Fragments he was carrying back into the System Space.
‘Puchi’—after this action was completed, Lide noticed another sharp limb piercing through his heart from the corner of his eye.
His body was impaled by two limbs… beyond any chance of recovery.
Indescribable intense pain rampaged through Lide’s will, and he could vividly sense his life force slipping away at an indescribable rate.
Death was approaching.
He mustered all his remaining strength to slightly twist his head, and in the final moment before he fell, he finally saw the culprit behind him.
It was a Ghost-faced Spider with a mantis-like figure, about two blades in height and three blades in length, and it even had a pair of wings on its back. The aura it exuded was… extraordinary.
This plane had nurtured more than one extraordinary being.
After this thought crossed his mind, Lide’s vision darkened, and his consciousness plunged into silence.
At this time, the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, with her right eye destroyed, rushed to Lide in an infinitely ferocious manner and, in the most brutal fashion, tore him into pieces with her sharp forelimbs.
Once everything was over, tranquility slowly returned to the air.
Only the painful howls of the Ghost-faced Spider Queen remained.
Moments later, the two-blade-tall extraordinary Ghost-faced Spider, flapping its wings, flew next to the eight-blade-tall Spider Queen, emitting a strange sizzling sound.
Moments later, the Ghost-faced Spider Queen furiously bent down, searching above the shredded carcass for the now vanished Spider Egg.
Moments later, realizing the absence of the Spider Egg’s scent, the Ghost-faced Spider Queen fell into an even more violent madness than ever before.
“Roar~”
The spider webs hanging high in the air were torn apart like ragged cloth by the Ghost-faced Spider Queen, who even crushed the towering mountains with her limbs.
This half-plane fell into an indescribable chaos due to the disappearance of the Spider Egg.
Nobodies knew how many Cave Spiders were slaughtered by the enraged Ghost-faced Spider Queen that day…
—
—
—
Lide felt as though he had undergone an incredibly unforgettable experience.
He could feel his body being torn apart.
And then… was this what death felt like?
The empty, baseless feeling of drifting in the endless void was something he never wanted to experience a second time.
Afterward, his consciousness seemed to enter an inexplicable environment.
Like a mother’s womb, or some kind of sticky incubation chamber.
It was a pitch-black space where his thoughts moved sluggishly.
Even thinking simple thoughts, like what one plus one equaled, took a long time to answer.
Yet within this darkness, he faintly sensed the body on Earth.
It seemed he could return to Earth if he wanted to.
But as he prepared to do so several times, a massive fear instantly welled up in his heart, suggesting that such an action would have grave consequences.
With his thoughts severely restricted, Lide was unable to ponder too much. The overwhelming fear instinctively made him abandon any plans to return to Earth.
He continued to drift in that unknown dark world.
There, only eternal silence existed, and he could not perceive the passage of time. Fortunately, as his thought processes slowed and his responses dulled, he didn’t feel much boredom.
Maybe a day passed, or maybe it was a year.
At a certain moment, Lide suddenly felt as though he had regained a physical body.
But this body was very weak, so much so that he couldn’t control it to make any excessive movements.
It merely allowed his thoughts to speed up a bit.
Then, again, time dragged on.
Lide could feel his reborn body becoming stronger, and at this time his cognitive abilities were also gradually recovering.
In this void of pitch-black space, he eventually managed to think strenuously.
The first question was where he was now?
A previously idiotic question, but it took Lide a long time to find the answer—in the Blood Pool.
Reassembling the body?
Yes…
As he pondered such simple matters, Lide’s thoughts gradually became more normal.
Moreover, he could also feel his body getting stronger and his spirit gradually improving.
Another long stretch of time passed, and suddenly Lide felt a sensation in his soul.
It seemed that he could leave this dark environment.
With a thought.
He suddenly opened his eyes.
He was met with a snow-white ceiling.
Sunlight streamed in from outside the window, illuminating the room in dazzling brilliance.
Propping himself up with his arms behind him, Lide slowly sat up and took a moment to adjust to the familiar environment before snapping back to reality.
This was Earth, this was his room…
With a slight frown, he wondered, had he returned? But what about the body in the Glory?
He quickly closed his eyes and sensed carefully, and after a moment, he sighed in relief.
He could sense that the body within the Glory was still developing, growing slowly like a baby.
He couldn’t help but smile wryly and shake his head at the thought.
“I didn’t expect that the Spider Plane would still have a second Transcendent, that was really an oversight.”
But at the same time, he felt somewhat fortunate. It was also lucky that this probe revealed the second Transcendent; otherwise, the price he might have to pay when actions unfolded later could be much greater.
The Blood Resurgence (limited) left a bat in the Blood Pool of the Bloodline; upon the original body’s death, it could be reborn in the Blood Pool. After rebirth, there would be a weak period of 1 month with a cooldown time of three months.
Lide still clearly remembered the attributes of this trump card, but what puzzled him was, just how long did rebirth take?
He could feel the speed of body consolidation was not fast, even slowing down due to the exceedingly large amount of energy required.
This caused him some irritation. There were many things waiting for him to handle in Dawn City, and not being able to return was truly uncomfortable.
After a moment’s thought, he took out his phone, glanced at the time, and began to calculate.
“June 20, 2051… The last time I went out was a month ago, on May 10th. That means this time, my body repair has left me unconscious for about a month.”
Fortunately, not too much time had passed.
He sighed with relief after thinking it over.
Now that Dawn City had its own team, even if he didn’t return for a short period, no major chaos would ensue.
Moreover, now that he had appeared in the Blood Pool, Harrison would definitely receive the news in the shortest time, and this Chairman of Dawn City would surely make the correct judgment.
He stood up and stretched comfortably.
Since he couldn’t return, he might as well rest well for a while. Since the in-game beta had closed, he had started a long period of seclusion. On Earth, he only checked in every ten days or half a month, while over at the Crimson Moon, he had become an utterly hands-off manager.
After taking a shower, Lide changed into a Burberry casual business attire and prepared to go out.
Looking at the mirror image with a face and demeanor that were bursting with charm, a satisfied smile appeared on Lide’s face.
Ever since becoming the Blood Clan Ancestor, every part of his body was trending towards perfection. His muscles and bones were growing stronger, slowly deviating from human to Superman.
Of course, the most apparent change was still on the outside—the perfect appearance was beyond simple description, and the longer the time passed, the more astonishing he became.
An even more crucial aspect that set Lide apart was—his demeanor. If an impressive appearance left a deep impression, then the disposition of someone who had experienced great trials and was in control of countless destinies was like a resounding slap.
A vivid memory.
Even men had to admit the brilliance and luster of this man.
As the ruler of Dawn City and an elegant member of the Bloodline, his unique demeanor worked like a Charming Skill that could drive the opposite sex crazy and addicted.
Lide made some slight preparations before he left the house with his mobile phone in hand.
Before stepping out, he turned back to glance at the house left to him by his parents, his gaze inexplicably filled with nostalgia.
This time, he planned to switch to a new residence.
The public beta of “Glory” was about to start. Although Earth was safe, just in case, he needed to move to a more secure and private location.
A luxurious villa community in Shanghai captured his attention as he browsed on his phone.
Though he didn’t want to admit it, no one could deny that this world has never been much about fairness. Once you hold enough wealth, you can easily access things that ordinary people can’t touch in their lifetime.
Whether it’s stunningly beautiful or handsome opposite sexes, globally limited edition luxury sports cars, or custom-made private jets.
That’s why people madly chase money, climbing up at all costs.
No one gets excited about those papers that are more disgusting than garbage; it’s just because those papers represent resources, power, and the control that can satisfy any of your desires, the pleasure of making others kneel and flatter you.
Lide had a more visceral impression of these words as he stared at the overly sweet smile of the villa saleswoman in front of him, whose looks were on par with any so-called star.
Here, Fairy Lake Villa District, in the heart of Shanghai where every inch of land was worth its weight in gold. Three years after the opening, it became one of Shanghai’s most luxurious villa communities. However, because of the price, sales had been slow.
“Mr. Li, this is one of only two remaining villas in the Fairy Lake Villa District. All residents here are either rich or noble, and even Shanghai’s richest own properties here…”
As she spoke, the high-heeled beauty seated herself gracefully next to Lide, her long legs, clad in black stockings, brushing against him as if accidentally.
She then proceeded to naturally hand him the floor plan clipped to the folder for him to examine, her face beaming with a more and more delightful smile.
“Mr. Li, this 400 square meter villa is priced at 250 million yuan, perfectly matching your status…”
The moment Lide entered their store, he caught everyone’s attention, including hers.
His presence was too outstandingly refined, combined with his not-less-than 100,000 yuan Burberry casual outfit— ‘young and wealthy’, this label was prominent and eye-catching.
Clothes can be borrowed, and she had seen imposters pretending to be rich, but temperament was something that could never be faked.
That elegant nobility perfectly encapsulated what it means to be prestigious.
Customers of this type were always VIPs.
She had wrestled this chance away from several competitors, and she had to cherish it.
Selling a villa would net her at least a 300,000 yuan commission, and if the buyer didn’t bargain too much, that could even rise to 500,000 or more.
The incentive was much greater than that of most other opportunities.
This kind of chance didn’t come by every year. If it really happened, she wouldn’t mind not just sitting next to him but also accepting whatever ensued.
Moreover, leaving other aspects aside, even if there were no entanglements of interest, just to have something wonderful happen with the man before her—the most handsome and exciting she had ever met in her life—she was—willingly.
Out of the corner of her eye, she stealthily admired Lide’s perfect profile as he looked down at the floor plan. His every move exuded charm beyond resistance.
At this moment, the girl’s feet tensed slightly; she unconsciously pressed her knees together, smoothing out her black skirt and quietly shifting her legs closer.
Lide sensed the girl next to him breathing somewhat more rapidly and turned his head slightly to see the blush on her pretty face; his expression was a bit strange.
Since he left the house, nearly every girl he passed would take a few extra glances at him, but none were as direct and blatant as this one.
Those long legs in black stockings seemed to touch his legs unwittingly.
Feeling the unusual touch, Lide coughed lightly and stood up, a flawless smile on his face.
“Miss Wang, my assistant is already on her way. I am quite satisfied with this villa, and my assistant will confirm the relevant information with you.
If all goes well, I plan to purchase it.”
He had already thoroughly reviewed the villa’s details online before coming, with the virtual house viewing allowing him to know even the count of tiles in the bathroom.
Even before he arrived, he had decided whether to buy or not, and his visit was just for further confirmation.
As for the girl, looking at her eyes almost dripping with excitement, Lide shook his head. It seemed if he wished, a simple dinner and a movie tonight would be enough for an easy victory.
“Mr. Li, you…”
Just as the excited girl in front of him was about to say a few words of thanks, a middle-aged lady with black-frame glasses accompanied by a round-faced girl in a suit entered the room.
“Mr. Li~” Cheng Lu, the assistant Zhao Yue had found for him, greeted Lide with a smile.
Seeing his slightly chubby assistant, Lide gave a slight smile, “Assistant Cheng, thank you for your efforts.
I have decided to purchase this villa, please coordinate the details with Miss Wang.”
A command from his boss was naturally uncontested, and the role of a personal assistant also essentially acted as a steward.
“Yes, Mr. Li.
Should the funds come from the company account or…”
If the funds went through the company account, the house would be in the name of Crimson Moon. In name, it would be company property, but since the entire company was Lide’s, the difference was there, but it was essentially not substantial.
“No need, I still have some funds in my account, enough for this.”
Lide shook his head, there were still 500 million in his account, a sum he had exchanged before the beta test closed, just in case. He simply hadn’t transferred it to the company yet.
Now he was truly a tycoon, and not just on paper.
Among the more than three thousand listed companies on the A-share market, less than half made a profit that exceeded 500 million a year; money in this world wasn’t as inflated as in the movies.
“Yes, Mr. Li.”
After discussing the house purchase issue, Lide suddenly remembered something and felt a bit embarrassed.
“How has Crimson Moon been doing lately?”
He had invested several billion in the company and hadn’t checked in for over a month, leaving everything to Zhao Yue and her management team.
It seemed a bit cold-hearted.
Seeing Lide’s expression, Cheng Lu smiled, finding a boss like Lide quite rare.
Even if he didn’t care, not checking in for a month seemed extreme. It was as if his investment of several billion was just child’s play and not even on his radar.
“Mr. Zhao has been advancing the company’s projects steadily according to your will. The staff of the three main departments combined has already exceeded a thousand,
Mr. Zhao has also invested fifty million in the data analysis center for the second phase of construction, which is expected to be completed in two months, just in time for the launch of ‘Glory’.”
Hearing this, Lide nodded, “Alright, I’ll leave this to you to handle, I’m going to the company right now.”
“Yes, Mr. Li.”
After he finished speaking, Lide turned and left, heading to the roadside where the stunningly beautiful saleswoman, with her perfect looks and figure, immediately jogged out to see him off.
Tap tap tap~
Even ordinary high heels seemed to have a different vibe under those long legs.
“Mr. Li, may I add you on WeChat? Don’t worry, I won’t disturb you; I just want to send you some information regarding the villa and the surrounding shopping district…”
She finished speaking and blinked her large eyes at him, seemingly in all earnestness.
Watching the 1.75-meter-tall girl in front of him dressed in black tights, Lide couldn’t help but laugh.
Such a girl would surely be considered a goddess in the eyes of most people.
Beep beep~
The self-driving taxi behind him had already honked its horn.
“Okay.”
Lide let out a small smile.
It was a good excuse. In the past, he used the same tactic to ask for WeChat from female clients… Unfortunately, since parting with the 996 lifestyle, those opportunities were gone.
After Lide left in the taxi, the saleswoman, who had shown such grace, revealed a radiant smile and eagerly opened up Lide’s WeChat Moments to meticulously check each post.
The easiest way to learn about someone was to look through their Moments…
Lide, of course, was unaware of her actions, comfortably leaning back in the seat of the driverless taxi after confirming the address with the intelligent system.
He had no plans to buy a car; he had been too poor before, and now he hardly needed one. If he entered Glory, he’d be gone for months, and a car would just sit in a warehouse collecting dust. Plus, with transportation so developed now, calling for an autonomous taxi was instant and more convenient than hiring a driver.
He casually took out his phone to log onto the ‘Glory’ forum to check if there was any new gossip.
After such a long time, he wondered what ridiculous things those silly players had posted.
As he went on the browser, a pop-up news headline caught his attention and slowed him down.
Two men partnered to create counterfeit bills, investing 200,000 RMB to buy equipment, only to produce 180,000 RMB in counterfeit money, incurring a loss of 20,000 RMB. Caught in regret at the time of their arrest, lamenting the difficulty of starting a business…
Lide paused, swiped reflexively, and the next news story appeared.
A man armed with a kitchen knife tried to rob a bank, only to have the cashier laugh at him from behind bulletproof glass until a janitor subdued him with a mop…
His mouth twitched severely, refusing to give up, he scrolled down to another story.
A couple fantasized about winning a five million RMB lottery before bedtime, then actually won but ended up fighting over the division of the money…
After reading a few of these ridiculous news stories, Lide contemplated deeply.
Damn it, if anyone says again that characters in movies and novels don’t have brains, I’ll have a word with them.
This is all based on real characters…
Robbing a bank with a kitchen knife, losing money on fake bills…
Indeed, reality is the most magical world.
And it only got more exciting from there.
A man became so addicted to video games while burglarizing a home that he was caught only when the homeowner returned and reminded him of his original intent to steal….
Two strangers on a train got into a fistfight after arguing over who knew more about Northeastern rice….
A woman attempted suicide by jumping into a river but, being a swimmer, ended up swimming and crying at the same time…
A woman who rented a room with an online friend was robbed by him, leaving her no choice but to seek help from her own husband…
It wasn’t until the taxi alerted Lide that he had arrived at his destination that he snapped back to reality, glancing at his phone, he realized that he had been distracted by such performative, absurd news stories for the past half-hour.
He had even forgotten to check the “Glory” forum – those foolish netizens were a weak force compared to these truly ridiculous news stories.
“Sillyness is truly contagious… but I have to say, these ridiculous news stories are quite entertaining – truly enticing.”
After savoring the taste, he finally put his phone away.
Shaking his head clear of those silly tales.
His expression returned to normal.
Upon exiting the taxi, he walked into the industrial park and, standing beneath the building, looked up at the characters “Crimson Moon” with a slight sense of realization.
Every time he spent a long period immersed in “Glory,” it made him feel as if that world was where he truly belonged…
Earth seemed more like a dream world.
He took a deep breath, his deep eyes calming down, and then stepped into the company that belonged to him.
Although Lide was the biggest boss, due to infrequent visits, he was a rare sight to many employees, with most never having seen him.
It was only in “Crimson Moon” that a select few employees greeted him, and most of them were girls.
With “Crimson Moon” recently expanding its hiring, those new employees who saw the old staff greeting him became very curious about this big boss.
Especially the girls, who, upon seeing Lide with his almost maxed-out super-high attractiveness, immediately had their eyes light up.
After Lide left, many started discussing him frantically, with topics ranging from, “Ahhh, why is our boss so handsome, does he have a girlfriend? No? Maybe he likes guys, how exciting… I really want to join their game.”
This made the male employees, who were outright ignored, wear unhappy expressions, muttering resentfully about how these worldly women didn’t appreciate a man with potential.
What’s so good about that jerk? Is he just taller, more handsome, and richer? Besides that, what else does he have??
Hmm, what else??
Hmph, superficial.
At this moment, Lide had already taken the elevator to the top floor.
With his graceful walk, handsome look, appropriate dress, and noble demeanor, he was the focus of many employees, especially the starry-eyed female staff members, as he approached Zhao Yue’s office.
Thump, thump, thump~
Even though he was the boss, knocking was a necessary mark of politeness and refinement.
“Come in,”
Hearing the voice, Lide then turned the doorknob.
Click, click.
Huh?
Feeling the immovable doorknob, Lide grew a tad skeptical.
“Wait, the lock is broken, I’ll open it…”
The voice inside had just finished speaking, and Lide exerted a slight force with his wrist. His body, which had undergone transformation, possessed a strength so great that even he had not yet realized it.
Click, bang! With a loud noise, he forcefully broke the lock.
Just then, Zhao Yue, who was trying to open the door, lost her balance when her force suddenly found no resistance due to the broken door latch, causing her high-heeled frame to become unsteady in an instant.
“Ah!!”
The second after Lide had twisted the lock completely, he felt a figure in a fiery red suit scream and lunge toward him.
Unable to dodge in time, he was fully embraced in a fragrant hold.
Sss~
Lide’s first thought was…
Soft…
Tender…
Is this what a young matron feels like?
I truly am…
