Not only are we selling weapons there, but we have also started to sell other life necessities like clothing, fabrics, food, and mining tools…
The resources centaurs exchange with us are mainly ore and Demon Beast hides.
Through trade with them, we have acquired a large amount of strategic materials needed by Dawn City.”
Frey spoke with pride, as the current development of the Dwarf Hill Ridges was indeed exceptional, and his contributions were undeniable.
“Our trade with the Fishman Tribe is a bit different; they control abundant resources, making our trade with them more of an equal exchange.
Yet, the Fishman Tribe has already contributed 70% of the magic raw materials, which are the primary sources for both the Dawn Mage Tower and the Crimson Mage Tower.”
The trade between Dawn City and the Dwarf Hill Ridges is exploitative, taking advantage of unequal industrial systems to extort wealth.
However, the trade with the Fishman Tribe is based on mutual need; the Fishman Tribe needs the weapons and armor from Dawn City, and Dawn City needs the Fishman Tribe’s magic raw materials, with both parties very satisfied with this exchange.
“Kapp, how are things going in Dwarf Valley?”
After ensuring that everything was on track, Lide continued his inquiries.
Being at the helm of a large business, he had returned after an 8-month absence and had an abundance of information to catch up on.
“Your Majesty, the development of Dwarf Valley is proceeding normally; due to planning issues, Dwarf Valley has now become a transit hub for Dawn City.
Almost all large transactions are flown to Dwarf Valley from Dawn City before being conducted externally.”
“The most important thing on the other fronts is the Secret Silver vein; this rich mine produces a stable output of 60 pounds of Mithril each month, and the production is very stable.
Additionally, the valley’s other two large iron mines also produce a large amount of ore each month.”
“Also, to counter the forces of the Underworld, the Lion Tribe has been expanding of late, and now commands an army of over 50,000 Beastmen.
Among these 50,000, thirty thousand are Level 5 warriors or above, with 5,000 currently guarding our military fortress in the Underworld.”
Kapp paused slightly as he finished, his expression tinged with hesitation as he spoke.
“Your Majesty, I’ve returned to my original Lion Tribe and consolidated everyone into the current Lion Tribe, among whom is a Shaman who was from the old Lion Tribe. His Level has reached 17, and he has been eager to meet with you…”
The Lion Tribe’s Shaman had watched over him as he grew up, so although Kapp had effectively placed the other under house arrest, he had not taken any more aggressive actions,
Partly due to the bonds between them and partly because he recognized the Shaman’s wisdom and strength, Kapp hoped that Lide could subdue the Shaman and make him his assistant.
Lide was momentarily taken aback—a Level 17 Shaman? This was indeed new information.
When it comes to high-level combat powers, the more, the merrier.
By now, his Power of Faith had swelled to an astonishing 150,000 after months of accumulation.
So, subduing a Level 17 Shaman was no difficult feat.
“Alright, go and bring him to me.”
A flicker of reassurance passed through Lide’s eyes.
With Dawn City’s growth, Dwarf Valley hadn’t become superfluous; on the contrary, in the current period, it had become the public face of Dawn City.
Almost all operations first went through Dwarf Valley before proceeding outward.
This was a rule Lide had established previously.
To ensure Dawn City’s safety and secrecy, it would no longer make direct external contacts but would go through Dwarf Valley instead.
Although it added an extra step and became somewhat cumbersome, it ensured Dawn City’s security to the greatest extent.
The main reason Dawn City could develop so smoothly was its superior geographical location. As long as this advantage remained undiscovered, Dawn City could continue to grow safely and quietly.
Until the day Dawn City became strong enough to ignore all enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 328 330 The Almighty Divine Monster Asreaga
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 328: Chapter 330: The Almighty Divine Monster: Asreaga (10,000-Word Mega Chapter) Chapter 328: Chapter 330: The Almighty Divine Monster: Asreaga (10,000-Word Mega Chapter) “Ding~ You have hatched a Divine Being—Divine Monster, gaining 200,000 character experience.”
What?
Divine Monster??
Upon hearing the system’s notification, Lide’s expression was priceless.
Why would a Divine Monster, a mythical being from legends, hatch from a bronze egg he had seized from the Spider Plane??
Isn’t that a bit far-fetched…
Divine Monsters are born of divine beings that died young or creatures that received divinity and were cursed by divine beings.
There are countless types of Divine Monsters; no two are the same in the world. These bizarre, terrifying, and ferocious beings embody all the evil in the world—a great terror unimaginable, untouchable, and indescribable to ordinary people.
All beings of light and goodness curse Divine Monsters; they are the mortal enemies of all intelligent life.
The appearance of a Divine Monster could instill panic in a nation, even an entire plane.
Luckily, since ancient times, most Divine Monsters have been sealed by powerful divinities in the Abyss and various Lands of Extreme Evil.
Although the Main Plane of Glory has a long history, it seldom hears news of such extremely evil and cruel divine beings.
Yet now, the system was telling him that a seemingly insignificant bronze egg from the Spider Plane was harboring such an extremely evil and terrifying being.
Isn’t that a joke??
It gave him a surreal feeling, like accidentally finding a nuclear bomb while taking a casual walk outside.
Taking a deep breath to calm his mind, Lide’s gaze slowly returned to normal; his experienced heart had enough resilience.
To prevent any accidents, he immediately closed all the space gates inside the Land of Bone-Burying.
The existence of a Divine Monster was too evil; he couldn’t guarantee absolute safety.
Instantly, only the cracking bronze egg and the Cow Bone Undead trembling in fear in the corner remained in the Land of Bone-Burying.
The aura of Extreme Evil emitted by the Divine Monster could instill fear in any being in this world.
Even the undead belonging to the Evil Camp seemed as pure and innocent as maidens under the influence of the bronze egg’s aura.
Untouchable, unimaginable, indescribable.
The aura emitted by the Divine Monster, even to Lide, the Lord of the Land of Bone-Burying, contained a terrifying dread that sent shivers down his spine.
In the deathly silent Land of Bone-Burying, on the bone-strewn white skeletal ground, the ancient bronze egg began to crack little by little.
Crack~
Suddenly, a loud bang, and a forelimb with sharp claws emerged from the bronze eggshell; the world’s most evil being was about to be born…
Merely the appearance of this claw made the oppressive atmosphere inside the Land of Bone-Burying denser by more than tenfold, making even the deathly air seem to tremble.
The bizarre Cow Bone Undead had hidden as far away from the bronze egg as possible, its soul trembling, visibly emanating fear from its soul, a being that gained strength by gnawing on skeletons.
Lide’s eyes narrowed at this scene.
It was coming out…
After the sharp, scythe-like forelimb tore open the bronze eggshell,
Crack~ The originally barely intact bronze egg shattered as if a piece of glass heated to a high temperature was suddenly thrown into cold water.
Bang~
A crisp sound echoed in the Land of Bone-Burying.
At the moment the bronze egg burst, a heartfelt, ominous burst of chaotic light flashed.
The body of the Divine Monster emerging from the eggshell suddenly swelled, growing to a height of three blades before Lide could even blink; conventional logic simply did not apply to this divine being.
As the pale white, mixed with pale green and pale blue, chaotic light faded, the true form of the Divine Monster appeared before Lide.
Powerful and evil—that was Lide’s first impression of the Divine Monster before him.
Three blades tall, its strong body appeared as if it had been molded by melting bronze and then poured into a sculpture crafted by the finest artisan in the world, each inch, each muscle exuding an explosively powerful force that made one’s heart tremble.
Beyond imagination, incomparable.
With dark gray wings that cannot be described for their terror sprouting from its back, the gruesome barbs on those flesh wings could make a warrior holding a thick shield tremble in fear—they were the bloodiest of weapons.
Its narrow eyes glinted with an extreme murderous intent, embodying the purest form of evil, devoid of any trace of humanity or kindness.
That was the gaze of a demon, the whispers of a Grim Reaper, the indescribable terror that came from a Divine Monster.
Its horns slightly curved, forming a bow shape, exuded a sense of strength.
Covered in gray skin, its densely inscribed body emitted a chilling aura of Extreme Evil.
These were the marks passed down by the Ancient Gods, blasphemous language, words that could end the world—mere sight of which could drive ordinary humans instantly into madness.
The hands of the Divine Monster were not humanlike but were dagger-sharp claws; no one could doubt the lethal capability of those cold, gleaming claws, strong enough to slice through dragon scales.
Behind it, a tail as long as five spears, reminiscent of a knight’s lance, carried a deadly and dangerous presence. The tip of the tail sported a pitch-black eye, as hard as forged metal spear tips or like an abysmal eye choosing its prey, its mere movement enough to send chills down one’s spine and make one’s hairs stand on end.
It seemed like the next second, that tail of Extreme Evil might launch a devastating strike.
A killing machine.
Every part of this Divine Monster’s body was honed for slaughter.
The claw-like fingers sharp as daggers, the barbs on the wings that could tear shields apart, the abyssal eye-like sharp tail tip, the scythe-like hooks on its knees, and toes colder than razors.
No one could imagine the exaggerated destructive power this being would unleash upon entering an enemy’s ranks.
Lide suppressed his emotions and opened the attribute panel of the Divine Monster.
The attributes displayed made him take a deep breath.
This Divine Monster truly lived up to its name… these attributes were against the heavens.
Agares the Destructor
Title: God Eater (Once devoured the bodies of divine beings during the Ancient Battle, all attributes +1000%, and damage caused to the Light Attribute and Natural Divine System factions increased by 1000%)
Curser of the Gods (Cursed by the gods and in return, cursing the gods, causes panic in beings with a Legend Level below 50, decreasing all attributes by 30%.
Gaining eternal life in the curse, as long as its divinity persists, Divine Monster remains immortal, even if torn apart, it can reincarnate. Damage caused to beings with divine power increased by 1000%)
Age: 2,689,877 years
Level: 19
Divinity: 10 points (Each death, resurrection requires 5 divinity points)
Profession: God Eater (Devouring divine beings or divine life forms gains more power)
Divine Monster Talent: Extreme Evil (Can devour all negative energies to permanently increase its own power, and has a 10% chance to acquire the skill of the devoured.)
Eternal Body (Advanced) (Immune to Five Circle or below spells, physical defense increased by 2000%, body recovery speed increased by 2000%, can devour negative energy to heal injuries, immune to instant death spells)
Body of Divine Monster (Contains tremendous destructive power within its body, unable to wear any equipment, but gains additional traits: Indomitable Body, Indomitable Body (Basic) limbs as sharp as Extraordinary Weapons, body as solid as an Extraordinary Shield, can devour Extreme Evil energy for Evolution.)
Space Mastery (After devouring a Bronze Dragon Egg and half a Plane’s Plane Power, it attained extremely strong spatial affinity and control capabilities, can freely traverse various Planes without being repelled by the Plane Will, immune to all space-based spells)
Bloodline: Extremely Evil Blood (Immune to all control skills, soul and mind skills, all negative statuses, carries a Five Circle Demon Aura—Soul Enslavement, every 10 seconds within 50 feet, enemies are hit by a Five Circle spell shock, if they fail a spiritual resistance check, their soul is enslaved)
Introduction: Survived the Battle of the Ancient Gods, hid in a Bronze Dragon Egg to evade the gods’ detection. Although most of its power was lost during its slumber, its divinity remains unextinguished, still possessing terrifying potential and power. Permanently at odds with the Light God System and Natural Divine System, permanently enemies with the Good and Neutral camps.
Seeing the attributes of the Divine Monster gave Lide a tingling sensation on his scalp.
Even though this Level 19 Divine Monster didn’t have many skills, each was terrifying.
First, the two titles—God Eater (All attributes +1000%, increases damage against the Light Attribute and Natural Divine System factions by 1000%), Curser of the Gods (Causes panic in beings with a Legend Level below 50, decreasing all attributes by 30%. As long as divinity is not extinguished, the Divine Monster remains immortal, damage against divine-powered beings increased by 1000%).
These titles were ridiculously powerful, almost bursting the scale—Lide thought that the two titles he gained after activating his Divine Position couldn’t even compete.
A Divine Monster truly does not play by the rules of strength.
The remaining skills—Extreme Evil, Eternal Body, Body of Divine Monster, and Space Mastery,
Added up with the Bloodline: Extremely Evil Blood.
Lide scrolled back and forth several times to review the skills, and finally had to admit, the combat power of this Divine Monster was beyond the skies.
Just summarizing it made him feel goosebumps arise.
Immune to all negative statuses, immune to Five Circle and below spells, immune to space-type spells, immune to instant death and mind-control skills, as long as it still had divinity, it could continuously resurrect, freely traverse spaces, and permanently enhance its own power by devouring negative energy…
And an exaggerated percentage increase in all attributes…
Lide was somewhat tempted to ask, “Is there anyone within Level 19 who can contend with this Divine Monster?”
“I’m not targeting anyone… but all those at Level 19 are a pleasure to behold.”
“These life forms that survived from ancient times really don’t make any sense.”
It took a while before Lide could somewhat calm his spirit.
However, his expression turned complicated after seeing the Divine Monster. Could this creature possibly devour its master?
It was impossible to comprehend the existence of a Divine Monster, and he couldn’t determine it either.
With a thought, he directly connected to the Plane Stone of the Land of Bone-Burying.
Moments later, he sighed in great relief.
He could feel that his soul mark was imprinted on the soul of the Divine Monster the moment it was born at Level 19.
At this moment, the Divine Monster, which had survived from ancient times until now, was under his control.
Furthermore, due to the Power of Faith, he felt his control over the Divine Monster was even greater than the first life born in the Land of Bone-Burying, the Cow Bone Undead.
With a thought, Lide waved his hand in his office, and under the watchful eyes of Harrison, who had been quietly waiting for him, opened the Space Gate to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Zzzap—
The space shattered, but just as the Space Gate opened,
the Level 19 Divine Monster, sensing the presence of an outsider, suddenly turned around. Its narrow, crimson eyes emitted a lethal ferocity, and its sharp claws fiercely slashed through the air, the blade-like chill gleaming upon them.
Tap, tap—
Tap, tap—
Lide stepped through the Space Gate in his black Mage robe, looking directly with an indifferent gaze into the cruel and bloodthirsty crimson eyes of the Divine Monster,
as if the terrifying gaze that could shatter the resolve of a stalwart warrior didn’t exist.
After getting slightly closer to the Divine Monster, Lide could see more clearly the killing machine towering three blades high.
A sense of oppressive force from its massive form hit him face-on.
Yet, he faced it as if it was merely air, his gaze indifferent.
“Asreaga the Destroyer…”
However, before Lide could finish his words, the Level 19 Divine Monster suddenly stepped forward a few paces, then knelt on one knee before Lide.
That head, bearing enormous bull horns, deeply bowed.
“Father God…”
Father God? What an odd title.
And this language…?
The words spoken by Asreaga were in none of the languages Lide had ever heard, though he could understand their meaning.
This unfamiliar language even made his skin crawl; he could vividly feel that the words of this Divine Monster were spoken in an Ancient Profanity, older and more malevolent than the three Extreme Evil languages: Abyss Profanity, Undead Profanity, and Hell Profanity.
The tone and intonation were strange, accompanied by a strong mental impact and soul cleansing, enough to cause a mental breakdown in ordinary people upon hearing this language.
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly; if it was Father God, then Father God it would be. He looked piercingly at Asreaga.
“My child, Asreaga, why were you slumbering inside a Bronze Dragon Egg?”
This was what puzzled Lide the most. From the system’s description, it was known that the egg hatching the Divine Monster was a Bronze Dragon’s egg.
It was unbelievable that a Divine Monster could enter and survive countless years inside a Bronze Dragon egg.
The Bronze Dragons, masters of space among dragons, are counted alongside the Golden Giant Dragons and the Five-Color Dragons as one of the three great races of the Dragon Clan.
The ancient Bronze Dragons were capable of contending with deities, and the protective nature of dragonkind was well-known in Glory, let alone among the Bronze Dragons, a mighty and rare species.
Upon hearing this, Asreaga, the Level 19 Divine Monster, appeared slightly stunned, a trace of confusion flashing in his eyes. After trying to remember for a moment, he shook his head.
That ancient language of evil rose again.
“Father God… countless years of slumber have caused me to lose most of my power and memories. I only remember that I was torn apart by an indescribable mighty deity, then fell into a long sleep.”
Some confusion lingered on Asreaga’s face, etched with evil inscriptions.
Sleep had overtaken him for far too long, so long that he had forgotten everything about his past.
Lide’s mouth twitched slightly; being torn apart by divine beings, it must have been the gods who killed him.
However, the fact that the other party had lost their memory was somewhat regrettable to him.
During the ancient times, there had been several Battles of the Gods, but much of that information had been lost to time and the intentional actions of some.
Now a Divine Monster, alive for over two million years, lacked those buried memories, which made him feel a sense of loss.
If the other party still remembered his former treasure, the Divine Artifacts…
Cough cough, indeed it was impossible for him to have all the good fortunes to himself.
“Asreaga, how were you born?”
The birth of Divine Monsters had always been a mystery in Glory; some wandering poets said that after the divine beings fell, Divine Monsters were the grudges of the gods born from divine corpses,
there were also legends that Divine Monsters were Divine Sons born from divine beings, naturally possessing divine power but easily cursed by the abyss and hell; once cursed, the Divine Sons would turn into Divine Monsters, becoming undying beings.
Although Divine Monsters were renown for being undying, if their divinity was eroded away, they could still be killed.
However, because the divinity was so overwhelming, even divine beings needed a long time to erode it, so most defeated Divine Monsters were just sealed by divine beings in secretive places, hoping to destroy them over time.
It wasn’t that the divine beings didn’t want to kill these Divine Monsters outright, but rather that they couldn’t; the divinity was indestructible, and even if their bodies were torn apart and their souls strangled, they would reconstitute in some land of extreme evil; sealing thus was the best countermeasure.
Asreaga, looking at Lide’s serious expression, seemed puzzled, “Father God, it was you who granted me rebirth.
In the chaos and the void, I heard your call; you reshaped my body with the Power of Death, formed my soul with divine power…”
Me?
Lide was slightly stunned but still felt somewhat helpless looking at Asreaga’s serious expression.
This guy, it seemed, really had lost most of his memories.
After a moment of thought, he grew curious about the process that had revived Asreaga.
He hadn’t expected that the Power of Death and Power of Faith would turn out to be the key to activating Asreaga.
“It must be that the Power of Death formed Asreaga’s body first, followed by the Power of Faith which formed the soul;
This was the only explanation for why the Bronze Egg’s panel stated it required powerful life force for incubation, yet Death’s Power was used in the end.”
Subsequently, Lide asked Asreaga some questions, but still failed to gain any useful information.
This Divine Monster, speaking the Ancient Profanity, knew nothing about the past except for being killed by divine beings; all memories had been lost with his power during the long slumber.
This made Lide lose interest in continuing the conversation.
“Asreaga, my army is fighting in the Underworld, I will send you to…”
This was a Level 19 Divine Monster, whose powerful battle capabilities could undoubtedly become his ace.
With Asreaga stationed in the Underworld, he could pull his forces from below, as the players were about to arrive; he needed to personally oversee the upcoming upheaval.
“Asreaga will follow your orders, Father God…”
In front of Lide, the Father God who had granted him new life, this ancient Divine Monster with two horns and an evil existence was very submissive.
This eased Lide’s initial worries.
His biggest fear about sealing the Land of Bone-Burying was the weirdness and unknown nature of Divine Monsters; after all, Divine Monsters were beings even divine beings dared hunt, no one could be sure if they would turn against their master, but clearly, he had been overthinking it.
“Asreaga, before you head to the battlefield, you need to learn to use the common language of Glory.
The Ancient Profanity you speak is too evil; my subordinates cannot converse with you.”
As the Blood Clan Ancestor, whose blood had been purified by the remnants of divine beings, Lide naturally did not need to elaborate on his Magic Resistance.
But if his strength was discomforted by the Ancient Profanity of this Divine Monster, one could imagine how ordinary subordinates would fare against this terrifying being.
This was a difference in the level of life, unbridgeable.
After all, Asreaga had previously battled divine beings; the divinity within him was a living presence.
“Yes, Father God…”
Lide looked pleased at the Level 19 Divine Monster, and with a wave of his hand, reopened several Space Gates that he had just closed.
Currently, there are four Space Gates opened in the Land of Bone-Burying.
One gate was fixed at the breeding farm, another opened at the walls of Dawn City, and the other two were created at the entrance to Giant Valley leading into the underworld and in the passage of the underworld.
Through the establishment of these space gates, the transportation efficiency of Dawn City’s military and other later-stage supplies was immediately and dramatically improved.
For example, troops could be dispatched directly from the space behind the walls of Dawn City into the underworld passages.
What used to require Magic Language Bats for a journey of five or six Sunshine Hours could now be reduced to less than a minute, saving a great deal of time and energy in logistics.
However, the opening of the space gates required a certain amount of Power of Death. The more supplies that passed through and the longer the opening time and the greater the distance, the more power was consumed, which limited Lide’s idea of opening unlimited space gates within Dawn City.
But overall, the space gate at the Land of Bone-Burying was indeed another trump card in Lide’s hand.
The fact that Grey Stone Castle could remain firmly implanted at the entrance to the underworld facing the endless onslaught of Cave Spiders without a scratch over these past few months, was undeniably due to the enormous logistical support system at its core.
Without Crossbows capable of removing magazines, without continuous bombing from Alchemy Bombs, without various solid equipment and a rich reserve of supplies, Grey Stone Castle could not have withstood the endless assault of Cave Spiders that occupy half a plane.
Dawn City was confronting half a plane with the strength of a single city. And how long had the Cave Spiders existed? Fifty thousand years? A hundred thousand years?
In terms of comprehensive strength, the Cave Spiders were far stronger than Dawn City.
Dawn City relied on its incredible tenacity to forcefully target the Cave Spiders.
“Father God, so many fresh souls, is this all food for me?”
At the moment Lide activated the space gate, Asreaga immediately sensed the tempting souls outside the gate.
The bloodthirsty desire in his eyes stirred.
The presence unique to the Divine Monster once again permeated the Land of Bone-Burying.
The Cow Bone Undead, which had just caught its breath, trembled once more and curled up again, this time the bizarre skeleton dared not even look at Asreaga, as if afraid that the evil being would commit a heaven-defying atrocity.
So scared…
“Father God, at the deepest part of this plane there is a life full of Light Power.
That must be an angel from the Light God System, right?
Father God, I smell weakness in her soul…”
Asreaga turned his gaze towards the White Bone Altar just as Lide was about to open his mouth to explain.
The terrifying aura that made one’s blood run cold intensified.
“She also contains rich divinity… Father God, that is my food…”
Lide’s mouth twitched harshly.
So, you’re not just talking about the humans outside, you want to target that Twelve-winged Blazing Angel too?
If you hadn’t lost your power, maybe it would be feasible, but now… even though injured and asleep, the opponent is a Divine Creature above level 30, capable of killing you in a second if awakened.
“Asreaga, outside is Dawn City, all life there is under my command, they are the foundation of Dawn City’s rise, you must protect them from enemies instead of harming them.”
Lide’s expression grew serious, this Divine Monster was too strong; if it went berserk, no one in Dawn City could control it except him, so it was essential to give a warning.
Hearing this, Asreaga nodded, the bloodthirstiness in his eyes slightly faded.
“Yes, Father God, those are all your personal property, I will protect your food…”
Food? Lide smirked, it seemed the being was not wrong, after all, the Bloodline’s food is indeed blood, although now the residents of Dawn City offered their blood more willingly than anyone…
“The angel within the Land of Bone-Burying was once suppressed by me, she is a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, a Divine Creature above level 30, and the Seventh War General under the Master of Dawn.
She is still slumbering, but the power within her is not something you can consume.”
He refused Asreaga’s idea mercilessly.
If Lide could consume her, he wouldn’t allow this creature to do so either, after all, she was a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
After accumulating more Power of Death, he would be able to hasten his transformation of her.
Compared to this level 19 Divine Monster, a level 30 Blazing Angel fascinated him more.
Only the long conversion time of over ten thousand years had previously dampened his spirits, but after fighting the Cave Spiders and accumulating Power of Death, he saw a chance to transform the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
So, no matter whether Asreaga could consume her or not, he would ruthlessly refuse.
Go play by yourself; want to compete with me for an angel? Ever seen a fist as big as a sandbag?
And besides, how impressive would it be to bring out an angel; everyone would be envious.
If he carried a Divine Monster with him, it would be like hanging a golden taunting halo around himself; any sane person would want to kill him.
After all, “Divine Monster” was synonymous with destruction, making even an extremely evil being like an Abyss Demon seem dull in comparison.
“Yes, Father God…”
After the Divine Monster’s soul was reshaped by the Power of Faith, it began to obey Lide’s commands unconditionally.
At that moment, Lide also realized this, and with a thought, he stopped observing Asreaga through the Plane Stone and directly communicated his Power of Faith… A moment later, his eyes shifted.
Lide could clearly perceive through his Power of Faith the Spiritual Sea and soul of Asreaga.
Even if he wanted, he could now directly control or erase the other’s soul through the Power of Faith.
This discovery made Lide’s eyes reveal a hint of contemplation.
“My only Divine Art: Soul Assimilation, uses the Power of Faith to forcibly change the soul attribute of the other party to gain their faith, and the soul of Asreaga this time was entirely condensed by the Power of Faith.
Thus, although this Divine Monster hasn’t become a Holy Temple Knight of the Dawn Sect or anything else, I have already mastered his soul.
No wonder the legendary synonym for destruction is so obedient.”
After some reflection, a smile appeared on Lide’s face.
Glory is a real world, so solely studying skills from the attribute panel’s descriptions and explanations would leave many hidden attributes undiscovered, hence further exploration is necessary.
After slightly clarifying his thoughts, Lide waved his hand and opened a Space Gate leading to the office.
Harrison had just sensed a fleeting Divine Monster aura in the Land of Bone-Burying as Lide opened the Space Gate, causing him to shudder.
Though he had great confidence in Lide, he couldn’t help but feel a bit worried and stayed in the office without leaving.
The mysterious presence made his heart palpitate.
Seeing Lide emerging again brought a trace of joy to his face, but his expression changed upon seeing Asreaga, the level 19 Divine Monster, appearing behind him.
Danger, extreme danger.
Even just a glance at Asreaga made Harrison’s scalp tingle, and every cell in his body was reminding him of the terror of this being.
“Clan Leader…”
Sensing the undisguised gravity in Harrison’s eyes, Lide revealed a smile.
“Harrison, this is Asreaga… a new member of Dawn City.”
After a brief introduction, he casually added,
“Asreaga is a Divine Monster who survived from the ancient times.”
Gulp.
Harrison, who had been managing the City Hall of Dawn City through countless trials over the years, subconsciously swallowed his saliva.
His eyes, filled with incredulous brightness, stared at the evil presence towering over 9 feet, with double horns on its head and wings on its back.
A Divine Monster?!
This, how is this possible?!
A Divine Monster, that was the extremely evil entity daring to kill even the Divines.
The Clan Leader could even subdue a Divine Monster??
With this thought, Harrison’s eyes revealed a fervent admiration.
Asreaga seemed to sense something, his narrow crimson eyes glanced at him once, but even this simple glance made Harrison feel like his soul had frozen.
Terror, sheer terror!
“Concerning matters of Dawn City, explain them to Asreaga, and also go to the Dawn Mage Tower to find a few mages who can solidify the common language of the continent.
Asreaga currently uses the Ancient Profanity, a language that can even defile the Divines, believe me, you won’t want to hear him speak.”
Harrison took a deep breath, and although he had received many tasks from Lide’s hands before, this was the first time he truly felt pressure.
A pressure emanating from the depths of his soul.
Facing Asreaga made him feel a heartfelt fear, an intimidation from a higher being that was unavoidable.
Although Bloodline was considered an Upper Race, compared to a Divine Monster with divinity, it was still a far cry.
Looking out across Dawn City, except for that Twelve-winged Angel suppressed by the Land of Bone-Burying, only Lide could slightly dominate this Divine Monster.
After all, Lide himself had undergone a Divine Calamity, strong and resilient enough to make knees weak.
“Yes, Clan Leader.”
“Asreaga, you and Harrison go down. Remember, this city is my city, the residents aren’t your food. The Underworld will have the souls you need.
Harrison will hand over everything about Dawn City to you, and you must follow Harrison’s orders.”
Lide’s will was a divine decree that Asreaga, a level 19 Divine Monster, couldn’t refuse; he immediately nodded.
“Father God, Asreaga obeys your commands…”
The moment those blasphemous words in the Ancient Profanity echoed within the room, Harrison’s face drastically changed; he even sensed the murderous emotions rushing to his brain, turning his eyes blood-red instantly.
How?!!
He hurriedly took a few deep breaths, and only after Asreaga remained silent did Harrison manage to suppress that killing intent.
When the City Hall chairman recuperated and looked at Asreaga again, his expression became solemn.
This Divine Monster… too powerful.
Lide also noticed Harrison’s earlier state and turned to glance at Asreaga, his eyes filled with some emotion.
This was still a Divine Monster that had lost most of its power. If it were in its prime, how powerful could it be?
And how powerful would the divine being that could kill this Divine Monster be?
Still need to grow… the outside world is full of bosses.
“Asreaga, until you learn the common ‘Glory’ language, you are not allowed to use Ancient Profanity in public,” Lide instructed.
The Divine Monster, sporting two large curved horns, was slightly startled but immediately nodded.
But this time, he remained silent.
Harrison finally sighed in relief and promptly led Asreaga away; although Asreaga made him feel uneasy, any task Lide assigned must be completed immediately regardless of the circumstances.
Watching the two disappear through the door, Lide wore a complex expression.
“Raising a Divine Monster, tsk tsk, feels much more formidable than raising a giant dragon…
The only trouble is that this guy absolutely cannot appear in the Human Empire.
Otherwise, Dawn City would face encirclement and suppression from the entire main Plane of Glory.
Good grief, Asreaga makes enemies with both the Light God System and the Natural Divine System, as well as the Good Camp and Order Camp.
The mocking aura on this guy is definitely maxed out; Withered Bone, the chatterbox, is just like a little brother before Asreaga.
And once his identity as a Divine Monster is exposed, needless to say, even the strongest empire in the central region of the main Plane of Glory would be alarmed.”
Thinking of this, Lide couldn’t help feeling both delighted and troubled.
Asreaga’s strength was undeniable; he would undoubtedly be a super trump card in his hand, and this Divine Monster’s potential was also terrifyingly formidable; with some time to grow, even slaying gods was not an unreachable dream in the future.
But his identity meant he would have to live in the Underworld for a long time and couldn’t appear on the battlefield in the surface world.
If the Undead Clan was considered a public enemy by all life on the main Plane of Glory, then Divine Monsters were fear incarnate.
Because, according to legend, once a Divine Monster appeared, it would destroy the entire Plane, a literal annihilation, these supremely evil beings’ ultimate pursuit being silence in the world; they would tear the Plane apart into nothingness, turning it into chaos.
Even the Undead could not tolerate such extreme madness, which is why Divine Monsters were so feared.
The Bronze Egg had hatched, settling one of Lide’s desires.
But seeing the Power of Death on his attribute panel, which had been accumulated over several months and was now depressingly empty, he couldn’t help but show a bitter smile.
“I thought I was going to be rich, but in the blink of an eye, I’m back to square one.
This is really… too hard.”
“And at this rate, when will the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel be successfully converted? A level 30 Divine Being, much tougher than Asreaga.”
The Twelve-winged Blazing Angel had almost become an obsession for him; the scene of forcibly preventing the god from descending to the Bone-Burying Plane had never faded from his mind.
But it was clear that the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel was not coming out any time soon.
“And about upgrading the Land of Bone-Burying from rare to rare, it needs a million Power of Death, and at current rates, should take about a month. But when will my Frost Giant Dragon be recruited?”
Moreover, according to the current situation, recruiting the Frost Giant Dragon would definitely require an astronomical amount of the Power of Death.”
Even hatching an egg consumed over 3 million units of the Power of Death, and even that wasn’t enough, it also required 200,000 units of the Power of Faith. God knows how much Power of Death it would cost to recruit a Frost Giant Dragon, the ultimate life form of the Undead race.
After a moment of thought, Lide couldn’t help but show a wry smile. “This is too difficult.”
He felt his poverty once again.
The bigger the enterprise expanded, the poorer he became.
When Dawn City was first developing, it lacked basic resources such as food, cotton, and steel, but now that it had grown to a point where not even Gold Puck was lacking, it lacked high-level rare resources like the Power of Faith, Power of Death, and Magic Crystal Stone.
He felt like he had never been wealthy.
Thinking about it, Lide suddenly laughed out loud.
“A poor sod who can make a few hundred thousand Gold Pucks a month?”
“Isn’t that a bit too much? I am Little Ma; even though I make hundreds of billions a year, I have no interest in money, I haven’t touched money my whole life…”
“I am Brother Qiang. I have face blindness. I don’t even know if my wife is beautiful…”
“I grew up in an ordinary family…”
“Ten billion is just a moderate amount, let’s set a small target for him first, say, one billion…”
Indeed, on the road to success, one still needs to learn from the tycoons.
Three Sunshine Hours later.
Lide nodded in satisfaction at Asreaga, who had been brought back by Harrison.
“Have you learned the common tongue?”
“Yes, Father God…”
When Asreaga spoke, it was already in the common tongue of Glory, but the strange accent made it a bit uncomfortable.
But however uncomfortable, it was much better in Harrison’s eyes than the Ancient Profanity that Asreaga had spoken before.
That was a terrifying language not bearable by the life on the Main Plane; he could hardly endure it.
Harrison even suspected that this Level 19 Divine Monster, merely reciting the Ancient Profanity in the airspace above a human city, could cause the entire city’s populace to mentally break down.
“Very well, Harrison must have already communicated the basics about Dawn City to you.
We are now conquering the Underworld, and I plan to bring that vast land under my domain.
Currently, the Cave Spiders that occupy half the plane are hindering our progress.
And I need you to fight for me.
Asreaga, are you willing to become the sharp blade of Dawn City, become my spear in hand, become the eternal nightmare of all enemies?!”
Asreaga looked at the domineering and forceful Lide standing before him, his narrow crimson eyes flashing a frenzy.
It was an unconditional trust and worship toward Lide. The loyalty of this Divine Monster, whose soul was reshaped by Lide, was no less than that of anyone else.
“Father God, Asreaga will fight for you with my soul, my divinity, my everything.
One day we will surely kill those filthy, disgusting gods, behead them, shatter their Divine Countries, and devour their believers.
This world will ultimately belong to you—the great Dawn God who masters blood and Bloodline.”
Hearing these fanatical words, Lide’s heart shuddered. “Are you trying to defy the heavens? Wake up; you’re not at Level 20 yet; you’re not the same Divine Monster as before.
If I let you out, it wouldn’t take three days before the churches with immense hidden power would send Legendary fighters to kill you, and some of those ancient Demigods might even show themselves.
“Asreaga, follow me, you will become my sharpest spear in conquering the Underworld.”
Fortunately, the Underworld hasn’t been conquered yet; deploying the Divine Monster there is making the most out of him. No worries about him being discovered.
Moreover, Asreaga’s Extremely Evil Talent—able to devour all negative energy to permanently increase his strength—suitably fits the current state of the Underworld.
This talent has a knack similar to the Bloodline’s growth through devouring fresh blood.
Of course, the potential of this Divine Monster is definitely higher than an average member of the Bloodline.
“Yes, Father God…”

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 329 331 Testing the Edge of the Divine Monster
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 329: Chapter 331: Testing the Edge of the Divine Monster (11,000 words) Battle Chapter Chapter 329: Chapter 331: Testing the Edge of the Divine Monster (11,000 words) Battle Chapter Lide made some arrangements before tearing the space before him and entered the Land of Bone-Burying with Asreaga.
By then, the Land of Bone-Burying no longer had the deathly Power of Death that was almost condensed into a mist; the air within the two thousand diameter bone burial ground was exceptionally clear.
It was very much like the tragic state after three rounds of using the “big precious sword” every day for ten days—really not a drop left.
Lide, looking at the squeaky-clean Land of Bone-Burying, felt somewhat helpless; this time, it was truly a regression to the pre-liberation era.
Fortunately, the level 19 Divine Monster was sufficiently against the heavens, ensuring that he did not make a loss. Otherwise, all the spider skeletons would have gone to waste.
With a sharp glance around the Land of Bone-Burying, he suddenly saw that the Cow Bone Undead, which had been leisurely moments ago, had now hidden itself in a corner.
Seeing the trembling Cow Bone Undead, Lide couldn’t help but find it slightly amusing; this creature was indeed a unique one.
Fearful?
You’re an Undead; what else could make you feel fear?
You are a synonym for fear…
An Undead being scared like this is truly unprecedented.
He spared a glance at the Cow Bone Undead, who didn’t even dare look at Asreaga, shook his head, and said no more. Just let it grow on its own; he had no expectations of it amounting to anything significant.
Without lingering, Lide took the level 19 Divine Monster and departed from the Land of Bone-Burying through another partly closed Space Gate.
Whether for slaughtering pigs in the Land of Bone-Burying or for transporting goods, a Space Gate was necessary. However, the space was not operational twenty-four Sunshine Hours every day.
Maintaining a Space Gate for long durations consumed a considerable amount of the Power of Death; keeping it open all the time would be too costly and inefficient.
Lide spent a long time researching this issue and finally found a solution.
He left a Spirit Imprint on the Plane Stone of the Land of Bone-Burying so that designated personnel could activate the Space Gate, which was usually closed, by bringing one of his specially-made scrolls to it. The imprint on the Plane Stone would harness the Land of Bone-Burying’s power to open the Space Gate and allow passage.
It was as if he had installed an intelligent remote control system in the Land of Bone-Burying—those with the key could enter, but without it, they couldn’t open the door.
This thought-out usage that Lide had developed with much effort was something he found quite satisfactory, as it did not delay urgent military affairs, conserved resources as much as possible, and allowed the Space Gate to remain open for transit whenever needed—exceedingly convenient.
But to be honest, it all came from being poor; if he had plenty of the Power of Death, he wouldn’t bother nickel-and-diming like this.
After Lide and Asreaga left, the Cow Bone Undead, which had buried its head in the ground as though it wished to squeeze into the bones, cautiously raised its head.
Finally, after making sure from all sides with its hollow eye sockets several times that the figure that had made its soul shiver had indeed left, it relaxed greatly.
With an almost anthropomorphic flop, it sat down on the ground and with its bony hooves patted its ribcage; its soul trembled within its head.
Mother of pearl, that scared the life out of me…
After the Cow Bone Undead caught its breath, it looked around a few times, then, as if having remembered something urgent, it suddenly bounded from the ground and started digging holes in the white bone-covered ground like a goofball…
This world is too dangerous; I must build my house underground…
Lide didn’t notice the Cow Bone Undead’s silly actions; upon leaving the Land of Bone-Burying, the environment before him darkened instantly.
In front of him was an underground space approximately 20 blades high and 200 blades in length and width.
The warm yellow light from Magic Lamps illuminated the space on the rocky walls all around.
Many logistics personnel were busy arranging the goods transported from Dawn City: food, armor, crossbow bolts, fresh water… and so on, countless supplies were piled on the ground.
Busy, yet orderly.
Upon seeing Lide’s figure, the logistics personnel’s eyes lit up with fervor, a hint of zeal flashing across their faces.
They all bowed in unison to Lide with a hand on their chest.
“Good day, your Highness…”
“Your loyal Believers greet you, great Dawn Sovereign.”
“Kachar City Lord, we warmly welcome your arrival…”
“….”
They all addressed Lide differently, but without exception, all were filled with respect.
It was a respect and worship that came from deep within, without any external pressure, because they all knew.
The tall and handsome figure before them was their guardian deity, their future.
“Good day, my people….”
Lide nodded with a smile, having been through similar situations too many times to count, making him somewhat numb to it.
At that moment, behind him, Asreaga’s long, narrow, violent crimson eyes narrowed slightly. This Divine Monster had an insight and Perception that outsiders could hardly imagine.
He could even effortlessly sense the fluctuations emanating from the souls of the residents when they faced Lide.
This peculiar soul fluctuation made him start to ponder.
“Father God, are these your Believers?
I have memorized their soul’s scent…
Your believers will be protected by Asreaga…”
Hearing the level 19 Divine Monster’s words with a strange tone behind him, Lide turned around, his expression somewhat peculiar.
“You remembered the soul aura of those people? With so many in Dawn City, it’s impossible for you to remember just these few, let alone everyone…”
“Ancestor,” Asreaga shook his head and began to explain, “Each divine being’s believers or worshippers emit a unique aura of the soul due to the different divine positions and doctrines held by the deities.
The followers of evil divinities emit an aura that is violent and cruel, while the followers of the Light God System exude an aura filled with nauseating Holy Light…
Your believers and worshippers also emit a distinct aura from that of any other deity’s followers…
So as long as they are your believers or worshippers, I can sense them.”
Hearing this explanation, Lide took another glance at Asreaga, thinking that a Divine Monster indeed isn’t ordinary—being an existence even the gods can’t kill is truly something else.
The soul’s aura is extremely faint, particularly that of ordinary people. Even he could barely sense it, much less distinguish further.
In comparison, the perception of Asreaga, this Divine Monster, was disturbingly strong.
“Very well, Asreaga, these believers and worshippers are our wealth, and I believe you will perform to my satisfaction.”
Lide nodded and gave a word of caution.
The soul of this Divine Monster had been reshaped by the Power of Faith, and he noticed that the other’s behavior had become more normal. Though the aura remained violent and fierce, it no longer reveled in destruction as the Legendary Divine Monsters of the tales did.
This discovery pleased Lide; he favored orderly subordinates. The chaotic madmen were something he couldn’t accept.
After a brief conversation and seeing the growing number of residents around him, Lide waved his hand and didn’t linger any longer; he unfolded his Dawn Wings and took Asreaga with him to the Underworld.
The battlefield where they faced the Cave Spiders required the presence of this level 19 Divine Monster; he had no time to waste.
He also wanted to test just how formidable the battle prowess of this attribute panel filled with nearly bug-like skills and Divine Monster was.
Flying in the dimly lit underground tunnels didn’t pose an obstacle for either of them.
As a member of the Bloodline, Lide was a natural creature of darkness, seeing better the darker the environment, and Asreaga, being a Divine Monster, needless to say, almost had his All Attributes maxed out.
Whether in pitch-black space or even in magma, this Divine Monster could maintain more than enough condition.
Walking from the Land of Bone-Burying through the space channel to the Underworld would take two days, but flying there didn’t even take two Sunshine Hours.
The underground passages that were expanded at no small cost now consistently had a height of about 10 to 15 blades and a width of around 20 blades; although it wasn’t as free as flying above ground, it wasn’t too bad either.
However, at this moment, Lide didn’t know that the Underworld had already undergone a sudden change.
—
—
—
Bang~
Zzzt~
Betty’s close-fitting armor was struck by a level 17 Bone Armor Spider that suddenly sprung from behind. Although the razor-sharp Turtle Teeth didn’t penetrate the Extraordinary Armor’s defenses, the immense force still made Betty taste blood in her mouth, which then trickled from the corner of her lips.
And the two level 15 Ghost-faced Spiders in front had already closed in to attack while the Bone Armor Spider launched a surprise assault, giving the Northern Land Valkyrie no time to breathe.
Seeing this, Betty didn’t retreat. Her sharp gaze was even more piercing than that of eagles, and her fighting spirit surged like the tide.
Northern warriors are fearless and undaunted.
Facing giant dragons, Northern people would dare to charge—the battlefield is no place for them to take a single step back.
Enduring the intense pain from the back, Betty forcibly twisted her body, her pitch-black Extraordinary Giant Sword swung fiercely, cracking~
The level 17 Bone Armor Spider that had just attacked Betty didn’t have time to retract; in the instant the cold light flashed, the massive spider head burst apart.
Splurt~ Green viscous fluid splattered in all directions.
The two level 15 Ghost-faced Spiders were already upon her, leaving no time for Betty to dodge, but she paid no heed to their attacks. The strength contained within her body tensed like a coiled spring at its limit, then exploded in an instant.
Splurt~ The moment the level 15 Ghost-faced Spiders attacked Betty, two huge heads flew high into the air.
Burp~
Betty spat out another mouthful of scalding blood. Facing three top-level combat forces, she suffered minor injuries, but her opponents—all dead.
But in an instant, Betty’s wounds returned to normal.
Northern Royal Bloodline, possessing the Extraordinary Traits: Fearless.
Activating the bloodline grants immunity to pain, immunity to mental magic effects, Extraordinary Traits: Fearless strengthened threefold, strength increased by 100%, stamina and Life recovery speeds increased by 1000%, and can harness the power of the Bloodline to heal bodily wounds, with a duration of one Sunshine Hour.
Although she had killed three high-level Cave Spiders, Betty’s expression became extremely grave.
Because the scene beneath Grey Stone Castle’s walls was truly alarming.
In front of the city walls at a distance of 50 blades, three giant holes lay side by side as if meteors had smashed into the ground and formed these huge pits. That wasn’t the main issue; the key was that these pitch-black tunnels were spewing countless high-level Cave Spiders like fountains.
These holes seemed as if they had been directly burrowed from the Spider Cave.
The scene was incredibly shocking.
And what was more serious was that over 100 level 15 Cave Spiders had somehow climbed onto the supposedly impregnable city walls.
Leading them were 6 level 19 Cave Spiders and over 20 level 18 Cave Spiders…
This was the most frenzied retaliation launched by the Cave Spiders since the establishment of Grey Stone Castle.
This wasn’t everything.
Among these hundreds of Cave Spiders, there were also numerous spiders that Betty had never seen before.
Magic Spiders that could cast Spirit Magic, Bone Armor Spiders with hard shells, and even tiny but incredibly fast High-Speed Spiders, Poison Fog Spiders that emitted toxic mists from their mouths…
More than a dozen unfamiliar types of Cave Spiders had all charged at once onto the wall of Grey Stone Castle’s main fortress.
The scene before them made it clear that the Cave Spiders had dug underground tunnels and then launched a surprise attack with a large number of high-level Cave Spiders on Grey Stone Castle, whose defenses were directly penetrated without preparation.
Betty witnessed this scene with her own eyes, from the moment countless Cave Spiders surged out of three collapsed underground caves, to the near collapse of the wall—in just under five minutes.
In this process, more than 1,000 Beastman Warriors died; it was the most severe loss Grey Stone Castle had ever suffered.
The brutal battle drove Kapp and his top combatants to madness.
But the Cave Spiders had come prepared.
In the sky, an 18th-level Withered Bone and a 15th-level Castro were ambushed by the Cave Spiders underground. Two 19th-level Ghost-faced Spiders spit webs to drag these two airborne units to the ground.
Then, other Cave Spiders swarmed them, managing to immobilize the two highly mobile fighters.
Following that, 18th-level Beastman King Kapp was confronted by a hunting squad made of two 19th-level, five 18th-level, and over ten 15th-level Ghost-faced Spiders. The dense assaults forced Kapp into a desperate fight.
Although the 18th-level Beastman King was strong enough, he couldn’t lend a hand amidst such horrific encirclement and could only watch as Grey Stone Castle’s wall fell.
Betty, too, became a target of several 18th-level Ghost-faced Spiders and more than ten top-tier combatants of the 17th level.
She was unable to extricate herself to join others in battle.
Additionally, the 15th-level Frey, the 16th-level Koso, each had their own adversaries.
Thus, all high-level combatants of Grey Stone Castle were forcibly contained by the Cave Spiders, regardless of the cost.
This resulted in a very awkward situation.
Without the aid of top combatants, the attack from the low-level warriors on the spiders above 15th-level was extremely limited.
Even with good equipment and sharp weapons, due to level suppression and the sheer number of over a hundred spiders, there was simply no solution.
Taking advantage of the chaos on the walls, the Cave Spiders below began to continue stacking a human wall; no one was stopping the spiders, and this time, they succeeded effortlessly.
After reaching the top of the wall, the Cave Spiders started to spin webs from the top, hanging upside down and weaving downwards.
The wall was coated with Oily Skill, making it impossible to climb from below, but spinning webs downwards allowed the spider webs to cover the wall.
The anchoring point was on the upper wall, rendering the Oily Skill useless.
In just a short amount of time, the 35-blade-tall walls of Grey Stone Castle became covered with a thick layer of spider webs.
Once the Oily Skill effect was lost, the wall no longer served as a natural barrier, and the Cave Spiders climbed up the wall in dense clusters from below.
The sight was incredibly exaggerated, enough to make anyone with a fear of dense patterns feel a tingling scalp and curling toes.
The situation spiraled out of control.
With the element of surprise and the eruption of force from the Cave Spiders that was nearly tenfold more than usual, all top combatants were engaged, causing the previously impregnable Grey Stone Castle to start falling.
Although the Beastman Warriors were courageous and fierce, they melted away like ice under snow in the face of the higher-level and numerous Cave Spiders.
These warriors relied on Magic Scrolls they carried to barely stabilize the situation, but there were too many.
The Cave Spiders were just too numerous.
Magic Spiders were using magic to restrain the top combatants, Bone Armor Spiders acted as tanks to limit their movement, and Ghost-faced Spiders lay in wait to ambush, especially the Bone Armor Spiders whose hard shells could not be broken by Extraordinary Weapons in a short time.
The crossbows on the city tower fired every second, shooting more frequently than ever.
The Spellcasters in the tower behind the walls were constantly weaving magic, and even their Magic Scrolls were being torn apart frantically, as if they were free.
But due to the collapse of the walls and the Cave Spiders that surged like a tide from the underground pits, the scene was still collapsing.
Grey Stone Castle used to withstand the large numbers of Cave Spiders effortlessly, reinforced by firepower and protective walls.
But now, as most firepower points could no longer hold back the onrush of Cave Spiders, the overwhelming advantage of numbers came to the forefront.
A tactic of sheer numbers is often the most intractable, requiring no technique, merely a flood of bodies, yet once a breach is made, the ferocity of this tactic multiplies tenfold.
The urgent horns blew from behind Grey Stone Castle, their sounds resonating across the battlefield.
Then, the sky suddenly darkened, as Magic Language Bats rushed out of the cave behind like a school of fish.
Flapping their wings swiftly, they beat a path toward the battlefield.
Magic Language Bats, Grey Stone Castle’s trump card, had finally entered the fray.
The commander of Dawn Wings—Fanatic Oli, observing the nearly overrun walls below, immediately recognized the urgency of the situation.
With a wave of his hand, a Magic Language Knight following close behind him immediately took out a short horn, and the shrill sound of the horn sounded anew.
Hearing the horn, the already swift Magic Language Bats hastened their speed even more.
Woosh woosh~
In less than a minute, over a thousand Magic Language Bats had already appeared in the skies above Grey Stone Castle.
Oli immediately directed the Magic Language Bats to form a guard team formation, and moments later, those carrying alchemy bombs began to fly out from the cave.
These were the real weapons of mass destruction.
But in that brief three to five minutes, as the Magic Language Bats gathered, the situation on the battlefield below drastically worsened.
Castro and Withered Bone were overwhelmed by countless Cave Spiders, with the two aerial units forced into close combat with the spiders, leaving them no capacity to support others.
Fortunately, the massive bodies of both beasts were extraordinarily tough, and close combat posed no problem for them, but they were ultimately held back.
And the 18th-level Beastman King Kapp, the lion of the barren wastelands, was not faring any better. He was hunted by two 19th-level and ten 18th-level Ghost-faced Spiders—a force powerful enough to make one’s heart tremble.
Separated and alone in battle, Kapp had to fight single-handedly against this formidable force at its extreme.
It was only because this lion was strong enough that he, alone with a set of armor and a long knife, could clash directly with the enemy without falling at too much of a disadvantage.
But it was clear he could no longer spare his hands to command the nearly fallen Grey Stone Castle.
Koso, as a Bronze One-eyed Giant, robust in stature, could rampage beneath the city walls, but when the Cave Spiders recklessly piled on, even Koso’s progress was hindered.
Betty and Frey received the same treatment.
And so, with no leader, the walls of Grey Stone Castle fell.
When the walls were covered in webs, the unobstructed Cave Spiders surged like a tide, and Grey Stone Castle, as solid as a reef, was quickly overwhelmed.
There were simply too many.
Not only were there a multitude of Cave Spiders above the 15th level, but the number of 10th-level Ghost-faced Spiders was beyond count.
The Cave Spiders, occupying half the plane, had unleashed all of their strength.
A race whose lifespan was unknown to all now showed everyone their terrifying tusks.
Boom~
Yet, although Grey Stone Castle was collapsing, the war had not ended.
The already airborne Magic Language Bats finally dropped their alchemy bombs at this moment, and the roar of the Death God echoed in the skies above Grey Stone Castle.
What once sounded unbearably noisy was now like a divine chant celebrating the gods in the ears of the warriors of Grey Stone Castle.
Boom~Boom~Boom~
The specially made alchemy bombs detached from the Magic Language Bats’ carrying armor and plummeted down with unstoppable momentum.
With over 500 Magic Language Bats densely bombing the area, the battlefield was instantly turned into a meat grinder.
Flames soared into the sky, and the Cave Spiders were torn apart at the moment of the alchemy bombs’ explosion, their limbs scattered.
The blast sent debris, scorched earth, and remnants flying into the sky, with green goo flying about like raindrops.
Corrosive sounds continuously rang out upon hitting the ground.
Oli watched with a piercing gaze, calmly commanding the swarm of bats in their bombardment.
The three huge underground tunnels became the key targets for the alchemy bomb assault.
These were the sources of all evil.
Whoo~Whoo~Whoo~
The underground holes, gushing like faucets, were instantly filled with alchemy bombs, howling as they fell from the sky.
Boom~
The moment the alchemy bombs penetrated underground, the firing pins inside were triggered, and the compressed Magic Crystal Stones released an immense energy, the muffled sound of the explosion burst forth.
Over three thousand alchemy bombs almost scoured the area around the city walls within a thousand blade’s reach.
Finally, when an alchemy bomb unintentionally landed on a certain point on the ground, boom~ the sound of the cave collapsing resounded.
And then the land heaved as if struck by the fist of a Titan of enormous stature.
Rumble~
The three tunnels dug by the Cave Spiders collapsed in unison.
Oli witnessed this epic event from the sky.
Dozens of Blade’s width-wide underground tunnels seemed to have lost a critical support point, then the ground above began to cave, and the earth directly sank over ten Blades’ height.
The surrounding soil poured into the collapsed tunnels like seawater gone mad.
Rumble~
With continuous, dull sounds, the three tunnels dug out by the Cave Spiders burst apart.
It took a full three minutes for everything to settle.
The underground tunnels now resembled three gigantic snakes, stretching from the base of Grey Stone Castle’s walls to the end of sight.
Countless Cave Spiders were buried in the ground and underlying tunnels in that instance.
The brief bombardment of alchemy bombs had solved the immediate problem, but had not addressed the fundamental issue facing Grey Stone Castle.
The crisis was still ongoing.
The war was not over yet.
This time, the cave spiders seemed to be making a desperate all-in gamble, not just by deploying a staggering number of high-level forces.
What’s more, the cave spiders running from the ground directly ignored the scent within the alchemy bombs that the cave spiders found extremely repulsive and enraging.
If Oli could see the states on the bodies of the cave spiders, he would notice a special attribute: Fanaticism of the Spider Queen.
Fanaticism of the Spider Queen: For three Sunshine Hours, the cave spiders are in an excited state, losing rationality, fearless of death.
What was even more deadly was that at this moment, a black line appeared in the distant sky.
Flying spiders—more of them than they had ever faced before.
Seeing this, Oli’s eyes sharpened, his face becoming incredibly solemn.
At this moment he confirmed something again—the cave spiders were launching their final assault.
Looking at the frenzied situation below, he could only arrange his formation in readiness for combat; even if the Magic Language Bats no longer had alchemy bombs, the current situation did not allow them to return to the cave behind for resupply.
If they withdrew, then the aerial defense line of Grey Stone Castle would be completely overtaken by the flying spiders, and the already bloody castle would step directly into the abyss.
They had no way out anymore.
“Prepare for battle!”
Accompanied by a roaring rage that thundered through the sky, Oli, holding the Sky Knight Spear and driving his Level 12 Dawn Bat, led more than 2000 Magic Language Bats in a charge against the flying spiders that occupied the entire sky.
Since there was no retreat, they had no choice but to fight to the death!
Dawn Wings, fearless.
All for the sake of dawn!
Boom~
At the moment of collision, the world seemed to fall into a frenzy.
Round after round of crossbows fired wildly amid the countless flying spiders’ attacks, but in the face of the aerial onslaught from all directions, even a multitude of bolts could not kill them all.
Close-quarters combat had begun.
Blood, severed limbs.
The flying spiders were almost instantly torn to shreds in the ferocious charge of the Magic Language Bats, limbs flying everywhere.
Although the base combat strength of the flying spiders was weak, the deadly poison they carried made the Magic Language Bats dare not underestimate them.
Once struck by the poison, the bodies of the Magic Language Bats would be directly corroded, leaving no possibility of survival if their bodies were eroded in mid-air.
As the two sides collided, the Sky Knights seated on the backs of the Magic Language Bats almost went mad too.
These strictly trained human warriors now had no time for fear, their fingers pulling triggers frantically, every crossbow bolt carrying a heart-vibrating intent to kill.
Pchoo~
One of the flying spiders, failing to evade, had its head directly exploded by a bolt coming head-on, and, enveloped in green viscous liquid, the bolt, undeterred, penetrated the abdomen of another flying spider behind, with the Fine Gold Arrowhead passing through,
The enormous force propelled that flying spider’s body fiercely backward, impaling another flying spider that had just flown past with a crossbow bolt as long as an arm.
Like skewering lotus roots.
The ensnared flying spiders let out eardrum-piercing screeches in their struggle, but all was in vain. The two stringed-up cave spiders lost their power of flight and plummeted from mid-air, crashing to the ground with bursting bodies.
Bodies spewing forth green viscous liquid several blades high before falling back down, the highly corrosive liquid pockmarked the spider corpses on the ground, a doomsday scene of devastation.
But no matter how abundant, the supply of bolts would eventually run out.
After an uncountable number of flying spiders weathered the storm of bolts, the next phase of intense close-quarters fighting began instantly.
While the Magic Language Bats were tied up by the flying spiders, the ground-bound cave spiders were surging forward once again, in the absence of the alchemy bomb bombardments.
And at this time, a large number of Beastman Warriors and human warriors of the Winged King also surged out of the cave behind the Grey Stone Castle.
The scene was crazy and bloody, full of the flavor of war from a magical world.
Both sides engaged in the bloodiest struggle within the walls of Grey Stone Castle, which had never fallen before.
When paths crossed.
There were no extra choices, forward, forward, always forward!
Death or survival,
Everyone was fighting with all their might for the next breath.
“For dawn!!!”
When that inspiring slogan was shouted, the roars of all the warriors inside Grey Stone Castle tore through the sky.
——
——
——
——
Betty’s battle had entered its most perilous stage, with over 20 Cave Spiders, each above level 15, hunting her down.
In her hand, the black Extraordinary Giant Sword shone with a brilliant light—Extreme Intention, a specialization of Extraordinary Warriors, and also the ace trait that made a Northern Warrior honored as the foremost of the three great warriors of Glory.
After activating her bloodline, this Northern Land Valkyrie, with her terrifying combat skills and exaggerated regenerative abilities, had already slain over 30 Cave Spiders by her side, of which at least 10 were level 15.
Her Legendary Level combat skills allowed the Valkyrie to charge unbridled across the battlefield.
Boom~
After dodging an ambush from a Cave Spider, her body, which leaped high into the air, landed forcefully on the ground. The moment her legs touched the gray rocks, she propelled herself upwards like a drawn bowstring.
The immense force caused dense fissures to appear in the stones above the walls of Grey Stone Castle.
Leaving several afterimages in the air, Betty’s sharp gaze fixed on the level 18 Bone Armor Spider in front of her, whose defense had reached the extreme, causing her great trouble.
But all was the decision of fate, and this Bone Armor Spider before her would be the fifth she had slain!
Her killing intent surged.
Sensing the imminent danger, the Bone Armor Spider on top of the city wall arched its body fiercely, its eight sharp limbs planted on the ground as its furious eyes stared intently at Betty, whose figure was almost invisible in the air.
But just as they were about to collide—
Betty, who had already jumped midair, suddenly felt an extremely lethal presence approaching from the front.
Her expression changed.
Her body was in midair, with no possibility of evasion.
Yet, the Northern Land Valkyrie still managed to twist her body with her terrifying combat skills and used the giant sword in her hand to block in the direction of the incoming deadly danger.
Craaack~
The space in front of her suddenly shattered, and a spider with mantis-like forelimbs emerged from the Dimension Space to attack Betty.
A trap, a danger!
Every pore on Betty’s body was warning her.
But by then, the Blade Spider that had set a deadly trap within the space had already launched its attack.
Level 19.
A level 19 Blade Spider with mantis-like forelimbs.
In the blink of an eye, the razor-sharp limbs of the Blade Spider hacked down, and Betty barely raised her giant sword to block. Bang—In the moment of collision, she only felt a terrifying force transmitted through her hand, numbing her palms, and the giant sword nearly slipped from her grasp.
But it wasn’t over yet. In the instant of their clash, the space behind Betty shattered once again.
Another level 19 Blade Spider appeared, its blade-like limbs nearly sharp enough to slice through skin.
At that moment, Betty had no way to evade; she could only watch as the sharp limbs hacked towards her.
Following this strike, even if the Northern Land Valkyrie survived, she would be severely injured; the trap set by the two level 19 Blade Spiders in cooperation with several level 18 Ghost-faced Spiders was that terrifying.
Time seemed to slow down at that moment, and Betty could clearly see the limbs slicing towards her from her side.
But just as the Blade Spider’s strike was about to hit her—
Whoosh~
Her vision dimmed.
Suddenly, a familiar silhouette appeared in front of her.
A pair of wings with dark crimson bloodlines, a handsome face that was outrageously striking, a tall and slender figure, with a dominant and formidable aura.
Lide… her master.
In the blink of an eye, Lide directly pulled Betty into his embrace, taking the hit from the sharp limbs of the Blade Spider that was aimed at her.
Spurting~
Betty was intercepted in Lide’s arms, but she watched with her own eyes as the limbs, sharper than razors, pierced straight through Lide’s chest.
Bloody and brutal.
The Northern Land Valkyrie, who had never shown an ounce of worry even when all her bones were broken, clenched her heart tightly at this scene, and her lips were bitten to the point of bleeding out of instinct.
Lide had heard the urgent bugle call from within the cave.
That was the signal for a high-level danger.
So she flew out at top speed.
Upon arriving at the entrance to the Underworld, she saw Grey Stone Castle, nearly overwhelmed, and she also happened to witness the scene of Betty’s ambush.
Without a moment to think, she instantly teleported in front of Betty.
After releasing the lock on his bloodline and activating the Ancestor Bloodline, as long as his head was not chopped off, even if his heart was pierced, he could recover normally within just a few seconds, thanks to his terrifying regenerative powers.
So, instinctively, he used his own body to block that lethal Blade Spider limb for Betty.
Although the recovery ability of Northern Warriors was formidable, it was still not comparable to his own, so he did not feel there was anything wrong with his actions.
What Betty saw was different…
But at this moment, Lide had no time to ponder, as another Level 19 Blade Spider charged at him after he had been pierced through.
Lide’s pupils shrank sharply at the sight, recognizing them as the same type of Blade Spider he had encountered in the Spider Plane; the one that had suddenly emerged from the Dimension Plane to kill him was an Extraordinary Spider.
Murderous intent filled his eyes.
With one hand, he grasped the forelimb of the Blade Spider that jabbed into his chest, turned fiercely, and the gurgling Magma Fireball formed rapidly in his hand.
The Blade Spider paused, then sensing the fatal danger Lide emitted, another Blade Blade came slashing horizontally at him.
Lide’s gaze hardened, not caring about the Blade Blade, as the Magma Fireball went directly into the gaping maw of the Blade Spider that sought his life.
Splurt—he was impaled by the Blade Spider once again.
Yet at the same time, the Four Circle Spell, infused with the Power of Crimson, burst inside the Blade Spider’s mouth.
Bang~
Instinctively, Lide shielded Betty in his arms.
Crack~
The Blade Spider that didn’t have time to withdraw exploded like a watermelon, its terrible Magic causing the Dragon Scale Shield Lide had released temporarily to shatter.
The other Blade Spider was blown away by the Magic Energy surge.
Then, the terrifying heat directly assaulted his back.
Crack~ His body was rapidly corroded by the high temperature.
Yet inside his body, the Ancestor Bloodline was repairing his injured body rapidly, like a tug-of-war.
Betty, protected in Lide’s arms, the Valkyrie who would never make such a fatal mistake of being distracted on the battlefield, had not yet snapped back to reality.
Feeling the scorching breath in the air, Betty lifted her head slightly and saw Lide’s extremely handsome face.
Her heart shuddered again.
Why??
The Northern Royal Family’s mind was filled with this question.
Why would one who controls Dawn City and has countless subordinates risk his life to save her, and in such a mad way?
The figure she once defeated with ease had, unknown to her, grown to such an extent.
In a daze, Betty saw Lide vanish from his spot, followed by a fracture in space.
When he reappeared, he was holding the head of another Level 19 Blade Spider.
Lide wrinkled his brow at Betty, who was intently staring at him.
He always felt that today’s Betty was a bit odd, not at all like the usual proud Valkyrie filled with battle spirit.
After feeling it out briefly, a coldness flashed across his face, and the Magma Fireball appeared in his hand again, and in the moment the Four Circle Spell took shape, he slammed it fiercely toward an inconspicuous spot on the ground below the city wall.
Boom~
The ground burst open, the terrifying high temperature turning the nearby corpses and the ground to ashes.
And a Magic Spider hidden beneath was killed with one blow.
“An Level 18 Magic Spider?”
After the presence in the shadows vanished, Lide’s brows relaxed slightly.
“Betty, you were affected by Magic in the fight just now…”
Betty suddenly felt clarity in front of her eyes, and the sluggish reaction in her mind towards the danger she had just faced all cleared up.
Immediately, she regained her senses.
Was I influenced by Magic?
But remembering Lide’s action just now sent another shudder through her heart, and the Valkyrie inexplicably felt a bit lost. Was it just because of the Magic Spider’s influence?
On the battlefield, Lide had no mind to observe so much, nor was he aware of Betty’s bewildering thoughts at that moment.
Turning to look at the Cave Spiders that scattered because of the Magma Fireball’s power and were regrouping for another assault, his eyes flashed with a hint of cold detachment.
He turned and stared menacingly at the empty space behind him.
“Asreaga.”
“Father god….”
Crack~
Before Betty’s astonished gaze, the space behind Lide simply burst open, followed by the appearance of a lifeform that emitted an unimaginably evil presence.
With gray wings upon its back, twin curved horns atop its head, and narrow eyes that showed no emotions but rampant bloodlust, the creature’s gray skin was etched with ancient, evil inscriptions, exuding a deeply dark aura.
Its sharp fingers, the sharpest razors in the world, would tear through even space when swung.
Just by glancing at it, Betty felt an overwhelming fear, as if looking any longer would result in her soul being devoured by this unknown entity.
Evil and terrifying, powerful and fierce.
That was Betty’s impression of this unknown entity, accompanied by an indescribable sense of danger. The moment Asreaga appeared, every cell in Betty’s body was warning her.
Even as those narrow, fierce eyes gazed upon her, she could smell the scent of death.
It seemed that if this unknown existence were to take action, she would be led into the realm of the Death God.
Betty’s gaze sharpened, and she pushed down the instinctual fear in her heart. Her lofty battle will surged tumultuously and she unflinchingly met the other’s gaze.
Northern Warriors, fearless, dauntless!
Asreaga, this Level 19 Divine Monster, felt Betty’s surging combat intent and halted momentarily. But after sensing the aura her soul emitted, it retracted the desire to kill her. This was the Father God’s property…
“Kill them…”
Lide gestured towards the surrounding Cave Spiders with an indifferent tone.
“Let me see if the spear in my hand is indeed sharp.
Go, let the world reacquaint itself with your strength.”
“Asreaga obeys your command, great Father God…”
