After receiving Lide’s command, the murderous intent in Asreaga’s eyes began to erupt.
The aura unique to the Divine Monster swept across the land like a tempest.
It rose mightily.
Everyone inside Grey Stone Castle felt a dreadfully horrifying presence spreading out, all creatures only felt a fear stemming from their souls assaulting them.
Indescribable, untouchable, unimaginable.
This was the essence of the world’s purest evil, no words could depict that extreme evil presence which did not belong and should not exist in the world.
At the peak of this momentum, Asreaga, the Level 19 Divine Monster, made its move.
The form of the Divine Monster, that had emerged after Lide, suddenly vanished.
In the blink of an eye, the three-blade-tall Divine Monster appeared before a Level 17 Ghost-faced Spider.
But in the next second, Asreaga’s figure disappeared again, and the Ghost-faced Spider had no chance to resist, its head simply burst.
Psscht—the green corrosive fluid spurted out several blades high.
By the time Lide saw Asreaga’s form again, the Divine Monster had already appeared in front of the second Ghost-faced Spider.
That spider had no half-second to react, exploding instantly. Even with Lide’s perception, he could only catch a fleeting afterimage in Asreaga’s hand, followed by the spider’s explosion.
Asreaga’s claws glistened chillingly in his hands; at that moment, they were the Death God’s scythes.
No one could escape the Death God’s harvest.
Fear spread, death loomed.
What followed was even more exaggerated.
With every flicker of Asreaga’s figure, another Cave Spider appeared in front of him, and the next second, he would vanish.
Where he had just appeared, only the shredded corpse of a Cave Spider remained.
Eerie and ferocious.
Space Mastery (After the Divine Monster devoured the eggs of a Bronze Dragon and half of a Plane’s Plane Power, it gained tremendous affinity and control over space, unfettered in traversing different dimensional spaces and immune to all spatial magical spells imposed by the Plane Will.)
The massacre began the moment the Divine Monster took action, and the crowd around never imagined that combat could be this brutal.
After every flash, another Cave Spider was shredded to pieces by Asreaga.
Not a single Cave Spider could survive a second under the hunt of this Divine Monster.
The scene was shockingly dramatic.
Countless fierce and brutal Cave Spiders in front of Asreaga turned into hunted sheep.
Those who were even slightly slow to react couldn’t catch sight of Asreaga’s form; they could only see one after another Cave Spider heads exploding on the walls of Grey Stone Castle.
Such was the power of the Divine Monster, domineering indeed.
With the progress of the slaughter, the intense evil aura on Asreaga intensified, even causing great panic the moment he appeared.
At last, Asreaga seemed to find such slaughter unsatisfying, no longer using spatial talents, but instead, flapping its wings, he charged toward the surrounding Cave Spiders.
The Power of Death enveloped the Divine Monster’s body, making it invincible with the power of death. At Levels 15, 16, 17, and even Levels 18 and 19, no Cave Spider could block this ancient Divine Being for even a second.
It was a one-sided massacre.
This Level 19 Divine Monster, within this dim Underworld, once again revealed to the world the tusks of a Divine Monster.
The gods of old had not slain him; in his future, he was destined to slaughter the gods…
Even Lide, upon witnessing this scene, faintly foresaw the day when this Divine Monster would tear apart the realm of the Light God and behead the divine beings, devouring their bodies…
Raising a Divine Monster, truly quite interesting…

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 330 332 After-Effects of Pig Raising Treating
chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 330: Chapter 332: After-Effects of Pig Raising, Treating Spiders as Pigs (10,000-word Mega Chapter, Plea for Monthly Votes~ Pity) Chapter 330: Chapter 332: After-Effects of Pig Raising, Treating Spiders as Pigs (10,000-word Mega Chapter, Plea for Monthly Votes~ Pity) And at this time, a new change arose on the battlefield.
After the 19th-level Divine Monster Asreaga had cleared a small area around him,
there were still Cave Spiders undeterred by death.
A Bone Armor Spider, with its defense at an astonishing level 19, let out a hoarse roar with every ounce of its strength and lunged towards Asreaga to attack.
Relying on its terrifying defense, the Bone Armor Spider remained unscathed even when facing the longsword of the 18th-level Beastman King Kapp.
But in the face of Asreaga, although its soul was quivering, it still had confidence that it was invincible.
However, as the Bone Armor Spider charged into Asreaga’s 50-blade range, its footsteps suddenly faltered and its massive body shook, almost collapsing to the ground.
Because a terrifying aura had assaulted its soul, reeking of blood, rage, and evil.
At that moment, the Bone Armor Spider could clearly feel its soul rapidly collapsing, as if it were being ripped from its body.
This was the bloodline of Asreaga—Extremely Evil Blood, carrying with it the Death Aura of a Five Circle Demon, which causes Soul Enslavement within a 50-blade range; every 10 seconds, the enemy would be struck by a Five Circle Magic shock, and failing the mental resistance check meant their soul would be enslaved.
This aura also lent great assistance to the Divine Monster’s unchecked slaughter.
Just as the Bone Armor Spider was struck by the Five Circle Magic, a strong force emanated within its soul, stabilizing its nearly-collapsed spirit.
Soul Chains—the Extraordinary Spider Queen was sharing its burden with a Soul Chain, providing strength to support it.
After surviving the Five Circle Magic shock, the Bone Armor Spider became more ferocious, its eyes filled with intimidating cruelty.
Its murderous intent was directed straight at Asreaga.
After Asreaga had ripped through the Cave Spiders blocking his path with his claws, his narrow and ferocious eyes caught sight of the Bone Armor Spider rushing towards him.
Feeling the murderous intent of the Bone Armor Spider, the extremely evil aura on his body became even denser.
“Annihilation… death… back to chaos and silence…”
Ancient Profanity language swirled like a Soul Shock wave across the battlefield dense with the aura of death.
A group of Beastman Warriors nearby, hearing this blasphemous language not of this world, had their eyes turn blood-red instantly; their blood surged in madness, recklessly charging at the Cave Spiders in front of them.
Confusing the mind, the killing intent was chilling.
Even these warriors of strong will could not resist the Ancient Profanity language if their levels were not high enough.
Terrifying and appalling.
Seeing a creature dare challenge his dignity, the violence in Asreaga’s eyes intensified, and his body’s speed suddenly increased significantly as he collided with the Bone Armor Spider.
The sharp mandibles of the Bone Armor Spider, capable of piercing a warrior’s thick shield like a scythe, were bared at Asreaga, intending to tear into him.
However, Asreaga, violent and menacing, let his sharp claws tear through the air towards the spider.
The two collided in that instant.
Crack~
The sharp, hard mandibles of the level 19 Bone Armor Spider, which could easily penetrate a warrior’s shield, snapped like rotten wood as Asreaga mercilessly sliced them to pieces.
Then, accompanied by that surge of extremely evil aura, the Bone Armor Spider was torn apart by Asreaga into shreds.
Limb pieces flew across the air, and blood spattered everywhere.
The solid bone armor that could withstand crossbow bolts without damage could not last a second longer.
The scene was extremely bloody, filled with a violence that stirred one’s blood.
With the fall of the Bone Armor Spider, the second act of Asreaga’s performance began.
Slaughter, blood, death.
No one could describe just how terrifying the Divine Monster on the battlefield was; this Divine Life form that even divine beings feared was the extreme epitome of evil in this world.
Piling all negative adjectives upon this Divine Monster was by no means an exaggeration.
Asreaga’s carnage brought about a disastrous annihilation to the Cave Spiders that were originally containing the top combat forces of Grey Stone Castle.
No Cave Spider could escape the hunt of this Divine Monster that had mastered space.
This being, which had lived for millions of years and reached the pinnacle of level 19, a Divine Life form, could never be measured by ordinary levels in terms of combat power.
Even the Cave Spiders that wished to flee stood no chance; having obtained the spatial control ability of the Bronze Dragon, any prey he set his eyes on was doomed.
No exceptions.
When a Divine Monster possesses the ability to tear through space with its attacks and is endowed with invincible mobility, it becomes the most terrifying killing machine.
Born to kill,
those hundreds of level 15 Cave Spiders were being exterminated at a frantic pace under Asreaga’s indifferent hunt.
Meanwhile, the several top combatants who were originally restricted by the Cave Spiders regained their freedom. Riding on this wave, the Beastman Warriors began their frenzied assault, quickly reclaiming the city walls that had been occupied by the Cave Spiders.
The power that top combatants unleash on the battlefield defies anyone’s imagination.
Lide was not idling while Asreaga was sweeping through his enemies.
At this moment, he was flying mid-air, with magma fireballs bubbling in his palms.
But what was different from before was the appearance of three magma fireballs in his hands.
Extreme Skill—Class Triple Casting.
The theory was to activate the magic models of two magma fireballs simultaneously, then rapidly activate the third one.
The limitation of spiritual power allowed him to control only two magic models at the same time. Lide now adopted a rotation system, swapping the magic power inputs into the magic models at an extremely high frequency, maintaining the spell in its maximum state.
Reaching the effect of Triple Casting, of course, required an extreme test of Magic Affinity and magic control abilities and, most importantly—not being afraid of death.
If the magic power input into the magic model stutters for more than 0.1 seconds, it would collapse and cause a rebound.
Lide had to switch back and forth between the three magic models within this 0.1-second timeframe, ensuring each power input was accurate without error.
This extreme casting skill, scarier than dancing on the edge of a knifes, could be likened to walking a tightrope in mid-air while balancing a knife on the rope and playing floor routines on the tip of a needle atop the knife.
However, Lide’s Bloodline had been purified by Divine Remains, bringing his affinity with magic power to the utmost peak.
That’s why he could be so reckless.
Any other person might not be able to cast even once before being rebounded into idiocy.
Lide had also mastered this skill that pushed past limits only after countless trials.
Looking back, he had to thank the artifact fragment that reduced magical rebounds by 50%.
Of course, besides the danger, another side effect of Dual Casting was that the casting time for the magma fireballs increased from 3 seconds to 4 seconds.
Yet compared to before, it was a huge improvement; now, in 4 seconds, he could cast three magma fireballs, whereas previously, it took 3 seconds to cast two.
One in a second, one in 1.5 seconds—using the Class Triple Casting technique, his casting speed had increased by 50%.
Before his Bloodline was unlocked and evolved, Lide would need at least 20 seconds to cast a Four Circle Magic, but after tapping into his potential, his casting speed began to skyrocket, now reaching the extreme in reduction.
Given that Lide, even in a normal state, could now recover hundreds of magic power points per second, he was undeniably a magic artillery battery.
Floating mid-air in Grey Stone Castle, every second he could smash down bubbling magma fireballs.
The ground before Grey Stone Castle, which was previously swarming with Cave Spiders, was cleared by his firepower alone.
The earth was torn apart by the violent magic, with mud and rocks melting into lava at the high temperature.
Its lethality was even more exaggerated than a Divine Monster who roamed without fear with its control over space.
Asreaga targeted the high-level combatants with precision, while Lide boasted full coverage firepower, turning both high and low levels into ash under his magic.
The distinction between warrior and Mage was vividly demonstrated at that moment.
Wuu wuu~
As the war horns sounded again from within the castle, signaling the call to arms, more warriors began pouring out from their caves, launching a full counter-offensive.
Although this surprise attack by the Cave Spiders was very resolute, to the point where Grey Stone Castle would have likely fallen had Lide not arrived,
the power of Dawn City was not to be underestimated either.
Once the Cave Spiders lost the distraction of top combatants, it was time for Dawn City to strike back.
After Lide released another round of magical bombardment that eradicated a group of Cave Spiders preparing to gather, he finally had time to survey his surroundings.
The most eye-catching, of course, was the level 19 Divine Monster, Asreaga.
The Divine Monster had just, in a matter of minutes, relying on its unique talent—control over space—hunted down more than 40 cave spiders above Level 15.
The exaggerated battle results directly reversed what was almost a collapsing situation.
Lide sensed the changing tide and, moved by it, directly flapped his wings and flew above the city walls.
He arrived before the recently liberated Beastman King Kapu, his gaze burning as he stared at the lion.
“Kapu, command all warriors to follow me in a strike.
The cave spiders must have used up the majority of their trump cards to send out such a powerful force.”
Lide spoke with certainty; even cave spiders that occupy half a plane couldn’t easily mobilize hundreds of Level 15 combat forces.
“Once we exterminate this force, the cave spiders’ external power will inevitably experience a vacuum period.
And that space is our best opportunity to take over the spider nest.”
“The magic crystal veins… will be marked with the imprint of Dawn City.”
Lide’s eyes shone with a piercing light.
His purpose for initiating this war had never changed—the magic crystal veins, obtaining the Power of Death was just a bonus in the process, it was the rich magic crystal veins that were the ultimate goal.
The importance of the magic crystal veins needs no mention, no matter the cost, he must get his hands on them.
Including the three months of attrition before this, the Spider Plane had already suffered uncountable losses of Level 15+ combat power before Grey Stone Castle, and the plan to drain the higher-level strength of the cave spiders has been perfectly achieved; the layout to seize the magic crystal veins could now be closed.
Moreover, with the Divine Monster Asreaga in place, the danger that higher-level cave spiders posed to the forces of Dawn City had been reduced to the extreme.
No cave spider could survive the Divine Monster’s hunting.
His previous hesitation in taking over the magic crystal veins was because of this—having the mobility to support or even exterminate any high-level cave spiders that appeared, none of his men could achieve this.
He could, but he couldn’t be stationed in the Underworld forever, thus he decided to drain the high-level force of the cave spiders, and only after their high-level power decreased to a certain extent and the forces of Dawn City could cope, would he then seek to capture the magic crystal veins.
Originally, his plan would have taken at least another three months for the next step, but the strength of Divine Monster Asreaga had advanced his plans.
And the outcome might be even better.
Boom, boom, boom~
Following Lide’s order, the long-sealed gates of Grey Stone Castle were opened.
Countless well-equipped beastman warriors wearing heavy armor marched out of the city gate in unison, led by their king—the lion of the barren wasteland, Level 18 Beastman King Kapp, charging ahead.
At this moment, the flying spiders in the sky, after the defeat of the cave spiders on the ground, let out a piercing screech and quickly left the battlefield under everyone’s gaze.
Lide’s will was the direction Dawn City advanced in, from the beginning to the present; this eternal core has always remained unchanged and will not change in the future.
The Magic Language Bats in the sky, having suffered losses of more than 300, returned to the passage behind the mountain to resupply alchemy bombs and crossbow bolts.
The war horn was like a voice passed down from ancient times, making every warrior’s blood boil at this moment.
Fight, fight!!
The cave spiders on the surface could no longer stop Dawn City’s army surging with momentum.
Unstoppable, the wetlands in front of Grey Stone Castle had become a sea of bones and corpses, where the cave spiders kept retreating.
Castro and Lord Withered Bones now regained their freedom, these two giant beasts, which had just been overrun by countless cave spiders, now directed their inner fury toward the still surging cave spiders.
Castro, clad in extraordinary armor, with Lide presiding, had absolutely no worries, pushing his speed to the limit.
The blade blades on his two wings were like slicing through tofu; after supersonic flight in the sky, he suddenly dived sharply downwards.
Ziila~
The bodies of the cave spiders were directly burst into pieces.
Extreme Sharpness (When attacking with dual wings, there’s a 70% chance to directly sever armor below Transcendent ★ quality, with lower quality armor having a higher chance of being severed.)
Obviously, the bodies of the cave spiders could not reach the hardness of Transcendent-level equipment, so in the face of lower-level cave spiders, Castro was an invincible force.
The whirlwind from his wings was the scythe of the Death God, endless fear spreading throughout.
The cave spiders on the ground faced a ferocious assault from the iron behemoth; the giant beast that once single-handedly destroyed the dwarf city in Dwarf Valley once again revealed the majesty of a new king.
Even the Divine Monster Asreaga, who had brutally crushed cave spiders on the battlefield, was not as dazzling at the moment as Castro.
When the Blade Wings with 16 edges unfolded, they plunged from the sky and carved a bloody, brutal path of death on the ground. Within the span of those 16 blades, all the Cave Spiders were torn into shreds.
It was like a scythe had been swung, previously in Unrivaled Mode, to mow the grass.
And now the other top combat forces that had been suppressed were all erupting.
Lord Withered Bones, the Bone Dragon of level 18, though not as fast as Castro, became a super artillery with his Dragon Language Magic.
With no high-level Cave Spiders to restrict him, the loquacious skeleton’s magic was as dense as the words he spewed.
“Damn Cave Spiders, you dare offend the great Lord Withered Bones!!”
“The sins you’ve committed can no longer be forgiven, death, and silence will be your only destiny.”
“The great Lord Withered Bones will crush your laughably weak souls, tear apart your meager and feeble bodies, and trample everything about you.”
“I am—the Dragon of Destruction!”
“I am the great being that ends all, the eternal of this world, the only Undead across the Multi-dimensional Plane, wahahaha, miserable ants, meet the Dragon Breath of your Lord Withered Bones, and it’s time for your filthy bodies to be purified by Dragon Breath…”
While everyone was in the midst of battle, only the Bone Dragon in the air, flapping its damaged wings, kept babbling, boasting about its prowess and invincibility, completely forgetting the awkward scene in which it had just been dragged to the ground by Cave Spiders and ganged up on, unable to take flight.
Bronze One-Eyed Giant Coso, Crimson Hunter Frey, and Grote, the Child of the North, still violently slaughtering on the battlefield, all manifested the cutting edge of Dawn City’s top combat power.
The force that the Cave Spiders had just unleashed was too fierce. Over a hundred level 15, or higher, Cave Spiders, represented the accumulated heritage over countless years, something Dawn City could not match.
It was more than normal to be overwhelmed. Being able to withstand such a level of encirclement without major issues demonstrates the strength of the army Lide had built at great expense.
Without those high-level Cave Spiders to restrain them, their edge made one shudder.
Whoo-whoo—
As more and more Beastman Warriors emerged from Grey Stone Castle, the Cave Spiders, who had always been on the offensive, began to collapse.
Especially under the unrestrained slaughter of several top combat forces, this collapse worsened. Any dense group of Cave Spiders that formed was crazily targeted and no longer able to amount to anything.
Lide hovered in mid-air, looking down at the army moving forward.
From the sky, the scene resembled one from epic mythology.
Countless Beastman Warriors marched over a battlefield washed by Alchemy Bombs and magic, filled with holes from the bombardments, the surrounding air carrying the stench of scorched hair.
Spider corpses piled up on the ground, with corrosive green goo fizzing on the surface. The thick gunsmoke in the air never dissipated, and occasionally, the bodies of not-yet-dead Cave Spiders twitched.
This once marshland was unrecognizable, transformed into an apocalyptic scene post-Battle of the Gods.
Beastman Warriors, donning solid armor forged by Dwarves, advanced step by step through the shattered battlefield, slaughtering the stubbornly resisting Cave Spiders that had lost their leader.
When the tens of thousands-strong Beastman army mobilized, control of the battlefield was wrested back into the hands of Dawn City’s forces.
Particularly when the resupplied Magic Language Bats began bombing again, the battle initiated by the Cave Spider assault neared its end.
An hour later.
Lide looked at the dimly lit cave before him, the air rank with the musty stench of spiders, his gaze icy.
He turned to Frey and Beastman King Kapp behind him.
“Proceed as planned. First, thoroughly scout the condition of the underground passages, and during the occupation, demolish all secondary passages, leaving only the necessary main ones for ease of defense.”
“In addition, establish checkpoints at intervals to combat the Cave Spiders, so even if one is overrun, there are others as a buffer.”
“And after occupying the Magic Crystal Ore Veins, defensive fortifications must be constructed to resist the Cave Spiders’ counterattacks. Finally, establish a fortified camp at the exit of the Spider Plane to encircle and annihilate the Cave Spiders.”
Lide’s thinking was clear; his goal had always been to seize the cave’s Magic Crystal Veins.
Now the Cave Spiders were the only obstacle.
Since there were obstacles, they had to be cleared.
This operation wasn’t complicated; taking advantage of the Cave Spiders’ weakened forces, he intended to cut off their retreat.
To build defensive works at the exit of the Spider Plane, preventing the massive assembly of Cave Spiders.
Then, use that as a base to surround and eliminate the Cave Spiders around the Magic Crystal Veins. Without new reinforcements from the Spider Plane, even a myriad of Cave Spiders near the Magic Crystal Veins would be in vain.
The plan was simple, but the only difficulty in its execution was the uncertainty of how many high-level Cave Spiders were still present in the underground tunnel.
Upon hearing Lide’s orders, Beastman King Kapp and several top-tier warriors immediately began the operation to tackle the Cave Spider nest.
—
—
—
—
Originally, they had anticipated that invading the Spider Nest would pose a tremendous challenge, but Lide was surprised to find that it went unexpectedly smoothly in the end.
Although the number of Cave Spiders was still countless and their resistance fierce,
there were only a very few Level 15 Cave Spiders.
The majority were Level 5 to 9 Cave Spiders.
So, despite the large number of Cave Spiders, with the top-tier warriors leading the charge, Dawn City’s army was able to crumble their defenses.
Moreover, the exaggerating number of Cave Spiders was limited by the underground passage, making the battle even more successful.
After all, even the largest underground passage can only accommodate a limited number of Cave Spiders.
With high-level warriors present, the pressure faced in the underground tunnel was countless times less than the pressure faced when confronting the spearhead of the Cave Spiders head-on at Grey Stone Castle.
They proceeded steadily and systematically.
After losing the majority of their high-level forces, the Cave Spiders were gradually devoured by the army of Dawn City.
There was hardly any power left to resist.
Five Sunshine Hours, ten Sunshine Hours…
When the entire Spider Nest had been occupied by Dawn City’s army, Lide was still somewhat astonished.
He had been prepared for a major battle in this underground tunnel, but in the end, even Asreaga barely had to lift a finger before they had easily enclosed this maze-like Spider Nest into their fold.
Included, of course, were the Magic Crystal Veins Lide had never forgotten.
“Divine father, is that the spatial channel to the Spider Plane up ahead?”
Lide stood in the underground tunnel, and the Divine Monster Asreaga beside him inquired.
In this vast and open underground space, Beastman King Kapp and other top-tier warriors were leading their most elite troops, surrounding and slaughtering the Cave Spiders in front of the Spider Plane’s spatial channel.
This was the Cave Spiders’ last bastion of resistance.
Knowing the value of the Magic Crystal Ore Veins, the Cave Spiders never ceased their efforts, continuously pouring out from the spatial channel.
But without equivalent forces—and those that were equivalent being hunted by Asreaga as soon as they appeared—the Cave Spiders simply couldn’t stir upheaval. Even as reinforcements arrived, their numbers were still declining as they couldn’t keep up with the rate of death.
“Yes, Asreaga, that’s the Plane where I found you, and there are two Extraordinary beings inside…”
Lide stood atop a boulder, overlooking the battlefield below. Seeing that the situation was under control, he did not join in.
His gaze became slightly complex when he looked at the spatial channel established on the rock wall.
Death was not a pleasant taste, a sense of eternal silence that outsiders could hardly comprehend.
The moment when he had been killed by that Extraordinary Blade Spider still lingered in his mind.
Asreaga’s narrow crimson eyes emitted an endless violent aura.
“Divine father, I sense a familiar presence… I have devoured the power of this Plane before…”
Lide nodded, the attribute panel of Asreaga did mention that it had devoured Plane Power.
After a moment of consideration, a look of realization dawned upon him.
“Could you possibly take control of this Plane?”
The Spider Plane was without a master. Although its rules weren’t complete, if Asreaga could take control, then the hidden Extraordinary Spiders within it would no longer pose a threat.
Upon hearing this, Asreaga immediately released its power to sense carefully, and after a moment, shook its head.
“Father God, the rules of this plane have been seriously compromised; unless the Plane Stone can be found, no one will be able to control it…”
Castro, although he had lost most of his memory, could still easily discern some common-sense issues.
Lide nodded, as this had merely been a sudden inspiration and there was no reason to feel disappointed.
After pondering briefly, as if he had thought of something, his eyes blazing, he fixed his gaze on the 19th-Level Divine Monster.
“It’s not surprising that controlling this plane is not possible, but since you have obtained the plane’s Power of Space, can you close these spatial passages?”
Close the spatial passages?
Asreaga was also interested, “Father God, please wait a moment…”
After speaking, his body disappeared on the spot, and a few breaths later, Asreaga’s figure appeared in front of a honeycomb-like rock wall covered with Space Gates.
The Divine Monster’s Extremely Evil aura spread throughout the underground space in an instant as he arrived.
The Cave Spiders, which had just been fighting off the undead, now howled in utmost terror, like encountering an ancient beast, scrambling to flee.
The pure evil aura was evidently causing great panic amongst these creatures.
The surrounding warriors, witnessing this scene, slew the spiders even more frantically, giving them no chance to breathe.
Asreaga ignored these events, his gray wings flapping as he hovered in front of the rock wall, his narrow eyes intently fixed on the Space Gates before him.
His aura began to spread out, even causing the light around him to dim in that moment as though an ancient terrifying lifeform was awakening, filled with indescribable evil.
The already frightened Cave Spiders were now even more agitated, their howls piercing the eardrums.
Asreaga’s strong right arm stretched out, his sharp claws like daggers of godslaying.
Whoosh~ He waved his hand through the air, and crack~
Like porcelain shattering, more than a dozen Space Gates in front of him burst instantaneously, their crystalline fragments turning into phantoms.
Several Cave Spiders, half emerged, were shredded by the exploding space, not surviving a second more.
Looking intently once again, the original Space Gates had vanished, leaving behind only holes in the rock wall.
Lide, who had been observing Asreaga, brightened at this sight.
Could it really be possible?!
The Space Gates on the rock wall were the only passage linking to the Spider Nest, but there were too many on this nearly hundred-blade-tall rock wall, and the Cave Spiders could amass in great numbers in just a short time.
If they could close some of the Space Gates, the pressure on the army stationed here would be reduced by more than half.
At this moment, Asreaga’s success undoubtedly gave Lide hope.
In a flash of movement, Lide appeared beside Asreaga.
“Asreaga, can you reopen Space Gates after destroying them?”
“Father God… I will try.”
Asreaga did not give an affirmative answer; his right hand stretched out again, his gray skin inscribed with Ancient Profanity drawing in a breathtaking aura.
Terrifying energy surged from his body, and with a slash of his claw, the space shattered once again.
Moments later, the shattered space stabilized, forming a door.
From the other side of the shattered space came the unique scent of the Cave Spider.
“Father God, I can sense the coordinates of the Spider Plane; opening a Space Gate is not difficult…”
After sensing it for a while, Asreaga replied, “However, my power is now limited, and I can only stabilize one Space Gate a day…”
Lide nodded in satisfaction upon hearing this; as long as the gate could be opened, nothing else mattered.
“Very well, now we only need to keep the bottom twenty Space Gates; destroy all others.”
The Space Gates couldn’t all be destroyed—if they were, the Cave Spiders would have nowhere to come out.
Nowadays, the Cave Spiders posed no threat to Dawn City, especially with the Divine Monster Asreaga stationed there.
As long as those Extraordinary Spiders couldn’t pass through the Space Gates, this place would be absolutely safe.
With Dawn City secured, the Cave Spiders themselves had become a resource.
And it was a precious resource.
What was he lacking now? He lacked everything… But the most urgent was undeniably the Power of Death.
And after the Cave Spiders no longer posed a threat, they could undoubtedly become a source of the Power of Death.
Biological resource points, perhaps this name suited the current Cave Spiders better.
Or it could be referred to as—a pig farm, a sideline of the big pig farmer.
Thinking of this, Lide couldn’t help but crack a smile.
“This is pig-farming syndrome ah… Indeed, pig farming is the true path.
After fighting such a long war, even you yourselves have become my spoils of war, this is really interesting.”
Of course, this crude idea would need to be refined later, but now the most critical thing was to clear out the entire Spider Nest.
This labyrinth-like Spider Nest harbored a considerable number of Cave Spiders, they hadn’t even finished scouting in a day’s time, it was too vast.
If they didn’t completely clear out the remaining Cave Spiders, mining the Magic Crystal Ore afterwards would undoubtedly be much more troublesome.
Crack~ Crack~
As Lide pondered, Asreaga had already taken action.
The claws, imbued with strong spatial force, waved in the air and explosions continuously rang out.
Space Gates on the rock wall in front of them were being extinguished one by one like Magic Lamps, leaving only the bottom twenty.
After destroying more than half of the Space Gates, the number of Cave Spiders that appeared in the Underworld immediately decreased, and without the support of new forces, the surrounding army’s slaughter of the Cave Spiders also entered its final stage.
Squish~
When the last Cave Spider outside was crushed, only the Cave Spiders newly emerged from the Space Gates remained.
But even the largest of these twenty Space Gates could only accommodate three to five Cave Spiders at a time, hardly a concern.
This war had turned into a game of whack-a-mole.
As long as the Cave Spiders dared to show their heads outside the Space Gates, they would immediately face ruthless attacks.
Seeing this, Lide’s expression turned somewhat odd, how did this scene look… quite amusing? Watching the warriors’ enthusiastic appearance made him want to try a real-life version of whack-a-mole.
Shaking his head, to prevent any incident, Lide still decided to leave this level 19 Divine Monster to guard here.
“Asreaga, you stay here and guard the Space Gates. Those two Extraordinary Spiders might not be able to come out, but they definitely won’t be content after their nests have been occupied.”
“Although for the attack on Grey Stone Castle, these Cave Spiders have already played their last card, with over a hundred level 15 Cave Spiders killed by us, they must have been severely wounded.
But no one can be sure of what might happen; maybe they still have stronger forces hidden.
Your power is more than enough to guard these twenty Space Gates.”
Using the level 19 Divine Monster Asreaga to guard the Space Gates was completely overkill, like using a giant dragon to kill a goblin, somewhat wasteful, but the Magic Crystal Ore Veins were too important; stability was a must for now. It wouldn’t be too late to withdraw him once the defenses of the Magic Crystal Ore Veins were built.
This task was naturally without any challenge for Asreaga.
Even if these twenty Space Gates surged with a large number of level 15 Cave Spiders at the same time, Asreaga’s combat ability would be enough to kill them with ease.
Cave Spiders were just ordinary creatures, not even a Strong Battle Race, let alone comparable to the existence of a Divine Monster which was a Bloodline beyond compare.
So at the same level, Divine Monster killing Cave Spiders was like slaughtering chicks; there was no chance for resistance.
This was the difference in Bloodline and the essence of life; both level 19, the Cave Spiders at most would be normal or elite versions, while Divine Monster Asreaga could be of legendary or even mythic version, an absolute crushing state.
After arranging these matters, in the dim underground tunnel, Lide with Frey turned to leave for the Magic Crystal Ore Veins, the shrunken Castro perched on his shoulder.
Because of their large bodies and lack of Transformation Skill, Withered Bone and Kosu could only stand guard outside the underground passage.
Grot and Kapp were left by him to reorganize the military equipment, if there were no accidents, for a long time, these two, in combination with Asreaga, would be in charge of guarding the Magic Crystal Ore Veins.
Seeing the situation under control, Betty slightly lifted her head, holding her greatsword and followed Lide.
Just before in the battle, her senses were affected by the Magic Spider, nearly leading her to a verge of death.
But this Northern Land Valkyrie had regained her former wildness after coming to her senses.
More than 20 heads of level 15 Cave Spiders were the best explanation.
Glory of the North had always shone upon her, and the Northern Warriors never retreated.
“Your Majesty, we have brought the Magic Crystal Ore Vein under our control, but the underground tunnels here are too complex, and we have not yet fully explored them.
Although we’ve been sending in Blood-colored Blades to map the area for the past few months, there are still many regions that remain unexplored…”
Frey, following beside Lide, reported that this naturally proud second-generation Bloodline had been waging war in the Underworld for several months.
With a clever mind and a strong arm, Frey had now become the second most important Commander in the Grey Stone Castle’s army, only surpassed by Kapp.
Lide had always been generous in promoting talent, but unfortunately, Frey still had to manage the Dwarf Hillocks and the Fishman Tribe and couldn’t always be stationed in the Underworld.
These two resource points were essential sources of materials for Dawn City and had to be controlled by someone reliable.
“Hmm, make sure to speed up the process… inform Harrison immediately to dispatch the construction department here.
I need to connect the Magic Crystal Ore Vein with the underground tunnels of Grey Stone Castle.
From now on, the Magic Crystal Ore Vein will become the core resource point for our expansion in the Underworld.”
There was a distance between Grey Stone Castle and the Magic Crystal Ore Vein.
The war fortresses that had been built couldn’t protect the Magic Crystal Ore Vein; a new fortress had to be constructed here.
After a moment, Frey, who was leading the way ahead, stopped in his tracks and gestured towards the tunnel in front.
Lide nodded slightly, but he suddenly remembered something, turned his head and looked back at the Valkyrie who had been quiet all this time, her gaze vigilant as she surveyed her surroundings, his face showing a hint of a smile.
“Betty, from now on, neither the Crimson Mage Tower nor Dawn City will ever lack Magic Crystal Stones again.
Come, let me show you the Magic Crystal Ore Veins that belong to Dawn City.”
Betty looked at the highly spirited Lide and nodded slightly, her wild eyes revealing a hint of interest; she rarely saw Lide with such an expression.
Following Lide’s steps, Betty trod through the somewhat uncomfortable underground tunnel, breathing in the slightly rotten air, moving step by step forward.
When Lide reached the entrance of the tunnel, he sharply stopped, indicating to Betty with an interested gesture.
“This is our spoils of war!”
Betty, holding her giant sword, advanced towards the outlet hanging in mid-air at the edge of the cliff.
Suddenly, the underground cavity opened up by the Cave Spiders appeared before her eyes.
Upon seeing the scene below, a member of the Northern Royal Family experienced such a dramatic tightening of her pupils that her shock was unmistakably etched on her face.
In this vast underground space, both in length and width exceeding two thousand blades.
Densely packed and resplendent Magic Crystal Stones were laid out like crystals.
Amidst the light of glowing plants on the cave ceiling, the whole spectacle shone brightly, like a floor covered in diamonds.
Even a giant dragon’s hoard would pale in comparison to such a sight.
Anyone who saw this would feel a genuine shock.
This staggering wealth was enough to drive the King of the Human Empire mad.
This was the future of Dawn City.
“This… this….”
Betty opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but in the end, she could only shake her head, unable to utter a word.
The scene was beyond description.
The North was impoverished, with only a few Magic Crystal Ore Veins that were as tiny as could be; although she was a royal, this was the first time she had witnessed such a heart-stirring spectacle.
Even the King of the North’s treasury wasn’t one-tenth or even one-hundredth the size of this underground space.
Lide, looking down at the Magic Crystal Stones below that were emitting a strong energy fluctuation, also felt very moved.
Nobody expected that the Cave Spiders, which had suddenly appeared on the surface to hunt miners, would guard such a staggering fortune.
With these Magic Crystal Stones, he could finally start the long-anticipated Magic Industry.
Dawn City had secured the chance to rise.

chapters.content:
﻿Chapter 331: Chapter 333: Prince Anos’ Revenge Memoir (10,000-word Mega Chapter) Additional Plot, Skip If Disliked~ Chapter 331: Chapter 333: Prince Anos’ Revenge Memoir (10,000-word Mega Chapter) Additional Plot, Skip If Disliked~ “Hahaha, you think you’re fit to become a prince of the Nolan Empire?? What a joke even the goddesses would laugh at.”
“Your mother was a lowly maid, and the blood flowing through your veins is the most despicable of all, you’ve completely disgraced our royal family.”
“Your magic talent, I heard it was ruined by a group of thieves?? Hahaha, how pitiful…”
“You’re that weakling and coward… Prince Anos??
I am the daughter of Duke Aonke, noble duke blood flows through my veins, I would never marry a piece of trash like you!! The marriage contract we had is now void!”
“Anos, your mother committed suicide last night because of your existence, ashamed, she took her own life with an alchemy poison made by the Keneili Snake Clan, I personally watched her body decay bit by bit, Anos, if you kneel and beg me, maybe I’ll pity you enough to return your mother’s skeleton to you… Haha, are you touched? My… dear brother…”
“Brother…”
“Brother…”
A demon-like voice echoed heavily in Anos’s ears, as if to devour his soul.
“Ah!!”
Anos abruptly opened his eyes, sitting up instinctively, and stared wide-eyed at the room illuminated by the magic lamp, gasping heavily, his back soaked in sweat.
But even after waking up, that nightmarish scene still lingered in his mind.
His hands instinctively grabbed the blanket tightly, the insults that were engraved on his soul spurred anger from deep within.
Those, all of them, were his enemies, the ones he intended to take revenge on!!
Anos Nolan, born to a maid, the most disgraceful existence within the Nolan Royal Family.
The name Anos was a joke in the Nolan Capital, a prince that even the beggars on the street would mock.
Because, everything about him was far too lowly.
From the day he was born, he was viewed as a disgrace.
So it was with those jeering princes, and so it was with his father whom he had never met.
For his birth was a mistake.
A laughable mistake.
The country drunk, getting a child with a lowly maid bought from the slave market—wasn’t that a colossal mistake?
If not for an ancestral decree, perhaps that humble slave maid would have turned to bones before she even bore him.
After being born with the title of prince, Anos never received any favor from the king; even that father he never met always saw him as a disgrace, after all, having a child with a lowly maid—how could such an act be worthy of his royal dignity?
And this was just the beginning.
From childhood, Anos grew up in a discriminatory environment, barely revealed to have mage talent, but had his talent destroyed on the day of the test by a few level 3 thieves.
Previously, a young commitment to marry the daughter of the newly prominent Duke Aonke family was arranged, but once the Aonke family secured their position in Nolan Capital, Duke Aonke’s eldest daughter came and mercilessly tore up the marriage contract.
This once again made Anos the laughingstock of Nolan Capital.
Of humble birth, low talent, not to mention being publicly humiliated by a fiancée tearing up their engagement—Anos, although bearing the title of a prince, lived a life even more pathetic than a beggar.
Had he been just an ordinary person, perhaps nobody would talk about him, but under jealousy and envy, insulting a prince brought more pleasure than insulting anyone else.
Thinking thus, Anos Nolan took a deep breath; his young face filled with stubbornness and defiance.
As long as he hadn’t died, he would never give up, unless he stopped breathing, nothing could halt his steps toward revenge.
Although he possessed a surname viewed as a glory in the Nolan Empire, Anos always considered it a disgrace, an ingrained disgrace in his bloodline.
“Sending me away to the southern provinces from the capital, slaughtering all my guards, stripping away all my possessions… Do you think that will stop me?”
The seventeen or eighteen-year-old boy, his inner rage was tumultuous.
But moments later, he slowly suppressed his fury, a vision of a captivating figure with long black hair and sparkling eyes softened his heart.
Suddenly his expression softened.
“Three years, Feiyana, just three more years.
After three years, I will return to the capital, and I will make those damned bastards pay for everything… Feiyana… wait for me, I won’t let you marry that lame old noble from the north, never!!”
Anos knew his mother was murdered, knew his magic talent was destroyed by thieves hired by others, knew his assignment to the city of Green City, a city he had never been to before, had been orchestrated.
But he was too weak, too weak to fight back against his enemies.
Now his only hope lay in the territory assigned to him.
With this thought, Anos clenched his fists.
If he could get a rich land parcel in Green City, manage it well, perhaps in three years, he might have a chance to exact his revenge.
He had only three years left; after three years, the girl he loved most, who had not only given him all her savings to help him escape the Nolan Capital but had also suffered severe injuries in the process, would fulfill her marriage contract—marrying a nobleman over 60 years old with a lame leg.
Damn the marriage contract, damn the family alliance!
Bang bang bang~
Suddenly, the knocking on the door interrupted Anos’s thoughts.
“Prince Anos, Duke O’Kelly requests your presence.”
The voice of an outside guard came through the tightly closed door.
O’Kelly Nolan, the City Lord of Green City and also the governor over the entire southern province, was a member of the Nolan Royal Family.
As a member of the royal family, Anos, despite his low status, still carried the bloodline of the Nolan Royal Family. Therefore, when he left the capital, he could be assigned a piece of territory.
Yes, a piece of territory that belonged to him.
Though this territory required approval from the controller of the southern province, Duke O’Kelly, it was still his own land.
This piece of territory was Anos’s only hope…
“I’ll be right there.”
After responding, Anos took a deep breath, turned his head, and glanced at the modest room—the City Lord’s residence provided for servants’ living quarters… and also his room…
He didn’t pay much attention to these details. After today, he would have his own land, his blue eyes filled with a hint of longing and hope.
He stood up and went to the mirror.
In the mirror appeared a handsome young man with blue eyes and golden short hair, dressed in luxurious noble clothing,
but discordantly, his emaciated body looked so frail and powerless, unable to support the weight of his lavish clothing.
He adjusted the somewhat disordered clothes on his body, which his mother had sewn for him when she was alive and were now the only presentable clothes he had.
Anos bit down on his teeth, his inner anger buried deep.
“Let not your emotions control you.”
These were the words his mother had cautioned him with; he had never dared forget them.
After a long time, creak—, the door opened, and two guards at the door looked at Anos, who emerged with a somewhat odd expression.
“Prince Anos, you have been wearing this outfit since arriving in Green City three days ago. Perhaps it’s time to change, especially since you are meeting the Duke today…”
Anos, expression unchanged, shook his head, “No need. Let’s go.”
Saying so, he walked straight out, two guards behind him revealing a hint of ridicule, “I always thought the legends were false…
I can’t believe this Prince Anos is really such a waste, can’t even afford a proper outfit, and yet he is still a prince?”
There was a perverse pleasure in their derogatory language, a low-ranking guard insulting a noble prince; look how mesmerizing that was.
“It’s said that Prince Anos was born to the King and a maid, always despised by the King, otherwise he would not have been sent away from the Nolan Capital…”
Another guard also didn’t spare his own mockery, relishing the pleasure of seeing someone of such high status reduced to lower than their own.
Human nature always has a dark side… mocking a once great person provides a thrill much greater than deriding a street beggar.
Ahead, Anos hadn’t heard these derogatory remarks; he still held a sliver of hope for tonight’s banquet.
If assigned a good piece of land, if managed earnestly, there would eventually come an opportunity for revenge…
The past humiliation and hatred, I will repay with blood…
After the skirt of the Night Goddess enveloped the earth, the air entered a state of pitch black and silence.
However, in the City Lord’s residence, the gown of the Dark Goddess seemed to have turned transparent, the magic lamps along the corridors brilliantly illuminating the path, unaffected by the darkness.
Walking through the winding path, crossing the luxurious frescoed corridors, it took a full twenty minutes before Anos, led by the guards, reached tonight’s banquet hall.
He could already hear the bustling noise inside from a distance.
After the guards behind him left, Anos approached the banquet hall, slightly surprised by the indifferent guards beside him, but said nothing, intending to push open the semicircular doors engraved with holy angels himself.
However, a guard standing by coldly stopped him.
“I’m sorry, today is Duke O’Kelly’s official banquet, and uninvited individuals are strictly forbidden from entering.”
Hmm?
Anos furrowed his brows, his posture frozen, “I am Prince Anos, invited by Duke O’Kelly…”
The young guard blocking his way let out a cold laugh, “Prince Anos? Hehe, was there ever such a person in the Nolan Empire? I’ve never heard of any Prince Anos!”
Hearing this, how could Anos not realize he was being targeted.
His eyes flickered with anger.
“Hmph, are you sure you want to stop me? I don’t care who is behind you, but if things get out of hand, are you sure your backers can protect you?!”
His tone was sonorous and firm, showing no signs of retreat.
Though deeply dependent and under others’ roofs, Anos was well aware of his advantage. Even if he were unpopular, he still carried the halo of a prince; no guard, no matter how daring, would easily dare to stop him.
As expected, the guard hesitated for a moment, but in the end, he gritted his teeth and did not let him in.
“I’m sorry, without Duke O’Kelly’s orders, you cannot enter…”
Humiliation, that sense of being looked down upon, surged again in Anos’s mind.
But what could he do? Fight? After his Magic Talent had been disabled, his Level was still 1…
Scold? A prince quarreling with a guard at the front door? It would only be him who would be embarrassed.
Leave? Today was the time to allocate territories; if he left now, all hope would turn into bubbles.
Child, remember, in this world, being weak is the only sin…
These words, advised by his mother on the night before she died, echoed again in Anos’s mind.
Weakness is the only sin.
Because he was weak, even the door guard dared to stop him, and the saddest part was that he could not resist…
His fingers slowly clenched into a fist.
His heart roared in this moment.
Become strong, I must become strong!!!
Eeek~
It seemed that the noise at the door was heard inside.
The massive living room door was pushed open, and a young man in luxurious clothing walked out with an indifferent expression and glanced coldly at Anos.
“What happened?”
Before Anos could speak, the guard who had been very indifferent just a moment ago immediately stepped forward, looking wronged, and pointed at Anos to complain.
“Mr. Lika, just now I tried to invite Prince Anos into the hall, but he disdainfully insisted that Duke O’Kelly come out to greet him. He said he was a prince, of noble status…”
Anos watched the face of the guard who was slandering him before him change colors; just as he was about to speak, the young man who had come out coldly said,
“Prince Anos, why are you causing trouble for our guards? Although you are a prince, Duke O’Kelly is your elder!
Hmph, let’s leave it at this for now, but if there is a next time, I will definitely report this to the Duke.
Come in.”
After saying that, he didn’t even give Anos a chance to reply before turning and walking away.
Leaving only Anos, his body slightly trembling.
Looking again at the guard who had returned to his previous disdainful demeanor, he just felt a surge of blood in his mind.
Do not let your emotions control you… do not let your emotions control you…
Anos struggled to suppress the anger in his heart; he knew it was all part of a conspiracy, intended to infuriate him.
Turning his head, Anos could only pretend as if nothing happened and walked straight into the house.
This 18-year-old youth was at an age of boiling passion, but he had to endure unimaginable humiliation from outsiders.
Yet, he was powerless to resist.
Weakness is the original sin, there are no mistakes in this world, the only mistake is not being strong enough.
“Hmph, consider yourself lucky, great Prince Anos… Haha, it’s really a laughable title.”
The guard, watching Anos prepare to enter the house, laughed carelessly.
But his tone was nauseating.
Anos didn’t turn back; his fingers were almost clenched to the point of bleeding.
Tap, tap~
Tap, tap~
Treading on the luxurious Derick maple wood floor, Anos entered the banquet hall for this occasion.
Yet his arrival as a prince was even less noticed than a maid’s… completely ignored.
The banquet hall was filled with over a hundred extravagantly dressed nobles, engaging in lively conversations.
The magnificent hall was adorned with colorful oil paintings celebrating the great heroic kings who once founded the Nolan Empire.
Although Anos had entered the banquet hall, he was as invisible as a ghost; not even the servants acknowledged his presence.
Even though he was dressed lavishly, he seemed out of place, like a dwarf at an elf gathering, which appeared quite bizarre.
Just as Anos was feeling exceedingly awkward, he suddenly felt a tap on his shoulder.
He swiftly turned around to find a middle-aged man dressed in a baron’s attire standing beside him.
Anos, somewhat puzzled, looked at the man who had approached him, just about to ask questions when the man spoke first.
“Your Highness Anos, I am Griss Bob, a baron from Green City. I am honored to meet you.”
After these words, Anos felt surprisingly flattered.
Throughout his life, he had never been treated with such respect. Although the man was merely a baron, his treatment was far superior compared to Anos’s previous encounters.
“Baron Griss, the honor is mine…”
Seeing the somewhat excited and flustered young man in front of him, Griss’s smile grew more sincere.
“Prince Anos, you are here today for the allocation of land, right?”
Anos’s expression changed slightly, and he looked at Griss with caution.
“Do not misunderstand, Prince Anos. I learned about tonight’s land allocation ceremony from a guard of Duke O’Kelly…” Griss spread his hands and then smiled meaningfully.
“Moreover, I inadvertently overheard some information about the lands being allocated today from the guard’s conversation… I thought you might be interested…”
Hearing this, Anos’s interest was piqued, but Griss’s sudden appearance and uninvited favors made him very wary.
“Baron Griss, I want to know what your intentions are.”
There’s no such thing as a free lunch, and Anos was not swayed by Griss’s information.
Predicting Anos would ask this, Griss said with a beaming smile,
“Prince Anos, once your territory is established, I hope my merchant caravan could benefit from some tax relief in your lands. Believe me, my guild will bring additional opportunities for the development of your territory…”
Hearing this, Anos finally relaxed, understanding that a request was only reasonable and proper.
“Welcome, Baron Griss…”
After hearing this, Griss’s smile became even brighter.
“By the Goddess above, this is the best news I have received today. I swear to the Goddess of Wealth, your highness, you won’t be disappointed.”
After saying this, Griss stepped closer, leaned towards Anos and whispered.
“There are six plots being allocated today. The best one is near the Eagle River, and the worst one is the Red Moon Territory. The other plots are…
So, Prince Anos, if you wish to develop properly, you need to secure the land near Eagle River…
But under no circumstances should you choose the Red Moon Territory.”
Hearing this, Anos’s face showed a hint of contemplation.
“Why shouldn’t I choose the Red Moon Territory?”
Griss shook his head, “If you want to meet the Death God, feel free to choose it.”
“Ah??”
“The Red Moon Territory is bordered by the Dwarf Hills to the east and the ocean to the south…”
“Is there a problem with that?”
“The Dwarf Hills are Centaur territory, and those brutal creatures love to raid human nobles, while the southern ocean is controlled by the Fishman Country, which is still at war with us. Anything can happen…
I forgot to mention, there have been ten landowners of the Red Moon Territory before, and without exception, all were killed within the territory…”
Hearing this, Anos instinctively shuddered. Ten owners, all killed?
He immediately realized that this must be a trap prepared for him.
“Baron Griss, thank you for your advice. I think we will become friends…”
Friends? A meaningful smile appeared on Griss’s face.
“Yes, we will become friends…”
As they conversed, a new development occurred in the room.
O’Kelly Nolan, the lavish Duke and city lord of Green City, entered the banquet hall under the protection of guards, walking with firm steps.
The crowd around immediately stood up upon seeing the figure of Duke O’Kelly, bowing and greeting this noble of high status with a hand-on-chest salute.
“Good day, Duke O’Kelly…”
“It is an honor to be invited by you…”
“Respected Duke O’Kelly, the Kir family sends its greetings to you…”
The scene was vastly different from the one that had welcomed Prince Anos earlier—it was like comparing goblins to a giant dragon.
A flash of longing passed through Anos’s eyes as he witnessed the scene.
If he could possess such power… then he could definitely take his revenge, without a doubt!
Moments later, his dream took a step closer to reality.
For Duke O’Kelly had announced that tonight, he would allocate territories to those of age within the Nolan Royal Family.
Allocating territories was a tradition of the Nolan Royal Family.
After reaching adulthood, the young royals would receive lands, distributed across various provinces, and it was through this method that the Nolan Empire firmly controlled the entire country.
Among those who were allocated territories alongside Anos today were five others, one of whom was Duke O’Kelly’s third son—the others were also members of branches of the Nolan Royal Family from the southern provinces.
The Nolan Empire had been established for three thousand years; over these millennia, the Nolan Royal Family had spread throughout the entire country, hence there were always groups of young people receiving land every year.
“According to imperial law, any royal family member who is allocated territory must achieve some accomplishments beneficial for the empire within three generations; otherwise, the land will be reclaimed.
Young gentlemen, land is the foundation of the empire. I hope you can build up powerful cities on your own lands.
The future belongs to you.
Chief Akala, you will preside over this ennoblement ceremony.”
After his brief speech, Duke O’Kelly did not continue to host the ceremony but turned and left after announcing the rules, apparently busy with some urgent matters.
In Green City, Duke O’Kelly held the most venerable position, commanding respect even from the Extraordinary Mage, Lock; no one dared to say a word against his actions.
After Duke O’Kelly left, an old man with a hawk nose dressed in a black tailcoat leisurely made his way through the crowd.
With a wave of his hand, his guards, under the gaze of all present, unfurled a large map made of sheepskin which displayed the southern provinces, with several territories notably marked in red.
“Now, please, members of the Royal Family designated for land allocation, step forward.”
Immediately, five young men, dressed luxuriously and exuding an impressive demeanor, walked out from the crowd, including the young man Anos had encountered at the door.
“Is this Duke O’Kelly’s third son? He really is handsome…”
“Oh, my goodness, Marquis Mike’s eldest son has grown up so much, we must demand they honor our family’s marriage agreement with them upon our return…”
“…”
As the five noble youths stepped forward, they instantly sparked countless discussions—youthful, handsome, and soon to be landowners.
All these factors combined to ensure they were the center of attention.
The hawk-nosed butler in the tailcoat glanced briefly at the group in front of him and nodded slightly. The corner of his eye caught sight of the list in his hand as he glanced around the crowd, then slowly said,
“Is there one more? From the Royal Capital, Prince Anos…”
Upon hearing this, the previously bustling hall suddenly fell silent as if someone had choked everyone at once.
Then, someone burst into laughter which could not be held back, followed swiftly by explosive laughter that filled the air with a merry atmosphere.
“Ha ha ha ha, who would have thought that the son of that lowly slave would dare come to Green City to claim land?”
“A prince? Our Nolan Empire surely does not have such a prince; even the king himself has not acknowledged his existence…”
“I heard this Prince Anos is only at level one? Ha ha ha, my seven-year-old son is already at level two, why would the king allow such a worthless person to come to Green City?”
“…”
Everyone was ruthlessly discussing all this.
A child born to a former slave maid, one who had been considered a disgrace by the king from birth.
Such a background surely qualified as legendary—of course, the kind of legend that provoked ridicule.
Anos stood there, fists clenched tightly as they made a cracking sound, watching the unrestrained laughter around him.
A rush of blood went straight to his head.
Humiliation—it was like being stripped naked, thrown into the street, and displayed to everyone.
It was a trampling of his soul.
But what made Anos feel even more humiliated was that he was powerless to change the situation.
Yes, he was just a Level 1 waste, the child of a slave maid, a prince regarded as a disgrace by his own father.
He was furious at the injustice of the world towards him, but he was even more angry that he was powerless to fight back when faced with these injustices.
He was almost deprived of even the right to speak out in rebuttal.
Because a rebuttal from a weakling was merely shameless, lacking self-awareness, and a lowly statement that only drew ridicule.
“Prince Anos, don’t give up…”
Just when everyone was scoffing, the voice that came from behind gradually pulled together Anos’s nearly crumbling heart.
“Baron Griss…”
After turning his head to glance at the middle-aged man behind him, Anos turned around and, with gritted teeth, stepped forward.
The surrounding whispers surged like waves crashing over him, he was like a lonely boat sailing through the storm, at any moment likely to capsize.
The hawk-nosed butler watching the scene showed no change in expression.
Dignity is earned by oneself. Without strength, who is to blame for being humiliated?
“Now, let us begin.”
Without paying too much attention to Anos, the hawk-nosed butler slightly turned and began to signal towards the map held upright by the guards behind him.
“I have marked six areas on it.
Everyone may choose one as their territory, but remember, once the territory is chosen, it will be bound to you forever and cannot be changed.
Your descendants must achieve the feats stipulated by the royal family within three generations to continue holding this land, otherwise, you will lose the right to inherit the land.
Now, begin. You may freely choose.”
After saying this, the hawk-nosed butler spoke no more.
This allocation happened annually, and most of these lands would return to the control of the empire within a hundred years… Very few could continue their family and territory.
Upon hearing this, except for Anos, the other young individuals all turned their eyes towards the leader among them—the third son of Duke O’Kelly.
Rank and order were preserved; this position of a third heir to the Duke was by no means comparable to theirs.
Originally, the position of the prince was the most esteemed here, but clearly, Anos was not qualified.
This prince, without family background, talent, strength, and even regarded as a disgrace by his father, how could he possibly be the one to choose when even the guards dared to mock him?
But as the others waited for the Duke O’Kelly’s third son to choose, the overlooked Anos stepped forward two steps and directly pointed at a piece of land in the middle area of the map.
“Your Excellency, I choose this piece of land…”
Suddenly, the surrounding crowd was startled, looking at him incredulously.
Had this waste gone mad? He actually dared to choose before the little Duke.
The hawk-nosed butler nodded, said nothing, and had the guards put a red sticker on that territory.
And the land marked was—Eagle Riverside.
However, Anos did not stay happy for long, the disregarded little Duke immediately stepped forward, glaring furiously at Anos.
“Who gave you the audacity to choose Eagle Riverside?!!”
After saying this, under everyone’s gaze, he tore off the sticker and carelessly threw it on the ground, then stretched out his hand for the guards to paste his sticker.
After this action was completed, he still despised Anos with a glance.
“Prince Anos, recognize your status, this is Green City…”
The few noble sons behind him showed the same expressions, ignoring Anos, and proceeded to choose their favored territories.
In fact, before choosing the territories, they had already determined their lands, and if not for Anos’s presence, even this ceremony could have been omitted.
The royal family’s rules of allocation were nothing more than a formality in their eyes.
A rush of blood went straight to his head.
At this moment, Anos’s soul was almost ignited by rage.
Disgrace,
It was an unmerciful trampling of his dignity.
Indeed, he would not hesitate to draw his sword, to tear these damnable nobles to pieces, and to cast their souls into hell to burn.
“The Eagle Territory belongs to the little Duke, the Derick Territory belongs to Marquis Mike…”
The hawk-nosed butler read until the end, then turned his head and looked at Anos, who had already bitten his lips till they bled, and said indifferently.
“The Red Moon Territory, bordered by the Dwarf Hills and the ocean, belongs to Prince Anos.”
“Today’s grant ceremony ends here, please enjoy the dinner everyone.”
After the last sentence was spoken, the hook-nosed old steward turned around and left immediately without sparing another look at Anos, whose territory had been forcibly snatched away.
The surrounding crowd witnessed this scene and sneered.
“Hahaha, trying to compete with the Little Duke for territory, how foolish.
Just because you have the title of Prince doesn’t mean you get to choose first…”
“Red Moon Territory? Hahaha, what a great place! I heard that the centaurs in the Dwarf Hills love to plunder human property.
The last lord of the Red Moon Territory was minced into meat sauce by centaurs five years ago, wasn’t he? How pitiful, Prince Anos. After owning the territory for just a few days, he might become centaur food…”
“Red Moon Territory is also adjacent to the sea, and the Fishman Country has been attacking our coastal cities recently, surrounded by centaurs and Fishmen… Hahaha, I wouldn’t dare go to that territory even if it were given to me…”
After the perfunctory grand ceremony, Anos once again became the laughingstock.
Everyone ridiculed his foolishness, and they also laughed at the tragic fate he was about to face.
The Red Moon Territory, that was famously known as the land of death for lords in the southern province.
The land had a total of ten owners, each one without exception, died within their own territory, only a noble who never dared to step into his territory and later abandoned it survived.
Now, this despised Prince Anos was going to be a man doomed to die, which made these nobles gossip and mostly watch the spectacle with mocking and spectatorial attitudes, only a few felt pity for the Prince’s tragic life.
But under the influence of music and wine, they soon forgot that pity.
The sky had fallen.
All hope was extinguished when the old steward declared the Red Moon Territory his.
Anos stared blankly at the bright red sticker on the map.
Surrounded by centaurs and Fishmen…
He remembered Griss’s repeated admonitions.
The words of the people around him confirmed it all.
The tragic experiences of the former lords of the Red Moon Territory starkly revealed the cruelty and bloodiness of the world.
Those hidden in the shadows must have orchestrated all this.
They wanted him dead, wanted this royal disgrace dead…
If they sent someone to kill him, his status as a prince of the Nolan Royal Family might draw attention; but if he died within his own territory, he would merely become a laughingstock, nobody would care about a failure.
The sky darkened, and the luxurious surroundings appeared to Anos as lifeless as ancient graves.
His heart, already burdened with humiliation, was struck again.
All hope was gone.
The territory which once fueled his intentions for revenge, was his hope; but now, that land, more terrifying than oblivion itself, shattered the last bit of hope he had.
Endless despair enveloped him.
He remembered his mother, whose tender eyes were filled with reluctance before she left that night, she must have known what she was going to face, she must have.
He remembered his father, who considered him a disgrace to the Nolan Royal Family, whom he had never met in his lifetime,
He remembered the eldest daughter of the Aonke family, who tore up his engagement in front of him.
He remembered his royal brother, who coldly told him in front of him that his mother was killed by a potent poison, even her body had decomposed…
He remembered being attacked by several thieves severing his casting talent forcefully…
He remembered the girl filled with tears, hoping and waiting for his return…
He remembered all the past insults, sarcasm, contempt, ridicule, derision, and humiliation he had faced.
Weakness was the greatest sin.
At this moment, Anos etched it into his soul.
Only with power, could he have everything…
If I could attain power, I would give my all!!
Even if it’s my soul!!
A roar surged nearly bursting from his soul.
The prince, who stood in the center of the crowd yet was treated as if he were invisible, clenched his teeth, his lips already showing a crimson hue.
His fingers, exerting too much force, had split his clenched palm open, and the blood slowly dripped onto the white velvet carpet, blossoming into small bloody patches.
Yet all of this went unnoticed.
A waste, who would spare him a second glance?
Anos, as if he had lost his soul, staggered, stumbled, and hurried out of the still joyous hall.
The surroundings, like mountains, heavily pressed upon his head.
Everyone was trampling on his soul, stomping on his skull with their soles, mocking and humiliating him in every way possible.
A waste… a worthless prince born of a lowly maid…
Nightmare-like words constantly echoed in his mind.
Anos, forgetting everything around him, staggered out of the city lord’s residence, his eyes filled with dead ashes.
Lost, without purpose, he roamed the streets.
With a splash, after stepping into empty air, he seemed to have fallen into a mud puddle, Anos subconsciously got up, his pupils unfocused, staring meaninglessly ahead.
“Young man, do you desire power?”
Just as Anos unknowingly wandered for a long time, curling up in a street corner, unnoticed by the bustling crowd around him.
A gentle voice sounded in Anos’s ears.
His gaze emotionless, his hands hugging his knees, Anos lifted his head to look at the face hidden under the hood, revealing only a high nose bridge.
“Who are you?”
His voice was unnaturally hoarse, like a harsh sound made by rubbing sand on the ground.
Hearing this question, the Cloaked One’s eyes, hidden in the shadows, revealed a profoundly meaningful smile.
“You can call me — the Eternal.”
“Anos, do you desire power?
Do you crave immortality?”
“Do you desire revenge?”
“Do you yearn to trample your once-enemies underfoot, tear apart their bodies, and violate their souls?”
“Do you wish to reclaim all that you have lost and make the world tremble for you?”
Anos felt a shiver in his heart, that demonic whisper continuously echoing in his ear.
Striking the deepest desires of his heart.
Power… only power could solve all the problems now.
I desire, I yearn for everything he speaks of.
From hope rising to shattering, suppressed to the extreme, Anos suddenly threw back his head, using all his strength to let out a thunderous roar.
“I desire everything you speak of!!! Everything!!”
“I need power!! The greatest power!!! Even if it costs my soul!!!”
Loud voices echoed through the streets, but eerily, the passersby remained indifferent, seemingly not hearing the beast-like roar.
“Even if, for this, you become a demon?” The shadowy eyes of the Cloaked One flashed, “Even if forever hidden in darkness?
Even if becoming a creature that revels in evil?”
Anos’s heart shuddered, but he didn’t hesitate for a moment.
“I! Am! Willing!”
Word by word, resolute, his tone filled with irrevocable determination.
“Very well, young man.
From today onwards, you will gain immortality, gain power, gain everything you want…
We will avenge you, help you win back everything you have lost.
Indeed, we will help you ascend to the throne of the Nolan Empire—crown you as the King.
Just remember, we are — the Holy Light Bloodline…”
