chapters.content:
Chapter 375: Chapter 377: At the Break of Dawn, the Horns Sound Chapter 375: Chapter 377: At the Break of Dawn, the Horns Sound April 12, in the afternoon, as dusk approached, the sky grew dimmer.
A squad of grim-armored Dwarf soldiers was marching at the time, and wherever they went, whether it was Demon Beasts or other beings, all were intimidated by their vast numbers and hastily cleared the way.
Ahead of this Dwarf army were over 20,000 goat cavalry members, with massive curved horns that looked like they were forged from steel, radiating a sense of power.
Behind the goat cavalry was a contingent of tens of thousands of Dwarf war chariots, crafted by Dwarves into the shape of hedgehogs, which were hair-raising to behold.
Following those were the Dwarf heavy infantry, encased as if in tin cans. It was said that in ancient times, the formidable Dwarf heavy infantry could withstand the charge of cavalry. Though the legends might be somewhat exaggerated, they also indirectly attested to the formidable nature of Dwarf heavy infantry.
Among them were crossbowmen clutching powerful crossbows whose lethality was no less than that of bows, classified as weapons with a high floor and a low ceiling.
A crossbow in the hands of a child could severely injure or even kill the enemy if they pulled the trigger and hit the target, whereas, with a longbow, a child couldn’t even draw the string.
Of course, once proficient with a longbow, the various tactical shots were something that crossbows could not match.
The Dwarves had a love for forging weapons and fine wines and naturally had no interest in practicing with longbows, so the easy-to-use, powerful crossbow became their weapon of choice.
Naris Copper Hammer, the 19th Level leader of the Copper Hammer Tribe, and Rabiao Hammer, the 17th Level Clan Leader of the Barbarian Hammer Tribe, rode majestic male goats at the forefront of the goat cavalry, leading the army forward.
It had already been a full half month since they left the Blue Sea Province, but the 15 days of marching had not tired this amazingly enduring troop.
On the contrary, as they drew closer to their destination, the entire Dwarf army became increasingly exhilarated.
The Southern Provinces were mostly hilly terrain, which caused little trouble for the Dwarves, skilled at marching through the mountains and rocks.
“Rabiao, what place is this? How far is it until we reach the Barren Wasteland?
My battle-axe can’t wait to taste the fresh blood of the Beastmen!!
And those damned Vampires, we’ll take them out into the sunlight and let them burn to death!
Nobody dares to compete with the Dwarves for Mithril, nobody!”
The voice of Naris Copper Hammer sounded full of righteous indignation.
The male goat beneath him seemed to sense his master’s anger, lifting its forefeet high and stomping fiercely onto the ground.
Soil splattered.
Me-eh~
Despite the aggressive and fierce action, the sheepish bleat that followed gave a somewhat comically angry vibe.
“Look, my little treasure is already enraged. If male goats ate meat, he would be very willing to devour the brains of those Beastmen.”
Hearing his counterpart’s question, Rabiao Hammer’s deep eyes revealed a hint of anticipation. It was the anticipation of imminent revenge and the eagerness to reclaim the Secret Silver Vein.
“Naris, this is the territory of Green City, which is the capital of the Southern Province. We’ve just passed by it.
Next, we will follow this trade road directly through the border of the Nolan Empire and reach the Barren Wasteland.
In no more than five days, we will reach the valley that belongs to the Barbarian Hammer Tribe.”
“Speed up! I can’t wait any longer! The Secret Silver Vein belongs to the Dwarves only!”
Naris Copper Hammer shouted.
And at that moment, far from the range of the Dwarf army, on a small hill, a group of about ten gamers preparing to hunt Gnolls caught sight of the massive Dwarf army.
They immediately looked excited.
“Holy shit, this is the first time I’ve seen so many Dwarves. Look at these Dwarfs’ equipment; it’s so sturdy I could hack at it all day and not make a dent, right?
What the hell are these guys up to, dragon slaying?”
“Goat cavalry?? The main fighting force of the Dwarves, they’ve got to be up to something big…”
“Shall we follow them and see? If we could snag a few high-Level quests, we’d be set…”
“Follow them your ass, let’s just stop them outright…”
“Aren’t you afraid of death? The experience penalty in this crappy game is so severe…”
“Nonsense, of course, I’m afraid to die, but would you pass up this kind of opportunity?”
After some noisy quarreling, they all reached a consensus. In the end, they sent three players to go up and chat with the Dwarves to take on some quests.
With the player’s nature, faced with a scene of this magnitude, they definitely wouldn’t let it slip by; they’d risk being mistakenly killed over it.
The three designated players also knew to avoid risks wisely, conscientiously stowing all their weapons and equipment into their System Space, and walked towards the Dwarf army with clean hands.
Anyway, they couldn’t beat them in a fight, and if something did happen, they might not even have a chance to run, let alone kill themselves before being slain by Dwarves…
Players beaten countless times by Glory had seldom acted as unrestrained as before.
Obeying rules was the blood-stained lesson drawn by countless people; those who didn’t abide by the rules were mostly still lingering at Level 1 or were beaten to the point of quitting the game…
“Respected Dwarf sirs, we would like to talk with you~”
Before they could get close to the main force, a few Dwarf goat cavalry responsible for guard duty spotted the three players brazenly approaching.
“Who are you?”
The male goat stood about 2.6 blades tall, quite burly, and the Dwarf riding it looked down from a height with a commanding gaze.
“Dwarf sire, we are adventurers from the Lost Plane. Do you have any quests that you need us to complete?”
The young man who spoke first sounded a bit naive.
Hearing this, several Dwarves exchanged glances, all with somewhat odd expressions.
Are these guys idiots?
With such a huge army behind them, do they still need them to help complete quests?? What could a few Level 3 professionals do? Transport hay for the goats?
“Not needed, leave here quickly, stupid humans, we have no time to play with you.”
The leading Dwarf said and even gave them a glare, turned his goat around, and left.
Dwarves were a kindhearted race and, though never soft on enemies, had little inclination to bother with these innocuous humans.
The three players were suddenly anxious; they were sent packing before even starting, which could not stand. The leading Assassin player decided immediately.
“Dwarf sire, I have important intelligence to report to you!”
Several dwarves pulled on the reins, their faces expressing speechlessness as they looked at the three players, “You guys have important information?”
One of the dwarves burst out laughing.
“Important information? What important information could you possibly have? That Aunt Mary’s roast turkey tastes awful?”
“Hahaha, Aunt Mary’s roast turkey? That truly is a nightmare…”
“Oh my, you guys still remember that? I’ve had enough, the taste from ten years ago still makes me scared of anything turkey-related. By the Forge God above, it’s the only thing I’ve ever been afraid of in my life…”
The dwarves erupted into laughter, then ignored the players and started to regroup.
“Damn it, are these dwarves idiots?”
The three players felt somewhat helpless. This was a tough crowd, wasn’t it?
But they lacked the courage to approach again. Though they could communicate with the dwarves, provoking them would be costly, and they would lose all the experience they had worked hard to gain over the month by doing quests.
“Let’s go, damn this broken game, why is it so hard to accept a quest…”
“Ptui, just a dwarf? If grandpa here were to do a quest I wouldn’t even bother with them. These shorties have probably never experienced my scolding!”
At this moment, the disturbance caused by the players caught the attention of two Dwarf Clan Leaders.
“What’s going on? Who are those humans?” Nalis Copper Hammer asked, somewhat irritated, to a dwarf beside him.
“Please wait a moment…”
After a short while, the dwarf returned, “Clan Leader, those are adventurers from the Lost World, claiming that they have important information to report…”
“Adventurers from the Lost Plane?” Nalis Copper Hammer’s eyes lit up with curiosity. The Copper Hammer Tribe was located deep in the mountains, and players had yet to enter this stage because the towering walls had blocked them out.
He had not yet had a real encounter with these legendary beings rumored to be able to resurrect themselves.
“Rabiao, are you familiar with the adventurers from the Lost Plane?”
Rabiao shook his head, “Before I found the Copper Hammer Tribe, I had many dealings with these adventurers. However, they act with no logic, have no sense of rules, and are nothing like us.
However, their information is quite accurate. Maybe we could summon them to get the latest on the events happening in the Barren Wasteland.”
Hearing this, Nalis Copper Hammer nodded, “Then call them over…”
These days they’d encountered quite a few players, but the Dwarf Army was too busy to deal with them. Now that they were nearing their destination, some useful information might not be amiss.
The somewhat disgruntled players had just turned to leave when the sound of hoofbeats followed them, and several goat riders approached.
“Adventurers from the Lost Plane, our Clan Leader summons you.”
This?
The three players exchanged glances and quickly became excited, with thoughts of epic quests, hidden professions, dragon eggs, and Divine Artifacts flashing through their minds.
This was bound to be a windfall.
Without hesitation, they quickly followed.
As for what they had just said, they claimed they couldn’t remember…
Shortly after, the three players met the two Clan Leaders seated high atop their sturdy goats.
“Adventurers from the Lost Plane, is there any information you’d like to report to us?” Nalis Copper Hammer lost interest after looking at the famed Undead.
A bunch of Level 3 rookies couldn’t even beat the sturdy goat he was sitting on.
Uh…
The assassin player, who had spoken out of desperation, was suddenly at a loss. What information did he have? Hadn’t he just bluffed to meet them?
Feeling the stares of the people around him, he panicked.
Who knew bragging came with a price nowadays?
I’m foolish, seriously foolish. I knew these dwarves were easy to talk to, but I didn’t expect you to take me seriously. We agreed it would be heartfelt, not hard-hitting. Now what? In trouble?
“Are you deceiving me?”
Nalis Copper Hammer raised an eyebrow, his aura emanating outwards like an Evil Dragon.
The three players immediately felt as if a boulder was pressing on their chests, almost unable to breathe.
The assassin player panicked at the response. This was bad.
After struggling for a while, he suddenly remembered the recent buzz about Divine relics. Though it was the talk of all Glory, it still counted as important information.
And it seemed that the NPC barely paid any attention to this according to the forums…
He decided to speak up on the spot.
“Respected Dwarf sir, there is indeed some information to report to you, but it’s such a significant matter that I’m not sure how to begin…”
Although mentioning the cliched Divine relics might get him beaten, he had to act confident–what if they didn’t know?
But Nalis Copper Hammer, unaware of the players’ foolish nature, became interested.
“What’s your name, adventurer from the Lost Plane?”
Uh, why didn’t he continue asking?
The face of the assassin player named Knowledgeable Sister froze, and then, under the watchful eyes of the others, he mustered up courage and said.
“I, my name is Knowledgeable Sister…”
What the hell?
Knowledgeable Sister?
Looking at the burly man and then thinking about the name he just heard, the scene fell into a deathly silence.
Then someone chuckled lightly, followed by all the dwarves erupting into boisterous laughter.
“Cursed adventurers, hahaha, you kill me! By the Forge God above, I bet this is the funniest joke I’ve heard in my life.”
“Knowledgeable Sister?? If Aunt Mary knew about this name, I swear, she’d be so happy she’d never roast another turkey… hahaha…”
“Hahaha, I can’t take it, I’m going to fall…” Thump–before he could finish speaking, a dwarf couldn’t contain himself and toppled over from his goat, raising a cloud of dust as he hit the ground.
The player named Knowledgeable Sister wished he could travel back in time to the day the game server launched and drag himself out of the gaming pod to slap himself hard.
“Damn it for picking such an unlucky name!!!”
Tearful big sister wanted to cry without tears…
The two players beside her showed no mercy as they flashed their big white teeth, laughing just as loudly as the Dwarves.
“Ahem, Intimate… Adventurer from the Lost Plane, you may now share your information.”
Nalis Copper Hammer really couldn’t bring himself to say the name.
“Yes, Dwarf sir,” Intimate Big Sister couldn’t wait to get past this part, and hastily said, “Esteemed sir, I wonder if you have heard about the Divine Remnants?”
“Divine Remnants?” Nalis Copper Hammer and the surrounding Dwarves exchanged curious glances, “Are you referring to the Divine Remnants of Risier City that’s been all the buzz outside?”
“Yes.”
“Isn’t that Divine Remnants just some false news spread by you adventurers?”
Intimate Big Sister’s mouth twitched; who spread false news? This news was truer than gold; the problem was that few of you believed it.
“No, sir, this is genuine news, not false. Our Lost Plane is interconnected, possessing very advanced means of communication.
Once a person gets the news and is willing to share it, the whole world can quickly become aware.
There are those among us who have entered Risier City and witnessed the sight of the Divine Remnants…
And Risier City is less than 100 kilometers from here; the Beastmen have still not retreated, so it’s very possible the Divine Remnants have not yet been excavated by the Beastmen.
If you are willing to explore, you could arrive by tonight…
Moreover, more and more Human Clan armies are starting to lurk around, and the Beastman Army has become more vigilant… It seems the seal on the Divine Remnants is about to be broken.
With such a powerful Dwarf army at your disposal, perhaps you can get a share of the spoils.”
“Beastmen are stationed there??” Hearing this, Nalis Copper Hammer’s eyes widened, “Those damned bastards!”
He turned to Rabiao Hammer, “Rabiao, is Risier City really just a little over 100 kilometers from us? Do we need to divert our path to confirm this?”
Rabiao fell silent for a moment, pondering, and then suddenly turned to look at the three silly players.
“Is what you say true? Does Risier City really have Divine Remnants?”
“Absolutely true, sir!! You can also send a vanguard force to verify it. Once they are near Risier City, just capturing and questioning a few local people will confirm the truth.”
Hearing this, Rabiao nodded, “Nalis Clan Chief, we can change our route. Risier City is a Human Clan city. The Beastmen often quickly retreat back to the barrens after invading Human Clan cities.
For them to occupy a Human Clan city for such a long time without leaving, there must be a reason.
Moreover, Risier City also has direct access to the barrens, so if these adventurers are lying, we would only lose half a day at most, not a significant loss.
But if it’s true, then those damned Beastmen won’t have the pleasure of reaping the rewards alone!”
Nalis Copper Hammer was immediately persuaded by such well-founded arguments.
“Very well, my brother, then we head to Risier City to see if those despicable Beastmen really did uncover the Divine Remnants.”
The Dwarves might love their ore, but the allure of the Divine Remnants was obviously no less than that of a Secret Silver Vein.
“Send the orders down, the army will turn, heading towards Risier City.
Send a vanguard of 1000 from the Mountain Goat Cavalry to scout for any ambushes and danger; the main force will depart half a Sunshine Hour after the vanguard.”
The Dwarf signal officer received the order and immediately went to pass it on, while the three players got instantly excited, following their advice meant there was a chance.
“Noble Lords, if you have any tasks, you can entrust them to us adventurers, we don’t fear death…”
“Very well, Intimate… Big Sister…” Nalis Copper Hammer forcibly suppressed the urge to say the ridiculous name, “You follow the vanguard to scout ahead, and your two companions will stay with the main army as we move forward.”
The three of them immediately lit up with excitement; they all heard the system’s promotion, their faces filled with exhilaration.
“Yes, sir!”
Watching the teeming army, Intimate Big Sister felt like she was about to ascend to heaven – she had struck it big this time, and hurriedly sneaked a few snapshots to show off on the forums.
You might not believe it if I said it, but I brought tens of thousands of Dwarf troops to Risier City to fight the Beastmen–damn, it’s thrilling.
Other aspects of this lousy game may be lacking, but the realism is to die for.
And so, unbeknownst to all, a Dwarf army, because of the sudden appearance of players, quietly advanced towards Risier City.
Mountain Goat Cavalry, Dwarf War Cars, Dwarf Heavy Infantry, Dwarf Crossbowmen… an army formidable enough to make anyone take notice was, by a sheer stroke of luck, heading towards an explosive situation.
At this time, it was the afternoon of April 12th… It seems there was only one more day until the seal of Risier City would be broken.
—
—
—
“Your Grace, 30,000 troops have assembled at Grey Corner City, and our secret mobilization order has brought the entire 200,000 troops in readiness.
Among them, 20,000 heavy cavalry, 30,000 light cavalry, 30,000 archers, 100,000 infantry, 10,000 from the Pegasus Cavalry, and a sieging corps of 10,000 armed with siege crossbows are ready.
At this moment, all troops, under the protection of priests from the Knight Temple and the Noble Temple, have drawn near to within 50 kilometers of Risier City.
Now, everyone is waiting for your command.”
The Knight Captain, donning a blue cloak, stood at Duke O’Kelly’s side and reported, his cloak billowing in the strong wind.
Duke O’Kelly had yet to speak, when the bishop from the Noble God Sect stepped forward respectfully.
“Your Grace, the Holy Light Pearl has given warning thrice; tomorrow will be the day the seal breaks.
We are running out of time.”
Duke O’Kelly turned to glance at the bishop and nodded slightly.
“Send the orders, the army will advance 40 kilometers, and at dawn tomorrow, sound the horns!
I need to take Risier City as quickly as possible… God of Nobles above, I swear, the Beastmen will serve as stepping stones beneath our feet!”
“At your command!”
After the Knight Captain turned to deliver the orders, Duke O’Kelly’s expression turned solemn.
“Bishop Sir, this time I have summoned 1,000 official Mages from the Mage Association of Green City to join the Pegasus Cavalry in this campaign.
“All spellcasters will be under your command. You may now lead them to prepare. To cast large-scale composite magic, the preparation time is not trivial.”
“This war will be unprecedented in its intensity. I can already smell the gunpowder…”
“This time, failure is not an option. Victory is our only choice!”
“Yes, Duke!”
The bishop, wearing a pristine white priestly robe, bowed deeply and then turned and left the towering loft.
Duke O’Keilly stood atop the loft, thirty blades high, overlooking the quiet Green City below, his gaze growing more profound, his eyes filled with unwavering determination.
Whoosh whoosh~
At that moment, countless shadows swept across the sky, and a tremendous sound of tearing through the air rang out.
Duke O’Keilly slightly raised his head, his eyes catching sight of numerous white figures.
White wings, strong bodies clad in thick armor, double riders, one with a longbow, the other with a shield and lance…
Pegasus Cavalry.
This was Green City’s ace in the hole, as well as the powerful weapon against the Beastman’s double-legged flying dragons.
In Duke O’Keilly’s pupils, the silhouettes that covered the sky were reflected.
“The war… is about to begin…”
“The ancient evil, I have already felt its awakening…”
“This is the first opportunity, and perhaps, also the last.”
“The day they awaken, will be the day of humanity’s destruction. Green City needs my protection.”
“In my name, O’Keilly Nolan, let the battle commence!”
—
—
—
The mobilization of the military seemed to cause a great stir, especially when the Pegasus flew directly over the city, unable to hide their forms.
But by that time, Duke O’Keilly was no longer prepared to conceal his intentions.
When the war at Risier City broke out, this matter inevitably could not be kept secret, what he needed now was– to conquer the city occupied by the Beastmen, even at a terrible cost.
Even when deciding on this plan, Duke O’Keilly had already cold-bloodedly considered that this terrifyingly powerful army was entirely made up of men walking to their deaths.
Mercy does not command an army; only by completely shedding human weakness and sympathy can one qualify to control the army most effectively and thus gain victory in war.
After the Pegasus Army had vanished from sight in the sky, Duke O’Keilly no longer hesitated and turned to enter the house.
Guards immediately stepped forward to arm him.
As the tall Duke O’Keilly, cloaked in a cape of the Nolan Empire’s flag color–the dark blue of Blue Heart Maple–stepped into the backyard, hundreds of ready Pegasus awaited his command.
All of these Pegasus Cavalry were Level 10 beings, each squad of ten led by a Level 15 Sky Knight, the reserves Duke O’Keilly had accumulated over decades of ruling the southern province. These elite professionals were his tools of rule.
“Duke!”
Hundreds of Sky Knights simultaneously removed their helmets and saluted in unison.
“Mount up, we march!”
These were Duke O’Keilly’s absolute confidants, who could never betray him. Their morale was so high that not even warriors would retreat, so there was no need for any pre-battle rally.
“Yes!”
Clang clang~
In a mere moment, all the Pegasus Knights mounted their steeds.
“Ascend!”
Whoosh whoosh~
Wings kicked up the leaves and dead grass on the ground, as the white Pegasus Knights soared into the sky, with Duke O’Keilly riding a four-winged Pegasus at the forefront, leading the way.
Their target pointed straight at Risier City.
Once the Pegasus left the City Lord’s manor, the already anxious sects and nobles realized that Duke O’Keilly seemed to be undertaking a significant matter… They felt something was amiss.
In the past, however severe the situation, a portion of the Pegasus Knight Order always remained at the City Lord’s manor, but such a complete departure had never been seen before.
When they indirectly confirmed the whole message through servants of the City Lord’s manor, a huge commotion erupted among the upper echelons of Green City’s nobility.
All they discussed was one thing: what was Duke O’Keilly up to?
When their spies confirmed that Duke O’Keilly recently moved a large number of troops toward Risier City, and that the Pegasus Army also headed in the direction of Risier City, they could no longer contain themselves.
Could the Divine Relic at Risier City be real?? If not, why would Duke O’Keilly make such a move?
Risier City, already abuzz over the Divine Relic, once again caused an uproar, and countless messages spread through pigeons, falcons, and magic to the surrounding areas.
Before long, the entire Nolan Empire would know about the Divine Relic, for a fake relic did not warrant the mobilization of a huge army by a Duke who governed a province, nor warrant his personal attendance.
At last, the vortex of Risier City, which settled briefly due to the players’ intervention, began to boil over in earnest.
April 13th, dawn.
As the first light of the day struck the land outside Risier City.
What appeared was a shocking scene: hundreds of thousands of human soldiers with spears at the ready, their military bearing austere.
Warriors, thieves, spellcasters, priests, knights, archers, and most of the mainstream Glory professions could be seen.
The Pegasus Cavalry in the sky occupied the high ground, and siege equipment was being rapidly assembled below, while the Caster Corps began laying out large-scale composite magic.
Nobody could have imagined that, overnight, the region outside the city controlled by the Beastmen could be occupied by human forces.
But whether it was the Beastmen on the city walls, or the surrounding players, or the spies hidden in the shadows, upon seeing such an epic scene, everyone had the same realization:
The war had come so suddenly.

chapters.content:
Chapter 376: Chapter 378: The Flames of War Ignite, The Battle of the Five Armies Chapter 376: Chapter 378: The Flames of War Ignite, The Battle of the Five Armies As the first glimmer of dawn illuminated the earth,
a horn sounding like it came from ancient times spread across the entire battlefield.
Wuu wuu~
The sound was desolate and heart-shaking.
Nearing, a battle worthy of entering the annals of Glory had begun.
Leading the army of Duke O’Kelly, 100,000 warriors stood at the forefront, with tens of thousands of cavalry pressing on both flanks. The use of cavalry in a siege was nearly negligible, their main role was to prevent sudden attacks from the Beastman Wolf Cavalry.
Right beside the warrior battalions, archer legions were arrayed; over ten battalions of ten thousand appeared like dark swarms upon the grassland.
Over a hundred six-bladed catapults creaked and groaned as they were cranked, with large rocks being lifted onto them by several warriors.
As the first batch of catapults was loaded with boulders, adjacent generals drew their Cross Longswords without any hesitation, roaring loudly,
“Release!!”
Bang~
The soldiers holding the winches in front instantly let go, then the chains rapidly unwound and spun back, with uncontrolled catapults suddenly snapping upwards, the massive inertia flinging the terrifying rocks, weighing over 500 pounds, high into the sky.
Whoo whoo~
Just how terrifying were the sounds made by hundreds of boulders could be understood from the Beastmen guarding the walls of Risier City at that moment.
Thud~
Boom boom booom~
Like thunder falling from the ninth celestial layer!
The first boulder, with the momentum of thunder, smashed into the city walls, and the solid battlements tore apart like paper; behind the walls, dozens of Beastman Warriors were crushed into minced flesh by the rock, their shields and armor offering no protection whatsoever.
The boulder’s relentless force continued, rolling several times before smashing through the inner short walls and falling directly into the city.
Beastmen scrambing to assemble behind the walls abruptly looked up, just to see a vast shadow envelop them; in their eyes reflected the striking, blood-stained patterns on the stone.
Filled with endless horror, they were too late to dodge.
Puchi~
Blood splattered, and in an instant, over a dozen mangled corpses littered the ground, with the scent of blood spreading into the air.
Bang~ Bang~ Bang~
The walls of Risier City were hit with a brutal assault.
Debris flew, flesh ground into pulp.
After one round of attack, thousands of Beastmen, yet to recover from the shock, were smashed into blood mist.
The screams of the injured Beastmen, along with the thickness of blood in the air, resembling mist, echoed across the battlefield.
At this time, an enormous commotion arose from the human formations; looking out, dozens of siege tower carriages were pushed forward by thousands of warriors from behind the battalions of ten thousand.
Archers densely packed the seven-layer-high tower carriages, arming them like porcupines.
Their target was straight at the city walls.
Wuu wuu~
The bleak sound of the horn blew once more, and this time, the front five battalions from among the ten-thousand-strong formations began to advance toward Risier City alongside the siege towers.
The siege had begun.
The previously stunned Beastmen finally reacted, with a Beastman Governor wielding an iron whip letting out an extremely furious roar, prompting the giant catapults within the city to start cranking.
Under the oppressive clouds darkening the sky, huge boulders flew out from Risier City, their whooshing breaking the air like the roar of demons, tracing long arcs in the sky.
Then,
they fell.
Thud~
The first boulder smashed into the human army’s formation, instantly obliterating dozens of people, scattering blood, breaking mud, and severed limbs.
Following the first boulder, hundreds more swiftly descended.
Bang, bang, bang~ The silent battering sounds, like siege hammers pounding the earth, carved out numerous bloody paths of death.
The high martial spirit of the human army was immediately suppressed by the assault.
Roar~
Witnessing this, the Beastmen on the city walls let out beast-like roars.
The true war had begun.
If the battle scenes of blockbuster movies were awe-inspiring, then witnessing a siege involving hundreds of thousands of troops made one’s blood surge from their feet to their head.
Absolutely heart-stopping.
“Bowmen, suppressive fire!!”
As the troops drew near the walls of Risier City, a human general roared his command, and the signal officers immediately waved their flags.
Moments later, archers from several ten-thousand-strong formations violently drew their bows to the sky, then released in unison. Bowstrings twanged sharply, and the piercing arrows screamed through the air, filled with a chilling intent to kill.
Across hundreds of paces, the arrows with white fletching raced towards the city walls, blackening the sky.
At that moment, the initially dim sky was completely covered by arrows, as the god of death descended upon the world.
The Beastmen on the walls were not to be outdone.
“Kill them!!
Loose arrows!!!”
Twang~ the sound of bowstrings resounded as showers of grey arrows clashed mid-air with the white-fletched ones.
The muffled sounds of impact were ceaseless.
Then the rain of arrows plummeted down in their swift descent.
Thud~
Blood splattered; screams tore through the air.
Even sturdy armor had its vulnerabilities. A human warrior’s neck was pierced cleanly by a sharp arrow, blood spurting high into the air. This Level 9 warrior couldn’t even survive three breaths before collapsing, his body temperature dropping rapidly.
The surroundings were steeped in bloodshed.
Under the baptism of the arrow rain, within a few breaths, dense formations of the human army fell, at least a thousand men down, while a significant area on the Beastmen’s towers was also cleared.
With the advance of the troops, the war intensified.
Catapults hurled massive boulders accompanied by the relentless barrage of arrows, with the explosive sounds of their impact resonating in every corner of the battlefield.
The wounded warriors’ howls, like the mournful cries of dying beasts, were deeply unsettling. Severed limbs were everywhere, and blood already threatened to dye the earth red before the two sides even clashed in close combat.
“Charge!! Scale the walls!!”
Unable to tolerate the progress of the advance, the commanding generals of the human formation immediately issued the order to charge.
Woo woo~
The urgent war horns sounded, and the human legions, now 300 paces from the city wall, pushed forward tower carriages, carried siege ladders along with various engineering apparatus, and began to surge forth.
The scene was like a tidal wave flooding the earth, and the walls of Risier City stood like rocks being battered by the relentless waves.
“Fire! Quick!! Kill those damn humans, fools, shoot the arrows quickly!! Let the humans taste what it’s like to be hunted by Beastmen with the bows in your hands!
Death is calling to them!!
Beast God above, we are enveloped in your divine glory, kill!!”
The raging voice of the Beastman Governor filled the front of the walls, enveloping the majority of Beastmen, who were already fiercely quick with their bows, to speed up even more.
However, just as the words fell, a huge rock descended from the sky, and the terrifying sound of it breaking the air filled the faces of the surrounding Beastmen with an unmistakable horror.
Bang~
Crash~
The Beastman Governor who had just shouted out aloud was instantly smashed into a pulp along with several other Beastmen around him.
The area went silent at the sight of this, but instead of fear, the rich scent of blood slowly turned the eyes of the Beastmen crimson, and their killing intent escalated.
“Roar!!”
“Kill!!”
“Climb up!!”
“Attack!!”
Accompanying this, the first batch of the Human Army reached the city below.
Under the barrage of arrows shot by the Beastmen, dozens to hundreds of the Human Army fell dead for every step they advanced.
No one knew exactly how many lives this charge had cost; everyone was just rushing forward. ON the battlefield, there may be a chance to live if you fight, but flight would earn you nothing but beheading by a Military Governor.
Boom~
After paying a steep price, the Human Army, pushing towering Tower Carriages, crashed against the city walls.
The siege Tower Carriage was undoubtedly the pinnacle of engineering in this era–enchanted Tower Carriages were very light and easy to move, turning them into deadly weapons when attacking these unprotected walls.
The soldiers, who could look down upon the walls of Risier City from their taller siege Tower Carriages, stood ready. As soon as the Tower Carriage hit the wall, an iron plate mounted on its front came crashing down, its terrible force shattering the battlements ahead. The soldiers, unable to wait any longer, burst out of the Tower Carriage.
When the two sides met in close combat, an even more brutal melee began.
More than half of the hundred Tower Carriages were destroyed as they neared the city wall, but there were still over fifty that latched onto the walls.
And the Human Army at the base of the wall immediately set up climbing ladders. These cleverly designed siege machines were raised swiftly against the wall using lever principles.
Bang, bang, bang~
In just a few breaths of time, hundreds of ladders were laid against one section of the wall,
And the Beastmen, harried by the Tower Carriages, were momentarily unable to deal with these ladders, forced to watch helplessly as the humans climbed up en masse like ants.
Even with their crossbows firing as fast as possible, they couldn’t kill everyone!
The war went on, and the killing continued.
The sounds of battle, shouts, and wails became the main melody of the battlefield where armor was pierced by arrows, weapons clashed violently, and blood sprayed through the air.
A Level 15 Werewolf went berserk, his body ballooning in size as he shrugged off everyone’s attacks and charged onto the Tower Carriage. He ignored the assaults of dozens of humans, his formidable combat prowess unleashing a wave of bloody carnage.
None could stand in his way.
On the other side, a Level 15 top-ranking Human Professional drew his combat blade after climbing up the ladder and onto the city tower, rending nearby Beastmen to shreds, immediately cementing a foothold for the army below to climb up.
The collision between short-range weapons on the wall turned it into a meat grinder.
This was where the scythe of the Death God harvested, devouring all life.
Every second brought a fall; with every breath, bodies tumbled from atop the walls.
The Human Army’s assault was too sudden, the time from the start of the war to hand-to-hand combat didn’t even exceed 10 minutes.
The Beastmen of Risier City hadn’t had time to deploy most of their forces yet, so the walls were rapidly falling.
Wu wu~
As the situation turned dire, deep sounds of a bullhorn echoed within Risier City.
Then, to the delight of all Beastmen, a thrilling sight appeared in the sky–a dense flock of Double-legged Flying Dragons.
Huge dragon wings obscured the sky, while the gaping maws dripping with corrosive saliva issued icy roars that sent chills down the spine.
The Double-legged Flying Dragon was the Beastmen’s most powerful Air Force.
The beating of dragon wings emitted a massive whoosh through the air, and the dense clouds in the sky, dark as ink, provided a backdrop for these killing machines. They seemed like demons crawling out of hell.
Hoo-hoo~
They dove downward.
No one could have imagined the staggering spectacle of thousands of double-legged flying dragons diving from the sky toward the human army’s formation.
Even the most steadfast warriors felt their legs involuntarily weaken at this moment.
Hear-hear~
But just as the double-legged flying dragons appeared, the Pegasus with wings on their backs and bodies as white as snow also took flight from behind the human formation.
They were like messengers bringing the light, their holy and majestic appearance was the complete opposite of the double-legged flying dragons, which reeked of slaughter and death.
The double-legged flying dragons, ready to dive, were forced to abandon hunting the ground troops and dashed fiercely toward the Pegasus Army.
The sky was now completely shrouded by wings, and the pitiful light was almost gone.
The two flying troops crossed paths in an instant, the pure white feathers of the Pegasus and the dragon wings of the double-legged flying dragons clashed in the sky like a collision between light and darkness.
Bang~
Sizzle~
A shower of corpses fell from the sky like raindrops at the moment the battle commenced.
A Pegasus, too slow to evade, was torn apart by the double-legged flying dragon right before it. Two sky knights didn’t even have time to fight back before they fell from the sky, following the blood and dismembered limbs.
After several dull thuds, the ground was left only with gore, and no one survived.
A double-legged flying dragon that had just approached was shot in the eye by a knight riding a Pegasus. And before it could escape, a warrior wielding a sky cavalier spear pierced and tore through the flying dragon’s skull, striking it down valiantly.
The carnage in the sky was even crueler than on the ground; there were no wounded here, only fallen soldiers.
With the entrance of both air forces, the battle escalated to another extreme. All the adjectives in the dictionary seemed insufficient to describe the scene except for ‘gruesome.’
Hundreds of thousands in the armies’ thirst for killing completely shocked the players watching from afar.
They had never imagined that war in a game could be so bloody and violent.
In a very short time, news of a large-scale war in Risier City spread rapidly among the players. Those near Risier City started to flock there frantically.
Anos City, a player’s main city, was very close by. In a short time, over 100,000 players rushed toward Risier City, where they would witness an epic war.
—-
—-
—-
Woo-woo~
The endless sound of the war horn cut through the entirety of Risier City, from a great distance…
To the north of Risier City, the Dwarf Army that had just arrived 5 kilometers from the city immediately heard the war horn echoing across the sky.
Nalis Copper Hammer, the clan chief of the Copper Hammer Tribe, suddenly sharpened his gaze.
“What’s happening ahead? Have the vanguard unit report at once!”
“Yes, Clan Chief…”
The messenger rode away on a mighty ram, while the two players accompanying the Dwarf Army exchanged concerned glances, inwardly uneasy.
Please, let nothing be going wrong now; they had finally gotten acquainted with the others.
In less than three minutes, the sound of hooves trotting on the grass approached, and the Dwarf messenger reappeared.
“Clan Chief, the forward unit reports that a large-scale war is taking place in Risier City. Humans are currently attacking the city.
The Beastmen have contracted their forces and are fully engaged in responding to the human offensive…”
“Large-scale war? Who initiated the attack? How many troops do they have? What’s the current state of the battle?”
“Clan Chief, the war was initiated by the human army from Green City. We do not currently know who the commander is.
Their forces numbered over 200,000, and the war had begun just before the Sunshine Hour, with both sides currently at a stalemate.”
Oh?
This news surprised Naris a bit, and he turned to glance at the clan leader of the Rabiao Hammer Tribe beside him–Rabiao Hammer.
“Rabiao, how much do you know about the humans of Green City? Why would they attack Risier City at this time?”
He had no interest in the war between humans and beastmen, indifferent to who lived or died, as neither race had left a good impression on him.
However, if this war was started over divine relics, that piqued his curiosity.
After all, beastmen had occupied Risier City for more than two years with no commotion, but it was only after the news of the divine relics that they launched an attack to reclaim it, which seemed highly suspicious.
“Clan Chief Naris, I don’t know much about Green City…
But no matter what, humans are extremely greedy creatures, and they definitely wouldn’t rashly start a major war without the motivation of interest.
Perhaps we could get a little closer…”
But before Rabiao could finish speaking, suddenly, boom–
The skies above Risier City were wild with thunder and lightning.
Dense clouds were lit up by direct lightning, dragon wings arced through the sky, and then, to everyone’s shock, an Eye of Chaos and Death, filled with blood, slaughter, death, and an endless aura of extreme evil, appeared out of nowhere above Risier City.
The entire sky dimmed the instant the lightning vanished.
The thick black clouds revolved around that Eye of Chaos and Death like the eye of a storm within force-12 winds, filled with a chill that numbed everyone from the soles of their feet to the back of their skulls.
Death God descends…
The Eye of Chaos and Death wasn’t completely freed from its shackles yet, as one could see upon closer inspection that countless dimly glowing rune chains bound it.
But what was truly alarming was that with each few breaths, a rune chain would shatter, making it clear that once all chains broke, the Eye of Chaos and Death would break free from its shackles.
Fear devoured everything.
Everyone felt as if a demon with a gaping maw loomed behind them, ready to tear apart their souls at any moment.
Within a hundred kilometers, anyone who looked up could see that eye in the sky, the eye spreading terror and death.
Civilians and low-level professionals with feeble wills collapsed to the ground, legs giving way upon seeing the Eye of Chaos and Death, rendering them combat ineffective.
Even more professionals, with faces stricken with horror, didn’t look back as they ran away, desperate to escape this great terror, knowing death could descend at any moment.
Ancient evil was resurrecting… There were those who could describe how chilling the aura of extreme evil, lingering from ancient times, truly felt.
Even the most mentally resolute warriors found their teeth chattering at this moment.
“Leave this place, Naris! The Evil God here is breaking its seals!
It still holds a portion of its power; if we aim for our opponents, even if we emerge victorious, the losses will be grievous!”
Upon witnessing this, Rabiao Hammer immediately gestured to prepare for evacuation; the emergence of the Eye of Chaos and Death was beyond what he could endure.
This clan leader of the Barbarian Hammer Tribe was not lacking in wisdom.
Naris Copper Hammer also nodded in complete agreement; it was extremely unwise to confront an ancient Evil God still retaining some of its power in a city whose assets were unknown.
“Alright, prepare to retreat…”
However, just as the dwarves were making preparations to retreat, suddenly there was a brilliant glow in the sky, and then, around the Eye of Chaos and Death, five ethereal figures appeared.
An armor, a longsword, a longbow–and then there was a crystal ball radiating with auras of death and destruction, and finally–a war hammer.
Five weapons, each with an aura above it that set hearts racing.
An uncontrollable thought rose in everyone’s minds–Divine Artifacts.
That was the aura of Divine Artifacts…
And there were actually five Divine Artifacts inside Risier City!!
The professionals who had been ready to flee now halted in their steps, their gazes fervently fixed on the sky.
If they could get one of them… their destiny would have been rewritten directly.
The allure of a Divine Artifact was a thousand times, ten thousand times more tempting than becoming Nobles, becoming Spellcasters, possessing countless Gold Pucks, and so on!
That was a Divine Artifact!!!
The Dwarves even stopped preparing to leave, their attention unconcerned with the other four Divine Artifacts, everyone’s gaze fixed intensely on the phantom image of the hammer.
“That’s the Forging Hammer??” Nalis Copper Hammer’s eyes widened to the extreme, his voice dry and hoarse.
“In the ancient Battle of the Gods, the first generation Forge God fell, and the Forging Hammer disappeared with him.
Although the current Forge God had recast a Forging Hammer, compared to the Forging Hammer that once ranked in the top five of the Divine Artifacts, it was still somewhat inferior.
So… is this Forging Hammer real??”
After Nalis finished speaking, he exchanged a look with Rabiao, and both saw shock in each other’s eyes.
Rabiao took a deep breath, his hands trembling slightly.
“I feel it, my Bloodline is responding to that Divine Artifact that belongs to our Dwarf race!!
Nalis… Is your Bloodline echoing the Forging Hammer??”
As the exclusive Divine Artifact of Dwarves, the Forging Hammer possessed endless might, and Dwarves also had a trait, which was a natural sensitivity to this Divine Artifact.
Therefore, in Dwarf mythology, there was also a legend that the Dwarves were creatures given life by the Forge God with the Forging Hammer.
“I feel it too, my Bloodline is boiling at this moment…”
Nalis Copper Hammer suddenly turned his head to look at the Dwarf goat cavalry behind him, all Dwarves’ expressions at this moment becoming full of longing and fervor; it was clear that everyone sensed the Divine Artifact belonging to the Dwarves, no Dwarf could remain as before.
“Send the order down, prepare to siege!!!”
Nalis Copper Hammer roared.
“The Forging Hammer reappears, the glorious epoch belonging to the Dwarves is about to come once more!!
My clanspeople, that is our Divine Artifact!!
No one can steal our treasure from the hands of Dwarves!!
Even if it means the burial of all Dwarves here today, we too, do not! spare! any! price!”
With an excited and determined tone echoing above the Dwarf Army.
The Dwarf Army instantly boiled with enthusiasm.
“For the Dwarves!!!”
“For the Dwarves!!!”
The terrifying roars almost shattered the warriors’ shields.
Boom boom boom~
Immediately following this, the massive Dwarf Army charged towards Risier City from their original retreat position, without a hint of hesitation.
The war had undergone an immediate transformation without anyone realizing.
The Dwarves had entered the battle.
The Beastmen in Risier City were already having some difficulty dealing with the sudden attack by the Human Army, and now the anger of Beastmen flared up again as the north side of the city walls set up siege engines.
These damned shorties, why leave the underground mining to come to Risier City??!
The Dwarves didn’t seem to carry too much siege equipment, but relying on their superlative forging skills, they promptly dismantled the siege engines and catapults and brought them along.
They were assembled immediately.
The scene was quite magical, as the dwarves, who originally lacked the ability to besiege, suddenly had dozens of catapults appear within their ranks, as well as tower carriages and scaling ladders.
The efficiency of the dwarves left the two players following in their midst dumbfounded. Indeed, there wasn’t a single race in Glory that was simple.
“Pass the order, have the catapults smash the city walls!”
Naris Copper Hammer bellowed orders to the dozens of catapults set up behind him.
“I need a path for the cavalry to charge through!”
Using cavalry in a siege?
Although the statement was strange, if one looked across all of Glory, apart from the Sky Cavalry, the only other cavalry that could play a role in a siege were the dwarves’ goat cavalry.
Because they could launch an attack on the city walls.
As long as the goats had a foothold, the goat cavalry could charge directly from the ground into the city walls.
It simply defied all logic.
With the temptation of that ghostly image of the Forging Hammer in the sky, the efficiency of the dwarves reached unprecedented heights.
Bang~ Bang~ Bang~
The urgency of the dwarves sparked the battle on the north side of the city walls in an extremely short amount of time.
Huge boulders hurled from the catapults smashed against the city walls–boom–the hard walls cracked like a spiderweb after the impact.
Strangely, these boulders did not target the Beastmen on top of the city walls but instead directly bombarded the exterior of the walls.
Boom~
Stones relentlessly thrown out chaotically flew about, creating small and large holes in the solid exterior walls of Risier City.
At this moment, the Beastmen within the city were also retaliating fiercely, with huge stones continuously crashing into the dwarven army’s formation, carving long and bloody paths.
The catapults had a range of nearly 600 blades, and aside from ballistas, neither side’s archers could reach the other, so they could only engage in a purely catapult bombardment.
However, the dwarves felt fortunate that the human attack had drawn the main attention of Risier City, meaning they faced less pressure–at least no Double-legged Flying Dragons appeared in the sky.
At the eastern city walls, under the will of Duke O’Kelly of the humans, the fierce attack continued, turning the city walls and the earth blood-red after two Sunshine Hours of combat.
Bodies and limbs were everywhere.
The battlements of Risier City had been leveled by the catapults.
The towering Tower Carriages unceasingly transported warriors to the top of the city walls, and with the advantage of a preemptive strike, the outermost walls were already overtaken by the human army by more than half.
The Beastmen resisted ferociously, but how could the all-in attack launched by Duke O’Kelly, who had mobilized the elite of the entire southern province, be a joke?
Large numbers of Level 10 elite troops filled the ranks, and Level 15 top Professionals were not uncommon, their fearless qualities inflicting the Beastmen with the painful memory of being trapped in the barren wastelands for tens of thousands of years, unable to leave.
And just as the battle was at its most tense, a terrifyingly indescribable wave of magic burst from the human camp.
Moments later, a red fire cloud appeared above Risier City.
Four Circle large Composite Magic–Meteor Fire Rain.
Then, from within that colorful cloud, countless fireballs fell like raindrops, dense and numerous.
Thump~
The fireballs, carrying terrifying heat, exploded upon hitting the ground, sending up skies full of sparks, igniting the wooden houses inside the city instantly. Any Beastman struck didn’t even survive for a second more.
But, eerily, no significant counterattack from the Beastmen’s Shaman Army was seen by the human troops, only a few scattered Shamans casting spells in resistance, but their spells seemed apprentice-level in strength.
The spellcasters of Risier City didn’t seem intent on supporting the extremely difficult city wall defenses.
With the help of the Mage lords, the desperate battle situation immediately changed, and the already unstable city wall defenses were breached by the human army.
Within twenty minutes, the walls were completely under human control.
But this was far from the end.
Risier City was very large, and no one knew how many troops the Beastman Prince had gathered here over the past two years.
So although humanity had stormed into Risier City, the even more brutal and cruel alley battles had merely just begun.
The armies on both sides were fearless and resolute in battle, slaughtering each other directly with no avenue of retreat to speak of.
There was only advancement, to exterminate the enemies in front!
The will of Duke O’Kelly was the direction this army was advancing, and the Beastmen would never surrender or admit defeat!!
There is only the fight to the death!
—
—
—
At this moment, at the center of Risier City, in front of the pit where the Divine relic lay, Beastman Prince Shahrarm Furious Blood Roar was watching as the altar was gradually revealing its true form.
Next to the black altar, hundreds of Shamans were casting spells to unlock the seals imposed by the ancient inscriptions on the Divine relic.
“Your Highness!! Human troops have breached the city, and their magic is too powerful, we have suffered heavy losses!!
And the northern city wall is under Dwarf attack, we need reinforcements!!”
A Beastman Military Governor, his face smeared with dirt, reported to Shahrarm, his shattered armor and the blood still emitting heat were testament to just how fierce the recent battle was.
But at this moment, Shahrarm was not paying attention to these details, his gaze fixed firmly on the dark altar.
After a long while, he finally spoke in a cold voice.
“Send the orders down, dispatch the Wolf Cavalry, all Beastmen fight to the death!!
We only need to wait for three Sunshine Hours!!
After three Sunshine Hours, all enemies shall turn to ashes!
I, shall inherit the power of the Divine, and be crowned king!!”
“As you command, Your Highness!”
The Beastman Military Governor struck his chest fiercely, saluted, and then without any hesitation, turned and left.
With three Sunshine Hours, given the massive Beastman army inside Risier City, even 10 Sunshine Hours wouldn’t be enough for them to breach the core area.
At this moment, a Werewolf Priest, who was silently watching everything, looked at Prince Shahrarm with a somewhat indifferent expression, then gestured to the somewhat dull Shadow High Priest Emi next to him after a moment.
“Your Highness, the Divine power inside this Vampire might be able to expedite the unlocking of the seal…”
Shahrarm, who had five octopus-like tendrils on his chin, frowned upon hearing this and glanced at Emi who was bound by Magic Prohibition Chains.
“Are you sure he won’t cause trouble? Now, we are only one step away!”
“Your Highness, this Vampire is now under our control, nothing will go wrong,”
“Good, Vampire, go break the seal, remember, your life is in your own hands, after the seal is opened, I will let you go…”
Before he could finish his words, a terrifyingly fearsome aura swept in from the distance, making even the Eye of Chaos and Eye of Death in the sky, which had been exerting pressure, pause for a moment.
Shahrarm quickly raised his head to look outside Risier City, and saw several gigantic pits appear in the sky beyond the city, from which countless withered bones poured out and fell to the ground.
“Undead??!!”
Shahrarm’s complexion subtly changed, he wasn’t afraid of Dwarves, and he had ways to deal with humans, but he had never anticipated that he would invoke the Undead from the once Radiant Empire.
These calamities were definitely not simple existences, their Skeleton Sea could flatten Risier City.
When Shahrarm turned his head again, his expression was no longer as relaxed as before, his voice carrying a trace of urgency.
“Quick!! Unlock the relic at the fastest speed!!!”
Upon hearing this, Emi, who had been motionless, suddenly stirred, and right as he was about to act, a powerful force swept over his soul, and for a fleeting moment, his spirit trapped by the unknown power caught its breath and his eyes regained a moment of clarity.
“Your Majesty??!!”
“Emi, hold on for one Sunshine Hour, I will personally lead the army of dawn to descend…”
