chapters.content:
Chapter 377: Chapter 379: The Battle of the Five Armies, The Return of Ancient Evil (7400 words) Chapter 377: Chapter 379: The Battle of the Five Armies, The Return of Ancient Evil (7400 words) “Unseal the shackles, and you shall receive my reward…”
“Unseal the shackles…”
“Unseal the shackles…”
Countless voices echoed like valley echoes within Emi’s mind, ceaselessly reverberating.
Had it not been for Lide forcibly infusing a surge of Power of Faith into Emi through the Bloodline just moments ago, his consciousness would’ve already sunk into the endless temptation.
Attempting to resist a Divine assault with a Level 15 body was a difficulty so horrendous it was nearly indescribable…
“One Sunshine Hour… dawn will come.”
A strong obsession allowed Emi to barely maintain the last bit of clarity in his heart amidst the endless fear, but he couldn’t hold on much longer, no one could remain indifferent under the Dignity of the Divine.
Crack–a crisp sound pierced Risier City’s skies, and several gigantic fissures in the skies outside of the city expanded even further.
Countless Withered Bone skeletons fell like gravel from the sky, dropping from a hundred-blade height.
Some Skeleton Warriors’ heads shattered upon impact, their Soul Fires dissipating; some had their bodies broken into fragments, unable to move again, already incurring significant losses before battle had even begun.
But the Undead, they never care about casualties.
Their numbers were the biggest insoluble problem…
Once a total of nine openings appeared in the sky, an indescribably large Undead army rapidly took shape.
Skeleton warriors that fell unharmed quickly stood up, then began forming regimented formations under the organization of High-level Undead.
If one were to say that humans appeared suddenly under the veil of magic, then the Undead blatantly slaughtered their way out before the Beastmen’s very eyes.
In just ten minutes, more than five ten-thousand-man army formations appeared on the ground. Even though they consisted of Level 5 to 9 Skeleton Warriors, the numbers were so considerable it was frightening.
Moreover, the holes in the sky showed no signs of stopping their discharge of Undead; at this rate, perhaps after another Sunshine Hour, there would be hundreds of thousands in the Undead army.
Roar–
After the five ten-thousand-man army formations took shape, a mournful roar sounded; watched by the Beastman Warriors defending the city, whoosh–over 30 Undead top-tier lifeforms with tattered Dragon Wings and bodies of white bone, the Bone Dragons, streamed out from the inverted openings in the sky.
These Level 15 top-tier lifeforms immediately became the protagonists of this sky.
No one could have imagined the Undead would commit such a horrifying combat force.
These were Bone Dragons, the symbolic lifeform of the Undead!
And accompanying the emergence of the Bone Dragons, even more High-level Undead began to fall from the openings.
Death Knights in heavy armor, Skeleton Archers with Bone Arrows, and even monstrous Undead composed of countless piled-up white bones, reaching seven or eight blades in height.
Monstrous Undead had bloated bodies of white bone that seemed as if their creators had stuffed all the bones they could into their bodies, creating massive spherical skeletons, exuding an unsurpassed eeriness.
After more than fifty Monstrous Undead appeared, the Undead Commander finally sounded the horn for the assault.
The mournful wail of the White Bone Horn spiraled over Risier City’s skies, reaching vastly distant locations.
The Undead, having assembled more than five ten-thousand-man army formations, began their attack.
The Undead knew no pain, had no anguish, hardly any intelligence; the will of the High-level Undead would be their direction forward.
Boom, boom, boom–the thunderous footsteps composed yet another melody.
30 Bone Dragons freely spread their Dignity across the sky, and for the Undead Empire that occupied a nation, even though Bone Dragons were top-tier lifeforms, it wasn’t too difficult to create these combat forces with their substantial resources.
Behind the ranks of the Undead army, a horrific number of over 5,000 Knights on skeletal horses patrolled the perimeter to avoid surprise attacks from other enemies.
Mixed Undead species were at the heart of the Skeleton Warriors’ formation, following the grand Undead army as they marched towards Risier City.
Skeleton Archers began to draw their bows and fire, these lifeforms that feared not death completely disregarded the dense volley of arrows raining down from the city walls. As long as their Soul Fire wasn’t struck, even if their bones were filled with arrows, they could still attack with vivacity.
Thump~
The closer they got to Risier City, the more fiercely the Undead army was attacked.
The Beastmen’s catapults recklessly expended massive stones, and each rolling boulder caused immense damage to the Undead, leaving crushed bones scattered everywhere–a truly devastating weapon.
Low-level Skeleton Warriors wore no armor, and the long swords in their hands were mostly rusted, with many Skeleton Warriors carrying bone spears and Bone Knives, exuding a sense of primal simplicity.
Despite this, the Beastmen on the city walls still felt an unbearable torment, because–the Bone Dragons had arrived.
After the Double-legged Flying Dragons were tied down by Green City’s Pegasus Army, the other city walls’ Beastman forces could no longer count on air support.
If Beastman Prince Shahrarm had been present to lead the war effort, perhaps the situation could have been alleviated, but the temptation of Divine Power was too great for anyone to resist.
As a result, when the Beastman forces were garrisoned in Risier City, Shahrarm had already treated this mighty army of over 400,000 as sacrificial pawns.
All warriors were but chips for him to gain power.
A cold-blooded Beastman King.
Under such circumstances, the Beastmen, even with the capability to resist being attacked by humans, Dwarves, and Undead combined, did not get to utilize it.
Retreat was inevitable.
Roar~
One Bone Dragon, with tattered Dragon Wings, began to gather pale blue Death Energy in its throat. As it swooped down from the sky and violently bowed its head, it released a Dragon Breath full of destruction and Death Aura, spraying out like a flamethrower.
Above the city walls, hundreds of Beastmen were swept directly by the Dragon Breath, sizzling as if boiling water had been spilled on ice. In the blink of an eye, every Beastman touched by the Dragon Breath saw their flesh rot away,
their skeletons didn’t even shed blood but decayed instantly, as if deprived of hundreds of years’ time and turned to dust.
These powerful Beastman Warriors didn’t survive to take another breath under the devouring Death Dragon Breath.
Even more frenzied Bone Dragons directly dove onto the city walls, their 16-bladed wingspan acting like sharp, lengthy knives, slaughtering mercilessly wherever they struck.
An entire area of the wall was instantly cleared.
These brief attacks from the Bone Dragons caused an unimaginable psychological pressure on the Beastmen.
Fear began to spread.
The Bone Dragons were too strong.
Even if Beastmen of the same level stepped forward to block them, they could not pose much of an obstruction to the agile Bone Dragons.
The advantage of the Air Force was showcased to the fullest in this moment.
“Siege crossbows!!”
“Aim at these filthy Undead!”
“I will kill and destroy their souls!”
The Beastman Military Governor could no longer tolerate the scene of being hit without the ability to retaliate and, roaring with rage, ordered the siege crossbows originally aimed at the Undead outside the city to turn and target a new enemy.
Huff, huff~
The Beastman Warriors grasping for breath yanked the siege crossbows with combined strength, raising the angle of fire towards the sky.
Their direction of attack switched from ground to air.
“Fire!”
Accompanied by a furious roar, the whooshing sound of the crossbows tearing through the air rose once again as bolts thicker than a wrist were launched by the powerful bowstrings.
A cold gleam struck the eye.
More than twenty siege crossbows targeted a single Bone Dragon that had been brazenly standing atop the city walls, breathing out Dragon Breath. Then, in less than a second–
Crack~ Sizzle~
These Bone Dragons, recently created, could not compare in durability to the Withered Bone that had survived tens of thousands of years. A crossbow bolt directly struck the base of a wing.
With a splatter, the Solid skeleton showed a spiderweb of cracks, and right then, a second bolt hit near the same spot.
Sizzle~ The Level 15 Bone Dragon’s formerly sturdy wing shattered with a crisp blast, shot completely through.
The Bone Dragon that had once been a mighty force was reduced in a blink of an eye to only one wing, flapping the remaining wing in a crazed attempt to take off, but incapable of flight.
But beneath the relentless aim of the siege crossbows, all struggle was futile.
Thud–an arrow pierced straight through the Bone Dragon’s eye socket into the back of its head. The enormous creature’s body stiffened abruptly, then the blue Soul Fire within swelled and blazed, even emitting a blinding light, before bursting like a balloon–fragmenting completely.
Boom, boom, boom~ With the Soul Fire vanished without a trace, the Bone Dragon’s massive body, like a collapsing statue, plummeted down from the city walls.
Roar~
The Beastmen, upon witnessing this, let out thrilled and raging howls, their morale soaring.
With the siege crossbows redirected, the arrogance of the Bone Dragons was instantly suppressed, the terrifying Undead Life no longer daring to recklessly assault the city walls.
The Beastmen secured their defensive line.
And what relieved the Beastman Military Governor was that although Undead Bone Dragons were fierce, the Skeleton Warriors that reached the base of the walls had no means of climbing up.
They lacked siege weapons.
Instead, these Skeleton Warriors became live targets for the Beastmen, with countless bones falling every second.
Woo, woo–
But the good times didn’t last long. Accompanying the Undead Commander’s sounding of the White Bone Horn, a scene that sent a chill down the spine of the Beastman Military Governor occurred.
Within the ranks of the Skeleton Army, those seven to eight blade-height Undead mixtures suddenly accelerated, charging at the city walls with a frenzied rush.
These swollen bodies, like giants fattened tenfold, undeterred by arrows, with each step trampled several Undead underfoot, and the ground seemed to tremble under their berserk rampage.
Facing the towering Solid walls, the Undead mixtures did not show the slightest sluggishness, slamming into them just like battering rams.
Then,
A ghostly blue energy flickered from the belly of the undead hybrid, and its entire body began to inflate like a balloon until, at a certain critical point, boom–
It burst violently.
A powerful shockwave swept through the area like an invisible tidal wave. Beastman Warriors on the city walls were instantly killed by the sonic wave, while the soul fires of at least a thousand Skeleton Warriors exploded.
The casualties of the Undead were nearly ten times as devastating as those of the Beastmen.
But this scene did not bring joy to the Beastman Governor. Instead, his face showed an expression of horror, because–the city wall had cracked.
Those monsters that could not be harmed by ordinary tools and could only be killed by siege crossbows and catapults–were actually being used to destroy the city wall!!!
The damage caused by these swollen Undead mixed breeds terrified every Beastman who witnessed it.
Because this was not all, there were still dozens more of the Undead hybrid kind left.
“No!! Everyone focus fire on those damned creatures!! Don’t let them get close…”
The Beastman Governor’s angry words were cut off as booms and thunderous explosions sounded once more.
Several undead hybrids charged toward the breached section of the wall again, acting like individual Alchemy Bombs–no, they were even ten times more powerful than Alchemy Bombs.
The section of the city wall under attack was blasted down by the Undead… The scene was extremely shocking.
Seeing this, other Undead hybrids that were preparing to attack other parts of the city walls immediately abandoned their original plan and charged straight toward this section of the wall.
The Beastmen had been stunned by the huge sonic wave and were unable to stop them.
Larger explosions resounded across the entire sky.
The heavens and the earth seemed to collapse.
Under the self-destruction of dozens of high-reaching Undead hybrids, the solid walls of Risier City completely collapsed, leaving a gap 50 blades long torn open.
By the time the sound of the explosions had subsided, the heart of the Beastman Governor seemed to stop beating at the sight of this.
Then the veins on his neck bulged, his face contorted, and he roared with all his strength.
“Hold the breach!!!”
More than ten nearby Beastman Governors issued the same insane cry–they knew that if the city walls fell, the Beastmen would absolutely not be able to withstand the enemy’s attack, because it was the Undead outside the walls.
Those fearless entities that did not know fear or pain–living incarnations of everyone’s nightmares.
The Beastmen, their ears buzzing from the violent roar of the explosions, were now all enraged.
Regaining their senses, they viciously rushed to plug the breach. Their flesh and blood were to build the wall anew.
If the Undead breached the city, they would all die! Those damned Demons would not spare any life that had a beating heart.
“Kill!”
“Roar!”
“Charge!!”
An even more brutal war erupted. This was not the previous exchange of arrows; it was a bloody melee of flesh against flesh.
The Undead, who had just suffered more losses than the Beastmen, didn’t take it seriously at all. Nine holes in the sky continued to pour out Undead like gravel, endlessly sending more to the battlefield, with seemingly no chance of stopping.
The Skeleton Army surged forth like a tide under the cover of the Bone Dragon.
In a brief span of time, they reached the collapsed city walls, where they were greeted by the bloody cleavers of the Beastman Warriors.
A Beastman Warrior clad in human armor, wielding a long blade, roared in anger as he stood at the forefront of all Beastman Soldiers. His muscles bulged, his eyes blood-red with rage. After going Berserk, he was like a sharp blade clashing head-on with the oncoming wave of Undead.
Zing~
With a flash of his blade, his formidable Level 16 battle prowess turned the countless Undead into a scatter of shattered bone remnants.
After going Berserk, the Beastman Warrior was unmatched in bravery.
But other Beastman were not as lucky. A Level 10 Undead was bisected vertically by the weapon of a Beastman in front of it during the clash,
yet this Undead, paying no heed, brandished its rusted long blade with a deadly whoosh, striking the Beastman’s neck and causing blood to spurt several blades’ height.
The fierce eyes of the Beastman flashed with reluctance, but he was powerless to resist any longer, collapsing to his death.
After this Beastman fell, the Undead, dragging its broken body, charged straight at the next Beastman.
As long as the heads of the Undead were not damaged, as long as they could still move, these frightening lives would continue to assault.
Though the combat strength of individual Undead was not strong, their disregard for death placed immense pressure on the frontline-resisting Beastman, as if a mountain was pressing on their chests.
This 50-blade wide section of collapsed city wall became a bloody meat grinder, with bodies rapidly piling up.
—-
—-
—-
Meanwhile, as the Undead breached into Risier City, the northern walls faced their greatest enemy–the Dwarf Goat Cavalry.
Once the Dwarven catapults irresponsibly bombarded the city walls, leaving the walls pocked with holes of various sizes,
the mountainous cavalry, braving the Beastman arrows, began their charge.
The sight of over twenty thousand goat cavalry charging the walls could shake one’s soul to its core.
Boom, boom, boom~ the hooves pounded the earth, and the grasslands emitted a deafening roar, even the towering city walls of Risier City trembled.
The Beastman of Risier City could not even muster an effective response before the goat cavalry was upon the walls.
“Shoot!! Shoot quickly!! Stop those damned goats!!”
Like the rage of the impotent, the Beastman Military Governor’s fear-tinged roar became a backdrop to the saga of the goat cavalry.
The Beastman Archers, aside from drawing their bowstrings more vigorously, seemed to find no better way to respond.
But arrows were never going to suppress the Dwarves.
As the first wave of goat cavalry reached the base of the wall with a thunderous momentum, they suddenly sprang up under the horrified gaze of the Beastman, then the goats climbed straight towards the top of the wall, footholds formed by the holes created by the catapult attacks.
Agility unparalleled.
The scene now appeared as if taken from a church mural depicting Ancient myths, filled with fantasy and unspeakable grandeur.
In just a few breaths, Risier City’s towering walls were already swarming with the goat cavalry.
In their efforts, the Beastmen shot arrows and hurled stones, but compared to the fierce Dwarven Goat Cavalry clad in solid armor that protected their entire body, they could hardly scratch the surface.
Although they could hunt down a few, many more still charged forward.
The first of the mountain cavalry charged up the city walls after several rounds of arrows, with the Dwarf atop the mighty goat bellowing ferociously.
“Damn Beastman brats, taste the Dwarf’s battle axe!!”
As the words fell, the goat beneath him leaped high, landing squarely in a gap among the Beastmen, then bowed its head, exposing its massive curved horns, thicker than an adult’s thigh by three parts.
Stomp, stomp–the mighty male goat pawed the ground twice before bursting forth with its greatest strength in a forward charge.
The scene became almost unbelievable as the Goat Cavalry charged among the crowds atop the city walls!
The terrifying impact of their charge was magnified on top of the city walls; the densely packed Beastman Warriors, though immensely strong, were plowed through as if tilling the earth, splitting the masses apart.
Beastmen were squeezed off the city walls, unable to resist.
This stretch of the city wall became chaotic due to the charge of a single member of the Goat Cavalry.
Seizing this brief moment, the second, then the third, an unending stream of Goat Cavalry surged onto the city walls of Risier City.
Even though a ring of the cavalry’s corpses had already piled up at the base of the wall, and the Dwarf casualties were devastating, they had successfully made it to the top.
Cavalry held a significant innate advantage over infantry, which was hard to overcome.
Once they made it to the wall, these Dwarves harboring a steadfast belief in the Divine Artifacts fought with a fierceness that the makeshift resisting Beastmen couldn’t hope to match.
They swept through.
When the number of Goat Cavalry atop the city walls surpassed 1,000, the battle’s victor for the defense of the walls was declared.
The entire process could only be described as a brutal slaughter; the tall Beastman Warriors couldn’t even mount an effective resistance against the encircling Goat Cavalry.
After taking the city walls, the Cavalry’s influence rapidly spread around, and in a brief period, they seized the city gates. Once the gates were flung open, the Dwarf army streamed inside.
Just like the Undead and humans, the Dwarves began to engage in close-quarters combat with the Beastman army, entering into the most brutal form of street fighting.
Carnage spread; the scythe of the Death God recklessly harvested every soul that fell in battle at that moment.
Undead, humans, Beastmen–all three armies had now penetrated into Risier City.
Though the Beastmen had a massive army of 400,000, they began to falter under the siege of the three forces; none of the participating troops were easy targets.
Elite humans, tenacious Dwarves, the fearlessness of the Undead–the Beastmen were starting to crumble.
Rumble, rumble–
Just as the Dwarves were making headway, silver dragons danced in the sky, lightning striking like the divine punishment of annihilation.
A breath indescribably terrifying permeated everyone’s heart, causing the soldiers engaged in fierce combat below to slow their actions.
That orb, suspended beneath the thick black clouds, filled with endless darkness, Chaos, and the Eye of Death, opened abruptly after the killing below reached a critical point.
Yes, that eye, brimming with boundless terror, hadn’t been open until now. At this moment, that eye truly opened.
No one could describe the color of that eye; it was a synonym for Death, destruction, annihilation, slaughter, darkness, brutality–the physical manifestation of all negative descriptors.
Heaven and Earth changed hues, and all things turned into delusions.
An infinite aura of Extreme Evil began to envelop the earth, and the ancient Evil was resurrecting; the souls of the fallen were being yanked by unseen colossal hands, being devoured by that eye filled with destruction in an unstoppable manner.
Great terror descended!
Central area.
Hundreds of Beastman Shamans watched with ashen faces as Emi stood above the pure black altar; all of them were horrified to the extreme.
Because from that damned Vampire, emanated an indisputable aura of terror.
It was so Evil, so frightening, so… despairing!
The Evil God, it was that sealed Evil God, it was the one that represented all the sins of the world!
But now, no one could stop it!
They had already exhausted all their strength just maintaining their current state under the power of the Evil God; even a few apprentices were now kneeling in fear, worshipping the living God before them.
Boom–
Emi unfurled her bat wings, her pale face taking on a grey hue, decaying and dark, as she vigorously raised her hands towards the sky.
“I, have returned!!”
The blasphemous language of the Ancient echoed through the heavens, filled with a fear that made one’s hair stand on end, a declaration to the Divine, a provocation to the whole world.
In that moment when the Eye of Chaos and Death opened and gazed at Emi,
An indescribable powerful aura emerged; it was the revival of the Ancient, it was the awakening of the utmost evil from between heaven and earth.
The sky, changed.
The heavy clouds above seemed to be stirred by a colossal hand, whirling madly around the Eye of Chaos and Death.
Everything around it was like the Abyss breaking apart!
And with it, the Rune Chains that trapped the Eye of Chaos and Death began to explode at the rate of one per breath.
This terrifying and bizarre existence was about to break free.
Those around Risier City, both players and natives, felt a chill down their spines upon witnessing this scenario, as if they were witnessing an epic event that could change the glory of history.
With the opening of the Eye of Chaos and Death, the five Divine Artifacts floating beside it began to emit an increasingly intense aura, to the point where everyone could see the true form of the artifacts through the shadows.
Terror accompanied by temptation.
At that moment, Emi’s consciousness had sunk and drowned in the boundless power; the moment he stepped onto the pitch-black altar, an indescriptible powerful force surged into his body.
Divine Power, that was the power of the Divine!
But this did not excite him; instead, a nameless fear rose in his heart.
His worst fear was upon him, the ancient Evil God couldn’t wait to descend; it couldn’t even wait half a day.
Endless power filled every corner of his body.
The space around him trembled at this moment.
And his control over his body plummeted to a freezing point; after the opening of the Eye of Chaos and Death in the sky, everything changed.
In that instant, he felt an extremely evil aura take over his body, and then he completely lost control of his body; he could only watch as a passive observer the actions of this terrifying outsider.
The Evil God had now fully taken over his body!!
“Sire, I no longer have the strength to delay even one day…”
Crack–
At the very moment Emi felt the consciousness of the Evil God take over his body,
The sky beneath the thick black clouds suddenly cracked like a spider web, as if shattering like a mirror.
Then, within a hundred kilometers of Risier City, everyone could witness the emergence of a Sky Country.
It was a realm filled with the aura of Death, through the semi-transparent space you could clearly see the inside; scorched land with countless precious minerals laid out, various precious weapons, Magic Scrolls, armors…
And there, you could even see the corpses of the Divine, yes, corpses; broken limbs, headless bodies, with endless grey power swirling around, the surrounding space was twisted.
That was a power only the Divine could wield.
Although this Divine Country was filled with a chilling aura, those who witnessed it fell into madness.
Divine Country!!!!
This was the Divine Country of the Evil God, and moreover, the Evil God was really dead, no – had been dead. Even if it was now revived, how much combat power could it retain without a body?
Greed devoured every person who saw this scene.
The world’s most terrifying emotion isn’t fear, but the desire inside one’s heart; that is the ultimate existence, inescapable.
And with the appearance of the Divine Country, a phrase of the utmost evil that has echoed from the Ancient times began to reverberate in the sky, terrifying, creepy, and frightful – that blasphemous language filled with all imaginable evils of the world.
“Plague and Death were, Plague and Death are, Plague and Death shall forever be.”
“He is everlasting, He is from the past, He exists in the past, and He exists now, He is the lord of plague and Death, the spreader of sickness and destruction.
He is everlasting, and He is the one; He shall not perish, He shall live eternally, and He shall be reborn…”
Every tone was like an explosion in the soul, and all within hundreds of kilometers dimmed under that horrifying power.
Fear spread.
Boom–
An even more shocking scene took place; with the rise of the phrase of utmost evil, the Divine Country imprisoned in the sky abruptly plummeted down.
The Beastmen in the central area were engulfed by an indescribable force, and then the semi-transparent Divine Country violently crashed into the ground.
Boom–
The earth split apart, and the sky collapsed.
Like a magnitude twelve earthquake, the center of Risier City where the black altar was situated, simply exploded and collapsed.
Dirt splattered, and dust obscured the entire sky.
The Beastman Prince could only lead the people around him in a frantic evacuation, but when the dust settled ever so slightly.
The scene before them made the eyes of the surrounding Beastmen widen, their breaths sharply quickened.

chapters.content:
Chapter 378: Chapter 380: Battle of the Five Armies, Plague of Mad Rats (7800 words) Chapter 378: Chapter 380: Battle of the Five Armies, Plague of Mad Rats (7800 words) No one could describe the breath of the moment when the Divine Country fell from the sky and the earth collapsed.
It was as if a weak child stood in front of a cage containing a vicious beast, accidentally unlocking the cage, and then the beast burst open the iron door, appearing with its gaping maw dripping blood.
The scene was incredibly horrific and thrilling, beyond even what language could express.
A pit a thousand blades wide and two hundred blades deep appeared under the gaze of the Beastmen.
The recent collapse of the ground had directly devoured tens of thousands of Beastman Warriors nearby.
Plasma was still seeping out slowly from the rocks underground.
It was like the Land of Death from the depths of Hell.
And before everyone’s eyes, the center of the pit, the black altar connecting to the Divine Country, remained intact.
What was even more shocking was that the Vampire with outspread wings, emanating a blasphemous presence, was still hovering in mid-air.
The blasphemous language still faintly lingered in everyone’s ears.
“Plague and death were, plague and death are, plague and death will always be…”
It was as if a replay button had been hit, the phrase echoing continuously.
A sensation like a weight pressing on their chests now hovered in the hearts of every Beastman.
But this was not the focal point that captivated everyone, the Beastman Prince’s gaze was fixed upon something else–traces of the Divine Country had unexpectedly been revealed upon the shattered earth.
The massive pit below was directly connected to the core of the Evil God–the Divine Country; nine massive Space Gates formed a circular pattern guarding the black altar, allowing those outside to see into the Divine Country through the Space Gates.
Then, the next scene shattered everyone’s imagination.
The Divine Body, broken in the Divine Country, slowly drifted through the Space Gates and finally hovered beside the Vampire.
This eerie image was simultaneously displayed in the sky, the chaos and the Eye of Death had vanished, but a virtual representation appeared under the thick black clouds.
It was so pronounced that it could be seen in sync from hundreds of kilometers around.
Now, after some promotion, over 100,000 players near Risier City who saw this scene were blown away.
They could witness such a scene at this stage, and it was truly awe-inspiring.
Each second, people were logging off to share screenshots; the horrifyingly stimulating war scene satisfied these entertainment-seekers and even drew the attention of players network-wide.
The progress here affected the hearts of the players, as they saw this as a campaign mission in “Glory,” which could potentially involve the players in some historical processes.
But at this moment, nobody paid attention to the adventurers shouting ‘holy shit’ around them; the gaze of the natives was drawn to the ghostly image in the sky.
The broken Divine body’s limbs drifted apart, two arms and two legs floating away, while a headless torso moved slowly.
Although this Divine Body was the size of a normal human, the strange curvature of the body and the row of fierce spines on the back still conveyed that this Evil God was once a being beyond their comprehension.
However, what was more astonishing was not just the terrifying body; the absence of the head also piqued curiosity.
The body of the Divine seemed to contain an infinite power of the Elemental Plane; each pulse sent ripples through the surrounding space, and the rich energy emitted made everyone feel an uncontrollable fervor.
This was the power of a god! The ultimate existence in Glory!
They felt it, the fleeting power that was intoxicating.
And the critical point was… their bodies were sealed, yes, although the consciousness of the ancient Evil God had revived,
its Divine Body was still bound by the ethereal chains inscribed with Ancient Runes, and these virtually solid rune chains were definitely not something that could be undone in a moment.
At this crucial time, by the pit, an incredibly bold idea rose in the mind of the Beastman Prince Shahraram.
He was going to slay a god!!!
Thump thump~
Thump thump~
Once this insane idea took root, it grew unrestrained, like wild grass in the spring breeze.
If before, excavating the Divine relics to obtain the powers of the sealed Divines was considered indirect operation, then now it was a case of taking up the knife directly to confront the challenge head-on.
One was to pick up what was ready-made; the other required a price to be paid, a price that might be too harrowing to describe.
But from the moment he came to excavate the Divine relics, the Beastman Prince had made thorough preparations; how could it be possible that he only had one trick up his sleeve?
“All forces prepare to seize the Divine Body!! Additionally, immediately send someone to call back the Double-legged Flying Dragons and the elite Beastmen above level 10!!”
“All others, do your utmost to delay the time!”
This command was undoubtedly extremely cold-hearted.
Withdrawing forces at a time when support was already needed meant that what awaited those Beastmen would be a terrible slaughter.
But to Shahraram, this was the best decision, because for the ultimate goal, all the Beastman Warriors of Risier City were dispensable goods, without exception.
For the power of the Divines, what counted these sacrifices?!
“All Beastmen, draw your swords, follow me, Bimong, into the assault!”
With another command, the Beast Bimong, which had yet to show itself in the battle formation, suddenly emerged from the shadows of some street, its towering body more than ten blades high, exuding a chillingly violent aura.
The three-bladed long claws in its hands were Bimong’s strongest weapons, so exaggeratedly powerful they could easily rip through city walls!
Its grey-black fur was filled with a rigid visual sense, and its muscles, more intimidating than cast iron, resembled a magnified giant.
This Golden Life form was known to be comparable to giant dragons of the same level, with countless words in ancient legends used to describe their might.
Following along Bimong were over 30 warriors, each mounted on a wolf, armoured in the finest plate, wielding the sharpest longswords, and without exception, their levels were all above 15.
These were the absolute elite, painstakingly cultivated by the Beastman Prince with the resources of the Beastman Empire.
Their sole purpose was–sacrifice.
Following these level 15 warriors was a level 19 Minotaur Shaman, different from the Werewolf Shaman, who had already eerily vanished from sight,
the Minotaur Shaman’s Curse Stick was inscribed with indescribably strange runes, and the recently terror-stricken Shaman Army immediately surrounded it.
But that wasn’t enough for Shahraram, his gaze resolute, he gestured with his hand, and a corroded iron sword appeared out of thin air in his grasp.
Though rusted, the iron sword was enveloped by a presence eerily similar to that of an Evil God.
That was the power of a Divine…
“The Evil God has not fully awakened, and his body remains sealed.
Now, the adversary can only descend upon that vampire, and I shall use this weapon imbued with Divine Power to forcefully suppress the foe. Taking advantage of this opening, we must seize the Divine Body and Divine Artifact!!”
“In the name of the Warhorn of Furious Blood, attack!!”
The last sentence was nearly roared in desperation.
Wuu wuu~
Right after the Beastman Prince gave the order, the Beastman Military Governor immediately sounded the warhorn and all Beastman troops began their full assault.
But at the very moment the Beastmen prepared to act, under everyone’s shocked gaze, the vampire floating above the altar drifted to ground height, its blood-red eyes now filled with boundless gloomy energy.
Emi swung her hands fiercely, uttering words of Extreme Evil.
“o…kl…oi… Earth… heed my summoning!”
The moment the Spell was chanted in blasphemous language, the surrounding Magic Power underwent a terrifying disturbance, like the tide crashing against the shore after the sea had risen.
Rumble rumble~
Under Emi’s manipulation, the earth trembled. The ground that had sunk began to slowly rise, much like plants rapidly growing in spring.
The two hundred-blade deep pit, under the watchful eyes of those around, leveled out with the ground. The deep pit the Beastmen had been digging for nearly two years became even ground in just a handful of breaths.
However, the nine giant Space Gates did not change with the ground, still forming a circular arch around the Black Altar.
But after the altar rose to the surface, an even more envy-inducing scene appeared. Five orbs of chaotic light–Divine Artifacts–also floated out from the Space Gates, gently bobbing around him just like the body.
At this moment, Emi seemed like a King seated high upon his throne, with every move filled with an awe-inspiring Dignity that rose from the depths of one’s heart.
Along with an extreme sense of terror that seeped into one’s soul.
No one could imagine why a vampire could bear the descent of a Divine, but it no longer mattered, for everything around him was far more appealing.
Prince Shahraram’s gaze was fixed on the Divine Artifacts and the Divine Body; he wanted them all!
“Attack!!”
Just as all the Beastmen charged with frenzy and fearless ferocity, the entire sky plunged into darkness and then a voice that made one’s scalp tingle came from the nine Space Gates.
Squeak squeak~
Squeak squeak~
The next scene sent a chill down the spines of the Beastmen who were halfway through their charge.
Rats, endless and innumerable rats. No, these were not rats, these were Half-rat men with the bodies of rats and the heads of humans.
These bizarre, grotesque creatures oozing with foul stench and plague virus poured out from the Space Gates surrounding the Black Altar, like locusts.
Each Space Gate was thirty blades long and twenty blades high, but these plague-bearing Half-rat men were piled up to fifteen blades high, making all the Beastmen’s hair stand on end at this moment.
The Plague of Mad Rats broke free, like floodwaters bursting through a dam.
The reflection in the sky was a true mirror of this horrifying scene. The crowds within a hundred miles saw the earth collapse, witnessed Emi’s invocation bringing forth a surging ground, observed the Divine Body’s levitation and the majesty of the Divine Artifacts, and now, they bore witness to the apocalyptic vision of the Fierce Rats’ emergence.
These consecutive events had a massive impact on most people, even slowing their breaths.
What followed was an even more chilling sight, as after the Half-rat men emerged from the Space Gates, the blasphemous language swirling in the sky suddenly grew louder.
“Plague and Death were ancient, Plague and Death are present, Plague and Death shall be eternal.”
“He is the everlasting, He is the past, He existed in the past, He also exists this evening, He is the master of Plague and Death, He is the spreader of disease and destruction.
He is eternal, He is also the only one, He shall not die, He shall live forever, He shall also be reborn…”
That was the curse of Extreme Evil passed down from ancient times, a spell that terrified all who heard it.
Upon hearing the spell, all the Half-rat men suddenly swelled in size, their bodies which were originally one blade tall, grew to 1.7 blades, and some even to 1.8 blades, in just a few breaths…
These already dreadful Half-rat men had become nightmare creatures. Their claws bore fatal germs of deadly poison, their massive jaws were the mouths of plague and death, and every part of their bodies could kill an enemy.
At this moment, combined with that ancient blasphemous language, everyone suddenly realized, this Extreme Evil Ancient God must reign over plagues and–rats, yes, these filthy, despicable, garbage-like rats, but in the mouth of the Evil God, these scorned creatures had become everyone’s ultimate fear–the Fierce Rats.
The collision happened just a few breaths later.
The Beastmen who blew the war horns charged directly at the Fierce Rats, and the Fierce Rats, empowered by the blasphemous language, showed not a hint of fear–on their distorted humanoid faces twisted the most brutal expressions as they roared into battle.
Zila~
In the moment of the clash, blood splattered and limbs shattered.
The most elite Beastmen were there; these fierce warriors, led by the Beastman Prince, used their mighty individual strength to savagely slaughter the endless Half-rat men.
But the speed at which the Fierce Rats surged forth was more exaggerated than the Undead falling from the sky, innumerable, inexhaustible.
The thick scent of blood rose like mist, and in an instant, corpses covered the ground, the brutal battle shocking everyone in a mere moment.
Even more horrifying, the souls of these fallen warriors were pulled out and devoured by Emi upon the Black Altar.
The more intense the war, the more terrifying the aura upon Emi grew.
Things began to evolve into a situation no one could have predicted.
—
—
—
But not even the most terrifying scenes could deter the three armies that had already breached the walls of Risier City.
When the reflections appeared beneath the dark clouds, humans, Dwarves, and even the last-to-arrive Undead all fell into a state of extreme frenzy.
They saw it, yes, they saw the Divine Body, they saw the Divine Artifact, they saw the yet-to-fully-recover Evil God, they saw the hope to obtain precious treasures.
Duke O’Kelly, sharp-eyed like a hawk in the cavalry camp, stood out strikingly.
This lord who ruled the entire southern province had a resolve as steady as still water. After glimpsing the scene in the sky, his tone carried an unshakeable determination, a relentless advance.
“Blow the horns, the whole army attacks!!
This time at Green City, there is no room for failure!”
Beside him, the God of Nobles’ bishop fell silent; the Holy Light Pearl in his hand, once the size of a fist, had now turned pure black.
Cracks even appeared on it.
“Duke, do we really have no other choice?”
Holding on to the last sliver of hope, the bishop asked once more unwillingly.
“Bishop,” in the dawn of battle, no, from the moment His Majesty sensed the resurgence of evil, we have had no retreat.
Victory or annihilation,
no one can stop me from acquiring what I desire, even if it costs the elite of the entire South!”
The army of 200,000 was the elite that Duke O’Kelly had cultivated over many years, their weapons and equipment, their Level, all were top-notch, his treasured force in times past.
But this time, before the war even began, he had already regarded all his men as dead.
This iron-blooded Duke had an inexplicable likeness to Prince Shahraram, both formidable figures.
“Yes, Duke!!”
—-
—-
—-
The northern city wall.
“Damn it, why haven’t our goat cavalry broken through the Beastman’s defense??
By the Forge God, I can already smell the Forging Hammer’s scent!!”
Nalis Copper Hammer roared furiously, “Seize the moment, for the Glory of our ancestors awaits us ahead!!
Let those Beastmen and those filthy rats taste the might of Dwarf Warhammer!!
For the Dwarves, charge!!!”
“For the Dwarves!!”
Instantly, as if infused with vigor, the Dwarves began another charge, and this time, even more incredibly, the goat cavalry leaped onto the rooftops alongside the streets of Risier City, bypassing the dense ranks of Beastman Warriors below, heading straight for the center.
Cavalry running atop roofs, perhaps aside from the Dwarves’ cavalry, one could not find a second such force in all of Glory.
Compared to the Dwarves’ cunning, the Undead’s assault was simpler and more effective.
Bone Dragons made use of their aerial advantage to clear the way, Death Knights charging directly behind the rank of Skeleton Warriors, often trampling and breaking the skeletons before they even begun to fight,
even the barriers made by Beastmen in the streets were being destroyed by the terrifying charge of Death Knights.
Fearless of pain, fearless of Death.
The Undead never extinguish.
Due to the lack of Air Force resistance against the Bone Dragons, plus the Death Knights’ heedless charge, it was the late-arriving Undead Army that advanced the fastest.
The Dwarves might have been clever, but not many could truly reach the central area, as many streets had already been destroyed, without even the rooftops remaining; they had no room to exercise their advantage.
The three armies pressed in simultaneously.
Moreover, at this critical moment, Beastman Prince Shahraram had even pulled away part of his elite forces.
This caused the already faltering Beastman Army to descend into even faster disarray; the brave Beastmen, without unified command, could only become cannon fodder.
—-
—-
—-
Emi, dressed in a gray Mage’s robe, floated above the Black Altar with outstretched arms, Divine body, Divine Artifacts all floating around her.
Her blood-red pupils were now invaded by a dark energy, devoid of any fluctuation, like stagnant water, making Emi seem more like a puppet on strings, soulless.
After releasing the Mad Rats, Emi suddenly drew back her outstretched hands, then accompanied by the echoing blasphemous language in the sky, she began to carve inscriptions out of thin air.
Gray energy rippled outwards, and the mutilated bodies floating around Emi without limbs and heads began to shimmer.
The dense Ancient Runes on these shattered bodies could make anyone with a fear of clusters shiver.
Those runes exuded the same aura as the ones that had bound Chaos and the Eye of Death before, terrifying and chilling.
If Lide were here, he would immediately recognize this as the body mentioned by Emi, said to be imbued with Divine Status.
Each rune Emi etched onto the body caused another rune to burst.
This unshielded action instantly attracted everyone’s attention; Emi was now the focus of millions within a hundred kilometers of Risier City.
Perhaps she could no longer be called Emi, but should be addressed as the God of Plague and Death, the body merely a temporary vessel for It.
The real Emi had long been squeezed into an invisible space of consciousness.
Seeing this scene, all the attacking forces tensed up.
Everyone could feel that if they did not get what they wanted before the God of Plague and Death unsealed the body,
once the Ancient Evil God freed Its sealed form, everything would undergo a tremendous change.
They would have no chance of obtaining what they desired.
Both Dwarves and humans fell into their final frenzy, they each had their own reasons to fight desperately, while the Undead showed no greater stir, but just observing their placing all high-ranking Undead into battle revealed they too had made their move.
As the God of Plague and Death acted, the slaughter became even more vicious.
The horns of war resounded like the mournful cries of scavenger crows, always accompanied by the blasphemous language echoing over Risier City.
Once the Beastman Army’s elites were pulled away, they melted like snow meets boiling water, dissolving swiftly. With the three armies pushing desperately, the Beastman Army quickly collapsed, and the Dwarves had already caught a glimpse of the God of Plague and Death hovering in the air.
At this time, in the core area, Beastman Prince Shahraram had also fallen into madness.
Killing like a maniac.
Under his command, the level 19 Bimong with ten blades became a massive weapon on the battlefield.
Although the terrifying Mad Rats surged forth, this Epic beast, with its vast size and strong defenses, rampaged recklessly among the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
But what infuriated and frustrated the Bimong was that it dared not approach the nine Space Gates.
Its animal instincts warned it of a mortal danger, a warning from its soul, forcing it to evade.
Yet, to hunt for the Divine, to seize Divine Artifacts and Divine Body, one had to pass through the gaps between the Space Gates.
This put the Bimong in a vicious cycle, left only to vent its anger on the Fierce Rats.
But the good times didn’t last long. The Beastmen, originally containing the Fierce Half-Ratmen with high-level combat strength, began to struggle significantly.
As an increasing number of level 10 and higher-ranking Half-Ratmen joined the fray, the levels growing higher and higher, Shahraram felt the crisis mounting.
A greater change had to be made!
The Beastman Prince, strong as a raging bull, could no longer tolerate the current pace and furiously hurled his rusty iron sword at the Plague and Death God.
Mid-flight, as if sensing the aura of the Evil God, the iron sword violently erupted with a green glow and then, with the unstoppable force of a collapsing mountain, it thrust toward the Plague and Death God, who was etching inscriptions into thin air.
With that strike, space itself shattered.
But what shocked Prince Shahrarm was that the iron sword, imbued with the power of the Beast God, failed to overpower the Evil God before him. Upon entering the region of the Black Altar, the sword was halted midair by a powerful force.
It merely caused the actions of the Plague and Death God to slow down slightly.
However, that delay was only momentary. After being interrupted, the Plague and Death God abruptly stopped, turned its head, and its gray pupils looked toward the iron sword bursting with terrifying power.
Its mouth suddenly gaped open, and a shriek like a demon tearing at a soul rang out. The iron sword, containing infinite power, instantly burst apart.
Everyone’s soul tingled with numbness.
A terrifying surge rose in the air, carrying with it boundless might as it blasted outwards. The width of the Space Gate, initially 30 blades wide, suddenly expanded to 50 blades.
The number of Half-rat men pouring out from the Space Gate instantly surged several-fold.
And that wasn’t all. After the shrill screams resounded, the bodies of the Half-rat men swelled to a height of 2 blades and became as burly as iron towers.
The battle had undergone a tremendous reversal.
The true Plague of Mad Rats was unleashed.
The ear-splitting screeching, far from ceasing with the Plague and Death God’s renewed effort to unbind its body, continued persistently, as if carved into the very fabric of space itself.
Under the power of that persistent shriek and blasphemous language, every Half-rat man became extremely formidable.
The Beastmen, initially holding the advantage, found themselves in an immense disadvantage. Even possessing a great titan like Bimong was not enough to reverse this absolute disadvantage.
There were too many, innumerable…
The Beastmen had once held a numerical advantage, but now with nine Space Gates, each 50 blades wide, continuing to spew out fierce Half-rat men, any talk of a numerical advantage was a joke.
And if the Beastmen didn’t devise a change soon, they could soon be overwhelmed by the unleashed Fierce Rats.
The onlooking crowd fell silent at the scene. Was this the power of the Divine?
To directly enhance Half-rat men from 1 blade tall to 2 blades tall, to clash head-on with the ferocious Beastmen–such power was surely beyond the comprehension of ordinary humans.
“Concentrate our forces around me as the core!!
Leave the other positions, those damned humans and the Undead want to plunder the Divine Relics, don’t they?
Then give them the chance!!”
After his iron sword, which he had been confident could suppress the Ancient Evil God, proved ineffective, the Beastman Prince lost his originally confident demeanor.
That iron sword had once been wielded by the Beast God, and on the way there, countless sacrifices had been offered to have the Beast God seal a portion of its power within it once again.
But even such a terrifying weapon could not last even a second, the horror of the Ancient Evil God exceeded his imagination.
Yet the Divine Artifact and Divine Body were tempting him, giving him one last sliver of hope.
Having paid such a heavy price, if he did not obtain what he desired, this loss would be too grievous to accept.
Whoo-whoo~
Just a few minutes after Prince Shahraram ordered the abandonment of the siege on the Divine ruins, the sound of the human horn arose in the distance.
The humans, who had fought with all their might, finally broke through the Beastman obstruction and entered the core area of Risier City.
But what greeted them was neither wine and flowers nor divine artifacts and jewels but a group of fierce Half-Ratmen who had overwhelmed the Beastmen.
The strength of the fierce Half-Ratmen dealt a heavy blow to the human army.
But Duke O’Kelly’s will was unshakeable as human warriors, archers, knights, and even the Pegasus Cavalry circled above this area, hunting in packs.
Yet, the number of fierce Half-Ratmen seemed too vast, pouring out of the Space Gate in endless waves, relentless as the sea.
More exaggerated than the Undead–and most chillingly–with the blessing of Divine Power, the once frail Half-Ratmen had become incredibly strong.
The human warriors could only barely hold their ground.
“Damn rats! Taste dwarf axes!” shouted an angry voice as a Dwarf Army, riding stout mountain goats, charged ferociously from another side.
These heavily-armored Dwarves, covered in bloodstains, may have been through a bitter fight, yet their faith in their eyes remained unbreakable.
Following the Dwarves were the Undead, who occupied another vacant area, these beings immune to the concepts of death and pain.
A mournful roar echoed from the sky above, as Bone Dragons, flapping their damaged wings, cleared the path ahead, while the Death Knights, leading legions of Undead, collided head-on with the fierce Half-Ratmen.
The fearless faced the ferocious and cruel, both sides clashing into a blur of blood and flesh.
Beastmen, Dwarves, Undead, Humans,
Four armies converged.
For over a hundred kilometers surrounding Risier City, millions witnessed this epic scene from the reflection in the sky, and as they saw the Beastmen pressed hard by the crazed Half-Ratmen, everyone knew the final battle was about to commence.
The core zone spanning over ten kilometers of Risier City became the arena for the decisive conflict.
Victory meant mythical god-slaying; defeat portended the resurgence of an ancient evil… After an Ancient Evil Divine’s survival on the Main Plane, no one could guarantee what would happen.
Players held their breath at the sight, frantically capturing the moments.
Among the natives, some began to run in the opposite direction of Risier City to avoid the coming disaster, while others charged straight into the city, seeking to fish in troubled waters amidst grave danger.
But at this moment, outside the city that no longer held anyone’s attention,
A gargantuan figure was making a racket as it soared on its wings.
“Gah, gah, gah~ You damned Beastman spawns, Lord Withered Bones has arrived. Are you ready to be annihilated?!”
“None can breathe under the breath of Lord Withered Bones. I, the Undying King, shall become eternal…”
“Gah, gah, gah, do you feel my might? Yes, I am invincible, the invincible Lord Withered Bones…”
Accompanied by the chatter of this bothersome Bone Dragon, an incredibly vast army was advancing swiftly below.
The breaking dawn’s army arrived just before the final battle.
The battle of five armies, the endgame battle.
