“Duke, this powerful Lord is using his own power to subdue this ancient evil deity!
I’ve read in the ancient texts in the church, that during the Battle of the Ancient Gods, some powerful deities of the Light Attribute, in order to gain more combat power towards the later stages of the war, transformed the evil gods into their own servants!”
The main character bishop got more and more excited.
“That means, Lord Ilo is enslaving that ancient Evil God!”
“Enslave an Ancient Evil God?”
Duke O’Kelly couldn’t help but draw a sharp breath upon hearing the statement, his eyes filled with shock.
Isn’t this too audacious?
How terrifying must Lord Ilo’s power be?
Why would such a character stay in the sinful western district of Green City?
Could it be that this formidable supreme being, just like the legends say, is engaging in asceticism among the common folk to experience the vicissitudes of life and seek breakthroughs to higher realms, just like the monks of the sects?
Admiration brimmed in Duke O’Kelly’s eyes at the moment.
To subjugate a Divine being as a servant, what dominance and boldness that is! If given the chance, he must visit such a person.
The wildly imagining Duke O’Kelly didn’t know that at this moment, Lide was merely trying to wrest back control of Emi’s body.
As for wanting to enslave this Ancient God, it was purely a daydream, and even ten million Power of Faith might not be enough; after all, the other party was a True Divine, not just anyone who could be enslaved.
The holy Power of Faith entered Emi’s body but did not result in the scene Lide had anticipated. Instead, the grey power belonging to the Evil God intertwined directly with the Power of Faith.
There was no scene of the Dark Power being dispersed by the Light Power.
“The Evil God of Plague’s Dark Power doesn’t fear the holy Power of Faith at all; this Evil God is too strange…”
Although he didn’t achieve the desired effect, Lide still frantically infused the Power of Faith to suppress the other.
Emi was now the critical point in the battle of Risier City; anyone could have problems, but Emi could not.
He had to ensure Emi controlled her own body, temporarily sealing the God of Plague, otherwise, the trip would have been in vain.
As for snatching the Divine body and Divine Artifacts floating near Emi, Lide had thought about it, but these ultimate treasures contained the Divine Power of the God of Plague; he could not move them.
This planning quickly took effect.
Although the God of Plague was terrifying, by ill-fate, it occupied Emi’s body, its abilities barely starting to be displayed before being suppressed by Lide using Bloodline Power and the Power of Faith.
Under the backlash of the Bloodline and the invasion of the Power of Faith, this Ancient Evil God slowly began losing control over Emi’s body.
Especially after Lide’s Power of Faith started helping Emi’s imprisoned consciousness.
“My lord…”
In the chaos and darkness, Emi suddenly felt a radiant glow filled with potent energy flood in, instantly revitalizing his frail soul as if reborn.
Upon opening his eyes and seeing the world outside again, Emi was so moved that he nearly cried, even thinking at one point that he might die.
He finally saw hope.
“Emi, immediately take control of your body, don’t hesitate!
The God of Plague inside you has been temporarily suppressed by me, but my power isn’t enough to hold him down for long; your cooperation is necessary.”
Though Lide’s voice was stern and frosty, it immediately gave Emi a pillar of strength, “Yes, my lord!”
With the Power of Faith as a backing, Emi’s confidence surged. Sensing the pure Dark Energy inside his body, he immediately began mobilizing his power to block it, forcibly vying for control of his body.
Feeling Emi’s struggle, the Ancient Evil God began to feel unsettled.
“New Sun God, you cannot stop me; this world’s rejection of Divine beings has reached an unbearable level.
Your descent to this world must have consumed most of your power. I sense your feeble Divine Power; when your Divine Power is exhausted, that will be the moment I devour your soul…
Give up resisting. Abandon the title of New Sun God and embrace the Ancient Days, and you will receive everything you desire…”
The tempting Ancient Profanity language slowly echoed in Lide’s ears, like a devil whispering.
Although this Evil God was extremely weakened, Lide was well aware that its words were accurate; he indeed could not stop it.
However, his goal was not to kill the Ancient Evil God. He hadn’t spent such a great amount of effort just to confront an Evil God he had never encountered before — he wasn’t that idle.
He suddenly turned his head to look at the empty area beside him and shouted angrily,
“Asreaga… can you devour it?”
His ultimate weapon was not merely the Power of Faith.
Then, in the perception of the God of Plague, an abrupt figure appeared near the Dark Altar. It was towering at three blades tall, with two curved long horns on its head and beating Demon Wings behind.
This mysterious figure that had suddenly appeared was engraved with Ancient Profanity Inscriptions, exuding an aura that even made his heart tremble.
With an incredibly shocked tone, the God of Plague uttered a word full of sin.
“Divine Monster!!!”
A Divine Monster, a terrifying entity that feeds on the Divine, hunting the Divine despite being from the ancient times the God of Plague couldn’t ignore its power,
For Divine Monster treated both the Light Faction and the Evil Camp’s Divine entities indifferently — all were food.
“New Sun God, you actually rear a Divine Monster?!!”
Hearing this shocked tone, Lide slightly narrowed his eyes. The tone of this Evil God was not like this just a moment ago.
“It seems this move was the right one. The threat of the Divine Monster to the Divine is unimaginable.”
The enemy’s fear, that was what he needed to continue exploiting.
“Asreaga, are you able to kill this Ancient Evil God?”
“Father God, although this Evil God has lost most of its power, I too have lost my former divinity. It is indestructible…”
Hearing this, Lide wasn’t disappointed; if this Evil God was so easily killed, it wouldn’t have survived until now.
“What about these Divine Bodies? Can you devour their divinity?”
The food of a Divine Monster was divinity; devouring divinity would make them even stronger.
Asreaga’s eyes filled with cruelty shook his head.
The blasphemous language from his mouth was still as cold as ice.
“Father God, these Divine Bodies are engraved with powerful seals. I cannot break the seals in such a short time…”
Hearing this, Lide’s brow furrowed; if that was the case, then the harvest this time was truly too meager.
Even at this moment, he sensed that the God of Plague inside Emi’s body sighed with relief.
However, Asreaga’s second sentence took a turn again.
“But the seal on this left arm has loosened. Just give me some time, I can unlock the seal on it…”
Lide’s eyes instantly brightened, quietly eyeing the headless body containing Divine Status. He inquired,
“What about this body? The seal has already been half unlocked…”
“The power contained in this body is too terrifying. If the seal is broken, this Evil God will immediately return to its original form, and we will be unable to resist it…”
Asreaga shook his head, “These Divine Bodies and Divine Artifacts are all wrapped in Divine Power. To take them away, we can only destroy this Divine Power…
Father God, my current power is not enough to obtain all items… and the power of the Divine Artifacts is too strong; I can only get one object from these Divine Bodies.”
Asreaga’s words left Lide slightly disappointed; he had intended to sweep away all the items, but it seemed that it was not feasible for now.
Two arms, two legs, along with a headless Divine Body and five Divine Artifacts.
One could say that everything around the God of Plague was the world’s top treasures.
However, in the current situation, there was simply no way to have it all. Adults couldn’t always get everything they wanted, and the necessary decisions still had to be made.
Taking a deep breath, Lide immediately made a decision.
“Take that arm with the weaker sealing power and move quickly, I can only hold off the opponent for five more minutes…”
In the presence of the God of Plague, the two blatantly divided his body, instantly igniting the wrath of the Evil God.
“New Sun God, I have now memorized the flavor of your soul. When the Destiny Tablet shatters, I, will surely descend upon the Main Plane and roast your soul for a million years!”
Hearing this, Lide’s spine chilled again, feeling an indescribable horror about to strike him down.
His heart stopped beating at that moment.
“The Destiny Tablet shattering? What the hell is this damn Evil God talking about?
What is the Destiny Tablet? Why do I feel like I’m in danger just hearing about it?”
It was terrifying, like someone with a strong, muscular arm was strangling his neck, making it difficult for him to breathe.
Lide’s face looked uneasy. How could this Evil God talk so much? Although these secrets were substantial, they were too exaggerated and beyond his comprehension.
Yet, as an Extreme Evil being that survived from ancient times, the Divine Monster seemed completely unaffected by this news, still carrying out Lide’s orders.
After flapping its wings, it violently flew next to the Divine Body floating in the sky and directly took one of its arms with a brutal and bloodthirsty gaze.
The moment the arm was removed from its floating path, it seemed to trigger some seals, and an indescribable terrifying aura immediately enveloped the area.
It was like a child walking to the entrance of a pitch-dark cave, only for a tiger with its huge mouth wide open to rush out, filling even a resolute warrior with enough horror to weaken his legs.
Surprisingly, at that moment, a corrupt and evil aura also erupted from Asreaga, an Ancient Level-19 Divine Monster, which forcefully countered that terrifying aura.
The situation calmed down.
But looking at Asreaga’s expression, it was evident he was under unspeakable pressure, his neck veins bulging, and his facial expressions particularly ferocious.
Lide felt a twinge of tension seeing this.
“Asreaga, leave this place and head to the predetermined location!”
“Yes, Father God…”
After the words fell, the towering Asreaga, carrying the arm as if he were shouldering a mountain, left.
Lide could only shake his head, as the system space notified him that he could not collect items with divinity. He had no choice but to let Asreaga act on his own.
A sharp claw shattered the space ten blades away from the altar, and using his powerful spatial control, Asreaga disappeared into a spatial rift.
Seeing this, Lide breathed a slight sigh of relief; at least they had a guaranteed gain from the war that had cost countless resources.
Even if they only obtained a divine arm this time, he felt it was a huge gain.
It was a Divine Body containing flesh and divinity–the remains of a Divine within the blood pool reduced to mere bones had given the Holy Light Bloodline a foundation. One could imagine how precious the Divine Body was.
The value of such a treasure was incomparable to any amount of ordinary Gold Puck or minerals.
The illusory space around the Black Altar blocked the view of the outside, murky and indistinct, not even reflecting the sky.
Entering this area was like being blindfolded.
At this moment, Lide was unaware if there had been any changes in the outside war. He could only hurry to secure more benefits.
Upon sensing Asreaga quickly moving away, Lide turned his attention back to Emi, who was still held down by the forehead, as he continued to forcefully infuse the Power of Faith into her.
Dealing with this Evil God was the focus of this mission. Although countless strategies had been considered before arriving, the actions taken now clearly didn’t connect with the earlier simulations. Plans never changed as fast as situations.
“Emi, can you control the body now?”
“My Lord, it’s too strong, the power of this Evil God is too overpowering. I can barely resist, but I can’t make more useful movements…”
The ancient God of Plague no longer spoke after Asreaga left; the evil god had fallen into silence, yet Lide could distinctly feel that the dark power around him had become more active.
The opponent would definitely not surrender without a fight.
“How can you seal this evil god for a longer period of time, or make him leave your body?”
“My lord, the altar under your feet…”
Emi’s voice was extremely weak; if it weren’t for Lide using the Power of Faith to support him, Emi’s soul would have likely collapsed under the onslaught of the Plague God by now.
In the corruption of the evil god’s power, who else could endure?
“Altar?”
“Yes… this altar is the key to the entire seal; most of the Plague God’s power is locked within it. I previously obtained some power from inside it…
You could also obtain some power from it to drive him out…”
Using the power of an evil god against another evil god? This move was quite cunning.
“Do you know how to do it?”
“The Plague God had already destroyed much of the altar’s seal, waiting for the moment when he could unseal his body and instantly regain most of his power.
So now, you don’t need to break the seal anymore; you just need to communicate with the altar using your spiritual power to gain a portion of its power.
But be careful, the power inside the altar is more vast than the ocean; you only need to obtain a small part, as taking too much might allow this evil god to control you…”
Emi’s ruthless revelation provoked the once-subdued Plague God into fury yet again.
“Damn New Sun God, that is the power of ancient days, how dare you covet it?”
Lide ignored the Plague God’s words completely; firstly, he was too lazy to argue, and secondly, he feared that the opponent might reveal some dreadful secrets, which he truly might not be able to withstand.
Legend has it that some powerful, malevolent deities, in order to keep certain terrifying secrets, often set curses with their mighty divine power, cursing anyone who probes these secrets for life.
Although the cost of setting such curses is almost unbearable for the deities, once the curse is successfully established, anyone who touches those taboos will face great peril.
These legends appeared in the Glory Myths collected by Lide’s men; he originally thought they were merely fabrications by wandering poets, but the recent terrifying crisis had subtly changed his mind.
“Emi, as soon as I gain the power, I’ll transfer it to you. Once you break free from his control, immediately retrieve the divine skull, and we’ll evacuate…”
“What? My skull has been hidden by you? New Sun God, you dirty, contemptible thief!”
The Plague God hadn’t expected that his missing skull had been secretly hidden by Lide and Emi. This move enraged him once more.
If the Plague God regained power at this moment, he, an ancient deity, would likely stop at nothing to kill Lide.
As a deity, even though sealed, he had never experienced such humiliation.
He was the sovereign of ancient days.
The deity who controlled plague and spread death!
Clearly, Lide did not care about what the Plague God said. This was the Main Plane, and this evil god, even if he managed to escape, couldn’t stay here long; he would inevitably be rejected by the will of the Main Plane to other planes. By then, no matter how much he despised him, what could he really do?
His body plummeted down onto the altar.
Then, following Emi’s instructions, he emanated his spiritual power…
But at that instant, the surrounding illusory space violently shook, the overlapping and separating spaces finally stabilized.
The spatial coordinates of the Plague God’s Divine Country were now completely locked onto Risier City.
Instantly, the previously silent space filled with the hissing of Fierce Half-Ratmen, while at the same time, the roaring of the Half-Elf army fighting the surviving Half-Ratmen once again reverberated through the sky.
But this was not all, for the Ancient Profanity that had been echoing in the sky ceased with Lide’s forceful suppression of the Plague God.
Although the gray energy that allowed the half-rat man to evolve into a fierce half-rat man was still present, the absence of the blasphemous language seemed to have altered the surrounding environment, at least the oppressive dark aura had dissipated.
Countless half-rat men, revealed due to the space being fixed, let out sharp shrieks upon seeing Lide enthroned on the altar.
This alien presence drove numerous fierce half-rat men into madness, but the terrifying aura of the Black Altar prevented any from drawing near, forcing them to circle around.
Numerous fierce-looking half-rat men bared their sharp teeth and surrounded him with shrieks, creating an exceedingly unsettling scene.
However, Lide had no time to deal with anything else at the moment, as the Centaur army was sufficient to handle everything, so he continued to disperse his spiritual power to explore the altar.
After encountering resistance from Emi’s will, Lide saw a sharp decline in the power of faith he was consuming, and by his current estimates, he could barely hold on for five minutes.
This meant he had to find a way to suppress the Evil God within these five minutes, otherwise, once it freed itself, he would face tremendous trouble.
The reflection in the sky, having lost the control of the God of Plague, remained silent, and despite the crowd around Risier City witnessing the recent events, they remained unclear about what exactly had happened.
“What is this NPC trying to do? Didn’t he just make that Evil God kneel down? Why did some mysterious person take the Evil God’s arm?”
“You don’t know shit. Didn’t you see that the Evil God is being sealed? Ever played a game before? Next comes the cinematic in the game.”
“I bet they’re about to break the seal, and then the Evil God will revive, regaining its body and obediently become a subordinate to that cool NPC.”
“Are you the so-called ‘know-it-all’?? But it does make sense, that guy was too cool. Damn, in front of hundreds of thousands of soldiers, he made a god kneel with just one sentence, absolutely badass.”
In the few minutes after Lide approached the God of Plague, the onlooking players were still immersed in the shocking scene of him leading hundreds of thousands through the half-rat men.
But just as they were busily discussing, someone sharp-eyed suddenly noticed a huge tear above the Beastman Army,
followed by three incredibly formidable-looking Beastmen stepping out of the shattered space–two Beastman Warriors and one Beastman Shaman, all from the Lion-man Clan.
“What’s with more people showing up??”
“What are these Beastman NPCs up to?”
“I feel like a fight’s about to break out again. Really looking forward to that handsome NPC named Ilo taking action!”
Beastman Prince Shahrarm, upon seeing the three figures in the sky, couldn’t suppress a smile on his face.
His ultimate backup had finally arrived.
The Extraordinary Spellcaster among the Beastmen waved his hand, bringing the two Beastman Warriors floating to face Shahrarm.
After landing, the three nodded slightly.
“Your Highness…”
Even as Extraordinary beings, they needed not bow, for in this world, power was the eternal truth.
Shahrarm gestured to pound his chest towards the Extraordinary Spellcaster, “Thank you for coming.”
Then, with a hint of confusion, “Why didn’t you respond to my call earlier?”
The Extraordinary Shaman shook his head, his gaze solemn.
“Your Highness, the Ancient Profanity echoing above Risier City contains the most evil of powers. If those above Extraordinary appear in this city, they would be attacked by extreme evil and enslaved by it.
We are here now because that blasphemous chant has ceased…”
Pleased with the news, Shahrarm then pointed towards the Black Altar.
His tone was chilling, and his intent murderous.
“Kill them, snatch the Divine Body and Divine Artifacts!”
The three Extraordinary Beastmen simultaneously turned their heads to look at Lide, who was sitting atop the altar.
The scene fell suddenly silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - Chapter 382: Chapter 384: Casually Obliterating Three Transcendents, the World in Awe (8000 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 382: Chapter 384: Casually Obliterating Three Transcendents, the World in Awe (8000 words)
Lide was not paying attention to the actions outside at this time; his spiritual power began to spread out, exploring toward the altar below.
He had to seize the opportunity to gain power now, for once the Power of Faith was exhausted, he would encounter big trouble. The Ancient Evil God that hated him with a passion would surely risk its dying breath to strike at him once.
The moment his spiritual power touched the altar, Lide’s eyes instantly narrowed.
He felt an indescribable power surging within this altar, like the center of a category eighteen storm in the ocean, an endless and violent energy.
His own power was so insignificant in the face of this energy that he felt like a child facing a One-eyed Giant.
But just as he sensed that power, an extremely dark aura emanated from around the energy, tyrannical, dark, cruel, bloodthirsty–the most negative adjectives Lide could think of were not enough to describe a fraction of it.
His soul was almost devoured at that moment.
Great terror descended.
He bit down hard on his teeth, using the Power of Faith to protect his Spiritual Sea. Only after isolating that grey aura did the danger slowly subside.
He breathed a slight sigh of relief inwardly–too dangerous. If he had been a fraction of a second slower in his reaction, he might have really had to go back and soak in the Blood Pool.
After that incident, Lide immediately maximized his inner vigilance.
With his heightened focus, he could now clearly sense that the souls of the fallen warriors around him were being absorbed by the altar and then transformed into pure energy, merging into the original energy of the altar.
“What a tremendous Death Aura; if all this energy were to be absorbed by the Land of Bone-Burying… at the very least, tens of millions of points of the Power of Death could be gained. Such a pity,” Lide thought with a hint of envy, but he could only resist the temptation. The energy within the altar belonged to someone, and although its owner couldn’t currently control it, his own Level 19 power was incapable of shaking it.
He withdrew his attention, focusing on the task at hand.
Lide began to stretch his spiritual power into the depths of the altar, as Emi had instructed, touching the pure, water-like energy that lay in the pitch-black space, enshrouded by the grey aura.
After breaking through the corrosion of the grey aura, his spiritual power touched the energy, but at that instant, the energy in the sea of energy, like an overflowing reservoir finding an outlet, began to pour into his body at an unstoppable and terrifying speed.
Although Lide, as the Blood Clan Ancestor, had been bathed in Divine Calamity and his Divine Body had an undeniable ability to withstand power, he still experienced intense pain at that moment.
It was too terrifying–the power was too overwhelming.
It felt like a three-centimeter diameter drain with a five-centimeter diameter steel pipe jammed into it.
The inflow of energy exceeded his capacity to bear; his muscles and blood vessels were all bulging.
The intense pain made the normally resolute Lide struggle to bear it, his facial muscles involuntarily twitching, giving him a somewhat fierce look.
But this pain wasn’t purely suffering; it also brought with it a sense of satisfaction from gaining power, a mix of pleasure and pain that made him feel as if he were torn between heaven and hell.
But that wasn’t all–his soul, which had been stretched thin, now suffered even greater erosion.
The nearly tangible grey power violently eroded his Spiritual Sea, seeking to tear apart his soul. The Power of Faith was rapidly depleting, and he wouldn’t be able to hold out much longer.
Under the nearly twisting impact of the energy, Lide still forcibly stabilized his nearly crumbling heart.
After a short 20 seconds, his body was full to bursting. Just before his blood vessels were about to explode, he abruptly severed the mental connection.
Whoo~whoo~
His exaggerated breathing was like a bellows in operation or a drowning person breaking the surface, gasping for air without restraint.
Pale-faced, Lide was by now completely soaked in cold sweat.
“Ding~ You have obtained a portion of the Divine’s power. Temporary trait–Divine Gift acquired; All Attributes elevated to Legendary level, duration 5 minutes.”
After he disengaged from the altar, the long-missed notification sound of the system rang out.
Lide’s eyes brightened, and after a slight sense check, he felt an indescribable terror of energy churning inside his body, like bubbling lava flowing through his veins, an incomparable power constantly about to explode.
“The power of the gods… Legendary…
The taste is too wonderful, I feel like I could explode a mountain…”
With his body somewhat torn, Lide’s wounds healed in mere blinks under the influence of the powerful energy. As he turned, the space around him began to twist and shake; the energy overflowing from his body was terrifyingly immense.
Lide briefly focused his mind to control that energy. He stepped into the void, approaching Emi, who was still struggling to hold on.
“Get ready, I’ll transfer some power to you and then force the Evil God out of your body. We don’t have much time to waste…”
Feeling Lide’s aura, the God of Plague, currently wrestling with Emi for control of the body, got enraged yet again, letting out a desperate roar.
“Damn New Sun God, have you really stolen the Ancient’s power?!”
The tone was furious, and also carried disbelief, as if, for this Ancient Evil God, it was unimaginable for the New Sun God to be accepted by the Ancient power.
Lide didn’t bother with the Undying God of Plague, focusing on the task at hand. Once his Power of Faith was exhausted, the Evil God would lose restraint, and what might happen then was anyone’s guess.
He had to temporarily seal the God of Plague before that moment and then claim the god’s head.
A head imbued with divine presence, Lide couldn’t even begin to describe its terrifying value.
It could even possibly allow him to achieve Transcendence.
The temptation was enough for him to risk anything.
“Yes, my Lord…” Emi spoke weakly, her expression somewhat contorted. This second-generation Bloodline was enduring immense pain.
Without hesitation, Lide placed his hand back on Emi’s forehead.
But just then, wuu wuu~
A deep horn sounded from behind.
Suddenly, tens of thousands of the Beastman Army turned back and came again, Beast Bimong leading the way, the Wolf Cavalry breaking through the thinning ranks of the fierce Half-ratmen.
Then, these ferocious Beastmen, roaring and howling without a moment’s hesitation, charged directly into the ranks of the Centaur Army.
Boom boom boom~
As the roar of the Beast Bimong, which bore the Golden Bloodline, bellowed, hundreds of Centaurs close to the Beastmen were torn to shreds by a powerful force.
Three indescribably domineering presences surged.
The abnormal scene immediately caught everyone’s attention.
“Is that??! Transcendent??!!”
Duke O’Kelly was riding a Pegasus midair, his face filled with surprise at the sight of the Beastman Army attacking the Centaurs.
Especially unbelievable to him were the three leading Beastmen exuding golden energy.
He sensed the aura belonging to Transcendents.
“Why have Transcendents appeared??” Duke O’Kelly abruptly turned his head to look at the bishop beside him, also riding a Pegasus, his tone full of confusion.
“Could it be because that terrifying blasphemous language vanished??”
The bishop hesitated upon hearing the question, his face revealing a moment of uncertainty.
“Duke, it’s not key why the Transcendents have come, but how we should respond now that they have.”
“Transcendents? Will they trouble Lord Ilo?” Duke O’Kelly was dismissive.
In his heart, he had already acknowledged the figure that made deities kneel as an incredibly powerful being, so what were three suddenly appearing Beastmen?
That was Lord Ilo!!!
Hmph.
Watching Duke O’Kelly’s resolute gaze, the bishop hesitated, unsure of what to say next.
He always felt something was off, but at present, everything seemed normal.
Three extraordinary Beastmen and the Beast Bimong charged forward as the spearhead, with the rest of the Beastmen ferociously following suit.
The sudden attack by the Beastmen had clearly caught the Centaur Army off guard, instantly resulting in nearly a thousand centaur casualties.
High-level combat power held a crushing advantage over low-level forces.
But the centaurs were no pushovers. As a strong battle race, these formidable beings feared nothing!
The Beastmen’s onslaught did not disrupt the centaurs’ formation. Under the command of the Iron Hoof Tribe’s Clan Leader Sam, they immediately began to counterattack.
The first to strike were naturally the Centaur Archers.
While the Beastmen Army was merely spectating before, they had not yet experienced the prowess of the Centaur Archers. Now, facing them directly, they realized why the meat-winged half-ratmen that had obscured the sky were cleared away so swiftly.
But it was already too late.
The cost of the powerful bows exceeded all Beastmen’s expectations.
The sky filled with a rain of arrows as dense as locust swarms, and the lightly armored, or even cowhide-clad Beastmen Army, immediately suffered a brutal onslaught.
Thwack~Splash~
With the sound of the bowstrings, blood splattered.
A single volley resulted in over 2000 Beastmen falling dead, their horrific killing efficiency making Duke O’Kelly’s eyebrows twitch from afar.
When they had recently crushed the fierce half-ratmen underfoot, most people had focused on Lide at the center of the battlefield, inadvertently overlooking the centaurs.
Now, without Lide’s dazzling presence, everyone re-evaluated this army and immediately noticed the difference.
Precise and forceful crossbows, solid and immovable armor, sharp weapons that could pierce through thick shields, strong bodies capable of smashing boulders… all of this spelled terror for the opposition.
They were too powerful.
This Centaur Army was definitely not something any other army within Risier City could match.
“Kill!!!”
Because the Centaur Army was overwhelmingly powerful, the half-ratmen emerging from the New Sun God’s divine country had their momentum curbed and, despite their numbers, failed to break the centaurs’ encirclement.
With no pressure from the rear, Sam immediately commanded half his forces to confront the Beastmen.
At this moment, the Giant Army, which had been slaughtering the fierce half-ratmen nearby, also pivoted under command to target the Beastmen.
Both armies were about to collide once more.
Lide originally couldn’t be bothered with these disturbances. The Divine body was the only important matter at hand; he had led his army here to occupy others and create enough space for himself.
However, after the Beastmen Army attacked the Centaurs, he sensed three icy gazes suddenly sweep over from behind, their intent to kill clear and identifiable.
At that moment, reflected above the skies of Risier City, millions witnessed three extraordinary beings soaring through the air, crossing over the battlefield and forcibly breaking into the radius of the fifty blades surrounding the Black Altar.
The three extraordinary individuals radiated billowing golden energy like flames, and the meat-winged half-ratmen around them didn’t dare to approach under the extraordinary pressure, instantly creating a vacuum around them.
“Lowly humans! A 19th-level Mage dares to impersonate a Divine being?!”
The words of the Beastman Shaman echoed through the reflection over a hundred-mile radius around Risier City, startling everyone.
Level 19?
The crowd, not understanding the situation, looked up at Lide in the sky.
No way, just a moment ago, he made a Divine kneel with a single sentence and he’s only level 19? How is that possible??
At this time, even just seeing the reflection in the void, the crowd around Risier City felt an indescribable terror emanating from this Beastman.
It was like… a Divine descending to the world.
Could it be another god??
This sudden turn of events was thrilling for both players and natives.
However, the Beastman’s speech continued.
“Although I don’t know what treasure you used to control this Ancient Evil God, you cannot deceive me with the aura of your Soul Fire, pitiful human…”
Although Lide had activated his Ancestor Bloodline, he had not revealed his true Bloodline form. This was a derivative use of the Bloodline he had researched recently. Even though this would cause a certain drop in combat power, the advantage was that it allowed him to have stronger power without exposing himself.
Divine Power…
On hearing the Beastman’s words, Lide’s brows furrowed sharply.
He actually felt Divine Power on this Transcendent Beastman, and that power was even more terrifying than the sealed Ancient Evil God.
There could be only one answer–the Beast God.
As the main god of the Beastmen, its strength was comparable to the Master of Dawn, the main god of the Light Attribute.
But he never expected a Transcendent Beastman to suddenly emerge with such a level of power.
His gaze pierced deeply into the Beastman’s eyes, knowing that the Beastman had many hidden moves up his sleeve in order to obtain the hidden legacy of the Divine.
But…
After feeling the terrifying power inside his own body for a moment, Lide inexplicably wanted to laugh.
Although the other party had borrowed the Divine Power of the Beast God, it seemed not to be imbued into himself to increase combat strength, but more like… for probing?
The Transcendent Beastman Shaman, upon seeing Lide’s indifferent reaction, furrowed his brows sharply. If he hadn’t been uncertain whether he had successfully suppressed the Evil God, he would have attacked by now.
But the lack of reaction from the other party made the situation somewhat tricky for him.
He decided to keep pressuring the level 19 Great Mage, speaking words infused with Divine Power.
“I have been granted the Eye of True Knowledge by the great Beast God. As long as the power of the Beast God does not fade, I can see the Soul Power of all beings.
You cannot hide from me!”
His tone was cold, “Perhaps you possess a powerful treasure that can control this Evil God, but a level 19 human Mage has no right to compete with me for this Evil God!”
The words, filled with Divine Power, once again reached the ears of the crowd within a hundred miles around Risier City. Immediately, everyone erupted.
“Damn, really?? That NPC is only level 19?? Not even Transcendent, but why can a level 19 be so strong?”
“No way, that Evil God is being controlled by a level 19 Great Mage??”
“Drama of the year, I didn’t expect such a twist. I knew it, that NPC couldn’t possibly be that powerful! How could it make a Divine kneel…”
“Get lost, you were the most excited when you were bragging just now. Even Sichuan opera doesn’t change faces as quickly as you do…”
A group of players displayed expressions of enjoying the drama, and some even immediately turned to mocking Lide.
This crowd of idiots just came to watch the show. Why should there be someone so cool and powerful? Even if it’s an NPC, it makes many people uncomfortable.
Seeing this scene suddenly made many people feel a dark sense of pleasure, as if witnessing a person who had once been well-off now about to fall into misfortune.
The complexity of human nature was displayed in just a few short sentences.
And upon hearing the Beastman Shaman’s categorical statements, the natives also couldn’t help but hesitate, immediately splitting into two distinct factions: those who believed and those who did not.
“It’s impossible, Lord Ilo is the Dark Tutor of Green City, he who guided the Heart-eating Demon Wales to transcendence. How could he possibly be Level 19??? This must be the despicable Beastmen spreading lies and chaos!!”
“Heh, I knew this Ilo was an imposter, how could transcending be so simple??? Maybe the Heart-eating Demon Wales was about to transcend all along, and this Ilo just happened upon a dead rat…”
“By the Goddess above, I dare to bet, Lord Ilo is definitely a true Divine. The God of Plague was unharmed even when surrounded by hundreds of thousands of troops, and now he’s been defeated by Lord Ilo!”
“The Beastmen did say that this Ilo possesses some secret equipment that caused this situation, have you ever seen a Divine kneel? No… There must be a reason for this.”
“…”
Lide, once revered and worshipped, instantly became the target of criticism by some after the Transcendent Beastman Shaman had spoken.
The scene was reminiscent of those internet spectators on Earth who would praise someone one second for their skill, and the next second upon a loss spew insults that such a person deserved to be trashed.
Both Dwarf Clan Leaders, Rabiao Hammer and Nalis Copper Hammer, were also somewhat astounded upon hearing this, exchanging glances that communicated the oddness reflected in each other’s eyes.
“Clan Chief Nalis, I have a feeling that Beastman wasn’t lying…”
Naris Copper Hammer also nodded, his eyes narrowing into slits.
“If it’s true, it’s even more advantageous for us. Facing a Transcendent is much easier than facing a true Divine… May the Forge God be above us, I hope it is so.”
Beastman Prince Shahrarm was so excited at this moment that his blood had already surged to his head.
That Divine, under scrutiny of the Eye of True Knowledge, turned out to be merely a Level 19 Great Mage!
This news nearly drove him mad; he had never felt the treasure of the Divine ruins so close at hand.
If only he could subdue that Level 19 Great Mage and seize the artifact suppressing the Evil God from him, then everything would be his.
As for whether the opposing party could suppress the Evil God with their own strength, Shahrarm hadn’t even considered it. How could a Level 19 Great Mage possibly have the strength to suppress an Evil God? Not even the absurd myths from the bards dared to weave such a plot.
Lide’s dark, profound eyes were like stars twinkling, and his expression at this moment was quite subtle.
After the Beastman Shaman had finished speaking, a cold arc formed on the corner of his mouth.
“Are you done?”
Hmm?
Upon hearing this, the three Transcendent Beastmen felt a sudden chill, because the Lide they had seen as weak just a moment ago suddenly surged in momentum.
A terrifying horror that was indescribable swept over them, like the gaping maw of a Demon swallowing them.
From all directions, inescapable.
The warriors who were fighting below felt a shiver in their hands, a chill down their spines. They even slowed their combat and stole glances towards the source of that terrifying presence.
What could this be??
The Transcendent Beastman Shaman’s eyes flashed with disbelief.
He sensed that Lide’s soul power was clearly Level 19, but why was this momentum so terrifying now??
Impossible, this must be the opponent’s trick; after all, his artifact could suppress an Evil God!
The Eye of True Knowledge, granted by the great Beast God, could not possibly be wrong!
The Shaman’s magic power began to run wild, anger flaring within the Transcendent Beastman Shaman. He yearned to tear apart this Level 19 Great Mage!
At this moment, Lide made a move that everyone would remember for the rest of their lives.
In front of millions of onlookers surrounding Risier City, he stretched out his right hand and then gently clenched his fist towards the three Transcendent Beastmen.
Whoosh~
In that instant, the heavens changed color, and the earth trembled.
The dense black clouds in the sky spun wildly like the eye of a storm, as though a terrifying beast capable of tearing apart the heavens and the earth had been born.
The rich grey energy around began to surge and gather, spreading terror!
In the blink of an eye, a supremely powerful force imprisoned the three Transcendent Beastmen that were mid-air.
That was the power of the Divine Country!
Emi, having inherited part of the God of Plague’s power, had hidden the Divine heads within the Divine Country, using the power it provided.
After Lide gained the power of the God of Plague, he too obtained the authority to summon the power of the Divine Country.
Lide did not know how powerful the God of Plague’s Divine Country was, but it was undoubtedly a thousand to ten thousand times stronger than the Land of Bone-Burying.
The Land of Bone-Burying, with merely a range of a thousand blades, could suppress life forms at the level of a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel. Although he could only use less than one percent of the Divine Country’s power, how hard could it be to crush three Transcendent beings?
These three Transcendent Beastmen were thus imprisoned in mid-air with just a slight bend of his hand.
“No!!”
“Damn it, let go of me!!”
The Beastmen’s faces changed drastically, and horrific energy burst forth from their bodies, like a terrifying erupting volcano.
But all of it was in vain; that invisible cage was the power of the Divine Country, the foundation of a world, and no amount of explosive force from them could change anything.
A struggle of trapped beasts, futile and powerless.
Lide’s face remained indifferent, his deep eyes reflecting everything before him, without a single redundant word. Amidst the millions of shocked gazes,
he suddenly clenched his fingers into a fist.
The energy of heaven and earth violently erupted at that moment, space itself seemed to twist under the mighty force,
Splatter~
A Death Flower blossomed in the air.
Millions witnessed this bloody and terrifying sight.
The moment Lide clenched his fist, endless spatial power crushed from every direction, the three Transcendent Beastmen were pressed like mountains, and without any chance to escape, they exploded.
Flesh and skeletons turned into a mist of blood.
The scene was extremely cruel and bloody.
Three Transcendent.
Slain.
Without any superfluous words, without any unnecessary delay, these three Transcendent Beastmen appeared for less than 30 seconds before they were directly crushed to death by Lide.
It was truly like squashing bugs, he crushed these Transcendent beings to death.
The scene looked shockingly indescribable.
Millions around Risier City witnessed this and simultaneously fell silent, their eyes widened, mouths agape, and all words failed to describe what they saw at that moment.
Crushing three Transcendents!
This scene simply sent everyone’s blood boiling.
Those who had criticized Lide now felt a burning pain on their faces, looking at the people next to them with a sense of shame.
For those existence even Divines knelt before, what right did they have to question him?
The players were practically going crazy.
“Holy shit, I’m gonna lose it!! How could this be so freaking cool!!
Three Beastman Transcendents, for crying out loud! That’s Transcendent!!! Just like that, crushed to death?!!”
“Honey, come out and see God…”
“Hahaha, what did I say, that NPC is definitely the strongest discovered in ‘Glory’! Bar none!
Just wiped out three Transcendents with a wave of his hand! Damn, I’m so excited I might have a stroke right now!! I’m itching to draw a sword and slash a couple of Beastmen to cool down!”
“Too freaking awesome!! This NPC has literally broken through the heavens!! Damn!!”
Duke O’Kelly, upon witnessing this scene, was so excited his face turned beet red. With a fierce slap on his Pegasus, he turned his head towards the bishop beside him, and with a mix of frenzy and worship in his voice, he roared softly.
“Didn’t I tell you, Your Excellency the bishop!!!
Transcendent?! Transcendent is nothing but crap before Lord Ilo!
Crushed to death!! Just like that, crushed by a single hand!!”
The usually well-composed Duke even resorted to cursing, revealing how thrilled and excited his heart was.
The bishop, although equally shocked, couldn’t help but give Duke O’Kelly a puzzled look after hearing this.
The mysterious Lord Ilo had killed the Beastman Transcendent, what does that have to do with you… Doesn’t this mean it will be even harder for us to get what we want from him?
Lide’s domineering actions had stunned everyone in Risier City, with admiration spreading like wildfire.
But only the Beastmen felt as uncomfortable as if they had eaten a dead mouse.
Especially Beastman Prince Shahrarm, who had already seen hope for victory, but the harsh reality dealt him a heavy blow.
At this moment, his ears buzzed, his mind in complete disarray.
“Why?? His Soul Fire was only Level 19, wasn’t it?? How could he be so powerful!!!
Why couldn’t the Eye of True Knowledge discover this mysterious person’s true power??
That was a gift from the Beast God himself!!”
Shahrarm’s eyes dimmed as he realized that the Eye of True Knowledge, for which he had offered so many sacrifices, had deceived him.
His ultimate trump card was so easily crushed by the enemy, literally pulverized, leaving nothing but a mist of blood in the air.
“How can there be Divines in the main plane of Glory??”
Shahrarm’s mind was a whirlwind of questions, he couldn’t even dare to believe what had happened.
That was a Transcendent, a being that could even hold its ground against Legendaries and couldn’t be killed so easily.
But before that mysterious person, there was not even a chance to resist, just an explosion.
Roar~
Just then, a furious roar broke the somewhat quiet atmosphere of Risier City.
One of the ultimate combat forces of the Beastmen–Bimong, was currently emerging from the Centaur Army with boundless strength, roaring as he charged, and in a blink of an eye, he had reached the area around the Black Altar.
Originally, Bimong was to cooperate with the three Transcendents in the attack, but he was too late in his killing spree.
“No!!”
Seeing this, the Beastman Prince let out a cry of despair.
The three Transcendents were not his subordinates but had been borrowed from the Royal Capital; their death was of no personal consequence to him.
But Bimong was the most powerful direct combat power under his command, who, when grown to a Transcendent, would be a crucial support in his contest for the throne.
And now, Bimong had rushed in front of the enemy, with the blood mist in the air not yet dispersed…
But rage solved nothing, Shahrarm could only watch the back of Bimong, knowing it was too late to recall him.
Lide narrowed his eyes slightly as he saw Bimong, ten blades high, daring to enter the area enveloped by the Divine Country.
A few strands of chill appeared on his face.
A beast flowing with the Golden Bloodline?
He had taken a fancy to it the first time he saw it in Risier City two years ago, but he didn’t have the ability then, now…
Under the watchful eyes of millions, Lide once again extended his hand and clenched it slightly.
Myth reborn.
The ten-blade-high Beast Bimong was thus frozen in place, no matter how it struggled and roared, utterly incapable of moving.
How can the power of a whole world be taken lightly?!
After binding the beast, a sharp cold gleamed in Lide’s eyes.
He slightly raised his hand, and the ten-blade-high Bimong was lifted into the sky.
The sight of a beast as tall as a three-story building suspended mid-air was spectacular, Bimong roared and struggled in the sky, but couldn’t make the slightest impact.
Then, Lide clenched his fist.
Crack~
A crisp sound of bone shattering echoed, and the ten-blade-high giant beast’s skeleton completely shattered, its majestic presence one moment instantly reduced to mush, its roars turning to pained whimpers.
A one-hit kill.
Seeing its condition, Lide was expressionless, casually tossing it before the Centaur Army.
His tone was indifferent and detached.
“From now on, this Bimong can be used to pull carts…”
These words echoed within a hundred kilometers of Risier City.
Millions of people, after hearing this, were awestruck, a deep admiration and reverence rising from within.
The players were so envious their eyes turned red.
The ultimate combat power of the Beastmen–Bimong, just to pull carts??
Is this what a Divine is? Too freaking domineering, right??
Looking at Lide again, it seemed his brilliance was blinding at that moment.
Lord Ilo, from this day forth, was destined to become a mythic tale, echoing through the main plane of Glory in the songs of wandering minstrels.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - Chapter 383: Chapter 385: Forcibly Seizing the Evil God's Head, A Storm is Coming (9600 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 383: Chapter 385: Forcibly Seizing the Evil God’s Head, A Storm is Coming (9600 words)
It must be said that Lide’s strategy of using a human body to snatch the treasures of Risier City was very effective.
Although the identity of Lord Ilo in the underworld of Green City was well known, people are always like this, they only believe what they want to believe.
At this moment, Lide, emanating holy light, was filled with a commanding presence that forced people to submit.
If someone loudly pointed out, “This is a vampire,” outsiders who heard it would just scoff.
Have you ever seen a vampire who could wield the power of Holy Light?
Such a statement would shut the opponent up instantly. As a purely dark life form, how could a vampire possibly use the power of Holy Light?? Even the most naive child wouldn’t utter such words.
If today’s act was carried out in the guise of a vampire, the effect would undoubtedly be different.
“Duke O’Kelly, it is said that the identity of Lord Ilo is that of a wicked vampire… Your opinion?”
The bishop hurriedly interjected, addressing the increasingly fanatic Duke O’Kelly.
Most high-ranking nobles in Green City knew about the vampire, and logically, with so many sects of the Light Attribute present, shouldn’t someone have exterminated the vampire by now?
But the world is never simply black or white. The western district, although a haven of sin, is also intertwined with the interests of each sect.
If there is no darkness, what is the purpose of light?
Without the evil of the western district, how would these foolish commoners ever appreciate the value of worshipping the divine?
Thus, the existence of the western district seemed unthinkable, yet so bizarrely justified.
Moreover, the legendary Lord Ilo is above the transcendental… no one in their right mind would want to provoke a dark life, not guilty of any grave sin, and unmatched in power.
Therefore, the higher-ups of Green City have always turned a blind eye to the evil in the western district…
“A vampire?” Duke O’Kelly frowned, “Do you think a magnificent being capable of wielding Holy Light Power could be a vampire?”
“But this is something witnessed by countless people, and the intelligence reports that the individual even guided the heart-eating demon Wales to transcend…”
“No buts, I’ve never heard of a vampire that isn’t corrupted by the Holy Light Power, let alone able to control it.”
Duke O’Kelly spoke gravely to the bishop, “Maybe you don’t understand, but legend has it that some beings of immense power incarnate as mortals to seek breakthroughs and to experience life anew…
The great Life Goddess once walked the earth as a mortal, enduring disease and pain, experiencing the joys and sorrows of life.
Could not such a powerful existence as Lord Ilo incarnate as a vampire?
For a powerful divine being, disguising as a dark life is not difficult at all–learning a few spells of dark magic would suffice, but a vampire controlling the Holy Light is impossible!”
…
The bishop was at a loss for words, unable to refute. The myth that the Life Goddess once incarnated as a human on the Main Plane and experienced the full spectrum of human life was well known and highly respected by all beings. How could he deny it?
“Bishop, it’s our fortune that such a person appears in Green City…”
Seeing that the bishop did not argue, a glint appeared in Duke O’Kelly’s eyes.
“If we can receive the protection of Lord Ilo, then even if we cannot gain the power of the Evil God, it would be enough to ensure the survival of Green City in the face of the looming horrific disaster!”
In Duke O’Kelly’s eyes, Lide was like a savior, carrying the future of Green City.
It seemed absurd, but Duke O’Kelly’s emotions were not difficult to understand.
Knowing that great changes were imminent and even the southern province faced destruction, he had missed that last chance.
But in a time of despair, someone descended like a Heavenly God and saved everything, reigniting hope, the emotional turbulence was hard for others to comprehend.
The bishop opened his mouth but then closed it again, not knowing what to say, as the situation was now beyond their control.
At this time, Lide paid no mind to the small actions of others. After casually dispatching a level 19 Beast Bimong, his gaze swept over the crowd.
His eyes turned cold as he observed the army below battling the fierce Half-Ratman.
The Power of Faith was running low, leaving him little time. He wouldn’t have time to attend to the Centaurs when he could no longer control the Evil God.
His gaze quickly found Sam, the chief of the Iron Hoof Tribe, covered in blood-stained armor, and transmitted a message to him alone.
“The Evil God is about to descend, withdraw at maximum speed, and ignore everything else!”
Lide’s chilling words made Sam perceive the threat, and he immediately began ordering the troops below to retreat.
“Centaur Army, retreat at full speed!”
After extensive training, the centaurs had deeply ingrained the notion that military orders were iron laws; once an order was given, it had to be followed no matter how unusual.
The remaining 110,000 centaurs began to retreat under their leaders’ commands, and the Giant Army also started to pull back at the same time.
This army truly embodied absolute obedience.
The fierce half-ratmen gushing from the Divine Country still wanted to pursue the centaurs, these servants of the divine seemed almost endless, impossible to eradicate.
Lide frowned, a slight wave of his right hand unleashed a terrifying force like a mountain collapsing or a tsunami sweeping in.
Then, under everyone’s watchful eyes, within a hundred blades’ radius around the Black Altar, the fierce half-ratmen burst apart as if smashed by a huge hammer.
Pfft~
Limbs and fragments flew through the air, the scene resembling a devil conducting a massacre in Bloody Hell, chilling to the bone.
Lide’s gaze was indifferent and untroubled. Battle-hardened, he was long accustomed to death and blood; a stern ruler forged in fire and blood.
A towering monarch.
He called upon the power of the Divine Country to seal off this space, preventing the half-ratmen from escaping. Then, without further care, Lide turned to face Emi, placing his right hand back on Emi’s forehead.
The divine power he had just gathered from the Black Altar surged into him.
This Evil God was the greatest threat to Risier City; he couldn’t attend to anything else until this foe was dealt with.
Duke O’Kelly’s pupils constricted upon seeing the Centaur Army withdraw, his thoughts spinning wildly before he abruptly turned to look at a nearby human commander.
“Issue the order immediately! All troops, retreat from Risier City as fast as possible!”
“Ah? Your Grace, this…” The bishop was momentarily stunned and looked somewhat perplexed.
“Silence! Execute the order immediately!” Duke O’Kelly’s face was stern, not wasting words with the man.
The retreat of the centaurs, brought by Lide, hinted at an indescribable danger.
Was Lord Ilo’s withdrawal indicating that something significant was about to occur?
In Duke O’Kelly’s mind, Lide’s status had already reached an unparalleled height, influenced by every little ripple.
It must be said, this human army, long nurtured by Duke O’Kelly as his trusted force, displayed even more resolute obedience than the Centaur Army.
Once the order was given, they immediately disengaged from the scattered fierce half-ratmen and feverishly fell back in a rapid retreat.
More frantic than a flight for their lives.
The Dwarf Clan Leaders, noticing the humans’ movements, hesitated and exchanged looks in silence.
“Chief Rabiao, should we retreat as well?”
Indeed, since that dominant figure effortlessly crushed three transcendents on the Black Altar, they knew this no longer concerned the dwarfs.
No one could rival that lord’s might; with even transcendent beings crushed, how could they withstand his power?
Yet, their reluctance made it hard to decide; after all, the Forging Hammer was at stake, tied to the fate of the entire dwarf race.
“Let’s retreat, Chief Nalis. Regardless of who obtains the Forging Hammer, this time we can’t partake,” Rabiao Hammer said painfully before turning away.
With 80,000 in the Dwarf Army having dwindled to less than 50,000 after several brutal battles, the casualties were severe.
If they continued, these dwarfs risked perishing in this City of Death.
Chief Nalis Copper Hammer took a deep breath and then decisively said, “Retreat!”
The dwarfs, having more reasons than most to fight to the death, were simply powerless now; the disparity in strength between the allies and enemies was too great.
Once the dwarfs had retreated, the previously bustling central battlefield was left with only a few fierce half-ratmen and the still reluctant Beastman Army.
The Beastmen had invested too much, starting from the planning two and a half years ago, the involvement of hundreds of thousands of troops, to the death of a transcendent…
It could be said that Beastman Prince Shahrarm had bet all his resources on the divine relics.
But now, he faced an unacceptable outcome.
If he left now, upon returning to the Beastman Empire, he likely would face an irreparable situation.
“By then, it won’t just be a matter of ascending to the throne of the Beastman Empire but whether I can even retain my current status is questionable.”
“Among the beastmen, the strong are revered, a loser does not deserve to lead the beastmen of the barren wasteland.”
Silence was the main theme of the beastman army at this moment; the centaurs withdrew, and the beastman warriors, who were just in battle, dared not say a word and could only watch them leave.
“Your Highness…” At this point, a beastman governor approached Shahrarm, his armor shattered and his body covered in blood, his expression extremely somber, “We need to make a choice now…”
A choice?
Shahrarm watched the silhouette of the centaur army disappearing with the Beast Bimong, his expression extremely heavy.
He knew he had to make a choice, but now… what should he choose?
To stay or to leave?
This iron-blooded beastman prince, after a series of failures and setbacks, felt a bit lost.
He had been so sure and confident, but the events of today felt like slap after slap hard upon his face, leaving him unable to recover for a long time.
His spirit was gone.
Not long after various armies retreated, the thick clouds in the sky that looked like falling mountains suddenly flashed with thunder.
Boom, boom, boom~
The thunder exploded suddenly.
Thousands of silver dragons danced in the black clouds.
The previously vanished Eye of Chaos and Death reappeared in the sky with the lightning.
“Plague and death existed in the past, plague and death exist now, and plague and death will exist forever…”
The previously vanished blasphemous language echoed through the sky again, and the half-rat men, originally sealed by Lide with the power of Divine Country and unable to appear, began to surge out again.
It was like the shackles of some cage had been opened, and evil returned.
Moreover, this time, unlike before, the headless Divine Body that was sealed was now radiantly shining, beginning to emit an indescribable dark aura.
Then, rising straight up from the altar, it floated below the Eye of Chaos and Death.
Then.
Crackle~
Thousands of thunderbolts, like wildly dancing twisted silver spears, all struck down on the Divine Body.
The scene resembled an apocalypse in a mural, chilling to the core.
Crack~
The ancient runes inscribed on the Divine Body burst like glass at that moment.
Then, blue crystals scattered across the sky, creating, against the black clouds and lightning, an indescribable beauty.
Yet amid this mesmerizing scene, a great terror seemed to descend.
As the seal began to break, an infinite black fog surged like a vortex directly into the headless Divine Body.
Even more terrifying, from the black altar below, a power so intense surged upward, forming a huge gray energy pillar, which was also absorbed by the Divine Body.
“What is this??”
Millions of people around Risier City who witnessed this epic scene suddenly widened their eyes, overwhelmed by the sudden turn of events.
And a few armies that had already retreated a distance began frantically running backwards, too terrified.
Lide, feeling the God of Plague’s departure from Emi’s body, suddenly withdrew his hand.
His expression turned extremely somber.
He had planned to use the power of the God of Plague to seal the other within Emi’s body when this Ancient Evil God decisively abandoned Emi’s body, sacrificing its own soul energy, carrying the headless Divine Body soaring into the sky.
This action was a massive drain of soul power, a significant loss even for a divine being.
“Emi, quick, this evil god is desperately risking everything now, take out that head, and let’s leave here immediately!”
Hearing this urgent speech, Emi, who had just gained control of his body, also turned extremely solemn. Without any hesitation, as the Black Altar erupted with terrifying energy, he suddenly began inscribing inscriptions with both hands.
Moments later, Lide could sense that the power from the Divine Plane was being summoned.
In just a few blinks, the ugly grey head of a rat appeared in Emi’s hands, sealed densely with mysterious inscriptions and topped with a long horn, exuding an indescribable terror.
Lide reached out to take it and tried to put it into the system space without success. Without a half moment’s hesitation, he turned and ran out with Emi.
At this time, the energy erupting from the altar intensified, a towering grey column of energy connecting to the headless divine body.
Looking up from the ground, it appeared like a massive fountain bursting upward, the column’s diameter reaching a staggering five blades.
Even a transcendent entering this column of energy would be filled with horrific energy in a few breaths, possibly even bursting apart.
This was the divine power of the Ancient Evil God sealed within the altar, which, although it had lost much of its power over countless ages.
But, a god is always a god, no longer the sort of existence that the beings of the mortal world can imagine. This is an existence rejected even by the will of the Main Plane, unimaginable until one reaches that level.
When the God of Plague entered the divine body at all costs, darkness began to spread, and terror began to arrive.
At this point, the reflection in the sky completely shattered, and the last sight of millions around remained on that soaring energy pillar.
Although people slightly closer to Risier City could still faintly see the scenery above Risier City, they could no longer see inside the city.
But whether natives or the Beastman Army reluctant to leave, all felt a heartfelt shock from the energy pillar in the sky.
“New Sun God, your sins cannot be washed away even with divine power!
I will use the ancient fire of destruction to scorch your soul for a million years!!!”
The blasphemous language echoed throughout Risier City.
At that moment, the Eye of Death also abruptly turned toward Lide’s location.
Lide, currently holding the sealed head, turned around and left the area enveloped by the Divine Country.
Hearing this terrifying sound, he instinctively looked up to see that horrifying scene in the sky.
Under the infinite energy impact, the seals on that divine body had all burst open, and as the seals shattered, the suppressed divine body began to slowly revive.
With the resurrection of ancient evil, great terror descended upon the world.
The aura spreading around felt like the abyss had appeared on the Main Plane, as beings of extreme evil born from mud and flesh roared towards the heavens.
This sinful aura would make even the bishop priests of the Light Attribute Divine feel their souls tremble and their legs weaken.
This was not a being of this world, this was an existence beyond worldly understanding.
Rumble~
Accompanied by the unsealing of the body, a sound of chains echoed in the world, as if some ancient and enduring rules were reviving.
Lide could even clearly sense that the rules of this world were repelling the divine body, as if the latter had violated some taboo.
“Indeed, divine beings cannot be tolerated by the Main Plane, as soon as it regains its strength, it will definitely be expelled from the Main Plane…”
Although his mind was racing, Lide’s movements never stopped.
After obtaining the head, the main objective of this trip was already achieved. The only task remaining was to ensure that the Evil God’s head remained under his control.
“Emi, stay close!”
After using High-level Floating Skill and Instant Teleportation to escape from the area enveloped by the altar, Lide waved his hand, and Castro, which had been secretly shrunk and hidden inside his clothes, suddenly swelled against the wind, a steel giant clad in Extraordinary Armor appeared.
Its Blade Wings filled with a chilling light.
Without any hesitation, Lide and Emi immediately mounted it.
Then, Four Circle Magic — High-level Floating Skill was directly applied on Castro.
“Castro, leave this place at the highest speed!!”
After his words fell, he channeled all the remaining divine power inside his body into Castro.
In that instant, Castro, a newly born sovereign, felt as if it had drunk dragon blood, sensing its power soar to the extreme.
“Hold tight!”
This was the first time Castro dared to say such a thing.
The moment the words fell, before Lide could react, a terrifying whizzing sound erupted.
The scenery beside him transformed into a streak of flowing light.
Castro’s body exploded with three consecutive bursts, his speed reaching a degree where the naked eye could no longer trace his presence.
It was truly horrifying.
Lide, steady as an old dog, barely managed to save Emi from being thrown off balance by quickly casting a Shield spell.
Now augmented with Four Circle Magic High-level Floating Skill and Divine Power, Castro’s flying speed, Lide estimated, was two to three times the speed of sound.
That is about 1000 blades per second, with 1000 blades being two kilometers… Within a few seconds, Castro had vanished from the skies above Risier City.
This sudden change left the Beastman Army, still without a decision, utterly astonished.
The Beastman Prince, Shahram, watched the disappearing figure of Lide and then glimpsed the bursting Divine Body Seal in the sky, cursing Lide ten thousand times in his heart!
Then he turned and let out a heart-wrenching scream.
“Retreat, all forces!!!”
At this moment, Shahram’s blood ran cold. He had initially hoped to watch and possibly seize an opportunity at the last moment for a turnaround, but with Lide’s departure, he knew this round was doomed to a catastrophic loss.
Now, Shahram regretted it immensely, questioning why he had bothered attacking Risier City in the first place…
But there was no antidote for regret; he could only swallow this bitter pill alone.
Just a few breaths after Lide left Risier City.
Boom~
A colossal roar that tore through heaven and earth erupted from the sky.
At the center of the black cyclone, the key point of energy surging at the Black Altar–the headless Divine Body–finally shattered all its seals.
Crack~
A transparent wave of energy blasted from the sky with ferocious speed, sweeping violently in all directions.
Then, a breathtaking scene unfolded, the entire Risier City flattened as if by a giant hand.
Tall buildings collapsed under the pressure, and the legions inside the city exploded and perished. The scene looked as exaggeratedly horrific as the apocalyptic paintings in churches.
The Centaur Army, fortunately, had withdrawn early, suffering only thousands of casualties, with the rest escaping unscathed from Risier City.
But the Human Army and the Dwarves were completely caught off guard, suffering losses of over one-third in the end.
When the Human Army finally fled Risier City, only about 40,000 remained from an original 200,000–a loss of 80%; this was not just a heavy loss but a decapitation.
The Dwarf Army, from 80,000, was reduced to 30,000, the losses equally dire.
The most tragic, however, were the Beastmen. Of the elite 400,000 stationed in Risier City, less than 1000 survived, a direct loss of 99.8%, marking the greatest tragedy of this event.
Fortunately, the Beastman Prince survived, thanks to his Extraordinary Equipment… though, that might be considered unfortunate.
With such devastating losses, one dared not even think what they would face upon returning to the barren wastelands…
Meanwhile, as the Centaur Army’s Iron Hoof trampled their camp, the Divine Monster Asreaga forcibly shattered their spatial gateway, cutting off their source of troops.
Resulting in their complete annihilation at the end of the war, not one survived.
The thirty Bone Dragons also perished without a survivor.
Although the losses were staggering, given the characteristic nature of the Undead race, it seemed not entirely unacceptable.
One could say that in this battle of the five armies in Risier City, all four parties paid a grave price, with only Lide reaping the benefits alone.
The Beastmen, most wretched among them, would certainly be recorded in the annals of Glory’s ill-fated, very likely topping the list.
—
—
—
—
As the seal on the Divine Body was broken, everything changed,
The ancient rules of the sky began to slowly awaken.
The Main Plane of Glory does not tolerate Divines, such is the will of the Main Plane, no god, no matter how powerful, can contest it.
The Main Plane is vast and boundless, capable of accommodating billions of lives to thrive, the contained power is terrifying, even the Life Goddess at such level could not probe into it.
Once the ancient rules of the Main Plane were triggered, the pressure felt was beyond description with mere words.
The consciousness of the God of Plague finally found a dwelling after entering the body, although the arms and legs remained sealed, and the head was also taken away.
But that dispersing consciousness was no longer without a carrier.
His power was reviving.
“New Sun God!”
A voice, like tens of thousands of humans screaming together, instantly echoed above Risier City.
The surrounding crowd, not having time to react, immediately plunged into fear.
An irresistible aura permeated the air, as if a giant dragon had opened its eyes, staring at them, and everyone felt the extremely evil aura lingering from ancient times…
The demons were howling!
Seated behind Castro and speeding through the air, Lide felt a chilling sensation.
Though mere seconds had allowed them to fly tens of kilometers, the impending danger still pressed against his throat like a sword drawn from its sheath, seemingly ready to devour his soul at any moment.
Every cell in his body was alerting him.
However, even faced with such a terrifying aura, Lide’s expression remained calm with no sign of panic.
Unmovable as a Mountain.
“Castro, increase the speed… as long as we fly beyond a hundred miles, this Evil God can’t do anything to us.”
Lide, who still possessed a part of the Evil God’s power, had a cold gaze, sensing the enormous power enclosed within Risier City as the seal for the God of Plague.
For the God of Plague to regain strength, it must devour that lingering power; if the newly unsealed power were to disperse directly, the loss would be unbearable for the Evil God.
Though the enemy’s power recovery was brief, it was enough for them to gain some distance.
Once the God of Plague regained its power, the world would certainly not accommodate a divine entity.
So, Lide, who appeared to be dancing on the blade’s edge, had accurately calculated each step. The risk involved was unimaginable because any slight error could lead to total failure, but if successful, the rewards could drive one mad.
A complete Evil God’s head was held in his hand.
Its value was worth far more than billions in gold; it was a treasure beyond worldly wealth.
Moreover, the Evil God’s head might well be his key to breaking through to transcendence.
This was the crucial point; for this, even if the risk were ten times greater, it must be attempted.
Strength is the only eternal constant.
No external object is as vital as one’s own strength.
As the Ancestor of the Bloodline, one of the Upper Races, once he became transcendent, even Lide could not predict how powerful he would become.
And when he achieved transcendence, Dawn City would burst forth with true brilliant radiance.
Now, the resistance hindering the development of Dawn City would no longer be a problem.
But just as Castro was speeding away, Lide suddenly felt something was amiss, because the terrifying aura that had made his hair stand on end had vanished.
Abruptly turning his head, he witnessed a scene he would never forget.
Red, the red of fresh blood.
A blood-red cloak covered the sky over Risier City.
No one could describe the vastness and toughness of that cloak, nor did anyone know why such a bizarre and strong cloak had appeared so suddenly.
But the blood-red cloak appeared.
Even the terrifying aura emitted by the Ancient Evil God was covered by the red cloak.
The Eye of Chaos and Death that stared at Lide was also blocked by the Blood Cloak.
The cloak, which covered the sky above Risier City, glowed faintly with the light of fresh blood and became the most dazzling existence under the thick dark clouds.
At that moment, the cloak was the sole protagonist between heaven and earth.
The crowd around Risier City, who had not yet left, was suddenly stunned by this scene, a spectacle unheard of even in epic myths, leaving everyone wide-eyed and dumbfounded.
What is this??! Why would there be such a gigantic cloak in this world??
No one answered their questions, but the moment Lide saw that familiar shade of blood red, his pupils sharply constricted.
The image of that proud girl, who always held her head high and even in the face of death never bowed, appeared in his mind.
That Blood Cloak, made from dragon skin, seemed to still vividly linger before his eyes.
Andabella… That girl, proud to the core, was the lord of Risier City, the leader of the Risier family, and a descendant of the former Risier Royal Family, her body coursing with noble and ancient royal blood.
Most crucially, she still owed him a piece of Legendary Equipment…
“The Ancient Evil God, my ancestors suppressed you for countless ages, though the flow of time has dissolved those ancient vows, and the creations of the Holy Light have gathered dust.
But Risier City belongs to the Risier family, and to the former Risier Royal Family.
I, shall inherit the Glory of my ancestors!”
A resounding, firm voice echoed across the sky.
Even merely hearing that crisp voice could one feel the deeply ingrained pride exuding from its speaker’s bones–a pride that penetrated the soul.
The crowd around Risier City felt a thrill in their hearts upon hearing these words, inexplicably feeling inspired by the commanding aura of the statement.
Some people are born leaders–Lide was such a person, and that incredibly proud voice undoubtedly possessed a charm that could inspire others to follow into battle.
“The Risier Bloodline??!!
How is it possible that such an ancient bloodline still exists in this world?!!”
The voice of the God of Plague, still not fully restored to power in the sky, spoke coldly again; however, this time there was a hint of frantic annoyance, lacking the excitement felt when power was initially gained.
“Ancient Evil God, the Risier Bloodline shall endure!
Evil will ultimately be purified!
In the name of the Risier Royal Family, I draw my sword against you!”
But beneath the sky-covering Blood Cloak, that lofty voice didn’t bother with any superfluities and directly declared war.
Declaring war against the Divine!
Then, under the shock-filled gaze of all.
The Blood Cloak covering the sky began to radiate brilliant light, with pale white energy tinged with shades of crimson.
The originally oppressive dark sky seemed punctured by a great hole, with thick clouds dispersing directly; above the sky, a blinding sunlight beamed through the hole in the clouds.
It very much resembled the descent of a Divine being.
Under the vast clouds, the sunlight scattered through the black hole spread above the land, bringing a sense of hope and light.
Under the illumination of the sun, the crimson cloak burst forth with an even more dazzling radiance.
In the sky, the blasphemous language swirling about halted abruptly under the cloak’s awe, the freshly revived evil on the Main Plane seemed like it was struck by a giant hammer and began to collapse and disperse.
Sensing the urgency of the situation, the God of Plague no longer concealed his power.
In the sky, the Eye of Chaos and Death under his manipulation suddenly formed a huge vortex, and at the center of the vortex, a terrifying Space Gate appeared.
Indistinctly, one could glimpse through the Space Gate to the scene beyond–an expanse of void and the Land of Death, flies buzzing around carcasses, bloated pale corpses strewn across the ground, magma flowing robustly, and traces of sulfur scorched by flames everywhere…
The Abyss.
It was the most Extreme Evil existence in the world.
The Ancient Evil God directly opened the Abyss Gate.
Then, under the gaze of all, the headless body with an arm and two legs, along with five Divine Artifacts, disappeared into the Eye of Chaos and Death.
In the sky, only an eternal blasphemous language resonated…
“Plague and death were once present, plague and death are present now, and plague and death will also be eternal.”
“I am eternal, I am the past, I existed in the past, and I also exist this evening, I am the ruler of plague and death, I am the spreader of disease and destruction.
I am eternal, I am also the only one, I shall not die, I shall live forever, and I shall also be reborn…”
“Descendant of Risle, I am already aware of your soul’s aura tied to the New Sun God…
When fate is shattered, I shall descend once again…”
“I shall descend again…”
“I shall again…”
“…”
Endless echoes rose within this world, their content filled with spine-chilling messages.
He will descend again??
Those nightmarish words startled everyone, and they faintly felt a crisis from the future…
It seemed this was not an ending, but a new beginning, an unprecedented start filled with evil, darkness, terror, slaughter, and blood…
After the God of Plague departed the Main Plane, the black clouds in the sky began to disperse quickly as if losing their supporting strength, and the sun above the clouds pierced through like thousands of sharp swords penetrating a thick shield.
Dawn was coming.
An instant aura of hope filled the earth.
This should have been a happy scene, but those who had just witnessed the event felt as if something was clutching their necks; no cheers could be emitted.
“I shall descend again…”
That phrase, like a terrifying magic curse, lingered in everyone’s minds.
They wanted to dismiss it as a joke, but they found themselves unable to speak.
Because that presence was too terrifying.
