then evil and dark auras spread out from the crystal ball, flooding into his body like the raging torrents of a river.
Like a level twelve hurricane whipping up towering waves.
But after countless Divine Calamities shattering and rebuilding him, Lide’s body was now so resilient it was beyond simple description.
Furthermore, being in the Land of Bone-Burying with billions of the Power of Death as his backing, this backlash was insignificant.
The power surged tenfold in strength and dominantly suppressed the energy, and after all was stable, his spiritual power slowly spread into the crystal ball.
Suddenly, he felt the tightly closed Eye of Chaos and Death.
Instead of recklessly exploring that immensely evil power, he spread his spiritual power like a spider’s web, moving around the periphery of the crystal ball.
After a short while, he found a mark enveloped in surging grey Divine aura.
The aura of the God of Plague.
This crystal ball had been marked by the God of Plague’s soul imprint. To control this Divine Artifact, one must erase the traces of the other and leave his own behind.
However, the only problem was that erasing a soul imprint in the throes of Divine power was not so straightforward–it required either tremendous strength or delicate operation.
Lide’s eyebrows slightly furrowed, unwilling to delay, he directly mobilized the Power of Death and sent it surging toward the crystal ball.
With over three billion of the Power of Death, he had the privilege to be willful.
Within a few breaths, the dense Power of Death in the Land of Bone-Burying surged from the gray clouds in the sky, becoming so concentrated that it coalesced above the Land of Bone-Burying.
Then, under Lide’s control, it directly invaded the Crystal Ball.
The uncontrolled Crystal Ball, although it triggered some of its power to defend itself, was still suppressed by his unreasonable Power of Death.
Ten minutes later, a sound of unwillingness and sharpness came from inside the Crystal Ball, and then with a clink, light-grey Energy Crystals fell from inside the Crystal Ball like shattered glass.
The Crystal Ball that had just emitted a fearsome aura immediately retracted its presence.
Lide nodded slightly, the God of Plague’s Spirit Imprint had been crushed by the overwhelming Power of Death.
Without hesitation, he directly imprinted his own soul mark upon it.
In just a few breaths, supported by the raging Power of Death, Lide successfully claimed the Divine Artifact for himself.
The moment the soul mark was engraved, Lide clearly felt a connection established with the Divine Artifact. The Crystal Ball that had resisted him now became exceedingly docile, allowing his power to explore and enter.
However, what made him frown was that at the very center of the Crystal Ball, the chaos and Eye of Death still emitted a dangerous presence that he could not affect no matter how he tried.
After thinking it over, Lide decided not to delve deeper for the moment and shifted his gaze.
After seizing the Divine Artifact, the divinity of the God of Plague, which Lide had deliberately ignored, was fully exposed to him like a young girl slipping off her bathrobe.
Feeling the terrifying power of that divinity, Lide turned his head and looked over at Emi, his eyes subtly shifting.
Then, with a single step, he appeared right in front of Emi.
“Emi, prepare to accept the divinity of the God of Plague. This power can help you achieve transcendence…”
Ah?
Even with Emi’s composed demeanor, he couldn’t help but shudder upon hearing these words, his eyes brimming with an incredulous delight.
“Your Highness…”
Lide gave a slight smile.
“I have already absorbed enough divinity. Though the divinity inside the artifact can still benefit me, it won’t significantly increase my power any further, and continuing to consume it would be of little effect.
You’re different, your body has been transformed by the God of Plague, and during our time in Risier City, you even withstood the descent of that Evil God.
Only in you can these divine traits be perfectly utilized.”
“Your Highness, but…”
Seeing Emi about to speak, Lide waved his hand to cut off his ramble.
“No need for more words, I’m not discussing this with you. You only need to obey the command.
Moreover, achieving transcendence means taking on more responsibility. Dawn City doesn’t need deadweight.”
Lide’s firmness immediately made Emi close his mouth.
“Yes, Your Highness.”
Lide hesitated no longer and waved his hand, and the Crystal Ball harboring chaos and the Eye of Death slowly floated in front of him.
The Crystal Ball, slightly larger than a fist, was not transparent and carried a degree of dimness; the chaos and Eye of Death at its core were fraught with an evil presence.
With one thought, the divinity inside the Crystal Ball began to slowly transfer out.
But at that moment, the imprisoned chaos and Eye of Death within the Crystal Ball opened slightly. In that instant, it seemed as though the world dimmed.
The surrounding evil aura swiftly gathered strength, wildly intensifying.
An indescribable terror pervaded the hearts of every warrior, as if a stone weighing millions of tons pressed on their chests, a feeling even more terrifying than facing an Ancient Giant Dragon directly.
Lide’s brows furrowed, as he felt this crystal ball seemed even more extraordinary than he had imagined. What exactly was the existence within this eye?
But he didn’t rush to delve deeper, continuing instead to manipulate the divine substance.
With each breath, a wind suddenly whipped up around them, and the divine substance within the crystal ball slowly diffused out like mist, then surged into Emi’s body under Lide’s control.
Emi, at this moment, was like a sponge, absorbing the divine power.
Below, the watchful 18th-level Beastman King Kapp’s pupils shrank sharply at the sight.
Even though separated by a thousand blades’ distance, he could vividly sense the terrifying energy contained within the grey mist that emanated from the crystal ball.
Several top-tier warriors nearby, whose eyes were also sharp, showed looks of envy. Everyone knew that this time, Emi had truly struck it lucky.
And indeed, as anticipated, after the grey mist surged into Emi’s body, his aura began to climb steadily.
At the end, his presence was as towering and oppressive as tall mountains, inspiring terror and awe.
In the entire Land of Bone-Burying, only Lide’s strength surpassed his; all others, even the 19th-level Withered Bones, could only be suppressed by him.
Moreover, Emi’s aura continued to surge violently, becoming more and more domineering, even seeming to distort light and space at this moment.
Several minutes later, when all of the divine substance in the crystal ball had been absorbed by Emi, Lide immediately withdrew his hand.
Looking at Emi in front of him, who seemed like a volcano about to erupt, he gestured with his hand.
“Go find a quiet place for meditation. The place where I stayed before wasn’t bad; I will have someone continue to guard you.”
“Yes… Your Highness…”
Emi’s face, now bearing a pain he could not hide, quickly turned around to descend after responding.
The turbulent and violent power within him was nearly splitting him apart; he had to straighten out that power as soon as possible, or else he might explode even having previously endured the power of the God of Plague.
After Emi entered the underground area where he had just meditated, Lide felt quite pleased.
Before long, Dawn City would see the rise of a second Transcendent.
Truly, the rich leading the way for the rest…
Coming back to his senses, he turned his gaze to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Even now, the Land of Bone-Burying still resembled the aftermath of a great battle.
Injured warriors were receiving treatment from the Bloodline, with Blood Mages who could draw energy from blood directly taking on the role of priests, and blood was in endless supply around them–so long as one still breathed, they could be brought back from the brink.
Of course, the real Dawn Priests had also joined in the effort to help.
The defensive wall, standing eighty blades high, was covered in dense claw marks. Having withstood continuous assaults for several months without collapse was in itself an impressive feat.
Inside the area enclosed by the walls, shattered bodies of Fierce Half-Ratmen littered the ground like trash, the entire view devoid of the white bone floor, everything covered in blood and limbs.
Broken war blades, snapped longswords, fractured shields…
Coupled with the charred flags and the foul-smelling air.
Everything spoke volumes of the scale of the battle that had recently taken place here.
The scene was pervaded by an indescribable fierceness.
Upon seeing this hellish landscape, Lide’s expression changed little.
His gaze swept once over the warriors below, still looking up at him expectantly.
He felt a stirring in his heart.
Perhaps, after months of fierce battles, Dawn City needed a proper conclusion.
After pondering for a short moment, his ringing voice echoed across the Land of Bone-Burying.
“My people, the warriors of Dawn City.”
The warriors below immediately lifted their heads, their ears perked, eyes gleaming as they looked towards Lide who was floating midair.
“This five-month bloodshed has been a calamity for Dawn City.
Yet only through fire can steel be forged.
Your courage,
Your perseverance,
Your fearlessness,
Your noble qualities fill me with pride.
You are my subordinates, the children of Dawn, and guardians worthy of respect and admiration from all residents!
It is because of your bravery and valor that Dawn has remained unscathed, our families and our land safeguarded.”
Lide’s gaze was intense, his tone sinking a few notches.
“But during this ordeal, countless companions have left us.
Those warriors who shed their blood will not be forgotten by me, nor by the citizens of Dawn City!
Their names will be engraved on the Monument of Dawn Heroes; their heroic deeds will be recorded in the annals of Dawn City’s history; their families will be cared for by Dawn City.
And all of you will receive the rewards I bestow!”
As he spoke these words, his voice suddenly surged, then with a profoundly stirring tone, he firmly declared.
“Now, in the name of the Lord of Dawn, I proclaim.
The war of the Ancient Evil Gods’ invasion into Dawn City is officially over.
We have triumphed!”
The last sentence left all the warriors below stunned.
After a moment, someone began to shout, and a tumultuous roar of noise and joyful cries erupted throughout the Land of Bone-Burying.
We’ve won, we’ve won!!!
This nearly five-month-long war had finally ended.
During these months, the Sun Eye did not rest, from rise to set, from dusk to dawn, the entire Dawn City enveloped in gunfire and the sounds of battle.
Warfare was the sole recurring theme in Dawn City over these five months.
Even the most steadfast warriors, in the face of such relentless battling, could feel the weariness deep within.
It is in times of chaos that one longs for peace.
Now from their ruler’s mouth, the one for whose glory they had guarded with their lives and souls, came the words: they had won.
This overwhelming surprise even brought tears to the eyes of the stalwart warriors.
Yes, we’ve won!!
“Hahaha!! Long live Dawn City!!!”
“I knew it!! No one can withstand the power of Dawn City!! We have won!!”
“That bitch-born Evil God!! Even if you crawl out from the abyss, you will still become a ghost under my sword!”
“Long live!”
“Praise Dawn City, praise the Kachar City Lord!”
“Long live His Excellency Kachar!!”
The noise of celebration nearly brought down the city walls, and the cheering became a high-pitched victory anthem over the Land of Bone-Burying, this bloody battlefield.
Many people were jubilantly tossed high by the crowd, and even many warriors who were strangers embraced each other tightly.
Eventually, the fervent sounds of celebration spread out from the Land of Bone-Burying, and numerous support staff outside began to run madly through the city, shouting at the top of their lungs.
“His Excellency and our army have crushed the invasion of the Evil God!! We have won!!”
We have won.
Under the predawn sky, the mercury-like moonlight made the city gleam brilliantly.
And those believers who were praying softly burst into indescribable excitement when they heard the shouts from the streets.
“Praise His Excellency Kachar!!”
“Praise the dawn!!”
“By the Goddess above, we have triumphed!!”
Tears streamed down the faces of many believers at this moment, neighbors hugged in their pajamas, couples kissed each other, and families embraced one another tightly.
The entire city erupted into commotion, waves of cheering broke out one after another, making the mountains on both sides of Dawn City seem to tremble with the sound.
But after a moment, everyone felt that this subdued way of celebrating couldn’t satisfy their excitement, one by one, the residents, in their pajamas, didn’t care anymore and started to take to the streets, and under the moonlight, began to celebrate wildly.
This night, Dawn knew no sleep.
Everyone remembered this night of victory.
And after this battle, the spirit of Dawn City’s people soared to an alarming degree.
And Lide, the one who led them to victory, became the object of everyone’s feverish praise and worship.
From that point on, no one could shake Lide’s position, nor could anyone overturn his rule. On this land, he was worshiped in the most passionate way by everyone, he was the one and eternal king.
—
—
—
With the dawn breaking, although many people who had celebrated all night began to go back to catch up on sleep, there were still a large number of residents crazily celebrating on the streets.
In Moonlight Square, this massive square capable of accommodating hundreds of thousands of people had become a sea of joy, with residents playing their instruments on the side, and many young girls dancing to the music.
The City Hall had set up free food distribution points around the square, bread coated with honey, various fried snacks, large chunks of roasted meat…
The logistics department was busy making food for the entire city, and despite being weary, the smiles on their faces were beaming. Many residents even brought out their home-made delicious food for everyone to enjoy.
Dwarves, Beastmen, Bloodline, goblins, Half-Elves, even One-eyed Giants and Double-headed Ogres all joined in the revelry.
The entire scene was filled with a harmony and concord that outsiders couldn’t comprehend.
But the revelry outside didn’t belong to Lide, who hadn’t left the Land of Bone-Burying at that time.
As the celebration began, all the warriors had evacuated the defensive walls.
And Lide had placed all the crossbows and movable equipment on Dawn Square.
At this moment, the desolate Land of Bone-Burying was left with only him.
The only difference from before was that now the Power of Death in the Land of Bone-Burying was at its absolute peak.
The most eye-catching part was the circular area with a radius of five hundred blades within the defense walls; it had all become the Land of Corruption.
After several months and millions of fierce Half-Ratmen consumed by the Land of Bone-Burying, this Land of Corruption had reached Advanced Level, and the area around the core Space Gate with a hundred blades radius reached Perfect Level.
If used to nurture the Death Flower, it would easily bloom in large numbers.
The war was over, and while the crowd outside was celebrating, it was time for him to clear up the loot.
This piece of Land of Corruption was merely a small addition to this war–too much excitement for anyone to handle.
Lide sat alone atop the twelve-layer White Bone Altar, next to the floating Angel Wings. The gain was so substantial that he needed to audit them one by one.
The first was naturally his level.
He had leaped directly from Level 19 to Transcendent Level 23, far exceeding the plan he set before seclusion and laying a solid foundation for his upcoming hunting of the Black Dragon in the Sludge Swamp and the conquest of the Underworld.
Second was the over three billion Death Aura on his attribute panel, an utterly breathtaking gain, which unlocked the Frost Giant Dragon, activated the twelve-layer White Bone Altar, and even facilitated the transformation of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
The third was Emi’s level, which, barring any surprises, might mean that Dawn City would welcome its second Transcendent in a month or two, an irreplaceable factor in his strategic planning.
Fourth was the arc-wrapped Evil God’s Horn, where the origin power of the God of Plague was sealed. He had only consumed a minimal part of it, and this horn was also tied to the Divine Position of the God of Plague…
Finally, it was the Divine Artifact in his hand–the Crystal Ball.
After a brief tally, Lide felt this was more than just striking rich; it was more like a windfall that could cause a stroke.
“Save the best for last, let’s check the Divine Artifact first…”
Lide, in high spirits, took out the Crystal Ball, and after a slight sensing, frowned at the chaos and the Evil God’s Eye at the heart of the ball.
He had no time to attend to this strange eye before, but now the more he thought about it, the more he felt there was something extraordinary hidden, as if it concealed a remarkable secret.
Upon opening the attribute panel, the characteristics of the gray Crystal Ball appeared before his eyes.
Ancient Evil God’s Eye
Quality: Inheritance Artifact
Skill: Death Gaze (Manifests a chaotic Evil God’s Eye suspended in the sky, scrutinizing the land below. The owner of the artifact can survey any location observed by the chaotic and deadly eye. The farther or broader the observed area, the larger the Divine Power needed.
Enemies who gaze directly into the chaotic and deadly eye will undergo a Divine-level will check–if they fail, they’ll be inflicted with a negative status–a Fear debuff, reducing all attributes by 30%.)
Lord of Black Magic (Casting Dark Magic will receive an extra evil power boost, and the magic will be perfected automatically, reducing 70% of Magic Power consumption, while casting time for all non-Forbidden Curse spells is fixed within 5 seconds.)
Special Skill: Ancient Inheritance (This is the eye of an Ancient Evil God; it could be integrated into one’s own under certain conditions to gain all the power of the Evil God’s Eye. Note: This process will subject one to the erosion of ancient power.)
Explanation: An Ancient Evil God’s eye was condensed by strong Divine Power into a Divine Artifact which still maintains its vitality. Its true potential is far from realized and can only be fully harnessed by implanting it into a body.
Upon inspecting the Divine Artifact’s attributes, Lide’s brow immediately furrowed.
There was no denying that the artifact far surpassed his expectations–not because it was mighty, but rather because it turned out to be an Evil God’s eyeball.
Moreover, even more astonishing was that after such an extensive period, it had not lost its vitality and could still inherit the power of the Evil God’s eyeball.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - Chapter 392: Chapter 394: The Birth of the Frost Giant Dragon (11,000 words, asking for monthly votes)
chapters.content:
Chapter 392: Chapter 394: The Birth of the Frost Giant Dragon (11,000 words, asking for monthly votes)
Lide, holding the Ancient Evil God’s Eye, couldn’t help but fall into deep thought.
The quality of the item was not to be questioned, but the conditions alone were enough to make him frown.
To inherit it, he would need to withstand the erosion of ancient powers…
While that statement seemed simple, Lide knew better than anyone just how excruciating this seemingly easy erosion could be.
Moreover, that ancient power was not something that could be stopped by sheer willpower. If he didn’t have the Power of Faith to protect him, his soul would have been enslaved long ago.
That was the power of ancient days, the power of the divine.
With this in mind, the number of candidates who could obtain the divine artifact’s power immediately dwindled. He could endure it. Emi, after her breakthrough to transcendence, might also be able, and Asreaga, whose whereabouts were currently unknown, seemed possible as well, as he was a symbol of darkness and evil in this world–a Divine Monster.
Others, even Withered Bone, a Level 19 undead, would find it tough.
After some thought, Lide decided to put away the divine artifact for the time being. He would wait for Emi’s breakthrough to transcendence and Asreaga’s return before making a decision.
As for why he wasn’t inheriting the power of the Ancient Evil God’s Eye… Lide shook his head. He felt the chaos within the crystal ball and the Eye of Death were incompatible with him.
The artifact vehemently repelled his presence, and even after he had imprinted his soul mark upon it, he couldn’t activate it smoothly.
It’s better not to mess with such ancient evil items if there’s no compatibility, and Lide’s keen perception told him that this item was not suitable for him.
Although it seemed a shame to give it up, Lide didn’t care much.
An ugly and unsightly eye–what if integrating it ruined his appearance… If he ended up with the ghastly visage of the God of Plague, that would be bloody annoying. After all, good looks are justice.
And this possibility was far from small. The powers of the Ancient Evil God were too strange, and nobody understood what was going on.
Having determined its use, Lide didn’t take another look. It was a good object but incompatible with him.
With a thought, the Ancient Evil God’s Eye disappeared from its spot.
System Space couldn’t store items containing divinity, and this divine artifact was no exception. However, that didn’t prevent him from hiding it deep beneath the Land of Bone-Burying.
The entire plane was his storage space; he could place items however he wanted.
After securing the Ancient Evil God’s Eye, Lide turned his attention to the Evil God’s Horn wrapped in arcs of electricity in his hand.
The horn, containing the origin power of the God of Plague, held a power beyond what outsiders could imagine. Even the surrounding space was slowly warping under its might, giving an unreal sense of illusion to those who looked upon it.
Nobody would know that although Lide had seized the Divine Position of the God of Plague, this horn was the key to unlocking that position.
The Divine Position of Plague that he had taken was not assimilated by him but remained within the horn.
In other words, whoever held this horn would gain a fifth of the Divine Position of Plague. This horn was more like the key to the “Plague” Divine Position.
His initial goal of attacking Risier City was just the divinity within the head of the God of Plague, but he did not expect to find a treasure within the head that was no less significant than the divinity itself.
It was an unexpected joy.
“The ‘Plague’ Divine Position has never been anything benign in the myths and legends; its emergence often signifies germs, infectious diseases, death, and destruction.
The most important thing is that this Divine Position is not compatible with my own powers. Plague and disease are part of the Curse System, whereas blood and the Bloodline are a different path…”
Lide’s eyes flickered uncertainly.
“Divine Positions aren’t necessarily better the more you have. Too many can lead to confusion. The best state is one of mutual enhancement.
Blood and the Bloodline are the best examples… If I were to take on a Divine Position of death or slaughter, I could accept that, but plague…
There’s no strongest, only the most suitable…”
Lide was still cautious in the face of such a high-level temptation, not being lured by the surface appearance.
His thoughts were very clear–he knew what he needed. Stuffing oneself with all manner of good things might seem ideal, but it was more likely to weigh one down and slow progress.
“Though it’s not suitable for me, it’s definitely a top-tier treasure.
It’s even more useful than the Ancient Evil God’s Eye artifact, which has yet to show its full value.
This is power that can be seen and felt.”
Lide began to seriously consider everything related to the Divine Position of Plague.
“Also, there’s another important point, I believe the ‘Plague’ Divine Position has been underestimated. Plague shouldn’t just mean sheer slaughter and spreading infectious diseases…
If you think about it differently, what if there was a type of plague that doesn’t cause fatal harm to humans, but instead can grant a human the claws and physique of a wild beast, wouldn’t such a plague still be negative?
The essence of the Plague Divine Position is to use divine power to create germs that can transmit diseases. The myths I’ve collected mention that some plagues can turn people into powerful and insane bloodthirsty hunters who kill on sight…
But if we eliminate the lack of rationality, just enhancing strength, could it work?”
Lide’s thoughts whirled frenetically, his gaze as deep as the abyss.
It has to be said that this daring idea of his entirely contradicted common knowledge of glory; plague is plague, meant for killing and instilling fear. Who would think of using it to enhance strength?
“However, this is just a preliminary thought. Concrete conditions will require a great deal of experimentation to verify this idea…
If that’s the case, although I’m not suited for this Divine Position, Emi may well be.”
Thinking this, Lide suddenly smiled. He found that many aspects of the God of Plague suited Emi perfectly.
Because the target had received the baptism and transformation of the God of Plague’s Divine Power, Emi was able to use all of these things related to the Ancient Evil God.
He wasn’t even a good fit for Emi.
“This guy really is incredibly lucky, starting from his fall to become a Shadow Priest in the Knight God’s temple in Green City, he accidentally entered the Knight God’s Divine Country and didn’t die but instead glimpsed the Power of the Divine,
then was chased to near death by the bishops of the Knight Temple but at that time became a Bloodline and obtained eternal life,
not to mention getting trapped in Risier City, where far from meeting disaster under dire circumstances, he gained the Power of the Divine and even escaped unscathed.
Now, after escaping, he’s also well-suited to the power of the God of Plague, not only seizing the chance for a transcendent breakthrough but also compatible with the Divine Position…”
Lide couldn’t help but feel a mixture of laughter and tears when he thought about Emi, the blasphemer, and the series of encounters after he became a Bloodline.
Others struggle their whole lives and never get such things; this guy just lies down and wins, so lucky that Lide could only feel envious.
If not for this guy being his Bloodline, Lide would almost believe he was a chosen child, which was truly more genuine than the constructed Destiny Heroes like the half-centaur with the Gale Bloodline – Guiedo and Prince Risle.
Shaking his head without thinking too much about it, he opened the property panel of the horn in his hand.
Plague Horn
Quality: Divine-level
Unique Trait: Plague God Position (Contains the origin power of the God of Plague, and after obtaining this weapon, you can control a part of the Plague God Position)
Introduction: This is an incredibly rare and precious treasure, containing the origin power of the God of Plague, which can be absorbed to gain a part of the Plague God Position, but one must withstand the backlash of Ancient power.
The introduction was as simple as ever, the horn didn’t even come with skills.
But it was this simple introduction that was enough to drive everyone mad.
A Divine Position, something countless Legendary Strongmen dream of, is the ultimate Glory, surpassing all the boundaries of power.
Now, it was in Lide’s hands.
Whether he absorbed it or someone else did, it meant touching the power of a god.
“It’s a pity, if it were a Blood God Position, that would be a windfall…”
Lide shook his head with a tinge of regret.
Out of sight, out of mind, he waved his hand and placed the horn beneath the ground of the Land of Bone-Burying.
“This way, I have two Divine Artifacts that can enhance the power of the Bloodline…”
Compared to Divine Artifacts, these tools, Lide preferred to enhance the power of his subordinates.
Divine Artifacts, though strong, were objects after all; he couldn’t very well send an artifact to lead his troops, in the end, people had to do all of that.
And one’s own power was often the most fundamental core; despite the strength of Divine Artifacts, it required strong enough professionals to utilize them,
take the Eye of the Ancient Evil God for example, just the Magic Power consumed to activate it could make a Level 19 Great Mage pale.
Moreover, with the next few plans in mind, he needed stronger subordinates to execute them, like a king of a nation, the powerful forces in his hands were the capital for dominating the world.
Having put away the Plague Horn, Lide continued sorting through his next acquisition with a cheerful mood.
His eyes moved to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Opening the attribute panel.
Land of Bone-Burying (Undead Plane)
Level: Rare (next level Rare, upgrade requires 100,000 Death Power)
Death Power: 333253902
Traits: Capable of Growth, Undead Transformation
Special Troops: Frost Giant Dragon (not activated)
Special Building: Skeleton Altar (damaged), can speed up the transformation of Extraordinary Level Undead Life, Plane Level reaching Rare can unlock
Special Area: Land of Corruption (Basic, diameter 100 blades), Land of Corruption (Advanced, diameter 1000 blades) (formed after being irrigated by copious blood, possessing strong death attributes, can cultivate special Undead)
Plane Size: diameter 2000 blades
Anchored Coordinates–Dawn City (can open a Space Gate within 800 kilometers in diameter of Dawn City to enter the Land of Bone-Burying)
Introduction: …
Every time Lide saw the data on the Land of Bone-Burying, he couldn’t help wanting to laugh out loud.
Although he had just spent 10 million Death Power to clear the soul mark of the God of Plague from the Eye of the Ancient Evil God, he still had 330 million Death Power.
What’s called a tycoon, this is, what’s called a big spender, this is…
Lide, who had been accustomed to being poor, had a feeling of sudden wealth as if he’d won a billion from a fifty-cent lottery ticket.
Previously, he had to split even a little bit of Death Power in two to use it, but now… the question is, how do you spend a few billion in cash? Online waiting, quite urgent.
“Let’s upgrade first, let’s activate the function of recruiting a Frost Giant Dragon first, my Nine Dragons Chariot is finally about to make its debut…
“Although I can’t capture a giant dragon outside, what’s stopping me from just raising one?”
Lide chuckled heartily, deciding he would soon make good on a boast he had made previously to summon nine Frost Giant Dragons that would do nothing but gallivant all day, pulling his carriage around.
After indulging in his whimsical fancy, with just a thought from Lide, the system alert immediately chimed.
“Ding~ Would you like to spend 1 million Power of Death to raise the Level of Land of Bone-Burying?”
“Yes.”
The moment he confirmed, whoosh~ though there was no wind, waves arose as the Power of Death whirled from the sky like a vortex, frantically flowing into the Plane Stone buried deep beneath the ground.
At that instant, Lide’s mage robe began to flutter slightly, matching his strikingly handsome face, exuding an indescribable coolness.
Moments later, Lide sensed that the Plane Stone had devoured enough power and then began transforming the Power of Death into Plane Power.
With an abundance of Plane Power spreading rapidly around, the fringe regions of the Land of Bone-Burying started to expand outward due to the powerful influence of the Plane Power.
The scene looked like something out of a chapel fresco depicting creation myths.
The entire Plane was expanding; the spatial barriers at its edge were extending into the depthless void, with its area increasing rapidly.
This upgrade process lasted for three Sunshine Hours; by the end of it, Lide simply merged his soul directly into the Land of Bone-Burying, personally experiencing the sensation of a Plane level increase.
It was mysterious and also drew him even more tightly to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Boom~
As the power within the Plane Stone was exhausted, the whole Land of Bone-Burying shook, and only then did the expansion trend cease.
Lide glanced at the attribute panel, and sure enough, the Land of Bone-Burying had indeed been elevated from Rare to the Advanced level, and its range had soared from a diameter of 2,000 blades to 5,000 blades.
But he didn’t stop there; he chose to upgrade once more.
Now he had an ample supply of Power of Death at his disposal, and the Level of the Land of Bone-Burying was of utmost importance, so it needed to be prioritized.
Common, Rare, Advanced, Perfect, Extraordinary, Legendary, Mythical… This was the complete upgrade chain for a Plane.
Advancing from Advanced to Perfect required ten times the Power of Death, reaching 10 million.
Of course, to the current Lide, the large dog owner, this was no issue at all, and without much thought, he chose to upgrade yet again.
Crack~ Crack~
Once the Plane Stone had absorbed enough Power of Death, the whole world widened again.
Lide, having just experienced the euphoria of the Plane upgrade, continued to integrate into the Land of Bone-Burying. The growth of the Plane felt like his own body growing, and that sensation was incredibly satisfying, even more so than a 9999-valued Super Greatsword.
The second upgrade lasted for five Sunshine Hours, and when the soul’s sensation of basking in hot springs faded away, Lide came back to his senses.
The Land of Bone-Burying, now at Perfect Level, had its attributes impressively boosted.
Its diameter increased from 5,000 blades to 10,000 blades, which translates to 10 kilometers.
The defensive wall he had constructed before the upgrade, standing 80 blades high with a diameter of 1,000 blades, had occupied a large area of the entire Land of Bone-Burying, but after reaching the Perfect Level, this circle seemed rather insignificant.
Lide opened the attribute panel and glanced at the attributes of the Land of Bone-Burying; his mood, which was fairly good until then, suddenly grew tense.
He found that things had now changed.
Land of Bone-Burying (Undead Plane)
Level: Perfect (Next level Extraordinary, upgrade requires 100 million Power of Death)
Power of Death: 322253902
…
“Advancing from Rare to Advanced requires 1 million Power of Death,
And from Advanced to Perfect requires 10 million, now from Perfect to Extraordinary it’s 100 million…”
The more Lide thought, the weirder his expression became.
“So by that logic, from Extraordinary to Legendary would require 1 billion?
Then… a Divine-level would need 10 billion???”
Lide’s temples throbbed.
As he looked at his own three billion Power of Death, it suddenly didn’t seem as appealing.
“Let’s just upgrade first. What if I’m overthinking it and after Extraordinary it’s not a tenfold increase but just double? That way I could ascend straight to the top level…”
Although he comforted himself for a moment, a bad premonition still emerged in Lide’s heart.
Go big or go home, he had already achieved perfection–why not upgrade to Extraordinary?
With a decisive conviction, his Power of Death plummeted from three hundred and twenty-two million to two hundred and twenty million in an instant.
The process of breaking through to Extraordinary for the Land of Bone-Burying took even longer than he anticipated. He continued to infuse his soul into the Plane Stone, once again reveling in the gratifying sensation of gradual expansion.
By the afternoon of the second day, September 22nd, the Land of Bone-Burying at Extraordinary Level had completed upgrading.
When Lide opened his eyes again,
he found that everything around him had changed.
The Land of Bone-Burying at the Extraordinary Level could no longer be compared with the Rare or Perfect Levels.
At this moment, the diameter of the Land of Bone-Burying had increased from 10,000 blades to 50,000 blades, which is 50 kilometers.
It had become a genuine small plane, rather than the miniature plane it was initially.
The greater change, however, was in the stability of space.
If previously, a Transcendent could easily twist the space within the Land of Bone-Burying, now even if the head of the God of Plague burst forth with that power again, it could only tear a piece of space three to five blades long, and could no longer tear through twenty to thirty blades of space as easily as before.
Of course, the original buildings, such as the defense walls 80 blades high and the alchemy towers more than a hundred blades high, had not collapsed due to the expansion of the plane, under Lide’s intentional protection.
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly, and with his right hand extended, he could feel the endless power of space filling his hand.
With a wave of his hand, an indescribable force surged out, like a storm of Level 18 stirring up colossal waves.
A few breaths later, a giant grey hand, about 5,000 blades in length, appeared in the distant sky.
Like the resurrection of an ancient Demon God, it blotted out the sun and its mighty presence was like the mountains and seas.
After feeling that power, the corners of Lide’s mouth turned up very slightly, and then with a fierce downward press of his right hand, the giant hand spanning half the sky followed his action–descending from the heavens.
Boom~Boom~Boom~
The hand, like a mountain thousands of fathoms high, hammered down on the ground.
At that moment, the earth of the Land of Bone-Burying broke apart, and countless skeletons splashed up a hundred blades high.
A terrifying surge of air, like a storm, blasted in all directions, with the lifted skeletons mixed within it, the scene resembled demons from hell crawling out of the abyss.
It took a full five minutes for the Land of Bone-Burying to return to calm.
Looking at the spot where the giant hand had struck the ground, a clear imprint of five fingers appeared, with the surface collapsing another fifty blades downward…
“This feeling, it’s more than tenfold stronger than the Plane Power I was able to mobilize before…”
Lide couldn’t help but feel uplifted at the sight, barely able to conceal his excitement in his eyes.
“Even if I have not reached the Transcendent level, within the Land of Bone-Burying, I can unleash a force stronger than that of the Transcendent.”
With the Plane Power on him, Lide was an unbeatable existence in the Land of Bone-Burying unless someone had the power to forcefully confront the entire Land of Bone-Burying.
“This is an incredibly strong trump card.”
“No wonder in the mythological legends, the divines mostly stayed within their own Divine Country. As long as they are grounded in the Divine Country, they are in an invincible position…”
“This feeling is just too wonderful…”
Even with Lide’s temperament, he felt somewhat intoxicated at this time.
The whole plane was revolving around him, and he could freely mobilize the plane’s power, far stronger than his own. That feeling was indescribably potent.
After an excited experience for a while, Lide then turned his attention to the attribute panel of the Land of Bone-Burying.
The Land of Bone-Burying at the Extraordinary Level had undergone significant changes.
Land of Bone-Burying (Undead Plane)
Level: Extraordinary (Next level Legendary, upgrading requires 10 billion Power of Death)
Power of Death: 223,253,902
Traits: Capable of growth, Undead transformation
Special Troops: Frost Giant Dragon (Can spend Power of Death at the Skeleton Altar to recruit the ultimate Undead troop – Frost Giant Dragon. The stronger the recruited Frost Giant Dragon’s power, the more Power of Death it consumes)
Special Building: Skeleton Altar (Damaged, can be repaired with Power of Death) to accelerate the transformation of Transcendent-level Undead Life.
Special Area: Land of Corruption (Basic, 100 blades in diameter), Land of Corruption (Advanced, 1,000 blades in diameter)
Plane Area: Diameter of 50,000 blades
Anchored Coordinates – Dawn City (Can open a Space Gate within a 2,000 kilometer radius of Dawn City to enter the Land of Bone-Burying)
Introduction: This is a Rare plane with growth potential, once controlled by a powerful divine, now it is re-blooming with Glory.
Not bad, not bad at all, Lide thought, his smile growing even more brilliant after reading the attributes.
The distance that the Space Gate could be opened had increased from a diameter of 800 kilometers to a diameter of 2,000 kilometers,
which meant that as long as one is within 1,000 kilometers of Dawn City, they could directly enter Dawn City through space.
1,000 kilometers, that could directly open a space from Dawn City to Dwarf Valley.
What did that represent?
In the future, the risks of Dawn City being exposed would be greatly minimized.
And the most important point was that it could significantly reduce the time needed for travel, further enhancing the production efficiency of Dawn City.
Because of the existence of this tool, the Space Gate, the Land of Bone-Burying had already become the production engine of Dawn City, with an astonishing role.
In other aspects, it was manageable, but the Space Gate was an absolute killer in production.
After the Land of Bone-Burying was upgraded to the Transcendent level, the Plane Power became so powerful that it could open more Space Gates with less consumption.
The benefits this brought were almost indescribable.
Lide grew more and more excited as he thought about it.
For example, Dawn City was about to develop the Moonlight Plain, where he would establish an agricultural town and even an industrial area later, as he had already used up the land on the Moonlight Plain.
With the Transcendent-level Land of Bone-Burying, he could permanently set up a few Space Gates within the towns on the Moonlight Plain, directly connecting them with Dawn City, eliminating the need to consider the distance.
Even he could establish towns hundreds of kilometers away from Dawn City, on the other side of the Moonlight Plain, without worrying about transportation between them.
Eventually, Dawn City would become an unbeatably huge mega-city.
The future Dawn City might have countless satellite towns, with Space Gates becoming a standard facility, allowing residents even hundreds of kilometers away to reach Dawn City in the blink of an eye.
Lide’s thoughts began to wander, and he was very excited at the thought of a scene that could only be realized in this magical world.
If the scene he envisioned truly came to be, then Dawn City would become a paradise divine kingdom only found in myths.
Moments later, Lide reluctantly shook his head, reigning in his wandering thoughts, as this was bound to be a long process of investment without short-term results.
After regaining his focus, he turned his attention to the next priority.
The ultimate undead creature–the Frost Giant Dragon.
After the Land of Bone-Burying reached the Transcendent level, he could finally recruit Frost Giant Dragons.
God knows how long he had been coveting this ultimate troop.
The Nine Dragons Chariot would soon emerge.
“But do I need to use the White Bone Altar for this recruitment?”
Lide’s thoughts stirred, and he reviewed the system’s introduction again, and moments later information flowed into his mind.
“I just need to input Power of Death… and then wait for the White Bone Altar to deliver?”
Having read the system information, Lide’s eyes immediately lit up. With one step, he appeared above the twelve-layer White Bone Altar.
The crack that the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel had sliced open was especially evident.
This altar had once been a place where Evil God believers summoned the Undead gods, and it was also built by the hands of the God of Skeleton himself.
Approaching the altar, Lide’s thoughts moved, and he opened the altar’s attribute panel.
Skeleton Altar
Status: Damaged (Damage degree 37%, recruitment or conversion of undead requires 37% more Power of Death), can be repaired using Power of Death.
Features:
Conversion (Can accelerate the conversion of Transcendent-level and above Undead Life)
Recruitment (Can recruit high-level Undead Life through the White Bone Altar)
Introduction: This is an ancient Undead Clan Divine altar built by the deity themselves, possessing miraculous power. However, it’s now damaged, causing an increased consumption of power when used.
37% damage?
Lide frowned; the extra percentage of Power of Death consumed was terribly annoying.
It felt like a scam that could bleed him dry if he wasn’t careful.
Without hesitation, and with over two billion Power of Death left, he silently commanded the system to repair, and immediately a system notification sounded.
“Ding~ Would you like to spend 37 million Power of Death to repair the Skeleton Altar?”
It also costs thirty-something million Power of Death?
The corner of Lide’s mouth twitched. He had been too careless and hadn’t expected the system to be so unreasonable, casually erasing hundreds of millions of Power of Death.
But at this point, he was resolved, even if it meant facing a burly English strongman of over two hundred pounds.
“Yes.”
After his affirmation, the Power of Death from 223,253,902 dropped to 186,253,902 with a swish.
Then the twelve-layer White Bone Altar was immediately enveloped by the surging Power of Death.
The Power of Death, like something that could melt bones, slowly dissolved the cracked parts and then bonded them together again, quickly fusing into one.
In less than ten minutes, 37 million Power of Death was consumed, and the twelve-layer White Bone Altar, once split by the sword of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, was restored to its normal condition.
But just as Lide was about to start summoning, there was a sudden clacking noise, and the White Bone Altar seemed to come to life, emitting a chilling coldness that could chill one’s spine upon a single glance.
Lide raised an eyebrow and directly connected to the Plane Stone, and then the interior of the White Bone Altar appeared before him.
The core runes and arrays of the White Bone Altar began to slowly repair under the abundant Power of Death; this altar was not simply a stack of bones, and the external damage was just a scar.
The noisy clattering lasted for half a day before subsiding.
When Lide looked again, the damaged state of the White Bone Altar had vanished, returning to normal.
He nodded slightly, excitement slowly emerging in his eyes.
After a bath, it was time for the real work.
Summoning the Frost Giant Dragon.
It had to be said that Lide was quite enamored with the idea of this ultimate life form that existed only in legend.
After all, that idiotic Bone Dragon had completely ruined his impression of the Undead, and there was also that cow he raised…
Damn, it even gnawed away at the seal of the Ancient Evil God, peculiar as hell. Now the Cow Bone Undead, having consumed Divine Substance from the Plague God’s skull, had hidden away in his underground palace, who knows what it was plotting…
Thinking of this, Lide couldn’t help but shake his head, hoping to summon a more normal Undead this time.
“The system upgrade says, the more Power of Death I gather, the stronger the Frost Giant Dragon will be…”
“Let’s start with ten million to test the waters…”
No more hesitation. Following the information provided by the system, he began to infuse Power of Death into the White Bone Altar before him.
As for the Angel Wings floating above the White Bone Altar, Lide chose to ignore them. That feather was the main consumer of Power of Death. He was on a tight budget now, with no spare cash for pleasures.
The air turned ominously dark due to the Power of Death.
Powerful gusts of Death Energy swallowed the sparse light.
The originally pale skeletons of the White Bone Altar emitted a faint white light after absorbing Death Energy. However, this white light was not the sanctity of Power of Faith, but a chilling, eerie sense of terror.
As Death Energy accumulated, a massive phantom began to form above the White Bone Altar.
Lide felt a sensation in his heart. He could feel that the Land of Bone-Burying was mobilizing the soul marks once imprinted in the Plane Stones.
Having all the memories of the Land of Bone-Burying, he naturally knew how many terrifying lives this Plane forged by the Evil God had birthed.
Most of these life-forms’ soul marks dissipated with the collapse of the Bone-Burying Plane, leaving only the soul mark of the ultimate troop, the Frost Giant Dragon.
In other words, his summoning of the Frost Giant Dragon was not creating something out of nothing, but the Land of Bone-Burying was reconstructing their souls based on the Frost Giant Dragon’s soul mark, bestowing them with new bodies.
Even so, it was terrifying enough.
With the insane gathering of Death Energy, the phantom on the White Bone Altar gradually solidified.
Suddenly, large pieces of skeleton began to rise from the ground. These bones, as if held by a giant hand, were pieced one by one onto the ghostly giant dragon’s body.
Inside the Land of Bone-Burying, above the twelve-level White Bone Altar, the phantom of a giant dragon took shape amidst endless Power of Death, with bones actively flying to build its body – a scene as miraculous as it was heart-shattering.
Even Lide found himself mesmerized by this spectacle.
This was the proper unfolding of the Magic World.
He was witnessing the birth of the ultimate Undead troop!
As more and more bones accumulated, the shape of the dragon’s body became clearer.
The interconnected bones began absorbing Death Energy, fusing into a true dragon’s body under the influence of the powerful energies, like clay slowly molding together.
Lide was astounded by the sight.
It was magical. Without witnessing this scene with his own eyes, he couldn’t have imagined its grandeur.
But just when Lide thought the process would continue until the Frost Giant Dragon was fully formed, a sudden system prompt made his heart skip a beat.
“Ding~ Detected Divine Substance diffusing in the air, fulfilling the conditions for constructing an Extraordinary Giant Dragon’s soul. Would you like to spend 100 million Power of Death to upgrade the Frost Giant Dragon under construction to Extraordinary?”
This is possible?? Was he blessed by the Goddess of Luck today??
What is a sudden joy? This is it.
After being stunned for a moment, Lide’s smile burst forth, beaming from ear to ear.
“Ding~ To summon an Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragon, Divine Substance must be consumed. The Divine Substance in the air is dissipating. Please make your choice quickly.”
The system’s second prompt snapped Lide back to reality, his face amused. Was there really a choice to make? Was he expected to choose to give up?
“Confirm upgrade.”
After making the choice, the once-abundant Power of Death on his attribute panel plummeted–a sight that made the corners of Lide’s mouth twitch.
Only because he had struck it rich in the past few months did he afford this Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon. Otherwise, it would have been out of reach.
Moments ago, he felt like a boundless tycoon, only to be reduced to a humble 76 million Power of Death. While still a luxurious amount by previous standards, it clearly wasn’t as durable.
Sigh, still too young. He had thought he could live the wealthy landlord life, but it turned out he was still a modest peasant…
Lide had no time to ponder further. After choosing to promote the Frost Giant Dragon, the surroundings became even dimmer, as if a terrifying Demon was being birthed, filling the air with a cold breath that could send shivers down one’s spine.
And as the White Bone Altar received over a hundred million Power of Death, the white light radiating from its bones illuminated a hundred-blade radius, but the chilling sensation intensified.
Suddenly, with sharp eyes, Lide noticed that within the original defensive walls, bright grey energy shards began to rise from the high-level Land of Corruption.
After a slight perception, he understood–these were the diffusing Divine Substances.
“Some of these were from Fierce Half-Ratmen who died but weren’t absorbed by the Divine Artifact, the Eye of the Ancient Evil God; others were scattered when Lide erased the soul marks of the God of Plague, a whole lot scattered all over.
At first, it was unimpressive, but after being gathered by the White Bone Altar, hundreds of tiny fragments flew out.
Though each fragment’s divine essence was extremely weak, when accumulated, they amounted to a substantial sum.
These divine fragments didn’t linger in the air for long, they poured directly into the skeletal dragon’s body above the White Bone Altar along with the ashen Power of Death.
The moment the divine fragments entered the skeletal dragon’s body, the already terrifying aura of this dragon’s body flared up as if a bucket of gasoline was poured onto a roaring fire, exploding instantly.
Meanwhile, the bones flying around sped up, and the rate of the dragon’s body’s assembly visibly increased.
After the bones were pieced together, under the influence of that powerful energy, they melted instantaneously to become the joints of the dragon’s body.
It took a full twenty minutes for the flying bones to cease, and upon looking again, the scene had become incredibly spectacular.
Above the twelve-tiered White Bone Altar, glowing with a ghastly white light.
A Bone Dragon, its wingspan 26 blades long, all composed of white bones, was audaciously unfurling its wings. Although the Soul Fire within its skull had yet to be ignited, the aura it emitted was enough to astonish anyone.
Underneath the colossal dragon body, four strong legs, sturdier than battering rams, stood erect, with sharp claws like deadly Daggers in an assassin’s hands.
Upon its broad back, a row of ruthless spines like short spears adorned it, while the damaged dragon wings made of bone segments bore hooks capable of tearing through steel with ease, and a long tail like a steel whip with a spear tip at its end, sharp and unmatched.
This was a Frost Giant Dragon far more dominating than any Withered Bone, not just in size, but in its very construction.
Around it, the Power of Death swirled madly into the newly crafted dragon body post-construction.
The once somewhat loose and fragile dragon body began to tighten under the wash of powerful energy and started to emanate a hard luster.
Finally, every part of the body was as if forged from a thousand hammer blows, harder than steel.
This Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragon had been under construction for a full Sunshine Hour, and after it had achieved perfection under the forging of the Power of Death.
Lide felt a stir in his heart, sensing an awe-inspiring power surging within the head of the still and silent dragon carcass in front of him.
Like the eye of an 18th level storm, calm yet with an explosive pressure around it, intense enough to make one’s courage falter.
Boom–
A thunderous boom suddenly erupted in the sky over the Land of Bone-Burying.
From above the ninth heaven, a dazzling bolt of Thunder, as if heralding a mountain’s collapse, thunderously descended.
In that moment, the whole world was illuminated by that singular flash.
The lightning strike was so quick that Lide hardly recognized its form before it vanished.
Crackle–
The bolt of lightning seemed to have a targeted aim, striking directly upon the skull of the dragon’s body.
Then in that instant, Lide saw blue sparks ignite within the hollow, dead skull of the dragon.
These sparks, the second after they appeared, set the entire skull alight like burning grease.
Boom–a sound of flame eruption, and instantly, a blinding blue fire blazed forth.
The Soul Fire of this Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon was ignited.
An indescribable, horrifying presence rose from the Frost Giant Dragon, and the temperature of the surrounding air plummeted by dozens of degrees.
Even the ground made of bones was swiftly covered with a layer of frost.
A true Frost Giant Dragon.
And with the rise of that chill, another even more terrifying presence emerged.
Even Lide felt the impact of that aura–Dragon Power.
The unique intimidating presence of giant dragons, the symbol of ultimate beings.
Roar–
Though its throat lacked flesh, this Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon let out a dull, low growl.
“I am awakened from the ancient times…”
With a dry and deep draconic language, these words echoed inside the Land of Bone-Burying, to which Lide reacted with a particularly subtle expression.
Does this Frost Giant Dragon retain memories from its past??
Hoo-hoo–
Before he could ponder further, atop the twelve-tiered White Bone Altar, the freshly reborn Extraordinary Giant Dragon suddenly flapped its wings and took flight.
That terrifying Dragon Power filled every corner of the Land of Bone-Burying.
It seemed as if the world held only this Extraordinary being’s image.
Soaring the skies, it looked down upon the world with contempt.
Witnessing this, Lide’s brow twitched, and he directly spoke.
“Do you still have your previous memories?”
But to his surprise, the Frost Giant Dragon made a sudden turn and landed heavily in front of him, then lifted its head high, looking down at him with disdain.
“Pitiful human, was it you who awakened me? Speak, what reward do you desire…”
???
Lide’s face was full of question marks. Was this dumb Frost Giant Dragon joking??
He said with some disbelief.
“Are you sure you’re talking to me?”
The Frost Giant Dragon lifted its head even higher, its hollow eyes glaring at him from an angle.
“Pitiful human, could it be that speaking to the great Lord Frost has excited you to the point of losing your clarity?”
Lide: “…”
Seeing that Lide did not speak, the Frost Giant Dragon grew impatient and with a fierce flap of its wings, it soared into the sky again.
“Pitiful human, when you decide what reward you want, then ask me!
I haven’t spread my wings for hundreds of thousands of years…”
Lide’s mouth twitched fiercely when he heard this. Was this guy trying to rebel?
“I can feel my soul imprint engraved within this dragon’s soul, but there is a force preventing me from controlling it… Could it be because of divinity?”
ROAR~
The roar of the extraordinary giant dragon in the sky snapped Lide back to reality. Seeing the other’s unbridled behavior, his eyes narrowed slightly.
“Put aside whether it’s divine or not…
Did I give you permission to fly?”
He stretched out his right hand slightly, and then a giant grey hand of 5000 blades suddenly appeared above in the sky.
The entire sky was covered by it, like a primordial demon god had extended its palm, and it seemed like the next second, it would shatter the entire plane.
The extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon, with a wingspan of 26 blades, looked as small as an ant before this giant hand.
Sensing the sudden surge of power in the sky, the Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragon was suddenly startled, then, as if provoked, became extremely enraged and bellowed furiously.
“No matter what, there is no one who can defeat the great Lord Frost!!
Taste my Frost Dragon Breath!!”
Zzzt~ A dragon breath capable of freezing space spewed out towards the giant hand.
This action caused Lide’s brows to raise. Then, with a slight press of his right hand and his fingers clenching into a fist.
With just that one motion, the world changed color; mountains crumbled, and seas churned.
The Land of Bone-Burying seemed to tilt, and space itself trembled.
The Frost Dragon Breath from the extraordinary dragon, containing terrifying energy, was as harmless as a baby’s drool before the giant hand.
PUFF~
Under the coverage of the giant hand, there was nowhere to hide.
The dragon with a wingspan of 26 blades was caught effortlessly by the giant hand as if it were a baby chick.
Seeing this scene, Lide’s eyes were as cold as ice, and with a slight downward pressure of his right hand,
BANG~
A nuclear blast shook the heavens.
The earth shattered, and space fractured.
A wave of air mixed with white bones rose a hundred blades high, creating a storm-like gust within the Land of Bone-Burying.
The Extraordinary Giant Dragon, which had only just been strutting about, was now firmly pressed against the ground by the giant hand, creating a huge pit hundreds of blades wide and tens of blades deep around it.
And the Frost Giant Dragon being pressed to the ground, no matter how much power it unleashed, could not break free.
Facing this scene, Lide’s expression remained calm, this astonishing spectacle was merely a casual act for him.
He stepped forward and disappeared from the spot.
In the blink of an eye, he reappeared before the extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon, floating in the air, looking down at the Frost Giant Dragon that now resembled a dead dog pressed into the ground,
Slowly advancing.
Under the dragon’s angry and shocked gaze, he placed his foot directly onto the head of the extraordinary giant dragon.
His eyes were as sharp as a hawk, and a playful curve formed on his lips.
“Now, do you know who is the master?”

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - Chapter 393: Chapter 395: The Golden Ancestor Bloodline, Logging Off to Return to Earth (9000 Words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 393: Chapter 395: The Golden Ancestor Bloodline, Logging Off to Return to Earth (9000 Words)
Lide stood dominantly atop the head of the Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon, which just moments before, had been flaunting its power. Now, it was subjected to relentless trampling.
“Release me, despicable human!!”
Infinite rage flickered across the eyes of the Frost Giant Dragon, a creature that, despite its haughty traits, seemed unwilling to accept defeat.
“I will freeze your soul for a million years!!”
Lide’s brow furrowed slightly as he completely ignored the impotent roars of the dragon.
Concentrating slightly, he sensed the soul inside the dragon’s skull emanating an unsettling evil aura… It seemed the divinity had made the giant dragon forget who its master was.
Without excess chatter, his left hand stretched out slightly, and a faint holy light began to swirl around it.
Sensing Lide’s movement, the Frost Giant Dragon started struggling frantically.
“Damn you, human!! You will suffer my punishment!! Release me…”
But no matter how the dragon struggled and cursed, the holy light still spread into its skull.
However, after only a brief moment, Lide withdrew his hand, his brow more furrowed than before.
Due to the dragon’s intense resistance, his Power of Faith couldn’t reach into its soul. Forcing it would not only increase the consumption of his divine power tenfold but could also harm the newly born Soul Fire of the dragon.
“I am a noble Frost Giant Dragon, lowly human, you dare ambush…”
“Release me, I wish to fight you! A true fight!”
Seeing the Frost Giant Dragon that was still babbling while being pinned to the ground, Lide immediately grew irritated.
Too much nonsense.
His body suddenly disappeared from the spot.
Just as the Frost Giant Dragon sensed the disappearance of the human from atop its head and paused in confusion…
Suddenly, that terrifying grey giant hand reappeared.
“No!!”
Lide stood thousands of blades away, his right hand slightly lifting, then that massive hand, large enough to cover the heavens and the earth, directly picked up the Frost Giant Dragon as if it were a mere chick.
What followed was even more shocking–the giant hand grabbed the dragon’s tail and swung it like a whip, smashing the massive creature, with a wingspan of 26 blades, onto the ground.
Bang~
The dragon collided with the ground, creating a horrific shockwave that formed a circle and sent shattered bones flying thousands of blades away.
The scene made one’s heart tremble.
The Frost Giant Dragon that had just been babbling was smashed more than ten blades deep into the ground, and before it could recover, Lide’s right hand lifted again, then slammed down hard.
The giant boulder in the sky was his avatar at this moment, with the Plane Power swirling in his hand.
Boom~ Boom~ Boom~
For the next ten minutes, the Frost Giant Dragon truly became an actual piling machine, as the land of Bone-Burying shook with the sounds of the earth bursting.
Even with its power reaching the Extraordinary, the Frost Giant Dragon had no chance to resist against the suppression of an entire plane, and by the end, even its Soul Fire was flickering as if it could extinguish at any moment.
When the Frost Giant Dragon no longer made a sound and cracks appeared on its skeletal body, Lide finally stopped.
Boom~
The giant hand tossed it aside carelessly, and the newly birthed Extraordinary laid in front of Lide on the white bone ground like a dead dog, unable to babble any longer.
“Now, still stubborn?”
Roar…
The Frost Giant Dragon, upon seeing Lide, instinctively shivered, opened its mouth, then closed it again, pathetically turning its head to the side.
This devil…
Seeing this, Lide Kachar couldn’t be bothered to say more to the silly dragon influenced by divinity, stepping again on the dragon’s head as the Power of Faith began to emanate.
Feeling the sacred aura, the Frost Giant Dragon’s body shuddered, about to make a move, when Lide’s cold voice arrived.
“Try moving again?”
Damn it, despicable human, once I regain my strength, I will definitely devour your soul…
The Frost Giant Dragon cursed bitterly in its heart, but outwardly it showed a remarkable level of submission, letting Lide’s power penetrate without resistance.
With no resistance from the Frost Giant Dragon, the Power of Faith flowed much more smoothly.
Lide carefully sensed it, and after a moment, the frown on his face slightly relaxed.
He had found the root of the problem.
Deep within the soul of the Frost Giant Dragon, a cluster of power emitting an evil, decaying aura was slowly revolving, clearly influencing the dragon’s soul power.
“This fellow’s abnormality is indeed because of divinity. The power of Ancient Gods is too elusive… In the future, if I encounter this again, I must be careful and vigilant.”
Realizing the root of the problem, Lide did not hesitate; the surging Power of Faith enveloped the evil power, then directly dragged it out of the Frost Giant Dragon’s soul.
This haughty Frost Giant Dragon didn’t dare even make a sound now, honestly allowing Lide to act.
Moments later, in Lide’s hand appeared that evil power, wrapped in a brilliant white Faith’s power.
The power was like a drop of thick ink, the terrifying aura it emitted enough to chill anyone to the bone.
It was the power of Ancient Gods, capable of corroding the mind, devouring souls.
After sensing briefly, Lide waved his hand and called upon the Plane Power to seal away this Ancient power.
This thing was too sinister; better not to touch it if possible.
He had suffered so much while devouring divinity because the Divine Power of the God of Plague contained this Ancient power, corrupting minds, making people lose their sanity.
If it weren’t for the Power of Faith protecting him, he would have long been enslaved by that power.
The power of an Ancient God is extremely mysterious and difficult to explore; Lide had never been clear about what exactly the Ancient power was, only able to roughly determine it as an extremely evil energy.
And the Ancient God, perhaps, was a divine being who possessed this evil power and was not corrupted by it.
After Lide cleared the mind of the Frost Giant Dragon from the Ancient power, the previously indignant Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon was taken aback.
It just felt like its soul had been emptied, then a familiar aura came, and when it saw Lide again, its previous anger immediately turned into admiration and worship.
“Great Master, Stran Frost Trace, I offer you my highest respect.”
This Extraordinary being, created by the Land of Bone-Burying and recruited by Lide, had been marked with a soul imprint from the moment of its birth.
Completely under his control.
Now was the correct way to open it; before had just been an accident.
Lide watched as the Frost Giant Dragon, which had been so stubborn moments before, bowed its proud head, and he smiled faintly.
Now it was right.
Without saying much more, driven by curiosity, he directly opened the property panel of this Extraordinary Giant Dragon.
The Frost Giant Dragon’s long list of lavish attributes immediately appeared before him.
Stran Frost Trace
Title: Frost Controller (Spiritual power +500%, immune to frost damage, immune to instant death skills, reduces 50% fire magic damage)
Frost Giant Dragon (All magic attacks carry frost attributes, randomly causing freezing, slowing, stiffness, and sluggishness, each negative status reducing 10% attack power and 10% movement speed, stackable up to 8 times.)
Age: 1
Level: Extraordinary-lv20
Profession: Frost Controller
Bloodline: Frost Giant Dragon Bloodline (Mastery of all ice dragon language magic–total of 327 spells, including 7 forbidden curses)
Special Skill: Extraordinary Undead (The ultimate life form of the Undead Clan, strength increased by 3000%, defense increased by 2000%, deterrent power against Undead Life increased by 500%, can forcibly enslave Undead Life below Level 15)
Extraordinary Body (Reduces damage from attacks below the extraordinary by 70%, reduces damage from extraordinary levels by 30%, immune to control skills below divine level, immune to all soul and mind-type skills)
Extraordinary Dragon Power (Exerts an undeniable suppression on non-dragon life forms, only high-level bloodlines are immune; those affected by Dragon Power will experience negative states such as fear and panic, all attributes decrease by 40%, lives below extraordinary are highly likely to submit to the emitter of Dragon Power)
Unique Skill: Frost Breath (Dragon Breath with an Absolute Zero characteristic–can emit an extremely cold breath, capable of cracking space, frost damage increased by 5000%)
Frost Armor (Can cover the body with a layer of absolute defensive frost armor, capable of withstanding one divine-level damage)
Introduction: The ultimate life form of the Undead Clan, ignited by divine soul fire, born under the forging of the divine, inherits all series of dragon language ice magic while possessing a robust body.
Lide looked at Stran’s attribute panel with an amusing expression, although at first glance, the Frost Giant Dragon’s skills seemed not too many.
But the bloodline section was indeed extremely exaggerated; a total of 327 ice dragon language magics, including 7 forbidden curses…
7 forbidden curses, which greatly outclass those ordinary skills.
And the other skills were also powerful enough to make one dizzy; Dragon Breath has the feature of Absolute Zero that can crack space, Extraordinary Body reduced damage by 70%, Frost Armor capable of withstanding one divine-level damage…everything seemed incredibly powerful.
Without exaggeration, an army below the extraordinary assaulting this Frost Giant Dragon probably wouldn’t be enough even if there were a hundred or two hundred thousand of them.
A single forbidden curse could decimate a city in minutes.
The billion spent on the Power of Death was not in vain, Lide was quite pleased.
Then, as if he remembered something, his eyes sparkled with curiosity.
“Stran, do you still have memories from before?”
This fellow had screamed something about awakening from ancient times upon his birth.
The Plane Stone had recorded the soul mark of this Frost Giant Dragon, and he had recruited this fellow using that extremely faint soul mark as a trigger, then reconstructing its soul and body through the Power of Death.
Logically, that faint soul mark should barely retain any memories.
So he was very curious.
“No, master, I don’t have memories from before.” Stran shook his huge head, this giant creature with a wingspan of 26 blades had already climbed out of the pit by that time.
But it seemed this guy didn’t learn from the past, and just raised his head again, full of vigor.
“I just feel like I’ve been asleep for a very long time, and saying this makes me sound strong!”
The Frost Giant Dragon was quite assertive, showing not even a hint of embarrassment, with a tone filled with undeniable pride.
Me???
Lide’s face fell, wondering why your age shows as 1 year old.
So you were just pretending, what a waste of emotions.
Suddenly, he felt a headache coming on.
Why is it that none of the undead have a normal brain?
Withered Bone was like this, that stupid bull was like this, and this extraordinary giant dragon was no better, you’re all extraordinary, why keep pretending…
“Alright, there’s a Bloodline down below making a breakthrough to the extraordinary, you just guard him from now on,”
Lide glanced at this fellow with visible annoyance.
“At your command, my master.”
Stran bowed slightly, performing a rather elegant noble gesture like a human, still holding his head high with those glimmering blue soul flames.
After answering, the Frost Giant Dragon violently flapped its wings, soaring in the skies above Emi.
Seeing this, Lide was exasperated, Why so haughty? This guy is an undead…
Why can’t there just be one with a normal thought process???
Thinking about his several undead, his lips twitched fiercely.
A chatterbox, a timid oddball, a haughty one.
Incredible.
After coming back to his senses, he ignored Atlanta flying around in the sky and glanced at his attribute panel, which still had over seventy million Power of Death remaining. His gaze then fell upon the floating angel wings above the altar.
“If I keep holding back, who knows when the fall will happen, can’t catch a wolf without risking the sheep…”
With a thought, he left only twenty million Power of Death, transferring the rest into the angel wings.
Instantly, over fifty million Power of Death enveloped the holy feathers like thick black ink, beginning to corrupt them.
Darkness spread, and evil erupted.
The previously silent angel wings trembled under the insane erosion of the Power of Death and, under Lide’s watch, the holy feathers slowly darkened.
He could distinctly feel the holy power being devoured by the Power of Death.
Then Lide opened his attribute panel, indeed, fifty million Power of Death had reduced its transformation period by five hundred years…
Current remaining transformation time–12,741 years
Lide’s face showed helplessness.
Originally, he thought with three hundred million Power of Death he could live like a wealthy lord, enjoying a rich life, but the ripples hadn’t even started to spread when it was all gone.
One hundred thousand Power of Death could accelerate the transformation by one year, to completely corrupt a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, he still needed 1.27 billion Power of Death…
Thinking about this number made his teeth itch.
If he just relied on raising pigs to accumulate Power of Death, he wondered if he could see this angel fall by the time he ascended to godhood.
Moreover, after the windfall from slaughtering Fierce Half-Ratmen in the past few months, returning to his previous stable pig-raising life wouldn’t be so easy.
Lide pondered as a thoughtful look passed through his eyes.
“Raising pigs doesn’t necessarily mean we have to do it ourselves, we can just slaughter others’ pigs, your wife, pah, your pigs I’ll slaughter…
Can we find a monster-infested plane and lock its spatial coordinates, wouldn’t that work?”
Thinking this, his eyes slowly began to brighten.
“Then, just like how we dealt with the Fierce Half-Ratmen before, we can set up a defensive position, using defensive structures to slaughter monsters from other planes…”
“The feasibility of this idea is definitely not low…”
“But there are a few problems that also need to be resolved, the first is how to find a suitable plane, this plane’s monsters must firstly be numerous, and secondly, the top combat forces should not exceed what Dawn City can handle…”
The more Lide thought about it, the more promising it seemed.
“I’ll record this down for now, I’ll execute it once I handle the trivial matters in Dawn City.”
Turning his head to glance at the angel wings on the White Bone Altar, a smile finally appeared on his face.
“Twelve-winged Blazing Angel… ten thousand years transformation time…
Now, I finally see hope.”
—-
—-
—-
After handling the matters of the Land of Bone-Burying, Lide didn’t linger. He tore through space and returned directly to his office.
Looking at the office carpeted with gray velvet, hung with high-quality silk curtains, and furnished entirely in classical taste, his mood instantly improved a lot.
Although the Land of Bone-Burying allowed him to control the entire plane’s power, its gray gloom, coupled with bones everywhere, really wasn’t a place suitable for prolonged stays.
Comfortably sitting in the plush chair behind his desk, Lide stretched lazily and then focused his attention on his attribute panel.
Having been busy for so long after his breakthrough, he finally had time to study the attributes he gained after transcending the ordinary.
With a flicker of excitement in his eyes, he began to seriously review them.
Lide Kachar
Race: Bloodline (Ancestor)
Legend Level: 7 (+1) Widely Renowned, Legend Level 8 in the Underworld.
Titles: Master of Crimson, Immortal King, Giant Conqueror
Level: Extraordinary lv23 (0/2.3 million)
Magic Power: 20000/20000
Bloodline: Ancestor Bloodline (Golden), Evolution Level 0% (Can absorb fresh blood to increase evolution level)
Talent Specialization: Blood Clan Ancestor (Unique)
Blood-soaked Rebirth (Restricted): Can leave a bat in the Blood Clan’s blood pool, can be reborn in the blood pool after the body dies, weakened for one month after rebirth, cooldown one month.
Rare * Restricted Skill:
Extraordinary Crimson Power: Passive, all attacks carry the Power of Crimson, causing armor breaking, chaos element, and corrosive damage, each attack will envelop the opponent in debilitated and fear-filled negative states, each layer of negative state will cause all attributes to drop by 10%, can stack up to 7 layers.
Active: Can control the Power of Crimson to invade the opponent’s body, causing their blood to boil and burst. The more the Power of Crimson invades, the higher the damage caused.
Additional Traits: Extraordinary Penetration, the magic resistance of enemies corrupted by the Power of Crimson will be greatly reduced.
Extraordinary Bloody Storm (uses 50% Bloodline Power, releases 100 slaughter bats each containing 50% of the body’s strength, can also use the blood in the bodies of slain enemies to conjure slaughter bats with 80% of the enemy’s strength, slaughter bats can consume blood to grow, reproduce, and split, duration until blood energy is exhausted, can actively control slaughter bats)
Extraordinary Shadow Blade (can enter Dimension Space after transforming into Bloodline, immune to Divine Level and lower Investigation Skills, obtains Absolute Slaughter trait, Absolute Slaughter: ignores any defense below Divine-level and deals true damage on the first attack, deployment requires consuming 50% Bloodline Power.)
Extraordinary Slaughter Hand (Combat Awareness, Combat Skills, Battlefield Sense elevated to Legendary Level), gains Special Trait: Extraordinary Danger Perception (can sense imminent threats)
Bloodline Shackles (You have absolute dominion over Bloodline members, you can control Bloodline members through the Bloodline Shackles, issuing commands that assimilate into the Bloodline.
