The endless power made him feel as if he were a divine demon resurrected from the fall of the gods in the Battle of the Gods.
The space around him, unable to bear this exaggerated power, cracked open inch by inch like a spider web, a scene that shocked the soul.
And it was at this moment, atop the three-hundred-blade tall mountain, a sound of metal and stone clashing rang out, tap tap~
Then, a gigantic spider appeared before Lide, standing eight blades tall, twenty blades long, covered with black fur, below which were eight limbs sharp enough to tear through shields.
The most terrifying thing was that this monstrous creature had a fierce and twisted face on its head that induced chills,
and its gaping maw, flanked by turtle-like fangs sharper than dragon-slaying giant blades, could grind steel into dust at every closure of its jaws.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen!
Lide’s eyes sparked with thousands of beams of light, and his fighting spirit surged mightily.
His aura skyrocketed once again.
Today’s prey, he decided, was his!
He opened the attribute panel subconsciously, and the Extraordinary Spider Queen’s level appeared before his eyes, Extraordinary*lv21, but before he could take a closer look at its skills and attributes, a terrifying killing intent struck from the front.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen, which was two hundred blades away from him, suddenly opened its mouth wide and, before he could even blink,
Hiss~ A shockwave capable of shattering space erupted from its mouth.
This frightful shockwave, like a blast of air from a cannon, immediately subjected everything within a two-thousand-blade radius to indiscriminate attack.
The Cave Spiders around were directly blasted apart, green liquid splattering everywhere.
The fungal mats on the floor were torn like paper, and the rocky ground below crumbled, countless stones flying up into the sky.
The scene was like the doomsday destruction of the world, filled with an ominous atmosphere that made cold sweat break out on one’s forehead.
And where Lide stood was the primary direction of the shockwave’s attack; the space in front of him crumbled inch by inch due to the overwhelming energy, suggesting that the strike could even fell a dragon.
But astonishingly, Lide made no move, yes, he simply floated in the void, seemingly unfazed by the attack that could have killed an ordinary person a hundred, a thousand times, as if it were just a gentle breeze.
Yet the Extraordinary Spider Queen would not show mercy, instead amplifying its howl. It had recognized him as the thief who stole the spider eggs.
Rage was exploding.
Whoosh whoosh~
The air shockwaves, like swords capable of tearing through armor, collided with Lide within the blink of an eye.
At that moment, wind whipped up giant waves, mountains crumbled, an unstoppable force.
Crackle~
The instant the blast hit Lide, a splattering of blood occurred.
But even more shocking was the fact that even though that force could tear space apart, it couldn’t make him retreat so much as half a step!
The surrounding peaks turned into rubble, rocks, and remnants of Cave Spiders’ limbs soared through the air, all of these merely backdrops to the eternal figure in the sky.
After a full thirty seconds, the Extraordinary Spider’s terrifying shockwave finally receded.
Looking at Lide again, the scars on his body miraculously healed back to their original state at the moment the shock wave faded.
The scene was simply as if a Demon God had been reborn.
He had actually withstood the shock wave released by a Transcendent, using his flesh alone.
Moreover, it was a direct confrontation without using any defense skills.
If outsiders saw this scene, they would surely exclaim that it was impossible, for how could such a body belong to a normal life form!
Even a giant dragon would have to retreat from this world-ending shock, to withstand a Transcendent attack head-on and remain unscathed–just how powerful was this figure??
Lide’s eyes were icy cold as he withstood a Transcendent attack, merely wanting to test how his defense was now that he had activated the Golden Ancestor Bloodline.
Now it seemed, it was quite to his satisfaction.
After all, this Spider Queen was truly a Transcendent, and her level reached as high as 21.
Such an attack, even if there were tens of thousands of warriors present, would definitely be annihilated in an instant.
So it was no exaggeration to say that the power Lide now possessed had transcended the limits of what ordinary people could imagine.
Even among the Transcendents, he could be considered to have unparalleled combat strength.
“Now, it’s my turn.”
Lide saw the Transcendent Spider Queen wanted to make a second attempt, a cold curve forming on his lips.
What was nearly an unbeatable Transcendent boss a year ago, now seemed trivial to him.
The moment his words fell, a terrifying and indescribable aura surged up from Lide’s body.
The abyss shattered, and Hell collapsed.
Cave spiders within the vicinity of tens of thousands of blades felt as if an Abyss Evil God who could tear heaven and earth asunder had descended upon the world.
And the scythe of the Death God was reaping their souls.
Boom~
The Power of Crimson on Lide’s body ignited like Hellish Demon Flames.
The terrifying power caused the space around to twist madly.
His magic power circulated, and in the blink of an eye, the first Four Circle Spell–Forbidden Skill appeared.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen, who was still preparing for a second attack, was immediately extinguished.
Because the magic power around it had been frozen, and it couldn’t be mobilized.
And Lide, as the caster, was not affected by his own spell under his mental control.
But this was merely the beginning.
His gaze cold and terrifying, within a few breaths, several powerful Four Circle Spells were consecutively cast.
Magma Fireball, Thunder God Descent, Ice and Snow Disaster, Ultimate Storm, Earth Stone Spur…
After becoming Transcendent, his control over magic power increased once again, and the potency of these Four Circle Spells also received a boost.
Spells infused with the Power of Crimson were like natural disasters destroying the world.
The terrifying Magma Fireball exploded right beside the Extraordinary Spider Queen, and the realm of thunder, like a myth of world destruction, burst forth with a roar.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen couldn’t avoid it in time and had to endure two Four Circle Spells directly.
But just as the Extraordinary Spider Queen came to her senses and prepared to get up and flee, a terrifying blizzard–Ice and Snow Disaster–suddenly whipped up within a two-hundred-blade radius space, the cold storm dropping the temperature by dozens of degrees in an instant. The space, which had become hot from the high temperature, was directly frozen.
And then the terrifying Tornado Storm began to rise–Ultimate Storm, with tornadoes spanning a diameter of 50, and as many as eight of them!!
The horrifying wind speed instantly tore through rocks, and those shattered stones, accelerated by the storm, shrieked through the air like sharp long knives, violently tearing apart the mountain suspended in midair.
No matter how solid the mountain, under the assault of as many as eight terrifying storms, it would likely crumble before long.
Even more astonishing was that the cold frost, rather than dissipating amidst the storm, actually intensified its destructive force.
Ultimate Frost Storm.
The combination of two Four Circle Spells had resulted in a potency several times that of a single Four Circle Spell.
Amidst the terrifying storm, the Extraordinary Spider Queen, whose magic power had been forcefully dispersed by the Forbidden Skill, could only rely on her body to endure, bending her abdomen sharply trying to spit out webbing and venom.
But under the terrifying ice storm which was akin to a stranglehold, even rocks crumbled to pieces–how could spider silk and venom cause any harm?
What was even more shocking was that, at the critical moment of the carnage, a dreadful spike, emanating a faint Power of Crimson, suddenly protruded from the ground.
And then, bolstered by an appalling Magic Power, the earth spike rose with unstoppable force, smashing directly towards the mountain peak,
like a sharp knife cutting through tofu–pfft~ the broken stones clinked. At this moment, the Extraordinary Spider Queen, ensnared by the ice storm, was utterly unaware that the mountain she relied on had been pierced through.
After a few blinks–crack!
The entire mountain split in two, and by the time the Extraordinary Spider Queen realized what was happening, there was no way to avoid the earth spike that surged towards its abdomen.
Pfft–a sound of flesh being penetrated rang out, followed by the formidably haughty Extraordinary Spider Queen, which was impaled through the abdomen by the spike imbued with the Power of Crimson.
The Cave Spider, twenty blades in length, was lifted high on the spike, a sight that left onlookers speechless.
At that point, the mountain began to collapse due to some loss of balance, with 8 violent tornadoes mixing with ice and snow tearing apart the fractured rocks.
Seeing this, Lide’s gaze shifted subtly, his right hand reaching out and slightly clenching into a fist. The tornadoes directly attacked the center, giving the Extraordinary Spider Queen, pierced by the earth spike, no chance to react.
Hiss–cries of pain sharper than a knife etching glass by tens of thousands of times erupted.
A massive ice storm encirclement, a terrifying spike piercing through–the Extraordinary Spider Queen received an extremely brutal blow in an instant.
And in the end, 8 tornadoes, each 50 blades long, merged into one super tornado storm over 200 blades in size.
Even the clouds in the sky were stirred by the storm at this moment, and the ground’s fungal mat, shattered rocks, and the Cave Spider’s broken remains were all swept up by the storm.
The scene resembled divine punishment descending on the unforgivable sinners in the murals of a church.
It was a heart-shaking spectacle.
Accompanied by the howling wind in his ears,
the howls of the Extraordinary Spider Queen became increasingly agonizing. This Extraordinary creature, which had only attacked once, was suppressed on the spot by Lide without any chance of resistance.
But then, a system notification suddenly sounded, causing him to pause slightly.
“Ding~ Spiritual power has reached the required level and has successfully performed Multi-casting. The Casting Talent of Dual Casting has been upgraded to Multi-casting.”
Multi-casting?
He had just subconsciously slammed out several potent Spells, without any thought given to the issue of multi-casting.
But now, he could feel that the barrier which had previously hindered his casting had vanished. As long as his spiritual power could handle it, he could simultaneously cast as many as 10 Spells.
A true artillery Mage.
Having received the system’s message, Lide had a subtly complex expression. Multi-casting wasn’t something ordinary Transcendents could achieve–it required additional conditions.
The key aspects had to include Extraordinary Magic Affinity and Extraordinary Magic Control–these two Extraordinary passive skills.
But the biggest problem was that the “Extreme” level was already the pinnacle for passive skills and under normal circumstances, it was impossible to reach the Extraordinary Level.
Unless someone was a super being with terrifying bloodline like Lide, even those who ascended to Legendary status could at most wield Dual Casting, and at best perform a Fake Triple Casting as he had before.
After absorbing Divine Power and upgrading, his potential had reached a terrifying degree beyond words. With Multi-casting at his disposal, even Lide couldn’t estimate his own strength at this moment.
Hiss–
With several Spells attacking simultaneously, the cries of the Extraordinary Spider Queen grew fainter and fainter.
This queen might be formidable, but in front of Lide, who had myriad means at his disposal, it was merely a creature being crushed.
Lide’s gaze was piercing. Sensing that the opponent’s aura was waning, he slightly waved his hand, and the Spells at that moment dissipated in an instant, like a light breeze brushing past. The scene that was once apocalyptic moments ago turned into a stream babbling gently.
But the surrounding devastation still served as a reminder to outsiders of what had just happened here.
The Extraordinary Spider, impaled by the spike, was now drawing breaths sparser than its exhalations, and even with a formidable body, it was now like a lamb awaiting slaughter.
In this fight, Lide hadn’t even used one-third of his strength, and merely a few Spells thrown down had already debilitated the Extraordinary creature.
Although there was only a two-level disparity, the difference in combat power was as vast as the sky is from the earth.
Just as Lide was about to move forward and check the body status of the Extraordinary Spider Queen, the space behind him suddenly tore apart.
Then, an odd spider with three-bladed limbs resembling mantis scythes appeared behind him.
Thin wings flapped madly, the surging air currents bringing it exaggerated speed, and its two blade-like forelimbs swiped horizontally at Lide.
The air exploded with the urgency of malice unveiled.
Lide felt the killing intent and his lips curved into a chilling smile. Just as the ancient spider’s blade-like forelimb was about to tear him apart, he slightly turned his body and with his right hand, he casually grabbed the blade that could slice through steel like it was mere weeds.
The dreadful force that could rip apart space became as futile as a child’s effort in front of him.
The same trick–he had stepped into the Spider Plane before, only to be killed by this Extraordinary Blade Spider, and now it dared to try the same tactic again.
How pitifully stupid.
The Blade Spider’s large green eyes flashed with rage, and another blade-like forelimb came slicing through the air, ripping the space with its sharp edge.
But to its astonishment, Lide extended his right hand and grabbed the other blade-like forelimb as well.
What??
At this moment, the Blade Spider’s mind must have been filled with question marks. What kind of move was this?
Before it had time to react, suddenly it felt a sharp pain in its forelimbs, and plurt plurt–with two dull sounds, green liquid sprayed out.
Then the Extraordinary Blade Spider watched in horror as its two lethal weapons were brutally ripped out by this terrifying being before it.
The blade-like forelimbs–gone.
Lide held the Blade Spider’s weapons in his hands, his lips curving into an even colder smile.
When a tiger loses its teeth, what can it do to roar and intimidate?
Feeling that its once easy prey had become an unstoppable terrifying entity, the fairly intelligent Blade Spider didn’t choose to fight head-on. Instead, it turned and vanished into the dimension, fleeing.
Lide didn’t seem surprised by this at all, but his bloodshot eyes grew colder.
The two blade-like forelimbs disappeared from his hands, and then with a clench of his right fist, the Bloodline Power burst out like magma, and the Power of Crimson enshrouded his body, igniting fiercely as if doused with gasoline.
Bloodline Power, depleted by 50%.
As his body burst forth with nearly overwhelming strength, Lide threw a punch at the void before him.
At that instant, the Power of Crimson, compressed to its extreme, exploded with a ferocity a million times greater than that of a cannonball.
It seemed as though heaven and earth were trembling.
And then an even more stunning scene ensued–within 500 blades’ range around Lide, space shattered like a broken mirror.
Spatial turbulence erupted.
The very same Extraordinary Blade Spider that had just hidden in the Dimension Plane was thrown out of the exploding space like a dog.
Lide saw this and his gaze became even more indifferent; his right hand reached out, and Power of Crimson surged again, then his five fingers clenched into a fist.
Crack–
Power of Crimson dissipated.
Hoo-hoo–around 500 blades in space, the Power of Crimson, now like water being absorbed by a sponge, crazily surged toward the Extraordinary Blade Spider.
In the blink of an eye, a crimson hue enveloped the Blade Spider.
At this point, the Blade Spider only felt its soul threatened by an indescribable sense of danger as something seemed to devour it.
But as it attempted to enter the Dimension Plane once more, a sharp command cut off all its hopes.
“Explode!”
Lide’s indifferent voice echoed through the shattered world, and then the Extraordinary Blade Spider’s body burst–bang–into pieces.
Its limbs shattered to nothing, its body riddled with dozens of dense holes, as green fluid gushed out.
The Extraordinary Spider, which had just been intent on hunting Lide and flaunting its power, now crashed to the ground like a dead dog,
Boom–a dull sound upon impact, and while not yet dead, it was in no better condition than an Extraordinary Spider Queen besieged by several Four Circle Magic attacks.
Spider Plane, two Extraordinary beings.
Suppressed.
No dallying, no hesitation, these two Extraordinary beings, who had dominated the Plane for who knows how many years, were now like sheep to be slaughtered under Lide’s feet.
And as for the surrounding Cave Spiders, without the control of the Extraordinary Spider Queen and under the imposing, god-like aura of Lide, they didn’t dare come close and fled in utter terror.
At this moment, Lide was like a Demon God revived from ancient times.
