chapters.content:
Chapter 397: Chapter 399: Shattered Divine Status – Twilight (9400 words)
Suppressing the two Transcendent spiders hadn’t posed the slightest difficulty for Lide, for the disparity in their combat abilities had long been incomparable.
Lide glanced indifferently at the Blade Spider collapsed on the ground, barely clinging to life, and shook his head.
He had intended to hone his skills, but now…
He hadn’t even taken off his long johns, and the opponent was already finished.
Snap~
With a snap of his fingers, an enormous transparent hand appeared in the sky, lifting the twitching Blade Spider from the ground.
He then turned to face the Extraordinary Spider Queen.
Looking at the Spider Queen, pierced through the abdomen by spikes and still emitting desperate screeches, Lide gestured with his hand, canceling the magic.
The spikes, losing the enhancement of magic power, began to crumble from the sky piece by piece, the Spider Queen’s massive form tumbling down.
Whew~
A Magic Shield rose around Lide, warding off the dirt kicked up by the fall.
The dust settled.
The two rulers from the Spider Planes lay neatly collapsed on the ground, utterly defeated and as lifeless as dead fish.
The eyes of both Transcendent spiders, as they looked at Lide, were filled with unquenchable rage and unmistakable terror.
Lide’s frightening strength had exceeded their wildest imaginations; these creatures, who ruled hundreds of millions of Cave Spiders, had no power to resist this horrifying and bizarre life form.
Hiss hiss~
The Extraordinary Spider Queen let out several agonized cries, which faintly conveyed a willingness to submit.
Creatures that reached the Transcendent level possessed a certain intelligence, and Cave Spiders were not known for their tenacity.
Many Dark Life creatures from the Underworld enjoyed keeping such monsters to guard fortresses or mazes.
However…
Lide shook his head; it was unfortunate, but he already possessed a Death Spider Queen. Although the Death Spider Queen was of a lower level, it was sufficient as cannon fodder.
The role of the Cave Spiders had already overlapped with that of the Death Spiders, and he seemed to have no great need for their power.
By comparison, continuing to maintain the status of the Spider Plane as a pig farm of sorts could be of greater aid to him.
After all, the Power of Death could summon ultimate life forms like the Frost Giant Dragon, while the Cave Spiders… aside from being ugly, were good for nothing–especially the Ghost-faced Spiders, which were hideously appalling, likely to give a dog a fright just by standing in the yard.
But no matter what, these were still two Transcendent beings. Although they were weak, their level was significant.
If he were to kill them just like that, it would certainly be a bit of a waste.
Without hesitation, Lide stepped forward, speaking the blasphemous language as cold as ice,
“Submit, or be destroyed!”
The terror-inducing words of Ancient Extreme Evil were not meant to be understood by others; the meaning could be directly conveyed through a mental connection to the receiver.
Ever since acquiring this ancient language from Asreaga, Lide enjoyed using this tongue filled with an air of Extreme Evil to deal with such Dark Life creatures.
It was effective not just because they could comprehend it, but also because it exerted a tremendous psychic deterrence.
Hiss hiss~
With absolute clarity, both Transcendent spiders issued a straightforward cry of submission.
As a species not known for strong willpower, when faced with an overwhelmingly powerful being, submission was merely a survival instinct’s choice.
As for Lide taking the eggs from the Spider Queen… after laying eggs, even the Black Widow Spider would consume the male spider it mated with; such creatures were more driven by instinct, where survival instincts trumped all other priorities.
Seeing their reaction, Lide wasn’t too surprised. He extended his right hand, and the Power of Faith began to permeate the air.
With over five hundred thousand units of the Power of Faith, he felt confident. It was just a matter of subduing two Transcendents, right? Tonight, Mr. Zhao would pick up the tab…
The glow flared slowly but blindingly in the dim environment, the Power of Faith spreading like a tide towards the heads of the two spiders.
Both Transcendent spiders were already inclined to submit, and with Lide’s presence still overwhelmingly oppressive, they possessed no will to resist. Hence, the Power of Faith smoothly began to transform their souls.
Ten minutes… Twenty minutes…
Half a Sunshine Hour later.
The Holy Light was dazzlingly brilliant.
Lide’s Power of Faith had just decreased by 200,000, leaving him with only 300,000 in the blink of an eye.
But in return, he had once again obtained two fighters of Extraordinary Level.
Although their combat abilities were nothing spectacular compared to his own, Extraordinary was still Extraordinary, and they were not something that a Level 19 could compare with.
After the baptism and transformation by the Power of Faith, the two spiders had silently returned to normal; even the two front limbs that Lide had forcibly ripped from the Blade Spider had started to sprout new growths, and they might soon regrow into formidable weapons.
Opening his attribute panel, Lide saw the properties of the two spiders appear before his eyes.
Blade Spider
Title: Blade Slaughterer (increases strength by 1000%, sharpness of forelimbs by 500%, attack speed by 200%)
Level: Extraordinary-lv20
Skills: Extraordinary Assassination, High-speed Flight, Breath Concealment, Bloody Slash, Rapid Slaughter, Silk Spitting.
Passive Skills: Extraordinary Bone Armor, Sharp Dual Blades, Intense Poison,
Special Skill: Spatial Concealment
Bloodline: Spider Bloodline (limb regeneration)
Rating: A Blade Spider with an innate talent for assassination, it is a hunter in the shadows, preferring to kill its enemies from behind.
Ghost-faced Spider Queen
Title: Ghost-faced Spider Queen
Level: Extraordinary-lv21
Skills: Super Strong Air Wave Shock Wave, Spitting Intense Poison, Resilient Spider Silk, Weakness Curse, Fierce Attack.
Passive Skills: Strong Body, Strong Bone Armor, Intense Poison
Restricted Skill: Spawn, Dominate Spider Swarm
Bloodline: Spider Queen Bloodline (enhances egg-laying speed)
Introduction: An Extraordinary Spider Queen with formidable abilities, capable of ruling the entire spider swarm, with every spider in the swarm unconditionally obeying her orders.
After briefly reviewing the skills of the two Extraordinary Spiders, Lide nodded slightly.
The roles of the two spiders were different; the Blade Spider followed the assassin’s path, while the Spider Queen took the dominion path. Both were quite useful and could be put to good use.
Especially the Blade Spider, as the Blood Pool had lacked a powerful Guardian since he had reassigned Frey, and the Blade Spider’s emergence undoubtedly filled this gap.
An Extraordinary Guardian to protect the most precious Blood Pool of the Bloodline, to guard the Divine remains within, was fitting for the current scale and strength of Dawn City.
As for the Extraordinary Spider Queen, her role was even greater.
The Spider Plane was a natural pig farm, and what he needed was for the Spider Queen to order all Cave Spiders to lay eggs diligently, then wait for the hatched Cave Spiders to mature and take themselves to the Land of Bone-Burying to be slaughtered.
It was that simple.
Those spiders that were above Level 15 would be kept for future battles when a large-scale war broke out.
Due to the unique nature of the Spider Plane, enslaving the Extraordinary Spider Queen was equivalent to enslaving the Spider Plane itself.
In this broken Plane, no third Extraordinary creature would arise, so no one would contest the Spider Queen’s position.
“Lead me to your nest.”
Having been transformed by the Power of Faith, the recent wounds had already fully healed. Lide could command the Extraordinary Spider Queen directly through the Spirit Imprint left inside her, communicating with her mind.
Visiting the nest was naturally to see if there were any gains to be had. The Divine Monster Asreaga had been found within the nest of the Spider Queen, and who knew if he would find another…
Such things were also unpredictable. Asreaga was a being who had survived since the Ancient times and had fought with Divine entities.
Most crucially, he had lost his memories before entering the Bronze Egg, so even he was unaware if he had left any treasures to restore his strength upon revival, and there had also never been a chance for a secondary exploration.
Asreaga was a Divine Monster, and any treasure left by such a terror would surely be extraordinary.
“Ssss~ As you command, master…”
Although the Spider Queen couldn’t speak, after the baptism by the Power of Faith cleansed her soul, she could still convey her thoughts through the soul mark in her mind.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen stood up and strode in another direction.
The Blade Spider, in turn, hid itself within the Dimension Plane.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen couldn’t fly, but her speed was nonetheless swift.
This colossal being climbed atop a towering mountain and then started swinging from place to place as if it were on a giant’s swing. The sight was reminiscent of… Spiderman?
An immense creature, 8 blades high and 20 blades long, swinging wildly between the mountains in the sky – it’s quite the indescribable scene.
Along the way, many a Cave Spider were smashed to bits by its movements, but the Spider Queen didn’t care in the slightest, quite domineering indeed.
Lide watched this scene with a rather complex expression.
A Spiderman swinging his life away was one thing, but a creature of your size doing it… that’s utterly terrifying.
About ten minutes later, the Spider Queen abruptly released the webbing from her posterior and the giant body plummeted from the sky, landing with a thunderous boom that caused the nearby ground to tremble.
A twitch came to Lide’s mouth; he couldn’t shake the feeling that few around him were anywhere near normal…
Looking down slightly, he saw a small valley below him filled to the brim with Magic Crystal Stones piled up like a mountain.
It was the very Spider Nest he had encountered the last time he had breached the Spider Plane.
The valley was four to five hundred blades in length and width; one could only imagine how extravagant it was to fill such a large area with Magic Crystal Stones.
Ssss~
The Extraordinary Spider Queen made two shrieking sounds and then gestured towards the valley as if presenting a treasure,
Lide, who felt somewhat covetous when he first saw this sight, didn’t react much this time.
Having seized the Magic Crystal Vein, these Magic Crystal Stones, although numerous, were somewhat less impressive to him.
But since he was here, these Magic Crystal Stones obviously couldn’t go to waste on this creature.
“Have the Cave Spiders carry these Magic Crystal Stones out to the outside of the space passage. Leaving one-tenth should suffice for your use. If that runs out, report back to me.”
“Yes, master…”
After passing the message to the Extraordinary Spider Queen, though she seemed reluctant, she decisively carried out Lide’s commands. A loud scream later, a dense swarm of Cave Spiders appeared from afar and, like ants moving house, began to carry the Magic Crystal Stones out.
Lide watched with satisfaction; these creatures might be ugly, but they were quite good at toiling away.
After a thought, he turned his gaze back to the Extraordinary Spider Queen.
“Last time I was here, I obtained a Bronze Egg from you. Have you collected anything similar?”
That Bronze Egg was a precious treasure that hatched a Divine Monster, previously a Bronze Dragon egg that Asreaga had occupied.
“Something similar?”
The Spider Queen thought for a moment and then shook her head, “Master… I only found that one egg…”
Registering the information conveyed by the Spider Queen, Lide raised an eyebrow. He had only asked on the off chance, not too concerned about it.
After all, acquiring Asreaga alone was proof of the Goddess of Luck’s favor.
But just as he was about to remove his focus, the next piece of information from the Spider Queen caused his expression to stiffen.
“But, near where I found that egg, I sensed a Magic Crystal Stone that scared me a lot… It seemed like it wanted to devour my soul…”
Oh??
Devour the soul??
Lide’s interest piqued, “Take me to see it.”
The Spider Queen shook her head, “It is no longer in its original place…”
“Then where is it?” Lide asked, puzzled.
“I brought it back…”
Can I… not engage in such pointless talk?
Lide’s face was full of straight lines, doubting the intelligence of the Spider Queen…
“Find that magic crystal stone.”
“Yes…” After responding, the Spider Queen turned and directly entered the valley, beginning her search.
Lide watched the other party carelessly rummaging through the magic crystal stones, his mouth twitching again, as the slight interest that had just risen instantly vanished.
Could this creature really discover anything valuable? He was very skeptical.
These arthropod monsters were just like this; although they possessed intelligence, they also had a measure of stupidity. They might be good for fighting and dying, but hopeless at doing anything else.
After three Sunshine Hours, the cave spiders had moved away most of the magic crystal stones in the small valley, and the Extraordinary Spider Queen was still searching inside.
Just as Lide’s patience was running out and he was ready to leave the Spider Plane, the behemoth finally seemed to have found something. She turned around with a crystal stone the size of a thumb in her mouth, as if offering a treasure, and exited the small valley.
“Master~ I found it.”
Receiving the information in his mind, Lide blinked in astonishment, for he had not held out any hope that she would find anything.
Looking at the giant mouth, on which the magic crystal stone seemed no bigger than a grain of rice to the Spider Queen, Lide waved his hand and summoned Mage’s Hand, then plucked the stone from the Spider Queen’s mouth.
When he took the grey, inconspicuous magic crystal stone into his hand, he couldn’t help but feel disappointed.
There was nothing, not even a trace of magic power to sense, let alone something that could devour souls–it was just a plain, semi-transparent stone.
“Could this…be a mistake?”
Lide, having not figured out the rationale, opened the attribute panel with the mindset of taking one last look.
But with just that glance, his eyes widened to the extreme.
Fragmented Divine Status
Quality: Special
State: Fragmented/Asleep (requires one million Dark Faith Power to activate)
Description: A fragmented divine status that still harbors the power of “Twilight Divine Position,” requiring a massive amount of Dark Faith Power to activate.
Am I freaking blind??
Lide’s eyes bulged, his face filled with disbelief.
It was actually a divine status?!!!
He was just blindly groping for a dead mouse to see if there were any good things left where the Divine Monster had been.
But wasn’t this too outrageous??
A divine status, just tossed on the ground like trash, only to be turned up after much searching??
If he hadn’t asked that question today, would this item have been overlooked?
“Asreaga, that wasteful creature, had hidden such a thing only to forget about it, what a waste…”
Lide was somewhat heartbroken, yet his expression was ecstatic.
This divine status existing here was definitely Asreaga’s doing; besides that Divine Monster that could clash with divinities, who else would throw a divine status on the ground? Moreover, it was found next to that Bronze Egg.
This was undoubtedly a contingency Asreaga left for himself, to use for a rapid recovery of power after resurrection.
But surprisingly, after so many years, that one never had the chance to revive, and after his own resurrection, he also lost his memory, causing this precious divine status to be hidden away by an arachnid that couldn’t count.
“Quick, keep searching, look for things that have a similar aura to this magic crystal stone!
Also, immediately mobilize all cave spiders to find any items with unusual auras, search the entire Spider Plane for me!”
Lide naturally wouldn’t stop there; he ordered the Spider Queen to continue the search. Even though the chance was slim, such an item was worth any price, let alone a simple search.
Hiss~
Upon receiving Lide’s instructions, the Spider Queen immediately started issuing commands, and in just a few breaths, all the spiders on the Plane set into motion.
All sorts of odd items were brought to the foot of the small hill for Lide to choose from.
Lide, while discerning among them, focused his attention on the fragmented divine status in his hands.
Even knowing it was divine status, he still couldn’t sense anything from it when his spiritual power spread out, as if indeed it was just a stone.
A frown briefly creased his brow as the Power of Death surged in, but the Divine Status didn’t react at all, as if it had no need for such power.
After a slight pause, Lide began to convert it into the Power of Faith instead,
however, to his surprise, a severe corroding noise ensued as the Power of Faith touched the Divine Status. The dark Godhood trembled, showing extreme resistance and repulsion.
Lide stopped for a moment, looking somewhat regretfully at the attributes above.
To activate it requires 1 million Dark Faith Power.
He had just tried it out, but it still did not work.
Dark Faith Power… What he possessed was the pure Light Faith Power, completely opposite to Dark Faith Power.
Only evil faiths could produce Dark Faith Power, such as the slaughter, blood sacrifice, and world destruction worshiped by Evil God believers, which generate Dark Faith Power.
Lide’s brows were tightly knotted.
It was easy to handle Faith Power, but Dark Faith Power undoubtedly presented him with some difficulty.
The Dawn Sect’s foundation had already been established, and he certainly couldn’t just transform it into a Dark Sect, could he?
The loss would definitely exceed the value of this Godhood; it would not be worth it.
After pondering for a moment, a light suddenly flashed in Lide’s eyes.
Where is this?
This is the Underworld.
What’s abundant in the Underworld?
Dark Races, of course. Races like Half-Elves, who are neutral, are the absolute minority in the Underworld, with most being purely Dark Races.
To acquire Dark Faith Power, why bother changing the Dawn Sect? Couldn’t he just preach underground?
“But to preach in the Underground, there’s a very important point – I can no longer use the name of the Dawn Sect, otherwise, even Dark Creatures could only generate Light Faith…”
After thinking it over, Lide’s eyes gradually lit up.
“I don’t need to always stick to the Dawn Sect… Why can’t I create a new Sect for preaching?”
“I already have so many disguises, one more wouldn’t make a difference…”
Once he figured out this key point, Lide’s thoughts became clear, and a myriad of ideas began to rise.
After rubbing the Godhood for a moment, Lide’s eyes squinted slightly, the brightness in them flickering uncertainly.
“Godhood, Divine Position, Divine Calamity – these are the most precious items of Glory.
Especially this Divine Calamity, its value could even exchange an entire human country.
No matter the cost, it must be activated.
If I could assimilate this Divine Calamity, my strength would increase to an unprecedented level…
By then, let alone Extraordinary, even Legendary beings would be inferior to me.
At the juncture when the Ancient days are upon us, this Godhood couldn’t have come at a better time. Lurking in the abyss, the God of Plague is still eagerly watching, and if this ancient Evil God manages to descend to the Main Plane when the old days come, it will desperately seek to destroy Dawn City…”
Lide immediately made up his mind, setting his next target – the Underworld.
No one could shake his resolve.
And whether it was for activating the Godhood in his hands or the strategic planning for the upcoming war in Dawn City, conquering the Underworld had become inevitable.
This was truly a colossal gain.
Lide’s smile simply could not be subdued, his steadfast heart overwhelmed by joy.
—
—
—
Having acquired the Godhood, Lide stayed in the Spider Plane for a full three days.
He carried out a thorough search to ensure that no other treasures were missed.
Divine Status was too precious, and Lide feared missing anything that hadn’t been found yet–that would be a terrible loss.
But in the end, the Cave Spiders turned the entire Plane inside out, and even after several dozen small hills of strange items had piled up in front of the small valley, no other treasures were discovered.
Seeing this, Lide had no choice but to call off the search, while also instructing the Spider Queen to send out a team of Cave Spiders to search for a long time.
Putting aside the acquisition of Divine Status for the moment, in the past few days, Lide had gained a deeper understanding of the Spider Plane.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen was born from the death of the previous generation, and the Spider Plane only had two Extraordinaries; the others were, at most, Level 19.
The most important point was that all spiders on the Spider Plane could be considered the offspring of the Extraordinary Spider Queen.
It wasn’t that all these spiders were her direct children. Rather, the Extraordinary Spider Queen would birth the second generation of spider queens, whose levels hovered around 15. These spider queens would then lay eggs, from which the common Cave Spiders would emerge.
Among them, the Level 15 Magic Spiders and Bone Armor Spiders were all birthed from the eggs directly laid by the Extraordinary Spider Queen, altered through mutation.
But what she birthed most were the common spider queens.
At present, the entire Spider Plane had about 200 common spider queens, each capable of laying 200 spider eggs a day.
With 200 queens, that’s 40,000 eggs. In other words, in a month with thirty days, 1.2 million eggs could be laid, amounting to 14.4 million in a year.
Moreover, the incubation period for Cave Spiders was short, hatching in just a month, with adulthood reached two months thereafter.
In other words, a Cave Spider took only a total of 3 months from hatching to reach maturity. Although this was much slower than the Death Spiders, which could consume the Power of Death and mature in less than a week after hatching, it was offset by the sheer number of common spider queens.
This was also why the Cave Spiders could keep pouring out ceaselessly from the Space Gate over the past year or so.
After understanding the reason, Lide decisively ordered the Extraordinary Spider Queen to continue laying eggs to increase the number of common spider queens to 1,000.
But the Extraordinary Spider Queen had her troubles, “Master, we cannot sustain such a large number of spiders…”
The Spider Plane had limited carrying capacity, and it was not possible to increase military assets indefinitely; this was an aging Plane, incomparable to the prosperity of the Land of Bone-Burying.
After some consideration, Lide promptly offered a solution.
“There’s no use just keeping these spiders. Issue the command,–apart from those needed to maintain the operation of the hive, all remaining Cave Spiders should attack the Land of Bone-Burying… that is, the Plane opposite the Space Gate.”
The inability to sustain them was due to the current too great stock on the Spider Plane. Once this stock was consumed, wouldn’t they be able to sustain them?
The current role of the Spider Plane was akin to a pig farm, and Lide did not care about these hideous Dark Creatures covered in fur.
He only needed the Power of Death, vast amounts of it.
The Power of Faith had already transformed the soul of the Extraordinary Spider Queen, who naturally complied obediently with Lide’s commands.
Although no more Divine Status had been found in these three days, a staggering amount of Magic Crystal Stone had been moved back to the Land of Bone-Burying.
This was also a considerable gain, worth at least 2 million Gold Pucks–though he had no plans to sell the Magic Crystal Stone.
As for the level of the Extraordinary Spider Queen… what did a mere tool need with a level? Simply be the diligent manager of a pig farm was enough; he didn’t need this queen for the battlefield.
However, another figure came as a slight surprise to Lide. He hadn’t expected that, after several major battles, there were now more than 200 Level 15 spiders in the Spider Plane.
The Cave Spiders that occupied a Plane indeed had a power that had slowly amassed over time and was not to be underestimated.
But compared to their tens of millions in number, it seemed irrelevant, and with over a million eggs produced each month, having a contingent of high-level combatants was only natural given such vast numbers.
The only pity was that the combat power of creatures such as Cave Spiders was not comparable to that of humans or Bloodline of the same level. Grote of Level 17 could easily kill twenty to thirty Level 15 Cave Spiders…
The gap was anything but small.
But having them was definitely better than not. It counted as a contingency here, something to unleash in the future if all else failed to absorb some damage.
By the time Lide had dealt with all matters of the Spider Plane and returned to the Land of Bone-Burying, it was already September 27.
Holding the gray Divine Status in his hand, his expression was quite pleased.
This trip to the Spider Plane was definitely a super massive haul.
He not only enslaved two Extraordinary Spiders and took control of the Spider Plane to establish a stable pig farm, laying a solid foundation for the future acquisition of the Power of Death but also acquired a treasure of immeasurable value–Divine Status, and one that contained a part of the Twilight Divine Position.
His Transcendent perception felt that Twilight Divine Position seemed particularly suitable for him… because the Twilight Divine Position has a very terrifying extension–Dark Divine Position.
No need to say more, the Bloodline was the darling of the night; without the land of light, they were the most formidable beings.
Therefore, Lide placed an even greater importance on this piece of Divine Status in his heart.
The current pressing task had shifted from accumulating the Power of Death to nurture the Frost Giant Dragon, to waging war in the Underworld for a new round of preaching, to obtain the Dark Faith Power.
—
—
—
Land of Bone-Burying.
Lide looked at the Extraordinary Giant Dragon soaring in the sky and felt very pleased. Everything he saw in the last couple of days seemed delightful to him, even the Cave Spiders didn’t seem that ugly anymore.
At this moment, a Blade Spider was lurking in the void behind him, while the Extraordinary Spider Queen continued to rule over the entire Spider Plane, orchestrating his grand pig-raising scheme.
Right now, Lide had no interest in lingering; he needed to return to Dawn City right away to formulate his plan for conquering the Underworld.
Spreading faith was the righteous path.
“Master… so many shiny treasures… Are these gifts you bestow upon me?”
As soon as he arrived in front of the massive pile of Magic Crystal Stones, Atlantis’s figure appeared beside him, a glint of greed and possessiveness in the eyes of the Frost Giant Dragon.
The greed for wealth was etched into the soul of dragons, even if they were undead.
“In the future, you may establish a Dragon Nest on the twin peaks flanking Dawn City. As long as you perform meritorious deeds in the future, I will reward you with treasures to fill your Dragon Nest.”
Seeing this scene, Lide couldn’t help but chuckle as he watched the Extraordinary Giant Dragon’s eyes light up with a single sentence.
“Master, you are truly great~ Praise you~”
Lide nodded slightly and gestured towards the Spider Plane.
“In a moment, a large number of Cave Spiders will swarm from the Spider Plane. You’re responsible for eradicating them.
Remember, do not enter the Spider Plane. Its Spider Queen has already been conquered by me. These Cave Spiders only become nourishment for this Plane if they die within the Land of Bone-Burying.
You may clear them out once every Sunshine Hour.
In a month, I will send someone to relieve you.”
“As you wish, my master~”
Atlantis responded proudly, still displaying a haughty air even while accepting the task.
Lide couldn’t be bothered to pay more attention to this creature. Having an Extraordinary being clean up those Cave Spiders was definitely more efficient and convenient than a few thousand soldiers.
After making the arrangements, he didn’t linger any longer and directly tore through space, appearing in the underground passage.
At this moment, Kapu was still waiting with a group of people, looking rather simple-minded.
“Good morning, Your Highness.”
“There will be no more Cave Spiders appearing here. You can dismantle the defense system here.”
Lide looked at the Level 18 Beastman King, who had accomplished quite a bit for Dawn City, and praised him, “You’ve done well during this time.
Next, the goal for Dawn City will be the territories beyond the Magic Crystal Vein. You will serve as Dawn City’s spearhead, leading our conquest of the Underworld once again.”
“This vast land will all fall under Dawn City’s dominion!”
To see is to conquer.
The next step for Lide was the entire Underworld.
Regardless of whether Divine Status appeared or not, he had already set his sights on the Underworld. It was just that the Divine Status made him speed up his pace somewhat.
The surface powers, after a long evolution, had already occupied most of the fertile lands, except for a few godforsaken places.
To acquire rich lands, one would have to stir up war.
But the Bloodline’s characteristics condemned them to being hunted by all humans once they were exposed.
One or two Bloodline members could still manage although they would draw the church’s attention. But once the Bloodline began to expand, that would become intolerable to any human–because Bloodline could only survive by consuming humans.
Other Dark Races, although fearsome, could live without humans and did not need to constantly cling to humans to suck blood.
Therefore, while humans still harbored hostility towards other Dark Races, it wasn’t as exaggerated. But with Bloodline, the relationship was almost entirely defined by mortal enmity.
The more numerous the Bloodline, the more humans would die, something no one could tolerate.
Moreover, as Dawn City developed, Lide could already feel that in the not-too-distant future, the city would inevitably hit a bottleneck.
Dawn City had passed the stage where a mere thirty to fifty thousand people could significantly boost its strength.
At this point, whether in terms of the number of humans or the expansion of power, the unclaimed territories of Dawn City were slowly reaching saturation.
Thus, the best option for Lide to expand Dawn City at this stage was the Underworld.
Although the environment here was harsher than the surface, the Underworld was teeming with a variety of races and life, and it also had abundant mineral resources to compensate for the resource scarcity that had always been a drag on Dawn City.
More importantly, the Underworld was now his to enjoy alone.
There was currently no intelligence indicating any surface power had appeared here.
This was too tempting–how much benefit would Dawn City gain from sole enjoyment of such a large cake?
According to intelligence gathered over this period, the Underworld was an irregular oval shape, approximately 4,000 kilometers in length and width.
The southern province was only 5,000 kilometers in length and even less in width, just 4,000 kilometers.
So the Underworld was a vast land comparable to the southern province.
The area that Dawn City had explored didn’t even account for 1% of this land.
At a time when turmoil was about to erupt outside, if the Underworld could be brought into the fold as Dawn City’s private land, then for a long time to come, Dawn City would maintain rapid development.
Of course, there was now an extremely important point–evangelism.
He needed to evangelize to harvest the faith of the Dark Life, and it took one million Dark Faith Power to activate Divine Status, which was no small number.
Of course, these plans envisioned by Lide would require him to carry out more precise operations.
After giving instructions to Kapu, Lide returned directly to Dawn City through the Land of Bone-Burying.
As for the Magic Crystal Vein, it would soon be connected by a fixed Space Gate, so there would be no need to detour through the underground passages to the Magic Crystal Vein in the future.
This fixed space, once opened, would be tantamount to having the Magic Crystal Vein located within Dawn City itself.
This was why Lide was willing to spend hundreds of millions of Power of Death to upgrade the Land of Bone-Burying to an Extraordinary level.
Having the ability to open Space Gates anywhere was of great assistance to Dawn City, even to an extent that Lide couldn’t fully describe.
The simplest comparison–work efficiency had improved more than twofold.
Previously in the mining area, the Magic Language Bats were needed to transport the ore; now, directly through the Space Gate, the mined ore could be hauled right in front of the Steel Refining Furnace,
completely omitting the long transit distance as if the Steel Refining Furnace had been built on top of the vein, which was more than just convenient to describe.
And there were countless similar situations, including construction stones from mountains could be mined and moved directly to the construction site, logistics supplies could arrive instantly…
Even now, Dawn City could be directly connected to Dwarf Valley through a Space Gate.
This significance was extraordinary, for it meant the Dwarf Valley was directly integrated into Dawn City.
It was this unreasonable; a Space Gate could link two cities thousands of kilometers apart directly together.
For trade, cultural exchange, this level of convenience had unimaginable benefits.
Departures from Dawn City would be greatly reduced in the future, significantly minimizing the risk of Dawn City being discovered by outsiders.
The Blood Pool.
After returning to Dawn City, Lide did not go back to City Hall but headed straight to the Blood Pool.
Both paths by the Blood Pool were now lined with Magic Crystal Stones, from which energy visibly dissipated and was then slowly absorbed by the fresh blood in the Blood Pool under some special aroma.
In the central area sealed by stone doors, the resting place of the Holy Spirit, Lide could still sense the rich energy contained within.
However, his purpose today was not to inspect the Blood Pool, but to leave the Extraordinary level Blade Spider here.
As the foundation of the Holy Light Bloodline, the Blood Pool, which contained treasures like the remains of the Divine, had previously been woefully insufficient in its defenses, but the presence of the Blade Spider could compensate for the lack of high-end combat force.
After giving orders to the guarding Bloodline members, Lide left amid the excited and admiring gazes of several Bloodline descendants.
At this moment, his entire focus was on the shattered Twilight Godhood; he had no time for other matters.
Upon tearing the space, Lide appeared directly in Harrison’s office and his first words to this capable subordinate made him widen his eyes in shock.
“Harrison, I’ve acquired a Divine Status…”

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - Chapter 398: Chapter 400: Conquering Black Iron Castle, Defeated Without a Fight (7800 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 398: Chapter 400: Conquering Black Iron Castle, Defeated Without a Fight (7800 words)
Hearing Lide’s words, Harrison’s expression was truly marvelous.
He even began to doubt if he had misheard. What was Divine Status? The most fundamental power of a Divine being, its value simply indescribable in words.
But now… Lide was saying he had obtained one. Could such a thing be so easily acquired?
“Your Highness, are you speaking of Divine Status?”
Watching Harrison’s astonished expression, Lide felt a bit of schadenfreude. When he first saw the Divine Status, his expression wasn’t much better than Harrison’s.
“Yes, a Divine Status containing the Twilight Divine Position…”
It even contained a Divine Position?!!
Harrison’s eyes widened further, his face filled with disbelief.
Was this equivalent to raiding the home of the Deities, or had he breached another Divine relic?
By the Creator God above, was he dreaming?
Seeing Harrison unable to recover for a long while, Lide began to recount how he had acquired the Divine Status with a smile. After listening, Harrison finally came back to his senses.
His face flushed with excitement, “Your Highness, you have surely been blessed by the Creator God!
Not only to subdue such a terrifying existence as a Divine Monster but also to obtain Divine Status!!
By the Creator God above, the Holy Light Bloodline will certainly become a race of Divine Descendants!”
A race of Divine Descendants, children of the Divine beings.
If one were to look at the current trend, it seemed the probability of Lide achieving Divinity was significantly increasing.
And as the direct Holy Light Bloodline, if Lide truly achieved Divinity, then without a doubt, they would be the biggest beneficiaries.
Divine Descendants were not just a fantasy.
“Let’s not entertain too many thoughts for now.”
Lide waved his hand. Becoming a Deity was still too far-fetched; even reaching Legendary status was a long journey ahead. The focus should be on increasing strength in preparation for the impending disaster of the Olden Days.
“Now, I need to obtain the Dark Faith Power to activate this Twilight Divine Status.”
“The best place to garner Dark Faith Power is undoubtedly the Underworld…
Half-Elf, Gray Dwarf, Dark Night Elf, Half-Beast, Cave Dwellers, Griffon… etc., all these races can help us gain Dark Faith Power.”
Harrison also steadied his emotions and, after a moment of thought, decisively said,
“Your Highness, conquering the Underworld was part of our plan all along, we can start immediately.
We’ll use our army to suppress resistance, and use faith to dissolve dissent. This land will be enshrouded in your radiance.”
“Correct, that’s exactly what I was thinking.”
Lide’s eyes blazed, “We need to conquer a city and then use it as a foothold to radiate outwards.”
“Are you referring to… Black Iron Castle?”
Harrison’s gaze sharpened, “The city established by the Half-body people is undoubtedly a core location in the vicinity of the Mire Swamps.
According to our intelligence department, there are many tribes and groups around, such as the Dark Night Elves to the south of Black Iron City, and the Half-Beast people to the north, all of which are tribes with powerful forces.”
Lide nodded thoughtfully.
“I had intended to erode the Underworld slowly, allowing this land, just like the Centaurs of the low hills, to become part of us under the economic influence of Dawn City.
But now with the Olden Days approaching, we are running out of time. Our corrosion plan can only be changed to a faster conquest plan.”
“The power of Dawn City has already become incomparable to the past, conquering this land is more than enough!”
“No matter how much power they hide, no matter how strong they are, the iron hooves of Dawn City will crush everything!”
Lide’s tone was calm, but the boundless domineering ambition within was enough to make anyone take notice.
With the power in his hands, he was able to face all challenges of the Underworld fearlessly.
“Your Majesty, your vision shall become the guiding light for Dawn City!”
Harrison bowed with his hand on his chest, his eyes filled with a fanatical worship that was even more fervent than that of zealous believers.
The speaker of City Hall had witnessed Lide ascend against the heavens step by step, growing Dawn City to possess several individuals of extraordinary standing; his trust in Lide had already reached the maximum even without the influence of bloodline.
Lide took a deep breath, his eyes sharp as a hawk’s.
“Harrison, issue the order immediately to assemble the army. Deploy all the legions of the King’s Blade for battle-ready status.”
“This battle will be the one to establish the rise of Dawn City, there is no turning back!”
The King’s Blade was an army Lide had built with his own hands, controlling all troops except for spellcasters and Bloodline.
This included the Dawn Wings, the Beastman Legion, the Centaur Legion, the Human Legion, and the Giant Legion.
Each legion differed greatly in number and strength.
The Dawn Wings, after several expansions, now numbered 5,000, equipped with 8,000 Magic Language Bats, of which 3,000 were responsible for airdropping Alchemy Bombs,
The other 5,000 were Magic Language Knights, armed with aerial crossbows, tasked with sniping enemy air units and protecting the bombing squadron.
The Beastman Legion originated from the Lion Tribe, with a total of 50,000 individuals, and in Dwarf Valley, there were an additional 60,000 Beastman Warriors ready to join the battlefield at any time, forming the main force for the underground campaign.
The Centaur Legion was dispatched from the Iron Hoof Department in the Dwarf Hills to resist the fierce Half-Ratmen, totaling 40,000, split equally between archers and heavily armored warriors.
The Human Legion, totaling 10,000, comprised archers, thieves, warriors, knights, and more, and was the most diverse profession-wise.
The Giant Legion, currently active at 1,200, consisted of 1,000 Double-headed Ogres and 200 One-eyed Giants, with over 10 individuals possessing combat strength above level 15, equipped with high-level standard equipment, a veritable iron flood.
Beyond these regular legions, the spellcaster forces were also exceedingly luxurious.
The number of Holy Light Bloodline members had already exceeded 2,700, with 2,000 of these being Blood Mages; the rest were Bloodsucking Sword Guards and Blood-colored Blades.
After over three years of training, the Mage Tower of Dawn currently had over 200 battle mages ready for the battlefield, all above level 5.
Although no level 10 Advanced Mages had yet been cultivated, the investment of resources Lide had spared no expense on made this spellcaster force formidable enough to astonish.
In other words, adding up all these tribes, the number of troops Lide could mobilize at any moment had already exceeded 100,000.
This did not include the Self-Destructing Spiders and troops that were not mobilized abroad.
So formidable was their might.
“At once.”
Harrison took his leave to carry out the order, and without lingering in the office, Lide directly tore through space and appeared in the Dawn Church.
This war would by no means be inferior to the Battle of the Five Armies at Risier City, and the entirety of Dawn City would mobilize for it.
However, unlike the last time, the Sect would play a significant role in this conflict.
He wanted the territory, and he wanted the Power of Faith.
Seeing Lide appear suddenly in the church, Nicole, who had not gone out, was somewhat surprised.
Now tall and gracefully shaped, the girl immediately came to Lide’s side and curtsied slightly, “Good day, Lord of Kachar~”
Those big, round eyes brimmed with joy; she had not seen Lide in a long time.
Lide smiled slightly at the sight, “Nicole, where is your sister?”
“Sister went to evangelize in the Underworld, Lord City Mayor, were you looking for her?” Nicole’s voice couldn’t help but hold a tinge of loss.
“No, looking for you is just as good,” Lide’s words brought an immediate smile to this vivacious girl’s face.
“We are about to dispatch troops to conquer the Underworld.
But unlike before, this time it’s not just for land and resources, it’s for faith.”
“For faith?”
Nicole’s delicate brows slightly furrowed as she looked at Lide with a hint of hesitation.
“But our missionary work in the Underworld is already on the right track, and it won’t be long before I believe many Half-body people will become your followers…”
“No,” Lide waved his hand, his gaze fixed on this charming girl, “This time, I need the faith of the Dark Race.”
“The Dark Race?”
Nicole was somewhat surprised, “But the dealings of the Dawn Sect are too transparent, rarely would the Dark Race betray their own camp…”
Actually, it’s not about betrayal but unwillingness, getting a group of bloodthirsty Dark Race to believe in a sect that advocates peace is like forcing lions and tigers to eat grass.
This is also why the Dawn Sect has only been able to spread among the Half-body people so far.
“No, this time we are not spreading the Dawn Sect.”
“Not spreading the Dawn Sect?” Nicole was somewhat perplexed.
“Twilight is approaching, the Multi-dimensional Plane will fall into destruction, the great God of Twilight is the eternal Main God, only He can save all people, His believers will obtain eternal life when the world perishes, heretics and unbelievers will be given eternal suffering by the God of Twilight.”
Lide solemnly recited a standard doctrine of an Evil God, watching Nicole’s bewildered expression, he slowly continued, “I will establish a new sect, and this sect will be named the Twilight Sect…”
“And you will cooperate with the Twilight Sect in evangelism.”
Nicole’s eyes widened in shock, “Lord City Mayor, you’re going to establish a new sect?”
Although she didn’t believe in sects herself, she knew that sects weren’t so easily established… otherwise, wouldn’t there be sects all over the world, and those humans who joined the Evil Camp wouldn’t be so well-behaved.
“There’s no need to worry, this evangelism is not about abandoning the Dawn Sect but to harvest the faith of Dark Life, hence the need to establish a new sect.
Nicole, your talent in management is rare, and this time you will accompany me to the Underworld; the Twilight Sect, in its early stages, will need your cooperation in management.”
Upon hearing this, Nicole’s eyes sparkled with excitement, accompanying Lide to the Underworld? Everything else was irrelevant; just this sentence had the girl raring to go, feeling as though the air itself became fresher.
“Yes, Lord City Mayor, Nicole will not disappoint you.”
“Go and choose some trustworthy and clever priests to accompany us.
After the troops are fully mustered, we’ll set out immediately.”
—
—
—
Black Iron Castle.
As a Half-body people’s city, it’s always been a symbol of prosperity, at least for the races of the Underground.
And now this belief became even more widely accepted.
For the overland power known as Dawn City brought to Black Iron Castle a plethora of precious materials, many of which were not found in the Underworld.
Interestingly, the distribution of materials brought by Dawn City was limited to only a few Half-body Nobles within Black Iron Castle.
Within just over half a year, these Half-body Nobles with business rights saw their power expand dramatically, and their private soldiers and guards even donned extremely valuable armor.
This made many half-body nobles green with envy.
Within a luxurious noble estate near the city center of Black Iron Castle, a banquet was especially lively.
The reason was that today, messengers from Dawn City, the respected Count Audis, invited all the city’s nobles to a feast, explicitly stating that Dawn City would choose more half-body nobles for collaboration after tonight’s dinner.
Even the city lord hurried over upon hearing the news.
“Did you hear that Lord Audis intends to reselect a few cooperative partners? I wonder if it’s true?”
“Do we even need to say it? The goods from Dawn City sell so well, the families who have been in partnership with them these past days have made a killing…”
“If His Excellency Count Audis offers the management rights to magic scrolls tonight, I’ll do whatever it takes to get in on that…”
“If I could get the management rights to weapons, perhaps my subordinates could upgrade to high-level equipment and longbows in half a year…”
The luxurious hall was brightly illuminated by magic lamps, as bright as the earth’s surface, with half-body nobles dressed in Dawn City’s luxurious clothes engaging in conversation with one another.
Most people were focused on tonight’s goal–the new distribution of management rights by Dawn City.
Dawn City, leveraging its powerful industrial strength, had been furiously dumping products in the Underworld recently.
The half-bodies didn’t know about the huge profits from dumping stock, only that they could get a piece of the action by working with Dawn City, so they were very cooperative.
Second-generation Bloodline Audis was sitting at the next seat at the central round table of the banquet hall. The seat of honor was empty; it was his habit because in his heart, only Lide deserved the seat of honor, even in his absence.
Watching the increasingly lively crowd, a barely concealable smile adorned the face of this second-generation Bloodline.
After Lide handed the Underworld over to him, he had not disappointed, managing it to thrive.
He not only secured a massive amount of resources for Dawn City every month but also ensured that the Dawn Sect could peacefully spread their beliefs in this land.
The smooth development of the Underworld had significantly raised his position within Dawn City.
For him, who had been almost invisible among the second-generation Bloodline previously, this was undoubtedly an event worth celebrating.
“Lord Audis, Sir Frey is looking for you…”
At that moment, a member of the Bloodline approached and whispered in Audis’s ear.
On hearing this, a flash of surprise crossed Audis’s eyes. Why would Frey show up at this time?
Doesn’t the Dwarf Hills need him to stand guard?
With a sense of astonishment, Audis stood up and after a brief exchange with a few half-body nobles, quietly left the bustling banquet hall.
Guided by the Bloodline, Audis entered the back hall, but at the moment he stepped into the room, his face revealed a hint of surprise.
“Your Majesty?”
Lide was standing with his hands behind his back under the brightly colored mural in the back hall, exuding an aura of elegance and composure.
Hearing the voice, Lide turned his head and saw Audis’s astonished expression, smiling faintly.
“What, don’t you recognize me?”
At this moment, Audis came back to his senses and quickly moved forward to greet him with a bow.
“Good evening, Your Majesty, I just didn’t expect you to arrive so suddenly.”
After speaking, his eyes slightly sharpened, as if recalling something, and he quickly followed up with a question, “Your Majesty, is there a task you need me to carry out?”
According to Lide’s character, he would normally appear openly and aboveboard; it was rare for him to arrive quietly incognito, hence Audis’s question.
“A task?” Lide laughed, “How about you become the city lord of Black Iron Castle in the future?”
Audis was no fool; his heart immediately tightened, “Your Majesty, are we planning to move against the half-bodies?”
“Tonight, all the high-ranking members of the Half-body race have arrived?”
Lide asked a seemingly irrelevant question, but Audis instantly understood.
“Your Majesty, everyone is here.
Tonight, we plan to bring in a few new partners to redistribute the interests. The Half-bodies we’ve supported before have been effective, so we’re taking this opportunity to expand our influence…”
“There’s no need to go through such effort anymore, after today, Black Iron Castle will only heed the commands of the City Hall.”
Lide’s gaze was calm, “I infiltrated this place to confirm whether there are any Extraordinary beings hidden within this city.”
“Extraordinary? Have you detected their presence?”
“This city doesn’t have any Extraordinary beings.”
Audis felt as if he had misheard, why did he detect a hint of regret in Lide’s tone?
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly, his expression somewhat nuanced.
With the power of Dawn City, overpowering this city wouldn’t be the slightest challenge, but after all, there were many hidden forces in the Underworld.
So, for the sake of safety, he came to confirm first whether Black Iron Castle had any forces that would exceed the army’s capability to deal with. Otherwise, if an Extraordinary being appeared at a critical moment, what if a Forbidden Curse was dropped down? How many men would he lose then?
But now, it seemed he had overestimated this city.
Indeed, Extraordinary beings with such terrifying combat power should be rare; it’s not normal for anyone to have several Extraordinary beings appear overnight like Dawn City does.
“Your Majesty, what should we do next…”
Before Audis could finish, the outer hall suddenly became noisy.
“Great Mage Mahari…”
“Lord of Collins, good evening.”
The hubbub outside seemed to herald the arrival of some important person.
Upon hearing this, Lide smiled faintly and strode out directly.
“Audis, come with me to meet the last Lord of Black Iron Castle. Afterward, this city will become a thing of the past.”
“As you wish, Your Majesty.”
A hint of excitement flashed through Audis’s eyes. The fact that Lide had broken through to the Extraordinary was no secret among the high-ranking members; knowing this, they stood tall with confidence.
Collins Grey Claw, a Level 18 Half-body, as the Lord of Black Iron Castle, was feeling a great deal of pressure lately.
Because the edge of Dawn City was too sharp.
Although the two sides were currently in a cooperative relationship, Dawn City had managed to support a few Half-body Nobles with their exceptional goods, Nobles who were previously not favored by him. These Nobles had gained so much influence recently, creating significant obstacles for him.
Moreover, the Dawn Sect had recently been fanatically spreading their faith, posing a great threat to Black Iron City’s own sects, to the extent that many people begged him daily to stop the other party’s preaching.
But that was not the key issue; the key was that recently, the other party also wanted to extend their influence into the army, a discovery that enraged him. The army was his taboo and something utterly intolerable.
So today, he specifically brought with him the protector of the Black Iron Mage Tower–the Level 18 Great Mage Mahari Grey Claw,
with the intention of suppressing the momentum of Dawn City and showing those despicable vampires who was the true master of Black Iron Castle.
“Where did that vampire go?”
The previous warmth and greetings ceased as Collins Grey Claw’s indifferent words rang out, silencing everyone.
Watching the domineering presence of Collins, all the Half-bodies sensed something wrong.
This did not seem like he came for a banquet, but rather like he came to accuse them.
This made many Half-body Nobles’ eyes dart about, starting to calculate in their minds.
“Audis! The damned vampire!!
The Lord of Black Iron Castle has arrived; come out and greet him immediately!”
At this moment, two Half-body guards behind Collins shouted loudly, their tone disrespectful.
The surrounding crowd buzzed with discussion, evidently surprised by this scene.
But no one responded.
The atmosphere was so quiet, one could hear a pin drop.
Tap tap~
Just as the atmosphere grew tenser, suddenly the sound of footsteps rose from the silent hall.
This immediately caught everyone’s attention.
Accompanied by the footsteps, a figure emerged from the back hall–an elegant demeanor like royalty passed down through millennia, with an almost perfect appearance–in front of everyone.
“Lord of Kachar?”
Collins was startled inside, a hint of apprehension rising in his eyes.
The last time they met, Lide’s terrifying presence had left him with palpitations to this day.
But seeing the Level 18 Great Mage behind him, his confidence returned.
A Level 18 Great Mage was undoubtedly Black Iron City’s trump card; he did not believe this vampire could stand against it.
“Lord Collins, is there a problem?”
Lide’s gaze was indifferent, and after scanning the crowd, he raised his eyebrows.
The strongest was just a Level 18 Great Mage… it’s really somewhat uninteresting.
Hearing Lide’s blunt words, a furious Collins slapped the table and rebuked Lide with a cold voice.
“Lord of Kachar, when we negotiated our cooperation, it was agreed that Dawn City would not do anything to harm Black Iron Castle.
Now, your people have crossed the line, not only supporting a portion of the Half-bodies against me but also planning to control Black Iron Castle’s army!!”
Lide suddenly recalled an interesting saying from Earth upon hearing this: if treaties weren’t made to be broken, then why sign them?
Unchanged in expression, he glanced around at the Half-bodies with varying expressions and said with a smile,
“What do you intend to do?”
Collins furrowed his brow, the calmness in Lide’s demeanor unnerving him, but still, he suppressed the strangeness in his heart and spoke,
“From today onward, all the trade cooperation of Dawn City can only be conducted with the City Lord’s Estate, and moreover, you have to request permission from the City Lord’s Estate before each preaching session, proceeding only after receiving approval.”
Lide gave the Level 18 Half-body a somewhat odd look upon hearing this.
This guy… wants to have it all?
“What if we don’t agree?”
“Don’t agree?” Collins looked at Lide, whose presence was as ordinary as any human’s, and his gaze turned cold, “No, Lord of Kachar, you will agree!”
The moment the words fell, the Magic Power of the gray-robed Great Mage beside him surged instantly.
His formidable presence was alarming.
Numerous Half-bodies around them felt like they were facing a wild dragon in the wilderness at that moment, the immense pressure making it difficult even to breathe.
“Hissss~ Great Mage Mahari is getting stronger and stronger!”
“Last month, I heard that Great Mage Mahari killed a level 15 Ghost Wolf with a single spell…”
“That’s terrifying, those two Vampires must have been scared witless by Lord Mahari!”
“Alas, what a pity, I was hoping to get some franchising rights from them, but now it all belongs to the City Lord’s estate…”
Amidst the buzz of discussion, not a single Half-body Noble thought Lide would refuse.
After all, this was the Protector of Black Iron Castle, an Advanced Mage whose level had reached 18.
Lide felt the pressure, his face showing some astonishment.
Is this it???
Seeing that Lide didn’t speak, Collins showed a hint of satisfaction, feeling quite sure about accomplishing today’s goal.
Even if the opponent could contend with Great Mage Mahari, he probably wouldn’t want to cause a conflict within Black Castle City, for this was still his territory. Once a fight broke out, he was confident he could take down the opponent.
“Now, I assume Kachar City Lord has agreed, right?”
Lide smiled, “I have a better idea…”
Seeing this, Collins felt a surge of triumph in his heart. When he first laid eyes on Lide, he thought a battle might ensue today, especially since Lide’s aura had been notably powerful last time.
But he didn’t expect the opponent to seemingly chicken out now.
The smile on the face of the level 18 Half-body City Lord became even more radiant.
“Go on, Kachar City Lord.”
But at that moment, with everyone in the hall watching, Lide said something that stunned the crowd.
“From today onwards, Black Iron Castle becomes the territory of Dawn City, and there will no longer be any need to discuss the distribution of rights.”
Collins’s face stiffened, “What did you say??”
A surge of intense anger flared up in his eyes, “City Lord Kachar, this is not the time for jokes.”
“Joking?” Lide’s smile slowly faded, and the gleam in his eyes, sharp like an eagle hunting its prey, was piercing and bright.
“Do you think you are worthy of joking with me?”
With that said, the entire room was shocked.
All the Half-body Nobles looked at Lide with indescribable expressions.
Had they heard wrong just now?
Under the coercion of an 18th-level Great Mage, this Vampire dares to say such things?!
Did he not fear the wrath of Great Mage Mahari???
But in the next second, an indescribable aura began to pervade the hall.
The sky fell, space twisted.
At this instant, everyone felt their souls quivering.
Collins, who had just been enraged, was now gazing at Lide with an utterly shocked look, as if the calm man he’d seen before was anything but ordinary.
If an 18th-level Great Mage like Mahari was a wild dragon in the wilderness, then the aura Lide now exuded was like that of an Ancient Evil God, a creature that slashed through countless planes with its sword, cutting a bloody swathe from the abyss.
Terrifying, invincible.
Beings from entirely different dimensions.
Lide’s gaze was cold as he watched the crowd; his Transcendent aura erupted at that moment. The oppressive might, like a deity seated above the ninth heaven, peered down upon all life.
No one could withstand this force, no one dared meet his eyes, no one dared trespass on his dignity.
Master of Crimson, when an enemy gazes into your eyes, they will be forced to undergo a Legendary Level willpower check. If they fail the will check, they will develop fear towards you, with All Attributes dropping by 20%.
Immortal King, when facing Dark Creatures with a Legend Level below 10, the opponent will fall into negative states such as fear, panic, and willpower weakening, with their attributes reduced by 20%.
Terrifying Presence, enemies will be checked for willpower every ten seconds; those below the threshold will fall into boundless fear.
Two titles, one aura-class Skill, instantly plunged the hall into endless fear.
Previously, before reaching Transcendence, beings of the same level couldn’t bear the combination of these three Skills emanating from Lide. Now, after becoming Transcendent, upon unleashing this power…
The effect was more than tenfold.
Thump-thump~ Thump-thump~
Amidst this cataclysmic aura, the Half-body Nobles’ legs went weak, and they collapsed to the ground, unable to muster any will to resist in their hearts.
This Vampire now truly seemed like a harbinger of Death, causing their souls to tremble.
Too terrifying.
“Transcendent?!!”
The level 18 Half-body City Lord Collins Grey Claw’s eyes went wide with disbelief and horror.
He couldn’t have imagined that this Vampire was a being of Transcendent level!
Endless fear engulfed him, and a profound regret rose within. If he had known the opponent was Transcendent, not only would he not have threatened him, but he wouldn’t have even sought an audience…
Great Mage Mahari, under this cataclysmic pressure, clenched his teeth and circulated his Magic Power. As a Great Mage, his will was still steadfast.
He couldn’t just admit defeat. Resist, he must resist!
“Is this all?”
Lide looked on indifferently, then without further ado, he extended his right hand, and the Power of Crimson immediately flared.
And in front of everyone’s shocked gaze, his five fingers gently clenched into a fist.
*Pop!*
A burst of blood, and the Death Flower bloomed.
The level 18 Half-body City Lord was blown to pieces on the spot.
The room fell into a profound silence instantly. The Half-body Nobles’ inner fears multiplied at that moment by tenfold, a hundredfold.
Leeaving the City Lord’s title aside, this was an 18th-level Half-body!
18th level!!!
There were only two like that in the entire city.
And now, right before everyone’s eyes, one was crushed to death.
Dying without a shred of dignity, like a worm squashed on the roadside.
What use was their resistance???
The Half-body Nobles’ self-esteem sustained a fatal blow.
Seeing this, Mahari’s heart skipped a beat, and his legs gave out; he fell to his knees as the magic power he had mustered scattered.
With the thick smell of blood in the air, everyone who looked at the elegantly standing Lide was shrouded in fear.
It was as if they were looking upon an Evil God…
