These words immediately made the attendees look solemn, but he continued without hesitation.
“The Naga are not an indigenous race of the Underworld, they come from the Abyss, and they have now found a way to reopen the once-destroyed Space Gate.”
“The most critical point is–the Black Dragon of the Mud Swamp has also joined them.
That Black Dragon has touched the pinnacle of Transcendent, and if the Naga opens the Abyss Gate, it’s very likely he’ll immediately break through to Legendary.
Once the Black Dragon becomes Legendary, then no one in the Underworld will be able to stop it.
If the Black Dragon then uses the power of the Naga to conquer the Underworld, dominion over it will belong to them.”
Lide swiftly summarized the entire situation.
Those present were no fools–except for maybe the Naga… The threat was immediately apparent upon hearing this news.
If the Naga truly achieved their goal, the army of Dawn City would have to retreat from the Underworld.
By then, let alone preaching, even the Magic Crystal Veins they were currently mining might be snatched by the Black Dragon.
One could easily sense the enormity of the crisis this posed, and if it happened, it would be an unacceptable loss for Dawn City.
The importance of the Underworld had already become increasingly apparent, and at this critical juncture, whoever tried to seize control of it from them was digging at the roots of Dawn City!
This was intolerable.
“City Lord, how much longer until the Naga open the Space Gate? And where is the Black Dragon now?”
Nicole stepped forward, her delicate and stunning face bearing a hint of inquiry.
“If we can find out where the Black Dragon is, can we attempt to assassinate him first to avoid future trouble?”
This spirited girl instantly grasped the key point: the Black Dragon.
If the Black Dragon were eliminated, even if the Naga managed to open the gateway to the Abyss, they might not be able to do much to Dawn City.
This was a bold yet potentially effective strategy.
The eyes of the people around her lit up.
However, the Level 17 Naga shook his head. “The Space Gate will be opened in about half a month.”
“The Black Dragon has always lived in the Mud Swamp, and only the Chief has the method to summon him. Including myself, all of the Naga are unaware of the Black Dragon’s exact location.”
At this, everyone fell silent; it seemed they had underestimated the difficulty of this war.
Nicole didn’t give up despite this, her bright eyes shifting as she continued.
“If that’s the case… You could use your authority to claim you’ve found a treasure lost by the Naga Tribe or discovered the materials needed to construct the Space Gate.
Lure the Naga Chief out from the Naga Tribe.
Once we ambush and defeat him, couldn’t we then obtain the method of summoning the Black Dragon?”
And if the City Lord were to subdue the Naga Chief, perhaps, like ruling the Centaurs, we could directly use the Naga Chief to govern the Naga Tribe.
As a result, not only would we avert the looming crisis, but we would also gain a significant ally.”
Lide looked at the girl who was presenting her ideas with a smile; he couldn’t help but admit that the girl’s mind was indeed agile.
“Do you think it’s feasible?”
The crowned Naga, upon hearing Lide’s query, pondered for a moment and then smiled bitterly as she shook her head.
“Master, the Chief has already gathered all the materials; currently, she is setting up a Magic Array. The most crucial thing now is to open the Space Gate. Nothing can make the Chief leave, not even a Divine Artifact appearing.
So this method won’t work either…”
After two suggestions were successively rejected, Nicole did not lose heart and continued.
“Then, can you disguise yourself and infiltrate the Naga’s stronghold to steal the materials for constructing the Space Gate, or use Alchemy Bombs to destroy it…”
Lide was amused by what he heard; this young girl sure had many bizarre ideas.
“No one can enter the Chief’s sanctuary, not even me…”
“Can we poison them? Just poison all the Naga to death…”
“Can we lead trouble elsewhere? Draw other monsters to the Naga’s stronghold…”
“Can we…”
What followed was Nicole continuously coming up with ideas. This girl’s agile thinking and cunning approaches from various angles widened everyone’s horizons–were there really such sly maneuvers?
The only pity was that, while most of her ideas sounded great, they had low feasibility.
When Nicole finished speaking, there were actually a few good plans that Lide approved of.
Like luring a few important missions from the Naga Tribe and then using the Power of Faith to convert adversaries so that they would betray their own during a crucial moment.
Or having the crowned Naga carry Alchemy Bombs back and then wait for the right moment to bury them beneath the city walls and blow them up during a critical time.
These two plans were highly feasible because of the crowned Naga’s status.
Lide’s approval brought a sweet smile to Nicole, sweeter than honey.
The other experienced veterans were not idle either; based on their own insights and experience, they began offering various opinions. Although they were not as clever as Nicole’s, theirs were more practical.
After a day, once everyone had expressed their opinions, Lide took everything into consideration and made the final decision.
“Although the information we have received is that the Space Gate will be successfully constructed in half a month, no one knows if this is just misdirection by the Naga Chief.
For safety, we must attack the Naga’s stronghold in a week!”
“This war is to seize the rule of the Underworld. Dawn City must achieve victory no matter the cost!”
Lide’s gaze was sharp as a blade, his tone firm and unshakable–a death order, leaving no room for negotiation.
With the tone set, the specific commands followed.
“Kapp, you will command all the Beastman armies, and in my absence, you are responsible for coordinating the troops and commanding the attack.
Also, immediately send a message back to Dawn City, instructing Harrison to prepare the siege engines, and order the Alchemy Factory to spare no expense in producing the best, most powerful Alchemy Bombs.”
“Yes, Your Highness.”
“Audis, you are in charge of leading the Magic Language Bats and Dawn Wings; in the upcoming battle, you will be the main force–don’t disappoint me…”
Audis stepped forward, his expression utterly solemn, “By your command, Your Highness.”
Lide’s tone didn’t falter as he turned to the 18th-level Half-Elf Mage, “Mahari, you are responsible for mobilizing the followers of the Twilight Sect in the rear, getting those with strong combat power from the Dark Race to also join this war.”
“As you wish, Your Highness.”
“Naga, I will act alongside you next; we must lure out more of the Naga elite in the shortest time.
These Naga will become your protectors and helpers within the Naga Tribe.”
“Yes, Master.”
Nicole, who had been eagerly waiting for her own orders, suddenly pouted pitifully at Lide when none came; however, the girl dared not speak up, as this was not the occasion for talking back or acting spoiled.
“Kedri Sharp Tooth, you will lead the priests of the Twilight Court, supporting the main army in the attack!”
The now extremely powerful super Cave Dweller nodded, his voice filled with a fatalistic fervor.
“Your Highness, fighting for you is everyone’s honor!”
From a weak Cave Dweller to being endowed with this devastating power, others could not fathom how profound this Cave Dweller’s devotion to Lide was.
Even if Lide asked him to die, the Cave Dweller would not hesitate.
After making the arrangements, Lide nodded slightly. Out of the corner of his eye, he noticed Nicole still pouting and couldn’t help but smile slightly.
“Nicole, this time I will assign the Giant Army to come here, and you will command the Giant Army in the attack.”
Upon hearing the command, Nicole, who had just felt aggrieved, immediately smiled radiantly. If it weren’t for the crowd, she would have definitely jumped up in celebration.
The entire Giant Army had been trained by her.
Furthermore, this was the first time she had been permitted to participate in Dawn City’s external warfare; taking command of the Giant Army undoubtedly constituted Lide’s greatest recognition of her, which delighted her even more than the command itself.
“Understood, Lord of Kachar City!”
Seeing Nicole’s happy demeanor, Lide spoke solemnly, “This is a very important mission. If it is not completed, military law is no joking matter.”
Military matters must not be taken lightly. If Nicole’s performance had not won his approval, no matter what, he would not have delegated the command of the Giant Army to her.
“Yes, I will complete the mission decisively!” Nicole responded firmly and cleanly.
Lide, seeing this, did not elaborate further. The training over the past few years was not only for Nicole to grow up but also greatly honed her own abilities.
After arranging Nicole’s duties, the initial framework was set up.
As for the more detailed tasks, such as which legion would lead the main attack, how to use siege engines, how the reserves should prepare, and so forth, these detailed arrangements would naturally be handled by a more professional military command.
As the dominator of Dawn City, he only needed to control the general direction.
After everyone had left, Lide sat alone in the main hall, frowning at the empty surroundings, and then sat down to meticulously sort through the threats he might face during this period.
First and foremost was the most urgent crisis — the Ancient Arrival.
No one and no records had ever noted anything about the Ancient Arrival.
The unknown is the greatest fear.
This was a concern that he constantly bore in mind due to its many uncertainties.
Although he had received vague information from Zhao Yue about snow covering the land and the blood moon rising at the time of the Ancient Arrival, it was still far from enough.
It was as if he knew that a major event would inevitably occur in a few months, but he didn’t know what the event would involve or what impact it would have. This uncertainty was the source of his anxiety and unease.
Therefore, he could only make the most of the last two months to prepare his strategies.
It was now November 5th. By late December or early January, it was traditionally the time when snow covered the land.
Realistically speaking, he had at most two months left.
Even more importantly – the Ancient Arrival would inevitably be accompanied by the arrival of the Ancient Evil God.
He hadn’t forgotten the God of Plague, that bringer of fortune.
This meant that in two months, he might very well face the threat of the God of Plague directly.
This danger was not as simple as it seemed; although he had gained the upper hand in their previous two encounters, that was in specific circumstances, and the God of Plague had not even exhibited 1% of his power.
Once he could descend to the Main Plane, it would undoubtedly be an unprecedented disaster for Dawn City.
At the very least, the centaurs of the Dwarf Hills would be forced to leave, and Risier City’s Fierce Half-Ratman would undoubtedly overwhelm the Dwarf Hills. The Iron Hoof Tribe, lacking natural defenses, could not possibly withstand the endless Fierce Half-Ratman.
According to this reasoning, once the Dwarf Hills fell, it would be akin to directly severing his arm.
Not only would his sphere of influence shrink, but the availability of various resources would also be drastically reduced.
Thus, he must prepare for a rainy day. Intensifying the storage of supplies was a strategy, and opening up new channels for resources was another.
The Underworld was vast and rich in resources; should the situation he anticipated occur, it could completely compensate for the loss of the Dwarf Hills. This was also a major reason why he was eager to conquer the Underworld.
After a brief summary, Lide confirmed the potential crises that might urgently arise in the near future.
1. The unknown catastrophe brought by the Ancient Arrival,
2. The direct threat of the God of Plague,
3. The shortage of resources after losing the Dwarf Hills.
Aside from the dangers brought by the Ancient Arrival, there were also several other troubling issues in Dawn City at present.
The most typical was–the population.
Although the population was sufficient for the short term, Lide’s vision for Dawn City was that of a vast city. Currently, with merely 150,000 humans, it was far from reaching that standard.
Even though Dawn City had recently taken in tens of thousands of Half-Elves, Centaurs, Beastmen, and other races, pushing the population just over the 200,000 mark,
for him, the core human population was still too low.
In two months, the Bloodline would once again embrace the first embrace, and the number of Bloodline would surge from over 2,700 to over 5,400.
And next year, even more remarkably, the number of Bloodline was expected to exceed 10,000.
This was an extremely exaggerated and frightening number. With a population of 150,000 supporting over 10,000 Bloodline, although it seemed more than sufficient, it was clear that development was being restrained.
So, how to continue expanding the population would also become a challenging issue troubling Dawn City in the next phase.
“Internal troubles and external threats, the current Dawn City may seem strong, but it still lacks some depth.
Conquering the Underworld would greatly make up for this deficiency.”
After careful consideration, Lide became increasingly certain about the importance of the Underworld.
Not to mention anything else, the fact that he was the only outsider here who could develop freely without restrictions was something incomparable to the outside world.
As long as he conquered this world, everything here would belong to him.
It was different in the outside world; even if he conquered the Dwarf Hills and strategized over Gale City, he would still face threats from the sea, humans, Beastmen, and the Fierce Half-Ratmen of Risier City.
This powerful geographical advantage was something the outside world lacked.
“Indeed, farming is the ultimate truth… While you all are fighting fiercely out there, I develop my farm here. When you are all desperate, wouldn’t it be perfect for me to come out and clean up the mess?”
After serious contemplation, Lide once again clarified his developmental direction for the next phase.
Rule the Underworld, farm the land!
There was no retreat to speak of.
Whether it was the Black Dragon or the Naga, even if they truly opened the Abyss, he would never give up.
This place was crucial for the future development of Dawn City following the descent of ancient times.
But just then, Lide suddenly felt a stirring in his heart.
He sensed a familiar presence calling him.
What was this?
He abruptly stood up, then connected his consciousness with the Land of Bone-Burying.
Moments later, an uncontrollable joy appeared on his face.
Emi had transcended the extraordinary!!
On the verge of battle, he now had another extraordinary combat power in his hands.
But just as he thought the surprises were over, another familiar presence emerged in his mind, calling out to him.
“Father God…”
Hearing that, Lide’s eyes snapped open; Divine Monster–Asreaga, the Divine Monster who had taken the arm of the God of Plague, and had been missing for over half a year, had finally awakened!
He immediately focused his mind, connecting with Asreaga through the Power of Faith.
Moments later, Lide’s smile was as brilliant as the stars.
“Hahaha, the return of two Extraordinary beings!
What does it matter if the Black Dragon has touched Legendary Status?
Let the bayonets clash, only then will we see who remains standing.”
It seemed that Emi and Asreaga had conspired to awaken at the same time.
At this critical moment in his dealings with the Extraordinary powers and the Naga Tribe, adding two more Extraordinary beings was undoubtedly a tremendous boost for the upcoming battle.
Moments later, Lide’s expression shifted; he noticed something was amiss.
By his calculations, the number of Extraordinary powers he could utilize had reached an astonishing five…
– Divine Monster Asreaga,
– Blasphemer Emi,
– Frost Giant Dragon Stran,
– Along with the Blade Spider,
– And finally, himself.
The Extraordinary Spider Queen should also be counted, but she was too clumsy for battle; having her lay eggs was enough.
A total of six Extraordinary beings, five of which could be mobilized for war.
After careful consideration, Lide suddenly realized.
He had unknowingly amassed such a terrifying force.
Five Extraordinary beings!
He could even directly take over Green City.
And he was so powerful that no matter if Green City was harboring other Extraordinary beings, they could only prostrate themselves at his feet.
With this thought, his previous concerns about the ancient descent vanished.
A lofty spirit arose in his heart.
No matter how mighty you are, in front of five Extraordinary beings, everyone must bow down.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - Chapter 406: Chapter 408: The Divine Monster Fused with a Divine Body, The Half-Elf's Fury (9400 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 406: Chapter 408: The Divine Monster Fused with a Divine Body, The Half-Elf’s Fury (9400 words)
Underworld, three hundred kilometers from Twilight City, lies a vast region shrouded in hundreds of kilometers of toxic mist.
This place is forbidden for living creatures.
Because the mist carries intense poison, most lives that come into contact with it fail to survive.
As time passed, few life forms ventured into this area anymore; those who understood left, and those who didn’t died.
The Underworld is vast but has a harsh environment. Regions like this one are not uncommon, which is why most of its living beings belong to the Evil Camp’s Dark Races.
Because good races simply cannot survive in such conditions.
Cruel, bloody, dark; jungle law that’s a hundred times more ruthless than the surface world.
The land is buried in sins unimaginable to outsiders.
However, contrary to outsider expectations, at this moment, in the center of this mist-shrouded area, below a mountain peak a thousand blades high, a city has been built.
It was so bizarre and shocking.
Upon closer inspection, the city carved into the recess of the mountain looked like a gargantuan abyssal beast lurking in the shadows, ready to hunt.
It sent chills down one’s spine.
The architecture of the city was extraordinarily peculiar, filled with an indescribable sense of eeriness, as if the structures didn’t belong to the Main Plane but had drifted in from a Different Plane.
The city walls were built against the flanks of the mountains, blocking the valley’s exits and keeping the entire city in a completely protected environment.
The walls, rising 50 blades high and made from massive stones, looked like inverted rivets. Instead of being smooth and even, they resembled spiked shields with thorns, appearing as if they were a gargantuan hedgehog magnified a thousand times.
Strange as the walls were, the battlements atop the walls were unlike those of human cities, looking more like inverted fangs, with their pointed tips facing skyward and exuding a strong sense of demonic architectural presence.
The two city gates below were enchanted with eyes of darkness, standing one on each side. These Dark Eyes emitted strong magic fluctuations, and no one could guess the powers they contained.
Just the city walls alone gave off an extremely dark and terrifying aura.
But that wasn’t all; the structures within the walls were even more bizarre.
Spread erratically inside were many tall, slender houses built from huge stones, with walls painted with red, twisted, and weird symbols.
Their tips were identical to the pointed battlements. Seen from above, the city looked like an abyssal beast opening its gaping maw, and the houses below were its sharp fangs.
Horrifying.
These were definitely not dwellings that a good race would construct.
Zooming in, the creatures bustling in and out of these buildings were precisely the Upper Race that Lide had long coveted–the Naga.
The numbers of these evil, cruel Dark Life forms were indescribable…
On the streets, on the walls, inside the houses… No one could have imagined that the infamous Naga of the Underworld had established a magnificent city, unbeknownst to all, within the deadly mist.
At this time, in the centermost area, within a 20-blade-high fang-shaped building, a dozen or so four-armed Nagas respectfully gazed toward the chief in the main hall, who was gently wiping a long blade.
This Naga leader had a crest on its head as well, but the Naga Chief’s crest was much more majestic than that of the crest-bearing Naga transformed by the Power of Faith dealt with by Lide.
In comparison, the crest-bearing Naga looked underdeveloped, while the Naga Chief now seemed like the true crown.
The Nagas below dared not speak while their chief was cleaning the blade, until after a long while when the Naga Chief paused slightly in its actions. One Naga then dared to step forward and report.
The Naga language was cold and menacing.
“Great Zali, we have opened the Space Gate that connects to the Abyss. Should we inform His Excellency Austin?”
The hair-raising voice circled the hall, and if Lide were here, he would have been utterly astonished.
Because the crest-bearing Naga had said it would still be half a month before the Space Gate could be opened, but the reality was obviously different.
Zali Blood Teeth–that was the name of this Naga Chief, this terrifying being who ruled over tens of thousands of Nagas.
The Chief’s narrow eyes narrowed slightly, glancing at the questioning Naga with a hint of chilliness.
“His Excellency Austin?”
The corners of its mouth curled into a cold smile.
“Do you really think that the great Naga need to cooperate with a Black Dragon??”
Ah? What??
All the Nagas looked at each other, all somewhat bewildered.
“Lord Zali, wasn’t it your proposal to ally with the Black Dragon?”
Alliance with the Black Dragon was a promise personally made by Zali of the Blood Teeth, so why the change of heart now??
Zali of the Blood Teeth shook his head, his eyes growing colder.
“Yes, it was my proposal, but the situation has changed.”
Honor? Such a gene did not flow in the blood of the Naga.
“We have opened the Abyss Gate ahead of schedule, which the Black Dragon must be unaware of, leaving us ample room to maneuver.
The Blood Teeth Naga come from the Abyss, why should we rely on the power of the Black Dragon to conquer the Underworld??
Do we not have our own people?”
As the Naga chief spoke, the chill on his face dissipated, his eyes instantly filled with indescribable excitement and madness. No race was as fickle as they were at this moment.
“I have already contacted the Blood Teeth Naga of the Abyss… This time, we are going to hunt the dragon!!”
Hunt the dragon?!!
The Naga in the hall were stunned by this declaration.
The Black Dragon Austin had touched the pinnacle of legend, whereas the most powerful life in the Naga tribes was the Extraordinary Level 20 Clan Chief before them.
Moreover, the breakthrough was recent, and his presence was still unstable.
One was on the verge of entering legend, having lain dormant in the extraordinary for hundreds of years, a terrifying entity, while the other had just stepped into the extraordinary and might not even fully wield his own power.
How great was the gap between them?
And now they were thinking of hunting that Black Dragon, an idea that was undoubtedly insane.
The races of the Good Camp could never do such a thing, but what about the Naga, a brutal Dark Race, cruelty and bloodshed their nature.
Cooperation with the Black Dragon was out of necessity, and doubtlessly, if they now possessed the power to resist the other, the promises made earlier could be discarded any time.
“The Blood Teeth Naga Tribe of the Abyss has agreed to join us in hunting the Black Dragon.
They will send their most powerful Extraordinary Nagas, and this time there will be as many as four!”
Zali of the Blood Teeth’s gaze was cold and murderous.
The Abyss is a higher-level Plane than the Main Plane, containing an immense amount of energy and existing for countless ages.
So, the Extraordinary that are rare in the Main Plane are not an uncommon sight within the Abyss.
Moreover, being an Upper Race with powerful talents, it was not difficult for the long-existing Naga Tribes of the Abyss to have several Extraordinaries.
“Clan Chief, four Extraordinaries??”
The Nagas below gasped at this revelation, and although the Black Dragon was formidable, he was not invincible.
With a good plan and the aid of four Extraordinaries, slaying a dragon was not an empty boast.
The prospect of bathing in dragon blood for benefits and glory made every Naga’s heart boil with excitement.
“After slaying the Black Dragon, the Blood Teeth Tribe of the Abyss will send new forces to help us conquer the Underworld!”
The Naga Chief’s tone grew more impassioned.
“We are a branch of the Blood Teeth Tribe of the Abyss, originally sent to the Underworld to conquer it.
Only, we did not anticipate the Space Gate shattering and losing contact.
So, starting from today, we shall merge once again into one tribe.
Backed by the support of the Blood Teeth Tribe from the Abyss, the Black Dragon is not worthy of alliance with us.
This bountiful Underworld will belong to us alone!!”
The Nagas below were all breathing faster.
Conquering the entire Underworld, this was almost the ultimate pursuit of all Naga.
The vast and resourceful land was only fit to be ruled by the noble Naga.
After the Naga Chief mentioned this plan, any Naga who initially had objections fell silent, with nothing but desire for the future and excitement to hunt the Black Dragon remaining.
“Chief, what shall we do next to proceed with the plan?”
Zali Blood Teeth didn’t immediately answer upon hearing this. Slowly, he put down the cloth he was using to wipe his long knife, then gripped the knife in one arm and fiercely slashed at the open space in front of him.
Whoosh~ The sound of cutting through the air was like a demon’s howl.
“Once the preparations in the Abyss are complete, I will notify you. Remember, we are not to discuss this matter with anyone!”
The icy tone made all the Naga startle, and they immediately responded in unison.
No one expected such a drastic change to occur among the Naga. Meanwhile, Dawn City was still preparing for the imminent war.
As soon as Lide sensed that Emi and Asreaga had awakened, he rushed back to Dawn City.
With the great war about to unfold, the addition of two powerful combat forces into his hands undoubtedly added important chips to the war’s balance, which was now beginning to tip towards victory.
Under Lide’s military orders, Dawn City, which already bore a hint of glory, began to spin in madness. Putting aside the construction of civilian life, the military side had fully entered a state of full-load production.
The Alchemy Factory, the Magic Scroll Factory, the Weapon Factory, along with their subordinate Crossbow Manufacturing Facilities, had all entered a stage of continuous full-load operation twenty-four hours every day.
These factories were producing a vast amount of materials every moment.
Some of these materials were stored, some were distributed to the army, and some were traded with the outside world to obtain more raw materials.
With a tight schedule and heavy tasks, the entire Dawn City was in an extremely busy state.
To Lide’s satisfaction, the City Hall, which had improved and evolved continuously, handled the situation with ease. Though Dawn City was busy, it was well-ordered and ran without major issues.
With the promotion of the Propaganda Department, most residents were aware of the crisis facing Dawn City and began actively participating in the massive production effort.
Having recently experienced several months of fighting the God of Plague in the Land of Bone-Burying, the residents were acutely aware of the danger and, thus, were exceptionally united.
Upon returning to Dawn City, Lide didn’t go to the City Hall to find the Speaker–Harrison–as usual but appeared directly in his own office in City Hall.
Looking at his familiar office, Lide’s mood brightened instantly.
After sitting down, with just a thought, the space in front of him shattered and then his office saw the appearance of two additional figures.
One wore a Priest’s robe, emanating powerful magic fluctuations, with a minor magic tide stirring up due to his presence.
The other was three blades tall, bare-chested, with muscles like forged steel exuding an intimidating sense of power.
Extremely evil ancient inscriptions were marked upon his skin. The Extreme Evil aura he exuded could drive ordinary people into madness and despair, especially those blood-red eyes that brimmed with indescribable brutality and bloodlust.
The blasphemer Emi, the Divine Monster Asreaga.
Seeing them, Lide smiled with satisfaction.
The return of two Transcendents, there was no greater surprise at this moment.
Subconsciously, he opened the attribute panels of the two.
Emi Kachar
Title: blasphemer (Damage bonus against Divine Position holders +300%)
Dark Walker (Gains an additional 50% attribute bonus in the night and shadows)
Age: 72
Level: Transcendent-lv20
Profession: Shadow High Priest
Restricted Skill: Extraordinary Shadow Control, Extraordinary Shadow Magic Perception, Extraordinary Shadow Devouring
Unique Skill: Shadow Voidification (able to freely enter and exit the Shadow Plane, and can transform one’s body into a shadow, immune to 99% of physical damage, immune to 99% of magical damage, duration 10 seconds, cooldown ten minutes)
Shadow Dominator (as the controller of shadows, dominating the power of shadows, immune to all shadow, curse, mental, soul-based magic, and casting shadow spells without magic power consumption)
Bloodline: Bloodline (gains the ability to vampirically heal physical injuries)
Magic: …omitted, a total of 52
Introduction: A powerful descendent of the Bloodline, once a blasphemer who attempted to explore the dignity of divine beings, a strong entity who walks under the cover of night and shadows.
One must say that Emi is indeed worthy of the title of Shadow High Priest; all his talents and spells are shadow-related.
And with two powerful unique skills – one nearly invincible for 10 seconds, one allowing the casting of shadow magic without the consumption of magic power – this is simply overpoweringly aberrant.
One can imagine, given Emi sufficient time to learn shadow magic, this Shadow High Priest would become the second super-cannon in Dawn City after him.
Lide smiled satisfactorily, looking downward at the attribute panel of the Divine Monster.
Compared to Emi, he was more expectant of Asreaga.
Agares Destruction
Title: God Eater, Curser of the Gods
Age: 2,689,878 years
Level: Transcendent–lv21
Divinity: 60 points (resurrection requires 5 points of divinity upon each death)
Profession: God Eater
Divine Monster Talent: Extreme Evil, Eternal Body (Perfect), Divine Monster Body, Space Mastery
Unique Skill: Divine’s Right Hand (devouring the right arm of a divine being, gaining terrifying strength. When attacking with the right arm, can penetrate defenses below Powerful Divine Power Level, can shatter equipment below Legendary Level.)
Bloodline: Extremely Evil Blood
Introduction: …
Contrary to Lide’s expectations, Asreaga’s skills hadn’t changed much, the biggest difference being the addition of a skill — Divine’s Right Hand.
But this additional skill was outrageous.
Able to penetrate defenses below Powerful Divine Level…
Divinity is classified as Weak God, Less-powerful God, Medium Divine Power, Powerful Divine Power, and then levels like the Life Goddess and Death God, which are of the Divine King tier.
However, the only known beings of the Life Goddess and Death God caliber are these two.
Thus, Powerful Divine Power is the pinnacle most divine beings in the pantheon could reach… so to be able to penetrate defenses below Powerful Divine Power… Lide could only describe it as outrageous.
Doesn’t that mean that Asreaga could pierce through any armor forged by ordinary gods in the future?
“Breaking through to Transcendent is not a qualitative change for Asreaga, who once reached the peak; it’s at most a partial restoration of power, so it makes sense there isn’t much change in abilities.
But this Divine’s Right Hand is too exaggerated.
Not only can it pierce the shields of gods below Powerful Divine Power Level, but it can also shatter equipment below Legendary Level.
Does this mean that Extraordinary Level equipment is like mere paper in front of this Divine Monster?”
Thinking back to the immense effort he once put into forging a set of Extraordinary Equipment, Lide couldn’t help but twitch at the corner of his mouth.
Now, the highest level of equipment in Dawn City, aside from the Inheritance Artifact, the Eye of the Ancient Evil God, was also just Extraordinary.
That meant the Divine Monster could easily destroy all the equipment in Dawn City…
This left Lide excited but also somewhat gloomy; having overly strong subordinates can sometimes be a headache, making the industrial system he had built seem somewhat insignificant…
Shaking his head, he thought no more of it.
Although Asreaga was alarmingly powerful, he was no longer the Lide of before.
With the Golden Ancestor Bloodline, he had absolute confidence in suppressing this once divine-battling monstrous being in a one-on-one situation.
“Good day, Your Grace.”
“Father God…”
The greeting from the two interrupted Lide’s thoughts.
Looking at his two generals, Lide felt pleased and first turned his attention to the Divine Monster.
“Asreaga, where did you go after you snatched the divine arm in Risier City?”
The guy had made him send people to search around the Dwarf Hills to no avail, which was really frustrating.
However, what the Extraordinary Divine Monster said next made his expression freeze.
“Father God, I pierced through the earth and have been slumbering in the magma beneath the surface blades…”
Is this even human language???
What does it mean to have pierced through the earth and to slumber in magma??
Just because you’re a Divine Monster, you can do such outrageous things?
Glancing out of the corner of his eye at the guy’s two skills: Eternal Body (Perfect), Body of the Divine Monster.
Then he fell silent; this millions of years old abomination couldn’t be judged by common sense.
Emi, standing nearby, twitched at the corner of his mouth.
He had only encountered Asreaga once when fighting over the divine body in Risier City.
Before coming, he had felt a bit of pride in himself, having broken through to the Extraordinary Level, and had wanted to compare himself with the legendary Divine Monster. Hearing these words, however, instantly snuffed out the small flame of defiance in his heart.
Such a freak… bathing in magma…
Not to mention when he had not broken through to the Extraordinary, even now the extreme and terrifying magma could hardly be endured for long.
Lide no longer paid attention to the Divine Monster, whose strength was freakish, and turned his gaze to Emi.
“Emi, how do you feel after breaking through to the Extraordinary?”
“Your Highness, I feel that my mastery over shadows has reached a pinnacle.”
A hint of intoxication showed in Emi’s eyes; the feeling of possessing absolute power simply couldn’t be described in simple words.
The Extraordinary, is a life form from another dimension.
Lide nodded slightly upon hearing this and suddenly, as if remembering something, he waved his hand lightly and space in front of him shattered once more, releasing two items he had sealed in the Land of Bone-Burying.
The horn of the God of Plague, imbued with the Twilight Divine Position.
The Divine Artifact that had been snatched from the hands of the God of Plague, sealing the eye of the Ancient Evil God.
Both of these items were treasures beyond measure in monetary terms.
Sensing the terrifying power contained within the two equipment, both of them brightened up.
The Divine Monster Asreaga even showed some interest in the eye of the Ancient Evil God.
He could feel that there seemed to be a powerful body of an Evil God sealed inside… there was an energy fluctuation inside that was identical to that of the arm he had devoured.
Emi did not have such strong perceptive abilities; he only felt that the horn of the God of Plague was very attractive to him.
After all, he had broken through to the Extraordinary by fusing with the divinity of the God of Plague, the Plague God Position was, in essence, the power of the God of Plague.
“These two pieces of equipment are both snatched from the hands of the God of Plague…”
Lide said, his eyes slightly strange.
God of Plague, that old Evil God is probably still dreaming of the day he comes to the Main Plane only to have his soul stripped and roasted over a fire.
He and the God of Plague were now truly mortal enemies.
“This is just the God of Plague’s horn, within which is contained the Divine Position of the Plague.
Emi, without a doubt, this equipment is most suitable for you; you should grasp the power of the Divine Position as soon as possible.
If my guess is correct, the Plague God Position might possess powers far beyond our imagination.”
He had made some guesses about the Plague God Position before; perhaps the Plague might not only cause death but might also make one stronger.
Many legends tell of plagues that give people superhuman strength while turning them into bloodthirsty demons, killing all life around them… If one were to remove the negative traits like loss of reason and amplify the increase in strength, would it still be considered a plague?
That was why Lide kept the Plague Divine Position for Emi–he didn’t have much time to research these matters.
After Emi took the horn, his face was filled with indescribable excitement; he could already feel that power calling out to him.
“Your Highness, I will not disappoint you.”
“Mm, go. Merge with it as quickly as you can. In a week, we will start the war against the Naga, and I need you in battle.”
“As you wish.”
Once Emi tore through space and re-entered the Land of Bone-Burying for seclusion, Lide handed the Ancient Evil God’s Eye to Asreaga.
Ancient Evil God’s Eye
Quality: Inheritance Artifact
Skills: Death Gaze, Lord of Black Magic
Special Skill: Ancient Inheritance (This is an eye of an Ancient Evil God that can under certain conditions be fused with one’s own eye to acquire the full power of this Evil God’s Eye. Note: This process will endure the erosion of ancient power.)
Lide possessed the golden Ancestor Bloodline, and his future achievements were boundless. Moreover, he didn’t need such external forces to enhance his combat strength, so he had no interest in this Evil God’s eye.
Originally, Lide planned to let Emi use this eye, but since Asreaga had already merged with and devoured an arm of the God of Plague… Seeing the near aberrant effect it had, fusing with an eye of an Ancient Evil God might bring him even greater surprises.
Lide was quite looking forward to this.
“Asreaga, an eye of an Ancient Evil God is sealed within this.
It might suit you.
Go, merge with it quickly. The upcoming war will be very fierce.”
“Yes, Father God…”
Asreaga was much more composed than Emi; having once stood at the pinnacle, such things were not particularly remarkable to him–indeed, he had owned things that were even better.
Although much of his memory was lost, the visceral feelings of his soul didn’t lie.
After both of them disappeared, Lide stretched lazily.
His confidence now was certainly not lacking.
Dawn possessed five transcendents with off-the-charts combat power, including a Divine Monster with ultimate fighting power among the ultimate fighters, which naturally left him in high spirits.
If it weren’t for the potential to cause tremendous trouble or attract legendary figures to take action, he would actually be tempted to directly lead his troops to take over Green City.
This large city with a population of millions had all the resources he needed.
Unfortunately, that thought remained just a thought; not to mention the messy religious forces within Green City, even the Nolan Empire’s Legends were something he couldn’t handle.
“I still need to continue developing my foundations. Once I have five Legends in my hand, not to mention Green City, even the southern provinces will have to be annexed into Dawn City’s domain.”
After briefly fantasizing about the future, Lide got up and went out to Harrison’s office.
Seeing Lide, who was supposed to be preparing for war in the Underworld, suddenly appearing, Harrison was taken aback. He quickly stood up and greeted him.
“Good day, Your Highness.”
“Mm, have you arranged the production of the siege engines and the corresponding equipment?”
“Your Highness, production has already started.
In five days, along with our inventory, we can provide 50 Tower Carriages…”
Lide waved his hand, “The Tower Carriages are secondary. How many goblin trebuchets that throw Alchemy Bombs have been produced?”
The goblin trebuchet was specially designed by goblins to throw Alchemy Bombs, the principle being that regular catapult stones are replaced with Alchemy Bombs.
However, after goblin refinement, the goblin trebuchet’s throwing distance reached an astonishing six to seven hundred blades, far beyond that of a normal catapult.
Lide was well aware of the power that Alchemy Bombs could unleash when boosted by catapults, so he had always instructed the Magic Industry Research Institute to improve the catapults.
The current generation of goblin trebuchets being produced was already the third, with a throwing distance of 900 blades.
A distance of 900 blades combined with Alchemy Bombs would surely become a nightmare for any defending army.
“Your Highness, according to your command, a total of 1,000 units have been produced.”
1000 units?
Lide nodded in satisfaction; the quantity was sufficient.
Imagine, a thousand gun barrels firing simultaneously; the sweeping effect was beyond what outsiders could possibly exaggerate, and this firepower could be sustained…
“Good, transport these military supplies to the Underworld as soon as possible.
The sooner we are prepared, the faster we can initiate the attack!”
He did not know the progress of the Naga’s Space Gate construction and could only hasten preparations.
“Yes! Your Highness.”
—-
—-
—-
Underworld, Liusi City.
This city, home to over 500,000 Half-Bodies, harbored the hopes of all Half-Bodies in the Underworld.
It was precisely because of this city’s presence that Half-Bodies became the ostensible rulers of the Underworld–though the territory they controlled was less than one-tenth of the Underworld’s total area.
But this did not hinder their pride.
Yet at this moment, that pride seemed to have been shattered.
In the center of Liusi City, at the City Lord’s Mansion.
The shared ruler of the Half-Bodies, the Extraordinary Half-Body who had achieved Level 24, the Dominator of Liusi City–Kakarilo, was currently staring incredulously at a tattered, skin-and-bones Half-Body below him, his tone tinged with disbelief.
“You’re saying that a surface power has occupied Black Iron Castle??”
It had been a month since Black Iron Castle’s fall, but due to the speed of Lide’s occupation, combined with the strong lockdown by Magic Language Bats for twenty-four Sunshine Hours,
And with a Level 18 Half-Body Mage acting as an insider, the news of Dawn City’s capture of Black Iron Castle had not been leaked.
Thus, as the Dominator of Liusi City, Kakarilo was so astonished upon hearing the news.
“Lord Kakarilo… Yes, it’s a surface power!! Those damned Vampires!! We must hang those filthy creatures!
Their Vampire Clan Chief killed the Lord of Black Iron Castle during a banquet, then took advantage of the chaos to blockade the entire city…
After occupying Black Iron Castle, they even renamed it to God of Twilight, proclaiming themselves to be the God of Twilight, starting to make the entire city follow the Twilight Sect, even the great temple of our God has been sealed!!
These damned heretics cannot be forgiven!!”
The Half-Body, worse off than a beggar, was filled with resentment; he was a fervent believer of the Half-body God, having witnessed the scene of Lide crushing the Lord of Black Iron Castle and subsequently enduring the series of proselytizing activities.
No matter how tight a city’s lockdown, there would always be a slip-up.
So, after more than half a month, this Half-Body finally found an unlooked-for chance to escape through the city’s sewers…
The events at Black Iron Castle were utterly intolerable for a zealous believer like him, so he harbored more resentment towards Lide than anyone else.
“Surface Vampires?!”
Kakarilo’s eyes narrowed, and a barely concealable killing intent began to permeate the air.
“The Dignity of the Half-Bodies will not tolerate any trampling!!
Whether it’s Vampires or vampire bugs!”
Having said this, he abruptly turned to look downward, “Send 3,000 Black Beak Giant Eagles to Black Iron Castle to gather information, and report back to me immediately if the situation is confirmed.”
The Half-Body guards below promptly took the order and left.
After giving the order, Kakarilo looked again at the Half-Body fanatic, “Tell me everything you know!”
Previously, after Dawn City and Black Iron Castle had agreed to a trade, the nobles of Black Iron Castle, in order to consolidate their interests, collectively decided that this message must not be leaked to Liusi City.
Because once Liusi City became aware, the transcendent bigwigs among the Half-Bodies would inevitably take over, and then, their acquired interests would significantly diminish.
Interesting enough, Black Iron Castle was thousands of kilometers away from Liusi City, and given that it was a barren land with nothing but a muddy swamp nearby to catch the attention of Liusi City,
so they had no interest in paying any more attention to this remote city–although it once was the main city of the Half-Elfs,
this resulted in the Half-Elfs trading with Dawn City for nearly a year without being discovered by the big shots of Liusi City.
Had it not been for a Half-Elf zealot who risked his life to set out alone, traveling thousands of kilometers without being hunted by the monsters along the way, this matter still might be unknown.
Of course, Kachar was very angry that the Black Iron Castle nobles kept this hidden, but no matter how angry he was, Black Iron Castle was still a Half-Elf city, and it was not for surface powers to swagger around.
He believed that the Half-Elfs were the rulers of the Underworld, and now someone dared to challenge the status of the Half-Elfs, which was not just as simple as seizing a city, it meant that the other party wanted to get a foothold in the Underworld.
This absolutely could not be tolerated.
It was a matter of racial survival conflict, retreat meant obliteration.
Had the Half-Elfs first discovered the surface’s Dawn City, the lives from the Underworld would have made the same decision to conquer Dawn City.
As to which side is righteous… in the struggle for living space between races in the pursuit of glory, there is no word for justice, only positions.
Merely ten minutes later, a legion of Black Beak Giant Eagles took off from the military camp of Liusi City, heading straight for Twilight City.
The flying speed of the Black Beak Giant Eagles was not slow, reaching 300 kilometers per hour, even slightly faster than ordinary Magic Language Bats–after all, they were eagles.
For a journey of thousands of kilometers, it took less than four Sunshine Hours to arrive.
These Black Beak Giant Eagles were simply ordered to scout the situation and were not aware of the strength of Twilight City, even the escaping Half-Elf zealot had limited understanding.
So when Twilight City appeared before the legion of over 3000 Black Beak Giant Eagles, the Half-Elf commander, seething with murderous intent, didn’t even dispatch a small team to scout first but pressed on the entire legion, charging directly above Twilight City.
They even thought they might have a chance to directly crush those surface forces and take over this city that belonged to the Half-Elfs when they saw no aerial units guarding above Twilight City.
The Dawn Warriors within Twilight City, seeing the Black Beak Giant Eagles wreaking havoc unabashedly inside the city, were also stunned for a moment. What was happening??
It happened to be the time for the Magic Language Bats to change guard… Unexpectedly, the Black Beak Giant Eagles had seized the opportunity and invaded Twilight City.
Audis, who was in charge of Dawn Wings, felt extreme shame when he saw this scene.
Lide had just appointed him to lead Dawn Wings, and now such a major flaw had appeared; did this not suggest he was incompetent??
Outraged, Audis immediately ordered all Dawn Bats and Magic Language Bats to take off and hunt down the Black Beak Giant Eagles that dared to invade Twilight City.
When over 8000 Magic Language Bats led by 500 Dawn Bats took off from the four corners of Twilight City, the Half-Elf commander who was still dreaming of a great victory instantly felt his blood go cold.
The Half-Elf didn’t have time to issue a retreat order before the Magic Language Knights, riding on Magic Language Bats, had already pulled the trigger of the aerial crossbow.
Whoosh whoosh~
The piercing sound of tearing through the air rose as the entire formation of Magic Language Bats started shooting wildly along their predetermined flight paths.
Specially designed flight paths ensured that the formation of Magic Language Bats would not cause friendly fire, while also increasing the lethality.
3000 Black Beak Giant Eagles faced 8000 Magic Language Bats, and these were Magic Language Bats with long-range aerial capabilities.
Instantly, Twilight City was like a scene of dumplings being dropped; Black Beak Giant Eagles fell from their once invincible state, crashing and damaging many houses.
In the end, Audis went into a rampage, unwilling to stop even after the Half-Elfs had retreated, forcefully leading 500 Dawn Bats in pursuit of the Half-Elfs.
The speed of the Dawn Bats, upgraded through the Power of Faith, reached 400 kilometers per hour, a full one-third faster than the Black Beak Giant Eagles.
One could imagine under such circumstances what good the Half-Elfs could do??
In the end, if it weren’t for the Black Beak Giant Eagle under the Half-Elf commander that reached Level 15 managing to forcefully break the encirclement, the 3000-strong air legion would have been entirely wiped out.
But even so, in the end, only the sole surviving individual managed to flee…
When Lide received this news, it was several Sunshine Hours later, and he immediately put aside his trivial tasks and returned to Twilight City.
He had intended to delay the battle with the Half-Elf main city, as preaching and conquering the Naga Tribe was currently the most important thing.
But things did not go as planned.
Now, to ensure a foothold and avoid future troubles, Twilight City might have to confront the Half-Elfs head-on.
The Half-Elfs who had suffered a great loss would certainly not just let it go.
The smell of gunpowder for war had already pervaded the skies over Twilight City.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - Chapter 407: Chapter 409: The Brute Lide, Single-Handedly Takes on the Half-Elf Main City (Part 1) (8000 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 407: Chapter 409: The Brute Lide, Single-Handedly Takes on the Half-Elf Main City (Part 1) (8000 words)
“Your Majesty, Liusi City is over a thousand kilometers away from Twilight City, and even if they deploy troops, it will take at least a week…”
On the walls of Twilight City, Lide’s gaze jumped to the distant horizon, while the Level 18 Half-Elf Great Mage, Mahari, reported respectfully from behind.
“If they march against us, there is one path they must take–the Dark Forest.
No matter how the troops from Liusi City march, the Dark Forest is an unavoidable point.”
“The Dark Forest?”
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly, “What are the characteristics of the Dark Forest?”
“Your Majesty, the Dark Forest is extremely gloomy. Its trees have become withered and rigid due to the erosion of the Undead’s aura, but due to the heavy fog, they do not catch fire and have remained thus for hundreds of years.
On both sides of the Dark Forest lie vast areas of death fog, which are not only highly toxic but also teem with ghosts and Undead Life.
It is said to have formed from the fusion of a fragment from an Undead Plane from tens of thousands of years ago.
It is a place of death, where entering is extremely terrifying, and even the Extraordinary face the risk of downfall.”
Ghosts? Undead?
Why does this have something to do with the Undead again?
Lide’s brows tightened. He didn’t delve deeper into this; the Undead were not creatures to be trifled with.
His thoughts shifted back to the Half-Elves.
By normal logic, the Half-Elves, having suffered a great loss, would definitely not let matters rest. After all, he had not just turned the Black Iron Castle into Twilight City but also hunted and killed thousands of Black Beak Giant Eagles sent by them.
Having lived in the Underworld for so long, it was impossible for the Half-Elves to not have a hint of arrogance.
Any ruler of Half-Elves with a bit of sense would know that with Dawn City appearing in the Underworld and even capturing their cities, this issue would definitely not end amicably.
Indeed, Lide’s actions had blatantly informed them that Dawn City intended to vie with the Half-Elves for dominion over the Underworld.
Under this circumstance, Lide didn’t believe for a moment that the Half-Elves would endure; it would be odd if they didn’t bring their full force to annihilate this provocative group.
However, the key problem was, how he should deal with these Half-Elves, as he currently did not wish for Dawn City’s army to engage in battle with the Half-Elves.
The threat of the Black Dragon and the Naga was more urgent and formidable than that of the Half-Elves.
Seeing Lide fall silent, Mahari, after a brief contemplation, continued to speak, “Your Majesty, if we plan an ambush, the Dark Forest would be a good location.”
In his view, Lide’s questions were undoubtedly about planning to ambush the Half-Elf army en route.
But to his surprise, Lide shook his head, his eyes revealing a trace of amusement.
“Plan an ambush? No, I’m just interested in the Undead of the Dark Forest.
As for the Half-Elf army…”
His gaze sharpened, and a cold murderous intent surged out of him like an avalanche.
“I will make a trip to Liusi City to settle this problem.”
A trip to Liusi City??
Mahari’s eyes widened to the extreme upon hearing this, his heart shocked to the core.
Lide’s words were spoken lightly, but the message they conveyed sent a shiver down his spine.
Was His Majesty intending to confront the main city of the Half-Elves all by himself?
This thought arose in his mind, and Mahari felt his throat go dry.
He wasn’t very clear about the full extent of the forces within Liusi City, but the known information was–there were at least two Extraordinary beings, and possibly more hidden Extraordinary that had not yet revealed themselves.
Half-Elves, as the nominal rulers of the Underworld, had held their position steadily for years, not through blowhard claims but through solid strength that had to be acknowledged by outsiders.
“Your Highness, there are at least two Transcendent Half-Elves in Liusi City, and there might even be more powerful forces hidden… Are you sure…”
Mahari was absolutely loyal to Lide, and he always considered Lide’s interests in everything, which was why he was now braving a warning.
“Two Transcendents?”
Lide looked at Mahari with interest, “Besides those, what other forces are hidden within Liusi City?”
“This… There is said to be an aging Half-Elf Clan Leader, whose power has touched the fringes of the Legendary.
However, this old Clan Leader hasn’t appeared for a long time, and it’s rumored he has already died…” Mahari was somewhat uncertain.
“So that would be three Transcendents?”
The casual tone of Lide made Mahari start, he then responded with a bitter smile, “Yes, Your Highness, it’s very likely that the old Clan Leader is still alive.”
Three Transcendents, no wonder the Half-Elves could become the rulers of the Underworld in name; they indeed had some capability.
But Lide’s smile remained calm; three Transcendents were strong, but what of it?
Since stepping into Transcendence, he hadn’t encountered a being who could fight him on equal terms… Three Transcendents, perhaps, could bring him some surprises.
After pondering for a moment, he turned his head to look down at the warriors busy cleaning up the fallen Black Beak Giant Eagle from the city wall.
He said lightly,
“Issue the order that, in my absence, Kali will lead Twilight City, with Nicole assisting. The preparations must be accelerated.”
The two Bloodlines behind him immediately nodded in agreement and turned to leave.
Seeing this, Lide fell into a slight contemplation, and after a moment, he initiated communication with a certain being in his mind.
Upon feeling the response within his heart, he looked off into the distance.
Whoosh whoosh~
A tiny black dot was speeding towards him from the far horizon.
After a dozen breaths, the black dot grew larger, and Lide on the city wall now looked towards the magic words of the black dot.
It was a massive Undead Life form, its white skeletal body covered with thick frost, and blue Soul Fire burned fiercely in the hollow white skull.
With each beat of its tattered Dragon Wings, huge gusts were whipped up, even leaving a trail of frost condensation in the sky in its wake.
Feeling the terrifying approach of that Undead Life, Mahari’s face involuntarily changed color.
“Your Highness, that is an Undead Giant Dragon…”
He could feel the other’s strength, but since it was unclear whether it was friend or foe, he looked to Lide, appearing as if it might be a force of Dawn City.
“Atlantis, a Transcendent Frost Giant Dragon.”
Lide nodded slightly, “When I’m not here, Atlantis will provisionally protect Twilight City.”
Mahari was slightly stunned, and the admiration in his gaze towards Lide grew even stronger.
A casual act yielded a Transcendent; was this the real power of Dawn City?
This Half-Elf Great Mage transformed by Lide had always been in Twilight City and had not had the chance to visit Dawn City, thus naturally unaware of Dawn City’s real strength.
Even beyond Mahari, most of the high-ranking members of Dawn were unaware of how much power Dawn City really concealed.
Not to mention others, just the six Transcendents were enough to leave people astonished.
Whoosh whoosh~
While the two conversed, Atlantis, the Transcendent Frost Giant Dragon, had already arrived at Twilight City.
26-bladed wings could certainly be described as blotting out the sky.
Moreover, with the extraordinary aura emanating from its body, this Frost Giant Dragon could only be described with the word “terrifying.”
Atlantis had always been slaughtering Cave Spiders in the Land of Bone-Burying under his command; this was the first time the Frost Giant Dragon had appeared in front of outsiders.
When he returned to Dawn City, he had the Extraordinary Spider Queen order the Cave Spiders not to enter the Land of Bone-Burying, then transferred Atlantis to Twilight City.
Because Castro, with the benefit of Lide’s spell-enhancement, had flown at supersonic speeds and was much faster than Atlantis, so while Lide had returned, this creature was still on its way, flying slowly.
Many warriors within Twilight City felt Atlantis’s terrifying presence, their eyes filled with vigilance.
Especially those newly converted believers of the Dark Life, who began to tremble uncontrollably. The extraordinary Dragon Power was a dignity that penetrated deep into the soul; these regular-bloodlined beings of the Dark Race simply had no immunity to it.
But just as the bolts prepared on the crossbow carts below, and the Magic Language Bats readied to swarm up, Lide’s voice, amplified by magic power, resonated throughout the entire city.
“Atlantis, contain your aura.
From today onwards, you are tasked with guarding Twilight City.”
“By your command, my lord…”
Lide’s voice instantly relaxed the expressions of the warriors below; it was one of their own.
Then Mahari saw this Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragon directly descend upon the city wall; the head that was held high moments before now bowed respectfully towards Lide.
Lide didn’t pay much attention to this tsundere Frost Giant Dragon.
Twilight City was not as safe as Dawn City; it now required extraordinary guardianship, otherwise, just any high-level combat power could cause immense damage to Twilight City.
High-level combat power in Glory was like a nuclear weapon, utterly incomparable to low-level troops.
After his instructions, Lide took out the palm-sized Castro from his bosom and then forcefully threw it forward.
Whoosh~
This nascent bat king swelled in the wind, and in the blink of an eye, there stood a steel giant beast with 16-bladed wings in front.
However, the majestic Castro still appeared somewhat mini in front of the 26-bladed wings of the Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragon.
Seeing Castro appear, Atlantis seemed somewhat annoyed. The tsundere Frost Giant Dragon exhaled two icy breaths from its nostrils, drastically lowering the temperature of the air.
“Hmph, it was just that the great Lord Frost didn’t exert full strength just now…”
After speaking, it raised its head, took off with a flap of its wings, and headed towards the city center.
This abrupt statement left Mahari completely confused, but Lide could only laugh bitterly. This creature was miffed at being slower than Castro… such a tsundere.
Without further contemplation, Lide simply floated up and stood behind Castro, his gaze turning towards Mahari.
“Come aboard, we’re heading directly to Liusi City.”
He spoke calmly, as though suggesting a casual stroll.
He didn’t want to get entangled with the Half-body Clan’s army just yet, so the best method was… to ensure the Half-body Clan wouldn’t dare to cause a fuss over Twilight City.
And what better way to ensure the Half-body Clan wouldn’t dare to fuss?
Other than with fists, what else?
In the past, Lide didn’t quite like such brutish actions, but now, giving it a go once in a while was quite thrilling.
Truly delightful…
Mahari’s heart quivered as he, too, climbed and stood on Castro’s back. Although still somewhat worried, Lide’s order weighed heavily like a mountain, undeniable.
Whoosh~
Upon receiving Lide’s command to take flight, Castro’s legs powered forcefully, and then, with a crack, it kicked off the city walls, leaving behind gashes with its tremendous strength.
With this boost, the massive body shot upwards, and combined with the flapping of the Blade Wings, it immediately ascended into the sky.
The guards on top of the city walls didn’t realize that their ruler was about to take on the Half-Elf Main City alone…
Meanwhile, in Liusi City.
When Kakarilo, the Level 24 Half-Elf ruler, heard the news that out of the 3000 Black Beak Giant Eagles only one person had escaped back, he was completely engulfed in rage.
How long had it been? How long had it been since anyone dared to challenge the Half-Elves!
But now, those damned surface dwellers had slaughtered even the Black Beak Giant Eagles he had sent out to gather intelligence.
3000 Black Beak Giant Eagles, and not even a ripple was made!
“Clan Chief, those despicable vampires had actually set up an ambush!
Our scouting team plunged into Black Iron Castle, not spotting a single trace of aerial guards, which led me to believe that these vampires didn’t possess any flying troops, so I commanded the army to storm in and take back Black Iron Castle!
But as soon as our forces entered the range of Black Iron Castle, tens of thousands of giant bats appeared from all around!
Moreover, these bats had humans riding on their backs, who had fixed siege crossbows on the bats, possessing strong anti-air capabilities.
Once we engaged in battle, we were at an absolute disadvantage and despite my orders to fight to the death, we were eventually tied down by those despicable vampires…”
The commander in charge of the Black Beak Giant Eagle Corps was filled with sadness and anger, pinning the blame of the whole Eagle Corps being surrounded due to his blind command on the Magic Language Bats.
Kakarilo wasn’t in the mood to check for the truth of the matter; after all, with only one person having escaped, there was little to verify.
The only thing on the mind of the ruler of Liusi City at this moment was one thought.
To mobilize all forces and exterminate those damned vampires!!
Whether it was Black Iron Castle being captured or the escape of only one single Black Beak Giant Eagle.
Both pointed to an infuriating truth, that the surface forces actually dared to disregard the existence of Liusi City.
This was no longer a simple challenge but a blatant disregard for the Half-Elves!
The surface forces’ ambition to compete for the rule of the Underworld was no longer concealed.
The Half-Elves could absolutely not tolerate such provocation from outsiders.
Kakarilo’s eyes gradually turned icy.
“Issue the command, notify the twelve subordinate Half-Elf cities, each city is to dispatch twenty thousand troops to Liusi City.
At the same time, immediately issue a war order.
The surface forces have occupied our former main city–Black Iron Castle, and now they have even killed our 3000 Black Beak Giant Eagles!
Those damned surface forces want to take over the entire Underworld, to enslave the great Half-Elves!
This war, we fight to the death!”
Dare to provoke the Half-Elves, then prepare for annihilation!
Kakarilo’s murderous intent surged, and he abruptly turned to look at the messenger beside him.
“Notify Derick, and tell him to ready the troops for a campaign.”
“This time we will not only kill those surface dwellers and make them spit out the Half-Elf cities they’ve occupied, but we’ll also ascend to the surface to let those damned beings know the might of the Half-Elves!”
This indeed was a crisis, but Kakarilo saw the opportunity within it.
Surface dwellers could come to the Underworld, so why couldn’t they ascend to the surface?
The lives of the surface world coveted the riches of the Underworld, but the Underworld was just as eager for the sunshine and land above.
Both were staring at each other from within the abyss.
Under the command of Kakarilo, the Half-Elf army immediately began to rapidly assemble.
Countless Half-Elves, learning that Black Iron Castle had been occupied by surface life, were instantly unable to contain their rage.
“Damn Vampires! I’ll stuff my longbow into their mouths and shoot through the backs of their heads!”
“Hmph, these disgusting surface beings, the great Half-Elves are invincible in battle. Once we march to the surface, I will use a razor to slice off their heads and feed them to the worms!”
“Heard that female Vampires are quite beautiful? Gagaga, are you all ready to enjoy those Vampires?!”
“…”
It wasn’t just anger. Many Half-Elves, upon hearing news of surface life, started to palpitate with excitement. They fantasized about killing their way to the surface, plundering the wealth of Dawn City, and tormenting the female Bloodline…
Although they were a neutral faction, the Half-Elves were certainly not any kind of benevolent life.
Their reign over the Underworld for so many years relied not on kindness but on the most brutal killings. Only blood could intimidate the other Dark Races.
Otherwise, why would those Dark Races obediently trade in the Half-Elves’ cities??
In unseen places, the blood on these Half-Elves’ hands was no less than that of any Dark Race; it’s just that they claimed to be neutral…
The troops assembled with the utmost speed under Kakarilo’s orders, especially after he issued a three-day pillage decree, which drove all Half-Elves mad.
Once they stormed the surface and occupied Dawn City, the Half-Elves would be free to rob, kill, and torment females. In these three days, any and every sin could be committed without restraint.
This order instantly sent the morale of the Half-Elves to an extreme high.
Everyone was eager to immediately ascend to the surface and slaughter the city.
The troops in Liusi City quickly gathered under the stimulus of the pillage decree. In just half a Sunshine Hour, the commanders of Liusi City’s major legions had already arrived in the main hall of the City Lord’s manor.
Among them, a leading Half-Elf Archer had a particularly terrifying presence.
One could sense that this was the second Extraordinary warrior of Liusi City, the 21st Level Extraordinary Archer Derick Eagle Eye.
Liusi City’s publically acknowledged strongest combat power.
“Kakarilo Clan Chief, all of Liusi City’s armies have been completely assembled. Shall we march now?”
Derick Eagle Eye, with his Extraordinary Combat Power, commanded the entire Liusi City’s army. Upon hearing the news about attacking the surface forces, he immediately organized the troops at the fastest speed.
The Underworld was fraught with danger, and the armies were in constant battle. The Half-Elves, battle-hardened, acted with a speed incomparable to ordinary people.
Kakarilo frowned, “The armies from the twelve subordinate cities are still on the way. Isn’t it too early to march now?”
In his opinion, while Liusi City’s one hundred thousand-strong army could easily take down the surface forces that occupied Black Iron Castle, Kakarilo was actually contemplating a direct attack on the surface, which was why he hesitated.
“Clan Chief, we can completely capture Black Iron Castle and then rest there while waiting for the following troops to arrive. We can also use this time to gather clear intelligence about the surface world.”
Derick Eagle Eye’s suggestion gained Kakarilo’s approval.
“Very well, you must have all heard my order!
After we invade the surface, seize that Vampire’s city, everyone will have three days to pillage!”
Kakarilo, in front of these high-ranking commanders, stirred everyone into excitement the moment he spoke these words.
Each face showed eagerness to be part of a great heist.
This ruler of the Half-Elves could not even fathom in his dreams that the Vampire he was planning to eliminate was driving a steel giant beast toward Liusi City at a terrifying speed.
With the enhancement of High-level Floating Skill, Castro’s speed had reached at least 2000 kilometers per hour.
“With exaggerated speed, he recklessly charged through the Underworld, even capable of smashing any flying Demon Beasts he encountered directly.
The horrific fog didn’t even have time to corrode his armor before he had already passed through it.
It was only when he reached the Dark Forest that Castro slowed down, and this strange land also piqued Lide’s interest.
The intensity of the Undead aura within the Dark Forest was unimaginably thick.
Looking down from the sky, below were more than ten blades high, pitch-black and withered, bizarre trees. The twisted trunks and branches looked like Demons dancing, chilling to the spine together with the scorched earth.
What was even more terrifying was that at both ends of the Dark Forest thick fog swirled, and even Lide felt the hairs on his body stand on end as he neared the mist.
Danger Perception warned him, there was an indescribable threat lurking within that fog.
He even faintly heard sighing sounds emanating from the depths of the fog, and with each sigh, the sensed danger spiked tenfold.
It all spoke of a terror that was hard to describe.
The Dark Forest was only dozens of miles in length and breadth. Lide deliberately stopped for half a Sunshine Hour, studying the heart-palpitating dense fog for quite a while, but ultimately he did not set foot into it.
Now was not the time for unplanned distractions, as more important matters awaited him.
He marked this mysterious seat of Undead Life in his mind though.
After dealing with the Black Dragon and the Naga, he would surely come to explore this place again, especially intrigued by that strange sighing sound and what kind of existence it might indicate.
Level 18 Half-body Mage Mahari, who seemed quite interested in exploring further just by watching Lide, was extremely anxious.
This Dark Forest was known as a forbidden zone for life in the Underworld, having claimed the lives of even Extraordinary beings who entered and never came back alive–and not just one of them. He was terrified that Lide might whimsically want to take a turn inside.
It was only when Lide left the perilous place that Mahari finally heaved a great sigh of relief.
After leaving the Dark Forest, Dawn City was no more than 500 kilometers away. Lide, observing the surrounding still filled with the unique dim scenery of the Underworld, showed a slight change in expression.
The closer he got to the Half-body Main City, the more his heart stirred–not with fear, but an inexplicable yearning.
“Hopefully, the Half-elf’s Extraordinary will give me a bit of a surprise; otherwise, wouldn’t it be too dull?”
His eyes blazed, like a lion ready to hunt.
Castro spread his wings and soared, crossing mountains, leaping over lakes, piercing through poison mists, and crashing through the clouds. Following Mahari’s guidance throughout the journey, he finally saw signs of Liusi City.
On the far-reaching horizon, a city sprawled across the ground like an Abyssal Giant Beast entered Lide’s view.
Magnificent, dignified.
Black Iron Castle was at least ten times smaller in scale compared to this city.
Even more extravagant than Green City in the southern province, it was hard to imagine that such a grand city could be built in a place like the Underworld.
Seeing this scene, the light in Lide’s eyes grew even more brilliant.
Because he was about to trample this city beneath his feet.
At this moment, Lide was unaware that the ruler of Dawn City had already issued a three-day siege order against Dawn City. If Dawn City’s army truly couldn’t hold back, these Half-elves would undoubtedly transform into the most cruel Demons.
Neither side realized what the other had done…
When Castro sensed that Lide’s mood was somewhat excited, his speed surged, taking only a dozen breaths to approach Liusi City.
As they neared, the blurry shadows in Lide’s eyes became sharp and clear.
This was his first time seeing this magnificent city built by the rulers of the Underworld.
Grandeur, that was his first impression.
Liusi City was carved out of an entire mountain, using the mountain itself as city walls, the city established within the thousands of blades thick rocks.
This scene could simply be described as exaggerated; Green City’s magnificence could only be called tiny in front of this city.”
Its walls towered over three hundred blades high, and even the thinnest part was several hundred blades thick. Using mountain cliffs as city walls was undoubtedly the most exaggerated defense system.
Conventional siege weapons trying to bring down the walls… I’m afraid they’d pound away for ten years and still not make a dent.
The only way to penetrate the city was either from the air or through the narrow passage a hundred blades wide at the front.
But here too, towering walls stood guard, with densely packed shooting holes in the surrounding cliffs resembling locusts, making the attacks encountered when entering even more brutal.
This terrifying defensive power would likely withstand the assault of millions of troops, making the city impregnable.
Seeing this, Lide couldn’t help feeling impressed; such a defense system was simply a chasm of heaven.
Fortunately, he was not so foolish as to bring troops to lay siege to the city, not needing to take the conventional path.
He turned his head to look at Mahari.
“When the time comes, you’ll do the speaking, I will temporarily bestow upon you the use of a language in your spiritual sea…”
Mahari was startled, somewhat confused by Lide’s intent but still stepped forward two paces and respectfully complied with the command.
Lide placed his hand on Mahari’s head, and after a moment, the holy light receded, then Mahari’s expression suddenly turned quite strange.
He never would have expected Lide to ask him to do this…
—
—
—
At this moment, the city of Liusi was mobilizing its army. Kakarilo, the 24-level Half-Elf Clan Leader, had just mounted a 17-level Black Beak Giant Eagle, while a 21-level Extraordinary Archer beside him also mounted a 15-level Black Beak Giant Eagle.
The entire city was ready to set out with its troops.
But after the news that they were about to attack the surface reached the streets, they were now packed with people.
The Half-Elf residents of Liusi City were extremely excited and agitated at this moment.
“Where is Clan Chief Kakarilo? After you conquer the cities on the surface, you must bring back those female Vampires!”
“Are our armies setting out again? The last time we mobilized on such a large scale was two years ago when we exterminated the Lizardfolk; we completely enslaved those wretched Lizardfolk, who are still mining ores for us in our mines to this day. This time, we’ll add some Vampires to our mines!”
“Kill those surface dwellers! Our Half-Elf longbows can hunt giant dragons! Those lowly, filthy Vampires dare to provoke the mighty Half-Elves; this is undoubtedly their gravest mistake!!”
“…”
The streets were rarely this lively; hundreds of thousands of Half-Elves had emerged from their homes at this moment to see off the warriors from several city barracks.
Many were shouting about enslaving Vampires and capturing the surface dwellers to mine or sell them on the Flowing Song streets…
Kakarilo could hear the intense shouting outside from inside the barracks and a strong desire arose within him. This time, he would conquer everything!!
Flatten the surface cities!
“All troops, deploy at once…”
As Kakarilo waved his hand and gave the order loudly, a terrifying voice laden with Extreme Evil suddenly emanated from outside Liusi City.
The blasphemous language of ancient times echoed over the city, silencing the once bustling crowd as if their throats had been gripped; everyone went silent in an instant.
“All Half-Elves of Liusi City, listen,
My Lord, the Clan Leader of the Holy Light Bloodline, the great God of Twilight, the Ruler of Dawn City–Kachar decrees to you.
All of you drop resistance and kneel to surrender!
Liusi City has been surrounded by my Lord alone.
Resisters will become spirits trampled under the feet of my Lord.”
Then, the blasphemous language echoed powerfully through some force.
“Become spirits trampled under the feet of my Lord…”
“Trampled under the feet…”
“Spirits…”
The vast Liusi City, upon hearing this blasphemous language, fell eerily quiet at that moment.
Clan Leader of the Holy Light Bloodline?
God of Twilight?
Ruler of Dawn?
Only after the echo had completely faded did the Half-Elves come back to their senses.
Then, the streets, filled with Half-Elves, suddenly erupted like a volcano, with huge waves of furious curses shaking the surrounding mountains to the brink of collapse.
Especially that line about one man surrounding Liusi City enflamed their rage to new heights.
“Damn bastard!!! That lowly Vampire dares to provoke us like this!!”
“One man has surrounded Liusi City?! How dare he! How dare he utter such arrogant words!!”
“Kill him, no! Drain that Vampire who dares to challenge us of his blood, extract his soul, and burn it for a thousand years!!”
