After a day, the entire Naga City was searched, and shocking news made it difficult for Lide to sit or stand still.
No sign of the Naga Chief or other high-level Nagas was found inside Naga City.
But the soldiers discovered a space gate that emitted an evil aura.
Upon investigating, they found a land shrouded in the smell of sulfur and covered with scorched yellow soil.
In other words, the thing Lide had been worried about actually happened–the Abyss Gate was already built by the Nagas in advance!!
The news was startling.
The Nagas had already opened the space gate; had that Black Dragon gone through? What was on the other side of the space gate? Did those Nagas escape to another place or flee to the Abyss?
And would powerful beings pour out of this space gate?
Countless thoughts weighed heavily on Lide’s expression.
“Kapp, have the army temporarily withdraw from Naga City. I’m going to check out the space gate.”

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - Chapter 414: Chapter 416: The Rise of the Destiny Hero—Prince Anos
chapters.content:
“Hurry up and shoot… I can’t take it anymore… Are you a pig? How can you miss at this range? Aim your arrows better!”
“These damn rats are so fiercely wild, I’ve already died twice, and now they’re charging again?”
“Whimper, whimper, there are so many little mice, I’m so scared… Motherf*cker, how dare they bite me, where’s my big sword? If I don’t chop these bastards up today, they won’t learn to respect women…”
“They’re so ugly, these Fierce Half-Ratmen are so hideous…”
In Anos City, players locked in fierce combat had reached a fever pitch after two days of fighting.
There were too many.
Too many Fierce Half-Ratmen.
Killing them was fruitless, exterminating them impossible.
These evil creatures, oblivious to pain, unacquainted with retreat, were simply the bane of players.
Although players were fierce, the potential loss of experience made them reluctant to risk their lives for real.
The back and forth resulted in a huge gap, with the Divine Servants fighting to the death on one side and players looking to retreat and capitalize on the other, so while the defense of the walls was manageable, the scene drastically changed after the walls were breached.
After moving into urban warfare, players could only form small squads to resist, but the Fierce Half-Ratmen on the other side had no fear of death.
Thus, even with millions of players participating in the defense, they could only retreat step by step.
Crimson Moon, Dark Contract, Red Dragon’s Fury; these were the three main player guilds of Anos City. If not for these guilds’ core players taking on most of the pressure, Anos City would probably have already fallen by now.
Among these guilds, Dark Contract and Crimson Moon were the strongest. In truth, it was the two guilds covertly controlled by Lide that were the core of the resistance against the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
As time passed, the situation in Anos City became increasingly passive, and the disadvantages were especially unbearable for solo players, who even began to desert…
The higher-ups of Anos City could only wryly smile at this. It wasn’t that they didn’t want to command the players, it was just that 70% of Anos City’s players had come from other areas after hearing about the epic quest here.
To think that they could marshal a million unruly player troops in just two or three days was pure fantasy.
Moreover, given the capricious nature of players, assigning them quests was one thing, but commanding them was another; they might not even care to listen.
The scattered players were also a major reason why Anos City was breached.
But no matter the excuses, the slow fall of Anos City was an undeniable fact.
This war, though limited to Anos City, had become a landmark event, potentially even reshaping the landscape of “Glory.”
Because this was the first time the Evil God Camp had launched an attack on a player’s main city under player leadership, the implications were far-reaching.
If the Ancient Evil God Camp emerged victorious, would that mean there were more benefits for players joining them? If Anos City fell this time, could their own cities be next?
Given that “Glory” could enhance physical fitness, with undeniable effects on the real world, the entire world’s attention was focused on this battle and countless media, streamers, and websites were reporting on it around the clock.
The posts on the “Glory” forums also skyrocketed.
“These NPCs are too ruthless, deploying so many monsters, mmp, who can withstand this?”
“We absolutely cannot surrender, Anos City’s banner has not fallen, how can we retreat! Anos City, forever valiant!”
“Kill them, they can’t hold on anymore!! If we break through their lines, we win!! Long live the Ancient Camp!!”
“F*cking Ancient Camp players, you traitors, human scum!! Collaborating with the Evil God to attack our own main city, I despise you! Middle finger up.jpg”
“This war is truly thrilling, never thought I’d see a scene more shocking than a blockbuster movie”
In the last few days, traffic on the “Glory” official website was several times higher than usual.
But in the beginning, players could still face the battle with a light-hearted attitude; however, as the battle turned sour, everyone watched helplessly as Fierce Half-Ratmen advanced through the city, conquering one district after another.
As companions fell one by one, anger began to rise within.
They started taking the war seriously.
But the disadvantage had already surfaced, and no resistance seemed enough to turn the tide.
The harsh reality of the battlefield was laid bare for the players to see.
For the first time, players realized firsthand that their much-prized skills were so weak and ineffectual on the battlefield.
Players could resurrect, but there was an eight Sunshine Hour cooldown period, and since the game’s public testing aligned time with reality, it was a full eight hours in the real world, too.
At first, players could hold their ground against the assault of the Fierce Half-Ratmen, but as time went by and due to the sheer number of people waiting to respawn, the numbers rapidly decreased, leaving the entire city falling at an alarming rate.
“Your Highness, Prince of Anos City, District Seven has fallen!! We only have five districts left!”
Atop the towering Anos Mage Tower, once the Nolan Royal Family’s waste, now the lord of Anos City–the Prince of Anos City stood at the highest floor of the Mage Tower, gazing at the distant warfront.
This Mage Tower was a Subtower erected by the Crimson Mage Tower and, with no expenses spared, was completed within just half a year, reaching a height of 30 blades and becoming the city’s tallest building.
The anxious soldiers behind him had urgent looks on their faces.
“Just ahead of the Mage Tower is the temple of the Life Goddess. If it falls, adventurers from the Lost Plane won’t be able to resurrect. At that point, Anos City will truly fall…”
As a main player city, only about 20% of its population were natives, and nearly 99% of those fighting were players; the original inhabitants rarely risked their lives for Anos City.
Players, however, could only resurrect at the Life Goddess’ temple, and due to the high demand for player resurrection in Anos City, a total of four temples were constructed.
But the other three had already fallen to the assault of the Fierce Half-Ratmen. If this last temple were also breached, players would have no place to respawn but in Green City.
That would leave no option but the fall of Anos City.
“Only by holding the Life Goddess’ temple can we have a glimmer of hope.”
Prince Anos looked intently ahead, the piercing roar of magic blasts mingling with the anguished cries of the wounded, the city he had proudly built with his own hands was inching closer to defeat.
“Has Green City responded to our call for assistance?”
“Your Highness, those damned Nobles would rather we fall immediately–they won’t send troops to help us!”
Hearing this, Prince Anos’s gaze grew particularly icy; even now, certain members of the Nolan Royal Family wished for his death.
“The old grudges and accounts will be settled with them soon enough!
Notify the Centaur Army, follow me to battle!”
The Centaur Army, the strongest force supported by Dawn City for Anos City.
There were tens of thousands of them, and previously it was the ability to hire Centaurs that had allowed Anos City to attract players so quickly.
He had not intended to use the Centaurs, for although they were powerful, they could not resurrect, whereas the endlessly respawning players were the ultimate force.
But the situation had become dire for the very foundation of Anos City, and he had to play his last card.
“Your Highness, allow me to take charge of this! Your leadership is needed here!”
Not only the higher-ups of Anos City but also the presidents of various player guilds summoned urgently were looking at Prince Anos with surprise; taking the troops out at this time took real courage.
“Execute the order!”
With a cold shout, the commander shuddered then looked at Prince Anos with respect, promptly turned, and went to gather the last of the forces.
Once the commander had departed, Prince Anos City sharply turned to the guild presidents who had gathered with him.
The battle for Anos City involved not just Anos City players–it had captured the hearts of players, so much so that even players from the Nolan Capital had rushed there.
“Gentlemen, the fate of Anos City hangs by a thread. Whatever your reasons for coming to Dawn City, you have earned my friendship.
After we repel those filthy Divine Servants, I shall treat you all to the finest Elf Wine.”
Many players looked at Prince Anos, who seemed completely different from before, with peculiar expressions.
Especially the guild players from outside the city; they had heard plenty about the “legendary deeds” of Prince Anos–born to the King and a Maid after a drunken affair, seen as a disgrace by the Royal Family, utterly without Talent…
But these legends couldn’t be further from the Prince Anos, the masterful and commanding lord of Anos City standing before them now.
“Prince Anos, if it’s possible, please allow me to join you.”
Zhao Yue, who had been silent, stepped forward with a firm gaze towards Prince Anos, “Crimson Moon shall share the fate of Anos City.”
This?
Presidents of other guilds couldn’t help but exchange glances.
If the situation was hopeless, most were unwilling to stay and face death–unlike Crimson Moon, whose entire fortune was invested in Anos City.
“President Yue, no need for more words, your presence was requested to continue commanding the troops, to hold the line.
Trust me, as long as the flag of Anos City doesn’t fall, Anos City shall endure!”
His tone was indifferent but unshakable.
The slightly frail young Prince now seemed to truly embody the demeanor of the Destiny Hero.
After Prince Anos finished speaking, he turned and left, with the surrounding guards stopping any players who tried to follow.
Once Prince Anos’s figure disappeared, the remaining players looked at each other in silence.
This??
Zhao Yue glanced at these players with a hint of disdain, then held her head high and walked away.
These people had alternatives; Crimson Moon did not.
Seventy percent of Crimson Moon’s investments were in Anos City; if it were conquered, nearly a year of effort would have been wasted.
Anyone could leave, but not her; she had to account for all of Crimson Moon and to that heartless boss.
Thinking of this, Zhao Yue’s eyes filled with a profound resentment–more unsettling than that of a spurned woman… Where had her boss died? How could he disappear at such a critical moment?
Outside Anos City, as the main target of the Fierce Half-Ratman was Anos City, the surrounding areas remained unaffected by their assault.
At least two to three hundred thousand players had gathered to observe the spectacle.
Several Mages used the Mirror Image Skill to allow everyone to witness the war conditions in Anos City firsthand, while some players uploaded snapshots to the forums from atop flying Demon Beasts they’d acquired from gods know where.
But just as countless cloud players unable to enter “Glory” were eagerly viewing those screenshots on the “Glory” forums, suddenly a message excited everyone.
System Alert: Anos City is in a state of war, players may initiate live streaming within a 100-kilometer radius of the city, streaming will be limited until the end of the war.
“F*ck, finally we can stream! I’m dying to see…”
“When did Glory become so accommodating? Their previous policies were a bunch of bullsh*t…”
“Hahaha, I’ll start streaming, make you all jealous with the three cuties I’ve taken care of…”
“It’s unfair, I demand all streaming permissions be opened. Why can only Anos City’s surroundings be streamed??”
Whether it was players in the game or those on the forums, everyone was shocked to see the sudden announcement on the “Glory” official website, some even exclaimed it was a rare sight, that the usually unresponsive “Glory” website had updated at all.
Even because of this system prompt, “Glory” topped the trending searches within just half an hour.
And with the release of that notice, the official website of “Glory” quickly opened up a live streaming area.
Netizens could click in to see a live broadcast of real-time footage.
And it even thoughtfully included a barrage feature.
Many players who were seeing the “Glory” game video for the first time were instantly captivated, deeply impressed by the realistic scenes.
No one knew how the official website of “Glory” was able to live stream.
The perspective was from high above in the sky, clearly showing countless fierce half-rat men snarling and clawing their way toward the players.
Players brought to bear all sorts of weapons: archers, thieves, assassins, priests, warriors, and even some rare hidden Professions like Druids, Beast Tamers, Undead Summoners, and many more.
The clash between the two sides was utterly thrilling to witness.
Those players wearing virtual helmets could immerse themselves and experience the sensation of wartime combat–it was simply invincible.
In no time at all, the live stream of “Glory” was flooded again.
“Holy shit, I recommend everyone watch the ‘Glory’ live stream with a virtual helmet or a gaming pod; the feeling is too damn shocking!!”
“People used to say ‘Glory’ is very realistic, I didn’t believe it, but after I just put on the helmet to watch the live stream, it scared the piss out of me…”
“No wonder this game can improve players’ physical fitness, with this level of realism, fighting every day inside is just like in reality, isn’t it?”
“We strongly demand ‘Glory’ to produce more gaming pods!!…”
The exaggerated live broadcast effects on the official website of “Glory” immediately attracted countless players who were already curious about this cutting-edge technology game.
Even not only Huaxia’s players, but also players from all over the world could experience the charm of “Glory” in the live broadcast at this moment.
After those Russians experienced what is called immersion, they started shouting omg, unbelievable… Is this the creation of God? Why can Huaxia people make such a high-level game, and they can’t?!
Many foreign players, especially those from the disappointed capitalist empires of Europe and America, begin to rage post, cursing their own country as trash and stating that it must be a systemic problem; they love their country, but the country does not love them, and they are demanding the introduction of this game that belongs only to Huaxia…
No one knew exactly how the official website’s live stream was operated, but the perfect camera angles and close-ups of various crucial battles made it very satisfying for those outside of the game to watch.
It was absolutely an epic movie experience.
Even many in-game players, upon learning that the live broadcast had started, promptly found a safe place to log off and watch instead, as viewing from outside Anos City didn’t offer as direct and thrilling an experience as watching the live stream.
No matter what tumult was happening in the outside world, the progress within “Glory” would not slow down because of a live broadcast.
The fierce half-rat men soon overran two more districts, leaving the vast Anos City with only 3 districts left to hold.
Speaking of three districts, there were actually only two because the district behind the Life Goddess temple might as well not exist; once the Life Goddess temple falls, Anos City can no longer be defended.
“Look, what is that??”
“Holy shit, so many centaurs!”
“Brother, next time you see scenes like this, don’t just say ‘holy shit’ or ‘666’, use some proper words–majestic, crushing, earth-shattering, like a tidal wave, like wind sweeping leaves, magnificent, stately…”
Observant players watching the live stream spotted the half-rat men’s Steel Army emerging from hidden corners, their solid Dwarf Armor making this force look incredibly valiant and mighty.
The barrage in the live streaming room was instantly filled.
“Is this the Centaur Army? Holy shit, it looks so awesome. How can this game be so realistic…”
“Is Anos City finally going to use their trump card? Damn it, why didn’t they use it earlier, now they use it after I’m dead.”
“Ah, what a pity, I can only be revived in three more hours, now I can only watch the live stream to curb my cravings. If it wasn’t for that damn fierce half-rat man’s sneak attack, I could have taken down at least 100 more!”
“Anos City is done for this time, the players from the old days’ camp are too damn sly!”
“This scene is more spectacular than any blockbuster, the only regret is, why is all the gore blurred out? It doesn’t look exciting at all.”
With the official’s top-notch live streaming skills, viewers could oversee the entire battlefield, and at this moment, everyone noticed that the battle of Anos City was clearly entering its final stage.
Because any discerning eye could see that the outcome of this war was almost clear.
Especially when the “Glory” official live stream occasionally zoomed out, enveloping the entire battlefield within the camera’s view, it plainly depicted the current situation.
Gray-bodied fierce half-rat men had already taken over most of Anos City, while players clad in colorful clothing and armor were being compressed within a few streets, and even these narrow areas were gradually being consumed by the overwhelming number of fierce half-rat men.
Moreover, the dense swarm of flying half-rat men in the sky was everyone’s nightmare, these flying monsters being the principal culprits in the fall of Anos City.
The existence of the flying half-rat men meant that players had to always be on guard against their ambushes while facing the fierce half-rat men, which caused them immense trouble.
But just then, on Anos City’s most important streets.
Players still resisting bravely suddenly got excited.
Because the Prince of Anos City, leading the Centaur Army, appeared.
If the last two streets were conquered by the fierce half-rat men, then all their efforts today would be in vain; the Prince of Anos City undoubtedly gave all the players still holding out a glimmer of hope.
They had not lost yet!
At this moment, the number of remaining players in the three districts had fallen below 100,000. In other words, after two days of warfare, over a million players had died, fled, were injured, or evacuated, leaving Anos City with only 10% of its defensive forces.
“First and second divisions of the Centaur Army, form up!!”
Clad in black armor and wielding a longsword, the Prince of Anos City rode upfront on a pure white Unicorn King, leading all the centaurs.
He unleashed a roar of rage.
“Citizens of Anos City, today, I, Anos Nolan, the lord of Anos City, will defend the glory of Anos City with my life!
As long as I do not fall, Anos City will not succumb!
Sound the horn, and fight to the death!”
His resolute tone carried the momentum of facing death without fear.
This prince, who was regarded by players as the Destiny Hero, had now become the focal point of over a billion people through the live broadcast.
At any time, the sight of a warrior willingly facing death always commands respect.
The fearless Prince Anos had clearly won widespread praise.
At this moment, his stature in the hearts of players was rapidly rising.
This is exactly what the protagonist is supposed to do; this NPC is definitely a very important character in the next phase of “Glory.”
The Centaur Army consists of seven thousand heavily armored soldiers and another three thousand archers, who had already quietly assembled.
The main avenue where Prince Anos stood was a hundred blades wide and five thousand blades long, the most essential thoroughfare of Anos City, leading directly to the city gates and the primary battlefield.
Upon hearing the prince’s command, tens of thousands of horse soldiers started to form ranks on the main avenue.
The cold armor, towering stature, firm gaze, and high morale all spoke of the legion’s strength.
Players watching the live broadcast unexpectedly felt their hearts lift with anticipation.
“Damn, are these NPCs really going to charge in headfirst?”
“Nonsense, centaurs are suited for charging, not for alley fighting. If they wait for the Fierce Half-Ratmen to entrap these centaurs in narrow terrain, it would lead this powerful army to a slow death.
It’s better to press forward, breach an opening to relieve pressure on the frontline, and don’t forget–players can resurrect continuously. The longer the drag on, the more it benefits Anos City.”
“This NPC’s got some nerve, daring to charge head-on under such extreme disadvantages…”
“…”
No matter how the live stream viewers and players saw it, at this moment Prince Anos suddenly lifted his sharp greatsword.
With a fierce swing forward,
The horns sounded loudly at the command of the orderlies.
Wuuu~ Wuuu~ Wuuu~
All of the Centaur Army’s soldiers’ eyes blazed with fury as they commenced the most ferocious charge.
Tap Tap~
Tap Tap~
The sound of hooves trampling on the cobblestone ground made the earth tremble beneath the thundering of thousands of horses.
The world shuddered.
Players standing aside on the streets to make way for the centaurs could feel the vibrations numbing their legs.
Billions of viewers in the live-stream watched in awe as the Centaur Army cut deep into the midst of the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
The scene was enough to send adrenaline surging through their brains.
Such legendary acts of heroism stirred everyone’s emotions.
Facing certain death upon the city’s fall, they still led their cavalry to assault consecutively… their courage was admirable.
Just after a few breaths, the Steel Army, formed of centaurs, collided with the ferocious, clawing Divine Servants– the Fierce Half-Ratmen–with the most brutal force.
Puchi~
The scene instantly turned incredibly bloody.
From a bird’s-eye view, one could see clearly that on the main avenue of Anos City, a torrent of steel surged with a breathtaking force.
Everything blocking its path was trampled into a mush of flesh.
Though the Fierce Half-Ratmen were fierce, they could only put up futile resistance against the high-speed charge of the centaurs.
The centaur’s long spears were like the Death God’s scythe, wantonly harvesting the souls of these Divine Servants, and their charging bodies were like battering rams for siege, enough to pulverize all life before them.
And the highly focused Prince Anos took the lead, his longsword slashing wildly in combat, hacking the encroaching Fierce Half-Ratmen to pieces, his black armor even stained crimson with their fresh blood.
War, slaughter.
Anos City’s last Steel Army, under the lead of Prince Anos, had actually broken through the blockade of the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
On the main avenue of the city, tens of thousands of Fierce Half-Ratmen were trampled into a mush, turning this hundred-blade wide, five thousand-blade long road into a path of death and blood.
The scene seemed to approach a new turning point.
Prince Anos, once considered a disgrace to the Nolan Royal Family, now became the true protagonist in the hearts of all players.
This royal ‘waste’ who was once mocked even by guards and servants had undergone a tremendous transformation. Perhaps when the three-year agreement comes due, this “Destiny Hero” will truly rise.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - Chapter 415: Chapter 417 The God of Plague Appears, Finally Seeing Lord Ilo (9000 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 415: Chapter 417 The God of Plague Appears, Finally Seeing Lord Ilo (9000 words)
“F*ck, is this NPC this badass?”
“Iron hooves charging into battle, looks damn cool.”
“But, this is only a temporary reprieve. We’re still far from breaking the siege.”
While the sight of tens of thousands of centaurs trampling over the berserk ratmen was indeed impressive, a grim reality remained–the number of berserk ratmen had reached a million, and these centaurs couldn’t inflict any fatal damage.
Before the city walls lay a huge undeveloped area, sprawling in scope.
After Prince Anos led the centaur charge into this area, these Divine Servants reconvened from either side of the main road towards it. They had no time to react further before the berserk ratmen cut off their retreat.
The numerical superiority of the berserk ratmen became undeniably evident at that moment.
Although the Centaur Army had trampled over 100,000 berserk ratmen on the main road, after reaching the vast area in front of the city walls, the centaurs lost the most important thing–their momentum from the charge.
It was like a sharp knife stuck in thick mud, still sharp but unable to continue slicing through the surrounding mire.
If this road stretched for hundreds of kilometers, then everything in front would have been shattered by the centaurs. But now, the walls that once protected them had become an obstacle that restricted the centaurs.
Without their speed, the centaurs faced a massive crisis in an instant.
Especially the flying half-rat men, who now swarmed like locusts, quickly covering the sky.
In just a few breaths, the official livestream of “Glory” could no longer see Prince Anos’ Centaur Army below.
The berserk ratmen clustered like ants, these evil creatures roaring with a brutal desire to kill as they rushed towards the Centaur Army.
Tear these damned centaurs apart!
The order embedded in their souls to kill all life around them made the berserk ratmen fearless of all danger.
At this moment, they became synonymous with death, brutality, and slaughter.
Although the war had taken a slight turn, the overall direction had not changed.
Prince Anos wielded a sword unmatched in sharpness, with each slash ensuring the death of a berserk ratman, but as the centaurs were tightly ensnared by the berserk ratmen and couldn’t gain momentum for another charge, he couldn’t give the order to charge again.
The battle reached a stalemate.
Moments later, Prince Anos issued a resolute command.
“Form a circular formation, with the archers at the center and the centaur heavy armor warriors as guards!”
Since there was no way to fight back, they would become a steadfast nail in the heart of the berserk ratmen, easing the pressure on the defenses behind them.
Seeing this, netizens watching the livestream couldn’t help but shake their heads and sigh. Anos City was destined to fall.
The disparity in strength between the two sides was too great. Prince Anos’ actions could buy time, but it was merely a slow death.
At this moment, the live chat went wild.
“This is really it, it’s over. I thought these centaurs might make a difference in the last moments, but it seems their efforts are just futile.”
“The only player city is falling? Sigh, there are just too many monsters from the ancient factions… In such a situation, only an Extraordinary could save the city.”
“Extraordinary coming? Whoever says that probably knows nothing. Do you even know what level of power an Extraordinary is? The whole southern province only has one in Green City, and that one has to stay there. Why would he come to Anos City?
If you ask me, it’s better to run away early. That stupid prince lacks intelligence too. He’s thinking of turning the tables in this situation? He should look at his own capacity…”
“Exactly, and even if an Extraordinary could come, it would be useless. Didn’t you see that half of the city below is filled with servants of the Ancient Evil God? I don’t believe there is any power that can kill these millions of berserk ratmen…”
The players watching the livestream were incredibly pessimistic. Even those who harbored a sliver of hope found it difficult to imagine any chance for Anos City to turn the situation around.
The fall of Anos City was imminent.
Outside Anos City, many native inhabitants used magic to witness the battle unfolding, their expressions markedly grave.
Unlike players, this land was their home, where they had grown. If Anos City were to be captured, wouldn’t it mean that other cities might also face the threat of the Ancient Evil God?
For players, losing the main city might sting for a moment, and they could just move somewhere else and thrive. But natives couldn’t do that as whimsically; this was their home.
“Your Grace, the Fierce Half-Ratmen have already overrun most of Anos City, with only the last Life Goddess temple standing.
Once the final temple falls, the adventurers from the Lost Plane will lose their place of rebirth, and Anos City will be completely conquered.”
In the lord’s estate at the heart of Green City, Duke O’Kelly was perusing documents in his study when the bishop of the God of Nobles approached him with a solemn face, reporting the situation of Anos City.
“After the fall of Anos City, as the largest city in the south, Green City will no doubt be directly exposed to the forces of the Evil God from Risier City, Your Grace. We need to prepare early…”
Hearing this, Duke O’Kelly put down the documents in hand, looking up with a serious expression at the bishop standing in front of his desk.
“Would sending troops to rescue now still help North City achieve victory in war?”
The bishop shook his head, giving a bitter smile, “Your Grace, whether at the beginning or now, we have not been capable of coming to the aid of Anos City.”
“Oh?” Duke O’Kelly raised an eyebrow, “If we could have one more city to hold back the Evil God of Risier City, that might not necessarily be a bad thing…”
“That was true before, but now circumstances have changed…” The bishop’s eyes were sharp. “By now, Your Grace’s views on the adventurers from the Lost Plane must have undergone a significant shift, haven’t they?”
To say significant was an understatement; it was a monumental shift.
Duke O’Kelly was lost in thought.
Anos City, relying solely on players, had withstood the onslaught of millions of Fierce Half-Ratmen for several days.
To the high nobility of Green City, this was absolutely heart-stirring.
How long had Anos City been established? Barely a year.
And how long had the adventurers from the Lost Plane been around? Merely a bit over a year.
Yet this city, existing for only a year, coupled with adventurers who had appeared for just over a year, possessed the strength to withstand the charge of millions of Divine Servants.
Moreover, the lord of Anos City had once been royal waste, scorned by them–a prince born to a maid.
What did this imply? It meant that the adventurers of the Lost Plane were a force full of potential, and now their potential had begun to unfold, no longer blindly messing around due to their ability to revive endlessly.
The adventures of the Lost Plane had the power to change the course of wars.
This was the greatest discovery of the Green City nobles since the outbreak of the Anos City campaign.
In the Main Plane of Glory, power was the sole and everlasting criterion for judgment.
Since the adventurers of the Lost Plane had now possessed considerable strength, their natural treatment could no longer be as disdainful as before.
Duke O’Kelly’s eyes held a mix of amazement and apprehension, nodding somberly.
“Yes, the war has shown that the adventurers from the Lost Plane played a role that cannot be overlooked. But what does this have to do with whether we support Anos City or not?”
“Your Grace, Anos City is referred to as their main city by those adventurers… In other words, they see Anos City as their home.
And in this period, the number of adventurers that Anos City has taken in from the Lost Plane has already far exceeded the number of adventurers in Green City.
Previously we considered them a burden and didn’t pay attention, but now, if this trend continues, then Anos City will inevitably have even more adventurers.
For Green City, this is a huge impact, because we also need their strength.”
“But this war that has suddenly erupted seems to have provided us with a breakthrough. If Anos City falls, those adventurers will inevitably have nowhere to return.
At that time, Green City will be their only destination.
Therefore, from the perspective of any interest, if Green City wants to gain the most, it can only hold its forces and not make a move.”
Duke O’Kelly was certainly no fool; he understood as soon as he heard this that the bishop had intended from the beginning to let Anos City destroy itself–its devastation would actually be more beneficial for Green City.
As the supreme ruler of the southern provinces, Duke O’Kelly was not a man of indecision or excessive kindness–traits that did not lend themselves to stability in his position.
“Dispatch troops to monitor the vicinity of Anos City, while keeping the entire city on alert to prevent the servants of the Evil God from attacking Green City. As for Anos City… let it be.”
The bishop nodded, “Your Grace, you need not be concerned. With the war progressing to this extent, even if we were to deploy all our forces to rescue Anos City, victory is uncertain, and it is even more likely that we would suffer heavy losses while Anos City falls.
Moreover, I suspect that the servants of the Ancient Evil Gods still have some tricks up their sleeve, possibly waiting for us to make a move.
This war is unwinnable for Anos City. Not our troops, not even if Lord Rock himself, an Extraordinary, intervened, could make a difference.
At this stage of the battle, no one can save this city destined to fall; no one has that kind of strength.”
Duke O’Kelly gave a faint sigh upon hearing this and picked up the documents to review them again.
The strategic location of the Red Moon Territory was not important, and neither was Anos City built upon it–it was, at most, a city established by a royal outcast.
Moreover, a powerful and prominent figure in the royal family had given him several hints; he had no reason to deploy troops, and even if he did, victory was not guaranteed, so he could only remain silent.
“Go now, and bring news immediately once you receive it. Prepare the contingency plan for after the fall of Anos City…”
“Yes, Your Grace.”
Although the players demonstrated astonishing combat strength, and Prince Anos, whom the nobles of Green City deeply despised as a royal waste, turned out to be unexpectedly valiant,
when news came that Prince Anos, leading the final Centaur Army, charged into the Fierce Half-Ratmen and was then overwhelmed by their number, no one held any hope for this war anymore.
Not even an Extraordinary’s intervention could change the outcome now.
—
—
—
“We can’t hold them back anymore! Retreat, fall back to the rear defense line! President, let’s go, we can’t hold this position!”
A warrior player suddenly beheaded two Fierce Half-Ratmen and grabbed a nearby player to retreat.
At the forefront, Zhao Yue the assassin, who had turned into an assassin class, was wielding a delicate and small crossbow, frantically shooting the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
Assassins were extremely skilled with weapons suited for assassination such as throwing knives and crossbows.
This was a secondary street block held by the Crimson Moon players; relying on their formidable combat strength and the complete set of superb Dwarf Equipment, the players were like nails firmly hammered into their position.
However, players in the surrounding streets had already been killed by the Fierce Half-Ratmen, and despite their prowess, they could not hold out alone and had to retreat to the next street corner, using the prepared defensive position to snipe at the oncoming Fierce Half-Ratmen.
“Everyone retreat to the next defensive position! I’ll cover our rear!”
Zhao Yue did not hesitate; the crossbow in her hand was a Perfect level piece of equipment produced by Lide’s weapons factory, a perfect tool for hunting down these level 7 or 8 Fierce Half-Ratmen with deadly accuracy.
She alone stood as the core position of the ADC marksmen, the most powerful support point of firepower.
As her words fell, the other players immediately began to retreat, trusting in Zhao Yue’s ability.
After the players of Crimson Moon left the defensive line, the Fierce Half-Ratmen below surged up like a tidal wave.
Zhao Yue’s eyes were cold, and the crossbow in her hands, loaded with bolts, could shoot thirty shots, with only a 0.3-second interval between each shot. Although the range was only a hundred blades, it was the deadliest weapon in this environment.
Whiz, whiz, whiz~
The trigger was frantically pulled, and those fierce Half-Ratmen charging up burst open with a splattering sound.
Zhao Yue alone forcibly contained the speed at which these Divine Servants charged, and it was fortunate that the flying Half-Ratmen had all gone to hunt the Centaur Army, greatly relieving the players’ pressure. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have been so relaxed.
The bolts in her hands were exhausted in less than 10 seconds under the intense battle.
Seeing this, Zhao Yue’s hands flashed, and an exquisitely crafted quiver appeared in her hands. In less than three seconds, she reloaded, and the bolts shot out again.
Her gaze remained cold as she, a voluptuous lady clad in leather armor, exuded a charm on the battlefield that no one could block–a pity that no one was there to appreciate this deadly allure.
After the fifth clip was spent, Zhao Yue touched the crossbow in her hands with a hint of emotion, unconcerned by the bloody carnage below.
This was the crossbow that Lide had given her, a pity that the unscrupulous capitalist was nowhere to be found now.
Now that the Crimson Moon was facing destruction, he didn’t show up…
Her resentment could not help but burst forth.
“What a pity, Anos City is surely beyond defense now, even if Lide were here in the face of such a situation, I fear he would be helpless.
No one can withstand these millions of fierce Half-Ratmen…
Am I truly unwilling to accept this, that more than a year of efforts have come to naught?”
Zhao Yue took a deep breath, with a touch of reluctance, she stepped and turned away. Her irregular footwork allowed her to maintain speed while retreating and shooting back; her voluptuous body, paired with agile movements, was filled with astonishing charm.
By the time all Crimson Moon players had retreated to the next position, many had already lost all hope.
For underneath their feet was the last street, and just beyond the street lay the Life Temple. Once the temple fell, the resurrected players would have no foothold, and all would vanish like bubbles.
“It’s over; this time it’s really over. Even the Destiny Hero, Prince Anos, has been surrounded by fierce Half-Ratmen; Anos City, no longer holds any hope…”
“Alas, I always said one shouldn’t accept things given for free. Knowing Anos City was giving land away, one could foresee this scenario. It’s probably the game designers’ intent, creating a monster siege just so the players can’t freeload, damn those game designers, f**k their ancestors…”
“Should we give up? Continuing to fight is nothing more but dying one more time…”
“Defeat is certain; after fighting to this point, even an Extraordinary would be unable to save us, unless some Divine being suddenly appeared and wiped out all these fierce Half-Ratmen with one strike…”
“Divine? Ha, are you dreaming?…”
Pessimism was rampant in the hearts of every player from Anos City.
By now, almost no one believed Anos City could still stand.
Its fall was a foregone conclusion, and many players were already calculating whether to strategically withdraw…
Unsettled hearts, declining morale.
And in the “Glory” game’s official live broadcast room, the cameras, extremely cunning, focused on the chattering players, their words instantly causing the streaming audience to wail in despair.
“Can’t really blame them; fighting to this extent is already impressive. In my opinion, they might as well give up. Why bother holding out here, just a waste of experience…”
“It’s all over. Not even the gods can save this…”
“Anos City has fallen, which city will be next? I’m now wondering whether I should stay in Green City; with this rate, Green City being razed is just a likely event.”
The barrage of comments was overwhelmingly negative; even the most hopeful players had their illusions shattered.
The backbone of the city, Prince Anos, and the Centaurs were trapped at the entrance of the city wall, facing the mad charge of hundreds of thousands of fierce Half-Ratmen; annihilation was only a matter of time.
And to make matters worse, they were cut off, unable even to run.
The remaining players were disheartened and low in morale, pitifully few in number compared to the fierce Half-Ratmen who still fought fearlessly. The gulf between the two sides was apparent to anyone.
As things progressed in the way everyone had anticipated, Anos City continued to be devoured. In the end, players even began fleeing the city, and not even the native Military Governor could prevent their exodus.
The situation became increasingly clear; the fall of Anos City was no longer in doubt, especially when the Fierce Half-Ratmen attacked from the rear gates of Anos City, eventually surrounding both the Mage Tower and the Life Goddess Temple, bringing the war to its conclusion.
Under the onslaught of the numerous Fierce Half-Ratmen, the territory controlled by the players diminished step by step.
But just when everyone thought the war was over, an unexpected change occurred.
The thick clouds in the sky plummeted like collapsing mountains, and a terrifying presence spread out, as if the Abyss Demon God had torn through space to emerge on the Main Plane.
An 18-level storm whipped up millions of tons of seawater to crash against the cliffs, its roar thunderous.
What is this??
Along with the doubts of countless people, the tumbling clouds coalesced into a vortex, and suddenly a shadow appeared in the sky. Then, as if attracted to something, the dark clouds surged downwards.
The scene was like the apocalypse from a wandering bard’s tales, where the entire sky’s dark clouds transformed into a vortex spinning downward until, eventually, that massive vortex slowly descended into Anos City.
The shocking scene left viewers in the livestream in a silence akin to death, to the point where even the chat was empty for a long while.
Not until the black cloud vortex in the sky dissipated and peace returned did the viewers become agitated again.
“What was that?? Damn it, why not zoom in??”
“Hurry up and check!!”
“Did something fall from the sky??”
The camera in the official livestream seemed to heed the voices of the viewers and instantly zoomed in, focusing on the being that had descended from the clouds.
When the camera focused, everyone saw the entity that had caused the extraordinary phenomenon and gasped in unison.
“What the fuck is that monster??”
“That’s terrifying…”
“Such a powerful aura; look, those Fierce Half-Ratmen are retreating, some are even kneeling…”
In the clearing where the Centaur Army was encircled, a creature appeared before everyone, standing five blades tall, with a body covered in disgusting tumors, resembling an enlarged version of a Fierce Half-Ratman.
This creature was far uglier than a Fierce Half-Ratman but the aura it emitted made everyone’s throats tighten.
Transcendent!!
Yes, it was the aura of a Transcendent!
At this moment, not only were the players watching the livestream in an uproar, but the natives who had witnessed this scene through magic were also perturbed.
Many immediately used magic to transmit the information of the Evil God dispatching a Transcendent back to Green City.
When Duke O’Kelly received this message, his heart was instantly filled with horror.
His worst fear had finally come to pass.
The emergence of a being in Risier City with a combat power he least wished to see.
Transcendent.
This meant that Green City’s greatest trump card, the Extraordinary Mage Lord Rock, would no longer be their ace in the hole, for the foe now possessed the strength to contend with them.
Although he had been able to keep his composure internally, now he was truly panicked.
If Anos City were to be breached, would the adversary then set their sights on Green City next?
And who could be sure that there was only one Transcendent existence within Risier City, or worse, that there existed combat power even beyond the Transcendent?
All of this was shrouded in a fatal veil.
“Bishop, have we received any news from Lord Ilo?”
The reporting bishop shook his head, “I’m sorry, Lord Ilo has not been seen since the battle at Risier City…”
“Keep a close watch on Anos City. I want to know everything after that evil Transcendent appears! At the same time, find Lord Ilo as soon as possible. Green City needs the protection of a true powerhouse!”
—
—
Players using gaming pods and helmets to watch the live broadcast were almost scared out of their wits by the five-blade-tall Transcendent Half-Ratman.
The aura it emitted struck directly at their souls.
Those netizens who had never played “Glory” experienced what it was like to feel spiritual oppression for the first time.
It was as if someone had their arm around their necks, a stone pressing on their chests, making breathing extremely difficult.
“Transcendent?? Is this what a Transcendent is? I’m truly scared shitless…”
“Is this really just a game? How can that aura be so lifelike?!”
“I couldn’t even breathe at the moment I saw that creature, damn, that’s terrifying!”
The chat in the live streaming room was instantly flooded with messages, everyone was deeply shocked by the sudden appearance of the Transcendent.
This was also the first time many “Glory” players came into such close contact with a Transcendent; the official live broadcast brought everything about the Transcendent into the game without any discount.
Ordinary games instill fear through visuals, music, color, etc., but Transcendents in Glory merely by standing there, without any action, could make everyone feel weak at the knees.
The aura they emitted wasn’t something that could be mimicked by a game; it was the fear that lower life forms feel when encountering higher life forms, just like mice instinctively terrorized by a cat.
After the arrival of the Transcendent Half-Ratman, the Half-rat men flying overhead and the Fierce Half-Ratmen shrouding the Centaur Army began to retreat frantically, revealing the Centaurs within a few breaths.
Only then could the players through the live broadcast see the scene clearly.
The Centaur Army formed a circular formation, with the heavily armored Centaurs outside and those wielding bows inside.
The bodies of the Fierce Half-Ratmen were piled around the perimeter of the formation, up to seven or eight blades high, creating a wall of corpses.
A terrifying Land of Death.
Of course, with the Fierce Half-Ratmen’s mad siege, the number of Centaurs had also dropped from over ten thousand to six thousand.
The loss of life was indescribable.
Prince Anos, who led the charge, now had armor that was nearly shattered, pockmarked everywhere with the marks left by the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
This was an almost decimated army.
But what was worse, this broken battalion had encountered an even stronger enemy – the Transcendent Half-Ratman.
Prince Anos, sensing the opponent’s Abyssal Giant Beast-like presence, turned to look at the Centaur Army behind him, and in his heart no longer harbored any will to survive.
A Transcendent had been sent out… they, had no hope left.
His mouth tasted incredibly bitter; perhaps he would never be able to return to Nolan Capital to exact his revenge.
“Lowly Centaurs, and that despicable life form, I sense a familiar aura on you… that damned New Sun God!”
Unexpectedly, the Transcendent Half-Ratman didn’t immediately commence the slaughter but instead looked toward Prince Anos with a cold gaze.
The ancient blasphemous language resonated through the sky.
“That despicable New Sun God in Risier City and his Divine Country stole my Divine Artifact… This hatred will never die; he will become the prey I hunt!!”
Outside Anos City, many of the natives were stunned upon hearing this tone, their eyes widening as they looked at the images conjured by the Spellcasters, stammering.
“This, this is not Extraordinary, it’s the Evil God from within Risier City!!”
Hiss~
The crowd around gasped in shock when they heard this.
An Evil God??!! This was a thousand times more daunting than any Extraordinary threat.
“Are you sure??”
“His tone and the chilling language of evil match exactly with the Evil God of Risier City!! Creator God above, this time it’s actually the God of Plague himself who has come…”
Soon, not just one native confirmed through the information spoken by the Extraordinary Half-Ratman that the perpetrator was indeed the scourge within Risier City–the God of Plague.
Although they did not understand why he would descend upon a Half-Ratman of only Extraordinary Level, everyone knew that with the arrival of this Evil God, the last flame of hope for Anos City had been extinguished.
Many people were already preparing to leave the area, because once Anos City fell, no one could guarantee that the Evil God would not go on a killing spree among the nearby population.
The God of Plague looked indifferently at the Centaur Army before him, his gaze locked directly onto Prince Anos Prince.
He sensed the Bloodline within the other, a scent he would never forget in this lifetime, that damn New Sun God!!!
The intent to kill began to climb step by step, the body that had cost a great price to condense into a 24th Level Extraordinary was infused with a terrifyingly monstrous power.
He planned to slaughter the Centaurs by himself, and then extract the soul of that Vampire to interrogate it, to find traces of the New Sun God!!
With killing intent surging and eyes flashing like lightning, the Evil God’s body, 5 blades tall and as if cast from copper water, burst forth explosively.
In the blink of an eye, he crossed a distance of hundreds of blades, and under the gaze of billions watching the livestream, this 5-blade-tall monster charged into the Centaur Army, initiating the most brutal massacre.
The Centaurs, although clad in Dwarf-forged Steel Armor, were completely futile in their resistance against a 24th Level Extraordinary, especially one that carried a fraction of the soul power of the God of Plague, an incredibly daunting presence.
The claws of the God of Plague, a blade in length, snapped the Centaurs’ long spears as if they were mere weeds.
The spears that struck him were like wooden sticks thrust against an iron plate, utterly unable to penetrate his defenses.
The long-suppressed roar of the God of Plague now poured out onto the Centaurs.
His body, like the most ferocious green giant, rampaged and slaughtered through the Centaur Army, shredding to pieces any who dared to obstruct him.
Blood and limbs splattered everywhere.
The entire Centaur Army was unable to stop him in the slightest.
The scene looked like a prophecy from the doomsday murals of a church, shocking and terrifying.
In the live broadcast room, seeing the sheer dominance of the God of Plague, everyone exploded.
With a mere wave of his claws, he could tear apart one sturdy Centaur after another in steel armor, displaying power that made one’s scalp tingle.
“Holy shit, this is just a pure Human-shaped Mecha!! Who could possibly defeat this???”
“Long spears as thick as my wrist, just torn apart like that?? Too freakish!!”
“I bet even the normal Hulk couldn’t take down this monster!”
“Anos City really hit a streak of terrible luck, not only being besieged by so many fierce Half-Ratmen but now a monster of Extraordinary Level has emerged…”
“What Transcendent?? Don’t you know? This monster is the Evil God within Risier City, and now somehow it’s descended upon this beast.”
“Is there even such a move? Then isn’t Anos City in an even worse state?”
Netizens were watching the excitement, but the players were sighing incessantly. That was their main city, and it was being targeted by an Evil God. Even the players who weren’t developing in Anos City felt a bit stifled and annoyed.
You’re just an NPC and that’s fine, but you even want to bring down the only main city we have in ‘Glory’? Are you even human??
But the NPCs had too much power and the players could vent their frustration nowhere.
“Damn, these goddamn game designers, they just can’t stand to see us doing well. We finally built up a player-friendly main city and now they’re just sending a god to destroy it!!”
“Right, I felt something was off just now. Why would they send an Evil God through just because we’re a few levels up? It must be those goddamn designers who dislike us deciding to wipe out the player’s main city…”
“Again, asking, who knows the official website address for Glory? Damn their granddaddy!!”
“Alas, is there anyone who can save this city??”
The phrase ‘a rabbit dies, a fox grieves’ could be used to describe the netizens and players watching the livestream, but for the players in Anos City, only ‘despair’ would suffice.
As words of blasphemy echoed through the sky, when that Transcendent aura oppressed their hearts even from thousands of miles away, the air fell silent.
Everyone was swallowed by despair.
Transcendent… these fierce Half-Ratmen even had a Transcendent descending upon them…
Everything was gone.
Zhao Yue stood atop a collapsed building’s ruins, desperately pulling the trigger of the crossbow in her hands. But deep down, she held no hope, yet she still clenched her teeth and made her last effort, intent on dying on the battlefield!
If the president of Crimson Moon wasn’t there, she had to take on this responsibility!
Hun Yuan Thunderclap Hand Cheng Kun, the top three leaders of the Dark Contract Guild, showed bitter faces at this moment. Looking back at the diminishing number of players emerging from the Life Goddess’ temple, they were filled with helplessness.
The players knew it was futile. Apart from their own guild members, no one else was willing to resurrect and return to meet their deaths.
It was all over. After the fall of Anos City, the Dark Contract Guild was likely to decline… They had invested so much, and now, losing everything they had, it would be difficult for them to rebuild such a strong force as now.
Puchi~
As Hun Yuan was lost in thought, a sudden pain pierced his chest. Glancing down slightly, he saw the arm of a fierce Half-Ratman bursting through his torso.
Blood was everywhere.
“Second Brother!!?”
“Damn!!”
“President!”
Thunderclap Hand and Cheng Kun rushed forward and killed the fierce Half-Ratman in a few moves, but Hun Yuan’s gaze had already dispersed.
With the pain of impending death, he said with difficulty, “Damn it, it hurts so bad…
If possible, keep leading the remaining people to the end; we can’t retreat anyway…”
As his words fell, Hun Yuan heard the system’s notification that he was dead and needed to wait eight hours to respawn, but just before he exited the game, a voice like thunder rolling from the ninth heaven boomed in the sky, causing him to suddenly widen his eyes.
“God of Plague? Who gave you the audacity to run wild on my turf?…”
Then came the fuzzy voices of the surrounding people, a mixture of shock and joy.
“Lord Ilo??!!”
