These chambers housed 1,000 individuals per team, and 10 Priests would be sent to indoctrinate them.
"The prayer chambers have the assistance of Giants and the Bloodline; the construction is progressing very quickly, with dozens being built every day."
Anthony nodded and continued to inquire, "How is the indoctrination progressing?"
"All is going well at the moment. These Cave Dweller believers have a fixed schedule of praying 12 Sunshine Hours each day.
Besides about 200,000 cave dwellers needing to work daily to produce Microglow Mushrooms for everyone to eat, the rest are continually praying under the Sun Eye, with the devout believers now exceeding 300,000."
Millions of Cave Dwellers, praying 12 Sunshine Hours daily...
This was an incredibly impressive feat, one outsiders could hardly imagine the Twilight Sect achieving in a mere month, what many sects took decades to achieve.
But at this moment, Anthony did not display much joy, remembering an absolute command he had received, his expression became even more solemn.
"Currently, Naga City has a total of 1.35 million Cave Dwellers, 1.42 million including this new batch.
But the number of devout believers is only one-fifth, Kedri, this is not enough!!
I hope to see half of the Cave Dwellers become devout believers in a fortnight... His Majesty’s command must be fulfilled!!"
"The God War absolutely cannot be negatively influenced by us."
Kedri Sharp Tooth abruptly stood upright and saluted Anthony.
"At your command, Lord Anthony!"
Although he now controlled Naga City, his status, raised from Dawn City, was incomparable to that of a cave dweller; furthermore, Anthony, possessing a legendary profession, was strong enough to defeat this super cave dweller.
After reminding Kedri Sharp Tooth, Anthony no longer lingered; he hurriedly turned and left as there were more cave dwellers waiting for him to transport, and he had no time to waste.
Since over a month ago when Lide wielded the power of Bloodline and Faith across countless planes to bring down Divine Power, commanding everyone to develop followers of the Twilight Sect at all costs, the entire Twilight City had begun to frantically mobilize.
Lide had informed everyone that he was engaged in a colossal and unprecedented clash—a God War—in the abyss with a powerful Evil God.
The God War needed an immense amount of Faith Power for support, requiring a vast number of the Dark Race to become followers of the Twilight Sect.
These nearly 1.5 million cave dwellers were the spoils of war from Twilight City’s frenzied efforts during this period.
This weak race couldn’t handle much, not of great value, but there was one particular reason that Twilight City chose this race as the main target for expanding its followers—cave dwellers were extremely easy to convert.
Other races might take ten days or half a month to become mere general believers.
But cave dwellers, given just three to five days, could become followers, and their faith deepened more easily; after studying and comparing, the upper echelons of Twilight City swiftly formulated a plan to plunder cave dwellers to become followers of the Twilight Sect.
This trait instantly provided a great advantage to the cave dwellers; due to their weakness, they were easy to convert, their weakness ensured procreation, hence a larger population.
These prior disadvantages, now became advantages.
The capture plan, after reaching two hundred thousand cave dweller converts, immediately received Lide’s praise.
Thus, everyone was resolute in executing this grand plan of harvesting followers.
As targets of the hunt, the cave dwellers were naturally captured continuously.
Indeed, if these lives weren’t adept at burrowing, often building their nests hundreds of blades deep underground which caused significant troubles for the army of Twilight City, the numbers would likely be substantially higher.
Yet, even so, the number exceeding 1.4 million was astonishing enough.
"For His Majesty!! For the God War!!
We shall achieve ultimate victory!!"
When everyone consolidated their morale, the entire city was in a state of fervor.
Kedri Sharp Tooth immediately took people to the outskirts of the city, and upon meeting those fearful and uneasy cave dwellers, the essence of his cave dweller bloodline emanated.
That familiar, gentle cave dweller scent instantly calmed the anxious cave dwellers below.
King of the Cave Dwellers... the fierce pressure was simply too much for these cave dwellers to endure.
After a few brief words, these cave dwellers submitted.
Below, priests from the Twilight Sect, already prepared, immediately began taking these cave dwellers down to the newly established prayer chambers.
Half of each prayer chamber was filled with firmly faithful followers, and even some devout believers, among whom these new cave dwellers would listen to the priests’ preachings.
Most intelligent lifeforms exhibit herding behavior.
Mixing new cave dwellers with believers was a strategy specifically developed for cave dwellers, proven absolutely unbeatable after trials.
The insecure cave dwellers, in an environment where everyone practiced faith, would become general believers within a day.
This burrowing race wasn’t known for its steadfastness.
Prayer rooms were established within the mountains thousand blades high behind Naga City.
Cave dwellers were best at digging caves, which meant their requirements for a living environment were quite simple—they could manage in dirty, messy conditions as long as there was enough food.
Currently, many cave dwellers had become dedicated praying personnel; upon waking each day, they spent their time in prayer rooms praying, contributing their humble faith to the great Twilight City.
But for these underground beings, such an environment didn’t make them uncomfortable.
Instead, with plentiful food and a secure environment, coupled with the support of their faith, they felt life here was better than in the outside world.
Though they had lost some freedom, they had gained much more.
It made sense that these easily managed beings were chosen as believers, their mentality perfectly suitable for captivity...
Among the thousands of caves that stretched across half the mountains, the Cave Dwellers in one prayer room after another were whispering their prayers.
The power of faith formed by these prayers was crossing time and space, accumulating on the majestic figure they worshipped through certain primal rules.
——
——
——
Far from the glorious Main Plane lay the bottomless abyss.
It served as a haven for evil, a place capable of making the entire multi-dimensional plane shudder with terror.
This land, exuding the scent of sulfur, harbored all imaginable evils.
Moreover, it was home to numerous mighty beings—the ancient Abyssal Giants, soul-devouring Ghosts, angels seduced into corruption by desire, bloodthirsty Evil Gods, and greedy, cruel giant dragons.
Enchanting Demons, Charming Demons, Flame Demons, Drowned Demons, Double-horned Demons, Soul-devouring Monsters, and countless other demons feasted on slaughter here.
Additionally, there were Fallen Angels, Abyssal Abominations, multicolored Evil Dragons, and deep prison demons forming a legion of ancient golden demonic races ruling over numerous planes.
This was the land of ultimate evil, that could be described using every negative adjective to depict this chaotic, decayed land filled with death, slaughter, cruelty, and blood.
At this time, within an unnamed layer of this Land of Extreme Evil, Lide, who had been missing for a month and a half, was trapped in a dark magic array filled with a corrosive aura.
Beyond his three-bladed energy, a transparent energy barrier encapsulated him like an inverted bowl, blocking the highly corrosive black mist.
Shifting his attention away from himself, he peered out through the barrier.
The area enveloped in darkness met his gaze; the sky devoid of color, filled with roiling black fog that seemed ready to unleash demon heads with gaping maws at any moment.
The air was thick with the sting of sulfur, a unique scent of the abyss containing potent toxins, deadly with even a single breath to ordinary humans from the Main Plane.
Lide’s current condition was not good. His mage robe was corroded and pockmarked; his streamlined, perfect muscles faintly visible through the fabric.
His handsome face was suffused with pallor, likely due to excessive depletion.
Beside him was a five-bladed, circular, curved Eight-Armed Snake Demon, the Divine Body of the Snake Race God.
But it also contained immense Divinity, which he could not store in the System Space and could only place beside him.
The altar that was originally by his side and sealed the Snake Race God had shattered upon his entry to the abyss, and it was then that he had killed this once immensely powerful Evil God.
The only regret was that his god-slaying act, worthy of myth, was known only to those in Twilight City and no one else.
As for Asreaga... that Divine Monster was bombarded by the God of Twilight upon entering the abyss and vanished, swept away into some chaotic spatial flow.
The mastermind behind this dark magic array, using Soul Crows to transport him along with the altar sealing the Snake Race God, was none other than the evil deity— the God of Twilight.
At this moment, this high and mighty Evil Divine was watching Lide, who was still attempting to resist futilely, with a hunter’s mentality.
"What a delightful soul... You pathetic thief, although you have devoured the soul of that fool, the Snake Race God, and even gained his Divine Status, you no longer have a chance to assimilate it.
This past month, you’ve relied on the energy obtained from devouring his soul to fend off my corruption, but your power is growing weaker...
Give up resistance, Vampire..."
Hidden within the dark fog, the God of Twilight, like a Divine King looking down upon all creation from his altar, constantly disrupted Lide’s will with profane abyssal language.
"Though you are incredibly stubborn and foolish, the fact that you’ve lasted this long has indeed surprised me. Perhaps I can offer you a promise, yes, a promise.
"If you give up resisting and pledge your allegiance to me now, I can allow you to become my subordinate god..."
At this moment, the Abyssal blasphemous language shifted from the soul-piercing sharpness to an Enchanting Demon-like seductiveness.
"Abyss above, you should be proud that for millions of years, no one has ever been acknowledged by the great God of Twilight...
Your resistance is destined to be futile, so why not give up now and become my subordinate god, thereby obtaining infinite power?"
"And take a look around you, where are you?... This is the Bottomless Abyss, separated by countless planes from the Main Plane.
You cannot escape... Here, only I am the absolute."
The tone of the God of Twilight grew more and more emphatic, as black fog surged.
"I am the master of the Abyss, the eternal and undying God of Twilight!
Submit to me, and you will receive my blessings... Continue to resist, and once your power is drained, I will extract your soul and sear it with demonic flames for a million years!
Now, make your decision, Vampire, whether to submit to me and become the great subordinate god or to be destroyed and have your soul extracted!"
The Abyssal blasphemous language reverted from temptation to a formidable deterrence and intimidation.
Alternating between soft and hard tactics, this evil divine being of the Abyss played multiple roles alone.
Upon hearing these words, Lide’s profound eyes hardly fluctuated, even harboring a hint of mockery.
Thinking these words alone would intimidate him?
The strong disdained to converse extensively with the weak.
The God of Twilight’s extensive nonsense wasn’t truly an attempt to subdue him but rather indicated that the evil god was also very weak, unable to kill him before his power was exhausted.
What nonsense about subordinate gods, if he simply gave up resisting, his soul would definitely be devoured by the other party at the first opportunity.
When Lide was dragged into the Abyss over a month ago, his heart was somewhat panicked, but after frantically devouring the Snake Clan God first, he instantly gained a terrifying power boost.
At that time, the God of Twilight struck, trying to crush him with absolute power.
However, by leaning on the Dark Faith Power and the power gained from devouring the Snake Clan God, he stubbornly resisted.
During this struggle, the God of Twilight, who should have killed him in one blow, ended up at a stalemate with him.
This made Lide instantly realize that the God of Twilight was not as powerful as the God of Plague and seemed to be close in strength to the Snake Clan God, both being sealed.
This resulted in the God of Twilight being unable to easily kill him even if he could release all his power in the Abyss.
This discovery greatly steadied his mind.
The divine body of the Snake Clan God contained an immense amount of energy, but this energy was not utilized because the Snake Clan God was sealed and the Soul Power was weak.
Using the Dark Faith Power, he devoured the soul of the Snake Clan God and gained the boost from that power, thus he continuously resisted the attacks of the God of Twilight.
But he was unable to escape and instead got trapped even deeper because of the weakening power of the Snake Clan God.
After being trapped, Lide had been trying to find a way to break free.
Finally, after trying countless methods, he found that the Dark Faith Power was the best way to deal with the God of Twilight.
That led to the transmission of orders through the Bloodline and Power of Faith, instructing Twilight City to frenziedly expand its believers.
Also because of issuing this do-or-die command, his Dark Faith Power had been increasing at a terrifying speed over this month and a half.
Over a million Cave Dwellers prayed to him day and night, which was an astonishing concept.
This was also the first time Lide directly realized why other Sects required believers to pray daily, even having special collective prayer times weekly.
Because after long periods of prayer by believers, the acquisition speed of the Power of Faith would greatly increase.
According to his estimate, the increase speed of the Dark Faith Power was more than three times that of the believers of the Dawn Sect, an exaggerated and unbelievable rate.
Lide heard the words of the God of Twilight and looked up at the sky, speaking slowly.
"God of Twilight? You, worthy of such a God Name?"
Rejecting the other party’s alliance? Sorry, he didn’t even entertain the idea of refusal, showing utter disdain from the outset.
As Lide spoke his merciless words, the transparent barrier outside erupted in swirling black mist like an 18th Level storm, filled with terrifying noises.
"Vampire!! You have utterly enraged me!! Your flesh, your soul, everything about you will be devoured by me!!"
Hearing this impotent fury, Lide paid no heed and shifted his gaze back to the attribute panel of the Twilight Sect he had been closely monitoring.
It contained a key attribute he had been waiting for over a month.
It was also his greatest reliance for turning the tables.
Twilight Sect
God of Twilight—Lide Kachar (Fake God)
Divine Arts: 1, Soul Assimilation, 2, Faith Enhancement
Divine Position: Twilight (currently mastered 0.01%, mastery reaches 100% you will completely control this divine position)
Doctrine: Twilight is imminent, the multi-dimensional plane will be destroyed, the great God of Twilight is the eternal Main God, only He can save mankind, His believers will achieve eternal life when the world is destroyed, unbelievers and heathens will be gifted endless agony
Holy Object: None
Number of Temples owned: 12
Number of believers: Fanatical believers 321, devoted believers 350,000, believers 650,000, generalized believers 420,000
Power of Faith: 997,890 points
This string of impressive figures was vastly different from a month ago.
Over a million believers were nearly unsolvable.
Additionally, the Power of Faith had reached the critical point of 990,000, just over 2000 points shy of 1,000,000.
What can 1,000,000 Power of Faith do?
Lide quietly clenched the thumb-sized black sphere in his hand.
Fragmented Divine Status
Quality: Special
Condition: Fragmented/Asleep (requires 1,000,000 Dark Faith Power to activate)
Introduction: A fragmented divine status, but it still nurtures the power of the "Twilight Divine Position," needing a great amount of Dark Faith Power to activate.
His sending troops to the Underworld months ago was aimed at gathering Dark Faith Power to activate the Divine Status.
And now, following the Twilight Sect’s nearly frenzied recruiting campaign, the believers had exceeded a staggering figure of 1.4 million.
He finally accumulated enough to meet the staggering requirement to activate the Twilight Divine Status—1,000,000 Dark Faith Power.
What did the rampaging God of Twilight outside the barrier rely on?
Wasn’t it his own power?
The Twilight Divine Position was undoubtedly like the claws and tusks on a tiger’s body. Once he cut off the God of Twilight’s tusks and claws, what could this evil god use to bare its fangs at him?
At this thought, Lide’s gaze grew even colder.
After a momentary wait, the number on the attribute panel silently ticked forward.
The Power of Faith column now read—1,000,000 Power of Faith...

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 431: Activating Divine Status, Beating Up the God of Twilight (10,000-Word Mega - )
chapters.content:
Chapter 429: Chapter 431: Activating Divine Status, Beating Up the God of Twilight (10,000-Word Mega Chapter)
million Power of Faith.
Lide saw the number on the attribute panel and his eyes shone brightly; after months of hard work, he finally saw the payoff.
He looked up at the sky where it seemed a giant hand was stirring the dark fog, a cold curve forming on his lips.
Without any hesitation, the Power of Faith began to be channelled into the Twilight Godhood.
"Ding~ Do you want to consume 1 million Dark Faith Power to activate the Twilight Godhood?"
"Confirm."
The moment he confirmed the activation, Dark Faith Power burst forth from the panel like water gushing from an opened dam gate.
But the shocking power showed little reaction upon entering the Twilight Godhood, as if the thumb-sized black sphere was a black hole that could devour the starry sky, never to be filled, regardless of the energy it consumed.
The terrible energy caused uncontrollable vibrations in the surrounding space, and the scent of Dark Faith Power permeated the air.
Such an obvious action immediately caught the attention of the God of Twilight.
The Abyss Evil God, hidden in the dark fog, invisible in form, went insane upon seeing the Divine Status in his hand.
Black fog formed into countless demon claws, frantically shredding Lide’s transparent Barrier.
Crackle~ Like millions of demons surging from the darkness at this moment, the barrier with a radius of 3 blades began to slowly shrink under the force of the assault, rapidly depleting its energy.
"My Divine Status?! You dare to covet my Divine Status! You cannot succeed!!"
"Damn Vampire! I will pull out your soul, stuff it into worms, and then throw you into demon excrement to soak for a million years!!!"
"Ah!!"
Mad roars, heart-wrenching screams.
Abyssal blasphemy caused the black fog to rise in towering waves, as if a gigantic beast thousands of feet tall was rolling within the fog.
The countless demon claws around him were more frenzied, constantly tearing at the transparent Barrier.
From a bird’s-eye view from above, the transparent Barrier now resembled a sole canoe in a towering wave, seemingly at any moment it could be submerged by the high waves.
Previously, the God of Twilight planned to use his home field advantage to slowly wear down Lide, especially since Lide was in the Abyss, far from the Main Plane, and this was his territory.
His plan had been effective earlier, at least in the eyes of the God of Twilight.
The Evil God sensed every day the weakening of the power within Lide’s body, the power he had devoured from the Snake Clan God being rapidly consumed.
Each day, the God of Twilight felt a step closer to his goal.
But at this moment, Lide’s actions had undoubtedly crossed the God of Twilight’s bottom line.
This damned Vampire dared to devour the Twilight Godhood right in front of him!!!
That was his source of power; how could he tolerate this??
This was even more unbearable than being bullied in front of his own eyes!!
Enraged, the God of Twilight carelessly began a furious assault on Lide despite the limited power within his own body.
He wanted to kill this bastard! Crush his head, dry his flesh, and tear his soul to pieces!!
Lide was very much aware of the God of Twilight’s actions; those terrifying black fogs were transformed from the Divine Power and soul energy of Twilight City, containing extremely terrifying forces.
If an outsider had come, even a legendary one would have already been devoured.
But he was not fighting alone; a hint of cold light flashed in his eyes, as he channeled a wave of Dawn Sect’s Power of Faith into the Divine Body of the Snake Clan God at the moment of activating the Godhood.
The God of Twilight wanted a life-or-death battle...
He deserved it?
The complete Divine Body, upon receiving the Power of Faith, seemed to touch a critical node and then suddenly erupted with a terrifying force, pushing the surrounding transparent Barrier outward by 3 blades, reaching a radius of 6 blades.
Although he had absorbed the power of the Snake Clan God, he had kept a trick in hand, a hidden trump card that was activated now, forcibly blocking the God of Twilight’s attack.
The Snake Clan God, though sealed for countless years and greatly weakened, still retained the essence of Divine Power within its Divine Body; the weakening of power did not alter its nature.
Using his spear against his own shield.
The Snake Clan God could never have guessed that his summoning of the God of Twilight was supposed to help him kill Lide and save his own life.
But he hadn’t anticipated this hand of abyssal checkmate brought by Twilight City, causing the altar that sealed the Snake Clan God to shatter due to the terrifying Plane Power after being transmitted to the Abyss.
This directly resulted in his Divine Body appearing right before Lide, who then fiercely devoured his soul without giving any time to react.
The Divine Body, containing all the unutilized power of the Snake Clan God, now became Lide’s spoils of war.
The summoned assistant ended up killing himself, and his body became the capital for Lide to confront the God of Twilight.
If anyone knew all this, they would surely judge the Snake Clan God as the most wrongfully dead character in "Glory"—Glory Dou E.
Realizing this change, the God of Twilight’s anger surged, but faced with a force of the same level, he had no choice but to clash directly.
If his divine status were still intact, let alone one vampire, even ten or a hundred would be mere worms—he could easily erase this area with a single Divine Art.
But the weakening of his powers left him unable to cast Divine Arts, and having lost his divine status in the previous Battle of the Gods, he could only resort to the most primitive methods to clash with Lide.
Lide had long seen through this, which is why he was able to integrate divine statuses here with such impunity.
Therefore, although vigilant, he still followed the pre-set plan—integrating the divine status.
Divine status, as the most fundamental power of a divine being, like divinity and divine position, is the source of divine power.
Divine status is akin to a human heart, divinity is like blood, and divine position is like human consciousness; they form an organic whole, lacking any one of which would greatly reduce the power of a divine being.
At this moment, Lide held the source of the God of Twilight’s power in his hands, which was tantamount to controlling his lifeblood, driving the God of Twilight into a frenzy.
With the infusion of the Power of Faith, the Twilight divine status began to emit a faint glow, reminiscent of the twilight after the sun sets, invigorating the spirit.
The immense Power of Faith caused the long-dormant divine item to slowly awaken, bursting forth with vitality.
Power was surging.
Lide could clearly feel that after the infusion of the Power of Faith into the divine status, the aura it radiated towards him became increasingly benign and affectionate.
Because the Twilight Sect had millions of believers, he had already mastered 0.01% of the Twilight Divine Position. Although minimal, this was purely activated by himself.
For this reason, the Twilight divine status felt exceptionally affectionate toward him.
As more and more Power of Faith was infused, the divine status, the size of a thumb, began to rapidly brighten, and the emanating fluctuations grew increasingly astonishing.
When the light touched Lide, his spiritual power actually reached into the divine status, and he discovered that the restrictions originally closed off to him inside the divine status had quietly been lifted.
Realizing this, Lide’s thoughts moved, and spiritual power began to flow into the divine status, then wandered through the most mysterious and fundamental core of power in this world.
When his spiritual power reached a certain threshold in the divine status, it seemed to activate something, and a flood of vast, patchy information began to transmit into Lide’s mind.
Exploring the structure of the divine status, a shock thrilled through Lide, and then scenes that astounded him appeared before his eyes.
The sunrise arose, and the sun hung high in the sky,
The sunset fell, and the bright moon floated in the Star River.
The cycle of the sun and moon, the rules were repeating.
Day after day, flowers bloomed and withered, day after day, fruit trees decayed, and time never ceased.
That wondrous feeling made Lide feel as if he was witnessing the most fundamental rules of the world turning.
His soul cheerfully trembled in jubilation at this moment.
Twilight Divine Position... So this was what Twilight Divine Position meant.
Regardless of sunrise or sunset, a day always came to an end, and twilight always arrived.
Twilight referred to the time after sunset when darkness gradually fell, but it didn’t solely represent the weather. In the interpretation of the Original Rules, Twilight represented an era of rules reaching its end, with significant changes about to occur.
This divine position meant he could control the direction of this significant change at the end...
The deeper Lide delved, the richer he found the connotations of the Twilight Divine Position to be. It was far more than just a metaphor for the time after sunset.
Also due to the Twilight Divine Position, Lide gained a deeper understanding of the Bloodline and Blood divine positions.
Bloodline didn’t just represent the vampires as a group of beings; it also represented the birth, growth, and death of a race—extraordinary implications.
And Blood represented power, life, regeneration, and also decay...
Assorted thoughts surged through his mind at this moment.
Lide also realized for the first time that the power he commanded held so much potential to be unearthed—his previous perspective was childishly simplistic.
Yet, as the God of Twilight ferociously attacked, he suddenly halted, for he sensed the change in Lide’s aura.
It was the aura of twilight, a sensation he could never forget, even over millions of years.
This damned vampire, he had actually managed to integrate his divine status!
A hint of uncontrollable panic rose in his heart.
After the panic, the God of Twilight plummeted into extreme madness.
He felt that if it continued like this, he might actually have his power stolen by this despicable vampire—right before his eyes.
But what enraged him most was that even though he knew what Lide was doing and that he was right in front of him, he lacked the power to shatter that damned shield!
"I can’t just wait like this anymore!!"
The God of Twilight, watching Lide, whose aura was growing stronger, made a decision.
"...އަމުރުތަކުގައިވެސްމެއެވް...އެއުރެންނަށް..."
A series of complex and obscure spells resonated within the surrounding black mist, and after a moment, it spread like a blast wave to a far distance.
Lide furrowed his brows upon hearing the spell; although he sensed the actions of the God of Twilight, at that moment his attention was fully captured by the Twilight Godhood.
Seasons changed, the sun and moon revolved; no matter the time, place, or object, nothing could escape the theme of twilight.
Even on the Elemental Planes, where there were neither sun nor seasons, the traces of twilight were indelible.
This was the law of change, utterly irresistible; even planes that had existed for hundreds of millions of years faced twilight, aging was twilight, collapsing mountains were twilight, drying rivers were twilight...
Birth, growth, decline, death, and twilight represented the process from decline to death.
The experience this Divine Status provided to Lide was invaluable; it was his first time truly understanding what a Divine Position meant.
Only when the Dark Faith Power on the attribute panel dropped from one million to zero did Lide’s experience with the Twilight Divine Position end, and the Twilight Godhood in his hand was fully activated.
The faint light emitted from the Godhood in his hand gave Lide the comfort of walking down a tree-lined path after sunset.
Whoosh~ Just as he was deeply experiencing that feeling, the Twilight Godhood, like a bolt of lightning, flew straight towards his chest and without any hindrance, merged directly into his heart.
Ah~
That feeling...
It was so fulfilling.
A hint of intoxication flashed across Lide’s eyes.
After merging with his heart, the Twilight Godhood began to emit an even more potent power; this power directly coursed through his heart, inflating every blood vessel and bone in his body like a pump.
Thump, thump~
Thump, thump~
His heart, already strong and vigorous, became like one cast of steel, each beat bringing him immense power.
At this moment, his blood vessels surged like lava flowing.
Lide’s aura began to rise step by step; even the already near-perfect Golden Ancestor Bloodline began to automatically replenish itself under this terrifying energy.
It takes a million Dark Faith Power to activate a Godhood; the level of this Divine Status and the power it contained are staggeringly impressive.
Lide’s aura rose rapidly; now, he couldn’t afford to be distracted, only striving to rapidly devour the surging power within his body, using it to transform his physique once more.
Amidst the overwhelming power, the space around him contorted and distorted.
Everything around blurred, Lide could no longer hear the malicious curses issued by the God of Twilight in the language of the abyss, nor perceive the black mist around him that seemed like demon claws tearing at him.
At this moment, the sound of his heartbeat overwhelmed all other noises.
All he could hear beside his ears was the thump, thump—the pulsing of his blood following his heart’s beat.
Under the baptism of this immense power, he vaguely saw sunrises and sunsets, stars moving, the laws of Glory displayed before him, allowing him to comprehend the true essence of the Twilight Divine Position.
He felt exhilarated, but the God of Twilight was nearly driven mad.
Under the gaze of this Evil God, the familiar faint light began to spread from within Lide’s body, replacing the barrier set up with the Snake Clan God’s power, and even expanding its breadth to a radius of 15 blades.
The dark light swallowed all the light around, and the God of Twilight could only watch helplessly as Lide disappeared from view, unable to observe what was happening inside.
Even more infuriating for him was that this dark glow was the Power of Twilight, which had once belonged to him!!!
In a furious rage, the God of Twilight began to assault the Dark Barrier formed by the dark power, reckless of the cost.
But what terrified him was that the surrounding black mist, upon colliding with the Dark Barrier, had no effect at all, not that it couldn’t shake the barrier, but rather the Dark Barrier was actually absorbing his energy and replenishing itself...
Filled with reluctance and resentment, the God of Twilight experienced for the first time what it was like to be hindered by the Power of Twilight, unable to endure how Lide was handling it.
"Vampire!! You wouldn’t want to know the terrifying taste of enraging me!!"
As the God of Twilight grew increasingly irate, a sound of footsteps resonated within the black mist, then a chilling tone emerged.
"Great God of Twilight, your believer, heeding your call..."
"Please issue your divine command, my god..."
That was a voice with a foreign accent, not possibly human, seemingly older and more sinister than the language of abyssal blasphemy.
The God of Twilight fell silent for a moment before his voice boomed like thunder cascading from the heavens.
"Within the Dark Barrier, a foreign vampire whom I captured has stolen my treasure!!
That damnable heretic must not be left alive!!
My loyal followers, breach the barrier, kill that vampire, and retrieve the treasure, and I will reward you with great power!!"
At that moment, the blasphemous language of the Abyss, high and mighty, was filled with divine pressure, inducing unavoidable fear.
It was in stark contrast to his previous impotent fury.
It seemed that only now was the God of Twilight truly manifesting himself, not diminished in power in the slightest, testing the loyalty of his believers as if it were merely a formality.
The race speaking ancient and evil languages shouted excitedly.
"By your command, our god, any who dare to profane your glory deserves to have their heads chopped off!!"
This was followed by a burst of strange, eerie cries.
Moments later, those evil lives rustled through the gaps parted by the black mist, coming towards Lide.
Once a portion of the Abyss life emerged from the passage, they immediately revealed their true forms.
Had Lide seen this scene, he would have been utterly astonished, for these were not any ordinary race but the Upper Race — the Naga — with red sharp spines on their backs, four robust arms, and serpentine lower bodies.
He would have never expected these evil lives he had once encountered in the Underworld to be followers of the God of Twilight.
The only good news was that these Nagas were not particularly powerful; aside from their leader who was level 19, the other thirty-odd Nagas were around level 10 and none were Transcendent.
The level 19 Naga leader was a robust male with a particularly striking black eye in the middle of his brow.
Upon seeing the Dark Barrier, the Naga leader, instead of attacking, showed a change in expression and hesitated.
He sensed a power from the barrier that felt familiar, and that power was indeed the power of the God of Twilight.
Moreover, the Twilight Power inside the barrier was even denser and more potent than that concealed within the black mist by the God of Twilight himself.
Compared to the God of Twilight instructing them to attack the barrier, it seemed that the entity inside the barrier was more deserving of their devotion.
What’s happening?
All Nagas, sensing this, looked at each other, suddenly at a loss.
It was as if their master had sent them to catch a thief, but upon arriving, they found that the master appeared to be the thief because the thief resembled the master more.
Moreover, in the midst of the heavy flow of Twilight Power around them, the traces of belief in their minds blurred, leaving them even more unable to discern the true from the false...
Watching the Nagas hesitate to act, the God of Twilight was seething with rage.
What are these fools doing? If they wait any longer, that damn vampire will consume my Divine Status!!
"Nagas! Break that barrier! Kill the blasphemer inside!!
My loyal followers, that thief has stolen my divine object and is now converting the divine power within it. Do not hesitate, strike and kill him!
After you kill that vampire, you will receive my blessing!!"
Hearing this, the Nagas steeled their hearts, and their gaze toward the barrier sharpened, but just as this group of Nagas decided to act.
Suddenly, a voice from within the Dark Barrier made them falter.
"My children, I am your father god.
That damnable Fake God took advantage of my seclusion to recuperate and sneaked into the sacred area, attacking me...
The feeble power of the Fake God did hurt me, but that was all.
You are merely pawns the Fake God brought to disrupt my recovery. He is already trapped around here...
My children, come into the Dark Barrier, I will protect you...
Once I regain my power, that already wounded Fake God will have his soul annihilated by me!
The Divine Body of the Fake God is already dead, only his soul remains wandering outside! He cannot escape!"
What is this situation??
The leader of the Nagas, sensing that familiar twilight aura, suddenly widened his eyes, at a loss.
A Fake God attacking?
Is this divine entity inside the barrier the true God of Twilight? Is the one outside the Fake God who attacked the God of Twilight?
This revelation threw the Nagas into confusion.
If they were not in an environment rich with Twilight Power distorting their perception, they naturally could have discerned clearly who the enemy was.
But the problem was, they could only sense the presence of their god of Twilight, but couldn’t discern exactly who it was...
The God of Twilight, upon hearing Lide’s shameless words, exploded with rage almost to the point of detonation, roaring furiously.
"Damn you, Vampire!!! You liar!!
I will devour your soul!!
Drain your blood!!"
But just as the God of Twilight raged, the glow of the Dark Barrier suddenly surged, and while the Naga looked on dumbfounded, it quietly enveloped them.
Because the power was so familiar, they didn’t think to resist, and the wariness in their eyes vanished in an instant, for they felt no danger.
Instead, being engulfed by the Dark Barrier gave them a very comfortable sensation, like returning to their mother’s embrace, secure and warm, even their inner power rising gradually...
If initially they had doubts, now almost all Naga were swayed, thinking this one must be the true God of Twilight.
The feeling was too splendid.
No one but the God of Twilight could possess such pure Twilight Power. Could a Fake God have such power??
Ultimately, it was because the Divine Status within Lide’s body was originally that of the God of Twilight, and as believers, the Naga were very familiar with the Twilight Power, that’s why they switched sides so quickly.
At this point, another major problem was that the God of Twilight simply couldn’t prove it was itself.
Now both parties possessed Twilight Power, but the Divine Status within Lide contained power that was purer and richer than what the God of Twilight currently had.
Thus, the roles reversed.
"My children, stay here and wait for me...
That Fake God’s Divine Body is here, help me guard it. Once I regain my strength, it will be time to annihilate that Fake God’s soul."
Lide spoke with a fatherly tenderness, and amidst the spreading aura of Twilight, these Naga were instantly lost.
It wasn’t that they were too foolish, but the power of Twilight was simply too authentic, how could such a high level of power be stolen?
In comparison, the God of Twilight hidden within the black mist seemed more like a counterfeit.
Moreover, because the Dark Twilight Power also contained the Power of Faith, it had already begun to slowly enhance their strength.
Compared to the impoverished God of Twilight, the difference was simply too great.
Everyone prefers to believe that the Divine Power they worship is stronger.
As Lide’s words fell, the dark light flashed, and the Naga saw the Divine Body of the Snake Clan God.
That gigantic figure, four blades long, was so conspicuous at the moment, especially with the divine fluctuations it emanated, startling the Naga, almost like the last straw breaking the camel’s back.
This was indeed a true Divine Being.
Even in death, the divine authority that penetrated the soul was still vast, an existence unimaginable to ordinary life.
These Naga were now completely convinced by Lide’s words.
After all, compared to the bland God of Twilight, Lide, whether in terms of the emitted Twilight Power, his rhetoric, or the Divine Body before them, was far more persuasive.
The Naga leader thought this, immediately kneeling on one knee before the blurry figure of Lide, his eyes filled with guilt and regret.
"Your Majesty, that damned Fake God deceived us!!
This unforgivable error, we will defend your dignity with our lives!"
After these words were spoken, Lide suddenly heard a system notification chime.
"Ding~ You have obtained the loyalty and faith of the Kabar Naga Clan; you gain 100,000 character experience."
Lide, hearing this sudden prompt, twitched the corner of his mouth, almost bursting out in laughter... this was undoubtedly his most bizarre deception to date.
The minions summoned by the God of Twilight had actually defected to him...
If it weren’t for the need to focus his mind at this moment, he would certainly have delved into why these Naga were so peculiar... Can’t they even comprehend the Divine Power they worship??
He did not notice that the divine power surrounding them had twisted the Naga’s perception; furthermore, the Divine Status was originally that of the God of Twilight. The Naga were followers of the God of Twilight, but how were they to judge who was the God of Twilight?
Of course, it was judged by whose power was purer, how could Lide, who held the Divine Status, be compared to a ghostly God of Twilight?
Thus, this extremely bizarre scenario was indeed unfolding.
The God of Twilight upon hearing this nearly suffocated.
If he knew profanity, he would certainly curse these Naga’s ancestors for eighteen generations... I prompted you to eliminate that vampire to prevent him from devouring my Divine Status.
But now, not only do you not stop him, you actually defected to him?
!!!!
"You fools!! I am the God of Twilight!!
Damn Naga!! You are as foolish as that Vampire!!"
Hearing the God of Twilight’s curse, the Naga were not happy.
At this moment, in their eyes, Lide, who emitted an even stronger aura, was the true God of Twilight. This despicable Fake God attempting to steal divine power was utterly unforgivable!!
The leading level-19 Naga chief took two steps forward, his gaze cold as he looked at the swirling black mist in the sky, and spoke indifferently.
"Damn heretic!! Your divine body has already been killed by our god! Yet you still try to deceive your way through!!
How dare you try to glimpse the majesty of our god?!
You filthy insect, your head should truly be stomped into the mud!!"
The God of Twilight was almost exploding with fury.
What did he hear?!
This damn Naga, daring to insult him to his face?!!
They dare to insult the god they worship!!
The God of Twilight almost felt an energy rush directly to his soul. This Evil God was truly maddened by immense fury.
"You!!!
Ah!!!"
After the roar, the black mist in the sky turned directly into a giant black fist hundreds of feet long, then fiercely bombarded the Dark Barrier.
Bang~
The ground shattered, forming dense webs of cracks, and stones scattered across the sky. Even the Dark Barrier faded a bit under this terrible attack.
At this point, the God of Twilight didn’t care about the consequences.
The black mist was his soul transformed, the denser these mists the stronger his power. Similarly, when these black mists disappeared, he would utterly perish.
Each of his attacks consumed a portion of the black stone mist.
At this moment, the God of Twilight’s attacks seemed tremendously terrifying.
As the giant hammer struck the ground, the surrounding black mist again condensed into soul crows, tens of thousands of crows swarming like locusts toward the Dark Barrier. Each soul crow burst apart upon colliding with the barrier.
The exaggerated scene slightly terrified the Naga.
But thinking of their god’s divine power behind them, they instantly gained full courage. Even several Naga spellcasters cast spells to bombard the crows, and the Naga chief furiously cursed the God of Twilight...
This scene was like fuel to the flames, driving the already furious God of Twilight even madder.
The intense attacks were like divine punishment of apocalypse; even tens of thousands of troops would struggle to withstand them, likely to be annihilated in an instant.
While the God of Twilight was going mad, Lide’s integration with divine status had reached a critical point. Secretly, his level on the attribute panel had already reached level 24.
One more step, and he would break through to Legendary.
Legendary and Transcendent are absolutely not from the same realm.
If Transcendent is like a city’s foundation, Legendary is like the foundation of a nation, functioning like a nuclear arsenal.
A country without Legendary could never grow strong; this is the peak deterrent force on the Main Plane. Even among high-level beings of the Abyss, Legendary is an extremely powerful existence.
After breaking through to Legendary, one can seek the true peak—Divine Enthronement.
Achieving divinity is indeed the ultimate pursuit of all life.
Because only by becoming a divine entity can one obtain eternal and immortal life, probe into the original power of this world, and freely roam across the multi-dimensional planes.
Under the washing surge of terrifying power from the divine status, Lide could clearly feel the power within him enhancing.
His soul became more resilient, his bloodline could contain more power, his body grew stronger, and his bones more solid...
He was undergoing a rapid transformation.
Correspondingly, his control over the Twilight Divine Position was also increasing bit by bit.
1%...2%...5%...10%...until finally an exaggerated 30% before slowly stopping.
Controlling 30% of the Twilight Divine Position felt wonderfully exquisite.
Everything seemed to reveal its patterns before his eyes; he could even predict when the surrounding Naga would age, when they would move from their peak to twilight.
This is the power of rules, having touched the core of this world’s original source.
The power of Divine Status was overwhelmingly immense.
Lide had progressed from Level 23 to Level 24, using less than 30% of his power, while the remainder gradually accumulated, elevating his body, consolidating his soul and optimizing his Bloodline.
Step by step, he was moving towards Legend.
At a certain point, when the power of Divine Status reached its extreme, Lide suddenly felt an epiphany, as if he could step into the realm of Legend at any moment—if he so desired.
Yet, deep inside, he felt there was more power to be absorbed, more elevation to be achieved, similar to when he had leapt from Level 19 to Level 23 during his breakthrough into Transcendence.
Ultimately, Lide forcefully restrained the impulse to break through to Legend immediately, not only because he could deepen his foundation but also because last time he had transcended, he had slept for months on end.
He was unsure what commotion breaking into Legend would cause. With the God of Twilight ever watchful, if he sought death, he must at least find a suitable place.
Having made up his mind, Lide continued to absorb the power of Divine Status until it was depleted, yet he remained at Level 24.
But when he opened his eyes, how much stronger did he feel than before?
Quasi-Legendary.
He had already perceived the domain of Legend, an unprecedented realm, but now was not the time; he could only stand at the threshold without stepping through.
His aura slowly receded, and naturally, the system’s notification followed.
"Ding~ You have merged with the Twilight Godhood and gained the Power of Twilight, mastering 30% of the Twilight Divine Position.
You have automatically comprehended the following Divine Arts.
Twilight Radiance—Consume 10,000 Power of Faith to unleash a ray of light imbued with the Power of Twilight, capable of depriving an opponent of Life, aging their soul.
Twilight Barrier—Consume 10,000 Power of Faith to release a barrier, within which the life of any being will be plundered to replenish the barrier’s power, the wider the barrier’s range, the more Power of Faith is consumed.
The Approach of Twilight—Consume 10,000 Power of Faith to cast a light of twilight, briefly shifting the opponent into old age, the stronger the target, the more Power of Faith is needed."
Upon reading the system’s prompt, Lide’s eyes brightened.
Three Divine Arts?!
This was akin to striking it rich overnight.
Furthermore, all these Divine Arts were offensive in nature, fundamentally different from the Twilight Sect’s Faith Enhancement and Soul Assimilation.
Divine Arts are the most powerful offensive methods of Divines, essentially, the strength of the Divine dictates the power of the Divine Arts, but even the weakest Divine’s Arts are not something ordinary beings can withstand!
Above Forbidden Curses, only Divine Arts reign supreme.
Lide slowly rose to his feet, his gaze shifting toward the black mist outside the barrier.
That Evil God was recklessly bombarding the barrier, causing the earth itself to tremble.
A Divine’s wrath must not be taken lightly, even if the adversary had lost most of its power.
With a wave of his hand, the dark glow dissipated, and Lide, revealing his true Bloodline form with half-spread wings, appeared before the eyes of the Naga.
Seeing Lide, the deceived Naga were instantly thrilled to the utmost.
For they had only known the God of Twilight as soul energy and had never seen his form; naturally, Lide’s appearance excited them immensely.
"My God, your humble believers plead for your forgiveness, we have sinned!"
The leader of the Naga was the first to step forward and kneel, his narrow eyes filled with remorse, having almost been deceived by that Fake God—unforgivable.
Lide nodded in satisfaction, he always preferred to conquer his enemies without bloodshed...
"Rise, my children, the cunning of that Fake God is beyond your imagination."
His gaze then turned cold.
"Next, it’s time to kill this damnable blasphemer!"
With a fierce wave of his hand, under the astonished gaze of the Naga, Lide floated up and plunged into the dense black mist.
"Thief! Scoundrel! You wretched Vampire!! I will crush your soul!!"
When the Evil God saw Lide emerge, brought near soul collapse by rage, it finally found a vent.
)
Endless power surged toward him; the Evil God no longer cared for anything else, determined to drag Lide down even in death.
Countless Soul Crows with chilling killing intent attacked, targeting only Lide.
Feeling the surging power rushing towards him, the corners of Lide’s mouth slightly lifted.
"Pathetic Fake God, it seems you have misunderstood one thing... Now, I am the God of Twilight!"
After the words fell, his right hand stretched out, and a faint light diffused from his palm, the Power of Twilight wafted out.
The Power of Twilight, something he comprehended after mastering 30% of the Twilight Divine Position, was similar to the Power of Crimson but was not a Skill; it was control over the Twilight Divine Position.
The surrounding Soul Crows, the instant they flew near him, were like entering a time tunnel, each rapidly disintegrating.
Like moths to a flame, the Soul Crows were directly disintegrated by the Power of Twilight.
Twilight, signifying the proximity of destruction and death, accelerated their march toward death.
These Soul Crows were utterly futile against such a high-level power.
Tens of thousands of black soul crows, dragging long black energy tails in the air, charged directly at Lide, but they were obliterated before even getting close to him.
The scene looked as spectacular as an apocalyptic myth.
The God of Twilight, seeing this, felt as if his heart was bleeding; that was his power! All of this should have been his!
Sigh~
Upon realizing that ordinary attacks were ineffective, the God of Twilight decided to risk it all.
A thick black mist began to madly condense in the sky, and a giant hand hundreds of blades long slowly took form.
If this hand were to strike down, it would be enough to make the earth burst open.
Upon seeing this, Lide was inspired and looked toward the Divine Art he just comprehended—Twilight Radiance—that could strip away the opponent’s life, making their soul age and decay.
It seemed that this Divine Art was specifically prepared for the God of Twilight, who naturally couldn’t possess a body having lost his Divine Status, and with the battle having reached this point, any trump cards should have been used by now.
Watching the giant hand still condensing in the sky, Lide’s sharp perception spread out, and he instantly realized that the God of Twilight, to increase the hand’s power, was now gathering his soul inside it too.
Lide’s expression was quite spectacular as he witnessed this.
This exploration of the Divine relics indeed had twists and turns; nobody expected things to develop to this extent...
Now, it was time to end it all.
"Twilight Radiance!"
The newly comprehended Divine Art had no restrictions on using the Dark Faith Power. There were still over 300,000 units of the Power of Faith on the Dawn Sect’s panel, and at this moment he straightforwardly smashed 100,000 units of the Power of Faith to cast this Divine Art.
Below, dozens of Naga watched as a terrifying aura that made their souls tremble diffused from Lide’s palm.
In the sky, the giant hand also formed at this moment, the surrounding black mist thinning out due to the formation of the hand, one could imagine the price the God of Twilight had paid this time.
It’s a long story, but all this happened in just a few breaths.
The moment the giant hand formed, carrying with it the aura of shattering star rivers and splitting the sky, it smashed down, seemingly poised to penetrate the earth and turn mountains and seas upside down.
View the correct content at
Lide spread his fingers open, then slightly brought them together, touching his thumb to his middle finger, exerting a little force.
Snap~
A crisp snap echoed through the sky.
Then, under everyone’s gaze, the God of Twilight’s conjured giant hand was instantly eroded by a dark energy, and in just two blinks, like ice meeting boiling water, the black hand began to rapidly retreat.
Ice thawed, tiles disintegrated.
"No?! How could you possibly comprehend Twilight Radiance?!"
Accompanied by a screech filled with extreme agony and reluctance, that black power burst like fireworks,
exploding in the sky.
Black fireworks; this moment had a different flavor.
Lide hovered above the ground, his already extraordinary figure illuminated by the fireworks of black Divine Power above him, made sublime by the surroundings, inciting an urge for adoration and kneeling submission.
The majesty of a king.
God descends upon the world.
The Naga below, upon seeing this scene, couldn’t help but be mesmerized. With just a snap, that powerful Evil God disintegrated into a black mist and dissipated.
Adoration nearly spilled from their eyes.
This was the Divine they worshipped!
Truly magnificent!
Praise our God!
These Naga, unaware that the explosion was actually their worshipped Divine, were still moved by the grandeur of the scene...

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 432: Post-War Gains, The Beginning of Conquering the Abyss Plane (9400 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 430: Chapter 432: Post-War Gains, The Beginning of Conquering the Abyss Plane (9400 words)
"ding~ You killed the God of Twilight (Medium Divine Power), gaining 200,000 experience."
"ding~ The number of Divine beings you have killed exceeds two, earning your Divine System Master title an additional trait—’Divine Might like Hell.’"
"Divine Might like Hell, any life enveloped by your aura will sense that you have slain Divine beings, significantly increasing your intimidation power against Divine-Life forms above Level 30."
After the system’s prompt resounded, it marked the end of this twisting and turning God fight.
From discovering the Divine relics to killing two Divine beings, the twists in this affair far exceeded Lide’s expectations; likely, no one could have anticipated so many ripples from it.
"Sadly, only the soul of the God of Twilight remains after exploding; not even a hair was left behind..."
Lide regretted the dissipating soul power in the air and those scattered Divine essences which had become too thin and were now left to fade away.
"However, it’s a relief that the title of Divine System Master gained an extra trait. Now, facing those Divine beings transformed into Saints in the Main Plane, I will possess more deterrent power."
But just as Lide thought everything was over, he suddenly sensed very thin Divine Power in the air gathering towards specific areas on the ground.
This piqued his interest; his senses spread instantly, following those faint traces of Divine Power.
After a moment, these barely detectable thin Divine essences burrowed into the ground, absorbed by a small silver stone.
"Divine Stone?"
Lide’s eyes lit up. The altar that sealed the God of the Snake Race, once entered into the Abyss, was crushed under the pressure of the planes, scattering the Divine Stones around it.
Unexpectedly, these scattered Divine Stones directly absorbed the sparse Divine forces in the air.
"Good, I’ll leave them for a while, and after they’ve absorbed all the Divine essence, I’ll dig them out."
Lide was quite satisfied at this moment, considering it an unexpected pleasant discovery.
After ensuring there were no other disturbances, he began to reflect on his gains from this battle.
First and foremost, the complete Divine Body of the God of the Snake Race, the biggest loot, was equivalent in value to a Divine Artifact.
If used properly, it could significantly enhance Dawn City with more Transcendents.
He had never been this wealthy before—a whole Divine body! If used to make soup, how nourishing it would be; forget surviving seven rounds in a night, even twelve would be manageable...
Second was his Level, which had now reached the edge of Legend. As soon as he found a safe place to retreat, he could break through the boundary and enter another level at any time.
Strength was the basis of everything, especially now that the ancient days had arrived, making it all the more critical.
The third gain was the newly mastered Twilight Divine Position. Although he only had 30% control over it, he had mastered three powerful offensive Divine Arts, greatly supplementing his weaknesses in this area.
Moreover, the Twilight Divine Position provided him significant insight, allowing him to understand the Divine Positions of Bloodline and Blood anew.
Given some time for serious research, even without the Divine Stone, he could significantly enhance his control over these two Divine Positions.
Invaluable.
After some consideration, Lide was quite satisfied.
These three gains far exceeded his expectations, making the last two-plus months of adventure completely worthwhile.
Of course, his gains didn’t end there.
Below, the Naga Tribe, along with the entire tribe, had become his Believers, and in the Main Plane’s Underworld, he had more than 1.4 million Believers.
1.4 million Believers, no less lethal.
These Believers were praying day and night, contributing twenty to thirty thousand Power of Faith every day.
This made him a super top-tier owner.
Thinking of this, Lide concentrated his mind; he almost forgot to send the message of victory to the Main Plane.
He immediately used the Power of Faith in his Spiritual Sea to transmit the news of the God fight victory to the high echelons of the Twilight Sect across countless Planes.
And in the Underworld, upon receiving the news Kings like Beastman King Kapp, Half-Elf Great Mage Mahari, and characters like Super Cave dweller Kedri Sharp Tooth, all became incredibly excited.
It wasn’t just a win in this God fight—His Majesty had slain two Evil Gods in the Abyss!
By the Creator God above, this was almost unbelievable.
That was an ancient evil god from the Abyss!
And after the high-ups learned of Lide’s victory in the god war, the news quickly began to spread to the lower ranks of the army.
Before long, the entire Twilight City was engulfed in celebration.
Especially after knowing that the great Kachar had killed two Abyss evil gods in the god war, the fervor escalated.
"Kachar, your greatness, too grand! A godslayer! He actually slew gods!"
"Hahaha, I bet those evil gods got their heads crushed by his boots, just like how I crush those worms..."
"Long live! With Kachar so mighty, how could those heretic divinities ever stand a chance?"
"Hahahaha, long live the Twilight Sect!"
This god war that lasted nearly two months had everyone in Twilight City in a state of utmost tension, the atmosphere heavy like never before, as the consequences of Lide’s defeat were unimaginable to all.
This was true for the upper echelons and even more so for the army below.
Everyone worried, everyone feared, to wage a god war in the Abyss, the thought alone was desperate...the Abyss!
At this moment, in this extremely oppressive atmosphere, news of victory arrived...
The atmosphere that had been restrained for nearly two months was suddenly released, and everyone’s mood rebounded at that moment.
Roars and shouts of anger, the entire Dawn City was in a state of immense excitement, seemingly trying to release the repressed feelings through their voices.
The best way to resolve internal conflicts is to face external ones. As Twilight City, while indoctrinating the evil races of the Underworld with mostly pan-believers,
this unified external confrontation and intense management and repression, in turn, elevated many believers’ faith in the Twilight Sect by a significant margin.
With their oppressed hearts now relieved, even the naturally arrogant Naga were seeing a rapid rise in their faith levels.
Such are the benefits of a victorious war.
The victors gain everything.
"Lord Kapp! To think that the victory achieved by His Highness came so swiftly, should we continue the trade with the Half-body Main City??"
Level 18 Half-Elf Mahari stood by Beastman King Kapp’s side, unable to hide the joy in his eyes.
Kapp, watching the excitedly celebrating army from the loft in Twilight City Square, felt his weariness wiped away, and laughed out loud.
"Of course we shall continue. His Highness has issued new orders—to continue converting the Cave Dwellers into believers of the Twilight Sect.
Yet, on top of that, we need to allocate part of our efforts towards logistical support.
Now nearly 1.5 million Cave Dwellers and an army of seventy to eighty thousand consume a huge amount of food daily.
If it wasn’t for the Microglow Mushrooms’ growth cycle being only a month, our logistics might have already collapsed from the demand."
Even though the god war was won and the crisis averted, the development of believers must continue.
But along with developing believers, we also need to catch up on the logistics that were paused in response to the crisis.
This past month, in fact, the greatest difficulty lay not in capturing the Cave Dwellers but in how to provide them with food.
Had it not been for the huge amount of food obtained from conquering Naga City previously, Twilight City might now be facing a severe food crisis.
"Yes, Lord Kapp," Mahari responded gratefully, turning to make another trip to the Half-body Main City.
But this time his demeanor and aura had undergone a massive change; he now set off with the attitude of one whose deity had triumphed in the god war.
With a strong backing, his confidence was naturally solid.
The Underworld rejoiced, and the Naga, having witnessed Lide snap his fingers and defeat the God of Twilight, were also exceedingly thrilled.
This was their revered and great Divine—the God of Twilight!
The glory of the god was naturally the glory of the believers, their shared pride.
Being believers of a powerful divine, they naturally felt proud and dignified, and their faith was greatly elevated.
At this moment, Lide withdrew his focus; the Main Plane was temporarily safe, there was no need to worry excessively, now he must address the predicament he faced—how to extricate himself from the Abyss.
Upon this thought, his gaze shifted to the Naga below.
Seeing the reverence in the eyes of this upper race brought a smile to his heart.
These fools could never imagine that the true God of Twilight had been blown up by fireworks right before their eyes.
This was a true case of the scapegoat standing in plain sight of these Naga...
But in essence, to the Naga, who the God of Twilight was did not matter; what mattered was whether the God of Twilight was strong enough to bring them greater benefits and a sense of security.
In Glory, the essence of a believer’s worship of a Divine is actually transactional; the believers exchange the Power of Faith for the Divine’s protection and rewards.
Thus, who the transactional party is becomes secondary; what they can provide is what’s more important.
This underlying logic is why so many humans worshiped Evil Gods – not because the Evil Gods were benevolent, but because they offered something the Divines of Light Attributes could not.
When Lide landed on the ground, the Naga immediately began to pay their respects in reverence.
"My God, your brilliance is enough to make the Abyss tremble, praise be to you."
Dozens of Naga had eyes filled with indescribable fervor.
They had personally witnessed the fall of a Divine.
Such a direct impact was hard to describe in words.
The one that was killed was a god! The pinnacle being of this world!
Lide nodded slightly, "Very good, my children, your loyalty has won my approval."
After a slight praise, he shifted the conversation.
"I have spent a long time restoring my power in the forbidden lands; this time, I will leave the seclusion and accompany you to your tribe.
As my people, I will guide the future and direction for the Kabar Naga Clan."
Naturally, he could not stay in the Abyss forever, but to leave the Abyss, he must first figure out where exactly he was and how to return to Dawn City.
The Ancient Evil had already descended, and the servants of the Evil Gods had begun their frenzied attacks on everything in the Main Plane; the order of the Main Plane was nearly collapsing.
Additionally, with the emergence of new players, the situation had become very chaotic.
He could not sit idly by with an uneasy heart.
Moreover, there was a presence deeply worrying Lide – an archenemy he had offended countless times, who would flay and debone him upon sight – the God of Plague.
That Ancient Evil God’s Divine Artifact had been stolen by him, his Divine Body had been seized by him, even his Divine Position had been gifted to Harrison...
The Fierce Half-Ratman of Risier City must have turned the world upside down by now; it was uncertain whether that Evil God had descended onto the Main Plane.
The relationship between the two was definitely of the sort that would erupt into a life-and-death struggle upon meeting, of course, that was the God of Plague’s perspective. If that Evil God was willing to sit down and talk, maybe they could bury the hatchet and put past grudges aside, Lide was more than willing.
Hearing Lide’s words, the Naga leader’s face revealed a hint of surprise.
The magnificent crown accompanying him to the Kabar Naga Clan?
"Your Highness, it is an honor for our Kabar Naga Clan!"
The Naga leader felt like he had found a Divine Artifact. The previous God of Twilight had made this a forbidden land to accumulate power, thus rarely interacting with the outside world.
But the God of Twilight couldn’t just do nothing; to gain more Power of Faith, he had reluctantly granted significant benefits to the Naga.
The Naga, having received past rewards, were naturally extra sensitive to this, and since they now regarded Lide as the previous God of Twilight, they were utterly submissive to him.
The God of Twilight was dead, and all that he did had now become trophies of war for Lide, who had perfectly inherited all.
If the God of Twilight knew of this situation now, he would rather have killed himself than transport Lide into the Abyss.
It was undeniably a brain-bursting loss.
Lide smiled meaningfully.
"I am never stingy with rewards to those who believe in me..."
With these words, he had the Naga’s hearts leaping, some even wished they could take Lide back to the Naga Tribe to worship right away.
"If we could award them with three or five treasures, wouldn’t they ascend to heaven?" Lide thought, with high hopes, his image growing ever more imposing in the eyes of the Naga.
After a short while, the black fog surrounding them had dispersed due to the Death of the God of Twilight, and the light in the air regained some of its brightness.
Lide’s thoughts shifted as he realized that the Divine Power of the God of Twilight had mostly dissipated, with a small portion naturally scattered and the rest absorbed by the Divine Stone.
It was time to harvest.
Despite the God of Twilight merely existing as a soul, this region that served as his habitat could very well be hiding something valuable.
Turning his head and looking around, Lide felt a bit troubled.
The area was so vast, how long would it take him alone to search?
After a little thought, he looked to the Naga leader; these tools were ready to be put to use.
"Tell me your name, Naga."
The named Naga leader was overjoyed and quickly replied,
"Oli Kabar."
"Oli, I have sustained some damage in the last Divine Battle, and I had to seal a part of my memory.
Somewhere in this land, I seem to have buried some treasures, but I no longer remember where they are.
Send people back to the Kabar Tribe, lead your clan to search this area, and if you can find those hidden treasures, I will reward you with a part of them."
This statement made Oli, the Naga leader of Level 19, jubilant; to him, Lide was implicitly rewarding them.
"As you command, your highness, we will definitely retrieve the treasures you’ve lost."
"Besides the treasures I’ve forgotten, there is also a special type of ore scattered in this area."
Lide finished speaking, waved his hand, and the translucent Mage’s Hand appeared, reaching for the Divine Stone he had just spotted.
Snap—Gravel flew about, and a silver rock was quickly grabbed and returned.
The Naga leader, overwhelmed with honor, received the Divine Stone from the Mage’s Hand,
"Take this Divine Stone and search the surroundings; there should be a significant quantity. Moreover, replace all searchers with the most loyal believers."
"As you wish, your highness.
Please follow me, let’s return to the Kabar Tribe first, and let my kin handle the search here. Only the most devout believers are worthy of executing your commands..."
"Good."
Lide smiled faintly, then let the Naga leader lead him towards the Kabar Naga Clan.
Exiting the area devastated by the God of Twilight, Lide then took interest in observing this Abyss Plane.
The dim light seemed to be an eternal characteristic of the abyss, with neither the sun nor the moon capable of illuminating this evil land.
The area controlled by the God of Twilight was a rocky terrain stacked with rubble, surrounded by heaps of carcasses of various humanoid creatures, Demon Beasts, and other indiscernible race’s skeletons.
Some dry corpses were buried in the debris, occasionally revealing half a shriveled head or a weathered limb.
The scene was exceedingly sinister.
The breeze blowing in the air carried a heavy scent of sulfur, which mixed with the abyss’s unique evil, and if one looked and listened closely, faint blasphemous languages of the abyss could be heard in the wind.
That was the manifestation of the abyssal will—the low murmurs of the abyssal blasphemy with no specific meaning but could constantly erode one’s soul with evil.
Even the mentally resolute warriors couldn’t last long in such an environment; this is the ultimate reason why no benevolent life could exist in the abyss, as its rules wouldn’t allow.
The abyss...
Lide took a deep breath; as a prominent member of the Bloodline, naturally, he would not be affected by the blasphemous language of the abyss.
Looking up at the sky, which was dim without sun, moon, or stars, it seemed that this place was always in this state, much like the Underworld.
Fortunately, the plane where the God of Twilight resided was relatively normal and didn’t resemble the apocalyptic living conditions depicted by wandering bards.
"Oli, do you know of the Black Scale Naga?"
After leaving the area of the God of Twilight, Lide seemed to remember something and looked towards Oli Kabar, the leader of the Naga at his side.
The Black Scale Naga are Nagas from the Underworld; after Dawn City conquered Naga City, the upper echelons of the Black Scale Naga disappeared, most likely having escaped to the Abyss through a spatial channel.
After the disappearance of Asreaga, a master of space, the most effective way for him to return to the Main Plane was to locate the region of the Black Scale Naga and reconnect the spatial channel to the Main Plane.
But with the Abyss being so vast and having countless planes, he naturally had no way to know where they were.
Originally, Lide was prepared to be disappointed, but the words of the Naga leader surprised him greatly.
"Black Scale Naga? My lord, the Black Scale Naga rule over the 272nd plane and are constantly at war with the Abyss Snake Clan...
Our Kabar Clan moved here from the plane ruled by the Black Scale Naga millions of years ago."
Oli looked at Lide somewhat confused, not understanding why he suddenly asked this question.
A moment later, something came to mind, and he said excitedly,
"My lord, the Black Scale Naga have never worshipped any deities... Are you planning to conquer them?"
Conquer the Black Scale Naga?
Lide raised an eyebrow, a hint of amusement flickering in his eyes—this seemed to be a viable path...
The best way to open a channel to the Main Plane was to get the Black Scale Naga to cooperate.
But for these Upper Races to cooperate, what better method was there than holding them down and forcing them?
However, the issue was how strong were the Black Scale Naga? And where exactly was the 272nd plane?
It would be rather awkward to not even know the way there.
"Oli, do you know the way to the 272nd plane?"
"My lord, our current residence, the 270th Gravel Plane, is not far from the Black Scale Naga. The territory of the Double-Horned Demons has a bidirectional teleportation gate leading to that plane..."
Upon hearing this, Lide’s face broke into a slight smile of surprise; he didn’t expect to find a way back so quickly, having mentally prepared himself for a prolonged stay in the Abyss.
His mind stirred.
Was that teleportation gate occupied by the Double-Horned Demons?
Double-Horned Demons were a common type of demon in the bottomless Abyss, named for the two sharp horns on their head.
These middle-level demons varied greatly in strength; a powerful Double-Horned Demon Lord might possess demigod-like power, while the weakest were merely level 10.
"How strong is that group of Double-Horned Demons?"
"They have two Extraordinary demon lords, with a force exceeding 100,000, controlling the central region of the Gravel Plane."
Dual Extraordinaries?
Lide nodded, observing that the overall strength of the Gravel Plane wasn’t too formidable.
The Abyss was constructed from countless planes, where the deeper you go, the stronger the demons became.
Planes above layer 300 were considered surface planes, while only those below layer 600 could be deemed Deep Planes, where the strongest Demon Dukes and Evil Gods in the Abyss resided.
With so many planes in the Abyss, the strength of life in each plane also varied.
Generally, the richer the resources in a plane, the stronger the demons inhabiting it.
The Gravel Plane had few resources, so apart from some weaker races, no powerful demons were willing to waste time on such a barren plane.
"Apart from the Double-Horned Demons, are there other races on the Gravel Plane?"
"My lord, in the south of the Gravel Plane, there is a group of Enchanting Demons, numbering around 100,000, commanded by an Enchanting Demon Lord who has just reached Extraordinary level.
To the west reside a group of Abyss Half-orcs, about 200,000 strong, led by a level 19 two-headed Half-orc.
The north is known as the Rotten Land, burying countless bodies and now occupied by a group of powerful Undead. Outsiders do not know the specifics, but there definitely exists Extraordinary Undead.
There are dozens of other races scattered around, but their strength is not significant..."
After listening to Oli’s introduction, Lide raised an eyebrow.
Abyss truly lives up to its name, as this advanced plane contains an extremely dense concentration of energy. A barren plane here could easily produce five or six Transcendents, incomparable to the main plane.
After a brief consideration, a decision formed in his mind.
"Oli, as my believers, the Kabar Naga Clan must become the most esteemed existence among all races.
The Gravel Plane will also belong to the Twilight Sect."
The leader of the Naga was no fool; his face showed uncontrollable delight at these words.
"Your Highness, the Kabar Naga Clan vows to fight to the death to spread your Glory!"
The surrounding Naga high-ranking members were also overwhelmed with excitement; Lide’s words had unmistakably shone a bright light upon them.
This mighty being, capable of crushing Divine beings with ease, would support the Naga in conquering the entire plane!
This was a dream they had never dared to imagine.
The strength of the Kabar Naga Clan in the Gravel Plane was only sufficient for self-preservation, and expanding outward seemed nearly impossible.
But now, with the support of the Great God of Twilight, everyone felt brimming with confidence.
They believed that the Naga Clan would inevitably become the rulers of this plane.
Behind them stood a towering being capable of slaughtering Divine entities.
"Very well," Lide nodded satisfactorily as he saw the excited Naga.
To conquer and occupy a plane, the Black Scale Naga Clan would certainly need enough subordinates.
One person challenging an entire plane was uninteresting unless he reached Demigod status.
This was the Abyss, filled with Evil Gods as common as dogs; who knew how strong the foundational power of the race occupying the plane was—they might instantly annihilate him with a Divine Artifact.
Although chaos had already emerged in the main plane, it was not yet to the extent of destruction.
With Emi, an Extraordinary there, and the well-hidden Dawn City merely needing to consolidate its power, the outside world would hardly pose a significant threat.
The Underworld also harbored an Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragon, a pool with an Extraordinary Blade Spider, and not to mention the Extraordinary Spider Queen from the Spider Plane.
These four Extraordinary beings were power enough to defend Dawn City.
But if he could rule a plane in the Abyss as a stronghold,
Dawn City could then use this stronghold to raid resources from the Abyss, executing his long-contemplated plane-farming plan.
This was a strategic arrangement, with the potential to decisively shape Dawn City’s future, its importance truly extraordinary.
