At this time in Green City, due to the erosion of ancient powers, the outside world was full of threats, and many cities had even been overrun by monsters.
Furthermore, with the disappearance of the gods, the power of the Sects had almost completely collapsed, and the believers who had once believed in various Sects fell into confusion.
Their own gods had disappeared; did they still need to continue believing in a group of missing Divines?
Apart from a few fanatic believers, most believers held this attitude.
And at this moment, those believers whose faith was shaken came into contact with the Dawn Sect, which had a true God at its helm... thus the preaching speed of the Dawn Sect became unprecedentedly fast.
At this moment, in Green City, over 500,000 believers of the Dawn Sect, seeming mad in the eyes of others, kneeled down on the streets, their eyes filled with an incredulous fervor.
"My God! Your humble believer has sensed the power you bestowed!! Praise you, your Glory shall shine upon the darkness!"
"I feel the gaze of my God!! The great God of Dawn, I will pray to you in the most devout way..."
"That aura... is it Lord Ilo?!! The strength in me, it has grown stronger?! This is a gift from the Lord, such glory, to have received the blessing of Lord Ilo..."
The surrounding residents, who heard the prayers of the Dawn believers, looked puzzled. Were these ordinary believers like them truly receiving the attention of the Divine? Could this be possible?
But the fanatic expressions made the crowd hesitate, it seemed indeed possible... after all, that person from the Dawn Sect is Lord Ilo.
That day, the number of residents visiting the Dawn Sect reached a new high, and when those who became new believers received the enhancement of strength, they immediately spread the astonishing news.
Before long, the message that believing in Lord Ilo would be rewarded with strength spread throughout Green City, and the doorstep of the Dawn Sect was nearly worn out.
Abyss.
In the Gravel Plane, the Chaotic Army that was encircling Half-Beast City, after the believer system was activated, suddenly saw a boost in morale.
Many Enchanting Demons even let out exceedingly strange shrieks, like the cries of utmost pleasure, ah~
All the demons that had been forcibly conquered by Lide and who worshipped him now sensed an increase in their own strength.
It was a blessing from the great Divine in the sky—the God of Twilight.
"The reward of my God, I have received my God’s reward..."
"My strength has increased!!"
"Praise the Twilight!"
Members of the Chaotic Army were almost all at the believer level, as unbelievers and general believers had mostly been pushed out as cannon fodder. So, the vast majority were now enjoying a 5% enhancement in all attributes.
Although it seemed minor at only 5%, the collective increase among over a hundred thousand people elevated their overall strength significantly.
The light from one matchstick burning is faint, barely noticeable even if intensified a bit. But when ten thousand matchsticks are strengthened at the same time, the effect is dramatically different.
After the army below had adapted to their increased power, Lide turned his attention to Half-Beast City.
The key now was to first incorporate the Gravel Plane into his realm and completely conquer this plane, making it a stronghold for Dawn City in the abyss.
He was somewhat impatient to start his plane nurturing plan.
Looking at the towering, formidable Half-Beast City shrouded in a thick scent of blood, Lide’s eyes flickered.
After two wars, he had basically figured out the patterns of abyssal warfare, and now there was no longer a need to sacrifice lives.
After a brief moment of thought, he waved his hand, and in just two seconds, a bubbling Four Circle Magic—Magma Fireball—appeared in his hand.
Having ascended to the transcendent level, the Four Circle Magic, considered top-tier for most spellcasters, had become as simple as casting a Small Fireball for Lide.
The affinity and control over magic power provided by his Ancestor Bloodline had surpassed the limits most life forms could imagine.
The Magic Model in his mind constantly ran, continuously inputting magic power, and Magma Fireballs were produced every two seconds as if laying eggs.
Later, to speed up, Lide simply cast multiple spells at the same time.
The terrifyingly powerful Four Circle Magic—Magma Fireball, surrounded him by the hundreds in less than three minutes.
The entire sky was twisted by the scorching heat of the terrifying magma balls.
Viewed from below, one could clearly perceive the originally dim sky now filled with chillingly hot energy.
It was as if the sky had collapsed, and the Earth’s magma was pouring upward.
The Chaotic Army below sensed the disturbance and immediately felt a deep fear and uncontrollable admiration.
In the abyss, where power was supreme, strength served as the best credential.
And whether previously or now, every time Lide demonstrated his power, he genuinely made these abyssal races tremble.
With a calm expression, Lide continued to cast his spells. When he sensed that his control had reached a critical limit, the space around him was densely packed with over 200 Magma Fireballs.
The sky looked as if it had been burned through by boiling magma, the surrounding light now replaced by the heat emitted by the magma.
At the peak moment, Lide’s eyes hardened, and he swung his arm forcefully.
In that instant, heaven and earth seemed to collapse.
Countless Magma Fireballs, trailing long flames, drew arcs in the sky as they hurled towards Half-Beast City.
The Abyss Half-orcs atop the city walls had already noticed Lide’s movements, but were powerless to stop them. Seeing this scene, their faces drastically changed, instantly consumed by fear.
The terrifying might of the Magma Fireballs was so frightening that even before impact, the half-orcs’ legs trembled involuntarily.
No one could withstand such a high-frequency bombardment of Four Circle Magic.
Boom~
The first magma fireball struck the city wall and exploded instantaneously, sweeping up a colossal wave of flames. The heat, reaching nearly ten thousand degrees, devoured the half-beasts within a hundred blades’ diameter in an instant.
These strong creatures of the Abyss life could not withstand the fire for even half a second and were directly turned into char.
But this was merely the beginning.
Boom~ Boom~ Boom~
What is a spell battery?
What is a fireball sweeping the ground?
At this moment, Lide perfectly showcased the terror of an old Mage lord.
He revived the magic machine gun that he hadn’t used in a long while, the fireball Gatling, a famous scene.
Dada Dada Dada~
Four Circle Magic Magma, just like the improved Small Fireballs from years ago, bombarded the towering walls of the Half-Beast City one after another.
The first one, the second, the tenth, the fiftieth...
Under the stunned gaze of more than a hundred thousand Chaotic Army.
That wall, forty blades high, piled up with countless boulders, solid beyond imagination, began to melt under the fearsome magical bombardment from Lide.
Yes, not collapsed by bombardment, but due to the extreme heat.
The giant stone wall could not withstand the temperature caused by the exploding magma fireballs, melting like ice meets boiling water, turning red and becoming magma.
Boom~ Boom~ Boom~
The whole universe seemed to be scorched clean in the blistering waves.
Even at a distance of nearly two thousand blades, the Chaotic Army was significantly affected.
Even the demons, well-adapted to harsh conditions, felt unbearable discomfort, each breath as if sparks were scorching their throats.
Boom~ Boom~ Boom~
The scorching giant wave now made the Abyss Half-beasts feel as though the sky had collapsed; they had never experienced such a terrifying scene before.
How could this possibly be the work of a human??
The collapse of the plane, the divine punishment of world destruction, could it be anything else?
They were about to be destroyed by a catastrophe.
These evil and chaotic lives, who would even dare to fight a five-colored evil dragon, now screamed, roared, and howled as they ran backwards.
Over thirty thousand half-beasts turned to char in the first round of bombardment...
And at this time, an ancient Abyss Blasphemous language oozing out with the flames brought the resistance will of these Abyss Half-beasts to an all-time low.
"I am the God of Twilight.
Abyss Half-beasts, the Gravel Plane will be under my control, all who do not believe in me will suffer world-destroying divine punishment.
Resistors, die!
Unbelievers, die!
Those who believe in me, may recite my name and seek my protection in destruction."
After the blasphemy, a tremendously terrifying divine power spread out, pressing down over the entire Half-Beast City.
Like a Chaos Void Beast capable of devouring planes, it now opened its eyes, larger than the sun, moon, and stars, brutally watching everyone.
God!!
It was actually a god!!
Feeling the deep soul-crushing pressure, all half-beasts realized that the terrifying magic was personally cast by the Twilight God worshiped by the Nagas!
With this realization, these evil beings felt suffocated.
They had heard rumors that the Nagas were protected by a deity, but most did not believe it; now, they couldn’t help but believe.
Once they understood, fear instantly eroded their souls. How could they, with the strength of half-beasts, stand against a deity?
And at that moment, a thunderous crash completely overwhelmed the will of the half-beasts.
The segment of the wall targeted by Lide’s attacks finally collapsed because its base had melted into magma.
The wall crashed into the magma, splashing sparks everywhere.
"Submit, or be destroyed?"
With that supremely evil speech, not a single Abyss Half-beast dared to resist any longer.
"Submission, great God of Twilight, we are willing to submit to you!"
"We are willing to spread your glory."
"Great Lord, your power astounds us, submission to you is an honor for half-beasts..."
Feeling the actions of the half-beasts, from afar Lide looked at the remaining twenty or so magma fireballs in the sky, waved his hand and dispersed these Four Circle Magics.
He curled his lips slightly, somewhat dissatisfied.
"They couldn’t even withstand one round... What a miscalculation."
The half-beasts would be furious if they knew his thoughts, as who could withstand being bombarded by a hundred pieces of Four Circle Magic?
"Once the flames die down, enter the city to take control."
Lide immediately gave the order to the Naga Army below.
"These half-beasts will serve as the vanguard against the Double-Horned Demons..."
Thus, this war, devoid of any suspense, came to a swift conclusion. The half-beasts lacked even Extraordinary Combat Power; had it not been for his attitude of wanting to train troops, Lide alone could have erased this city.
His combat power now was at a city-destroying level, crushing a city single-handedly was no problem.
If taken further, it would reach Catastrophe Level—destruction of planes.
Beyond that is an ultimate existence even he cannot fathom—the Divine.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 436: Five Transcendents Recruited, Hope of Returning to the Main Plane (8600 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 434: Chapter 436: Five Transcendents Recruited, Hope of Returning to the Main Plane (8600 words)
Abyss Half-orcs in Half-Beast City knelt in submission, after which the Chaotic Army directly assimilated these ugly half-beasts.
Although they might be unsightly, they proved to be very effective cannon fodder, which allowed the total number of the Chaotic Army to reach the scale of 260,000.
Moreover, the level of all the troops was above 10, a force so powerful that it would absolutely terrify anyone on the Main Plane.
Level 10 in a large city like Green City might count as a skilled fighter, at least a heavyweight on a certain street, but in the Abyss, sorry, that’s merely the bare minimum.
But sadly, those with combat power above level 15 numbered only a pitiful thirty or so, partly the higher echelons of the Enchanting Demons and partly the upper ranks of the half-beasts.
Among them, reaching level 19 were only the Naga Leader and the recently subdued Half-Beast Leader.
Compared to the huge base number, one could determine that the high-end combat power of the Abyss wasn’t actually plentiful.
However, with Lide present, there currently wasn’t too much of a problem with top-tier combat power.
The scale of 260,000 troops, combined with the combat power formed after reorganization, meant that the Gravel Plane, fundamentally a barren Plane, had no power to obstruct the advance of the Chaotic Army.
Time moved on to February 5th.
Under Lide’s command, the integrated Chaotic Army began their sweep across the Gravel Plane. Tribe after tribe was steamrolled.
Under the deterrence of death, the number of Twilight Sect believers grew daily, and the actions of the Chaotic Army were decisive: those who did not worship Lide had only death as an option.
Under frenetic expansion, the numbers of the Chaotic Army began to skyrocket.
By February 15th, the Chaotic Army had occupied the giant gravel regions in the south, west, and the junction of both sides of the Gravel Plane.
All small tribes found within the occupied territory were conquered or annihilated by the Chaotic Army.
To this point, Lide had directly conquered nearly half of the Gravel Plane, and after repeated expansions, the number of the Chaotic Army had reached an astonishing 400,000.
The Double-Horned Demons, occupying the central region of the Gravel Plane, had also sensed the danger during the major movements of the Chaotic Army.
To cope with the expansion of the Chaotic Army, the Double-Horned Demons likewise began to extend their reach to the surrounding small tribes, enslaving large numbers of tribes wherever the Double-Horned Demon Army went.
The original number of 100,000 swelled to 250,000 in a short time, more than doubling.
This insignificant and barren Plane in the Abyss began to fall into the tense smoke of battle, just like countless other Planes.
Under Lide’s will, in just a month and a half, the Gravel Plane went from a five-way standoff to a showdown between two powers.
Chaotic Army vs. Double-Horned Demon Army.
As for the Undead hidden in the Northern Rotten Land, these peculiar beings showed no sign of activity, as if the world-shattering wars outside had nothing to do with them.
Sensing the indifference of the Undead, both sides preparing for war also tacitly refrained from disturbing these evil beings.
Both contenders knew that their true enemy was each other; as for the Undead, they could wait to sweep across them after dealing with their opponent.
Time continued to turn, and by February 20th, the Chaotic Army, having finished reorganizing, began to assemble from all directions, their fearful sharp spears pointed directly at Double-Horned Demon territory.
The Double-Horned Demons, who had been watching the Chaotic Army, quickly noticed this change. The army prepared for battle, and countless enslaved demons and servants were driven to the front lines to serve as cannon fodder.
A titanic epic battle involving over 600,000 was about to unfold.
In this war, the victor’s prize would be the entirety of the Gravel Plane.
The loser would become the stark white bones amongst the rubble, joining the countless corpses of Abyss Demons to sleep eternally.
Both sides headed into battle with absolute confidence in their victory.
Although the Double-Horned Demons had heard that the Chaotic Army had a deity at their helm, it was merely hearsay, and most people absolutely did not believe it.
If the other side truly had a deity, could they still be alive to this day?
What kind of existence was an Abyss Evil God? Butchering the entire Gravel Plane wouldn’t even require much effort.
Therefore, the Double-Horned Demons were convinced that this was nothing more than a lie crafted by the Naga to shake their confidence.
For this, the Double-Horned Demons were highly disdainful and even went as far as to mock and scorn the Naga’s actions.
Although the Double-Horned Demons didn’t understand why the Naga Army could be so ferocious as to completely overcome the Enchanting Demons and the Abyss Half-Beasts, they didn’t care.
As the most powerful force in the Gravel Plane, even if the Naga Army’s numbers were nearly twice their own, the Double-Horned Demons still did not harbor the slightest fear.
Abyss Worms were actually the most numerous life forms in the Abyss. Yet, have those filthy creatures ever ruled the Abyss?
The Double-Horned Demons were ambitious, and the Chaotic Army was even more fanatical.
An army of 400,000, how terrifying it was.
The Believer System activated by Lide was practically fatal to those Abyss Races who had just pledged allegiance to the Twilight Sect.
Once they became believers of the Twilight Sect, they instantly gained a boost in strength. Even the most casual believers received a 1% attribute enhancement, causing those newly converted to ascend rapidly in their level of devotion.
After all, this was a tangible, substantial benefit, unlike other Evil Gods who required sacrifices to bestow their gifts—making the Twilight Sect simply too competitive.
The deepening of their faith drastically increased the formidable strength of this terrifying army, and their morale soared to an extreme. They were already eager to prove their devoutness to the Divine being they worshipped, seeking to use such means to receive even more power as a reward.
The air in the Gravel Plane was filled with a solemn and tense atmosphere.
On February 23, 400,000 soldiers of the Chaotic Army thrust their blades into the territory of the Double-Horned Demons.
Both armies faced off in the central region of the Gravel Plane.
The epic battle, orchestrated single-handedly by Lide, was on the brink of igniting.
The Double-Horned Demons, unlike the Abyss Half-Beasts, hadn’t built cities but were in a very primitive tribal form with no walls whatsoever.
So this army, numbering 250,000, marched directly out onto the expansive gravel ground to confront the Chaotic Army from afar.
"Those Double-Horned Demons’ blood is so delectable, this time I can drink to my heart’s content..."
"I love the thrill of chopping off demon heads, it’s truly intoxicating..."
"For His Highness’s glory!"
The Chaotic Army had already entered an excited state with the Divine being above them and an absolute advantage in numbers. This was a battle they could not possibly lose.
Just before the battle was about to commence, Lide, radiating a dark glow and suspended high in the sky, surveyed the battleground several times. Under everyone’s watchful eyes, he decided to do something that would drastically enhance the degree of belief—empower his subordinates with the Power of Faith.
This was something he had always wanted to do. Although the Chaotic Army was numerous, they lacked proper combat strength besides him.
400,000 people without even a single Extraordinary among them was pitifully inadequate.
This was undoubtedly a good opportunity to both boost his prestige and also intimidate the Double-Horned Demon Army.
As for whether or not the enemy might attack during this last-minute breakthrough... Once Divine Power began to emanate and rise, then try attacking if they dare.
His gaze swept below and, in a moment, Lide selected three individuals.
The first was the 19th Level Naga Leader—Oli Kabar. The second was the leader of the Abyss Half-Beasts, also at Level 19.
The last one was an extremely evil life form they happened upon while suppressing a small tribe—the Abyss Butcher.
Abyss Butchers were stitched-together life forms, these evil lives were creations by worshippers of a certain Evil God.
Chaotic, evil, brutal, strong—these were the hallmarks of the Abyss Butcher.
These terrifying creatures, standing 5 blades tall and weighing 3000 pounds, brandishing enlarged butcher knives, with green toxic corpse gas floating around them, constantly muttered blasphemous language that could pollute the soul with several stitched abnormal organs.
Correct content is on
But what made Lide most interested was that this frightening stitched monster was actually from the Order Evil Camp.
He was completely indifferent to the lives of the Chaos Evil Camp, as no one could predict what those with deranged minds would do next.
He also held disdain for those conquered demons.
Lide, who harbored an intense desire for control, detested disorder and chaos because situations were difficult to control amidst chaos, especially when his subordinates were a horde of demons.
Thus, the three level 19s he had chosen this time all belonged to the Order Evil Camp.
Indeed, the leader who commanded the Abyss Half-orcs was also from the Order Evil Camp, vastly different from the ordinary Chaos Evil Abyss Half-orcs.
The appearance of the Half-Beast Leader made Lide realize that the alignments of the Abyss Race were not unchangeable; even within the same race, there could be a variety of alignment tendencies.
The knowledge of the Abyss within the Main Plane was far too scant. The tales told by wandering bards mostly recounted stories about those powerful Abyss Evil Gods, with little spread of the ordinary but significant underlying rules.
"I am the God of Twilight..."
As the blasphemous language of the Abyss echoed above the skies, everyone simultaneously looked up at the gloomy orb of light.
The next line made everyone’s heart skip a beat.
"I have enslaved the Twelve-winged Angels of the Light Gods and personally slain the Abyss Evil Gods."
"Today, before conquering the Gravel Plane, I shall grant the most devout the power to break through to the Transcendent level."
"Today it is them, tomorrow it will be you who have earned merits."
A single stone stirred up a thousand ripples.
The demons of the 400,000-strong Chaotic Army below, upon hearing these words, showed deep longing in their eyes.
What does power represent in the Abyss? Everything!
Now, some of them had been blessed with the power of an Extraordinary Level.
That was Transcendent, a top-tier existence no matter which Plane one was in.
Even in the terrifying Abyss, where the map level was outrageously high, a Transcendent could still dominate.
After Lide’s words fell, all his Aura Skills activated, and the Main God’s Power surged like a raging storm, stirring up immense waves.
At that moment, the magnificent Divine Power was like a prison, the Star River swayed, and the sun and moon grew dim.
It seemed as if all the Planes of existence floated and sank beneath his feet, and the Abyss trembled with his every gesture, with mountains quaking.
Each time they felt that soul-penetrating oppression, the believers of the Chaotic Army couldn’t help but feel how insignificant they were and how mighty their faith was.
Adoration, fanaticism.
Unlike the Chaotic Army, the Double-Horned Demon Army, far away by thousands of blades, felt as if a giant hand was gripping their necks, their madness replaced by fear.
Could there actually be a Divine?
Divine Power was not something ordinary life could contend with, it was an overwhelming force on a different level of existence, surpassing most skills in the world.
Even those two Extraordinary Level Double-Horned Demons felt like ants under a giant’s feet, as if they could be crushed by that terrifying power at any moment.
Fear inevitably rose within the Double-Horned Demon Army.
The war had not yet started, but solely through a show of force, the army of more than 250,000 Double-Horned Demons was nearly collapsing.
The oppression emitted by Lide had clearly exceeded the limits of their imagination.
High-level demons often had absolute dominion over Low-level demons.
When facing Lide, who was like a natural disaster, the innate demonic nature of worshiping and submitting to the strong was now fully sparked.
The fearful yet yearning look in the Double-Horned Demons’ eyes was the best proof.
Before the overwhelming pressure, like mountains crumbling and tsunamis surging, the army of the Double-Horned Demon Commander immediately began to show great disturbance.
Enslaved Low-level demons, unable to withstand the oppressive force, began to run madly backward, and if not for Demon Governors furiously lashing at those Low-level demons, just the pressure spread by Lide could have caused the army to collapse.
But what came next was even more shocking.
To maximize the effect, Lide, his silhouette emitting a gloomy light, floated to the central position of the tens of thousands in the Chaotic Army.
The Naga Leader, the Abyss Half-Beast Leader, and the Abyss Butcher, three terrifying Level 19 Abyss Lives were now being pulled into mid-air by his absolute strength.
In this open area, with an excellent field of vision, the Abyss Lives could clearly see everything that Lide was doing.
Under the overwhelming Divine Power, three groups of energy, emanating terrifying fluctuations, split from the gloomy light sphere beside Lide and then individually merged into the three Level 19 Evil God creatures.
Zzzzt~
After that power separately integrated into the Naga, Half-Beast, and Abyss Butcher, everyone sensed their aura climb directly from Level 19.
Bit by bit, they approached the peak that everyone was immensely eager to reach—stepping into the Transcendent.
Divine Arts—Faith Enhancement, could consume the Power of Faith to strengthen subordinates.
Elevating three Level 19s to Transcendent in one go, although it was only a one-level difference, the required energy consumption was by no means low.
Lide’s greatest confidence came from—at this moment on the Twilight Sect panel, the number of his Believers had reached an astonishing 3.2 million.
That’s right, without even counting the Dawn Sect Believers, just the Twilight Sect Believers alone had reached 3.2 million.
The 400,000 below in the Chaotic Army were all Twilight Sect Believers, and after several miracles were performed, coupled with the fact that becoming a pan-Believer could also receive the strength of the Believer System, this led to at least a Believer-level among these 400,000 Chaotic Army members.
Of course, the main force behind such a rapid increase in his Believers was still the Cave Dwellers of the Underworld.
Those lives that had never been given much attention, after being brought under the Dawn Sect’s purview, had been consistently pillaged.
Recently, Twilight City traded with the Half-Elf Main City, and in just a short month, they received over 500,000 Cave Dwellers from the Half-Elves.
So, until this moment, the number of Cave Dweller Believers had reached a staggering 2.7 million...
The Cave Dwellers, a weak race that had never been taken seriously, renowned only for their digging, now this racial trait had become the Twilight Sect’s greatest weapon.
With this exaggerated base number of Cave Dwellers, when added to other Dark Races, his total number of Believers reached 3.2 million.
The exaggerated number of Believers brought an impact that made the Power of Faith on Lide’s attribute panel rise astronomically every day.
Now his Dark Faith Power had reached an unprecedented 1.7 million points.
And it has been less than two months since he activated the Twilight Godhood at the cost of 1 million Power of Faith.
Lide looked at the Power of Faith that was rapidly declining on his attribute panel, his facial expression was utterly calm, with food in hand, his heart was as steady as an old dog.
Having been poor for so long, Lide, who had often fantasized about having millions of Power of Faith to splurge, finally felt a bit of prosperity after years of effort.
Being rich was just so cool...
If it weren’t for being in the Abyss, he would certainly prioritize boosting the strength of his old subordinates who had followed him through thick and thin.
It seemed like a long time since he had heard that chatty skeleton cursing...
And then there was Emi, who was researching the plague; who knows if his Subordinate God had come up with any powerful plague during these few months he was in the Abyss...
Huff, huff~
While Lide’s thoughts were wandering, a significant upheaval occurred in the three beings in front of him.
The souls of these Evil beings were evolving into a higher level under the influence of the Power of Faith, and their bloodlines were also evolving.
And the Dark Faith Power on Lide’s attribute panel was rapidly depleting with the transformation of the three individuals.
Ten minutes, twenty minutes, a full two Sunshine Hours later.
When the 1.7 million Dark Faith Power was reduced to only 200,000, crack~ a sound like shattering glass echoed.
Then, at that moment, the momentum of the three Evil lives surged wildly, their pressuring aura sweeping across heaven and earth, that was the aura of a Transcendent.
Under the gaze of tens of thousands of eyes.
Naga, Half-Beasts, and the Abyss Butcher, monsters sewn together, these three had broken through to the Extraordinary.
The Chaotic Army below completely boiled over after seeing this scene.
"Above the Abyss, great god, did they really bestow upon them the Extraordinary power?!!"
"This, this, this is too shocking!!"
"Extraordinary, oh! The strength of our god is enough to make the Abyss pale!"
"Praise you, Great God of Twilight, to bask in your glory for all my life is my greatest honor!"
That was the Extraordinary!
Right before their eyes, the three individuals who mere moments ago were at level 19, had become such terrifying beings within just two Sunshine Hours!
The shock of witnessing this firsthand was far more powerful than any words could convey.
If Lide looked at his attribute panel at this moment, he would definitely find that after the recent events, over one-third of his followers had ascended directly to Devout Believers.
This wave of Faith harvesting wasn’t bad.
The Chaotic Army was overjoyed, but the Double-Horned Demon Army felt as choked as if a fishbone had gotten stuck in their throat.
These demons had been full of confidence, only waiting for the war to start before crushing the Naga Army.
After all, their leaders were two powerful Extraordinary beings, and they occupied the Gravel Plane’s core area relying on their Extraordinary combat power.
But now, under their watch, the opposing side had forcefully ascended three Extraordinary beings.
What the hell was this crap?!
The opposition outnumbered them by nearly double, and now even in high-end combat power, they couldn’t compare.
That would have been bearable, bearable with gritted teeth, but most ridiculous and exaggerated was that within this damn Naga Army, there actually existed Divine beings!
How were they supposed to fight this??
The strength of the two sides wasn’t even in the same league.
Leave alone three Extraordinaries, just the appearance of the Twilight God would spell their doom.
Fighting against a Divine was a battle with no chance of victory.
The previously high-spirited Double-Horned Demon Army now felt their legs soften one by one.
Demons might be brutal, bloodthirsty, chaotic, and evil, but they were certainly not foolish beings.
Their cunning, if anything, might even surpass that of Devils; it was just their inherently chaotic nature that made these creatures seem insane.
In the face of a hopeless war, their first thought would absolutely not be to fight to the death.
At this moment, in the rear of the Double-Horned Demon Army, two Extraordinary Two-Horned Demons, towering at four blades high with a pair of black horns on their heads marked with ring-shaped signs, their muscles looking as though they were cast from copper water, made the surrounding demons shiver in terror.
These two Extraordinary beings fell silent after sensing Lide’s oppressing might.
Too terrifying, even separated by thousands of blades’ distance, they could sense that suffocating oppression.
That was certainly not any ordinary Divine Power!
They had once seen an Evil God in an Abyss Plane, the being that commanded over ten million Abyss Demons, but even that aura wasn’t as dreadful as that of the Divine presence before them.
This realization instantly reduced their will to resist to the limit.
How were they to fight this??
Engage in a tough battle against an invincible Divine??
Those brutal eyes were now filled with unspeakable despair.
Above the Chaotic Army at this moment,
Lide felt a surge of satisfaction as three individuals made their breakthrough to the Transcendent level, a smile spreading across his face.
Although it cost a total of 1.5 million Dark Faith Power, an average of 500,000 per person, which could only be described as extravagant, the gaining of three Transcendents was absolutely exhilarating.
This was about becoming Transcendent, not just any Tom, Dick, or Harry. In the Main Plane, there were only a few within an entire province.
It was not just powerful— it was like having human-shaped nuclear bombs.
With three Transcendents in place, the Chaotic Army was now thoroughly stabilized.
Even if he had to leave the Abyss for a brief period, there was no need to worry about the newly established power being destroyed.
Lide was extremely satisfied with this.
It had been only a little over three months since his arrival in the Abyss, and in that short time, he had managed to muster an army of 400,000, with three Transcendents anchoring it.
This achievement had undeniably surpassed his expectations.
Or perhaps it was better to say that the Abyss map was just too advanced— even in a barren Plane, he was able to pull together an army of several hundred thousand above level 10.
In the Main Plane, this force could sweep across an entire province.
What was even more outrageous was that the Gravel Plane did not even span a fifth of the southern province’s size and was considered one of the most barren types of Planes in the Abyss.
Now that he had elevated the strength of his subordinates, it was time to get down to business.
Conquering the Gravel Plane!
"Ye lowly Double-Horned Demons, I, the God of Twilight, command that from this day forth, the Gravel Plane shall belong to the Twilight Sect.
All who are my believers shall enjoy the most exalted rights upon this Plane.
All others, who exist within this Plane, shall be annihilated by my own hand!"
Like blasphemous language handed down from ancient times, overwhelming Divine Power pressed down, enveloping the sky.
The entire sky seemed to freeze at this moment.
Just as Lide was about to issue the attack command, suddenly, there was a commotion among the Double-Horned Demons. After a few breaths, two impressive Demons shot into the sky, powerfully flapping their wings.
Double-Horned Demons did not have wings, but those who reached the Transcendent level were granted Demon Wings— so these two were certainly Transcendent Demons.
Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly. Although they were far away, he clearly made out their flight path.
Were these two Transcendents looking to challenge him to a duel?
A hint of amusement rose in his eyes. He hadn’t yet slaughtered a Transcendent Demon...
However, just when the two Double-Horned Demons approached the Chaotic Army, they did something that left Lide completely stunned.
The two imposing Transcendent Demons, in front of tens of thousands, suddenly knelt down out of thin air, bowing their heads.
"Great God of Twilight, the Tekel Clan is willing to submit to you and hold you as our eternal faith..."
This...
Lide’s mouth twitched— they surrendered just like that??
He had been preparing for so long, sharpening his blade, ready to test the Chaotic Army’s combat strength after a few revisions in recent times.
Unexpectedly, these two were so easily frightened...
He had truly underestimated the deterrent power of a Divine being in the Abyss against ordinary Demons.
The Double-Horned Demons were only Middle-level Demons, merely existing on a barren Plane like Gravel Plane. They might seem strong, but in the Abyss, they were nothing, so insignificant that nobody would bother with them.
Under such circumstances, encountering a terrifying being that could instantly promote three Level 19 lives to the Transcendent and whose Divine Power was greater than any Evil God they had ever encountered was beyond Lide’s imagination.
The pressure in their hearts was immense.
This was the Abyss, where defeat meant no one could survive.
Moreover, the key issue was that they did not possess the capability to oppose a powerful Divine being.
By contrast, Lide directly promoting his three subordinates to Transcendent was very tempting to them.
Those were Transcendents just like themselves, created with a mere wave of the hand.
How great had the risks they took been to break through to Transcendent? The comparison was simply unbearable.
Even more crucially, if they defected, would they receive the same treatment... or even be awarded the breakthrough to the level they had long dreamed of—Legendary.
The thought of this word made the Double-Horned Demons restless, as relying on the resources of the Gravel Plane to break through to Legendary was nearly impossible.
And venturing into other Abyss Planes would likely result in being hunted by beings that were Transcendent or even higher.
Thus, for the Double-Horned Demons, the chance of breaking through to Legendary was pitifully slim.
But if they defected to Lide, it might truly be possible to be granted the power to break through to Legendary.
Was it to resist hopelessly and then be cruelly destroyed, or to defect to the other side in order to gain greater power... When these two options were laid before them, both Double-Horned Demons chose the latter without hesitation.
To survive, to become stronger.
At this moment, all the Demon Armies below were eagerly watching Lide, while the air fell into a silent atmosphere.
Although the Double-Horned Demons surrendered, not all Evil Gods were willing to accept captives, and some brutal Evil Gods even delighted in slaughtering captives for amusement.
If Lide was unwilling to accept the submission of the Double-Horned Demons, the next moment would unleash a torrent of bloodshed.
Many demons were even sweating in their palms at this moment; they absolutely did not want to face an army led by a Divine being.
Lide’s imposing presence had not yet receded, and the terrifying Divine Power surged like a vast ocean, billowing into the heavens. In this moment, the two Transcendent Demons shivered uncontrollably.
Just as he was about to speak, Lide didn’t expect a system notification to sound.
"Ding~ The Double-Horned Demon Lord submits to you. Do you accept? Upon acceptance, you will gain the loyalty of the Tekel Double-Horned Demon clan. If refused, they will become your mortal enemy."
The sudden system prompt took Lide by surprise. Was there even a choice to make?
"Humble Tekel Clan, I accept your fealty. From this day forth, you shall become devotees of the Twilight Sect, my servants.
And I, in turn, will protect you."
"Ding~ You have obtained the submission of the Tekel Double-Horned Demon clan, and have now occupied two-thirds of the Plane. If you capture the entire Plane, you will receive the title of Plane Conqueror."
Hearing the system notification, Lide’s expression was one of surprise. Plane Conqueror?
That title sounded cool. He wondered what the attributes would be like...
But that would have to wait until he had conquered the Undead to the North to activate it.
Hearing Lide’s direct words, the two Transcendent Double-Horned Demons let out a huge sigh of relief, both able to see a glint of surprise in each other’s eyes.
They had survived... What was more important was that they had also been accepted by this great Divine being.
Praise the Abyss, to be able to defect to such a powerful entity was truly the favor of the Goddess of Luck.
These two excited demons could never know that Lide, whom they considered to be as mighty as one could be, was just like them, still Transcendent... not even having broken through to Legendary.
As Lide’s voice echoed across the sky, the Double-Horned Demons, who had already had their legs turn to jelly from facing the Divine Might, were immensely relieved.
Facing a life that could resist, demons were definitely the most vicious beings, but when facing an overwhelming evil force that they could not resist, these chaotic and disorderly evil lives often chose to surrender without hesitation.
Loyalty? No, such a thing did not exist in the Abyss, even the powerful Demon Lords ruled demons through force, not so-called loyalty...
Power, in this land, was everything.
The situation had developed to the point where the war had ended.
The surrender of the Double-Horned Demons hastily concluded the long-prepared war in a somewhat anticlimactic manner.
Although victorious, many in the Chaotic Army were dissatisfied with the swift surrender of the Double-Horned Demons.
These Demons had robbed them of the chance to accrue merits and receive rewards from Lide, which was intolerable.
"I swear, those idiotic Double-Horned Demons must have been scared shitless by his Majesty’s Dignity! Even those filthy Abyss Worms aren’t this weak!"
"They’re a bunch of spineless slugs, the lot of them, damn it!"
"The Glory of our God shall live forever, who said these Double-Horned Demons were powerful? In the presence of our God, they can only kneel..."
"Damn it, if they had surrendered later, I would have been the one to receive the greatest merits and rewards from his Majesty!"
Contrary to the discontent of the Chaotic Army, the Double-Horned Demon Army became excited upon hearing they no longer had to oppose the Divine.
"This is truly a wise choice!"
"Praise the Abyss, the aura of the God of Twilight is truly shivering. Surrendering to such a powerful being is wonderful..."
"Do we also have Divine protection now?"
Worshipping power, surrendering to power, the eternal unwritten laws of the Abyss were on full display at this moment.
Lide, sensing the changes below, couldn’t help but be rendered speechless; the Abyss was truly marvelous.
He glanced at the two Extraordinary Demons in the distance, "Follow me."
After speaking, he turned his attention to the three who had just broken through to extraordinary, still in a state of excitement and fervor.
"Oli, dispatch men to incorporate the Double-Horned Demon Army into the Chaotic Army, execute this immediately."
"Yes, your Majesty!!"
The Naga Leader Oli immediately took the command and went down.
The Order Evil Camp, for staying true to rules, had now become the enforcer of Lide’s orders.
The nearly twenty thousand members of the Naga were staggering in size at the start, but now within the Chaotic Army, numbering over 400,000, they were hardly noticeable. All they could do was just that.
Lide, after waiting for the Naga Leader to issue the orders, also felt somewhat troubled.
Dawn City’s army expansion had taken years to develop a suitable military system, yet now, in just a few short months, he had acquired a larger force than what Dawn City had built up over several years, making the management challenge indescribable.
Fortunately, Abyss Demons essentially required no management, relying entirely on Lide’s immense deterrence and the Believer System. Otherwise, chaos would have ensued long ago.
Following the end of wartime confrontation, the army below immediately became a mess. Seeing this, Lide couldn’t be bothered to intervene further and simply called the two Extraordinary Two-Horned Demons to a quiet place.
He hadn’t forgotten his initial plan—find the portal back to the Main Plane. Ruling the Gravel Plane was merely a by-product of this plan.
As told by the Naga, there was a Teleportation Gate in the territory of the Double-Horned Demons that led to the 372nd Plane, ruled by the Black Scale Naga.
The Black Scale Naga, in turn, had opened a Space Gate with the Underworld’s Naga City.
But when Lide had explained to the two Extraordinary Double-Horned Demons about the Main Plane and the Space Gate, the answer from the Demons left him completely astounded.
"Your Majesty, that ancient Teleportation Gate has an incredibly long history, it seems to be a structure left over from the last Battle of the Gods.
The other end of the Teleportation Gate is not fixed at the 372nd Plane; as long as you know the spatial coordinates and have sufficient energy, you can certainly open the gate to the Main Plane..."
Upon hearing this, Lide’s immediate reaction was:
Can I finally leave this godforsaken place??

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 437: Return to the Main Plane
chapters.content:
Chapter 435: Chapter 437: Return to the Main Plane
The Extraordinary Demon’s Transmission Array that could return to the Main Plane was definitely an unexpected boon.
To return to the Main Plane from the Abyss was as difficult as throwing a person onto Mars and expecting them to return to Earth on their own without leaving them a spacecraft.
Had Asreaga been with Lide, there would not have been too much worry, for that Divine Monster’s mastery of space had exceeded the limits of most people’s imaginations, providing plenty of chances to return to the Main Plane.
But the problem was Asreaga had been attacked by the God of Twilight upon entering the Abyss, and by now, who knew which layer of the Abyss Plane the spatial whirlwinds had blown it to.
Having lost the Divine Monster, which was a human-like Transmission Array, Lide had even prepared himself for the possibility of staying in the Abyss for several years.
Unexpectedly, the Double-Horned Demon had given him such a huge surprise.
"Tell me your names."
The two demons looked at each other, both somewhat excited.
"Your Highness, my name is Blood Horn Tekel, his name is Black Horn Tekel."
Blood Horn? Black Horn?
Lide looked at the two four-blade-tall Double-Horned Demons, his mouth twitching slightly. Indeed, they were two brothers, and both were so ugly...
He casually opened their attribute panel to take a glance. Both were level 21 Extraordinaries.
Their attributes and skills were ordinary, all Abyssal skills, nothing special.
Having finished viewing the attributes of the two demons, Lide felt amusingly that the Extraordinaries who once dominated the Main Plane were worth so little before him...
Tasting the implications, Lide then realized that in the Gravel Plane he had already subdued five Extraordinary Demons, and if he included the few Extraordinaries from Dawn City, the Extraordinary combat power he held exceeded ten people.
It seemed indeed not so rare anymore.
Thinking of this, Lide felt somewhat moved. When he had first crossed over to Glory, the entire Bloodline had trembled before the Extraordinary Mage of Green City.
But at this moment, he already wielded the power to easily obliterate that city of millions, including that Extraordinary Mage.
His growth had outstripped everyone’s imagination.
Moments later, Lide came back to himself, his gaze continuing to rest on the two Double-Horned Demons. What made him frown was that these two Extraordinaries inclined towards the Chaos Evil Camp, which undoubtedly displeased him.
Disorder and chaos meant to Lide that one could never know what would happen the next second, and these chaotic creatures would ruthlessly risk even their own lives.
But he would make do with them, after all, they were two Extraordinaries who could stir up a storm on the Main Plane... Think of them as enforcers, that’s all.
With that, his tone turned somewhat colder.
"Where is that Transmission Array? Take me to it."
"Your Highness, it is at the center of the tribe..."
Both Extraordinary Demons felt the displeasure in Lide’s voice, breaking into a cold sweat, and after reflecting, they couldn’t figure out what they had done to offend the powerful being before them.
A superior’s every word and action was enough to make the ruled speculate in fear.
The allure of power.
The two demons dared not delay, immediately guiding Lide toward the tribe.
At this time, the twenty-odd thousand Double-Horned Demon Army below was still undergoing reorganization by the Chaotic Army, appearing messy and clearly not to be sorted out within seven or eight Sunshine Hours.
Lide couldn’t be bothered to care too much, as long as he could return to the Main Plane, he could dispatch a complete officer corps at any time to organize these demons.
Dawn Academy had been open for over three years, and not only did the academy cultivate ordinary academic talents, but it also had a specialized military school for military talent.
With the reserve of talent now in Dawn City, organizing the Chaotic Army was not a problem.
A few minutes later, the Double-Horned Demons leading the way in front stopped and gestured for Lide to land beside a building made of piled rubble with a rugged, primitive style.
The building, over ten blades high and thirty blades wide, resembling a barrel, was completely assembled from rubble, making one wonder if it would collapse the next second as it looked anything but Solid.
The building had no door, only guarded by two level 14 Double-Horned Demons, who trembled upon seeing the Extraordinary Demons, quickly bowed down, not even daring to take a deep breath.
Demons didn’t have any notion of kinship. High-level demons treated Low-level ones just as cold-bloodedly, and it was all too common to casually kill a few when in a bad mood.
"Your Highness, inside here is that Ancient Teleportation Array."
Without sensing any threats inside, Lide nodded slightly and entered.
After entering, a transmission array in the shape of a disk about ten blades in diameter appeared before his eyes at the center area.
That gray disk was engraved with a dense mass of Ancient Runes, emanating an old and vicissitudinous breath that assailed the senses, seemingly an ancient relic that had been passed down for millions of years, exuding considerable value at first glance.
However, the disk was now covered by a thick layer of dust, looking as if it hadn’t been used for a long time.
Standing before the disk-shaped Ancient Teleportation Array, Lide turned his head to look at the two Extraordinary Demons by his side.
"How is this Transmission Array activated?"
Blood Horn and Black Horn exchanged glances, with Black Horn barely concealing a whisper of fear in his voice upon feeling the Dignity of the Main God emanating from Lide.
"Your Highness, every time this Teleportation Array is activated, it requires a large amount of Demon Crystals.
If there are not enough Demon Crystals, the teleportation will burn the flesh and Soul of the one teleported as energy.
We once had three Extraordinaries, one of whom was devoured alive because the array didn’t have enough energy..."
Lide’s brows furrowed. This was indeed very Abyss-like.
After a brief thought, he looked meaningfully at the two demons.
"If it can burn flesh and souls, then using demons as fuel would work too, right..."
Seeing the look in Lide’s eyes, the two demons were immediately so frightened that they trembled and dared not move, their eyes filled with indescribable panic.
"Your Majesty..."
They were genuinely afraid that Lide might impulsively kill them both on a whim.
The being before them was the powerful God of Twilight; at such a close distance, even fleeing was an impossible luxury.
Lide’s eyes flickered slightly; although the two demons had submitted to him, their fealty was merely forced by his formidable strength and utterly unreliable.
In the Abyss, betrayal was as common as a meal; one could not take the words of demons at face value.
He wanted to use the Teleportation Gate, but he still needed to use the Power of Faith to subjugate the two demons properly.
"Blood Horn, Black Horn, kneel."
The moment the words fell, his aura surged explosively, Divine Power vast as towering mountains crashing down from mid-air with the force of a storm.
Outside, several thousand blades away, the two demons trembled under the Divine Power. Now, in such close quarters and confined space, they faced the Main God’s Dignity head-on.
That impact was like standing beneath a collapsing skyscraper as an ordinary person, with no possibility of resistance.
Thud~
Despite the panic, despite the terror, and despite the intense desire to flee this place of horror, the bodies and souls of the two Extraordinary Demons instinctively forced them to kneel in worship.
"Your Majesty..."
Their voices were filled with unspeakable despair; their brutal eyes were also devoured by fear, and at this moment, they even thought Lide intended to use them for a Blood Sacrifice with the Teleportation Gate.
Lide wasted no words, stretching out his hands and placing them on the foreheads of the demons, as the Power of Faith surged forth.
Divine Skill—Soul Assimilation.
The Dark Faith Power had just advanced three levels, leaving 200,000 leftover, and for safety, Lide directly utilized the Power of Faith from the Dawn Sect.
The Dawn Sect’s Believers, after crazed propagation in Green City, had reached a total of 800,000. Yes, you heard right, 800,000!
With a population that had already gathered more than three million, Green City was currently in panic without the gods’ protection, making it the best time to propagate the Sect, and the Dawn Sect seized the opportunity, naturally inflating like a balloon.
And for these past few months, he hadn’t used the Power of Faith of the Dawn Sect, so his attribute panel had already accumulated an extravagant 1,100,000 points.
Although it was not as exaggerated as the Dark Faith Power consuming a million and then accumulating 1,700,000, it was definitely the most affluent he’d been since establishing the Dawn Sect.
With grain in hand, the heart remains steady.
The surging Power of Faith, like a river bursting its banks, poured in.
Begin to penetrate the bodies of the two demons, assimilating their souls.
A few minutes later, when the density of the Power of Faith reached a certain threshold, Lide suddenly sensed something.
The Faith Power of the light side, when facing demons, seemed able to alter their alignment tendencies to a certain extent.
Alignment tendencies are the understanding of the world a life form has or the influence of rules it is subject to, whether orderly good or orderly evil. Chaos and evil inherent in demons are no exception.
But at this moment, Lide discovered that Faith Power, upon invading the souls of demons, could alter their soul nature to some degree, thereby triggering a shift in alignment tendencies.
Although he couldn’t turn the demons from the Evil Camp of chaos and evil into the Order Camp of good and lawful, he could transform them into evil order.
Sensing this change, Lide immediately became interested. As a standard boss of the Evil Order Camp, he didn’t want his underlings to all be chaotic beings who wouldn’t heed commands.
Thinking it, he immediately increased the output of the Power of Faith, starting to change the soul nature of these two Extraordinary Demons...
Ten minutes, twenty minutes... After a full day, he slowly ceased the outpouring of the Power of Faith.
At this point, his attribute panel had decreased by a full 500,000 points of Faith Power, a staggering consumption.
But when Lide opened the attribute panels of the two demons, he felt the expenditure was worth it.
Blood Horn Tekel
Race: Double-Horned Demon (Evil Order)
Level: Transcendent—LV22
Skills: ...
Black Horn Tekel
Race: Double-Horned Demon (Evil Order)
Level: Transcendent—LV22
Skills: ...
The attributes of the two demons were largely similar, but their levels had risen from 21 to 22, and their alignments had changed, all of which was not a loss.
What interested him most, however, was what this event signified.
There was no longer a need to worry about the chaotic tendencies of the demons causing trouble when enslaving them in the future.
This was indeed good news for Lide, who had a very strong desire for control.
About ten minutes later, the two Extraordinary Demons slowly regained consciousness.
When they looked at Lide again, their eyes were no longer filled with fear as before, but with closeness, worship, admiration, and unconditional trust.
Lide reflected that every time he used it, the Divine Skill of Soul Assimilation was practically indistinguishable from a bug.
He then asked without ceremony.
"Is there any trap hidden within this Teleportation Gate? Why did you not use it?"
The demons might have deceived him earlier, but now there was no need to worry.
"Your Majesty," the Transmission Array bears no traps; we wouldn’t dare deceive you.
We haven’t used it primarily because the Gravel Plane lacks Magic Crystal Stones. This Ancient Teleportation Array left behind from ancient times is shrouded in mystery and requires an astronomical number of Magic Crystal Stones to activate.
The Gravel Plane has no Magic Crystal Veins. In the past, we’d slaughter other demons and use their souls and bloodlines to activate the array...
But this method is too dangerous. Last time, due to insufficient energy, one of our Extraordinary companions was drained of their flesh and soul..."
Upon hearing this, Lide was finally reassured.
So it wasn’t because there were traps but simply because of poverty.
Indeed, poverty is the greatest original sin in this world. Without money, nothing can be done.
As a standard filthy rich individual, Lide began his performance.
With a wave of his hand, under the astonished gaze of the two demons, a pile of Magic Crystal Stones shimmered like the stars appeared before them.
Of these, the highest quality—the Star Magic Crystal Stones.
There were more than two hundred of them, worth millions of Gold Pucks, and they were priceless in the market.
To demons accustomed to poverty, the sight turned their eyes enviously red.
The surging Magic Power contained within could even allow them to advance one or two levels.
"Proceed to activate the Transmission Array in the way you operate it..." Lide said in a casual tone, feeling little about the matter.
Ever since seizing the Magic Crystal Vein, he seldom worried about Magic Crystal Stones.
Moreover, for emergencies, Magic Crystal Stones, Alchemy Bombs, and Magic Blood were the three items he had stockpiled the most in his System Space.
Magic Crystal Stones were the least of his worries; most extravagant was the Magic Blood; he had stored enough to last him twenty normal years of use.
Even to be used as expendable items in combat, they could sustain over ten instances of high-intensity fighting.
This was also the reason he remained composed upon arrival in the Abyss; the supplies in his System Space were sufficient to support his leisurely existence for a considerable time.
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Once their souls were converted, the two demons received orders with greater enthusiasm than anyone else and immediately set about their task.
Lide glanced a few times as they arranged the Magic Crystal Stones and then lost interest. He knew nothing about Magic Arrays and was too lazy to learn; it was too much effort.
After a full six Sunshine Hours, when the Naga Leader Oli Kabar, along with the Abyss Half-Beast Leader and the Abyss Butcher, came to report to him, the two demons were still not done.
"Your Majesty, the army has been completely reorganized. After reorganizing the Chaotic Army, there are a total of 65 Ten Thousand People Armies, of which eight armies are level 14 elites, and there are altogether 57 individuals with combat power above level 15.
Please give your orders!"
armies meant 650,000 people, and these were all beings above level 10.
Lide nodded slightly. There had been no casualties since there had been no confrontation with the Double-Horned Demons, so both sides had retained their full strength.
After the demons surrendered, the power of the Chaotic Army naturally surged.
Unfortunately, there were fewer than 60 individuals with combat power above level 15, which was a stark contrast to the number of 650,000.
"No wonder the impoverished planes of the Abyss aren’t regarded by those powerful Evil Gods; with so many people, they can’t support even a few at level 15. The Gravel Plane truly lives up to its name, stones and nothing but stones..."
Lide shook his head and could only sigh at this. Although the power level in the Abyss was high, cultivating high-level combat forces still required resources, which the Gravel Plane obviously lacked.
But regardless, this was now his territory, and although this force might not count for much in the Abyss, it was shockingly powerful compared to the Main Plane.
He immediately issued orders to the Naga Leader.
"Oli, have the priests immediately convert the newly joined demons to our faith. Within three days, any who do not believe in the Twilight Sect, kill!"
Lide spoke coldly, showing no mercy toward these evil beings from the Abyss.
The Gravel Plane was now largely occupied by the Chaotic Army, and the Undead in the Northern Rotten Land were unimportant. To level the Undead, even cannon fodder was no longer needed.
Besides the Twilight Sect, no other voices would exist in this place.
The Gravel Plane would become a nail hammered into the Abyss of Dawn City in Lide’s plans.
Whether it was to invade the Abyss or to use it as a base to execute the Abyss piggery plan, everything could be manipulated at will.
Towards the Abyss, he would be stricter than towards the Underworld. Any who did not believe in the Twilight Sect were heretics and would be killed without mercy.
He had no feelings for these brutal demons; killing tens of millions would not shake him.
The Iron-blooded Monarch.
"As you wish, Your Majesty. Your Glory shall shine upon the Abyss!" The Naga Leader declared loudly, his eyes brimming with fanatical adoration.
After Lide bestowed upon them Extraordinary strength, their souls had already assimilated; to them, Lide was now the one True God.
While they conversed, suddenly a bright light burst forth from behind.
Following that, the Transmission Array clicked as if gears were locking into place, and it instantly began to rotate.
The Ancient Runes that had been passed down since ancient times started to be activated one by one, with a faint blue light emanating from within, filling the air with the power to twist space.
The disk began to creak and turn, the surrounding space twisting into chaos.
"Your Majesty, it’s activated! The Transmission Array is activated!" The two demons, who had been laboring for half a day, jubilantly approached Lide as if they had won a prize.
"Good, very good."
Lide’s joy was evident in his eyebrows.
"How do I operate the Transmission Array?"
"You just need to input your spiritual power, then you will be able to sense the specific way to operate it..."
Lide nodded, took a few steps forward, and his spiritual power extended slowly into the Transmission Array like the tentacles of an octopus.
Moments later, he felt a surge of vast information coming through and instantly knew how to operate the Transmission Array—as long as there were definite spatial coordinates, he could use the Transmission Array to open a Teleportation Gate.
Lide was not familiar with space, but he had something that no outsider could compare to—the Land of Bone-Burying.
This plane, which belonged entirely to him, was ten thousand times stronger than any spatial coordinates.
His spiritual power merged into the Transmission Array, and his heart began to communicate with the Land of Bone-Burying far away on the Main Plane.
Under normal circumstances, such a distant Land of Bone-Burying would not respond to his call, but through the extended power of the Transmission Array, in just a few breaths, he sensed that plane belonging to him.
And when the Land of Bone-Burying detected Lide’s aura, it too sent out cheers and leaps for joy, its thin plane consciousness subconsciously welcoming its master.
After the spatial coordinates were determined, the Ancient Transmission Array burst out with an indescribable terrifying power, and a stream of blue light broke through the layers of the Abyss Plane, stretching across countless distances, connecting inside the Land of Bone-Burying.
Seeing this, Lide couldn’t help but be astounded; indeed, this was something left over from ancient times, far too exaggerated.
Once the Transmission Array connected to the Land of Bone-Burying, a Space Gate three blades high, and five blades long, appeared out of thin air above the circular platform of the Transmission Array.
The moment the Space Gate appeared, the more than two hundred Star Magic Crystal Stones around it, worth millions of Gold Puck each, immediately dimmed, obviously indicating the tremendous energy consumption of opening a gate to the Main Plane.
At the moment of the Space Gate’s appearance, Lide did not enter because he sensed a unique energy fluctuation...
Following his gaze, a stream of gray energy slowly emerged from within the Space Gate, but instead of dissipating, it began to erode the Space Gate.
Lide’s eyes widened; the Land of Bone-Burying was actually invading directly into the Abyss...
His plane, it was preparing to defy the heavens.
While everyone watched, the unguarded Ancient Transmission Array was being eroded, little by little, by the gray energy emitted from the Land of Bone-Burying.
Those Ancient Runes that had been emitting light blue energy began to belch out gray-white energy.
Lide’s expression was quite a spectacle.
Although he hadn’t stepped into the Space Gate, he sensed that the Land of Bone-Burying was very excited to erode the Transmission Array as if devouring it was greatly beneficial to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Unfortunately, the plane consciousness of the Land of Bone-Burying was too insignificant, unable even to form self-awareness, only possessing the most primitive instinctive characteristics, so he could not discern what effect the Ancient Transmission Array had on the Land of Bone-Burying.
But since the Land of Bone-Burying found it useful, he naturally wouldn’t interrupt; raising a plane was much more stimulating than nurturing other things.
Ten minutes, twenty minutes, half a Sunshine Hour later...
Click-clack, click-clack—a sound of gears turning rose, and then the Transmission Array, previously emanating a blue energy, was completely swallowed by the gray energy.
The next second, the system’s prompt suddenly sounded.
"Ding~ Your plane—the Land of Bone-Burying has devoured the Ancient Transmission Array, the rules have been complemented, and the teleportation function has been activated.
You can use the Land of Bone-Burying to start the Ancient Transmission Array, opening Teleportation Gates to various planes of the Abyss (due to the limitations of the Ancient Runes, this function is limited to the Abyss)."
?!
Lide’s eyes widened, a look of disbelief appearing on his face.
Is this even possible??
Couldn’t be more awesome.
He was about to implement the Abyss pig-raising plan after returning to Dawn City, and now he had gained this super Divine Skill capable of opening Teleportation Gates.
It was a perfect match for his plan, like dry wood meeting fierce flames.
Indeed, the Goddess of Luck, that lady not fond of wearing undergarments, still approved of his pig-raising plan.
Just after the system prompt rang, a strange noise came from the Transmission Array.
Click-clack—
Boom—
Then, before everyone’s eyes, the Ancient Transmission Array—that massive circular platform—exploded directly, as if it were being scooped out of the ground by hand, with gravel splattering around.
And before anyone had the chance to blink, it flew into the Space Gate and disappeared without a trace.
When the dust settled, there was just that hovering gray Space Gate left in the air.
"Your Highness, this..."
The two Double-Horned Demons witnessing this scene widened their eyes, somewhat at a loss; the Ancient Transmission Array had just... vanished??
They had never thought about moving the Array, but each touch had brought a sense of great danger, as if moving them would trigger a fatal attack, and now it had just simply disappeared?
Lide waved his hand.
"Do not worry, this is my doing."
After speaking, he turned his head and glanced at the few people behind him, "Manage the Chaotic Army well, I’m going to visit the Main Plane for a while, and I’ll be back soon."
"Yes, Your Highness!"
After a brief instruction, Lide turned to the gray Space Gate floating in mid-air, a flicker of excitement in his eyes.
After leaving the Main Plane for a few months, he could finally return.
His form flashed, and he disappeared into the Space Gate.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 438: The Silly Husky Unexpectedly Became a God, The Terror of the Bygone Arrival (10,000-Word Mega - )
chapters.content:
Chapter 436: Chapter 438: The Silly Husky Unexpectedly Became a God, The Terror of the Bygone Arrival (10,000-Word Mega Chapter)
Swoosh~
Lide’s figure vanished from the abyss and reappeared in the Land of Bone-Burying through a Teleportation Gate.
The moment he appeared, the mighty power of heaven and earth blessed him, enveloping him in boundless strength.
As the master of this Plane, Lide could wield all power within the Land of Bone-Burying.
He was the dominator, the only one.
Hovering in midair, Lide felt an indescribable sense of security flood his heart. He was finally back...
After a moment of reflection, his gaze swept across his surroundings.
Scenes familiar yet long unseen unfolded before his eyes.
The sky over the Land of Bone-Burying was dim, as if shrouded in a layer of gauze.
The white bone-strewn ground radiated a deathly aura that chilled the heart, its malevolence unquestioned. Yet now, in Lide’s eyes, this evil felt strangely comforting.
The central area’s stone walls, once erected to oppose the Fierce Half-Ratmen, still stood tall. However, due to the lack of management for too long, the walls were stained and scabbed with dried blood, their surface etched with dense scratch marks, emanating an aura of desolation and solemnity.
The Rotten Land within the high walls, where millions of Fierce Half-Ratmen were buried, was now covered in blooms of Death Flowers. These flowers, which could enhance the soul strength of the Undead, were considered treasures beyond price, invaluable to the Undead.
The land was so fertile that tens of thousands of Death Flowers bloomed within the stone walls, creating a blood-red sea of blossoms against the white bones and blackened bloodstains, invoking a skin-crawling eeriness.
Gazing along the stone walls toward the right, in the peripheral areas of the Land of Bone-Burying, several Space Gates stood silently erect.
Ordinary residents shuttled through them like schools of fish.
Some Gates were dedicated to transporting goods, others exclusively for pedestrian use, and even fixed military channels crisscrossed densely like a honeycomb.
These inconspicuous Space Gates were among the most precious assets of Dawn City. They kept the city in a state of rapid development, increasing work efficiency by tenfold, a hundredfold.
After sweeping past the area with the Space Gates, his vision shifted to the edge below the Land of Bone-Burying. There, a vast Space Gate over fifty blades long and thirty blades wide connected to the Spider Plane.
This was originally where Lide raised pigs.
However, due to the campaign in the Underworld, Frost Giant Dragon Altan had been dispatched to Twilight City, leaving no time to slaughter Cave Spiders.
The plan to use Cave Spiders to breed pigs and thereby harvest the Power of Death had to be put on hold.
Now, through the Space Gate, one could faintly see the large and ferocious Cave Spiders pacing back and forth.
But by the command of the Extraordinary Spider Queen, these beasts dared not overstep, so their ghastly sounds were absent from the Land of Bone-Burying.
"The pig-raising plan must be restarted as soon as possible. How much Power of Death have we wasted these past months?"
With that thought, Lide subconsciously opened his attribute panel for the Land of Bone-Burying to check his attributes.
He still had over thirty-two million units of the Power of Death.
Summoning an Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragon required one hundred million units of the Power of Death, and also a certain amount of Divine Power.
Though it seemed plentiful, it was indeed a reliable channel for cultivating ultimate combat power.
No matter how many Extraordinary forces he had, it was never enough.
Though the Power of Faith could also cultivate Extraordinary beings, such precious resources were not infinite; the more he earned, the quicker it was spent.
Having a stable channel to summon ultimate combat power was invaluable.
Even more, the summoned Extraordinary Giant Dragons were far from reaching the upper limits of the Land of Bone-Burying. As long as he had enough Power of Death, summoning Legendary or even Demigod Level beings was not a fantasy.
Thus, the pig-raising plan had to not only continue but to be implemented vigorously. Even if Frost Giant Dragons were not recruited, it was necessary to earn the Power of Death first and then bring downfall to the Twelve-winged Blazing Angels. Lide had coveted this Divine Monster for far too long.
After pondering for a moment, Lide no longer lingered on his surroundings, shifting his focus to the gains from his trip to the abyss.
It was time for his favorite task of reaping the rewards.
This unexpected descent into the abyss had certainly exceeded his plans, but if the gains were included, the trip was absolutely worthwhile. It was not just worth it—it was a profit great enough to turn onlookers envious with bloodshot eyes.
He had had many adventures, but the spoils of this one were among the top in recent years.
The first was establishing the Chaotic Army.
An army of 650,000 demons, each above Level 10, was bound to amaze.
Among them, the top-tier combatants at Level 15 numbered in the dozens, with five transcendents who could roam unrestrained across the Main Plane.
Pulling this force into the Main Plane, it was no exaggeration to say it could steamroll the southern provinces without issue.
Even faced with the current strength of Dawn City, the Chaotic Army could cause significant damage.
This legion would later become the primary executor of his invasion into the abyss, for implementing the pig-raising plan.
Its significance was extraordinary.
The second achievement—Gravel Plane.
Yes, the Gravel Plane. Although it is quite barren compared to other Abyss Planes, so barren that it’s no exaggeration to say that even moderately strong Demon Lords of the Abyss wouldn’t even spare it a glance.
But, the most critical point is that, no matter how barren the Gravel Plane might be, it was still part of the Abyss and was now completely under his control... He saw the Undead of the Rotten Land as already being doomed to extinction, and once he completely conquered the entire Plane, he would also obtain the title of Plane Conqueror.
And to control a Plane implies significant meaning. It would be the future foothold for Dawn City’s invasion into the Abyss, the base, the headquarters—all here.
A bridgehead, that was Lide’s positioning for the Gravel Plane.
Moreover, although this Plane was barren in the hands of Demons, that might not be the case for Dawn City. Perhaps upon exploration, a few rich mineral veins could be discovered.
And now that the Land of Bone-Burying had swallowed the Ancient Teleportation Array, he had gained the ability to teleport to other Planes within the Abyss, which made having such a steady headquarters even more important.
The third gain was levelling up to Level 24, allowing for a retreat at any time to make a breakthrough into Legendary, as well as achieving 30% control over the Twilight Divine Position, gaining a clearer understanding of Divine Power, which greatly facilitated his subsequent mastery of blood and the Blood Clan Divine Position.
The fourth gain is the most crucial—5 shen long serpent god’s Divine Body.
This was a complete Divine Body that, according to Lide’s sensing, still contained at least half a Divine Stone.
This greatly increased the value of the Divine Body.
Lide, who had devoured the Twilight Godhood, knew the value all too well. It directly allowed him to achieve 30% control over the Twilight Divine Position and also acquired three attack-type Divine Arts, worth billions.
If he set out to do so, he could use this Divine Body to cultivate several Ultimate Combat Powers.
And the key point for his breakthrough into Legendary also lay on the Divine Body.
Therefore, after comprehensive consideration, the serpent god’s Divine Body was the most precious treasure in his haul.
Thinking of this, Lide’s eyes brimmed with even more satisfaction.
This time, he had unexpectedly been thwarted by the God of Twilight, but he had not expected his gains to become more substantial.
Truly, life is full of uncertainties.
Although these few achievements were already to the extreme, it didn’t end there.
Stretching out his right hand, his fingers slightly opened, a silver stone appeared out of nowhere in his palm.
"Divine Stone."
Lide felt his body’s craving for the stone in his palm and smiled faintly.
This trip to explore the Divine Ruins was aimed solely at improving his control over the Divine Position with a Divine Stone.
Falling into the Abyss was entirely an unforeseen turn of events.
When Lide killed the God of Twilight, the soul-black mist that the other party condensed dispersed in all directions, swallowed by these thumb-sized stones; it was then that he discovered the existence of Divine Stones.
The Poison Snake Altar exploded due to the force of the Plane when it entered the Abyss, causing the Divine Stones to scatter too widely. Lide couldn’t be bothered to collect them himself and simply let the Naga do the searching.
When the Naga delivered the found Divine Stones to his hands, he was busy with conquering the Gravel Plane and didn’t have much energy to absorb their power, so he left it until now.
Feeling his body’s yearning, Lide’s thoughts moved, and a light crimson energy softly spread out, directly enveloping the Divine Stone in his palm.
Under the effect of the Power of Crimson, the mysterious power within the Divine Stone was completely devoured.
When that power entered Lide’s body, a very special feeling flooded his mind, as if he had a slight enlightenment about the environment and the rules around him.
This felt similar to when he devoured the Divine Stone of the God of Twilight, experiencing the vicissitudes of the world’s laws.
But the difference was, the power contained in a Divine Stone was too weak, and that momentary feeling vanished in an instant—not even lasting five seconds.
"Ding~ You have absorbed a Divine Stone, and your control over Divine Position has slightly increased."
Slightly increased?
Lide wasn’t surprised upon hearing this because the Divine Stone in his hand was only a basic-level one, while the highest quality one was a Perfect Level...
He didn’t plan to use it right now—it wouldn’t be too late to use when making a breakthrough into Legendary.
Glancing at the Divine Position on his attribute panel, as expected, there was no change; clearly, this slight increase wasn’t enough to make the data on the attribute panel fluctuate.
After devouring a Divine Stone, Lide considered that he had sorted out all the main gains.
One, army; two, Plane; three, Level and Divine Position; four, Divine Body; five, Divine Stone.
Actually, there was also the number of Believers, but that belonged to the efforts of those beneath him in the Main Plane, so he didn’t count it.
It couldn’t be denied that this haul fattened him up considerably.
He alone significantly increased the foundation of Dawn City.
The opening of the Abyss held profound significance, even surpassing that of the Underworld.
