One could foresee that if this situation continued for another three to five months, apart from those staunchly faithful believers, most would leave the Dawn Sect...
A storm aimed at the Dawn Sect had begun, and the manipulator behind the scenes seemed to grow increasingly unrestrained.
Duke O’Kelly, who once strongly advocated for the Dawn Sect, had started to live in seclusion two months prior, with many residents of Green City seldom seeing him leave his manor anymore...
During the months of Lide’s seclusion, the situation in the outside world had quietly undergone tremendous changes.
And at this moment, he was still deep in slumber in the heart of the Land of Bone-Burying, like this plane was incubating a dragon egg, transforming... and awaiting his awakening.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 443: Lide’s Breakthrough to Legendary, the Beginning of Reaching the Peak (9200 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 441: Chapter 443: Lide’s Breakthrough to Legendary, the Beginning of Reaching the Peak (9200 words)
Time flowed ceaselessly, and under the rifts in the sky, the situation of Glory further deteriorated.
The breath of ancient days seeped into the Main Plane through those rifts, much like water leaking from a dam. As time progressed, the ancient powers grew denser, leading to more and more lives being corroded by this ancient force, making the situation increasingly unmanageable.
Crops failed, rivers were polluted, plants began to wither, and the worshipers of the Evil God became increasingly rampant, with order collapsing step by step.
The servants of the ancient Evil Gods and the creatures corrupted by the ancient days rampaged across the Main Plane. These chaotic and brutal monsters, knowing only slaughter, left ruins and desolation wherever they went.
Compelled by necessity, small cities began to converge towards larger cities, and the large cities also actively retracted their powers from beyond their outskirts.
The final scenario had the large cities as cores, forming isolated "islands" on land, with the traffic between cities resembling navigation at sea, always vigilant of the storm of ancient monsters that might strike.
But the worst had not yet ended, with the formation of city-islands, a major event shook the entirety of Glory.
The Sun Goddess, transformed into a saint, used her Divine Arts to convey a message to her followers—the fragments of the Destiny Tablet could dispel the breath of ancient days and restore normality to the rules.
This message, jolting countless forces, immediately captured everyone’s attention.
At such a critical moment, the omnipresent erosion of ancient power had become a nightmare in everyone’s minds.
Because no one knew if they would be the next person affected by the ancient power, or if their relatives and friends were being corrupted.
The fragments of the Destiny Tablet could restore everything to normal, which was a lifeline for everyone.
Before the ancient days descended, most people had little concept of order, but having experienced slaughter, death, and chaos, everyone deeply realized how precious the tranquility of the past was.
Only after losing it, did they cherish it.
News about the Destiny Tablet instantly became the top concern for all cities and superiors.
A storm began to brew.
And accompanying the news of the Destiny Tablet was another rumor that terrified the gods, making the already tense situation in Glory explode like cold water poured into boiling oil.
The Goddess of Commerce and Wealth had fallen.
Yes, a true deity had perished on the Main Plane.
The disappearance of the Goddess of Wealth might have been undetectable to outsiders, but her fervent and steadfast believers could not be deceived.
When the believers found the body of the Goddess of Wealth, tracing back its origin, it was shockingly discovered that the famous goddess in Glory had perished in a small coastal city with a population of only two hundred thousand.
Although the Goddess of Wealth was only a medium divine power deity, her special divine position—commerce and wealth—meant her influence on the Main Plane was even greater than many more powerful deities.
Yet now, this always-neutral goddess had died in an inconspicuous small city, and the god-slayer tracked by her followers was merely Extraordinary!
Yes, an Extraordinary being had killed a former medium divine power deity.
Moreover, this Extraordinary used the Divine Arts of the Goddess of Wealth during the believers’ siege and successfully escaped.
This news swept through Glory like a storm.
Everyone was shaken.
God-slaying!
What a mad act, but now, it was starkly unfolding before everyone.
For the first time, people truly understood what the Life Goddess had said, that the deities would lose their power and descend to the mortal realm, was so literally true.
Previously, those who revered the gods, now after the fall of the Goddess of Wealth—an influential but not very powerful deity—their fear and reverence for the deities collapsed.
Gods were no longer high and mighty; they too could be killed.
The ambitions of many Extraordinary and Legendary beings grew wildly like weeds.
If even an Extraordinary could kill a deity, did they still deserve awe? Did they still deserve their exalted status?
The answer was self-evident.
And another thought inevitably rose.
"If they, like that Transcendent, could slay gods and then seize their divine status, could they have the chance to become the next deities?!"
Imagining this scene, countless people gasped for breath.
These were deities.
The beings they had always looked up to, worshipped, and feared were now potentially within their reach...
Even if it meant death, it was worth a shot.
Originally, the concerns and fears of those powerhouses about transcendent beings becoming saints and descending onto the main plane quietly transformed into excitement.
Many began to realize that this was not only a massive crisis but also an unprecedented opportunity.
Once they seized this chance, they too could become exalted gods.
Three days after the fall of the Goddess of Wealth, the fall of another god with powerful divine power completely ignited this storm.
The followers of the God of Wind and Rage, during their prayers, vividly sensed the demise and dissipation of their god.
Their god had also been hunted.
The fall of the God of Wind and Rage was even more terrifying than that caused by the Goddess of Wealth.
Because the fall of one deity could be explained as an accident, but the fall of a powerful divine force, especially one holding a combat divine position, made any excuse seem feeble.
The gods were no longer invincible; to slay a god with a mortal body was no longer just a myth spoken of by wandering poets.
Initially, the gods who manifested their majesty in various cities simultaneously went into hiding.
Many transcendents and legends, who already controlled substantial forces, began quietly using their power to search for these hidden gods, ostensibly to protect them...
The situation in Glory thus became increasingly chaotic.
---
---
---
As time passed in chaos, August 10, 3526, Era of Glory, in Dawn City.
The chaos outside had little impact on this city hidden among the mountains.
Strict law enforcement, a tolerant environment, and a prosperous life made this city a unique paradise in Glory.
At this very moment, the creators of this great city, the god revered by countless as the God of Dawn and Twilight, was sleeping.
In the Land of Bone-Burying, Emi, floating in the air, was overseeing the battlefield below, where millions of skeleton warriors were battling the demons continuously pouring in through the space gate.
Blood flowed in rivers, bones shattered into mountains.
Emi, the executor of the plan "Use a borrowed knife to kill the pig," had been relentlessly at work.
Using the Dark Sovereign’s blade to butcher the pigs of the Abyss Plane.
This plan had been in operation for a full half-year now, and Emi had used the Land of Bone-Burying to secure a formidable ten planes for the Dark Sovereign.
As a result, the Dark Sovereign’s fondness for Lide greatly increased.
Of course, correspondingly, 80% of the demons from these ten planes were killed in the Land of Bone-Burying.
At this moment, the dense power of death in the sky had formed nearly tangible dark clouds, the emanated aura making everyone tremble.
Emi, who had been observing the above battle, suddenly shifted his gaze to the ground; he felt that the core of the earth had started to change.
It was as if a giant beast of the abyss sleeping within was awakening. Although it was not fully awake yet, the terrifying aura emanating from it caused Emi’s hair to stand on end.
Emi felt not fear but a flicker of surprise and excitement in his eyes.
"Your Highness... are you awakening?"
In the deepest part of the Land of Bone-Burying,
Abundant, this was the sensation conveyed to Lide.
Never had he felt so complete, extending beyond mere physical fulfillment to spiritual and soulful contentment.
It was like the comfort one feels lying on a sofa after a hearty meal, altogether transformed.
While devouring the divine body of the Snake Clan God, the residual divine status within was activated by him.
The origin power of the Snake Clan openly displayed before him, the energy embedded within the divine status plunged him once more into the state of comprehending rules.
The last time has been when he activated the Twilight Divine Status.
Moreover, as he had no intention of merging this time, he simply burned up the divine status, hence the process of rule comprehension was especially prolonged.
Under the influence of the divine status, the world’s rules appeared like a disrobed being of the opposite sex, displaying all their perfections before him, mountains rose and valleys deepened...
While he was in the midst of comprehending these rules, the Divine Stone, under the devouring Power of Crimson, gradually dimmed.
The power within his body was like a dam collecting water, slowly filling up.
In this process, his bloodline, his body, and even his soul were undergoing a gradual transformation.
A rebirth from the ashes.
Half a year was enough to be considered lengthy, crops had gone through a season of growth, flowers had bloomed, withered, and fruited... Lide was in his chrysalis, also waiting for that moment to transform into a butterfly.
At this moment, his understanding of divine positions also deepened.
Twilight Divine Position, the cycle of day and night, the alternation of all things, everything approaches the day of twilight, the undying gods, the everlasting planes, even the multiverse that spans millions of years.
Blood Divine Position, representing life but also death, dark and bloody as well as bright and holy, blood knows neither darkness nor light...
The existence of blood is merely a rule essential for the majority of life, without which life is a mutation, incomplete, blood completes the rule of life.
Correct content is on
Blood Clan Divine Position represents a race, from the birth of the race, to its flourishing, aging, and death, this is the transformation of the natural rules,
Just like the life cycle of plants from germination, growth, blooming, fruit setting, withering, to death, it signifies neither darkness nor evil nor light nor goodness, but merely a part of the original rules.
As the controller of this divine position, Lide could, to some extent, use the divine position to interfere and guide the development of the entire race.
Countless insights not only gave Lide a clearer understanding of himself but also deepened his understanding of the entire world.
In the process of comprehending the rules, he even clearly sensed the calling of his believers, praying, beseeching, repenting, blessing... He became a true divine being, overseeing all creatures.
Finally, when both his soul and body had transformed to their extremes.
Lide, with his eyes previously closed, slowly opened them.
In that instant, the world turned upside down.
In the Land of Bone-Burying, amid a fierce bloody battle, the undead and demons felt as though a terrifying life force had opened its eyes and was watching them.
That frightfully intense fluctuation caused everyone’s hair to stand on end, the Soul Fire of the undead warriors trembled like candles in a strong wind, making one wonder if they might extinguish the next second.
The demons trembled violently, even their inherent lust for slaughter and brutality was forcibly suppressed, their eyes filled with fear.
That power exceeded their wildest imaginations...
Lide slowly extended his right hand, the Power of Crimson diffused out, demonic flames burning upon it, his fingers suddenly clenched into a fist, crackling—the Power of Crimson dispersed, the space around him warped at that moment.
Feeling the power emanating from within his body, Lide took another deep breath.
Powerful.
Unprecedentedly powerful.
And at this moment, he could even faintly discern the flow of rules around the Land of Bone-Burying, he could now see through the facade to deeper level rules!
Just then, the system notification sound rang out continuously.
"Ding~You have broken through to Legendary, your current level is 28."
"Ding~You have gained a deeper understanding of the world, and your control over blood and Blood Clan Divine Position has significantly increased, currently 15% control level."
"Ding~Your control over blood and Blood Clan Divine Position has exceeded 10%, and you have comprehended new Divine Arts—Blood Purification, Blood Clan Assimilation."
"Ding~You have gained a new understanding of the Twilight Divine Position, control level increased by 10%, currently at 40%"
"Ding~Your bloodline has transformed to Legendary Ancestor Bloodline, significantly increasing your strength."
"Ding~Your racial talents and skills have gained tremendous enhancement."
A series of system notification sounds invigorated Lide instantly.
His heart was also immensely excited.
Level 28.
Legendary.
When he had halted consuming the Twilight Godhood, now he finally obtained the best reward, if he had directly stepped into Legendary then, his level would merely be 25.
No need for any additional language to describe it, just the data on the attribute panel at level 28 says it all.
Even now, when the Divine has descended to the Main Plane as Saints, Legendary still remains a presence that stands at the summit of the mountain.
Before the descent of the Ancient, Legendary was the foundation of a nation, even the once vast Nolan Empire had only two or three Legendaries publicly known.
Now, he possessed this power, a power exclusively his.
Lide Kachar laughed heartily.
The previously suppressed emotions were swept away, he felt a boldness akin to daring to ridicule Huang Chao for not being a true man.
His gaze then turned to his own attribute panel.
Lide Kachar
Race: Bloodline (Ancestor)
Legend Level: 30 (Reputable)
Titles: Master of Crimson, Immortal King, Divine System Master (Traits: Main God Dignity, Divine Power like Prison), Giant Conqueror, Savior
Level: Legendary lv28 (0/10 million)
Magic Power: 100k/100k
Bloodline: Ancestor Bloodline (Legendary)
Talent Specialization: Blood Clan Ancestor (Unique)
Blood-soaked Rebirth (Restricted) Can leave a bat in the Blood Clan’s blood pool, can be reborn in the blood pool upon body’s death, weak period of 20 days, cooldown time 20 days.
Rare·Restricted Skill:
Legendary Crimson Power (Can manipulate the Power of Crimson to invade the opponent’s body, causing the enemy’s blood to boil and burst. The more the Power of Crimson invades, the higher the damage it inflicts, dramatically reducing the enemy’s magic resistance and causing full true damage to those below Legendary, capable of corroding Weak Divine Power level defenses)
Legendary Bloody Storm (Consumes 50% bloodline power to release 100 bats each containing 60% of the main body’s strength, can also utilize the blood within the enemy’s body to condense Lide’s 90% strength slaughter bats, which can gather the Power of Crimson, inflict true damage to defenses below Extraordinary, capable of piercing magic shields, can devour blood to grow, reproduce, and divide, lasts until the blood energy is exhausted)
Legendary Shadow Blade (Transform into Blood Clan after entering Dimension Space, immune to detection techniques below Weak Divine Power, gains Absolute Slaughter Trait, Absolute Slaughter: Ignores all defenses below Weak Divine Power in the first attack, causing true damage, deploying costs 50% bloodline power.)
Legendary Slaughter Hand (Combat Awareness, Combat Skills, Battlefield Sense, etc. upgraded to Divine-level), gains Special Traits: Legendary Danger Perception (capable of sensing imminent threats)
Bloodline Shackles (Unbinding the shackles of the main body activates Legendary Ancestor Bloodline, all attributes ascend to extreme upon activation, and gains Undying Body Trait,
Undying Body: The body has no vital points, even if the head is chopped off, can still use bloodline power to regenerate and recover, currently capable of restoring fatal damage—10 times, can consume internal blood to maintain this state for a long time.)
Racial Skills: Transform into bat, blood-sucking recovery.
Passive Skills: Multi-casting, Legendary Power, Legendary Physique, Legendary Agility, Legendary Magic Affinity, Legendary Magic Control
Blood Clan exclusive magic, can grow: roughly ... 6 extreme skills.
Magic: roughly...
Lide looked at his attribute panel and his smile did not diminish.
All his skills had been upgraded from the Extraordinary Level to the Legendary Level.
Whether it was Bloodline or passive skills and talents, it could be said that there had been a qualitative improvement.
But the one thing that surprised him was that many skills’ detailed data descriptions had disappeared, and they also had fewer traits than before.
Apart from Bloody Storm still having relatively accurate data, skills like Bloodline Shackles, which previously could unlock a 500% increase in power, now only had a description of elevation to the extreme.
It appeared that the system could no longer precisely describe his power.
The combination of Talent and Bloodline, along with the overlay of the Power of Faith and Divine Arts meant that the power Lide now possessed, as displayed by the system, was in a rather ambiguous range.
Even Lide himself could not accurately estimate his own power.
He could only feel that if there were a Transcendent being like a Double-Horned Demon in front of him, he could kill it with a slap.
He had stepped into another level of life, a level that countless people would worship...
Even Lide could feel that if he wanted, he could even shatter the ground of the Land of Bone-Burying and, with all his firepower, breaking through this plane would not be too difficult...
The power to destroy planes... He had now become a human-shaped calamity.
"Although there’s no detailed data assessment, I can feel the rich power flowing and settling in my Bloodline like magma...
I’ve stepped into a height that cannot be described with data.
Legendary..."
Lide took a deep breath, his heart more exhilarated than the last time he broke through to the Transcendent.
In the great disaster of the Ancient Times, only by controlling powerful forces could he confront the situation.
As the Master of Dawn, relied upon by the faith of millions, he naturally had to step upon the mountain peak.
Turning his head to look around, at the Legendary realm, everything around him became vividly clear.
Seeing the rules in motion, Lide had an insight in his heart about understanding rules: the first layer is to see the mountain as a mountain, the water as water; the second layer is to see the mountain not as a mountain, the water not as water; and the third time back to seeing the mountain as a mountain, the water as water.
He was now in the second stage, where everything he looked at had changed, no longer resembling the previous world.
In his eyes, this underground world was no longer made up of accumulating bones, but rather, it was the rules of the Land of Bone-Burying that were in motion.
That feeling was fascinating, and after observing for a moment, Lide got completely immersed in it.
The world operates, everything converges...
The origin of the world was right in front of him, the only true way to explore.
After a long time, a thought suddenly arose in Lide’s heart that he never wanted to leave this state... but in an instant, a strong sense of vigilance snapped him back to reality.
When he came to his senses, his forehead was sweating.
"Close call, experiencing the rules of the main world for the first time almost made me completely lost..."
After waiting for a moment, adjusting to the power inside him, he finally detached from that state of transcending things and overlooking rules, and his heart gradually returned to normal.
After calming down, Lide couldn’t help feeling a bit strange.
"No wonder the gods are described as aloof and indifferent in legends.
This state, being able to see at a glance how the world’s rules turn, is indeed fascinating and gives a feeling of being close to the origin of the world, making it hard to detach.
I should enter this state less often in the future, having no desires is even more exaggerated than turning on ’Sage Mode’ afterward..."
Thinking this, Lide shuddered; that state was too frightening, he just felt like he had pulled down the pants of the truth of this world.
"But now it appears that beneath the truth’s underwear are two hairy legs... unbelievable."
After steadying his spirit, Lide regained his excitement, glanced at the system prompt, and looked forward to his divine panel with anticipation.
This achievement wasn’t just in him becoming stronger—his sect hadn’t been idle over the past six months.
Dawn God—Lide Kachar (Fake God)
Divine Position: Blood Clan (control level 15%), Blood (control level 15%)
Divine Arts: 1. Soul Assimilation, 2. Faith Enhancement,
3. Blood Purification (can purify the bloodline, enhance bloodline potential, eliminate hidden dangers in the bloodline; the stronger the target, the more power of faith consumed)
4. Blood Clan Assimilation (transforms non-undead beings into Blood Clan beings, or partly into Blood Clan, inheriting Blood Clan traits; the stronger the target, the more power of faith consumed)
Lide’s face lit up with a radiant smile.
He hadn’t expected this breakthrough to bring such a significant increase in control over his divine positions.
From the previous 2%, it had shot up directly to 15%, and that was true for both divine positions—simply incredible.
And the understanding of these two divine arts was almost monstrous.
One could enhance the potential of a bloodline, while the other could transform non-undead beings into Blood Clan members.
This was absurdly powerful; now he could create Blood Nagas, Blood Demons, Blood Beastmen, Blood Giants... and so on.
Thinking about this, he was somewhat eager to see the situation after assimilating other life forms into Blood Clan—whether they could gain talents similar to the Blood Clan, whether their power could significantly increase in darkness, whether they could gain the ability to heal through bloodsucking?
"These two divine arts, the more I think about them, the more endless their potential seems...
If I first use Faith Enhancement, then Blood Purification, and finally perform Blood Clan Assimilation, what kind of creature would emerge?"
Lide thought and itched to experiment, but having no target at the moment, he had to suppress his eagerness.
His gaze continued downward, to the next attribute listed.
Number of Followers: Zealous Believers 45, Devout Believers 60k, Believers 350k, Nominal Believers 520k
Power of Faith: 3.25 million
The combined number of followers in the Dawn Sect had now reached 930k.
And with half a year of accumulation, the Power of Faith possessed a staggering over three million.
This phase really fattened him up a few hundred pounds.
"More than three million Power of Faith? My ancestors never had it this good!"
Lide became increasingly excited, "If that’s the state of the Dawn Sect, what about the Twilight Sect?"
With the ability to enslave Cave Dwellers, the propagation efficiency of the Twilight Sect is absolutely several times that of the Dawn Sect, he quickly looked at the Twilight Sect’s panel.
God of Twilight—Lide Kachar (Fake God)
Divine Position: Twilight (already mastered 40%)
Divine Arts: 1. Twilight Radiance—releases a ray of light infused with Twilight Power that can deprive the opponent of life, causing the opponent’s soul to age and decay, the stronger the target the more power of faith needed.
2. Twilight Barrier—releases a barrier, life within the barrier will have their lives plundered to supplement the barrier’s power, the wider the range of the barrier the more power of faith consumed.
3. Twilight Approaching—releases a ray of Twilight Light, causing the opponent to temporarily enter old age, the stronger the target the more power of faith consumed.
Unexpectedly, although the Twilight Divine Position had an increase of 10% in control level, it hadn’t triggered the activation of a new divine art.
However, Lide wasn’t disappointed; he could sense a clearer understanding of Twilight, feeling he was close to touching the origin of the divine position, which would definitely bring a stronger enhancement than grasping one or two divine arts.
As his eyes moved downward, seeing the followers and Power of Faith of Twilight City, his hand involuntarily trembled, and his face displayed an ecstasy.
Number of Followers: Zealous Believers 1,236, Devout Believers 1.2 million, Believers 2.2 million, Nominal Believers 2.3 million
Dark Faith Power: 12.3 million
Even at first glance at these two attributes, Lide thought he might be blind.
The number of believers had reached a terrifying 5.7 million, and the Dark Faith Power had even broken through the sky—12.3 million!!
How exaggerated was this data?!!
Accumulating tens of millions of faith power in just half a year was insanely lavish!
Lide, feeling as if he had won a 500 million jackpot, began to breathe rapidly.
"I can’t take it anymore, quickly bring in a hundred people for me, I want to elevate all of them to Transcendent!!"
He felt as if he was going to ascend to the heavens.
"Elevating a Transcendent seems to be 500,000 Faith Power, 10 would be 5 million, 20 would be... ahem, keep it low-key, I was just expressing my mood, I didn’t say anything."
Lide did some quick calculations and promptly curbed his inflated mentality regarding the newfound wealth.
Thinking it over, tens of millions of Faith Power didn’t seem very useful after all, only capable of elevating 20 to Transcendent... no, when did Transcendent become so cheap??
Those were powers that could dominate the Main Plane, a single individual ravaging a city was no big deal.
Lide thought about it; Transcendent really had rapidly devalued in Dawn City...
Setting aside Faith Power, having nearly 6 million believers still thrilled him immensely.
Believers were the foundation of everything, with 6 million believers, what was there to worry about regarding Transcendents? Using Faith Power to forcefully raise someone from Level 1 to Legendary wasn’t a dream.
"Too thrilling, hahaha."
After reviewing the attribute panel from top to bottom over a dozen times, Lide reluctantly turned it off.
This time of seclusion had successfully transformed him from a poor farmer to a landowner.
Suppressing his inner excitement, he glanced at the cramped space he had lived in for several months.
At this point, the complete divine body had turned into a snake carcass, shrunk by hundreds of times, and those Divine Stones had all turned into dust, none left.
"Not bad, this snake carcass can be left for that foolish ox to chew on..."
Feeling the power within his body had completely stabilized, Lide no longer hesitated, his figure appearing in midair over the Land of Bone-Burying.
The moment he appeared, the intense battle below between millions of undead and demons caught his attention.
"This terrifying war, the abyssal pig farming plan seems to be going quite well..."
After glancing at the battlefield, Lide’s awareness spread, instantly bringing everything at the Land of Bone-Burying into his mind.
Setting aside the battlefield for now, the Space Gate connected to the Spider Plane was shrouded in dense black fog, and the central area where the Fierce Half-Ratmen were being besieged, now had tens of thousands of the Death Flowers planted along the rock walls also covered in black fog, and the positions of several Space Gates in Dawn City were firmly protected.
Obviously, all these were Emi’s masterworks.
Once these key positions were covered by the mist transformed from the Power of Death, the remaining areas of the Land of Bone-Burying turned into the battlefield for implementing their plans through indirect means.
The battle between the undead and the demons.
And shortly after Lide appeared, Emi, who was supervising the battle from afar, instantly teleported next to him, her eyes filled with surprise.
"Your Majesty, have you broken through?"
Lide looked at his earliest conquered Bloodline, his expression quite pleased.
"Yes, I have stepped into the Legendary."
"Legendary!!" Emi’s eyes were filled with deep admiration; back in Dawn City when Lide first embraced him, his level wasn’t even as high as his.
But in just a few short years, he couldn’t even see Lide’s shadow anymore.
Lide smiled slightly, not dwelling further on this topic, and gestured towards the battlefield below where over three million troops were engaged in mutual slaughter.
"How is the plan progressing?"
Emi, upon hearing this, grew even more excited, speaking with a hint of thrill.
"Your Majesty, the plan is progressing very smoothly. The Dark Sovereign has not suspected our scheme.
Before conquering other abyss planes, I always open the Space Gate at the key locations where demons are most concentrated in the target plane. Then, I lure them into the Land of Bone-Burying for the undead to battle with the demons.
After dealing with most of the demons, the undead construct a Transmission Array on that attacked abyss plane and transport high-level undead to fully occupy that plane.
This past half year, we’ve used this strategy to aid the undead in conquering a total of ten abyss planes, with at least twenty million demons and an equal number of undead perishing in the Land of Bone-Burying."
Lide nodded in satisfaction.
The brilliance of the Abyss Slaughter Plan lies in its ability to aid the Dark Sovereign in conquering other planes, yet still garner a significant share of the profits.
Indeed, whether it was the undead or the demons who died, the Land of Bone-Burying reaped a considerable amount of the Power of Death.
And crucially, the high-level undead and demons battling each other in the Land of Bone-Burying provided much more Power of Death than the previously encountered Fierce Half-Ratmen.
"Good, now that we’ve gained the trust of the Dark Sovereign, we can initiate the second phase of the pig-raising plan."
The plan for the second phase—to use the undead army to target the resource-rich demon-inhabited abyss planes. Once the demons are wiped clean by the undead, secretly close the Space Gate to that plane, and send Dawn’s army alone.
Meanwhile, the unsuspecting undead tools keep attacking the next plane.
With each opening in the Land of Bone-Burying having as many as ten Space Gates, creating battlefields on two planes simultaneously poses no problem.
"Yes, Your Majesty." Emi nodded, about to speak but suddenly held back, hesitating for a moment before saying,
"Perhaps, Your Majesty, you should consider taking command personally, and leave this place to me.
Many significant events have occurred this past half year; Dawn City is currently under tremendous pressure."
Lide’s eyebrows raised, and he spoke in a stern voice.
"Many significant events?"
"Yes," Emi’s expression grew more solemn.
"Recently, the Half-Elves of the Underworld have begun crossing boundaries to provoke us. According to the intelligence we’ve gathered, their god seems to have issued orders to initiate a war for control of the Underworld against us."
"And the situation in Dwarf Valley is even more critical. Just over a hundred kilometers away from Dwarf Valley, a space that seals an Ancient Evil God unexpectedly appeared on the wasteland a few months ago.
Countless Ancient Monsters poured out from that space, much too close to Dwarf Valley, which is now under the attack of millions of these creatures. Even more terrifying, the seal of that Ancient Evil God seems about to break, creating a dire situation."
"On Dwarf Hills, Guido Blackwind led millions of Centaurs to attack Gale City a month ago, attempting to take over the entire Centaur population by conquering Dwarf Hills.
Yet, just when they were about to breach the city, traces of the Centaur God appeared in Gale City.
To aid Guido, we initially dispatched thousands from the Bloodline, with hundreds perishing in this war. It’s highly likely that the Centaur God, having noticed traces of Dawn City through Divine Arts, has now declared us mortal enemies..."
"Meanwhile, in Green City, Dawn Sect’s proselytization has also faced challenges. The high-level nobles collectively resist Dawn Sect, even the city guards suppress it. According to our analysis of gathered information, the hidden mastermind is likely the God of Nobles."
Emi’s barrage of information prompted Lide to fall silent.
A glint of cold light slowly rose in his eyes, sharp as a drawn sword, ready to cut through steel.
"Since war is approaching, let them taste the edge of Dawn."
"Order all troops to prepare for war."
"This time, all territories we’ve marked, will become lands under Dawn’s rule."
"The Underworld, Dwarf Hills, Green City..."
"Let them be flattened."

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 443: The Power of Death Rich to the Extreme, Elevating Subordinates to Legendary
chapters.content:
Chapter 442: Chapter 443: The Power of Death Rich to the Extreme, Elevating Subordinates to Legendary
Emi couldn’t help but feel her blood boil upon hearing Lide’s words.
"Trample them." Just four simple words, yet they spoke of supremacy over all.
Only such a ruler could lead Dawn City to glory.
"Your Majesty, are we to make use of the power of the undead in this war?"
Her gaze fell upon the fierce battlefield below, and her tone held a hint of chill, "These undead, if harnessed well, can certainly..."
Lide shook his head.
"No need, the Dark Sovereign line is very important, holding extraordinary significance for us.
There’s no need to draw upon the power of the undead for such trifles. If we were exposed... the loss would be unacceptable."
The Dark Sovereign was a powerful piece in his game, destined for greater things in the future.
He would avoid using the undead if possible; his "pig-farming" strategy was secure enough to give him peace of mind, but everything else was not so certain.
Upon hearing this, Emi felt it was rather a pity but said nothing more.
"As you command, Your Majesty."
Lide glanced at the battlefield once more but didn’t pay it any additional mind. As long as both sides fought within the Land of Bone-Burying, he would be the ultimate beneficiary.
The Land of Bone-Burying didn’t care whether you were undead or a demon; any death within its bounds contributed to its power.
At this thought, Lide slapped his forehead, almost forgetting something important—preoccupied with talking to Emi, he hadn’t checked how much Power of Death he had accumulated.
In just half a year’s time, even the more elusive Power of Faith had accrued tens of millions, so the Power of Death must not disappoint, surely?
With a gaze filled with anticipation, he opened the attribute panel for the Land of Bone-Burying.
Once he caught sight of the Land of Bone-Burying’s details, his breathing grew more rapid.
This haul was indeed hefty.
Land of Bone-Burying (Undead Plane)
Level: Extraordinary (Next Level Legendary, requires 1 billion Power of Death)
Power of Death: 932 million
Features: Capable of growth, Undead Transformation
Special Troops: Frost Giant Dragon
Special Building: Skeleton Altar (accelerates the transformation of Extraordinary Level undead life)
Abyss Transmission Array (can open a transmission array within the Abyss, free to choose the target plane, with closer planes to the Abyssal depths consuming more Plane Power)
Special Area: Land of Corruption (perfect)
Plane Area: 50 km in diameter
Anchor Coordinates—Dawn City
Introduction: ...
Lide’s gaze swept over the other attributes, his focus only on the 932 million Power of Death.
million...
His heartbeat quickened a bit; if his Divine Calamity was sufficient, he could conjure nine Extraordinary Frost Giant Dragons out of thin air.
Nine dragons drawing a coffin, crossing the stars...
Could this dream be on the cusp of realization?
"No, creating Extraordinary beings is not urgent. First, let’s see the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel; the Master of Dawn’s Seventh War General, which I’ve suppressed for several years now, seems quite promising..."
Lide’s eyes sparkled; nine Frost Giant Dragons were nothing—what if he transformed an angel? Surely, riding atop an angel would be even more incredible.
Work during the day, and throughout the night as well...
His attention shifted to the twelfth-layer White Bone Altar shrouded in black mist.
Inside, a pure white Angel Wing floated gently, still exuding an indescribable sanctity, despite its cracks from several million Power of Death transformations.
Opening the attribute panel.
Twelve-winged Blazing Angel
Status: In transformation, converting to species—Fallen Angel
Transformation Time: 12737 years (consumption of Power of Death can accelerate transformation, 100,000 Power of Death for 1 year)
Introduction: A Twelve-winged Burning Angel ranked seventh under the Master of Dawn; although she has lost much of her strength over the long years, she still possesses unimaginable might.
After a brief calculation, Lide shook his head; it was still somewhat short.
But after investing the nine hundred million, it wouldn’t be far off.
This investment was sure to pay off.
Without further hesitation, he manipulated the Land of Bone-Burying, channeling all the Power of Death he had amassed over half a year directly into the Angel Wing.
Over 900 million units of the Power of Death, what an exaggerated force that was.
The entire space was now slightly trembling, and the dense force in the sky, nearly substantial in nature, seemed to be devoured by a black hole.
Moments later, the twelve-layer White Bone Altar beneath the Angel Wings seemed to have been triggered by the massive energy, as a chilly bone-white light began to intensify and then, the surging Power of Death was completely absorbed by the White Bone Altar.
Just as Lide was surprised, the Original Rules within the twelve-layer White Bone Altar began to slowly activate under the surge of the gargantuan Power of Death.
Although the activation of those miraculous Original Rules consumed a considerable amount of power, the Power of Death, after being enhanced by the Skeleton Altar, invaded the Angel Wings with an even more violent stance.
"Is this a feature of the White Bone Altar? Accelerating the transformation of undead life above the Extraordinary Level?"
Then, under his gaze, the sacred wings began to slowly lose their luster under the onslaught of the massive Power of Death, slowly turning black.
The sacred light began to be dispersed, and coldness and evil took over the exterior of the wings.
And as an even larger torrent of the Power of Death flooded in, the Angel Wings’ resistance began to gradually collapse until at last it slowly dissipated.
The Power of Death on Lide’s attribute panel began to decrease at a rate of millions per second, which was indeed staggering.
Nevertheless, it took over ten minutes for these 900 million units of the Power of Death to be completely expended.
When the Power of Death returned to zero, suddenly the system’s notification sounded.
"Ding~ With the blessing of the White Bone Altar, the Power of Death has gained a certain degree of amplification. The fall of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel is now influenced by the rules and has entered an irreversible state.
The estimated time until complete corruption is 3000 years (Death Power can be used to accelerate the fall)"
Seeing this, Lide could not help but wear a smile from ear to ear.
An irreversible state? This meant that the transformation of the Twelve-winged Burning Angel into a Fallen Angel was now a done deal.
He also needn’t worry about the Master of Dawn suddenly using Divine Arts to summon the other party away after restoring power.
This wasn’t a baseless concern. Divine beings had varying strengths; after the destruction of the Destiny Tablet, the weaker ones might not even defeat an Extraordinary, but there must undoubtedly be powerful divinities— who knew what the other party might be hiding?
He used all of the Power of Death to transform the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel also because of such concerns... Zhuge’s life was one of caution: Better safe than sorry.
Moreover, obtaining a Divine Monster above Level 30 at such a crucial moment would greatly bolster his confidence in facing the current perilous situation.
"Over 3000 years of time... that would be over 300 million units of the Power of Death.
If it had been in the past, such a figure would have been astronomical to me.
But now, as long as the plan to ’borrow a knife to kill’ continues, in two or three months’ time, I will undoubtedly gain a Divinity of extreme power.
This is a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, a War General under the command of the Master of Dawn!"
Lide felt elated. He had coveted the sealed Angel not just for a day or two but finally saw hope.
After a brief moment of contemplation, he turned his gaze to Emi with a deep tone.
View the correct content at
"Emi, in the next three months, continue executing the Abyss pig-rearing plan.
This matter is of extraordinary significance to us; I can only rest assured with you in charge." For this Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, any price was worth paying.
"Majesty, what about the external wars..." Emi’s face showed some hesitation; Dawn City was about to engage in warfare, and his guarding the Land of Bone-Burying at this time seemed a bit excessive...
"There is no need to worry. I will personally lead the army and ensure that nothing can hinder the advance of Dawn.
You can now go to the Mage Tower of Dawn and relay the orders for battle.
Those territories that should have belonged to us long ago—I will take them all back this time."
His tone was calm, yet it was filled with an overbearing and bold confidence, as if those forces backed by divinities were nothing more than insignificant.
Watching the unquestionable Lide, Emi’s eyes lit up with respect, and he felt something indescribable in his heart.
Even if he weren’t Lide’s Bloodline, after witnessing the personal charisma of this ruler, he would probably still willingly sacrifice himself for him.
Some people are just natural leaders.
"Majesty, your command is the direction of Dawn’s advance. I will defend your will with my life!"
His tone was firm and fearless; for the sake of Dawn, he would march on without looking back!
---
---
---
The war below continued, and in the short term, no mishaps would arise.
After Emi disappeared into the Land of Bone-Burying to issue the orders, Lide glanced at the battlefield and then ripped through space, leaving the Bloody Land.
Above Dawn City.
Dressed in a black-and-white woven mage robe, Lide floated in midair, scanning in all directions.
At this moment, the thick clouds obscured the light, making the bustling city seem somewhat dim, with some street corners even turning on Magic Lamps.
Looking up, the rifts in the sky still sprawled like a spiderweb.
The ancient, decaying breath of the olden days never stopped seeping through.
And compared to half a year ago, the concentration of ancient forces in the air now was clearly several levels higher.
Sensing this change, Lide’s gaze overlooked the city district below, where he keenly noticed that the green plants lining the streets had withered, as if frostbitten after autumn’s arrival.
Yet, it was only August, the prime time for plants to thrive.
Lide’s eyes flickered slightly; stepping into the Legendary realm, he could sense something extraordinary about the rift in the sky.
That was the manifestation of the world’s origin, and the appearance of the rift meant there were problems with the world’s source.
If no one were to repair it, then this fissure would continue to widen, possibly reaching the final stage where it became an irreparable scar.
Once it reached that level, the entire Multi-dimensional Plane might be approaching twilight, just a step away from destruction.
As the God of Twilight, Lide had a vague sense of the ultimate direction of those rules in the sky without any external intervention.
Of course, that was just the trajectory without external intervention. With so many mighty beings descending upon the Main Plane, no one wished to sit idly by and await doom.
After a deep look at the crack in the sky, Lide stopped pondering. There was still a long time before the day of world destruction, thinking too much was no use. What was most important now was to expand the territory of Dawn City.
For such a long time, Dawn City should have already conquered those lands he had marked.
With a single step, his figure appeared directly in Harrison’s office.
Just returning from outside, Harrison’s face was very solemn. As soon as he entered the room, he was startled to see Lide, then his face lit up with surprise.
"Your Highness..."
Upon seeing Lide, Harrison’s inner tension instantly relaxed. As the Speaker of the City Hall, the pressure he had been under lately was as heavy as a mountain.
The Half-Elf God of the Underworld, the Ancient Evil God outside Dwarf Valley, the Centaur God of the Dwarf Hills, the God of Nobles within Green City...
While Lide was in seclusion, Dawn City had to face the hostility of four Divine entities, and one could imagine the immense psychological pressure.
If it wasn’t for the numerous Transcendents in Dawn City, the situation would have been more than just great pressure by now, and it’s likely that some forces would have already been crushed.
But the pressure that had been building up inside him over this time now dissipated like smoke, as if just seeing Lide’s figure could give him infinite courage and confidence.
Lide noted the sense of relief in Harrison’s tone and smiled slightly, gesturing towards the door.
"Harrison, have Cap and Withered Bone meet me in the garden behind City Hall."
"Yes, Your Highness," Harrison immediately turned to leave, giving the guards their orders before returning to the room.
Lide looked at his right-hand man with satisfaction, nodding his approval.
Without Harrison, who knew how many tedious political affairs he would have had to deal with.
Although Harrison was not high in Level or combat power, his importance was absolutely top-tier in Dawn City, with almost no one able to replace him.
"Harrison, you’ve worked hard these past days.
Now let me take the helm."
Harrison was very excited, "Your Highness, all will follow your arrangements."
"Good, Emi has told me about the crises facing Dawn City recently.
Those enemies who dare to obstruct the advance of Dawn City will inevitably be trampled into mud and hanged from the railings!
This time I will personally command the war and conquer all the territories that should belong to Dawn."
Hearing this, Harrison’s blood surged. Were the edge and might of Dawn City to be revealed to the world?
Was everything finally about to begin?
His emotions surged with excitement and enthusiasm.
"Your Highness, everyone in Dawn City will follow your footsteps to the death!"
Lide’s gaze gradually became sharper. He had broken through the Legendary threshold, reaching unprecedented heights, and the shackles that once plagued him could no longer hold him back.
Power is the only everlasting constant.
"Issue the orders, all troops prepare for war; the first battle, the edges of Dawn’s forces will flatten the Underworld."
The Underworld, Dwarf Hills, Green City, Dwarf Valley... There were reasons to conquer any one of these forces first.
However, due to the 5.7 million Twilight Sect Believers, the Underworld had risen to first place.
These Believers were key to his journey to Glory and ascent to the summit. If the Half-Elf God were given a chance and the Cave Dwellers suffered massive casualties, that would be a loss he could not accept.
And after capturing the Underworld, enslaving more Cave Dwellers, the number of Believers might even break ten million, taking him to an unprecedented level.
"YES, Your Highness!!"
"How are Dawn City’s supplies faring currently?"
"Ever since the coming of the old days, Dawn City has been producing various war materials at full capacity; our armor already fills the warehouses, all the war materials are in readiness."
"Good! Go down and issue the commands."
After Harrison conveyed Lide’s will, the long-silenced and suppressed Dawn City immediately boiled with activity.
Prepare for war, prepare for war!!
The Highness is back, and any existence daring to provoke the dawn will be trampled into mincemeat.
Dawn, fearless!
King’s Blade Legion, Dawn Wings Legion, Centaur Legion, Beastman Legion, Giant Legion, Twilight Legion... donning armor, sharpening longswords.
Alchemy Bombs loaded, Goblin Bomb Trucks assembled, Dragon Hunting Crossbows ready, and heavily armored warriors clad... Legion after legion of well-equipped troops stepped through the Space Gate in the Land of Bone-Burying into the Underworld.
During the period of war preparations in Dawn City, in the backyard of the City Hall.
Lide looked at the two figures before him with an emotional expression.
To the left was the Level 18 Beastman King—Cap Lion, who had taken tremendous effort to capture this powerful Lion-man Clan Warrior amid a sea of enemies.
After subduing this lion, Cap had always been active on the front lines of Dawn’s external wars.
Throughout years of campaigns, Cap led armies to defend and strike from all sides for Dawn, earning tremendous accolades.
And to the right, with an 18-blade wingspan, inside the white skull, the Soul Fire blazed fiercely...
"My great master, your Glory has already lit up the whole sky, and I rushed over as soon as I heard your command..."
"I guess you must want me to follow you into the Abyss! Praise Death, this is indeed an exhilarating command. Those worms of the Abyss should have trembled under the Dragon Breath of my great Dragon of Destruction..."
"Oh~ I bet it’s my strength and loyalty that have won me such Glory... Cackling, you damned Abyss spawn, are you ready to welcome the arrival of your sovereign?"
"I am Death, the eternal and immortal existence, tremble, cackling..."
Lide looked at the Bone Dragon, who had been babbling nonstop since he came to the garden, and his mouth twitched. It had been more than a year since he had seen this guy, but he was still chatty.
He did harbor some emotions for Withered Bone, who could babble to such an extent it was truly extraordinary.
The reason he had called the two of them was simple.
To promote their Levels.
Yes, he would elevate their Levels.
As Dawn City developed, only Emi, who was granted the Plague Divine Position and became a Subordinate God, had barely managed to keep up with his pace.
These meritorious ministers who had earned honors for Dawn City should also continue to follow in his footsteps, traveling to the bottomless Abyss and the Undead Plane to wage war for him.
Rather than being frustratingly relegated to some insignificant position to be buried and grow old due to a lack of strength.
"Cap, Withered Bone, you have both followed me in battles across directions and established immortal merits for Dawn City. Today, I will bestow upon you the power to break through to Legendary."
Cap shuddered at these words, his eyes filled with disbelief.
"Your Highness, you..."
His voice was hoarse and dry, even having difficulty finishing his sentence as if his throat was choked by fish fins.
Seeing Lide’s serious eyes, the Beastman King, this powerful Lion-man Warrior who had never shed a tear even when stabbed in the chest by a longsword, suddenly had his eyes well up with tears.
As Dawn City grew in strength, although Cap still commanded the army, watching the appearance of those Extraordinary beings by his side, his sense of loss grew increasingly severe.
But for a native to increase his Level was not simple; Talent, opportunity, and effort were all indispensable.
With Cap’s Talent, breaking through to the Extraordinary was already very challenging, so he had prepared himself to be phased out by Lide... to retreat to a secondary role, becoming an unimportant character, to watch as a bystander while Dawn City grew stronger.
Hearing Lide’s words at this moment, the emotional depth in his heart nearly brought him to tears.
His Highness had not abandoned them.
"Legendary? Cackle cackle cackle, it’s wonderful...
My master, your greatness is enough to dim the sun and outshine the stars, praise be to you~"
In contrast to Cap’s excitement, Withered Bone, the Undead with an abnormal mental circuit, seemed far more carefree and began to call out excitedly.
Lide smiled. He still preferred to use these old subordinates, whom he was accustomed to.
Without further ado, he gestured with a wave of his hand.
"Bow your heads."
Hearing the order, Cap immediately stepped forward and knelt on one knee in front of Lide, lowering his proud head in complete submission.
Withered Bone also handed over his head, burning with Soul Fire, his tail whipping back and forth like a steel whip, the sound of it slicing the air quite piercing.
Without hesitation, Lide extended both his hands, pressing on a head with each, then looked at the Divine Arts on his attribute panel.
There were three that could enhance strength—Blood Purification, Faith Enhancement, and Blood Clan Assimilation.
"For Cap, all three Divine Arts should be useful, but I wonder if they would work on Withered Bone, a skeleton?"
But Lide, possessed of tens of millions of Power of Faith, was not afraid. Since it was uncertain, he would simply try each one, such was the plain and unadorned life of a magnate.
"First is Blood Purification."
After settling on his approach, Lide’s eyes narrowed, and his demeanor turned very serious.
The Power of Faith within him surged into the bodies of the two like a tidal wave.
Cap only felt a powerful force emanating from Lide’s palm, like standing at the foot of a mountain during a landslide, feeling so insignificant beneath that energy as though he were an ant.
Powerful vigor flowed, with every passing moment Cap’s Bloodline started to slowly purify and transform, as if some flaw had been filled, leaping toward a higher order of life...
On the other side, the Dark Faith Power merged into Withered Bone’s body, following the white bones to the Soul Fire within his skull.
The blue Soul Fire, like doused with gasoline, ignited and roared fiercely.
"What a pleasant feeling, master..."

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 445: Ascension to Legendary: The Undead Blood Dragon, The Beginning of Conquest
chapters.content:
Chapter 443: Chapter 445: Ascension to Legendary: The Undead Blood Dragon, The Beginning of Conquest
Blood Purification, as the name implies, purifies the bloodline, perfects it, and ultimately enhances the potential of the bloodline.
This Divine Art had an extraordinary effect on Cap Lion, but when applied to Withere Bone, subtle changes occurred.
The structure of Undead Life is very unique—they lack the physical bodies of normal lives, and for this reason, the Divine Art directly affected the soul of Withered Bone.
Lide found this scene quite intriguing.
The ethereal blue Soul Fire surged along with the influx of the Power of Faith, swelling like it had ingested a tonic. Then some rules were supplemented by the Divine Art, and began to slowly transform.
Withered Bone, however, wouldn’t stop chattering even under these circumstances.
"I feel like my soul is taking flight, Master..."
"Something’s burrowing inside..."
"Oh~ praise You, You’re really incredible..."
Lide’s eyelids twitched at the babbling. What was this idiot ranting about? Finally, he could bear it no longer.
"Shut up!!"
After that outburst, Withered Bone shuddered with fright and dared not make another peep, its hollow eyes casting a somewhat aggrieved glance at Lide...as if chastised by its master like a misbehaving dog.
Free of interference, Lide immediately became calm and quiet, keenly experiencing the changes in both individuals after the release of the Divine Art.
The Divine Position of Blood is very neutral. It is neither evil nor good, but a complement to the rules of life.
The Divine Art of Blood Purification is designed to repair the flaws of life, enabling it to reach a more perfect state.
As Withered Bone belonged to Undead Life, its life rules were inherently incomplete, and the ability to revive was far from having the comprehensive rules of normal life.
This was why Undead converted from corpses were generally weaker than normal lives at the same Level—it’s because life rules had changed.
Becoming Undead meant the transition from normal rules to aberrant ones. Although they could still survive in another form, they had already diverged greatly from normal life.
However, after administering the Divine Art to both, Lide unexpectedly found that what he had assumed would be a major effect on Cap Lion and a minor effect on Withered Bone was not the case.
In the end, though Cap Lion, being a normal life, merely had his standard powers supplemented, and the enhancement he received was significant but within acceptable limits.
In contrast, Withered Bone, whose life rules were flawed, experienced an outburst of momentum like a dam releasing the floodwaters after being supplemented, receiving an enhancement far exceeding that of Cap Lion.
Ultimately, Withered Bone even underwent a significant mutation. Its Soul Fire, guided by the Power of Faith, traced like long blue threads, starting to circulate anew through that skeletal body, forming soul pathways akin to blood vessels.
Though unable to regain a flesh and blood body, the completion of the rules resulted in a new set of rules accommodating Undead survival.
The final result was that after Blood Purification, Cap Lion had consumed 500,000 Power of Faith whereas Withered Bone had an exaggerated 1,500,000 expenditure, a full three times that of Cap Lion.
Sensing the transformation in the aura of the two, Lide nodded with satisfaction and without hesitation, began to cast the second Divine Art—Faith Enhancement.
As one of the core Divine Arts, the effect of Faith Enhancement was unquestionable, and this time, he spared no expense in elevating both of them to Legendary.
Such was the arrogance afforded by ample Power of Faith.
The external war of Dawn Sect was about to commence, and the stronger the forces in his hands, the more leverage he held.
After all, he could not manage all the territories alone; most of the time, he would need his subordinates to resolve conflicts and fights.
Tens of millions of Dark Faith Power gave Lide solid confidence, his hands now like the mighty river in the rainy season—robust, broad, and majestic.
Rushing toward the two individuals.
The soldiers guarding around the City Hall and even the residents walking on the streets felt the ferocity of that power at this moment, and all turned their heads toward the garden behind City Hall.
Although the scene inside was obscured by high walls and greenery, an inexplicable dread arose in everyone’s heart.
As if inside, a giant dragon that could rip apart heavens and earth was rearing its head and roaring, its mighty presence like a collapsing mountain, involuntarily making one aware of their own insignificance.
Ten minutes, twenty minutes...it wasn’t until after three Sunshine Hours had passed that Lide finally withdrew his hands from the two.
At that moment, only 200,000 of the Dark Faith Power remained on his attribute panel—down from over twelve million.
The Faith Power of the Dawn Sect also dropped from over three million to five hundred thousand.
The total was close to 15 million, one could say that this time Lide had truly invested heavily.
This earth-shattering power sent both Cap and Withered Bones into a deep slumber.
Cap sat cross-legged on the grass, his body surrounded by a golden power, the pure Golden Power enveloped him like a thick cocoon.
And the moment he broke free from the cocoon would mark the birth of a legend.
On the other side, Withered Bones was even more exaggerated.
At this moment, the chatty skeleton’s body, with blood vessels constructed by the Soul Fire, had turned a blood-red color, as if real blood vessels had been reformed.
It was also suffused with the Power of Crimson, identical to the power emanating from Lide.
Even the Soul Fire within Withered Bone’s skull took on a faint crimson hue; against the stark white bones, the dragon now appeared to be ignited by demonic flames.
Upon seeing this, anticipation flashed across Lide’s face.
According to his plan, the three Divine Arts were to be released one after the other: Blood Purification, Faith Enhancement, Bloodline Assimilation...
But when he used the Bloodline Assimilation Divine Art at the end, he discovered that Cap, who should have been most suitable for the assimilation, could forge his own path after the purification of his bloodline.
In comparison, becoming a Bloodline creature might even impede the near-perfect bloodline he possessed, so at the last moment, he decisively chose not to cast it on Cap.
On the other hand, Withered Bones was different; the special composition of an Undead life gave Lide a lot of room to maneuver.
The Bloodline Assimilation Divine Art was extremely domineering, a change at the level of rules, and it spared no Undead... In the end, it directly assimilated Withered Bones into the Bloodline.
What kind of life would result from an Undead being transformed into a Bloodline creature? A Blood Undead Dragon? An Undead Blood Dragon? A Dragon Blood Undead?
He was actually quite eager to find out.
Two beings, transitioning towards a higher plane of existence, had now fallen into the deepest slumber.
Lide’s spirit spread out, observing their metamorphosis through the Power of Faith.
Correct content is on .
He was also internally confirming his own understanding of Divine Position and Divine Arts.
This period of slumber wasn’t short, and it wasn’t until the next morning that the two showed signs of stirring.
The first to awaken was Cap; the Beastman King who sat cross-legged on the ground suddenly opened his eyes, and the Golden Power surged forth from his body, like an ancient behemoth descending upon the world, his golden eyes shimmering with a chilling ferocity.
He stood up abruptly, towering proudly.
The mane of this Beastman King had completely transformed into a pure golden color, and his body had grown taller, reaching three blades in height.
His strong muscles caused his clothing to tear apart, and it seemed like they were made of bronze pouring through the gaps, exposed to the air.
His eyes shimmered with compelling golden light.
His powerful aura made the surrounding air as dense as melting steel, making it hard to breathe.
At that moment, the system’s notification arrived as expected.
"Ding~ Your subordinate, Cap Lion, has been elevated to Legendary Level 25, earning the title of King of Lion; King of the Lion-man Clan, increasing his intimidating effect on the Beastman to devotion, Legend Level increased by 30, and significantly attracting Beastman below Legendary to pledge allegiance."
Just as Lide’s eyes shone with pleasant surprise, Withered Bones on the side suddenly spread its wings; the entire Bone Dragon shot up in size like a sprouting bamboo shoot.
Its wingspan grew from 18 blades to a massive 24 blades, making it a colossal creature.
Even more astonishing was that within the fire burning in Withered Bone’s skull, strands of the Power of Crimson intermingled like blood, and in his originally white skeletal body, the Power of Crimson had reconstituted blood vessels with pure energy.
Under the aura of blood-colored power, the Bone Dragon appeared both majestic and enigmatic.
A Bone Dragon like none before was born.
"Ding~ Your subordinate, Withered Bones Destructive Dragon, has successfully advanced to Legendary, now at Legendary Level 26, and has transformed into an Undead Blood Dragon, inheriting all Bloodline traits, and receiving a new title—King of the Blood Dragon.
King of the Blood Dragon, the first Blood Dragon ever born in the world, the perfect fusion of Bloodline and Undead Bone Dragon, possessing not only the extraordinary traits of the Undead and Dragon, but also the formidable Talent of the Bloodline, Legend Level increased by 50.
Furthermore, since the Undead Blood Dragon was granted life by the Lord of the Dawn Divine, tinged with the essence of a god, it automatically becomes subordinate in the Dawn Divine, activating the Divine Position—Dragon (0.01%), Undead (0.01%), Vampire (1%)."
After hearing the system prompt, a flash of surprise appeared in Lide’s eyes.
This talkative creature had actually gained such great benefits, the first Undead Blood Dragon born in the world???
Had he actually created a new race?
And what’s more exaggerated was that this fellow had even become his Subordinate God, activating three Divine Positions all at once... Although the control level of each was very low, these were still Divine Positions.
Having them, even if he were unable to condense a Divine Status and become a True God, he would not be subject to the Level 30 limit any longer and could continue to raise his level.
Within Glory, Level 30 was a tremendous threshold.
For ordinary life forms, Level 30 was the peak, the maximum level, fully leveled.
To break this shackle, one had to grasp a portion of the power of the gods to continue ascending.
Just like the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, although not a Divine being, they could surpass the Level 30 cap because they possessed Divine Calamity.
This was one of the Original Rules of Glory, unchangeable.
Hence, those who reached Legendary status would surely seek Divine Enthronement.
Otherwise, they would have to find a way to acquire some Divine traits; otherwise, their level would be stuck forever at the Demigod phase of Level 30.
But was Divine Enthronement that easy?
Before the days of old had come, how exalted were the Divine beings?
To peek into such power was as difficult as ascending to heaven.
And seeking the lesser goal of acquiring some Divine traits, which seemed not too high of a request, was suffocatingly difficult for main-plane beings.
That’s why when the Olden Days descended, and the power of the Divine weakened to a nadir, such that even mortals could slay gods, those ambitious ones and powerhouses were so fervent.
For the opportunity they had waited for countless years had finally arrived.
In face of their inward desire and the instinct of life to pursue higher powers, the Dignity the Divine had established in the old days seemed so pale and powerless.
"My master... I feel a tremendous power coursing within me; I have broken through to become Legendary!!"
"Praise be to you, my lord, for your might is enough to dim the shine of the sun..."
"Cackle cackle cackle... Beastman brat? Want to taste the breath of the great Dragon of Destruction?..."
Lide watched Kapp, whose expression turned sour in an instant, and his face filled with black lines; this idiot, even if he became a god, was still the same old chatterbox, a habit that was incurable.
But being talkative had its benefits... If they faced an enemy and needed a meat shield, just throwing him over would definitely attract all the firepower... It would be simply delightful for covering the retreat.
Ignoring the Withered Bones who was arrogantly boasting there, Lide turned his head to look at Kapp.
"Kapp, how do you feel?"
Kapp took a deep breath, stepped forward, and knelt on one knee, his eyes brimming with excitement and an indescribable mania.
"My liege, I have reached the heights of the most Talented of the royal family among the Lion-man Clan... But this is not the end; the Bloodline within my body has become nearly perfect. Given time, I will surely step into the realm of the Demigod."
Moving from originally finding it exceedingly difficult to break through to Transcendent to now having the confidence to reach the Demigod level of 30, the change was no small feat.
Lide nodded in satisfaction. Cultivating two Legendaries with promising futures cost him fifteen million Power of Faith well spent.
One broke through to Level 25 and became Legendary, with fully unleashed potential and a promising future.
Another reached Level 26, not only becoming the world’s first Undead Blood Dragon but also his Subordinate God, activating a Divine Position and possessing limitless possibilities.
Adding him to the mix, Dawn City would then have three Legends to stand guard.
Three Legends under one banner, before the Olden Days descended, a mighty empire would have no more than that.
But how extensive were the territories an empire ruled? And how many lives did they govern?
Therefore, Dawn City needed to expand its territory.
Whether it was the power in his hands, or the ambition pulsing in his heart, the lands now under Dawn’s rule could no longer satisfy him.
His gaze settled on the attribute panels of the two, examining them briefly.
After reaching Legendary, all of Kapp’s Skill attributes had improved qualitatively, one of which even derived a powerful passive skill comparable to the Power of Crimson.
Golden Power: Attacks carry properties of armor penetration, corrosion, scorching, and bleeding, and once the Golden Power invades the body, it will tear the opponent’s flesh apart, dealing true damage that cannot be exempted.
This Skill, akin to the Power of Crimson, was a work of similarity in principle; of course, the effect when wielded by Cap Lion paled compared to Lide, but there’s no denying that the Beastman King Kapp was now truly worthy of his title as the Beastman King.
A Level 25 Legendary, previously within the Beastman Empire, was also a top three entity.
Compared to Kapp, Withered Bone’s skills were even more splendid.
Not only were all his skills elevated to Legendary Level, but he also acquired the Power of Crimson, Lide’s most favored passive skill, and was even granted an extremely powerful Talent—Undead Blood Dragon.
Undead Blood Dragon: 1) Able to absorb fresh blood and Death Energy to heal bodily injuries, and as long as the Soul Fire isn’t completely extinguished, even if the body is destroyed, it can fully recover to its peak.
2) Can leave a soul mark within a blood pool, which allows resurrection in the blood pool if slain, with a cooldown of three months.
3) Can consume the soul energy within the body to transform dragon race life into Undead Blood Dragons; the transformed Undead Blood Dragons will be completely submissive and under absolute control.
Blood sucking for restoration, rebirth, developing Bloodline—these three points of the skill were simply remarkable; Withered Bone had inherited the strongest traits of the Bloodline.
Lide’s face beamed with a smile, double happiness with twofold gain, he was thoroughly elated.
The Power of Faith expended compared to two powerful Legendaries was no longer unacceptable.
After a brief contemplation, he directly gave the order,
"Kapp, proceed to Dwarf Valley at once to confirm whether the seal of the Ancient Evil God will break. If it will burst open in a short time, lead the Lion-man Army to defend Dwarf Valley.
If it won’t break shortly, return to Dawn City and join the main army in the assault on the Underworld."
"Widhered Bone, follow me to the Underworld and prepare the troops for an immediate attack on the Half-Elf God. That territory, which should have belonged to Dawn City long ago, now it’s time to take it back."
The most likely areas to face danger, which also caused Lide the most concern, were the Underworld and Dwarf Valley.
On one hand was the Half-Elf God, who could threaten millions of Twilight Sect Believers at any moment, and on the other was the Ancient Evil God, who could awaken and break the seal at any time.
As for the Centaur God in the Dwarf Hills and the God of Nobles within Green City, although their danger wasn’t negligible, it wasn’t fatal yet.
"As you command, Your Excellency!"
Kapp’s voice was full of vitality, as his inner strength was his greatest confidence.
The Golden Power began to burn within this Lion-man, combined with the majestic mane atop his head, he stood as a Golden War God revived from ancient times.
"Ga ga ga–Master, I can hardly wait, those filthy Half-Elves should have been turned to ash under my Dragon Breath long ago!"
"Of course, as well as that damned Half-Elf God, ’god-slaying’ is such a delightful term..."
Withered Bone let out another sharp, eerie laugh, together with his skeletal body shrouded in the Power of Crimson, he resembled a horrifying beast that had just crawled out from the bloody plasma of Hell.
At this very moment, within the bustling Magic Industry Research Institute of Dawn City, atop the highest building in the central area, a graceful figure was gazing out at Dawn City in the distance, thinking of the soldiers busy preparing for war.
"This is the choice of destiny, the prologue of a new epic, and an unprecedented great cataclysm.
The decayed forces of yesteryear have returned to this world, overseers once sealed by the Creator God now looking down on the Multi-dimensional Plane once more, where shall Glory go?"
"This city, teeming with infinite Life Force, which I have never seen before, can it truly carry my hopes?"
The half-Mermaid Cassalina, draped in a white veil, peered through the open window at the assembly of soldiers in the far-off Dawn City.
Her exquisite face was nearly perfect, with deep blue eyes like the starry sky.
Her hair floated gently behind her head as if soaked in water, exuding an indescribable charm.
"If you are truly Dawn, then I hope you can lead this city towards a real dawn... Kachar City Lord."
The ancient language whispered under her breath was not any known speech, cryptic and difficult to comprehend.
This mysterious being, who had once guarded the Destiny Tablet, showed complex emotions an outsider could not understand as she gazed into the distance.
"Fate has taken everything from me, but I’ve never believed that fate can dictate everything..."
"If you can show me hope, I am willing to become the sword in your hands, to cut through the decay of the old days...
As much as, to sever the ties of fate..."

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 446: The Five Armies Gather, Using the Dark Sovereign’s Blade to Slaughter the Half-Elves (10,000-Character Mega - )
chapters.content:
Chapter 444: Chapter 446: The Five Armies Gather, Using the Dark Sovereign’s Blade to Slaughter the Half-Elves (10,000-Character Mega Chapter)
"Hurry up, His Majesty is watching you, don’t think about slacking off!!"
"Prepare for the campaign immediately, have all your weapons ready..."
"Under His Majesty’s glory, Dawn City shall become the ruler of the Underworld..."
"For Dawn!"
August 13, Twilight City.
The assembled Dawn Army had all gathered in this city that originally belonged to the Half-Elves.
Lide stood atop the city walls, his gaze profoundly sweeping the distance.
From below, the legion could see that towering figure; even without any movement, the army’s power surged.
He was their savior, their sovereign whom they loyally served, and the one who would lead Dawn City to brilliance.
After the army had fully assembled, Lide began to ponder.
Currently, the army within Twilight City was mainly composed of five forces.
First, the Beastman Army, numbering 50,000.
If including the 150,000 army still stationed in Dwarf Valley, the number of Beastmen in Dawn City exceeded the humans that he had always supported by a great margin.
The reason for such a number was that Dwarf Valley was originally close to the barren wasteland, and the reputation of the Lion Tribe in the vicinity was quite good, which is why the number of Beastmen had grown very rapidly before the Ancient Times fell upon them.
Second, the Centaur Army, 100,000.
The Centaur Army was primarily from the Iron Hoof Tribe of the low hills, which, after several expansions, had likewise grown to over 200,000.
At this moment, this army that Lide had conquered very early on had all relocated to Dwarf Valley, guarding the Secret Silver Vein together with the Lion Tribe.
Because the city was too small, when the Iron Hoof Tribe came to Dwarf Valley, 100,000 were immediately reallocated to form the Centaur Army, while the remaining 100,000 joined the Beastmen to confront the Ancient Monsters.
Of course, now on the low hill ridges, the Gale Empire under Guido had already risen, and he could completely acquire millions of Centaur Warriors once he dealt with the Centaur God.
Third, the Demon Army, now within Twilight City, brought together a whopping 200,000 demons—yes, a full 200,000.
The Abyss Pig Farming plan had turned the Dark Sovereign into Lide’s blade, and after establishing cooperation with the Gravel Plane, the Undead had withdrawn from this plane.
Thus, Lide had now incorporated the entire Gravel Plane into the territorial map of Dawn City.
With no more dangers, hundreds of thousands of demonic troops were naturally no longer needed to be maintained all the time; summoning 200,000 to the Main Plane was not an issue at this moment.
After reorganization by the military officers of Dawn City, they could now basically command the demons; at least internal conflicts during battles were avoided. However, to achieve as refined control as the Main Plane’s army still had a way to go.
Fourth, King’s Blade, totaling 30,000.
This force, nurtured by Dawn City, was composed of several small legions—the Air Force had Magic Language Knights, Bomb-carrying Magic Bat, and the ground forces included the Giant Army, Holy Light Bloodline, Caster Corps...
Although the King’s Blade did not boast in numbers, their strength was not to be underestimated, particularly after the last Dawn Festival, when the Bloodline had once again expanded.
Currently, the total number of Bloodline exceeded 5,500, and there were four Thousand-man Squads of Blood Mages.
4,000 Upper Race Spellcasters, its strength could be imagined.
Fifth, the Twilight Legion, numbering up to 250,000.
This legion was established during his previous conquest of Twilight City that had spread the faith of the Twilight Sect and usually stationed in the city to gather underground lives as believers.
The Underworld had a substantial number of lives, so their composition was also very complex, including Lizardmen, Kobolds, Harpies, Naga... and about twenty other races.
However, due to being overly mixed and the combat strength being uneven, it ranked last among the five major legions.
After making some calculations, a flash of awe crossed Lide’s eyes—the total military strength of these five forces had already exceeded 500,000.
It was indeed a staggering figure.
500,000—that was a real army.
