The highest building top floor of the Magic Industry Research Institute Center.
This floor, offering a wide view and breathtaking scenery, was originally intended as a meeting place for research discussions, but now it has become a private domain.
And its owner is none other than that most terrifying being—Casilina Abets Storm.
Lide’s gaze rested on the half-mermaid standing by the window, who at this moment was gazing at Dawn City, which was as bright as day with its lights all lit up.
View the correct content at .
Her hair floated gently behind her head as if underwater, her sea-blue eyes calm and waveless, and the holy aura about her, like a devout believer praying in a church, was amplified countless times by the sheer white gauze she wore.
"Good night, Lady Casilina."
"I sense some anxiety in your heart, Kachar City Lord, what brings you to seek me out?" the half-mermaid asked, turning calmly to look at him, her voice as flat as ever, as if all things in this world were unrelated to her.
Paired with that cool demeanor, the mysterious figure standing by the window seemed even more detached from worldly affairs.
Lide originally had many questions he wanted to ask her, but upon seeing Casilina’s clear and transparent eyes, filled with an indescribable sanctity, he immediately felt a clarity wash over him, and those questions mysteriously vanished.
Could this mermaid possibly possess some aura of tranquility?...
Lide nodded slightly, speaking slowly.
"Lady Casilina, have you sensed the appearance of new Destiny Stone fragments lately?"
Ever since the Destiny Tablet shattered, all the fragments were enshrouded by the Power of Destiny, and only when that power dispersed could outsiders sense them.
This mermaid who guarded the Destiny Stone, although she sensed the fragments in ways Lide didn’t understand, she too could not overcome the obstruction of the Power of Destiny and had to wait...
He had not held out much hope, but to his surprise, Casilina nodded her head.
"Yes."
"Oh?" Lide’s eyes lit up, "Could you tell me where?"
"It’s already been taken by the Sun Goddess..."
I...
Lide’s mouth twitched, this information was as good as none at all.
The Sun Goddess? Within the entire Light God System, that was definitely a top-five terrifying presence.
Even if she descended upon the Main Plane, she would undoubtedly be incredibly powerful, and if the fragment ended up in her hands, all Lide could do was to hear about it.
Immediately, as if struck by a thought, he mused.
"No wonder the Sun Goddess spread the news about the Destiny Stone fragments. It turns out she already had one herself."
Casilina looked at Lide with her usual calm composure without making any comment.
The Destiny Stone, crushed by the wheels of time, no one knows how many pieces it broke into, nor which space they fell into, and it’s unsurprising for anyone to have gotten them.
Lide kept his eyes fixed on her and continued.
"Lady Casilina, I have observed that the cracks in the sky are gradually widening over time, and those Ancient Evil Gods with formidable powers will truly descend in the near future.
The disaster, I fear, has not even started yet..."
"Kachar City Lord," Casilina shook her head, her expression unchanging, seemingly unsurprised by this.
"No one can stop the coming of the Ancient Dominators, not in the Main Plane, nor in the Abyss or the Undead Plane.
That Ancient Dominator of old, his purpose is to destroy the entire Multi-dimensional Plane.
No one will survive.
The current disaster is indeed far from beginning. It is only when the Ancient arrives that it will be the day of destruction for all things..."
Lide’s heart chilled upon hearing these words.
As he had suspected.
The descent of the gods onto the mortal realm is not the end. The Ancient Dominator who engineered all this, how could he so easily relinquish it all.
The current inhabitants, seemingly terrifying, were probably just an appetizer.
Not even the Ancient Evil Gods have appeared yet; the apocalyptic catastrophe capable of destroying the Multi-dimensional Plane hasn’t truly begun.
But his heart was still troubled by a few questions.
"All the gods have descended to the mortal realm, so why haven’t the evil gods of the Abyss and Undead Plane lost their power like the other gods?"
He personally witnessed the terror of the Dark Sovereign, the gods have lost their powers, yet the deities born from these two evil places are fine, isn’t that strange?
Why do you get to be the exception? Isn’t that a slight to the gods of the Main Plane?
"The evil gods born from the Bottomless Abyss and Undead Plane are not bound to the Destiny Tablet..."
Casilina shook her head.
"Their fates are bound to their respective planes; as long as the abyss is not destroyed, their power will exist eternally, as with the undead," Frey remarked.
Lide gasped in astonishment.
"Why are these evil divine beings so different from the gods of the Main Plane?"
He had an elusive feeling that he might be delving into the deepest secrets of this world.
On hearing his question, Casilina gave him a meaningful glance with her deep ocean blue eyes.
"This is not a mystery you can explore now. Ask me again when you are about to ascend to divinity."
Hearing the firm tone in Casilina’s voice, Lide shrugged his shoulders, feeling a bit disappointed but refrained from asking further.
This mysterious guardian of the Destiny Tablet must know some secrets, but he could not force the answers if she was unwilling to speak; who knew to what extent her power had recovered.
But surely, she couldn’t be far from the level of the Sun Goddess.
After a moment’s contemplation, Lide changed the subject to the main reason for his visit.
"Lady Casilina, I am about to explore the Dwarf Valley to investigate the seal of an Ancient Evil God.
Perhaps we could capture one to study. Would you be interested in joining me?"
At Lide’s words, Casilina’s eyelids twitched.
"You aim to capture an Ancient Evil God... just for research???"
Her usually calm tone carried an unusual hint of incredulity, suggesting that she found the idea preposterous.
Lide nodded as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
"That’s right, to know your enemy...
Our knowledge of Ancient Evil Gods comes only from the cracks in the sky and their ancient minions. We haven’t truly understood these gods, and this could lead to misjudgment.
I think capturing one for study might reveal something different."
Casilina fell silent for a time before finally looking at him with a tinge of emotion.
"Perhaps, that’s what makes this city different from the others."
Though the remark was somewhat cryptic, Lide understood the subtext... you are quite unusual.
To this Lide was indifferent.
After all, he was not a native of Glory World, having been shaped by the internet from a young age; his thinking could not possibly align with these beings.
After reflecting for a moment, he continued.
"If Ancient Evil Gods are so terrifying, shouldn’t we strive to understand them thoroughly?"
"Ignorance breeds fearlessness... but perhaps, you are correct,"
Casilina’s detached gaze rippled once more.
After a brief silence, she waved her hand, and a blue stone the size of a thumb appeared out of thin air.
"If you cannot suppress the Ancient Evil God after breaking the seal, try using this stone.
Just place it on the body of an Ancient Evil God, and it will nullify their power."
Surprised by her words, Lide quickly reached out to receive it. Was it really that amazing?
He hurriedly opened his attribute panel.
Tears of Purification
Quality: Special
Skill: Dispel (Able to dispel all negative energies, especially effective against Ancient and Chaotic energies)
Description: This equipment is forged from the only tear shed in the life of a powerful deity and possesses incredible energy.
Not bad, the attributes were simple, but it was clear that the equipment was specifically forged against Ancient powers.
But what was this about being forged from tears?
Such a large stone from tears... could it be from the eye of a One-eyed Giant?
After quietly ridiculing the idea, Lide swiftly tucked away the equipment and looked back at Casilina, his eyes filled with greater satisfaction.
He had known that the mermaid was a treasure; it seemed future excavations were in order, as he hadn’t realized she hid such precious things.
"Thank you for your generosity, Lady Casilina...
The people of Dawn City will remember your grandeur and selflessness. Should we make progress this time, I will inscribe your merit on the Monument to Dawn Heroes for posterity to admire for a thousand generations."
Lide spoke with earnest formality, heaping praise upon her in a grandiose fashion.
Good grief, he might not offer much in terms of benefits, but he could offer reputation, which might fit the tastes of such a deity better than ordinary profits.
The mermaid glanced at him, her demeanor returning to its usual cool indifference, showing no reaction to his words.
Lide smiled faintly and continued,
"Lady Kaslina, after the Ancient Evil God’s arrival, Dawn City might face dangers.
We still lack top-tier combat power to suppress the situation. If I am out and the city encounters any trouble that the army cannot resolve, I hope that, for my sake, you could lend a hand and help out."
His visit this time was firstly to see if he could coax... err... invite Kaslina to join him in exploring the Ancient Evil God’s seal,
and secondly, to find a patron for Dawn City. Although he couldn’t command Kaslina, having an existence of her caliber stationed at his home base gave him greater peace of mind. At the very least, he didn’t have to worry about someone sneaking in and stealing his homeland.
Kaslina nodded with an expressionless face,
"Kachar City Lord, I am already a member of Dawn City; it’s my responsibility to do so."
Lide smirked; that was a yes.
Although he couldn’t determine the mermaid’s level, from every aspect, she was undoubtedly a powerful ally.
Is the Destiny Tablet something anyone is qualified to guard? It bears the fate of all the gods and the entire Glory.
Although she ultimately failed to protect it... the one who came to steal the Destiny Tablet fought against the Creator God, the Ancient Dominator...
It’s not that our forces were incompetent, but that the enemy was too cunning. It’s normal to be unable to defend it—if she had, wouldn’t she be another Creator God?
Afterwards, Lide chatted a bit more with Kaslina, but she didn’t reveal any more useful information, so he could only take his leave.
Once Lide’s figure disappeared from the room, the originally cool aura of Kaslina subtly softened.
She turned and looked through the window again at the shattered sky, her sea-blue eyes deep as if they contained swirling galaxies and collapsing suns and moons.
A rare complexity of emotions appeared on her frosty face.
"The arrival of Ancient times... this calamity that affects the entire world.
Is it good or bad for me??"
Her whisper carried a meaning no one could fathom.
The next day, under Lide’s orders, Forging Master Valen, second-generation Bloodline Frey, and Dark Contract Vice President Stanley, three key figures were summoned to Lide’s office.
Upon seeing the trio, Lide was quite sentimental; these were his old subordinates, who had witnessed the growth of Dawn City with him.
In front of their utterly shocked gazes, he directly took out three Divine Bodies, without hesitation, using the Power of Faith combined with the Divine Bodies to bestow upon them the power to break through to Legendary status.
The procedure was to first use the Power of Faith to strengthen their bloodlines and levels, and then give them suitable Divine Bodies for them to consume the contained Divine Status.
From the meeting to the conclusion, it took just over half an hour for these three important figures of Dawn City to be arranged by Lide to break through to Legendary status in the depths of the Land of Bone-Burying.
Although the war between the Undead on the surface of the Land of Bone-Burying and the Abyss Demons was still ongoing and the Abyss livestock farming plan had never stopped, the deeper underground would not be disturbed.
It might not take too long for the three to break through to Legendary status alone, but including consuming the Divine Status, that was uncertain.
But barring any unexpected events, in three to five months, Dawn City would welcome three new Legendaries, and the Dawn Divine System would add three more Subordinate Gods.
Although Lide was not very clear on the function of having more Subordinate Gods in the Dawn Divine System, he vaguely felt that the more, the better.
After arranging for the three, Lide glanced at the attribute panel of the Land of Bone-Burying, not forgetting that he was still over three hundred million Power of Death away from corrupting the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
What annoyed him, however, was that after two months, he had gathered just over two hundred million Power of Death and was still short by seventy to eighty million.
He immediately ordered Emi, who had been carrying out the pig-killing plan, to step up efforts and ensure that the Power of Death was accumulated within half a month.
He was already impatient to see the birth of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel; then, could he be unstoppable, as the gods and Buddha themselves...
The thought of riding an angel improved his mood, regardless of how he would ride it; just being able to do so was good enough.
After instructing Emi, Lide tore through space, appearing from the Land of Bone-Burying back in his office.
Upon seeing his figure, the waiting Harrison immediately excitedly said,
"Your Excellency, have they been well arranged?"
"All is well; we just need to wait for them to emerge. In a few months, we will have three more Legendaries."
Harrison’s eyes nearly popped out; there could be no better news than this. Of course, Lide hadn’t told him that in perhaps half a month, Dawn City might welcome a being with Divine Status.
The war general under the Master of Dawn didn’t even need to know the opponent’s level; the prefix alone was incredible.
But Harrison didn’t think that far; Legendaries were once lofty beings for him, and even Transcendents were powerful enough to destroy the Bloodline. Now that Dawn City had such a strong force, he naturally felt extremely excited.
It took a long time for him to calm his mind, and then he remembered another matter.
"Your Excellency, do we need to send a large army for this exploration of the Ancient Seal Site?"
Having dealt with the issue of the three breaking through to Legendary status, Lide was now set to explore the sealed site of the Ancient Evil God.
The seal was too close to Dwarf Valley, like a ticking time bomb that could detonate at any moment. If not cleared first, he could not be at ease.
"This time for the expedition, taking Lord withered bones and Kapu with me is enough, too many people would instead affect our actions."
Lide was not planning to bring a large army this time, the Ancient Evil God was too mysterious, and if they encountered an unstoppable enemy, it might not be possible to protect the troops below.
While conquering a force required a large army, for a point-to-point targeting of a specific goal, bringing an army might become shackles—he would worry about casualties and be restrained, unable to make aggressive moves.
Plus, he now held two powerful trump cards in his hands—Dark Sovereign and Tears of Purification given by Lady Casilina.
If things really went south, he could simply draw the blade that was Dark Sovereign, and he believed that even if the Ancient Evil God was unsealed, it might not be able to best the Dark Sovereign.
The Dark Sovereign was after all the fifteenth ruler of the Undead Plane, how powerful was that?
Even if the Ancient Evil God was strong before, it had been sealed for such a long time, how much power could it possibly have left?
Hearing this, Harrison did not say more, having nothing but sincere admiration and worship for Lide’s wisdom. Since the other party had made a decision, all he needed to do was to offer his full support.
Lide thought for a moment and realized he had almost missed something.
"We need to step up reconnaissance in the Lost Sea, especially on that Sea Beast known as Sea God. The Destiny Stone Fragment is critical to the future of Dawn City."
Saying this, his expression became a few degrees more solemn.
"The power of the ancient forces in the Main Plane is becoming richer, and it may not be long before those Ancient Evil Gods who have not yet revealed their true forms will truly descend upon the Main Plane...
The time of apocalypse is just before us."
The Sea Beast in the Lost Sea, a Demigod-level creature, had obtained a fragment of the Destiny Tablet, which was information revealed by Casilina when she revealed her true identity to Lide.
This piece of the Destiny Stone Fragment was the one he was most confident in obtaining. Demigods were strong, but with time, he could single-handedly vanquish them.
Even if he spared no expense, leveraging the Dark Sovereign’s power could also slaughter that Sea Beast.
Of course, he would absolutely not operate like this unless it was absolutely necessary.
What level of treasure was the Destiny Stone Fragment? If the Dark Sovereign discovered it and decided to covetously claim it for himself, he could only cry up to the heavens.
After all, the two of them were just ordinary collaborators, and the other party seemed harmless because on the surface, Lide was seen as an existence equal to that of the Dawn Main God. If there were bigger interests involved, why wouldn’t the other party turn? It would be odd if they didn’t...
More importantly, the Twelve-winged Burning Angel was about to emerge.
That was his biggest backup. Once this ultimate weapon surfaced, what were Demigods? Even facing a True God, he would not panic in the slightest.
"At present, the intelligence command center has deployed our most elite personnel into the Lost Sea, and all news about the Sea Beast is within the scope of our investigation," Harrison said, confidence visible on his face.
"Moreover, through the bridge built by the Blue Star Tribe, we have formed a Lost Alliance with seven other Fishman Tribes. The alliance shares resources and exchanges information. Those Fishman Tribes received quite a few resources from us, and our people also took this opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of the Lost Sea.
Although the Sea Beast known as Sea God is extremely mysterious, we have already unearthed quite a bit of information.
Perhaps, after resolving a few surrounding dangers, the full details of that Sea Beast will come to light before you."
Lide nodded in satisfaction upon hearing this. He always trusted Harrison with his tasks, for though his strength was not great, he was his right-hand man.
A Lost Alliance? Forming an alliance with the Fishman Tribes was quite interesting.
"The sea has a broader ecosystem than land, and even stronger lifeforms within it.
Since an alliance has already been formed, take more care to nurture it well. It may be of great help to us later on."
"Yes, Your Excellency."
After giving his instructions, Lide confirmed that Harrison had no issues and did not stay any longer, proceeding directly to the back garden to call forth Kapu and Lord withered bones via the Land of Bone-Burying to prepare for departure.
The two Legendary beings stood in the back garden like towering mountains, exuding extraordinary presence, sparking a wave of envy among the surrounding guards.
This was Legendary... Who in Dawn City didn’t know that their breaking into Legendary was granted by Lide? Many were so envious their eyes turned red.
Upon seeing Lide come to the back garden, the two hastily paid their respects.
"Good day, Your Excellency."
"My lord, your Subordinate God—the Dragon of Destruction, the Tusk of Dawn City, the great Undead, the invincible Lord withered bones, greets you!"
Lide looked at Lord withered bones, who awkwardly supported his chest with his shattered Dragon Wings for the salutation, and his lips twitched. There was no need for so many titles...
Not bothering with niceties, he directly soared into the sky, mounting Lord withered bones’ back, then waved his hand and the space before him shattered.
"To Dwarf Valley, our mission is to explore the otherworldly space sealed with the Ancient Evil God."
Hearing this, the Soul Fire in Lord withered bones’ eyes blazed intensely as he cackled shrilly.
"Those Ancient Monsters that are even more disgusting than Abyss Worms should have been destroyed by the great Lord withered bones long ago..."
Lide slapped the back of Lord withered bones’ skull, causing the giant’s fractured Dragon Wings to flap vigorously, stirring up a storm in the back garden before vanishing into the space rift.
Kapu also ignited his Golden Power, rising into the sky like a War God, following closely behind.

chapters.content:
Chapter 451: Chapter 453: The Sealed Mysterious Sarcophagus (9800 words)
PS: Sorry, I had a writer’s block today, and only managed to grind this out after much struggle...
---
---
---
Dwarf Valley.
The original Dwarf City now had a massive pit carved into it, within which lay the Secret Silver Vein that drove countless people to frenzy, buried deep beneath the site of the former Dwarf City.
Although miners were still digging the vein, the oppressive atmosphere in the air couldn’t help but turn expressions grave.
The valley, where metal should be clanging constantly as mining went on day and night, now portrayed a different scene.
Warriors were sharpening their longswords, Priests were casting spells to heal the wounded, and the logistics units were transporting supplies to the front lines... an unprecedented war had swept over this secluded city several months before.
Their enemy was made up of monsters corrupted by the Ancient.
Currently, in Dwarf Valley, the gloomy skies seemed as if a Demon God was about to be born, with black clouds layer upon layer, as if mountains pressing down upon the city.
Crack~
In an area below unnoticed by anyone, space suddenly shattered like glass, and then Lide, riding a Withered Bone, burst out from the rift in space.
With a wingspan of 26 blades, the Undead Blood Dragon, infused with the Power of Crimson, was dominantly unstoppable, its Legendary Level pressure scattering in an instant, as if an Ancient wild beast descended upon the world, its majesty towering like mountains, overwhelming like the ocean.
Below, the Beastman and Centaur Warriors shivered in unison, looking up in terror at the colossus in the sky.
What colossal beast was this? The Withered Bone had expanded from 18 to 26 blades and was now ignited with the Power of Crimson, completely transformed, and naturally, the soldiers couldn’t recognize it.
It was only after a figure surrounded by the Golden Power burst through the fractured spatial rift that they grounded themselves.
The Golden Power... That was the king of the Lion Tribe, Lord Cap!
"Ga ga ga, I have already smelled the scent of the Ancient Monsters, truly a circle of revolting Abyss Worms. I, the Tusk of Dawn City, great Dragon of Destruction, today I shall annihilate you under my Dragon Breath!!
Be prepared to embrace eternal silence..."
The monstrous laughter in the sky made many elderly Half-Beasts twitch at the corners of their mouths as if remembering something, and they immediately let down their guard...
It was Lord Withered Bones...
The surrounding Centaurs looked at the Beastmen with some confusion, still wanting to inquire for information.
A few Beastmen, reminded of the painful experience of being forced to listen to half a day of nonsense, said nothing more, just muttering disdainfully on their faces; better not to know him, hoping you never have to recognize him... Otherwise, you’ll regret it.
Whoosh whoosh~
In the air, the Withered Bone was, of course, unaware of his reputation for being talkative among the Beastmen; at the moment, he was wantonly emitting his Legendary pressure.
His torn dragon wings beat, his huge form sped forward, and within a few breaths, he arrived above the city walls.
This was the main battleground between the Dwarf Valley and the Ancient Monsters.
It had been a long time since Lide had visited the Dwarf Valley, this land held significant meaning to him and Dawn City, and it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to call it the starting point of their fortunes.
View the correct content at
Now he began to seriously inspect this city, which was completely altered.
The Dwarf Valley had always been managed by Beastmen, but now Centaurs had also moved in.
Since the valley was fairly open, in front of the Secret Silver Ore, behind the city walls of the valley, another vast city had been established.
The new city had been under construction for four or five years; with Dawn City’s relentless support, this city could be called prosperous.
Solid houses neatly arrayed, clean, wide, and orderly streets, and a full range of life facilities...
Exaggerating not, if it weren’t for the fact that Dawn City later built a new district, even the old district would hardly compare to this Beastman city.
After glancing over the city district a few times, Lide looked towards the city walls with considerable satisfaction.
A city wall, standing steadfast between two mountain peaks, measuring about 300 blades in length, 30 blades in height, and 20 blades in width, is currently standing tall and defiantly.
This solid wall was built later; the original Dwarf wall had long been dismantled.
Completely blocking the entrance to the valley, to bypass the wall by climbing over the flanking peaks would require ascending about 500 blades.
However, the peaks are as steep as knife edges, too difficult for beasts to climb, accessible only to flying troops.
Interestingly, thick white fog shrouds the valley year-round, causing severe disorientation in direction once one rises over 200 blades.
Adding to this the defense of Magic Language Bats and ground crossbow formations, breaching the defenses from the skies is as hard as reaching heaven.
Correct content is on
Easily defended, difficult to attack.
The security of the wall was definitely several notches higher than that of ordinary human cities.
At this moment, this impregnable wall is experiencing a battle that can be called ruthless.
Countless Ancient Monsters were emitting the rotten breath of ancient times, charging fearlessly towards the city wall.
Their number was so vast that from the sky, Lide couldn’t see the end of them.
At this moment, in front of the city wall, a steep slope of corpses over twenty blades high had accumulated, allowing the Ancient Monsters below to directly step on the corpses and charge onto the 30-blade-high wall.
The ghastly wartime scene was like a church fresco depicting an apocalyptic scenario, with countless corpses and clotted blood turning this land into a place of blood and horror.
Lide noticed that these Ancient Monsters were of various species, with Corrupted Wild Boarmen being the most numerous, followed by Fallen Gnolls, Bloodthirsty Kobolds, and so on. Fortunately, there weren’t many flying Ancient Monsters, with the few quickly taken care of by archers.
However, Lide furrowed his brow at a troubling detail: most of these Ancient Monsters were level 9 or 10, and astonishingly, about 50% were level 10.
In comparison, the army on the city wall was at a disadvantage, most of their main force being only level 7 to 9, with few reaching level 10.
But thankfully, Dawn City’s equipment advantage compensated for the gap in levels.
Clad in solid armor forged by Dwarfs and wielding sharp blades, the Beastman warriors stood proudly atop the wall, striking any Ancient Monster that managed to surge over the pile of corpses.
Behind them stood dense ranks of Half-Elf archers, who were like snipers with their longbows, ensuring that with every arrow fired, an Ancient Monster would fall.
Not just atop the wall, the area behind was also filled with tens of thousands of Centaur Archers. Whenever the pressure in front was too great, these archers from the rear would provide immediate support.
And further back were hundreds of goblin bomb trucks, ready to open fire should even the archers fail to alleviate the pressure.
In addition, the Magic Language bombing troops and air combat troops were also on standby.
The all-encompassing, multi-tiered attacks turned the wall into an insurmountable rift, the Ancient Monsters surging forward like a tide, no matter how powerful, could only halt before the wall.
Yet, as the war continued, the pile of corpses at the base of the wall grew higher, eventually leveling with the wall, a truly terrifying sight.
Lide raised an eyebrow, about to take action, when he saw many warriors suddenly hoisting buckets of green slime to the wall’s crest, and under the cover of their comrades, they poured the liquid onto the towering heap of corpses.
Hiss~
Like highly concentrated sulfuric acid, the intense corrosion began, and to everyone’s surprise, what followed was even more astonishing.
After the green slime corroded the corpses below, it started emitting an oily green flame that then set the entire pile ablaze.
When over a dozen buckets of the substance were poured from different areas, the pile of corpses below was instantly set aflame with soaring green fires.
Using corpses as fuel, igniting the earth.
As the green flames burned, the Ancient Monsters continued to surge crazily, unaware of pain and fear, but now to no avail. They were scorched to death by the green flames.
The troops atop the wall seemed very experienced, and as the scene unfolded, they began to rotate out in an orderly fashion, with tribes that had been refitted moving forward, while the already exhausted warriors immediately went to the rear to recoup.
As for the Ancient Monsters that had swarmed like ants before, they were now blocked by the green flames, affording the city wall warriors precious breathing room.
"Lord Cap, what is that green slime?" Lide asked.
Hearing the question, Cap, who was standing not far away, quickly approached Lide, still sitting atop Lord Withered Bones.
"Your Majesty, it is an Alchemy Potion developed by the Magic Industrial Research Institute. It has a special effect that causes corpses to burn, but the cost is steep, so the warriors on the wall wait until the pile of monsters’ corpses fills the wall before they use it..."
Lide saw this scene and inexplicably felt a pang of heartache.
Because the Space Gate to the Land of Bone-Burying could only open directly into Dwarf Valley, the area around the city walls was outside the reach of the Space Gate, untouchable.
Thus, as he slaughtered these Ancient Monsters outside, there was no way for him to collect the Power of Death.
Under such dense attacks, it was unrealistic to expect the warriors to transport the bodies.
It could only be considered a sheer waste.
However, it was also okay, as the Land of Bone-Burying now was different from before, with the Dark Sovereign’s subordinates serving as his blade, and the Power of Death he obtained from fighting demons every day could be described as astronomically huge.
If he couldn’t eat these Ancient Monsters, other places could make up for it.
After observing the battle below for a moment, Lide confirmed there were no problems and did not linger; he urged Withered Bone to charge straight out of Dwarf Valley, heading toward the Land of Death that sealed the Ancient Evil God.
On the city walls below, the Iron Hoof Tribe chieftain, Sam, and the Lion Tribe’s priest, Morton, exchanged glances as they sensed Lide’s aura, both spirits lifting sharply at that moment.
Lide’s presence here meant that he was inevitably going to deal with the hidden danger of that Ancient Evil God.
This greatly relieved both of them, their eyes filled with excitement.
Over the past few months, even though Dwarf Valley seemed to have suffered no significant losses, only they knew the tremendous pressure they had faced.
The relentless fighting had everyone on edge, never allowing themselves a moment’s peace.
Now at last, they saw the dawn of the war’s end... There was never any doubt in their minds whether Lide could deal with the sealed Ancient Evil God.
After all, this was the Sovereign of Dawn, their master! Even if it were an unsealed Evil God, they dared to believe that Lide would triumph.
Lide’s reputation in Dawn City had already reached its peak, and those below, whether human or Beastman, Dwarf, or Centaur, all held a nearly fanatic trust in him.
He was their king!
——
——
With Withered Bone becoming Legendary, its flying speed had increased significantly. If it were not for accommodating Lord Cap, that guy would have disappeared after just a few flaps of its wings.
After leaving Dwarf Valley, Lide rode on the back of Withered Bone, scanning the quickly passing mountain and river scenery below.
As he flew deeper into the barren wasteland, the more he could feel the power of the Ancient era gathering ahead, like walking from light mist to dense fog, and from dense fog into light rain.
And due to the corrosion of Ancient era power, the dry earth had turned into a grey, hard state, with no grass growing and the streams murky.
Everywhere the Ancient Monsters passed turned to ash, and on the barren wasteland above, there were now no traces of normal life; the land more resembled a sulfuric region from the abyss.
In the sky there remained only the unconscious low roars from the mouths of the Ancient Monsters...
As Withered Bone flew by, quite a few Ancient Monsters noticed the out-of-place presence in the sky and furiously looked up, howling. Their voices were deep and brutal, filled with a bone-chilling intent of destruction.
Lide turned a deaf ear to this, his gaze sweeping across the land.
As disgusting as these monsters were, killing them all meant nothing to him; capturing the Ancient Evil God was the true purpose of this trip.
A hundred kilometers covered under the span of Withered Bone’s wings took only about ten minutes, and that was while still suppressing the flight speed for the sake of Lord Cap.
Huff huff~
Originally very excited, Withered Bone suddenly stopped its form above a hill, as the ghostly blue Soul Fire surged violently, its tone filled with some excitement.
"Undead above, master, we’ve arrived...
I sense evil afar, there must be treasures worth a fortune in there..."
Upon hearing this, Lide’s expression sharpened, and he immediately looked up into the distance.
He saw that ahead, the world was dim as if a heavy rain was coming, oppressively dark like a gloomy storm cloud about to burst.
The clouds in the sky swirled like a vast whirlpool, slowly rotating in one direction.
And the center of this whirlpool faced a shattered dimensional rift atop the parched earth below.
The spatial rift was irregularly shaped, like a huge hole left by a stone smashing through glass, with sharp edges all around, approximately a hundred blades long and fifty blades high.
Countless ancient monsters surged from that gap in the dimensional rift, pouring into the Main Plane like a tide released from a dam.
The staggering number was enough to send chills down the spine of anyone with a fear of crowds.
Even more exaggerated was the thick aura of ancient times that came surging in with the monsters.
Bathed in the aura of ancient times, the power of those monsters visibly increased.
Lide now understood why the levels of these ancient monsters were so high.
His gaze followed the ancient monsters as he looked towards the dark dimensional rift, which seemed to swallow all connections within.
He keenly perceived that within this space, there existed some unimaginable, terrifying beings.
His expression grew more solemn.
After pondering for a moment, Lide’s body floated up directly and flew out from atop Lord Withered Bones, standing midair.
"Follow behind me..."
As his words fell, he waved his hand, and the space around him shattered violently, then he stepped into the Dimension Plane.
Lord Withered Bones and Lord Cap immediately followed suit.
Upon entering the Dimension Space, their vision seemed veiled, and the faces of the ancient monsters below became somewhat blurry.
Without much hesitation, Lide flew straight toward the dimensional rift a thousand blades away.
After more than a dozen breaths, the three descended from the sky, with Lide hovering in front of the irregular dimensional rift, his expression growing heavier as he watched the ancient monsters shuttling below.
Since they were inside the Dimension Plane, those ancient monsters couldn’t sense their presence, so they fortunately didn’t draw any attention.
The space rift in front of them was like the gaping maw of an evil dragon, the irregular fissures around it like sharp tusks, seemingly ready to devour anyone who dared to step inside.
"Once we enter the Sealed Land, we must act cautiously. If we encounter uncontrollable danger, prioritize survival and retreat immediately."
Lide, somewhat uneasy, turned his head to give the two a special warning.
His Talent allowed him not to fear death, but it wasn’t the same for them. Once dead, they were truly dead, with no Talent for resurrection.
The fighting power of two Legends was crucial anywhere, so naturally, he couldn’t risk their safety.
"Yes, Your Highness."
"Master, rest assured, those weak, filthy, lowly worms will surely be burned to ashes by Lord Withered Bones’s Dragon Breath!"
Cap replied obediently, while Lord Withered Bones was quite confident, or rather, this mentally abnormal undead had always been very confident.
Lide couldn’t be bothered with this chatterbox. After taking a deep breath, he stepped right into the evil land that sealed the Ancient Evil God.
Boom~
The moment Lide stepped into the Sealed Land, a terrifying Spirit Shock, heavy as a thousand-pound hammer, slammed into his soul.
Bang~ Lide felt a wave of dizziness in his head, shaking his whole body.
"Such a powerful Spirit Magic..."
Lide’s eyes narrowed. This Spirit Magic definitely reached the Five Circle!
However, his soul had long been sublimated to the Extreme and transformed several times by Divine Calamity, reaching a level that most Legends could only look up to. The sudden appearance of this magic was merely a slight annoyance to him, with hardly any impact.
In fact, the higher the living being, the stronger the soul, and the much higher their immunity to Spirit Magic compared to ordinary magic.
"Damn bastard, dare to ambush the great Lord Withered Bones! But how could the almighty Power of Destruction be schemed against?"
"Don’t let me find out who you are, or I’ll make sure you taste what it’s like to have your soul scorched by dragon breath..."
The Lord withered bones behind him also cursed as he took the impact, but his chattering surprisingly lightened the heavy atmosphere a bit.
Lide turned his head to glance at the two behind him. They were both of Legendary status. Although the surprise attack had left them in a bit of disarray, it was not serious enough to cause any real trouble.
After confirming they were all right, he finally had time to observe the specific situation of this dimension where the Evil God was sealed.
Everything around him exuded an evil aura, an ancient, outdated, decaying evil that was entirely different from the evil of the abyss, and even more frightening.
The sky was cloaked in a dim mist, as if some terrifying lifeform was brewing within, the roiling fog seemed about to reveal some ancient Demon God...
At this moment, Lide could sense clearly that this was a manifestation of the ancient power gathered to the extreme.
Ordinary people, if even a tiny bit of ancient fog touched them, would immediately be eroded into an ancient monster.
Even if he were to recklessly enter the mist, it was not certain that he would come out unscathed.
His gaze shifted from the sky to the ground. Through the dense swarm of ancient monsters, he saw that the ground was not as dry and cracked as imagined.
Instead, it resembled black soil with a bit of stickiness to it, but upon closer inspection, the ground seemed not to be ordinary mud but a rotten black mire that formed only after flesh and blood had decayed and fermented over a long time. The aura of ancient days emanating from it was in no way inferior to the fog in the sky.
"An extremely terrifying plane..." Lide commented silently in his heart.
He looked around. The area was an open plain, swarming toward them like sharks smelling blood were innumerable ancient monsters, lured by the scent of the Main Plane through the broken rifts in space.
The ancient aura in the air was tens or even hundreds of times more intense than outside, and Lide could sense clearly that the ancient monsters around him were absorbing ancient power and growing stronger.
With just a few breaths their presence would surge until their bodies reached their limit.
This left Lide rather surprised. He had always been curious where these ancient monsters came from. Looking at this, they didn’t seem to be a race that could reproduce on their own—so why was there an unceasing, endless outflow, day after day, for months on end?
But these questions clearly required him to explore on his own.
After observing the entrance area for a moment, Lide did not linger and took out a map from the System Space. After confirming there were no mistakes, he directly headed in a certain direction.
After several months of exploration, the intelligence command center still didn’t have complete information on this plane, but the location of the Evil God’s seal was assuredly correct.
His Legendary Danger Perception also told him that the direction he was heading toward was the most dangerous.
"Be careful, both of you. This plane may very well hide some elusive entities. If anything seems off, retreat immediately..."
"Yes, Your Highness..." Lord Cap complied obediently, while Lord withered bones was somewhat excited, seemingly looking forward to the appearance of those mysterious ancient powerhouses...
This time, Lide did not cast any spells on himself. His dark crimson wing pattern unfolded and began to flap slowly. He started to proceed using the most primitive method.
Lord withered bones and Cap immediately followed behind, but the further they flew inside, the more solemn the twain became. Eventually, even the talkative Lord withered bones shut his mouth, carefully scanning their surroundings with his hollow eyes.
Because both had felt an overwhelming sense of oppression from their surroundings, as if a terrifying and ancient being was silently watching them.
Lide sensed that strange feeling as well, and his caution quietly rose to the extreme.
This was no place of safety; any manner of monsters might appear.
Silently, the shackles of his bloodline were unlocked, and his 28th Level Legendary power flowed like lava in his veins, the terrifying strength offering him some inner peace. Nevertheless, his eyes continued to scan for any sign of impending danger.
After about ten minutes of flight, a surge of blue energy suddenly erupted from ahead, expanding wildly like a giant bubble.
From the detection to the approach of the energy, Lide only had a breath or two, without enough time for much reaction.
And even within the Dimension Space, he could not avoid the impact of the blue energy.
In an instant, Lide released several Magic Shields around himself but didn’t get a chance to cast any on Cap before the blue energy struck.
Boom—As the blue energy swept over Lide, the outer Magic Shields burst apart like paper, then his spirit felt as if hammered down by a giant maul.
Lide felt a wave of dizziness at that moment, but his soul was tenacious, forcibly withstanding the assault.
"Another Five Circle Spirit Magic... Is this some kind of fixed spell that occurs every ten minutes??"
"However, the Intelligence Center didn’t mention this in their reports...
No, the Intelligence Center’s information was updated three days ago, which means that some changes have occurred in the Sealed Land during these days?"
Lide’s expression grew a few shades more serious at this moment. He could have dismissed the first encounter with the magic shock as an accident, but the second time was definitely indicative of an unforeseen event.
Considering this, even as he continued flying forward, his pace unconsciously slowed down a bit.
This land, rotted into flesh and bone, gathered old power into dense fog, reducing visibility to less than a thousand blades, always left him feeling uneasy.
Moreover, the closer he got to the target, the stronger the sensation of being watched became.
Ten minutes later, Lide suffered the third spirit shock...
Half a Sunshine Hour after entering the Sealed Land, he experienced the fourth attack, but after withstanding this assault, Lide quietly slowed.
For he had arrived at the place marked on the map.
Looking up in the distance, he immediately spotted a rather conspicuous presence.
It was a peak that stood erect, and while it was only a hundred blades tall, it was particularly striking in this plane of vast plains.
However, the sharply defined mountain peak caused Lide’s brow to furrow.
For thousands of iron chains emanating dark light, inscribed with ancient runes, were tightly coiling and binding the mountain.
The other end of the chains seemed to be deeply buried into the earth’s depths, as if to anchor the mountain to the ground.
But what truly surprised Lide was that the Intelligence Center had informed him of only a stone coffin bound by chains, seemingly just sealed on flat ground.
Now... what was going on with this mountain??
"Could it be that the Ancient Evil God is about to break the seal and has forcefully pulled this peak up from the ground?"
The thought made Lide click his tongue in wonder. If his guess was correct, then the power of the divine was truly terrifying... To even be able to uproot a whole mountain was an extreme exaggeration.
The presence of the Ancient Monsters was also diminished due to the terrifying aura emanating from the peak, staying far away, which eased his concerns a bit.
After a brief contemplation, Lide turned to look at the Kobold and Lord Cap, who were both visibly shaken by the scene before them, and spoke with a solemn tone.
"You two stay on guard at the base of the mountain, signal immediately if you encounter any formidable enemies; I will ascend the mountain to check."
Sensing the gravity of the situation, they both nodded in agreement.
After giving his orders, Lide didn’t hesitate and immediately flew toward the mountain peak.
But the closer he got to the mountain, the more palpable the sense of dread he felt.
The thousands of chains were suffused with a frightening essence. The runes on them glowed darkly, hinting at the vast passage of time they had endured.
It was foreseeable that the materials used to forge these chains must have been astonishing, and the forger of them exceedingly powerful.
What kind of force then warranted sealing with such immense treasures, materials, and effort?
With this thought, Lide grew even more wary.
Moments later, he quietly reached the mountaintop, and a surprising scene unfolded before his eyes.
The source of the thousands of chains was now tightly binding a stone sarcophagus, the inscriptions on the chains emanated formidable power, transferring bit by bit onto the sarcophagus, firmly sealing this mysterious coffin.
However, what made Lide’s heart beat faster was that the chains binding the sarcophagus showed large patches of corrosion. Many chains had completely snapped, and some had thinned to the width of a hair.
And from within the sarcophagus, the old energy that seeped out was like highly concentrated sulfuric acid, eroding those chains in an irreversible process.
Lide took a deep breath, his curiosity about the sarcophagus growing tremendously, and he subconsciously opened his attribute panel.
Sealed Mysterious Coffin
Quality: Unique Special Item
Status: Sealed (Struggle Degree 95%, reaching 100% will be completely unsealed)
Introduction:
The sarcophagus, infused with mysterious power, sealed some indescribably terrifying lives. At this moment, the life that was sealed was struggling to break free from its shackles.
The attributes of the sarcophagus made his eyes narrow slightly.
The sealed Evil God had actually broken free by 95%... Given this situation, in just a few days, the Ancient Evil God sealed within the sarcophagus was likely to break the seal and descend upon the world once more.
"Fortunately, I’ve arrived early; otherwise, I would have missed it."
After examining the attributes of the sarcophagus, rather than fear, Lide felt a surge of eagerness and excitement.
"Should I unseal it here?"
"No, no, that wouldn’t do. Unsealing it here would give the advantage to the other side, turning this place into their home ground... and who knows what else might be in this plane..."
He quickly dismissed the decision to break the seal directly. Initially, that had been his plan, but the situation had obviously changed now.
After some thought, another bold idea emerged in his mind.
"I wonder if it’s feasible to carry this sarcophagus back?"
"It seems entirely possible. Dawn City still has powerful figures like the mermaid guarding the Destiny Tablet, so that’s some insurance..."
"But before that, I need to reconcentrate the seal. I don’t want to carry a ticking time bomb back."
After a moment’s thought, he took out the Tears of Purification that the half-mermaid Cassina had given him from his pocket.
This pebble-sized stone was a treasured item capable of dispelling the powers of the Ancient and of Chaos.
Once his approach was decided, Lide no longer hesitated and burst out of the Dimension Space, directly descending onto the mountain peak.
Inscribed with runes, the iron chains emanated an aura so dangerous that Lide dared not touch them. He directly flew over the sarcophagus, avoiding the chains.
On closer inspection, he found that the sarcophagus was not small at all, measuring about 5 sharp blades in length and two in width, very orderly and precisely made.
Although tightly sealed, he could still feel the power of the Ancient seeping out from the nearly invisible seams of the sarcophagus.
Like the gaps in a water pipe, small but persistently leaking, the iron chains were also corroded by the extremely pure power of the Ancient.
After a moment of contemplation, Lide slowly approached the sarcophagus, but the closer he got, the more he felt the horror of the sealed life within.
Until, at last, every cell in his body was reminding him, Danger, extreme danger, to the point where he had an almost impulsive urge to flee the scene.
The level of danger he had initially perceived from the outside was 10, but after approaching, it was at least 1,000, a hundredfold increase.
However, at this moment, Lide’s gaze was as determined as iron, and his heart, forged in the fires of war, had long since transformed.
Suppressing his inner sense of danger and the instinct of his biology, he slowly placed the Tears of Purification in the gap between the chain and the sarcophagus, where they didn’t intersect.
Just by coming into contact with the power of the Ancient, it would purify, that was the method of use Cassina had told him.
Pop~
A crisp sound echoed as the Tears of Purification touched the sarcophagus, bursting forth like breaking through a barrier, unleashing a dazzlingly brilliant cyan energy.
That cyan energy continued to erupt, creating a transparent protective layer that enveloped the entire sarcophagus.
When the iron chains came into contact with the cyan energy, crack~ it was as if they triggered certain rules, and the Ancient Runes on them began to slowly rotate.
Chains buried deep in the earth erupted with an extremely terrifying energy, which then shot straight into the Tears of Purification.
Under Lide’s somewhat shocked gaze, the chains released all their energy, the Ancient Runes quickly dimmed, and those darkly glowing chains started to corrode wildly.
Only the pebble-sized Tears of Purification shone even more brightly.
Crack~ Crack~
As the energy drained rapidly, the chains began to shatter piece by piece.
Until at last, the chains, thousands in number, all turned to rust so fragile as bubbles and then broke simultaneously.
Crash~ When the last chain broke, the Tears of Purification violently smashed onto the sarcophagus, embedding into it as if a soybean was pressed into tofu.
"This??"
Lide was full of questions upon seeing this scene. Did the Tears of Purification have a vendetta against this sarcophagus? Why so aggressive?
Moments later, when he sensed again, he found that the aura around the sarcophagus was no longer leaking out.
When he opened the attribute panel of the mysterious sarcophagus again, he noticed a significant change in its status.
Status: Sealing (Struggle extent 95%, forcefully sealed by special energy, unable to unseal until that special energy is completely depleted.)
"The mermaids are the real bosses..."
After seeing this, Lide could only remark with resignation.
But even though it was sealed, how was he supposed to take the sarcophagus back to Dawn City?
Snap—A huge Mage’s Hand appeared, but as soon as it grasped the sarcophagus, the magic energy was directly devoured by a pale blue Shield.
This??
Lide didn’t want to believe it but after trying seven or eight different spells, he had to admit that this thing was immune to magic; any magic energy would be absorbed.
But at this point, he couldn’t possibly just abandon it...
Looking at the enormous mysterious sarcophagus, Lide thought for a moment. If a gentle approach didn’t work, then he’d have to go for the hard way—after all, most people preferred it harder...
He took two steps forward, his hands violently reaching out to grasp the bottom of the sarcophagus, and then with his whole body like a spring compressed to the extreme, he suddenly exerted force.
Crack—A loud noise of bones and joints under pressure sounded, and the huge sarcophagus was forcibly lifted at its front by Lide.
However, because the sarcophagus was too long, it wasn’t easy to handle, so he finally steeled his heart and went directly underneath the coffin, lifting the exaggeratedly heavy mysterious sarcophagus onto his back.
With a Legendary Physique, Legendary Power, and the Legendary Ancestor Bloodline, Lide’s strength had long since broken through the skies... Just a sarcophagus, even if it sealed an Ancient Evil God, so what.
Yet, after he lifted the sarcophagus, Lide instantly felt a terrifying ancient power viciously assaulting his body from within.
As if it wanted to devour his soul.
Lide’s eyes grew cold, and the Power of Faith began to spread out wildly, forcefully resisting that horrifying ancient power.
The coffin’s already on my back, and you still want to resist?? Giving you face??
Without further hesitation, he called over the two on guard below, preparing to pack up and escape...
When Withered Bones was summoned and saw the scene of Lide carrying the coffin, it was dumbfounded.
"Master, have you dug up the ancestor’s grave of the Ancient Evil God??"
Lide twitched the corner of his mouth, thinking you’re the one who’s dug up the grave...
Not wanting to say more, he instructed the idiotic Undead to land, and with the coffin on his back, he took step by step forward, mounting its back.
"Take off, back to Dawn City..."
"Master, aren’t you going to place the coffin on my back?" Withered Bones found the scene of Lide carrying the coffin without letting go quite odd. Since when did the master have this hobby?
Wasn’t unearthing graves what the Undead liked to do the most?
"The Ancient Evil God sealed within is about to break free, do you want to give it a try?"
Lide’s voice came through eerily...
Upon hearing this, Withered Bones instinctively emitted spiritual power to sense the sarcophagus, and then a terrifying aura nearly froze its soul in that moment.
Withered Bones shivered greatly, its Soul Fire surged wildly, and flapping its wings fiercely, it flew towards the space rift as if it had seen a ghost.
"No, master, we’ll head straight back to Dawn City..."
This mentally aberrant Undead had just sensed an aura inside the sarcophagus that could nearly destroy it. Now carrying a ticking time bomb on its back, it immediately wilted, crying out as it flew towards Dawn City.
Lide, returning with the sarcophagus on his back, couldn’t possibly imagine what amazing thing lay hidden within it...

chapters.content:
Chapter 452: Chapter 454: The Stone Coffin That I Sealed Myself (8000 Words)
Sealed Land.
Miles upon miles of dark clouds obscured the sun, and the thick fog formed from ancient power was like the gaze of a demon, filled with a breath that made one’s courage falter.
At this moment in the sky, a creature with a wingspan of 26 blades, enveloped in the Power of Crimson as if it had sliced its way out of hell, unfurled its wings and soared.
With each flap of its tattered dragon wings, its speed surged, trailing a long crimson tail flame behind it.
What was even more shocking was the figure on the back of this being, made of white bones and with hellfire burning upon it. The figure was handsome to the extreme, standing straight and tall like a mountain, carrying upon his back a giant coffin shrouded in blue energy.
The coffin seemed like an item that had persisted through the ages, its surface adorned with patterns formed by the erosion of countless years, the imprints left by time.
The sky was oppressed with dark clouds, the earth roared with the monstrous Ancient Monsters, and Lide stood atop the first Undead Blood Dragon in the world, carrying a mysterious coffin that sealed an Ancient Evil. The scene was as striking as an epic, stirring deep emotions.
This moment was one to be emblazoned upon the walls of temples to become a myth handed down through generations.
Lord Cap, unable to catch up with the Withered Bone startled by the coffin, was now following Lide and riding upon the Undead Blood Dragon.
Feeling the horrific aura of the coffin that was subtle yet unmistakable, the fear within Withered Bone continued to grow, having just experienced an escape from the terrifying Evil God sealed within, as if slipping away from the scythe of the Death God.
At this very moment, they were fleeing from the Sealed Land with all their might.
And Lide was, with every fiber of his being, battling the power of the Ancient Evil emanating from the coffin, his mind on nothing else.
The Ancient Evil God within the coffin did not intend to cease its resistance after being hoisted; it was fiercely struggling instead.
Since physical contact with the coffin wasn’t completely blocked by the blue energy of the Tears of Purification, Lide could clearly sense just how dreadful the presence within the coffin was.
That ancient power was the purest form of rot, malevolence, primeval force; he could only counter it with the Power of Faith.
But it was not easy for him, his Power of Faith was being depleted crazily.
Fortunately, just the followers of the Twilight Sect alone were close to 15 million. The amount of Power of Faith he received daily was astronomical, providing him with enough capital to clash head-on with the opponent.
But contending against the coffin’s power wasn’t enough, as Withered Bone escaped, Lide once again felt a sense of dangerous scrutiny.
He had this feeling as soon as he entered the Sealed Land, but now it was even more evident.
"Could it be that this Sealed Land contains other sealed Ancient Evil Gods?"
Lide’s thoughts raced, and he quietly warned Withered Bone and Lord Cap to be mindful of the unknown Evil God.
Both were already aware that something was amiss. As Legendary beings, their keen sense of peril had not diminished.
In an instant, Withered Bone increased in speed, the dragon wings beat furiously, drawing long flaming tails across the sky...
Because of the coffin, they could not enter the Dimension Space; hence, their unrestrained flight caused quite a stir.
The Ancient Monsters below sensed an unfamiliar presence in the sky that was not of the Ancient, instantly enraged, they let out skyward roars, as if venting their fury.
But the roar did not cease; it began to spread around, causing a broader range of engagement almost instantly.
Like drops of red ink in clear water, the roars of the Ancient Monsters spread uncontrollably into the depths of the Sealed Land.
Unstoppable.
Lide’s expression changed drastically because, after the roars began, the impact of the ancient power against him intensified more than tenfold in an instant.
It seemed the sealed Ancient Evil God had been provoked.
The Power of Faith on his attribute panel was plummeting. At this rate, he feared he’d not last half an hour.
And Withered Bone, too, sensed the urgency of the situation. The Power of Crimson on his body suddenly surged, and his speed rocketed as if he’d floored the gas pedal...
Swoosh~ Instantly, a blast of air was pulled out, and then he flew at a speed nearly invisible to the naked eye.
Swoosh swoosh swoosh~
Because the flight altitude was extremely low, those Ancient Monsters on the ground often only felt a wisp of breath sweep by, then could no longer see the silhouette of Withered Bone. Only the Power of Crimson dissipating in the skies still bore witness to his presence.
The region where the mysterious coffin was located was at most a hundred kilometers from the dimensional rift. With Withered Bone’s firepower fully unleashed, his flying speed had far surpassed that of the former Dawn Bat King, Castro.
Lide estimated it to be at least 2,000 kilometers per hour.
A journey of over a hundred kilometers took less than two minutes to cross, and the dimensional rift was already in sight.
But at that moment, something unexpected happened.
The fog in the sky, condensed from the Ancient Power, was as if stirred by a gigantic hand, producing waves more tumultuous than those of the tallest seas.
It was as if some ancient evil deity from ages past was about to awaken from the clouds.
The scene was extremely terrifying.
After just a few blinks.
Boom boom boom~~
An indescribable, untouchable, and unbearable presence violently emanated from the Ancient fog.
At this moment, heaven and earth were shocked into silence, and all things seemed to come to a still.
The Plane’s Original Rules seemed to have come to a halt.
Even those ferocious Ancient Monsters seemed as if their throats were pinched, no longer making any sounds.
In the midst of the thick black fog in the sky, an indescribably large, octopus-like figure emerged, its body formed by the condensation of the Ancient fog.
But chillingly, atop the octopus’s body was the face of a human, a mismatch so strange and horrifying with the rest of its body.
An unknown Ancient Evil God...
That was an unspeakable horror, a demon and evil spirit from the Exotic Realm City States, a monstrosity of Extreme Evil that does not belong to the human world...
Lide, bearing the stone coffin on his back, looked up at the sky. The extraordinary evil creature gave him a feeling as if his heart was being crushed.
His hair stood on end.
And just when Lide set his gaze upon the creature, the detestable being’s tightly shut eyes abruptly opened.
Their eyes met.
Time seemed to stop at that moment.
Lide saw in those evil-filled eyes the collapse of worlds, the crumbling of Planes, the Dimension Planes returning to the Chaos Void...
He also saw countless lives being slaughtered, devoured, and countless evil spirits lunging violently towards his soul...
Puh-chi~
Lide only felt a sharp pain in his Spiritual Sea, and a gush of fresh blood violently spurted out.
Just this moment of eye contact gave him a soul-shattering Spirit Shock, a hundredfold more ferocious than the previous Five Circle Magic.
And Withered Bone also felt a great terror, as if something was about to crush and shatter his soul.
He desperately flew onwards.
The mysterious Ancient being in the sky had by then also regained its senses.
"Kill... Destruction..."
A soul-shattering, otherworldly torrent of horrific sound swept through heaven and earth.
The ancient fog in the sky, under the vile speech filled with the exotic realm city states’ aura, instantly congealed into thousands of tentacles as long as blades, crashing down toward the ground.
It was as if they intended to use them for a slaughter.
Even this power was already enough to annihilate a hundred-mile stretch of land.
Those ancient power-infused tentacles, carrying the force that could obliterate everything, swept toward the ground, shattering space wherever they passed, returning all to chaos.
As thousands of tentacles pierced straight down from the black clouds in the sky, the scene resembled an apocalyptic disaster, filled with suffocating, profound terror.
"Explode!!"
Lide, enveloped by that terrifying pressure, let out a bestial roar. Bearing the coffin’s pressure, he was cloaked in surging Power of Crimson, which then rushed into Withered Bone’s body in a wildly violent manner.
Withered Bone let out a sharp cry and then uncontrollably once again increased its speed by a large margin.
Swoosh~
There was no longer a trace of the Undead Blood Dragon in the sky, only the lingering Power of Crimson in the air...
And in the second before the world-ending tentacles shattered the earth, Withered Bone, bolstered by Lide’s strength, finally flew out of the shattered space rift.
The moment they returned to the main plane, Lide seemed to sense something and abruptly turned back.
He saw thousands of blade-long tentacles bombard the earth at that moment; the rigid ground broke apart like foam.
Stones as long and wide as dozens of blades scattered into the midair and then fell densely like raindrops, a breathtaking scene.
This land entered a state of destruction after the strike of that Ancient Evil God. The howling ancient monsters, like ants in a storm, were instantly turned into dismembered flesh under the impact of that annihilating power.
Lide could not help but breathe a sigh of relief upon seeing this.
If they were any later, they would be crushed into a pulp like those ancient monsters at this moment.
The power of that Ancient Evil God was too horrific; a single whisper could condense thousands of blade-long tentacles and end the world... Such a posture was absolutely beyond the imagination of normal people.
The opponent was also definitely not like the God of Plague, who had been sealed for millions of years with much of its strength depleted; it must still retain a considerable part of its power.
"Your Majesty, I didn’t expect this Sealed Land to hide an Ancient Evil God we had not discovered.
Dwarf Valley... should we prepare to abandon it?"
Lord Cap stood on Withered Bone’s back, his face extremely solemn at this moment.
The intelligence center originally found only one sealed Evil God, but clearly, the secrets hidden in this Sealed Land far exceeded their expectations.
If that Ancient Evil God descended on the main plane, then Dwarf Valley, merely a few hundred kilometers away, would likely be discovered very soon.
At that time, it wouldn’t just be this city facing danger; what’s more terrifying is that it might also involve Dawn City.
Therefore, although Lord Cap was reluctant in his heart, he had already made up his mind to forsake Dwarf Valley; he only needed Lide to give the order...
As Lide resisted the ancient Evil God inside the coffin, his thoughts were also whirling wildly.
A second Ancient Evil God appeared; could there be a third, a fourth??
Although it seemed unlikely, who could be certain?
"Indeed, we need to prepare for this," he decided after a moment.
"Later, you’ll stay in Dwarf Valley and first move all the critical supplies to Dawn City, so that the army can be withdrawn at any moment in case of an emergency.
With the Space Gate, there’s no need to leave too much baggage in Dwarf Valley since resupply can happen at any time."
Dwarf Valley was essentially the cradle of Dawn City’s prosperity, its Mithril ore veins and iron mines playing irreplaceable roles in the city’s growth.
But now the underworld had been completely taken over by him, and there were other sources for Mithril ore veins, with plenty of iron mines too, so the significance of Dwarf Valley was no longer unique.
If a genuine crisis were to occur here, then losing Dwarf Valley wouldn’t matter; preserving life forces was far more important.
Population is the primary productive force—what use are so many resources when there are no people?
"Yes, Your Majesty..."
View the correct content at
Taking a deep breath, Cap responded.
Under the Withered Bone’s reckless wing-beating, they had already flown away from that spatial rift. Now, when he turned his head back, he could no longer see the apocalyptic scene.
Two minutes later, in Dwarf Valley.
Soldiers atop the wall saw a bone dragon infused with flames like those of hell hurtling across the sky, followed by a figure brimming with golden power jumping off the back of the skeletal dragon.
What surprised them, however, was that the bone dragon did not stay for a moment but flew directly deep into Dwarf Valley and then disappeared through a Space Gate.
Iron Hoof Tribe’s Chieftain Sam and the Lion Tribe’s Shaman Priest Morton exchanged glances, both with expressions of bewilderment.
What was going on?
What was His Majesty carrying on his back? It looked like a stone coffin... Where did he get that thing?
The Withered Bone’s speed was too fast; if Cap hadn’t slowed down a bit when he jumped off, they might’ve seen nothing at all.
Full of questions, both approached Cap, who had landed atop the wall.
When they asked him, Cap gave no answer but instead issued a weighty command.
"Immediately transport all non-essential military supplies to Dawn City, and have non-combat personnel evacuate as well. Dwarf Valley only needs to keep the essential miners and soldiers defending the walls; leave no one else behind."
"Lord Cap, what exactly is happening?" the Iron Hoof Tribe’s Chieftain Sam asked with surprise. This was no small matter—the city they’d built over several years couldn’t just be abandoned.
"A real catastrophe might be upon us soon..."
Recalling those octopus tentacles that ripped through the earth, destroying all in their wake, Cap felt a surge of overwhelming waves in his heart.
Should that Ancient Evil God descend upon the Main Plane, Dwarf Valley would be shattered in an instant.
They stood no chance!
If not for the Withered Bone’s swift flight, they all might have been left in that Plane.
"Didn’t His Majesty go to hunt down that sealed Evil God? Could it be he failed?"
The Beastman Sam Priest Morton’s voice was somewhat hoarse. If that was really the case, then indeed, they could not stay in Dwarf Valley... But after all, it was the city he’d strived for years to establish—he couldn’t bear to part with it.
"No, His Majesty has brought that sealed Evil God back to Dawn City, but there’s not just one Ancient Evil God in that Plane; there’s another terrifying entity that has already broken its seal.
If that Ancient Evil God descended, we would be unable to resist, and the best option would be evacuation..."
Noting the tremor in Cap’s voice, both showed signs of shock. Another Ancient Evil God?
After exchanging glances, they both fell silent.
Facing an almost unbeatable entity was too much psychological pressure.
"Carry out the orders, we have the Space Gate, even if Dwarf Valley has been occupied, we will eventually retrieve it one day."
"Yes, Lord Cap..."
With a somewhat reluctant response, the two turned and left, their mood having grown much heavier.
Cap stood atop the city walls, gazing at the soldiers below who bustled continuously, transporting military supplies to the walls in preparation for the next great battle, his expression complex.
These are all promising seeds...
After taking a deep breath, he turned his head to look straight ahead.
Through the burning piles of corpses in front of the city walls, his deep eyes stared at the Ancient Monsters surging forward like a tide, and he sighed softly... The real disaster, it seemed, was about to arrive.
The attacks they faced during this period were merely appetizers.
But after his sentiment passed, those same eyes did not show weakness; instead, they immediately hardened with resolve.
"No matter what, no one will make the Beastmen kneel and surrender. Beastmen only fall on the battlefield..."
For the sake of Dawn, he would never look back!
The belief in his heart was as firm as steel.
---
---
---
After Lide rode Withered Bone into the Land of Bone-Burying, his body was augmented by the Plane Power, and the formidable strength immediately brought peace to his heart.
The safest place in this world was this Dimension Plane belonging entirely to him.
The battle between the Undead and Demons continued below, but he did not spare them another glance. After confirming there were no issues, Lide placed the coffin he was carrying on his back onto the top level of the White Bone Altar.
Boom~ The highest level of the altar was a couple of sizes bigger than the Mysterious Coffin, but not by much.
When the coffin was placed on the altar, the Angel Wings, which had turned black, quietly drifted upwards a bit.
But then, as if sensing something, they directly flew above the Mysterious Coffin and began to emit a terrifying power.
At that moment, the Angel Wings paid no heed to their irreversible state of corruption. The dazzling Angel Holy Light fell upon the Mysterious Coffin, forcibly adding a white Shield over the Tears of Purification that had already been suppressing it.
A double seal.
Seeing this, Lide’s expression became quite nuanced; this was exactly like facing a mortal enemy.
What exactly is being suppressed within this coffin? Why do High-level powers engage with it relentlessly to the death...
The Tears of Purification is one thing, but the Angel Wings are no different.
After pondering for a moment, Lide, driven by curiosity, opened the attribute panel of the Angel Wings and discovered the corruption time of the Angel Wings was slowly decreasing from 3000 years.
Although it took several breaths for one or two days to pass, if this rate continued, it might not be long before Lide wouldn’t even have to expend the Power of Death to bring about the corruption, as the Twelve-winged Burning Angel would fall on its own.
Clearly, it was due to the immense power output by the Angel Wings affecting their own resistance to the Power of Death which caused this situation.
However, this situation was very favorable for Lide, as it meant he had yet another entity to suppress the Mysterious Coffin and could accelerate the angel’s corruption—killing two birds with one stone.
"I’m starting to feel more and more that the entity sealed within this Mysterious Coffin is not simple...
Even the Angel Wings want to take their shot without regard for their own loss... I really want to open it and see what’s hidden inside. Could it really just be an Ancient Evil God?"
Lide gazed upon the scene and couldn’t help but fall into deep contemplation.
"Do I call for the mixed-race mermaid to come and study this together?"
But the power of Lady Kaslina made him hesitate; the mysterious mermaid guarding the Destiny Tablet was no benevolent creature.
What if greed took hold of her upon seeing the sarcophagus or the Angel Wings?
He dared not gamble on human nature.
The Land of Bone-Burying was one of his greatest trump cards, and the Fallen Angel was even the ace in the hole.
The reason he dared to let Lady Kaslina roam freely in Dawn City was firstly that she had not shown any malice, and had also promised loyalty and protection to Dawn City,
and secondly because of the presence of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel; should she harbor ill intentions, this ultimate weapon would be the key to turning the tables, whoever it was, the Twelve-winged Burning Angel would not discriminate.
If she developed a greedy desire and acted forcibly, how would he deal with it then?
After serious contemplation for a moment, Lide decided to inform her of the news.
Within the Land of Bone-Burying, no matter how the mixed-race mermaid acted, he had sufficient counteracting forces.
Bolstered by the entire Plane, he didn’t believe he was unable to deal with her... especially since he could also make use of the Dark Sovereign’s blade.
His trump cards were actually quite numerous, he wasn’t weaker than her at all.
Moreover, deep down he was more inclined to trust the mysterious mermaid, after all, the Tears of Purification had been gifted to him by her.
More importantly, no one else knew more about the Ancient Evil Gods than her... If he didn’t consult with her, he couldn’t find anyone else to answer his questions.
This was entirely a seller’s market, even scarier than a monopoly, truly.
Perhaps the Dark Sovereign might also know something about the Ancient Evil Gods, but after all, that being was an evil Undead,
Lady Kaslina, no matter what, wouldn’t sink to the point of being compared with the Undead, he’d have to be out of his mind to seek out the Dark Sovereign...
Having made up his mind, Lide first sent Withered Bone back to Dwarf Valley to observe whether the space there had changed.
Given the state of the Ancient Evil God before, it should have been impossible for it to descend to the Main Plane, but he couldn’t afford to take chances with such things and had to repeatedly confirm it.
Compared to guarding against the Mermaid, preventing the Ancient Evil God was more critical.
Moreover, Withered Bone, the being with resurrection ability, had, since evolving into an Undead Blood Dragon, acquired the Bloodline’s talent of rebirth in the blood pool.
He’d subconsciously overlooked that before.
Since it couldn’t die, he wasn’t too worried.
Withered Bone felt a bit of fear after receiving the mission, but Lide’s command wasn’t something he could refuse, so he had no choice but to return obediently to Dwarf Valley.
Once Withered Bone had left, just as Lide was about to take action, Emi, who had been executing the abyssal pig farming plan in the Land of Bone-Burying, quietly appeared beside him.
"Your Highness, good day... I just sensed, um? What is this, this sarcophagus?"
Emi’s speech was interrupted when he saw the mysterious sarcophagus hidden within the deathly mist; he could faintly sense an extremely terrifying life within it.
The Angel Wings floating above the sarcophagus also greatly surprised him, what was it that could activate the Angel Wings?
Lide, however, had no inclination to explain so much, giving Emi a serious glance, "This sarcophagus seals an Ancient Evil God; it’s extremely dangerous.
Go find an abandoned Abyss Plane and mark down the Plane coordinates around the White Bone Altar..."
Emi’s expression turned stern, "Your Highness, are you worried the being will break the seal? If it becomes uncontrollable, will you banish it to the Abyss?..."
Lide shook his head, "No, this isn’t for the Ancient Evil God.
"I will bring that half-blood mermaid in later, and you should know that Kaslina’s identity is too shocking. If the other party has any ulterior motives, I fear they may be hard to resist."
"If we can’t beat her, we will just throw her into the Abyss..."
Emi nodded in admiration, "Yes, I will immediately find a desolate Plane close to the bottom of the Abyss... or shall we simply find a Plane where an Abyss Lord exists?"
Lide looked deeply at Emi, this guy indeed understood my intention.
