The energy emanating from the ancient stone coffin’s Sealed Land grew more terrifying over time, with the octopus tentacles that had torn the earth still vivid in his mind,
Once the Ancient Evil God of the Sealed Land broke free, the low hills would definitely fall, and even Dawn City in the Far Mountain Range might be impacted.
There was also the sea beast with the fragment of the Destiny Tablet in the Lost Sea, celebrated as the Sea God by the merfolk, possessing demigod-level strength...
He had grown stronger, but so had his enemies.
But as Wina went to prepare dinner, Lide suddenly recalled something and instinctively opened his attribute panel. After glancing at a specific attribute, an excited smile spread across his face.
Death Power: 300 million
Yes, after the intense battles of recent times, he had finally amassed 300 million in Death Power.
The Twelve-winged Burning Angel, still suppressing the Ancient Stone Coffin, had less than three thousand years left before its corruption.
In other words... with the Power of Faith, he could now induce the corruption of the Twelve-winged Burning Angel.
An unparalleled combat force was about to join him in Dawn City to battle through the ancient era.
Master of Dawn’s Seventh War General—Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, Freyja Dawn
—
—
—
While Lide enjoyed the post-war tranquility in Green City, Earth was experiencing tumultuous waves at this moment.
It wasn’t just because the war in Green City had drawn the attention of many players, allowing Lide to significantly boost his reputation.
It was also because something shocking had occurred.
Cracks had appeared in the Earth’s sky.
Yes, cracks, like a spiderweb!
These sudden, faint cracks might not be noticed at first glance, but their inconspicuous nature sent shivers down everyone’s spine.
This was because the players of Glory had recognized them—they were exactly like the cracks in the sky of Glory after the descent of the old days.
The discovery caused a global uproar.
Initially, expert scholars explained that these were caused by certain atmospheric phenomena.
But as similar cracks appeared across the entire globe, visible to anyone who looked up, the scholars’ explanations seemed incredibly feeble.
Because of these inconspicuous cracks, intense unrest erupted on Earth in a short time, forcing nations to declare states of emergency as military forces were deployed to control the situation.
Simultaneously, the official website of "Glory" announced they would provide unlimited access to gaming capsules, allowing players to enter Glory.
Everyone was furious, accusing the officials of Glory of hiding the truth. Why were the gaming capsules only made available now? What exactly was this game?
The usually unchanging official website of Glory issued a rare statement, claiming the initial limited release of gaming capsules was meant to delay this day. Now that the sky had cracked, there was no point in hiding anymore.
This announcement sparked even more heated discussions, with many people demanding the arrest of the operators of Glory.
But the official response was deeply evasive, as if hiding some earth-shattering secrets.
Conspiracy theories and doomsday proclamations flooded the public discourse.
However, with strict assurances from various governments and with military forces unchallenged, the situation gradually stabilized after a period of unrest.
Nevertheless, the cracks in the sky still posed an unprecedented shock to the world.
Discussions about these sky cracks proliferated across various forums.
"Damn, the apocalypse is here, who can save me, I can do laundry and cook, I’m seeking a boss to take me in!"
"Serious discussion, is Glory the real world? I’ve suspected it for a while, but now I’m sure."
"If the sky has cracked, will monsters emerge? Can we obtain the powers from Glory?"
"These damn bastards, you’ve ruined the Earth! Damn your ancestors!"
"The great Ancient Dominator is about to descend, I am a follower of the Ancient Dominator. If you want to join the Ancient Dominator, contact me, 200 bucks per sign-up, guaranteed to make you a subordinate of the Ancient Dominator, money back if not satisfied, serious inquiries only."
"Join the Destruction Sect, I am Priest Ouyang Destruction..."
"..."
Countless people vented their emotions online, with anger, fear, disbelief... all human reactions were perfectly displayed at this moment.
But everyone sensed that a world-altering cataclysm was about to arrive.
As for the future of Earth, everyone was bewildered at that moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 460: Successfully Corrupting the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, Returning to Earth (8400 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 459: Chapter 460: Successfully Corrupting the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, Returning to Earth (8400 words)
Southern Province, Risier City.
This city, once occupied by ancient monsters, had long since become a forbidden zone for life.
Initially, some daring players ventured into it, but as time passed, even the bold ones became extinct.
The ancient aura thickened day by day, raising the level of the ancient monsters so high that ordinary players were killed before even setting foot in Risier City.
At this moment, this city, drenched in ancient aura, was undergoing a shocking transformation.
Over a hundred miles, the dark clouds in the sky resembled a massive vortex hovering over the sea, slowly spinning with Risier City at its center.
The sun was obscured, and the clouds churned.
As the dark cloud vortex spun, the cracks in the sky were under immense pressure and began to widen bit by bit, growing larger and larger.
From the thickness of a wire to that of iron rods.
With the appearance of the spatial rifts, the chaotic ancient aura surged into Risier City like a burst dam.
This directly increased the ancient aura inside this wicked city by tenfold or even a hundredfold.
The surrounding area, already devoid of life, became even more dead and barren.
Conversely, the furious half-ratmen, basking in the ancient aura, received an enormous boost.
Those below Level 10 crazily ascended to above Level 10, and even Level 15 furious half-ratmen started to appear densely.
Although the potential of furious half-ratmen was limited, the ancient aura quickly brought these creatures to the limit of their potential.
Unnoticed by anyone, inside Risier City a terrifying army, all above Level 10, was slowly forming.
But this was just the beginning, as the dense ancient aura was transforming the interior of Risier City into an old-world capable of hosting Divine descent.
The Space Gate, standing originally in the center area, began to blur under the impact of ancient power.
If one focused closely, one could faintly see, through the space on the other side, a plane filled with countless furious half-ratmen, now completely anchored in the city center.
"Ha ha ha ha...
Finally, I can finally descend upon this world!!"
The blasphemous language of evil echoed throughout the sky at this moment.
The surrounding ancient power, activated by the blasphemous language, started to converge madly in one direction.
Moments later, in the central area of Risier City, a sound akin to shattering glass rang out, and the Main Plane connected with the other plane in that instant, eliminating the last barrier between them.
What was once shadowy was now starkly visible, with no further obstructions between the two sides.
Untold numbers of furious half-ratmen roared skyward simultaneously, emitting a shrill sound like a sharp blade scraping glass.
The heavens and earth trembled at the sinister roars.
Affected by this, the cracks in the sky fractured once more, widening into an even larger rift.
The ancient aura now gushed out like a high-pressure water cannon, turning the city into an eternally silent city of ancient times.
The moment the sky split, a terrifying and indescribable aura surged from the center of Risier City outwards like a towering tidal wave crashing in all directions.
Heaven and earth were in shock.
The furious half-ratmen, previously screaming skyward, suddenly stopped as if their necks were forcefully grasped. They trembled and cowered on the ground like mice who had seen a cat, utterly abject.
Huff huff~
Accompanied by the rolling ancient breath, a tall shadow emanating a dark light appeared in the center of Risier City.
The moment that figure appeared in the Main Plane, it seemed to trigger some ancient, eternally established rules, creating sounds of chains dragging across the sky and land.
But in an instant, those ancient rules fell back into silence.
Risier City had completely collapsed, and the ancient rules could no longer affect this city of ancient times.
The shadow, exuding an aura of extreme terror, realized this and immediately let out a nearly insane laugh.
"Hahaha!
The rules of the new day are shattered, and the Glory of ancient times shall once again envelop the earth!!
Curse you, New Sun God Ilo!!
Are you prepared to face my fury? I will extract your soul and burn it with demonic flames for a million years!"
"I will, in the name of the God of Plague, destroy this world!!"
——
——
——
At the same time, as the God of Plague descended onto the Main Plane, at the edge of the Ancient Forest, deep within the Storm Sea Domain, in the center of the Undead Empire, near the Royal Capital of the Nolan Empire...
One by one, the cracks in the sky above the ancient seals widened, and those ancient Evil Gods no longer acted like desperate fugitives from their seals but appeared in the Main Plane with an overwhelmingly tyrannical attitude.
The forces in the Main Plane, which had just adapted to the arrival of ancient times, faced an unprecedented crisis once again.
Because these Evil Gods descending upon the Main Plane were in their full forms, possessing peak Divine Power, unlike gods who had transformed into mortals.
Fortunately, due to the Main Plane’s rules not yet fully collapsing, these ancient Evil Gods could not yet leave the Sealed Land in a short time.
But everyone knew the storm had arrived, and a great battle unprecedented in history might commence tomorrow.
Not only were ordinary inhabitants terrified, but also those Divines who had yet to recover their power.
Everyone knew that once the rules of the Main Plane could no longer restrain these descended ancient Evil Gods, they might face their apocalypse.
In fact, the most tragic were those Divines who had not yet directly clashed with the ancient Evil Gods and had already been hunted down by the ambitious mortals of the Main Plane.
From time to time, news circulated about believers who could no longer sense the presence of their Divines...
Everything was moving toward an unknown direction.
But the lives in the Plane of Glory were unaware that not only the Main Plane was facing significant changes, the entire Multi-dimensional Plane was stepping into a countdown to destruction that day.
Undead Plane, the land filled with countless skeletons, counted from the dawn of creation, and at a certain moment, fifteen Undead Monarchs simultaneously looked up at the sky.
Crack~
Accompanied by a crisp sound, the sky of the Undead Plane, which had yet remained unaffected, also developed cracks.
The gushing ancient breath was as thick as water.
The disaster of ancient times finally reached this land of Extreme Evil.
The same was true for the Abyss, the land of ultimate wickedness; even it could not escape the influence of ancient times at this moment.
Crack~
The sharp bursting sounds echoed in every corner of the Abyss, whether on the surface of the first layer or in the deep abyssal layers six hundred levels down.
Anyone looking up would notice those spider web-like cracks clearly visible in the sky.
The fissure was untouchable, incorporeal, and indestructible, for it was a manifestation of the rules.
The thick ancient power instantly permeated the surroundings, and the whole world reeked of decay, which even the naturally malevolent demons felt as a fatal threat.
Indeed, the ancient power did not differentiate between the Evil Camp or the Good Camp...
Sensing the shift in the world, countless horror demon gods hidden in the deepest layers of the bottomless abyss roared toward the sky.
A terrible pressure rose like a storm one after the other, and the entire abyss was shrouded in divine might.
The abyss had never known the light for countless years.
Fallen Evil Gods lurked in this Land of Extreme Evil, and no one knew how many terrifying Evil Gods had been hidden in the abyss since the creation of the world through these long epochs.
But at that moment, those powerful beings that were in slumber had been awakened.
They sensed the fatal danger, yes, danger, that made their souls tremble.
That was the power of the ancient days, the power that destroys everything in the world.
The rulers of the ancient days had once governed the Land of Chaos that the Creator God had not shaped.
Now, He had returned, reborn.
This time He intended to annihilate everything, causing the entire multi-universe to return to nothingness and chaos.
In the deepest depths of the bottomless abyss, the sleep of numerous primordial Demon Sovereigns caused a wake-up, plunging the entire abyss into chaos.
The Demon Sovereigns sought to conquer a powerful plane to resist the impending threat of the ancient days, and the original masters naturally refused to yield, beginning to resist fiercely.
Chaos and slaughter were the eternal main theme of the abyss, and this time it was completely thrown into disarray.
Unable to know the changes within the abyss from the outside, Lide at this moment did not have much mind to care about it.
After realizing in Green City that the Power of Death was sufficient to corrupt the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, he arranged for the management of Green City and immediately rode Withered Bone at full speed back to Dawn City.
He had coveted the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel for years; this time, he absolutely intended to claim this powerful being for himself.
After entering the thousand-mile range of Dawn City, Lide waved his hand and tore open the space in front of him, riding directly on Withered Bone back to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Upon entering the Land of Bone-Burying, the power of the entire plane surged into his body instantly, flooding him with such overwhelming power that he almost groaned in delight—that was indeed a treasure.
Correct content is on
After a moment, he came to his senses, slightly perceiving that everything in the Land of Bone-Burying appeared before his eyes.
At that time, the Undead were still fighting with the demons; every second, demons and the Undead were pouring in from the Space Gate, and every minute, thousands of demons and undead perished.
The Dark Sovereign’s blade was truly sharp; he had already slaughtered so many demons, and the losses of Undead were countless.
Still, no matter how many losses the other side had, the Undead could immediately replenish; this made him reflect on just how invincible the Skeleton Sea tactic truly was.
"Your Majesty..."
Sensing Lide’s presence, Emi, who had built a plague laboratory in the Land of Bone-Burying, immediately came forward to pay respects.
This guy was currently executing the abyss pig-farming mission and simultaneously researching the plague.
"Emi, how did your last plague research go?"
After returning to the Land of Bone-Burying, Lide’s mood was no longer so urgent. The Twelve-winged Blazing Angel had become meat on the chopping block; it couldn’t escape.
Emi’s face immediately brightened with a smile upon hearing the question.
"Your Majesty, the last researched plague has made new progress in the past few days..."
"Oh? How effective?" Lide’s eyes lit up instantly.
"You can observe it yourself."
Emi smiled mysteriously, then a glass tube the size of a thumb, containing half a tube of green liquid, appeared in her hand.
If you looked closely, you’d find that the liquid seemed to be swarming with countless tadpole-like microorganisms, dense enough to scare anyone with a fear of dense clusters to wet themselves.
Lide, driven by curiosity, opened his attribute panel.
Unknown Plague
Quality: Special (Highly contagious, but with lower secondary infection rates)
Traits: Can significantly enhance the physical condition of the infected, but also cause their bodies to mutate. Death will occur if they cannot withstand the erosion of the plague.
Description: An unknown plague that causes mutation in the infected.
It truly was a plague... From just the description, no one would dare to experiment with it lightly.
This thing had its pros and cons.
After displaying it for a while, Emi threw the plague into the sky, and the glass tube cracked open with a snap.
The green liquid instantly turned into a dense fog and began to slowly descend.
Below, a Level 14 Double-Horned Demon was being overpowered by a Level 15 Black Knight, already battered and seemingly on the verge of being defeated.
But the next second, the green fog directly engulfed the demon, entering through his nostrils, mouth, wounds, skin, eyes, and so on, with countless microscopic organisms invading every part of his body.
The Double-Horned Demon, already scar-riddled, felt extreme despair, knowing that as a Level 14, he was no match for the Level 15 Black Knight before him.
But just as he thought he was going to die, a terrifying power surged through his body.
In an instant, the wounds on the Double-Horned Demon quickly healed and scabbed over.
Even more astonishing, the scabs instead of falling off started spreading around his body.
Within a few breaths, the Double-Horned Demon’s body was enveloped in a thick layer of scab, like he was wearing a layer of thick armor, significantly enhancing his defense.
Not just externally, the power within the Double-Horned Demon’s body also rapidly increased, muscles became firmer, bones stronger, and blood thicker...
In an eyeblink, an extremely hideous, gray-black shelled Double-Horned Demon with his entire body including his face covered emerged.
Although his appearance became extremely fierce, as compensation, he gained much stronger power.
The Double-Horned Demon, noticing this change, was overjoyed. He didn’t mind the change in his appearance at all. When did demons ever care about looks?
He didn’t even think he looked ugly; instead, he felt quite imposing.
Meanwhile, the Black Knight, sensing the change in the demon’s aura, also realized something was wrong. His bone knife furiously hacked away, determined to kill this damned demon once and for all.
But the now-transformed Double-Horned Demon felt robust and surged forward with newfound ferocity toward the Black Knight.
Swish~ The bone knife flashed past, the Black Knight’s battle blade heavily hacked at the Double-Horned Demon.
Initially, the Black Knight had thought that even if the strike didn’t kill the demon, it would at least leave a huge scar.
But instead, it was like a blunt knife chopping at cowhide, thudding dully upon impact.
The Double-Horned Demon, realizing this, was ecstatic. This layer of keratin was so solid??
At once, with a fiendish expression, he charged forth, embracing and ferociously biting the Black Knight, seeing hope for a reversal.
After a few blinks, spurting~ blood sprayed and a massive head fell to the ground.
The Black Knight, looking at his broken bone knife, showed an extremely angry expression. The Level 14 Double-Horned Demon was still violently killed by him. Although there was only one level difference between Level 15 and Level 14, the essence of life was markedly different.
Yet still, the price he paid to kill his opponent was extremely high, and his difficulty in securing victory increased several times.
But this was merely a glimpse of the battlefield. After being infected by the plague, the high-level undead no longer had the advantage over the low-level demons as before and could no longer easily overpower them.
Conversely, demons of the same level had already begun to crush the undead of their level.
Within moments, the area infected by the plague roared with the demons’ momentum, driving the undead into gradual retreat.
Seeing this, Lide nodded in satisfaction.
Although becoming infected with the plague turned them grotesquely monstrous, it also traded for a substantial increase in combat strength.
He estimated slightly; demons infected by the plague had their combat strength boosted by over 50%,
Of course, there were more than thirty demons that couldn’t withstand the plague’s erosion and died, but compared to the thousands of successful cases, he didn’t care much about these deaths.
How could one gain strength without paying a price?
Out of the corner of his eye, he curiously regarded the undead who seemed utterly unaffected by the plague and still cavorting about.
"Emi, is there a plague that could also infect the undead?"
Undead, being special beings, possessed many talents that ordinary life forms did not, such as immunity to toxins, plagues, and diseases.
Thus, ordinary plagues were nearly impossible to infect them.
"Your Majesty, to infect the undead, one would have to create a plague that can touch the soul... but that requires a great deal of time."
Hearing this, Lide waved his hand, "No need to think further, I was just asking out of curiosity.
Continue researching the current plague, refine it until it can’t be refined further.
Once it’s confirmed usable, apply it directly to the Chaotic Army on the Gravel Plane to enhance the combat strength of the Demon Army."
He hadn’t forgotten about commanding a Demon Army of several hundred thousand directly.
Now that Emi’s plague research was unproblematic, it could be used to enhance his army’s combat strength.
"As you wish, Your Majesty." Emi also appeared quite pleased, being praised by Lide was indeed an honor.
"Alright, you may return to your duties."
After observing the progress of the plague, Lide no longer stayed, but instant teleported next to the twelfth level of the White Bone Altar.
The mysterious sarcophagus he had carried out from the Sealed Land was still being doubly sealed by the Tears of Purification and the Angel Wings.
Most conspicuous were the Angel Wings, now intermixed in black and white colors, filled with negative energy.
Yet, despite this, the Angel Wings continued to emit a massive amount of Divine Power, suppressing the sarcophagus.
It was evident how incompatible the two were.
Opening the attribute panel.
Twelve-winged Blazing Angel
Status: Transforming, transforming race - Fallen Angel (irreversible)
Transformation time: 2823 years (Death Power can be used to accelerate transformation)
Description: ...
Lide glanced at it and nodded satisfyingly.
Previously, there were three thousand years left for the transformation of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, but as the Angel Wings continued to relentlessly output Divine Power to suppress the sarcophagus, the transformation time was reduced.
However, with the three billion Power of Death he now held in his hands, it was enough regardless of any reduction.
After a brief contemplation, he waved his hand, trying to remove the Angel Wings from the sarcophagus, but they remained unmoved.
Frowning, Lide released a burst of spiritual power, and moments later, shook his head helplessly.
He discovered that the object was rooted and had created a silent barrier cycle with the Tears of Purification below.
If he forcefully removed it, the barrier would break, but he might damage the Tears of Purification below.
After a few attempts, still the same, Lide couldn’t help but feel a bit troubled—was he stuck at the first step??
He pondered for a moment and then made a decisive decision.
If it couldn’t be removed, then he wouldn’t remove it—he would directly transform it.
The object in the stone coffin below was the Ancient Evil God, utilizing the power of ancient days. Although the Power of Death was negative energy, it was part of the Power of Glory, fundamentally different from the chaotic ancient power.
He wasn’t worried about the Power of Death nourishing the being within the stone coffin.
Without further hesitation, with a thought, the Power of Death above the Land of Bone-Burying began to pour into the twelve-layered White Bone Altar, its powerful force causing every bone on the altar to shine brightly.
As the only special building in the Land of Bone-Burying, the White Bone Altar facilitated the transformation of higher-level beings into the undead.
With the influx of the Power of Death, the White Bone Altar began to emanate a ghostly white light, but this light held no sanctity; instead, it was as disturbing as seeing bones in a graveyard.
The death power entered the altar, and under ancient rules, it slowly transferred to the Angel Wings.
The Angel Wings trembled, sensing the imminent danger, but the sleeping Blazing Twelve-winged Angel had long since lost the power to resist; even if it sensed something wrong in its haze, it was powerless to fight off the violation.
Lide glanced at his attribute panel; the Power of Death was dropping at a rate of millions per second.
Correspondingly, the transformation time on the Angel Wings’ attribute panel was also rapidly decreasing as the Power of Death was consumed.
He could visibly see that with the inflow of the Power of Death, the sacred aura in the Angel Wings was becoming increasingly faint, and something terrifyingly evil was brewing within.
It wasn’t an ordinary evil; it was filled with the purest forms of darkness, slaughter, and bloodshed.
When the most sacred life falls, its sanctity would turn into the purest darkness.
This was a saying circulated among the Abyss Dominators—the more sacred something is, the darker it becomes.
In human terms, when a sacred life falls, it gains far more power than ordinary beings.
This is why those Abyss Evil Gods tirelessly seek to tempt the heavenly divine beings to fall, for a fallen Bright God would be far more powerful.
Now, by a fortuitous coincidence, Lide was doing what every Abyss Evil God longed for—tempting a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel to fall.
Such a high-status angel in the Light God System was as exalted as some non-combat divine beings.
To have such an opportunity was definitely something that would make mighty Demon Sovereigns green with envy.
With the massive influx of the Power of Death, the Tears of Purification below also reacted, its blue energy bursting out in an even more domineering manner to suppress the stone coffin.
The mysterious stone coffin sensed something wrong and tried to resist, but under the forceful presence of the Tears of Purification, all efforts were in vain.
Lide silently watched everything, making no further moves—the coffin was too mysterious; he would wait for the angel to emerge before making any plans.
At the same time, he was filled with anticipation.
Especially when he saw the speckled white on the Angel Wings slowly disappear and black take over completely—he stared wide-eyed, unwilling to look away for even a moment.
Because he was about to possess a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel that made everyone tremble with fear!
His feelings were like unwrapping a love letter from a secretly admired goddess, like getting a Divine Artifact in ten consecutive draws in a game...
Though it had only been a few minutes, to Lide, the process felt as long as half a century.
Finally, at the end, the Angel Wings no longer emitted a hint of holy light, and the divine power suppressing the stone coffin from below completely vanished—he finally sighed in relief.
At this moment, the Angel Wings had turned completely black, so thorough and profound.
And on his attribute panel, only a mere ten million of the Power of Death remained.
Upon seeing this scene, Lide couldn’t help but sigh in amazement.
Over the span of several years, he had expended tremendous amounts of energy, manpower, and resources—even employing the troops of the Abyss Dominator to gather the Power of Death for him.
After years of planting seeds and countless sacrifices, the time had finally come to reap the rewards.
At this moment, Lide’s breathing even slowed down a bit as he stared intently at the Angel Wings.
He could feel that after the Divine Power had faded, the Dark Power became the only force present.
A terrifying aura was brewing within it; the Power of Death hadn’t disappeared but was completely absorbed by the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
In other words, the Angel was currently being transformed by the Power of Death...
The transformation process was akin to how a dragon egg hatches, gradually undergoing metamorphosis.
Lide, who seemed to recall something as he watched this, slightly narrowed his eyes.
"I remember when hatching the Divine Monster Asreaga, the Power of Death reshaped his Divine Body and the Power of Faith consolidated his soul...
Now that I have the Power of Death, can I continue to infuse the Power of Faith to make the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel even more powerful?"
After this thought emerged, he felt it was the correct move and decided to give it a try.
He glanced at his attribute panel; the number of Believers in the Twilight Sect had already surpassed 15 million.
Moreover, since the Dawn Sect had taken over Green City and subjugated the Centaurs, the number of Believers had also surged to 3 million and was expected to at least double in the near future.
Nearly 20 million Believers were now collectively bringing him an astronomical amount of Power of Faith every day.
At the moment, the Twilight Sect had over 12 million in Power of Faith, while the Dawn Sect had more than 6 million.
As a newly wealthy landowner, Lide instantly broke into a smile.
He felt capable once again.
His confidence swelled quickly, finally shedding the previous feeling of poverty.
Without hesitation, he took a step forward and instantly appeared above the twenty-first layer of the White Bone Altar.
He stood firmly next to the stone coffin and then slightly extended his right hand to touch the Angel Wings.
After making sure everything was in place, Lide took a deep breath as if the Power of Faith was bursting out like a dam bursting on a mountain.
The Angel Wings, receptive to this force, acted like a black hole devouring everything, greedily absorbing the Power of Faith.
With the addition of the Power of Faith, the black Angel Wings emitted a dim glow, slowly releasing a terrifying aura.
Although it was just a trace, it was enough to chill the heart of even the most steadfast veteran.
In the distance, obscured by fog, demons and the Undead near the White Bone Altar inexplicably felt a chill down their spines, instinctively distancing themselves from the altar even amid life-and-death battles.
It was an instinctual fear of life.
Noticing this change, Lide’s smile gradually broadened on his face.
His senses weren’t wrong; the Power of Faith indeed enhanced the power of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
He could distinctly feel that as the Power of Faith integrated, certain rules within the Angel Wings seemed to be completed.
However, the amount of Power of Faith needed to enhance a being like the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel was astronomical.
The Power of Faith accumulated by the Twilight Sect was completely depleted in less than ten minutes.
Lide, looking at the bottomless pit-like Angel Wings, could only grit his teeth and turn his attention to the 6 million Power of Faith of the Dawn Sect.
Even a rich landowner couldn’t sustain such extravagance... and he was poor once more.
However, it seemed that the person in question was a middle-aged woman in her forties, currently in great need; even tens of millions of Power of Faith were not enough for her.
With a tentative mindset, he began to channel the Power of Faith from the Dawn Sect and ultimately found that the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel was indiscriminate in its consumption, devouring the Power of Faith from the side of Light without care.
Several minutes later, just as the Power of Faith of the Dawn Sect was nearly drained, Lide finally sensed a saturated aura emanating from the Angel Wings.
Upon detecting this message, he then stopped.
However, after the infusion of the Power of Faith into the Angel Wings, it did not cause the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel to emerge immediately; instead, it plunged into a deeper transformation.
It was like hatching an egg.
Ten minutes, twenty minutes...
Two Sunshine Hours later, Lide’s brow slightly arched; after observing for two Sunshine Hours, he sensed that it would take at least three more days for the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel to complete its transformation.
He glanced down at the stone coffin beside him, waved his hand, and directly reinforced its seal with the Plane Power.
After ensuring there were no issues, he sat cross-legged on the White Bone Altar, waiting to witness the birth of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
But before long, he abandoned that idea; plans could never keep up with changes, and a message brought by Harrison made him immediately leave the Land of Bone-Burying.
Harrison, having the authority over the Land of Bone-Burying, could open a Space Gate and report to Lide as the head of the City Hall.
In the office of the City Hall, Lide looked at Harrison with a stern face.
"Are you saying that the Crimson Moon has sent a message, and cracks have also appeared in the skies of the Lost Plane?"
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Although Harrison did not understand why Lide was taking this matter so seriously, he still respectfully responded.
"The president of the Crimson Moon specifically marked the message with an extremely urgent seal, asking you to make a trip to the Crimson Moon immediately."
Lide’s eyes flickered uncertainly upon hearing the words, the Earth’s sky showing rule fractures... did that mean the Ancient Times could descend upon Earth?
When he received this news, his heart wasn’t as shocked as he had expected.
Because once he could summon Small Fireballs on Earth, he had been prepared for this.
However, he had to return to Earth immediately, regardless.
Cracks appearing in the sky carried enormous implications.
If the Ancient Times really did descend, could Earth resist those ancient monsters?
Lide did not have an answer.
His deep eyes looked toward Harrison.
"Harrison, when I attained the Legendary status, I found a way to enter the Lost Plane. The Lost Plane is critical, so I must make a trip there immediately."
"There’s something you must constantly monitor — the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel has completely Fallen.
She will awaken in three days. I will try to return within three days; if I do not return on time, you take care of her..."
Hearing Lide’s words, Harrison wasn’t surprised; from his perspective, the Lost Plane was merely an ordinary Plane, unique only in its great distance from the Main Plane, allowing those who came from there to be reborn.
Lide had even dared to occupy the Abyss; a Lost Plane was nothing daunting in comparison.
In contrast, the news of the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel excited him more.
"Everyone will follow your command, Your Majesty."
Lide gave Harrison a deep look and said no more, directly shattering the void before him, entering deeper into the Land of Bone-Burying and falling into a slumber, then directly returning to Earth.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 461: Establishing Dawn City on Earth, Returning to Glory (9400 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 460: Chapter 461: Establishing Dawn City on Earth, Returning to Glory (9400 words)
Lide opened his eyes, and the warm light of the bedroom appeared before him.
After sitting up, he moved his body slightly and turned to glance at the modern furniture around him, feeling an inexplicable sense of alienation.
Having gotten used to everything in "Glory," Earth made him feel somewhat disconnected.
Thinking about this, he couldn’t help but smile.
In "Glory," he was the Dawn’s Lord, holding the fate of millions in his hands, wielding immense authority, where a single command could compel millions of troops to lay down their lives for him.
On Earth, while he was also worth billions and controlled a large company with three or four thousand employees, viewed as a top-tier individual by outsiders, he was merely ordinary compared to Glory.
He slightly gathered his thoughts and stood up, walking to the floor-to-ceiling window in the bedroom. Whoosh—he gently pulled open the deep-colored velvet curtains, revealing the lush villa garden.
However, Lide wasn’t in the mood to admire the flowers. He slightly raised his head to look at the sky.
Under the brilliant sunlight, the sky was clear, yet a chilling scene emerged in such fine weather.
Spider-web-like cracks spread across the sky. Although much smaller than those in Glory’s sky, the psychological impact on people was tremendous.
This was Earth, the fundamental place for all players, and yet a scene from the game was manifesting here.
The impact on humanity was immense, and describing Earth as panicked would not be an exaggeration.
Lide took a deep breath, his eyes filled with complexity.
He could sense the ancient aura seeping out from the sky’s cracks. Although the cracks were small and the ancient aura leaking through was minimal, if this continued, Earth might face the same situation as Glory—ancient descent, the withering of all things.
Eventually, it might even lead to the descent of an evil god.
If those ancient deities appeared on Earth, how would this world stand against them?
Possibly with the strongest BOSS in nuclear weapons, Big Ivan?
His dark, deep eyes stared at the sky’s cracks for a long time without a word.
After a while, he finally sighed.
"Whether it’s a blessing or a curse, no matter what the future holds, we must face what is to come...
But the appearance of the sky cracks isn’t entirely bad. Influenced by them, Earth has already begun to change, for instance..."
With a slight thought, Lide took a step forward.
If anyone were watching, they would be dumbstruck, because the next second, he appeared hovering in the air outside the villa.
He stood aloft in the sky.
Like a deity.
Lide felt the magic power, though sparse, slowly circulating around him, his expression somewhat intricate.
"The invasion of the ancient aura has caused Earth’s rules to change, producing magic power.
Even though the current magic power is very thin, unable to compare with Glory, its significance is extraordinary."
Magic power was a very unique substance, invisible but indispensable, much like oxygen.
After pondering for a moment, with a thought, Lide’s body whoosh—suddenly ignited with a strong Power of Crimson.
A terrifying and intimidating aura burst forth from his body, spreading uncontrollably all around.
The surrounding flora and fauna, all life at that moment, ceased their activities, trembling in place.
It was the soul coercion from a higher life form, utterly unmatchable.
Feeling the power flowing inside him, Lide extended his right hand and snap—a snap of his fingers ignited a fiery red breath in front of him.
Like a black hole, that red breath instantly attracted a massive amount of surrounding magic power.
Then in mid-air, a bubbling Four Circle Magic—Magma Fireball—began to slowly condense.
The surrounding light distorted under the terrifying high temperatures, and an amazingly powerful force slowly took shape.
In the opposite villa’s yard, a husky raised by the homeowner seemed to sense something. It dashed out from the house into the yard, then barked frantically at Lide. After a few barks, it felt the aura was too horrifying and whimpered twice as it shivered and curled up under the eaves, staring at the forming fireball with a look of extreme terror, more comical than any meme.
Lide naturally wouldn’t bother with a husky; his own undead were even sillier than the husky...
His gaze fixed tightly on the magma fireball. This Four Circle Magic could be cast in less than a second after he had broken through to Legendary, but it was obviously impossible on Earth.
The magic condensation around him lasted a full three minutes until the magic power completely stopped, then his Four Circle Magic finally took shape.
The magma fireball floated in the air, like a mini sun, raising the surrounding temperature by at least ten degrees.
Feeling the relentless power within the fireball, Lide was not pleased.
"The power has decreased by about 30%, and the condensation time has increased from less than a second to three minutes... Now, my power on Earth is approximately equivalent to a Level 10 Advanced Mage of Glory. Not to mention Legendary, I can’t even reach a Level 15 Grand Mage."
A Level 10 Advanced Mage, same as his power when he first entered Glory.
"However, with the changes on Earth, it might not be long before I can regain my Transcendent power." Lide smiled. If he regained his Transcendent power, he wouldn’t need to worry about his own safety at all. With his abilities, unless facing Big Ivan directly, heavy artillery strikes would be ineffective against him.
However, another question intrigued him deeply; which of his bodies, Glory’s or Earth’s, was his true self? As he had broken through to Legendary, his body on Earth had also become a Blood Clan Ancestor like in Glory, ready to reveal his true Bloodline form on Earth whenever he wished.
If the rift on Earth continued to widen, would Glory connect with Earth, and if his true self could descend upon this region, would his body still sleep?
"Let it be, whether it’s an avatar or the true self, it’s all me, is there a need to decide which hand is more important? Would I chop off my right hand just because the left is more important?" Unable to find the answer, he couldn’t be bothered to think further. The boat will go straight to the bridge head naturally. His Legendary senses did not warn him, but he vaguely sensed this was a great opportunity. It seemed the union of the two worlds might be a chance for him...
"Ah... Ghost!!"
Below, a scream piercing through the sky snapped Lide back to reality, and he looked down to see an extremely beautiful young woman staring up at him in terror, obviously frightened.
Fortunately, it was broad daylight, or she might have been scared out of her wits at night.
Seeing this, Lide’s lips twitched. He had ignored outsiders, but now he immediately withdrew the Power of Crimson and waved his hand to dissolve the magma fireball. With a friendly smile, he greeted the girl, "Hello."
After the greeting, he stepped forward and his figure disappeared into thin air.
The girl below was terrified because she saw a mysterious figure glowing red and floating in the sky, but she didn’t expect that after he withdrew the red glow, he would be so handsome. Especially the smile and greeting at the end diminished much of her fear inside.
Once Lide disappeared, she slowly came back to her senses. "I didn’t think there would be such a handsome ghost... No, such a handsome young man can’t be a ghost, maybe he’s also a professional from Glory?"
The girl’s eyes lit up with the thought. Recently, with the appearance of the sky rifts, previously extraordinary players from Glory had shown remarkable talents. Many people had been seen performing feats like blowing up their neighbor Wang’s wall to drag out a wife, climbing up to the twentieth floor of a building alone at midnight to work overtime... and similar incidents were not uncommon.
It wasn’t strange anymore to see someone who could float in the air...
---
---
---
After returning to the villa, Lide quickly washed up and went straight to the underground garage of the villa, took an automated unmanned vehicle, and drove out.
He had been waging wars in Glory for a while and hadn’t returned to Crimson Moon for quite some time.
Communication with Zhao Yue and others was solely reliant on Glory’s communication channels.
Thinking about this company that he had high hopes for, but barely used a few times, Lide couldn’t help but feel a bit sentimental.
It wasn’t that Crimson Moon was unimportant, but rather, he was growing too fast, leading to Crimson Moon being of little help to him.
However, nearly two years had passed since the first public test, and after the Ancient Evil God’s descent, the experience players could gain greatly increased, and their levels soared.
The first batch of elite professional players trained by Crimson Moon had already reached level 10, maybe next war, they could utilize the players’ power.
Previously, when leading players into battles, those players could only serve as cannon fodder. Who were his opponents? Each one was a powerful map boss.
Underworld, Centaurs, Green City, Abyss, there weren’t many wars suitable for player participation.
But now, with players’ levels increased, things were completely different.
Ultimately, this world still spoke through strength; without strength, even truths were worthless.
After fastening his seatbelt, Lide glanced at his phone, which didn’t have many missed calls. Because there were communication channels in Glory, Zhao Yue and the others were not as urgently in need of contacting him, only a few calls were made in the past couple of days.
Not in a rush to contact Zhao Yue, he logged onto the official forum of Glory with a bit of curiosity.
Crimson Moon had a dedicated department watching the official forums 24 hours a day, compiling the most valuable news every week and sending it to him through Glory’s channels.
If he was away, Harrison would receive it, and Lide had instructed that Earth information must be adapted for Glory’s locals so they could understand, meaning Crimson Moon was also providing Dawn City with information.
Of course, the transmission of news was mutual, and the senior leaders of Crimson Moon would also receive intelligence provided by the Dawn City’s intelligence center. This complemented the communication channels between Earth and Glory.
This method had brought significant benefits to both parties.
At this moment, Glory’s official website forum had become a global focus, especially after the appearance of sky rifts, with various countries closely monitoring the forum at all times.
Posts were countless, with people posting frantically every second.
Lide glanced over, originally expecting these posts to be pessimistic, since the sky was cracking, but ultimately, he underestimated these internet trolls.
"Is there a Death Cannon? Doomsday’s coming, is there a big brother to blast one last Death Cannon, cry cry cry, like chubby, drip me, I weigh 320 pounds and have a waist circumference of 200."
"The world’s ending, I’m planning to build a shelter, started digging a basement yesterday, and broke through today, but this morning the downstairs neighbor came looking for me, and I realized I live on the second floor, wondering why last night I heard a woman calling useless stuff, couldn’t last three minutes..."
"Hahaha, get ready for destruction, foolish Earthlings. The great Galactic Dominator ruling the Kakabolo Star System is about to descend, everyone must die! But the god is merciful, now if you convert to our Kakabolo God Sect, you can safely survive the doomsday, those wanting to convert can contact me QQ489... referral fee only 80% now~"
"I think I’m getting stronger, what to do? Yesterday while being coquettish with my boyfriend, I accidentally punched him and sent him flying onto the wall, now he stubbornly wants to break up with me..."
"Holy crap, I cast the Small Fireball Skill, hahaha, I’m literally a fairy. The only problem is, I was having too much fun last night and accidentally burnt down the house, now I’m wondering which bridge is warmer in winter."
"..."
The various troll posts had Lide’s lips twitching, truly the world won’t perish as long as trolls exist.
However, there were also a few meaningful posts that gave him food for thought.
Among them, the post by the player known as the first player, Broken Sword Knight, had the highest value.
Broken Sword Knight: Haven’t posted for a long time, mainly want to discuss today about the sky rift and the arrival of the Ancient.
You all probably know about the rift that appeared in Earth’s sky, right?
If you are a spellcaster, you should clearly feel the ancient power emanating from the crack.
It goes without saying about this power, anyone who has entered Glory should know how terribly it can corrode life.
The only relief is that the ancient power is still very diluted at this moment, and it would need a long time to cause harm to Glory.
But foreseeably, in the not too distant future, Earth will invariably become increasingly dangerous.
Once the ancient power becomes dense to a certain degree, those infected ancient monsters will all become our common enemies.
You all should be aware of these dangers so I won’t talk too much, as for how to repair the rift, the only known method is to find the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
This is a message transmitted from the Sun Goddess, I’m not sure if it’s useful, because this item is too advanced, without being legendary, don’t think about getting involved.
If anyone gets a piece of the Destiny Tablet, please contact me. I am willing to send the most powerful army to protect you, and I could even have the Undead Monarch protect you!
Besides this, I want to discuss the connection between Glory and Earth with everyone.
If someone had previously said that Glory was a real world, I think most people wouldn’t have believed it.
People are more inclined to believe that this is black technology developed by our country, although this game can improbably enhance the physical abilities of players.
But now, whether Glory is a real world probably doesn’t need to be discussed anymore.
Then, the question arises, what connection is there between Glory, this multi-dimensional plane, and Earth?
Based on the information I have personally obtained, I have the following viewpoints for your reference.
First, Earth is a part of Glory. Just like the identities set up for us by Glory, Earth is a Lost Plane that also once belonged to Glory.
Now that Earth has reconnected with Glory, it has naturally attracted the attention of the Ancients. According to the information currently known, I believe this hypothesis fits very well.
Second, Glory was once a branch of Earth that disappeared for unknown reasons. Later, we found the way back—this way is through the game pods; each game pod is a spatial pathway to Glory.
However, eventually, for various reasons, the Ancient Evil God found Earth through these game pods, leading to the current situation.
This guess doesn’t have much factual basis and is purely my own conjecture based on the information I’ve obtained, so take it as you will.
Third, according to the official website of Glory, the purpose of limiting the release of game pods is to delay the arrival of the Ancient Days. This suggests that the arrival of the game pods is related to the Ancient Days coming. Could it then be assumed that the ancient days are bound to come, and that the officials of "Glory" also knew about this?
We can further speculate that the more people use game pods to enter Glory, the more likely it is to hasten the Ancient Days’ arrival.
The principle could be like spatial coordinates—the more players enter Glory, the more coordinates are left behind, making the connection between Glory and Earth more conspicuous, and thus easier for the Ancient Evil God to discover.
However, since the officials of "Glory" are aware of this, yet still allow us to enter Glory through game pods, then it must be that the arrival of the Ancient Days is inevitable. Since they’re coming anyway, might as well intensively train a group of players who can adapt to Glory.
Personally, I see a very high probability in the third point. If the official website could provide more explanations, I think it would be better.
Also, those of you who have different opinions about these points are welcome to discuss them.
The Ancient Days have come, and surely the future will change. If you want to prosper in this era of great strife, it will still depend on everyone’s own efforts.
There is no need to panic too much—Earth is not made of mud. When the time comes, bayonets will shine; who prevails over whom is still uncertain.
The replies below are numerous and number in the millions.
First floor: The big boss is indeed awesome, damn impressive! (voice crack)
Second floor: Holy shit, from what you’re saying, the officials of Glory really are deceiving us, hiding secrets even in these situations.
Third floor: I strongly suspect that Jian Sword is a staff member of the official team, otherwise how would he know so much?
Fourth floor: Big carving cute sister seeking a patron, can be cute, can be noble, can attack, can defend, can wear black silk or white silk...
Fifth floor: Great changes are imminent, alas, it’s hard to know whether they are good or bad for us.
Sixth floor: I heard the government is already counting the number of players, seems like they’re considering recruiting players into the army...
Seventh floor: So, Glory and Earth will be able to connect in the future? Holy shit, can I finally bring my kemonomimi to Earth?
...
After reading the post, Lide frowned. It had to be said that this sword’s knight, acclaimed as the top player, indeed had a keen sense no ordinary person could match.
These views had given him quite a few insights.
While Lide was delving deeper into the forum, the car quietly came to a stop.
"Master, we have reached the destination..."
The smart system automatically reported.
Lide, who was awakened, put down his phone, his face slowly regaining its calm.
No matter what shocking or bizarre events occurred, one core aspect never changed—power.
As long as you possessed power, no matter how the future changed, you could stand tall.
After composing himself, he opened the door and got out of the car.
—
—
—
As soon as Lide stepped out of the car, he saw the "Crimson Moon Club" sign. It was still working hours, so there weren’t many people entering the company.
Lide didn’t linger at the main entrance and directly walked into the company.
The receptionists, several tall and attractive girls, instantly lit up when they saw Lide.
Their faces lit up with excitement, and the most mature among them even wore a flirty smile.
"Mr. Lide, good afternoon."
"Mr. Lide, long time no see."
"Mr. Lide..."
As Lide listened to the chirpy voices, his expression remained unchanged and he nodded with a smile, leaving without uttering a word.
His graceful demeanor caused the receptionists to slow their breathing—a bit too handsome.
By the time his figure was almost out of sight, the girls burst into excited gossip.
"I told you Mr. Lide has the highest looks in the whole company, you didn’t believe me, now look at you all, eyes shining, like you want to devour him..."
"I heard Mr. Lide doesn’t have a girlfriend... Shall I introduce him to you?"
"Come on, do you think Mr. Lide would be interested in us? Just look at who Mr. Lide is, Crimson Moon is worth at least five billion now, he’s a top-tier tycoon..."
"Ah, it’s such a pity, the guys who pursue me, if only they had half of Mr. Lide’s looks or one-tenth of his wealth, I’d clean up and show up at his doorstep overnight..."
"Dream on, one-tenth of that wealth is still several hundred millions..."
A group of lively and attractive girls joking around attracted quite a few passing gentlemen, who were very interested. Some self-proclaimed handsome and successful men came forward to say hello and asked for WeChat contacts, but the outcomes were quite unsatisfactory.
With such brilliance before them, these originally decent men seemed dull and lackluster, leaving a few unsuccessful ones puzzled, completely unaware they had been outclassed...
The various departments of Crimson Moon were not located together, and the Professional Player Department even rented two additional buildings in this industrial park to accommodate enough space for gaming pods.
Lide was not planning to inspect other departments, striding with confidence, he headed straight to Zhao Yue’s office amidst respectful greetings along the way.
Although he hadn’t been to the company in a while, for the old staff, a boss as handsome as him was easy to recognize, no matter how long apart.
Being attractive and successful, it was odd not to draw attention.
Knock, knock, knock~
He gently knocked on the door of Vice President Zhao Yue’s office, looking at the door handle with a slightly weird expression, suddenly recalling the last time he had broken the handle...
Creak~
The door opened, and a round face with a hint of baby fat appeared.
"Mr. Lide?!" Cheng Lu’s eyes were full of surprise, "You actually came to the office..."
Lide, looking at his direct assistant, twitched the corner of his mouth. What do you mean, ’I actually came to the office’? It’s my company; I come whenever I want, right?
"You all have been working hard these days, the company operations are excellent, I am very satisfied."
"Mr. Lide, you always say that..."
Cheng Lu sounded a tad melancholic; she was Lide’s assistant, handling most of the work that Lide should have dealt with in his absence.
Correct content is on .
Effectively, she did the work of half a president but was still getting an assistant’s salary...
"Please come in first, Mr. Zhao is still in a meeting and hasn’t returned."
But who can complain when the other person is the boss, and the assistant salary was satisfying enough after all.
Lide smiled and stepped into the house, taking a seat on the sofa with Cheng Lu, who immediately began making tea.
Before he had even warmed the seat, a rapid tap-tapping sound of high heels approached from a distance.
Moments later, a fiery red figure entered through the open door.
Zhao Yue, dressed in a bright red business suit, was momentarily taken aback upon seeing Lide, but then approached him with great surprise and greeted him.
"Mr. Li, you’ve finally decided to come back."
Her tone, like Cheng Lu’s, carried a hint of playful resentment.
Lide, with his thick skin, pretended not to hear.
"Yes, the development of Crimson Moon has been quite good during this period, I’m relieved with you all here, please sit first."
He quickly changed the subject.
"What were you discussing in the meeting just now?"
When the conversation turned to business, Zhao Yue’s expression immediately turned serious. She stepped forward, opened a folder of meeting minutes, and placed it in front of Lide before sitting down.
"Mr. Li, the meeting just now was about discussing the next phase of Crimson Moon’s development.
As you know, the rift in the sky has had a huge impact on the entire human society, and Crimson Moon could not avoid it.
Even yesterday, official representatives specifically asked about our knowledge on the matter and also requested our assistance in the investigation, telling us to report any relevant information immediately..."
Lide’s expression sharpened slightly.
"So, the authorities are also unprepared for this event? Then who exactly developed ’Glory’?"
"From the personnel who questioned us, I really did not see any preparation on their part, though it could also be due to their low level.
The origin of Glory is still a mystery, the whole world is exploring, but I estimate that ’Glory’ really wasn’t developed by the officials.
Of course, it could also be a smoke screen released by the officials, and it might be difficult to ascertain in the short term..."
Lide nodded knowingly. If the officials had no knowledge of it, he wouldn’t believe it, but if it was entirely orchestrated by them, it would not be realistic either. With such technology and capabilities, they would have unified Earth and colonized the Milky Way long ago, rather than indulging in games.
"Let it be, this matter can’t be figured out by outsiders in the short term, we just need to stay updated.
For now, our task is to rally all the strength of Crimson Moon, striving to become even stronger before the great disaster arrives.
In the future, I want to make Crimson Moon so prominent that no one can ignore it, that nobody dares to ignore it..."
Seeing the fire in Lide’s eyes, Zhao Yue felt a shiver.
With Lide’s support, Crimson Moon developed at an unprecedented rate among all player guilds in Glory.
She deeply understood how exaggerated and terrifying this man’s influence in Glory was. Having dealt with Dawn City for a long time, she had almost deduced Lide’s true identity.
She was the vice-president of Crimson Moon, and her intelligence went without saying; a fool naturally could not have won Lide’s approval.
If, before the sky rift appeared, Lide’s power in Glory might not have been too impactful, but after the sky rift appeared, everything changed.
If a real connection between Glory and Earth were to materialize in the future, this man could potentially become one of the highest echelons of power, a person everyone would look up to.
Thinking of this, Zhao Yue slightly bowed her head, hiding the unusual gleam in her eyes.
Lide didn’t observe so closely; he was still contemplating the future developments of Crimson Moon.
Currently, without a doubt, Crimson Moon ranked first among all guilds in Glory, followed by the second-ranking, the Black Contract Guild, single-handedly founded by the second-generation Bloodline Stanley and prepared to colonize Earth.
He had a share in the Black Contract Guild to control the players, meaning he had control over the top two ranking player guilds.
Therefore, the power in his hands should not be underestimated.
However, how to best utilize this power was crucial; otherwise, it was just sitting idle, which was dull.
At that moment, Zhao Yue seemed to remember something and hesitated.
"Mr. Li, lately many major conglomerates have been wanting to acquire Crimson Moon... because we’ve developed too well, those conglomerates can’t compare to us."
"Acquisition?" Lide furrowed his brows.
"Yes, I rejected it outright, but I’m worried that some people might use other influences to pressure us, especially after the appearance of the sky rift."
Zhao Yue’s expression was somewhat grave, "So during this period, you must be careful about your safety."
Lide nodded slightly.
Those conglomerates had their reasons for wanting to buy out Crimson Moon; it wasn’t that they hadn’t invested a substantial amount of money, but rather their limitations prevented them from developing further.
After all, not everyone could get full support from the Crimson Mage Tower, a pivotal force in Green City, like Crimson Moon did right from the start.
In fact, right after the public beta of the game, when players realized the game could influence reality, many large conglomerates began to pour substantial funds into the game.
But the wealth of these conglomerates on Earth was immense, yet they couldn’t convert it into power within Glory. They wanted to exchange money, but which player had money to exchange at the beginning?
Crimson Moon was different, with a tycoon like Lide, resources were not an issue.
Together with the support from Anos City, the main city of the players, it was no exaggeration to say that Crimson Moon was absolutely the top-ranking among all player guilds, unrivaled by any.
However, this news did spark a bold idea in him...
Zhao Yue didn’t give him time to speak and continued.
"Whatever changes occur, our own strength is the most crucial."
"So we plan to expand our professional players again soon, aiming to increase the number of professional players to 8,000..."
8,000 people?
Lide glanced at Zhao Yue. This was no small number.
Currently, after several expansions, Crimson Moon had not yet reached 4,000 members, including the other two departments — the Data Analysis Department and the Game Commodity Trading Department.
But that still wasn’t enough to satisfy his appetite...
"No problem, we can take bigger steps and expand directly to 10,000 people.
We can massively recruit those players who already have a certain base, and we must make them sign contracts with us in both reality and the game."
Lide spoke and directly increased the number to 10,000 people.
It wasn’t that he didn’t want to recruit more, but the environmental constraints on Earth.
The loyalty of the personnel, various treatments, and all sorts of messy issues were very troublesome; recruiting too many hands could be very difficult to manage. A scale of tens of thousands was already dramatic enough.
Professional players on Earth were not like the native inhabitants of Glory; just paying them salaries was far from sufficient.
Crimson Moon’s current model was to recruit full-time professional players as the core, then mainly part-time professional players who could not come to work at Crimson Moon but had signed contracts, and lower-level players or those who had not signed contracts as a reserve force.
At this moment, the entire guild of Crimson Moon had already surpassed 400,000 members, but only a few thousand were core players.
After the catastrophe of the ancient disaster, the small towns around the southern province were destroyed, and those scattered players began to gather towards the major cities, with Green City and Anos City, the player main city, being the focal points for players around the Nolan Empire.
Now, Anos City had squeezed in over a million players, who, upon arrival, would selectively join certain guilds in search of shelter or benefits, and Crimson Moon, being the most powerful player guild, naturally absorbed the most people.
"Yes, Mr. Li, I will arrange this immediately," Zhao Yue nodded.
After contemplating for a moment, Lide voiced the bold idea that had just surfaced.
"Mr. Zhao, the ancient days have already eroded Earth, and the future may bring many unpredictable threats.
We need to prepare early."
Zhao Yue was slightly stunned, "What do you mean?"
"Immediately arrange for someone to buy a piece of land in the suburbs and build our Crimson Moon headquarters.
After all, with so many significant guilds, we should have a headquarters of our own instead of always renting someone else’s building."
Lide said meaningfully.
"In the future, this headquarters might shelter us through crises."
"Indeed, that’s the logic..."
Although it was said to be building headquarters, Zhao Yue instantly understood Lide’s true intentions.
Establishing headquarters was real, but the main goal was to build a base truly belonging to the Crimson Moon to resist the unknown cataclysm.
Such a base was simply impossible to have within the city.
Seeing Zhao Yue understood, Lide couldn’t help but give a slight smile, dealing with intelligent people was straightforward.
"How much funds do we still have on the books?"
"One hundred and twenty-eight billion..."
Hearing Zhao Yue’s reported figure, Lide’s face was filled with surprise.
More than one hundred billion in cash??
That was no small figure.
Seeing Lide’s puzzled look, Zhao Yue gently explained.
"Mr. Li, due to the approaching of the ancient disaster, players have a strong demand for weapons, equipment, and magic scrolls, but they lack the currency in Glory.
So, our game merchandise trading department set up a website for cash transactions of Glory items, and we directly sold equipment to players in RMB, which brought us significant income during this period..."
Hearing this, Lide could not help but remark on the players’ spending power.
Hundreds of billions of fund, and all in such a short time? That was even faster than what he made from selling Gold Puck.
"Alright, let’s go ahead with the arrangements then. Once a suitable location is chosen, spare no expense, I want to see our headquarters completed in the shortest time."
"Additionally, Earth has magic now, I will find some diagrams of advanced magic arrays in Glory for you, have someone confirm if we can build it on Earth."
"Mr. Li, trust me, I won’t let you down."
Zhao Yue smiled confidently, the voluptuous woman now exuding a formidable aura.
Lide nodded.
Since the cataclysm had arisen and nobody could stop it, they might as well face it with the strongest posture.
If he could establish Dawn City in Glory, why couldn’t he do the same on Earth?
"One last thing, prepare to arrange matters for the players of the Crimson Moon. Next, I will harness the power of the Crimson Moon."
An army built over a thousand days is for a moment of battle.
The sword that he had forged, the Crimson Moon, was also time to be unsheathed.
"Mr. Li, all personnel of the Crimson Moon are at your command," Zhao Yue said with a gentle smile, her demeanor resolute.
As a top assassin who had already reached level 14, she never feared battle.
"Very good."
Lide smiled contentedly.
"Report to me now if there’s anything else that needs my attention, in two days I’m returning to ’Glory’, with other important matters awaiting me..."
Zhao Yue had guessed Lide’s identity by now and naturally knew what mattered most, immediately starting to report.
In the following two days, Lide appeared punctually in the office building of the Crimson Moon, diligently dealing with the backlog of trivial issues.
This made many girls eager to try their luck, frequently finding excuses to approach him.
However, to the girls’ disappointment, in just two short days, their perfect idol had once again disappeared, which left those girls lamenting... why couldn’t such a handsome man belong to them?
After the busy two days, Lide handed over the task of establishing the Crimson Moon’s main base to Zhao Yue, then directly returned to Glory.
The Twelve-winged Blazing Angel was about to emerge... His anticipation was profound, and he couldn’t afford to miss such an important event.

chapters.content:
Chapter 461: Chapter 462 (Anti-Piracy Chapter, Do Not Subscribe) Level 36 - Death Burning Angel, Soon to Set Foot on the Summit of Dawn City
(This is an anti-theft Chapter, do not subscribe; it will be replaced in ten minutes, posted at 00:35 and replaced at 00:45.)
Harrison, although not understanding why Lide was taking the matter so seriously, still replied respectfully.
"The chairman of the Crimson Moon specifically marked the message with a stamp of extreme urgency, requesting that you must go to the Crimson Moon immediately."
Upon hearing this, Lide’s eyes flickered uncertainly. The appearance of a rift in Earth’s sky... Does it signify that the Ancient Ones might descend upon Earth?
When he received this news, his heart had not been as shocked as one might imagine.
Because the moment he could summon a Small Fireball on Earth, he had already prepared himself for this.
Nevertheless, he had to return to Earth immediately.
The emergence of a rift in the sky bore too significant a meaning.
If the Ancient Ones really descended, could Earth withstand the monsters of the old days?
Lide had no answer to this.
His deep eyes turned to Harrison.
"Harrison, when I broke through to Legendary status, I found a way to enter the Lost Plane. The Lost Plane is critical, so I must go there immediately."
"There’s something you must keep a constant eye on—the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel has completely fallen.
She will awaken in three days, and I will try my best to return within these three days. If I do not make it back, you must appease the other party..."
Hearing Lide’s words, Harrison wasn’t surprised after all; in his view, the Lost Plane was just an ordinary plane, its only specialty being that it was far from the Main Plane, and those who came from there could be reborn.

Lide couldn’t help but marvel at the players’ willingness to spend money.
Over a hundred billion in funds, in such a short time? Even quicker than what he earned from selling Gold Puck.
"Alright, then arrange it. Once a good location has been chosen, spare no expense—I want to see our headquarters completed in the shortest time possible."
"Additionally, with magic power now present on Earth, I will find some layouts for advanced magic arrays within Glory for you, and you will send someone to confirm if they can be built on Earth."
"Trust me, Mr. Li, I won’t let you down,"
Zhao Yue assured him with a confident smile, embodying the poise of a strong woman at that moment.
Lide nodded his head.
Since the Calamity was inevitable, and could not be stopped, they would face it with the strongest posture.
He had established Dawn City within Glory, so why couldn’t he build one on Earth as well?
"One last thing, get the players of the Crimson Moon ready. Next, I will mobilize the power of the Crimson Moon."
For every day soldiers are trained, there comes a time to use them.
The Crimson Moon, the blade he had forged, was ready to be unsheathed.
"Mr. Li, all personnel of the Crimson Moon are at your command at all times," Zhao Yue smiled calmly, her spirit showing her valiance.
As a top-level assassin already at level 14, she never shied away from battle.
"Good,"
Lide said with a satisfied smile.
"Report to me now any other matters that I need to handle, as I will return to Glory in two days to attend to important issues..."
Zhao Yue had guessed Lide’s identity and naturally understood what was more pressing—she started her report promptly.
In the following two days, Lide unusually showed up on time at the Crimson Moon’s office building, earnestly dealing with the backlog of trivial matters.
This caused many of the female staff to become eager, frequently finding excuses to approach him.
But to the disappointment of these women, the man they saw as the perfect male god disappeared again after just two short days, leaving them wringing their hands in regret... wondering why such a handsome man could not belong to them?
After busying himself for two days, Lide entrusted the establishment of the Crimson Moon’s main base to Zhao Yue and then returned directly to Glory.
The Twelve-winged Blazing Angel was about to emerge... He was full of anticipation and absolutely did not want to miss such an important event.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 463: The King’s Style, A Laugh and Joke, A Great General Slays the Divine (13,000 Words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 462: Chapter 463: The King’s Style, A Laugh and Joke, A Great General Slays the Divine (13,000 Words)
No one knew how many Fierce Half-Ratmen had gathered around Green City at that moment.
In the sky, on the ground, one could no longer see any traces of other beings when sweeping their eyes over the area.
Only these monstrously grotesque Ancient Monsters, with their fearsome claws and fangs, filled the space between heaven and earth.
One after another, densely packed, they resembled a once-in-a-millennium swarm of locusts devouring the earth.
Everything around them faded into darkness at that moment, with light becoming the most luxurious commodity.
On the walls of Green City, many veteran soldiers who saw this cataclysmic scene immediately looked extremely upset.
Some new recruits, just called up, were faring even worse; their legs were trembling, and they could hardly grip their weapons.
The pressure from the Fierce Half-Ratmen, surging like a colossal tidal wave, was overwhelming.
It was as though they were standing beneath a collapsing mountain, looking up at boulders tumbling down—a truly breathtaking and suffocating sight.
"By the Goddess above, why are there so many damn Ancient Monsters?"
"Quick, go notify Duke O’Kelly!!"
"Great God of Dawn, your humble believers pray to you, beseeching you to send down divine punishment to save your people..."
"Goblin bomb trucks, get ready!
Archers, get ready!
Once the enemy approaches within 500 blades’ distance, fire immediately!"
"..."
Roars, curses, and screams of terror created considerable chaos on the walls of Green City for a short while.
Anyone facing such an overwhelming number of enemies would feel their resolve waver.
However, contrary to the natives, the players were extremely excited.
"Damn, I didn’t sign up for the city guard for nothing. With so many monsters, it’d be outrageous not to level up a good three to five times."
"Here stands Xue Rengui, number 55 from the eighth squad of Qingshan Village, Hezi Village. Who dares to challenge me? Just watch me settle the mountains with three arrows! When their boss shows up, no bragging, but I’ll take him down with three arrows!"
"Quick, go to the West to invite the Buddha... no, wait, wrong script, go to the Dawn Temple to summon Lord Ilo!!"
"Damn, who the hell is touching my butt? I might be wearing a skirt, but I’m a man!!"
"..."
As time passed, the level of the players had significantly increased, making them a force that could not be ignored.
Green City even had a special squad composed of players who were ready to meet their deaths... though officially, they were called the Fearless Squadron, and only the bravest warriors could join.
As the Fierce Half-Ratmen drew closer from the distance, the previously noisy city walls gradually quieted down.
Even the players, upon seeing the ghastly visage of the Fierce Half-Ratmen surging like a tsunami, felt immense pressure.
Green City was the largest city in the southern provinces, and if it were breached, most of its residents would have nowhere to go.
Nearby was Anos City, but this player city could only accommodate a million people, and their presence there wouldn’t yield much benefit...
"Make way, Duke O’Kelly is arriving!!"
With the excited shout of one warrior, many people on the wall turned their heads simultaneously towards the entrance of the wall.
Moments later, a figure clad in black armor, whose hair had gone gray but who carried an imposing aura, stepped onto the towering city wall under the escort of guards.
"Duke..."
Wherever Duke O’Kelly passed, soldiers saluted.
At that moment, Duke O’Kelly had no time to concern himself with these trifles. He quickly walked to the main section of the wall above the city gate and leaned over to look out.
After seeing the overwhelming sea of Fierce Half-Ratmen, Duke O’Kelly’s blue eyes narrowed, his expression grave.
"Isa, has the military report been delivered to His Lordship?"
The middle-aged military officer behind him nodded.
"The report has been sent. His Lordship should have received it by now.
Duke, His Lordship hasn’t returned yet, please issue the order for war!"
Hearing this, Duke O’Kelly looked intently at the officer but said nothing. What command could he give?
He was currently the deputy speaker of the City Hall, responsible for public safety, not warfare... he had no authority over it.
This thought complicated his feelings...
But he harbored no resentment; with his wisdom, he naturally wouldn’t be dissatisfied over these matters. That he still held the title of deputy speaker was already considered a mark of esteem; otherwise, like those disobedient nobles, being purged would only be a command away.
Just as Duke O’Kelly reached the wall, a group with bat wings flew horizontally across the sky.
The sharp fangs, blood-red eyes, and wings of bats—all unmistakably identified them as Vampires.
Previously, if a Vampire dared to appear in Green City, they would be killed on sight for use as magic materials.
But at that moment, everyone only felt awe and fear.
For these Bloodline members had been subdued by the great Lord Ilo, becoming a power defending Green City.
The integration of the Bloodline into Green City initially caused some panic, but after all, these were Lord Ilo’s subordinates—who would dare say a half word?
However, the residents were no longer as frightened of the Bloodline, as these Vampires were not killers by nature. The blood they needed was openly purchased with Gold Puck, and they were quite generous.
Even the initial blood drawing had caused quite a stir, but later, when the commoners realized donating blood was safe and even profitable, their attitude towards the Bloodline significantly softened.
