Only the stubborn devout followers of certain sects continued to harbor malice towards the Bloodline, but that was all. Although not many Bloodline members came to Green City, they were all profoundly strong and feared no one.
Frey, a Second-generation Bloodline of level 25, had now been appointed by Lide as the deputy speaker of Green City and the supreme commander of the city’s army.
His Legendary-level power was in full display on the city wall.
The terrifying aura rolled like thunder from the sky, surging outward in all directions.
"All troops, enter Level 1 battle readiness.
All commanders execute military orders according to the plan.
People of Green City, we should not panic, for the Glory of Dawn envelops us.
Protected by His Highness, no one can breach our city walls!
No one can defeat us!
No one can desecrate His Highness’s Dignity!
For Dawn, the whole army shall meet the battle!!"
The firm and confident voice reverberated throughout Green City, amplified by magic.
The atmosphere, once frozen, burgeoned in an instant; warriors were no longer afraid, residents no longer terrified, and officers no longer lost, as everyone’s morale soared.
Yes, although those ancient monsters were numerous, they weren’t any better.
Not only did they have high walls for protection, but they also had Lord Ilo overseeing from the rear!
The radiance of Dawn shone on them, and Green City could not possibly fall!
Duke O’Kelly observed Frey, whose few words had greatly boosted morale, and took a deep breath.
The era of Dawn had indeed arrived...
At the same time, his spirit was also revitalized.
Since the Bloodline could be appreciated by His Highness Ilo, he might well be reused and lead the troops into battle once again!
He wanted everyone to know that he, O’Kelly Nolan, the man who once ruled the entire southern province, was not yet dead.
"Follow the Commander’s orders, everyone prepare for battle!"
"Sound the horns..."
"Ready the arrows..."
Whoo-whoo~
Accompanied by the war horns of Earth City, the Fierce Half-Ratmen, as they stepped into a 500-blade distance from Green City, suddenly switched from normal marching to all-fours.
Then, like cheetahs hunting wild beasts, their muscles taut, bearing savage expressions full of bloodlust, they charged furiously toward the city walls.
The flying Half-Rat men in the sky also increased their speed at the same time.
The slaughter was about to begin.
Boom-boom~
When an uncountable number of Fierce Half-Ratmen charged simultaneously, the ground shook as if a dragon were passing under it, quivering and wailing.
Even standing on the city walls, one could feel that vibration.
The city walls of Green City, reaching 50 blades high and 30 blades wide, constructed over a millennium, had become incredibly solid, almost indestructible.
"Goblin bomb trucks ready, fire!!"
Following the orders from various commanders, the goblin bomb trucks in the rear began clattering, their Magic Arrays emitting magic fluctuations.
Whoosh-whoosh~ Thousands of Alchemy Bombs, carrying powerful inertia, traced long arcs in the sky and finally crashed thunderously into the midst of the Fierce Half-Ratmen army.
Boom~
The ground shook.
Flames erupted skyward at that moment.
The dense mass of Fierce Half-Ratmen turned into straw in a storm, directly shredded by the explosive blast and mixed with soil, splattering up over ten blades high.
Death spread, and the Death God’s scythe ruthlessly harvested lives.
The high-flame properties of specific Alchemy Bombs splashed outward following the explosion.
The unquenchable fire-contaminated Fierce Half-Ratmen burned these ancient monsters into ash, filling the air with the stench of scorched hair.
Those Alchemy Bombs designed to kill with shrapnel were even more ruthless, as sharp fragments, propelled by the terrifying force of the explosion, shot outward.
The bodies of Fierce Half-Ratmen simply couldn’t withstand such high-speed fragments, as their bodies were pierced like paper, with a single piece of shrapnel often taking down four or five Fierce Half-Ratmen.
The exaggerated killing power of the Alchemy Bombs forcibly halted the savage advance of the Fierce Half-ratmen, like a giant hand restraining a titanic wave.
An area of the locust-like scene was cleared.
Upon witnessing this, the morale of the warriors atop the walls surged drastically, and only the expressions of gamers who witnessed this scene were incredibly varied.
"Holy sh*t, what is this thing?? Do these natives have no sense of martial virtue?? Damn, it’s already bad enough with magic, now they’ve even brought out bombs, is there any way for good people to survive?"
"I want to report these people for cheating!! I’m still using a bow and arrow, and you’re bombarding with cannons?!"
"This is too much, what is this thing??"
"A bunch of ignorants, you don’t know about Alchemy Bombs, 30 Gold Pucks each, available in stores... Damn, 30 Gold Pucks each? This salvo fired at least a few thousand bombs, ain’t that tens of thousands of Gold Pucks? Over a hundred million RMB?
This is fighting a war with Gils, this is literally burning money..."
Many players were seeing the effect of Alchemy Bombs fired simultaneously for the first time and were instantly stunned.
They had seen the power of magic, but the power of Alchemy Bombs still made their hearts tremble.
But after the first round of volleys, the goblin bomb trucks did not continue the artillery suppression.
While Alchemy Bombs were powerful, they also had a major flaw—too costly.
Though possessing three medium-sized Magic Crystal veins after capturing Green City, Dawn City still couldn’t afford unrestricted bombardment.
Even Lord Lide often sighed after tallying the Alchemy Bomb consumption post-battle; it’s no wonder the Alchemy civilization disappeared hundreds of millions of years ago—such resource consumption was exaggerated.
Without sufficient power, it is hard to sustain; the Alchemy civilization was so powerful, how many resources did it consume annually? Its destruction was not without reason.
After the artillery ceased, the Fierce Half-Ratmen, altered by the power of ancient times and devoid of fear and pain, surged forward again.
That trait alone, fearless of death, was enough to chill anyone’s spine.
"Archers, ready! Fire!"
Though the alchemy bombs had ceased their barrage, the sniping from atop the walls had not stopped.
The archers, long prepared, immediately drew their bows upon receiving the command and released their arrows at the Fierce Half-Ratmen now within a mere hundred blades’ distance.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh~
The sky was instantly engulfed by a dark cloud made of arrows.
The exaggerated number of arrows was so great that they even blocked the light.
Nearby players also fired off arrows, and with their skills, even those who were not archers could manage to procure crossbows for the attack, for Glory did not employ any weapon penalty system; as long as one was capable, even a warrior could cast spells.
The spellcasters on the walls recognized their cue and released the magic they had long prepared.
In a moment, various colors of magical light sparkled, complementing the arrows from the archers—a spectacle no epic movie could replicate.
Boom boom boom~
A flurry of lights and shadows.
Below, the Fierce Half-Ratmen fell like harvested wheat.
In this horrific onslaught, the Fierce Half-Ratmen suffered terrible losses; these ancient creatures were so numerous, there was no need to aim to kill them randomly.
This excited the players atop the walls who began to fire their bows frantically; after all, these were living ’experience babies’...
But such a large-scale war was never settled in a short time.
Though many had died, the Fierce Half-Ratmen were incomprehensibly numerous and still surged forth like a tide.
As time passed, the ground below was carpeted with corpses, and more and more Fierce Half-Ratmen reached the base of the walls.
However, these creatures faced an insurmountable problem—they could not cross the wall.
Fortified with magic from a millennium of construction, Green City’s walls were utterly unscalable.
Realizing this, the soldiers immediately felt relieved and prepared to continue the slaughter.
But the good times didn’t last long; not much time had passed before the faces of those fighters grew grim once again.
For some unknown reason, the Flying Half-Ratmen behind had mobilized...
There were even more Flying Half-Ratmen than Fierce Half-Ratmen; while the ground presents a flat surface that can only hold so many, the sky is three-dimensional.
Therefore, when the Flying Half-Ratmen attacked, cloaking the city like a black cloud, the soldiers atop the walls instantly felt immense pressure.
Archers promptly shifted their targets from the ground to mid-air.
The threat of the Flying Half-Ratmen also caused the Air Force Commander to frown; shortly thereafter, over thirty thousand members of Green City’s Pegasus Army took flight to meet the challenge.
Accompanying this, thousands of Magic Language Bats also took to the sky, guarding the airspace of Green City.
Just as the aerial battle was about to ignite.
Suddenly, a shockingly powerful wave emanated from behind the Fierce Half-Ratmen.
Boom boom boom~
Like a nuclear explosion, a horrifying sound burst in everyone’s ears, shocking the heavens and the earth.
Next, a daunting force, invincible in nature, hurtled toward Green City.
Where it passed, the earth shattered, giant rocks and soil were thrown a hundred blades high and then crashed down, a vision of apocalyptic destruction.
The Fierce Half-Ratmen were crushed into a pulp as if they were made of paper.
When that force neared Green City, the army atop the walls finally saw that it was a phantom of a giant rat, its sheer size a hundred blades tall, seemingly shattering the heavens and earth beneath it.
Although the first to suffer the damage were the Fierce Half-Ratmen,
the people atop the walls turned pale.
"Quick, move away from this section of the wall!"
But the order came too late.
In mere moments, before many could even react, the phantom rat a hundred blades high traversed time and space, arriving like a mythical god, colliding with the wall in an unconquerable manner.
Boom boom boom~ The sky and earth collapsed.
The solid wall, faced with this catastrophic force, was like a dam made of mud.
It shattered instantaneously.
Even the giant stones used in the wall’s construction, each dozens of blades high, were flung a thousand blades’ distance by the enormous force, crushing dozens before finally coming to a violent stop.
Looking toward the section of wall struck by the giant rat, the surrounding thousand blades’ distance had become a death zone.
The shattered chunks of the wall scattered like thrown sand; as the huge rocks pummeled from the sky, there was no escape, nowhere to run.
A gory mess.
The horrific catastrophe continued for a full minute before slowly subsiding.
When the surrounding soldiers regained their senses, they collectively gasped in shock.
Green City’s wall had collapsed!
The solid wall had been shattered for a segment a hundred blades long by the giant rat’s impact.
This terrifying scene left many warriors in utter shock.
What level of force could shatter a wall that extended a hundred blades’ length?
This was a wall fifty blades high and thirty blades thick, engraved with numerous magic arrays, even more solid than a mountain!
"Is it just destroyed like this??"
The surrounding commanders turned pale, suddenly remembering something, and hurriedly blew the horns for help.
The city walls had collapsed, and those damned Ancient Monsters would definitely not sit idly by!
The real battle was just beginning!
As expected, the path that had just been cleared by the giant rat was immediately filled by the nearby Fierce Half-Ratmen.
The fearless Ancient Monsters charged into the breach in the walls in the most brutal manner, determined to destroy everything in this world!
The surviving warriors, seeing the dense crowd of Fierce Half-Ratmen appear on the broken walls, immediately felt their hair stand on end...
Everyone knew that the real battle of flesh and blood had begun.
Wuu wuu~~
The urgent sound of the horns for help rang out, and the army, recovering from the shockwave, began to rush to support at top speed.
However, in this brief period, many Fierce Half-Ratmen had already surged onto the ruins of the walls.
Warriors in thick armor roared fiercely as they collided directly with the divine servants who feared no death.
Instantly, the sound of clashing, roaring, and screaming, along with the unique chaos of the battlefield, turned the land into a bloody slaughterhouse.
The fight quickly escalated to its most intense point.
Limbs shattered, and blood splattered everywhere.
Warriors on both sides of the walls also frantically shot to try to stop the Fierce Half-Ratmen flooding from the collapsed walls.
But these Ancient Monsters were simply too numerous, and with the addition of the flying Half-Ratmen, they seemed endless.
As the situation grew increasingly dire, the Alchemy Bomb Launchers once again roared into action, rumbling explosively and deafeningly.
The violent Fierce Half-Ratmen were finally forcibly stopped in their tracks by the barrage of fire.
"President Yue, we are assigned to defend the right side of the city gate, and the situation is extremely urgent now, those Ancient Monsters have already breached the collapsed wall..."
Zhao Yue, who had just logged on urgently after hearing about the Ancient Monsters attacking Green City, looked very grave after hearing his subordinate’s report.
"Immediately gather all the core players stationed in Green City, we are going into battle right now."
Player’s main cities, Anos City and Green City, were currently the only two large cities left in the southern province. The other cities were either too small or had already been captured, so the main forces of Crimson Moon were in these two cities.
Upon receiving this order, several players immediately went down to convey the message, and soon, thousands of Level 10 players began assembling, advancing towards the walls.
——
——
——
"I have already smelled the decay of the Ancient..."
"Gaga, the great Lord Withered Bones has arrived..."
"What an exciting battlefield indeed..."
"Master, do you need me to take action? These filthy rats should be purified by my Dragon Breath!"
High above, amidst continuous chatter, Lide gazed down at the landscape from more than ten kilometers away from Green City.
From a distance, the scene was more magnificent than any mythical war described by wandering poets.
Green City stood like a majestic lion on the land, grand and imposing.
But at this moment, this lion was under attack by a swarm of ants that blotted out the sky; a single ant was insignificant.
But ants that covered the sky like a storm, even a lion as majestic as a rock, faced the risk of being overturned by a towering storm.
At this time, the Fierce Half-Ratmen had just launched their attack, and because there were too many of them, they completely occupied the view in front of Green City while the back of Green City remained untouched.
Lide, watching from a far distance on the side of the battlefield, could clearly see the sky divided by Green City into a stark contrast.
One side was overtaken by the blackness of Fierce Half-Ratmen, the other retained its untouched brightness.
Green City had become the shield against the dark invasion.
Archers and spellcasters on the walls erupted in a burst of colorful attacks, adding a few touches of color to the dim environment.
Of course, these colors were beautiful but also deadly. With each fluctuation of magic, a slew of Fierce Half-Ratmen fell, greatly alleviating the pressure on the army.
From an outsider’s perspective, this scene was far more thrilling than any blockbuster movie.
But the battle quickly shifted; under Lide’s gaze, a giant rat phantom rose from the depths of the Fierce Half-Ratmen and charged toward the wall.
Boom—The originally perfect defensive line instantly exploded with a massive breach.
The two sides clashed in close quarters.
The Fierce Half-Ratmen immediately abandoned the idea of climbing other walls and surged directly through the lengthy breach.
Bang~ Bang~ Bang~
Alchemy Bombs exploded again, with the breached section of the wall at the center, terrifying shockwaves tore the earth apart, sending countless chunks of flesh flying.
Seeing this, Lide couldn’t help but shift his gaze to the rear of the Fierce Half-Ratmen, cleared by the giant rat.
The moment that mysterious being who released the giant rat took action, he sensed an all-too-familiar presence.
The Ancient Evil God—God of Plague.
At this moment, Freyja Dusk, the Level 36 Death Blazing Angel guarding Lide, quietly flapped her pure black wings closer to Lide.
Although she did not deliberately exude any dignity, her mere presence made the bones under Lide’s feet tremble, and she did not dare to utter a word.
A Level 26 Legendary and a Level 36 Medium Divine Power God, a ten-level difference meant a combat power disparity of more than a hundred times.
"Lord, those Ancient Monsters hide a revolting Ancient Evil God.
Shall I hunt it down for you?"
Lord Withered Bones shuddered upon hearing these words, the Soul Fire blazing fiercely in his hollow eye sockets.
At this moment, this undead felt as if he had seen his idol...
Listen to those words, that’s an Evil God who commands tens of millions of servants, speaking of hunting down his opponent.
His great Lord Withered Bones only dared to strike at the Ancient Monsters below...
Lide turned to glance at Freyja, who had already lifted the black Cross Longsword in her hand, his expression one of great pleasure.
This is what a qualified subordinate looks like, ready to fight the ultimate boss at a word’s notice, perfectly to his taste.
If it weren’t for the fact that this Death Blazing Angel was really not suitable for riding, he would actually like to try the feeling of riding an angel... It must be more comfortable than standing on this chatterbox.
"No need to rush, just wait..."
Lide didn’t hurry to make a move, as for now only the God of Plague, an Evil God had appeared; whether the opponent had ambushes or backup was unknown.
Rushing in like this, while heroic, was also very dangerous...
Behind the Fierce Half-Ratman.
Enveloped in a dense Ancient Fog, only a shadowy figure of the God of Plague could be seen, his aura incredibly ferocious at this moment.
"God of the New Sun..."
"I will devour the souls of all your believers, severing the sources of your power..."
"Send in the Giant Rat Army!"
The Evil Ancient Profanity was instantly transmitted, and the high-level servants enveloped in the Old Day’s aura immediately began to carry out the orders.
Soon, tens of thousands of giant rats, each 8 spans tall and 15 spans long, like small mountains, burst forth from the Fierce Half-Rat Men.
The army guarding the city changed their expressions dramatically when they saw the Giant Rat Army, more fierce and exaggerated than giant beasts.
"Enemy attack!!"
Whizz, whizz, whizz~
Arrows from the surrounding walls shot out like there was no cost, and though hitting the giant rats wasn’t an issue, their thick hides meant that even turning them into porcupines didn’t inflict fatal damage.
Instead, the pain fueled the giant rats’ fury as they surged towards the inside of the city walls.
The damaged walls had initially been blocked by the army, but once the giant rats joined the fight, the army started to suffer heavy casualties.
The size difference was too great, and each giant rat was incredibly at Level 15; the army simply couldn’t cope.
As hundreds and thousands of giant rats breached the city walls, the surrounding guard troops immediately began to disintegrate.
They were unmatched.
Seeing the situation deteriorate, the top-tier warriors of Green City who had remained hidden finally stopped holding back.
Frey, a second-generation Bloodline who had reached Level 25 Legendary, took the lead, soaring in the sky, his Bloodline Magic firing like a machine gun.
A giant rat often didn’t last three seconds before it would bleed out and be magically killed.
Although the Giant Rat Army was powerful, it had a major flaw—its massive size lacked agility.
This flaw was insignificant against low-level troops since they were tough and resilient, but to top-tier warriors, it was lethal.
Frey alone was quickly holding back the impact of the Giant Rat Army, a testament to the power of a Legendary warrior.
Other top forces were not idle, each lending their aid at this time.
Level 25 Legendary—Stanley,
Level 20 Transcendent—Valkyrie Betty,
Even Vina and Isa, who had both reached Level 20 Transcendent, were casting spells from afar on a high tower for support.
In addition to them, Lord Withered Bones, who was commanded by Lide and had reached Level 20 Transcendent—Heart-Eating Demon Wales, fought at the front line.
The inclusion of these powerful combatants immediately stabilized the shaking situation.
Lide, who was riding Withered Bones just above Green City, was somewhat moved when he saw this scene.
He had initially planned to intervene personally, but now it seemed... he had worried too much.
His subordinates were no longer the few weaklings from before.
If the Fierce Half-Rat Men didn’t have the God of Plague commanding them, Green City could easily stable with just these top-tier warriors.
Two Legends to anchor, and several Transcendents as the cutting edge.
This was not a force that just anyone could shake.
"I have already smelled the scent of death, master. Let the great Lord Withered Bones go and teach those lowly worms a lesson..."
"Let the light of Dawn spread..."
"I can’t wait to let them taste the Dragon Breath..."
Withered Bones, upon reaching Green City and seeing the battle, couldn’t contain his excitement and began to cackle wildly.
Lide, finding it funny but also resigned, floated up,
"Go ahead."
"Gaa gaa gaa, the great Lord Withered Bones has arrived, you filthy rats, are you ready to embrace death?..."
Withered Bones, released, cackled as he surged towards the breach in the city wall, his Power of Crimson spreading instantly, and his throat began to condense a gray-white Death Breath.
Lide glanced at Withered Bones then didn’t bother with him further, not worried about this creature with resurrection ability.
His gaze shifted slightly, then he saw atop a high tower dozens of spans high behind the city walls, two delicate figures casting spells with effort.
Vina and Isa.
Both girls had reached Transcendent status, Vina being elevated by the Power of Faith bestowed by him, whereas Isa advanced through her own Talent.
Lide had never before seen the two girls in battle and now watched curiously for a while longer.
That tower seemed to have been abandoned by a Great Mage long ago; most of the surrounding walls on the top floor had been dismantled, and half of the roof had collapsed.
Yet somehow, either Wina or Isa had cast a spell that made the cracked walls and roof incredibly solid, so there was no need to worry about them collapsing.
The two girls had vastly different styles of casting spells, with Wina favoring powerful spells that took a longer time to cast.
Most of her spells were of the Four Circle, and she loved using Magma Fireball and Fierce Thunder Magma Ball, clearing out swathes of enemies with each cast.
Her battle style, much like her business tactics, was bold and lethal, striking fear into others.
Isa, on the other hand, preferred spells of moderate power but quicker casting, somewhat similar to Lide’s early combat style.
And the variety of spells that this girl knew made Lide feel somewhat ashamed.
First Circle, Second Circle, Three Circle, Four Circle, even Five Circle Magic—she knew them all.
Lide watched for a few minutes and realized that, aside from a few spell types like Fireball Technique, Isa had not repeated any spells.
With two girls who had reached Transcendent status overseeing the tower, spells were being cast non-stop—every second, something was being unleashed, rendering the range in front of them empty.
A true "Spell Artillery."
Seeing this scene, Lide felt oddly complex, especially about Isa—it was as if his own sister had grown up, feeling both pride and a sense of loss...
This girl had grown up without him realizing it to such an extent.
He hadn’t been observing long when both girls seemed to sense something, turning their heads synchronously, and immediately spotting Lide in midair.
Their eyes lit up instantly.
"Teacher..."
"Lord Lide..."
Their voices were filled with surprise.
With a slight smile, Lide floated directly to the top of the tower.
As he landed, Isa couldn’t help but hurry over and then grabbed his hand.
She tilted her head slightly, her ruby-like eyes staring straight at him, filled with unconditional trust and reliance, her face radiating pure joy from the heart.
Although Wina made no move, her eyes were smiling, and the affection and closeness on her face couldn’t be concealed.
Lide chuckled and ruffled Isa’s head, then took the little girl’s hand and stepped forward to stand shoulder to shoulder with Wina.
His gaze swept over the nearby city walls and the Ancient Monsters constantly pouring through gaps in the walls.
"You’ve done great. The Ancient Times have come, the world is in chaos, and only strength is truly reliable. To live with peace of mind, to protect your loved ones safely, you must possess sufficient power."
"Lord Lide..."
Wina was somewhat moved by Lide’s words.
Years ago, she nearly sold by her foster mother to a sixty-year-old limping noble. If Lide hadn’t taken her back to the Crimson Mage Tower, she might have already ended her life.
That’s why even when she held a lofty status in Green City, she never forgot to practice magic every day, striving for improvement. Without Lide’s help, she was just a step away from becoming a Level 15 Great Mage.
Veena did not possess Isa’s Golden Bloodline or Lide’s opportunities, she only had her own hard work and perseverance.
Of course, her efforts to strengthen herself were not just about becoming powerful. Deep inside, she harbored a secret unknown to others—she hoped that one day she could become strong enough to protect Lide... just as he had protected her a long, long time ago.
Maybe she would never reach that height, but she still held onto that firm belief... that perhaps in the future, she might be the one to protect Lord Lide...
Lide glanced at Veena, whose expression seemed somewhat unusual. He was puzzled; he had only given her a couple of reminders, so why did she look so moved?
Naturally, he could not guess the little maid’s thoughts. However, if he knew, he would probably be deeply touched. Veena had experienced so much, yet she managed to maintain such a clean and pure aspect of herself, which was no small feat.
Lide wanted to say something more, but at that moment, a terrifying sound suddenly erupted from outside the city walls, as if thousands of thunders were simultaneously striking.
Boom ~
An extremely terrifying aura, grand and heavy, seemed capable of crushing the heavens and the earth, as if the divine power of billions of stars had gathered together, sweeping across the land.
The fierce half-rat men, who were furiously assaulting Green City, seemed like someone had hit the pause button. They instantly halted.
Then, these ancient monsters, disregarding their lives and whether they were still on the battlefield, bowed uniformly toward the distance.
As the fierce half-rat men covered the land and knelt in one direction, the entire sky seemed to quiet down.
All human warriors sensed that extraordinary and shocking aura. It felt like a colossal boulder was pressing on their chests, making it difficult to breathe at that moment.
Even their souls, their bodies, and their everything trembled unconsciously.
Great terror had descended.
It was an existence that transcended the ultimate limits of this world, merely emitting a wisp of aura, sufficient to dim the skies and reverse the river of stars.
"Plague and Death were in the past. Plague and Death are in the present. Plague and Death will exist forever..."
"He is eternal. He is the past. He exists in the past, and He exists now..."
"He shall not die. He shall live forever. He shall also be reborn..."
A sound, like millions of people simultaneously kneeling to pray, combined with a voice emanating from a non-human organ, echoed in the sky.
Moments later, a dark figure, like a star falling, appeared before the city walls.
It floated in mid-air, accepting the worship of millions of Evil God’s servants.
Under the gathered aura of ancient days, with the fierce half-rat men kneeling on the ground and the flying half-rat men bowing their heads.
Under thousands of miles of dark clouds and an indescribably tall figure emitting a dark light capable of suppressing heaven and earth, this illusory figure became the focus of millions of eyes in Green City.
The crowd, terrified by the horrifying aura, lost their color.
"What, what is this?!"
"Could it be that ancient Ancient Evil God?!"
"It is said that in Risier City, an Ancient Evil God is in command. Never thought they would marshal millions to attack us!"
"How are we to respond?"
"With such a terrifying presence, who can withstand this Evil God... Heaven above, is Green City doomed today?"
Many people were incredibly pessimistic, but at this moment, some believers also roared unwillingly.
"Lord, we have Lord Ilo! What is there to fear, that damned Ancient Evil God is nothing but a servant who worships our Lord!!"
"Yes, that’s right, Lord Ilo once dismissed the enemy with a single sentence in Risier City, there’s no way that Ancient Evil God can contend with our Lord!!"
"In the name of Dawn, the light of our Lord shines upon us!!"
Wrapped in the ancient fog, the God of Plague sensed the fear emanating within Green City, and his emotions escalated to an extreme.
What could be more exhilarating than slaying an enemy and fulfilling revenge in front of their followers, under the gaze of millions?
There was nothing.
Thinking of soon conquering the city and killing that enemy who haunted his nights, the God of Plague felt a climax-like pleasure.
As for encountering resistance, he had never doubted it, as he was a supreme being of level 34!
Who in this world could challenge him?!
Previously, he had suffered at the hands of the cursed New Sun God because he could not descend to the Main Plane.
Now, having descended, he was ready to settle old scores!
The God of Plague was very aware of one fact—after the ancient descent, many gods lost their power, which is why he was so confident.
Even if the gods were powerful, they still needed sufficient time to regain their strength, so he worried not at all.
At this time, there was no life force capable of killing the great Ancient Dominator.
And with time, as more ancient powers invaded, these gods, meant to control the world, would only grow stronger.
"I am the eternal Ancient Dominator—the God of Plague."
"You insignificant New Sun God, Ilo, I shall destroy your city, devour the souls of all your followers!
Your sins will be repaid with everything you have!"
"Ha ha ha ha, tremble under my dignity, fear!"
The blasphemous language, carrying soul-piercing evil, swept over; the army below changed color with fear, even the legendary Bloodline successors Frey and Stanley struggled to breathe under his divine power.
The entire Green City fell into a death-like silence, as if breathing too loudly would draw the terrible god’s attention.
Fear spread in an unstoppable manner at that moment.
That was a true Ancient Evil God standing before them!
Many felt the lingering silence within Green City and couldn’t help but show despair on their faces.
"Could it be that Lord Ilo has run away because the enemy is too powerful?!!"
"No, it can’t be, Lord Ilo wouldn’t abandon us!"
"Who can withstand such a terrifying Evil God... Lord Ilo, can you really?"
The divine might of the God of Plague was so horrifyingly terrifying that many warriors began to waver.
Facing such an entity, could the absent Lord Ilo truly withstand?
"Ha ha ha, New Sun God, come out and face your judgement..."
"I have sensed where you are, the scent of your soul cannot be hidden..."
"I will extract your soul and roast it with demon flames for ten thousand years!!"
The God of Plague was not in a hurry to make his move; he sensed it, sensed the elusive presence of that cursed New Sun God and, as expected, the opponent had not yet recovered his divine strength...
A cat playing with a mouse.
Watching his enemy be destroyed step by step satisfied his twisted desires to the extreme.
"A frail rat... who gave you the courage to shout in front of me?"
Accompanied by a calm voice, a figure making all the residents of Green City excitedly appeared in midair.
His elegant aura and unparalleled grace stunned everyone below.
Lord Ilo!!
The greatest protector of Green City.
When the believers of Dawn saw their divine being, they were overjoyed.
"Lord Ilo hasn’t abandoned us, he has come!!"
"Praise Dawn, our Lord will surely kill that monster!"
But at this time, many non-believers were full of worry.
"That’s an Ancient Evil God, can Lord Ilo really defeat him?"
"The opponent must be countless times stronger than he was in Risier City... How will the God of Dawn respond?"
"This battle... is likely perilous..."
Seeing Lide actually daring to appear before him, the vague figure of the God of Plague burst into crazed laughter.
"You insignificant New Sun God, did you ever imagine this day!!"
The excitement of getting his revenge drove the Ancient Evil God into madness.
He had waited far too long for this day.
"I will turn you into an undead monster, then whip your soul day and night, letting the Mad Rats devour your flesh!!"
Lide floated in midair, gazing at the God of Plague with a cold smirk slowly forming on his lips.
"Do you even qualify for me to make a move?"
The God of Plague was taken aback by the words and then erupted in rage, but before he could speak, Lide shut him down.
"Your nonsense is excessive."
After saying that, he slightly turned his head, looking beside him where no one stood, his tone indifferent.
"Freyja, I want the head of this rat."
The crowd below was stunned by his words, but before they could react, the space next to Lide suddenly shattered.
Then, a figure, emitting an aura several times more terrifying than the God of Plague, appeared in the sky.
Twelve pure black wings released an endless pressure, like the waters of the Nether River falling from the heavens,
The black cross longsword in his hand erupted with a hundred yards of dim light, seemingly devouring everything around.
"The first War General of the Dawn Sect, the Blazing Angel, Freyja Dusk, on the command of the Dominator, I am to decapitate you."
"I will draw my sword against you."
The crowd below fell into absolute silence. The first War General? The Dawn Sect has a protective Blazing Angel?
Meanwhile, as the God of Plague sensed Freyja’s presence, his body shuddered, his face, hidden from view, revealed a look of disbelief.
That feeling... Level 35 medium divine power?!!
No, how could that be possible, the descent of the ancient wasn’t even a year ago, how could such a terrifying new deity appear in the Main Plane so soon!
But Freyja wouldn’t wait for him to react; as her words fell, her body transformed into a stream of light, slashing towards the God of Plague with the posture of a falling star.
The space she passed through seemed erased by a giant hand, chaos reigned.
The half-rat men flying in the sky shattered like paper, turning into blood plasma.
The sky collapsed, all things ceased to exist.
The Star River reversed, the stars shattered.
A dazzling dim light traversed time and space striking directly at the worshipped ancient Dominator—the God of Plague.
The God of Plague couldn’t dodge, nor did he have time to dodge.
But this ancient Dominator was not afraid; instead, he mobilized all his divine power to strike back at Freyja.
He intended to show everyone that no one could stop his steps to destroy the world!
The ancient is eternal.
Bang~
At that moment, the two collided like two stars in the galaxy.
A terrifying shockwave burst at the center, like an 18-level storm turning over millions of tons of seawater into the sky.
The watching crowd buzzed in their ears, many even vomited blood and died on the spot, directly shaken to death.
When people looked up at the sky again, they found that the area of collision was now all blurred.
The powers of both sides exceeded the limits this world could bear, turning everything around into chaos and nothingness.
Although they were thousands of blades away from the battlefield, everyone felt as if they were millions of miles away, in another star river.
No one knew exactly what happened on that battlefield, nor could anyone see the details of the combat clearly.
They could only feel waves of energy continuously blurring the void, turning the battlefield into a place of chaos and absolute death.
The fight in the chaos seemed to make the universe roar, a collision between star domains, endless stars plummeting, limitless starry skies collapsing.
Time seemed to stop at this moment, everyone watching Lide floating in the sky felt every second pass like an eternity.
They desperately wanted to know who had won and lost, wanting to understand the cause of it all.
Just when everyone’s hearts were stretched to the limit, waiting anxiously.
It was unknown how long had passed, maybe a second, maybe ten centuries, but the tumultuous waves of battle in that area of chaos and nothingness suddenly ceased.
As if the battle had determined a victor.
Then, in front of countless players and natives watching from the city walls, a figure with twelve flapping wings broke through the chaos and approached.
But the sharp-eyed among them saw in the hands of that figure the body of a fierce half-rat with the Magic Language, now a corpse.
"What is that??"
"A body, a corpse!!"
"This, could it be..."
The astonished crowd shouted incredulously, their hearts shaken to the extreme.
The body had a longsword piercing through the chest, not yet pulled out, dripping blood...
Blood-stained battle garment, triumphant songs.
The victorious Freyja, holding the God of Plague’s body now reverted to its original form, in front of countless shocked eyes, approached Lide and laid the body of the Plague God before him.
Then this fearsome being who had just slain a deity kneeled on one knee in the void before Lide.
The head that was revered by all humbly lowered, like the most loyal subject submitting to her king.
"Master, the Level 34 God of Plague, has been executed."
The whole of Green City fell into silence upon hearing this.
All that remained in everyone’s ears was the sound of the wind blowing through the air...
Zhao Yue, who had witnessed the whole process from atop the city wall, seeing the Blazing Angel who had slain a god submitting before Lide, felt her heart beat extraordinarily fast while a nearly indomitable admiration rose in her eyes.
At this moment, she deeply understood that this man was unrivaled.
Wina clutched her Mage robe tightly in her hands, her palms sweaty as she watched the frenzy of countless people below towards Lide, her face revealing a smile that came from deep within her heart, and an incomparable pride... that was Lord Lide.
Isa clasped her hands together, stars twinkling in her eyes, "Teacher... is very handsome..."

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 464: The Next Phase Goal, Suddenly Opened Thoughts, This Time It’s Going to Happen...
chapters.content:
Chapter 463: Chapter 464: The Next Phase Goal, Suddenly Opened Thoughts, This Time It’s Going to Happen...
He died, an Ancient Evil God of immense power was dead.
His death was so abrupt, so startling and unexpected.
Just moments ago, the God of Plague had been roaring with demonic flames, unparalleled in ferocity, even shattering the city wall that stood 50 blades high and 30 blades thick and could withstand Four Circle Magic, its residual power still lingering in everyone’s hearts.
But now, his lifeless body was being treated as mere war spoils without any dignity, laid out before the Protector of Green City—beneath Lord Ilo.
The scene was overwhelmingly shocking, like an image out of an epic, capable of inspiring minstrels for ten thousand years...
Once the God of Plague was slain, the Fierce Half-Ratmen instantly fell into endless panic.
Those who had fought fearlessly only moments before were now scattering like headless flies, fleeing even faster than when they had arrived.
As the Divine Servants that had blotted out the sky dispersed like startled birds and beasts, light returned to the sky.
The residents below were stirred with overwhelming emotion.
Their gazes toward the sky were filled with adoration and frenzy.
Especially when Frey, upon returning bloodied from battle, announced "The Level 34 God of Plague, has been executed," the blood of the people below surged to their heads.
Correct content is on
Level 34... Just the mention of this level was enough to take their breath away. How terrifying a life was the God of Plague? To die so suddenly at the hands of another...
The crowd slowly began to boil with excitement.
"Is that a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel? Only the most powerful of Divine beings could command the loyalty of a Blazing Angel with twelve wings, and Lord Ilo has one... Praise the Light," a Believer of the Light Sect said, face alight with amazement.
"By the Goddess above, it’s unimaginable, unimaginable!! That Ancient Evil God who has survived from ancient times and could destroy the world was just like that, slain?" an old man with white whiskers said, eyes wide, taking a long time to recover his senses.
"How powerful is that Blazing Angel, to be able to kill a Divine being! And then there’s Lord Ilo, to whom such a terrifying life bows, how strong must he be?" an assassin hidden in the shadows trembled, muttering under his breath without realizing.
"..."
The natives were stunned, and so were the players.
Some players had witnessed the extraordinary scene where Mr. Li blew up the God of Nobles with a single punch.
But then again, everyone internally had some capacity to accept the power of Lord Ilo. Moreover, according to the analysis of the big shots later on, the God of Nobles who was killed without dignity hadn’t recovered to his peak state, so his death was not surprising.
But now, with just a command from one of his Blazing Angels, Lord Ilo had hunted and killed a Level 34 Ancient Evil God right in front of tens of millions of onlookers, with an invincible stance.
Such a display of heavenly might right before their eyes!
How could the players not be shocked?
That very night, numerous posts about the battle emerged on the official Glory forums.
"The First War General under the God of Dawn, with one hand blasts apart a Level 34 Ancient Evil God, invincible! Angel screenshot·jpg, Angel’s long legs close-up·jpg"
"I must admire Lord Ilo! This definitely sets the combat strength ceiling in Glory known to us now, who can contend with Lord Ilo, who?!"
"Damn, I envy the God of Dawn, with Angels to do his bidding, and during the downtime..."
"My husband looks so cool, I’m going to die..."
While they were still struggling to level up, the other side was already dealing with Divine beings, the gap was not a small one.
Instantly, Mr. Li’s reputation exploded among the players, of course, if the players knew that Mr. Li was from Earth, they might not be so friendly... apart from the female players, everyone else would likely curse him.
Floating mid-air, Mr. Li did not concern himself with others; right now, he looked at Frey, who knelt on one knee in midair, with a pleasantly surprised expression.
Though he was aware of the Death Blazing Angel’s strength, he didn’t expect that not even a Level 34 God of Plague could stand for five minutes.
Even though Frey had sustained severe injuries, even the Divine Artifact bound to her—Angel Battle Armor—had suffered extensive cracks, being able to take down a Level 34 Ancient Evil God was a fight of truly shocking and awe-inspiring power.
"Frey, you did well. Go and rest, heal your wounds first..."
At Frey’s level, as long as one wasn’t killed on the spot or had their core damaged, even the heaviest of injuries could recover swiftly.
The same was true for her armor. Extraordinary Level armor already had the ability to self-repair, and so, naturally, a Divine Artifact would not be inferior.
"Yes, my Lord."
Frey nodded; Mr. Li’s will was the direction she moved in. As a Guardian Angel, her sword was drawn only for him.
The Death Blazing Angel, whose armor was stained red with blood, stood up and slowly pulled the Angel Battle Sword from the heart of the God of Plague.
Bathed in Divine Blood, the battle sword shone brightly at that moment, emanating exceptionally astonishing energy fluctuations.
After glancing down at the fervently gazing crowd below, Frey’s figure blurred and she vanished into thin air.
At that moment, there was nothing left on the field but the corpse of the God of Plague, and Mr. Li, who stood aloof. He had not made a move in the battle but had acquired even more reputation than Frey who had just slain a Divine being.
After all, no matter how strong Frey might be, she was a subordinate who bowed to him.
One was the lord, the other his general...
Noticing this, Mr. Li pondered briefly before waving his hand and using the Magic Hand to toss the now human-sized gruesome corpse of the God of Plague to the Withered Bones flapping about in the sky.
He then turned to look at the excited warriors and residents below.
His voice, as if coming from the distant stars with a mysterious resonance, slowly echoed throughout Green City.
"My Believers, my people, I am the master you worship, the Protector of Green City—the God of Dawn."
As Mr. Li’s voice rose, the residents below instantly silenced, gazing at him with longing eyes.
Mr. Li’s voice then became deep and solemn.
"As you have seen, the world has changed, become dangerous, horrifying, leaving everyone bewildered and lost."
"Darkness has now enveloped the earth, night has descended upon the world, even the stars no longer shine as brightly, and the sun and moon have lost their light. Our past bliss has already been destroyed by the Ancient calamities...
My loyal believers, it’s my duty to inform you, the apocalypse, has come..."
The excited crowd below seemed to be doused with a bucket of cold water, their faces frozen in the euphoria of the moment.
Once again, the fear dominated by the Ancient Monsters crept into their eyes.
How many people in Green City had fled from other cities as refugees? At least two-thirds!
Therefore, they knew all too well just how terrifying those Ancient Monsters that had invaded their homes were...
At this moment, Lide activated the shadows within their hearts, and infinite fear emerged on their faces.
But then, as if thinking of something, the crowd’s gaze was fixed on Lide in the sky. At that time, they seemed to pin all their hopes on him.
After a brief pause, Lide sensed the change in the atmosphere below and nodded slightly in his heart.
"The calamaties of ancient times are inevitable, and nobody can escape.
"Even though the end of days is terrifying, residents of Green City, you need not fear..."
"Because you are the Dawn believers, my people!"
His tone suddenly became forceful.
"The light of Dawn shall shine upon you, even if darkness descends upon the land and all things turn to ash, I shall guide you towards the Dawn, towards hope."
"As long as I draw breath, no one can harm my believers!"
"This Ancient Evil God is the best testament!
"Its corpse, I will display in the central square for three days.
"I want everyone to know that the residents of Green City are Dawn believers, and Dawn believers are under my protection.
"My believers, you are never alone, I am your stronghold.
"All, for the sake of Dawn!"
After Lide’s speech, he surveyed the silent crowd before gradually becoming blurred, transforming into a streak of light that entered Green City.
The crowd below did not come back to their senses until long after Lide had disappeared.
They were all deeply shaken by his words.
Many felt an unprecedented sense of pride and honor at being Dawn believers for the first time.
The Divine beings they looked up to, their existence, could treat them with such kindness... What an honor!
"Child, did you hear the words of Lord Ilo just now? Come, let’s go to the Dawn Church to pray right now, believing in such a great being will be the greatest honor of our lives!"
"Father, I have to break my promise to you, I want to change my faith... I’m sorry, I will explain the reasons at your gravestone tomorrow when I sweep the grave..."
"The Divine being I once believed in is so trivial compared to Lord Ilo, great Lord, your light will surely become eternal..."
"This is Lord Ilo, our faith!!"
"..."
Returning with a grand victory, the weight of Lide’s words was naturally heavier than anything else.
And his speech had directly struck the hearts of the people below.
What a revered status he held?!
Lord Ilo, the God of Dawn.
The survival of the entire Green City hinged on his single thought.
Such a great figure would actually treat these humble believers so kindly and amiably.
What an honor?!
Excitement, adoration, various emotions fermented within their hearts, even many older women’s eyes reddened, and those believers were moved to the extreme.
----
----
----
With the God of Plague slain in battle and the Fierce Half-Ratmen scattered, this sudden war bolstered the confidence of all the residents of Green City.
Not just because they had repelled the encroaching enemy, but more so because everyone had a clearer understanding of their Protector—Lord Ilo.
It turned out that they no longer needed to worry about their safety like before, because their support had unprecedented strength!
On that day, after completing that brief but extremely powerful speech, the Dawn Sect’s believers had the largest increase since occupying Green City, surging by millions of believers in a single day...
Previously, the Dawn Sect had barely had over a million believers throughout the whole Green City, and now it had doubled.
The Dawn believers now accounted for half of the city’s population.
Even those residents who didn’t believe in the Dawn Sect admired and held a favorable impression of it,
It was just that many people’s years of faith habits made it hard for them to change their faith overnight, but with time, more and more people were sure to become Dawn believers.
Lide truly did as he had promised, directly hanging the Divine Body of the God of Plague in Green City’s central square for the residents to see.
This act also caused a huge sensation.
Even though the God of Plague was dead, the energy emanating from the Divine Body was still astonishing.
Even watching from a distance, one could feel waves of danger emanating.
This was a true Divine being, now just hung on the wall for everyone to watch... it was simply unbelievable.
Lide’s reputation soared to the pinnacle because of this act, directly leading to a continuous high-speed growth of believers in the days to come...
He had unequivocally become the biggest winner of this war.
As for the slain God of Plague, this Ancient Evil God could have never imagined that one day he would fall here, and even after death, be dragged out to be publicly displayed...
Lide couldn’t help but sigh, the God of Plague was probably the unluckiest Ancient Evil God in history, other Ancient Evil Gods after breaking their seals could not only kill at will but also make the surrounding forces tremble in fear.
But this one encountered him immediately upon breaking its seal. Lide robbed it all the way, from Divine Body to Divine Artifacts, and now it had even lost its life, it was truly a tragic tale...
That afternoon, at the City Lord’s Manor.
Lide had summoned all the highest-ranking figures currently in Green City, including Duke O’Kelly, Nicole, Vina, Frey, Stanley, and others.
After exchanging greetings with Lide, Nicole was the first to speak up.
"Your Excellency, should we immediately dispatch a large army to attack Risier City and eliminate this hidden threat completely..."
Dressed in a priest’s robe, Nicole looked very serious. When discussing formal matters, there was not a trace of a smile on the girl’s face.
Nicole had now been appointed as the Speaker of Green City Hall, a position of extraordinary authority.
This girl, whom Lide had raised, had shown a glimpse of her management talent when Lide first met her.
Now, after several years of training, her abilities were fully on par with Harrison’s, so Lide felt very assured in entrusting her with the management of Green City.
"Let’s hold off for now..."
Lide didn’t rush to agree, his deep eyes scanning everyone present.
"Frey mentioned that during the battle, the God of Plague did not use a Divine Artifact, and I did not find one on him either..."
This abrupt statement left everyone in the hall momentarily stunned, but it didn’t take long for Nicole to be the first to catch on.
"Your Excellency, I remember that when the God of Plague broke free from his seals, there were a total of four Divine Artifacts with him.
One of them, the Eye of the Ancient Evil God, was obtained by us through the Land of Bone-Burying and was later absorbed by Asreaga.
Logically, the God of Plague should still have had three Divine Artifacts remaining, and now they’re missing... Are you suggesting that there might be other Ancient Evil Gods within Risier City?"
Lide looked at Nicole with approval.
"That’s right. No one knows what Risier City has become now, and Frey, with her severe injuries, will need at least half a month to recover.
We need to have sufficient power to suppress the situation when we decide to pull out this thorn."
Seeing that everyone was beginning to understand, he decided not to keep them in the dark any longer and continued.
"However, we can’t just sit idle. Immediately issue an order to the adventurers of the Lost Plane to clear out Risier City.
First, clip its wings by clearing out a hundred miles around Green City. Once the surroundings are cleared, launch a total assault."
"In addition, we can also sweep across the entire southern province for Ancient Monsters, restoring some order.
But remember, the focus of this sweeping of Ancient Monsters is to rally the other cities that have not yet fallen. We don’t need to waste troops on those Lands of Dead Silence."
There’s nothing gained without effort. The biggest danger in the southern province is undoubtedly Risier City. As long as the atmosphere of the ancient days is not completely cut off, the Ancient Monsters will never be completely eradicated.
Therefore, Lide’s goal in sweeping the southern province was to plunder the population and resources, not for any other purpose.
"Yes, Your Excellency," everyone immediately responded.
After a moment of reflection, Lide spoke softly.
"The population of Green City is now too large and has exceeded its capacity.
To solve this problem, you must next transport some of the loyal Dawn Sect believers back to Dawn City.
Also, remain vigilant, although we have dealt with the largest immediate danger to Green City — the God of Plague.
The disaster of the ancient days is just beginning, far from over.
The future safety of Green City is not certain, so you must be mentally prepared for all aspects, especially... for giving up Green City."
At those words, the room instantly fell silent.
Give up Green City?
They had just slain a great enemy, and now Lide was preparing them to give up Green City. Could the future be so dire?
Lide observed the perplexed expressions and offered no further explanation.
Killing an Ancient Evil God, while commendable, does nothing in the face of the Ancient Invasion; it barely causes a ripple.
Who is the hidden hand orchestrating the Ancient Invasion? The ruler of the ancient times, that terrifying existence who was killed by the Creator God and then resurrected.
He once ruled the Land of Chaos before the birth of the multi-dimensional planes.
The Destiny Tablet, upon which Glory’s fate is inscribed, was crushed by his Time Gear, and it was he who reduced the heavens’ gods to mortals.
To survive the ancient catastrophe, what they faced was far from simply hunting a God of Plague.
Even a hundred Gods of Plague, before the ruler of the ancient days, would be nothing but minor nuisances.
However, spreading information about the ruler of the ancient days may not be a good thing, as some powerful beings could be sensed merely by the mention of their name.
So Lide had not planned to inform everyone.
"This is just a precaution; the residents haven’t deteriorated to this degree yet. Just be aware, you can go now..."
The excitement from their triumphant return had slightly faded, and after leaving, they pondered Lide’s intentions. Of course, these smart fellows began to prepare back-up plans unanimously.
After the upper echelons dispersed, Lide sent for Zhao Yue, the leader of the Crimson Moon, to come over.
He had important tasks to assign.
Zhao Yue felt unexpectedly uneasy upon hearing Lide’s summoning.
The clever woman had already guessed at Lide’s true identity, but as Lide hadn’t admitted it to her, her emotions were complex.
After all, anyone who had just witnessed Frey carrying the corpse of the God of Plague and then kneeling before Lide wouldn’t remain calm.
Entering the luxurious manor, Zhao Yue saw Lide, who claimed to be Lord Ilo, in the game for the first time.
Seeing Lide’s handsome face, Zhao Yue’s expression was very complicated, and it took a long while before she finally let out a sigh.
"Mr. Li, should I address you as Mr. Li...or as Lord Ilo?"
Lide smiled faintly.
Dawn City was providing intelligence support for Zhao Yue, and Frey had concluded that this clever older sister would definitely deduce his real identity. He just hadn’t expected that she hadn’t exposed him when he returned to Earth, only to reveal it now.
However, he wasn’t particularly bothered by this; Zhao Yue’s performance had already gained his approval, and with her position as the deputy head of the Crimson Moon, she was entitled to know more secrets.
"Anything is fine..."
Although he had already confirmed it in his heart, hearing Lide say it himself still caused Zhao Yue’s heart to tremble.
Her face could no longer hide the shock.
After a long time, she managed to suppress the surge of emotions.
Looking directly at Lide with her eyes wide, she spoke in a low voice.
"Mr. Li, aren’t you afraid I will leak this news?"
Lide shrugged his shoulders, his deep eyes looking straight into Zhao Yue’s beautiful autumn water-like eyes, and calmly said,
"I trust you."
Watching Lide’s firm and confident gaze, Zhao Yue’s heartbeat suddenly quickened, and a faint blush stealthily appeared on her face...
Her eyes shifted unnaturally away, avoiding his gaze.
"Mr. Li, you are my boss, and of course, I stand with you. I won’t tell anyone else..."
Although she was trying to suppress her inner emotions, her words came out very stiff and the tone quite unnatural. Zhao Yue realized this herself and quickly blushed, changing the subject.
"Mr. Li, what are your next plans? The Crimson Moon is ready to cooperate with you..."
At this moment, Lide had already dominated Green City, and he also controlled an appalling power like Frey.
His every move would now influence the pattern of the entire southern province.
Zhao Yue’s question was indeed not out of place.
Lide looked at the mature and plump older sister’s blush, and couldn’t help but smile briefly; such a mature woman also had the shy side of a little girl... Indeed, a case of ’gap moe.’
"Hmm, I have several plans that require your cooperation."
When the conversation turned to serious matters, Zhao Yue’s heart relaxed slightly, and her expression became stern.
"You command."
"As the main city for players, Anos City has now fulfilled its historical mission.
In my heart, Anos City should have only one voice, and the Crimson Moon will become the sole leader.
I don’t care what means you use, but from today onward, Anos City no longer needs additional guilds, or if there are extra guilds, they also need to be under control.
I will have Stanley and the Dark Contract player guild he controls cooperate with you. Having a Legendary sit in will make things a lot easier.
Additionally, Prince Anos will become your assistant..."
Lide’s eyes were burning as he looked at Zhao Yue.
Consolidating the power of the players had been on his mind early on. Previously, the players were too weak to be of use, so he hadn’t bothered with them.
Now that the players had leveled up and could be put to use, it was natural to implement this plan.
Zhao Yue, hearing his unyielding tone, nodded firmly.
"Mr. Li, rest assured, I have already prepared a contingency for this."
Hearing this, Lide said no more on the subject, having enough trust in Zhao Yue’s capabilities.
"I am about to issue a mission to clear out Risier City, and I will dispatch a large army to strangle the outer forces first. Have the elites of the Crimson Moon join in on the action.
Additionally, arrange for the Data Analysis Department to find news about shards of the Destiny Tablet.
Player forum activity is high; we can also attract players to help us search with a high bounty, such as setting a reward of 10 million in cash...
I need news about shards of the Destiny Tablet, this concerns our living space."
Clearing the threat of Risier City was a short-term goal, while finding shards of the Destiny Tablet was a long-term goal.
After dealing with the dangers around, he would have to focus on the Destiny Tablet shards.
The existence of the Destiny Tablet shards was critical for the survival of Dawn City and could not be neglected.
The intrusion of an ancient aura didn’t seem to cause any damage to Dawn City in the short term, but if it continued like this, sooner or later, the land of Dawn Plains would be unable to grow plants, and the Underworld’s land would no longer cultivate Microglow Mushrooms.
The scene would be a nightmare that no one could bear... perhaps tens of millions of people would starve to death.
Although Castlina had told him that the Sea God of the Lost Sea had obtained a shard of the Destiny Tablet, what was the effect of that shard? How large an area of Noble order could it restore? All these were still unknowns.
It was very foolish to place hope on an uncertain target.
He couldn’t just cling to one tree and not let go.
Moreover, both the information leaked by Castlina and the news broadcasted by the Sun Goddess, who had already obtained a shard of the Destiny Tablet, clearly informed the world of one thing – the shards of the Destiny Tablet would be the hope of the future.
So even if the shard in the Lost Sea was enough to protect Green City, he would still actively seek more shards; those were chips, chips to resist the ultimate boss.
The greatest confidence Lide dared to act on was that he had an extremely sharp battle blade in his hand – Frey, the Level 36 Death Blazing Angel.
Thinking of this, Lide’s thoughts suddenly expanded.
Apart from searching for shards of the Destiny Tablet, he could hunt those Divine beings before they regained their strength, obtaining Divine Status, Divine Bodies, Divine Artifacts, and the like to cultivate his subordinates.
He could also explore some ancient seals that hadn’t been broken and kill those Ancient Evil Gods...
After dispersing his thoughts, Lide suddenly found that with Frey as a trump card, the space for operation had suddenly increased much.
To outsiders, now was a time of extreme danger, but to him, it seemed... it was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
He had this inexplicable feeling that he was about to strike it rich...

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 465: Preparations Before Hunting Divine, Movements of the Divine Monster
chapters.content:
Chapter 464: Chapter 465: Preparations Before Hunting Divine, Movements of the Divine Monster
Lide’s mind was a whirl of thoughts which gradually cleared after being unlocked.
In the following period, utilizing Frey to obtain greater benefits would be the core of his actions.
The Death Blazing Angel that had reached Level 36 would likely be unbeatable for a very long time.
After a moment of contemplation, he continued speaking to Zhao Yue.
"Besides integrating players and searching for the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, have the Data Analysis Department center around Green City and collect information about the divine beings in the surrounding areas to create a map of where the divines have appeared..."
Zhao Yue listened with a shocked expression.
Suddenly, she recalled the scene of the Blazing Angel returning with a corpse...
Her mind raced.
"Do you plan... to hunt those divines who have not yet regained their strength?"
The gods had descended to the mortal world, and Lide held terrifying combat power like that of the Blazing Angel. If he chose to hunt those divines now, there would scarcely be anyone who could escape.
After all, an Ancient Evil God of Level 34 had already been killed, could anyone else fare well?
The attitude that Lide revealed left a profound impact on Zhao Yue. As one of the highest-leveled individuals within the Crimson Moon, her own Level was just 14, still some way off from 15.
And now, Lide was capable of hunting divine beings--the gap between them was staggering.
Lide nodded slightly.
"Not just those divines who haven’t regained their powers, including the sealed Ancient Evil Gods and even those that have descended to this world...
All are on my hunting list.
However, all this rests on the precondition that the Data Analysis Department can gather enough detailed intelligence."
Because Ancient Monsters ran rampant, most cities within Glory had become isolated islands on land.
The intelligence command center of Dawn City had gone to great lengths to build an information network. Just for this operation, it had been nearly destroyed, so messages beyond the southern provinces still needed to be scouted by Crimson Moon.
When Lide first formed the Crimson Moon, his original idea was to have it provide intelligence support for Dawn City.
"Rest assured, the Crimson Moon will not let you down, Your Excellency..."
Zhao Yue nodded confidently, but she quietly changed her address from Mr. Li to Your Excellency.
In Glory, Lide’s identity was too revered, and continuing to address him as Mr. Li was pressure she found too great.
Lide nodded slightly.
"Personally assign someone to handle these issues and ensure they are well supervised."
After finishing, he looked at her again, his brow furrowing.
"You are only Level 14? Hmm, that’s a bit low.
In half a month, I will issue a total assault command for Risier City. By then, I’ll help you advance to Transcendent..."
Why in half a month... because he no longer had any Power of Faith. The reserves he had built up had all been used three days ago to transform the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
Ascending to Transcendent would require hundreds of millions of Power of Faith, and the lower the Level, the greater the cost. So even with his exaggerated number of believers, he would need some time to accumulate.
Zhao Yue’s heart trembled at his words...
Advance to Transcendent?
Looking at Lide’s exceedingly handsome face, her heart swelled with tumultuous emotions.
With the appearance of the sky cracks on Earth, the power of bygone days eroded the land, and all the players within Glory could sense their inner strength surging.
There was even a consensus among the people that if the sky cracks expanded further, it was highly probable that Earth would become Glory-fied, in other words, players had a very good chance of fully inheriting the power within Glory.
Now, Lide’s actions were tantamount to granting her the authority to shape destiny--Transcendent, that represented pinnacle combat strength.
This undoubtedly gave her sufficient self-protection ability in the face of future dangers and calamities.
This brought Zhao Yue a greater sense of security than any gift of ten or twenty billion.
Power was the only eternal and unchanging truth, she had come to understand this deeply.
But the man before her could casually bestow such power onto others, the shock Zhao Yue felt at this moment was beyond description.
At the same time, her feelings toward Lide became very complicated...
f.(r)eew ebnov\ll.com
After taking several deep breaths, she said in a focused tone.
"Your Majesty, won’t this be a great burden for you..."
In Zhao Yue’s view, power naturally wasn’t something that could be bestowed at will, after all, it was Transcendent. Before the arrival of the Ancient Days, the entire Green City had only one Transcendent stationed there.
Destroying a city’s level of combat power wasn’t so easy.
Lide nodded slightly.
"To raise someone to Transcendent status, the price that must be paid is naturally steep, even for other Divines, it’s considered expensive."
Those Divines who had not yet recovered their powers found it difficult to accumulate millions of Power of Faith, and even if they managed to gather enough Power of Faith, they would use it first to recuperate their own strength. How could they possibly bestow it upon others for free?
So naturally, it was considered expensive.
"But this is my reward to you for your hard work over such a long period, no matter how great the cost, it’s worth it."
Hearing this, Zhao Yue felt inexplicably disappointed... Was it really just a reward for her work?
Although her mood was somewhat low, her face still maintained enough calm, "If that’s the case, then thank you, Your Majesty. If there’s nothing else, I will take my leave..."
Lide paused briefly, sensing that something was amiss with the mood... He then had a thought and seemed to realize something, attempting to add another sentence.
"Of course, there’s another most important reason... You are the person I trust the most, a unique presence by my side. I wouldn’t be willing to pay such a great price for others from the Crimson Moon to increase their power..."
Ah? Zhao Yue’s face flushed red upon hearing this, and the low mood dissipated in an instant. Suppressing the strange feeling in her heart, she spoke with feigned composure.
"Mr. Li flatters me. You carry on with your work, and call me if you need anything..."
After finishing her words, she didn’t wait for Lide to say anything and hurriedly turned and left the hall, but her step was suddenly much lighter.
Seeing this, Lide’s expression was rather colorful. He was not some inexperienced young man; of course, he noticed something different... It seemed like this mature and voluptuous woman was quite interested in him.
I thought you saw me as a colleague, yet you want to sleep with me...
But this behavior, why is it like that of a girl who’s never been in love...
He then shook his head—tens of millions of people’s fates rested on his shoulders, he had no time for flirting or falling in love. Why not just come directly to my room at night...
Thinking it over, he felt he was somewhat betraying his status now. As the Dawn Sovereign, holding immense authority and distinguished status to the extreme,
In the feudal society-like environment of Glory, under normal circumstances, there would be at least hundreds of High-level Nobles sending their daughters to his estate.
Now that his status was so revered, no one dared to do such a thing... If not handled well, it would be a sin of blasphemy.
"Actually, I’m not such a good person..." Lide was somewhat melancholic.
---
---
---
---
The Abyssal Depths.
This most evil place in the world had been boiling ever since the sky rift appeared.
The invasion of the Ancient powers was now threatening the survival of all Demons...
Even monstrous creatures that had slept since the Creation had awakened because of this.
Demon Lords, Dark Evil Gods, Abyssal Giant Beasts... No one could estimate how many frightful Dark Demon Kings existed in the Abyss.
At this moment, countless powerful evil beings were reviving simultaneously, causing an exaggerated impact on the Abyss...
Plane of the Abyss, 920th level—Putrefied Swamp, one of the deepest planes of the Abyss. This plane, filled with poison fog, carcasses, and mud, was occupied by a Demon Lord known as the Lord of Fury.
The Putrefied Swamp plane was three thousand kilometers long and wide, also considered a vast plane in the depths of the Abyss.
Legend had it that the Lord of Fury resided in the central region of the Putrefied Swamp, where there was a palace built from the skulls of demons.
This Lord of Fury had become a Demon of Medium Divine Power millions of years ago, and it was even rumored that he was only one step away from Powerful Divine Power, his strength being among the top in the nearby ten or more planes.
Currently, on the outskirts of the Putrefied Swamp, in a poisoned grassland unknown to many and overrun with mire and Demon Grass...
A fearsome Lifeform, three blades tall, was hunting in the shadows.
This terrifying being had a pair of curved, sharp horns on its head that not even Dragon Scales could necessarily withstand.
Its muscles were as Solid as if made from Fine Gold and Mithril, every inch filled with a trembling power, and its skin was engraved with evil Ancient Runes. The aura of Extreme Evil emitted from the runes made even Demons’ hearts tremble.
The pair of hands on this evil being were not human-like but extremely sharp claws, indisputably sharp. Not even a warrior’s thick shield would stand a chance before those deadly talons.
The chilling aspect was the opponent’s blood-colored eyes, which revealed unimaginable brutality and bloodlust.
Any life that dare look directly into those eyes would receive an inevitable Spirit Shock and become either a servant or lose sanity to become a bloodthirsty maniac.
If Lide were here, he would be surprised because this Extreme Evil life form was none other than the Divine Monster—Asreaga, struck by the God of Twilight and lost in the spatial turbulence.
At this moment, the aura emanating from Asreaga had undergone a heaven and earth transformation. Before his fall into the abyss, Asreaga had just stepped into the Transcendent realm, not even close to Legendary.
But now, the aura this Divine Monster exuded had reached Legendary and there was even a faint sense of the Divine Power emanating from him...
If one were to look closely, they would find that his Level had reached a staggering Level 29.
This was a Level that most beings of the Main Plane would bow down to in reverence.
In the more than a year lost in the abyss, no one knew what this Divine Monster had experienced.
Asreaga’s growth rate was even faster than Lide’s.
Tap-tap—
Suddenly, a blur of a figure crossed from beyond the fog, and the sound of footsteps squelching in mud and water resounded.
Hidden within the Abyss Demon Grass and poison fog, the slim, brutal bloodshot eyes of Asreaga narrowed slightly, his body bending ever so slightly, like a coiled spring compressing all of its power to the Extreme.
Crack—The sound of a dry branch snapping underfoot echoed in the instant.
Boom—
The compressed spring released in an instant, and the three-blade-tall Divine Monster burst forth with the speed of a thunderbolt.
At that moment, he was over a hundred blades away from his hunting target, but the Divine Monster burst forth before even a single breath had been taken.
Outside, in the rotting black waters and toxic mud, a five-blade-tall Fury Demon was advancing.
This demon, with a High-level abyssal Bloodline, was clad in thick Bone Armor, a gift from its Bloodline, through which even the claws of a giant dragon would hardly tear.
But the most attention-grabbing feature was the four arms on its back—each arm as thick as a bridge pier, filled with a strength that could make one’s legs buckle.
One could imagine the terrifying lethal force it would unleash once it entered combat.
Legend has it that the Fury Demon is a Bloodline from the Lord of Fury, left from ten thousand years ago, and is the highest Level Demon in the Putrefied Swamp.
This Fury Demon’s Level was an astonishing Level 30, a true Demigod.
Level 30 is the highest Level any life form can reach, known as Demigod Level, the pinnacle for ordinary life.
To increase one’s Level beyond this would require either Divine Enthronement or gaining a portion of a god’s power to become a Divine Being.
Judging from the aura emitted by this Fury Demon, it had not attained divinity.
Even so, a Level of 30 was enough to make most demons in the Putrefied Swamp steer clear.
This was just the outskirts of the Putrefied Swamp, without too much terrifying life present.
But as this Fury Demon passed through an inconspicuous patch of poison fog, swim—a figure with the force of shattering the void charged through the fog, slashing across.
The Fury Demon sensed grave danger and turned its head sharply, its eyelids reflecting a ferocious evil figure, and the aura it emitted caused the Demon to feel an unprecedented fear.
This was definitely not an ordinary demon!
But the Fury Demon was not some lowly creature. Rage surfaced on its face, and then its body swelled in size, charging directly at the opponent.
It was going to make this damned demon taste its fists!
The Divine Monster watched as the prey not only didn’t run away but even dared to charge directly at him, and the brutality in his eyes became even more fierce.
The claws of his hands quietly surged with a faint grey force, viciously swinging.
All of this would take too long to describe, but in reality, it all happened within a split second.
The moment of collision came, the surrounding space crumbled and twisted under the force of their powerful energies.
Demons within thousands of blades around them felt two incredibly terrifying auras collide. In that moment, it seemed as though they witnessed the collapse of a Plane, the shattering of mountains.
Two fearsome figures passed by each other.
And then, the next second.
Slash—
Blood sprayed, blossoming a grotesque flower of blood in the sky.
"Ah!!"
A voice of extreme agony howled, like that of a wild beast at the brink of death.
Looking at the scene again, Asreaga’s claws, as easily as piercing through flimsy paper, tore the body of the Fury Demon in half.
The upper body of the Fury Demon had been flung away, while the lower remained in the mud, blood splattering across the black mire, creating an eerie color.
Instant kill.
Level 29 vs. Level 30.
This Demigod-level Fury Demon couldn’t last even a second.
Divine Monster, an existence at the very pinnacle of this world.
Once, Asreaga had set his sights on hunting Divine beings, and even defeated a million years ago, he had escaped from the hands of the Divine and survived.
The essence of this Extreme Evil being had long transcended that of ordinary demons.
No matter how high the level of the Fury Demon, it was just an ordinary demon without Divine Calamity... Level 30 was no more than that.
At the moment of impact, the Fury Demon only felt a chill in its belly, then its body’s strength rapidly dissipated.
Its thick limbs propped on the ground, preventing a total loss of resistance, but that was all.
Torn in two from the abdomen, even the strongest of lives would be destroyed...
Asreaga slightly turned his body, his bloodthirsty, brutal eyes indifferently watching it all.
