The mysterious patterns branded onto the black armor by Mithril radiated an absolutely domineering aura.
Not bad, though not as imposing as the talkative Withered Bone, this appearance was certainly good enough.
Riding it would not cause any loss of face.
Lide floated up and sat upon the back of Castro, which he had not ridden for a long time.
His gaze switched to Freyja.
"Follow us."
With those words, Castro kicked the ground, and the great force lifted it off before it burst into flight with powerful wingbeats.
free\.c o(m)
Boom~
In just a few breaths, a sonic boom occurred, and Castro vanished from above Dawn City.
Freyja, seeing this, took a step forward and her body disappeared into thin air.
Sitting on Castro’s back, Lide felt an exceptional exhilaration.
By his estimation, after breaking through the Transcendent level, Castro’s speed had reached almost triple the speed of sound.
This made him experience the fierce wind in the sky; without keeping up a magical arc shield, even his scalp might be blown off.
The Lost Sea was about 2500 kilometers from the Far Mountain Range.
Even if traveling on land at a hundred kilometers a day, it would take half a month.
But in the sky, at Castro’s full-speed flight, the sea was already in sight in less than an hour.
Freyja’s figure was not beside him, but Lide wasn’t the least bit worried. After all, how could a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel be compared to Castro?
If it hadn’t been for the other’s truly petite size, he would have liked to ride on it for the journey...
Lide looked at the fast-approaching sea surface, his expression slightly changing.
"Demigod-level sea beasts... fragments of the Destiny Tablet..."
"Let’s hope everything goes smoothly on this trip..."

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 472: Arrival at the Lost Sea, an Unexpected Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 471: Chapter 472: Arrival at the Lost Sea, an Unexpected Situation
The sky was a gloomy cold; winter had already set in, and ever since the day the sky cracked, the world had seldom seen the sun.
Of course, for the Bloodline, this was perhaps good news. The thick clouds allowed them to preserve some of their strength during daylight.
Violent gales mixed with snow and ice slapped against the Magic Shield like knives.
Under Castro’s ultra-fast supersonic speed, the Magic Shield was stretched into a teardrop shape, pointed at the front and wide at the back.
Castro’s speed caused the landscape below to rapidly recede, as Lide, with a piercing gaze, looked down and directed Castro’s path.
Although the intelligence command center had located the whereabouts of the Demigod Sea Beast, he decided to visit the Blue Star Tribe first.
The Blue Star Tribe was the Fishman Tribe that had always cooperated with Dawn City. It was Lide who previously exchanged a Golden Bloodline octopus for the half-blood mermaid Kachar with the Fishman Tribe.
The original reason Dawn City came to the Lost Sea was due to the appearance of the Undead Empire, then the invasions of the Beastman and the Fishman attacks on the coast of the Nolan Empire, which caused a shortage of magical raw materials needed by the Crimson Mage Tower.
That’s why Lide sent people to the Lost Sea to find partners and provide Magic Materials for Dawn City.
The cooperation between Dawn City and the Blue Star Tribe was only achieved after a fight between him and the other party.
With time, supported by the powerful alchemy, magic, and technological capabilities of Dawn City, the Blue Star Tribe flourished even more.
By now, the Blue Star Tribe was one of the giants of the Lost Coast.
As to why it was the coast and not the deep sea, that was because the life forms in the deep sea were too terrifying, and the Blue Star Tribe did not have the strength to deal with them.
To facilitate trade between the two parties, Dawn City and the Blue Star Tribe jointly built a city on the coast.
Originally, Lide sent Guido Blackwind to establish the Gale Empire of the Centaurs, also intending to protect the safety of this city.
Now, although the Centaurs were gone, the Fishman Tribe had also stationed a large army there, so the security of the city was not an issue.
With the map’s markings, Lide easily found the coastal city he had never visited before on the coastline—Blue Star City.
Although the Ancient days had come and dangers lurked everywhere, the trade between Dawn City and the Fishman Tribe had not stopped.
Instead, to boost the stockpile of Magic Materials, Dawn City’s demand for supplies had recently surged.
Whoosh~
When Castro, with a Wingspan of 20 Blades, appeared over Blue Star City like a steel behemoth, it immediately caused quite a stir.
Whoo, whoo~
The short blasts of the horn sounded, soldiers on the walls began loading the siege crossbows, and everyone watched tensely at this Extraordinary magical beast intruder.
A single Extraordinary Magical Beast could destroy a city.
Lide had no interest in clashing with these warriors and simply urged Castro to fly into the city; the supersonic cruise was too fast for the city guard to react.
Then, amid a chorus of exclaimations, they arrived with a whoosh in the central square of Blue Star City.
Whoosh~
As the steel behemoth landed steadily, a crowd of onlookers immediately surrounded it.
Dawn City, apart from trading with the Blue Star Tribe, had also formed an alliance with more than a dozen Fishman Tribes around the Lost Coast.
So in Blue Star City, in addition to the Fishman of the Blue Star Tribe, there were many other Sea Clan lives as well—Merfolk, the Killer Whale Clan, Lobster Men, the Sea Cow Clan... and so on. Indeed, the sea harbored many life forms beyond just Fishmen.
The city had become a trading place for various tribes.
Due to the substantial interests involved, the city was strictly guarded.
Even when Castro landed in the square, Lide sensed a Divine-level life form that immediately released a powerful presence.
This Transcendent was familiar to Lide; according to intelligence, it was the Blue Star Tribe Chief, who had gained a significant boost at the last Sea God Festival.
Lide’s primary purpose for coming here was to directly inquire about the news of the Sea God from the Blue Star Tribe’s Clan Leader.
Floating down from Castro, he watched with a very calm expression as the sea creatures and Fishman Warriors, full of malice, crowded around him.
"Where are Amiya and Ivy??" he called out, his voice reverberating throughout the city, enhanced by Magic Power.
The surrounding Sea Clan members were all taken aback.
Who is this man? To dare openly call out to Lord Amiya and Lord Ivy by name.
But just a moment later, swish swish~
Two figures dashed from the sky and then securely landed in front of Lide.
"Good day, your Excellency, Blue Star City warmly welcomes your arrival..."
Ivy looked at Lide with surprise and admiration.
This man, dressed in a black Mage’s robe, with black hair and a graceful demeanor, was the City Lord of Blue Star City and the representative stationed there by Dawn City.
Lide originally had seven second-generation Bloodlines, and Ivy was one of them. Along with another second-generation Bloodline—Lucy, they were the only two females among the original seven.
"City Lord Kachar, good day, your arrival brings luster to Blue Star City!"
Now, the mermaid standing next to Ivy, who had a fish’s lower body and the upper body of a human, spoke respectfully.
Amiya Blue Star, the Blue Star Tribe’s Clan Leader.
This mermaid, who had once sparred with Lide, now exuded an Extraordinary aura and was not weak in strength.
The mermaid’s appearance was very distinctive, with blue hair floating gently in mid-air, giving off a dreamlike feeling as if always soaked in seawater.
What was noteworthy was that Amiya was slightly floating in the air, not standing on the ground.
Looking at Lide, whose face was indifferent, the Mermaid Tribe Chief wasn’t the least bit excited; instead, she was somewhat nervous.
The partnership with Dawn City was one of mutual benefit, and although they had built enough trust over several years, it was limited to trade.
As the Sovereign of Dawn, Lide’s command was overwhelming, and his visit would certainly not be without reason.
Dawn City had long since evolved from what she knew at the start.
A few months before, from Ivy’s words, Amiya learned of Lide’s true identity as the God of Dawn, with millions of Believers, and that his command included several Legendary beings. Since then, Amiya’s attitude towards her partner of several years had begun to change.
The surrounding Sea Clan members were astounded upon hearing Ivy and Amiya’s words.
This handsome human Mage was actually the legendary Dawn Sovereign.
Instantly, they all looked at Lide and Castro at his back with curiosity.
No wonder he’s the Master of Dawn, even his mount is an Extraordinary being...
Despite the ocean’s riches and high abundance of Advanced combat power, Extraordinary Level beings definitely stood at the top of the food chain. Now, one was merely a mount...
This display of might immediately gave them a new understanding of Dawn City.
Of course, if they knew that within the Dimension Space by Lide’s side there lay hidden a Level 36 Death Blazing Angel, they would probably be outright astounded...
Lide nodded slightly toward the two, then extended his right hand. As everyone watched puzzled, the mighty Castro behind him, with a Wingspan of 20 Blades like towering mountains, suddenly shook.
And then, its body rapidly shrank under everyone’s gaze, becoming a mini bat, the size of half a palm, fluttering to Lide’s side and landing on his hand.
Then, this Extraordinary giant beast was casually tucked into his clothing by Lide.
This scene again left the surrounding Sea Clan members in amazement. This is the Dawn Sovereign? Awesome...
Such a massive beast could shrink to such a minuscule size, quite an eye-opener.
Lide paid no attention to the astonished gazes of the surrounding crowd as he looked at the two figures before him with a smile.
"Long time no see, Chief Amiya."
Then he turned to the female Bloodline, Ivy.
"Ivy, lead me to the City Lord’s manor. I have important matters to discuss with you."
"Yes, Your Highness."
Upon hearing this, Ivy quickly summoned a servant to lead the way and then guided Lide toward the City Lord’s manor.
It probably wouldn’t take much time to inquire about the demigod sea beast, but it would hardly be fitting to just stand dryly in the square and ask, it would be unbecoming of his status.
Seeing this, Amiya immediately followed, but this mermaid, who had reached an Extraordinary Level, was very nervous inside.
Her Extraordinary senses were already extremely sharp. Though Lide didn’t actively exude pressure, she could still feel the almost imperceptible Legendary aura emanating from him upon drawing closer.
It was like having a blade pressed against her neck, causing her unease and restlessness.
A Level 20 in front of a Level 28 Legendary, it would be odd if she felt at peace.
Of course, a deeper reason lay in the fact that Dawn City had grown into a mammoth force that the Blue Star Tribe was no longer capable of dealing with.
Inwardly facing a power she could not contend with, anxiety was natural.
Amiya even had the self-awareness that if it weren’t for the Blue Star Tribe’s deep-sea location, with the ocean as a natural sanctuary, they probably would have fallen under Dawn City’s control long ago.
Glory was not Earth, where laws exist to ensure relative equality between trading parties through national agencies.
In Glory, transactions relied solely on power; whoever was stronger held absolute initiative. If the power disparity was too great, the weaker party might not even have the right to speak.
Although the cooperation between the Blue Star Tribe and Dawn City ostensibly remained equal, with the further widening of the power gap between them, inequality had long since taken root behind the scenes.
Amiya, as the Clan Leader of the Blue Star Tribe, needed to personally oversee Blue Star City, which spoke volumes on its own.
With her thoughts churning, Amiya followed Lide and Ivy to the City Lord’s manor.
Within the luxurious hall, Lide appropriately took the seat of honor without hesitation.
Amiya and Ivy sat to his left and right, respectively, each with differing emotions at the moment.
After Lide took his seat, he skipped pleasantries and got straight to the point.
"Amiya, you’re aware that I’ve been seeking information about the Sea God.
As the Clan Leader of the Blue Star Tribe, who has participated in several Sea God Festivals, I’m sure you’re quite informed about the Sea God."
The information command center had sent people to contact Amiya, but because of her high status, the information the spies obtained was not much different from what they got elsewhere, with little of use.
Thus Lide came in person for this occasion.
View the correct content at .
This Mermaid Tribe Chief dared not conceal information from others, but she definitely wouldn’t dare to hide it from him; she neither had the courage nor the ability.
The law of the jungle, survival of the fittest, this world has always been this cruel, with the strong maintaining absolute dominance over the weak.
With Lide’s words, Amiya’s expression relaxed slightly, thankful it was only these matters she was being asked about, nothing else.
The mermaid pondered for a moment before slowly responding.
"Kachar City Lord, regarding the Sea God, I don’t know much..."
"Get to the point," Lide said as he raised an eyebrow, his aura flashing briefly—he wasn’t here to listen to nonsense.
Feeling the terrifying aura from Lide, Amiya’s heart trembled, and she quickly began to speak.
"Kachar City Lord, I did not deceive you. Every time the Sea God Festival is held, the slumbering Sea God does not appear. After we kill the offering and throw it into the vast sea, it disappears without a trace."
"But if the offering pleases the Sea God, he will choose a few among those who presented the offering and bestow upon them great power.
I was granted power during the last Sea God Festival, which allowed me to break through to Transcendent not long ago."
Looking at Amiya, who did not seem to be lying, Lide frowned involuntarily.
The situation was almost identical to the intelligence he had gathered.
Was this trip in vain?
"During the sacrifice, is there any incantation or method to call upon the other party?"
Amiya shook her head.
"No, on the day of the Sea God Festival, the Sea God will appear on his own."
"Then is there any way to find the Sea God’s resting place?"
"No, the Sea God is too powerful and terrifying, we never dare to linger too long in that sea area, whether he is awake or asleep, we cannot see him..."
"..."
In the end, after asking for a long time, Lide was frustrated to find that Amiya wasn’t withholding the truth, but the Mermaid Tribe Chief genuinely had no clue.
This was preposterous - the Sea God Festival had a history of hundreds or even thousands of years, and every time they would just passively go to make offerings when the time came... They never actively sought to explore.
No wonder the technology and magic of these Fishmen were so backward; such thinking... was too dull.
Just when Lide was about to give up and go directly to the place where the Sea God had previously been offered sacrifices to investigate.
An unwitting remark from Amiya sparked his interest.
"Kachar City Lord, it seems that the Sea God is particularly interested in crustacean magical beasts and crabs.
The main reason I received the Sea God’s favor last time was that in addition to the Golden Octopus we traded with you, I also caught a giant crab with the Golden Bloodline."
"Afterwards, I inquired carefully, and others who were granted power along with me, their offerings were also crustacean and crab life forms..."
Crab life forms? Crabs?
Upon hearing these words, Lide immediately thought of the crab that liked to blow bubbles that he encountered when exploring the Divine relics with the Elf and the Red-eyed Lady.
And that crab was also of Demigod Level existence.
What impressed him most was that every one of the bubbles contained a space, and the Divine relic they sought was hidden within a bubble from a crab. It was all quite astonishing.
The only problem was that it was the Elf leading the way at the time; they had traveled so far from the sea area that he hadn’t noted the crab’s location.
And even if he had remembered, it might not be useful, since so much time had passed, and the creature might no longer be there.
But regardless, he had finally found some traces.
Now that he had an idea, Lide no longer hesitated.
"This information is very important, Chief Amiya. You’ve done well; I hope the Blue Star Tribe can have deeper cooperation with Dawn City under your leadership."
Amiya, flattered by Lide’s praise, immediately stood up in response.
"It should be so, Kachar City Lord. It would be our honor."
Lide nodded, took a deep look at Amiya, then rose without saying more and headed straight for the door.
Ivy and Amiya immediately followed him out.
It wasn’t until after Lide, riding on Castro, disappeared into the sky above Blue Star City, that Amiya finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Although she only dealt with Lide for the brief part of a day, it was an exceptionally intense experience for her.
Facing a legend, a terrifying existence that could kill her at any moment, the pressure on her heart didn’t need to be spoken.
And the Sea Clan and the Bloodline weren’t any related races either, so she was genuinely worried that Lide might turn his face in anger.
However, what reassured her somewhat was that even though Lide had grown increasingly powerful, from his attitude, Dawn City’s policy toward the Fishman Tribe hadn’t changed much.
Actually, Chief Amiya’s concern over Lide’s attitude, apart from his powerful strength, also harbored other thoughts deep in her heart.
After the coming of the old days, the crack in the sky was growing larger, and she could clearly sense the threat of ancient times.
Originally, she didn’t care too much, but an incident half a month ago completely changed her mind.
Half a month ago, near the territorial waters controlled by the Blue Star Tribe, an Ancient Evil God that had descended on the Main Plane suddenly appeared, seemingly looking for something but found nothing.
The enraged Ancient Evil God slaughtered the lives of half a sea area directly.
The Killer Whale Clan, which was comparable to the Blue Star Tribe in strength, was directly annihilated, and the seawater turned red for a whole week without dispersing.
This incident made her sense of crisis reach its peak.
Although the Blue Star Tribe was located in the depths of the ocean, with the sea acting as a natural barrier and seemingly not too much of a concern on the surface, reality had told her that before an absolutely strong being, the weak had no room to resist at all.
And as time went by, the situation would definitely deteriorate further, which was a visible threat to her and even to the entire Lost Sea area.
Therefore, she had been guarding over Blue Star City all along, and she had indeed intended to deepen cooperation with Dawn City.
The Blue Star Tribe needed the protection of a stronger power.
And the god of Dawn City, with tens of millions of believers, was the most powerful existence she could access.
According to normal judgment, the best choice should be to seek refuge with the Fishman Country, which was closer to the deep sea side.
But when she learned of the current strengths of Dawn City, her mind quietly changed.
The high-end combat power of the Fishman Country might not be able to compete with Dawn City.
Moreover, the threats in the deep sea were too many. If something happened, the current strength of the Blue Star Tribe alone would not be able to cope, and she didn’t believe that the Fishman Country would truly protect them.
Although the Blue Star Tribe was considered strong on the coast, it was nothing to speak of in the deep sea.
By comparison, if they could gain the protection of Dawn City, perhaps they would be able to live better...
But now, the only thing that troubled Chief Amiya was that Dawn City was too far from the sea.
Even if the Blue Star Tribe pledged allegiance to Dawn City now, they wouldn’t be able to move inland...
This fatal key factor was the reason she had been unable to make a decision.
Lide, who had already left Blue Star City, naturally did not know that Chief Amiya had thoughts of seeking refuge with Dawn City. Right now, he was looking at the map, guiding Castro toward the destination.
The place of the Sea God Festival.
The Sea God Festival took place every ten years, and the last one happened four years ago.
According to the deductions of the intelligence command center, to awaken the Sea God ahead of schedule, the flesh and blood of a large amount of high-level life is needed.
And just now Amiya said that the Demigod-level Sea Beast might have a particular fondness for high-level crab life...
This made Lide set his sights on the Ancient Space Crab he had seen before.
But for now, it was better to go and see first. If they could find that Sea God hidden in the Dimension Space, that would be best; if not, they would capture that Ancient Space Crab for the sacrifice.
The vast ocean was immeasurable, and Blue Star City was a good 2,000 kilometers away from the location of the Sea God Festival.
Thanks to the detailed map from the intelligence command center, marked by some iconic islands, Lide took several detours and arrived at that sea area about one and a half Sunshine Hours later.
The specific coordinates of the Sea God Festival were in front of a circular island.
The island was named Sea God Island, incredibly round as if drawn with a compass, and very recognizable.
All one needed was to offer sacrifices ten kilometers in front of Sea God Island to be sensed by the half-Demigod Sea God.
That’s how the Sea God Festival had always been done.
After arriving at his destination, Lide did not go hunting for sea beasts to sacrifice. Instead, he drifted off Castro’s body, speeding toward the surging sea.
Upon reaching the designated spot, he floated in the air right above the sea surface.
His spiritual power spread out like the tentacles of an octopus without any restraint.
At the same time, the pressure of his status as a Legendary Strongman began to emanate.
"Lowly sea creatures, I am the lord of the ocean. Arise and prostrate before me!!"
The ancient blasphemous language, filled with Spirit Shock, exploded in all directions.
Within dozens of miles, the presence of Lide, unrestrained, could be sensed.
Some marine life wandering nearby shivered, diving towards the seafloor in haste, while the seabirds, startled, screeched and scattered in all directions.
Only the blasphemous language continued to echo in this area...
One minute.
Two minutes.
After ten minutes, Lide ceased his calls in the blasphemous language.
By then, aside from the sea wind and the waves, there was no other movement around; even the marine life had fled far from this region due to the pressure of the Legendary Strongman.
The situation was strangely a bit awkward.
With a twitch of his mouth, Lide thought, this little runt’s hidden quite deep...
Provocation failed...
He cleared his throat and turned his head to the side.
"Frey, go down to the seabed and look for the resting place of that Sea God."
As his words fell, the calm space around him shattered with a crack.
Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel Frey, clad in black Angel Battle Armor, cut a striking figure as she appeared.
"Under your command, Sovereign."
After speaking, Frey soared upwards, then while under Lide’s gaze, plummeted straight down towards the sea surface like a shooting star.
Bang!
The instant Frey slammed into the sea surface, hundred-yard-high waves burst forth, as if a ten-thousand-tonne depth charge had been thrown into the ocean, majestic and terrifying.
Exaggerated tsunamis surged away towards the distance, swallowing everything clean.
Even the impact was so horrific that it created a huge vacuum at the point of impact, with sea water furiously rushing in at that moment.
Gurgling—the formation of a colossal death whirlpool ensued.
The scene looked as if it were straight out of a mural depicting a mythical legend, shaking the hearts of onlookers.
However, having witnessed the unparalleled sight of Frey slicing the Heavenly Mountains in half with a single stroke in the Plague God Country, Lide maintained sufficient composure.
This Level 36 terrifying being’s true strength was still beyond his judgement; he only knew that the creature was overwhelmingly powerful.
For the next ten minutes or so, the surrounding tens of miles of sea area seemed to be stirred by an ancient behemoth.
The water underneath roared chaotically, and giant waves as tall as several dozen blades continuously surged up on the sea surface.
However, what disappointed Lide was that despite the huge commotion Frey caused, the Sea God had not revealed even the slightest hint of its presence.
"It seems that the other party is not sleeping nearby... otherwise, even a pig would have woken up by now."
After a short while, Frey gave up on this crude method, emerged from the waves immaculate, and stood before him.
"Sovereign, I have not detected any powerful life presence nearby, nor any traces of other planes..."
Lide nodded, he had been mentally prepared for this.
He had done so much intelligence work before just to cope with this situation.
"Since brute force doesn’t work, let’s proceed as we planned before.
We’ll go deep into the sea and hunt some sea beasts for the offering..."
Having made a decision, Lide did not linger in the disturbed sea area, but remounted Castro and flew toward the deep sea.
The Lost Sea was vast and boundless. Legend had it that at the deepest part, the Sea Eye, there would be countless Legendary-level sea beasts, and even Divines might be found...
Legends were mostly legends, but the deeper one went, the stronger the sea beasts indeed became.
Yet, since arriving at the sea, Lide’s luck seemed to have run out.
In the following three days, even though Lide continued to head deeper into the ocean, he did not find any strong sea beasts.
It was as if the sea beasts had vanished overnight.
Finally, just when he was getting impatient, he encountered two Extraordinary-level magical beasts on an island, which barely made up enough offerings.
However, these past few days’ experiences still amazed Lide.
He had delved thousands of miles into the ocean and had not found any powerful sea beasts. It was too unscientific, the whole thing reeked of strangeness.
The ocean was rich in resources, with a higher probability of birthing powerful life than land, and according to reason, there should have been even more powerful sea beasts emerging now that the energy in the skies had thickened after the old days’ events. Yet, the reality was the opposite.
Although this had something to do with his not venturing into the deeper sea, wasn’t it too much that he couldn’t even sense them?
Fortunately, those two Extraordinary magical beasts were barely enough...
After Lide couldn’t find more high-level sea beasts, he stopped searching and returned to the site of the Sea God Festival in a rather unpleasant mood, bringing Frey with him.
Upon their return to the destination, he didn’t hesitate and immediately had Frey tear the two Extraordinary beasts in half and toss them into the sea.
The immense energy contained within the blood and flesh of the Extraordinary beasts instantly aroused the nearby ocean life for tens of miles.
But with Frey’s presence enveloping the area, none of those sea creatures dared to approach.
In the end, around twenty kilometers away from the corpses of the magical beasts, a vast circle formed; countless marine lives piled up like mountains, yet none dared to step beyond this boundary.
However, what caused Lide to frown was that the expected arrival of the Sea God had not occurred.
Ten minutes, twenty minutes, he waited a total of five Sunshine Hours, from dusk until the darkness of night.
The carcasses of the two Extraordinary magical beasts had become pale from soaking in the seawater, and the energy in their blood was also starting to dissipate gradually...
Seeing this scene, Lide’s expression became somewhat displeased.
"Could this damn Sea God really have slept to death??"
Then, as if remembering something, he had Frey restrain her aura, to see if that would make a difference.
He wanted to make one last effort.
After Frey’s presence vanished, the Sea God did not appear, but the surrounding marine life rushed towards the corpses of the two extraordinary magical beasts as if they were mad with urgency.
A gluttonous feast then began.
Lide did not interfere, his heart still harboring a sliver of hope...
What pissed him off, though, was that it was gone, nothing left after the corpses of the two extraordinary magical beasts were devoured.
The Sea Beast that had obtained the Destiny Tablet shard had not shown up.
Seeing this scene, Lide felt like someone who buys instant noodles and finds no flavor packet, eats raisins and finds only seeds without the fruit, or looks forward to a five-hour download only to discover it’s "Calabash Brothers"...
"You tell me you’re not coming after I’ve taken my pants off...
It’s not even this hard to get a first love into a hotel room..."
He was in a terribly sulky mood.
A moment later, Lide seemed to remember something and turned his gaze to Castro who was beside him.
"Castro, go to Green City right away and ask Betty if she can find the Ancient Space Crab we encountered when we explored the ruins of the Divine. If Betty doesn’t know, tell her about our current situation and have her inform Wina..."
Amiya had said that Sea Beast liked crabs, but unfortunately, Lide hadn’t taken note of the location where they found the Ancient Space Crab.
Having been led by the Elves without a specific sea chart, he had no clear idea of the direction, and what’s more, if that crab was hiding in the space like this Sea God, where would he even begin to look.
"Indeed, this world is too magical. When Frey is invincible, we can’t find an enemy..."
Lide sighed to the heavens, possessing the skill to slay dragons, yet unable to find any dragons to slay. Could anything be more frustrating?
Upon receiving the order, Castro immediately flapped his wings and triggered a departure.
Boom—with a series of air explosions, he vanished in an instant.
Watching Castro’s fading figure, Lide couldn’t help but feel a mixture of laughter and tears.
He had come to the Lost Sea prepared to let Frey engage in an epic battle against an opponent, ready for a fight that would shatter the heavens and reverse the seas.
But now, what was there to fight? Damn it, he hadn’t even seen the enemy.
Floating in the air for a moment, Lide, feeling somewhat depressed, was about to find somewhere to rest when suddenly an extremely odd horn call emanated from the depths of the Lost Sea.
Woo woo~
The sound was piercing, like the roar of some sea beast.
However, Lide could sense that this strange horn call was coming from some kind of powerful equipment...
After the horn sounded, the sea monsters below, still gnawing on the corpses, all stiffened at once.
The low-level Sea Beasts were okay, but several of the higher-level beasts, reaching Level 15, seemed to have received some kind of command, immediately abandoning their feast and started swimming towards the direction of the horn call.
They were responding to the call of the horn.
Seeing this rather eerie scene, Lide’s eyes narrowed slightly.
"Could the reason I can’t find powerful sea beasts in the deep sea have something to do with the horn call?
And who’s blowing the horn to summon these sea beasts??"
"Did that Demigod-level Sea Beast also respond to the horn? What about the shard of the Destiny Tablet?"
He suddenly felt that the current turn of events was somewhat beyond what he had anticipated...

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 473: Seven Divine Spirits
chapters.content:
Chapter 472: Chapter 473: Seven Divine Spirits
The horn sound emanating from deep within the Lost Sea seemed filled with Magic Power, compelling sea creatures to mindlessly swim in one direction.
But unfortunately, the horn sound did not last long. Just as Lide decided to set out and investigate, it abruptly vanished.
The air bore no trace of what had happened, as if nothing had occurred at all.
And those sea creatures influenced by the horn sound came to their senses and scattered in all directions...
Lide watched this strange and eerie scene with a persisting unease...
Since arriving in the Lost Sea, things had been off.
This sea seemed to hide some earth-shattering secret...
"Regardless," Lide thought, "I should wait for Castro to return. The Destiny Tablet fragment is the purpose of this trip. Whatever else happens, no matter how strange, must wait..."
After steadying his mind, Lide did not dwell on it any further and made his way to Sea God Island.
The air became still, with only the sounds of the waves and the sea breeze remaining.
A peculiar tranquility set in...
Night had deepened, and because of the rifts, not a sliver of light pierced the dense clouds that shrouded everything.
Frey had vanished again, leaving Lide alone on the island.
There was a moment of reflection for Lide. If he’d known, he would have brought the chatty Withered Bone with him—it’s better to have someone to talk to than to be bored.
Time ticked away slowly, and to Lide’s surprise, Castro had not returned after four or five Sunshine Hours.
And during this time, that strange horn sound was heard once more.
This time, like before, the sound only lasted for perhaps less than five minutes, still drawing numerous sea creatures toward the center of the area.
Night receded, and dawn broke.
Lide had waited through the night, but still, there was no sight of Castro, which made him furrow his brows.
Under normal circumstances, this time was enough for Castro to make the trip three to five times... What was happening now??
The wait continued until noon, when he finally saw the steel behemoth speeding toward him in the sky.
Whoosh whoosh~
Castro, with a wingspan of 20 blades, landed directly on the island, but there wasn’t just Betty on its back.
Two graceful figures leapt down and made their way towards Lide.
"Good morning, Lord Lide."
Betty was the first to speak, the Northern Land Valkyrie’s eyes filled with indescribable joy and excitement upon seeing Lide.
Lide nodded slightly, his gaze drifting to the figure on Betty’s right—a girl with a proud tilt to her head whose face was calm, yet her inner pride was palpable.
Her crimson cloak rustled loudly in the sea wind behind her, strikingly eye-catching.
A smile crossed Lide’s face.
"Long time no see, City Lord Andabella."
Indeed, the visitor was none other than Andabella, once taken to the Storm Sea Domain under the protection of the Red-eyed Lady, her bloodline full of pride.
Looking at the extremely handsome face before her, Andabella’s expression was complex.
"Should I call you Izreal... or Lord IIo?"
When Lide had saved Andabella in Risier City, he had bluffed a name from a game character... hence her question.
"Either is fine."
Lide, with a thick skin, was unfazed.
His eyes couldn’t help but drift over the girl... to the Blood Cloak fluttering in the wind behind her.
The texture of Dragon Skin, indeed a pleasure to look at again and again.
He instinctively opened his attribute panel, then grew surprised.
Blood Cloak
Quality: Inheritance Artifact (Bound)
Trait: ??
Description: ??
This cloak has actually upgraded to a Divine Artifact?
No wonder back in Risier City, when he had grabbed the head of the God of Plague, planning to flee, the suddenly appearing Andabella was able to directly block the raging God of Plague, even forcing that unlucky Ancient Evil God away from the Main Plane...
Divine Artifact...
Lide felt not the slightest bit excited... really...
"I suppose I’ll address you the same way Betty does, Mr. Lide..."
Andabella nodded, a hint of complexity that seemed too profound for outsiders flickering in her pale silver eyes.
She could never forget that time when Risier City fell, and the figure like a Heavenly God descended before her, blocking everything for her.
This man had pulled her back from the brink of destruction, and she owed him her life.
"Thank you for the assistance you provided to Risier City, and for your rescue of me last time..."
After a pause, with nervousness coloring her face, she asked.
"Mr. Lide, may I know how the members of the Risier family are faring now?"
Back when Risier City fell to the Beastmen, although Lide managed to save Andabella, he also took a large number of elite talents from Risier City with him.
Those elites greatly supplemented the talent gap in Dawn City at that time, and the goblins were also snatched up by Lide in that battle.
"No need to worry," Lide said with a smile, "your family’s elder—Horn is now the dean of Dawn Academy, holding a revered position.
And the other members of the Risier family have all become the backbone of Dawn City, living a prosperous life, no worse off than in Risier City."
The infrastructure of Dawn City was so advanced that even the quality of life of a regular noble might not compare to that of the common citizens of Dawn City.
Dawn City had long surpassed other cities of the world.
Hearing this, Andabella suddenly breathed a sigh of relief.
She couldn’t control other nobles of Risier City, but the members of the Risier family were her last blood relatives in this world, and nobody would want their own family to suffer.
"Mr. Lide, I once promised to find a piece of Legendary Equipment for you, which I have procured after much effort.
It is currently being kept safe within the Crimson Mage Tower by Miss Vena and is not with me."
Upon hearing this, Lide nodded slightly, looking ruefully at the bright red cloak...
"There’s no rush; I trust the judgement of City Lord Andabella."
After the pleasantries, it was time to get down to business. His profound gaze intensely focused on the proud girl who always held her head high.
"City Lord Bella coming here with Betty suggests that it’s not just for this matter."
"Last time we explored a Divine relic, we encountered an Ancient Space Crab. Do you remember that, City Lord Bella?"
Betty wasn’t someone oblivious to importance, and bringing Andabella here meant their visit had to do with the Ancient Space Crab that he was searching for.
Indeed, Andabella nodded, her tone still cool.
"Mr. Lide, after you fell into the abyss, we stayed at the Divine relic for quite some time.
To safeguard against any changes, I left a secret Bloodline mark on that Ancient Space Crab before we left the relics..."
With that said, there was no need for further words.
A light sparked in Lide’s eyes, and he made a decisive statement.
"City Lord Andabella, I will trouble you this time; I need the crab’s fresh blood to summon the Sea God here..."
Andabella had been aware of this matter before coming, and since she had agreed to come, she naturally did not have any aversion to the request, answering concisely and clearly.
Seeing everything settled, Lide no longer hesitated and immediately joined Betty and Andabella on their journey to find the Ancient Space Crab aboard Castro.
Castro, with a Wingspan of 20 Blades, had an extremely spacious back, so much so that not just three but even ten people could ride with ease.
Whoosh whoosh~
At three times the speed of sound, Castro was by no means slow, vanishing from the sea domain in the blink of an eye.
Andabella’s bloodline mark was like a compass, accurately sensing its direction and distance, which saved a lot of time in the search process.
Half a Sunshine Hour later, Castro flew out and paused over a densely packed area of islands.
Lide looked down from the sky, the sea was dotted with thousands of islands, large and small, scattered like stars.
Seeing this scene, Andabella spoke.
"Mr. Lide, this is the hiding place of the ancient space crab. I can sense that it’s in this area, but I can’t pinpoint its exact location anymore..."
Lide looked at the sprawling islands below and waved his hand.
"Frey, find that crab."
At his command, the level 36 Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel tore through the space and appeared, much to Andabella and Betty’s astonishment.
Frey’s Angel Battle Sword was unsheathed, its edge flashing fiercely as if it could slice through heaven and earth.
Divine Power crushed mountains, filling the air with a sense of impending doom.
"As you wish, my lord."
After her cold voice rang out.
Whoosh~
Frey’s body suddenly shot up into the sky.
Then, the Death Blazing Angel recreated the iconic scene of a meteor falling into the sea.
Boom~
With infinite Divine Power, Frey plummeted from the sky into the sea, the force of her impact like a colossal mountain smashing into the ocean’s surface. The collision sounded like thunder from the ninth heaven, exploding loudly.
At the center of the collision, a terrifying shockwave spread out, causing the sea to sink dozens of blades as if struck by a giant celestial hand.
After that, the sea area plunged into a state of fury.
Crack~
Sword Qi thousands of blades long surged up from the seabed, cutting in all directions. The Solid islands, like fragile glass cups, were shattered by the Sword Qi, sending giant boulders flying through the air.
The scene was intensely shocking.
Just a few minutes earlier, no one could have imagined that the sprawling expanse of islands over dozens of miles would be shattered in a mere dozen breaths.
Giant boulders tens of blades high shattered and flew amidst the Sword Qi, mixed with towering waves, turning the area into an undisputed Land of Death.
Yet, under such fearsome power, the ancient space crab showed no signs of movement...
Seeing this, Lide’s brows furrowed tight – wasn’t there a problem?
But as this thought arose, crack~suddenly, when Frey’s Sword Qi swept over a small island, the situation abruptly changed.
Boom~
A giant crab emerged from the sea like an ancient beast, its claws hundreds of blades long, exuding an aura of sheer terror with just one glance.
Even the most Solid city walls would seem like paper in front of these colossal claws.
Jet-black, with a massive island on its back, the crab’s form was exaggerated to the extreme.
The ancient space crab, which could create space bubbles, finally appeared.
Frey, having sunken to the sea bottom, sensed this and instantly flew out of the water, then stood tall before the ancient space crab.
With full might unleashed.
The terrifying Divine Power made it seem as though heaven and earth were prostrate at her feet, even Lide felt his own insignificance in that moment.
A level 36 life, how terrifying.
Although Frey appeared ant-like in comparison to the crab’s mountainous form, once both released their auras, the dynamics flipped completely.
Frey, like an ancient titanic beast, could shatter stars with one hand, while the exaggerated form of the ancient space crab was emphatically suppressed...
The battle was on the verge of erupting amidst the standoff.
But as Frey rose with her sword, her Divine Power escalating to the point it warped space for a hundred blades around her.
All of a sudden, the crab’s body trembled, and to everyone’s amazement, its exaggerated body began to shrink bit by bit until it was the same size as an ordinary human.
Although the crab’s size was still considerable, it was nowhere near the level it had been before.
What was even more surprising was that the Ancient Space Crab had completely let go of its aura, and then slowly started flying towards Frey out of thin air.
When it approached Frey, all eight of its legs kneeled in worship. This Demigod-level Ancient Space Crab, when facing a level 36 Death Blazing Angel, had submitted cleanly and neatly.
Lide watched the scene somewhat astonished.
What the hell? It was a Demigod-level crab, yet it submitted without even putting up a fight?
That was just too spineless.
Frey herself had not expected the mighty crab to give up so easily, and she couldn’t help but turn her gaze towards Lide.
Seeing this, Lide twitched the corner of his mouth and waved his hand, signaling her to hold back.
After all, his goal was the great crab, and now that he had it in his grasp, he was indifferent to whether it was alive or dead.
The real objective was to lure out the slumbering Sea God, the sky’s rift was constantly emitting a dense energy from ancient times, and there was not much time left.
"Frey, take this crab with you, and let’s return to the Sea God’s domain..."
"As you command, my lord."
After receiving her orders, Frey waved her hand, and a surge of grey power emerged, which continued to shrink the Ancient Space Crab, originally the size of a human, until it became a tiny crab that could fit on half a palm.
Miniature and adorable, it looked nothing like the terrifying behemoth that had blotted out the sky just moments before.
Frey held the Ancient Space Crab in one hand and the Angel Battle Sword in the other, then stepped forward and vanished on the spot.
Seeing this, Lide did not hesitate any longer and urged Castro to fly towards the area of the Sea God Festival.
The quest for the fragments of the Destiny Tablet had been fraught with twists and turns; although he had not encountered any formidable foes, it had been incredibly vexing.
Moreover, Lide still could not be sure if the crab’s blood would draw out the Sea God, whose resting place was unknown.
And then there was the mystery of that unknown horn sound, which added a mysterious veil to the Lost Sea Domain.
Half a Sunshine Hour later, at the location of the Sea God Festival.
Lide, riding Castro, had just approached the area when his expression suddenly changed.
He noticed that someone was already here.
And they were offering sacrifices to Sea Beasts...
From the looks of it, their goal was the same as his, the slumbering Demigod-level Sea Beast.
Lide’s mind raced.
"Could the news of the Destiny Tablet fragments have been discovered by these people??"
His gaze immediately grew colder.
The fragments of the Destiny Tablet were tied to the very survival of Dawn City.
This was a treasure he had to obtain!
No matter who the others were, if they dared to compete with him for it, they would be his mortal enemies.
No exceptions.
In the struggle for living space, there was no room for reason; if the others got hold of the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, the unfortunate ones would be the tens of millions of people in Dawn City.
Holding the Inheritance Artifact Andabella in his hand, Lide did not hesitate at all. A Legendary Level aura burst forth, causing Castro to accelerate and head directly towards several figures above the sea.
Lide’s unmistakable presence caught the attention of those mysterious people on the sea surface in that instant.
In that moment, seven auras powerful enough to collapse heaven and earth bore down upon them.
The divine awe, like a vast river of stars spilling across the sky, caused billions of tons of seawater to surge.
The entire sea domain seemed to have come to a standstill.
Feeling that terrifying aura, Lide’s complexion tightened.
Those seven auras were all Divine!!
On this small expanse of the sea, seven Gods had appeared!!

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 374: Divine of the Sea Clan, listen to me, we are actually friends...
chapters.content:
Chapter 473: Chapter 374: Divine of the Sea Clan, listen to me, we are actually friends...
The calm sea surface, where seven terrifying divine pressures fell like stars made the entire sea area thick like mercury, barely allowing even breaths to be drawn evenly.
Andabella and Betty now had extremely solemn expressions on their faces.
Both of their strengths were remarkable, but in the face of divine dignity, they still felt an almost suffocating pressure.
Yet, both girls showed no hint of fear at this moment, their demeanor outstanding.
Andabella gazed at Lide’s proudly erect silhouette, her proud face slightly softened, seemingly recalling the time when he had stood in front of her amidst danger...
Betty’s eyes filled with a fighting spirit as she looked towards the seven figures in the distance, Northern Warriors, fearless and undaunted.
Even in their weakest moments, they dared to charge at a giant dragon, the powerful divine pressure not only failed to frighten this warrior goddess but instead ignited a battle spirit within her.
Northern people never back down.
Huhu~
In just a few breaths, Castro approached those figures under terrifying pressure.
The sea area that had been sacrificed to the Extraordinary Magical Beast was now dyed red with blood, and the sea surface was dotted with over thirty bodies of sea beasts.
Moreover, these sea beasts were all Deep Sea Giant Beasts that Lide had never seen before, and a slight sensing revealed that these thirty corpses were all of Extraordinary Level...
An exaggerated and terrifying sight.
The Extraordinary Sea Beasts bled like water pumps from their wounds, their blood containing terrifying energy fluctuations.
The sea life within dozens of kilometers felt this and were incredibly excited, gathering around, but due to the fear of the divine presence, they only dared to hover nearby.
Eventually, a huge circle appeared in this sea area, with the center zone filled with the giant corpses, the surrounding water already stained red.
Outside were densely packed marine lives, too many to see the end,
creating a scene filled with bloodshed.
Lide’s gaze swept over the sea surface, and his attention turned to those seven figures emitting terrifying pressure.
These figures floating on the sea surface, the instigators of everything, were not ordinary human divinities, but authentic members of the Sea Clan—Killer Whale Men, Sea Seal Men, Sea Snake Men... among others in the seven figures.
Among them, the most terrifying in momentum was a mermaid in the middle.
Her head was adorned with a beautifully crafted crown made of pearls and gemstones, she held a trident, levitating above the sea surface, her golden hair floated mid-air, full of vitality.
Her azure eyes with sharp murderous intent closely watched Castro coming from afar, the surrounding light twisting under her pressure, extremely frightening.
Seeing this, Lide’s expression was cold and calm, with no fluctuation visible on his face.
He turned to look at the two girls behind him.
"If a battle occurs later, you both follow Castro and leave this area first."
The two girls, looking into Lide’s profound eyes, felt inexplicably moved inside. Before the imminent great battle, he still thought of them, so considerate...
Lide simply instructed them with a single statement, completely unaware of how sensitive the girls’ hearts can be...
After his words fell, he floated up directly and headed towards those seven Sea Clan gods.
His handsome face with distinct facial features showed no hint of fear, but instead was filled with a lofty demeanor, his eyes brimming with a dominating presence that looked down upon everything.
A Main God’s pressure permeated out.
Merely seven Sea Clan Gods.
I have a great general, capable of slaughtering gods of the heavens.
And even without Frey, he still carried a ring that could summon the Dark Sovereign.
Whenever he wished, he could bring out a slaughter blade of the Undead Monarch Level to slaughter these foes.
Were these seven Sea Clan Gods enough for him to kill?
Watching Lide approaching alone, the mermaid divine being at the center had a cold gaze.
"State your purpose, stranger of might."
Facing a Main God whose background was not clear, and before they became enemies, these Sea Clan Gods were also reluctant to act rashly.
The Dawn Main God’s formidable pressure was as glorious as a prison, facing seven without losing ground.
The scent of deicide he carried after slaughtering divinities was also clearly displayed in front of these few Sea Clan Gods.
The weak have no right to negotiate with the strong.
It was not the time to pretend to be weak; only by showing the strongest side can one gain respect.
Although the tone of the other wasn’t polite, Lide still keenly sensed the caution of these Sea Gods.
He didn’t bother to answer, knowing the enemy and knowing oneself would secure victory... He directly opened the attribute panel of the opponents, but after a glance, his expression turned extremely grave.
Were the origins of these gods a bit exaggerated?
Virginia Sea
Level: 34/40 (Strength not recovered)
Divine Title: God of the Great Sea
Divine Position: Ocean, Waves, Storm, Disaster
Skill: ???
Divine Arts: ???
Explanation: Divine Main God of the Ocean God System, once a powerful Divine Power God who controlled the force of the ocean, but for some reasons, has not yet recovered to peak strength.
Trident
Quality: High-level Divine Artifact
Attribute: Holding the trident allows one to control the power of the ocean.
Explanation: This is a weapon exclusive to the Sea God, only the master of the ocean can wield it.
Surprisingly, the lead mermaid’s Level is as high as 34, and her original Level was an exaggerated 40—Powerful Divine Power!!
The trident in her hand is also a genuine, official Divine Artifact, not a high imitation.
Besides the mermaid, the other six Sea Clan Gods are all at Level 31 with Medium Divine Power...
Lide, initially planning a swift victory, had a subtle expression after reviewing the attributes of the seven gods before him.
This was absurd.
He was just looking for a Demigod Sea Beast, and instead, he stumbled upon the entire Ocean God System!
Seven True Gods, wasn’t this a bit too much?
The other six gods were manageable, but Frey could handle it if she went berserk.
Only the Mermaid Main God filled him with vigilance—she was a genuine Divine Main God, and although her Medium Divine Power hadn’t been restored yet, such an established Main God wouldn’t be lacking in combat power despite her not-so-high Level.
Not to mention that she was holding the trident, a Divine Artifact of countless legends.
Lide inwardly gave up on the idea of swift victory.
A Level 34 Divine Main God, only two levels below Frey.
Even if Frey could win, it would likely come at a significant cost, and there were six genuine gods to assist her.
If a fight really broke out, he might not be able to suppress the entire Divine System...
"State your purpose, stranger," the Mermaid God repeated when she heard no answer.
Lide regained his composure upon hearing this and, after a moment of reflection, spoke slowly.
"Haven’t you found that Demigod Sea Beast yet?"
The moment he spoke, the air froze.
The seven Sea Clan Gods’ murderous intent surged instantly; they locked onto him, ready to strike with the force of thunder at any second.
Clearly, his words touched on their core interests—Half-body Sea Beast!
Seeing the change in the scene, Lide realized that his simple probe had yielded much information.
Their target was indeed that Sea Beast.
He didn’t wait for their response and continued to probe.
"Where did you learn about the fragment?"
This line was interesting. Lide didn’t specify it was the Destiny Tablet Fragment.
The meaning could refer to a Divine Artifact Fragment, a treasure map fragment, or any fragment.
If their target was the Demigod Sea Beast and not the Destiny Tablet Fragment, then he might still have some maneuvering space.
But a second later, he confirmed their real target.
For the Mermaid Main God, adorned with a pearl gemstone crown, her trident already began emitting terrifying fluctuations—it seemed ready to strike the next moment.
As she sensed the opponent’s murderous intent, Frey didn’t wait for Lide’s command and instantly shattered space to appear, valiantly guarding in front of Lide.
The overwhelmingly Divine Power of the Level 36 Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel was as rampaging as an 18-level storm, sweeping across heaven and earth.
The confrontations were forceful.
Frey’s appearance made the situation even tenser.
The Trident-holding mermaid, already wary of Lide cloaked in a god-slaying aura, now faced an even more potent Blazing Angel.
This heightened her vigilance to the extreme.
"Stranger divine being, the Destiny Tablet Fragment belongs to the Sea gifted to the Sea Clan, absolutely no one can touch it!"
Her cold tone carried chill murderous intent, with no room for compromise.
Though Lide was strong, were they weak?
Neither side was easy to deal with.
The Mermaid Main God before them was not some unlucky God of Plague, as a Main God of the Sea Clan Divine System, wielding the real Trident.
Moreover, they were above the ocean, their main battlefield, where her combat ability couldn’t just be described by her Level 34.
Not to mention, she had the assistance of six Level 31 genuine gods.
Thus, even though the Mermaid Main God was wary of Lide, she was definitely not afraid.
Lide, although few in number, also radiated the aura of the Dawn Main God, and Frey boasted the Medium Divine Power of Level 36.
Numerically outnumbered, their combat power appeared even mightier on paper.
Both parties knew well the terror of their adversaries; a battle would inevitably shake the heavens and earth.
Thus, neither dared to take that step lightly.
Lide furrowed his brows, his gaze intently fixed on the mermaid wielding a trident, and after a moment of contemplative silence, he slowly said,
"Ruler of the Seas, no need to be tense, I bear no ill intentions toward you."
After saying this, he gestured with his hand, signaling to Frey, who was holding her Angel Battle Sword and intently staring at the mermaid, to put away her weapon.
Frey, naturally following Lide’s command, swiftly sheathed her Cross Longsword, though her eyes still vigilantly watched the opposition.
Both sides were cautious of each other, and after Lide released a hint of goodwill, the tension eased slightly.
"We are not enemies, my friend," Lide said directly to the mermaid, the Female Sea God, with a dignified tone,
View the correct content at
"Ruler of the Seas, your name should be Virginia, right?"
"I have heard of you from a great being, so we should be friends, not foes.
My visit to the Lost Sea is also guided by that great being."
Upon hearing these words, the Mermaid Main God—Virginia Sea, furrowed her brows.
The previous Sea God was heavily injured and fell into a deep slumber during the Battle of the Gods a million years ago; she took over the trident unknowingly to outsiders and became the new Sea God.
Her divine name, apart from a few Ocean God System divinities, was unknown to outsiders; how did this strange Main God know her name?
Her tone was chilly.
"Strange divinity, where did you hear my name? Who is guiding you to collect fragments of the Destiny Tablet? How did they know there are fragments here?"
While speaking, Lide carefully observed the expressions of the mermaid across him, and seeing a slight astonishment on her face, he secretly smiled.
Katherine’s origin was immensely significant, as she was the fearsome guardian of the Destiny Tablet fragments.
Moreover, the key point was that Katherine was a mixed-race mermaid, which according to her, infiltrating the Main Plane was her own choice, suggesting that choosing to be a mixed-race mermaid was her subjective decision...
This was rather subtle; normally, if a godly spirit of human identity descended onto the Main Plane, they would choose to be human, and similarly, a dwarf would choose to be a dwarf...
From this, it was straightforward to deduce that before Katherine lost her power, she had significant ties to the mermaids, and she might even have been one of the mermaid race.
Lide’s words were an attempt to find alternative ways to resolve the dispute; compared to fighting, his words were as powerful a weapon as his strength.
The situation now was that clashing head-on with the opposition wasn’t wise, even though he had Frey, plus the ability to summon the Dark Sovereign, fully matching the opposition.
However, his purpose for this trip was the Destiny Tablet fragments, not to battle with a group of terrifying divinities who also held the home field advantage.
This was a complete Divine System, not just anybody; if there had been only one person on the other side, he might have rolled up his sleeves and gotten to it...
Lide’s gaze remained fixed on Virginia Sea, one word at a time,
"That great entity is also from the mermaid race; she came to the Main Plane several years before the ancient arrival and is currently a guest in my city..."
After a pause, he continued,
"And the Destiny Tablet fragments that you are looking for were originally our target. You should have discovered the corpses of two Extraordinary Magical Beasts under the water; that was our offering.
So it is not that we came to seize your spoils, but rather, you are trying to take what rightfully belongs to us..."
Upon hearing these words, Virginia’s expression became grave, her keen senses telling her that Lide was not lying, yet her heart now filled with even more doubt.
Mermaids have always been the royal family in the sea, and each Sea God was born from the mermaids.
But she had never heard of any other powerful divinities within the mermaid race.
Furthermore, having arrived on the Main Plane several years before the ancient arrival was not something just anyone could achieve, not even with her previous Level 40.
The rules of the Main Plane were too suppressive, simply beyond the disturbance capacity of regular divinities, even those with powerful divine powers.
Lide continued without pausing,
"As for why I know the traces of the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, it’s because that great being was once the guardian of the Destiny Tablet."
"And searching for the Destiny Tablet fragments is the command linked to you from that great existence of the mermaid race; thus, we are not enemies, my friend."
At these words, Virginia’s pupils sharply contracted as she suddenly recalled an ancient legend her father once told her, blurting out a name that shocked those other six from the Sea Clan around her.
"Philomis, Your Highness!!"
Lide’s eyes hardened, Philomis?
This name was significant in Glory; legend had it that Philomis, in the ocean created by the Creator God, used her blood to create the Sea Clan.
Her status in the ocean was comparable to that of the Life Goddess.
Could it be that Katherine was the legendary existence who created the Sea Clan?
The thought arose, and the veil surrounding that mixed-blood mermaid grew even more mysterious.
But this was not the time to ponder these thoughts. Lide’s gaze burned into the Mermaid Main God before him.
"Lord Virginia, that great being did not reveal her true name to me, but she informed me that the Sea Clan are her closest kin.
In the ocean, the lives we encounter are not enemies; should we meet a divinity from the mermaid race, I could reveal her message to you..."
The mermaid Main God’s hand, clutching the trident, tightened slightly, and her heart quietly believed in Lide a bit more at that moment...
Lide, without pausing, continued with some emotion.
"In fact, I’ve always been carrying out the commands of that great being.
Otherwise, I would have already made a move when I first discovered you."
Watching the disbelief in the other’s eyes, he smiled slightly.
"Do you think I lack the ability?"
As his words dropped, Lide channeled Divine Power into the ring on his hand, activating the aura left by the Dark Sovereign, though not entirely.
In that instant, an indescribable, terrifying Dignity swept across heaven and earth.
A Level 40 Undead Monarch was an incredible existence; even without appearing, it had already plunged the world into silence.
Along with this, Lide’s Divine aura explosively surged, distinctly separate from that of the Dark Sovereign, yet both overwhelmingly powerful.
Frey, seeing this, also released an aura of Medium Divine Power of Level 36...
For a moment, the might of two Main Gods, coupled with a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel, swept across the world.
Feeling the overwhelming Divine Power of the Main Gods, Virginia and the other six Sea Clan Gods’ expressions changed.
One Main God and a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel they could barely handle together, but with two Main Gods and a Level 36 Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel, the balance was broken.
If the other party truly wanted to start a battle, they would undoubtedly be defeated.
Having lived such a long life, they might not excel at everything, but their judgment was still sharp; fools did not live to such an age.
The power Lide displayed immediately shifted the Mermaid Main God’s attitude toward him.
Initially, when they were evenly matched, it was manageable, but him being in a stronger position and still so kind to them was incredibly rare.
Her heart quietly believed in six tenths of what Lide had just said... Perhaps that Mermaid God was not Philomis herself, but she must be some powerful existence from the Sea Clan not recorded in history.
Otherwise, they wouldn’t have shown such deference, and if they were truly powerful, would they discuss things so calmly?
When the weak argue with the strong, it’s nonsense, the powerless roaring, but when the strong reason with the weak, it’s kindness and amiability... Different statuses and positions, doing the same thing, create entirely different effects.
What the Mermaid Main God didn’t know was that Lide was purely for show, currently only at Level 28.
And while the Dark Sovereign was powerful, it was completely uncontrollable; if it sensed the Destiny Tablet Fragment, all his efforts would be in vain, so he wouldn’t summon it unless absolutely necessary.
The real power Lide could rely on was just the Level 36 Frey... That’s why Lide resorted to winning others over with virtue.
But there was a huge discrepancy in the information controlled by both sides. To the Sea Clan Gods, it appeared that Lide was showing goodwill to them...
After taking a few deep breaths, the Mermaid Main God looked at Lide and slowly said,
"Stranger of great power, the Destiny Tablet Fragment relates to the fate of our Sea Clan; we cannot give it up..."
Lide perceived the softening of the other party’s attitude and a sincere smile appeared on his lips.
This same smile had appeared once before when he first faced the Dark Sovereign...
Later, the Dark Sovereign had become his ally, and was now helping him implement the Abyssal Pig Farming Plan.
"No, my friend, I am not asking you to give up the Destiny Tablet Fragment, but rather this fragment is critical for that great existence to regain her strength."
Lide spoke with rightful conviction.
"She has watched over the Destiny Tablet for tens of millions of years and has established a connection with it that is impenetrable to outsiders, sensing the aura of each Destiny Tablet Fragment.
Once she regains her strength, she will guide us in finding more Destiny Tablet Fragments.
Therefore, Lord Virginia, what we are doing is investing in the future, not asking for your concession."
"That great being is one of your people, and although she now resides in my city, her not letting me confront you shows where her loyalties lie.
You can join me in meeting her later, we can form true allies, support each other, and face the increasingly severe ancient catastrophe together."
"And you rule over such a vast expanse of the ocean, is just one Destiny Tablet Fragment enough to meet the needs of your people?
Doesn’t the Sea Clan require more bargaining chips to handle the Ancient Invasion? Your urgent need for the Destiny Tablet Fragment must stem from feeling the pressure of impending world destruction, right?
The future is extremely perilous; this one Destiny Tablet Fragment is likely to have a pitiful effect...
And I believe you also need allies, powerful allies!"
These words left the Mermaid Main God deep in thought...
Displaying goodwill, using Kassandra as a link to bridge their relationship.
Flexing strength, showing off one’s muscles.
Offering incentives, using the future as bait to stir up their greed.
From Lide’s continuous words, not only did the seven Sea Gods find his points very reasonable, even Frey felt he was right...
From the initial fiery confrontation, the scene had now shifted to these Sea Clan Gods seriously considering whether to form an alliance with Lide...
Given his displayed strength, released goodwill, and that highly regarded Sea Clan God, they were all compelling reasons.
It seemed, forming an alliance with such a powerful Main God was not unacceptable, especially regarding the Destiny Tablet Fragment—if they formed an alliance, that wouldn’t be an issue at all; they could jointly seize other Destiny Tablet Fragments...

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 475 Creation God Artifact
chapters.content:
Chapter 474: Chapter 475 Creation God Artifact
The tension in the standoff melted away with Lide’s words.
Alliance, this was a path unimagined before.
But against the backdrop of the looming Old Days Catastrophe, when compared to an uncertain tomorrow and the visible dangers of the old days, this option, which ordinarily wouldn’t satisfy the Sea Clan Gods, suddenly became a decent choice.
The Ocean God System, though powerful, was also incapable of overcoming the Divine Calamity of world-ending proportions.
If they could ally with a divine system even stronger than theirs, they would undoubtedly stand a better chance against the approaching crises.
This was a win-win selection.
Moreover, the most crucial point was—Lide clearly had a deity of extremely high status within the Sea Clan on his side.
What did this indicate? It indicated that they were actually on the same side...
If they didn’t reconcile and continued the conflict, they would face the onslaught of two Main Gods and a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel more powerful than all of them.
The outcome was clear to them, and they simply couldn’t win.
If they reconciled, or even formed an alliance, then they would immediately gain a powerful ally, and both sides could join forces to seize other fragments of the Destiny Tablet, getting more chips to face the cataclysm of the Old Days.
This option not only avoided a sure defeat in war but also promised greater benefits.
After some contemplation, all seven sea deities realized that allying with Lide was better by all accounts than knocking heads until their demise.
Therefore, under these circumstances, the hearts of the Sea Clan deities inevitably wavered.
Seeing that the others didn’t refute him, but instead began to whisper among themselves, Lide’s smile immediately brightened a few degrees.
His purpose for coming to the Lost Sea was never war; it was the Destiny Tablet fragments he sought.
After the second rending of the heavens, the scent of the Old Days in the air grew stronger with each passing day. If no solution was found soon, Dawn City was bound to face a cataclysmic disaster.
And another very important point was that now the Sea Clan was qualified to become his ally.
In the end, strength was what spoke; if the other side had no strength, he would have just crushed them without all this talk. Now, since his strength wasn’t sufficient, he had to resort to deception...
Moreover, once an alliance was formed, he would have an additional ace up his sleeve—an entire divine system!
This was an absolute trump card.
Although they didn’t have the high level and combat power of the Dark Sovereign, compared to the Undead Monarch of the Evil Camp, the Ocean God System was clearly easier to control.
At least Lide didn’t have to worry that they would lose control and turn on him...
The Sea Clan belonged to the Order Neutral Camp and bore no clear tendency towards evil or good, so he was not worried that they would have any negative impression due to his Bloodline identity.
After some time, the conversing Sea Clan deities finally reached an agreement, and the Mermaid Main God wielding a trident—Lord Virginia Sea—floated forward.
Her deep blue eyes stared straight at Lide.
Her tone was solemn.
"Respected mighty one, we have yet to ask for your name and Divine Title..."
If there were others to introduce Lide at this moment, it might have elevated his stature, but in a conversation between two Main Gods, even the 36th Level Frey had no right to interject.
Lide looked straight into her eyes, his tone equally serious.
"I am the God of Dawn and Twilight—Lide Kachar, holder of the Dawn and Twilight Divine Positions, the Divine Main God of the Dawn divine system, currently with thirty million believers.
Also possesses a vast city on the continent—Dawn City, where that great Sea Clan deity now resides... "
The other details were good, but the mention of thirty million believers made the Mermaid Main God pause, a hint of envy appearing in her eyes.
The sea was boundless, teeming with life beyond count, yet most of these creatures were Demon Beasts without self-awareness, unable to contribute to faith.
Moreover, a significant portion of sea life consisted of the Sea Clan that worshiped human Divines, further exacerbating the scarcity of their already limited sources of faith.
In addition, the multitude of Ocean God System members, along with the existence of independent Sea Clan Gods outside her jurisdiction, further divided the pool of believers.
Thus, the number of Believers that Mermaid Main God currently possessed was just over ten million.
In fact, all of Glory’s believers were in a state of contention; although there were many lives in this world, when spread over each God System, they did not seem significant.
In comparison, Lide Kachar enjoyed the exclusive devotion of all Dawn City’s Believers, which was quite intimidating.
"Lord Kachar, please forgive our caution. We can jointly obtain the Destiny Tablet fragment, but as for the alliance, I need to go to your city and confirm with that respected member of the Sea Clan before making a decision..."
Lide’s words had indeed tempted them, but they were still just his side of the story, so verification was needed.
And the object of this verification was the Sea Clan Divine mentioned by Lide.
If everything Lide said was true, then an alliance between the Sea Clan God System and Lide would undoubtedly be a very fortuitous event.
Upon hearing this, Lide’s mood instantly improved greatly.
His words were a mix of truth and falsehood, but the key point—the validity of Cassilina’s existence—being true was enough.
As long as these Sea Clan Gods were willing to visit Dawn City, he was confident he could persuade them, or at the very least, if they couldn’t come to terms and hostilities ensued, it would be better to battle them on land rather than at sea.
"That is how it should be. Trust me, once you meet that great being, we will become the closest of allies and together welcome the challenges of the end times."
"Now, let’s find that Demigod Sea Beast..."
With the two negotiators having reached this point, the matter was basically settled.
The tense atmosphere between them dissipated in an instant. Although each party still maintained their guard inwardly, the overt hostility had vanished.
Curiously, Lide glanced down at the sea water stained red with blood.
"Lord Virginia, the sea is your dominant realm. Even if that Demigod Sea Beast is powerful, it couldn’t possibly escape your detection, right?"
He found their use of such primitive sacrificial methods quite surprising.
It was normal for him not to find it; the other party wielded a trident as the Sea God after all, finding a Sea Beast should have been as simple as a flick of their wrist...
The Mermaid Main God nodded lightly, "That Sea Beast is hidden in an exceedingly strange Plane, and I cannot sense it. We can only summon it using the most blunt methods."
Her Level had only recovered to 34. If it were back at the peak of Level 40, this would not be a difficult task, but for now, they were left with no options but to wait like sitting ducks.
Lide understood and nodded without further ado, gesturing towards Frey.
"I’ve just captured a Demigod Level Ancient Space Crab. According to the information I’ve obtained, that Demigod Sea Beast is particularly sensitive to the blood of crab species."
He then instructed Frey to let the shrunk Ancient Space Crab bleed...
Upon receiving the command, the space crab, which had been reduced to the size of half a palm, was casually thrown out by Frey, where it grew rapidly in the breeze.
In mere moments, a colossal creature emerged, nearly a thousand blades tall, with a pair of enormous pincers hundreds of blades thick.
It seemed as though the entire sky and ground were under the weight of this crab.
It was terrifying to the extreme.
But no matter its size, it was still only a Level 30 Demigod. Under Frey’s intimidation and signaling, the Ancient Space Crab grumbled a string of bubbles, then reluctantly used its pincer to strike its foremost leg.
Crack!—The huge pincer shattered a large chunk off a leg thicker than a building.
A pale yellow viscous liquid began to seep out from the leg...
Demigod-level beings contain such exaggerated amounts of energy; when that yellow mucus dripped into the ocean, it instantly caused a magic tide.
Sea creatures tens of miles away were now swimming as if mad, but because the divine power at the center was too terrifying, they dared not approach. The waters on the outskirts turned into a boiling cauldron...
Lide had no time to care about others; his gaze was firmly fixed on the ancient space crab while he keenly sensed every movement around him.
However, the ancient space crab, having bled for a few minutes, still showed no reaction...
This made him frown unconsciously.
"Cut a slit in each of its eight legs..."
The ancient space crab trembled at Lide’s words but before it could react, Frey had already taken action.
Crack~ Crack~
After several continuous sounds, the ancient space crab let out a painful wail, then the two eyes on its head revealed an incredibly aggrieved look, as if to say, "Don’t bully me like this..."
Gurgle gurgle gurgle~ Blood spurted out.
The sheer size of the ancient space crab was astounding; Lide suspected that its blood alone could fill the blood pool of Dawn City.
In just a moment, the sea of blood below was tinged with a hint of yellow, the surrounding energy dense to the point of nearly condensing into droplets.
Minutes passed like this, and just when everyone felt it might not be effective, a special aura suddenly spread in the sky.
It was as if something was secretly peering at them from the heavens.
No one present was weak; although the aura was very faint, they all sensed it.
Everyone simultaneously looked up at the sky.
They saw that 500 blades high in the sky, a space hundreds of blades wide was rippling slowly like water waves, seemingly about to burst forth with some terrifying life at any moment.
Seeing this scene, Lide couldn’t help but be speechless.
Who would have thought that the Demigod Sea Beast was damn well not sleeping in the ocean, but hiding in midair.
No wonder Frey stirred up the entire ocean and couldn’t find the opponent...
This was truly a headache.
The Sea Clan Gods were also staring at this scene with astonishment, clearly caught off guard by the opponent’s irrational tactics.
The moment Mermaid Main God Virginia Sea sensed the change in the sky, her trident burst forth with dazzling blue light.
Infinite divine power skyrocketed, like a primordial beast about to trample this vast sea.
Before Lide could take action, the Mermaid Main God had already charged with her trident.
