Seeing this, Lide’s brow furrowed. After a glance at Frey, who was eager to try, he slowly shook his head.
"No need to rush; the Destiny Tablet shard isn’t going anywhere."
Upon hearing this, Frey held back her intention to act.
In that brief instant, Virginia Sea had already plunged into the rippling space.
Crack~
Like a stone striking glass, a crisp sound echoed through the world.
Immediately, the entire sky shattered, and crystal-like spatial fragments instantly kicked up a maelstrom of spatial turbulence.
Then, the ferocious Mermaid Main God disappeared from everyone’s sight just like that.
Even though he couldn’t see it, Lide Kachar could clearly sense the horrifying extent of the fluctuations that spread through the sky.
Even a Demigod, let alone a True God of Level 31, would probably not escape death.
However, contrary to expectations, after the Mermaid Main God plunged into the fray, she did not return in the blink of an eye but sustained her presence for several minutes.
Just as Lide Kachar was frowning deeply, contemplating sending Frey up to investigate,
Boom~
View the correct content at
Suddenly, an indescribable colossal roar erupted.
That piece of space directly shattered.
Following that, the Mermaid Main God, holding a trident, returned carrying a gigantic head.
free\.c o(m)
Wherever she passed, the surrounding space became completely blurred.
It wasn’t until the Mermaid Main God drew closer that Lide Kachar could see clearly what that head was.
It was a massive serpent head, its presence extremely daunting, not something a Demigod could emanate, but that of a living, breathing True God.
But what drew the most attention was the position above the center of the serpent head’s eyes, where a grey stone fragment was embedded. It looked as though it had been forcibly crammed into its skin, filled with weirdness.
Holding the serpent head, the Mermaid Main God flew straight to Lide Kachar, her gaze burning brightly as she looked at him.
"Lord Kachar, this Sea Beast, due to the Destiny Tablet Fragment, has broken the rules and evolved into a Level 31 Divine Monster."
After that, she paused, her tone carrying a hint of inexplicable meaning.
"I’ve just tried it, the Destiny Tablet Fragment contains an extremely special power, I cannot touch it..."
She couldn’t merely fail to touch it. After she slew the Divine Sea Beast, she went directly for the Destiny Tablet Fragment, attempting to pry it out. But the moment she touched the Destiny Tablet Fragment, she felt her soul and body start to disintegrate...
She even sensed the breath of death at that moment.
Though she had not returned to her peak, she was a formidable entity of Level 34, and yet, she couldn’t touch the Destiny Tablet Fragment... Had she not retreated decisively, she would likely have incurred serious injury by now.
Still not resigned, she tried to use her trident to pry it out, but what chilled her to the bone was the fact that the trident, this High-level Divine Artifact, began to crumble upon contact with the Destiny Tablet Fragment...
This left her feeling quite conflicted; she hadn’t expected that after obtaining the Destiny Tablet Fragment, filled with countless hopes, she would be helpless against it.
"Unable to touch?"
Lide Kachar slightly startled, immediately opening the attribute panel of the Destiny Tablet Fragment with a touch of curiosity.
Destiny Tablet Fragment (Sequence: 17)
Quality: Creation God Artifact
Trait: Contains the power of destiny. Once this power is activated, the rules within a 100-kilometer radius will be restored to their normal state.
Explanation: This is a fragment of the Destiny Tablet, possessing unfathomable power. The complete Destiny Tablet carried the fate of the entire Multi-dimensional Plane, but it has been destroyed by unspeakable Old Dominators, and the Glorious Destiny is already shattered. Whoever collects the fragments and reassembles the Destiny Tablet will gain the favor of fate and the Divine Power of the entire Multi-dimensional Plane.
After reading the attributes, Lide Kachar took a deep breath. A Creation God Artifact, wow.
Just the name alone was out of this world.
But what did that Sequence 17 mean? Was this the seventeenth fragment? It seemed that many fragments of the Destiny Tablet had shattered.
The last part of the explanation was laden with deep significance; to reassemble the Destiny Tablet was to gain the favor of fate... Could this be understood to mean, it’s like gathering the seven Dragon Balls to summon the Dragon??
And carrying the Divine Power of the entire Multi-dimensional Plane was the consequence of summoning the Dragon.
So, by that reasoning, whoever could reassemble the Destiny Tablet would essentially become the ultimate grand authority of Glory?

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 476: Return to Dawn City, The Exaggerated Origin of the Half-Blood Mermaid
chapters.content:
Chapter 475: Chapter 476: Return to Dawn City, The Exaggerated Origin of the Half-Blood Mermaid
After checking the attributes of the Destiny Tablet fragment, Lide closed the attribute panel.
Just as he was about to take the Destiny Tablet fragment from the hands of the Mermaid Main God to examine it closely, he suddenly felt an overwhelmingly deadly threat.
It seemed as if merely touching the Destiny Tablet fragment would cause the Death God to reap his soul. His Legendary-level threat perception made him instantly stop this foolish act.
When he withdrew his hands and looked at the Mermaid Main God’s expression again, Lide understood instantly.
This Creation God Artifact, although incredibly powerful, was untouchable as the other had mentioned.
The artifact was one thing, but a Creation God Artifact was beyond the category of regular weapons and could not be reasoned with using common sense.
After pondering for a moment, Lide spoke slowly,
"Lord Virginia, is it possible to activate this fragment using Divine Power?"
The Mermaid Main God shook her head.
"I just tried. The moment I touch the fragment, its power starts to erode me, and not even the Trident Divine Artifact can resist that destructive power...
Divine Power is ineffective against the Destiny Tablet fragment."
As she spoke, she couldn’t help but show a bit of disappointment. The highly anticipated treasure was now untouchable, which was incredibly frustrating.
Lide nodded slightly and gestured to Frey.
"Try it."
Frey floated forward, and the Mermaid Main God, unobstructed, handed her the serpent’s head. As Frey approached the head near the Destiny Tablet fragment, her expression also slightly changed.
Her perception was so sharp that she instantly sensed an extremely terrifying power within.
But Frey did not lose heart and began to tentatively input Divine Power, though it seemed doomed from the start. The Divine essence she introduced was instantly devoured by the fragment, further augmenting its aura.
After trying various methods more than a dozen times, Lide could only smile wryly and gesture for her to stop.
In a final act of disbelief, he tried a few times himself, ultimately discovering that ordinary power indeed had no effect on the Destiny Tablet fragment.
This frustrated him somewhat.
After a slight contemplation and noticing the somewhat nervous expression of the Sea Clan Gods, as if they feared he would run off with that serpent’s head, he handed the serpent head back to the Mermaid Main God.
"Lord Virginia, please keep the Destiny Tablet fragment safe for now.
Let’s return to Dawn City together later and inquire about the fragment from that great existence."
The current situation had obviously exceeded his expectations, and now it seemed necessary to seek Kaslina’s help.
The Mermaid Main God did not decline, accepting the serpent’s head from Lide, and her inner vigilance relaxed significantly.
This small gesture greatly increased her trust in Lide.
After all, if Lide had merely been deceiving her earlier, there would be no need to let her keep the Destiny Tablet fragment after acquiring it.
Lide, however, didn’t focus on that and continued pondering how to control the Destiny Tablet fragment.
Cooperation was based on trust, and if he lacked even this courage, he couldn’t possibly have reached his current lofty status.
"As you wish, Kachar Main God, but before going to your city, I need to instruct my companions."
"Please do."
The Mermaid Main God nodded, turned around, and went to discuss with the six Sea Clan Gods behind her.
A few minutes later, the Mermaid Main God and the other six Sea Clan Gods reached some consensus.
Then, under Lide’s somewhat astonished eyes, the six Sea Clan Gods didn’t continue to linger in this sea area. Instead, they plunged into the ocean like meteors and disappeared.
After those gods had left, the Mermaid Main God returned and fixed her deep blue eyes tightly on Lide.
"Kachar Main God, my companions have already gone to the heart of the ocean to search for methods to use the Destiny Tablet fragment.
This time, I’ll accompany you alone to meet our Sea Clan’s Gods..."
Though her tone was calm, it was filled with strong confidence as if not fearing that Lide would have a change of heart halfway.
Indeed, that was the case. Although the Mermaid Main God had not yet recovered to her peak, she was confident that with the Trident in hand, even if facing a Level 40 Main God, she could escape.
Hearing this, Lide couldn’t help but admire her deeply, impressed by her impeccable demeanor.
Correct content is on .
What a fine mermaid, he thought. If given the chance, he would definitely keep her in a bathtub.
Dawn City had already housed a Cat Goddess. Keeping a Mermaid Main God in a bathtub was also not unacceptable. In the future, he could indulge in a trio of oil massage, massage, and foot rub. Her Trident could perhaps even serve as a tickle scratcher...
"Lord Virginia, believe me, your trust will not be wasted."
Lide finished speaking and didn’t go on rambling. He turned to glance at the Ancient Space Crab whose wounds had already healed, instructed Frey to put the Demigod Sea Beast away, and then turned back to rejoin Andabella and Betty, who were standing some distance away.
"Prepare to return to Dawn City."
Lide had kept the two girls away from the central battlefield to prevent them from being affected by any potential conflict, so they were unaware of his conversation with the Mermaid Main God.
At this moment, the two girls were still confused. Hadn’t there been a conflict brewing just moments ago?
How had everyone suddenly come together so quickly? Even a change of face couldn’t be that rapid, right?
The other party was genuinely Divine, and seven of them had appeared at once. Now, it seemed they had become allies with Lide??
Lide’s handsome figure became even more mysterious in the hearts of the two girls. Just how many more secrets did this man hold?
The Mermaid Main God also slowly approached, gave Castro and the two girls a calm glance, and then ignored them.
They were merely mortals after all, and to her, they could be obliterated with a single Divine Art without warranting a second glance.
Although the Mermaid Main God disregarded them, Andabella, and Betty could not afford to disregard the Mermaid Main God.
As the God approached, the two girls immediately sensed how terrifying the Divine pressure emanating from her was.
The cape behind Andabella fluttered without wind, sounding as if it were about to activate due to confronting a great enemy.
Lide said nothing about this, as with the Mermaid Main God’s identity and status, there was naturally no need for pleasantries.
However, after glancing at everyone, he suddenly realized with some surprise that all four present were female, and both in terms of beauty and power, each was more formidable than the next...
Andabella, Betty, Frey, the Mermaid Main God...
All of them were not to be trifled with; any one of them could destroy a city.
After a glance, he didn’t bother to think further; women only slowed down the speed at which he could draw his sword... but then again, he seemed to be a Mage, so whether his ability to draw a sword was affected might not have been that important...
He mounted Castro, the recently advanced Transcendent Dawn Bat King, who at this moment was so terrified that he didn’t dare to even breathe loudly.
The Mermaid Main God had not toned down her aura much; her Main God-level pressure made them somewhat breathless.
"Castro, head back to Dawn City immediately."
"Lord Virginia, I would like you and Frey to follow us."
Lide arranged this because he was worried that she might decide to flee on a whim, so he needed someone to keep an eye on her.
With Frey around, the Mermaid Main God, no matter how strong, could not just disappear without reason.
The Mermaid Main God nodded her head, not saying much. What was her status? Even without a mount, it was not possible for her to share a ride with Lide.
Whoosh~
Castro flapped his wings, creating a series of air bursts in the air and disappearing instantly over the sea.
Seeing this, the Mermaid Main God waved her trident, shattering the space in front of her, her figure vanishing from the spot followed closely by Frey’s, her form blurring...
Castro, now flying at triple the speed of sound, reached nearly four thousand kilometers per hour, although they had already ventured deep into the ocean.
But under Castro’s frenzied speed, they reached the Far Mountain Range, hundreds of kilometers away, in less than an hour.
Castro’s racing form suddenly came to a stop.
Because Lide was already able to sense the Land of Bone-Burying.
Within a thousand-kilometer radius of the Land of Bone-Burying, he could use the Space Gate to instantaneously teleport back.
Upon noticing Lide stopping, the space behind them shattered, and the Mermaid Main God and Frey appeared beside him.
"Main God Kachar, is there a problem?"
Lide looked at her, waved his hand, and a Space Gate appeared, shattering the space in front of him. Behind the door was a majestic city.
"We have arrived."
Having said this, he didn’t waste words with the Mermaid Main God. He urged Castro and directly passed through the Space Gate, descending above the Moonlight Square in Dawn City.
Seeing Lide leave, the Mermaid Main God’s expression tightened. Was this his Divine Country?
Passing through another’s Divine Country was not generally a good idea.
But after sensing for a moment and detecting no danger, she stepped through the Space Gate, having made her decision, already mentally prepared for this... Yet she was fearless.
The Mermaid Main God had barely had time to feel anything when, the next second, she appeared above Dawn City.
Looking down from the sky, a magnificent city unfolded before her eyes.
At first glance, this city seemed no different from other cities in the Main Plane, but a closer look revealed its uniqueness.
Correct content is on .
Most notably, the city was teeming with a multitude of different races.
Humans, Dwarfs, Beastmen, Centaurs, Half-Elves, Bloodlines, and even Demons...
The streets were densely crowded with countless races, yet there was no hostility or separation among them; Bloodlines walked shoulder to shoulder with humans, Dwarfs laughed with Beastmen...
It all seemed like an illusion, filled with an unreal sensation.
When had the world become so crazy? How could these vastly different, even hostile races live together so harmoniously?
Were they hallucinating or seeing illusions?
The expression of the Mermaid Main God was priceless, her eyes filled with disbelief.
Andabella felt the same; her worldview was completely overturned.
The girl couldn’t help but take a deep look at Lide’s back.
This guy, how many secrets was he hiding?
Lide noticed their astonishment and couldn’t help but find it amusing- it seemed that no one could escape this reaction upon arriving at Dawn City.
After guiding Castro to land in the square, he dismounted.
The crowd around him was extremely excited upon seeing Lide, yet they didn’t dare come too close and could only bow respectfully from a distance, their eyes filled with respect and admiration.
Lide’s reputation in Dawn City had long been maxed out, to the point of overflowing.
Seeing this, Andabella and the Mermaid Main God’s expressions changed once more.
They could keenly sense that the residents bowing, regardless of their race, were genuinely reverent towards Lide and not out of religious fanaticism.
This was extremely rare.
How well must the master of a city behave to earn such respect from his subjects? At least they were unable to achieve this.
Once a few people gathered around him, Lide waved his hand, reducing Castro in size and tucking it into his breast pocket, unbothered by the surrounding crowd; he was already accustomed to this kind of scene.
He led them straight toward the City Hall building facing Moonlight Square; naturally, they couldn’t discuss matters in the square.
There was a road for the Magic Track Car in front of City Hall and Moonlight Square, and just then, the Magic Track Car clanged its way toward them. Lide stretched his hand out to stop the others, waiting for the Magic Track Car to pass before continuing forward.
The passengers on the Magic Track Car became very excited upon seeing Lide, all rising to bow.
Although they were only a fleeting glimpse, these passengers did not act discourteously because of it.
Seeing the Magic Track Car, Andabella’s heart was once again filled with surprise.
The clever girl immediately realized the immense benefits this alchemy creation could bring to a city; after all, she had been a city lord herself.
In just a short time, this unprecedented city had already delivered several strong impacts to her.
The Mermaid Main God, carrying the monstrous serpent’s head, did not speak at this time, but her curiosity was no less than Andabella’s, though no one was there to satisfy her curiosity.
Guided by the guards, Lide led everyone by the Magic Elevator to the fifth-floor office.
Once they entered the luxurious and elegant room, Andabella and the Mermaid Main God felt slightly disappointed; they had become immensely curious about the city and actually wanted to explore it more deeply...
Betty had lived in Dawn City for a while before, so she did not have as much curiosity as the two others.
"Betty, why don’t you take City Lord Andabella for a stroll around Dawn City. I’ve already notified Dean Horn, and he will be here soon.
City Lord Andabella, perhaps you’d like to meet some of your kin."
Hearing this, Andabella and Betty knew that Lide and the Mermaid Main God had important matters to discuss, and without lingering longer, they turned and left the office under the guard’s guidance.
Once the two had left, Lide’s deep eyes looked at the Mermaid Main God standing before him.
"Lord Virginia, please wait here in the office for a moment; I’ll go invite that great being..."
"It should be so," the Mermaid Main God nodded.
Lide turned his head to look at Frey, who immediately understood, nodding back. Seeing this, Lide didn’t delay any further and stepped out, disappearing from the office.
As soon as Lide’s presence vanished, the Mermaid Main God turned around, her gaze curious as she looked towards Frey.
"I’ve heard of your name before, War General of the Master of Dawn, Lord Frey.
"When did you become a subordinate of the Kachar Main God?"
Upon hearing this somewhat abrupt inquiry, a slight turbulence appeared on Frey’s delicate face as she looked at the Mermaid Main God before her, who made her feel threatened, and slowly spoke.
"Your Excellency, there is no need to gather information from me. Everything about the Master is top-secret."
The Mermaid Main God gave a deep look to this fallen Twelve-winged Blazing Angel and then fell silent.
After a moment, she turned, holding in her left hand the serpent’s head embedded with a shard of the Destiny Tablet and in her right, a trident, and slowly advanced to the half-open window to gaze into the distance.
The sky rift, erupting with ancient forces, furrowed her brows and her mood suddenly plummeted.
Her agreeing so readily to Lide’s request for an alliance and coming alone to this city, far from the ocean, was mainly because the Sea Clan had no way out.
The invasion from ancient times had muddied the seas, marine life began to decrease, and even some of the Sea Clan had been corrupted by the ancient invaders and turned into detestable monsters...
No one could understand the despair of watching destruction approach each day, helpless to stop it.
At this moment, she saw hope in Lide, so even if there was only a sliver of a chance, she would not give up.
For the sake of the ocean, she would face all challenges fearlessly.
Lide arrived directly at the Magic Industry Research Institute through the Space Gate, then walked straight into the high tower where the Half-Elf Mermaid — Lady Kaslina — resided.
When Lide knocked and entered, the Half-Elf Mermaid, who had transformed into human form during the day, was standing by the massive floor-to-ceiling window gazing at the sky.
A thin white sand cloak draped on her, her bare feet tender like white jade, and her entire demeanor akin to a Divine descending to earth, involuntarily commanding awe.
However, to his surprise, at this moment Kaslina was holding a pure white cat in her arms, her delicate pale hand gently stroking the cat’s back.
Lide took a deep breath, approached Kaslina, and was about to speak, but his expression slightly changed upon seeing the pure white cat.
Bast?
He could sense that the cat in Kaslina’s arms was the same Cat and Joy Goddess he had captured when he had defeated the Knight God.
This annoyed him.
This mermaid was too unethical, considering it was my cat; she didn’t even ask and just secretly started petting it??
But considering he still needed something from her, he had to suppress his emotions.
"Lady Kaslina, I have retrieved the shard of the Destiny Tablet."
Kaslina, having heard this, turned around gracefully, her voice soft and measured as her ever-solemn eyes quietly observed him.
"I sensed it the moment you entered Dawn City."
Lide nodded; it was she who had guided him to find the shards of the Destiny Tablet, so sensing the presence of the Destiny Tablet was hardly surprising.
But that’s not what he came for; he needed to discuss how to handle the Mermaid Main God with Kaslina first.
If they could tie the entire Ocean God System to Dawn City, it would undoubtedly be a huge boost for Dawn City at this time.
And this hope lay with Kaslina.
After pondering for a moment, Lide began describing the process of the search for the Destiny Tablet shards and then said,
"Lady Kaslina, the great Sea God has accompanied me to Dawn City. I hope you can help me persuade her to make the Ocean God System an ally of Dawn City. This would be beneficial for both parties."
However, Lide least expected that after he finished, Kaslina would shock him with her response.
"That Mermaid Main God has my bloodline flowing within her..."
"The trident she holds was forged by me..."
?!!
Lide was utterly shocked.
His eyes filled with disbelief.
Although he knew this Half-Elf Mermaid was powerful with an extraordinary background — after all, she was a guardian of the Destiny Tablet.
But could she really be so powerful as to claim even the originally Level 40 Mermaid Main God as her bloodline?
And that high-level Divine Artifact trident was forged by her too?
Wasn’t that somewhat against the rules?

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 477: Bearing the Power of Destiny, The True Identity of Kassrina
chapters.content:
Chapter 476: Chapter 477: Bearing the Power of Destiny, The True Identity of Kassrina
Lide watched as Lady Kaslina casually revealed that the Mermaid Main God was her descendant and that the trident was her own creation, and it took him a long time to collect his thoughts.
This big shot’s background was far more terrifying than he had imagined.
He took a deep breath, allowing his thoughts to slowly regain composure.
No matter how significant her background was, she was now a member of Dawn City.
After pondering for a moment, he spoke.
"Lady Kaslina, since the Mermaid Main God carries your bloodline, that makes us family.
Forming an alliance with the Ocean God System to jointly face the Ancient Catastrophe is a perfect option for both Dawn City and your descendants—I hope you can help me achieve this."
The Ocean God System boasted a total of seven divinities, unlike the pretend divinity of big and small fishes in the Dawn Divine System. Once allied, the ultimate power in Lide’s hands would surge tremendously.
He would then possess much greater freedom of action.
Kaslina’s profound eyes quietly watched him as she slowly stroked a white cat in her arms, her serene demeanor untouched by worldly matters—so pure that no one could harbor any thoughts of desecration.
When Lide finished, this hybrid mermaid slowly uttered a word.
"Possible."
She fell silent after her word.
Lide immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
The hardest part was dealt with. Since the Mermaid Main God was a descendant of Kaslina’s bloodline, the intimidating Kaslina must have a way to persuade her; he wasn’t worried about that.
He thought for a moment and continued.
"Lady Kaslina, the fragment of the Destiny Tablet seems to possess a very mysterious power. We can’t directly touch it—what’s the reason for that?"
The fragment of the Destiny Tablet was still in the Mermaid Main God’s hands; they had obtained it but didn’t know how to use it, which was quite frustrating.
Kaslina’s previously plague-like expression fluctuated slightly, and the motion of petting her cat also stopped.
Her deep blue eyes looked at Lide with a tone that held a meaning difficult for outsiders to understand.
"To use the fragment of the Destiny Tablet, one must bear the Power of Destiny..."
"And how can one bear the Power of Destiny?" Lide pursued.
"A fearless heart, a pure soul, and an ancient spell—the Curse of Destiny."
Lide’s mouth twitched; what a bunch of nonsense—a fearless heart? A pure soul?
It seemed like the Curse of Destiny was ultimately what mattered.
"Lady Kaslina, am I capable of bearing the Power of Destiny?"
Kaslina looked deeply at him, her tone mixed with complexity and anticipation.
"Are you prepared?"
Lide raised an eyebrow. Prepared? This isn’t like booking a hotel room with a girlfriend; what preparation is needed??
Seeing the confusion on Lide’s face, Kaslina slowly explained.
"To bear the Power of Destiny and to gain the enhancement from the power of the Destiny Tablet means you will also attract the enmity of all Ancient Evil Gods.
For the Power of Destiny is the sole force against the arrival of the ancients.
The rulers of the Ancient Era coldly watch this world from beyond the Chaos Void; those who bear the Power of Destiny are their targets for hunting."
Lide frowned upon hearing this; so this is the downside?
But without a second thought, he solemnly said,
"Wouldn’t those Ancient Evil Gods spare me if I didn’t bear the Power of Destiny?"
The goal of the Ancient Evil Gods was to destroy the entire world; as long as he didn’t leave this world, he had to be a target for those chaotic beings.
Therefore, there was no such thing as enmity or not. As long as either side was still alive, they were sworn enemies.
Since there was no choice, why would he give up the chance to strengthen his powers?
"No, it’s not the same."
"Endowed with the Power of Destiny, you will be like a lighthouse in the darkness, and even those Ancient Evil Gods will sense your presence from afar."
"So, are you sure you want to continue?"
Despite her calm demeanor, the expectation in Kaslina’s eyes became increasingly evident.
Lide sensed that expectation, slightly taken aback, as Kaslina seemed to have high hopes for him...
But why would such a powerful being place high hopes on him?? It seemed more appropriate for the Mermaid Main God to bear her hopes...
Confused, he didn’t ask further. His gaze was resolute, and his tone solemn.
"Lady Kaslina, other than growing stronger, Dawn City has no other choice.
As the master of Dawn, I am supposed to protect my people.
Since there is no escape, let us face the wind and cut through the brambles!"
Kaslina looked at him approvingly, "Good, you bring my descendants here, and I will teach you how to bear the Power of Destiny."
Lide nodded in understanding, turned, and immediately shattered space to return to the office in the City Hall.
The Mermaid Main God and Frey were still there.
Seeing Lide return, the Mermaid Main God, standing by the window, turned around, her deep blue eyes showing a hint of inquiry.
"Kachar Main God, you..."
Lide waved his hand, cutting off her words.
"Lord Virginia, that great being is aware of your arrival. She just told me that your body flows with her bloodline..."
The Mermaid Main God was startled, unaware she had such an ancestor.
Suddenly, as if realizing something, she exclaimed involuntarily.
"Could it really be Lady Philomis, the Sea Clan Goddess?!!"
View the correct content at
In the legends of the Sea Clan, Lady Philomis used her bloodline to create the Sea Clan, the ancestor of all intelligent life in the ocean, her status in the Sea Clan akin to that of the Life Goddess.
If it was truly that legendary figure, not just she, but all the Sea Clan would carry her bloodline.
The Mermaid Main God immediately asked earnestly.
"Kachar Main God, has Her Highness agreed to see us?"
Lide gently nodded.
"I inquired, and that great existence has decided to summon you..."
The Mermaid Main God became instantly thrilled.
"Thank you for your introduction."
Lide smiled, said no more, and widened the Space Gate, then stepped through.
The Mermaid Main God quickly followed, and the silent Death Blazing Angel Frey also immediately joined them.
The Mermaid Main God’s emotions were delicate at this moment, tinged with nervousness, caution, and hope.
In these times, when the Old Days dawned, and the entire Multi-dimensional Plane faced the threat of destruction, the Sea Clan was too powerless.
Though she was powerful, she couldn’t protect the entire Sea Clan.
If it was truly the great Lady Philomis arriving, she could relieve herself of the heavy burden of her race’s survival...
She believed the great Lady could lead the Sea Clan in their strongest stance to face this world-ending catastrophe.
Lady Philomis’s reputation was exceedingly lofty in the Sea Clan, and even the Mermaid Main God, a Divine Main God herself, maintained enough respect for her.
With some trepidation, the Mermaid Main God followed Lide to the top floor of the Magic Industrial Research Institute Center’s high tower.
Eeek~
At the moment the door was pushed open, the Mermaid Main God’s body froze.
For there, holding a white cat, Kaslina was serenely looking towards the doorway.
Their eyes met, and the Mermaid Main God felt an immense kinship in Kaslina’s sea-blue eyes.
Even her bloodline within cheered and leapt at this moment, as if seeing some intimate elders, that was the call of the bloodline.
The Mermaid Main God’s eyes reddened, and she immediately came respectfully to Lady Kaslina, assisting her chest and bowing, her voice trembling.
"Descendant of the Nuhai family, Seventh Generation Sea God—Virginia Sea, I extend my most respectful greetings to you, Lady Philomis..."
"Philomis?"
Hearing this name, Kaslina’s face revealed a hint of haziness, her tone tinged with faint emotion.
"It seems to be my name millions of years ago... so long ago that I’ve almost forgotten this memory."
Upon finishing her words, her gaze turned towards the trident held in the hands of the Mermaid Main God.
Kaslina continued to hold the cat with her left hand and slightly extended her right hand; then the trident grasped tightly by the Mermaid Main God with a buzz flew directly out of her hands.
Before they could react, clang—the base of the trident smashed directly onto the floor in front of Kaslina, standing upright before her, causing spider-web-like cracks to appear on the hard ground.
Originally dull, the trident burst into a brilliant sea-blue light as it neared Kaslina, the divine artifact began to buzz and tremble, as if cheering and leaping.
Witnessing this, a few traces of reminiscence flashed through Kaslina’s eyes, and under the watchful eyes of everyone, her slender palm slowly gripped the trident.
Boom, boom, boom~
Just at that moment, a force surged out like the sky falling and the cosmos shattering, terrifying and overwhelming.
At this moment, all the stars in the sky seemed to orbit under Kaslina’s feet, and the mountains, rivers, and lakes were as minute as a single strand of hair.
The moon was bright in the sky, the sun hung high.
The boundless divine power was as fearsome as a prison, and time seemed to have stopped.
Inside the room, they felt as if they faced an ancient god who could crush the edges of the universe, with its immense and indomitable majesty impossible to look at directly or touch.
In just a few short breaths, which seemed like half a century to them.
When Kaslina released the trident, they once again felt their breaths and heartbeats.
Lide took a long sigh of relief, his regard for Kaslina rising considerably.
He was glad that he had not intended to use force to threaten her from the start, or else things would have gotten out of hand.
This extravagantly reputed goddess surely possessed strength far superior to Frey now.
Even if she had not yet returned to her full divine power level, she was probably not far off.
She truly was a powerhouse...
"The trident, it once joined me in the creation war that sealed the Ancient Evil Gods.
I haven’t held it for tens of millions of years; I did not expect it to still remember me..."
By now, Kaslina had retracted her formidable aura, returning to her transcendent demeanor.
Her deep blue eyes stared at the trident in her hands, her expression filled with nostalgia and memories.
The Mermaid Main God, seeing her divine artifact taken away by someone else, was not angry but filled with surprise.
It was the trident—apart from the contemporary Sea God, only the forger, Lady Philomis, could control it.
Her face instantly brightened with a radiant smile. There was hope for the Sea Clan; she had found Lady Philomis!!
Praise be to the Creator God!
After briefly reminiscing, Kaslina gestured, and the trident flew back into the hands of the Mermaid Main God, her gaze softening as she looked at the emotionally stirred Mermaid Main God.
"Virginia, the future of the Sea Clan is in your hands.
The trident contains the purest power, which is the manifestation of the ocean. As long as you do not abandon the ocean, the trident will always be filled with power, and even if destroyed, it can be reforged in seawater."
The Mermaid Main God nodded vehemently, then hurriedly voiced her inner anticipation.
"Lady Philomis, the Ancient Disaster has posed an unprecedented threat to the Sea Clan. I ask you to return to the ocean, lead us to fight the Ancient Invasion, and protect your descendants and people."
Kaslina heard this but shook her head, her tone profoundly meaningful.
"Virginia, the hope to resist the Ancient Invasion is not within the ocean..."
"Not in the ocean? Then where?" The Mermaid Main God quickly asked.
"I have been searching, but haven’t found an answer yet."
"But the ocean needs a leader, it needs your leadership..."
"No, the ocean needs your leadership, not mine.
For millions of years, I have not interfered in the affairs of the ocean. It was so in the past, it is the same now, and the future belongs to you, my children.
You are already eagles soaring in the sky, sharks surging in the waves; you no longer need my protection."
Lady Kaslina’s tone carried a hint of admiration, but her words filled the Mermaid Main God with immense loss, who then reluctantly gathered her spirits to ask.
"Lady Philomis, how should we then face the Ancient Invasion?
Now I and the Kachar Main God have found the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, but cannot harness the power of the fragments..."
Lide, who was observing the two, also became alert at this moment.
This was indeed the most important matter, as the fragments of the Destiny Tablet were critical to the future.
Kaslina looked at them both and spoke slowly.
"To control the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, you need to bear the Power of Destiny. I will now teach you the Curse of Destiny.
You can use this to harness the Power of Destiny through the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
I’ll say it again, to bear the Power of Destiny, you need a pure soul, a fearless heart.
The Curse of Destiny is merely an initiator."
This was the second time Kaslina mentioned it, counting the one just heard, and Lide immediately became more cautious.
The serious manner in which she spoke was definitely not to be underestimated.
After Kaslina finished speaking, she did not wait for them to ask for details, but waved her hand and a dazzling deep blue energy burst forth from her body.
The white cat in her arms immediately puffed up its fur, as if it had been electrocuted.
Both Lide and the Mermaid Main God felt a gentle force enveloping their bodies.
Instantly comfortable enough to want to moan out loud.
Lide thought this hybrid mermaid had some tricks up her sleeve. If she went to a bath center, those big sword wielders would be unemployed...
This thought flashed through Lide’s mind and was immediately followed by an extremely terrifying power that surged into his mind, as if to burst him apart.
The comfort on his face rapidly morphed into pain, as numerous pieces of information were transferred to him along with that energy.
As time passed, the energy grew stronger, increasing the information he received, and correspondingly the pain Lide endured intensified.
His earlier bathhouse thought had been thrown all the way to Java Country...
Fortunately, this process only lasted three to four minutes, not long enough to overindulge him.
Even so, by the time the blue energy dissipated, his clothes were soaked with sweat.
Lide wiped the sweat from his forehead, heart still in fright. That technique was too rough, it needed improvement, no, he definitely needed a better operator next time...
Once he had collected himself, he immediately discovered a very obscure spell in his mind, whose twisted symbols and peculiar pronunciation were beyond normal understanding.
Fortunately, with the aid of that energy, he had fully mastered it, and it hadn’t been in vain.
"Have you got it?"
The Mermaid Main God was also sweating profusely, obviously also in considerable pain, "Yes, I’ve mastered it, Your Highness."
Kaslina turned to Lide, who hadn’t spoken yet. "Kachar City Lord, if you haven’t mastered it, I can do it again..."
Lide interjected subconsciously, "I want a different techni—cough, I’ve mastered it..."
Kaslina nodded at his words, not dwelling on them any further.
With a wave of her hand, the snake’s head that the Mermaid Main God was holding shattered, and the fragments of the Destiny Tablet embedded in the skull slowly floated up.
Watching the two who had regained their composure, her tone indifferent.
"Are you ready?"
"What else do we need to prepare for?" Lide asked, his expression solemn.
"To bear the Power of Destiny."
Lady Kaslina gave Lide a meaningful glance.
Lide’s expression was resolute, "Let’s begin."
The Mermaid Main God beside him was equally fearless.
"Your Highness, please grant us power..."
Kaslina nodded, "When the Power of Destiny courses through your body, you must chant the Curse of Destiny to guide that power."
"Remember, if you cannot withstand the baptism of the Power of Destiny, you must decisively give up.
Otherwise, your souls will be eroded by the Power of Destiny, and then no one can save you."
She finished, adding thoughtfully,
"Even the Talent of resurrection won’t work in the face of the Power of Destiny."
Lide was momentarily stunned, then smiled.
Cannot resurrect... so what?
As the dominator of the Dawn, had he ever retreated even half a step?
At this moment, Lide stood upright, his determined gaze unshakable.
"Lady Kaslina, begin," he said.
Kaslina nodded, not saying more. She set down the cat that transformed from the Cat and Joy Goddess onto the ground, then waved, causing fragments of the Destiny Tablet to float up.
Her body erupted with a rich blue energy, and terrifying Divine Power once again permeated the air.
The previously silent fragments of the Destiny Tablet were finally touched.
A faint white power slowly diffused, and under Kaslina’s control, it enveloped both Lide and the Mermaid Main God.
The moment Lide touched the power emitted by the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, his entire body trembled.
The Ancestor Bloodline uncontrollably started to churn, and the bloodline shackles were unlocked in an instant, infinite power surging within him like a tsunami.
Then, that pale white Power of Destiny seeped into his body, the subsequent scene far exceeding his imagination.
Once the Power of Destiny entered his body, it began voraciously consuming his power like a ravenous child, the scene resembling a sponge absorbing water.
The pale white Power of Destiny, after devouring massive amounts of power, began to wildly grow stronger.
When that power reached a certain critical point, Lide’s originally clear consciousness blurred, he felt something stirring in his heart, and subconsciously chanted the recently learned Curse of Destiny in his mind.
Accompanied by that indescribable, strange spell, he felt as if he could see through the myriad universes at that moment, his perception even enveloping the entire Multi-dimensional Plane...
In a trance, he saw the Creator God forging the Glory Multi-dimensional Plane.
He watched an indescribably terrifying entity being split apart by the Creator God using the Creation Sword,
saw the Ancient Evil God being sealed in various corners of the Multi-dimensional Plane,
saw the Destiny Tablet being forged, saw the Life Goddess creating life, saw the birth of the abyss, saw the expansion of the Undead Plane...
And the rules of the Multi-dimensional Plane, from those ancient secrets, unrestrainedly revealing themselves before him.
He gradually became obsessed.
Original Rules, ancient secrets; he wandered through time, peering into many unimaginable, unrecordable secrets of the world...
But unbeknownst to Lide, his soul was fading, as if it might disappear at any moment.
Peering into the secrets of the world came at a price...
He didn’t know how much time had passed, perhaps a day, perhaps a hundred years, but Lide became lost.
The Power of Destiny blurred his perception; he forgot everything about the outside world, indulging in the excitement of exploring the world’s origins.
Through the Power of Destiny, he witnessed one Plane after another shattering, witnessed the beginning and end of one Battle of the Gods after another.
One powerful entity after another vanished before him, one Original Rule after another allowed him to comprehend.
These scenes made him addicted.
Just stay within time, just continue to perceive the origins of this world...
The thought from the Power of Destiny could not be refused, and Lide’s consciousness became more and more blurred.
But just as his soul was fading to a critical point, a sudden system alert jolted him awake from his trance.
"Ding~ You have fallen into the illusion of the River of Destiny, and 1,000,000 Power of Faith has been consumed to resist this temptation."
The originally fading soul suddenly began to condense again, and Lide’s self-awareness rapidly revived.
By the time he regained his senses, he couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.
Especially after sensing that his weak soul was nearly collapsing, he felt even more terrified.
It was a close call, if the system alert had come a bit later, he would have been lost.
"Indeed perilous, too alluring.."
Lide suppressed the fear in his heart, immediately collected his thoughts, and began to observe the power inside his body.
At this moment, the pale white Power of Destiny had devoured all the power in his body and was slowly transforming it.
But this transformation seemed quite difficult, and it wasn’t just devouring the power in his body, it was consuming his soul power every moment.
This made his already faint soul even more unbearable, as if it could be obliterated at any moment...
Lide noticed this and couldn’t help but frown deeply, thinking that expending power from his weakened soul state was certainly not the way to die.
He didn’t dare delay, and immediately began to absorb the surrounding Magic Energy for recovery...
But in a moment he gave up on this method, as the surrounding energy, though able to compensate a bit of the loss, couldn’t withstand the consumption of the Power of Destiny, and absorbing like this could at most delay death.
Lide pondered for a moment and seemed to think of something, quickly retrieving Magic Blood from the System Space and drinking it.
Thump thump thump...
The Magic Blood, containing immense power, spread the urgently needed energy throughout his body, especially the special energy in the blood which rapidly recovered the deficit in his soul.
But as the Power of Destiny sensed the disturbance, it accelerated its consumption rate, and the restorative power of the Magic Blood was devoured in the blink of an eye...
Lide frowned deeply, refusing to believe it...
There was enough Magic Blood stored in the System Space to sustain his normal consumption for twenty years, so he didn’t have much estimate.
Next, he was frantically consuming it.
While the unlimited supply of Magic Blood supported him, the Power of Destiny began to accelerate the transformation of his body.
However, this transformation wasn’t just strengthening his body, but also compensating for certain defects in his bloodline, making his body capable of adapting to the Power of Destiny.
As time gradually passed, Lide completely lost track of time.
He closed his eyes tightly, earnestly sensing the Power of Destiny.
Though he could no longer explore the secrets of the world through the Power of Destiny like he could at the beginning, the power of the Destiny Stone still enabled him to have a deeper understanding of the rules.
If he were to open the attribute panel now, he would most definitely find that the mastery levels of his Divine Positions were slowly increasing...
After an unknown amount of time, when the Magic Blood stored in the System Space was almost depleted, the transformation of Lide by the Power of Destiny finally reached a critical point.
Crack~
Like glass shattering, Lide felt the constraints inside his body completely break, followed by an indescribable terrifying power surging throughout his body.
He only felt that, at this moment, he was more than fifty percent stronger than before...
And the Power of Destiny circulating within him was absorbed by his body like water by a sponge, and had now been completely devoured.
His own power once again flowed through his blood vessels and muscles and bones, and if not for the strong power emanating from his body, Lide might have doubted whether the transformation by the Power of Destiny was just an illusion...
After a long time, when he became familiar with the power within his body, he slowly opened his eyes.
What appeared before him was the Mermaid Main God, her face extremely pale. She held a trident tightly in her hand, her face lost and despondent, filled with reluctance, yet also filled with immense guilt and self-blame.
Seeing Lide wake up, the Mermaid Main God widened her eyes with urgency and expectation as she asked.
"Kachar Main God, did you succeed?"
Lide felt his body, which besides becoming stronger had not changed much, and couldn’t help but have a bizarre expression.
It seems, I don’t even know if I’ve succeeded myself.
He had indeed become stronger...
Just as he was about to speak, the light in front of him twisted, and Lady Kaslina appeared inside the room holding a cat.
Her calm eyes showed a hint of surprise upon seeing Lide, sensing the aura emanating from his body, she spoke with a rare tone of admiration.
"A pure soul, a fearless heart..."
"Kachar City Lord, this might be the choice of destiny."
"From now on, you will become the sworn enemy of the Ancient Evil God, and as long as the ancient days linger, you will be perpetually hunted by them."
"In return, you shall receive the favor of destiny..."
Upon hearing this, Lide blinked, smiling nonchalantly. Even if he failed, those ancient monsters wouldn’t spare him anyway...
But what exactly is this favor of destiny? Child of Destiny? Falling off a cliff to find an unparalleled martial arts manual, walking out the door to predestined encounters with beautiful women from the "I Love a Stick"?
"Lady Kaslina, although I have become much stronger, my body hasn’t changed much.
Is bearing the Power of Destiny really this simple?"
After saying this, he thought for a moment, realizing it was indeed not simple. If it weren’t for the system, he might have truly been lost in the endless River of Destiny.
Upon hearing this, the expression of the Mermaid Main God grew even more bitter, her eyes carrying a touch of envy as she looked at him.
Kaslina shook her head.
"To bear the Power of Destiny, one must flow in the River of Destiny without being influenced, and the River of Destiny possesses an irresistible allure.
Once submerged in it, no one but oneself can aid or remind you.
Therefore, a pure soul and a fearless heart are necessary, or else one will surely become lost...
Even divine beings with Powerful Divine Power cannot resist the temptation of the River of Destiny.
But you have done it, which is beyond my expectations.
Kachar City Lord, perhaps, this is destiny."
Destiny? No, this is the system...
Lide twitched the corner of his mouth and didn’t explain anything. No matter how the trial was passed, passing meant success, and the results do not lie.
In the adult’s world, only the outcomes matter, who cares about the process?
"So, can I now use the fragment of the Destiny Tablet?"
Kaslina nodded slightly and waved her hand, and the fragment of the Destiny Tablet flew from somewhere, floating directly in front of him.
At this moment, the stunningly beautiful mermaid could not conceal her expectations, unseen by Lide.
"Now, it belongs to you."
Hope you do not disappoint me...
Looking at the Destiny Tablet fragment in front of him, Lide no longer felt danger; instead, a certain familiarity emerged.
He slowly reached out his hand towards the irregular, palm-sized stone tablet.
Gradually getting closer, he finally touched the Destiny Tablet, a cool stone sensation transmitted, his body rejoiced, and strength surged quickly.
The heart he had been holding silently settled.
He quickly took it in his hands for a closer inspection.
From its appearance, the fragment of the Destiny Tablet did not look special; it was just an ordinary stone tablet, with the rough texture characteristic of rock, holding a significant weight in hand but not overly heavy.
It was hard to imagine that such an ordinary-looking object could influence the entire destiny of Glory.
He opened the attribute panel for a glance, then shook his head. There were no changes to the attributes, the only difference was he could now touch it.
This was a Creation God Artifact. Although he hadn’t found any greater use for it yet, showing it off would definitely be spectacular...
With an experimental attitude, Lide mobilized the power within his body, slowly channeling it into the Destiny Tablet fragment.
Contrary to its previous resistance to his power, the fragment now began accepting his power, and the more strength he input, the more resplendent the pale white radiance surrounding it became.
"Ding~ Would you like to spend 1,000,000 Power of Faith to activate the Destiny Tablet fragment? Once activated, the original rules within a radius of 100 kilometers of the Destiny Tablet fragment will be completely restored. Note: Every 100 days, 1,000,000 Power of Faith must be re-injected into the Destiny Tablet fragment to maintain this effect."
Lide heard the prompt and didn’t hesitate, directly pouring the Power of Faith into the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
One hundred thousand, two hundred thousand, once millions of Power of Faith had been devoured by the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, swish~ suddenly, the fragments emitted a terrifying surge of energy.
A pale white energy formed a circular shield that surged rapidly outwards.
Raising the viewpoint, one could clearly see a giant circular shield spreading out from the center of Dawn City.
In just a few breaths, a transparent shield 5000 edges high and 100 kilometers in radius had formed, protecting everything within its range.
The Ancient powers that had existed in the air were quickly devoured by the shield as soon as it appeared, serving as nourishment for the shield.
The plants, which had been languishing under the influence of Ancient powers, now seemed to have been reborn, gradually becoming vibrant.
The residents of Dawn City also felt as if a heavy burden had been lifted from their hearts, and breathing became much easier.
After completing all this, Lide’s heart stirred, and he acutely sensed that everything around him had returned to normal, even the flow of magic power was hardly different from usual.
The Ancient powers in the air had vanished completely in a short time.
Realizing this tremendous change, Lide breathed a big sigh of relief.
No matter what troubles might come in the future, at least now there was no need to worry about Dawn City being affected by the invasion of Ancient powers.
The greatest impact of Ancient powers was on plants, and with tens of millions of people governing Dawn City, relying on food, there was no room for error in this matter.
Moreover, with the Destiny Tablet fragment’s range being a radius of 100 kilometers, as long as he anchored it on the Dawn Plain, it could cover the entire Dawn City.
"Thank you for your help, Lady Kaslina."
Having resolved the immediate troubles, Lide immediately felt much better.
Kaslina looked at Lide meaningfully upon hearing his words.
"No, City Lord Kachar, I should be thanking you."
"Thanking me?" Lide was somewhat puzzled; was this mixed-race mermaid confused?
"Yes, do you know who was the last person who bore the Power of Destiny?"
Lide seemed to think of something, his eyes filled with hesitation.
"It can’t be you, right?"
"Correct..." Kaslina’s eyes held a sense of release, and for the first time, her face lit up with a bright smile.
"I am the last person who bore the Power of Destiny..."
"But, the Destiny Tablet is not my aid, but a prison."
"A prison?" Lide raised an eyebrow.
"Do you know my true identity?" Kaslina seemed to have relieved millions of years of pressure, her tone much lighter.
True identity? This led Lide into deep thought. The guardian of the Destiny Tablet, the creator of the Sea Clan... these seemed to be just parts of Kaslina’s identity.
Before Lide could answer, Kaslina’s words shocked him.
"I am actually the Goddess of Fate from another Multi-dimensional Plane, but my plane has existed for far too long, already stepping into the end of an era...
When everything was about to perish, I encountered the powerful Creator God of Glory, the likes of which I had never seen in my life!
I pleaded with him to protect my people, and in return, I was to guard the Destiny Tablet bearing the fate of Glory forever..."
"When you took on the Power of Destiny, my covenant with the Creator God was fulfilled."
Lide gasped in astonishment, his heart trembling.
Although he knew Kaslina was extraordinary, he never imagined she could be to such an exaggerated extent!
A Goddess of Fate from another Multi-dimensional Plane...
His scalp tingled.
Wasn’t this too overpowering??
This was the Goddess of Fate, on whose whim the existence of everything depended, a notch above even the Life Goddess or Death God.
She was likely not far off from the Creator God.
This was definitely a foul this time...

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 478: Ocean God System’s Allegiance, Lide Level 29
chapters.content:
Chapter 477: Chapter 478: Ocean God System’s Allegiance, Lide Level 29
Lord Lide was so shocked by the earth-shattering revelation that Lady Kaslina disclosed that it took him a long time to come back to his senses, only after much effort did he suppress the tumultuous emotions inside.
This interracial mermaid is truly astounding...
It was not just him; the Mermaid Main God beside him also had her mouth agape with a face of disbelief looking at Lady Kaslina.
She had clearly also not anticipated that the creator of the Sea Clan turned out to be the Goddess of Fate from another multi-dimensional plane; this was beyond imagination, even busting one’s mind.
Inside the room, Frey, who had been silent all the while, also wore a calm expression, yet the shock she felt inside was no less significant than the others.
Although she had fallen to become a Death Blazing Angel, she had not lost her memory. Previously, as a War General under the Master of Dawn, she had heard and seen no less than anyone else.
Thus, she understood all too well how exaggerated this identity was.
Glory did not have a Goddess of Fate, but that did not prevent the Divine from knowing about the Goddess of Fate’s prowess. It was precisely because the Goddess of Fate was so powerful that Glory was unable to give birth to such a formidable Divine.
In fact, the objective of the Creator God in forging the Destiny Tablet was to replace the Goddess of Fate.
And now, with the fragmentation of the Destiny Tablet and Glory lacking a Goddess of Fate to suppress it, scenes of shattered rules appeared in the sky.
"Lady Kaslina, do you know the whereabouts of the Creator God?"
Lord Lide, having suppressed the shock in his heart, regained his senses and asked with a touch of curiosity.
The Creator God, according to the legends of Glory, disappeared shortly after creating the world, without any clear myth.
Lady Kaslina fell silent for a moment upon hearing this, as if Lide’s question touched upon certain secrets, but after a long while, she still began to speak, her tone laced with a hint of sentimentality.
"After creating the world, the Creator God overexerted His Divine Power and subsequently engaged in an unprecedented Divine Battle with the Ancient Rulers, sustaining very serious injuries.
In the end, He had no choice but to leave the newly established multi-dimensional plane of Glory and go into the Chaos Void in search of a way to heal His wounds.
But after the Creator God left, no news ever came back; nobody knows what happened to Him..."
Upon hearing this, Lord Lide couldn’t help shaking his head. With Lady Kaslina putting it this way, it was highly probable that the Creator God had fallen. It seemed hopeless to count on this individual who had gone missing for tens of millions of years.
After a moment’s thought, he changed the question.
"Lady Kaslina, after I carry the Power of Destiny, does it have any effect on you? Can other people also carry the Power of Destiny?"
Lady Kaslina looked at him deeply.
"I am not the Goddess of Fate of this world, and the source of my power is not the Power of Destiny, so your bearing of the Power of Destiny doesn’t affect me.
However, I made a promise with the Creator God that when a second person in Glory carries the Power of Destiny, it would mark the end of our agreement.
Before the fragmentation of the Destiny Tablet, let alone bearing the Power of Destiny, even reaching the level of the Life Goddess would not allow interaction with the Power of Destiny.
Not to mention bearing it.
But after the Destiny Tablet shattered, the Power of Destiny was divided into dozens of parts, and much of its power was sealed away by the Ancient Rulers, which is why you could bear this force.
However, the Power of Destiny you bear is not complete.
To gain more blessings, you need to collect other fragments of the Destiny Tablet."
"And the Curse of Destiny is not unique to me – many powerful Divines have learned it as well. This is a spell created by the Creator God, so in the future, there will certainly be others who will carry the Power of Destiny like you.
Therefore, you must not only face the hostility of the Ancient Evil Gods but might also be hunted by other Divine Beings of Glory..."
Hearing this, Lord Lide couldn’t help but fall into contemplation.
Whether he bore the Power of Destiny or not, there was no turning back. If he wanted to lead Dawn City forward, the only path was to become stronger, so he didn’t care about being hunted at all.
The only thing bothering him was that he had to collect the fragments of the Destiny Tablet one by one – an extremely time-consuming task.
"Lady Kaslina, is there a way for me to accurately find the locations of the Destiny Tablet fragments?
Glory is so vast, finding all the fragments surely won’t be easy..."
"And I can’t possibly stay by your side every day..."
Kaslina could detect the news of the Destiny Tablet fragments, but just as he said, he couldn’t just sit around waiting for the other party to give him instructions. This passive waiting was too contrary to his nature.
Kaslina spoke softly.
"City Lord Kachar, there’s no need to rush. One of the functions of the Curse of Destiny I have taught you is to find the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
When you recite this spell and use the Power of Destiny within your body, you will be able to sense the location of other fragments.
If you do not sense them, it is because the Power of Destiny on the fragments of the Destiny Tablet has not yet dissipated.
Similarly, others who bear the Power of Destiny will also sense the fragment of the Destiny Tablet in your hands."
Upon hearing this, Lide’s heart skipped a beat. It’s mutual?
In that case, Dawn City’s defense will require more of his attention in the future.
To avoid another incident like before, when Knights and gods of Conspiracy such as those could slip in unnoticed.
"Thank you for your guidance, Lady Kaslina."
Lide bowed to Kaslina. Regardless, although Kaslina had her little schemes, she had been quite good to him, giving him everything he was due and not holding back or hiding any information.
This being, who had lived for who knows how many years, was worthy of his respect.
Kaslina nodded, her gaze shifting toward the Mermaid Main God beside her, who had remained silent, with a touch of kindness flashing in her eyes.
"Virginia, although you can’t bear the Power of Destiny, the future of the Sea Clan will not be dimmed.
You are the descendants I brought from another Dimensional Plane, and the Sea Clan has persisted for countless eras, having faced even greater catastrophes, but we have always survived, and we will this time as well.
Dawn City has extraordinary potential. If you have no other plans, forming an alliance with the City Lord Kachar is a good choice.
Of course, I will not interfere with your decision. The future of the Sea Clan is yours to decide, and it should be up to you to choose your path."
The Mermaid Main God showed a touched expression, took a deep breath, and quickly adjusted her mood.
She had just failed to bear the Power of Destiny and almost lost her soul in the River of Destiny. If it weren’t for Kaslina activating the trident at a critical moment and waking her up, she would have been dead long ago.
It made her realize that she wasn’t as powerful as she had thought, and neither was the Sea Clan.
The current situation was clear, not to mention she had been considering forming an alliance with Lide.
Now, unable to bear the Power of Destiny, she couldn’t use the fragment of the Destiny Tablet, and the most crucial thing to fight against the Ancient power was the Destiny Tablet fragment.
So she had no choice but to ally with Lide—what else could the Sea Clan use to resist the Ancient Invasion?
The Ocean God System might be powerful, but on their own, they had no chance of surviving the apocalypse.
Moreover, Dawn City now also had the presence of Princess Philomis.
In terms of both emotion and reason, public and private, forming an alliance with Dawn City was the best choice.
"At your command, Highness."
The Mermaid Main God turned to face Lide, with a tone full of solemnity.
"I swear with my soul, from this day forth, the Sea Clan God System will become allies of Dawn City, and Kachar Main God will become a partner of the Ocean God System, never to betray each other. Should any violate this, may their soul dissipate."
"Ding~ The Ocean God System has requested to form an alliance with you. If agreed, you will become Divine Pact allies, and violators of the oath will suffer stern punishment from the Glory rules—exclusion by the entire Plane Rules."
Lide smiled brightly upon hearing the system prompt. He didn’t care about any oath; Dawn City urgently needed new forces, so naturally, he wouldn’t willingly break the oath.
Hence, the Mermaid Main God’s initiative filled him with joy.
He recited the oath just as the other party did, and soon thereafter, both parties felt a mysterious bond that was the effect of the oath.
After sensing the bond with Lide, the Mermaid Main God’s expression also softened. For her, the trip to Dawn City was immensely rewarding.
Despite not bearing the Power of Destiny, she found the Sea Clan’s creator, the great Princess Philomis, giving her a newfound sense of reliance.
Additionally, by becoming allies with Lide, she found a strong support for the Sea Clan. The power that Lide had displayed in the great ocean was even stronger than the Ocean God System.
Lide now carried the Power of Destiny, a potential without limits.
So for her, although she was unable to preserve the fragment of the Destiny Tablet, her gains were even greater.
For Lide as well, it was equally true. He not only carried the Power of Destiny and obtained a fragment of the Destiny Tablet, which meant that Dawn City would not have to worry about the erosion of ancient powers for a short time,
he had also gained the allegiance of the entire Ocean God System. Although the two sides were allies rather than subordinates, with his methods, it would not take long for these gods to become nearly indistinguishable from subordinates.
Another point was Kaslina; the heritage of this mixed-race Mermaid was astonishingly impressive, at a golden leg level.
In the future, he could certainly extract even more potential from her, and at the very least, she could be asked to sit in Dawn City. With this great god present, whomever wished to cause trouble in Dawn City would be the first to be unlucky.
However, there was still one issue before Lide that needed addressing: although he had formed allies with the Ocean God System, they were too far apart to provide each other with any practical care.
When he raised this question, it was Kaslina who spoke up to offer a solution for them.
"In this world, there are many unclaimed Elemental Planes. Virginia must be aware of the traces of the Water Element Plane; the Sea Clan could look for a few Water Element Planes, then anchor the space to Dawn City..."
This method could not be said to be perfect, but it was very controllable.
The Radiant Empire was a world composed of countless planes, and in addition to planes full of life like the Main Plane, there were many barren and single-element planes, such as the Fire Element Plane and the Water Element Plane.
By temporarily moving the Sea Clan to a Water Element Plane and then anchoring it to Dawn City, the two sides would be effectively connected.
Yet the Mermaid Main God hesitated considerably at this.
"Your Highness, there are numerous Sea Clan lives; I fear a few Element Planes might hardly bear them..."
Kaslina shook her head at these words.
"Virginia, as the ruler of the seas and the decision-maker for the Sea Clan, you need to see things more clearly.
We could not save all of the Sea Clan in the disaster of world-ending proportions; what is needed now is to preserve the fire seed, not to shelter the entire ocean..."
At last, the Mermaid Main God had no choice but to fall silent. Although the move was extremely cruel, it was the best method.
Wanting to protect everyone was simply unrealistic. If they had the power to do so, would they even need to flee?
Lide, upon hearing this, did not say much more. When it was time to let go, sacrifices were inevitable; kindness doesn’t command soldiers, and cruelty is better than none being able to live.
"Your Highness, I will arrange for this immediately, but I will not give up on the sea until the last moment!" the Mermaid Main God declared with her head high, her tone resolute.
Kaslina offered a faint smile and said no more; the survival of a race was no laughing matter...
With this, the discussions between Lide and the Mermaid Main God had achieved their respective goals.
But Lide did not rush to leave but instead continued chatting with the Mermaid Main God and Kaslina, building camaraderie and probing ancient secrets.
Perhaps because Kaslina had fulfilled her covenant with the Creator God and obtained her freedom, she was in good spirits, and she unprecedentedly shared with Lide many secretive matters.
For instance, the reason for the destruction of the Alchemy Era millions of years ago was because the Dwarves arrogantly attempted to create a god.
Even more audacious was the fact that these short greenskins actually touched upon this domain and created an Alchemy God with Divine Position, Divine Calamity, and Divine Status.
This directly enraged the gods, who developed a great fear of Dwarves.
Ultimately, over a hundred deities collaborated, regardless of the immense cost, forcibly exterminated the Alchemy civilization, destroying all alchemical materials, and even severing the history of that era, erasing most traces... Alchemy civilization thus vanished.
There was also the fact that every Battle of the Gods was actually instigated by Light Attribute deities, who always sought to conquer the Underworld and exterminate Demons. Yet in propaganda, it was always Demons emerging from the Underworld, intending to invade the Main Plane, with the gods desperately resisting...
Countless such secrets were too many to list, offering a truth far more concrete than the vague, unclear falsehoods he saw in the River of Destiny.
---
---
---
As Lide was discussing major issues with Kaslina and the Mermaid Main God, as well as delving into world secrets, Andabella and Betty, who had also come to Dawn City, spent the past week exploring every corner of Dawn City.
With Lide engrossed in carrying the Power of Destiny for a whole week, and the two girls left to their own devices, coupled with their high interest in Dawn City, they spent the week bustling with activity, enjoying the city’s sights.
The magic of Dawn City left the two girls in constant wonder.
Although Betty had been to Dawn City before and even lived there for a substantial time, that was three years ago.
In three years, the changes in Dawn City could only be described as earth-shattering. Many things that weren’t there before had been built.
Magic Track Car, running water, central heating, vegetable greenhouses, Space Gates, a city-wide illumination system... and so on.
The various constructions beyond the era made her feel as though she was in an Otherworld.
Betty felt this way, not to mention Andabella, who was visiting for the first time.
This proud girl witnessed such an astonishing city for the first time, and her admiration, even worship, for Lide had soared in these past few days.
Having been the City Lord of Risier City herself, she naturally knew the difficulty of managing a city.
Yet Lide had developed Dawn City from a small ancient castle into a massive city with a population of hundreds of thousands; how could she not admire his capability?
And not to mention the prosperity and hopefulness in the lives of the residents of Dawn City.
Although Risier City was not bad, she could sense the oppression and helplessness of the lower-class residents, but in this city, it seemed like everyone had smiles on their faces, their eyes lit by hope.
Even more staggering was that she couldn’t find even a single beggar in the city, not to mention the clearly remote streets were spotless, without any sight of beggars or homeless wanderers.
She couldn’t help but marvel at how extraordinary this city was.
And the sight of over ten different races living together in harmony was something that left Andabella speechless.
If she hadn’t seen it with her own eyes, who could have imagined that humans would one day chat happily with Vampires, Dwarves would engage in intimate conversations with Beastmen, and Goblins would laugh and play on the backs of One-eyed Giants...
It was hard for her to imagine how all this was achieved.
Calling this city Miracle City was by no means an overstatement.
Lide’s status in her heart rose higher and higher due to the things she witnessed these past few days.
Competent and capable people are always more attractive to the opposite sex; this saying is never false.
Over these days, Andabella also met the members of the Risier family and learned about their roles in the city, and her long-standing worries were eased.
Even without exaggeration, the living standards of her family now were something she envied.
Especially Elder Horn, who had become the head of Dawn Academy, his status was extremely prestigious. Not only could he teach but he could also research whatever he was interested in every day.
Although Andabella herself had reached Legendary status, she was truly a polymath at heart and had an even greater interest in researching knowledge.
If it wasn’t out of necessity, she would have much preferred to be a quiet scholar with vast knowledge, rather than a homeless wanderer who didn’t know what she was striving for...
And just today, as Andabella and Betty were about to go to the food street to continue sampling the rich cuisine Lide had transplanted from Earth, they suddenly received a summons from Lide.
The two girls, with their various thoughts, made their way to City Hall.
Lide, who had just concluded a meeting with the Mermaid Main God and Lady Kaslina, felt some emotion upon seeing them.
From any perspective, both Betty and Andabella were among the most outstanding girls.
Not only vivid in personality, but their abilities were also exceptional.
When they saw Lide, both girls had a hint of subtle expressions.
They were filled with wonder, admiration, reverence, and an indiscernible trace of affection...
"Good day, Kachar City Lord."
Andabella was the first to speak, a sincere look of admiration on her proud face.
"I’ve toured Dawn City these past few days, and I have to say, it is indeed a city that captures the heart.
I’ve seen many customs and practices, but only Dawn City has impressed me so deeply. Kachar City Lord, your wisdom would earn the praise of the Creator God!"
Lide looked at the girl’s eyes, barely concealing her admiration, and felt quite pleased inside; flattery, when well placed...
"All this wouldn’t be possible without the contributions from the Risier family. Andabella City Lord, what are your plans going forward?"
Andabella, initially full of enthusiasm, was taken aback by these words, revealing a touch of confusion in her eyes.
When Risier City was attacked by the Beastmen, she used the Blood Cloak to cover the army’s retreat, overextending her lifespan.
After being rescued by Lide, she immediately returned to the Nolan Capital, sought help from her mentor, and also fulfilled her promise—to obtain the Blood Holy Grail for Lide.
But deep inside, she harbored a breath of indignation, wanting to drive out the Beastmen and reclaim Risier City.
Yet, as the world changes, although the Beastmen were no longer there, Risier City was destroyed once and for all, not even wild grass could grow within the city.
The idea of rebuilding Risier City quietly shattered with the Ancient Invasion.
So when Lide asked what her plans were next, she found herself at a loss.
The hope of rebuilding the city was gone, the people of the Risier family were living carefree here, she had gained enormous power, but also lost the purpose to move forward...
Seeing the bewildered helplessness in Andabella’s eyes, Lide felt somewhat emotional, knowing that in these chaotic times, a peaceful life was nearly impossible.
After musing for a moment, he slowly said,
"Since you can’t find a place for now, why not join Dawn City, City Lord Andabella? Dawn City needs talents like you."
Lide genuinely appreciated Andabella; her character might be cold, but the temperament deep within her was very much to his liking.
The connection between people is all about fate—some you can see every day and feel nothing, while others you just meet and instantly bond.
Moreover, the Risier City under her management had truly prospered, and if it weren’t for the Beastmen invasion, Risier City might have already reached another level.
Dawn City was not lacking in low-level managerial talents, after all, with Dawn Academy training on a large scale, but the thirst for Advanced managerial talent was as great as that for high-level combat power.
Although Dawn City was already stable, the Underworld still had vast lands to be explored.
It was foreseeable that the situation in the main Plane of Glory would further deteriorate, and the Underworld would definitely become his major backland.
The current development of the Underworld by Dawn City was still very crude, so it was crucial to intensify expansion and management, and Andabella could definitely be sent to the Underworld to oversee the work...
Looking at Lide’s sincere gaze, Andabella’s proud face softened, and after a moment of contemplation, her heart couldn’t describe the feeling, but in the end, she nodded.
"City Lord Kachar, thank you for the invitation. From now on, I will fight for you."
After speaking, she bowed deeply to Lide.
Since Risier City could no longer be rebuilt, she had lost her purpose. If that was the case, then it was time to find a new direction for herself.
Within Dawn City, she had her remaining Bloodline relatives in this world, and she also loved this magical city.
Of course, most importantly, the owner of this city was the man who had once descended like a Heavenly God to rescue her from the Beastmen’s encirclement...
When Lide heard her words, the corners of his mouth curled up.
The girl who once held her head high and never backed down even in the face of death, was now becoming his subordinate, which felt quite marvelous...
Most critically, could he now make use of her cloak for himself?
The Blood Cloak had evolved into an Inheritance Artifact, becoming even more enticing.
That Equipment really suited his taste, wearing it he was a million times more dashing than the Ghost Cloak he snatched from the hands of the Knight and God of Murder that allowed invisibility.
Strength might improve over time, but being handsome is a lifetime matter...
"Very good, Miss Andabella, Dawn City welcomes you to join.
Believe me, you won’t be disappointed here.
Later, I’ll have someone take you to meet the Speaker of the City Hall, Harrison will provide you with a satisfactory job."
After speaking with a smile, Lide’s gaze shifted to Betty, who had remained silent the whole time.
After thinking for a while, he said softly,
"Betty, after we return this time, bring Isa to Dawn City."
"I will assign an army for you to train. The warriors of the North should not be buried without glory.
The future wars of Dawn City cannot be without your presence..."
Upon hearing these words, a wild glint erupted from the eyes of this untamed Valkyrie as she looked at Lide with a deeply moved expression.
