Her tone carried a hint of intense excitement.
"Lord Lide, I will not disappoint you!"
For Betty, who had been fighting with a longsword in hand since her childhood, life in Green City’s Crimson Mage Tower had been unbearably boring.
The desire for battle was a gene etched in the bones of the people from the North, impossible to erase.
Now, hearing that she had the chance to lead warriors into battle once again, the thrill in her heart was indescribable.
Lide observed the fervor in Betty’s demeanor and an idea struck him.
The knight he had previously captured along with the God of Murder was still suppressed in the Land of Bone-Burying.
This already-fallen Divine Position and Divine Status were still intact.
If it were possible, he could completely bestow the Knight Divine Position to Betty to enhance her strength, for this Valkyrie was worthy of significant cultivation.
After all, during the early days when Dawn City was weak, it was through Betty’s strength that they persevered, and this Northern Land Valkyrie had saved the Bloodline, so he would not treat Betty unfairly.
"Good, work hard. The future of Dawn City needs us to create together."
View the correct content at
Lide gave her an encouraging word, then as if something came to mind, asked with some curiosity.
"Betty, are you still able to contact your people?"
The Northern warriors were known as the first of the three great warriors of glory; their strength was extraordinary. However, before the days of the Ancient invasion, the Northern people had already been surrounded and attacked by the Radiant Empire and the Nolan Empire.
Betty was captured in that battle, then trafficked into the hands of Withered Bone, the chatterbox who sold her to Green City, and finally, through a twist of fate, Lide had become her master.
There are now two high-class Northern warriors in Dawn City, one being Betty and the other the Child of the North, Grote.
The two of them made significant contributions when Dawn City was yet to rise, which is why Lide held Northern warriors in such high regard, prompting this question.
Betty fell silent for a moment at these words.
"Lord Lide, my people have moved to another Plane through a Space Gate during the joint attack by the Radiant Empire and the Nolan Empire on the Northern Plateau. Now, I am unable to detect any news of them..."
Lide nodded in understanding, asking no further.
He was just inquiring casually; the Northern people numbered only three or four hundred thousand, and now the strength of Dawn City was already so formidable that there was no need to venture thousands of miles for the sake of these people.
He would only be interested if this number were multiplied by ten.
With this, Lide said no more, and summoned Harrison, gave him a brief regarding the girls, then let him take the two girls away.
Harrison knew the current situation in Dawn City better than he did and was more suitable to arrange tasks for the two girls.
After sorting out these trifles, Lide approached the window and looked up at the crack in the sky with a subtle expression.
While the ancient energy had been devoured and expelled by the Destiny Tablet fragment, the sky crack had not yet been mended; it still existed high above.
The sky crack was a fissure formed by the rules of the Main Plane. A small Destiny Tablet fragment couldn’t mend it—only when all the fragments were gathered could the repair be possible.
Thinking of this, Lide shook his head.
The Destiny Tablet fragments were exceedingly precious and rare; he only knew of one other fragment, in the Nolan Capital. The rest would need to be found slowly.
Still, he always felt those Ancient Monsters wouldn’t let things go so smoothly for him, especially now that he carried the Power of Destiny.
"Never mind, don’t think too much about it. If it’s a blessing, it’s not a disaster, and if it’s a disaster, it can’t be avoided.
Besides, Dawn City is now not something anyone can just provoke."
Lide’s mood lifted again.
The Mermaid Main God, after having a profound exchange with him, had now returned to the Lost Sea. Next time, she would lead the entire Divine to join him.
And at that time, Dawn City would definitely be considered a powerhouse.
This trip to the Lost Sea had to be said to be a complete win for Lide.
He not only achieved the predetermined goals but also gained an ally of a Divine System, oh so satisfying indeed.
After pondering briefly, Lide suddenly remembered the two Divines who were still directly suppressed in the Land of Bone-Burying.
With a wave of his hand, he shattered space and entered the Land of Bone-Burying.
His body floated high above the thousand-blade sky, and his perception swept over the Land of Bone-Burying, which immediately filled him with sentiment.
The Land of Bone-Burying’s role within Dawn City had become increasingly irreplaceable.
In the furthest corner, blocked by the dense Death fog, the Space Gate where people were busy coming and going,
Above the Bone-Burying Altar, the stone coffin sealed by the Tears of Purification lay quiet without a stir, yet the aura of Ancient Times emanating from it had not diminished in the slightest.
The wide area outside was the battleground for the three factions.
Fierce Half-Elves, Abyss Demons, Undead.
The three factions were ceaselessly locked in combat, a scene reminiscent of the eternal war between Hell and the Abyss—nonstop, day and night.
This war was originally only between the two parties involved in the Abyss pig-farming project—Undead and Demons.
But with his conquest of Green City, the occupation of Risier City, and the discovery of the Plague God’s Divine Country,
The Fierce Half-Ratmen have become the third party in the mix.
These Fierce Half-Ratmen had poured out from the Plague God Country.
Of course, the Plague God Country was not faring well itself, as it was now being devoured by the Land of Bone-Burying for its Plane Power.
Originally, Lide estimated that it would take about ten days for the Land of Bone-Burying to evolve by consuming the power of the Plague God Country.
More than ten days have passed since the initial devouring time.
After sensing for a moment, a radiant smile spread across Lide’s face.
He could now clearly sense that the Land of Bone-Burying had reached a critical point in absorbing the power of the Plague God Country, and he could upgrade the level of the Plane whenever he wished.
The next level was—Legendary.
The diameter of the extraordinary-level Land of Bone-Burying was 50,000 blades, which converts to 50 kilometers.
This area might seem neither small nor large, but for a Plane, it was indeed not enough.
The role of the Land of Bone-Burying was increasingly important, so upgrading its level had become a matter of urgency.
Without hesitation, he summoned the system panel with a thought.
"Ding~ The Land of Bone-Burying’s stored power has met the upgrade requirements. Do you wish to upgrade now? The upgrade process will take 7 days and will not affect the existing buildings and facilities."
There was no room for hesitation; he immediately chose to upgrade.
Swoosh~
The moment he selected the upgrade, the vast power stored in the Plane Stones, like water being released from a floodgate, instantly swept across the entire Plane.
The three factions engaged in battle below seemed to sense something and slowed down their actions slightly, but there were no significant changes throughout the Plane, and given the urgency of the battlefield, the war did not stop.
After carefully sensing for a moment, Lide nodded his head in satisfaction.
The Land of Bone-Burying, which had been extraordinary for so long, was finally continuing its upgrade.
I wonder how much the Land of Bone-Burying will expand this time?
Now, the feature to open Space Gates within a 1000-kilometer radius of Dawn City will undoubtedly see a significant enhancement after the upgrade. If it becomes possible to directly open a Space Gate from Dawn City to Green City, then that would be invincible.
I am truly looking forward to the scene of connecting the two cities directly.
"Thanks to the generous God of Plague, even in death, there’s still a contribution to society..."
Once the Land of Bone-Burying had stabilized, Lide’s perception delved underground where he discovered Emi, still in slumber within a hollow.
Beside Emi lay a withered Divine Body, faintly resembling a Fierce Half-Ratman.
Clearly, Emi had already consumed the power of the God of Plague and was currently undergoing transformation.
Lide didn’t pay much attention to Emi and waved his hand.
Two unconscious figures appeared before him. Although they were unconscious, the Divine Power they radiated was undiminished.
One was the Centaur God whom he had captured after conquering the Dwarf Hills, and the other was the Knight and God of Murder.
Both were living Divinities, a rarity to behold.
Originally, he hadn’t killed the Centaur God because he didn’t want to waste his soul, but unexpectedly, that snagged him a Godslayer Dagger after toppling the Knight and God of Murder.
This Dagger’s effect was to consume the souls of Divinities to augment one’s own strength.
Now, it couldn’t be considered a waste.
Keeping these two around was useless; better to send them on their way sooner and have them contribute to Dawn City.
Lide had no moral qualms. With a wave of his hand, the Godslayer Dagger, sealed deep underground, quietly appeared in his grasp.
First was the Centaur God. The Dagger pierced his heart and the slumbering soul was directly devoured.
If one looked closely, they might discern the imprint of a centaur emerging on the blade.
This fellow died swiftly, adhering to the golden rule of a bit player not exceeding three appearances in a scene.
Next came the Knight and God of Murder.
To pierce the mind with the blade intended for him was indeed satisfying...
After efficiently ending the two Divinities, he was about to proceed with the next step when the system upgrade alert suddenly sounded.
"Ding, you have killed two Divinities by yourself, and the experience gained has met the requirements for a level up. Would you like to level up now?"
I can level up now?
Lide couldn’t help but smile at the news. Since his return from the Abyss, forming alliances, first conquering the Underworld, then trampling the Dwarf Hills, and finally sweeping through Green City... which feat hadn’t been earth-shattering? Each campaign had provided him with an abundance of experience to the extreme.
He just never bothered to level up.
Now, after personally slaughtering two Divinities, the requirements had finally been met.
"Yes."
After confirmation, an immense force surged through his body, beginning to remodel his form.
However, his body had already been moving towards perfection after being transformed by the Power of Destiny, and the leveling up power circled his body three times, finding almost nothing to alter.
When Lide opened his eyes again, he realized that this leveling up process had taken only half a Sunshine Hour, and the improvement in his strength was less than a full level...
There was no change in skills or Divine Arts.
"It seems the stronger I get, the harder it is to level up; relying on ordinary leveling to gain significant improvements is quite difficult now.
Only major milestones like Level 30 or 31 or 35 can cause a real transformation..."
His level had reached the threshold of Level 29 after leveling up, the next step being Level 30, a Demigod.
Level 30 is the upper limit for a Glory Life, and without the power of a Divinity, one couldn’t break through this level.
But this wasn’t a concern for Lide, who already possessed several Divine Positions; such limiting milestones were as good as non-existent for him.
The only difficulty was, after becoming a Level 30 Demigod, how to achieve Divine Enthronement.
Now, it was time to consider this matter.

Chapter 478: Chapter 479: Industrialization of Magic, Magic Industrialization
Thinking of this, Lide couldn’t help but smile. Researching godhood seemed like no pressure for him at all.
Divine beings were extremely mysterious to outsiders; it was not an exaggeration to describe them as untouchable and inscrutable.
But for him, what untouchable nonsense—he had personally slaughtered his fair share of divine beings.
Moreover, Dawn City had another Destiny Goddess from a multi-dimensional plane, who knew everything; to her, becoming a god was trivial...
So for him, while other people considered godhood an insurmountable challenge, he merely needed to ask someone casually.
Perhaps, this was life... Only a knowing king is truly wise.
After thinking briefly, Lide didn’t dwell too deeply and shifted his gaze to the two divine corpses before him;
After the Divine Godslayer Dagger consumed the souls of the Centaur God and the God of Murder, one could distinctly feel the dagger’s power increase.
Following the deaths of the two divines, their power began to dissipate uncontrollably; however, the Divine Statuses carrying the Divine Position and Divine Power showed no changes and still peacefully resided within their bodies.
Without hesitation, Lide waved his hand, and a thumb-sized crystal flew out of the God of Murder and Knight, emitting a divine might as great as hell itself, instilling awe in anyone who witnessed it.
Interestingly, Lide sensed two distinct powers rotating within the Divine Status.
One radiated brightness and righteousness; the other was dark and evil.
These two powers were clearly the Divine Positions of the Knight and Murder.
Divine Position involved the privilege of using certain rules, and the higher the control over the Divine Position, the greater the authority one had over those rule-based powers.
Divine Positions varied in strength; powerful ones like Fate, Life, Death, and so forth represented the most fundamental and irreplaceable rules of glory.
Lower-tier Divine Positions included Sun, Ocean, War, and Strength among others, constituting potentially unlimited Divine Positions; most gods with these positions possessed Powerful Divine Power.
Both the Knight and Murder Divine Positions belonged to the lower potential category, such that even removing these rules wouldn’t affect the operation of the world.
Hence, the Knight God had previously possessed weak Divine Power, and the God of Murder, despite having killed countless divine beings, had just barely crossed into Medium Divine Power.
This is the limitation of Divine Positions, very similar to the disparities in bloodline—the stronger the bloodline, the higher the potential, and the more remarkable one’s future achievements.
The same principle applied to Divine Positions; a Knight’s Divine Position, no matter how exceptional, could not compare to a Sun God’s Position—they weren’t even in the same league.
In comparison, Lide’s highest control over the Twilight Divine Position was absolutely several tiers higher than these two.
Twilight was an embodiment of the world’s rules; nothing could escape the phase of twilight, making it an indispensable rule.
Thus, he wasn’t particularly interested in the Divine Positions of Knight and Murder, not only because they had low potential but also because they didn’t suit his combat style.
Lide picked up the crystal-like Divine Status, examining it closely in his hand.
He had slain many divine beings and seized many Divine Statuses; he was no stranger to such glorious treasures.
However, after sensing it for a while, he suddenly realized something... was slightly amiss.
His brow furrowed unconsciously.
After inspecting it for another moment as if recalling something, a thought stirred, and he slowly released the Power of Destiny hidden within his body.
Once the Power of Destiny enveloped him, Lide could distinctly sense a special connection with the surrounding rules, as if the thin veil covering a goddess had been torn away, creating a profound sensation.
After a brief contemplation, he manipulated a very subtle amount of the Power of Destiny into the Divine Status in his hand.
Moments later, a dramatic shift occurred.
If an outsider were present, they would be shocked to discover that the Divine Status, as hard as steel, was melting away like ice under flame, gradually dissolving into two parts.
Even more astonishing was that the two incompatible energies within were cleanly separated.
Incredibly divine.
After finishing, Lide retracted the Power of Destiny with a slightly intricate expression; he hadn’t expected his own ability to perform such a maneuver.
Subconsciously, he opened the attribute panel of the two Divine Statuses.
Shattered Divine Status
Quality: Special
Trait: Contains the position of Knight God and rich in divine power.
Introduction: After absorbing the power within the divine status, one can attain the position of the Knight God.
The attribute of another divine status was barely different, except that it contained the position of the God of Murder.
"I didn’t expect the Power of Destiny to have such an earth-shattering effect.
Although the Power of Destiny I carry is quite rare, I can still control a certain level of the origin power of Glory...
Dividing the divine status into two without any damage, this ability can indeed be described as transcendent."
Lide nodded satisfactorily.
After he had carried the Power of Destiny, he had received no system notification and thought its only effect was to activate the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
It seemed that he would have to research the Power of Destiny further in the future.
This power was too advanced, far superior to the Power of Faith.
After focusing his mind, he looked towards the other side—the body of the Centaur God.
With a wave of his hand, the divine status of his opponent flew out from within its body.
The divine status of the Centaur God was pure, untainted by other powers, which saved him an extra step.
"The Knight God’s position can be given to Betty, although her potential isn’t too high, it is still a combat-related divine position, and it will definitely enhance her significantly.
Besides, it’s not like one can’t have more than one divine position; I can plunder others in the future..."
"The Centaur God’s position will be given to Guido Blackwind of Centaur, now that the Centaur lives in the Underworld, it’s time to elevate the power of this King of the Gale Empire..."
"The God of Murder’s position has no suitable candidate yet; I can save it for now..."
After allocating the roles, Lide nodded satisfactorily, calculating that he would soon have two more individuals with ultimate combat power at the Legendary Level under his command, and both legends held divine positions, which was extraordinary.
After ensuring the distribution, Lide glanced at the Land of Bone-Burying where the upgrade was still ongoing, and the battle below wasn’t affected.
But just as he was about to return to Dawn City and bestow the Knight God’s position to Betty, a rampaging, wildly rampaging undead caught his attention on the battlefield below.
It was a cow-shaped undead standing about 3 sabers tall and 4 sabers long, with hooves on the ground and a pair of curved horns on its head, with the Soul Fire blazing within its skull.
Thanatos Dusk
The first life born in the Land of Bone-Burying, named by Lide, who instinctively mastered 0.01% of the positions of Death, Doomsday, and Despair after being named—a foolish cow...
But that was not the key—the key was the level of this cow bone undead had now reached Legendary.
That’s right, Lide slightly sensed and found that the aura emanated by the cow bone undead had reached Level 25!!
How long had it been since he last saw it?
Only about half a year...
This guy was only Level 19 before, not even reaching Transcendent, and now he damn well stepped into the Legendary.
If he hadn’t taken an extra glimpse today, he wouldn’t have noticed this fool had leveled up so quickly.
Thinking of this, he began to observe seriously, and after a moment, Lide finally realized.
This fellow must have gained some Skill while devouring corpses, cleverly concealing its own aura. With a blink, if one didn’t carefully observe, it would be easy to overlook.
Given the chaotic battlefield with tens of thousands clashing, it was normal that it had been overlooked.
At this moment, the cow bone undead was happily playing, its huge white skull lowered, its strong hooves bending forcefully as it charged towards the front, an unstoppable terrifying impact force shattered every life it hit along its path, flinging them wildly.
A trail of mangled limbs and fragments marked its path.
Legendary Level powers were naturally not something that the mere Level 19 or lower and fewer than 10 Transcendent armies of the Land of Bone-Burying could contend with.
The Cow Bone Undead aided no one, simply reveling in the slaughter. This silly cow excitedly charged from one edge of the Land of Bone-Burying straight to the other. Anyone unlucky enough to be trampled to death was just out of luck...
Lide found the sight somewhat amusing; this foolish cow always seemed to enjoy causing utter chaos.
"It seems like the Abyssal Pig-Slaying plan has benefited this fellow quite a bit. Think about it, gnawing on high-level corpses every day—its level would inevitably rise..."
The talent of the Cow Bone Undead was to devour corpses to increase its strength, and on this blood-soaked battlefield, if there was an abundance of anything, it was corpses.
So, it was no strange matter that this fellow had risen to a Legendary status...
After observing the Cow Bone Undead for a while, Lide shook his head and decided not to bother with this silly cow anymore.
Though a Legendary level was impressive, it was of no great use to Dawn City at the moment.
Better to leave it here to continue growing until the day it reached Demigod status. Riding it around Dawn City then would be quite amusing.
Lide chuckled softly after pondering this, waved his hand, shattered the void, and left the Land of Bone-Burying.
At that moment, the Cow Bone Undead below seemed to sense something, abruptly lifting its head to look toward the sky, but Lide had already departed and it detected nothing.
With a "Pfft" sound, grey energy sprayed from its hollow nostrils. This high-spirited foolish cow then lowered its head again and began sprinting with all its strength. Such energy, if not used for plowing fields, would be a waste.
If Lide had observed for longer, he would have thought of fixing a plow to this foolish cow. Perhaps, he could have pioneered an automated farming method...
This creature didn’t need to graze, rest, or know fatigue, with minimal wear and tear, a perfect renewable eco-friendly energy source indeed.

In Dawn City, when Lide reappeared in his office, his spiritual power spread out instantly sensing Betty and Andabella still in Harrison’s office.
He immediately stepped out and went to Harrison’s office.
Upon entering, Lide didn’t beat around the bush, his deep gaze turned to Betty, and he directly spoke,
"Betty, this is the Divine Status of the Knight God, containing a vast amount of Divine Power.
As long as you absorb this power, you’ll grasp part of the Knight’s Divine Position.
Although it’s not the most compatible Divine Position for you, it can significantly increase your combat power..."
He extended his hand, handing over the Divine Status to Betty.
After taking it, Betty immediately sensed the terrifying energy contained within. When her gaze returned to Lide’s profound eyes, her face blushed slightly, revealing an undisguised touch of emotion.
Though she had already stepped into the Transcendent realm and her strength was definitely not weak, normally, she wouldn’t be impressed by typical power-enhancing treasures.
But what Lide gave her was a Divine Status.
Who in Glory didn’t know the rarity of a Divine Status?
Such a treasure, bestowed upon her so casually...
Overwhelmed, she opened her mouth to say something but eventually, with a trembling voice, only managed to say "Thank you."
From the side, Andabella’s eyes showed a barely detectable trace of envy, but this proud girl didn’t say much.
Her reliance was the Blood Cloak behind her; she didn’t need to seek any Divine Position as long as she could fully master the Blood Cloak, it would be enough to benefit her for a lifetime.
"Betty, you can go to the room next to my office to absorb the Divine Status’s power. The City Hall is strictly guarded, and no one would dare disturb you."
Betty nodded, her wild eyes looking towards Lide showed a hint of tenderness, but she didn’t speak further, always one for action rather than words.
After Betty left with the guard, Andabella also received the order to head to the Underworld, gloriously becoming one of the city lords subordinate to Dawn City.
The Underworld was vast, and the ten plus new cities set up by Lide all needed people to manage them.
Andabella, as a highly advanced managerial talent, was in short supply, not to mention that she was beautiful and strong, and even had a Divine Artifact by her side...
After both girls had left, only Lide and Harrison remained in the room.
Harrison didn’t hesitate and seized the opportunity to update Lide on the recent work in Dawn City.
"Your Majesty, frequent fluctuations of the plane’s energy, sealed by the Ancient Evil God, have been detected near Dwarf Valley. Our scouts outside have even found the octopus tentacles you described before...
Based on our speculation, that plane is getting closer to destruction..."
Lide’s eyebrows raised. Ever since he had carried that stone coffin out from the Sealed Land, he had a feeling that this area could become a potential threat.
Now, that trend was becoming increasingly evident.
"Have the residents of Dwarf Valley all retreated back to Dawn City?"
"All the elderly, women, and children have been evacuated. Now, only the miners extracting from the Secret Silver Vein and mining iron ore remain in the valley.
Our city guard forces are equipped with Magic Language Bats, ready to retreat at any moment if the situation turns dire."
Lide pondered for a moment, then slowly said,
"When the Sea Clan Gods arrive, I will have them station Divines there, but prior to their arrival, do not relax our scrutiny of the Sealed Land.
We must also intensify the development of the Underworld, especially the ore aspect. As long as we can find sufficient veins, we can completely abandon the Dwarf Valley."
The Underworld was rich in mineral veins, but sparse in population, necessitating the deployment of a large number of Prospectors to explore.
Moreover, it took a significant amount of time to explore and mine these veins, which was why Lide, despite having control over the Underworld, had not yet seen substantial benefits from it.
This was also the reason why he had not yet abandoned the Dwarf Valley.
"Your Majesty, the Think Tank has already recognized this issue, and has developed several plans for the Underworld’s development in recent times."
The decision-makers at the City Hall were also not narrow-minded and had already devised strategies for this.
Lide nodded, then after a moment of thought, continued,
"How is the study of mining machinery blueprints provided to the Magic Industry Research Institute by the Crimson Moon progressing? Can they be manufactured?"
Since the Magic Industry Research Institute localized the automatic seeder and harvester to become the Alchemy Seeder and Alchemy Harvester,
Lide had started ordering the Data Analysis Department of the Crimson Moon to provide Dawn City with various mechanized blueprints.
Mining machines, lathes, milling machines, stamping machines, and many other practical equipment blueprints from Earth had been sent to the Magic Industry Research Institute.
The only issue was that, although the institute’s research capability was strong, magical adaptation still required some time to develop.
Among these, what most concerned Lide were the mining machines.
Dawn City was still using human labor in extracting ores, which was inefficient.
If mining machinery could be developed, it would greatly save labor and material costs.
Using Earth’s technology to help develop Dawn City had always been his vision, and he had been actively pursuing this approach.
For Dawn City to develop further, absorbing and utilizing the civilization’s crystallization from another world was undoubtedly the right approach.
Industrialization of magic, and magic in industrialization, this was the tone Lide had set for the future development of Dawn City.
In fact, several of Dawn City’s major factories had already begun initial steps toward industrialization.
The Alchemy Factory and Weapon Factory were among the forerunners.
Moreover, textile factories, breweries, printing plants, and other life-oriented factories were also beginning to shift towards industrialization.
It could be foreseen that in the future, Dawn City would completely integrate the crystallization of magic and Earth’s civilization.
At that time, the city would become even more magnificent.
Lide harbored a strong confidence in this.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 480: The Chaotic Situation
chapters.content:
Chapter 479: Chapter 480: The Chaotic Situation
As the Undead Empire rose from the carcasses of the Human Radiant Empire, it had always been dreaded by the surrounding nations.
However, this all changed after the Ancient Gods arrived.
The terror of the Undead was nothing compared to the horror of the Ancient Evil Gods that could destroy the entire world.
Moreover, with the land now divided by Ancient Monsters, cities had become isolated islands on the land, so no one cared about the repugnant Undead Life anymore.
At this moment, the Undead Empire’s capital—White Bone City, under the notice of the outside world, suddenly had exaggerated rifts appear in the sky, as if the entire world was about to shatter.
These rifts were not the result of the Ancient Invasion rotting away at space but seemed like the result of some supremely powerful force smashing space apart.
Crack~
In just a few breaths, the sky cracked open like it had been punched by a giant fist that blotted out the heavens, creating even more fractures that spread like dense spider webs across the entire sky.
Crack~
After the third strike, the sky burst asunder and above White Bone City appeared a world composed entirely of skeletons and exuding a Death Aura—the Undead Plane.
This Plane, which had existed since the beginning of creation, now directly tore through the space of the Main Plane and descended in a dominating manner.
Even more shocking was the fact that, on the other side, fifteen figures wearing White Bone Crowns audaciously appeared, cloaked in human skin capes and exuding a majestic Divine Power, like towering behemoths.
The Undead Monarchs, the rulers of the Undead Plane for millions of years.
At this moment, their potent Divine Power surged out unchecked, and beneath them, White Bone City instantly fell into silence.
The low-level Undead Life all knelt in unison, in the most humble posture, welcoming the arrival of their king.
The players in White Bone City found the burden too great, their souls and bodies trembling at this moment, even more so than the surrounding Undead, falling to their knees, collapsing to the ground.
Even the players who were reluctant to kneel were crushed to the ground by the irresistible Divine Power, in a more wretched state than kneeling.
How could these mere Level 10 players compare to the pressure of a Level 40 Powerful Divine Power?
Even the hardest bones seemed insignificant in the face of absolute power.
The Knight of the Broken Sword, as a top player who had been to the Land of Bone-Burying and knew of the Undead Monarch’s plans, was also unable to resist the Divine Power but maintained a shred of clarity in his heart, barely kneeling on one knee, not as overwhelmed as those players caught unprepared beside him.
Even so, at this moment, he felt an oppressive tightness in his chest, the terrifying pressure making it difficult for him to breathe.
"Are these Undead planning something? Are they all Divines?"
"Did we just hit the jackpot this time, with so many Divines descending all at once? If I could just take on an epic quest, wouldn’t that mean whatever I want, I would get?"
"Idiot, do you think you can even interact with such advanced life forms? You’d be lucky if you’re not outright killed."
"The Undead actually have so many powerful Divines, it looks like we’ve chosen the right faction..."
Some players, true to their nature, were muttering about wanting to take on quests.
The Knight of the Broken Sword wore a complex expression. The Undead were not benevolent beings, and these monarchs, especially, were not easy to deal with, were they?
Wanting to say something but then shaking his head, he remembered his recent trip to the Undead Plane. Now, whether in the Main Plane or in Glory, he had truly become an Undead...
While the players below were discussing heatedly, the Undead Monarchs in the sky, after enjoying the worship from below, finally spoke.
The leading Undead Monarch, holding a scepter forged entirely of skulls, with a human skin cape flapping loudly behind him, exuded an imposing aura as mighty and unshakable as a mountain.
Undead Profanity thundered like the roaring heavens, crashing down.
"I declare, from this day forth, the Undead shall return to the Main Plane, wherever my gaze falls, shall be Undead Land.
My will, shall be the direction the Undead march forward!"
"Undead, immortal!"
Upon hearing these words, the Undead below immediately had their Soul Fires flare up fiercely, promptly standing up and howling towards the sky.
The whole of White Bone City, millions of Undead, at this moment let out a chilling and terrifying roar that made one’s spine tingle.
The scene was as awe-inducing as an epic mural.
Some players inside the city didn’t take it seriously, but many others were filled with surging passion, roaring out loud one after another.
The knight with the broken sword now wore an expression on his face that was difficult for anyone to comprehend as he sighed softly.
The arrival of the Undead meant that the situation in the Main Plane of Glory was going to deteriorate further.
---
---
---
At the same time, in the Bottomless Abyss far removed from the Main Plane, accompanied by the crisp sound of shattering glass, many Demons suddenly stared upward.
The sky crack that enveloped the entire Abyss and was seeping out Ancient Powers had just widened once more.
The original fissure, which had been like a dike’s crack slowly leaking Ancient Powers, had now become a breach in the dike, gushing out Ancient Powers at a rate several times faster...
And sensing the surge of Ancient Powers, countless Demons began to grow restless within.
The power of the Ancients belonged to the Chaos Void, to a time before the creation of the world, when no life of Glory could endure that power’s corrosion and remain in its original state.
They were born archenemies, and even the most wicked Demons were no exception.
These Demons now felt a deadly threat, their nature preventing them from calming down, with no tangible enemy to confront; they could only roar and howl in madness...
Amidst this irritability, suddenly some Demons at the Demigod Level seemed to detect something, their faces revealing a ferocious smile as they violently waved their hands, tearing apart the space in front of them.
After briefly sensing the shattered space, these Demons quickly walked out from the broken space with a hint of elation.
These Demons crossed the Space Gate and suddenly appeared in the Main Plane.
Although the aura of the Ancients was even stronger on the Main Plane, adding to the Demons’ inner turmoil, the flowers, plants, and trees unique to the Main Plane were like treasures to these Demons who lived in a harsh environment.
Some Demon Lords rapidly turned around to return to the Abyss, then rallied their subordinates, leading a grand army of Demons from the Abyss to the Main Plane.
Some Ancient Evil Gods also noticed the change at this time, as the sky’s rule fissure widened and the rules of the Main Plane became even more fragile.
The tyrannical rules that used to separate the Abyss and the Main Plane no longer worked.
This discovery stirred the hearts of ancient beings that had been hiding in the Abyss for millions of years, and they immediately tore space apart, descending upon the Main Plane with the posture of kings...
Soon after, Demons began appearing all over the Main Plane of Glory in a very short time.
The arrival of the Demons made the already chaotic Main Plane even murkier, and the evolving situation had now entered a direction that no one could predict.
---
---
---
Storm Sea Domain, on an unnamed island.
A black bird-beast with four wings on its back was currently flying at high speed.
Yet strangely, the four-winged bird-beast, indifferent to life or death, was heading straight for the rock face of the island’s highest peak.
Its flight speed did not decrease at all, appearing as if it sought self-destruction by crashing into the rock face.
Just as the four-winged bird-beast slammed into the rock wall, in a moment expected to be its last, the solid rock facade rippled like waves and was directly penetrated by the bird-beast.
The rock wall was an illusion.
Flurry~
After passing through the rock wall, following the bird-beast’s line of sight, a long rock tunnel appeared, and after flying for about ten more minutes, the view suddenly cleared.
A city like a Divine Country emerged before its eyes.
It was a Floating City suspended in the sky, unimaginable that a city could actually float mid-air.
Several rivers fell from the city, crashing onto the ground below, causing splashes everywhere.
The several pathways connecting the city to the heavens were like rootless duckweed, curving and suspended in the air.
Alongside the roads, a variety of flowers were planted, now blooming with fervor.
Birds swirled around, and white clouds floated near the city walls.
This scenery seemed filled with a dreamlike sensation.
The four-winged beast, however, had no appreciation for these beautiful vistas, flapping its wings and soaring upwards, it flew directly into the heart of the gargantuan Floating City that hung in midair like a mountain range.
Whoosh~
After entering the city, the four-winged beast made several winding turns before flying into the central domed structure.
Inside this building, supported by square pillars engraved with mysterious patterns, a group wearing long red robes gathered around a stone table, engaged in heated discussion.
What stood out was that all of their eyes were red—a sight that would have sparked fear outside, for only the Dark Race bore such malevolent eyes.
Amongst the crowd, the Red-eyed Lady who had once explored the Divine ruins with Lide was also strikingly present.
At the moment, she was looking at the item on the stone table with a shock-filled gaze—a palm-sized fragment that emitted an aura of extreme terror.
Had Lide been there, he would have immediately recognized the fragment on the table as the Destiny Tablet fragment he had been seeking so desperately.
Fluttering—
As the crowd debated fervently, the four-winged beast fluttered its wings and flew into the room.
Noticing its arrival, the previously bustling group suddenly fell silent.
The Red-eyed Lady extended her hand, allowing the beast to land on her wrist, and then, after rummaging around its abdomen, she extracted a sealed letter.
After carefully studying the contents of the letter, the lady’s face revealed a trace of surprise. She quickly made her way through the crowd to the middle-aged man standing in a central position, wearing a silver crown.
"Your Majesty," she began, "Anos has sent word confirming that the red-eyed girl mentioned by Miss Andabella, who was lost in the Human Country, is indeed our golden heir stolen by the Long-tailed Giant Troll Clan over a decade ago.
"The golden heir is currently in Green City, and her Level has reached Transcendent..."
Her words sent a jolt through the hall, sparking an uproar like cold water hitting boiling oil.
"What??! The golden heir has appeared in the Human Country?!!"
"Ancestors above, is our Silver Moon Radiance City-State finally going to rise?"
"Your Majesty, I implore you to immediately send someone to bring the golden heir back; we need her..."
"Transcendent? Is this a naturally born golden heir? She’s not even twenty years old yet!! Ancestors above, we are saved!!"
The middle-aged man with the silver crown could not help but show a look of delight upon hearing this.
The golden heir was too significant for the Silver Moon Radiance City-State.
It could even determine the fate of the entire city-state’s survival and demise!
If not for the attack more than a decade ago, when the Long-tailed Giant Troll Clan, the eternal foe of the Silver Moon City-State, had taken the golden heir by surprise, perhaps the Silver Moon Radiance City-State would not be so isolated and helpless as it was now.
With a wave of his hand, the King waited for the surrounding crowd to settle before he slowly spoke.
"The golden heir is related to the life and death of our entire city-state; we must dispatch someone to bring her back immediately."
After his declaration, he lowered his head to look at the Destiny Tablet fragment wrapped in stone on the stone table before him, his expression grave.
Correct content is on
"This fragment that fell to our city might be the Destiny Tablet fragment spoken of by the Sun Goddess.
"We cannot touch it now, but perhaps when the golden heir returns to the city-state and inherits the power of her ancestors, we might be able to use this fragment."
"The golden heir is not only related to whether we can eradicate those evil Long-tailed Giant Trolls but also to the far more critical Ancient Invasion and the catastrophic destruction we are facing..."
As he spoke, many people subconsciously turned their heads to look at the sky through the window.
Although the cracks in the sky were smaller than in the Main Plane, no one could ignore the Ancient power seeping through...
"So this mission is of utmost importance, and I will personally lead the team."
The expressions of those around became extremely solemn.
The King scanned the group and continued,
"To prevent any mishaps, I will seal this fragment in the center of the city, and you must protect it.
"Like the golden heir, it decides the fate of our Silver Moon Clan."
Hearing this, the crowd around him collectively placed their hands over their chests and bowed, their tone solemn.
"We follow your command, Your Majesty!"
The King nodded, his gaze shifting towards the Red-eyed Lady.
"Summon the King’s Guard and accompany me to that human city, to welcome back our hope."
---
---
---
Earth.
The appearance of the sky rift had caused the entire world to undergo significant turmoil.
Game plots were becoming reality, and the impact was nothing short of startling.
Fortunately, the sky rift on Earth at this time was not very large, and the emanating power of Ancient times was not dense, which prevented the situation where Ancient monsters were everywhere like in "Glory."
Even so, the effect on social production and life was indescribable.
Some small countries in Africa and Europe were almost blown away, especially those so-called democratic states with loose political systems that had little control, which became a joke in the face of catastrophe and immediately fell into paralysis.
The sky rift made doomsday talks prevalent, and these small nations plunged into extreme chaos, with looting, killing, and people dying almost every moment.
In such a chaotic situation, something shocking happened—the traces of the Undead were discovered in a small European nation.
Yes, the Undead from "Glory."
At first, some thought it was just a prank, but when a small city of tens of thousands was swept away by the Undead and turned into beings of bone, humanity was shocked awake.
The disaster of Ancient times was indeed sweeping over Earth.
The sky had truly changed!
Those who had previously harbored wishful thinking no longer had an ounce of such mentality.
In an instant, the situation, already chaotic, became completely unmanageable.
The undead disaster was quickly extinguished by the military dispatched by surrounding nations, but the terror had already spread across the globe.
At this time, only powerful nations like Huaxia had not experienced too much turmoil, with society remaining relatively stable without too much upheaval.
This was also thanks to Huaxia establishing a Player Department under the official guidance, promptly dealing with problems, and even dispatching players to quell dangers, greatly ensuring social stability and the safety of its people.
Huaxia Official soon discovered the cause of the European Undead disaster—the players who had participated in the Undead Plane meeting were the source.
Huaxia Official followed the clues and found all the players who had attended the Undead Plane meeting and turned into Undead.
This prevented the Undead disaster from occurring in Huaxia.
The officials also established corresponding emergency departments dedicated to handling these matters.
However, panic had become an inevitable reality.
In no time, stockpiling food and digging deep shelters became the mainstream actions for everyone.
The Crimson Moon, arranged by Lide, was even more so, having purchased a vast piece of land in a mountainous region hundreds of kilometers from Shanghai by now.
Of course, officially, it was for establishing a headquarters.
Billions of funds poured in, hundreds of excavators, thousands of vehicles, began to build non-stop, day and night...
Under such financial power, nothing could stand in the way, and a mini-city shrunken countless times was being built at a remarkably fast speed.
"One day, one change" might be an exaggeration, but "every three days a small change, every ten days a significant change" was absolutely true—for in times immemorial, ’pay to win’ has been a universal truth.
With the appearance of Magic Power, Magic Arrays that were once only possible in "Glory" were infused with new life.
The Crimson Moon had the full backing of Dawn City, nearly drowning in piles of Magic Array blueprints—anything one could want was readily available.
Thus, a mini-city that combined the crux of two worlds’ civilizations was rapidly taking shape.
It wasn’t just the Crimson Moon; official departments and large conglomerates alike began to construct their own headquarters or shelter facilities.
Everyone knew that the future might be even bleaker.
Everything was entering an unpredictable course...

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 481: The Ocean God System Workers Arrive, Boss Please Let Us Work
chapters.content:
Chapter 480: Chapter 481: The Ocean God System Workers Arrive, Boss Please Let Us Work
The journey to the Lost Sea had delayed Lide’s plans to go to the Nolan Capital.
He had to write a letter, urging his affordable teacher in the Royal Capital, Spark, to take care, and at the same time, to continue to inquire about the news of the Destiny Tablet fragments.
The journey from the Nolan Capital to Dawn City was long, and even with Castro as his mount, going there would definitely cause a significant delay; it might take ten days to even a month to return.
Now that he had harnessed the Power of Destiny, he knew that the fragments of the Destiny Tablet wouldn’t be easily obtained by others, and thus he no longer felt the initial urgency.
So, he wanted to wait until he had settled a few things at hand.
First of all, naturally, was the upgrade of the Land of Bone-Burying; upgrading from Extraordinary to Legendary would take a week’s time, not long, but after the upgrade, the attributes of the Land of Bone-Burying would surely increase significantly, something he greatly anticipated.
Next was the issue of the Ocean God System. Since both parties had already formed an alliance, then what followed would surely be deeper cooperation. The alliance wasn’t just lip service—it needed to be put into practice.
The Mermaid Main God had already promised that as soon as a suitable Water Element Plane was found to accommodate the Sea Clan, they would immediately come to Dawn City and join forces against enemies.
Lide naturally agreed gladly, and he stayed here waiting for the others because he had to make some additional arrangements for these Divine beings.
Divines are proud by nature, and except for him, Harrison couldn’t command them in Dawn City.
I, a lofty Divine, why should you boss me around??
Power was the foundation for mutual respect. In Dawn City, the only one who could command the Sea Clan Gods was Lide, not even Frey might be qualified.
So, in the days following the upgrade of the Land of Bone-Burying, Lide didn’t leave Dawn City but instead took the rare leisure time to deal with political affairs together with Harrison.
While dealing with trivial political matters, he gained new insights about Dawn City.
It must be said that Dawn City had indeed changed dramatically, with four expansive territories under its rule, each one could be called massive.
The most central was Dawn City itself, which after migrating from Green City, had already broken through a population of 350,000, reaching the scale of a central city in this world.
Moreover, the technology of Dawn City far surpassed that of other cities in this world, dazzling people, and it would become even more magnificent and enchanting in the future, with limitless potential.
Next was Green City, this former core city of the southern provinces, with a population nearing 5 million.
After the annihilation of the Fierce Half-Ratmen in Risier City, the army of Green City was still gathering those small cities that hadn’t been overtaken, and one could foresee the population might grow even more in the upcoming period.
Green City had a mature industrial system and well-developed urban areas, already playing a significant role.
And during this time, the technology from Dawn City was being transferred back to Green City, and soon after, Green City would also possess part of the unique industrial system of Dawn City.
The third territory under development was the Underworld.
This vast land, although with a harsher natural environment than the surface, became a safe haven during the Ancient Invasion.
The Underworld currently housed over 3 million Centaurs, tens of millions of Cave Dwellers, and an additional 6 million of the Underground Race, with a total population nearing 20 million.
The only pity was that the Cave Dwellers, who made up half of the number, had too low combat capability to be deployed on the battlefield.
But these little dwarfs could dig holes and plant Microglow Mushrooms to survive, with no demand for quality of life, making them very easy to sustain. These Cave Dwellers were also an important source of faith for Lide, not a waste of food.
The final territory was the Bottomless Abyss.
The Gravel Plane, which Lide initially occupied, had already become the bridgehead for Dawn City’s invasion of the Abyss.
He had planned to use the Abyss to kill demons when he initiated the plan, opening a Space Gate in some mineral-rich Planes, drawing the demons of the Plane to the Land of Bone-Burying, using the Undead to eliminate these demons.
When these demons were nearly wiped out, the citizens of Dawn City would reap the benefits.
The plan was close to perfect, with the Dark Sovereign placing great trust in him.
Since the plot had been underway for so long, the harvest of Dawn City was naturally substantial; apart from the Gravel Plane, there were already five Planes that had fallen into the hands of Dawn City.
Although these Planes couldn’t be said to be truly rich, the unique minerals of the Abyss were plentiful, ranking them as moderate Planes.
However, the biggest issue with the Abyss was that life from the Main Plane was extremely susceptible to corruption and falling from temptation within the Abyss.
So, for now, Dawn City didn’t have the sufficient resources to develop these newly occupied Planes.
This made Lide both happy and troubled.
But it was also okay, as City Hall had already begun to handle these matters.
City Hall was no longer like when it was first established, with just a handful of big and small fish.
Due to the population under his rule surpassing 25 million, the scale of City Hall had become unprecedentedly vast.
Furthermore, with the centralized power system of Dawn City, Lide now had absolute control over the several territories under his subordinates, able to command them at will.
The political system established in City Hall had been refined over several years, allowing all aspects of Dawn City’s operations to run smoothly, without any chaos from rapid large-scale expansion.
On the contrary, it was surprisingly well-ordered, with all aspects progressing in an orderly fashion.
Lide was quite satisfied with this, although the now mature City Hall system was largely the result of the Think Tank and Harrison’s high-level self-improvement. But as the founding soul of City Hall, his contribution could not be erased by anyone.
A week later, Lide had dealt with all the backlog of political affairs, and he now had a clearer understanding of the current state of Dawn City.
Even without expansion, the current Dawn City was multiple times stronger than the Southern Province before the Ancient Invasion.
Industrial strength, magical strength, military power, the standard of living for its residents, and so on, had all surpassed the previous Southern Province.
The old Southern Province was a standard rule-based system, benefiting only a minority of Nobles while the lower-level residents were the oppressed and tragic figures.
Dawn City was the exact opposite, completely shattering the noble system and reallocating the resources that used to sustain the nobility to the common residents.
This resulted in the weakening of the Nobles and the common class gaining benefits.
This was also one of the reasons why Dawn City could stabilize the situation so quickly.
Most residents actually didn’t care who ruled them, as long as they lived well, none of that mattered.
But now, Lide was no longer interested in dealing with trivial political affairs. On the seventh day, he suddenly felt that the expansion of the Land of Bone-Burying had stopped.
With a heart full of joy, he directly shattered the Chaos Void to enter the Land of Bone-Burying.
Boom~
As Lide entered the Land of Bone-Burying, a huge sound like two mountains colliding echoed, and the entire Plane shook.
The system’s prompt sounded after the shockwave had dissipated.
"Ding~ Land of Bone-Burying has been upgraded to Legendary."
Lide’s eyes brightened, finally, the upgrade was successful.
He hurriedly opened the attribute panel.
Land of Bone-Burying (Undead Plane)
Level: Legendary (Next level Divine-level, upgrade requires 10 billion Power of Death)
Power of Death: 430 million
Traits: Capable of growth, Undead Transformation
Special Troops: Frost Giant Dragon
Special Building: Skeleton Altar, can speed up the transformation of Transcendent Level and above Undead Life
Special Area: Land of Corruption (Extraordinary)
Plane Size: Diameter of 100,000 blades (100 kilometers)
Anchor Coordinates—Dawn City (Space Gates can be opened within a 1500 kilometers radius of Dawn City to enter the Land of Bone-Burying)
Introduction: ....
Legendary, finally upgraded to Legendary, it wasn’t easy...
And, as expected, the next Level indeed required 10 billion Power of Death.
Lide heaved a great sigh of relief when he saw this.
It was fortunate that he could let the Land of Bone-Burying devour the Divine Country of the God of Plague; otherwise, relying solely on the abyss pig farming plan, who knew when he would be able to upgrade.
He had now amassed over four billion Power of Death, and if he was willing, by sacrificing some divinity from the Divine Body of the Centaur God or the Knight and the God of Murder, he could immediately recruit four Extraordinary Level Frost Giant Dragons.
But Lide’s horizons had broadened, and he no longer valued the Extraordinary.
As for those Powers of Death, he decided to save them for now, and when he had accumulated enough, see if he could directly recruit a few Divine-level Frost Giant Dragons...
What satisfied him the most was undoubtedly the expansion of the Land of Bone-Burying and the increased distance at which the Space Gate could be opened to it.
Originally, the Land of Bone-Burying had a diameter of 50 kilometers, but now it had doubled to 100 kilometers; from the sky, the edge was almost out of sight.
Before, he could open a Space Gate back to the Land of Bone-Burying within a radius of 1000 kilometers. Now, this distance had increased to 1500 kilometers.
Although it was still not possible to open a Space Gate directly from Dawn City to Green City, it was not far off, at most a couple hundred kilometers away.
It could be foreseen that once the Land of Bone-Burying upgraded from Legendary to Divine-level next time, it would be possible to directly open a Space Gate to Green City.
At that time, the two cities, nearly 2000 kilometers apart and separated by mountains and seas, would be connected together — a truly epoch-making event.
"Love across mountains and seas, yet mountains and seas need not be filled; just open a door and cross..."
Correspondingly, the connection range between Dawn City and the Underworld had also been pushed inward by 500 kilometers, greatly saving the round-trip distance.
Although the benefits of this upgrade of the Land of Bone-Burying were not as directly tangible as immediate rewards, it greatly improved the efficiency of Dawn City and strengthened the connections between different territories, these kinds of invisible benefits were more important to him.
And shortly after the upgrade of the Land of Bone-Burying, a powerful aura suddenly emanated from deep within the earth.
Moments later, the space before Lide shattered, and Emi appeared in front of him with an extremely excited expression.
"Your Highness, I have finished devouring the Divine Status and Divine Body of the God of Plague.
I have now reached 60% control over the Plague God Position..."
Hearing these words, Lide’s eyes brightened.
Not bad, comrade, a 60% control over the Divine Position is quite substantial.
"What have you gained?"
"Now I have a new understanding of plagues. It’s wonderful, praise be to you!"
Emi danced with excitement.
"The plague I’ve shown you before, which can greatly enhance the strength of those infected, I am confident I can continue to improve it.
And after the improvement, the effects will be at least 50% better than the original, even usable by the Extraordinary!"
Emi’s confident words made Lide nod in satisfaction.
The last plague Emi had researched was anything but simple, as it could significantly enhance the power of the infected lifeform, increasing combat capability by at least 30%, the only flaw being that it made one very ugly, incredibly ugly...
Deployed on humans, this plague wasn’t very effective, but it was perfect for Demons.
He put Emi in charge of the Plague God Position for this day, and it was clear that the results of her research had not disappointed him.
"Good, you can freely experiment with the sixty thousand Demon Army of the abyss. All I need is a powerful army; at any point in time, a powerful army is irreplaceable."
"As you wish," Emi replied respectfully.
Today was definitely a double celebration, with the completion of the Land of Bone-Burying upgrade and Emi’s breakthrough.
Lide’s smile was very warm.
But it seemed the good news for today wasn’t over yet...
After chatting with Emi for a few moments, the space beside him shattered, and Harrison stepped through. The Speaker’s tone was excited.
"Your Majesty, all of the Sea Clan Gods have already arrived and are waiting for you on the fourth floor,"
Lide’s eyes lit up.
Today really was a day of good fortunes.
He hadn’t expected the Sea Clan Gods to act so swiftly; it had only been a week, and they had already found the Water Element Plane... It seemed the Mermaid Main God had long been keeping an eye on the Water Element Plane.
He then asked Emi to continue with his plague experiments, and he followed Harrison back to Dawn City.
On the fourth floor of City Hall, right next to Harrison’s office in the reception room, a total of seven Sea Clan Gods were arranged to be here—the sole reason being that the space here was larger, and Lide’s office could not accommodate them all.
Lide walked into the reception room with Harrison, excitement in his heart. His gaze swept around, and the figures of the seven Sea Clan Gods appeared before him.
Leading them was, of course, the Mermaid Main God, with the remaining six being tall figures respectively: Sea Snake People, Killer Whale Man, Sea Seal Man, Sword Fish People, Lobster Man, and Giant Crab Man.
Of course, they were all Gods, only their original races were these creatures of the sea.
Among them, the Killer Whale Man drew the most attention, standing four blades tall in the five-blade-high hall, he resembled a small mountain, possessing an overwhelming presence.
The other Gods each had their own characteristics, all in line with their respective races.
Upon seeing Lide enter the room, all seven Sea Clan Gods stared at him with variously sized eyes.
Clearly, they were quite curious about the Dawn City Main God with whom they were forming an alliance.
The Mermaid Main God, holding a trident, smiled slightly and was the first to greet him.
"Good day, Kachar Main God.
The Ocean God System has all assembled. From this day forth, we will stand together against the Ancient Cataclysm, sharing life and death..."
Lide laughed heartily, and then his expression became formal.
"Lord Virginia, Dawn City will undoubtedly be your most trustworthy ally. Esteemed Gods of the Sea, on behalf of the Dawn Divine System, I welcome you with the sincerest of attitudes."
Seeing Lide take the initiative to greet them, the other six Sea Clan Gods dropped their formalities, hurriedly returning the gesture with respectful greetings.
There were no arrogant acts of defiance attempting to challenge him...
In the eyes of the Sea Clan Gods, Lide, as the Divine Main God, and one who had earned the trust of their sea-born creator, was certainly worthy of respect.
The rule of Glory, the aura of the mighty, brooks no challenge.
After a bit of polite conversation, the Mermaid Main God didn’t hesitate to start asking Lide about future arrangements.
"Kachar Main God, we have already arranged for our kin within the Water Element Plane, and we will next anchor the spatial coordinates, connecting the Water Element Plane that floats within the Chaos Void to Dawn City."
"What should we do after we’ve done all this?"
In her eyes, as the Sea Clan needed Dawn City, it was necessary for the Sea Clan to demonstrate sufficient value to be taken seriously.
Hearing this, the other Sea Clan Gods also began to ask a myriad of questions.
"Yes, Kachar Main God, as allies, we ought to help each other. Do you have anything that you need our help with?"
"We should stand together against the Ancient Cataclysm, so if there’s anything within our power, please do not hesitate to ask..."
"Kachar Main God, we hope our friendship will last forever. Since Princess Philomis is residing in your city, we will surely do our best to aid you..."
Lide looked at these Sea Clan Gods, almost moved to tears.
What excellent workers, they came knocking at the door all lively and enthusiastic, volunteering themselves with such high spirits.
It would be a real shame not to assign them some work.
Lide’s face revealed a purely innocent smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 482: Light Gods Form Alliance
chapters.content:
Chapter 481: Chapter 482: Light Gods Form Alliance
(Sorry, I have been stuck with writer’s block these days, I intended to take a break, but ended up staying up all night to write a short Chapter, please make do with reading it...)
——
——
——
Lide readily agreed to the demands of these workers.
What a good catch, for them to voluntarily come forward to be free labor, wouldn’t it be too remiss of him not to arrange tasks for these Sea Clan Divine?
Lide felt his soul had ascended at that very moment...
He dropped the pleasantries and started assigning tasks right away.
"Dawn City is our foundation, I’ll also keep a shard of the Destiny Tablet suppressed here, so I need at least two Divine to stay in Dawn City, no matter what, they must not leave!"
Guarding the home is absolutely the most important task—if there aren’t enough strong forces stationed, an outsider could sneak in and steal the crystal without anyone noticing.
Although with Casslynna present, the probability of such incidents is infinitely small, one should never be careless; the God of Murder and the Knight are stark examples of that.
Previously he was without means, but now, along with the Divine at Frey’s disposal, he was up to eight, which allowed him to operate many ideas.
After Lide finished speaking, immediately two Sea Clan Divine responded, accepting the task.
"Besides, not far from Dwarf Valley, there is a sealed Plane of an Ancient Evil God, that sealing plane harbors special mysteries, and Philomis herself had once intervened to seal the Ancient Evil God there.
Right now, I don’t have time to investigate in detail, so I need two people to oversee the Dwarf Valley and monitor any movements of the sealing plane..."
"Additionally, the Abyss Plane needs two Divine to help us expand our territory..."
After the distribution, the duties of the Ocean God System were clear.
And these Sea Clan Divine, instead of resisting, gladly accepted the assignments.
Initially, the Divine wouldn’t act so compliant, but due to Philomis, they were all eager to make an impression in front of her, which led them to be quite submissive to Lide’s orders.
After all, that Highness was the creator of the grand existence of the Sea Clan—should they manage to gain her favor, just a small hint from her might enable them to break through to Powerful Divine Powers...
Directly courting Casslynna was too daunting for them, so they had to look for a roundabout way by focusing on Lide.
Lide didn’t care much about the intricacies; since they had come to him, how could he possibly be polite? He arranged everything perfectly.
However, there was another issue—how should he arrange the Mermaid Main God?
Such a powerful main god, being left idle would be too wasteful, but if he were to arrange a role, he didn’t know where to place her—it seemed inappropriate everywhere. No, his bathtub was still empty... Lide’s mind started to wander.
After thinking it over, although the idea was tempting, at level 28 he was still unable to suppress her—he hated being on the bottom...
"I’m about to make a trip to Nolan Capital, and Frey’s protection means I temporarily do not need the Mermaid Main God’s company, but Green City is located on the outskirts and surrounded by enemies—it’s unknown what could happen.
Having her guard Green City would undoubtedly ensure sufficient safety for this city of millions of inhabitants.
Moreover, the Mermaid Main God wouldn’t need to make a public appearance, she would only need to guard from the shadows."
Lide nodded, confirming the direction of the arrangement.
After he relayed this message to the Mermaid Main God, she agreed promptly without any hesitation.
From the Mermaid Main God’s attitude, it was clear that, like the others, she intended to comply with Lide’s orders to the end.
Lide was in great spirits—I love those with strong obedience, the kind who would handle a whip but not fumble with handcuffs...
But as Lide was settling the roles for several Sea Gods, a Bloodline with an urgent expression hastily knocked on the reception room door.
The high-level message brought by this intel command center changed his expression instantly.
"Your Highness, the Undead Empire has dispatched tens of millions of Undead to conquer far and wide, beginning to expand their territory. According to intelligence, they have already annihilated three locations harboring Ancient Evil God seals.
When the Undead captured those sealed lands, the heavens and earth changed colors, Divine Power surged for miles, seemingly with the Undead Monarch personally intervening..."
"Besides that, numerous Abyss Demons have appeared in various areas of the southern province. These Abyss Demons emerged directly through Torn Space, not smuggling into the Main Plane through a fixed Space Gate.
Furthermore, the sheer number of demons and the broad extent of their involvement is unprecedented.
We theorize that this situation is likely because the Main Plane has been eroded by ancient forces, increasingly severe rule-breaks,
causing cracks in the rules that keep the Abyss separate, allowing Abyss Demons to freely open gates to the Main Plane."
The two sudden pieces of news furrowed Lide’s brow tightly.
Indeed, the situation had worsened further.
And it was foreseeable, in the crisis where the world was about to be destroyed, the Undead and Abyss Demons would certainly emerge in full force.
The most direct consequence was the further shrinking of the already pitifully small living space for the life forms of the Main Plane, resulting in tens of millions of lives dying.
However, the biggest problem now was, how should one respond to this situation?
But this wasn’t the worst of it, the words of the Bloodline relaying the news had not yet ceased.
"This piece of news was just shared with us by the Crimson Moon, on the perimeter of the Ancient Forest, more than ten Ancient Evil Gods are converging.
According to the Crimson Moon’s deduction, the Ancient Evil Gods are showing a trend of banding together and hunting the forces of the Main Plane.
It is estimated that soon, perhaps more than twenty or even thirty Ancient Evil Gods might gather around the outskirts of the Ancient Forest.
These Evil Gods gathered together without conflict, as if restrained by some powerful entities..."
Lide’s heart skipped a beat, and he drew in a cold breath.
The scenario he least wanted to see had occurred—the chaotic Evil Gods, intent on destroying everything, had colluded.
An already dire situation was bound to fall deeper into passivity.
With the Ancient Essence continuously pouring out of the cracks in the sky, the Ancient Evil Gods, having home-field advantage, uniting together would be a devastating blow to the forces of the Main Plane...
"Is there any good news?"
Lide suppressed the palpitations in his heart, noting that the Bloodline who was reporting had not stopped, feeling overwhelmed by the impact.
The high-ranking officer in the intelligence center nodded.
"Your Majesty, according to the latest intelligence, the Sun Goddess has joined forces with the Master of Dawn, the War God, the God of Power and Justice, the Elf God, and the Dwarf God, to form the Angel Alliance, in order to resist the Ancient Invasion!"
Lide’s expression finally eased a bit; this was the most comforting news among a series of bad news.
Not bad, the Light Gods were not stupid enough; once these guys regained their strength, they knew to unite to resist an enemy they could not defeat alone.
Actually, according to Lide’s initial thoughts, a similar alliance should have formed right after the Sun Goddess announced the function of the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
But to only form this alliance under such a deteriorated situation was lamentably inefficient to the point of meriting dismissal or even criminal accountability in Dawn City.
Of course, there were countless suspicions and conflicts among the gods; forming an alliance was already a choice in the face of a looming crisis, otherwise, this alliance could have been indefinitely delayed.
"And what else?"
Hearing Lide’s inquiry, the Bloodline perked up, thought for a moment, and continued to report.
"Your Majesty, immediately upon its formation, the Angel Alliance issued an invitation for the gods to reclaim their positions, aiming to absorb all the scattered Divine into their fold.
They also promised to protect any god that joins the Angel Alliance, to help them regain their power, and to welcome their respective believers."
"In addition to that, the gods of the Angel Alliance will collaborate to build an unprecedented city within the Ancient Forest.
The goal of this city is to relocate their ruled population of tens of millions, perhaps even hundreds of millions, into it."
Lide was startled after hearing this.
Although the Angel Alliance was slow in forming, this idea was undoubtedly bold.
The Light Attribute Gods planned to gather all available manpower and resources to build an unprecedented city, to concentrate their power to counter the Ancient Invasion, and inviting the gods to reclaim their position followed the same logic.
The problem was, although the idea made sense, implementing it would be dauntingly difficult.
However, if the Angel Alliance could successfully absorb the wandering Divine and help them recuperate, then building this city shouldn’t be difficult.
Dozens of Divine, employing Divine Arts, even though unable to create worlds, could still manage to construct a Holy City without much difficulty.
Just these few messages immediately made Lide sense the urgency of the impending storm.
The grand situation was changing.
The gathering Ancient Evil Gods, the assembling Light Gods, the descending Undead, and the Abyss Demons crawling out of the bottomless abyss.
This upcoming storm would be terrifying beyond description...

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 483: Spark Breaks Through to Legendary Level to Slap Lide’s Face (Thanks to Xiao Huoban Zhang Ruoxing’s Alliance Hierarch Reward)
chapters.content:
Chapter 482: Chapter 483: Spark Breaks Through to Legendary Level to Slap Lide’s Face (Thanks to Xiao Huoban Zhang Ruoxing’s Alliance Hierarch Reward)
After receiving these crucial pieces of information, Lide did not call anyone else to discuss them.
Instead, he silently gestured for everyone in the room to leave.
Once the room was empty, he walked over to the window and looked up at the sky, which no longer bore traces of ancient times but still showed cracks.
His dark eyes were as deep as a starry sky.
He began to seriously ponder the impact of these sudden events on Dawn City.
It was undeniable that the situation had deteriorated to an extreme; one misstep and Dawn City could easily fall into jeopardy.
The formation of the Angel Alliance shattered his earlier plans to hunt Divine Beings to strengthen Dawn City.
Six Powerful Divine Power Main Gods forming the Angel Alliance, calling other Divine Beings to join, held an undeniable allure for those Divine Beings still recovering their strength.
Eventually, scattered Divine Beings would surely gather, turning the Angel Alliance instantly into a colossal entity.
The upcoming wars would shift from scattered individual disputes to conflicts between major factions.
Without warfare, peace remains; but once war begins, it would surely shake the heavens.
The Angel Alliance and the Ancient Evil God, these two factions in direct opposition, may well witness a spectacle of dozens of Divine Beings slaughtering each other.
Once the situation of groups forming emerges, it will dramatically increase the difficulty for Dawn City to gain any benefits.
Moreover, there was the horrifying Life-filled Abyss, and the Undead Plane with its fifteen Undead Monarchs.
These events catching Lide unprepared truly struck him.
"No matter how dire the situation becomes, my focus can’t change—I must strengthen myself!"
"Currently, the Destiny Tablet fragments are still my primary target, and I cannot waver on this.
I can sense an extremely subtle change in my soul after it has been imbued with the Power of Destiny, but this change is not significant enough due to insufficient Power of Destiny..."
"It seems, my chance to ascend as a Divine is inseparably linked to the fragments of the Destiny Tablet..."
After pondering deeply for a long time, Lide’s gaze gradually cleared, and his thoughts returned to normal.
Regardless of the situation, the most crucial step now is to collect the fragments of the Destiny Tablet and then step into the realm of the Divine.
Powerful strength is the best way to cope with crises, without exception.
If he reached the heights of a Creation God, any damn crisis could be shattered with one strike.
With his thoughts organized, Lide made a decision.
He immediately called Harrison, his right-hand man, and shared his plans with him.
"Harrison, the situation we face has undergone tremendous changes and the original plans need to be adjusted immediately.
To preserve ourselves in such chaos, or even to gain more from it, won’t be easy.
The greatest danger to us is undoubtedly the Ancient Evil God; he will be our eternal archenemy.
But another factor cannot be underestimated—the Angel Alliance, a symbol of light.
Individuals can be selfless, but a group formed by individuals will inevitably be selfish and difficult to control.
After the Angel Alliance gains strength, if they detect traces of Dawn City, what do you think will happen?"
Harrison’s pupils contracted sharply at Lide’s words, but Lide did not wait for him to speak and continued.
"Make no mistake, it would be our nightmare.
When the strength of two sides is not equal, the weaker side has no say.
Thus, if Dawn City faces hostility from the Angel Alliance and our strength is not substantially improved, the downfall of Dawn City doesn’t need to be stated—it would likely be destroyed.
It might be slightly better than facing the Ancient Evil God, but not by much.
So, you need to have a clear understanding that while our greatest enemy is the Ancient Evil God, the Angel Alliance, representing the light, will be our second threat.
We now need to prepare for these threats in advance."
Lide’s expression was solemn.
For the Main Plane, the establishment of the Angel Alliance was undoubtedly a good thing, but it might not be for Dawn City.
If after its establishment, the Angel Alliance doesn’t think of confronting the Ancient Evil God directly but instead aims to sweep across the Main Plane with dozens of Divine Beings, amassing forces to fight later, what should Dawn City do then?
Should it just allow its painstakingly cultivated power to be snatched away?
Harrison’s expression also grew very grave.
"Your Highness, this matter relates to the future developmental direction of Dawn City, and we must face it with prudence. I will immediately arrange for the Think Tank to research countermeasures..."
Lide’s deep gaze fixed on Harrison, his stern expression softening slightly.
"Harrison, there’s no need to worry too much, with Katarina and the Ocean God System, we already have some power to protect ourselves."
He aimed to remind Harrison to be cautious, not to diminish their morale.
However, he would not place all his hopes on others, preferring to control the situation himself.
"I’m about to make a trip to Nolan Capital, and the return date is uncertain. Be very careful in your actions during this period. If you encounter a crisis that can’t be resolved, you can look for Katarina..."
Dawn City had a strong supporter; it would be a waste not to rely on it...
In Lide’s plans, Katarina would also become a significant force for Dawn City in the future.
However, for now, he had no means to directly command this impressively descended half-mermaid...
"Yes, Your Highness."
After a brief exchange, Lide asked Harrison to step down, and he then went to the backyard of the City Hall, mounting Castro and heading to Nolan Capital.
