Naturally, there were also many handsome men with pale faces wearing simple clothes, their chests and abdomens exposed, for high-class ladies to choose from.
It was said that lost-world adventurers particularly crowded into this profession until eventually, a work permit was mandatory to practice it.
This left many adventurers from the Lost Plane indignant, "This is pure racial discrimination; we must resist this unfair world and allow everyone the opportunity to work and let the light of righteousness shine on the main road... "
The gathering of these nobles at Nightingale Street did not attract much attention.
As nobles, if they gathered massively in a secluded area, they would inevitably provoke the vigilance of the Guard Army.
However, if they all went to a red-light district for a gathering, even the most vigilant spy would only pass by with envy and a sneer, "Group physical activity... Such decadent nobles."
Nightingale Street’s most luxurious brothel was brightly lit after dark, and by then, the largest room had been rented out by the nobles.
The first and third floors of this room were no different from any other brothel, with people drinking with the opposite sex.
Only the second floor lacked the expected pleasure-seeking scene; at this moment, the atmosphere inside was exceptionally serious.
Dozens of nobles sat together, their expressions solemn as they murmured something to each other.
Outside, their subordinates played with maids, and from time to time, playful giggles could be heard.
Anyone with clear sight would recognize that these nobles were using the brothel as cover to discuss some covert matters.
Once it was confirmed that all the nobles had arrived, an old noble in his early fifties with a defiant face stood up from the main seat, his eyes sweeping the room with a cold glint, and he spoke in a deep voice.
"Gentlemen, you should know why I’ve called you here today!"
The surrounding people immediately fell silent, each gazing directly at him.
The middle-aged noble snorted coldly and then shouted angrily,
"Duke O’Kelly has betrayed us!"
"Do you know what damned policy City Hall introduced today? Don’t know? Well, let me tell you...
As of today, Green City will abolish noble privileges and implement a points system; all people will enjoy respective levels of power based on their points.
And we, the nobles, will no longer hold any privileges!"
These words made the breathing of the nobles below immediately more rapid, with many eyes flashing with resentment.
Isn’t the very definition of a noble to possess powers above others?
Now that this power had been stripped away, what difference was left between them and others?
Seeing the rage arising on the faces of the nobles below, the middle-aged noble’s voice grew louder.
"Once this damned policy is implemented, we will never have a chance to turn over a new leaf!"
"We of elegance and nobility are to be seen as equals with those lowly, filthy commoners of Green City! Moreover, if their points exceed mine, their power will even rise above ours!!"
"That damned Fake God, after seizing our city, not only failed to protect our wealth but continually introduced various policies to exploit us!
This is absolutely unforgivable!!"
"We are nobles, the true masters of Green City, why should we be oppressed by a Fake God??"
"If this continues, it won’t be long before our noble status becomes a joke.
By then, that damned bastard will continue to oppress us, will seize our wealth, occupy our estates, and even take our women into his chambers!!"
Upon hearing this, the anger of the nobles in the room surged anew.
Many nobles were indignantly enraged, wishing they could stab those responsible for the policy,
but some nobles felt fearful within, filled with pessimism about the future.
After Lide had taken over Green City, while it was certainly a great thing for the common people, for the nobles who had the largest share of the benefits, it marked a painful beginning that was hard to describe.
Because all of Lide’s policies were in favor of the common people, they clearly knew that the nobles had been abandoned.
Their privileges were being stripped away, one by one, their interests eroded bit by bit; they had endured it so far, as they were still nobles and still possessed wealth and power unimaginable to commoners.
But today, the points policy introduced by City Hall had completely crushed them.
Because the first item of the points policy stated—henceforth, nobles will no longer enjoy any special privileges, everyone’s power will be determined by the number of their points.
This was absolutely intolerable to the nobles!
The very reason they are called nobles is because of various privileges that showcased their status.
Without those privileges, what use was the title of nobility? Was it just for show??
This evening’s gathering was their unwillingness to concede and their act of rebellion!
A silver-haired old noble stood up at this moment, his face burning with anger, and shouted loudly,
"That’s right! What Marquis O’Kelly said is absolutely true!!
We high-level nobiles of Green City cannot continue to endure quietly.
The glory of the nobles has dimmed, we must oppose the oppression of the Dawn Sect, oppose evil and darkness!!
We need to bring nobility back into the light, we are the true masters of this entire city!"
Originally still furious, the nobles quieted down as if someone had choked them, and an eerie atmosphere descended in the room.
They were unwilling and angry, indeed wanting to rise up and reclaim their power.
But, the mention of the Dawn Sect by the old noble sent chills down their spines.
The God of Nobles was slain before everyone’s eyes by Lord Ilo, and the God of Plague, who dominated Risier City, had his head chopped off by a subordinate of Lord Ilo as well.
Lord Ilo was too powerful, much like an ancient dragon overlooking them from the skies.
Even with all their dissatisfaction and unwillingness, in the face of such dragonpower, they could only tremble.
"Resist? With what shall we resist? Do we have the power to oppose that Fake God?!"
A young noble with a flushed face stood up, loudly questioning.
The only way to break the City Hall’s policy, to regain control of Green City, was to find a way to oppose Lord Ilo—the current true ruler of Green City.
The Marquis, sitting in the main seat with a cold gaze, scanned the crowd, revealing a ferocious smile.
"If, we have enough power to kill that damned Fake God,
would you, collaborate with us?"
At this,
the nobles in the room were all stunned, but seeing the Marquis’ confident expression, their hearts stirred.
If he wasn’t sure, he probably wouldn’t have summoned them here to discuss things.
So to speak, was there really a way to take back Green City from that damned Fake God?
Suddenly, everyone became excited.
"Marquis O’Li, please tell us what means you have to kill that Fake God! I have had enough of everything as it is!!"
"If we can kill that Fake God and take back Green City, I am willing to cooperate with all your actions!"
"Lord Marquis, Green City belongs to us nobles! Not that damned Fake God!"
"..."
The crowd was stirred up.
The nobles invited here were all meticulously selected, most of these nobles have suffered huge losses due to the policies of City Hall.
For example, nobles who monopolized food, salt, and steel because the related industries were all reclaimed by Green City and forbidden to be operated by outsiders, so their losses were the most severe.
These nobles had survived for hundreds of years by monopolizing these industries, and a single decree from City Hall deprived them of their wealth, how can they bear it?
Of course, there were also some nobles in the room with calmer expressions, who did not believe in what the Marquis said about someone being able to confront Lord Ilo. How could such a powerful Lord possibly be schemed against by a group of mortals?
Although Lord Ilo had caused them great harm, the prestige he brought by slaying gods could not be eroded by merely shouting "Fake God."
But no matter what these nobles’ mindsets were, everyone’s heart was more or less dissatisfied with the current regime.
They wanted to restore the rule of the nobility, restore the authority of the past, restore their noble status.
Rather than being suppressed everywhere like now.
Seeing the agitated crowd below, the Marquis standing at the forefront was very satisfied. After waiting for a moment, when the crowd’s emotions reached their peak, his tone became icy.
"To kill the Fake God, we can only rely on a true Divine!"
The crowd was momentarily stunned, but before they could react, the secret door opposite the main seat abruptly opened.
The sound of the door opening attracted everyone’s attention, and they all turned to look at the door, which let no light seep through.
It was like a Evil Dragon opening its huge maw waiting to devour its prey.
Dense darkness of the secret door resounded with the echoes of footsteps, as if someone was walking in a spacious cave.
Moments later, two sturdy figures slowly stepped forward and appeared before all the nobles.
As the light shone down, the identities of the newcomers became clear, prompting an involuntary exclamation from some nobles.
"Viscount Bernard!"
Whoosh~ instantaneously, a heated discussion ensued.
"Viscount Bernard, the former chairman of the Dark Contract!!"
"The one behind him, is that... Roy, the Eight-Armed Snake Demon?!"
"How could it be them?? Didn’t they steal Lord Rock’s Divine Artifact and flee years ago??"
"It seems, after Viscount Bernard left Green City with the stolen Divine Artifact, Lord Ilo then took over the Dark Contract..."
"Are they the trump cards that Lord Marquis is using to counter Lord Ilo?"
Viscount Bernard, as the founder of the Dark Contract, had lived in Green City for several decades, and many nobles had collaborated with him in the past.
So even though he had disappeared for a few years, he was recognized instantly.
The Dark Contract is an inevitable part of Lide’s rise, and one might even say that Dawn City rose only after incorporating the Dark Contract.
Bone Dragon Withered Bone, Child of the North Grot, former Evil God believers Stanley, these three major generals who had contributed significantly to Dawn City were all members of the Dark Contract.
No, in addition to them, there was also the blasphemer Emi; these four all from the Dark Contract were the top battle force that supported Dawn City in the early days.
After several years, Viscount Bernard, who had stolen the Divine Artifact—a scroll from the Twelve Magic Scrolls—had appeared once again.
Dressed in a black tailcoat, looking like an elegant gentleman, Viscount Bernard, hearing the crowd’s discussion, wore a standard noble smile on his face.
In a gentle tone, as if greeting a friend,
"Ladies and gentlemen, long time no see."
"I heard that someone has stolen my Dark Contract, so I’ve come specially to assist you and hang that thief..."
Upon hearing these words, many nobles shook their heads in disappointment.
Although, Viscount Bernard was no small figure, how powerful was Lord Ilo?
Was it even possible for a mere Viscount Bernard to rebel against such a force? Wasn’t that a mere fantasy?
Seeming to sense the distrust among the nobles, Viscount Bernard revealed a gentle smile and spoke calmly.
"My lord, the ruler of the first level of Hell, a Level 35 Devil Lord—Perol, sends his regards to you, friends of Green City..."
As his words fell, an indescribable aura of evil emanated from Viscount Bernard.
In a few blinks, that evil aura coalesced into a phantom devil with wings on its back and a long whip in hand.
Its terrifying divine power surged at everyone’s hearts.
"Viscount Bernard is my envoy, and his words represent my will.
Humble human nobles, obey my command, and you shall receive endless benefits."
After speaking, blood-red eyes swept around the room, and the divine power climbed even higher.
Not until no one dared to look up did the devil phantom nod in satisfaction and then vanished with a pop.
After the phantom shattered,
the room burst into an uproar.
One stone stirred a thousand ripples.
The ruler of the first level of Hell?
A Level 35 Devil Lord?
They had witnessed such a terrifying presence.
As the nobles in the room looked at the elegant Viscount Bernard, they only felt a chill running down their spines.
In their eyes, a divinity of Level 31 with weak divine power was already an extraordinary and eminent figure.
How formidable was a Level 35 Devil Lord!
Regarding divine power levels, Level 31 had weak divine power, Levels 32 to 34 had lower divine power, Levels 35 to 39 had medium divine power, and Level 40 and above had powerful divine power.
The gap between each level was far too great to simply describe.
Thus, to the nobles in the room, a Devil Lord of Level 35 with medium divine power was absolutely a godlike figure.
Everyone could assert that Lord Ilo, no matter how strong, could not possibly be as strong as a Devil Lord of Hell!
That was, after all, a Devil Lord of myth and legend.
Many nobles’s faces showed wild joy.
If they could truly gain the help of the first level Hell Lord, they could definitely kill that Fake God who stripped them of their power and restore the nobles’ glory!
As for cooperating with a devil? Bah, Lord Ilo was already sending them to the guillotine; did they even have a choice?
And wouldn’t it be safer to have the much more powerful Devil Lord protect Green City?
They certainly didn’t wish to lose their exalted privileges and be equal to those disgusting, filthy, lowly commoners.
They were the true masters of this city!
That damned Lord Ilo was a thief, a robber, a burglar; he had stolen their authority, and this was absolutely intolerable!
"Praise be to you, Viscount Bernard! You truly are our nobles’ savior!"
"If you could get the great Hell Lord to eliminate that Fake God, I am willing to support your plans..."
"The Fake God does not deserve to occupy a high position; we nobles are the rightful rulers of this city. Viscount Bernard, if we can reclaim Green City, we are willing to honor you as the City Lord!"
Watching the change in attitude among the nobles in the room, the elegant Viscount Bernard smiled broadly, his demeanor still graceful and filled with noble poise.
"My friends, having heard your complaints, I am aware of the unbearable things that Fake God has done to this city.
Lord Perol would be most pleased to nail that Fake God onto the walls of Green City."
"Trust me, even a Fake God who has stolen divine power can only reach level 31 at most, and even if they attain Weak Divine Power, they can only tremble under the awe of Lord Perol."
At this moment, a corpulent noble with a protruding belly stood up, his face marked with caution and a hint of hesitation as he asked.
"Respected Viscount Bernard, I want to know, what price must we pay to kill the Fake God and reclaim Green City?"
The room, previously buzzing with lively discussion, instantly fell silent, all eyes turning to Viscount Bernard.
Making a deal with the Devil always comes with a price, one that cannot be described in ordinary terms.
However, everyone present was a noble, and they had a much higher tolerance for such matters, so no one raised any objections.
Viscount Bernard smiled elegantly.
"The price? I need... one million fresh souls."
There was a collective sharp intake of breath.
One million fresh souls? That meant over a million people would die.
Before the days of old, Green City only had a little over a million inhabitants.
How was this any different from slaughtering the entire city?
Yet, some nobles were completely indifferent.
"Those filthy commoners are already overcrowding Green City, we don’t need to sustain so many..."
"Yes, those lowly beggars don’t deserve to live with me."
"Ha, I wish I could kill two million!"
Viscount Bernard’s smile grew thicker upon hearing this.
Over a million fresh souls, what immense power that would provide, his master would be pleased...
And once Lord Ilo was killed, one million souls would just be the beginning.
Even if it was two million or three million afterward, would these nobles dare to refuse?
Making a deal with the Devil... how naïve, or perhaps these greedy nobles no longer cared about the price for their own power?
He would only have to sacrifice these fresh souls and he would surely be rewarded by his master...
In fact, infiltrating Green City to form the Dark Contract had been to hunt for fresh souls, but back then the old days had not yet come, and with Transcendents in place, he couldn’t make big moves.
Perol is the ruler of the first level of Hell, and besides him, there are nine other powerful Devil Lords.
Hell has nine layers, each ruled by a master. The deeper one descends, the stronger they get, and the most powerful being is the Lord of the Nine Prisons—Asmodiers.
The Lord of the Nine Prisons is the ultimate dark boss, second only to the Life Goddess and the Death God.
His combat power is unparalleled in Glory, matched by none except the Life Goddess and the Death God.
He is the closest existence to the combat power ceiling of this world, highly respected among the gods.
Even the Sun Goddess, the War God, and the God of Power and Justice, gods with Powerful Divine Power, pale in comparison before the Lord of the Nine Prisons.
Although Viscount Bernard’s master is not the Lord of the Nine Prisons, the Devil Lord Perol of the first layer of Hell is powerful enough.
At least, in the eyes of the nobles within the room and Viscount Bernard, conquering Green City and slaying Lord Ilo, a name unheard of before the old days, was no problem at all.
Killing Lord Ilo and occupying Green City was merely the first step of Hell’s invasion of the Main Plane.
Once he conquered the city, he would perform a Blood Sacrifice of a million people; his master Perol promised that if he could complete the Blood Sacrifice, he would help him break through the Demigod boundary and reach level 31 with Weak Divine Power!
Viscount Bernard was very confident about this.
The future was in his hands!
Lord Ilo, are you ready to savor the taste of death?
—
—
—
Underworld, muddy swamps.
Infinite Dragon Power surged from the depths of the swamp, raging like a category 18 storm.
Zzzap~
In a vast mud pit, a huge black dragon with a wingspan of 30 blades and sharp, barbed horns emerged, flinging mud all around as it took flight.
The giant dragon soared in the sky.
The terrifying Dragon Power made all life within a hundred miles tremble as if facing a natural disaster, an overwhelming presence from a higher plane of existence, granting no reprieve to any life form.
What was even more shocking was that each of the Black Dragon’s scales bore twisted Hell inscriptions, and the aura it emitted had already stepped into the Divine realm.
Elevating the perspective, one could see a magic scroll emitting an evil aura above the Black Dragon’s head, embedding tightly into its flesh and scales, as if it had grown from the dragon itself.
Divine Artifact—Twelve Magic Scrolls.
There are twelve scrolls in total, but no one knows the power each scroll holds.
The Black Dragon had once snatched a Magic Scroll from the hands of goblins, while Lide carried two fragments of Divine Artifacts in his bosom.
Dawn City had spent a great deal in search of this Black Dragon but had never found any trace of it.
At this moment, the Black Dragon hidden in the poisonous mud daringly emerged.
Yet, no one knew what kind of terrifying life this Divine-realm-stepping creature had gained from the Divine Artifact...
But at this moment, judging from the aura it emitted, this Black Dragon was terrifying to the extreme.
"I am Death..."
"I am Destruction..."
"I am Slaughter..."
The Ancient Dragon language carried boundless oppressive power, crashing down and intensifying the fear of the trembling lives around.
"My Lord has bestowed me with power!"
"Slaughter, Death, Blood..."
"To destroy this corrupt world, only the Nine Prisons are eternal!!"
Whoosh~
The terrifying Black Dragon spread its black wings and flew out of the swamp, heading towards what was once Black Iron Castle, now known as Dark City.
—
—
—
Kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill!
Everyone must die!!
Destroy everything!!!
"I Love a Stick" was currently consumed by these chaotic thoughts.
As a top player, his favorite activity was to explore the strange and glorious places.
Recently, he had received news of a plane emitting the decay of ancient times located in a barren wasteland, sparking an insatiable desire in him to explore.
From the messages on the forum, "I Love a Stick" deduced that this place must be a terrifying location sealed with an Evil God.
Although the Ancient Evil God was extremely terrifying, this only piqued his interest, for as a player who could resurrect, his bravery was beyond conventional reasoning.
After making some preparations, he ventured alone into the barren wasteland...
To go on this adventure, "I Love a Stick" had specifically switched to the Thief profession and had fortuitously acquired a Legendary Level skill in a ruin that allowed him to completely conceal his form and aura. Additionally, during other adventures, he obtained a pair of enchanted wings that enabled flight.
This complete set of exploration equipment and skills filled him with confidence.
But everything changed after they stepped into that bizarre Plane.
I Love a Stick was startled.
In that Plane, ancient monsters densely covered the land like locusts.
And at that moment, these ancient creatures were all kneeling in one direction, seemingly praying to some unfathomable horrific existence.
The sight of those ancient creatures, with their white swollen, soft rotting bodies, made his scalp tingle and his stomach churn.
But ultimately, his curiosity overcame his physiological and psychological discomfort, and he began to explore deeper into this sealed Plane.
One day, two days...Finally, on the fifth day, after encountering countless life-threatening dangers, he fortuitously reached the depths of the Plane.
However, rather than finding the treasure he sought in the depths of the sealed Plane, he encountered a terrifying and mysterious existence.
It was a bizarre life form, slumbering in a deep pit, looking like an octopus magnified millions of times.
It had a body as large as mountains, tentacles thousands of blades long, each with innumerable eyes, big and small.
It was an evil and strangeness that was indescribable; even battle-hardened veterans would be stunned and driven mad by such a sight.
The aura it emitted seemed like the ultimate evil of this world, decayed and dark, penetratingly sinister.
At first glance of this slumbering bizarre life form, at the closed eyes upon those tentacles, I Love a Stick became lost.
In his ears rang countless evil curses of life, as if hundreds of thousands were chanting some heretical forbidden curses in unison.
His body involuntarily moved forward, step by step towards the abyss...
In a trance, he saw a stele, an ancient stele that seemed to seal some detestable entity beneath it, covered densely with ancient runes.
He did not know where the strength came from, but in his daze, he pushed over the sealing stele...
The moment the stele fell, he only felt a burst of Chaos Light shooting into the sky.
The bizarre life form in the pit suddenly opened countless eyes on its tentacles.
When he saw that life form, which should not exist in this world, he fainted.
When he woke up again, his consciousness was dominated and controlled by destructive and chaotic thoughts, seemingly wanting to turn him into that disordered, chaotic life form...
He could only forcibly resist that pull with his willpower.
Killing, I crave killing.
No, I do not crave it, I crave Teacher Xiao Ze...
Death, I crave death.
No, I have not finished watching the movies on my D drive, I absolutely cannot fall here...
Destruction, I want to destroy everything.
No, the black stockings from last night’s Miss are still at my place, they should at least be worn before they get ruined...
With a strong will to survive, I Love a Stick barely maintained some lucidity amid the chaotic thoughts.
In his mind, images of Teacher Xiao Ze on a plane, in a car, in a classroom appeared, then a scene where he punched someone’s head, splattering brain matter.
At last, with the aid of dozens of teachers rallying together, I Love a Stick regained consciousness.
But after waking from those chaotic and disordered thoughts, he sadly discovered that he could no longer control his body...
It was as if he was bound by ropes, unable to break free no matter how much he struggled.
Finally, with the tenacious will not to leave the teachers on his hard drive alone, I Love a Stick once again detached his consciousness, isolating it.
Only after his consciousness had been isolated did he suddenly realize that a bizarre soul, composed of countless entangled consciousness bodies, had appeared in his Spiritual Sea.
This consciousness body was the source of the chaos.
At this moment, he became a bystander inside his own body.
But it was not until this moment that he was horrified to discover.
He was no longer inside his body...
He had now become a part of that evil creature with an octopus-like body...
I Love a Stick fell into extreme terror.
Just after he had been tricked into breaking the seal, the octopus-shaped heretical abomination devoured him, but after his body died, his consciousness inexplicably did not revive; instead, it became a part of this heretical beast.
Gathering his wits, I Love a Stick began to slowly sense his surroundings through the eyes scattered all over his body.
Moments later, images came to him, and he fell into extreme shock.
Under his perception, he saw an abominable creature, thousands of blades tall with tentacles thousands of blades long, rampaging across the earth.
Wherever this Ancient Evil God went, the land crumbled and broke, mountains collapsed, and plants were crushed into the rock layers...
The horrific scene was like the apocalypse had arrived.
This abominable creature was him... he had become the Ancient Evil God!
"I curse you, grandpa... I’ve turned into the Ancient Evil God?? No, I’ve become a part of the Ancient Evil God??"
I Love a Stick was in agony.
"My elves, my cat-girl, my Enchanting Demon... I don’t want to live anymore, I’ve turned into a tentacle monster...
Wait, a tentacle monster? Hmm... according to the movies I’ve seen, this could actually be quite interesting.
Pah, I’m not that kind of person, I’m just critiquing the evil and darkness of this world with a critical eye."
Moments later, I Love a Stick was again in tears. If he was going to be a tentacle monster, at least he wouldn’t have to worry about forming a harem later.
But the problem was that now he only had a single thought left; even if Diao Chan was at his waist, it was useless... he simply could not control this terrifying Divine Body.
Moreover, whenever he approached the massive energy body formed by countless consciousnesses, he would be corroded by disorder and chaos.
If he forced it, he was more likely to lose control of his body and instead become part of those chaotic entities.
Roar~
In I Love a Stick’s perception, this Ancient Evil God was rampaging around, destroying everything.
Tentacles thousands of blades long, like iron chains, hammered on the ground, instantly shattering the wilderness, forming cracks dozens or even hundreds of blades deep.
No one could fathom the terrifying destructive power of an Ancient Evil God thousands of blades in size.
I Love a Stick watched the scenes unfold outside, his mind wavering.
Even though he had lost his original body, possessing such power didn’t seem like such a bad thing... Unfortunately, he was unable to control this mighty Divine Body.
Thinking this, he felt even more resentful.
Moments later, I Love a Stick shivered with realization as he noticed four other Ancient Evil Gods in the distance, slightly smaller in size.
But what gave him a slight sense of pride was that he was the boss among these octopus-like creatures covered with eyes and tentacles; his size was a notch above everyone else.
The Ancient Evil God that he embodied started roaring at the sight of the other abominable creatures, the language of Extreme Evil filled with resentment and decay, making it profoundly unsettling.
I Love a Stick could not understand the words, but he could somewhat sense their meaning from the chaotic consciousness around him.
It seemed that these Ancient Evil Gods had detected the presence of something, and they were on a quest to find it...
Unfortunately, the consciousness of the Ancient Evil God, being an amalgam of countless chaotic thoughts, was too disordered to convey precise intents, so I Love a Stick could not discern more.
After the discussion, all five Ancient Evil Gods started moving in one direction.
One Ancient Evil God was already terrifying enough; five together could practically destroy the heavens and the earth.
Anything in their path, even towering mountains, would be flattened.
Such beings of destruction could not have originated from the Main Plane; they were gods and demons of world destruction.
I Love a Stick could only feel awe and shock within the Spiritual Sea, perfectly playing the role of an onlooker.
Having destroyed hundreds of kilometers of land, I Love a Stick saw a valley shrouded in mist; no, from the perspective of the Ancient Evil God, this valley looked more like a small pit...
To his surprise, there were still people guarding the city walls there, and even when faced with the attack of the Ancient Evil God, they did not scatter but instead dared to fight back.
It seemed that this was the purpose of these Ancient Evil Gods, and after arriving here, the horrific octopus body paused, its tentacles thousands of blades long began to attack that valley...

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - 491: I Can Actually Battle Against Lord Ilo? This is Worth Boasting About for a Lifetime (8800)
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Chapter 491: I Can Actually Battle Against Lord Ilo? This is Worth Boasting About for a Lifetime (8800)
Huff, huff~
The fierce wind whipped with ice and snow, stinging the face sharply.
Castro’s speed soared to the extreme, a steel beast flapping its Blade Wings rushed through the vast white snow, leaving only a vague silhouette...
Upon receiving the sealed letter, Lide promptly made arrangements before leaving the Nolan Capital, driving Castro straight back to the southern provinces.
Although this visit to the capital was hasty both in arrival and departure, the gains were undeniably substantial.
The primary target—the fragment of the Destiny Tablet—had already been secured.
Moreover, the population of millions in the capital was an indescribable treasure, eagerly awaiting his relocation.
Of course, there were costs paid.
The Master of Dawn, that fool, had grown to hate him, a peace-loving pure-hearted man.
And the hatred between them had just begun to thaw...
Was it just because his men switched allegiance to me, because I got the Destiny Tablet fragment first, and because Nolan Capital now belonged to me? Was there really a need to be so petty?
Unlike me, I didn’t complain about any of these issues, willing to bear such burdens...
Lide grumbled resentfully about the decline in people’s integrity.
It was foreseeable that once the Master of Dawn regained his strength, he would definitely come to cause trouble for him.
Especially since that bastard was always eying Frey, who was his intended mount... utterly shameless.
This trip to the capital had its gains and losses, but, in reality, there was nothing truly lost.
From the Master of Dawn’s perspective, due to Frey, the two were naturally enemies, with no room for easing tensions.
Unless that fool ceased coveting his mount, willing to endure the loss of a Twelve-winged Blazing Angel.
But knowing the pride of the Master of Dawn, he would likely not give up on Frey.
The reason he negotiated so calmly in the capital was simply because his strength hadn’t yet returned to its peak, and he was not confident enough to defeat Lide.
Once he returned to a Powerful Divine Power Level, he would definitely seek out Lide at the first opportunity.
Thinking of this gave Lide a headache.
Ideally, it would be best to eliminate this threat during their conflict, but since the opponent was a main god of Powerful Divine Power Level with countless trump cards, defeating him was difficult enough, let alone killing him.
Shaking his head, Lide decided not to think about the Master of Dawn for now. When the time came, he’d face it—be it armies blocking his path or earth covering water. If annoyed, he’d just bring out Cassalina, this terrifying mixed-breed mermaid, even the Master of Dawn would have to call him "daddy."
Now, the most urgent matter was dealing with the Ancient Evil God in Dwarf Valley.
That Sealed Land indeed matched his prior conjecture, harboring not just one Ancient Evil God.
Fortunately, he had the foresight to dispatch two gods from the Ocean God System to guard it, otherwise those Ancient Evil Gods might have instantly devastated Dwarf Valley.
The stationed army likely wouldn’t have been spared.
"The sealed letter stated that the Ancient Evil Gods breaking the seals seemed to have sensed the aura of the Destiny Tablet fragments, continuously heading toward Dawn City.
Several Sea Clan Gods are strenuously resisting them, but these Ancient Evil Gods are extremely strange and cannot be killed, thus the battle continues arduously..."
"Does this unusual activity of the Ancient Evil Gods relate to me being discovered by the ancient ruler in the River of Destiny?"
"The more Power of Destiny I control, it’s like the moon in the night sky becoming brighter, inviting enmity from the Ancient Evil Gods.
Cassalina’s words were indeed true, I still stand out so strikingly, shining brightly..."
"This attack might just be the beginning. As long as I continue to collect fragments of the Destiny Tablet, Dawn City will inevitably face even harsher challenges."
"When that time comes, even the seven gods of the Ocean God System might not be enough.
I need more powerful subordinates, greater power!"
Lide’s brow furrowed.
The situation in Dawn City seemed fine for now, but undercurrents were swirling.
Whether it was the Angel Alliance or the pressure from the Ancient Sovereigns after controlling the Power of Destiny, it weighed heavily on him.
"Currently, there are only two paths, either survive and later host an Unrestricted Conference as a high noble in a feudal society,
or die, and everyone goes down together..."
After complaining for a bit, Lide slowly collected his thoughts and shifted his attention to the fragment of the Destiny Tablet in his hand, finally finding time to check its attributes.
He opened the attribute panel.
Destiny Tablet Fragment (Sequence: 15)
Quality: Creation God Artifact
Properties: Contains the power of destiny, once activated, the rules within a 100-kilometer radius will return to normal.
Rule Twisting: Activating the fragment can twist the surrounding rules, has a forcible purification effect on powers not belonging to Glory World, and can erase the Ancient Chaos power within a certain range.
Introduction: This is the 15th fragment of the Destiny Tablet, possessing unimaginable power. The complete Destiny Tablet held the fate of the entire Multi-dimensional Plane, but now it has been destroyed by an indescribable Ancient Sovereign, and the destiny of Glory World has long been shattered. Whoever collects the fragments and reassembles the Destiny Tablet will receive the favor of destiny and harness the power of the entire Multi-dimensional Plane.
After reading the attributes, Lide emitted a slight gasp; the sequence number of this fragment of the Destiny Tablet was indeed higher than the one in Dawn City.
Moreover, besides the ability to restore a 100-kilometer radius, it had an additional effect—Rule Twisting.
According to the introduction, it specifically targeted Ancient powers.
And unlike another property, this feature could be actively deployed.
That meant he could completely use it as a weapon when carrying it on his person.
Satisfied, he nodded; the Destiny Tablet fragment was the ticket to this survival game called The Arrival of the Ancient Era. The more he acquired, the more secure his future would be.
After confirming there were no errors or omissions, Lide closed the attribute panel and began to deeply sense his own body.
Moments later, a smile appeared on his face.
After absorbing the power of this Destiny Tablet fragment, the Power of Destiny within him had become significantly denser, at least doubling since before.
However, the only downside was that although he now possessed the Power of Destiny, he still could not use it freely.
The Power of Destiny was very similar to the Power of Faith that he had come into contact with at around Level 10, a rather high-level power.
He could only use the Power of Destiny very superficially to envelop himself and conceal his aura.
But this concealment was much stronger than the Power of Faith; it blurred his very essence, even allowing his whole body to physically disappear without a trace, more exaggerated than the Ghost Cloak he had obtained from the War God and the God of Murder that could turn someone into nothingness.
Sadly, this could only be considered a minor feature and wasn’t very effective in Divine Level battles.
To fully control the Power of Destiny, he feared he would have to reach the Divine Realm.
In contemplation, Castro fast approached the southern province.
A distance of tens of thousands of kilometers, at three times the speed of sound, only took just over three Sunshine Hours to traverse.
During this flight, Lide sensed the presence of various Divinities, including those from the Main Plane, Ancient Evil Gods, Demon Sovereigns, and even Hell’s Devil Lords...
From this glimpse, it was evident just how chaotic the Main Plane had become.
However, he had no intention of investigating these Divinities as his own backyard was on fire, leaving no time to manage such affairs.
The Sealed Land was only a thousand kilometers away from Dawn City; should the enemy break through the defense of the Sea Clan Gods, they would definitely assault Dawn City, which held down the Destiny Tablet fragment without hesitation.
Had it been before, his worries might not have been as pervasive.
But having witnessed the scene of the Ancient Sovereigns crushing the River of Destiny, he profoundly realized just how keen the Ancient Evil God’s perception was towards the Power of Destiny.
He could not be careless.
Huff, huff~
Castro soared over Green City, the vast city coming into view, but Lide did not linger, barely glancing at it before moving his attention away.
The secret letter said that envoys from the City of Silver Moon Radiance had already arrived at Green City, wishing to take Isa back.
However, this was not an urgent matter. With the army stationed in the city, unless Vina consented, the other party could not turn the situation.
On the contrary, those ancient evil gods in Dwarf Valley determined to destroy everything were the real concern.
Half a Sunshine Hour after Castro passed over Green City.
Dwarf Valley.
Miles away, Lide’s face turned grave.
The ancient evil god with the octopus body and a thousand blades had come into view.
These loathsome creatures made him exceedingly uncomfortable.
The Eye of Death covered in tentacles emanated a rotting and chaotic aura, enough to drive any ordinary person into madness at a mere glance.
Moreover, there were as many as five of these ancient monsters.
He vaguely saw again the day when the sky was filled with octopus tentacles smashing down as he returned from the Sealed Land with the coffin, the entire land shattering.
Recalling how he was chased out like a silly dog last time, Lide’s gaze grew icy.
"Last time I didn’t kill you because I was carrying the coffin and couldn’t free my hands, now you dare to act tough in front of me..."
Boom, boom, boom~
Just as he was preparing to maneuver Castro closer, suddenly a blaze of light erupted from the clouds in the distance.
A striking blue energy surged forward and viciously struck an ancient evil god, severing dozens of its tentacles.
But the energy did not dissipate; instead, it exploded in the sky, and with a crackle, it tore open a massive rift, as if the sky itself had split.
In that moment the rift opened, an overwhelming surge of seawater rushed forth...
The whole realm was shrouded in rising mist.
In the next second, a gigantic mermaid shadow wielding a trident appeared, its divine pressure overwhelming as a collapsing mountain.
The entire realm trembled under its divine might.
It was indeed the Mermaid Main God making a move.
In the mist, the space had turned into an ocean, and the combat power of the Mermaid Main God visibly surged.
Finally, facing five alone, she dominated unchallenged.
The trident, glowing with a brilliant blue divine light, shattered the surrounding space into chaos with each thrust, while the attacked ancient evil gods had tentacles explode and bodies scarred.
The scene was vastly exaggerated, more intense than any divine battle sung by wandering poets.
This was a true divine battle, each clash causing the world to tremble.
The only regret was that in this explosive battlefield, only the Mermaid Main God wielding the trident could harm those ancient evil gods.
The other four Sea Clan Gods, although they also took advantage of the vast seawater to increase their combat strength, often failed to sever the tentacles despite great effort.
More despairingly, tentacles of the ancient evil gods that were severed and fell to the ground would turn into ash mist and re-integrate into their divine bodies, regrowing new tentacles swiftly.
This near-undying ability was simply perverse.
Colliding with these tough and enduring ancient evil gods was definitely a headache for any divine being.
They could not be killed; a grievous wound would heal in a few breaths, yet a single attack from them could cause great damage to oneself.
Extremely troublesome.
Lide finally understood why these ancient monsters hadn’t been eradicated by the few gods of the Sea Clan.
Only the Mermaid Main God, relying on the trident, was resisting fiercely; the other Sea Clan Gods were completely ineffectual.
The difficulty posed by these Ancient Evil Gods was simply exaggerated.
Seeing this, Lide hesitated no longer and had Castro shrink down as he alone flew toward the battle zone.
Moments later,
above Dwarf Valley, Lide revealed himself.
The Dwarf Valley was located in the Far Mountain Range on the barren wasteland side, surrounded by mountains, with a very good environment.
However, after this divine battle, the geographical environment had drastically changed.
Apart from two or three peaks near Dwarf Valley, the other surrounding tall mountains were like drought-stricken land ploughed over, with peaks fractured, giant rocks thundering, mountains leveled, and streams redirected.
This battle among gods had caused irreparable damage to the surrounding environment.
Even some mountain ranges, due to the terrifying power of both parties, had pierced into the earth’s core, now ominously spewing magma.
A scene of apocalypse.
This was the true power of gods.
The city inside Dwarf Valley had become a casualty of the divine war, thankfully the warriors had already evacuated under the cover of the Sea Clan Gods, otherwise the losses would have been even more severe.
Sensing Lide’s arrival, the Mermaid Main God, who was battling ahead, called forth an illusion in front of him.
"Kachar Main God, we need your help!
These Ancient Evil Gods seem to have been empowered by some force, quickly recovering from severe injuries back to their peak.
We cannot kill them..."
Her tone carried immense gravity, reflecting the trouble imposed by the Ancient Evil Gods’ nearly undying ability.
In the eyes of the Mermaid Main God, Lide was a being of the same, or even higher, level and it was only natural for her to seek his aid.
Moreover, they were assigned to guard Dwarf Valley; the task couldn’t just be left to them now.
Hearing this, Lide’s eyelids twitched and he involuntarily glanced at his level 29 status, feeling a sense of melancholy... Sometimes boasting too much makes it hard to backtrack.
If the boasts could have come true, he would surely be unbeatable in the world...
"Frey, go assist the Mermaid Main God immediately, I want to see whether the recovery speed of these ancient monsters is faster, or if your sword strikes are quicker!"
After speaking, he stood with his hands behind his back, adopting a pose as if everything was under control.
The wind blew his robe, and combined with his extremely handsome face, it did soften the expression of the Mermaid Main God.
Being handsome is truly a lifelong affliction...
After getting a response, the illusion of the Mermaid Main God dispersed.
Behind him, Frey tore through the sky, boldly charging toward the Ancient Evil Gods.
Level 36 Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel.
Clad in black angel battle armor, wielding a cross longsword, the twelve black wings unfolded with a swish.
A terrifying pressure began to surge unabashedly toward the surroundings.
This appearance was simply the epitome of style.
As a god, and one that had reached the Medium Divine Power level, Frey’s dominance needed no further words.
With a sharp glance, she charged directly towards the nearest Ancient Evil God.
The terrifying fluctuations tore through the void, supremely indomitable.
Whizz~
At the next moment, several miles away, the tentacles of the Ancient Evil God targeted by Frey exploded directly, splattering blood all over the sky.
The Ancient Evil God let out a painful roar, its miles-long tentacles swung about, whooshing through the air like steel whips, carrying the momentum of exploding stars as they smashed towards Frey.
Frey, of course, wouldn’t be hit that easily. With a slight movement of her twelve wings, she began to fly agilely through the air.
She danced freely in the chaotic mess, filled with grace and agility.
Boom!
The ground under the assault of those tentacles shattered like fragile foam, exploding bit by bit; boulders and dirt were flung hundreds of miles high, and the entire scene resembled the apocalypse.
In the whirl of those tentacles, everything around turned to ashes.
Lide had his first direct sense of the Ancient Evil God’s horror—it was like a massive pile driver, with the entire heavens and earth trembling.
Moreover, as the Mermaid Main God had said, these Ancient Monsters simply could not be killed.
Even if the tentacles were cut off, they would instantly turn to ash mist, be reabsorbed by them, and new tentacles would quickly grow back from the severed spots.
The destructive power Frey unleashed was extraordinary, the tentacles that could shatter mountains were cut down like wheat.
But because of this bizarre regenerative ability, her dense, rain-like attacks didn’t have much effect.
Lide watched with twitching eyelids.
These guys were simply too tough—didn’t they follow any rules at all??
He even wondered if these monsters had activated some health-regenerating cheat; was this something mortals could accomplish?
Although they didn’t manage to kill these monsters, with Frey’s participation, the situation on the battlefield did stabilize, turning into a battle between five Sea Clan Gods and Frey against five Ancient Evil Gods.
But facing a group that had activated health-regenerating cheats and couldn’t be killed, the situation inevitably fell into a stalemate.
During this time, a Sea Clan God got carelessly struck by a tentacle, like being hit by a baseball, almost smashed into the crust, sustaining considerable damage and greatly reducing their combat effectiveness.
The situation became increasingly tense.
——
At this moment, "I Love a Stick" was experiencing extreme emotional fluctuations. Although he couldn’t control the Ancient Evil God’s divine body, watching his possessed tentacle monster battle a group of godly beings that could destroy worlds was still dazzling.
But when he spotted Lide, dressed in a black and white robe of interwoven magic, his heart was greatly shaken.
"Holy shit!! Wearing a black and white interwoven robe, almost a perfect nobility temperament... Is this Lord Ilo???
To actually meet this big boss!!
His fortune was unbelievable; the possessed evil god could actually fight against Lord Ilo?
This is worth boasting about for a lifetime!!"
Lord Ilo’s reputation among players was immense, always known as the strongest native deity.
Even after the descent of the gods, with powerful divine beings like the Sun Goddess and the War God appearing, Lord Ilo still stood supreme due to his extremely handsome appearance.
Although "I Love a Stick" was just a player, facing such a character, his heart was still full of admiration. He had fantasized countless times about freezing an entire city with magic, making deities kneel before him in front of everyone... Truly the king of kings.
This was the stuff of legends becoming reality.
If he shared this experience, he could already imagine the praise he’d get from those silly internet friends on forums...
"Too bad, if I could control this evil god’s divine body and really fight with Lord Ilo, that would be so cool..."
——
——
The battle between the two sides could only be described as earth-shattering.
Whether it was the deities of the Ocean God System or Frey, their strength was formidable, but the Ancient Evil Gods, with terrifying regenerative abilities and overwhelming size, appeared as invincible existences.
Lide had been observing from a distance for a long time and eventually made a frustrating discovery: if he didn’t nullify the Ancient Evil Gods’ regenerative abilities, they were likely to lose the terrifying divine battle in the end.
These undying beings were too troublesome to handle.
After much thought, Lide’s mind flashed—he remembered the fragment of the Destiny Tablet he had just obtained.
He took it out from his chest and looked at the attribute panel again, where one particular attribute made his eyes gradually light up.
Trait—Rule Twisting: Upon activation of the Destiny Tablet fragment, it can twist the surrounding rules, having a mandatory purification effect on powers not from Glory World. It can erase the ancient chaos powers within a certain range.
The Destiny Tablet was a Creation God Artifact and was used to suppress the divine destiny of Glory; part of its abilities was specifically aimed at chaos and ancient powers, as only these could overthrow Glory.
With a trial mindset, Lide slowly infused the Power of Faith into the fragment of the Destiny Tablet.
However, after spending hundreds of thousands, he frustratingly discovered that this amount of power couldn’t even stir a ripple; to activate the Destiny Tablet fragment with the Power of Faith, at least tens of millions were needed...
Spending so much was not even reasonable by extravagant standards.
A thought struck him, and he tried channeling the Power of Destiny within his body...
A moment later, his face showed a hint of joy.
Indeed, it took destiny to conquer destiny, the Power of Destiny was the key to unlocking the Destiny Tablet fragment.
Thinking this, his face showed a hint of oddity—wasn’t the Power of Destiny derived from the Destiny Tablet fragment itself? What else to use if not the Power of Destiny?
He couldn’t believe his own lapse in intelligence...
Muttering a self-deprecating comment, Lide didn’t hesitate any longer and began to increase the output, with the Power of Destiny surging massively within him.
The Destiny Tablet fragment started to emit a faint glow like a light bulb connected to a power source.
The most fundamental power of Glory began to slowly circulate.
With a thought, Lide set his eyes on the nearest Ancient Evil God.
"Frey, prepare to slay a god!" he called out, his voice cold and echoing through the sky.
In the shocked gazes of several Sea Clan Gods and "I Love a Stick," a murky force sprayed out from his hand.
The distant Ancient Evil God couldn’t react in time and was directly hit by this attack that transcended time and space.
Crack~
At the moment the Ancient Evil God was struck, a sound akin to shattering glass resounded within its enormous divine body.
Subsequently, the tentacled, eye-covered body of the Ancient Evil God trembled, and a violently decaying energy burst out like a punctured balloon, instantly whipping up a hurricane.
When the energy dissipated, the once mighty Ancient Evil God looked as defeated as a man who had just lost an argument with his wife, its tentacles drooping limply to the ground...
Noticing this scene, Frey thought quickly; her Angel Battle Sword burst forth with a sword Qi that could cleave heaven and earth.
Divine Arts—Blade of Destruction. Concentrating all her power, she unleashed a sword Qi with an unerring effect; the struck opponent’s soul would be destroyed, the lower their divine status, the greater the damage.
The long blue sword Qi crossed time and space, turning everything it touched to nothing.
Carrying endless Divine Power, it cleaved down on the Ancient Evil God’s head in a world-ending manner.
Splurch~
The thousand-blade tall Ancient Evil God was split in two by a single strike.
Corrosive blood sprayed like a fountain from the high sky, sizzling as it fell to the earth, corroding the land, rocks, and trees, creating massive craters everywhere.
In its last moments, the tentacles flailed wildly, smashing the ground within a thousand-blade radius as if countless steel whips were smiting it; the entire surface cracked open, even exposing the rocky layer beneath...
Dust and debris filled the air, blocking everyone’s sight.
Once the dust slightly settled, the body of the Ancient Evil God lay stiff and collapsed on the ground, completely void of life.
And its near-immortal ability failed to manifest again.
"I Love a Stick" felt a shiver of consciousness when he saw this scene. If he still had a body, he would certainly have heard himself swallowing.
The excitement of just battling with an entity like Lord Ilo from the myths transformed entirely into fear at this moment.
Although that Ancient Evil God was one of his underlings and was quite powerful, had he just been slain by Lord Ilo with a single move??
Even though it wasn’t Lord Ilo who killed the Ancient Evil God, if it wasn’t for breaking the almost undead state, that Ancient Evil God wouldn’t have died...
If his target had been me just now, could I have withstood it?
Thinking of this, "I Love a Stick" shivered with cold and panicked,
"I can’t die here... After finally becoming such a strong tentacle monster, I haven’t even had the chance to snatch a few elves to start a harem.
I, a righteous and upright gentleman, grand and bright, just and incorruptible, pure-minded, and tough as iron... how could I possibly fall here!
It’s no good; I need to make a strategic retreat. I can’t continue fighting. What if I hurt Lord Ilo? Even if I don’t hurt him, it would still be unethical to trample the surrounding flowers and grass..."
"I Love a Stick" suddenly burst out with an unprecedented will to survive, trying to forcefully control his body to flee.
But the chaotic aggregate of the primary consciousness ignored his desire to escape and instead furiously wanted to charge at Lide.
"I Love a Stick" was terrified, as Lide’s hands emitted a second beam of chaotic void light.
And so history repeated itself—his second underling was slain on the spot, blood splattered everywhere, more disastrous than the first time he went out to talk about life ideals with his girlfriend at night...
Now, "I Love a Stick" completely lost his mind. If this continued, wouldn’t he end up like his underlings?
Driven by an even stronger desire to survive, "I Love a Stick" recklessly charged toward the chaotic aggregate in the spiritual sea.
Upon touching the chaotic primary consciousness, his heart surged with infinite desires for slaughter and destruction, and he wished he could immediately rush up and blast Lide.
No, instructor Cangjing, Teacher Xiao Ze is still waiting for me to return. I can’t just fall like this!!
In the boundless chaos, "I Love a Stick" forcefully twisted his will and, relying on the exaggerated survival desire, barely managed to control the massive divine body and turned to run away...
Fortunately, the aggregate possessed only basic consciousness, without self-awareness, which allowed "I Love a Stick" to dominate this chaotic aggregate.
But in the end, "I Love a Stick" nearly collapsed.
The chaotic consciousnesses were constantly screaming and cursing in his ears, making his own consciousness increasingly muddled.
After fleeing the battlefield, he used up all his strength to detach from the primary consciousness and immediately passed out.
Seeing "I Love a Stick" escape, the two Ancient Evil God underlings did not continue to fight and directly followed him, as if such Evil Gods inherently obey higher beings...
In the skies over Dwarf Valley, Lide did not stop the three Ancient Evil Gods from leaving.
Embarrassingly, he discovered that with the current power of destiny within him, he could only activate the divine skill of twisting rules twice, and it would take at least a week to restore the power of destiny within him.
If the nearly undead abilities of those three Ancient Evil Gods were not revoked, it would be difficult to detain them.
The Mermaid Main God watched the three Ancient Evil Gods escape and did not continue the pursuit.
After battling these few creatures for nearly a day, although they could not harm her, and she had exhausted all her methods without being able to kill them, Lide’s decision to not chase made her lose interest in pursuing them.
The other four Sea Clan Gods who had been rather inactive throughout the fight now looked at Lide with admiration.
They had expended so much effort but failed to subdue the Ancient Evil Gods, but Lide had quickly killed two upon his arrival.
The disparity was enormous.
"Kachar Main God is truly exceptional; we did not ally with the wrong person," they thought.
The Sea Clan Gods and Mermaid Main God drew near to Lide and immediately began to praise him.
"Praise You, Kachar Main God..."
"Thank you for your assistance; without you, it might have been us facing defeat today..."
"Kachar Main God, You are truly powerfully awe-inspiring."
Lide modestly said, "It was nothing special, just that a few Sunshine Hours ago in Nolan Capital I fought with the Master of Dawn, ensuring he wouldn’t dare to spy on Nolan Capital again, but it was quite exhausting.
If I hadn’t clashed with the Master of Dawn, perhaps I could have arrived earlier today.
Unfortunately, this time I couldn’t keep all the Ancient Evil Gods here..."
His words weren’t wrong—he only mentioned that he had engaged with the Master of Dawn without specifying whether he had taken to the field himself or if Frey had taken action.
Hiss~
Several Sea Clan Gods glanced at each other, filled with surprise.
The Kachar Main God actually battled with the Master of Dawn in Nolan Capital?
And even managed to repel that powerful being ranked among the top five in the Light Attribute gods!!
Kachar Main God indeed possesses unfathomably terrifying combat power!!
No wonder he didn’t kill all the Ancient Evil Gods, having just fought the Master of Dawn, he must have expended a great deal of energy.
Lide’s stature once again rose in their hearts; they almost reached a point of deep reverence toward him.
They even started to entertain the notion that allying with such a powerful Main God would surely lead to a bright future.
The eyes of the Mermaid Main God also shone with brilliance, her gaze towards Lide becoming even softer.
Her eyes brightened upon seeing the shard of the Destiny Tablet in Lide’s hand.
"Kachar Main God, is that the shard of the Destiny Tablet you found in Nolan Capital?"
Lide, with an unchanging smile, nodded and even took out the Destiny Tablet shard to show.
"Yes, this Destiny Tablet shard is number 15; it indeed played a significant role in killing the Ancient Evil Gods."
Of course, this was true, but due to preconceived notions, they didn’t believe that Lide solely relied on the Destiny Tablet shard but rather his own power to kill the Ancient Evil Gods.
While they were conversing, Frey also sheathed her sword and returned.
In her palms, she held two Divine Statuses emitting immense evil presence; after the two Ancient Evil Gods’ bodies were slain, they rapidly shriveled and decayed, leaving only their Divine Statuses.
Lide glanced at them and then stored the Divine Statuses in his pouch without saying much.
But he cast a somewhat regretful glance over Dwarf Valley.
Though the battle of the gods, the Sea Clan gods already tried their best to protect the city below.
But the aftermath of the Divine Level battle was too terrifying; the city, built with so much effort and dedication, was now completely ruined, turned into a wasteland.
The invaluable Secret Silver Vein had been buried under boulders, and several large iron mines had also collapsed.
The scene looked inexplicably desolate.
"Let this city rest here..."
Looking at the city below that was now utterly destroyed, Lide’s eyes held a trace of emotion.
In a trance, he seemed to see again the time when he first led a few Level 15 battle forces to conquer this city.
Castro, clad in steel armor, could kill hundreds of Beastmen with every diving attack.
The Bronze One-eyed Giant, Koso, wielding two huge longswords, held off a thousand Wolf Cavalry alone, creating rivers of blood.
The Blood Clan Spellcasting Group with a massive mixed magic killed tens of thousands of Beastmen...
Each scene appeared as if it were happening just yesterday.
Lide took a deep breath, his voice carrying an indescribable complexity as he murmured.
"Dawn City..."
Within a background that seemed like the end of the world, the moment seemed to freeze.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - 492: When the Silly Player Becomes the Ancient Evil God Continued
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Chapter 492: When the Silly Player Becomes the Ancient Evil God Continued
"I Love a Stick didn’t completely lose consciousness after falling unconscious, he could still sense the vague information coming from the outside world.
He controlled the body of the Ancient Evil God to escape the dreadful battlefield, and after avoiding Lord Ilo who could easily kill him in seconds, the Ancient Evil God seemed to keep moving deep into the barren wasteland.
Then he encountered a Beastman city in the depths of the barren wasteland.
When the three-headed Ancient Evil God full of destructive desires encountered a city still inhabited by lives from the Main Plane, what would happen next was obvious.
But what surprised I Love a Stick was that this Beastman city was extremely terrifying, suddenly unleashing three powerful Beast Race Gods.
Then the two sides got entangled.
However, thanks to its almost Undead abilities, the Ancient Evil God was overwhelmingly dominant, continuously overpowering the opponents, and in the end, those three Beast Gods were severely injured.
But just when he and his few followers were about to win, a terrifying energy that directly struck the soul shot out from deep within the city, plunging the collective consciousness in his Spiritual Sea into extreme chaos.
He and two of his underlings began to uncontrollably fight each other, and eventually fought farther and farther away, completely giving up on the Beastman city.
After the collective consciousness plunged into madness, I Love a Stick suddenly woke up from his unconsciousness.
Then he was surprised to find that the entangled consciousness seemed to be affected by something, started to twist and collide, making the Spiritual Sea countless times more chaotic than before.
He was powerless to do anything about it, so he could only shrink into the farthest corner and quietly observe the scene.
After spying for a long time, I Love a Stick suddenly became ecstatic, although he didn’t know how to control the body of the Evil God, but he wasn’t without options...he could totally go offline and ask for help through posting.
There had to be players who knew the inside story, right?
Without any hesitation, filled with intense excitement, he went offline.
When he opened his eyes again, he was inside the gaming capsule.
I Love a Stick heaved a big sigh of relief, thankfully the logout function was still working, it would have been a big problem if he couldn’t logout...
Then he felt a bit worried again, what if he couldn’t return to the body of the Evil God when he logged back in?
He quickly logged in to confirm, and felt relieved again when he sensed the surrounding chaotic main consciousness, he started to post on the official website back on Earth.
And the content of the post was incredibly hardcore.
"Online waiting, I got the body of an Ancient Evil God, but how do I control it?"
Below it detailed how he found the Sealed Land, how he unlocked the seal, how he became the Ancient Evil God, and even spent a lot of effort describing his battle with the influential figure, Lord Ilo.
It also included hundreds of screenshots.
The apocalyptic scenes of destruction were completely depicted through the images, of course, Lide, the great hunk, was also captured in those screenshots.
This exaggerated post initially went unnoticed, people thought he was just bragging.
But once quite a few knowledgeable players confirmed the authenticity of this situation, the post immediately exploded.
Soon after, it was directly pinned on the official website, and in just a couple of hours, it reached over a million replies.
Hundreds of thousands of new threads appeared specifically discussing this issue.
Under the post of I Love a Stick, the responses from the silly netizens were incredibly enthusiastic.
Post 1: I’m literally blind, my eyes see no purpose. How could someone encounter such a good thing?? That body must at least be level 30 and above!!
Post 2: Post 1, if you’re inexperienced, better not show up, level 30? Level 30 is a Demigod, only from level 31 can one be called a Divine, this must be level 50 and up, congratulations to the uploader, haven’t seen such a high-level for a long time, last Evil God I encountered was only level 45...
Post 3: Big shot, please adopt me, yii yii yii, I also want to become a tentacle monster, my girlfriends urgently need comforting...
Post 4: A suggestion for you, if you can’t control it, then don’t bother controlling, come find me, I’m in the Ancient Forest, let me bear this sin.
Post 5: F*ck, why can’t I pick up a Divine Body too?? It’s not fair, strongly demanding a feature for everyone to become a divine...
Post 6: ...
Despite there being many replies, most of them were filled with jealousy and random stupid ideas, not much useful information.
Rather, it was other threads discussing this issue on the forum that gave him a lot to gain.
The post that made him feel most touched was released by a player named I Love Tiger Stick.
I Love Tiger Stick: After seeing so many discussions about the body of an Evil God, I feel deeply moved, actually, the solution I Love a Stick is looking for is simple.
Let me share my experience, I’m a hidden profession—Druid, every time I transform, I am dominated by the corresponding animal’s instincts.
For example, transforming into a bear made me crave honey, becoming a cheetah made me prefer hiding in the shadows, turning into a husky made me want to bask in the sun...
Later, I concluded a pattern: to resist instincts, one must possess significant spiritual power and willpower.
Moreover, this kind of strength isn’t the illusionary strength you claim to possess, but a solid, physical intensity.
Because of this, I spent a great deal of time and consulted countless resources to find out how to enhance my mental powers and willpower. Explaining too many principles may confuse you, so I’ll be concise — it’s just one word: consumption.
That’s right, it’s that simple. Humans need to eat food to grow, and spiritual power works the same way. Leveling up and transforming oneself is good, but consuming other spiritual powers is the quickest way to grow.
But don’t get too excited too early; this method wouldn’t be a secret if it were easy to implement.
The consumption I speak of requires extremely harsh conditions, the most typical being that the other’s consciousness must be within your Spiritual Sea.
If your consciousness enters another person’s Spiritual Sea, I’m sorry to say, you might be the one who gets consumed.
Consciousness has a very special nature; once it leaves one’s body, it often dissipates immediately, and just these two conditions alone are enough for 99.99% of people to fail.
So this sounds simple, but it’s actually extremely difficult to execute.
But now, I Love a Stick’s situation is different; this guy has already entered the other’s Spiritual Sea, or perhaps this is his own Spiritual Sea.
And what’s even more rare is that those chaotic consciousnesses don’t have enough self-consciousness.
In other words, this is just a pile of meat laid out before you; if you dare to eat, it all becomes your food.
So, to find a way to control the body, the simplest and most brutal method is to consume other consciousnesses to enhance your spiritual power, to strengthen the now weak consciousness.
So, how do you consume?
The method is also very simple; you just need to pull those loose, peripheral consciousnesses from the chaotic entity and then consume them one by one, starting from the smallest to the largest.
But remember, never peek into the other’s memories during consumption; you just need to absorb the spiritual power.
Otherwise, if you consume too much consciousness, you’ll blur your self-identity and might even become someone else.
Such consumption would no longer be called consumption; you would become a new aggregate of chaotic consciousness.
The risk involved is very high. Whether to try or not is up to you; if it seems impossible, it’s probably best to give up.
Otherwise, given the connection level between Glory and reality, you might go insane in reality, too.
This is a gamble with your life.
Of course, if you succeed, you’ll be the first among players, and even if an Ancient Invasion occurs on Earth, your status will be unreachable.
Life and death are fated; wealth and honor are in heaven! Good luck, buddy, remember us if you grow wealthy.
I Love a Stick was quite moved by this member of I Love Family.
Who would have thought someone would be so open about their secrets?
After browsing through many posts, he still felt this one was the most reliable and immediately returned to Glory to start the experiment.
Following this method, he felt like he found a new world.
That mass of chaotic consciousness indeed had some scattered, less entangled consciousnesses on the periphery.
This thrilled I Love a Stick greatly, and he began following the post’s instructions, gently guiding the spirits from the aggregate and then consuming them in a big fish eats little fish approach.
Initially, the consumption posed many problems, I Love a Stick’s primary challenge being the slow pace and the overwhelming memories making him nearly lose himself.
But after consuming more than a dozen thin consciousnesses, he gradually got the hang of it and learned how to filter out the useless chaotic memories.
Then, the rate of consumption started to increase rapidly.
That mountainous aggregate of consciousnesses in the Spiritual Sea slowly diminished like melting snow.
As I Love a Stick consumed more, he grew stronger, and the speed of consumption increased; even his physical body in reality started showing signs of becoming superhuman.
After a long period of consumption, within the Spiritual Sea, gradually, his consciousness grew larger than the mass of chaotic consciousness.
Moreover, he did not absorb the memories of those consciousnesses and remained unaffected by the chaos.
In the end, he consumed the remaining spiritual entities in one gulp, and with a thunderous noise, his mind became enlightened.
Suddenly, he felt almost ascended, ecstatic beyond comparison with his favorite ’big treasure sword.’
Endless power flowed from hundreds of tendrils, the energy gushing like magma almost overwhelmed him.
At that moment, he could even control the Eye of Death on each tendril.
"Level 35..."
"Ha ha ha ha ha..."
"I f***ing did it with a Husky!! I actually did it!!!"
"Now, I am an Ancient Evil God, and a Level 35 Ancient Evil God at that!!"
In his mad laughter, what spilled from his mouth was not human language, but the ancient tongue, causing the surrounding ten kilometers to tremble in the presence of this evil speech.
The thrill within I Love a Stick kept him from calming down for a long time, as he had truly become an invincible tentacle monster this time.
And with more than a hundred tentacles at his disposal, he wouldn’t have to worry about abducting a few hundred elves to start his harem.
A night with a hundred women wasn’t a dream anymore.
Feeling the power erupting inside his body like a volcano, with a thought, he lifted the thickest tentacle from the lower part of his giant octopus body and then smashed it down onto the ground with all his might.
Whoooosh~
The tentacle, with a screeching swoosh, smashed terrifyingly into the ground.
Boom boom boom~
At that moment, the ground burst open like rotten silt, giant rocks several tens of blades high and hundreds of blades wide shattered and flew in all directions, dust covering the entire sky.
The scene was like a star falling to Earth, destroying everything.
When the dust settled, in front of I Love a Stick appeared a massive crack over three thousand blades long and hundreds of blades deep.
To ordinary people, it looked like a scar from the heavens.
Seeing this exaggerated scene, I Love a Stick was so excited he nearly went insane.
He had seen the destructive power of Ancient Evil Gods destroying worlds before, but that was as a bystander.
Now, he himself was blasting the land and causing such a terrifying scene, and the sense of achievement felt entirely different.
"Ha ha ha, I’m so fierce now. Could I resist nuclear weapons if I went back to Earth?
No, that’s not right, the Russians still have Big Ivan, f***, these sick bastards, creating weapons that can destroy the world, are they out of their minds??"
"But now I can totally do whatever I want without fear, can’t I?"
"Come with me to snatch elves, I want to sleep with a hundred!!"
Excitedly babbling, I Love a Stick began to endlessly fantasize.
It took him a long time to snap back to reality.
"Play it cool, play it cool, I am just a plain old Level 35 Ancient Evil God now, at most unbeatable in the world, nothing too great."
After a moment of excitement, I Love a Stick suddenly seemed to remember something, turning his gaze to two of his minions.
Pensively.
"If I could devour the chaotic consciousness of this body, could I perhaps devour the consciousness of these two minions as well?
Then wouldn’t I have turned these two minions into my own extensions??"
If it were a normal life, this behavior would be suicidal, but Ancient Evil Gods don’t have independent self-awareness and only act instinctively, so this wasn’t impossible.
And now he was the big boss of the two minions, able to command them not to resist.
I Love a Stick was daring as always, and with that thought, he began emitting an aura to draw the two minions close to him.
The two Ancient Evil Gods had a clear subordinate relationship with I Love a Stick and scurried over to him immediately.
"My consciousness is so vast, I can definitely split some of it off, and since I absorbed the aggregate and gained extra characteristics, splitting seems not so difficult after all..."
After a slight hesitation, I Love a Stick began trying to split his consciousness, and unexpectedly, what he thought would be a difficult task was accomplished in the blink of an eye.
"This feels so strange, I can even turn myself back into the myriad entangled forms of consciousness from before..."
"Sure enough, have I been infected by the Ancient Evil God now? But, it doesn’t seem like a bad thing."
After pondering for a moment, I Love a Stick couldn’t figure anything out, so he simply stopped thinking.
With a thought, he used his tentacle to pull Minion 1 closer to him, then their heads collided together.
The two abominable entities in this state looked extremely terrifying and bizarre; if an outsider was present, they likely would think they were breeding...
After their collision, I Love a Stick controlled his own consciousness and delved into the other’s Spiritual Sea.
In that instant he entered the Spiritual Sea, his heart suddenly shuddered.
Chaos and desire for bloodshed surged forth, nearly dispersing his gathered consciousness.
He hastily imagined the teaching appearance of Teacher Xiao Ze and Miss Cangjing, which managed to preserve a pure and clean area in his heart.
After surviving the first onslaught, he immediately soothed the now visibly enraged Ancient Evil God. Once the entity calmed down a bit, he resumed his consumption of its consciousness.
One Sunshine Hour, two Sunshine Hours... after a total of ten Sunshine Hours, I Love a Stick suddenly burst into laughter.
"Ha ha ha, I’m seriously a genius!!"
And at that moment, Minion #1 also started laughing aloud, mirroring the same detestable demeanor; the scene looked incredibly bizarre.
Minion #2 looked utterly confused at his two counterparts, and even though it had a very faint self-awareness, it inexplicably felt like it should distance itself from these two idiots to avoid getting infected...
I Love a Stick felt incredibly peculiar at that moment, not only had his spiritual power significantly increased, but it also felt as though he had grown an extra hand.
After consuming Minion #1, things turned out just as he thought they would—the other was now under his control, becoming his avatar.
With an excited thrill, I Love a Stick then set his sights on the second Ancient Evil God.
Minion #2 trembled all over, sensing something but not daring to move due to I Love a Stick’s tyranny, he could only shiver and let himself be manipulated.
Following the same method, after some effort, the second Ancient Evil God was also consumed.
Having devoured three Ancient Evil Gods, his consciousness had reached an incredibly exaggerated state.
I Love a Stick even felt confident that he could forcibly consume another complete Ancient Evil God without dispersing his attention.
That powerful feeling was really peculiar, like a man suddenly obtaining the capability of the "Seven-Times-a-Night Champion"...
What made him even more ecstatic was that now Minion #1 and Minion #2 had completely become avatars at his beck and call.
That interconnected feeling felt like growing a third and fourth arm on the body, making control effortless, and he even managed to erase the chaotic and murderous negative emotions.
Now, he had become a player cloaked in the hide of an Ancient Evil God!
Although unsure whether he could still revive after dying, I Love a Stick was so excited he was almost going mad.
"Ha ha ha ha ha, transforming one into three pure essences, yes, I’m the real boss of Glory World!! Totally awesome!!"
"No, can’t get too giddy... Lord Ilo is way cooler than me, and if I provoke him and he breaks my invulnerable state, getting slain could indeed be quite entertaining.
I need to get out of here, I must snatch some Elves, I want the night to charm a hundred women..."
