Babbling crazily, I Love a Stick, along with his two avatars, turned and walked out of the barren wasteland, heading straight for the Ancient Forest in the heart of the continent...
This lsp really intended to rob the Ancient Gods of Elves, planning to execute what was on his mind.
That night, I Love a Stick posted on the forum about his successful transformation into three entities and shared screenshots of his three Evil God avatars.
Three horrifying Evil Gods covered in Eyes of Death, one moment hugging a mountain and cheering, the next puckering lips in a cute pose, then the three monsters lining up to wiggle their butts, and another moment over a hundred tentacles forming heart shapes together...
The scene was intensely cringeworthy but also caused a huge sensation.
Those silly players were filled with envy, posting madly as if it cost them nothing.
f.(r)eew ebnov\ll.com
"I damn can’t accept it, it’s really screwed up, I’ve been doing good deeds for decades and never encountered this; why did it happen to you!!"
"Jealousy has split me into pieces; didn’t think it was truly possible, I don’t want to mix up anymore..."
"For the love of decency, one possession was enough, why did you get ’buy one, get two free’!!"
The message from I Love a Stick also attracted global attention.
As rifts appeared in the sky on Earth, abruptly there was someone claiming to have obtained the body of an Ancient Evil God, its value was heart-racing to consider.
Various countries immediately tried to contact I Love a Stick.
Unfortunately, the Glory official website, even after the Ancient Invasion, retained its transcendent status; no one could locate the real address of this website, nor could anyone get specific details about the poster through the official website.
This left many countries sighing incessantly.
Silly players weren’t interested in I Love a Stick’s real identity; what most cared about was whether they could get I Love a Stick to share some benefits with them.
Many began harboring devious thoughts; how awesome would it be to employ I Love a Stick to help them kill monsters and level up? That would be as easy as a demigod executing kills.
And some guilds considered whether I Love a Stick could help them build cities, such a powerful trio of laborers could even move mountains, it would be a waste not to use them for infrastructure construction.
Numerous players contacted I Love a Stick directly, planning to establish a church for him, allowing players to become his Believers, so they could gain some spells and power...
At this time, I Love a Stick was blissfully unaware of the immense impact his becoming an Ancient Evil God had on Earth and Glory World, his mind was still fixated on Elves, determined to pull off a big job in the Ancient Forest...

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 493: To all the residents, I plan to tether a dragon in the square for their viewing pleasure (9200)
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Chapter 493: To all the residents, I plan to tether a dragon in the square for their viewing pleasure (9200)
Dwarf Valley had fallen, and in a way that no one had expected.
After several years of mining, the lion’s share of the Secret Silver Vein had already been consumed by Dawn City; the remaining ore, though still valuable, was no longer sufficient to justify Lide reopening the mines for further excavation.
Without hesitation, he returned to Dawn City with Frey and several Sea Clan Gods who now showed him noticeably more respect.
Although he had only been away for half a month, the sight of Dwarf Valley reduced to ruins stirred something within him as he returned to the prosperity of Dawn City.
His gaze immediately steadied.
This city, which he had built from the ground up, must not be allowed to follow in Dwarf Valley’s doomed footsteps, no matter the cost.
While he was lost in thought, a crisp crackling sound suddenly emanated from the sky, like glass being shattered.
All the people of Dawn City felt it and instinctively looked up.
In the sky above, a crack that had already split to some extent was being torn even wider apart by two colossal, sky-covering hands, with the sound of cracking echoing through heaven and earth.
The sky fissure had widened once again!
The residents below watched in undeniable panic, their eyes full of turmoil.
Many feared that in the next second, the fissure in the sky would burst open completely and an uncountable number of terrifying demons would fall through.
And with this widening of the fissure, the eruption of the Ancient Day Energy became visible to the naked eye—the ancient, decaying energy seemed to corrupt everything in the Main Plane.
With a hiss...
The Ancient Day Energy, now several times denser than before, erupted from the crack, colliding directly with the shield generated by the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
The moment of contact was like sulfuric acid poured onto the ground, emitting a sizzling corrosive sound.
Just as everyone’s hearts were in their throats, the Destiny Tablet pieces burst forth with a dazzling light.
In the next instant, the near-collapsed shield solidified once more and, just like before, began to absorb the Ancient Day Energy to strengthen itself.
Lide’s ashen complexion eased somewhat upon witnessing this.
At the same time, he felt some relief; thankfully, they had obtained fragments of the Destiny Tablet in advance. Otherwise, with the widening of the crack, he feared that in the first onslaught of Ancient Day Power, many residents would have been corrupted and transformed into loathsome Ancient Monsters.
Seeing this, the Mermaid Main God, surrounded by several Sea Clan Gods, looked somber and motionless for a long time.
Although she had found a Water Element Plane suitable for the Sea Clan to inhabit, she could only transfer a portion of them there.
Most sea creatures still struggled to survive in the Lost Sea...
But reality was even more cruel than the Mermaid Main God had imagined.
After the third sky tear, the entirety of Glory underwent a terrifying transformation.
Lost Sea.
The roiling Ancient Day Energy poured into the ocean like dark clouds.
The creatures swimming at the surface had no means of resisting this decaying force, merely allowing it to merge into their bodies.
High-level creatures fared slightly better; their strong physical makeup allowed them to resist for a time. Sensing danger, they swam rapidly toward the ocean floor.
The low-level sea life was devoured directly by the Ancient Day Energy, their bodies beginning to rot and their essence turning to decay.
Once corrupted by Ancient Day Energy, this process was irreversible.
Moreover, the surrounding Ancient Day Energy surged in even more violently, accelerating their transformation into Ancient Monsters.
One by one, Sea Clan creatures on the surface turned into monsters bent on destruction, their bodies rotten, appearing as terrifying as corpses dead for tens of days.
These newly transformed Ancient Monsters, upon the completion of their corruption, immediately began to attack the surrounding life.
Their intense desire for ruin made them long to kill all life around them.
The sea surface began to churn with rings of blood, the entire ocean following suit. The sea turned red with blood, and with too many marine lives lost, the ocean remained crimson for half a month, becoming a realm of death and bloodshed.
Ancient Forest.
This magical forest was now facing an unprecedented crisis.
From the sky rift, endless old powers surged out like towering waves, charging into the Ancient Forest with a posture of corrupting everything.
The trees, emitting a faint green glow, quickly drew nutrients from the earth, opposing the decay with the Power of Nature.
But the ancient aura from the sky rift was nearly endless, while the nutrients of the earth had a time when they could be exhausted.
The forest, which had survived since ancient times, started to wither, yellow, and rot from its edges, tree by tree, their roots breaking apart.
Only the center of the Ancient Forest, protected by the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, remained unscathed.
Raising the perspective, one could see a gigantic city at the center of the Ancient Forest, a hundred miles in diameter, a marvel to behold, being constructed swiftly.
And the ones participating in the construction were all Divines of the Light and Natural Divine Systems.
This Divine Gifted Holy City, the base of the Angel Alliance, was where they would make their stand against the Ancient Evil God...
Whether it would be effective, no one knew, but this was the greatest effort the Light Gods could muster.
Beyond that, the third sky rift had an even greater impact—total crop failure.
After the last sky rift, most of Glory’s vegetation was affected.
Yet many factions had managed to ensure the growth of crops in various ways.
But this time was completely different.
The ancient energy released by the third sky rift could no longer be remedied by ordinary means, unless there were enough Spellcasters using Magic to grow the crops; otherwise, widespread crop failure was inevitable.
But how scarce were the noble Mages?
In some cities that had not been overrun by Ancient Monsters, residents watched the crops in their fields rapidly yellowing, swallowed instantly by despair and fear.
It’s all over, everything is over.
With the world in Chaos, monsters from ancient times, Abyss Demons, and Undead appearing one after another, crops failed on a massive scale.
This severely worsened the already dire situation.
No one could imagine what the future would hold; despair had consumed the common people.
And the Doomsday God Sect, an extreme Sect worshiping the Ancient Evil God, began to gain larger-scale popularity...
Although Lide had not witnessed the negative impacts caused by the expansion of the sky rift, he could infer a thing or two.
But he had no time to think too much about it now, for upon his return to Dawn City, Harrison arrived beside him, his expression fraught with urgency, and began to report.
"Your Majesty, the Black Dragon from the Underworld has not yet receded, and the hundreds of thousands of acres of Microglow Mushrooms have been burnt to ashes by that Black Dragon..."
"Although the two crowned heads of the Sea Clan are still entangling it, the opponent possesses extremely powerful strength, and they can only barely prevent that damned Black Dragon from causing too much destruction."
The rampaging Black Dragon from the Underworld was giving Harrison more pressure these past few days than the Ancient Evil God in front of Dwarf Valley.
The Ancient Evil Gods could at most destroy Dwarf Valley, but the Black Dragon dared to stab them in the back in Dawn City, their main base.
Each attack by the opponent on a food cultivation area, each assault on a city, was a direct loss for them.
Lide’s brows furrowed, his expression turning somewhat unsightly.
This Black Dragon had been constantly mentioned in his ear since he discovered the Underworld.
But despite several attempts to track it down in the muddy swamps, he had never encountered it. Having held back for so long, the Black Dragon finally made its appearance.
"I said I would tie you up in Dawn Square for all the residents to see.
You used to hide and play dead, but now you dare to show up and mess around, even burning down millions of acres of my crops..."
Lide was also ruthless; millions of acres was no small number, one acre could support two people for a year, so the opponent had destroyed the food supply for over two million people for a year.
The thought alone was suffocating.
Moreover, he still had to relocate millions from the Nolan Capital to Dawn City, where food would definitely be a big problem.
Food was already scarce, and this bastard had burned so much more; it was simply unforgivable.
"Lord Virginia, could you please bring the Sea Clan gods with me to capture that Black Dragon?"
Lide turned his head and glanced at the Mermaid Main God, who was still lost in a trance.
"I want to catch the Black Dragon and tie it up in the square of Dawn City for my people to see."
Hearing this, the somewhat disheartened Mermaid Main God finally came to her senses, turned her head to look at Lide, and nodded.
"As you wish, Kachar Main God."
The other Sea Clan gods also nodded in unison.
The scene of Lide breaking the Undying Body of two Ancient Evil Gods in Dwarf Valley was utterly disheartening for them.
And he had killed the Ancient Evil Gods after battling the Master of Dawn in Nolan Capital.
This directly caused Lide’s stature in the hearts of the Sea Clan gods to rise dramatically.
At this moment, they also had the desire to demonstrate their own power and gain Lide’s recognition, especially since their previous encounters with the Ancient Evil Gods had not yielded any impressive results...
"Harrison, clear the square and inform all the residents that I need the square to tie up a dragon for them to witness..."
After Lide casually dropped those words, he turned and disappeared into thin air with the five Sea Clan gods.
Harrison immediately perked up and began issuing orders to clear the square.
Soon there was news that the Kachar City Lord was hunting the Black Dragon in the Underworld and was going to imprison it in the square, which immediately sparked heated debate and discussion among all the city residents.
---
Underworld.
The Land of Bone-Burying, now at Legendary Level, could open Space Gates within a 1500-kilometer radius, and through it, Lide appeared deep in the Underworld alongside several Sea Clan gods.
The dim and murky environment was the eternal theme of the Underworld.
Upon entering, Lide instinctively looked up at the sky, where the sky rift surging with Ancient Power appeared before him without any surprise.
His expression immediately turned colder.
The sky rift in the Underworld had widened.
Moreover, the key point was that the Underworld was not protected by the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, so it was fully exposed to the erosion of the Ancient Power.
Looking down at the ground below, the originally flamboyantly clawing underground plants, which grew twisted due to insufficient light, were now beginning to yellow.
Although these underground plants were more resistant to the Ancient Invasion due to the harsh growing environment than surface plants, in the long run, they inevitably followed the same path as those on the surface, withering and decaying.
Under the Ancient Invasion, there was not a single place in the entire world that could shelter life.
After observing for a moment, Lide let out a sigh and turned to look at the Mermaid Main God.
"Lord Virginia, can you sense your kinfolk?"
The reason there were only five Sea Clan gods grappling with the Ancient Evil Gods in Dwarf Valley was that two Sea Clan gods from the Underworld were confronting the Black Dragon.
It was unclear why the Black Dragon had undergone such drastic changes, leaving the two Sea Clan gods unable to triumph.
Initially, when Lide had learned about the Black Dragon, it had not even reached Legendary level, which was worlds apart from its current state.
The Mermaid Main God nodded slightly, sensing briefly, and then turned her gaze to the right.
"Follow me, Kachar Main God..."
After saying that, she sped off, moving as swiftly as lightning, not much slower than Castro.
Lide took out Castro’s Blade from his embrace, and a massive beast fluttering with Blade Blades appeared in mid-air.
His current flying speed was still a bit slower than Castro’s, about twice the speed of sound, and if he used Magic to accelerate, he could barely reach three times the speed of sound. Seeing that it was nearly as fast as Castro, he didn’t bother to fly on his own.
The other Sea Clan gods, seeing the two depart, also followed in a flurry.
---
---
"Accept destruction, taste death..."
In the central area of the Underworld, above a city that could accommodate more than a hundred thousand people, a giant dragon with a wingspan of thirty blades, its entire body covered in black dragon scales inscribed with Hell runes, was recklessly spewing out scorching dragon breath hot enough to melt steel.
Beneath it, the city made of rock was melting on the surface into magma due to the high temperature of the dragon breath.
That magma, like teardrops, slowly dripped down from the walls, hissing as it fell to the ground.
From the sky above, a city of magma was slowly taking shape.
And the residents of the city, they couldn’t even begin to resist before being burned to ash by the dragon breath.
This was a city mainly inhabited by lizardmen and boar people.
After Dawn City conquered the Underworld, they summarized the living habits of various underground races, and those with similar lifestyles were allocated to corresponding cities for centralized management.
Yet in the face of such terrifying life, no matter what underground race they were, they had no strength left to resist death.
When the Black Dragon massacred the city, it was as if the magic scrolls growing in the dragon scales and flesh shone even more brightly, the red light they emitted was scintillating.
And the souls of those killed below were drawn to something, frenetically surging into the magic scrolls.
After devouring more than a hundred thousand souls, the red light emitted by the magic scrolls became even more eye-catching...
"Black Dragon, you are courting death!!"
Just as the Black Dragon was rampaging in its killings, an enraged voice came from afar.
The God of Seals and the Swordfish God, responsible for guarding the Underworld, looked furiously at the city that had been destroyed before them.
They were indifferent to these underground lives and did not care much about their survival.
But they couldn’t tolerate someone doing this right under their noses; that was their duty.
The emergence of the city being slaughtered like this was their dereliction of duty.
Having just allied with Dawn City, this was their first mission, and now it had gone so poorly — they had brought shame on the Sea Clan God System.
For the two Sea Clan Gods, who wanted to perform well in their first mission and earn Lide’s acknowledgment of their strength, this scene was unforgivable!!
But this extremely difficult Black Dragon rendered them somewhat helpless; they simply couldn’t deal with this terrifying creature...
Sure enough, upon hearing the voices of the two Sea Clan Gods, the Black Dragon slowly turned around and looked down upon them in a mocking manner.
Dragon language thundered through the sky.
"Two lowly Sea Clan worms, do you think you are worthy to speak to Lord Calendor?
Now, kneel and submit, and Lord Calendor may spare your pathetic lives, allowing you to live a little longer."
Upon hearing this, the two Sea Clan Gods blew up; damn it, the audacity!
Fuming with rage, they charged towards the Black Dragon with the intent to annihilate it.
If they did not shred the Black Dragon’s foul mouth today, they would consider it a curse.
Rumble~
Three Divine Level beings instantly engaged in fierce battle.
But the scene did not unfold with the two Sea Clan Gods dominating the Black Dragon; instead, the Black Dragon fought one against two and had the Sea Clan Gods crying out in chaos.
Any contact with the dragon breath caused significant damage to them, while their attacks on the Black Dragon were completely resisted by the Hell Rune inscribed dragon scales, leaving it unscathed.
What’s more astonishing was that the magic scroll on the dragon’s head could instantly cast a High-level Forbidden Curse — Doomsday Flames.
Even for a God, being struck by a Forbidden Curse would result in severe injuries, so each time the Sea Clan Gods faced the instantly cast curse, they were flustered and distraught.
The Black Dragon surpassed the two Sea Clan Gods in physical attacks, magic attacks, physical defense, magic resistance, and even mental fortitude.
It was a complete overpowering in every aspect, so the two Sea Clan Gods, no matter how forcefully they fought, could not subdue this terrifying monster.
Instead, the Black Dragon grew more and more invigorated as the battle raged on, its taunting words never ceasing.
"Lowly crawlers, now do you understand the terror of Lord Calendor? Come now, grovel and help the Black Dragon Sovereign wipe his feet, and I might let you live a few more days..."
"Didn’t you get enough milk? Put some of that suckling strength into it..."
"Oh, unbelievable, your Divine Arts actually managed to scratch my Dragon Scale..."
The two Sea Clan Gods were so infuriated they almost spat blood, throwing themselves into the attack with abandon.
Where the titanic battle took place, the ground shattered, and rocks turned into magma.
After two Forbidden Curses, the small city below that could hold over a hundred thousand was directly leveled, with less than a thousand Lizardmen and Boar-People managing to escape.
In the dim Underworld, the battlefield of direct Divine collisions set everything around it ablaze, and even hundreds of miles away the sky glowed red with the reflection of the flames.
The scene was extremely shocking.
---
---
Lide, while flying, immediately urged Castro to speed up upon seeing the red glare in the distance.
Despite the distance, he could already sense the dispersing Dragon Power.
Even the earth below bore witness to the charred aftermath of the Dragon Breath and the popping sparks that ignited.
Moments later, 5 Sea Clan Gods and Lide drew near to the ruins of that small city.
Upon seeing the state of the battlefield, Lide’s gaze turned icy cold, his heart filled with chilling intent.
A city lay in complete collapse before him, its molten state from the intense heat having turned it into a city of magma.
He could feel countless lives had just perished, and the air still held the traces of souls...
Regardless of the race that lived in this city, they were all his subjects, his followers.
His gaze moved up from the ruins of the city.
In the sky above, a Black Dragon exuding an evil aura was unrestrainedly spewing scorching Dragon Breath, the black smoke from the burning land laden with dizzying, toxic fumes.
And the city that was destroyed, was clearly the doing of this terrifying being.
At this moment, the two Sea Clan Gods were fiercely clashing with it, the battle extraordinarily intense.
However, despite their ferocity, the two Sea Clan Gods could hardly inflict any damage to the Black Dragon. Its Solid Dragon Scales were like mountains, immovable.
In contrast, each breath from the Black Dragon or its casting of Dragon Language Magic forced the two Sea Clan Gods into an exceptionally sorry state, prone to taking a hit if they weren’t careful.
Realizing this, Lide’s brow furrowed tightly. He was just about to issue a command
When the two Sea Clan Gods battling the Black Dragon cried out in wild joy, calling loudly for backup.
Lide’s gaze turned cold as he glanced at the domineering Black Dragon, his intent to kill almost reaching its Extreme.
"Frey, seal the surrounding space to prevent the Black Dragon from breaking through and escaping."
"Virginia, lead the Sea Clan Gods in the assault on the Black Dragon. Be careful of the Divine Artifact he carries. I want him captured alive!"
His tone left no room for negotiation, ordering directly in the manner of a superior to a subordinate.
Upon hearing this, Frey’s figure vanished immediately. This Death Blazing Angel, whom he had personally corrupted, always executed his orders unconditionally.
In contrast, the Mermaid Main God frowned, Lide’s tone stirring some displeasure in her heart, but realizing he was angered by the destruction of the city, she did not voice any objection.
The other Sea Clan Gods also did not express any dissent.
After all, their efforts to resist the Ancient Evil God in Dwarf Valley had been less than admirable, and it was Lide who had resolved the problem.
In Dwarf Valley, the authority Lide had established now proved effective.
Power speaks.truth.
The mermaid Main God grasped her trident and glanced at the few Sea Gods beside her. Without uttering a word, she charged at the Black Dragon with a furious aura, her eyes filled with rage.
Clearly, she was venting her anger received from Lide onto the Black Dragon.
The other Sea Gods immediately followed suit.
In an instant, the Black Dragon, which had been smugly snide moments ago, had its expression stiffen and its eyes filled with fury.
"These damn Sea Clan reptiles, how dare you challenge the great Black Dragon Sovereign!?"
"Back off!!"
"Today, I will show you how the breath of a Black Dragon can destroy this world!!"
After speaking, the magic scroll above its head flashed with a red light. The Black Dragon’s throat lit up with an intense light, then it opened its massive maw and belched out a stream of scorching Dragon Breath that seared through space itself.
Sizzle~
The space within several hundred blades’ reach distorted due to the high temperature.
The mermaid Main God’s expression turned cold. The trident in her hands burst forth with a deep blue divine glow, and whoosh~ the sky suddenly poured down rain.
Correct content is on
Not even the scorching Dragon Breath could evaporate the droplets of rain condensed by Divine Power.
Among the downpour, the combat power of the Sea Clan Gods surged greatly, and they immediately began their assault on the Black Dragon.
The Black Dragon, fearless, began to fight back vigorously against the 1v7.
However, as impressive as taking on seven adversaries seemed, after just a couple of minutes, the giant dragon, who had initially scorned all under heaven, was already exhausted.
Despite having a formidable defense and aberrant attack power, it couldn’t withstand the storm-like offensive of seven Sea Gods.
Moreover, the mermaid Main God wielded a High-level Divine Artifact, the trident.
The trident was incomparable to the weapons of other Sea Clan Gods. Each strike left distinct scars on the Black Dragon’s massive body, and even dragon scales inscribed with Hell Runes could not withstand the bite of the trident’s edge.
In contrast, the Black Dragon’s Dragon Language Magic, though oppressive, could be withstood with the other Divine beings sharing the burden.
The concentrated attacks of the seven Sea Gods exceeded the saturation point of the Black Dragon’s defenses, causing the dragon scales to gradually suffer damage.
Lide looked on with an indifferent expression, not lifting a finger to help.
In terms of strength, he would have been superfluous in the fight; there was no need for him to join.
As for status, he was the undisputed final boss, the Sovereign of Dawn, and his intervention was not required.
A Black Dragon required his intervention, the Sovereign of Dawn himself? Were the Sea Clan Gods incompetent? Was Frey just for show? When had an emperor ever taken to the battlefield as a foot soldier?
He only needed to wait for his allies to defeat and capture the Black Dragon, bind it, and make it kneel before him. All he had to do was to issue the command that would decide its life or death.
That was the proper way to play this game.
However, contrary to Lide’s expectations, what he thought would be a quick takedown by the seven Sea Clan Gods, including the mermaid Main God wielding the trident, a boss in her own right, the Black Dragon was still fiercely clashing with them ten minutes later, exhibiting extraordinary combat strength.
The Sea Clan Gods grew more infuriated as the battle dragged on.
It was one thing not to kill the Ancient Evil God in Dwarf Valley, given that it was the chief culprit that plunged the whole world into darkness and chaos, mysterious and inscrutable.
But now, the entire Ocean God System was struggling against a single Black Dragon, especially when the aura the Black Dragon emitted was only at the level of a weaker Divine being.
It was a disgrace for them.
There stood Lide, watching.
As allies of Lide, who had easily toppled two Ancient Evil Gods upon his arrival at Dwarf Valley, it was embarrassing that they had to fight the Black Dragon for so long now.
Consumed by anger, they began to attack without restraint, unabashedly using Forbidden Curses, Divine Arts, and Bloodline Skills against the Black Dragon.
The Black Dragon was horrifyingly resilient, and each time it suffered severe injury, the magic scroll fused into its flesh and scales would channel a surge of energy into its body, enabling rapid recovery.
Although it wasn’t indestructible like the Ancient Evil God, the exaggerated defensive power of its scales and the lethal heat of its Dragon Breath actually made it more troublesome than the Ancient Evil God.
The Mermaid Main God, growing truly enraged as the battle wore on, made the divine light on her trident burst forth, as if it could shatter the stars, and began to attack furiously without concern for the drain on her power.
The Black Dragon had been spouting insolent retorts at the start, but soon it couldn’t even speak, as large chunks of its body began to crumble away, its flesh blurring, forced into a desperate flight.
It wasn’t until after being besieged for over twenty minutes that the Black Dragon’s body became covered with densely packed scars, hundreds in total, with several so deep they revealed half its internal organs.
The Magic Scroll embedded in its scales and flesh was providing less and less of a reprieve from such grave injuries, gradually becoming insufficient to sustain it.
Sensing its life rapidly draining away, and even possibly facing its end right there, the Black Dragon roared in fury.
"These lowly worms!! You cannot contend with the great Black Dragon Sovereign!! Forbidden Magic!!"
Having spoken, an infinite Dragon Power erupted, directly binding the Magic Power in the surrounding space.
Hearing this death-defying roar, several of the Sea Clan Gods were taken aback; then, they quickly retreated, escaping the range of the Forbidden Magic, their faces full of caution.
However, the seemingly furious Black Dragon showed a hint of cunning; the Magic Scroll on its head burst forth with boundless power, tearing open space itself, and then with a flap of its wings, it flew into the void.
"Wait until the great Black Dragon Sovereign has recovered, then I will return to bestow Death upon you!! Curse you, wretched worms!!"
This Black Dragon, unabashed by the pride typical of giant dragons, was actually trying to flee.
The face of the Mermaid Main God changed; if the Black Dragon escaped, how could she stand tall in front of Lide after this?
Infinite Divine Power poured into her trident from her hand.
The trident immediately erupted with a dazzling divine light.
In the nick of time, the Mermaid Main God hurled the trident directly at the Black Dragon.
At this moment, half of the Black Dragon’s body had already entered the void, sensing the terrifying attack coming but not turning back to defend, instead increasing its speed to enter the void.
The trident came hurtling through the air with infinite Divine Power; pfft—the sharp blade effortlessly penetrated the dragon scales, impaling the Black Dragon from behind and exiting through the belly, bringing with it dragon blood and organs.
It was completely transfixed.
Leaving behind a massive wound where you could see straight through from the back to the abdomen, with dragon blood spraying out.
Nevertheless, the Black Dragon, already resigned to leaving, did not hesitate despite such a severe injury and flapped its wings, disappearing into the void.
The trident now stood erect, embedded in the ground.
The very next second after the Black Dragon hid in the void, the Mermaid Main God appeared on the spot, an infinite burst of divine light in her hands, directly shattering a hundred blade diameter of the void.
However, after the void burst apart, there was no trace of the Black Dragon to be seen.
It had disappeared.
The faces of the other Sea Clan Gods present turned extremely ugly.
Their Divine System had laid siege to a Black Dragon, and it had managed to escape right in front of them?!!
They all glanced subconsciously at Lide in the distance, each filled with immense shame.
What a disgrace!!!
The Mermaid Main God was also ferociously angry, even feeling too ashamed to face Lide at this moment.
They had been trusted by him, yet they...
But just then, boom—
A thunderous explosion erupted in the sky, followed by space shattering apart not far from the Mermaid Main God, and the Black Dragon that had just vanished flew back covered in a deluge of blood.
The Sea Clan Gods immediately widened their eyes, seeing a Death Blazing Angel with twelve black wings standing firmly on the Black Dragon’s head, suppressing it with an undeniably dominant presence.
The Black Dragon had been retrieved??
Their faces showed immediate surprise and delight, their hearts roller-coasting from deep lows to soaring highs, suddenly filling with affection for Frey.
Luckily, this Death Blazing Angel was here; otherwise, they really would have suffered a supreme embarrassment today.
Frey had been waiting and had hidden herself, ready to prevent the Black Dragon’s escape, closely monitoring every move it made.
The Black Dragon, desperate to escape, disregarded everything and withstood the deadly blow of the trident.
After being severely injured and sinking into the void, it was so weak that Frey easily captured it.
Boom~
The giant dragon’s body crashed into the ground like a falling meteor, instantly splitting the earth and sending a shower of soil and rocks into the air.
Roar~
The Black Dragon let out a painful howl, still trying to resist, but its injuries were too severe. After struggling a few times, it could not get up.
In the end, it could only wail miserably, like a dying beast, its countless wounds adding to its pitiful state.
However, those present didn’t pity the Black Dragon. The city of hundreds of thousands was still ablaze, and it seemed the underground race would be buried there forever.
At that moment, Lide commanded Castro to approach the battlefield, watching the Black Dragon below with a cold gaze.
"Lord Virginia, I trouble you to seal this Black Dragon’s power and then bring it back to Twilight City."
Familiarity breeds acceptance. The Mermaid Main God was already somewhat amenable to Lide’s commands, and having just made a blunder, she readily nodded and agreed.
With a swift move, trident in hand, she approached the gasping Black Dragon, which appeared extremely weakened.
The Black Dragon’s eyelids lifted, and upon seeing the Mermaid Main God approaching, it tried to struggle to its feet, its throat starting to blaze again.
Seeing this, the Mermaid Main God gave a cold laugh. The trident in her hand burst forth with a brilliant azure Divine Power, and she thrust it directly at the Black Dragon’s head.
The Black Dragon, even in perfect condition, could not avoid her attack. Now weakened, it could not escape as the trident pierced its head with unstoppable force.
Lide, watching, felt a shock in his heart and instinctively wanted to call out to stop her. He still needed this dragon in Dawn City, and it would be pointless if it died...
But thankfully, though the trident pierced the Black Dragon’s skull, it did not penetrate through.
Drenched in dragon blood, the trident erupted in dazzling light, directly dispelling the Black Dragon’s power, snuffing out the fiery Dragon Breath brewing in its throat with a puff.
Upon seeing the sealing complete, the Mermaid Main God waved her hand, retrieving the trident to her side.
The surrounding Sea Clan Gods began to cast spells cooperatively. In a moment, a giant bubble enveloped the Black Dragon.
Once encased in the bubble, the Black Dragon’s eyes slowly closed, falling into a deep sleep, obviously sealed away.
Lide slightly nodded in approval.
"Please take it back to Twilight City."
After giving his instructions, he directed Castro to head straight back to Twilight City, treating the Sea Clan Gods effectively as his subordinates.
As Lide disappeared, the Sea Clan Gods instinctively turned to look at the Mermaid Main God.
She glared at them irritably.
"What are you waiting for? Do you need my help?"
The Sea Clan Gods shuddered and quickly cast spells to make the bubble float and move toward Twilight City.
The Mermaid Main God’s expression was complex as she watched this scene unfold.
For some reason, she felt that from the moment Lide commanded her, the Sea Clan God System was inevitably going to be integrated into Dawn City...
That man always had a special charm that inspired trust.
It was so when they first met in the Lost Sea, so when they formed an alliance in Dawn City, and still so just now...
Perhaps some are born to be leaders.
She lightly caressed the trident in her hand with her thumb, sighing softly.
This Divine Artifact, passed down to her by her father, symbolized the Sea Clan’s authority and power. Whoever held the trident was the Sea Clan’s leader.
But ever since she received the trident tens of thousands of years ago, she rarely felt genuine recognition and reverence from the Sea Clan Gods.
Feeling somewhat disheartened, she sighed, shook her head, and stopped dwelling on it as her figure moved to catch up with the Sea Clan Gods ahead...

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 494: This Despicable Vampire is Too Cunning (8400 words)
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Chapter 494: This Despicable Vampire is Too Cunning (8400 words)
Twilight City.
Originally, this city was used by the Half-Elves to guard the Mud Marsh, but now it hosted over 300,000 members of the underground races.
After Lide conquered the underworld, he had gathered the various races, originally scattered in different places, within the city.
This made it easier to spread the teachings, manage the races, and utilize their special characteristics.
Thus, the gathering of underground races in the city had become the mainstream, with those living outside turning into the minority.
In Earth’s terms, this was a significant acceleration in the urbanization process.
When Lide flew into Twilight City, he could clearly sense the tense atmosphere below, with fully drawn crossbows and vigilant soldiers, while Magic Language Bats had already taken flight to scout the surroundings.
They were obviously guarding against something.
When Castro’s massive figure appeared, it noticeably heightened the tension, with many warriors already aiming their crossbolts at him.
"The Black Dragon has been captured by me, stand down from alert."
Lide’s indifferent voice echoed through Twilight City, while the presence of the God of Twilight spread all around.
At least 90 percent of the city’s inhabitants were his followers, and sensing that familiar aura, there arose a chorus of cheers and rejoicing, causing the entire city to erupt in uproar.
It was the great God of Twilight, their faith! This was an oracle!
Even the soldiers still on alert quickly relaxed, and a portion of the Bloodline stationed on the city walls, sensing Lide’s presence, also showed beaming smiles.
Whoo-Whoo~
Wearing steel armor, Castro flew into the city under the soldiers’ watch, while Lide, from high above, could clearly feel that the city was several times more prosperous than when the Half-Elves controlled it.
Once Castro landed at the City Lord’s mansion, Audis and Andabella, who were second-generation Bloodline stationed in the underworld, along with Guido Blackwind from the Centaur Empire, quickly gathered around.
"Welcome, Your Majesty."
"Kachar City Lord, good day."
Audis was one of the original seven Bloodline under Lide when he took over the underworld, tasked with being the supreme commander and managing the underworld.
After joining Dawn City, Lide had sent this proud girl, Andabella, to assist Audis with managing the underworld and provide him a secure rear.
Guido Blackwind, now the king of the Centaurs, moved millions of Centaurs directly to the underworld after conquering the Low Hills, and has since ruled the Centaurs here.
Centaurs aren’t really suited to live in the underworld; vast grasslands are their actual home. But with the world almost on the brink of destruction, finding a safe place was good enough, and no one had the time to look for grasslands for them.
"Good day."
Lide nodded at the three.
"That Black Dragon disrupting the underworld has been captured by me.
The Sea Clan Gods are escorting it, and it will be sent here shortly.
You can arrange an exhibition to display the Black Dragon to the public for three days, and then arrange for its return to Dawn City."
The Black Dragon had been causing panic in the underworld these days, and capturing this powerful beast was naturally meant to calm people’s hearts, while also helping to spread the faith.
This Black Dragon was a true giant dragon; capturing such a creature was definitely a great help in spreading the faith.
It was also a way of recycling waste.
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Audis nodded, but his face still seemed somewhat worried, as if he was not just concerned about the Black Dragon...
It wasn’t just Audis; both Guido and Andabella also had solemn expressions, and hearing about the capture of the Black Dragon didn’t bring them much excitement.
Lide sensitively picked up on this and asked in a deep voice.
"What happened? Why do you look so troubled?"
Castro’s face grew uglier. He took a few deep breaths before speaking bitterly.
"Your Majesty, the food in the Underworld... it’s completely failed."
Lide was shocked. The food had failed?
The reason why he considered the Underworld as a major backup was not only its isolation from the outside world but also because it was capable of large-scale food production.
Although Microglow Mushrooms didn’t taste very good and weren’t particularly nutritious, at least they could fill stomachs and sustain a significant number of people.
Now, Castro’s words undoubtedly chilled him to the bone.
His thoughts swiftly turned, quickly pinpointing the key issue, and he said in a focused tone,
"Was it caused by the third Divine Calamity?"
The ancient air from above had corroded most of the plants, already causing a withering of countless trees, and the cracks in the sky of the Underworld were no less severe than those above. There were no other reasons that could have led to a complete crop failure.
Beside him, Andabella, who hadn’t spoken until now, showed a hint of apology, nodded, then shook her head.
"Lord of Kachar, it wasn’t entirely due to the third Divine Calamity. The ancient power in the Underworld was already quite dense. The growth of the Microglow Mushrooms was slowed because of this, and they were barely surviving...
A few Sunshine Hours ago, when the sky’s crack widened, it triggered a tidal surge of ancient energy in the Underworld. The already fragile Microglow Mushrooms withered and died within minutes..."
"How great is the loss?" Lide asked in a grave tone.
Castro promptly responded,
"The growth cycle of Microglow Mushrooms was originally just over a month, but due to the dense ancient power, it had extended to two and a half months.
We mobilized millions of people to expand the planting area to maintain the harvest.
The current planting area was twenty times that of last year!
They were half a month from being harvested, but now...
It’s estimated that this loss amounts to about enough food to feed tens of millions of ordinary humans for a year..."
Lide trembled inside, feeling as if his heart was bleeding.
Since the coming of the ancient times, food reserves were already low, and he had also taken in over five million humans from Green City and over three million Centaurs from the low hills.
The shortage of food had always haunted him like a curse.
Although they later developed the Dawn Plains and used automated machinery for cultivation, producing just enough food to meet the demand,
the problem was that the current stocks were too low. Any change, such as the Dawn Plains being unable to produce food for a year, would immediately lead to a severe food crisis.
That’s why he so highly valued food security and had always focused on the cultivation of Microglow Mushrooms in the Underworld...
But Andabella’s subsequent words weighed even heavier on Lide’s heart.
"That’s not even the key issue. The crucial point is—if we can’t eliminate the ancient energy, we won’t be able to cultivate Microglow Mushrooms ever again.
In fact, not just Microglow Mushrooms, other food crops will also become unplantable..."
In other words, it wasn’t just this season’s crops that had failed, but the future prospects were grim, too.
This sudden news was akin to a harsh stab to Lide.
A heart-wrenching pain.
Including the Cave Dwellers, the Underworld was home to over twenty million lives.
If they couldn’t produce food, relying solely on the Dawn Plains—though barely manageable—would mean tying the fate of Dawn City entirely to the Dawn Plains.
If a crop failure or similar issue occurred in the Dawn Plains, Dawn City would face an unprecedented disaster where millions, potentially tens of millions, would starve to death.
Lately, everything had been progressing smoothly, filling Lide with confidence, but at this moment, he could only muster a bitter smile.
"Such a lack of martial virtue, the main base has been stolen..."
With a wave of his hand, the Destiny Tablet Fragment seized from the Nolan Capital appeared before everyone.
Lide took a deep breath.
"This is a fragment of the Destiny Tablet, once activated, it will restore the rules within a hundred kilometers to the state before the ancient arrival.
You must immediately find a suitable place, I will place the fragment of the Destiny Tablet underground."
Initially, he had planned to use this fragment in Dawn City, but now he couldn’t care about that anymore.
As the rear main base in the Underworld, it must be stabilized, the food needed for over twenty million people is a strict constraint, not to be slackened in the slightest.
He dared not imagine the scene of tens of millions of people without food ... that would absolutely be a nightmare.
Hearing this, several people were immediately shaken, surprise evident in their eyes.
Lide unexpectedly wanted to place such an important thing in the Underworld ...
However, Andabella was not too surprised by this.
As the former City Lord of Risier City, she understood better what food meant for a power; it was the lifeblood, the foundation—without food, even an empire ruling the Multi-dimensional Plane would collapse instantly.
As Audis hastened away to research the suitable location to place the Destiny Tablet Fragment.
Inhabitants of Twilight City suddenly made a loud ruckus.
Lide faintly turned his head upon hearing the noise and looked into the distance.
Above the sky, a huge bubble floated over.
Even more eye-catching was that the bubble seemed like an incredibly solid cage, imprisoning a Black Dragon covered in scars.
And seven Sea Clan Gods, like heroes returning in triumph, were arranged on both sides escorting the Black Dragon into Twilight City.
Below, the citizens burst into cheers and exultation, the noise seeming to shake the city walls.
The Black Dragon had previously attempted to destroy Twilight City several times, fortunately, two Sea Clan Gods had risked their lives, forcibly making it change its mind, otherwise, the city would have been destroyed.
Having witnessed the Black Dragon’s strength, the residents were naturally immensely excited to see this legendary horrifying creature being captured.
After the Black Dragon was escorted by the Sea Clan Gods to the city center square, immediately tens of thousands of people surged in to watch, the scene exceptionally lively.
Preachers of Twilight Sect also opportunistically appeared, using the capture of the Black Dragon as a basis to start promoting the power of the God of Twilight ...
Seeing such a scene, Lide was not very excited internally; he was still pondering the impact of this total crop failure on Dawn City.
He had previously underestimated the power of the ancient days.
He had thought that possessing two fragments of the Destiny Tablet would allow him to rest easy.
But the total crop failure across the entire Underworld had severely taught him a lesson.
To keep Dawn City safe, two fragments were far from enough, maybe five or even ten would he need to stabilize his territory.
This hard lesson seriously pained him, more than losing hundreds of thousands of troops in a battle.
"We must continue to search for fragments of the Destiny Tablet, these two are still unable to guarantee the food supply, any problems that arise, Twilight City will face immense pressure.
Especially since I plan to relocate the population of Nolan Capital to the southern provinces.
These tens of millions of people are tens of millions of mouths that howl for food, the daily consumption is enough to cause headaches."
In contemplation, Lide returned to the manor house in the City Lord’s estate.
The Sea Clan Gods who had just enjoyed the worship of the people of Twilight City also came to the manor with some excitement.
The feeling of being worshiped was indeed exhilarating; they had rarely felt this genuine emotion from races other than the Sea Clan.
Lide looked at the Mermaid Main God and after musing for a moment, he inquired.
"Lord Virginia, from where did you find the Water Element Plane used to relocate the Sea Clan?"
The population of the Nolan Capital was a huge piece of fat meat; he didn’t want to just give it up.
But before that, he had to find a container capable of relocating the population, whether it be a Plane or a Divine Country, he ultimately needed one, or else he wouldn’t be able to get his mouth on that fat meat.
The Mermaid Main God didn’t expect Lide to suddenly ask this question. After organizing her thoughts, she slowly said,
"This Plane was not found by me, but a Lost Plane my father encountered in the Chaos Void during his early years.
This Plane is very suitable for the survival of the Sea Clan and has a broad range, so my father brought it back to the Sea Clan..."
On hearing this, Lide’s face was speechless.
These second-generation gods really are something, casually inheriting multiple Planes. How does one even argue with that?
He didn’t waste any more words, and explained the situation of the Nolan Capital to the Mermaid Main God, then directly said,
"I need a Plane that can relocate populations, and even allow tens of millions of humans to survive there for a while. Could you help me with this, Lord Virginia?"
Hearing this, the Mermaid Main God felt somewhat envious.
Lide makes a move and soon tens of millions of potential believers could be added to his account—what a wealth of believers!
However, she also knew her limits. These believers already belonged to others; if she dared to take them by force, the repercussions from those Divine Beings of the Light Attribute would be unimaginably severe upon discovery.
The Ocean God System had always had conflicts with the terrestrial Divine Systems.
Offending over a hundred Divine Beings at once was not something the Sea Clan was brave enough to attempt.
Yet, for some reason, she didn’t feel it strange for Lide to attempt it, nor did it seem overly worrying.
It seemed as though nothing was a problem for this man.
She couldn’t remember when exactly Lide had given her such a positive impression...
"This matter will take time."
The Mermaid Main God didn’t rashly agree but spoke cautiously.
"A Plane suitable for human life isn’t one of those with incomplete regulations or that are utterly chaotic. The easy-to-find ones have already been discovered."
Lide knew this was the case as well, so he did not feel disappointed.
"Then I’ll leave it to you, Lord Virginia.
This population is a precious resource for Dawn City.
Moreover, we stand together, sharing common interests and goals; if we grow stronger, then the Sea Clan God System grows stronger."
After finishing his speech, his tone became serious.
"I promise you, if this transfer of the Capital’s population succeeds, I can share a portion of the believers with the Sea Clan God System, no less than two million, and we can share the spoils together."
The heart of the Sea Clan Gods, initially somewhat conflicted, immediately spirited up, showing surprise and disbelief.
Is Lide willing to share believers??
If it had been any other Divine Being, they would’ve scorned such a statement as believers are the foundation of a Divine Being’s existence; sharing anything is possible except for these vital elements.
But when these words came from Lide, they involuntarily believed him.
Thanks to Lide’s reputation for his reliable manner, he already held a high position in their hearts.
Even the Mermaid Main God looked deeply at Lide upon hearing these words.
At this moment, she seemed thoughtful, as if understanding why the other was so charismatic.
What they regarded as treasures didn’t seem like much to him... It wasn’t surprising that he was so attractive.
Lide watched the change in attitude of the few Sea Clan Gods and smiled faintly.
The matter of transferring the population of Nolan Capital still hasn’t made any headway, having a promise now that can make the other party work for him seemed like a capitalistic dream of the year.
Of course, if the population were really transferred, he wouldn’t be stingy.
Giving the other party two million believers out of tens of millions of people was nothing, now that the Ocean God System had become his subordinates, their strength was his strength.
Although these subordinates weren’t officially aligned and outwardly maintained an ally’s stance.
But after these two commands, they had already started to undergo a mental shift.
He didn’t ask for much, just obedience to his commands; as for whether they truly submitted, it didn’t matter. He was always a pragmatist.
A moment later, Lide seemed to remember something and asked with a touch of curiosity,
"Lord Virginia, my Divine Country has been anchored at Dawn City for some reason, and I’m temporarily unable to use it.
So, I’m not sure if you can still utilize a Divine Country?"
Although he didn’t have a genuine Divine Country, the Land of Bone-Burying wasn’t too different from a Divine Country, so this assertion was somewhat plausible.
The mermaid Main God didn’t suspect anything and spoke with a somewhat complex tone,
"When the Destiny Tablet shattered and the gods became saints, our Divine Countries were sealed, completely immobilizing them.
Even three of my kin’s Divine Countries collapsed directly, destroying millions of years of accumulation overnight..."
This revelation made the three Sea Clan Gods beside her look distinctly upset, clearly touching on a sore subject.
So that’s how it was, no wonder these gods hadn’t utilized a Divine Country.
Lide nodded his head.
"How then can the seal be lifted?"
"Based on my speculation, it might be possible to use them either by restoring power to its peak to reshape the Divine Country’s rules or perhaps by waiting for the world’s rules to normalize, and the Divine Country to automatically restore."
At present, both conditions were hard to achieve.
Regaining strength needed a vast amount of time, and for the world to normalize was even more unlikely; not having the world destroyed soon would also be an achievement.
Lide pondered, this didn’t seem completely disadvantageous...
If the Divine Country could be utilized, when in Nolan Capital, the Master of Dawn would have already summoned a group of Holy Spirits from the Divine Country to gang up on him.
Each god’s Divine Country housed devout believers from their lifetime, with some powerful believers being cultivated into Holy Spirits by the gods, generally with strength at the Demigod or even Divine Level.
Once a divine war occurred with other gods, these Holy Spirits would be the warriors at the forefront.
Frey, this twelve-winged Blazing Angel, was chosen from the most powerful Holy Spirits by the Master of Dawn and cultivated using endless resources.
Nurturing this type of Divine Monster beloved by gods like twelve-winged Blazing Angels was extremely difficult and also particularly draining on original power.
This was also why the opposition was reluctant to let go.
Of course, the drawbacks of the Divine Country being inoperable were evident, as the Light Gods’ power was significantly weakened during the battle against the Ancient Evil God.
After pondering for a moment, Lide shook his head; whether the Divine Country could be utilized wasn’t something he could change, thinking more was useless.
He then turned his attention to the Black Dragon that had just been captured.
"How is the status of that Black Dragon?"
The God of Seals spoke from beside him, "The Black Dragon’s life force is extremely tenacious, though it’s heavily wounded, it’s not life-threatening yet.
It has now been imprisoned by our Divine Arts, falling into a deep sleep.
As long as it remains within the bubble, the Black Dragon’s condition will stay the same, its injuries won’t heal, nor will they get worse."
Lide slightly nodded.
"Is it possible to remove the Magic Scroll from the opponent’s head?"
The twelve magic scrolls embedded on the Black Dragon’s skull were artifacts snatched from the goblins.
The two fragments of divine artifacts that he had on him were torn from the magic scrolls on the Black Dragon.
Over a year ago, this Black Dragon hadn’t even reached the Legendary level, but now its battle power has directly ascended to Divine-level, which was completely illogical.
And judging from its condition today, it was inevitably because of the magic scrolls.
This also filled him with curiosity about the twelve magic scrolls on the Black Dragon.
"The magic scrolls are connected to that Black Dragon’s soul, removing them could possibly kill the dragon on the spot..." The God of Seals honestly responded.
They had been curious about the artifact when they captured the Black Dragon, but they couldn’t remove it.
Lide frowned, was there such an oddity?
"Let’s go check it out together."
Instantly, he took the people with him to the central town square.
Upon arriving at the square, the area was already crowded with various races—Beastmen, Centaurs, Humans, Lizardfolk, Harpies... and so on.
The races were more mixed than the types of animals in a zoo.
Soldiers parted the crowd, and under the fervent gaze of the surrounding races, Lide approached the Black Dragon enclosed in a transparent bubble.
Standing in front of this dragon with a wingspan of 30 blades, its massive size brought a considerable sense of oppression.
Although it was asleep, the pervasive Dragon Power still made everyone in the square feel as if a large rock pressed against their chests.
At the moment, the Black Dragon was covered in scars, and its flesh was still churning; likely due to the bubble, there was no dragon blood seeping from the wounds.
With a measure of curiosity, Lide opened the attribute panel of the Black Dragon.
Hell Black Dragon—Calendor
Level: 32
Divinity: 2000 points
Status: Severely injured, asleep.
Skill: ??
Bloodline: Hell Black Dragon Bloodline
Description: After swallowing a portion of Hell Power from a Divine Artifact sealed with Hell Power, it transformed into a divine being, spitting flames with a lethal hellish aura.
After seeing the Black Dragon’s attributes, Lide’s eyes narrowed.
There was indeed something bizarre about this creature.
The reason it became so strong was because it had swallowed a portion of Hell Power from a Divine Artifact sealed with Hell Power...
What was sealed with Hell Power?
His gaze turned toward the magic scroll fused with the dragon scales and flesh.
Sealed with Hell Power?
Was this serious?
Lide’s gaze deepened, his thoughts beginning to churn.
In the myths he had collected, Hell was divided into nine layers, with each layer guarded by a formidable Hell Demon Lord, and together with the Lord of Nine Prisons, the Hell Camp possessed ten powerful Evil Gods.
In terms of numbers, the Hell Camp was not considered strong, but the fact that the Lord of Nine Prisons alone elevated the entire camp’s battle power, making the entire Glory wary of underestimating Hell, showcased the might of the Lord of Nine Prisons.
The myths he collected were widely circulated and should pose no significant issues.
"But now the system upgrade mentions that the Twelve Magic Scrolls have sealed a part of Hell’s power..."
"Is there a special meaning to this? I’ve never heard that the power of Hell was incomplete."
"Moreover, this power directly transformed the Black Dragon from a creature who had yet to set foot into the Legendary, into a Level 32 Divine Monster, which is frankly quite exaggerated."
"What baffles him more is that the Black Dragon obtained the Twelve Magic Scrolls long ago; why did it only acquire their power now?"
"Previously, it was considering conspiring with the Naga to break through to Legendary in the Abyss, then to conquer the Underworld."
"All of this clearly does not conform to common sense."
"If the Black Dragon had obtained this power earlier, given a dragon’s arrogant nature, it would not have hidden and pretended until now; it would have already started to conquer the Underworld."
"Then, what could be the reason that the Black Dragon only obtained the power of Hell from the Divine Artifact it had long possessed?"
"What secret is hidden here?"
"The system’s introduction made Lide feel as if he had glimpsed some secret, but, frustrated by the scarcity of information, he could not make an effective judgment."
"Wake him up, I want to question him myself."
"With doubts in his mind, he naturally could not just overlook it, deciding to personally probe the Black Dragon."
"Upon hearing this, the Sea Clan God immediately stepped forward to cast a spell, and a moment later, a torrent of azure energy entered the bubble. The bubble instantly emitted a dazzling light, and the sleeping Black Dragon slowly awoke amidst the shining light."
"The giant dragon’s eyes opened, blinking a few times to clear the surroundings, then it became furiously enraged."
"Damn vermin, you dare to imprison the mighty Black Dragon Sovereign!!"
"You shall receive the punishment of the Lord of Nine Prisons!!"
"Lide’s gaze sharpened, Lord of Nine Prisons? Was this Black Dragon bluffing, or did it truly have a connection with the Lord of Nine Prisons?"
"Considering it swallowed Hell’s power to become a Level 32 Divine Monster, his thoughts raced."
"His eyes turned to the Sea Clan God."
"Take this Black Dragon to the City Lord’s estate."
"This wasn’t a suitable place to inquire about overly secret matters, and the information gleaned from the Black Dragon piqued his curiosity about the mysteries involved."
"He acutely sensed that this matter was definitely not so simple."
"The Sea Clan God instantly understood and cast a spell to make the bubble float."
"The Black Dragon tried to struggle, but with its power sealed, it could only be a lamb to the slaughter."
"The crowd watching the Black Dragon being removed was somewhat disappointed, but for most people, today was exciting enough; first, the Black Dragon was captured, then they saw the great God of Twilight, which was enough to satisfy them."
"Upon arriving at the City Lord’s estate, Lide had cleared the area, ordering everyone to leave, even the Mermaid Main God."
"The reason was that this interrogation involved the secrets of Hell, and knowing them would do no good for the Sea Clan."
"Out of trust in Lide, the Mermaid Main God did not doubt him."
"Once the crowd had left, Lide waved his hand, and a massive Magic Shield rose, cutting off the external world and eliminating the possibility of being spied on."
"After completing these arrangements, Lide revealed his true Bloodline form, and an evil aura permeated the area."
"His blood-red eyes coldly gazed at the Black Dragon that was furiously cursing inside the bubble, his tone as chilling as frost."
"Black Dragon, I am a believer of the great Lord of Nine Prisons, you filthy lowlife, dare to fraudulently use the Lord of Nine Prisons’ name!
"Who gave you the courage?!!"
"After speaking, the Dark Faith Power of the Twilight Sect operated, and various titles and Skills burst forth, the atmosphere around due to the revelation of the Bloodline true form became exceedingly malevolent, at this moment he was darker than Hell."
"Hearing Lide’s words and sensing his evil aura, the Black Dragon’s eyes widened, filled with surprise."
"Then, as if remembering something, it began shaking its head repeatedly."
"Impossible, you lowly crawler, don’t think you can deceive the great Black Dragon Sovereign!!"
Lide sneered and pulled out two Divine Artifact Fragments given to him by the goblin from his bosom, gesturing to the Black Dragon.
"Impossible? What is this? The Lord of Nine Prisons sent me to retrieve the Divine Artifact Fragments and to continue searching for the remaining artifacts to return to the Sovereign.
You dare to usurp the Nine Prisons Sovereign’s Divine Artifact—a capital crime!!"
As the Lord of Hell, with the Twelve Magic Scrolls sealing Hell’s power, if there was no connection, Lide could stuff his fist in his mouth...
So, he directly started to deceive the Black Dragon.
And coincidentally, he happened to have two Divine Artifact Fragments on hand, which undoubtedly greatly increased his credibility.
Sure enough, upon seeing the Divine Artifact Fragments in Lide’s hand, the Black Dragon immediately showed disbelief and shock.
"How is it possible!! Didn’t the Nine Prisons Sovereign say that the Purgatory Scroll was only for my use?? How did you get the Divine Artifact Fragment?
No, that’s not right, the Divine Artifact Fragment was torn apart by those damned goblins; you must have gotten it from the goblins!"
Lide’s heart sank, indeed the Black Dragon’s power was related to the Lord of Nine Prisons.
This was troublesome.
Thinking of that terrifying existence with a fearsome reputation and combat power through the roof, he felt somewhat vexed.
"Hmph, these were retrieved by me on the orders of the Nine Prisons Sovereign, and those goblins are a thing of the past..."
"Don’t change the subject, you dare use the name of the Lord of Nine Prisons to attack my city, the crime is unforgivable!"
The Black Dragon roared with fury.
"How dare you deceive the great Black Dragon Sovereign, I slaughtered those lowly crawlers to obtain fresh human souls, you don’t even know this and dare speak..."
Mid-sentence, as if suddenly thinking of something, he abruptly closed his mouth, then looked at Lide with a face full of rage, if looks could kill, Lide might have already been killed a thousand times.
This contemptible vampire was too cunning, trapping him into revealing too much.
Upon hearing this, Lide brightened up.
Hell Demons fancying human souls was no secret, practically a common scare used by ordinary folk in Glory to frighten children.
His thoughts began to whirl rapidly, and after a moment, he seemed to deduce the broader truth...
The Black Dragon had initially obtained the Twelve Magic Scrolls but was unable to use them, eventually, for some reason, he contacted the Lord of Nine Prisons, who taught him how to use the scrolls.
As a return, the Black Dragon had to provide enough fresh souls.
But this was just a conjecture; there were many confusions—why specifically human souls? And how did the two sides make contact? Why did the Twelve Magic Scrolls seal Hell’s power?
Was every scroll sealing the power of Hell, or only a part of them?
The focus on the Underworld, was it just to devour souls, or was there a preparation to hunt down those with fragments of the Destiny Tablet in Dawn City?
These questions plunged Lide into deeper confusion.
He always felt that the previously hidden Hell Camp, after the arrival of the ancient days, suddenly appeared and seemed to be plotting some shocking conspiracy.
Now, he happened to stumble upon it.
And whether he wanted to intervene or not, he had no choice now.
The Black Dragon was already his captive, and given the dragon’s pride, even if he released it, the dragon would likely harbor a grudge to death, possibly causing him trouble.
So, who needed to be killed would be killed, and what needed to be seized had to be seized.
Of course, these deductions could also just be his overthinking, but this still made him extremely vigilant.
Subsequently, the Black Dragon also learned to be wiser, no matter how Lide provoked, this creature would just repeat the few phrases about lowly, contemptible crawlers and disclosed no more useful information.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 495: The Encounter of the Two Despicable Dragons
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Chapter 495: The Encounter of the Two Despicable Dragons
Lide couldn’t uncover any more secrets from the Black Dragon, and after several failed attempts to remove the Twelve Magic Scrolls from its head, he didn’t linger much longer.
He gave up on continuing the pointless conversation with the Black Dragon.
There was still a golden thigh in Dawn City; when he returned, he’d ask Kacharina if the half-mermaid beauty knew anything about the past of the Twelve Magic Scrolls.
The fact that they sealed the power of Hell and could turn someone who hadn’t even stepped into the Legendary realm into a level 32 Divine Monster made it an interest definitely worth his attention.
"Black Dragon, if you don’t want to be imprisoned by me for all eternity and displayed like a common beast by those races you consider lowly, then spit out your true intentions sooner rather than later!
As the envoy of the Lord of Nine Prisons, I shall not tolerate outsiders coveting the power of Hell!"
Though Lide didn’t get much out of the dragon, he still left with these righteous words before turning around and departing.
The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting, and words cost nothing; who knows if one day, one of these words might change the dragon’s mind.
The Black Dragon glared at Lide with hatred, completely ignoring him.
Long after Lide had left, the Black Dragon, still raging and cursing, suddenly stiffened. A red light flashed over the scrolls in its mind, and an image of a flame-shaped figure appeared in its amber dragon eyes.
The Black Dragon’s demeanor changed in an instant, and its previously weak body stood up. It turned its head alertly to scan its surroundings then shook its head after feeling around briefly.
It inexplicably uttered a segment of extremely malevolent Hell Profanity.
"What a fool, to be imprisoned despite possessing such formidable power... Hmph."
With a cold snort, the Purgatory Scroll that was originally connected with the dragon’s soul in its head trembled, severing the connection; however, seemingly out of some concern, it did not leave the Black Dragon’s head.
After completing these actions, the red flame-like figure in the dragon’s eyes vanished, and the giant dragon body once again lay weak and powerless on the ground.
After a moment, the Black Dragon looked somewhat bewildered, sneezing out a puff of white mist, apparently unaware of what had just transpired, still grumbling indignantly.
"Damn vermin, offending the great Black Dragon Sovereign you all..."
The angry draconic language abruptly stopped mid-sentence, replaced by sheer terror.
"No, this can’t be, how could the Purgatory Scroll I fused with my soul suddenly disconnect..."
Immediately full of panic, it clamped its mouth shut and quickly closed its eyes, trying to re-infuse its soul with the Divine Artifact that granted it endless power.
---
Lide returned to the main hall where everyone was waiting for him.
"Kachar Main God, did you find anything?"
Only the Mermaid Main God dared to ask this question; the others were not of sufficient status.
Lide, considering the curious gazes of everyone present, hesitated for a moment but ultimately decided not to divulge this piece of information. He always felt that the Twelve Magic Scrolls were not so simple.
Before getting to the bottom of the matter, there was no need for everyone to know, as directly confronting the terrifying Lord of Nine Prisons could lead to nothing good.
"The Black Dragon was too cunning and didn’t reveal any concrete information."
Indeed, the Black Dragon had revealed very little, and his internal judgment was based on the system description as well as combining the mythological stories collected previously.
Without verification of the truth, it might not be useful to share it just yet.
"There should be quite a few secrets in the Magic Scrolls on its head. This time, I won’t leave the Black Dragon in the Underworld."
Lide did not dwell on this issue and turned his gaze to Audis.
"How is the placement of the Destiny Tablet fragment coming along?"
He only had two pieces of the Destiny Tablet, one suppressed within Dawn City. Now with the total crop failure in the Underworld, failing to place a piece there would make the pressure from its population of over twenty million too immense.
Audis turned his head and glanced at the distinctively tidy Andabella, nodding at her before he spoke.
"Following City Lord Andabella’s suggestion, the chosen location is within the coverage of the Land of Bone-Burying, so if we encounter an attack, we can quickly relocate the Destiny Tablet shard to the Land of Bone-Burying to prevent any incidents."
Lide looked at Andabella with admiration.
"What’s the exact location?"
"A hundred kilometers from the Magic Crystal Vein, there’s a plain area that’s very suitable for Microglow Mushrooms. It’s about 200 kilometers in diameter. We’ve previously cultivated over a million acres there, but due to the Black Dragon, the entire area was burned down."
Lide’s mouth twitched, damn it, this Black Dragon is too reckless, out of all things it didn’t have to burn the farmlands... After bringing the Black Dragon back to Dawn City, giving it a beating would be essential to vent his anger.
But if it weren’t burned, it would have withered anyway from the Ancient Tide. The Black Dragon turned out to be the perfect scapegoat.
"Keep the two Sea Gods previously stationed in the Underworld here; this is our critical base camp, don’t be careless.
Additionally, the Destiny Tablet shard will be under your protection. This time, I do not want any mishaps.
Audis, take me to that area."
Hearing Lide’s words, the two Sea Clan Gods felt somewhat ashamed. Their previous mission was indeed poorly executed, even unable to deal with a Black Dragon, it was quite embarrassing.
Moments later, led by Audis, a group of people arrived at the area exactly 100 kilometers away from the Magic Crystal Ore Veins.
Sure enough, as he said, it was a vast plain, and you could even see the charred Microglow Mushrooms on top.
After the Land of Bone-Burying was upgraded to Legendary, the distance at which it could open Space Gates had reached 1500 kilometers. Previously, it barely connected Dawn City to the Magic Crystal Veins, but now it had moved 500 kilometers deep from the outside of the Magic Crystal Veins into the Underworld, so this area was already encompassed.
After confirming its accuracy, Lide wasted no time and began activating the Destiny Tablet shard.
Once the Power of Destiny entered the shard, it shone like a light bulb with electricity, radiating a dazzling light.
Swoosh~ A vast Shield rose from the shard, with a surge of air following it.
The Shield expanded within a dozen breaths to a width of 100 kilometers, and within its range, all the Ancient powers were cleared away like the sky washed clean by rainwater, pristine in an instant.
The air was free of any decayed smell.
And at this moment, the surviving plants on the ground were re-endowed with life.
The surrounding crowd, sensing this scene, showed astonished expressions, and their gaze at the Destiny Tablet shard immediately changed.
This was a treasure capable of countering the Ancient powers, having it meant securing a ticket to survive the Ancient times.
Lide looked at the Destiny Tablet shard in his hands, deep in thought. You couldn’t just leave it lying around like this.
A moment later, an idea struck him.
With a wave of his hand, the ground slowly began to rotate, countless stones flew out, and to everyone’s amazement, a huge spherical stone emerged before all their eyes.
Lide nodded in satisfaction upon seeing this, and with a snap of his fingers, Mage’s Hand appeared, carrying the Destiny Tablet shard slowly towards the stone sphere.
Only then did people see that the stone sphere had a hollow connecting to its center.
Once the shard was placed at the center of the sphere by Mage’s Hand, he waved his hand again and countless stones flew up, quickly forming a massive stone sphere several meters in diameter, under the gaze of everyone.
When everything was done, the stone sphere began to sink slowly beneath the ground until it was covered by soil.
From the outside, apart from the soil being fresher, no trace was left.
Seeing the awed looks from the crowd, Lide smiled slightly.
"I’ve used the power of the Land of Bone-Burying to create this stone sphere; if anyone attacks, or uses magic to carry or transfer it, the Land of Bone-Burying will automatically retrieve the Destiny Tablet shard.
With Divine beings guarding from the outside and automatic relocation inside, we need not worry too much now."
The crowd looked at Lide with admiration; the idea was genuinely ingenious.
After resolving the issue in the Underworld, Lide didn’t plan to stay long. The Black Dragon and the Twelve Magic Scrolls weighed heavily on his mind, he had to get back quickly to confirm with Casselina.
Moreover, the search for other Destiny Tablet shards was also putting pressure on him.
After the cold reality of this round of crop failure hit, he directly perceived the importance of the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
It could be said that without the fragments of the Destiny Tablet obtained at the beginning, the wheat on Dawn Square might have met the same fate as the Underworld, a chilling thought indeed.
The planting time for this round of crops in the Underworld already exceeded the usual by two months, having taken up two months.
Now, after the crop failure and the restarting of land reclamation and cultivation, it would be at least another three to four months before the next harvest, resulting in a half-year delay.
With over 20 million people underground, including big eaters like the Centaurs, the logistical pressure was formidable.
Even Lide had every reason to suspect that the forces still surviving in the Main Plane of Glory were more likely to starve to death in the future than to be overthrown by the Ancient Evil God.
The tactic of the Ancient Invasion was too absolute, wiping out the entire world without the need for the Ancient Evil Gods to physically kill one by one; simply waiting for the ancient power to thicken in the Multi-dimensional Plane was enough to cut off everyone’s retreat.
Aside from the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, there was no chance of escape.
After giving a bit of encouragement to Audis and Andabella, Lide took the Black Dragon wrapped in bubbles and left through the Land of Bone-Burying to return to Dawn City.
Only the two Sea Clan Gods, along with Audis and Andabella, remained on the scene.
Once the surroundings quieted down, Andabella, with her cold expression and a flicker in her eyes as if she had thought of something, the proudly-spirited girl stepped forward to the two Sea Clan Gods. She looked at them directly and spoke softly,
"We hold the accomplishments of the two Highnesses close to our hearts, as do the hundreds of thousands of people of the God of Twilight.
