This time, we’ll have to trouble Your Highnesses to continue guarding the fragments of the Destiny Tablet. As soon as Kachar City Lord’s Divine Country upgrades again, there will be a direct connection to Twilight City, and at that time, Your Highnesses will no longer need to stand guard here."
Hearing this, the two Sea Clan Gods felt somewhat relieved as their current location in the wilderness truly couldn’t compare to the comforts of Twilight City.
After slightly reassuring the two Gods, Andabella turned her gaze to Audis.
"Lord Audis, moving forward, we must mobilize all available forces and transform the area shrouded by the fragments of the Destiny Tablet into farmland as quickly as possible.
If we cannot make it in time, then we should go to Dawn City to seek help from Spellcasters to assist us in cultivation.
Food relates to the lifeblood of everyone, and Kachar City Lord would absolutely not wish to see such uncontrollable events occur again."
"Furthermore, we must also make a request to the Magic Industry Research Institute to develop crops that can grow under the influence of ancient powers.
Additionally, the Magic Industry Research Institute can manufacture corresponding alchemy machines for mass production, just like the wheat on the plains of dawn."
After finishing her words, her gaze returned to the two Sea Clan Gods.
"Your Highnesses, the Underworld is sorely lacking water resources. If possible, we hope you can assist us with corresponding water irrigation improvements.
Kachar City Lord regards food matters most seriously, and if this can be accomplished, he will surely be pleased with Your Highnesses."
Andabella’s methodical speech laid out a clear work plan for everyone.
Audis, having already experienced Andabella’s capability, was not surprised in the slightest and immediately nodded in agreement.
The two Sea Clan Gods, on the other hand, found it somewhat odd to be ordered around by a Legendary figure.
But Andabella’s final statement that Kachar City Lord took this matter very seriously still made them hesitate to object.
After all, they had just bungled something, and it would be good to redeem themselves by doing more.
Once it was clear there were no issues, Andabella nodded slightly, her gaze becoming somewhat absent as she watched Lide’s fading figure.
No one knew what the proudly spirited girl was pondering at that moment.
---
---
---
Back in Dawn City, having hurried back from the Royal Capital to quell the chaos in the rear, Lide could finally rest for a moment.
The city he had poured countless efforts into building was now able to shelter him from the storm.
The Sea Clan Gods had dispersed upon returning to Dawn City, and the Black Dragon, as promised, was left by him at the City Hall in front of Moonlight Square.
The jest about inviting all residents to see the Dragon had become a reality.
Lord Kachar really captured the giant dragon!
This news quickly sparked intense discussion among the residents of Dawn City.
The entire city went crazy, people swarming in from all directions.
Everyone looked at the Black Dragon sealed in a bubble with immense curiosity.
This was a genuine giant dragon, and though they had encountered many powerful beings, this was their first time seeing a live Black Dragon.
Despite being scarred all over and looking somewhat ragged,
these marks didn’t diminish the Black Dragon’s standing in the eyes of the residents; in fact, with the terrifying aura of Dragon Power, the scars added an indomitable strength to its presence.
The massive figure coiled on the ground was truly awe-inspiring.
Of course, among the crowd, there were a few exceptions, like...
"Cackle cackle cackle, the great Lord Withered Bone has arrived, let me see what lowly life has been so spectacle’d?"
"Oh, it’s a black dragon whelp..."
"What’s this, little dragon whelp, you got captured? Cackle cackle cackle, how laughable. Hurry up and roll back into your Dragon Mother’s belly for more milk before you come out again, the outside world is too dangerous for an undeveloped little runt like you..."
"Oh, sorry, I forgot, Black Dragons have no Dragon Mother, they’re a bunch of wildlings discarded while still in their eggs... Apologies, I was mistaken, maybe your father was a mere hog..."
Lord Withered Bones was instantly thrilled upon noticing that the Black Dragon had been captured.
This chatterbox had ventured into the muddy swamps several times in search of the other party, but always came back empty-handed, which made him extremely unfriendly toward the Black Dragon.
He now preened before the Black Dragon, excitedly squawking and belittling with gusto.
The sealed Black Dragon was now awake and upon hearing this was instantly consumed by rage, encountering for the first time, someone with a filthier mouth than itself, retaliating without hesitation.
"You lowly reptile, you dare speak to me, the grand Black Dragon Sovereign? You pathetic Undead assembled from the corpse of a pig!"
"If I were you, I’d have long found a hog’s skeletal frame to claim as family..."
Lord Withered Bones immediately sneered back, mocking without pause.
"Cackle cackle cackle, a mongrel dragon sired by a hog dares to scorn the great Lord Withered Bone?... Omission of three thousand words..."
The Black Dragon, infuriated, retorted again: "...Omission of three hundred words..."
Lord Withered Bones countered: "...Omission of six thousand words..."
The onlooking crowd then witnessed an internal battle among the Dragon Clan, a war of words that littered the skies with saliva. They started at daybreak and ferociously debated until the dusk.
In the end, the gravely injured Black Dragon ran out of energy and passed out from sheer anger, leaving Lord Withered Bones the victor of Dawn City’s inaugural spit-fight championship.
Lide, from his office, could see the scene of the two spitting insults at each other and was full of speechless consternation.
It turns out dragons are really a bunch of lowlifes, each more foul-mouthed than the last.
Fortunately, scoundrels have a way of grinding each other down, and the haughty Black Dragon was no match for Dawn City’s number one chatterbox.
——
——
——

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 496: The Terrifying Lord of Nine Prisons, God Hunting Crossbow
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Chapter 496: The Terrifying Lord of Nine Prisons, God Hunting Crossbow
"As the two contemptible dragons below were spewing at each other, Harrison knocked and entered."
"Your Majesty..."
Looking at his exceedingly capable Bloodline, Lide nodded slightly, then, with a somewhat pained expression, informed him about the total crop failure in the Underworld and the placement of the stolen Destiny Tablet Fragment from the Nolan Capital in the Underworld.
Harrison’s face revealed a bitter smile after he listened.
"I just received a message from Audis, and I was planning to discuss this matter with you.
The Dawn Plains stretch 150 kilometers long and 60 kilometers wide. Although the Destiny Tablet Fragment placed in Dawn City can clear out an old aura with a diameter of 100 kilometers, there is still a stretch of the Dawn Plains that it cannot cover.
But since you’ve already made a decision, we can only postpone the full-scale development plan for the Dawn Plains."
The terrain of Dawn City is shaped like a gourd, with the neck part being the city district, and the belly below being the Dawn Plains.
A single Destiny Tablet Fragment can only clear a 100-kilometer radius, and with the city district included, a large part of the land on the Dawn Plains remains exposed to the old powers.
Lide heard this and nodded slightly.
He had originally planned to place that fragment of the Destiny Tablet on the Dawn Plains, but his calculations couldn’t compare with fate’s.
"No matter, I will go find the remaining Destiny Tablet Fragments as soon as possible."
"Is there anything else?"
Harrison relaxed slightly, his confidence infinitely boosted by Lide’s words.
After some thought, he became suddenly excited.
"There is one more major issue.
Your Majesty, the Magic Industrial Research Institute, together with the Half-Elves, Goblins, and the Dawn Mage Tower, have jointly developed a powerful crossbow—the God Hunting Crossbow."
Lide’s eyes lit up.
What is this?
The God Hunting Crossbow?
Does the name ’God Hunting’ mean it’s bragging, or is it really as fierce as it claims?
He became greatly interested all of a sudden.
"Give me the details."
"Yes," Harrison started, then spoke softly after organizing his words.
"In high-level combat, normal warriors can’t get involved at all.
And in divine wars, even Level 15 Great Mages can only watch from a distance and can’t do anything more because it’s beyond what most people can handle."
Lide nodded slightly; this was indeed true.
The higher the level of the battle, the smaller the role of ordinary soldiers.
In battles involving Divine beings, ordinary soldiers are completely useless; the opponent can cast Forbidden Curses and Divine Arts that destroy thousands around them with a single move, rendering regular soldiers as good as cannon fodder.
Harrison went on without stopping.
"For this reason, the Magic Industry Research Institute intended to design a crossbow that even mortals can use to kill deities."
"So you succeeded?" Lide asked, his eyes filled with expectation.
Harrison nodded, then shook his head.
"The difficulty of making this crossbow far exceeded our imagination; if it wasn’t the strength of the materials that was insufficient, it was the lack of power in the finished product or it being too prone to damage.
But just as the Magic Industry Research Institute hit a dead end, Lady Kaslina gave us tremendous help."
Kaslina?
Lide looked puzzled; he previously thought she was just passing time at the Magic Industry Research Institute, but this astonishingly sourced Half-Mermaid really could research equipment.
He suddenly recalled that she had mentioned once that the trident currently used by the Mermaid Main God was forged by her.
She really was a treasure.
It seems I need to expand the bathtub when I return...
"What did she do?"
"Lady Kaslina personally designed a powerful crossbow, the might of which surpassed imagination.
But that’s not all, she also activated the hidden heritage bloodline within the Goblin Clan Chief Moer’s being, allowing Moer Clan Leader to obtain ancient goblin knowledge that had been lost for millions of years.
Afterward, Moer Clan Leader summarized and combined the wisdom and suggestions of everyone, successfully creating an extremely terrifying crossbow.
Lady Kaslina named it the ’God Hunting Crossbow.’"
Having said this, Harrison revealed a hint of admiration in his eyes, evidently shaken by Kaslina’s achievement.
He was unaware of Kaslina’s terrifying background, still thinking she was just a mermaid Lide had brought back from the Lost Sea.
Even to this day, some believe that the incomparably beautiful and gracefully poised Kaslina is Lide’s concubine...
Correct content is on
Lide, seeing Harrison’s hesitant expression after he finished speaking, was puzzled.
Why did such great news suddenly seem like a fishbone stuck in the throat?
Immediately as if remembering something, Lide asked with a subtly curious expression,
"Does this ’God Hunting Crossbow’ have any flaws?"
Harrison’s expression became even more peculiar.
"There are no significant flaws in its power, but the manufacturing cost is extremely high, and the forging materials are exceedingly rare and astounding..."
Seeing Lide frown, Harrison didn’t dare to delay further and quickly added,
"To manufacture the ’God Hunting Crossbow,’ you need the skeleton of a divine entity as material and divine power as the driving force. If you could use a divine status as the energy core, the unleashed power would be even greater."
Lide understood why Harrison was speaking hesitantly; the damned manufacturing cost was exorbitant.
Skeleton of a divine being as material?
How many divine entities must be slain to produce a satisfactory number of these?
Yet, on second thought, since the crossbow was meant for slaying divine beings, it seemed reasonable that the materials should be precious.
"Besides using the skeleton of divine beings, is there another way to forge it?"
Lide had expected Harrison to deny it, but to his surprise, Harrison actually confirmed there was another method.
"Your Majesty, according to the goblin bloodline inheritance received by Moer Clan Leader, there is another method to create a powerful Alchemy Weapon.
It involves combining alchemy and magic to cast a massive Alchemy Magic Array, driven by Star Magic Crystal Stones. The collective power of the magic array could unleash the strength to slay gods.
But similarly, the consumption is extravagantly high, though it’s slightly better than using skeletons of divine beings.
Moreover, such alchemy magic weapons have an advantage—they can continuously expand the magic array to increase their power...
This was one of the most powerful aces of the goblins during the Ancient Alchemy Era.
But currently, our resources are sufficient to forge about eight of these. However, once manufactured, our storerooms will be so empty, even mice would scorn them."
Weapons from the Alchemy Era?
Lide found this intriguing.
Kaslina had previously shared their secrets with him.
The goblins of the Ancient Alchemy Era were the rulers of the main plane of Glory, with their alchemy invoking fear even in the gods.
Those green-skinned dwarves even managed to create Alchemy Gods, the utmost terror.
However, that also led to the goblins completely enraging the divine entities, which for the first time, unified against them and eradicated the Alchemy Era.
They even ensured that information from the alchemy age didn’t survive in written form; most of the current knowledge of alchemy was passed down orally or discovered in various ruins.
"What is this category of weapon named?"
"Alchemy Magic Cannons..."
That name... a twitch formed at the corner of Lide’s mouth as it seemed that they were headed down the bright path of explosive artillery.
And fortunately, the alchemy of Glory was not driven by gunpowder, or else he would have thought that this contraption was an Earth-like replica.
"The God Hunting Crossbow and Alchemy Magic Cannons can be manufactured at the same time, without affecting the normal operations of Dawn City. Firstly, build five Alchemy Magic Cannons, and as for the manufacturing resources, you’ll need to figure out a solution.
Additionally, you must construct all of the Alchemy Magic Cannons within the Land of Bone-Burying.
As for the God Hunting Crossbow... I will try my best to obtain the Divine skeleton."
The God Hunting Crossbow, being mobile, is not much of a concern, but the Alchemy Magic Cannons are destined to be engraved with Magic Arrays, which greatly reduces their functionality once fixed in place.
However, if constructed within the Land of Bone-Burying, it would be different; he could directly open a Space Gate and bombard the outside world from within the Land of Bone-Burying.
In that way, he would essentially have several movable cannons at his disposal.
In the future, there would not even be a need for additional preparations for battle, he could fight whenever he wanted.
If they couldn’t win, they could just close the Space Gate, and all would be well.
If the enemy dared to enter the Land of Bone-Burying, even better. He could suppress them with a flick of his wrist, without worrying about the Alchemy Magic Cannons being destroyed.
Harrison obviously thought of these points as well, and was full of praise.
After that, he discussed in detail with Lide for a long time, communicating the specific construction details.
Once Harrison went down buoyantly to arrange the cannon matters, Lide stretched comfortably at his office.
He came to the window, glanced at the scene of the Withered Bones and Black Dragon spitting fire at each other in the Moonlight Square, and couldn’t help but laugh in silence.
Too lazy to deal with these two giant dragons, his figure flashed and disappeared from the office.
The next second, he briskly walked up to the top floor of the central tower in the Magic Industry Research Institute.
This tower had been assigned to Lady Kaslina by his order.
At this moment, the doors were wide open on both sides, and outside the doors, Lide immediately saw Lady Kaslina holding a white cat and looking out the floor-to-ceiling window, deep in contemplation.
The half-mermaid with an astonishing background always wore a light, pure white thin dress, her feet as white as jade onions stepping on the thick carpet, exuding an inexplicable beauty.
Her graceful body was voluptuous, exceedingly tempting.
But beneath her stunning appearance, her cool and sacred aura made people dare not harbor any profane thoughts toward her.
Seeing Lide knocking and entering the room, Lady Kaslina’s white cat in her arms suddenly puffed up its fur, meowing unhappily and giving him a dissatisfied glare.
This Cat and Joy Goddess had now become completely Lady Kaslina’s pet, which quite frustrated Lide, who had originally planned to keep the cat as his own.
Wanting to pet a cat and someone else beating you to it, this world...
"Good day, Lady Kaslina."
Hearing his voice, Lady Kaslina did not turn around, her deep sea-blue eyes still gazing into the distance, her tone indifferent.
"You’re here to inquire about the Magic Scroll on the Black Dragon’s head?"
Lide was taken aback; indeed, she knew the secret of this Divine Artifact.
"Please tell me."
Lady Kaslina’s gaze shifted slightly, but her voice remained steady.
"You’d better not touch it; it belongs to the Lord of Nine Prisons, whose schemes are more astonishing than you can imagine."
Lide’s heart skipped a beat at these words, the Lord of Nine Prisons—the Twelve Magic Scrolls were surely connected to this ultimate Dark Boss.
After pondering for a moment, he ventured tentatively.
"Are you referring to... the power of Hell?"
Lady Kaslina swiftly turned her head, her eyes showing a touch of astonishment as she sized up Lide.
"I didn’t expect you could sense that sealed force; it seems you have many secrets hidden..."
Lide was rendered speechless; it was all thanks to the system’s backing, without which he couldn’t have deduced so much information.
"Now that you know, you should understand that it’s not something you can meddle with at the moment, unless you want to have a fight with the Lord of Nine Prisons."
Although Lady Kaslina’s tone was not very fluctuating, Lide could still feel her wariness towards the Lord of Nine Prisons.
This made him suddenly curious, which was stronger, Lady Kaslina or the most domineering ultimate boss of the Glory multi-dimensional plane?
"Lady Kaslina, who is superior, you or the Lord of the Nine Prisons?"
The white cat in her arms also perked up its ears, its big eyes filled with anticipation.
Kaslina looked deeply at Lide, "We excel in different areas."
Lide understood.
Although she didn’t spell it out, he read between the lines—the Lord of the Nine Prisons was stronger than her in terms of combat power, but Kaslina was able to look down on the Lord of the Nine Prisons in certain domains.
Kaslina’s words immediately filled Lide with apprehension toward the Lord of the Nine Prisons.
What was Kaslina’s existence? She was the Fate Goddess of other multi-dimensional planes, someone who had come with the Creator God to Glory, her existence predating even the birth of Glory.
Such a terrifying existence, yet she indicated that she could not overpower the Lord of the Nine Prisons.
That showed just how terrifying the Lord of the Nine Prisons was.
After thinking for a moment, he continued.
"Does each of the Twelve Magic Scrolls seal a portion of Hell’s power?"
Kaslina’s brow furrowed slightly.
"Knowing how powerful the Lord of the Nine Prisons is, why still ask?"
Lide cleared his throat.
"Although I do not wish to be an enemy of the Lord of the Nine Prisons, the Black Dragon has now been captured by us, and the Twelve Magic Scrolls on his head have become possessions within our bag.
Understanding more can help us to have strategies for the next time."
Kaslina was noncommittal about this explanation.
After pondering for a moment, she continued in that cool tone.
"The Twelve Magic Scrolls are part of the Lord of the Nine Prison’s schemes, and while I do know some secrets, I am unable to fathom his true purpose.
That powerful entity’s strategy is second to none, and what he doesn’t want people to know is hard for outsiders to discover.
But I can tell you clearly, the Twelve Magic Scrolls do indeed seal a part of Hell’s power, and not just Hell’s power—they also contain a part of the Lord of the Nine Prison’s power."
Lide was shocked.
"The Lord of the Nine Prisons is still so strong with a part of his power sealed away?"
"Why else would he be known as the strongest existence in Glory?
If not for the special nature of the Life Goddess and the Death God, these two original divinities would also dim in the light of the Lord of the Nine Prisons."
Kaslina gave him a pointed look.
To be so strong, this guy must be cheating, right??
Lide fell into thought, the Twelve Magic Scrolls sealed the power of Hell and the Lord of the Nine Prisons; it would be too big of a loss to just give up on them.
First, he should see if he could remove them from the Black Dragon’s head, take possession of them and then decide; it’s not too late to give up if things become too troublesome later.
Dawn City currently didn’t have the confidence to provoke the Lord of the Nine Prisons, and even Kaslina, the golden thigh, admitted she couldn’t beat the adversary; the divinities he had on hand probably couldn’t withstand a single major move from the adversary.
But that didn’t hinder him from making some additional arrangements, waiting passively was never his style.
"Thank you for your guidance, Lady Kaslina."
Lide nodded his head and thanked her.
"Also, thank you for your generosity regarding the God Hunting Crossbow and the goblin inheritance."
Kaslina didn’t speak again; she turned to continue gazing into the distance, her fingers slowly caressing the white cat in her arms.
The outside light shone into the room, leaving a somewhat vague shadow.
Her demeanor became even more sacred and ethereal.
Seeing this, Lide didn’t waste words and turned to leave directly.
The white cat quietly turned its head to look at him, rubbing its comfortable head and let out a soft meow.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 497: The Purgatory Scroll, Viscount Bernard’s Scheme
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Chapter 497: The Purgatory Scroll, Viscount Bernard’s Scheme
After leaving the Magic Industry Research Institute, Lide headed straight to the square.
At this time, the Black Dragon, which had been fainted by the stench of Withered Bone, had already woken up and was looking around, still wanting to trade insults with Withered Bone for three hundred rounds.
However, Withered Bone had already triumphantly returned home, happily nestling back into his lair for a nap.
Only a never-ending stream of onlookers surrounded the Black Dragon on Moonlight Square, all of them curiously peering at this legendary creature of life.
Soldiers maintaining order had roped off the area around the Black Dragon, allowing the crowd to observe from a distance.
If they got too close, the overwhelming Dragon Power was too much for most to bear.
When the residents around saw Lide appear on the square, it immediately caused a huge sensation.
Because he was often out, most believers rarely saw Lide once a year, and with the growing strength of Dawn City, the residents’ faith in Lide had become increasingly zealous; there were hardly any ordinary believers in the entire city anymore, with most being devout followers.
So now, appearing before the crowd’s eyes after capturing the giant dragon, the scene instantly exploded.
The crowd bowed in unison like a field of wheat being reaped, creating a stunning spectacle as tens of thousands made the gesture together.
"Good day, great Lord Kachar."
"Your humble believers welcome your arrival..."
"Praise you, the Lord of Dawn, who shines brighter than the sun!"
"We exist because of you, and your glory forever illuminates our hearts..."
Seeing this, Lide’s gaze was indifferent, his heart unmoved by the display as he let the crowd rise from their bows and walked straight toward the Black Dragon under the fervent watch of the residents.
The power of the Black Dragon, isolated by bubbles, had been completely sealed, leaving it even limper than a soft-shelled shrimp.
Upon seeing the earth appear, its anger surged.
"Where is that despicable Bone Dragon? Let him come to meet the great Black Dragon Sovereign! Don’t think by hiding you can mask your nature as a loser..."
This Black Dragon seemed to be like someone who had lost an argument, stewing over it afterward, convincing itself it would perform better the next time.
Lide could only frown; hadn’t it lost badly enough already?
Ignoring the Black Dragon, his gaze shifted toward the Twelve Magic Scrolls atop its head.
His eyes were full of curiosity.
These were artifacts sealed with the power of Hell and the force of the Lord of Nine Prisons after all.
During his previous investigation in the Underworld, he couldn’t check the attributes because the Magic Scrolls were connected to the Black Dragon’s soul.
However, it now seemed that the situation had changed.
With a thought, his spiritual power began to flow out, and after a moment, his face showed a hint of joy.
He could feel that the connection between the Magic Scrolls and the Black Dragon was not as strong anymore...
With an experimental mindset, he opened the attribute panel.
Twelve Magic Scrolls—Purgatory Scroll (Sequence 7)
Quality: High-level Divine Artifact (Special)
Condition: Slightly Damaged
Features: 1. Sealed with High-level Forbidden Curse—Doom Flame, can be released once every 10 seconds, consuming 100,000 human souls each time it is cast.
2. Dark Resurrection, the holder receives an energy infusion every 10 seconds that can heal corresponding injuries, consuming 50,000 human souls with each cast.
3. Soul Devouring Seal, able to devour nearby souls and seal them within the scroll.
4. Sealed (requires 10 million human souls to unlock)
5. Sealed (requires special Hell Energy to unlock)
Number of souls owned: 1,260,000
"""
Introduction: A special Divine Artifact sealed with Hell Power, to activate its original might, a vast amount of souls is required. Legend has it that gathering the Twelve Magic Scrolls will grant access to that sealed Hell Power.
After reviewing the attributes, Lide gasped in shock.
This piece of equipment was outrageously powerful and equally diabolical.
Both skills required the consumption of souls for each casting, and specifically human souls at that.
This means that to use this Divine Artifact, one must slaughter humans.
"Such a headache. Those are all pure followers. Who would willingly slaughter them?"
Which Divine would destroy their own foundation...
It was indeed equipment befitting the Lord of Nine Prisons, with an undeniably dark style.
On second thought, it doesn’t seem wrong — Hell doesn’t need human faith; of course, it sees humans as food.
Now that I can see the equipment’s properties, does it mean that...
Lide motioned with his hand to the Sea Clan God who had been standing guard next to him, signaling to open the bubble. The latter understood instantly and, after a moment of contemplation, cast a spell to create an opening the size of a person in the bubble.
Upon seeing this, Lide gave a small smile and snapped his fingers crisply.
A Magic Shield instantly enveloped the bubble.
Following the second snap, Mage’s Hand appeared out of thin air and slowly reached into the bubble. Under the horrified gaze of the Black Dragon, it snatched the blood-drenched Magic Scroll from atop its head with a tearing sound.
Feeling its own Divine Artifact being separated from its body, the Black Dragon violently attempted to stand up and take it back. But with its power sealed and further hampered by serious injuries, it was utterly powerless beyond cursing and shouting at Lide.
Moreover, Lide had the foresight to use the Magic Shield to block out the noises near the Black Dragon, rendering the latter’s curses inaudible. The Black Dragon had no choice but to curse to himself.
After realizing his curses were futile, the Black Dragon was so enraged that he spewed more fresh blood and passed out stiffly.
The blood-stained Magic Scroll, lifted by the Mage’s Hand, rapidly devoured the dragon’s blood, then returned to its normal appearance.
Lide took the scroll from the hand, dismissed the Mage’s Hand, and began to carefully examine this incredible Divine Artifact.
The Magic Scroll was entirely red in color, its texture rough like coarse cloth and quite grainy to the touch.
Unfurled, it was about thirty centimeters long and fifteen centimeters wide, inscribed with extremely twisted Hell Runes in an irregular arrangement.
Even a glance with Lide’s spiritual power made him feel dizzy, as if countless devils were bursting forth from the scroll, eager to devour his soul.
In the upper right corner, there were two noticeable gaps that looked as though they had been torn off.
With a thought, Lide took out the Divine Artifact Fragment that the goblin had presented to him and slowly affixed it onto the Purgatory Scroll.
The moment the Divine Artifact Fragment was attached, the Purgatory Scroll flashed with red light, and the fragments softened like melting water, seamlessly merging together with no gaps.
After the scroll repaired itself, the Purgatory Scroll glowed intensely, the temperature of the surrounding air rose by more than ten degrees, instantly becoming scorching hot.
The Black Dragon, who had just been knocked unconscious, came to upon sensing the commotion outside and saw, to his dismay, the now restored Divine Artifact in Lide’s hands.
Jealousy, unwillingness, resentment, disbelief, and rage — a torrent of emotions overwhelmed him.
The giant dragon’s eyes bulged with profanities brewing, but before he could utter a word, fury overcame him and he spewed a mouthful of blood, fainting once again.
Moments later, the light from the now complete Hell Scroll dimmed, and Lide checked its attributes again, only to find, surprisingly, that the scroll hadn’t changed at all.
Shaking his head, those two pieces were merely the ragged edges, lacking even a single Hell Rune, and didn’t affect the main body at all — whether they were patched up made no difference to its use, a slight miscalculation.
Nonetheless, this high-level Divine Artifact was now in his possession, and it was excellent to have, even if not for personal use.
And who knows, perhaps one day the rest of the Twelve Magic Scrolls could be gathered, potentially leading to an outcome like assembling the Destiny Tablet fragments, summoning the Divine Dragon, and becoming an existence on par with the Lord of Nine Prisons.
—
—
—
Green City.
Viscount Bernard sat at a round table covered with a white cloth, leisurely enjoying more than a dozen exquisite dishes with a gold knife and fork.
In this opulent hall, over a dozen elegantly dressed Nobles stood respectfully to the side, not daring to show the slightest dissatisfaction.
"""
Sitting opposite Viscount Bernard was Roy, the Eight-Armed Snake Demon, an upper-class abyssal demon, who was chewing a blood-dripping heart, making squelching noises that filled the originally pleasant atmosphere with terror.
The nobles didn’t even dare to glance at the Eight-Armed Snake Demon, trembling as they awaited the master of the house to speak.
Viscount Bernard seemed not to notice the gore as Roy consumed it, leisurely enjoying the meal on the table before eventually picking up a crystal cup filled halfway with red wine and rising slowly.
His hand gently swirled the glass, the red liquid spinning slightly, droplets clinging to the side of the glass, then slowly sliding down, leaving faint trails.
The graceful Viscount Bernard smiled at the more than ten nobles in the room, speaking in an amiable tone,
"Esteemed lords and ladies, do you know why I have called you here today?..."
An elderly noble, in his sixties with grizzled hair but an erect spine, stood up and spoke in a somber voice.
"Viscount Bernard, is it about the matter of Green City’s troops you mentioned last time? I promise you, as long as Lord Ilo is killed, the army will not be a problem."
"No, I am not worried about the army..."
"What do you intend to do then?" the nobles in the room asked, puzzled, not understanding what this apostle of the Devil Lord intended.
In fact, after they agreed to rebel against Lord Ilo that night, many of the nobles had second thoughts, feeling deeply uneasy about collaborating with a devil.
But on the following day, the bodies of the nobles who wanted out of the plot were found hanging at their own doorsteps; no one dared to speak of withdrawing again.
Everyone knew they had no way out...
Even if they now reported to Lord Ilo, they probably would not live to see the next day; they simply couldn’t resist the hunt of the devil.
If that was the case, they might as well go all in with their scheme. Perhaps by overthrowing Lord Ilo, they could regain control of Green City as first promised.
The thought of their power being ruthlessly stripped away by Lord Ilo made their resentment unstoppable.
Viscount Bernard let out a laugh, "You are all clever people; I like dealing with clever people.
Among all the nobles, your families have suffered the most severe losses.
This time, I will grant you a rare opportunity, as long as you complete the mission, your families will become the most powerful in Green City.
I will grant you status and power beyond what you had before!"
The nobles’ eyes lit up at this revelation. What was their collaboration with the devil for if not to reclaim the power that rightfully belonged to them?
They immediately began to speak.
"What would you have us do?"
"We are willing to follow your orders."
Seeing how compliant they were, Viscount Bernard’s smile grew even more radiant.
View the correct content at .
"I want you to use your current channels of information to spread the news that a fragment of the Destiny Tablet will emerge in Green City in one month..."
What?! The nobles were all startled. A fragment of the Destiny Tablet??
The only divine artifact mentioned by the Sun Goddess to counter the power of the Ancient Evil God??
A deathly silence fell over the room, as the nobles looked at each other, shocked by the news.
Why must they rebel against Lord Ilo?
On the surface, it was because their noble powers had been stripped away, but the deeper reason was, since the arrival of the Ancient, Green City’s lines of communication with the outside world were almost entirely cut off, leaving but scant trade routes.
Their living space was greatly diminished as a result.
With the situation as it was, Lord Ilo stripping away their power was akin to depriving them of their very right to survive, making rebellion necessary.
If the Ancient had never come, they could have simply lived in another city if Lord Ilo was unfriendly to them; but given the current circumstances, that was not an option.
Thus the news of the Destiny Tablet fragment’s impending emergence made them start to waver. If they could get their hands on the Destiny Tablet fragment, could they restore the pre-Ancient order?
Could they even become the new sovereigns of Green City with this transcendent divine artifact?
Would they then need to fear Lord Ilo at all?
Seeing their expressions, Viscount Bernard knew what they were thinking. His gaze grew more profound, and with an elegant air, he said,
"If you have the ability to snatch the Destiny Tablet Fragment from the Divine, then go ahead by all means—I will bless your efforts," he said.
This statement sent a collective shiver down the spines of the Nobles.
Indeed, even if the Destiny Tablet Fragment appeared in Green City, it was not something they could even hope to glimpse.
Not to mention Lord Ilo, even the Viscount Bernard here with his inscrutable power was enough to doom them.
Their greed was instantly quelled, and they each began to think again.
Moments later, an elderly noble past his sixties suddenly lit up with an epiphany, speaking as if he had just realized something.
"Viscount Bernard, this must be a false message, right?
Using the Destiny Tablet Fragment to attract attention from outsiders, and then certainly, Lord Ilo will not give up, leading to a conflict with the outside world, and then we benefit from the turmoil...
Such an excellent scheme!
And because the Destiny Tablet Fragment is so valuable, the outside world, not knowing whether it’s true or false, will still delve into Green City, which greatly increases the possibility of a conflict with Lord Ilo."
The other Nobles looked at Viscount Bernard with admiration upon hearing these words.
They hadn’t anticipated such a deep plot...
Viscount Bernard looked at the old noble with a meaningful gaze, then shook his head amid the astonished expressions of the others.
"No, this is not false news. The Destiny Tablet Fragment will indeed emerge here in a month’s time—this is the true message told to me by my master."
What?
The news is true?
The Nobles inside the room were in an uproar, all very puzzled.
Just to oppose one Lord Ilo, would it be worth using the Destiny Tablet Fragment—a treasure of such magnitude—as bait?
Exchanging a Destiny Tablet Fragment for just Green City, it seemed like a loss to them.
If one possessed the Destiny Tablet Fragment, where could one not survive? Why opt for Green City?
Viscount Bernard slowly sipped the red wine from his glass, and a faint blood-red color flickered in his blue eyes.
Correct content is on
"You will know what you need to know, and what you don’t need to know... you need not know...
All you need to do is convey this message through your channels to the outside world, but remember, it must be secretive, best to let the outside world discover this news inadvertently."
"May I ask, Viscount Bernard, how shall we proceed?"
"You do it like this..."
After Viscount Bernard detailed many fine points, he waved his hand, signaling for everyone to leave.
The Nobles, though full of doubts, could only depart the hall with their confusion, seeing how Viscount Bernard seemed disinclined to say more.
When only the Eight-Armed Snake Demon Roy remained in the room, Viscount Bernard pulled out a pitch-black Magic Scroll from his chest, stroking it with an intoxicated expression as if caressing a lover.
"It’s truly exhilarating..."
"Roy, tell me, do you think my master’s plan will succeed?"
The Eight-Armed Snake Demon casually wiped his mouth with a piece of tablecloth, leaving a glaring bloodstain on it.
His voice was laced with a chilly tone.
"The Main Plane thrives in Chaos, suitable for the birth of darkness...
When the master arrives here, even if the Ancient Evil Gods all come together, they will be nothing more than fodder...
Praise slaughter."
Upon hearing this, Viscount Bernard quietly stowed the black Magic Scroll back into his chest, graciously raising his wine glass.
His face was covered with a smile.
"Praise slaughter."

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 498: 4 Divine Status, Green City Has Destiny Tablet Fragment Emergence
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Chapter 498: 4 Divine Status, Green City Has Destiny Tablet Fragment Emergence
Lide Kachar, having finished his inquiry with Kassalina, did not return to the office but headed straight for the Alchemy Factory instead.
He was particularly interested in the God Hunting Crossbows mentioned by Harrison, especially since the goblin chief Moer had obtained the heritage of alchemy with Kassalina’s help.
Goblins once ruled an era, and alchemy was even feared by the divine.
It was just unknown whether the goblin chief had received a complete heritage of alchemy.
Now, the Alchemy Factory had become an extremely important facility in Dawn City.
Whether it was the production of Alchemy Bombs or the research and development of various Alchemy Weapons and Equipment, all were carried out here.
It’s worth mentioning that, while inspecting the various races of the Underworld, the army discovered a group of over 5000 goblins in a rather hidden corner.
After questioning, these goblins were found to be distant relatives of the goblins in Dawn City.
The goblins of Dawn City had also come from the Underworld; if not for the Black Dragon’s influence, they might still be living there.
As expected, the newly discovered goblins were absorbed into the Alchemy Factory, becoming a new force of production.
So, the Alchemy Factory was not short of manpower.
When Lide arrived, the entire factory was busy. The facility had expanded to at least five times larger than initially and had become a massive production base, respected by all residents.
Upon seeing Lide’s figure, the goblins immediately became excited.
These green-skinned dwarfs, with their extreme personalities of pride, arrogance, and timidity, knew very well who had given them the good treatment they received in Dawn City.
"Master, welcome to your arrival."
In the goblin chief’s office, which was so luxurious and extravagant it could be said to be made of pure gold, Lide sat on a glittering sofa with a rather odd expression.
These green dwarfs’ aesthetics had always been so straightforward, whatever could flaunt their wealth.
Moer, as the goblin chief and the manager of the Alchemy Factory, did not lack money, so he did not bother to manage it.
"Did you receive your ancestors’ heritage?"
Correct content is on )
Moer, who was once scorched by dragon breath and covered in scars, said excitedly and danced with joy.
"Yes, my master.
Lady Kassalina is the greatest existence in this world, and she has bestowed me with new power! Not only did she activate the ancient bloodline within me, but also endowed me with a wealth of alchemical knowledge.
It’s unimaginable, our goblin clan was once so powerful, powerful enough to have even ruled the entire Main Plane of Glory!!"
Goblins had long lost their cultural heritage, and the history when goblins ruled the world had also been erased by the gods, so it was entirely normal for Moer not to know about his ancestors’ past glory.
Looking at this fellow revealing a face as if he came from a distinguished background, Lide couldn’t help but find it somewhat amusing.
"Are the God Hunting Crossbows and Alchemy Magic Cannons handed down from your ancestors?"
A look of surprise crossed Moer’s face, followed by a face full of admiration.
"Master, your information is so well-informed.
Yes, the Alchemy Magic Cannon was knowledge I acquired from my bloodline heritage. Unfortunately, there are many more powerful weapons than this that the goblins had, but I was not able to receive them.
As for the God Hunting Crossbow, it is the masterpiece of the great Lady Kassalina, of course, I also modified it with some alchemy.
I bet that if we can produce enough God Hunting Crossbows, Dawn City will become the most powerful force in this world!"
Watching the bouncing individual before him, the corner of Lide’s mouth twitched. If it wasn’t for the other party’s appearance being so hideous from being ravaged by dragon breath, he indeed resembled a clown performing in a circus.
"Do you have a finished product?"
Erm... Moer’s face stiffened and he said sheepishly.
"Master, the God Hunting Crossbows lack the divine corpses as raw material.
The Alchemy Magic Cannons require time to build..."
Lide was speechless, after all this self-celebration, there were actually no finished products.
After pondering briefly, he waved his hand and four thumb-sized, shiny crystal balls appeared in his hand.
Seeing what was in his hands, Moer’s eyes immediately lit up, instinctively feeling these must be treasures.
"Master, what are these? I feel like they are treasures..."
With a smile, Lide spoke, and his next words almost made the goblin jump up.
"These are Divine Status."
"Divine Status?!!"
When did Divine Status become so cheap?
Four of them appeared all at once!
Moer’s mouth went dry, his face filled with an unsatisfied craving, I want...
This is a treasure, owning the materials for the God Hunting Crossbow would fulfill half the requirement, he could even use the Divine Status to create a simplified version of the God Hunting Crossbow.
Moreover, whether it’s used to forge the God Hunting Crossbow or other weapons, Divine Status is a treasure that could exhibit tremendous effects.
For a goblin, this was definitely a material that made their hearts beat faster.
Lide smiled and nodded.
The four Divine Statuses in his hands each had a story: one was from the God of Nobles, obtained in Nolan Capital when Frey slayed an Evil God and got one, two were obtained from killing a pair of octopus-bodied Evil Gods in Dwarf Valley, totaling four.
Among these four Divine Statuses, only the one from the God of Nobles came with a Divine Position.
The other three taken from Ancient Evil Gods did not come with any Divine Position.
Initially, Lide was quite surprised when he discovered that the Divine Status didn’t come with Divine Positions; in his previous understanding, this thing was supposed to be for carrying Divine Positions.
It was only after he asked Kachar that he learned the essence of Divine Status is the Energy Core, its main function is to carry Divine Positions, but it’s not useless without a Divine Position; it can serve as an Energy Core perfectly well.
Of course, there are many downsides to not carrying Divine Positions, the most typical of which is the inability to use the various powers accompanied by the Divine Positions.
These Ancient Evil Gods had blank Divine Statuses, which probably explained why they solely relied on physical strength to attack—they didn’t have any Skills to unleash.
This also gave Lide a deeper understanding of the Ancient Evil Gods.
Combining the information from the Crimson Moon, he could currently divide the Ancient Evil Gods into two categories.
The first category includes the God of Plague, which has Divine Positions, is smart and wise, and isn’t much different from normal Divine beings.
The second category is represented by the octopus-bodied Ancient Evil Gods in front of Dwarf Valley, with no Divine Positions and not much intelligence, acting purely on instinct.
Without a doubt, the first type of Ancient Evil Gods have a higher status within the Ancient ranks. In comparison, the second type of Ancient Evil Gods are more like minions, the kind dispatched as expendable frontline troops.
Tough skinned, resilient, almost impossible to kill: they are nearly perfect meat shields.
This could suggest that not all beings in the Ancient Camp are high-level Evil Gods; there is a hierarchy as well.
And the few Ancient Evil Gods he had encountered belonged to the category of meat shield cannon fodder...
Considering this, Lide felt a chill in his heart. Are their meat shield cannon fodder all this advanced?
However, what made him more uneasy was that since the Ancient Invasion, the combat strength the Evil Gods Camp had shown seemed not to be as overwhelming as the noise they’ve created.
Even with the help of the sky rifts, most cities in Glory had turned into isolated islands.
Yet the Ancient Camp had not swept everything away and had even allowed the Angel Alliance to be successfully established.
The current state seemed somewhat inconsistent with the Ancient Evil Gods’ previous stance of wanting to destroy the world.
This left Lide with a vague worry; it seemed as if the other side was brewing something. He didn’t believe the offensive by the Ancient Evil Gods was just this.
A greater storm was still to come in the future.
"Master, are all these bestowed upon me?"
View the correct content at
Moer’s sharp voice, filled with excitement and eagerness, snapped the daydreaming Lide back to reality.
Shaking his head without further thought, his gaze returned to Moer.
"No, they’re not a reward for you."
Moer’s excited expression instantly froze on his face, filled with pity, tears nearly falling from his eyes.
Lide chuckled, "These are for forging the God Hunting Crossbow. I will find the Divine skeletons as soon as possible; you get the preliminary work ready."
And the Divine Position of Nobility requires a large number of Nobles to become its Believers, and the higher the rank, the stronger the influence, and the more territory the Nobles control, the more power they contribute to the God of Nobles.
However, the nature of Dawn City is to denounce nobility, making the common people its core, so the Divine Position of Nobility doesn’t fit with the politics of Dawn City’s City Hall.
He had no intention of letting anyone control the Divine Position of Nobility. Nobility, what’s the use? If it’s gone, it’s gone, and the productive power released by the liberation of the people is definitely incomparable to that of the Nobles.
"Praise you, Master, for your kindness and wisdom truly make the sun lose its radiance!!"
Moer instantly shouted out, his smile as bright as a chrysanthemum, paired with his disfigured face instantly causing a wave of discomfort to anyone who saw it.
Truly, a smile uglier than a cry.
Lide thought for a moment and extended his hand towards Moer with a slight wave; Moer felt as if something had been stuffed into his head.
"I have granted you partial authority over the Land of Bone-Burying; those Divine Statuses will temporarily remain there. If you wish to use them in the future, you may utilize your authority to retrieve them.
Remember, Divine Statuses are treasures more precious than an entire Secret Silver Vein, and must absolutely not be lost."
"Rest assured, master, I will guard your wealth with my life!"
Morer patted his chest, exuding great confidence.
Given the goblin race’s avarice, they would lose themselves before they would let a Divine Status slip through their fingers.
Lide gave a slight nod, then curiously asked.
"Does the heritage you received include any special weapons, equipment, or alchemy?"
The ancient alchemy was a treasure; it was unknown how much heritage Morer had received.
Morer confidently raised his head, proudly saying.
"Lord, I have already obtained the heritage of the Five Circle Alchemy Bomb and the Forbidden Curse Alchemy Bomb. It won’t be long before our Air Force will be equipped with Forbidden Curse Alchemy Bombs capable of easily destroying a city!
In addition, my mind is filled with many rare, high-strength steel alloy formulas, which can elevate the level of our equipment by several grades."
A gleam flashed in Lide’s eyes.
Forbidden Curse Alchemy Bombs? They were existences on the same level as Forbidden Curses.
For Spellcasters to create Forbidden Curse Magic Scrolls, the difficulty was nearly sky-high, and many Divines couldn’t produce them.
But now, a substitute was about to be had...
His mood greatly improved.
The military power of Dawn City was his confidence.
Lide used to be somewhat helpless because ordinary soldiers didn’t play a significant role in high-end battles. But if various powerful equipment could truly be developed, then the industrial system of Dawn City would become everyone’s nightmare.
This was the crushing superiority of high-level productivity over lower-level productivity.
The strength of Dawn City lay in the fact that once an equipment piece capable of being replicated was created, as long as the raw materials could be ensured, hundreds, thousands, even tens of thousands of them could be produced in a very short time!
This was a capability that no other power within Glory possessed.
This was the crushing superiority of modern production concepts over Glory.
"Very well, mention whatever materials you need, and I will have City Hall prioritize meeting your requirements."
Lide spoke with full confidence.
Now, the territory he ruled over was so vast; the Underworld, Green City, the Abyss Plane, and even the Ocean God System of the Lost Sea had become de facto vassals to Dawn City... The era of scarcity in various raw materials had passed.
He could completely satisfy the current demands of all factories; there was no longer a need to painstakingly scrape by each day.
Morer was also aware of Dawn City’s current situation and was greatly pleased by Lide’s assurances, showering him with unabashed flattery, without so much as a blush.
Lide stayed in the Alchemy Factory for several Sunshine Hours, thoroughly understanding and touring each production workshop and research center before leaving satisfied.
-------------
-------------
-------------
"Your Majesty, shall we continue to wait? Why shouldn’t we just take action and seize by force?
That is our lost golden descendant, not someone from the Crimson Mage Tower!
I have already inquired; the Tower Master of the Crimson Mage Tower, Lide Kachar, is merely someone of the Great Mage level, and he has also not made a public appearance for several years.
According to what those Mage Apprentices say, Lide Kachar seems to often retreat into seclusion, and is not seen for lengthy periods.
These peculiar human Spellcasters always act like this, always preferring to study magic behind closed doors.
Therefore, he must not be out but hiding away! Let’s seize her by force; Lady Isa is our only hope for the Silver Moon Radiance city-state.
Only with a golden descendant inheriting the power of the ancestors can we stand against the Long-tail Trolls!"
Inside a popular inn near the central area of Green City, frequented by adventurers, over ten people wearing unified black robes and boasting a pair of red eyes were loudly discussing.
Red pupils—ordinary farmers would surely scream in horror, labeling them devils. However, here, everyone possessed the eyes only devils have.
Sitting in the center was a middle-aged man in his forties.
Upon hearing these words, he pondered for a moment and slowly shook his head.
"The human city is not our city-state; this place has its own rules. The current acting Power Holder of the Crimson Mage Tower appointed by Lord Ilo is Lady Vena.
Their relationship seems quite subtle.
If we act, we may anger Lord Ilo."
The young man who had just spoken and proposed the idea was visibly frustrated.
"We could make our move while Lady Isa is out and leave immediately after the deed is done.
Your Majesty, once Lady Isa inherits the power of her ancestors and realizes the responsibilities and destiny of the Silver Moon City-State, I am convinced she would not blame us.
And it’s not as if Lady Isa can’t come back; as long as the long-tailed giant trolls are re-sealed, she can return to Green City..."
This matter was related to the entire destiny of the Silver Moon City-State, of paramount importance, and once again, the youth’s words made everyone inside the room waver.
Seeing the mood shift, the young man from the Red-eyed Clan showed a glint of joy and continued to speak.
"And if we do nothing and just wait here, for how long should we wait?
If Lide Kachar returns in ten days or half a month, that’s still acceptable, but what if he takes a year or two, or has already fallen outside and can never return?
Shall we just simply continue waiting indefinitely?
Your Majesty, we cannot entrust our fate to someone else."
These words immediately swayed the already indecisive King.
Yes, the city-state is constantly under the threat of destruction. If they don’t have enough power to face the long-tailed trolls, how will they resist once those damned life forces completely breach the seal?
Moreover, there was the corruption of ancient powers. If the Golden Descendant doesn’t activate the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, then even if they could withstand the troll attack, they wouldn’t escape the fate of destruction.
The King’s heart was filled with turmoil.
On one hand was the life and death of his own people, and on the other hand, his moral compass and concern for Lord Ilo of Green City.
After a moment, the King nodded firmly, making up his mind.
"Continue to send people to inquire about the whereabouts of Tower Master Lide Kachar of the Crimson Mage Tower, and keep a close watch on the Crimson Mage Tower. As soon as the Golden Descendant appears, take immediate action.
Remember, do not harm the people around the Golden Descendant during this operation; after retrieving the Golden Descendant, everyone should withdraw separately. Even if the surrounding people are besieged, do not rescue them; use all your efforts to bring the Golden Descendant back to the Silver Moon City-State!"
Everyone’s spirits were lifted, and they acknowledged in unison.
But just as they were preparing to carry out their mission, a loud discussion suddenly came from the room next door.
"Have you heard? The Sun Goddess’s divine oracle, which can resist the ancient invasion, has revealed that the fragments of the Destiny Tablet will descend in Green City a month from now when the frost recedes."
"Really??"
"There’s no doubt about it. It’s said that the news came from a priest who worships the Sun Goddess. After the old priest mentioned it, he triggered a backlash and died on the spot."
"Hiss... So, does that mean our Green City is saved? You don’t know, but just two days ago when the rift in the sky widened, at least over a hundred thousand people in Green City were turned into ancient monsters.
The scene was too horrifying. If it weren’t for the immediate action of Lord Ilo’s priests, even I might have died at the hands of those ancient monsters."
"Nonsense, how could I not know? My son was corrupted by the ancient power, and he’s still undergoing treatment in the Dawn Church right now."
"Your son was corrupted, and you still come to eat??"
"I have twelve sons..."
A one-way Magic Shield was set up inside the room, allowing outside sounds to come in, but not out.
Hearing the discussions of others, the group of Red-eyed Clan people from Silver Moon City-State looked at each other with surprised expressions.
"The fragments of the Destiny Tablet..."
The Silver Moon King’s eyes flickered, pondering something.
And similar conversations were also spreading throughout Green City.
At first, nobody paid attention, considering it just nonsense.
But once some interested parties investigated and discovered that the priest of the Sun Goddess really died from such a rule backlash, and that in front of several disciples on his deathbed, he personally revealed that the fragments of the Destiny Tablet would come to Green City after the frost receded.
This genuine news immediately caused a sensation.
The Destiny Tablet fragments, after all, were the treasure revealed in the Sun Goddess’s oracle that could resist ancient powers.
Not only were regular citizens discussing it, but it also immediately sparked discussion among players. Once players start discussing it, it means the whole world became aware of this news.
Instantly, previously obscure Green City drew unprecedented attention; the Storm Sea Domain, the Undead Empire, the Ancient Forest, the Angel Alliance... the entire focus of Glory was now centered on Green City.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 499: Earth-Shattering News—The Core of the Destiny Tablet
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Chapter 499: Earth-Shattering News—The Core of the Destiny Tablet
The next day.
"Your Majesty, we have thoroughly scouted all the routes around the Crimson Mage Tower, and here are the blueprints."
After deciding to plunder the gold and retreat to the city-state of Silver Moon Radiance, the Red-eyed Clan began to devise their strategy.
A young member of the Red-eyed Clan was presenting the plan to the King of Silver Moon Radiance, the brand-new map on the oak table reflecting a dazzling light under the magic lamp.
"We have discovered that Lady Isa leaves the Crimson Mage Tower every three days to study magic at the White Tower."
The young man in a black robe brought his middle and index fingers together and slid them along a certain route on the map.
"The White Tower was established by the teacher of Lide Kachar, the Tower Master of the Crimson Mage Tower, who has now traveled to the Nolan Empire capital. The guard at the White Tower is not very strict."
"This is the only path Lady Isa takes to the White Tower. I have scouted all the shops on this street, and the information revealed by the shop owners coincides with what I have gathered from other sources."
"We can ambush her here, at the intersection of Cross Street. This point is the junction between the south and west districts; the west district used to be the part of Green City with many underground forces, hence, it has numerous escape routes, making it easier to flee. Also, before making our move, we can have some of our people cause a disturbance in the area furthest from this district to attract the attention of the army."
The young man was filled with confidence.
"Lady Vena, the Power Holder of the Crimson Mage Tower, is the Deputy City Lord of Green City, and she has a close relationship with Lady Isa. From this standpoint, Lady Isa`s disappearance would definitely infuriate her, so there’s a high probability that the top combat forces will seal the city."
"However, as soon as we capture Lady Isa, we can immediately flee. If Green City activates transport and spatial Magic Arrays, or sends Legendary-level beings to block off space, we can escape through the underground passages in the west district. Outside the city, we have our flying mounts; as soon as we get out, we can directly ride the mounts back to Storm Sea Domain, no one can stop us."
Although the young man only gave an overview, everyone there was not shallow in experience and immediately realized the high feasibility of the plan.
With a sudden attack, the opponent will definitely not have time to react, allowing them to resolve the battle quickly.
With a well-prepared plan against an unprepared opponent, even under strict protection, with their power, they could definitely complete the target with ease.
While there were several flaws in the plan, in everyone’s eyes, those were trivial, except for one point they couldn’t resolve.
That major risk was Lord Ilo, who had not shown himself yet.
After all, he is the ruler of the city, and they definitely did not want to face the wrath of a Divine being.
However, after a moment of consideration, they reassured themselves again, reasoning that since the operation was not a large-scale massacre and would be done quickly, it probably wouldn’t have much impact, and such a powerful being generally wouldn’t intervene in such trivial matters.
What kind of being is a Divine, after all? Who would constantly pay attention to these minor issues?
As for Lide Kachar, the Tower Master of the Crimson Mage Tower, they subconsciously ignored him.
To them, a spellcaster who was merely reported to be at Great Mage level was almost insignificant as an ant.
Among those who had come this time, the King of Silver Moon was a legitimate Legendary-level being, supported by two Transcendents.
Such a lineup, even before the ancient times, could dare to confront even the King of Nolan.
The gaze of the Silver Moon King gradually sharpened, staring at the map and contemplating for a long time before nodding slightly.
"Continue to refine the plan, and execute it in three days."
Everyone immediately became serious.
This operation involved the life and death of the Silver Moon Radiance city-state, and no one dared take it lightly for the consequences of any error would be unbearable.
At that moment, the Red-eyed Lady who had accompanied Lide on the last mission to explore the Divine relic suddenly stood up and spoke,
"Your Majesty, news of a Destiny Tablet shard appearing in Green City in a month has grown increasingly credible with a high degree of truthfulness.
Should we keep a portion of our forces to investigate?"
Looking at the furrowed brows of the Silver Moon King, she explained,
"Although we already possess a shard of the Destiny Tablet, we know nothing about how to use this precious relic or any prohibitions associated with it.
If we could take this opportunity to gather some information, it might be helpful to us."
Hearing this, the Silver Moon King glanced around, his gaze falling on the deep in thought crowd within the room and then relaxing his brow.
He turned his head towards the Red-eyed Lady,
"That sounds good. You’ve lived here for a period before, so we’ll entrust this matter to you. With your surpassing strength, you are well equipped to handle some situations.
To prevent any mishaps in the upcoming actions and secure the recovery of the golden descendants, consider yourself as a reserve force. You need only to standby at a distance and not get directly involved.
If our plan encounters resistance, you’ll provide immediate assistance. If it progresses smoothly, remain hidden and gather information about the Destiny Tablet shard."
This arrangement would not only ensure the affairs of seizing the golden descendants but also eliminate potential future threats in Green City.
The Red-eyed Lady nodded gladly.
Without saying more, the Silver Moon King glanced at the people in the room, and seeing that there were no objections, he stood up and ordered the operation to begin.
—
—
—
Earth.
As rifts appeared in the sky, the aura of ancient days grew denser.
At this moment, the entire world’s attention was focused on Glory, and everyone knew that their usual playing field had now become the decisive ground for Earth’s future fate.
Not just the nations of Earth were keeping a close eye on Glory; ordinary citizens were acutely sensitive to any changes there.
As the only known Divine Artifact capable of dispelling ancient powers, it drew attention much like a short-skirted girl without underwear.
No one wanted to see, nor wished to see, ancient forces devour Earth and turn Glory into a playground for ancient monsters.
Therefore, when the news broke that a shard of the Destiny Tablet would appear in Green City a month later, as winter waned,
it immediately captured the heightened interest of countless individuals.
That very night, large official forces started moving from various parts of Glory’s Main Plane towards Green City, all converging for the sole purpose of the Destiny Tablet shard.
Whether true or false, since this news had spread from the natives and even caused a sensation among them, it warranted close attention regardless.
Momentarily, the number of players in Green City exploded geometrically.
Fortunately, though Earth now had rifts in the sky and was under ancient invasion, players still retained their ability to respawn.
Correct content is on
This was the confidence of various nations and ordinary citizens.
Of course, many militarily strong nations were also prepared for the worst scenario.
Quiet military factories were now running at full capacity, producing various new equipment loudly; those military high-tech advancements also started appearing before the public eye.
Coupled with this, military spending began to double or even increase tenfold.
Even nuclear weapons like Big Ivan from Russia had been loaded into launchers, ready to strike at the horrifying creatures that might appear.
Everything was in preparation for the disaster that was very likely to erupt.
The atmosphere grew heavier day by day, and many residents had begun to hoard large supplies of food and water, preparing for the future.
Military power was a secret beyond the grasp of ordinary citizens, and most people focused their attention on the fragments of the Destiny Tablet that had suddenly appeared in Green City.
The Glory forum was undoubtedly the best place to discuss this topic, and that evening, millions of posts popped up.
"Who will team up with me to grab the Destiny Tablet fragments? Such artifacts could make you rich in one go!"
"It’s not fair, I’m too far from Green City, it would take hundreds of deaths to get there, does anyone have a flying mount to carry me? I’ll offer my twenty years of chastity as compensation, leg hair photo · jpg."
"I seriously suspect that the appearance of Destiny Tablet fragments in Green City is a conspiracy, just bait used by the Ancient Evil God to fish, and those Light Attribute Divine beings are taking the bait and being wiped out."
"I wonder how much this artifact would sell for if it were up for sale? At least a couple million, right? Since the apocalypse has arrived, if I get it, I’ll definitely sell it and then go find a brothel until the world ends."
"..."
All sorts of bizarre posts filled the screen.
This was the first time the silly players had heard of the Destiny Tablet fragments, so they were extraordinarily excited.
Previously, whoever got a fragment of the Destiny Tablet would tightly hide it, so this public display was truly exciting.
It was like buying a lottery ticket; although everyone knew their chances of winning were small, they still held a sliver of hope.
Maybe I will be the next lucky one?
At this time, an event stirred up tremendous waves, adding countless variables to the news of the Destiny Tablet fragment appearing in Green City... because the player who took possession of the body of the Ancient Evil God and fell to become the second person in "Glory"—the Knight of the Broken Sword—posted a message.
The information within was nothing short of sensational.
Knight of the Broken Sword: I haven’t posted on the forum for a long time. The news I received today surprised me, so I felt compelled to discuss the Ancient Invasion and the Destiny Tablet fragments with everyone.
The topic of the Ancient Invasion has been discussed by more people already, and I had posted about it a few months ago, but the level we touched on before was not high, so those discussions weren’t very useful.
But this time it’s different. The information I’ve obtained from the Undead Monarch might be useful to everyone.
I’ll share the relevant information.
The source of the Ancient Invasion comes from an ancient and mysterious being.
According to the Undead Monarch, this mysterious being was killed because it interfered with the Creator God’s creation of the Glory Main Plane.
Now, that murdered mysterious being has revived, intent on overturning this world, thus orchestrating the Ancient Invasion.
It’s worth mentioning that the current Ancient Evil Gods are the Divine Essence and flesh that scattered when that mysterious being was killed.
Yes, you heard right, the horrific Ancient Evil Gods of the Glory Main Plane are merely the flesh and Divine Essence that fell from that killed mysterious being.
I was shocked when I first heard this news and it took me a long time to come around.
Those powerful Evil Gods, merely a trace of Divine and a piece of flesh... how powerful must their original form have been?
Therefore, the Ancient Evil Gods are divided into two types—those formed from Divine Essence, possessing intelligence and holding a Divine Position.
The other type is composed of flesh, with chaotic, muddled thoughts, lacking intelligence, and they do not hold a Divine Position.
Among these two types of Ancient Evil Gods, those with intelligence are few, but most of those capable of thought command the chaotic, disorderly Evil Gods.
These extremely secretive pieces of information were what I heard while the Undead Monarchs on the Main Plane were discussing among themselves, and they are highly credible.
Hence, it can be inferred.
The real entity wanting to destroy the world is a terrifying being of extreme power, and that horrifying existence is our ultimate enemy.
The Undead Monarch did not mention the other party’s name, and his words were very vague, showing extreme apprehension.
It is evident that this mysterious and terrifying entity is probably far more horrifying than we can imagine.
Faced with such an almost invincible opponent, how should we respond?
There is no need for despair, as there remains a solution.
According to the information from the Undead Monarch, a portion of that mysterious entity’s power had been sealed within the Destiny Tablet, thus making the Destiny Tablet the only artifact capable of countering that mysterious existence.
The reason the other party crushed the Destiny Tablet with the Time Gear was firstly to destroy the Destiny Tablet that suppressed Glory, and secondly, to retrieve the power that had been sealed away.
Fortunately, despite the Destiny Tablet being shattered, for some unknown reason, the opponent did not manage to reclaim their power.
Therefore, this terrifying life form has not yet returned to its peak, allowing the main plane of Glory to be preserved thus far.
As a result, the antagonist repeatedly tears apart the rules, allowing the powers of the ancient days to invade the main plane to extinguish Glory in other ways.
The only way to stand against this terrifying life is to locate the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, reassemble the Destiny Tablet, and then use the power of the entire multi-universe of Glory to suppress the opponent.
Apart from this, there is no other way.
According to the discussions and deductions of the few Undead Monarchs, the fragments of the Destiny Tablet found near Green City are likely the core of the Destiny Tablet.
This is so because they sensed a unique aura from the Destiny Tablet fragments in their possession.
More crucially, the core of the Destiny Tablet is the key to reassembling the Destiny Tablet.
To successfully control the core of the Destiny Tablet, one would need to have enough fragments to resonate with it.
In other words, the more Destiny Tablet fragments one has, the greater the chance of controlling the core of the Destiny Tablet.
Thus, the Undead Monarchs are currently intensively searching for the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
And I have also been assigned the task of collecting them.
There are two main purposes for releasing this information. First, I want everyone to be aware of the urgency of the situation. Once the core of the Destiny Tablet is captured by the Ancient Evil God, the entire world will be destroyed.
Earth will not be spared either.
The second is to announce a reward for information about the fragments of the Destiny Tablet. If anyone discovers any traces of these fragments, please contact me immediately.
The Undead Monarchs have personally promised that as long as the information about the Destiny Tablet fragments is true, no matter what happens in the future, they will ensure the safety of the person who provides the information and will also grant them legendary power.
To summarize, if you have any information about the Destiny Tablet fragments, please DM me immediately.
There are fifteen Undead Monarchs, each a supremely powerful being and the most suitable force to control the Destiny Tablet.
As long as the Undead Monarchs can eliminate the Ancient Invasion, Earth can revert to its former state, and we will have no more worries.
Thus, whether for the world or for oneself, if you discover any fragments of the Destiny Tablet, please contact me.
The post by the Knight with the Broken Sword has caused an exceptionally strong sensation.
No one expected that the Ancient Invasion still hid such a profound secret, and that the Destiny Tablet fragments about to emerge bear such an important mission.
Reassembling the Destiny Tablet to fend off the Ancient Invasion is indeed a momentous affair.
The attention already heavily focused on Green City increased tens of times over due to this news.
Even players tens of thousands of miles away are now eagerly setting off for Green City...
Everyone knows that if the message from the Knight with the Broken Sword is true, this battle in Green City could determine the future of Glory and also the future of Earth.
In an instant, the situation surged.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 500: The Construction Maniac Starts to Work
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Chapter 500: The Construction Maniac Starts to Work
"Your Majesty, news has arrived from the Blue Star Tribe of the Lost Sea, they wish to pledge allegiance to us in exchange for the protection of Dawn City."
Lide leaned back in the chair at his desk, his gaze filled with interest as he looked at Harrison.
"Have the mermaids seen the light?"
Harrison nodded.
"That’s right. After the third Sky Rift expansion, the Lost Sea was devoured by the powers of old, and a large number of ocean creatures became ancient monsters, severely impacting the living conditions of the Mermaid Tribe."
Lide understood, he was aware of the news that after the expansion of the Sky Rift, the entire sea had been dyed red with blood.
Even the Ocean God System sought refuge with Dawn City, what could the Blue Star Tribe have to counter the invasion of the ancient past?
"So they want to pledge their allegiance. But we don’t have a place to accommodate them, and it’s unlikely that the Ocean God System would allow them to lead their tribes to join..."
Harrison quickly added.
"Your Majesty, the Blue Star Tribe has a special, damaged plane that can extend a domain of dozens of miles wide.
We just need to situate it inside the lake in front of Moonlight Square, and that could become a sanctuary for the mermaids."
Lide raised an eyebrow, wondering how scarce external planes seemed to be so plentiful in the hands of ocean life?
It was one thing for the Ocean God System to possess the Water Element Plane, but for the Blue Star Tribe to have a damaged plane as well, they were certainly not viewing Dawn City in high regard.
And here he was, still worried about how to relocate the populace of Nolan Capital.
"Alright, arrange it then. As long as it’s within our capacity, we won’t ever complain about having too many people."
A smile appeared on Harrison’s face.
"I will follow your orders.
Upon pledging their allegiance, the Blue Star Tribe is willing to offer up ninety percent of their wealth..."
"Quite the smart ones."
Lide chuckled, "When the time comes, let the goblins take a tour of their warehouses. Take back whatever materials that can be used for constructing Magic Alchemy Cannons and God Hunting Crossbows, but leave the Gold Pucks to them."
"Yes, Your Majesty."
Harrison nodded in agreement.
After the City Hall Chief left, Lide was just about to flip through documents to deal with government affairs when his office door was knocked on again.
"Come in..."
Creak~
The door swung open, and a mermaid, whose lower body was a fish’s tail and upper body was human, gently swayed her tail as she floated into the room.
"Good day, Lord Kachar Main God."
Upon seeing this, Lide stood up and nodded in acknowledgment.
"Good day, Lord Virginia. What brings you to me today?"
The Mermaid Main God’s Water Element Plane was settled on the spatial coordinates of the Dawn Plains, and she resided in the palace within the plane on normal days. She wouldn’t seek Lide out unless there was something important.
Hence the question when he saw her take the initiative to visit.
"I’ve heard that your subordinates are constructing weapons to resist the Ancient Evil God?"
Lide slightly nodded, "That’s correct. Do you have any advice, Lord Virginia?"
Constructing the Alchemy Magic Cannons required mobilizing the entire city’s strength; even a three-year-old child knew that Dawn City was making major moves. The Mermaid Main God couldn’t possibly be unaware of this.
"Although we cannot utilize our Divine Country and the accumulation of hundreds of thousands of years has been sealed, we also brought a cargo of resources when we evacuated from the Lost Sea.
It’s not much, but it’s something presentable. If you need it, we are willing to provide support for Dawn City..."
