Watching the Mermaid Main God’s earnest expression, Lide’s smile instantly brightened.
It didn’t matter about the money; what he mainly enjoyed was dealing with those who were beautiful.
"Thank you for your generosity, Lord Virginia. Forming an alliance with the Ocean God System was indeed the right choice.
And you can be assured, as long as Dawn City stands, the Ocean God System will never be destroyed by those damned ancient monsters."
Upon hearing Lide’s hearty assurance, the face of the Mermaid Main God softened as well.
The oceanic life was not skilled in weapon forging, a fact known to all; therefore, although their storerooms were filled with a great quantity of materials, these materials were not being put to use and were simply gathering dust.
On normal days, even if Lide was respected by them, he wouldn’t casually get access to the inventory to make weapons.
But now things were different, the two parties had formed an alliance, and they had to confront a formidable enemy that caused everyone to tremble in fear.
If they continued to hide their resources, it would be an irresponsible act towards themselves.
Therefore, she took this opportunity to move the inventory out for Lide to forge weapons— the stronger Dawn City was, the higher the safety of the Ocean God System would be.
The interests of both parties were aligned, so there was no issue of one side losing out.
Lide also appreciated such sensible behavior. What he feared the most at this stage were partners who dragged their feet, calculating against each other before even winning was definitely something he despised deeply.
After thanking the Mermaid Main God once more, he suddenly recalled the message he received last night.
The fragment of the Destiny Tablet in Green City would emerge in one month...
After this message was released, the intelligence command center presented the detailed information to Lide’s desk.
However, what caught his attention was the message from the Crimson Moon, especially the post sent by the Broken Sword Knight, which alarmed him.
The Undead Monarch actually believed that a Destiny Tablet fragment was to emerge in Green City, and not just any fragment but the most vital core part of the Destiny Tablet.
And to assemble the Destiny Tablet, the most crucial part was its core.
In other words, no matter his future plans, as long as he held onto the Destiny Tablet fragment, he had to contend for it this time.
If the core of the Destiny Tablet fell into someone else’s hands, he might not be able to keep these two fragments.
What weighed heavily on his mind was that due to the players, the whole world now knew of this message.
No one could predict how many terrifying Divine beings would arrive.
He never doubted the allure of the Destiny Tablet fragments on Divine beings, especially since the fragment that was about to emerge was the core part of the Destiny Tablet.
Just thinking about it, he could sense the immense pressure that Green City would face next.
That was the core of the Destiny Tablet, related to the fate of the entire Glory.
If things went awry, an unprecedented Battle of the Gods might erupt directly.
And then, Green City might very likely be destroyed in the war of the Gods...
Had the message been false, Lide would not have been so tense.
But the problem lay in the fact that, after receiving the message, he sensed through the Destiny Tablet fragment within Dawn City and did indeed feel the presence of another fragment in the direction of Green City.
Moreover, that presence was exceptionally unique, and he was filled with a longing desire for it.
Having been imbued with the Power of Destiny, his perception of the Destiny Tablet fragments had increased drastically. Therefore, he could determine that indeed a Destiny Tablet fragment was about to emerge in Green City.
However, the fragment was still shrouded by the Power of Destiny and had not revealed its true form, making it seem blurred and preventing him from locating its exact position.
Sooner or later that fragment of the Destiny Tablet would appear; this disaster was inescapable for Green City, and he could not avoid it either.
Shaking his head, Lide pulled himself out of his disordered thoughts and looked intensely at the Mermaid Main God.
"Lord Virginia, do you know that a fragment of the Destiny Tablet is going to emerge in Green City in a month?"
The Mermaid Main God was momentarily startled, then her brows furrowed tightly.
"I have not heard of it..."
Since entering Dawn City, her source of news from the outside world had completely relied on the information from the intelligence command center.
And such a grave matter concerning the Destiny Tablet fragment was not something the intelligence command center would inform the Mermaid Main God of without Lide’s approval.
Lide’s expression became serious, and after pondering for a moment, he recounted the message he received. Finally, he spoke in a solemn voice.
"Although we are far from prepared, the Destiny Tablet fragment in Green City concerns our fate. So this time, I hope that Lord Virginia can cooperate with me with all your might.
Survival or destruction may well be determined in this upcoming battle."
To snatch the Destiny Tablet fragment under the watchful eyes of the entire Glory was definitely not an easy task.
Yet, the importance of the core of the Destiny Tablet made it impossible for him to give up; to give up would mean losing the right to choose, and the future of Dawn City would then only be to sit and await doom.
His character wouldn’t allow such a thing to happen.
So, he must give it his all in this gamble.
Even the Mermaid Main God is not enough; by then, he will also request Lady Kaslina to come out of retirement.
Without Lady Kaslina’s support in such a battle, Dawn City wouldn’t stand a chance against the numerous Divine entities.
"For our future, I shall give all my strength to support you, Kachar Main God."
The Mermaid Main God was clear-cut in her stance, offering even the treasures from her storehouse, which showed her genuine recognition of Lide.
Lide nodded slightly, his gaze growing intense.
"In this month’s time, I will mobilize all of Dawn City’s resources to forge the God Hunting Crossbows and Magic Alchemy Cannons, while also seeking other Destiny Tablet fragments and hunting Divine beings, preparing for the upcoming decisive battle.
I hope you can act alongside me.
Perhaps this battle will be our most grueling yet, and we cannot afford the consequences of failure."
"Under your command, Kachar Main God!"
The Mermaid Main God didn’t show a hint of fear; since the battle was inevitable, she was ready to face it head-on!
The Ocean God System has never known fear!
After the Mermaid Main God left, orders started flowing immediately from within City Hall.
Dawn City, this colossal machinery, began to turn; the Magic Industrial System, which Lide had built with countless effort, was once again showcasing its awe-inspiring power to the world.
The building frenzy had begun...
Having ascended to Legendary status, the Land of Bone-Burying opened hundreds of Space Gates connecting different parts of Dawn City.
Materials from various storages were moved into the Land of Bone-Burying like flowing water.
Magic Industry Research Institute, Dawn Mage Tower, Alchemy Factory, Weapon Factory...all the heavyweight departments sent their top talents into the Land of Bone-Burying to assist in construction.
Moer, the goblin Chief who inherited the Ancient Alchemy, became the core all were rallying around, directing the departments in building two superweapons—the God Hunting Crossbows and Alchemy Magic Cannons.
The God Hunting Crossbows required the remains of Divine beings; Lide had none at hand and could only prepare in advance.
But the materials for Alchemy Magic Cannons were abundant.
Whether it was conquering the Underworld, exploiting the depths of various planes, or seizing Green City, Lide had amassed vast resources—ample to produce Magic Alchemy Cannons capable of bombarding Divine beings.
To expedite the process, Lide had all six Divine beings from the Ocean God System come back to assist, temporarily relinquishing his guardianship of the Destiny Tablet fragments in the Underworld.
Over 300,000 residents were directly involved in this epic construction, with more than 2 million participating indirectly.
Day and night, construction continued without cease for twenty-four Sunshine Hours.
One-eyed Giants, Centaurs, Half-Elves, Humans, Bloodline, Beastmen... any race that could be of use, no matter who they were or what they were doing, were immediately drafted to construct the Alchemy Magic Cannon.
Fortunately, Lide had the foresight to construct the Alchemy Magic Cannon within the Land of Bone-Burying.
In this plane entirely his own, he could delegate authority within the Land of Bone-Burying, mobilizing the plane’s entire strength for construction.
Had it been built outside, it would have likely taken ten times longer.
Adequate manpower, convenient construction environment, and sufficient materials meant the build of the Magic Alchemy Cannon was quickly taking shape at an astounding pace.
This time, all residents would contribute their wisdom and labor to the path of slaughtering Gods.
To slay Divine beings with mortal bodies was something only the alchemy that once made Gods wary could achieve.
And as Dawn City thrummed with activity, Lide visited Lady Kaslina’s dwelling again.
It seemed Kaslina knew he would come, as she spoke first.
"Do you wish to inquire about the Destiny Tablet fragment near Green City?"
Lide nodded.
"Lady Kaslina, please tell me the truth.
Rumors say that the Destiny Tablet fragments around Green City are the core of the Destiny Tablet, and the core is key to converging the whole Destiny Tablet.
This matter is thus of utmost importance to us in Dawn City."
Lady Kaslina turned around, her gaze burning as she looked at him, her tone filled with a touch of contemplation.
"This is the guidance of destiny, and it is a responsibility that cannot be escaped.
Do you know why the core of the Destiny Tablet fell near Green City?"
This question confirmed the authenticity of the news about the Destiny Tablet’s core.
Lide’s expression became even more grave.
"Please enlighten me."
This related to the future of Dawn City; he couldn’t let any information slip by.
"Because the area near Green City, including the entire Southern Province and the Barren Wastelands, is the first land created by the Creator God.
That is also why the Initial Plane with the sealed coffin appeared here.
And the Destiny Tablet is the core of Glory’s destiny, shattered by the Time Gear, scattering its pieces to every corner of the world.
By chance, guided by fate, its core has descended upon this land."
Upon hearing these words, Lide was lost in thought for a long time.
He hadn’t expected such profound origins hidden within...
After a moment, as if something occurred to him, he abruptly lifted his head to look at Lady Kaslina.
"Is this also the reason why you have stayed in Dawn City?"
Lady Kaslina nodded.
"That’s right, there is that reason. As the first land created by the Creator God, it is bound to carry more responsibilities.
I have never left Dawn City because I sensed a shift in destiny; this land might become the turning point for Glory.
Therefore, I must protect it."
Lide slowly nodded, finally understanding the reason why Lady Kaslina had stayed in Dawn City after awakening.
This fearsome being had perceived a possible future change long ago.
"Then why didn’t you inform me earlier?"
Lady Kaslina shook her head.
"Telling you wouldn’t have had much effect; your strength was not enough to change anything before."
A wry smile flickered on Lide’s lips; indeed, knowing such earth-shaking matters of Glory wasn’t good without sufficient power.
Correct content is on
After pondering for a moment, he spoke earnestly.
"I hope you can lend your assistance when the time comes; I must seize that fragment of the Destiny Tablet!"
His tone was decisive, without a hint of hesitation.
Lady Kaslina looked deeply at Lide.
"This is my destiny..."
Lide nodded solemnly.
"Thank you for your trust.
I need to return to Green City, I hope you can protect Dawn City for the time being."
After a slight nod from Lady Kaslina, she fell silent, turning back to gaze into the distance.
Seeing this, Lide took a deep breath and left without any hesitation.
The coming storm that Dawn City was about to face would be unprecedentedly terrifying.
He had to prepare in this last month’s time.
The battle was imminent!
In a daze, he could already see the clash of gods above the skies of Green City...
And doomsday was approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 501 Last Preparations Before Battle
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Chapter 501 Last Preparations Before Battle
Huff, huff~
Castro flapped his wings as he left Dawn City, speeding towards Green City.
It was early February by now, and although the cold current was still surging in the sky, it was noticeably getting warmer.
Lide did not use the Land of Bone-Burying to travel to Green City, as he was worried outsiders might notice the spatial fluctuations from there.
After learning about the imminent emergence of a core piece of the Destiny Tablet in Green City, one couldn’t be too careful.
Who knew if some powerful beings were already lurking around Green City? Caution never caused any harm.
Castro’s flight speed soared to the extreme, and in just a little over half a day, the majesty of Green City, like a lion sprawled out, was already in sight.
Lide did not ostentatiously urge Castro to charge straight in, and when they were at a distance, he let Castro shrink and took him into his arms.
He proceeded towards Green City alone.
At critical moments, there was no need for unnecessary show.
Upon entering the city, Lide immediately sensed that something was amiss.
After Dawn City had taken control of Green City, most of the residents typically wore relaxed smiles—it was rare to see streets filled with worried faces.
But now, the once easy smiles had vanished, each person’s face was tense, cautiously looking around, immediately bowing their heads and stepping back whenever a luxurious carriage drove by.
It seemed as if they were afraid of offending someone.
One or two people acting this way was one thing, but when there were many, it made the atmosphere extremely oppressive.
Just then, several passersby were whispering to each other, which immediately drew Lide’s attention.
"Did you hear? Last night someone killed more than ten guards in the city center, and none of those army officers have caught the perpetrator yet."
"Keep your voice down. I’ve heard about it too; it’s said to be because of the Destiny Tablet fragments..."
"Destiny Tablet fragments? Are those the Divine Artifacts the Sun Goddess spoke of that could resist the Ancient Invasion?"
"That’s right, I don’t know who leaked the information a few days ago, but a fragment of the Destiny Tablet is said to appear in Green City in a month, so these days have been particularly chaotic."
"Ah, isn’t that the truth? Especially those lawless adventurers, they seem to be brawling all the time these days..."
"Hopefully, once this is all over, we can have some peace..."
Once the group had walked away, Lide, who had masked his own aura, had a subtle expression on his face.
The fragment of the Destiny Tablet had not even emerged yet, and there was already a sense that a volcano was about to erupt.
What kind of terrible torrent would be unleashed in Green City when the fragment of the Destiny Tablet actually appeared?
"Should I evacuate the residents of Green City first?"
He dismissed this thought as soon as it arose.
Never mind that there was no place to put them.
Transporting millions of residents under the watchful eyes of countless people, as if it were a joke?
Dawn City would likely be immediately exposed to outsiders, and the Land of Bone-Burying could no longer remain hidden.
He certainly did not want his home base and trump cards to be exposed at this juncture—he wouldn’t find it at all amusing if someone attacked Dawn City in his absence and stole it.
Lide did not rush on his way and slowly proceeded along the streets towards the direction of the Crimson Mage Tower.
Because of the spell he had cast, his face was blurred and his aura was very faint; therefore, outsiders were only surprised by the mage’s robe he wore and did not give him any extra attention.
Moreover, because of the players, spellcasters who would usually be a rare sight were no longer so uncommon, so Lide did not attract too much attention.
He took this time to carefully observe Green City.
By the time he returned to the Crimson Mage Tower, he had a more direct understanding of the situation in the city.
It was not much different from what he had initially thought—Green City was like a city on the top of a volcano.
It could be submerged by erupting lava at any moment.
He walked from the city gate to the Crimson Mage Tower and immediately sensed the presence of no less than ten Legendary entities, and even a fleeting divine pressure.
It was only because the other party moved quickly that he likely refrained from taking action.
The God Hunting Crossbow at Dawn City still lacked materials.
And now was just the beginning. As time progressed, more terrifying lives would undoubtedly infiltrate Green City.
The most vexing part was that he could not stop the other party; standing out too much in the forest would lead to its destruction. Lord Ilo was currently the visible Guardian of Green City and the first enemy in many people’s eyes.
He certainly did not want to reveal too much of his hand before the battle had even begun.
At the entrance of the Crimson Mage Tower, Lide dispersed the magic cast upon himself, then stepped into the doors of the Mage Tower amid the surprised and delighted stares of the apprentices.
Moments later, everyone knew of Lide’s return.
Little Isa heard the heated discussions below and dashed out of the third-floor study of the Mage Tower. She then threw herself into Lide’s arms.
The girl’s eyes were filled with dependence and trust.
Patting the little girl’s head, Lide was also in a great mood; she was almost like a real younger sister to him in his heart.
Holding her hand, they stepped into the Mage Tower under the envious gazes of the apprentices.
"Isa, where is your sister Vina?"
"She’s at City Hall, teacher. Do you need me to inform sister Vina to come back?"
Sitting on the sofa on the first floor of the Mage Tower, Isa clung close to Lide’s seat like a clingy little cat.
"No need, let her be busy."
Looking at the girl who never seemed to grow up, Lide’s eyes were full of doting.
Suddenly, as if he remembered something, he hesitantly began to ask.
"Did Vina mention anything about your people to you?"
Vina’s ruby-like eyes dimmed slightly, and she pursed her lips, nodding her head.
"Teacher, they said that my parents left after giving birth to me...
And the reason they met with misfortune was the long-tailed trolls, those malevolent lives had severely wounded them before.
The bloodline within my body can inherit the power of the Silver Moon Clan and avenge my parents..."
She said with a somewhat blank expression on her face.
Isa was raised by foster parents. Even though she had suffered a lot, her heart remained pure. When the people of the Silver Moon Clan spoke to her about revenge, the girl didn’t feel much.
After all, she never saw her parents’ faces from a young age and felt no different from strangers, so it was somewhat abrupt when they suddenly spoke of revenge.
Moreover, they also said that she carried the future of the Silver Moon Clan, which made the little girl feel even more at a loss.
Hearing this, Lide fell silent for a moment, then revealed a slight smile to comfort her.
"Don’t worry, you still have your teacher here. Whatever happens, I’ll take care of it.
What are your thoughts? Do you want to help them?"
Although Isa was still not fully grown and lacked maturity, Lide still wanted to hear the girl’s thoughts.
After all, they were her people, and blood-wise, they might be the few remaining relatives she had in this world.
"Teacher..." Isa instinctively hugged Lide’s arm tighter, whispering with some nervousness.
"If, if possible, I want to help them..."
Lide smiled wryly and nodded.
"Alright, since that’s the case, once we get through this busy period, I’ll take you to the Storm Sea Domain."
He naturally couldn’t afford to be absent now; he needed to prepare for the coming war of the gods.
He not only had to hunt deities to gather their remains to build the God Hunting Crossbow but also had to search for fragments of the Destiny Tablet. The pressure was extraordinary.
Fortunately, Isa was very understanding and nodded obediently without any objection.
After chatting with the obedient Isa for a while and checking on her magic homework, Lide did not stay long. After giving the girl some instructions, he directly left the Crimson Mage Tower via magic.
Now was not the time for idle chatter.
Moments later, Lord Ilo reappeared in the estate of the City Lord of Green City, wearing a black and white mage’s robe.
This news was immediately spread by those who were interested, and for a while, many powerful beings began to stir restlessly.
Lide did not know when the fragments of the Destiny Tablet would appear, but outsiders did not know this, so they all wanted to ask him, the local serpent.
However, because of his previous formidable reputation in battle, no one dared to approach him to inquire for the time being.
These shrewd people all thought about staying in the shadows, hoping to benefit from the fisherman’s gain.
Even though Lide was reluctant to reveal all his power, he was not timid.
On the surface, he appeared to return alone, but in secret, a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel and the Mermaid Main God were protecting him.
If anyone dared to provoke him, he was ready to kill to establish his authority.
But to his disappointment, after he appeared, he waited a long time without anyone coming forward to challenge him, and his desire to assert his dominance had to be abandoned.
In the main hall of the City Lord estate.
Receiving the news of Lide’s return, all the high-ranking figures currently in Green City gathered.
Stanley, who controlled the Dark Contract; Deputy City Lord Wina; Duke O’Kelly, a Deputy City Lord; Deputy City Lord Nicole; Deputy City Lord Frey; and Grot, the Child of the North—these important generals were all present.
Lide did not beat around the bush. Once everyone was present, he relayed all the information related to the Destiny Tablet fragments to them and finally concluded in a solemn tone.
"One month from now, the location where the Destiny Tablet fragments appear will determine the fate of Green City. Everyone must be wholeheartedly committed to the tasks ahead."
The expressions of those below tensed, their gaze intense as they looked at him.
"Please give your orders."
Lide nodded his head and began giving directions.
"First, detail the plan for how Green City should respond once the Destiny Tablet fragments emerge, preparing for various scenarios, including battle and evacuation."
"Second, initiate the evacuation of residents to neighboring cities to reside temporarily, prioritizing volunteers."
"Third, enforce military orders strictly; no matter what level of crime is encountered within the city, show no mercy."
"Fourth, establish an emergency team composed entirely of high-level combatants to deal with enemies that regular troops cannot handle..."
"Fifth, transfer wealth..."
"..."
After more than a dozen plans were laid out, the atmosphere in the room tightened.
From Lide’s serious expression, everyone knew that this time, it was for real.
The forthcoming battle might exceed their imaginations.
After Lide had finished speaking, Wina stood up with glittering eyes, staring intently at Lide.
"Lord, can we use the adventurers from the Lost Plane as substitutes for the soldiers of Green City in this battle?
For example, hiring adventurers in advance to defend the city would allow us to withdraw our main troops, maintaining order while reducing our casualties..."
This suggestion brightened the room, striking a chord with many. The daring adventurers might not be good for other tasks, but they were the perfect choice to be scapegoats. With the right reward, those adventurers would be willing to do anything...
Lide pondered for a moment and then slowly nodded.
"I will arrange for the Crimson Moon Guild to take over the defense of Green City."
In fact, he had already considered this. After uniting with the Dark Contract, the Crimson Moon had completely taken control of the player’s main city, Anos City.
Their current strength was incredibly formidable.
After such a long time since the server opened, the mainstream player level had already reached Level 10, with top players uniformly at Level 15.
Millions of Level 10 players, an undeniable force that no one could afford to overlook.
Even these idiots had finally reached a level where they could make an appearance.
In truth, aside from high-level combat power falling short of Dawn City, Crimson Moon really couldn’t beat a regular army.
Faced with a bunch of people who weren’t afraid of dying, everyone had to hold back a bit.
"Lord, will the Destiny Tablet fragments definitely appear?" Nicole, upon hearing that Lide approved Vina’s suggestion, quickly stood up, her big eyes spinning wildly as if she was coming up with some plan.
Lide looked at the girl who had grown into a woman and shook his head.
"Nobody can be certain until the last moment, but as for now, the probability of the Destiny Tablet fragments appearing has peaked. Unless there’s an unexpected event, it’s inevitable..."
Nicole’s eyes lit up, "Then, can we lead the tiger away from the mountain, lure those heading to Green City to other places? Or use the information of the Destiny Tablet fragments to have them kill each other..."
Lide gave Nicole a second look upon hearing this, but after pondering for a moment, he still waved his hand.
"No need to think about these schemes. In the face of absolute power, they’re not that effective.
They will only distract us."
"..."
"Any other questions?" Lide continued to ask, disregarding Nicole who pouted and sat back down.
"Lord, how should the army..."
"Lord, what about the weapons in our armory..."
A Sunshine Hour had passed by the time the meeting was barely concluded.
The main direction of the meeting was to stabilize the situation, then evacuate the residents, and let the players take the place of the army to maintain order in Green City.
As for the topic of steadfastly repelling the invading enemy, it didn’t even come up—Green City’s military was no match for the enemy’s strength.
After the meeting, Duke O’Kelly, who had barely spoken during the session, stayed behind alone, seemingly having some indescribable dilemma he wished to share with Lide.
Looking at this once-unreachable ruler of the province to the south, Lide also felt quite emotional.
What a reversal of fortune in thirty years; a man who was once untouchable now but a screw beneath Dawn City, had become dispensable.
Duke O’Kelly’s inner turmoil was no less than that of Lide’s, but at this point, he no longer had the standing to make idle chat with Lide, as the difference in their status was like heaven and earth.
"Lord Ilo, may I request that you send my wife and daughter to Dawn City?"
The upcoming chaos would be beyond redemption, and his family was likely doomed if they stayed. Thus, Duke O’Kelly could only swallow his pride and implore Lide.
Hearing the request, Lide looked at him intently.
"I will arrange it later."
Duke O’Kelly immediately breathed a sigh of relief and then, chest puffed out, regarded Lide with a serious tone.
"Lord, after the army retreats, let me guard Green City for you. This place cannot be left without someone in command.
Even if Green City is destroyed in the upcoming divine war, I am willing to be buried with it."
This was Duke O’Kelly’s last ounce of pride. As the former ruler of the city, he refused to abandon his city, even if it meant giving up his life.
Lide looked at the duke with respect.
Anyone who could face death so calmly, no matter who they were, deserved respect.
"Duke O’Kelly, I respect your choice.
If you fall in battle, your children and wife will be looked after by Dawn City, and your name will be engraved on the Heroes’ Monument in Dawn City, for future generations to admire."
Hearing this, Duke O’Kelly straightened up sharply and gave a military salute to Lide.
All the final arrangements before the war were thus completed.
Lide, with a profound gaze, looked out of the window at the sky. The next time, the real battle would begin.
By then, this city that had stood for a thousand years might well become ruins...

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 502: Heading to the Storm Sea Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Chapter 502: Heading to the Storm Sea Domain
Clip-clop~ Clip-clop~
The sound of horse hooves rose from the streets.
A carriage with the emblem of the Crimson Mage Tower began to slowly drive out from the tower, heading towards the White Tower.
For the ordinary residents, a carriage bearing the flag of the Mage lords is considered to be a sacred object, not to be looked upon directly, and to be avoided, while to the Nobles, a Mage with powerful Magic Power is an enemy not to be provoked, and they wouldn’t dare to conflict with one.
Hence, the carriage traveled smoothly along its way, with no one daring to interfere.
For the stores along the street, this scene had long become a familiar one.
The carriage from the Crimson Mage Tower would pass in front of their shops every three days, with the novelty wearing off after the first few times.
But today, the atmosphere seemed somewhat different.
Unnoticed by the passersby, a number of mysterious figures in black cloaks had suddenly appeared on the street.
However, due to the increasing chaos in the city and the influx of adventurers, no one paid much attention anymore, or dared to care about these dangerously cloaked individuals. Better to mind one’s own business.
To stir up trouble could mean losing one’s life.
Click-clack~ Click-clack~
The carriage wheels rolled over cobblestones in rhythmic sounds, everything seeming no different from usual.
Yet the change occurred ever so stealthily; as the carriage passed a crossroads, the originally quiet street suddenly became as noisy as boiling water.
Suddenly, about a dozen mysterious figures in black robes launched an attack towards the carriage, their dreadful presence surging forth.
An ambush! Someone actually dared to ambush the carriage of the Crimson Mage Tower in the city!
Ah!!
Witnessing this sudden turn of events, the nearby residents immediately screamed and fled.
Those in black cloaks didn’t pay any attention to the scattering residents, their target being the carriage.
But before they got close to the carriage, a terrifying Magic fluctuation erupted from within.
In an instant, lightning flashed within a hundred meters radius around the carriage.
Four Circle Magic—Thunder God Descent.
Those charging towards the carriage in black robes instantly stiffened, collapsing on the spot, with only three or five still twitching and struggling, the others had lost their ability to fight.
Hiding in the shadows, the Silver Moon King saw this scene and was instantly filled with irritation.
These damned fools, they acted before reaching the spot! The King’s Guard soldiers were so reckless!
Such a wide range of attack would surely have alerted the city guards; now they’d have to wrap things up quickly!
With this thought, he no longer hesitated. His Legendary Level presence burst forth, charging towards the carriage.
At the same time, he shouted.
"Isa, I am your kin! We’re taking you back not to harm you, please do not resist..."
---
---
---
When the fight broke out, Lide was in the City Lord’s manor exchanging information with Zhao Yue, the president of the Crimson Moon.
He was inquiring about the location of Divine beings.
In order to increase his odds in the upcoming war in Green City in a month, he must strengthen his own power. While it was impossible for him to rise in Level in such a short time, the God Hunting Crossbow was undoubtedly the fastest way to enhance his strength.
To slay a Divine, such an item was a treasure at this critical juncture.
However, the prerequisite for using the God Hunting Crossbow was to possess the body of a Divine, without which nothing could be accomplished; hence he had to hunt down a Divine.
When Zhao Yue realized Lide’s intention, her expression became extremely interesting.
A Divine, what level of existence was that? To think of hunting as if it were a common task?
This gave her quite the sense of defeat.
But in Lide’s eyes, it seemed that this really wasn’t such a big issue.
With a somewhat peculiar mood, Zhao Yue shared the intelligence from the Data Analysis Department with Lide.
No matter what he was going to do, the Crimson Moon was to comply unconditionally with his commands.
Lide looked at the map, where the markings he had made were now densely packed, and the expression on his face was one of pleasure.
This was the advantage of having power; he didn’t even need to show up himself. With just a wave of his hand, there were people below who would take care of matters for him.
Just then, a thunderous boom suddenly caught his attention. Four Circle Magic? Or... Thunder God Descent?
It was as though he thought of something, and he abruptly stood up, looking towards the empty space beside him, his voice cold and severe.
"Frey, what’s happening outside?"
Swoosh~
The Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel appeared out of the shattered void under the shocked gaze of Zhao Yue.
"Lord, Isa is being attacked..."
A shock went through Lide’s heart, followed instantly by a surge of rage.
How audacious!
To dare to attack his disciple within Green City!!
Did they think his blade had lost its edge?
They were truly courting death!
"Frey, immediately take control of the situation!"
Having said that, he turned his head to another side. "Lord Virginia, follow her. If you encounter the enemy, show no mercy!"
The icy voice carried an endless intent to kill.
Daring to provoke a tiger, did these people no longer wish to live?!
As his words fell, both Frey and the as-yet unseen Mermaid Main God disappeared without a trace.
Seeing this scene, Zhao Yue got up anxiously and quickly asked.
"President Yue, what’s happened?"
After seeing Frey and the Mermaid Main God depart, Lide’s expression relaxed slightly.
With two such terrifying combatants, any disturbance within the city could be suppressed.
"My disciple has been attacked...
President Yue, go back and order the Data Analysis Department to conduct a full-scale search for traces of the Divine around Green City. I need to hunt a large number of deities.
Let’s not talk any more today."
Once Zhao Yue nodded in response, Lide didn’t say anything more, and his figure flashed away from the room.
Zhao Yue looked at Lide’s vanishing back, her expression quite complex, and finally, she sighed softly and turned to leave.
There was much she wanted to communicate with Lide about, and she would have liked to talk more with him.
But given the other side’s ever-growing power and authority, even the proud and confident her felt somewhat intimidated.
Naturally, Lide had no idea of Zhao Yue’s thoughts. He left the City Hall and arrived at the scene of the incident as quickly as possible.
By then, in barely a dozen seconds, the battle had already concluded.
A group of mysterious individuals dressed in black robes, with red eyes, were now slumped on the ground, devoid of the ability to fight.
Among them, one caught Lide’s eye and made it narrow—in exploring the divine ruins in the Lost Sea a year ago, the woman with red eyes had been by his side... that Red-eyed Lady.
Then his gaze shifted to the Isa floating in the air, surrounded by seven or eight Four Circle Magic Magma Fireballs, and his expression changed slightly.
These bastards, they really dared to make a move to snatch Isa!!
He had sent people last night to tell the Silver Moon Clan that he would personally lead Isa to the Silver Moon Radiance city-state after the matters in Green City.
But to his disbelief, these people were audacious enough to ignore his words.
This was truly seeking death!!
Murder intent flashed in his eyes.
"Teacher..."
Upon seeing Lide arrive, the Isa who had just been suspended in the sky, looking as though she could destroy the city with her magic at any moment, immediately dispersed all her spells and obediently flew to Lide’s side, her eyes full of dependency.
Lide nodded slightly, his gaze turning towards the wrecked ground and those Silver Moon Clan who had been subdued by Frey.
"Who gave you the audacity to commit violence in Green City?"
"Drag them all out and slaughter them, not a single one spared!"
At these words, the faces of the Silver Moon Clanspeople below turned ashen to the extreme.
Slaughter them??
Could it be that he no longer cared about Lady Isa?
As one, they lifted their heads hoping to see if Isa would speak out to stop it, but when they saw Isa showed no sign of intervening, their hearts sank to the bottom of the sea.
Indeed, they had never had any dealings with Isa, and counting from the first time they met, it had only been a few short days.
Perhaps she had not even remembered their names, to expect Isa to plead for them just because of a pair of familiar eyes... Wasn’t that too childish?
After realizing the crux of the matter, everyone’s face turned deathly pale.
They had always believed that what they were doing was right, that the city-state under the Silver Moon Radiance could not wait forever.
But when their plan was ruthlessly thwarted, only then did they realize that this time, they had launched an aggressive attack. If they had succeeded, it would have been fine, but having failed, it was their turn to pay the price of retribution.
The Red-eyed Lady was even more desperate. She knew how strong Lide was, but she couldn’t not save her own people.
Biting her teeth, under the Divine Power of Frey, she shakily stood up.
"Lord Ilo, is it possible, possible to bypass His Majesty the King?
We are willing to accept punishment, but His Majesty the King carries the fate of the entire city-state under the Silver Moon Radiance..."
"What does that have to do with me?"
Lide’s tone was cold, showing no mercy.
This time he was truly angered. Isa was like his own sister, and out of nowhere, a group of people wanted to violently take her away—how could anyone’s mother stand for that?
Not to immediately slaughter these scoundrels was already a testament to his patience.
The killing intent in his words filled the crowd below with even more despair.
Those who wanted to escape lost all hope when they saw the Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel unfolding its wings behind Lide, their eyes dimming, void of luster.
A Twelve-winged Blazing Angel, what a fearsomely powerful being—how could they hope to compete?
The opponent merely waved his hand, and they were suppressed. Now, they couldn’t even gather their magic power, no different from being paralyzed.
Had they known the opponent was so powerful, and his relationship with Isa so close, they would never have acted so rashly.
But there’s no medicine for regret in the world.
Seeing the situation in dire straits, the Silver Moon King tremblingly stood up, looked directly at Lide, and with all his might said,
"Lord Ilo, I have no intention of being your enemy. Isa has the Golden Bloodline, she’s the only one in our Silver Moon Clan who can inherit the power of our ancestors...
If you take Isa back to the city-state under the Silver Moon Radiance, you will immediately have a demigod-level existence on your side, which for you..."
"Do I need it?" Lide cut off the King’s words directly, unwavering.
What’s a demigod to him? Can it withstand a single strike from Frey?
Just as he was getting annoyed that his army below had not acted yet, a statement from the Silver Moon King stopped him in his tracks.
"Lord Ilo, I—I’m willing to exchange the pieces of the Destiny Tablet for the lives of me and my clanspeople."
Lide’s demeanor tensed, his gaze piercing the Silver Moon King like a blade as he said, word by word,
"You want to exchange pieces of the Destiny Tablet for your lives? You have pieces of the Destiny Tablet?!"
To control the core of the Destiny Tablet, one must have enough pieces of it.
He was currently lacking pieces of the Destiny Tablet—was this a dream come true?
Sensing Lide’s eager interest, the Silver Moon King immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
He was not afraid of Lide having a need, but rather that Lide would show no interest in the pieces of the Destiny Tablet—if that were the case, then their destruction was certain.
"We have it. After the Old Days descended, a rift opened in the sky, and a piece of the Destiny Tablet fell into the city-state under the Silver Moon Radiance, now in the hands of my clanspeople."
Damn, wasn’t that just wonderfully lucky?
Man does not receive such windfalls from the heavens...
Lide glanced at the Silver Moon King with displeasure; the fellow’s luck was simply incredible...
"If you are telling the truth, I can spare your clanspeople... Time is of the essence. I will make arrangements and then take Isa to accompany you to the Storm Sea Domain."
The Silver Moon King and his clan members lying on the ground were all startled and then overjoyed. They hadn’t expected such good fortune. Had they known, they would not have gone to such lengths; they could have simply offered the Destiny Tablet shard. Now, many had died in vain, and so much time had been wasted.
Lady Isa also quietly breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing Lide’s words. Although he had attacked her, he had not intended her harm, and if it weren’t for the extreme circumstances, the young girl would have hoped for his survival, since he was one of her clan.
Of course, she would not ask Lide for anything. In the girl’s heart, Lide was greater than the heavens, and she needed only to follow whatever decisions he made.
Lide hesitated no longer, his gaze turning to Bloodline Frey, who had already rushed to the battlefield.
"Frey, I’m about to make a trip to the Storm Sea Domain. You take charge of Green Town. Show no mercy to those who break the rules!"
Having said that, he turned to look at the void beside him.
"Lord Virginia, I’m about to visit the Storm Sea Domain. I will trouble you to temporarily take care of Green City. Assist them if they face enemies they can’t defeat and don’t worry, there shouldn’t be too many powerful deities appearing within half a month. I will return as quickly as possible."
Upon hearing this, the Mermaid Main God nodded slightly in the Dimensional Plane.
"I will follow your commands, Kachar Main God."
After giving his simple instructions, Lide, without further hesitation, swung out his hand and summoned Castro into existence. Then, he tossed both the Silver Moon King and the Red-eyed Lady onto Castro’s back.
As for the rest, they were all imprisoned until his return.
free\.c o(m)
With all this done, he took Lady Isa’s hand and sat on Castro’s back, soaring into the sky under everyone’s watchful eyes.
Previously, there was no respite on the flight to the Storm Sea Domain. If it were any other day, Lide would have planned ahead and not rushed, but the approaching Great War would not afford him such luxury; he had to cut through the chaos as swiftly as he could.
After the battle inside Green City, many top-level existences lurking within had retreated even deeper.
Frey had not concealed her aura when she made her move; a Level 36 Medium Divine Power deity, she represented an incredibly powerful life form.
This put off individuals aiming for mischief, and they quietly waited for the time when the Destiny Tablet shard would emerge. Thus, Green City’s public order unexpectedly improved.
West District.
Inside a luxurious estate, Viscount Bernard, the former President of the Dark Covenant, stood before a window, gazing through the clear glass at the direction where Frey had just swept through the Silver Moon Clan, a cold smile on his face.
"Quite interesting, a Fallen Angel has become the guardian of a city with millions of inhabitants..."
"And Lord Ilo happens to be a bona fide Vampire."
"This world has indeed experienced a change. At this rate, will Devils also become part of the Good Camp?"
After finishing his thoughts, Viscount Bernard seemed to remember something and turned to look at the Eight-Armed Snake Demon Roy, who stood in the shadows and gazed at the sky.
"Roy, if this plan succeeds, that Fallen Angel will be nothing but a plaything in our cage..."
"The power of the Nine Prisons shall devour the world..."
"This sky... only the ruler of the Nine Prisons can control it!"
The Eight-Armed Snake Demon’s narrow eyes revealed a bloodthirsty killing intent, and he sneered.
"Can the five million souls in this city activate the Twelve Magic Scrolls?"
"Not enough..." Viscount Bernard shook his head, his smile growing more disturbing.
"Then what should we do?"
"Those adventurers could make up the numbers..."
The Eight-Armed Snake Demon furrowed his brows.
"They are Undead."
"No, you don’t understand. The rules of the Lost Plane have fractures now. Once their souls are devoured by the Twelve Magic Scrolls, there will no longer be a chance for their resurrection!"
"Those fresh souls will become the nourishment for our Divine Enthronement!"
At this moment, Viscount Bernard’s demeanor became more elegant, but his expression also took on an increasingly sinister cast.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 503: The War That Decides the Future Trend
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Chapter 503: The War That Decides the Future Trend
The Storm Sea Domain billowed with tempestuous waves.
From Green City to the Storm Sea Domain, the distance was so vast that Lide couldn’t even begin to estimate it; all he knew was that Castro had flown for a full day and night before finally arriving at this perpetually storm-enshrouded sea domain.
For Lide, this was the first time he had laid eyes on such a renowned Advanced map.
Unlike the inaptly named Lost Sea, the Storm Sea Domain was truly as its name suggested—the moment they entered the ocean, they were enveloped by hurricanes.
At this moment, on the sea’s surface, the storm churned up layer upon layer of waves, and it seemed as if the entire sky were being torn apart by the terrifying hurricane.
Such a terrifying scene was akin to an apocalyptic disaster.
Even the rifts in the sky looked as though they were created by the storm.
Amidst the towering waves, Castro spread its wings wide, its sharp Blade Wings slicing through the waves, uncompromising and fearless.
This actually added a semblance of life to the image of doomsday.
"Lord Ilo, after you’ve obtained the Destiny Tablet fragment, would you be able to allow Lady Isa to inherit the power passed down by the ancestors of the Silver Moon Clan?"
The Silver Moon King, who had by now regained his breath, asked cautiously.
"You can rest assured; the power inherited by the Silver Moon Clan for tens of thousands of years is very pure, it will not cause Lady Isa any harm. Without Lady Isa’s protection, the Silver Moon Clan will not survive much longer..."
Hearing this, Lide raised his eyebrows and looked down at Isa, who was looking up at him hopefully.
"I need to confirm that the inheritance you speak of is safe. If it is, then dealing with that Long-tailed Demon won’t be much of a problem."
Isa’s face instantly lit up with a smile.
The Silver Moon King also heaved a great sigh of relief, saying excitedly,
"Thank you for your kindness."
To him, nothing else mattered; the Silver Moon Clan was the foundation, without which everything else was an illusion.
After receiving Lide’s promise, the Silver Moon King dared not say anymore and obediently stayed within the Magic Shield.
The rest of the journey proceeded without conversation.
Traveling forward amidst the storm was filled with danger; the colossal waves that hurled tons of seawater at Castro’s back could cause significant turbulence, appearing especially terrifying.
Several times they even required Frey’s personal intervention to get through the crisis; otherwise, they truly might have been swept into the sea by the hurricane and massive waves.
Lide didn’t know how the Silver Moon King managed to calculate their position within the storm. After entering the Storm Sea Domain, they flew for another five or six Sunshine Hours before the king had Castro slow down.
"Lord Ilo, after crossing this sea domain, we will reach an oval-shaped island.
On the left side of the island, cliffs connect to the city-state of Silver Moon Radiance. No need to activate a Magic Array; simply hitting the cliff will naturally allow passage."
Outside was a fierce wind and torrential rain; Lide couldn’t see clearly, but since the Silver Moon King said so, he didn’t bother to think too much about it—this guy wasn’t capable of tricking him with Frey’s protection.
True enough, a few breaths later, Castro appeared over the island, and the cliff mentioned by the Silver Moon King was very conspicuous.
Whoosh whoosh~
With a flap of the Blade Wings, Castro deliberately slowed down a bit, then gracefully passed through the cliff, which rippled like a water wave.
Behind the cliff was a dimly lit cave, but it was quite spacious, so there was no concern that Castro’s flight would be hindered.
A few minutes later, after a long stretch of flying, there was suddenly a bright light ahead, and Lide’s field of vision abruptly widened.
A city floating above the sky appeared before his eyes.
Countless stone slabs flew horizontally in mid-air, connecting to the city in the sky.
This scene looked very much like the mythical abode of the Divine.
Lide’s expression was quite peculiar upon seeing this spectacle.
He had seen a similar scene before, but that was in the Spider Plane, where mountains flew upside down in the sky because the Plane was close to collapsing, a phenomenon caused by overflowing power.
After sensing the environment for a moment, he was thoughtful.
The Silver Moon Radiance city-state was indeed established on another plane.
However, this plane was very stable, unlike the Spider Plane that could collapse at any time.
"Lord Ilo, this is our city-state. Our ancestors believed that the brilliance of Silver Moon City should surpass that of the sun and moon, so they named it Silver Moon Radiance!"
The Silver Moon King mentioned this with an expression of extraordinary pride.
Lide smiled, a city more brilliant than the sun and moon? The sun and moon must be rather dim then...
"Lead the way."
He couldn’t be bothered with nonsense; now wasn’t the time to chat with this fellow. He needed the Destiny Tablet fragment, needed to hunt Divine beings, and had no time to waste here.
The Silver Moon King grinned sheepishly and hurriedly gestured forward.
"Just fly directly into the city and land in the central square."
At these words, Castro immediately flapped its wings and flew directly into the city amid the gasps of the Silver Moon City residents.
Then, wooh wooh~
The sound of long horns resounded, and the entire city immediately went into alert mode.
Numerous armored soldiers took to the streets, and the central square was tightly cordoned off.
Castro, the steel beast, didn’t look like anything good; charging into the city unannounced, it was naturally treated as an enemy.
But when the soldiers saw the Silver Moon King, they immediately looked at each other in confusion.
Not an enemy??
The Silver Moon King got off Castro’s back, trembling with fear that the soldiers might attack Lide, and shouted to everyone in haste.
"Stand down, this is Lord Ilo, the ally I’ve brought back from Green City!"
Lide twitched the corner of his mouth upon hearing this. Why did that sound so familiar?
An Extraordinary Level Guard Commander, upon hearing this, immediately stepped forward to greet the Silver Moon King, then glanced at Isa in Lide’s arms with a sidelong look, surprised by the aura she emitted.
"Your Majesty, have you brought back the Golden Lineage?"
Upon seeing the Silver Moon King nod, the Guard Commander was overjoyed and then loudly announced to the soldiers and residents who were eagerly watching them.
"His Majesty has brought back the Golden Lineage!
No need to worry, those damned Long-tailed Demons can no longer threaten us!"
The crowd erupted in frenzy.
"Long live the King!!"
"Long live the King!!"
"..."
The Silver Moon King was embarrassed and didn’t quite know what to say at this point, so he could only secretly observe Lide’s expression and finally spoke somewhat stiffly.
"Lord Ilo, please forgive them. The Silver Moon Clan has suffered too long under the threat of Long-tailed Demons..."
Lide nodded slightly, not dwelling on the matter, not caring about these trivial issues.
"Where is the Destiny Tablet fragment?"
"It is being suppressed within the Country, please follow me..." The Silver Moon King, ignoring the residents around him who were paying respects, quickly led the way.
Isa was now looking curiously at all the Silver Moon Clanspeople around her who had the same crimson eyes.
This young girl had never seen such a scene and was filled with joy.
Although no one at the Crimson Mage Tower dared to discriminate against her anymore, the feeling of being an outsider was still not easy to dispel, for the stereotypes formed over millions of years could not just vanish so simply.
At that moment, seeing that everyone possessed a pair of blood-red eyes, she finally felt a semblance of belonging.
Lide led the little girl directly towards the Royal Palace, paying little mind to the strangely-styled city.
Ten minutes later, after passing one exquisite building after another, they finally arrived at the Country’s great hall.
At this time, news that the Silver Moon King had returned with the Golden Descendant had already filled the hall with the Silver Moon Clan’s high-ranking officials.
Everyone looked at Isa, who Lide was leading, with glistening eyes, their expressions full of anticipation.
Yet, the Silver Moon King paid no heed to the crowd and turned to the Guard Commander, "Bring me the fragment of the Destiny Tablet immediately."
Then, under the gaze of countless people, he came before the throne and respectfully said to Lide beside him, "Lord Ilo, please take a seat."
This action immediately caused an uproar in the room.
That was the throne of the Silver Moon Radiance city-state, how could they allow a foreigner to sit?
Had the Silver Moon King had a stroke? Why would he do something so foolish?!
Just as someone thought to stand up and object, the very next second, space beside Lide directly shattered, and amid the shocked gazes of the crowd, a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel with twelve black wings on its back stepped forth.
Divine Power instantly enveloped the hall, and everyone felt as if they were being watched by an ancient behemoth, their hearts almost consumed by fear.
The crowd’s initial dissent vanished as soon as Frey appeared, leaving only trepidation.
Especially those who had been prepared to object now looked terrible, nearly making a grave mistake.
A Twelve-winged Angel as his guard?!
By the Goddess above, could the one sitting on the throne be one of the Main Gods, Lord Ilo?
Everyone eagerly looked at the Silver Moon King, as if hoping he would offer an explanation.
The Silver Moon King managed a wry smile, for he dared not utter a word carelessly.
Stealing a few glances at Lide, noticing he bore no displeasure, the King steeled himself and said,
"Ladies and gentlemen, this is the ruler of Green City, the great God of Dawn, Lord Ilo!
Lord Ilo has come for the fragment of the Destiny Tablet, and the Golden Descendant is also brought here by Lord Ilo."
Upon hearing this, not a single person in the dense crowd dared to speak up, not even to respond to the Silver Moon King.
Correct content is on .
The Divine Power emitted by Frey was simply too terrifying, preventing them from considering anything else.
Realizing this, the Silver Moon King sighed lightly, opting to say no more and kept silent.
The fate of the Silver Moon Radiance city-state had been set when they were defeated by Frey.
They only had two choices: submit to this Lord or watch the Silver Moon Radiance city-state be destroyed.
Lide had no intention of engaging in idle talk with the Silver Moon Clan people and simply waited quietly for the Destiny Tablet fragment to be delivered.
The Silver Moon King did not make him wait long.
A few minutes later, a group of guards pushed a small cart into the hall, the cart covered with a stone slab sealed tightly with a myriad of magic curses, giving off a peculiar aura.
Seeing that nothing had gone awry, the Silver Moon King also relaxed, then personally lifted the slab full of seals and presented the Destiny Tablet fragment embedded in the stone to Lide as though it were a treasure.
A rich Power of Destiny burst forth as the stone slab was unveiled.
Lide’s eyes brightened as, under the shocked gaze of everyone in the room, he stepped forward and directly removed the Destiny Tablet fragment.
This?! Was it really possible to directly touch with one’s hands?
Seeing Lide unharmed, the faces of the crowd turned extremely interesting.
To activate the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, many lives had perished, never did they expect Lide to reap the benefits in the end.
Of course, these thoughts were bottled up inside; outwardly, not a single complaint dared to be made.
Sensing the Power of Destiny stirring within his body, a greatly pleased Lide turned his head to glance at Frey.
"Frey, go and assist Isa with the task. Check what this so-called inheritance of the ancestors’ power is all about. If there are no issues, help them eliminate the threat of the Long-tailed Giant Demons.
I need to go into seclusion."
Now that the item he desired was in hand, he wasn’t going to skimp on lending a hand to the Silver Moon Radiance City-State.
More importantly, these were Isa’s kin. If he were to exterminate these people, the child would undoubtedly be heartbroken when she grew up.
Upon hearing Lide’s words, the Silver Moon King was instantly filled with surprise.
"Thank you for your mercy, Lord Ilo!!"
Their reason for bringing Isa back to inherit the ancestral power was to deal with the Long-tailed Giant Demons, but the power of Twelve Death Blazing Angels was decidedly stronger than that which Isa would inherit from the ancestors.
Perhaps it might truly eliminate the peril that had plagued them for millions of years.
Those around who heard this were also filled with surprise; with the Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angels making a move, how could there be any disappointment?
At this moment, Lide was unaware that as he acquired the Destiny Tablet fragment and prepared to seclude himself to devour the Power of Destiny, an earth-shattering event took place in the heart of the Glory Main Plane—inside the Ancient Forest.
The Holy City that the Angel Alliance had built at great cost was encountering a hunt.
---
---
Ancient Forest.
This mysterious forest, which had been in existence since the creation of the world, had always been Elf territory, imbued with inconceivable magic power. For millions of years, even though the Elves had lost their dominion over the continent, the forest had never been touched.
However, today, the forest faced the threat of destruction. The trees withered in massive patches, the once fertile land now cracking and drying out, even revealing patches of sand.
The vibrant world seemed to disappear in the blink of an eye, leaving a somber and lifeless tune as the current main melody.
The culprits behind all this were those Ancient Evil Gods emitting a scent of decay, creating nothingness wherever they passed.
These violent, cruel, and bloodthirsty beings from the olden days were the ultimate endpoint of all wickedness; their very purpose of existence was to destroy this world.
Looking down from the sky, one could clearly see colossal beings that covered the heavens and the earth, advancing towards the depths of the Ancient Forest.
Where they passed, the forest decayed, the earth cracked, a scene of apocalypse unfolding.
These strange creatures were twisted beyond description; some had the bodies of octopuses, yet each tentacle was lined with countless eyes. A mere glance from an ordinary person into these eyes would drive them into madness, making them slaves to the Ancient Evil Gods.
Some were like pools of rotten sludge, made up of innumerable flesh and blood, squirming across the earth, swallowing all life in their wake.
Some appeared stitched together from various corpses, with organs representing most of the world’s creatures visible on their bodies.
And following these detestable creatures were densely packed swarms of decaying beings, monsters from ancient days that had long lost all thought and self, now ruled by the Extreme Evil of destruction.
The sole purpose of these ancient beings was to destroy the Holy City at the center of the Ancient Forest, the stronghold built by a united effort of the Light Attribute gods.
The Ancient Evil Gods of the olden cohorts had already gathered in numbers exceeding two hundred, and at this moment, all of the Main Gods of the Angel Alliance had returned, with hundreds of Divine beings standing in readiness.
An unprecedented Battle of the Gods was about to commence.
And this time, it would not be another civil war amongst the Glory Gods, but a righteous battle to defend the world.
Should the Angel Alliance crumble and the Holy City be destroyed,
then the most hopeful resistance force of Glory would turn to naught.
The future would face a new upheaval.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 504: Hundreds of Divines Fall
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Chapter 504: Hundreds of Divines Fall
Ancient Evil Gods hunted the Angel Alliance, initiating an unprecedented epochal war.
No one could imagine the peerless spectacle that would arise from the battle of hundreds of Divine beings.
On February 5, the Ancient Evil Gods appeared on the outskirts of the Ancient Forest, and all ancient life from the Main Plane began to congregate there.
By February 7, the number of Ancient Evil Gods on the outskirts of the Ancient Forest exceeded two hundred, and billions of ancient lives poured from the Dimension Plane like a tide, advancing toward the Ancient Forest.
On February 8, under the command of a mysterious life form shrouded in shadows, the Ancient Evil Gods launched an assault on the Ancient Forest.
That day, the Ancient Forest, which had existed for millions of years, suffered a devastating blow.
Giant trees withered, grass turned yellow, soil transformed into sand, and the once-pure streams flowed with deadly, poisonous sludge.
These beings, whose sole purpose was to destroy the entire world, unleashed unimaginable horrific destruction.
War erupted.
The Angel Alliance, which had already detected the movements of the Ancient Evil Gods, did not rigidly defend their Holy City deep within the Ancient Forest, waiting for a decisive battle. Instead, they dispatched a massive army, and even the Divine beings personally entered the fray, using the Ancient Forest to ambush the lives of old.
But the Ancient camp was too strong, and the Light Gods were forced to retreat at every turn.
At a critical moment, the trees, which had grown for millions, even tens of millions of years, were awakened by the twelve Divine Elf beings, and Natural Magic bestowed new life upon the ancient trees.
They stood up.
Tens of millions of ancient trees were transformed into War Ancient Trees, becoming the first line of defense against the Ancient Invasion.
War Ancient Trees, towering over ten bladed or even dozens of blades high, were like robust giants, each swing of their trunks or vines causing massive damage to the multitude of ancient lives, as dense as locusts, covering the ground and the air.
Flesh was smashed into paste by the trunks, and skeletons were absorbed by the roots...
Every inch of land the ancient lives stepped into held a horrific price of countless deaths.
For a moment, the terrifying War Ancient Trees slowed the advancing momentum of the Ancient Evil Gods.
On February 10, the Ancient commander hiding in the rear, seeing the disadvantage in battle, immediately gathered all forces and launched an attack.
The Ancient Evil Gods took the field.
These extremely terrifying lives some had octopus bodies of a thousand blades tall, others were like mud composed of rotting corpses, and still others were indescribable monstrosities pieced together from numerous skeletons.
The defenses, previously held firmly by the War Ancient Trees, were immediately torn open.
No life could survive an assault more terrifying than a natural disaster; this was the most Extreme Evil in the world.
However, the rampage of the Ancient Evil Gods did not last long as the Light Attribute Divine beings hidden among the ancient trees began to move as well.
Like hunters in the shadows, they struck in groups or individually, utilizing various traps to snipe one Ancient Evil God after another.
After clashing in battle, both sides immediately fell into a feverish state, with an exaggeration of ten or more Divine beings falling each day and dozens more suffering injuries.
Tens of millions of lives turned to paste in the aftershocks of the Divine conflict.
On February 11, this war, which had caught the attention of the world, began to reveal a different color.
Players appeared.
One day, these fearless folks suddenly discovered that hunting Ancient Evil Gods in the Ancient Forest earned them ten times more Experience Points than anywhere else...
The extravagant benefits tempted countless players.
This was the opportunity of a millennium to boost their Levels.
Players near the Ancient Forest rushed there in droves, with at least thirty million participating in the battle.
Players were like persistent plasters, clinging onto their existence. Even if killed, they would bounce back to life the next day as lively as ever.
It was I Love a Stick, the player who acquired the body of an Evil God, that ignited the players’ enthusiasm.
This guy became an inside traitor for the Ancient Evil God Camp, single-handedly killed three Ancient Evil Gods with three Divine Bodies, two of which were finished off by players...
The two players, with the terrifying Experience Points gained from hunting gods, directly stepped into the Transcendent realm.
Correct content is on
Players also suddenly realized that with I Love a Stick around, they could definitely stir up some major trouble.
Consequently, a large influx of players sneaked in to poach their own gains.
I Love a Stick didn’t mind the players leeching off him; at his level, he had reached the peak. Killing those monsters didn’t yield any Experience, and he had long lost interest in those ordinary things.
Amidst the chaos, he fished in troubled waters and acquired two more avatars of Octopus Evil Gods. Now, he alone controlled the bodies of five Ancient Evil Gods.
It was nothing short of astonishing...
The actions of the great players did not affect the course of the war, though. Despite countless Ancient lives being lost, the horrific beings’ advance on the Ancient Forest did not slow down at all.
There were simply too many Ancient beings. Every Ancient Evil God had tens of millions of minions, and even after days of battles with casualties exceeding a billion, their numbers seemed undiminished.
The Ancient Forest turned into a battlefield stretching over tens of thousands of kilometers.
Death was the only prevailing theme at that moment.
As time marched on, the war further deteriorated.
Those scattered Ancient Evil Gods from every corner of the Glory Main Plane began to congregate, and their numbers, according to players’ estimates, at one point exceeded 600...
This was a force capable of destroying the world—a terrifying thought.
Of course, while the numbers of Light Attribute gods were not as great, with the influx of many deities coming to the rescue, the total count also exceeded 200.
Despite retreating step by step in confrontations, relying on their indomitable will and coordination, the Light God System did not collapse.
On February 16th, when half of the Ancient Forest had fallen, the situation took another turn.
Players, Ancient Evil Gods, and the Light Camp—the already entangled triad—faced another twist.
The Undead joined the war.
The Undead Plane opened thousands of Space Gates as wide as a hundred blades on the periphery of the Ancient Forest.
Countless skeletons swarmed out of the Space Gates.
These fearless Undead Life immediately plunged a knife into the flank of the Ancient Camp.
Even more surprising was that, on the same day, hundreds of Demon Sovereigns opened passages to the Main Plane in the Bottomless Abyss. Chaotic, bloodthirsty demons surged in like a stormy tide.
They too violently entered the battle within the Ancient Evil Gods’ ranks.
Unlike beings of the Light God System, Undead and Demons did not discriminate; they attacked any life they encountered, not specifically targeting the Ancient Evil Gods alone.
The flow of events gradually slipped into an indescribable chaos.
But objectively speaking, nearly a hundred Demon Sovereigns of Level 30 or above and no less than ten Undead Monarchs joining the battlefield effectively restrained the frenzied onslaught of the Ancient Evil Gods.
The situation became even tenser.
In this unprecedented, multiverse-wide melee, it was not just oddities like I Love a Stick who could control Evil God bodies that appeared; some terrifying beings subtly revealed their true forms.
A detestable creature with twin horns on its head, a row of fierce spines on its back, razor-sharp fingers, and blasphemous runes etched on its skin moved through areas of space-time flux, hunting high-level beings at will.
If Lide were here, he would have immediately screamed—Asreaga!
The Divine Monster lost in the abyss had finally returned to the Main Plane.
Asreaga was no longer the same Legendary Level existence he once was.
His aura had astonishingly reached Level 34...
No one could imagine what the Divine Monster had done during this time to grow to such a terrifying extent.
In this chaotic battle, Asreaga, who could control space, emerged as a big winner.
On this battlefield, fought over by the undead, demons, humans, elves, Ancient life forms, and players, a multitude of high-level lives were now engaged in mutual slaughter.
And these lives were his prey.
Devour, grow.
One by one, divine entities turned into withered corpses in his hands, and their Divine Status became energy inside him.
An Extreme Evil life was born amid bloodshed and skeletons, gaining strength.
A Divine Monster that had existed for millions of years had returned, bloodthirsty once more due to the Death Flower.
February 20th.
The area around the Ancient Forest had turned into the Dead Silence Land.
The scorched earth emitted black smoke, the shriveled trees were leafless, and their branches clawed the air like devils, leaving no trace of green anywhere.
After half a month, the Battle of the Gods had finally reached its conclusion.
The Ancient Forest had ultimately been flattened.
The number of lives in the Ancient camp was beyond anyone’s imagination.
Furthermore, when it came to high-end combat power, the combined forces of the undead, demons, and the Light Attribute gods were less than half the number of Ancient Evil Gods.
Moreover, the undead and demons were not allies of the Light Attribute gods, they would attempt to kill each other on sight, just as they would any Ancient life form, completely void of any concept of banding together against a common enemy.
It even seemed that the undead and demons shared the same goal as the Ancient camp, desiring to conquer Holy City established by the Light Gods.
Apart from the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, they sought nothing else.
On the eve of the birth of the Destiny Tablet’s core, having more fragments undoubtedly offered a greater advantage for the forthcoming battle for supremacy.
Against this backdrop, the retreat of the Angel Alliance was not so surprising.
At dusk on this day, the Ancient Evil Gods arrived at the gates of Holy City.
The entire sky was shrouded in the black aura of the Ancients.
The Light Gods, who had suffered nearly a hundred divine casualties, made a stand without retreat and engaged in an epic showdown with the Ancient Evil God.
The Sun Goddess, wielding a Destiny Tablet fragment, summoned the Sun Illusion to shine in all directions.
Under the Sunlight, the battle power of all Light Camp gods surged tremendously.
The War God held a shield in one hand and a spear in the other, plunging into the ranks of the Ancient Evil God camp, unstoppable, a display of unrivaled Divine Power.
The Elf Main God, wielding a longbow, ensured that each arrow struck a formidable enemy.
The God of Power and Justice, the Master of Dawn, also valiantly charged into battle.
Seemingly due to the effect of the Destiny Tablet fragments, these Main Gods had now regained much of their strength, their combat power domineering and formidable.
The ten monarchs of the Undead Camp stood out in this battle, leaving behind a trail of skeletons each time they used Undead Magic. Even the Octopus Evil God, possessing the tenacity of life within a cephalopod’s body, was stripped of life.
The Demon Sovereigns fought their separate battles but their formidable individual strength still inflicted considerable damage on the Ancient camp, despite being solo fighters.
This unprecedented siege lasted for three days and three nights.
No one could describe the brutality of the scene; the entire sky had become unusable for space magic because the energy released after the collision of the gods was too terrifying, with spatial turbulence that was almost more fierce than a storm.
The earth shattered, and mountains collapsed.
All of it had turned into an apocalyptic landscape.
February 23rd.
Holy City had crumbled.
The Sun Illusion summoned by the Sun Goddess was devoured in a single gulp by an Ancient Evil God hidden in thick fog, the War God’s shield was damaged and the spear broken, the Elf Main God now had no more arrows in hand...
The gods of the Light Attribute faced an unprecedented predicament, and extinction was but a thought away.
But in the most critical moment, the God of Power and Justice sacrificed himself, trading his burning life and soul for unmatched combat prowess.
His Level temporarily rose to an unprecedented 45, and although it was just for a short minute, it tore open a path of survival for the Light Gods.
Upon seeing the God of Power and Justice bleed out and fall, hundreds of millions of residents within Holy City wailed in grief, with tears streaming down their faces.
The retreating gods of the Light Attribute could no longer protect the fragments of the Destiny Tablet. Only two pieces, imbued with the Power of Destiny by the Sun Goddess, were taken away; the remaining six pieces were all lost in the chaotic battlefield.
In the end, ten Undead Monarchs joined forces to forcefully snatch one piece, while hundreds of Ancient Evil Gods grabbed two pieces.
Of the remaining three pieces, one was stolen by a Hell Demon who emerged from the shadows at the last moment.
Unexpectedly, the last two pieces which were originally claimed by the Demon Sovereign, were seized by a mysterious Fallen Angel who appeared out of nowhere with twelve dark wings sprouting from his back.
This enigmatic Fallen Angel seemed to have employed some terrifying Divine Arts, his Level skyrocketing to 40 within a short time, and with the speed of lightning, he killed a Level 36 Demon Sovereign and snatched the remaining two fragments.
But he too was subjected to the frenzied attack of the demons and, in the moment before his impending fall, a Divine Monster with twin horns boldly appeared, taking him and escaping through the spatial turbulence.
Disappearing at the same time were dozens of Divine corpses from the battlefield...
The demons roared in fury, but were helpless to act.
The Battle for Holy City had come to an end.
Although the final outcome was unexpected, it was within reason.
The Angel Alliance had suffered an unprecedented blow, with more than a hundred divinities falling in this war, reducing the number of surviving gods to less than one hundred...
Billions of human residents perished at the hands of the Ancient Evil Gods when Holy City was breached.
Both the Undead and the demons suffered heavy losses.
Players, as one of the participants, reaped significant benefits; not only did a portion of the players gain massive increases in Level, but the number of Transcendent players skyrocketed to double digits.
Of course, the players’ camp paid a price, with one-third of them dropping three to four Levels.
And as the main aggressors of the Ancient Invasion, over 400 Evil Gods fell, with the number of Ancient lives lost being incalculable...
It was an indescribably fierce war.
The Ancient Forest, standing since the dawn of creation, was completely turned to ash, nearly exterminating the Elves.
This battle also shattered the greatest hope of the Main Plane of Glory to resist the Ancient Invasion, turning the situation extremely dire.
It seemed as if there was no longer any power that could stand up to the Ancient Invasion.
Many turned their gaze upon the last hope for turning the tide—the core of the Destiny Tablet.
Only by reassembling the Destiny Tablet could the Ancient be suppressed, and the core of the Destiny Tablet was the key to its assembly.
At this time, it seemed there were only a few days left until the core of the Destiny Tablet would emerge in Green City...

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 505: Everything, For The Dawn
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Chapter 505: Everything, For The Dawn
The collapse of the Angel Alliance directly led to the deterioration of the Glory Plane to a point near irretrievable.
After the Ancient Evil God destroyed the Ancient Forest, the destruction spread outward in a circle, initiating a sweep that could only be described as terrifying.
Exterminate everything.
These abominable creatures swept through the Main Plane in a manner far more terrifying than a raging flood.
Wherever they passed, grasslands turned into deserts, houses into ruins, rivers dried up and broke off...
Even those cities that had initially survived by luck encountered the annihilation of the Ancient Monsters during the no-corner-left-untouched sweep.
Furthermore, with more than 200 Ancient Evil Gods still alive, an apocalypse had already begun.
If no one resisted the sweep of these Ancient Evil Gods, the vast Glory Main Plane would no longer have even a half-inch of normal life remaining.
Even the specially positioned players from the past were greatly affected by this change, as the destruction of cities and the shattering of the Life Temples caused their resurrection points to disappear one after another.
Players, amid the chaos, were continuously driven out and spread outwards from the center of the Glory Main Plane.
Many realized through this battle alone that it was no longer possible to withstand the Ancient Evil Gods with ordinary strength.
