Previously, the Angel Alliance, still confident in their strength and quite proud internally, had not completely depended on the core of the Destiny Tablet in Green City, believing they had enough strength to combat the Ancient Invasion.
But a slap from the Ancient Evil Gods made them realize the bloody reality of just how cruel it actually was.
The dire situation forced them to start heading to Green City, seeking the last glimmer of life and hope.
Now, the only way was to reunite the Destiny Tablet, perhaps only in this way could the Ancient be suppressed.
Due to the collapse of the Angel Alliance, the core of the already highly-anticipated Destiny Tablet became the focus of everyone, and Green City was placed under the microscope for observation.
Fortunately, Green City was located far from the central area of the continent, giving the Ancient lifeforms no chance to sweep through in the short term.
However, this luck did not last long as everyone received a despair-inducing message.
After a massive amount of Divine Beings from the remaining Angel Alliance infiltrated the southern provinces of the Nolan Empire, those Ancient Evil Gods seemed to have received an order too, beginning to change their direction towards a rapid march to the Nolan Empire, with Green City as their target.
With the terrifying speed of these Ancient Evil Gods, it would only take a few days before an endless stream of Ancient Monsters would come slaughtering their way here.
After this message spread, the Light Attribute gods, already devastated by a recent defeat and akin to stray dogs, were even more panicked and filled with pessimism about the future.
Some Divine Beings simply gave up resisting and hid in a broken Plane, becoming the first wave of the feeble.
Fortunately, most Divine Beings still had courage and responsibility and had not lost their will to fight.
February 25th.
Dawn City.
The biting winter had slowly passed, and in a few days, it would be the Planting Season.
For the residents of Dawn City, the turmoil outside did not affect them as Dawn City had become a paradise isolated from the outside world.
The residents did not share the pessimistic sentiment about seeing no future as seen outside.
Everyone was busy with their work, as the great Lord Kachar had personally issued an order to mobilize all the residents to help City Hall build the Magic Alchemy Cannons...
View the correct content at .
Although they weren’t quite sure what the Magic Alchemy Cannon was, since it was an order from Lord Kachar, they naturally complied unconditionally.
Lide’s reputation in Dawn City had already maxed out, so City Hall merely needed to issue a policy in his name, and the entire city would immediately spring into action.
And now, after nearly a month’s work round-the-clock by hundreds of thousands of Dawn City residents, in addition to the cooperation of the Ocean God System Divine Beings and the convenience of the Space Gate in the Land of Bone-Burying.
This time, led by the Goblin Chief, twenty Magic Alchemy Cannons were quietly completed without anyone outside knowing.
Lide, who had just returned from the battle in the Ancient Forest with two fragments of the Destiny Tablet, was overjoyed when he heard this news.
"You’re saying, these twenty Magic Alchemy Cannons, each attack is equivalent to a full strike at a Level 32 weak Divine Power?"
In the City Hall office, Frey, a Level 36 Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel, stood to his left, and Asreaga, who had climbed to Level 35 after returning from the Abyss, stood to his right.
Mermaid Main God, who had returned to Level 35, was floating in mid-air with a trident in hand.
With the Blazing Angel on his left and the Divine Monster on his right, the Mermaid Main God was taking orders below.
The scene was truly explosive.
At this moment, Lide finally had the appearance of a Divine Main God of the Dawn.
Under the gaze of these few, Moer, the Goblin Chief, who initially wore a proud expression, now trembled in fear.
It was odd to think he could still be proud in front of such terrifying Divine Beings.
"Yes, master, twenty Alchemy Magic Cannons have been built, and that’s not all.
Connecting four nearby ones can unleash damage equivalent to a Level 35 Medium Divine Being.
And if the twenty Alchemy Magic Cannons are connected together, they can produce an attack at the Level 40 Powerful Divine Power!"
Hearing Moer’s words, Lide was overjoyed.
It was like gaining a powerful ally out of thin air.
The Alchemy he had once made the gods wary of was indeed terrifying.
He suddenly remembered something and hastily asked,
"What are the costs of using the Alchemy Magic Cannons, and how many times can our stock support firing?"
Building them was not the final point; providing enough power for their operation was what truly completed them.
Without bullets, even a Gatling is just a stick for burning.
However, Moer’s words allowed him to breathe a slight sigh of relief.
"Master, we discovered several new veins of Demon Crystal Ore in the Abyss, and after deploying hundreds of thousands of demons for violent mining, these crystals have already been transported to the Land of Bone-Burying.
Currently, our stock is estimated to support each Alchemy Magic Cannon firing ten times."
"And if all are connected together?"
"The same, the current reserves connected together are also enough for ten launches."
Lide nodded. Connecting the twenty cannons for use meant executing attacks at the Level 40 Powerful Divine Power ten times, or equivalently the Level 35 Medium Divine Power Divine fifty times...
"That’s barely passing, but it’s not enough; I need more Magic Crystal Stones. Our enemies this time will be unprecedentedly strong.
Asreaga discovered several Magic Crystal Ore Veins in the Abyss’s lower planes. I will send him to lead the Demon Army to mine those veins. Prepare accordingly; this time, we will spare no expense!"
Asreaga, though he spent his time in the depths of the Abyss in slaughter, was also well aware of Lide’s craving for Magic Crystal Stones and paid particular attention to this matter.
The reason the most powerful Demon Sovereigns resided in the lower planes was due to the abundance of resources there, with Rare Magic Crystal Ore Veins not being uncommon in the lower planes.
"As you wish, I will ensure that people cooperate with Lord Asreaga to extract enough Magic Crystal Stones." Moer, overjoyed, nodded repeatedly.
Lide slightly nodded in response, then changed the topic.
"I’ve brought over forty Divine Remains from outside; how long will it take to turn all these Divine Remains into God Hunting Crossbows?" These were all procured by the Divine Monster using his powerful Space Control.
Discussing this topic excited Moer once again.
"Your Highness, most of those Divine Remains still retain their Divine Status; do you need to select some?"
"No time for that."
Lide waved his hand; under normal circumstances, he would naturally keep some good Divine Status to enhance his subordinates’ strength.
But the next major battle, which could decide the survival or destruction of Glory, was impending, and he didn’t have time to let his subordinates slowly absorb those Divine Status.
The focus now had to be on enhancing combat power.
"Yes, then I will use them all..." Moer’s words, although sheepish, could not hide the excitement in his eyes that anyone could see.
"Per your previous instructions, the materials for manufacturing the God Hunting Crossbow are all prepared. We just need the Divine remains to start the production.
Given the current production rate, we will be able to transform all these Divine remains into God Hunting Crossbows within three days."
Lide breathed a sigh of relief.
Three days was still enough time.
"Hurry up and report immediately if you encounter any difficulties.
This time, you will decide the future of Dawn City, Moer. If the war is won, you will be the hero who saves the world.
I promise you, the name Moer Grey Mist will be passed down by wandering poets and revered by all. You will become a legendary figure among goblins, and the goblins will take pride in you!"
The already excited goblin became even more agitated upon hearing this, shouting animatedly as if he could hardly wait to get to work.
Seeing the high spirits of the other party, Lide did not waste more words and dismissed him.
Moer, the disfigured goblin, entered a frenzied state and tore through space to return to the Magic Industry Research Institute, beginning to lead the forging of the God Hunting Crossbow.
Divine Monster Asreaga also did not stay long, following Moer as he left, for he needed to lead the Demon Army to mine Demon Crystal Ore in the lower abyss.
Once both had left, the room finally quieted down.
Ten days earlier, after emerging from seclusion in Silver Moon Radiance City-State having consumed the power of the Destiny Tablet fragment, Lide learned of the great war erupted by the Angel Alliance and immediately set off with Frey.
Isa was sent back to Dawn City by Castro, and Silver Moon Radiance City-State’s long-tailed giants’ threat was also swiftly dealt with by Frey.
The Mermaid Main God, now looking at Lide with some hesitation, spoke,
"Kachar Main God, how many Destiny Tablet fragments did you obtain after the Angel Alliance was breached?"
The Mermaid Main God had not partaken in that twilight-of-the-gods-like battle, having received orders from Lide to hold Green City.
Moreover, the situation was too chaotic then; apart from herself, no one knew exactly how many fragments had been taken by whom.
Lide smiled slightly.
"Lord Virginia, I obtained one from the Silver Moon Clan, two from the hands of demons... adding to those originally possessed, I now hold a total of 5 Destiny Tablet fragments."
Hisss~
Although guessing that Lide had made a significant gain, the Mermaid Main God hadn’t expected that he already amassed 5 Destiny Tablet fragments without anyone realizing...
She felt a sense of relief that she had chosen to ally with Lide.
Such a character was indeed too strong.
Now, the entire world was eyeing the Destiny Tablet fragments.
What was crucial was that, from start to finish, Lide had used his own forces to accomplish these feats; the Ocean God System just helped him monitor home.
Initially, the Mermaid Main God had reservations, fearing Lide would use them as cannon fodder, but now it seemed her suspicions were narrow-minded.
Lide, knowing the thoughts of the Mermaid Main God, would probably be both amused and chagrined; he too wanted to utilize them as weapons, but the situation did not allow it.
"Kachar Main God, what should we do next?"
Although the Destiny Tablet fragments had been secured, the Mermaid Main God felt even more at a loss.
The outside world was too daunting, with even the Main God of the Light Attribute struggling to cope. What should they do, and what could they do?
Lide observed her somewhat directionless gaze and sighed softly.
At this moment, probably all life on the Glory Plane felt this same bewildering helplessness as the Mermaid Main God.
The Angel Alliance, in every aspect, was the flagbearer of resistance against the Ancient Invasion, rooted in the strength of the Sun Goddess and several Main Gods themselves.
Now, it was gone.
Could they truly still resist the Ancient Invasion?
Could they really handle those detestable beings?
No one knew the answer, they could only cling to the last flicker of elusive hope, placing everything on the core of the Destiny Tablet.
Lide understood the other’s mindset, but while the Mermaid Main God could afford to be perplexed, he could not.
He was the sovereign of Dawn, the spiritual leader of all, needing to stand at the pinnacle to direct everyone forward.
He was the eternal lighthouse.
If even he lost direction, then Dawn City truly had no hope.
"Lord Virginia, you need not worry, even if faced with the most chaotic situation, the final battle will surely be our victory!
This is an unprecedented war and is destined to be recorded in the epics as a triumphant song.
All you need to do now is return to Green City, hide yourself, carefully observe the Divine beings infiltrating Green City, and discover their hideout.
Leave the rest to me.
In this most critical war, I will fight alongside you."
At this point, only a few days remained until the manifestation of the Destiny Tablet’s core, and it was too late to have the Mermaid Main God do anything—better to comfort her and wait for the final battle.
As expected, upon hearing Lide’s words, the puzzled look on the Mermaid Main God’s face disappeared, and she regained her usual demeanor.
She stared intently at Lide.
"Kachar Main God, becoming allies with you is the proudest choice of the Ocean God System, looking forward to fighting the enemy together with you!"
After speaking, she bowed deeply to Lide, the Main God expressing her heartfelt convictions in the most sincere way possible.
Lide’s expression softened, and then he solemnly spoke the phrase viewed as a belief by countless residents of Dawn.
"Lord Virginia, all for Dawn!"
After the Mermaid stood up, she looked directly into Lide’s eyes, took a deep breath, and for the first time she shouted the slogan filled with conviction.
"All for Dawn!"
At this moment, the two truly became allies in every sense of the word.
After the Mermaid left the office, Lide’s expression no longer held the sly confidence.
He stood up, went to the window, and as he faced the rifts in the distant sky, he took a deep breath.
"Frey, do you think we can win?"
Frey was silent for a moment, then looking at his back, she spoke with unwavering resolve.
"Sovereign, whether we win or lose, I will stand by your side, until eternity."
Lide turned around, looked into Frey’s unshaking eyes, sighed slightly, and then quickly adjusted his mindset.
A few breaths later, the sovereign of Dawn reappeared.
He smoothed out the wrinkles on his clothes and continued gazing out the window.
At that moment, the sky seemed to project the faces of familiar comrades—Isa, Vina, Betty, Andabella, Nicole Nilow, Harrison, Emi, Frey, Stanley, Withered Bone...
These people’s destinies were already tightly linked with his.
He was not fighting alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 506: Divine-level Land of Bone-Burying, Earth Undergoes Another Mutation
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Chapter 506: Divine-level Land of Bone-Burying, Earth Undergoes Another Mutation
Land of Bone-Burying.
Lide looked at this blazingly active plane, his expression filled with delight.
For now, the Land of Bone-Burying had finally accumulated enough Plane Power to elevate its level.
The last upgrade was from Transcendent to Legendary; this time, it was from Legendary to Divine-level.
If using the Power of Death, upgrading from Legendary to Divine-level would require a whopping 10 billion...
But now it didn’t need that much Power of Death to upgrade.
The major contributor to all this was the God of Plague’s Divine Country, which current ownerless state had nearly collapsed after being devoured by the Land of Bone-Burying...
Every time Lide thought of the God of Plague, he felt profoundly moved; it could be said that Dawn City rose from the God of Plague’s corpse.
In life, he had contributed Divine Positions, Divine Calamity, and Divine Artifacts; and even after death, he left a Divine Country for the Land of Bone-Burying to devour and strengthen.
It was truly moving.
"Ding~ Would you like to upgrade the Land of Bone-Burying? The upgrade will take 5 days."
With the thought of upgrading the Land of Bone-Burying, Lide heard the system notification.
He quickly confirmed the selection.
Five days was enough.
After his confirmation, the Plane Stone hidden deep within the Land of Bone-Burying surged out dense Plane Power in an instant.
Then, under Lide’s gaze, the boundaries of the Land of Bone-Burying began to expand rapidly outward, and the earth underneath also thickened.
After confirming that the original location of the Land of Bone-Burying wasn’t disturbed by the upgrade, he did not linger any further and turned to leave.
There were people managing the construction of the Magic Alchemy Cannon; he did not need to bother too much.
He still had two fragments of the Destiny Tablet that had not been devoured yet; it was time to find a quiet place to enhance himself.
This was directly related to the possession of the core of the Destiny Tablet.
But before that, he needed to take a trip to see Lady Kaslina.
Next, how to deal with the Ancient Invasion and how to vie for the core of the Destiny Tablet were major issues, and he needed to discuss them with Lady Kaslina, this astonishingly originating hybrid Mermaid.
This was crucial for the fate of Dawn City...
Within the busy Magic Industry Research Institute, Lide’s figure flashed by; he did not disturb the bustling workers.
Kaslina seemed to have anticipated Lide’s arrival; rare for her, she was not standing at the window looking into the distance but was seated at a wooden table set with two cups of hot tea.
When Lide arrived, he saw Kaslina dressed in a light long dress, barefoot, holding a white cat in her arms, leaning slightly on the chair.
Seeing this peacefully serene scene, he was almost reluctant to disturb it.
He approached and greeted her softly.
"Good day, Lady Kaslina."
View the correct content at
Once Kaslina gestured for him to sit, Lide did not hesitate and comfortably sat opposite the hybrid Mermaid, casually picking up an exquisite teacup and taking a big sip of warm black tea.
After setting down the teacup, he pondered for a moment, seemingly making an important decision.
His right hand reached out, click~click~click~
Three fragments of the Destiny Tablet were lined up on the table.
"Lady Kaslina, these are the fragments of the Destiny Tablet I acquired from outside, two of which I have yet to devour the Power of Destiny."
He said, his gaze burning as he then slightly pushed the two fragments of the Destiny Tablet that had not been devoured toward her.
Seeing Lide’s action, a subtle look of relief flashed through Kaslina’s indifferent eyes, then she slowly shook her head.
"No, Kachar, I do not need the Power of Destiny.
"I even spent tens of millions of years trying to free myself from the entanglement of the Power of Destiny, which holds no value for me...."
"Free yourself from the Power of Destiny?" Lide’s face showed a hint of surprise.
When it came to this matter, Lady Kaslina took a deep breath, her chest heaving dramatically under the thin veil.
Even her usually tranquil face changed, her tone somber.
"Yes, the Power of Destiny might be a rare power for you, but for me, it is a prison of tens of millions of years..."
Having said this, her deep blue eyes fell into contemplation.
"Countless ages ago, I was the Goddess of Fate in other multi-dimensional planes.
When the lifespan of that multi-dimensional plane was about to end, approaching the epoch’s termination, I couldn’t bear the destruction along with my kinsfolk, so I stole the Power of Destiny to protect them.
However, after the Power of Destiny was seized by me, the multi-dimensional plane, lacking the strength, collapsed hundreds of years ahead of time...
Before the world collapsed, the Plane Will announced to all lifeforms how I had stolen the Power of Destiny."
At this point, her typically indifferent eyes displayed an unmistakable fear and guilt.
"Billions of lives believed I had betrayed the multi-dimensional plane, they cursed and verbally abused in frenzy.
Finally, in the moment the multi-dimensional plane collapsed, all the souls fused into a perpetual curse—as long as I bore the Power of Destiny, my soul would never find peace."
Upon hearing this, Lide’s complexion changed, being cursed by the life of a multi-dimensional plane, that would even deeply impact the Creator God, wouldn’t it?
Kaslina slightly lifted her head, then slowly closed her eyes.
"For millions of years, my soul has been continuously cursed by billions of lives, without ever stopping; I haven’t even slept for a single day.
Can you imagine a multi-dimensional plane’s lives screaming, wailing, mourning, cursing, verbally abusing, and resenting in your mind?"
Lide’s face darkened.
Let alone a multi-dimensional plane, even if a single person cursed him nonstop for twenty-four consecutive days, not letting him sleep, he’d probably go insane within a few days.
No wonder Kaslina didn’t want the Power of Destiny anymore; enduring that punishment for tens of millions of years without breaking down is truly a miracle.
He pondered his wording, then cautiously said,
"Lady Kaslina, if I were to carry the full Power of Destiny, would I also...."
Kaslina opened her eyes, a slight smile curving her lips.
"If this curse were to be transferred to you, would you accept the Power of Destiny to fight against the Ancient Invasion?"
Lide’s expression tightened, and after a long contemplation, he took a deep breath.
His gaze met Kaslina’s unflinchingly.
"For Dawn!"
His slogan rang out powerfully, laced with unshakeable determination.
Sensing that Lide was not lying, a hint of admiration appeared in Kaslina’s eyes.
"You are braver than I thought."
Lide slowly shook his head.
"No, I am not brave; I am merely fulfilling the responsibility of being the Dawn Sovereign.
I still have family, subordinates, and the Dawn City to protect."
Kaslina fell silent for a moment, then finally sighed softly.
"If I were my younger self, perhaps I would also be attracted to you, the Sovereign of Dawn..."
As she finished, she suddenly winked at him.
Lide smiled wryly, choosing not to continue the conversation.
"Miss Kaslina, can a curse really be transferred?"
"Regardless of whether or not there is a curse, you’ve already prepared yourself, so why ask again?"
Lide fell silent, but eventually he steered the conversation back to the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
"Since you don’t need these two fragments of the Destiny Tablet, I will devour the power within them.
To snatch the core of the Destiny Tablet, I must rely on them..."
Kaslina’s expression had already regained its calmness, as if the previous words hadn’t come from her.
"There are a total of thirty fragments of the Destiny Tablet. Although you’ve obtained five, it’s still not enough. I’ll go fetch two more for you..."
Lide’s eyes lit up.
"Could it be from the hands of the Undead Monarch?"
Kaslina neither denied nor confirmed, "Go, don’t waste any more time."
Lide said no more, nodded, stood up, and left.
After Lide’s figure had disappeared, Kaslina gently touched the cat in her arms, her tone carrying a hint of peculiarity.
"Can I finally unburden myself now?..."
Meow~
——
——
——
Earth.
Something extremely terrifying had happened.
After the Angel Alliance was defeated by the Ancient Camp, the crack in the sky widened once again.
The ancient aura began to gush in like a fountain.
The entire world plunged into an unprecedented crisis, and people were panic-stricken.
Moreover, the impact this time was greater than all previous instances combined.
After the ancient power intensified, the first to appear were those twisted, rotten creatures harboring apocalyptic intents.
Some physically weaker humans were directly consumed and infected by the dense ancient power.
When the scene of those transformed humans turned monsters bloodthirstily rampaging through the cities emerged, it immediately caused a societal crisis.
Armies from various countries began to bring tanks into the streets, and the entire world fell into immense panic overnight.
In Huaxia, a country with strong unity and cohesion, it was slightly better; any disaster was immediately resolved with unanimous effort, and the officials were exceptionally supportive.
However, in gun-ridden, so-called free countries in Europe and America, it was different.
These countries immediately suffered unprecedented devastation.
The government ordered restrictions on travel and gatherings to avoid great risks, but the public defiantly disobeyed; they demanded their freedom and then took to the streets with protest signs...
This directly led to many incidents of people being corrupted by the ancient power during protests...
After becoming monsters, these corrupted people began attacking those around them...
What’s more terrifying, if those hit by the monsters didn’t die, they were more susceptible to corruption by the ancient power.
This effect was similar to the transmission of a zombie virus...
Before long, a disaster akin to a zombie crisis erupted in the countries of Europe and America.
Even after the army forcibly suppressed several major infectious outbreaks, there were still people taking to the streets demanding freedom, and the government was completely unable to prevent these freedom-seeking people from continuing to gather and protest en masse...
The storm began to shake.
And online, the news about the Ancient Invasion was particularly lively, with so many rumors that official clarifications couldn’t keep up.
The most attention was still drawn to Glory’s official forum.
At this moment, this mysterious forum had become the focus of the entire world, and anyone who could still access the internet was following it.
It constantly tugged at the heart of the entire world.
However, most people were not discussing the expansion of the sky traces at this time; instead, they were talking about the top player who controlled five bodies of Evil Gods—"I Love a Stick."
Because after the Angel Alliance fractured, "I Love a Stick" felt a great sense of responsibility and voluntarily allied himself with the Huaxia Official.
Unlike those capital-controlled elected governments abroad, in the face of such a major disaster, the reliability of the Huaxia Official naturally inspired trust.
In handling major crises, Huaxia was unparalleled in the world; other countries had to start from the second tier.
And players had mixed opinions about "I Love a Stick’s" actions.
Players from Huaxia deeply appreciated it and loudly proclaimed that it was the most admirable action.
Players from other countries were bitter to death, furiously denouncing "I Love a Stick" as someone who should not become a servant to the government, even citing examples from their own countries to try and admonish him.
But the result was that Huaxia players turned on ridicule mode, digging up various incriminating materials and shaming those foreign players to the point of embarrassment, some even wishing they could sever ties with their own countries and immigrate on the spot.
The number of posts on the forum also exploded.
"Come on, ’I Love a Stick’ has already moved to the southern province of the Nolan Empire, this time he plans to participate in the scramble for the Destiny Tablet fragments, everyone hurry to support him!!"
"You’ve moved me, bro, worthy of someone who can choose such a broad-minded and righteous name like ’I Love a Stick’, worthy of my admiration like ’Fairy Love Mallet’."
"It’s said that after ’I Love a Stick’ became an official, he enjoyed ministerial-level treatment directly, even his aunt’s nephew’s daughter got a very good job arranged."
"You haven’t seen it, ’I Love a Stick’ being officially taken away to the military camp for protection, man, the entire city was locked down."
"I Love a Stick" alone was equivalent to the combat power of 5 Divine Levels, so the Huaxia Official naturally wasn’t stingy with treatment.
Straight to minister.
"I Love a Stick" was also extremely satisfied with his treatment; previously just an ordinary homebody, who would’ve thought he’d become such an important person that people would stand guard every time he went out to use the restroom...
His daily life was blissful.
However, the players’ discussions about this matter were soon drawn to a military mobilization order issued by the Huaxia Official.
The main content of the mobilization order was that, according to the Huaxia intelligence department, the Destiny Tablet fragment that was about to emerge in Green City would determine the future situation of the entire Main Plane of Glory.
Therefore, it hoped that high-level Huaxia players would go to Green City to help "I Love a Stick" obtain the Destiny Tablet fragment...
This announcement immediately caused a huge response.
It had been so long since the Ancient Invasion began, and it was the first time players received an official notification from the government.
It instantly boiled over.
A sense of honor in fighting for the country quickly ascended.
Countless posts instantly flooded the forum.
"In real life, I can’t do much for the country, but can’t I even do it in Glory?"
"Raise soldiers for a thousand days, use them at this moment! Gentlemen, I’ll take the first step!"
"Mighty Huaxia with a billion soldiers, how could I be missing?"
"Sorry, I’m a nobody, as a beta player my level is only 16, although I can’t help much, I have already planned to die back to level 0 this time."
"I’m already standing on the city walls of Green City, waiting for your arrival, let this battle show the blood of the descendants of Yan and Huang."
"Only death awaits!!"
"If it must be war, then let it be war, the blood of Huaxia’s children has never cooled, and we have never retreated even a half step."

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 507: Demigod Lide, Awaiting the Great Battle’s Arrival
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Chapter 507: Demigod Lide, Awaiting the Great Battle’s Arrival
Deep in the Land of Bone-Burying, five fragments of the Destiny Tablet were arrayed in a row before Lide.
The fragment of the Destiny Tablet that was originally suppressing the Underworld had also been retrieved by him.
In desperate times, desperate measures were necessary, although this would affect the cultivation of crops in the Underworld.
But if the core of the Destiny Tablet was not obtained in a few days, then there would be no point in thinking about the harvest. The land need not be tilled—just wait for death...
At this critical juncture, there was no room for second thoughts.
Those Ancient Evil Gods that had already turned their direction and were assaulting Green City aimed to destroy the entire world. Although the Far Mountain Range was vast, how long could it exist if the outside world was obliterated?
Thus, Lide no longer had any options left; it was either life or death.
Now, what Dawn City needed was to harness every bit of strength, to make a final, all-in gamble.
Out of the five Destiny Tablet fragments before him, he had already absorbed the power of three, with two still remaining to be devoured.
At that moment, Lide stood by the five Destiny Tablet fragments feeling a transcendent and marvelous sensation as if he were floating above worldly concerns.
Even sometimes, in his absent-mindedness, he seemed to catch glimpses of some ancient secrets.
These were the reflections lingering in the River of Destiny. The more saturated his power of Destiny became, the closer his connection to the River of Destiny grew.
But because of this, he inadvertently saw the former rulers that oversaw the River of Destiny, whose eyes carried the rotation of the Star River and were filled with an oppressing sense of despair.
Fortunately, this was an unconscious connection with the power of Destiny, fleeting in an instant. Otherwise, he might have faced oblivion again, like last time.
That ultimate dark boss was truly too terrifying.
Lide hesitated no more, holding tightly to the two fragments whose power of Destiny he had not yet devoured, his thoughts slowly sinking into stillness.
The power within his body began to function, unleashing a strong suction force.
The Destiny Tablet fragments trembled and subsequently emitted a chaotic light, as a special power surged into him.
The dormant power of Destiny within him started to operate, reviving the potent force slowly.
His Bloodline Power, instead of repelling the power of Destiny, underwent a miraculous fusion with it, complementing each other, incredibly harmonious.
However, the situation soon took an unexpected turn; the power of Destiny within these two fragments was too intense, to the point where Lide felt overfilled, causing him considerable discomfort, even affecting his Spiritual Sea with tremors.
But a moment later, the curse proved to be a blessing. An overabundance of the power of Destiny forced an evolution in his Bloodline.
The Bloodline Power began to cycle frenziedly, attempting to digest the energy brought by the power of Destiny.
Once the power of Destiny within his body reached an extreme, a faint silvery-white light emerged, and Lide’s blood transformed from its normal red to silver...
And it became increasingly viscous.
It was as if he had cultivated the legendary extreme existence of blood—Mercury Blood.
According to ancient legends, only the mightiest of life forms could condense Mercury Blood, as it holds ten times the power of ordinary blood.
One Sunshine Hour, two Sunshine Hours...
Time trickled by, and unaware of the transformation of his blood, Lide was still earnestly devouring the power of Destiny.
Each time he had absorbed the power of Destiny in the past, it would involuntarily draw him into the River of Destiny for a journey.
But this time he sensed danger, and his subconscious strongly resisted going to the River of Destiny.
That Ancient overseer of all the Planes was undoubtedly the nightmare of all beings.
Perhaps due to his resolute will, this time, unusually, he did not enter the River of Destiny while absorbing and did so at a much faster rate than the previous times.
After a long time, a miraculous scene unfolded.
After devouring the two Destiny Tablet fragments, Lide’s aura did not become stronger; on the contrary, it became more indistinct.
Even looking at him from the opposite side, one would unconsciously overlook this person.
As if he no longer existed in this world.
The power of Destiny...
This is the primal, core power of Glory, he who controls this origin power will eternally transcend the world.
No longer constrained by life span, he can’t even be killed with the power from within Glory.
The only possibility of death might come after the world reaches its end, perishing alongside it.
At this moment, Lide hasn’t yet reached such a state, but the power of destiny provided by the five fragments of the Destiny Tablet has already intensified to a critical point.
Right now, if Lide wishes, he could even briefly erase his trace of existence, and this erasure would originate from the very core of Glory, causing the entire world to forget his existence.
However, the consumption of using this method is enormous, and the duration is very short, so there isn’t much necessity.
Time swiftly passes, February 28.
The weather is gloomy and cold.
Though three days remain before leaving behind the Frost Month, today’s sudden chill seems to tell people that the warm season of rebirth is still a long way off.
But whether it’s cold or hot, nothing can stop the gigantic Dawn City from turning.
Dawn City has now become a true city that never sleeps, its citywide lighting system begins to operate at nightfall, and its factories have not rested for a moment.
Dawn City is like a massive machine that operates day and night, and its residents are the screws in this machine, affecting every aspect.
One Alchemy Magic Cannon after another is constructed, one God Hunting Crossbow after another is rolled out of the production workshops...
However, at this moment, Lide has no time to concern himself with the situation outside, as the devouring is about to complete.
When the last strand of the power of destiny flows into his body from the two fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
A long-missed system notification sound rings in his ears.
"Ding~ Your level has been raised to Level 30, entering a special state—Demigod. While in the Demigod state, your level will no longer be able to increase."
"Ding~ Detection shows you already possess a Divine Position, Divine Power, and Believers. The special status of a Demigod is removed. You only need to ignite Divine Fire to become a Weak God at Level 31.
Or you can refuse Divine Enthronement and continue to increase your levels; in that case, you will become a Divine Monster beyond Level 30."
Lide opens his eyes and takes a deep breath after repeatedly checking the system notifications.
Although not yet a god, he has finally reached the crucial milestone of Level 30.
The next step forward would transition him into a being of another dimension.
Moreover, because he possesses the Rare Divine Position and Divine Power, he can decide not to ascend to godhood and continue to level up, becoming a Divine Monster, which is quite user-friendly.
Of course, Lide wouldn’t be foolish enough to forego godhood in favor of becoming a Divine Monster.
After confirming there were no other notifications, Lide slowly stands up and stretches his limbs.
Crack crack~ The sound of his bones echoes, and he feels an indescribable, terrifying power within his body.
He even believes he could punch through the space in front of him, which is extremely frightening.
After a brief sense of the power, surprise shows in Lide’s eyes; his strength has increased by at least 80%.
This is just from leveling up once.
The difference between a Demigod and Level 29 is truly terrifying.
Moments later, he notices the blood flowing in his veins...
"Silver blood?!," Lide exclaims, eyes wide with surprise.
The thick, mercury-like silver blood flows through his veins, now comprising over 90% of his previously scarlet blood.
And this silver blood grants him a terrifying power that defies description.
Most of his power increase this time seems to be in his blood.
After taking a few deep breaths to recover his composure, he ponders, if all his blood evolves into silver blood, that would likely coincide with his level reaching 31, ascending to godhood.
"It’s a pity... just give me two more months, no, even one month, and I could become a god."
"But time waits for no one..."
A bitter smile appeared on his face.
In a few days, the critical time point for the emergence of the Destiny Tablet core would arrive, and there was no more time for him to develop at his leisure.
A war of unparalleled horror would inevitably break out by then.
The Angel Alliance was very likely to throw all their forces into the fray, for this was their last hope.
The Abyss Demons and the Undead Plane, these two great forces, would also refuse to let their fate be controlled by others, and would fight to the death as well.
What was even more terrifying was the mastermind behind all this—the Ancient faction.
Those intelligent Ancient Evil Gods must be aware of the importance of the Destiny Tablet core. When the time came, it was feared they would muster all their strength and devour all the factions in one go!
This was destined to be a more brutal and perilous war than the fall of the Angel Alliance.
For everyone knew that during the time of the Angel Alliance, they still had a way out, they could still flee, but in Green City, there was simply no escape.
Either they would seize the Destiny Tablet core and reforge the Destiny Tablet to suppress the Ancients,
Or they would be slaughtered by the Ancient faction, the Destiny Tablet stolen by the Ancient Evil Gods, and then everyone would helplessly await the destruction of the world by the Ancients.
There was no third option.
Even hiding in a Dimension Plane like a turtle would be useless, for after defeat, the world was bound to be purged, the cracks in the sky would burst open, and all of Glory’s everything would turn to nothingness.
Now, looking at the once-thriving Ancient Forest transformed into a land of death filled with deadly, sticky ooze, one could imagine what kind of future they were facing.
Lide shook his head, no longer pondering on this. His gaze shifted to the attribute panel.
"Why haven’t my skills changed much? Although all my attributes have increased, they clearly don’t match my current Level 30 status..."
Although he could feel his strength had improved by a tier, the attribute panel didn’t show significant changes.
This vexed Lide, but after pondering it for a moment and not coming to a conclusion, he didn’t bother to dwell on it any longer.
After collecting the five shards of the Destiny Tablet from the ground, he stepped out and vanished from the Land of Bone-Burying.
---
---
---
A Sunshine Hour later, City Hall.
The summoned Goblin Chief Moer and Dwarf Forging Master Valen were both excitedly looking at Lide, who sat behind the office desk, as if they both had encountered something worth getting thrilled over.
Valen was the first to speak, his dwarfish face covered in a large beard and showing great excitement.
"Your Majesty, the God Hunting Crossbow you ordered the dwarves to forge has been completed!!"
Hearing this, Goblin Chief Moer immediately blew a fuse, glaring furiously at Valen and bellowing.
"Damn Dwarf!! The God Hunting Crossbow was ordered to be forged by the goblins under the great master’s command!
You dwarves were simply hammering the iron for the goblins! At best, you qualify as laborers! The real merit belongs to us!"
Valen was not to be outdone and glared fiercely back at Moer.
"Hmph, without the dwarves, you wouldn’t even be able to lift a hammer!"
"Without goblins, you dwarves would only know how to lift hammers!!"
"Without dwarves, you..."
Lide looked at the two squabbling quarrelsome little men in front of his desk and his face filled with exasperation.
His right hand tapped the desk loudly and he said with a cold demeanor.
"Talk nonsense once more and I’ll cancel your material quota for one year, sending you to breed pigs at the farm!"
Both of them didn’t dare to get angry at Lide and immediately quieted down, though they still glared at each other, neither willing to concede.
Forging the God Hunting Crossbow was a feat of towering merit; whoever did well could potentially be extolled by the bards throughout all of the Main Plane of Glory and even be recorded in history books for posterity to revere.
Such glorious "Glory" was simply an irresistible temptation for the two Dwarves.
"Valen, you go first and introduce us to the power of the God Hunting Crossbow."
Valen, whose name was called, puffed up instantly, arrogantly glared at Moer, and nearly infuriated him to death.
"Your Highness, the God Hunting Crossbow had always lacked materials, so there was no finished product. Initially, we could only estimate that its power was enough to slay Divines.
Once you provided enough materials, we commenced forging immediately.
With the blessing of Dwarf Secret Skills, the crafted God Hunting Crossbow greatly increased in power.
After testing, we can now confirm that each attack has the power to kill a Level 32 Weak God.
In order to tackle even more powerful Divines, the forging community, led by Dwarves, discussed that in addition to this, we would forge a crossbow capable of hunting Level 40 Powerful Divine Power Gods.
After multiple pieces of Guidance from Lady Kaslina, we spent no less than twenty Divine corpses and Divine Status, and with Lady Kaslina personally enchanting the weapon,
we finally crafted an unprecedented powerful crossbow, capable of killing a Main God!
Lady Kaslina named it—Main God Hunter."
Lide’s eyes lit up upon hearing this.
A crossbow specifically forged to hunt Level 40 Main Gods—Main God Hunter...isn’t this a bit too awesome??
"Main God Hunter? Not bad, you’ve done very well.
Besides that, how many regular God Hunting Crossbows did you forge?"
Moer, who had been watching on the side as Valen excluded the Goblins completely, trembled with urgency and quickly interjected upon hearing this.
"Master, we have forged 20 regular God Hunting Crossbows, and there are upwards of a thousand bolts, which I forged using a lost art of Alchemy, without any relation to Dwarves!
And while forging the God Hunting Crossbow, the Dwarves were just helping to hammer, really useless..."
Valen’s eyes were about to bulge out with rage, wishing he could immediately drag this damnable fool away for a good beating.
Lide couldn’t be bothered with these two idiots.
"Just transport all the weapons to the Land of Bone-Burying once they are forged.
Was the platform for placing the God Hunting Crossbows constructed as instructed?"
"It has been built. As soon as you give the order, it can be put into use immediately." Moer nodded eagerly and then, as if remembering something, he added,
"Additionally, thanks to the support of the Ocean God System at all costs, we have built 5 more Alchemy Magic Cannons, making a total of 25 now!"
Lide was truly surprised to hear this.
The upgrade of the Land of Bone-Burying would be complete in two more days, but it was foreseeable that once the upgrade was finished, the Space Gates that could be opened from there would certainly be able to encompass Green City.
By then, he would be able to use the Space Gates to venture out for battle.
The Alchemy Magic Cannons and God Hunting Crossbows would become portable superweapons.
With a Space Gate open, he could directly shoot at the Divines outside and even switch locations after firing.
And if the enemy wanted to destroy the God Hunting Crossbows and Alchemy Magic Cannons, his Land of Bone-Burying would act as the best shield.
Anyone daring to enter would be suppressed by his Plane Power.
Then he could set up an ambush with Frey or the Mermaid Main God within the Land of Bone-Burying, making any intruders suffer greatly.
Alchemy Magic Cannons, plus 20 God Hunting Crossbows and one Main God Hunter, his power had suddenly become ample.
The scene would probably be extremely spectacular when they all fired in unison.
However, forging these materials had completely exhausted the resources he had amassed from his expeditions and conquests, and it was only with great difficulty that even Divine Monster Asreaga, leading the Demon Army, could plunder enough materials from dozens of Dimension Planes.
Of course, the key to all this was actually Kaslina; having an Ancient Deity at home was the only reason these formidable weapons could be crafted. Otherwise, he would have been unable to make use of these materials.
At this moment, Lide’s heart finally relaxed somewhat, now all he needed to do was wait for the Land of Bone-Burying to finish upgrading, and then wait for the birth of the Destiny Tablet’s core.
Wait for that decisive battle that would determine the survival of "Glory".

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 508 Hunting Lide
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Chapter 508 Hunting Lide
"I just got these two Destiny Tablet fragments, but the Power of Destiny within them has already been devoured..."
Lide looked at Lady Kaslina, who appeared in his office for the first time, his gaze involuntarily falling upon the two Destiny Tablet fragments on the desk.
Three days ago, Lady Kaslina had promised to fetch him two fragments of the Destiny Tablet, and to his surprise, she had made good on that promise.
Now, along with the five he already had in hand, he possessed a total of seven fragments.
Considering there were only thirty fragments of the Destiny Tablet in all, he nearly owned a quarter of them.
This was certainly an astonishing figure.
The Angel Alliance, previously having over a hundred Divine beings and even seven or eight Main Gods with Powerful Divine Power, had obtained only eight fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
After being breached by the forces of old, only the two fragments taken by the Sun Goddess remained.
Including those fragments yet to be discovered, the number Lide controlled was likely already the highest.
"Lady Kaslina, do you know how to control the core of the Destiny Tablet once it emerges?"
Lide gazed intensely at the half-mermaid beauty before him, aware that the more fragments of the Destiny Tablet he held, the better his chances in the struggle for its core.
However, as to how to use these fragments to control the core of the Destiny Tablet, he was completely mystified.
The characteristically aloof Lady Kaslina slowly shook her head.
"It’s a special connection, one that can’t be manipulated by any means.
The more fragments of the Destiny Tablet you hold, the stronger your connection to its core will be...
Once the Destiny Tablet appears, you will understand. There’s no point in discussing it now, it would be beyond your understanding."
A wry smile tugged at Lide’s mouth, translating her words in his head to something along the lines of, "Even if I told you, you wouldn’t get it, so let’s not waste our time..."
After a moment of contemplation, he said solemnly,
"Lady Kaslina, I must make a trip to Green City at once, and I’ll trouble you to hold down the fort in Dawn City for the time being.
Furthermore, the Land of Bone-Burying will be upgradable in two days, and when the Space Gate is activated, its range will undoubtedly cover Green City.
Since you have access to the Land of Bone-Burying, should I be unable to return in time, I hope you can lead the armies of Dawn City to provide support."
As critical moments drew near, conflicts could erupt without warning.
Lide was not at ease about leaving Green City unattended and felt the need to personally oversee it.
Now that he had the home field advantage, he had to make good use of it.
"Go ahead, with me here, no one will be able to cause destruction within Dawn City."
Lady Kaslina nodded faintly, her tone gentle yet carrying an undeniable authority.
As the Goddess of Fate from another Dimension Plane, who once aided the Creator God in forging the Glory of the Multi-dimensional Plane, her words held immense weight.
Lide nodded, picked up the two Destiny Tablet fragments from the desk, and together with the other five, anchored them within the Land of Bone-Burying.
The fragments of the Destiny Tablet could not be stored in System Space, and keeping them on his person was not particularly safe. If they were discovered, he could become the target of dozens of Divine beings... and he was not looking for a death wish.
As Lide was preparing to leave, Lady Kaslina, as if remembering something, spoke softly.
"If you can make it, it would be best to return after the upgrade to the Land of Bone-Burying is complete.
The stone coffin you brought back from the land that was initially sealed with an Ancient Evil God—it’s about time to open it."
A stone coffin?
Lide was taken aback; previously, he had carried a stone coffin brimming with decay from the Plane where an Ancient Evil God had been sealed within Dwarf Valley.
At the time, Lady Kaslina had told him to open it when he was on the brink of divinity, but he’d been far too preoccupied to give it much thought.
Now in a blink of an eye, he had also reached level thirty.
"I’ll make it back in time. Once the Land of Bone-Burying is upgraded, the distance between Dawn City and Green City will be but a blink away."
Lady Kaslina gave a slight nod, her eyes returning to their usual indifference as she fell silent.
Lide saw this and wasted no time, directly leaving the City Hall, mounting Castro, and speeding towards Green City.
An hour of Sunshine Hour later.
Green City.
Before even entering the city, Lide used magic to conceal his figure and released a strand of the Power of Destiny to reduce the presence of his nearly perfect visage to absolute zero.
He did not attract the gaze of outsiders.
After entering the city, Lide’s first impression was—chaos, followed by the sheer number of people, incredibly many.
So many that the crowd reached a sea of people, the scene quite similar to a popular tourist spot in Huaxia Country during the National Day holiday...
The crowd was so dense that it was almost numbing.
Most of these were players, gathered from various parts of the Main Plane of Glory.
These foolish ones were shouting loudly, like squeezing onto a bus.
The news about the imminent emergence of the core of the Destiny Tablet was now common knowledge.
This battle related to the future of Glory, even to the destiny of Earth, was too important, so all the players that could, had hurried over.
Green City already had nearly 5 million residents, already at the upper limit of residing density, and it was overcrowded on a normal day.
Now that several times the number of players had crowded in, the entire city had fallen into extreme congestion.
A city with an energy-carrying capacity of 5 million people now bore almost 20 million people... the mere thought was terrifying.
Even by comparison, Green City’s situation was still better; Anos City, the main city for players, was truly about to explode at this moment.
Even the rafters were crowded with people...
Lide originally wanted to observe the environment of Green City, but after half an hour without making it two hundred meters, he exploded with frustration and teleported straight back to the Crimson Mage Tower...
Isa had already been sent back to Dawn City by Lide, and most of the mages with potential had been transferred away by him.
Thus, the normally bustling Crimson Mage Tower was now presenting an unusually deserted scene.
When Lide arrived at the entrance of the Mage Tower, it just so happened that Viola’s carriage was returning from the City Hall.
Seeing Lide’s figure, his little maid leaped from the carriage, joyfully running over to Lide’s side while ignoring the ambiguous smiles around her.
Her eyes, like sapphires, were brimming with joy from deep within, as if they were about to overflow with water.
"Lord Lide..."
Looking at the little maid whom he had already devoured, a trace of indulgence showed on Lide’s face.
He reached out to ruffle the girl’s little head.
"You’ve worked hard; is the City Hall job very busy?"
Viola looked at the tenderness in those deep black eyes, feeling her heart nearly melting.
She shook her head, her tone proud.
"No, being able to share your worries is my fortune."
Lide laughed heartily, taking Viola’s slender, jade-like hands in his amidst her shy and blissful gaze, and stepped into the Mage Tower.
But no one noticed that, a few hundred blades away from the Crimson Mage Tower, on the top floor of a three-story tavern, two mysterious individuals clad in black robes were keeping a constant watch on the Crimson Mage Tower.
After Lide appeared and entered the Mage Tower, the two robed figures exchanged a look, their faces revealing a touch of excitement.
"We’ve finally waited for the prey to appear.
Last time, the target left Green City after a brief moment; this time, we absolutely cannot let him leave.
Let’s go, return and inform Viscount Bernard..."
The other robed figure hesitated a bit.
"Is the Tower Master of the Crimson Mage Tower, Lide Kachar, really Lord Ilo?"
"What, you doubt Viscount Bernard’s judgement?!" said the first robed figure fiercely as he glowered at the other.
"I’m telling you, if you dare betray me, I will definitely kill you myself!!"
The other party was startled and quickly said,
"No, I’m just a bit incredulous, how could I ever betray you because of this."
View the correct content at
"Hmph, that’s better, now go back, the hunting plan will start Immediately!! Taking control of Green City will be of great help to Viscount Bernard’s subsequent schemes."
---
---
---
Crimson Mage Tower.
After Lide Kachar led Vina back, he felt pleased looking at the little maid clinging to him closely.
Her big, watery eyes were filled with love.
Thinking about the unprecedented horrific war coming in a few days, with an uncertain future, his heart was also moved.
In Vina’s somewhat unexpected gasp, Lide Kachar scooped her up in a princess carry and thumped up the stairs.
Feeling Lide’s breathing, Vina curled up in his arms, her face already blushed like a cooked shrimp.
But the scent from Lide’s body made her heart extremely content, and the love in her eyes became even more touching.
By the time Lide put Vina on the bed, her neck was flushed with crimson, and her eyes were slightly hazy.
Vina wriggled out of Lide’s arms, feeling a bit unwilling to part, she timidly turned her head and saw those intensely dark eyes watching her, immediately feeling shy beyond words.
She whispered trembling,
"Lord Lide, right now, right now it’s still daylight..."
Lide Kachar laughed heartily, then slipped off both the girl’s and his shoes and socks, and climbed into bed.
Vina shivered at the sight, quickly closed her eyes tightly, even her breathing slowed, feeling her heart pounding, pounding away.
But unexpectedly, after a moment of nervousness, nothing she had anticipated happened. Slowly opening her eyes, she then saw a face with a clean smile looking at her from the side.
A touch of confusion crossed Vina’s face, and then seeing the narrow smile on Lide’s face, she flushed with great embarrassment, and with a whimper, buried her head in Lide’s chest.
"Lord Lide..."
Her voice was trembling, now with a mix of bashful annoyance and a mature woman’s unique charm.
Lide extended his hand to hold the girl in his arms, gently patting her back.
He chuckled softly in her ear,
"You naughty girl, what were you just thinking? I just wanted to hold you..."
The girl trembled all over, and immediately became unbearably shy, burying her head even deeper, her limbs clinging tightly to Lide Kachar like an octopus, as if afraid he would leave her.
Seeing her unteased state, Lide Kachar laughed, his expression softened, and he gently tweaked her earlobes, whispering,
"In a few days, we’ll face an unprecedented battle. Girl, are you scared?"
Vina shook her head in his arms, still in a state of shyness.
Lide couldn’t help but smile slightly, looking up at the window on the other side, the cracks in the sky caught his eye.
The air became quiet.
For a moment, his dark eyes rarely showed a hint of uncertainty, he murmured,
"Sometimes I really fear failure, for if I fail, perhaps I might never see you all again, and if I fail, the Crimson Mage Tower, Dawn City, everything will turn to nothing..."
The expectations of the people of Dawn City, the trust of his followers, the pressure of the entire world at risk of destruction, Lide Kachar was shouldering it all at this moment.
He carried far more than outsiders could imagine.
He is now not just the ruler of Dawn, but also the hope and the spiritual refuge of Dawn.
In the moments when the ancient world was on the brink of destruction, anyone could fall, anyone could give up, anyone could shrink back, but he could not.
Behind him lay the gazes full of hope, the expectations of countless people.
A boy’s transformation into a man often began with taking on responsibilities, and a mature man’s burden grew heavier, sometimes to the point where it was hard to take a deep breath.
Vina noticed the change in Lide’s emotions and suddenly lifted her head from his chest.
Her slightly disheveled hair brushed across her face, the blush not yet faded, giving the girl an enchanting beauty.
Those sapphire-like eyes saw a bewilderment in Lide’s eyes that had never been there before, causing her heart to ache.
She reached out to gently touch his handsome face.
Her voice was weak, but filled with unwavering certainty.
"Lord Lide, Vina will always follow you, until death, until the world is destroyed, until everything ceases to exist...
Even if Lord Lide loses everything, you will still have me, I will always be here..."
Lide, looking at the unmatched resolve in the girl’s eyes, felt his heart melting.
He leaned down and kissed her deeply.
Passion deepens when love is strong.
They were both ignited in an instant.
Afterwards, Lide also learned for the first time.
It turned out that a mage’s body could be so flexible.
For example, knees could be pressed against a chest...
Legs could be opened into a straight line...
Could...
——
——
——
In the west district of Green City, inside a luxurious manor.
"Lord Ilo has appeared at the Crimson Mage Tower? Hahaha, I have finally waited for this moment."
Viscount Bernard, holding a glass of red wine, had a sharp look in his eyes. "I thought that fake god would continue to hide."
Hearing this, the Eight-Armed Snake Demon Roy looked somewhat puzzled at Viscount Bernard.
"The situation has now changed; the news of the Destiny Tablet fragment has drawn the attention of almost the entire Main Plane of Glory. Why does it still matter for us to continue hunting Lord Ilo?"
Viscount Bernard turned to the high-level demon from the abyss, his smile gradually brightening.
"Roy, the great Nine Prisons will be eternal... The overlord gave me a special piece of information some time ago; Lord Ilo might be hiding more than just one fragment of the Destiny Tablet.
Moreover, he also holds one of the Twelve Magic Scrolls.
You know that other things don’t matter to us, even the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
But the Twelve Magic Scrolls are absolutely not to be touched by anyone else!!"
The eyes of the Eight-Armed Snake Demon contracted sharply, and his slender eyes held a cold chill.
"Why don’t I know about this? What other information have you not told me?"
"No, no, no, Roy, I did not intend to conceal it from you, but some things... knowing too much isn’t always beneficial..."
Viscount Bernard was indifferent to the Snake Demon’s anger, slowly sipping the red wine.
"Prepare to move. Once you bring back the head of Lord Ilo, I will share with you more useful information, such as how to become a Twelve-Armed Golden Snake Demon..."
The Eight-Armed Snake Demon snorted coldly and gave Viscount Bernard a deep look before turning and leaving.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 509: Level 35 Hell Demon Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Chapter 509: Level 35 Hell Demon Lord
Crimson Mage Tower.
Lide stood in front of the room’s window, refreshed and gazing into the distance.
On the bed behind him was Vina, whose body covered by the quilt, revealed a jade-white delicate foot, and her rounded shoulder jutted out from beneath the covers. Although it seemed perfectly innocent at first glance, it sparked endless imagination.
The girl, unable to withstand the thrashing, had now fallen into a deep sleep, yet the corners of her eyes still betrayed a hint of captivating ardor.
After looking out into the distance for a moment, Lide stretched, walked back to the bedside, and looked down at the deeply sleeping girl with a slight smile.
After stealing a kiss on her blushing lips, he began to straighten out his slightly wrinkled mage robe.
Just as he was about to leave, still deeply asleep, Vina seemed to sense something and suddenly opened her eyes, peeking out from the quilt with hopeful eyes at Lide.
"Lord Lide..."
Seeing the girl’s longing gaze, Lide showed a warm smile.
He folded back to the bedside for another deep kiss, waiting until Vina’s face was flushed with red once more before he got up.
"Be good, there’s a lot to deal with at City Hall. You sleep a bit more, I’ll be back in the evening."
Looking at the young man of peerless elegance by the bed, Vina nodded happily.
"Mm, I’ll wait for you at home."
Lide smiled tenderly, then leaned in to kiss her forehead once more before he turned to leave.
Inside the room, Vina was left alone, staring blankly at the ceiling. After a moment, she suddenly showed a silly smile...
As Lide descended the stairs, he found a young mage waiting anxiously at the doorstep, yet too apprehensive to step into the Mage Tower, thus pacing back and forth at the entrance.
The young mage, upon seeing him, immediately sighed with relief and hurriedly approached him to report.
"Lord Lide, the Dark Contract has discovered traces of a Destiny Tablet Fragment!"
Those words instantly invigorated Lide.
"Be clearer."
"Half an hour ago, Lord Stanley received intelligence that a unique auction item was found in the black market controlled by the Heart-eating Demon Wales, which possessed an extremely special power.
Subsequently, intelligence personnel accidentally heard an Extraordinary Strong surmise that it seemed to be a Destiny Tablet Fragment...
Lord Stanley received the news and immediately went to investigate personally.
According to Lord Stanley’s deduction, even if that item isn’t a Destiny Tablet Fragment, it must be related to one."
Lide’s eyes narrowed, as the Destiny Tablet Fragment was too sensitive an issue at this point—no information could be missed.
"Where is the item now?"
"Still in the black market, the seller has been detained by us."
Lide nodded, no further words needed.
"Fine, you may go. I’ll handle this matter personally."
"Yes, my lord."
After watching the departing mage, Lide nodded slightly, assured that the mage hadn’t lied and wasn’t a spy...
He confirmed there was no problem, then in a flash, he disappeared on the spot.
Green City, West District, Black Market.
This place was originally the territory of the Heart-eating Demon Wales, tightly controlled by the Demon Heart.
After Lide conquered Green City, and considering the Demon Heart’s past favor in maintaining the Dark Contract for him, he permitted it to continue controlling the black market.
Of course, this would be under the leadership of City Hall, and it could no longer commit any misdeeds in Green City.
The Heart-eating Demon who regarded Lord Lide as a mentor agreed to these terms without a second thought, never considering defiance.
The tranquility and order in the western district during this time was inseparable from this guy’s efforts.
The bustling black market of the past had been firmly guarded by hundreds of people.
Since the black market was underground, controlling a few exits would dominate the situation.
Stanley, a second generation of Bloodline with a fierce scar on his face and once a believer in the Evil God, was sitting in charge, personally overseeing the situation.
The Heart-eating Demon Wales stood beside Stanley, obediently, showing no signs of his past arrogance as one of the three great leaders of the Underworld.
"Lord Stanley, I really found this stone tablet by accident. I heard everyone was looking for fragments of the Destiny Tablet, so I thought I’d try to sell it for a good price..."
Right now in the main hall of the black market, a pale-faced middle-aged man knelt on the ground, constantly explaining.
On the round table in front of this man lay a stone tablet imbued with a very special force, memorable at a glance.
Stanley watched the middle-aged man with a sharp gaze, speaking calmly.
"You say you found it? How come I never stumble upon such treasures?
We’ve searched the street you mentioned three times and found nothing.
If you don’t start telling the truth, I’m sorry, but in the next second, they might see your head displayed on the table!"
A murderous aura began to thicken around him, his eyes becoming increasingly icy.
The Heart-eating Demon Wales joined in with a creepy cackle.
"Just tell the truth. We only want details, not your life. How much is your life even worth? Speak, and you’ll be fine.
Rest assured, Green City is now under Lord Ilo’s control. Nobody will hurt you as long as you don’t break the law."
One played the heavy, the other the soft touch, thoroughly intimidating the man, but he still couldn’t provide more information, repeating the same story over and over.
The two exchanged glances and shook their heads. Apparently, the man knew only so much and they couldn’t get any more out of him.
But just as they were about to have someone lock him up,
suddenly the space in the hall shattered, and a figure appeared before everyone.
"Lord Ilo!!"
"Lord!!"
Upon seeing Lide, both became very excited.
Especially the Heart-eating Demon Wales, who had not seen Lide in a very long time, was extraordinarily thrilled.
Before him stood the great being who had led him to the transcendent realm!
Of course, Wales might never know in his lifetime that Lide had not even reached level fifteen the first time they met...
This guy was doomed to be fooled for a lifetime.
Lide nodded, foregoing pleasantries, and directly picked up the stone block with the special force. His eyes then showed a hint of disappointment.
"This is not a fragment of the Destiny Tablet... although there is a power of destiny on the stone, it was intentionally left there by someone."
Lide’s gaze turned to the middle-aged man still kneeling, suddenly narrowing his eyes as if he sensed something.
"You dare continue to pretend in my presence? The devilish aura in your body, even when masked with the power of destiny, is as blatant as a torch in the night."
free\.c o(m)
What?
Stanley and the Heart-eating Demon Wales were taken aback, then stared in disbelief at the middle-aged man kneeling on the ground.
This man, whom they had interrogated for so long, was actually a Hell Demon??
As they stood puzzled, the middle-aged man on the ground suddenly let out a strange cackle, and then his facial skin melted like wax.
Momentarily, a green-faced, tusked, fierce-looking Devil appeared inside the room.
The Devil looked exactly like the minstrel’s image in midair, with twisted horns on the head and a pair of wings on the back, as a tail swayed from side to side behind.
"Heh heh heh, though you’re but a Fake God, being able to see through my disguise is still quite impressive..."
The Devil showed no fear, his face revealing a sinister smile of successful scheming.
Just as Stanley and Wales, deceived by it, became enraged wanting to move forward and attack,
suddenly the space trembled.
Then everyone felt as if the surrounding space had solidified, as if it were completely sealed off.
Stanley’s heart skipped a beat as he tried to use Space Magic, but it had no effect whatsoever.
Seeing this, the Devil’s smile became even more chilling.
"Stop struggling, Lord Ilo, this place will be your burial ground.
We expended a tremendous amount of effort to deal with you and your Fallen Angel... hahaha."
After his words fell, suddenly a Magic Shield enveloped the entire black market.
The Magic Shield was like a giant glass cover that could block everything; it even drained all Magic Power in that moment.
As everyone was uncertain and alarmed, the space at the entrance of the hall shattered, and Viscount Bernard, dressed in a tailcoat and with graceful manners, appeared before everyone’s eyes.
Before people could react, a High-level Abyssal Demon—the Eight-Armed Snake Demon Roy—also stepped out of the space, those narrow eyes twinkling with a chilling coldness.
But that wasn’t all; the third figure was the most shocking.
Viscount Bernard and Roy took their positions on either side of the Space Gate, followed by the appearance of a Devil Lord with two heads and four arms.
In everyone’s minds, the name of a fearsome title immediately arose: the Lord of the First Level of Hell—Perol.
A Devil Lord with a level of terror reaching 35.
In the minstrel’s tales, this fearsome Devil Lord was extremely evil, devouring the souls of a hundred young girls every day.
Lide’s expression tightened marginally upon seeing this scene, a Devil Lord?? Quite intriguing.
His heart devoid of any panic, he leisurely shifted his gaze toward Viscount Bernard.
He still had an impression of this former chairman of the Dark Contract.
Back when the other party had a conflict with the Crimson Mage Tower, Viscount Bernard took advantage of the situation to seize the Twelve Magic Scrolls.
He sent Withered Bones to attack the Crimson Mage Tower to distract Green City’s Guard Army, then he personally led a team to storm the City Lord’s mansion to snatch the Twelve Magic Scrolls from Extraordinary Mage Rock’s hands.
That battle was still fresh in his memory.
"Viscount Bernard, I didn’t expect you to return to Green City."
Lide, seeing no second Hell Lord appearing from that space, had a slight smile on his face.
"I thought you had escaped alive, but it seems you’ve come back to seek death."
A flicker of anger passed through Viscount Bernard’s eyes; Lide was essentially the one who had risen to power by stepping on the Dark Contract.
He naturally felt extremely displeased with this person who had taken over the fruits of his labor for decades.
"Seek death? Hehehe, nothing but a Fake God, and you dare to be insolent in front of Lord Perol.
Where is that Fallen Angel of yours? Call her out."
Frey, having appeared before hundreds of thousands while slaying an Ancient Evil God attacking Green City, was no secret at all.
Lide paid no attention to Viscount Bernard, turning his gaze toward the Devil Lord Mopelor.
"So Hell is planning to get involved in Green City as well?"
The towering three-bladed, two-headed, and four-armed Devil Lord had a cold gaze.
"Is the affair of Hell something you can pry into? Where are the Twelve Magic Scrolls you got from the Black Dragon?"
Lide’s pupils suddenly constricted.
Only a few people close to him knew about him taking the Twelve Magic Scrolls from the Black Dragon’s head.
How did this Hell Lord know about it?
Thinking of Cassina’s evaluation of the Twelve Magic Scrolls, a shock immediately went through his heart.
Could it be that the Lord of Nine Prisons had always had control over the Twelve Magic Scrolls? Yes, after all, the scrolls sealed his power; how could he not care?
"Twelve Magic Scrolls? Sorry, I accidentally lost them during a battle between the Angel Alliance and the Old Days Camp..."
Hearing this, Perol let out a cold sneer, seemingly unwilling to waste words with Lide. His gaze turned towards the blank space behind Lide.
"Come out, Fallen Angel, today you and this Fake God will both die."
As his words fell, Perol’s four limbs simultaneously punched towards that blank area.
Crackle~
In that instant, an extremely terrifying energy burst forth from his four arms.
The void directly exploded.
The next second, Frey, a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel with twelve black wings unfurled, appeared from the void.
Holding the Cross Angel Battle Sword, her gaze was coldly fixed on this Level 35 Hell Lord.
"How dare you blaspheme the sovereign with just you?!"
Perol sneered and waved his hand; a White Bone Sword, forged completely from human fingers, appeared out of thin air in his hand.
"A Fake God dares to claim sovereignty?!"
As he spoke, the aura of his Level 35 Medium Divine Power began to surge.
The horrifying Divine Power burst out without restraint.
Although the black market was large, it seemed incredibly narrow as the Divine Power tornado swept through.
Frey was not to be outdone. Her Level 36 strength was also extremely formidable, with Divine Power like a prison, surging forth.
It was a standoff.
But just as they were about to clash, the space to Lide’s right shattered, and then a being with horns on its head, wings on its back, and covered with dense Ancient Runes, emanating an aura of Extreme Evil, appeared.
Level 35 Divine Monster—Asreaga.
But that was not all; in mid-air, the Mermaid Main God, holding a trident, tore through the void, her sharp gaze zeroing in on the Hell Lord like a hawk.
What had been a one-on-one duel just a breath ago had suddenly turned into Frey, Asreaga, and the Mermaid Main God encircling a single Hell Lord.
Viscount Bernard, who had felt assured of victory just a second ago, now looked pale as he watched Lide’s sudden reinforcements appear.
Shock filled his eyes.
"How is this possible? How could you, a Fake God, have so many powerful subordinates?! This can’t be happening!!"
Twelve Death Blazing Angels, Divine Monsters, the Mermaid Main God—who among them wasn’t extraordinarily strong?
Having one as a subordinate was already extremely rare, yet Lide had summoned three with a wave of his hand.
This was just too much; what happened to the agreed upon one-on-one duel??
And now, Hell Lord Perol’s expression had also become extremely grave.
In a one-on-one scenario, he was absolutely confident he could defeat or even kill a Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel.
But with two beings of the same level present, he would be overpowered, and might even have to pay a heavy price to escape.
And now, three beings of the same level had appeared... Instantly, a sense of death’s threat overwhelmed him.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 510: Lide Strikes, Killing the Hell Lord
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Chapter 510: Lide Strikes, Killing the Hell Lord
Viscount Bernard really wanted to curse his mother right now, all his suffering was written on his face, yet he couldn’t even cry.
What happened to the ambush? How did it suddenly turn into a counter-ambush?
All he could do was eagerly hope that the Hell Lord would take on three adversaries and complete the harvest...
Lide looked pleased with the current situation on the field.
To prevent any mishaps, he had used the Power of Destiny to mask the presence of the Mermaid Main God and Asreaga when they left Dawn City, preventing them from being discovered by the Hell Lord.
He had absorbed the power of five Destiny Tablet fragments, and the Power of Destiny within him was strong enough to connect to the River of Destiny.
Although he didn’t know where Hell Lord Perol had obtained a stone imbued with the Power of Destiny, Lide was sure that the other party did not possess the Power of Destiny.
That’s why the current scenario had unfolded.
While his thoughts churned, the situation on the field suddenly changed.
The 35-level Devil Lord Perol, surrounded by three adversaries, didn’t sit idly by. With two heads and four arms, he tightly gripped a longsword made from human finger bones, charging towards Frey with an unstoppable rage.
This movement was earth-shattering.
The space around him erupted and shattered under the energy emanating from his body.
The terrifying Divine Power surged without restraint at that moment, crushing dozens of Level 10 guards inside the building to the ground, who then bled from their ears and mouths, unable to get up.
Even Wales, a Transcendent Level Heart-eating Demon, broke out in cold sweat on his face and was almost unable to move.
The majesty of the Divine simply wasn’t something ordinary people could withstand.
However, the top-tier adversaries of the Hell Lord were unaffected by the intimidation and fiercely held their ground.
The first to make a move was Frey, who was targeted by the Hell Lord.
Twelve black wings unfurled, and her Angel Battle Sword was overwhelmingly powerful.
She slashed horizontally with a clang!
The Hell Lord held his swords with four arms and clashed directly with Frey.
In just a few breaths, the two exchanged dozens of sword strikes, and the surrounding space rippled like water.
Around them, the terrifying spatial turbulence swept across like sharp blades.
free\.c o(m)
The scene was immensely horrifying.
However, the standoff was quickly broken as Divine Monster Asreaga and the Mermaid Main God joined the fight.
Asreaga, being a Divine Monster, couldn’t use weapons, but his nearly blade-length claws could pierce through any defense weaker than Powerful Divine Power, even more terrifyingly lethal than a Divine Artifact.
The Mermaid Main God wielded a high-level Divine Artifact trident, each thrust accompanied by a blue divine light that made the stars flicker and space ripple.
What was an evenly matched scene quickly turned into three against one, with Hell Lord Perol on shaky ground under relentless assault.
The underground black market where this was taking place was completely obliterated as though struck by an eighteenth-level storm.
Buildings collapsed, rocks exploded, the scene resembled the end of the world.
By now, Lide had hidden himself in a corner. With four Medium Divine Power-level combatants clashing, he, a Level 30 Demigod, was not yet capable of intervening.
Stanley and the Food-devouring Demon Wales stood tightly by his side, as if still intent on ensuring his safety.
Lide watched with a hint of amusement but didn’t pay too much attention, his gaze fixed on the central battlefield.
