He didn’t know what Level of power the Magic Shield enveloping the black market was, but despite the four inside engaging in a massive battle that turned space into chaos, it surprisingly hadn’t broken the shield.
The Hell Lord was increasingly disheveled now, facing attacks from three adversaries of the same Level, the pressure almost constantly keeping him on edge.
It was only his extremely rich combat experience that prevented him from quickly bleeding to death.
Yet this made the 35-level Hell Lord even angrier. How esteemed was his status, and when had he ever been subjected to such indignity?!
"Bernard!! Go kill that Fake God!! I want him dead!!!"
After dodging the Divine Monster’s lethal claws once more, the Hell Lord snarled furiously through gritted teeth.
Today’s primary goal was to kill Lide, not to battle these terrifying beings.
As long as he achieved his objective, even if he couldn’t win, he could still escape by gritting his teeth and paying a certain price.
Hearing this, Viscount Bernard and the Eight-Armed Snake Demon Roy, who were dodging the aftershock of the battle by Lide’s side, immediately turned their gazes toward him.
The two sneered and charged at him with a cold murderous intent.
By this time, Viscount Bernard had reached the Demigod Level, and though the Eight-Armed Snake Demon was a bit inferior, his level was as high as 29, belonging to the very top tier of Legendary.
They had long estimated Lide’s level and deduced that his highest was only Demigod.
In a battle of equal levels, Viscount Bernard was absolutely confident that he could kill him on the spot.
If it weren’t for Frey’s protection, they wouldn’t even plan to call upon the Hell Lord.
Lide watched the two charging towards him, his expression subtle.
Really treating me like a pushover? Any Tom, Dick, or Harry dares to provoke me?
He waved his hand to make Frey and the Heart-eating Demon Wales, who were preparing to intercept, disperse; his aura surged instantly.
Ancestor Bloodline, activate.
Swish~
Wings sprouted on his back, and the true form of the handsomely extreme Bloodline appeared, with the crimson Power of Crimson bursting forth instantly.
Like Hell’s flames blazing fiercely.
His red eyes coldly stared at Viscount Bernard and the Eight-Armed Snake Demon, not backing down but instead moving forward with an unstoppable momentum to attack them.
At that moment, Bernard’s body suddenly swelled to three times his height, resembling a mini-giant, his terrifying muscles causing his tailcoat to burst open and revealing swathes of gray muscles.
Seeing Lide still daring to attack him, he immediately exploded with rage.
He forcefully exerted strength from his waist, concentrating all his power into his right fist, and then swung at Lide.
With a bloodthirsty and crazy smile on his face, it seemed as if he had already envisioned the scene of Lide exploding into a mist of blood with one punch.
Lide also swung his right fist, his Power of Crimson at this moment condensed to the extreme.
Simultaneously, he expended 500,000 Power of Faith to boost his own strength, which, after already partially incorporating the Silver Blood, soared once again tremendously.
As he passed, the space became blurry.
Under the watchful eyes of Frey and the Heart-eating Demon Wales, the two collided with the force of a meteor crashing.
Boom~
Terrifying energy pressed down, and the space around instantly exploded and shattered; the rocky ground a hundred feet below cracked like a spider web.
But what shocked people even more was that Viscount Bernard, who according to the scene should have overpowered Lide like a mini-giant in an absolute manner, suddenly cracked crisply, and his arm, three times thicker than an ordinary person’s thigh, burst explosively scattering into pieces.
Blood spattered, and limbs flew.
One strike severed an arm.
Lide’s eyes were cold to the extreme, he pursued relentlessly, not backing down; his bloody wings flapped in the back, speeding him up even further, throwing another punch at Viscount Bernard.
The terrible pain made Viscount Bernard’s face change drastically, and in a hasty defense, he could only meet Lide’s punch with his left fist.
But the next second, his left hand also exploded under the absolute violence of Lide’s attack.
In just a few breaths, the once unbeatable Viscount Bernard now had both arms severed, the situation suddenly took a drastic turn.
"Ah!!"
Visacont Bernard, in pain, wanted to retreat, but how could Lide, who held the initiative, possibly let him escape?
His momentum surged again, keeping up the speed; his terrifying power burst out like a tsunami, his right fist glowing with endless light.
He swung out.
Bang~
In midair, blood splattered as Viscount Bernard was violently shattered by Lide.
Even his limbs were twisted by the turbulent space around them, turning into a mist of blood, leaving no bones behind.
At that moment, the Eight-Armed Snake Demon Roy had just arrived at the battleground, and seeing this horrific scene, his soul almost fled his body.
But as he tried to escape, he saw a crimson figure swiftly moving towards him, like marrow into bones.
The Eight-Armed Snake Demon’s eight arms each wielded a longsword.
Seeing that he couldn’t escape, a touch of brutality flashed in his narrow eyes, and he slashed directly at Lide, his blade sharp enough to cleave through the void.
However, facing the grim longswords, Lide didn’t dodge at all, his gaze icy as he charged through the blades.
The Eight-Armed Snake Demon, overjoyed at the sight, thought Lide rashly offering himself up for death!
Without any hesitation, all eight longswords chopped down on Lide, instantly resulting in flesh and blood flying.
Unexpectedly to the Eight-Armed Snake Demon, although the longswords slashed into Lide’s body, there was a blunt feeling, as if cutting through cowhide with a dull blade.
Such incredible defense!
In shock, he saw Lide, who had taken the swords with his flesh, already close at hand, and the next second, a fist gleaming with crimson light flashed before his eyes, followed by a sharp pain in his head, then nothingness.
Puchi~
A headless corpse collapsed to the ground, the Eight-Armed Snake Demon’s longswords clattered scattered around.
Looking at Lide again, the scars from the slashes on his body were healing at a visible rate, disappearing in a few blinks of an eye.
Undying Body: The body will have no vital spots; even if the head is severed it can still regenerate and recover by consuming the Power of Bloodline, currently able to regenerate from fatal injuries up to—10 times, using internal blood to maintain the state for extended periods.
Within a few breaths, a Demigod of Level 30 and a top-notch Legendary of Level 29 both exploded dead.
Terrifyingly fierce.
And these two trash dared to fight him?
Lide’s gaze was cold.
Possessing the Bloodline of the Bloodline Ancestor, he was the king of the Bloodline, the sole sovereign; moreover, after becoming a Demigod, most of his Bloodline had transformed into the legendary silver blood.
Although these two individuals were not low in level, the gap in innate potential and Bloodline compared to his was vast.
Killing them was no different from slaughtering dogs.
Frey and Heart-eating Demon Wales were completely shocked by the scene, instantly taking down two people, an attitude of such a powerful being truly inspires awe and adoration.
They, fighting with those of the same level, couldn’t be sure of victory, how could such a scene where a son beats his father appear?
In the battlefield skies, the Hell Lord, held in check firmly by the three, seeing this became furious.
"Damn it! These idiots couldn’t even kill a pathetic vampire!!"
His tone infused with boundless rage, he swore that if those idiots weren’t already dead, he would personally reduce them to dust!
But just that moment of distraction, the Mermaid Main God seized the opportunity, her trident erupted with a dazzling brilliance, then the Hell Lord’s movements slowed as if he were in mud.
All being top-tier entities, sensing this rare chance, they immediately launched the most fierce attack.
Frey, wielding the Angel Battle Sword, quickly closed in on him.
Puchi~ The sharp edge of the sword pierced through the Hell Lord’s chest, blood spurting out in crimson, Frey’s power of death rapidly devouring the Hell Lord’s vitality.
The Divine Monster Asreaga’s sharp claws tore a gaping wound out of the back.
While other attacks, imbued with Extreme Evil energy, fiercely corroded the Hell Lord’s wounds, hindering his recovery.
Their coordinated assault inflicted severe injuries on the already burdened Hell Lord, his terrifying aura visibly diminished, his strength reduced by at least 20%.
In top-tier combat, a reduction in power could mean suppression, let alone a whole 20%!
In a fury, the Hell Lord emitted Hell’s malevolent power, forcibly countering the Mermaid Main God’s slowing effect with Divine Arts, also escaping the range of Asreaga and Frey’s assault.
But after he broke free, the situation did not improve but got even more out of control.
The trio fought with increasing ferocity, the Mermaid Main God wielding a trident and using various terrifying Divine Arts to hold off the Hell Lord, while Frey led the main attack, fiercely clashing with her opponent.
The Divine Monster Asreaga relied on his Extreme spatial abilities, moving through the chaotic spatial currents, becoming an extremely exaggerated and lethal assassin.
Support, warrior, assassin, three-in-one, they almost completely annihilated the Hell Lord.
He’s going to die, if this continues, he’s definitely going to die!!
The breathing of the Hell Lord grew heavier, his two-headed, four-armed Divine Body now covered in scars, his body increasingly weak.
Although he could withstand the three of them for so long, he couldn’t continue much longer.
However powerful he was, he was ultimately only Level 35, and under the joint attack of equal combat strength, he would still bleed!
This couldn’t go on any longer.
With determination in his heart, the Hell Lord roared skyward after the Divine Monster once again tore his body apart.
His terrifying two-headed, four-armed Divine Body surged, his strength skyrocketing crazily.
Level 36, 37, 38, until it stopped at Level 39, the terrifying Divine Power of the Hell Lord ceased.
Realizing this scene, the trio attacking him did not retreat; instead, they attacked even more frantically.
The Hell Lord, now temporarily elevated to Level 39, became extremely terrifying. Under the joint assault of the three, he fearlessly withstood their attack, even managing to make them continuously bleed.
In less than thirty seconds, the Divine Monster’s Divine Body had been torn twice.
Frey and the Mermaid Main God also sustained serious injuries.
Extremely frustrated and angry, the Hell Lord used his Bloodline Skills, initially thinking he could suppress the opponents, but he hadn’t expected these three formidable adversaries to not falter at all, instead, they restrained him completely.
Realizing his body’s strength was still declining, he roared helplessly and emitted an extremely terrifying shockwave from his body, booming~
The trio was pushed back by this energy, and at that moment, the shield enveloping the black market above finally shattered.
The Hell Lord breathed a sigh of relief, smashed the void in front of him with a punch, and stepped into it.
He had to run now; otherwise, he would truly fall here.
As long as he could return to Hell, he didn’t believe the three would dare to pursue him!
With the Lord of the Nine Prisons presiding over Hell, it was a place of despair that no one dared to invade!
At this moment, the Mermaid Main God and the others were still unable to stop the Hell Lord from stepping into the void.
But just then, a cold command came from below.
"Freeze!!!"
The Hell Lord, with half a foot about to step into the void at Level 35, suddenly felt an ancient aura abruptly awaken, then an ancient, desolate air crossed over from ancient times.
In that instant, he felt his body’s strength become utterly unresponsive, completely suppressed by that aura on the spot.
He even faintly felt the will of the world focusing on him at this moment.
His heart filled with horror at that moment, what kind of power was this?!! That it could mobilize the will of the world!!!
Seeing this scene, the Mermaid Main God and the others didn’t hesitate to explode with all their power, charging directly toward the Hell Lord in the void.
As the crisis approached, the Hell Lord couldn’t resist at all.
With a spurt~
The Mermaid Main God’s trident pierced through his heart from the back, with a zap~ Divine Monster Asreaga appeared, his sharp claws piercing directly from the top of the head, perforating both heads.
Frey swung her longsword, with a crack~ severing the Hell Lord’s spine, leaving a scar more than ten blades deep.
Level 35 Hell Devil Lord.
Dead.
Lide gazed at the scene in the sky, his expression relaxed, feeling the deficit in his body, his expression again mixed with astonishment.
Power of Destiny... so powerful.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 511: Dark Sovereign, Let’s Form an Alliance
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Chapter 511: Dark Sovereign, Let’s Form an Alliance
When Lide saw that the Hell Lord was about to escape successfully, his heart moved, and he directly mobilized all the Power of Destiny to block the other party.
He had not expected the power of the Power of Destiny to be so terrifying.
When he used the Power of Destiny, he could also mobilize the power of the entire Glory World.
Although the power of the world he could mobilize at his current level was very weak, it was still the entire world, no matter how weak!
That’s why a Level 35 Devil Lord was left in a daze right there!
This bought time for Frey and the other two to kill their opponent.
However, after he used this move, his Power of Destiny was completely drained, and based on the recovery speed, he was afraid it would take four to five hours to use it again.
"In other words, do I now have a binding-class Skill with a cooldown of four to five hours?
And the intensity of the binding is such that even Divine beings with Medium Divine Power cannot contend with it..."
Lide was all smiles.
It must be said, the Power of Destiny, as the most fundamental force of Glory, was indeed explosively powerful.
Previously, although his battle power was not weak, he was not able to participate directly in the battle of the gods.
But now that he had discovered the extra effects of the Power of Destiny, he no longer had to be a mere bystander, and could be a powerful support at critical moments, playing a decisive role.
He had gained a formidable weapon.
While Lide was in this excited state, the Divine Monster placed the corpse of the Hell Demon Lord in front of him.
"Father God, this is his Divine Status..."
Lide reached out to take it and, looking at the Divine Status emitting an evil aura, he shook his head slightly in regret and looked towards Stanley.
"Send someone to take this corpse and Divine Status back to Dawn City, and give it to the goblins to make the God Hunting Crossbow."
Normally, he would naturally distribute the Divine Status to his subordinates, but at this critical time, if they could not win this battle, they could only wait for death.
So the key was to enhance their fighting power as quickly as possible, and forging the God Hunting Crossbow was the fastest and most directly effective method.
Although it was a bit like killing the goose that laid the golden eggs, he no longer had time to wait for the goose to lay more eggs.
As long as they could survive, what could they not have in the future?
Stanley nodded respectfully, he would always follow Lide’s commands without question.
The Mermaid Main God, after seeing Stanley go down to call for people, regarded Lide with a thoughtful expression.
"Kachar Main God, I just sensed a special aura on this devil, it seemed to be a Divine Artifact.
But after we killed it, that aura vanished, as if it was taken away by some force in a way I cannot detect..."
Lide’s eyes narrowed, and a familiar Divine Artifact name surfaced in his mind...
"A special Divine Artifact aura? The Twelve Magic Scrolls?"
It seemed to be just as he had previously conjectured.
The true master of the Twelve Magic Scrolls, that terrifying Lord of Nine Prisons, was still secretly controlling the Twelve Magic Scrolls.
This was a frightfully dangerous existence that required extreme caution.
His keen intuition and the special perception he gained after controlling the Power of Destiny made Lide feel that the Twelve Magic Scrolls seemed extraordinarily important...
The Purgatory Scroll he had taken from the Black Dragon’s head was still suppressed in the Land of Bone-Burying, it seemed he needed to go back and retrieve this treasure.
"Lord Virginia, thank you for your reminder, I will make arrangements for this."
After thanking her, Lide did not continue on the subject.
The Twelve Magic Scrolls were very sensitive, sealing away the power of the Lord of Nine Prisons and a part of Hell’s power, and the Lord of Nine Prisons was the ceiling of Glory World’s battle power.
As the Life Goddess slept and the Death God did not appear, the presence of the Lord of Nine Prisons became increasingly conspicuous—no one wished to offend such a terrifying being.
A little ignorance is not necessarily a bad thing.
The mermaid, seeing this, slightly nodded her head and said no more.
When the Mermaid Main God left the side of the Hell Lord’s corpse, preparing to conceal her presence, Lide’s eyes shifted as he looked at the blurred flesh of the body.
He suddenly remembered the Undead, whose reputation was not much inferior to that of Hell; those beings that did not fear death seemed to have a hard time after the Ancient Invasion.
He was still carrying the ring given to him by the Dark Sovereign.
Lide stroked his chin, pondering in secret.
At this point in time, the pressure the Undead were under was hardly less than that of humans.
Although no Ancient beings had been reported to have invaded the Undead Plane as of yet, the sky rifts were growing larger, and the Ancient energy began to gnaw away at the undead aura, an indisputable fact.
The undead aura is an innate condition for the birth of the Undead; without sufficient undead energy, the corpses of ordinary beings, after death, cannot transform into the Undead.
Now, because of the Ancient Invasion, the undead aura of the Undead Plane was gradually dissipating.
This was an absolutely unacceptable situation for the Undead.
This was why the Undead had dispatched a large army to participate in the battle with the Angel Alliance...
After figuring out the key points, Lide’s gaze became more profound.
In this way, it was not impossible for the Undead to become his aid.
The current state of Dawn City, although not weak in power, had opponents like the remnants of the Angel Alliance, Hell, or the Abyss who were all stronger than him.
Not to mention the Ancient faction that wanted to destroy it all.
Co-opting some, uniting some, and suppressing others, this was the essence of political struggle, but it was also completely feasible in war.
Most crucially, he and the Dark Sovereign were genuine allies; they had already established a preliminary trust between them.
After seriously considering whether the plan in his mind was feasible, Lide gestured to stop the soldiers who were preparing to move the Hell Lord’s corpse.
"Stanley, there’s been a change. Take everyone out, move the corpse later..."
Stanley was startled, but he did not ask further and immediately complied.
"Yes, Your Highness."
He then immediately left with the Heart-eating Demon Wales and his subordinates.
After the crowd had evacuated, only Asreaga, Frey, and the Mermaid Main God remained by Lide’s side.
Lide pondered for a moment, his gaze falling on the few before him, "I will speak with the Undead Monarch about the core matters of the Destiny Tablet shortly.
Lord Virginia, I hope you can cooperate with me."
He wasn’t worried about the Divine Monster and Frey; he just feared that the Mermaid Main God might have some aversion to the Undead, which could spoil things later.
Asking her to leave was not an option either; he still needed the Mermaid Main God as a bargaining chip...
"Lord Kachar, you need not worry; the Sea Clan is a neutral faction and has little dislike for the Undead."
The Sea Clan controlled the seas, and most of the Undead were land-based and aerial troops; even if they wanted to attack the sea, they lacked the strength. Therefore, there was no enmity between them.
The words of the Mermaid Main God allowed Lide to let go of his concerns, and his right hand removed the ring that had always been on his left hand.
This ring was left to him by the Dark Sovereign when he borrowed his blade in the Underworld to slaughter the Half-body God and two Gray Dwarf Gods in exchange for more divine soul spirits.
By infusing power into the ring, he could summon the Dark Sovereign to come.
He had always considered the ring a trump card.
And indeed, a Level 40 Undead Monarch certainly deserved to be called a trump card.
Several breaths later, while the others watched, the ring in Lide’s hand emitted a gloomy glow, and the temperature in the air suddenly dropped.
Moreover, this coldness was not ordinary, but a chill that felt as though countless evil beings were watching them from the dark, ready to devour everything at any moment.
View the correct content at
The gray-white energy emanating from the ring condensed in the void and, after a moment, a magic mirror five blades tall and three blades wide appeared in front of Lide.
The surface of the mirror rippled like water.
When the ripples settled, an image of a terrifying being, wearing a golden crown, draped in a human-skin cloak, brandishing a White Bone Longsword, and exuding an aura as mighty as an ancient giant dragon, appeared in the magic mirror.
The Dark Sovereign.
Even across countless planes, they could still feel the frightening pressure emanating from the being.
Lide’s aura as the Dawn Main God had also been fully unleashed by this point, and together with the frenzied burning of Power of Faith, his presence was just as imposing as his opponent’s.
Behind him, the formidable presences of Divine Monster Asreaga, the Mermaid Main God, and the Twelve-winged Death Blazing Angel all unleashed their full power, their Divine Power surging tumultuously, immense as mountains collapsing.
The moment the two sides met, a silent clash ensued.
Lide took the initiative to speak with a smile, "Dark Sovereign, my friend, it has been a long time since we last met."
Hearing Lide’s familiar greeting, the Dark Sovereign wasn’t put off, having interacted with Lide a few times before, and had come to roughly understand what kind of person he was.
"A long time? To the Undead, it is but the blink of an eye..."
Lide’s mouth twitched at the Dark Sovereign’s remark, which he found incredibly annoying.
The lifespans of the Undead were nearly eternal, and to them, hundreds of thousands of years were but moments...
Compared to other races with lifespans of mere decades or centuries, this was downright overbearing.
Fortunately, the Bloodline wasn’t a race with a short lifespan... Lide felt quite relieved about this.
After the Dark Sovereign finished speaking, the Soul Fire flickered in his hollow eyes, as at that moment he had seen the three terrifying beings behind Lide.
"Divine Monster...
Fallen Angel...
Mermaid holding a high-level Sea Clan Divine Artifact..."
The somewhat hollow words of the Dark Sovereign carried a hint of rare surprise.
Clearly, the appearance of Asreaga and the others was beyond his expectations; after all, beings like Divine Monsters were not weak presences, each capable of drawing attention.
"Dawn Main God, it seems you have gained quite a bit recently..."
The last time he saw Lide, he had been alone, a bare commander, but now, after not much time, he had gathered such a formidable force around him.
The Dark Sovereign felt a touch of envy in his heart. Although the Undead were numerous, they actually lacked high-level combat power, nowhere near as many divines as the human divine race.
Lide smiled.
"These are but some ordinary subordinates, still falling short compared to the fifteen monarchs of the Undead Plane."
The Dark Sovereign’s Soul Fire paused for a breath, speechlessly observing Lide.
What do you mean by ’just ordinary subordinates’? Were Divine Monsters ordinary, or was it the Twelve-winged Fallen Angels that had become ordinary? If they are so ordinary, why don’t you hand them over to me? I wouldn’t mind...
And you alone want to compare with the entire Undead Plane? If you were stronger than all of us, then the Undead Plane would be of no concern.
"Dawn Main God, did you summon me this time because you have a matter to discuss?"
Feeling a bit weary at heart, the Dark Sovereign had no desire to waste words with this fellow and went straight to the point.
"I still have to deal with the Ancient Invasion; there’s not much time for idle talk..."
Hearing this, Lide stopped beating around the bush and his expression turned serious as he gravely said,
"Dark Sovereign, I wanted to meet with you to discuss our united resistance against the Ancient Invasion."
Resisting the Ancient Invasion together??
The Dark Sovereign was startled, and then somewhat puzzled.
"Resisting the Ancient Invasion together??" He had never considered such a thing before.
After all, who would dare to discuss alliances and cooperation with the Undead.
Lide nodded as if it were a matter of course.
"The Ancient Invasion is a crisis facing the entire Multiverse of Glory World.
Since we have a common enemy, and this enemy is powerful enough to instill fear in us, even putting forth all our effort might not guarantee victory, then why can’t we cooperate?"
The Dark Sovereign slowly nodded, acknowledging this statement.
"Then how do you plan to cooperate with the Undead?" he asked.
Lide said in a deep voice,
"I know the Undead must have their own plans and strategies. It will be difficult to cooperate with outsiders willingly before the emergence of the core of the Destiny Tablet.
Moreover, you must be quite confident in your ability to contest for the core of the Destiny Tablet.
So this time our cooperation will not be like usual, but in a unique way."
The Dark Sovereign perked up at this.
The Undead Plane possessed formidable power; they certainly had their own plans, so cooperating with the outside world was not essential.
If Lide actually proposed something like mixing our forces together to snatch the core of the Destiny Tablet, he would mercilessly refuse.
The Undead were not naive enough to trust outsiders with major decisions that could determine fate.
"Dawn Main God, you may speak."
Lide looked steadily into the Dark Sovereign’s hollow eyes with a penetrating gaze.
"The struggle for the core of the Destiny Tablet will undoubtedly encounter a war far more terrifying than the Angel Alliance.
Whoever captures the core of the Destiny Tablet will inevitably face a siege from the others.
But our enemy is not each other; it is the Ancient camp.
Thus, I propose that the Divine of Dawn align with the Undead to form an offensive and defensive alliance, each relying on their own abilities when contesting for the core of the Destiny Tablet.
However, if either of our sides captures the core, then the other side will not contest it further and will protect the possessor.
And the one who obtains the core of the Destiny Tablet will have to pledge to cooperate unconditionally in the future if the other side needs to use the core."
This proposal was undoubtedly creative, starting as enemies but then turning into allies...
View the correct content at
The Dark Sovereign’s eyes flickered, surprised by the proposal, and found this method of cooperation not unacceptable.
After pondering for a while, he said slowly,
"Dawn Main God, the strength you’ve shown now has won my respect but to form an alliance with the Undead Plane, your strength is not sufficient yet..."
The Undead Plane had fifteen monarchs, while Lide appeared to only have four people on his side at most; the overall strength was far inferior to that of the Undead Plane.
He could recognize Lide, but the Undead Plane would not.
Lide seemed to have anticipated this, and with a mysterious smile, he brought up the strongest support from Dawn City.
"Our strength is not enough? No, it is the Undead’s strength that is not enough!!"
These words made the Dark Sovereign’s Soul Fire jump, just about to get angry, but Lide’s next words caused his Soul Fire to surge.
"The Divine of Dawn, has the Goddess of Fate presiding over it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 512: Earth’s Space Shattered, Ancient Monster Appears
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Chapter 512: Earth’s Space Shattered, Ancient Monster Appears
Dawn Divine Power had the Goddess of Fate presiding over it?! When the Dark Sovereign heard Lide’s words, his Soul Fire trembled.
But he soon reacted, questioning with doubt.
"Dawn Main God, Glory does not have a Goddess of Fate, you don’t need to deceive me!!"
The Destiny Tablet was created by the Creator God to replace the Goddess of Fate.
Others may not know these secrets, but as Undead who have lived so long, what didn’t they know?
Lide looked directly at the Dark Sovereign, his tone solemn.
"Deception? No, Dark Sovereign, if you hadn’t become the Undead Monarch, you would not be entitled to know this message.
Do you know who originally guarded the Destiny Tablet?"
The Dark Sovereign immediately hesitated.
The theft of the Destiny Tablet by the Ancient Evil God was well known, but since it was stolen, there must have been someone guarding it...
But this message was unknown to all other Undead Monarchs...
He immediately perked up, hesitating to ask.
"Dawn Main God, do you mean to say that the Main Plane of Glory really birthed the Goddess of Fate?
Was the Destiny Tablet previously in the hands of the Goddess of Fate? But why have we never sensed the existence of Destiny?"
After his words fell, the empty sockets of his eyes stared intently at Lide.
Correct content is on
Because his next words would directly determine the future course of the situation in Glory.
Unexpectedly, Lide shook his head to deny it.
"No, Glory has never birthed a Goddess of Fate."
"Dawn Main God, I cannot understand your words, then why did you say that the Dawn Divine Power has the Goddess of Fate presiding..."
Dark Sovereign got a bit confused by Lide. Since there was no Goddess of Fate birthed, where did the presiding Goddess of Fate come from?
Lide smiled slightly.
"Glory never birthed a Goddess of Fate, but does that mean other multi-dimensional Planes won’t give rise to one?"
That statement caused the Dark Sovereign’s Soul Fire to flare up, like fuel dumped on a fire.
Divine Power surged wildly, the surrounding space seeming to congeal at that moment.
"Other multi-dimensional Planes?!!"
His usually ethereal tone carried a rare excitement.
"Dawn Main God, do you have contacts with other multi-dimensional Planes?"
Lide smiled slightly, neither denying nor confirming, continuing the previous topic.
"The goddess of Fate who joined the Dawn Divine Power followed the Creator God to Glory.
She even personally participated in the Creation!
After Creation was completed, the Creator God entrusted her with the responsibility of guarding the Destiny Tablet.
It was only after the Destiny Tablet was stolen by the Ancient Evil God that she reappeared in the world."
"With such a figure presiding over the Dawn Divine Power, do you think they are any less than the Undead?"
The Dark Sovereign fell silent.
If what Lide said was true, then even if the Undead Plane had fifteen monarchs, it wasn’t something to boast about...
The Goddess of Fate, a higher existence than life and death, no need for any further words, just this Divine Title is enough to represent everything.
After pondering for a long time, he slowly said, "I need to verify if the information you’ve provided is true..."
This was related to the future situation; he couldn’t just agree based on Lide’s mere words.
Lide nodded.
"If that’s the case, then let us discuss the alliance again tomorrow at noon. I hope the other fourteen monarchs will also be present.
And the Goddess of Fate of the Dawn Divine Power will also appear on time."
Aligning with the Undead was too significant a matter, it was not something to be decided with a few words; everyone had their own schemes, and not so easily changed.
Moreover, this plan was only a spur-of-the-moment idea, and he had yet to communicate it with Casslynna.
With that, the two had their own thoughts and there was nothing more to say.
After Lide and the Dark Sovereign agreed on the specific time, Lide dismissed the Magic Mirror.
Sensing the disappearance of the Dark Sovereign’s presence, the previously silent Mermaid Main God now curiously asked.
"Kachar Main God, does Her Highness Philomis really want to cooperate with the Undead?"
Philomis was Casslynna’s former name, and the Sea Clan always referred to her that way.
In the eyes of the Mermaid Main God, Casslynna was the Ancestor of the Sea Clan, having once controlled the Power of Destiny, her status was supremely honored.
Aligning with the Undead was too demeaning.
Lide smiled wryly upon hearing this; you didn’t know the daily pain Casslynna endured.
The entire world, countless lives are cursing her, such torment isn’t something simple words can describe!
If you were her, not just aligning with the Undead, but even allying with pigmen would be exhilarating if it could relieve the pain...
The Undead represented a power capable of changing the situation; forming an alliance with these beings was more beneficial than harmful.
And the terms he proposed absolutely aligned with the interests of Dawn City; he held in his hand no less than seven fragments of the Destiny Tablet, occupying a quarter, he didn’t believe the Undead had more...
"Your Excellency Virginia, please return to Dawn City and inform Her Highness Philomis of today’s relevant news; she will naturally make a decision.
Feel free to also bring back the Divine Body of the Hell Lord."
The Mermaid Main God nodded slowly in response, no longer asking questions.
The Sea Clan was a neutral race; whom Lide allied with did not concern her, as long as it benefited the greater situation.
—
—
—
Lide, who was planning an alliance with the Undead, was unaware that Earth was in turmoil.
For the gaps in the sky had widened again, with the Ancient Energy almost condensing into mist!
But that wasn’t the main issue. The main issue was that space fissures appeared within the territories of the United States, Great Eagle Country, Neon Country, Northern Fur Bear, and Huaxia. Through these space fissures, the Ancient Monsters of Glory could directly invade Earth...
The moment this news was released, it immediately exploded public opinion, causing a global uproar.
The sky fissures had already brought immense exaggerated pressure to the whole human society, and now the pressure soared to the Extreme.
Those were the Ancient Monsters capable of destroying everything! When seen in Glory, one might treat it as a game, but now they appeared at everyone’s doorstep! Who could remain calm?
In an instant, various nations immediately began emergency mobilization: the military took over cities and public security, controlled stations, and regulated the media; the atmosphere changed abruptly.
Fortunately, the space fissure that appeared in Huaxia was not in a populated area but on a vast, sparsely populated prairie.
Mengnei Prairie, beside a small village unnamed in map navigation, over the lush grassland, within a kilometer radius, space rippled like water.
From afar, looking down, one could clearly see another world with scorched earth existing within this space.
In that world, countless swollen, decaying monsters roamed around, where they passed, the vitality faded, leaving only emptiness and silence...
Among them, some monsters were particularly sensitive to space and, sensing an unfamiliar presence nearby, they tore through the fragile space like ripping paper and brazenly appeared on Earth.
These ancient monsters were distorted, without a standard shape, the only commonality being the decaying and chaotic power they carried.
Once they appeared in this lush grassland area, the surrounding grass immediately turned yellow.
The plants began to rapidly wither and turn yellow...
The first to discover the ancient monsters on Huaxia territory were a group of herders, whose cattle and sheep were startled by the ancient monsters, wildly fleeing in all directions.
To identify the main cause, several people banded together to investigate.
At a distance, on a small hill, they saw that the number of ancient monsters had already reached the hundreds of thousands.
The scene was extremely horrifying.
Moreover, once the monsters gathered in considerable numbers, they began to disperse in all directions.
The herders were terribly frightened and immediately reported to the authorities.
This message immediately caught the high-level attention of the officials.
Within minutes, the authenticity of the message was confirmed by the satellites in the sky.
When satellite images captured those nauseating ancient monsters, it immediately caused a huge uproar.
A red alert was sounded.
By this time, several towns and villages had already been attacked by the ancient monsters. Due to the advanced network, within just ten minutes, the entire Huaxia, and even the whole world, knew about the spatial rift on the Huaxia Prairie.
The military stationed nearby was now moving at top speed, with helicopters and drones immediately taking off towards the site of the incident.
At the same time, the official media broadcasted to everyone that within a hundred kilometers of the area where the ancient monsters appeared, all people were to evacuate.
Although the outbreak was sudden, the orderly response by the officials did not lead to much chaos.
By the third hour of the ancient monsters’ appearance.
Tens of thousands of troops reached the battlefield.
Simultaneously, the population within hundreds of kilometers started evacuating outward.
The official media did not keep this incident confidential but instead started a live broadcast through drones almost immediately.
This was humanity’s first close and real-time view of these terrifying ancient monsters.
The decision to live broadcast by the officials caused a huge sensation in a short time.
Many were puzzled by why the message was made public; wouldn’t it have been better to handle the situation secretly? Could this not cause panic and even social unrest?
But by dusk, when the military began firing from their positions, most people understood why Huaxia dared to live broadcast.
Incalculable shells fell like rain from the sky.
The view from the drone broadcasting at several kilometers in altitude showed fireworks exploding brilliantly.
The long-tailed shells howled in the air before crashing onto the ground, then instantly raised huge flames, directly shredding those ancient monsters with shockwaves or burning them to death with high temperatures.
This was truly a ground bombardment with bombs, exponentially more intense than Dawn City’s alchemy bombs.
Since its founding, Huaxia had suffered from insufficient firepower, so artillery was always a priority in military development.
Decades later, during this invasion of ancient monsters on Earth, Huaxia finally showcased the fruits its compelled military advancements due to its phobia of inadequate firepower.
In the core area where the ancient monsters had descended, the fireworks did not cease for a full half-hour...
Numerous netizens were also experiencing such a scene for the first time and were exhilarated to find that the army protecting them had become so powerful.
The confidence of the Huaxia officials to broadcast live was overwhelmingly strong.
The Ancient Monsters that had initially scattered around did not survive long, as they were quickly found and eliminated one by one by the army’s carpet search.
Most of these Ancient Monsters were Level 10, and many were even Level 15, possessing physical qualities far superior to ordinary humans.
However, under the attack of modern thermal weapons, they were no more than bubbles.
These bloodthirsty monsters, when faced with personal weapons more terrifying than Barrett sniper rifles, simply met their ends with a shot to the head.
If the Ancient Monsters had possessed intelligence, they might have caused a significant impact on the army, but fortunately, the Ancient Monsters only knew slaughter and destruction.
When a country’s interior is intact, the power it can wield is truly astonishing.
The space rift that appeared in Huaxia was controlled within an extremely short period of time.
It was even estimated that from the spread of the Ancient Monsters to when the situation was controlled, the entire process took no more than 6 hours, and the casualties were merely around a hundred residents of nearby villages from when the spread first began...
In the face of such a world-ending disaster, to have only this number of casualties was already a miracle.
In contrast, other countries with space rifts were not so fortunate.
The space rift in the United States opened near New York, a country that used Hollywood to export its values to the world and always ended with the United States saving the world—now, it indeed had the task of saving the world...
Over fifty to sixty space rifts, each two to three hundred meters long, were scattered around New York; Ancient Monsters surged out like a tide.
Among them, not to mention Level 15 Ancient Monsters, there were even Transcendent beings.
Once reaching the Transcendent level, they were no longer ordinary life forms.
Even heavy artillery firing at them couldn’t be fatal; only intense bombing could eliminate those Transcendents.
And because the Space Gates were too dispersed, the United States military couldn’t mobilize in time, leading to large numbers of Ancient Monsters eroding the surrounding cities.
The situation, within just a few hours, felt almost out of control.
Suddenly, the entire United States was plunged into fear.
In the Great Eagle Country, this once never-setting empire was in an even more tragic state; due to national power decay, the army’s number had already dropped to an all-time low.
When the Space Gates shattered, the entire country had to rely on ordinary law enforcement officers armed with guns to go to the battlefield.
Heavy artillery bombardment didn’t arrive until the next day... But by then, the Ancient Monsters had already swelled to millions, becoming a horrific calamity of world-ending proportions.
To completely annihilate them, a dreadfully heavy price would have to be paid.
The most violent response to the Ancient Monsters came from the Northern Fur Bear, a country with underdeveloped everything except an exaggerated military power, which launched the most insane offensive in an extremely short amount of time.
The newly appeared Ancient Monsters were bombarded to nothingness.
Even their supreme leader had signed an order to use nuclear weapons at any time.
Truly imperious.
Among the countries where space rifts appeared, the most tragic was arguably Neon Country.
The space rift opened directly in their most bustling Tokyo, where upon encountering crowds, the Ancient Monsters completely lost control.
In just seven or eight hours, half of Tokyo fell, with millions of people dying instantly, the scene was tragic.
By the time their self-defense forces arrived, the Ancient Monsters had already spread, making it impossible to exterminate them with simple artillery fire.
Because among the Ancient Monsters were also a large number of humans, if they used artillery, it was feared that the humans who would die would be several times the number of Ancient Monsters.
Unable to cope with the crisis, Neon Country began seeking help everywhere... but sadly, at this point in time, no one cared to respond.
Not even their "father" the United States reacted, instead, they redeployed their aircraft carriers back to their homeland; at this time, they simply couldn’t care for this "son" anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 513: Resurrection of the Ancestor of the Undead
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: Chapter 513: Resurrection of the Ancestor of the Undead
February 29, at dawn, Lide met the approaching Lady Kaslina inside the Crimson Mage Tower.
This terrifying Goddess of Fate, as always, wore a thin long dress and was barefoot with snow-white soles, still holding that pure white kitten—The Cat and Joy Goddess.
Upon seeing Lide, Lady Kaslina’s expression barely changed, as she calmly gazed at him.
"Was allying with the Undead a spontaneous decision you made?"
Lide nodded slightly, "Yes, uniting all uniteable forces to confront a common enemy is the thought of a great person, which is enough to benefit us for a lifetime..."
Lady Kaslina arched an eyebrow. The thought of a great person?
"Do you know the origin of the Undead?"
Lide looked at her curiously.
"Lady Kaslina, don’t say that the Undead were also something you brought from another multi-universe..."
"No, the Undead were the first batch of life created by the Creator God, who originally intended to use them as a template for creating life, but due to some defects, it was not widely implemented..."
Lady Kaslina shook her head, revealing some ancient secrets that had long been lost.
"The first Undead created by the Creator God is still sleeping in the Undead Plane, endowed with great affection by the Creator God, its power almost comparable to the Lord of Nine Prisons."
Listening, Lide’s mouth twitched, why was everyone’s background so frightening?
He then thought of something, and curiously asked.
"Are you acquainted with that sleeping Undead?"
"Part of its life source was extracted from me..."
Lide looked at Lady Kaslina, both shocked and delighted.
"So does that mean we can have a powerful ally?"
He deeply felt that bringing Lady Kaslina back from the Lost Sea was the right choice, simply the most praiseworthy thing he had ever done.
This big golden leg truly has an incalculably valuable golden shine.
"We still can’t be sure, it has been sleeping for too long, and I’m not confident in awakening it..."
However, Lady Kaslina did not give Lide a definitive answer.
"But I will personally handle this matter, there’s no more time for it to continue sleeping, the future is full of fog..."
Looking at Lady Kaslina’s cold face, Lide paused slightly, feeling somewhat moved.
"Lady Kaslina, you’re not doing this just to break the curse brought by the Power of Destiny, are you?"
Lady Kaslina looked deeply at him and slowly said,
"The Creator God is no longer here to take me to the next multi-dimensional plane..."
Lide fell silent.
Last time Lady Kaslina’s world was destroyed, the Creator God brought her to Glory, but if Glory were destroyed, where could she go?
The current Lady Kaslina, although still unfathomable, was far from being able to create a multi-dimensional plane like the Creator God.
If she had that power, she wouldn’t need to be hiding in the shadows, directly tackling the old rulers would be splendid...
Moreover, finding an unknown multi-dimensional plane in the endless Chaos Void was no easier than recreating a universe.
"Don’t worry, as long as Dawn City remains unshattered, as long as I’m still breathing, this world will not be destroyed!"
Lady Kaslina, looking at the determined Lide, suddenly showed a slight smile on her cold face.
"A 30th-level Demigod, and your confidence is even bigger than mine..."
After saying this, she took another deep look at him.
"But though you are weak, I indeed see hope in you, and I hope that you won’t disappoint me..."
Lide wanted to say something more, but Lady Kaslina gestured with her hand.
"Summon the Undead, perhaps, it’s time to meet that old friend who has slept for countless ages..."
"Was that sleep a command from the Creator God?"
"No," he lay in a slumber due to the lack of essential life properties, wanting to use the prolonged time to rectify the shortcomings left in him by the Creator God."
Lide was speechless. Such high-end secrets were beyond him, and he could only listen.
At that moment, he no longer dwelled on it excessively and took the Dark Sovereign’s ring back into his hand, beginning to input power into it.
Moments later, the ring erupted with a burst of dark light shining straight into the mid-air.
Soon after, the familiar Magic Mirror appeared.
This time, however, the Magic Mirror expanded over tenfold, occupying half the room.
Like ripples on water, the surface of the Magic Mirror wavered and gradually revealed the scene on the other side.
It was a majestic palace constructed of skulls, and within the palace stood fifteen crowned Undead Monarchs in a U-shape.
As these Undead Monarchs appeared in the Magic Mirror, Lide only felt a terrifying extreme Divine pressure sweeping over.
It was like an ordinary person standing under a mountain of blades, looking up, while at this moment, the mountain was collapsing.
That almost irresistible force surged violently, overwhelming everything in its path.
Upon seeing Lide and Lady Kaslina, every one of the fifteen Undead Monarchs subconsciously turned their gazes towards Lady Kaslina while only the Dark Sovereign acknowledged him with a nod.
These Undead knew their trade; Lady Kaslina’s appearance instilled a shiver in their hearts.
The blue flames in the skulls jumped, igniting high like gasoline had been poured.
"Respected Majesty, we sense a special aura on you, resembling our Ancestor of the Undead..."
Slowly the central Undead Monarch spoke up, its hollow eyes burning ever more visibly with Soul Fire.
Lady Kaslina’s expression remained indifferent; then, under Lide’s watchful eyes, she took a step that seemed to cross thousands of worlds and traverse the Star River universe.
In the blink of an eye, Lady Kaslina appeared directly inside the Undead Hall constructed from white bones.
Just as Lide was about to say something, he was horrified to discover that, unknowingly, he had also arrived in this deep hall of bones with Lady Kaslina.
What a marvel!
And now he was to face the Divine Might of the fifteen Undead Monarchs directly.
Instantly, he felt his bones crackling, the surging Divinity so exaggerated and terrifying.
The gap between level 30 and 40 was like that between gods and toddlers, not even beings of the same dimension.
Yet, despite this, Lide still maintained a cold glare, looking directly at these top-tier beings.
The Power of Faith within him was being consumed wildly at this moment, emitting Divinity that was just as formidable.
Negotiation was a zero-sum game; though Lady Kaslina was present, he could not afford to show any sign of weakness.
"I had once known your Ancestor..."
Lady Kaslina seemed imperturbable, even if the skies were to collapse.
Cold and indifferent.
At this, the fifteen Undead Monarchs were shaken.
Because under their watchful eyes, Lady Kaslina had appeared in the Undead Hall as if nothing had happened, and they couldn’t even detect how she got there.
This inadvertent action pressed a terrifying burden on them.
Correct content is on
"This Majesty, do you really hold the Divine Position of Destiny?"
The central Undead Monarch continued to question, initially skeptical of the Dark Sovereign’s words, a vampire’s Divine ranking with the Goddess of Fate from another dimensional Plane presiding? Could this be a joke??
But now, there was no doubt in his heart.
Even if she wasn’t the Goddess of Fate, the figure before them was an entity immensely powerful.
"Divine Position of Destiny?" Lady Kaslina slowly shook her head, "I abandoned it many years ago..."
All the Undead Monarchs’ Soul Fires paused at once.
Abandoned for many years??
The implications were profound.
"Then you..."
The Undead Monarch wanted to say something, but Lady Kaslina did not give him the chance.
"No need for more words, these matters, your Ancestor will inform you of them.
I am now going to awaken the sleeping Ancestor of the Undead."
These words startled the fifteen Undead Monarchs.
"The Ancestor has long since merged with the Undead Plane, can you still awaken him?"
They did not know how many times they had tried to communicate with the Ancestor of the Undead, but it seemed he had completely integrated into the Undead Plane, so they were filled with surprise upon hearing this.
Lady Kaslina did not respond to this question; she slowly stroked the cat in her arms then waved her hand, and the Cat and Joy Goddess floated up, directly inserted into Lide’s arms.
The next second, the thinly veiled hybrid mermaid, like a goddess of love and beauty descending into the world, gently floated in mid-air, her body emitting a dazzling azure glow.
The radiance was stunning.
The next second.
A trident of the Mermaid Main God suddenly appeared in Lady Kaslina’s hand.
The moment she grasped the trident, the aura around Lady Kaslina instantly shifted from calm to furious, like the unpredictable vast sea.
The pressure emanating from her body was like a tremendous flood submerging everything, akin to a world-ending calamity.
Then, under the gaze of more than ten Undead Monarchs, her divine power surged around like a violent storm.
At this moment, Lady Kaslina, for the first time, displayed her strength as the Goddess of Fate.
The might of the fifteen Undead Monarchs before her was simply childlike and weak...
An ancient aura that crossed through the ages flowed from her, awe-inspiring to behold.
That vast divine might soon enveloped the entire Undead Plane.
Countless sleeping undead were awakened, most of their Soul Fires trembling weakly.
Originally there were Undead Monarchs who boldly wanted to stop Lady Kaslina, since this was the core city of the Undead.
But faced with such terrifying disturbances, they immediately extinguished that thought and could only silently watch the situation unfold.
They could sense the terrifying power contained within Lady Kaslina’s body; this was no longer an existence that a level 40 Main God could touch!
Amidst the overwhelming divine might, Lady Kaslina’s presence climbed to a peak, and then she uttered an Ancient language that no one had ever heard.
"The ancient world has perished.
The once shattered old days are now returning.
The Creator has departed, his Glory should be inherited.
Awake...
Awake..."
Although no one could understand these words, everyone grasped their meaning.
A necessary characteristic of a high-level language—listeners automatically understand its implications.
And in Lady Kaslina’s call, the trident in her hand seemed to come alive, with countless Sea Clan carvings forming phantoms, one by one, one after another, began traveling above the Chaos Void.
Thousands of blade-long whales flew in the sky, hundreds of blade-long crabs tumbled within the bones...
This scene appeared profoundly mysterious and carried a terrifying horror.
As everyone waited almost holding their breath.
The chants recited in unknown divine language echoed over and over again in the Undead Plane.
After a very long time, there was still no response in the sky.
Lide wore a somewhat solemn expression, had the call failed?
His gaze turned to Lady Kaslina floating in midair, "The Ancestor of the Undead... failed to awaken?"
As he spoke, all the Undead Monarchs looked toward Lady Kaslina, their eyes filled with tension.
In that moment, Lady Kaslina, as imposing as a hellish divine presence, lightly said.
"No, he is awakening, a million years of slumber requires some time to gather strength..."
Lide stopped speaking upon hearing this and then silently waited.
However, this time the wait was extraordinarily long: ten minutes, twenty minutes... Finally, after three Sunshine Hours, something different began to happen.
Lide could now clearly sense that the undead aura around him was converging in a certain direction, as if drawn by a great vortex.
If he had observed at that moment, he would have seen that the entire Undead Plane’s undead aura was rushing toward an unremarkable grave in the central area.
Moreover, the speed was accelerating, as if a black hole was swallowing all this power.
It was hard to imagine what kind of existence could devour the undead aura of nearly half the Plane in one gulp...
After the surrounding undead aura became increasingly thin, suddenly fluctuations appeared at the scene.
In front of the Mermaid Main God, a space shattered abruptly.
Then, under everyone’s eager gaze, an ordinary skeleton stepped out.
Yes, just an ordinary humanoid skeleton, which even appeared quite frail with an especially small skeletal frame.
However, the moment this frail skeleton appeared in the Undead Hall, all fifteen Undead Monarchs kneeled on one knee simultaneously, their Soul Fires burning furiously.
"Welcome back, Ancestor of the Undead!!"
Lide’s pupils suddenly constricted. The Ancestor of the Undead...
Until now, he had not sensed any aura from the other party; if the other did not actually appear before his eyes, he could not even confirm that there was a living entity there...
Yet, he possessed the Power of Destiny... this Ancestor was too terrifying!
Upon seeing a trace of joy in his eyes, Lady Kaslina looked at his frail body and shook her head.
"Millions of years of slumber, and you still haven’t solved the problem with your body..."
The skeleton voiced ethereally.
"This is a flaw of my origin, only solvable with time. Now, I’ve improved a lot compared to before the slumber."
Lady Kaslina was somewhat surprised.
"I didn’t expect the method you thought of back then would actually work."
Then she felt a bit regretful.
"It’s a pity there’s no more time for you to continue your slumber."
The skeleton’s Soul Fire flickered slightly.
"I sensed the power of the old days... Has it, resurrected?"
"Yes, the ruler of the old days has reconstituted its Divine Body, and after stealing the Destiny Tablet, crushed it with the Time Gear."
Hearing this, the skeleton fell silent.
After a moment, he slowly shook his head.
"My power is far from perfect; I cannot face it..."
"No, you don’t need to deal with it, we have someone who will..." Lady Kaslina’s tone grew solemn.
"Someone will take charge?" the skeleton’s Soul Fire brightened, "Is the Lord of Nine Prisons willing to make a move??"
Lady Kaslina shook her head, "It only wants to hide within Hell, even planning to claim a share of the spoils after the world is destroyed..."
The skeleton couldn’t help but look disappointed.
"Apart from the Lord of Nine Prisons, who else is capable of bearing such a heavy responsibility? The Life Goddess and Death God? No, they fall far short..."
Lady Kaslina’s expression softened, then she turned to look behind her.
The skeleton was taken aback, his gaze following Lady Kaslina’s, and then his Soul Fire surged even higher.
"I sense a different kind of aura in him..."
Lady Kaslina gave a slight nod.
"He is the one who can contend with the ruler of the old days..."
Lide: ????

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 514: Return to Earth
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: Chapter 514: Return to Earth
"He," "is the one who could contend against the Ancient Ruler..."
When Lide heard these words from Kaslina, his expression turned very strange.
Since when did I have that kind of power?
Though full of doubt, he still restrained himself from asking outright.
The Ancestor of the Undead seemed thoughtful as he glanced at Lide, nodded his head, and surprisingly did not utter a word in dispute.
Then the Ancestor of the Undead turned his head as if to discuss some secret matters with Kaslina, both of them directly silencing their voices.
As they spoke, the Ancestor of the Undead kept turning to look at Lide, flames of soul burning in his eye sockets, always giving off the impression that he had other plans in mind.
It wasn’t until half a "Sunshine Hour" later that Kaslina lifted the sound barrier, her cold gaze sweeping over the room, then she spoke in a voice everyone could hear.
"Dawn City will form an alliance with the Undead as of today.
When the Destiny Tablet’s core emerges in Green City, we will each use our abilities to contend for it.
Once one side obtains the core of the Destiny Tablet, the other side must defend the one that acquired the core."
The slight figure of the Ancestor of the Undead also slowly nodded at this time.
"This pact is hereby signed, all Undead must comply!
Remember, we now have a common enemy, our goal is to stop the Ancient Invasion, not for the so-called Destiny Tablet!"
The fifteen Undead Monarchs did not dare utter an extra word and could only nod in agreement.
"We shall follow your command, Ancestor."
Not only were they descendants of the Ancestor of the Undead, but the soul pressure emitted by the Ancestor was also too terrifying to defy.
Seeing this, Kaslina did not linger further. She turned her thinly clad body slightly, then took a step and, in the next moment, appeared directly inside the Crimson Mage Tower.
Lide only felt a blur before his eyes, and the hallway of the first floor of the Crimson Mage Tower appeared before him, with no sensation of how he had returned, just like when he had entered the Undead Plane.
The Magic Mirror, which had just occupied half of the house, had also vanished, leaving only a faint trace of Magic Fluctuation echoing in the air.
Meow~
Sensing that the danger was gone, the white cat in Lide’s arms immediately leaped out, jumping into Kaslina’s arms, then turned to give him a resentful glare.
The cat looked adorably fierce.
Lide did not pay attention to the little wild cat, his gaze fixed intently on Kaslina.
"Lady Kaslina, what did you discuss with the Ancestor of the Undead just now? Can you tell me?"
Kaslina calmly glanced at him.
"There are things that are better off not known by you..."
Lide quickly understood; the two of them were most likely discussing how to deal with the Ancient Ruler, and the opponent’s plans were probably sky-high, making it difficult for him to intervene right now.
Not pursuing the matter further, he changed the subject.
"Just now you said I could confront the Ancient Ruler... may I know how I should prepare?"
Kaslina’s eyes narrowed, her tone laden with meaning.
"When the time comes, you will know.
Trust me, aside from your subordinates, I am the person in this world who least wishes to see you in harm’s way."
Carrying the weight of a curse for tens of millions of years was an unimaginable agony; at this moment, Kaslina saw a glimmer of hope for its lifting, and the turmoil within her was naturally beyond others’ comprehension.
Lide nodded, "In that case, I will immediately pass on the message of Dawn City forming an alliance with the Undead to my subordinates, to prevent any mishaps."
After a moment’s hesitation, he asked,
"Are you now able to predict when the Destiny Tablet Core will emerge?"
"The power of destiny from the Destiny Tablet Core has not dissipated, so no one can know its location and the time of its appearance in advance...
But I have a premonition that it will be soon, very soon the Great Cataclysm will occur, we just need to wait calmly..."
Lide silently nodded his head without speaking again.
After seeing that he had nothing more to say, Lady Kaslina did not stay too long in the Crimson Mage Tower. After advising caution against the Ancient Rulers, she stepped forward and vanished without a trace.
Looking at the quieted down Mage Tower, Lide breathed a sigh of relief.
Summoning Lady Kaslina to negotiate with the Undead had, without a doubt, been the right move.
He had not only gained the Undead as powerful allies, but he had also awakened the terrifying existence known as the Ancestor of the Undead.
Now, with the entire world facing destruction, there was only one common enemy for everyone—the Ancient Rulers.
The Ancestor of the Undead was clearly on the same side as him now. By that logic, strengthening our forces was equivalent to weakening theirs.
Whether it be the Undead or Demons, Loren welcomed all formidable entities.
One more person meant additional strength.
Even if these malevolent beings did not want to unite, the terrifying pressure from the Ancient’s camp would force everyone to fight.
"Lord Lide, Lord Lide!!"
A frantic shouting suddenly came from outside the Mage Tower, startling Lide from his contemplation.
"Come in."
The person outside hurried in with quick steps upon hearing the voice.
A young man garbed in a mid-level mage’s robe breathed a sigh of relief upon seeing Lide, and quickly spoke.
"Lord Lide, an urgent report from the Crimson Moon states that the sky of the Lost Plane has shattered, and the Ancient Monsters have now emerged..."
The sky of Earth has been shattered??
Lide’s heart jolted as his gaze pierced the young man reporting to him like a knife.
"Explain in more detail."
Although most of his thoughts were concentrated on Glory, Earth was still the place that nourished him, he could not possibly abandon it.
"Yes, my lord." Seemingly intimidated by Lide’s stern look, the young mage took several breaths to calm his internal panic.
View the correct content at
"President Yue of the Crimson Moon says that the shattered sky is above the prairies of the Lost Plane, where a large number of Ancient Monsters have appeared.
However, the army of the Lost Plane is very powerful and has managed to control the situation for now.
Only Ancient Monsters of the Extraordinary Level can cause disturbances.
President Yue also said that the army of the Lost Plane has paid a visit to the Crimson Moon, and if you have time, they hope you can make a trip..."
After hearing this, Lide’s tense eyebrows relaxed slightly.
Fortunately, it wasn’t a scenario where the skies across the whole world cracked and the Ancient Monsters scattered out.
In such a case, even if the army were incredibly powerful, it’s feared that 95% of the population would perish...
"Alright, I will handle this matter.
You go and inform Vina that I will be in seclusion for a day, and if there’s an emergency, they can wake me."
"Yes, Lord Lide."
After the young mage left, Lide, without much hesitation, turned and went back to his bedroom, lying down and immediately falling into a deep sleep.
Earth.
Lying in bed, Lide suddenly opened his eyes, then sat up and picked up the cell phone charging by his bedside to check it.
He first entered the official website of Glory.
At this moment, most of the posts in the forum were about the discussions on the appearance of Ancient Monsters on Earth.
"Oh my goodness, I live only 200 kilometers away from where the Ancient Monster appeared, should I run now?"
"Do you think Earth’s Ancient Monsters can provide me with Experience? Logically speaking, if Glory does, Earth should too..."
"Is anyone forming a team to go to the grasslands and hunt monsters to level up? Time waits for no one!"
"Is it really going to be the end of the world? I don’t want to die; is there any big shot who can take me in?"
"Awesome, the dense artillery bombardment on those Ancient Monsters is just so thrilling, unless a Divine being appears, there’s no way any Ancient Monster could break through the encirclement"
"..."
After reading around the forum, Lide found that most people were not as frightened by the Ancient Monsters’ invasion as he had imagined.
Curious, he then followed a player’s post link to the official live broadcast channel.
BOOM BOOM BOOM~
The sound of artillery fire instantly transmitted out.
Lide focused his attention on the screen, where countless artillery shells explosively detonated at that moment.
Even though the drones were filming from thousands of meters in the sky, they could still clearly capture the scene of bombs carpeting the ground below.
In the live broadcast, Ancient Monsters were continuously appearing out of the void.
These monsters were extremely ferocious, not only bloodthirsty and murderous but also full of a decaying power that was nauseating.
However, although there was a large number of Ancient Monsters, as soon as they reached a certain density, they would immediately face a barrage of artillery fire.
Self-propelled howitzers, rocket launchers, mortars, anti-aircraft guns, heavy artillery, tank main guns... over twenty artillery positions could bombard any area at 360 degrees with no blind spots.
Those fearsome Ancient Monsters had virtually no chance to resist in front of modern weaponry, either being torn apart by the blast wave from the bombs or melted by the high temperatures, with only a small number managing to survive by fluke.
Yet, these surviving Ancient Monsters still had to face multiple layers of barriers from the military forces that had already locked down the area.
The military had long set up heavy machine guns waiting for them.
The terrifying configurations of firepower on the battlefield were extreme, with the muzzles of various sizes being too numerous to count at a glance.
When the warriors pulled the trigger, flames spewed out, and anything within range was immediately annihilated by the metal storm.
Lide even saw in the live broadcast an Extraordinary Level Ancient Monster, after breaking through the bomb’s barrage, being torn to shreds alive by a heavy machine gun more fierce than a Gatling.
The military’s combat strength at this moment could be described as off the charts.
The sky rift had appeared early, giving each country enough time to prepare.
Once the national machinery was fully geared up for war, how terrifying could the scene be? It was probably beyond anyone’s imagination...
The modern industrial military factory, which was far more advanced and on a much larger scale than that of Dawn City, had already been producing various weapons and equipment non-stop, day and night.
The consumption on the grasslands, in the eyes of a perfected military-industrial system, was like a light drizzle, which could easily be met even if it was ten or even twenty times more.
Watching this, Lide was also filled with surging emotions.
Bomb carpeting, this was the real charm of industry.
The industrial system of Dawn City was still a good distance from Earth’s.
However, after seeing this scene in the live broadcast, he settled down as well.
With Huaxia’s strong crisis response capabilities, there wouldn’t be too much of a problem unless the sky completely shattered, and Ancient Monsters were everywhere.
Moments later, Lide seemed to remember something and, with a touch of curiosity, searched for the fates of other countries invaded by the Ancient Monsters.
After a glance, his expression turned odd.
The bears to the north were the strongest, even more fierce than Huaxia. At the moment, they were discussing whether or not to send their army into Glory. Big Ivan had prepared dozens, ready to launch at any moment...
The United States, on the other hand, dispatched a powerful military force to eliminate the Ancient Monsters scattered near New York.
Since the Space Gates near New York were too dispersed, it was extremely difficult to clean up. Moreover, many Ancient Monsters had already breached into the city, causing massive panic.
The Great Eagle Country fared even worse. Several cities had already fallen. If not for the aid of other European Union countries, the situation might have already been beyond salvage.
The island nation, Neon Country, was the most tragic of all. Tokyo, its most bustling metropolis, had already been two-thirds destroyed by the Ancient Monsters.
Although Neon Country’s self-defense forces had begun encircling and annihilating the Ancient Monsters, the overwhelming number and complicated terrain meant their efforts were pitifully ineffective.
In an instant, the whole country plunged into turmoil because of the fall of one city.
Lide was not too affected by these countries’ plights. After checking the messages, he had a clear understanding.
He flipped open the phone book and dialed Zhao Yue’s number.
"Mr. Li, you sure are a rare visitor. Is it that you only show up when Earth isn’t on the brink of destruction?"
Hearing Zhao Yue’s slightly plaintive tone, Lide couldn’t help but smile.
"I only just got the news that Earth has changed, and as you know, the situation in Glory is more important than Earth’s."
If the Ancient faction achieved victory, how much longer could Earth survive?
Those dreadful Ancient Monsters certainly had the capability to devour the entire planet.
Zhao Yue’s tone also softened upon hearing this.
"I understand. We only sent someone to notify you because it’s a serious matter—the officials have sent someone..."
Lide’s eyes narrowed, somewhat surprised.
"What did the officials say?"
Crimson Moon was now undoubtedly the top player guild, leveraging the advantage of the players’ main city, commanding over a million members.
And all of them were at the top tier of power, terrifyingly strong.
Perhaps no one cared about Crimson Moon in the past, but after the arrival of the Ancient Monsters on Earth, it immediately gained attention.
"The envoy from the officials didn’t give us a hard time, they just wanted a promise from us."
"A promise?"
"Yes, they hope that when Huaxia is in danger, Crimson Moon can help."
Lide felt a touch moved by this, "What did you say?"
Zhao Yue spoke softly, "When the country is in peril, we must stand up and fight. The sons and daughters of Yan and Huang have never been cowards!"
Lide laughed out loud.
"That’s exactly what I wanted to hear! What is home without a country?!"
"Mr. Li, the official also wants to meet with you. It seems they have other matters; can you arrange some time?"
"Hmm, it’s already 4 PM, let’s set it for 8 tonight. I’ll head to the office right now."
After hanging up the phone, Lide briefly freshened up and headed straight out the door.
Meanwhile, he was also curious about what the official wanted with him...

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 515: The Determination of Huaxia Official
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Chapter 515: The Determination of Huaxia Official
Crimson Moon.
Although he was the biggest boss of the company, Lide spent so little time at the company that he was even less familiar with it than some new employees who had been there for only half a month to a month.
Fortunately, thanks to his nearly perfect looks, his popularity within the company was consistent, and there were few who didn’t recognize him.
"Good afternoon, Mr. Li, Mr. Zhao has been waiting for you in the office."
Cheng Lu, the assistant with a bit of baby fat, had been waiting for Lide at the entrance since early morning.
"Have the officials arrived?"
"Not yet, no, I should say they just left. Mr. Zhao has already arranged a meeting with them at eight o’clock on your behalf."
Lide asked as he walked into the company.
"Do you know their purpose?"
Cheng Lu shook her head, "I’m not sure, Mr. Zhao is fully in charge of this matter, and I was not involved in their discussions."
Lide nodded slightly and said no more.
At the same time, he pondered the purpose of the officials’ visit.
According to his guess, it was most likely related to the situation with Glory or the fragments of the Destiny Tablet.
After all, Crimson Moon was undoubtedly the leading guild among the players, with immense influence.
Upon entering the company, most employees were somewhat surprised to see Lide, as seeing him at the company was a rare occurrence.
They hurriedly greeted him.
After he left, there was a significant buzz, the male employees were just envious of Lide’s looks.
The female employees, however, were practically popping their eyes out—wasn’t he just too handsome?
A few new girls were so excited after Lide left that they grabbed their colleagues’ hands, exclaiming that coming to work at Crimson Moon was not in vain.
If they could catch the boss, they were even willing to diet...
Vice President’s Office.
Lide entered the room with Cheng Lu, and Zhao Yue, who had been waiting, immediately turned around upon hearing the noise. Upon seeing Lide’s nearly perfect face, her eyes lit up.
No matter how many times she had seen him, Lide always made her feel like she couldn’t get enough.
After all, who wouldn’t want to interact with someone of outstanding ability, a wealthy background, and extremely good looks?
"Good afternoon, Mr. Li."
Lide nodded, exchanged a few pleasantries, and then, without further ado, sat on the sofa.
After Cheng Lu and Zhao Yue had taken their seats, he spoke softly.
"What is the official’s attitude toward us? What do they want us to do?"
Since they had come knocking, it was impossible that they were just merely reminding Crimson Moon to step in during a crisis; there certainly was another motive.
But Zhao Yue’s next words surprised him.
"The officials seem to have realized your true identity within Glory, so they haven’t given a clear stance, but they appear very friendly for now."
Realized his identity within Glory?
That was not simple.
Although he had rarely hidden anything in Glory lately—after all, things had reached this stage, and there was no need to disguise anymore.
To link the identity of the boss of Crimson Moon, Lord Ilo, with something completely unrelated like this required quite a bit of information.
It seemed that the anomalies on Earth truly pressured the officials, forcing them to exert much effort on Green City.
He never doubted the power of the national machinery; once resources were invested in something, the force it could unleash was not to be underestimated by anyone.
At this moment, Cheng Lu was a bit puzzled, "Mr. Li, do you have an important identity in Glory?"
Lide smiled and turned to look at Zhao Yue, "It’s not any particularly important identity..."
Cheng Lu had just responded with an "oh," but his next statement had the girl’s eyes widening in disbelief.
"Lord IIo of Green City is me..."
"Lord... Lord IIo of Green City?!!!"
Cheng Lu’s voice became shrill due to his surprise.
"The number one ranked Divine Spirit on the Glory forum?
The most handsome god ranked number one on the beauty list?!!!"
Her tone was filled with shock and awe.
At that moment, the girl felt as if the world had gone mad...
She had drooled over screenshots of Lord IIo countless times... But upon taking a close look at Lide’s face, she realized, of course, how could there be many such handsome men...
After a moment, as if something struck her, she abruptly turned her head to look at Zhao Yue.
Cheng Lu remembered that Zhao Yue had collected thousands of screenshots of Lord IIo, and hid them well; the last time she thought they were from some movie.
Zhao Yue, catching Cheng Lu’s look, seemed to remember those screenshots too, blushed slightly, and glared at the person who had rummaged through her computer, then signaled with her eyes not to speak out of turn.
Lide was dumbfounded; he hadn’t expected Lord IIo to have so many identities...
"If there isn’t a second Lord IIo, then it must be me."
He didn’t dwell on this issue, "Now that they know my identity, they probably won’t entertain any inappropriate thoughts toward the Crimson Moon.
After all, the rift in the sky has already shattered..."
Zhao Yue nodded in agreement.
If it were a normal day, some people within Huaxia Official might still have ulterior motives.
But after the break in space, any such thoughts would be curtailed, for no one knew when Glory might completely merge with Earth.
Now, to become enemies with a Divine Spirit, especially one controlling a vast force, would be a major issue if space truly shattered.
Unless they could kill or control Lide directly, everything else was moot.
