But the current problem was, the larger the crack in the sky, the closer the Earth players’ levels were to those in Glory; no one could predict at what level Lide, the Divine in Glory, would be in terms of combat power.
After pondering for a while, Zhao Yue hesitantly asked, "How should we negotiate with the Official?"
Lide’s gaze sharpened, his tone solemn, "Mr. Zhao, you need not overthink this, as a descendant of Huaxia, I would never betray my country!"
After these words, a thoughtful expression crossed his face.
"Even at this critical juncture, we might even get Official support..."
Glory was about to face its final battle, and he needed to unite all possible forces against the formidable enemy.
He had already allied with the Undead; why not bring the Official into Dawn City’s camp to fight against the terrifying Ancient Monsters?
Perhaps, in terms of high-end power, the players still couldn’t match the Ancient camp.
But now, with the main force of players nearly at Level 15, they were undeniably a formidable force.
With proper use, they could play a significant role.
And what force had more authority to mobilize the players than the Official?
Though the Crimson Moon was strong, it was nothing compared to the influence of the Huaxia Official.
Hearing this, Zhao Yue’s expression visibly relaxed; after all, no one wanted to be at odds with their own country.
"Mr. Li, your magnanimity is admirable."
Lide smiled without continuing on this topic, changing the subject.
"How is the current situation with the Crimson Moon?"
"The Crimson Moon has fully entered a wartime state. The main city is firmly under our control; just give the order, Mr. Li, and over two million players will immediately go to battle.
Additionally, the Data Analysis Department of the Crimson Moon has already integrated with the information command center of Dawn City, all our data will be synced there in real time."
Zhao Yue spoke about this topic confidently and in high spirits.
"As for Earth, the Crimson Moon Base we are currently constructing has completed its first phase without sparing any expense, and the second phase is under construction.
The safety defense of the base is extremely high; its most crucial underground shelter can withstand a large-scale nuclear explosion aboveground without being damaged.
Currently, 30% of the staff have moved in, and we can relocate the entire Crimson Moon there at any time..."
Lide, upon hearing this, was quite satisfied.
Crimson Moon could now control two million players, a force already comparable to Dawn City’s army.
Even more, due to the higher levels of the players, the overall combat strength was stronger than that of Dawn City’s army.
He had spent billions building the base on Earth; the purpose was to prevent a sudden fusion and collision with Glory, like an asteroid hitting Earth, which would create a huge shockwave that destroyed everything.
At the same time, solid defense facilities could also prevent the sudden appearance of Ancient Monsters.
On Earth, his strength had only just touched Transcendent, and he needed some protection while he was asleep.
"Prepare a room for me inside the base, and after I’ve touched base with the officials, I’ll move in."
The Crimson Base, which could not even be destroyed by a nuclear bomb, was the true headquarters; even if a crisis really occurred, he would have enough time to react.
After all, he couldn’t be sure whether Earth’s body was completely disentangled from Glory, and if Earth’s body was destroyed, it could have dire consequences for Glory.
According to Maslow’s hierarchy of needs, survival and safety are the most basic needs.
In times of peace, people hardy feel these needs, nor do they have strong sensations; but when the apocalypse comes, safety needs will overpower everything else.
If life itself is lost, then all else is empty talk.
"It’s already prepared," Zhao Yue smiled. "It’s in the most central area."
View the correct content at
Cheng Lu nodded, "Yes, Mr. Zhao’s room is right next to yours..."
Zhao Yue’s face stiffened, then he glared at the talkative one with a slight blush on his face, explaining,
"For the convenience of discussions, I have arranged all core management in one area..."
Lide waved it off, amused, "It doesn’t matter, anywhere will do. Have your families moved in yet?"
He hadn’t built the base for himself alone; he was a lone figure and didn’t need such a large space.
The extra areas would be allocated for use by company members, and currently, as long as there was space available, official employees of Crimson Moon could bring their families to live in.
"My parents are packing up now, and they’ll move in tomorrow. Other employees who need it have already filed reports, and the base should be full within three days..."
"Okay, handle it, and within one month, the conflict in Glory will have results."
Lide did not elaborate further.
The focus was still on Glory; without securing the Destiny Tablet core, even the strongest defense facilities built on Earth could not prevent the erosion from the Ancient camp.
And although the current army was defeating the invading Ancient Monsters, if the Ancient camp launched a full-scale invasion, Earth definitely wouldn’t last long.
Earth was strong in firearms, clueless about Magic... Those powerful Ancient Evil Gods could kill an entire city with one Spirit Shock, without even needing to destroy mechanical armor...
Lide then discussed with Zhao Yue how Crimson Moon could assist him in preparing for the upcoming war.
It was 7:40 PM when a staff member at the door notified them that the official personnel had entered the meeting room, interrupting their discussion.
Lide and Zhao Yue exchanged glances, then stood up together and headed straight to the meeting room.
Walking through the company, Lide noticed that not many employees had left work.
Due to the appearance of Ancient Monsters on Earth, the pressure on most people these last few days had been great, leading many to voluntarily work overtime.
They had all heard about the base and wanted to perform well, to secure some benefits for their families.
Arriving at the office, Cheng Lu first pushed open the door, and seeing this, Lide stepped inside.
Upon entering, he immediately noticed three officials with gentle demeanors but sharp eyes, two gentlemen and a lady.
From their attitudes, it seemed the middle-aged lady who sat in the center was the decision maker.
Upon seeing Lide, all three stood up in unison and proactively shook his hand.
"Mr. Li, hello, my name is Ai Linsong, I am the head of the Shanghai Security Bureau, and I am pleased to meet you."
Lide shook hands briefly with the woman in her early forties and released it quickly, smiling faintly.
"Ms. Ai, hello."
After shaking hands with two other gentlemen for a short while, both parties took their seats.
Lide was the first to ask a question.
"Ms. Ai, Mr. Zhao from my company mentioned that you had something important to discuss with me, may I know what it is that warrants such formality?"
Hearing his straightforward words, Ms. Ai’s eyes narrowed slightly, then she turned to look at Cheng Lu beside her.
Lide understood immediately, gave a signal with his eyes to Cheng Lu, who promptly said he would go to pour some water, then turned and left, casually closing the door behind him.
Seeing this, Ms. Ai hesitated no more and spoke softly.
"Mr. Li, I apologize for visiting you only now, but the situation is urgent, we had to come...
Your role is too crucial, it might even determine the fate of the future world."
Having been forewarned by Zhao Yue, Lide was not surprised, and he looked at her with interest.
"How so?"
Ms. Ai’s expression grew more serious.
"Mr. Li, your affiliation with Lord Ilo was known to us a month ago.
Of course, you need not worry, the government views you with great positivity.
This is a great thing for us, after all, Huaxia needs outstanding individuals like you to defend it."
Lide nodded slowly.
"Ms. Ai, Huaxia has never undertaken the inhumane actions like those in the West when faced with significant peril; fighting for Huaxia is our duty."
He then looked intently at her.
"I understand your concerns. The Ancient Invasion is an irreversible process; only by reassembling the Destiny Tablet can we combat the Ancient Invasion.
The core of the Destiny Tablet, which is crucial for gathering the fragments of the Destiny Tablet, is about to emerge.
You must be more aware of the news of the emergence of the core of the Destiny Tablet than I am..."
Ms. Ai looked deeply at Lide.
"So, I am here by order to ask if you have confidence in capturing the core of the Destiny Tablet? This relates to the fate of the entire Earth and the survival of Huaxia."
"If you are confident, then we will support you with all our might, even if it means utilizing military orders to coordinate all players..."
Lide was deeply moved, a brilliant light shining in his eyes.
He now realized that he had underestimated the extent of the government’s commitment.
In the face of major issues, Huaxia indeed never disappointed.
After pondering for a moment, he nodded solemnly.
"With the government’s full support, I am sixty percent confident..."
Ms. Ai’s eyes revealed an undisguised excitement.
"Really that high?"
Lide nodded. "In my faction, there resides a Goddess of Fate from another Dimension Plane..."
Hiss~
Ms. Ai and the two people beside her exchanged looks, their faces filled with indescribable shock.
At the same time, they were immensely excited.
They had spent a month using countless resources to investigate Lide, only visiting once they were sure he was trustworthy, but his initial response gave them such a tremendous surprise.
At this moment, they seemed to see hope...
